source.en: AMLO (Cap. 615) Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.9段

en.q: Under the AMLO, "money laundering" is defined as an act intended to have what effect?
options: Making proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be, or represent, such proceeds
Providing or collecting property intending or knowing it will be used to commit a terrorist act
Disposing of cash proceeds from crime into the financial system as the first laundering stage
Splitting a large transaction into smaller transactions to avoid reporting duties
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, s.1 of the AMLO defines ML as an act intended to make property that is (or represents) the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be such proceeds. The other options describe the statutory definition of terrorist financing, the placement stage of laundering, and structuring to evade reporting — none of which is the statutory definition of ML itself.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「洗錢」一詞指出於達致何種效果的意圖的行為？
options: 使屬可公訴罪行的收益（或代表該等收益）的財產，看似並非該等收益
懷有意圖或知道財產將用於作出恐怖主義行為而提供或籌集財產
把來自非法活動的現金得益存放並注入金融體系，屬洗錢首個階段
將一宗大額交易拆細為多宗小額交易，以規避申報或盡職審查的責任
tc.explain: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條將「洗錢」界定為：意圖使屬可公訴罪行收益（或代表該等收益）的財產看似並非該等收益的行為。其餘選項分別描述「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義、洗錢過程中的「存放」階段，以及規避申報的拆細交易手法，均非「洗錢」的法定定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10段

en.q: Which of the following correctly lists the three common stages of money laundering, in order?
options: Placement → layering → integration
Integration → placement → layering
Placement → smurfing → conversion
Collection → transfer → withdrawal
en.explain: The Guideline (¶1.10) identifies three common stages: placement (disposal of cash proceeds into the financial system), layering (complex transactions to disguise the source) and integration (creating apparent legitimacy for the funds).

tc.q: 下列哪項正確依次列出洗錢的3個常見階段？
options: 存放 → 分層交易 → 整合
整合 → 存放 → 分層交易
存放 → 拆細 → 兌換
籌集 → 轉移 → 提取
tc.explain: 指引第1.10段指出洗錢有3個常見階段：存放（把非法活動的現金得益注入金融體系）、分層交易（以複雜多層交易隱藏款項來源）及整合（為犯罪得來的財富製造表面合法性）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(b)段

en.q: In the money laundering process, "layering" refers to which of the following?
options: Separating illicit proceeds from their source through complex transaction layers
Disposing of cash proceeds derived from illegal activities into the financial system
Creating the impression of apparent legitimacy for criminally derived wealth after layering succeeds
Keeping all criminal proceeds as physical cash so they never enter the financial system at all
en.explain: Layering separates illicit proceeds from their source through complex layers of financial transactions designed to disguise the source and subvert the audit trail (¶1.10(b)). Disposing cash into the financial system is placement (¶1.10(a)); creating apparent legitimacy after layering succeeds is integration (¶1.10(c)); keeping proceeds entirely as cash describes neither stage.

tc.q: 在洗錢過程中，「分層交易」是指下列哪項？
options: 透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益與來源分開
處置來自非法活動的現金得益，並注入金融體系
在分層交易成功後，為犯罪得來的財富製造表面的合法性
將犯罪得益全數保存為現金，使其完全不進入金融體系
tc.explain: 分層交易指透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益及其來源分開，從而隱藏款項來源及掩飾審計線索（第1.10(b)段）。把現金注入金融體系是「存放」（第1.10(a)段）；在分層交易成功後製造表面合法性是「整合」（第1.10(c)段）；將得益全數保存為現金並非任何一個階段的描述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(a)段

en.q: A drug trafficker brings a large amount of street cash to a money changer and converts it into another currency, moving it into the financial system for the first time. This best illustrates which stage of money laundering?
options: Placement
Layering
Integration
Refinancing
en.explain: Placement is the disposal of cash proceeds derived from illegal activities into the financial system (¶1.10(a)) — the first entry of dirty cash. Layering and integration come later; “refinancing” is not a stage of ML.

tc.q: 一名毒販攜帶大量現金到找換店兌換成另一貨幣，令該筆款項首次進入金融體系。這最能說明洗錢的哪個階段？
options: 存放
分層交易
整合
再融資
tc.explain: 「存放」指處置來自非法活動的現金得益並注入金融體系（第1.10(a)段），即黑錢首次進入金融體系。分層交易及整合屬較後階段；「再融資」並非洗錢階段。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.11段

en.q: Which statement about the statutory definition of "terrorist financing" is CORRECT?
options: Providing or collecting property intended or known for use in terrorism, even if never used
It only covers property that has actually been used to commit one or more terrorist acts
It only covers property that directly or indirectly represents proceeds of an indictable offence
It only covers cross-border transfers made on behalf of a terrorist or terrorist associate
en.explain: TF under Sch. 1 includes providing or collecting property intending or knowing it will be used for a terrorist act — whether or not the property is actually so used. TF property need not represent proceeds of crime (even indirectly), no terrorist act need actually occur, and the definition is not confined to cross-border transfers.

tc.q: 關於「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義，下列哪項正確？
options: 懷有意圖或知悉財產用於恐怖主義行為而提供或籌集，即使未使用
只涵蓋已被實際用於作出一項或多於一項恐怖主義行為的財產
只涵蓋直接或間接代表可公訴罪行得益的財產
只涵蓋代表恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者而作出的跨境資金轉帳
tc.explain: 根據附表1，恐怖分子資金籌集包括懷有意圖或知悉財產將用於作出恐怖主義行為而提供或籌集財產——不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用。有關財產無須直接或間接代表犯罪得益，亦無須有恐怖主義行為實際發生，定義亦不限於跨境資金轉帳。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: What is the key difference between money laundering (ML) and terrorist financing (TF)?
options: ML looks at the source of property; TF looks at its destination or use
TF focuses on the source of the property, while ML focuses only on its destination or use
Both ML and TF necessarily involve property that is derived from criminal conduct
ML is investigated by the JFIU, while TF is investigated only by the FATF
en.explain: Per ¶6.1, ML is concerned with the source of property; TF's focus is the destination or use of property, which may derive from legitimate sources. The reversed pairing, the false claim that both always involve criminal proceeds, and the invented JFIU/FATF investigative split are all incorrect — the FATF does not investigate individual cases (¶1.13).

tc.q: 洗錢與恐怖分子資金籌集的主要分別是甚麼？
options: 洗錢著重財產來源；恐怖分子資金籌集則著重財產終點或用途，用途可以合法
恐怖分子資金籌集著重財產來源，洗錢則只著重財產的終點或用途
洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集所涉財產均必然源自犯罪活動
洗錢由聯合財富情報組調查，恐怖分子資金籌集則一律由財務行動特別組織調查
tc.explain: 根據第6.1段，洗錢著重財產來源；恐怖分子資金籌集的重心則在於財產的終點或用途，而有關財產可以是從合法來源取得的。相反的配對、聲稱兩者財產必然源自犯罪活動，以及聯合財富情報組／財務行動特別組織的調查分工說法，均屬錯誤——特別組織並不負責調查個別案件（第1.13段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: Which of the following best describes the Financial Action Task Force (FATF)?
options: An inter-governmental body that sets international AML/CFT standards
A United Nations agency empowered to impose financial sanctions on member states
The Hong Kong regulatory authority responsible for licensing money service operators
An international criminal court that investigates and prosecutes money laundering offences
en.explain: The FATF, formed in 1989, is an inter-governmental body that sets standards (the FATF Recommendations) for combating ML, TF and PF, and monitors compliance through evaluations of jurisdictions (¶1.13). It is not a UN sanctions agency, a licensing regulator, or a court.

tc.q: 下列哪項最能描述財務行動特別組織（FATF）？
options: 制訂打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集標準的跨政府組織
一個獲授權對成員國施加金融制裁的聯合國機構
負責向金錢服務經營者發牌的香港監管機構
一個調查及檢控洗錢罪行的國際刑事法院
tc.explain: 特別組織於1989年成立，是跨政府組織，制訂打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的標準（特別組織建議），並透過評核監察各司法管轄區的合規情況（第1.13段）。它並非聯合國制裁機構、發牌監管機構或法院。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: As a member of the FATF, Hong Kong is obliged to do which of the following?
options: Implement the latest FATF Recommendations
Undergo a FATF evaluation every year
Follow FATF Recommendations selectively
Publish its own list of high-risk jurisdictions
en.explain: As a FATF member, Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations (¶1.13), in full and on an ongoing basis — not selectively. No fixed annual evaluation cycle is stated, and it is the FATF itself, not Hong Kong, that identifies and publishes high-risk jurisdictions.

tc.q: 作為財務行動特別組織的成員，香港有責任做以下哪項？
options: 實施最新的特別組織建議
每年接受特別組織評核
有選擇性地跟從特別組織建議
自行公布高風險司法管轄區名單
tc.explain: 作為特別組織成員，香港有責任全面並持續實施最新的特別組織建議（第1.13段），而非選擇性跟從。條文並無訂明固定的每年評核周期，而識別及公布高風險司法管轄區是特別組織（而非香港）的職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: Which of the following pieces of legislation is one of the six main Hong Kong ordinances concerned with ML, TF, PF and financial sanctions identified in the Guideline?
options: United Nations Sanctions Ordinance
Securities and Futures Ordinance
Business Registration Ordinance
Insurance Companies Ordinance (Cap. 615)
en.explain: ¶1.14 identifies six main pieces of Hong Kong legislation concerned with ML, TF, PF and financial sanctions: the AMLO, DTROP, OSCO, UNATMO, UNSO and WMD(CPS)O. The Securities and Futures Ordinance, Business Registration Ordinance and Insurance Companies Ordinance are real Hong Kong ordinances, but none of them is among that list.

tc.q: 下列哪項法例是指引所指香港六條主要涉及洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集及金融制裁的條例之一？
options: 《聯合國制裁條例》
《證券及期貨條例》
《商業登記條例》
《保險公司條例》（第615章）
tc.explain: 第1.14段指出，香港六條主要涉及洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集及金融制裁的條例為：《打擊洗錢條例》、《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《聯合國制裁條例》及《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》。《證券及期貨條例》、《商業登記條例》及《保險公司條例》均為真實的香港條例，但都不在上述六條之列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20段

en.q: Which of the following is a function of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (OSCO)?
options: An offence of money laundering for proceeds of indictable offences
Establishing the licensing regime for money service operators
Imposing customer due diligence requirements on financial institutions
Implementing United Nations sanctions against places outside the PRC
en.explain: The OSCO, among other things, creates an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences, and gives investigation and confiscation powers (¶1.20). Licensing and CDD are AMLO functions; UN sanctions are implemented under the UNSO.

tc.q: 下列哪項是《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》的功能？
options: 來自可公訴罪行的得益增訂一項洗錢罪行
設立金錢服務經營者發牌制度
對金融機構施加客戶盡職審查規定
實施聯合國對中華人民共和國以外地方制裁
tc.explain: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》其中一項功能是增訂一項有關來自可公訴罪行得益的洗錢罪行，並賦予調查及沒收得益的權力（第1.20段）。發牌制度及盡職審查規定屬《打擊洗錢條例》的功能；聯合國制裁則根據《聯合國制裁條例》實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21段

en.q: Besides the mandatory elements of the relevant UNSCRs, what else does the UNATMO implement?
options: The more pressing elements of the FATF Recommendations related to TF
All FATF Recommendations relating to money laundering and proliferation financing
Decisions of the International Criminal Court concerning terrorism financing
Extradition treaties between Hong Kong and foreign jurisdictions
en.explain: ¶1.21 states the UNATMO also implements the more pressing elements of the FATF Recommendations specifically related to TF, beyond the mandatory UNSCR elements. It does not implement FATF Recommendations on ML or PF generally, ICC decisions, or extradition treaties — none of which the Guideline mentions.

tc.q: 除相關聯合國安理會決議的強制性元素外，《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》還實施甚麼？
options: 特別組織建議中與恐怖分子資金籌集有關的部分
所有與洗錢及擴散資金籌集有關的特別組織建議內容
國際刑事法院就恐怖分子資金籌集作出的裁決
香港與其他司法管轄區之間訂立的雙邊引渡條約
tc.explain: 第1.21段訂明，《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》除實施相關聯合國安理會決議的強制性元素外，亦實施特別組織建議中與恐怖分子資金籌集有關而較具逼切性的部分。該條例並不實施關於洗錢或擴散資金籌集的特別組織建議、國際刑事法院的裁決，或引渡條約——指引並無提及這些內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.26及6.7段

en.q: Under the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance (UNSO), who makes regulations to implement sanctions decided by the UN Security Council, and where are designated parties published?
options: The Chief Executive makes the regulations; designations appear in the Gazette or on the CEDB website
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise makes the regulations; designations are published on the C&ED website
The Secretary for Justice makes the regulations; designations are published by the courts
The Monetary Authority makes the regulations; designations are published in newspapers
en.explain: The UNSO empowers the Chief Executive to make regulations implementing UNSC sanctions, including targeted financial sanctions; designated persons and entities are specified by notice in the Gazette or on the CEDB (Commerce and Economic Development Bureau) website (¶6.7). The CCE, Secretary for Justice and Monetary Authority have no such role under the UNSO.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》，由誰訂立規例以執行聯合國安理會決定的制裁？被指認人士名單於何處公布？
options: 行政長官訂立規例；指認人士見於憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站
由海關關長訂立規例；被指認人士的名單於海關網站或政府憲報公布
由律政司司長訂立規例；被指認人士的名單由各級法院公開頒布
由金融管理專員訂立規例；被指認人士的名單於各大報章公開刊登
tc.explain: 《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官訂立規例，以執行安理會決定的制裁（包括針對性金融制裁）；被指認的個人及實體透過在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的公告指明（第6.7段）。海關關長、律政司司長及金融管理專員在《聯合國制裁條例》下並無此角色。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.27, ¶6.10; s.4 WMD(CPS)O
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.27及6.10段；《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條

en.q: Section 4 of the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance prohibits a person from doing what?
options: Providing services reasonably believed or suspected to be connected to proliferation financing
Exporting any dual-use goods without a licence from the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
Operating a money service business without first notifying the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
Providing any services to a customer located in the DPRK or Iran, regardless of reasonable suspicion
en.explain: s.4 WMD(CPS)O prohibits providing services where a person believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that the services may be connected to PF — a belief/suspicion test, not a blanket prohibition (¶1.27, ¶6.10). Dual-use export licensing and CEDB notification are not what s.4 itself prohibits, and a blanket DPRK/Iran-customer ban misstates the test — the country-specific UNSO regulations (¶6.9) are a separate regime.

tc.q: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條禁止任何人作出甚麼行為？
options: 基於合理理由相信或懷疑與擴散資金籌集有關而提供服務
未領有商務及經濟發展局許可證而出口任何兩用物品
未有事先通知商務及經濟發展局而經營金錢服務業務
不論有否合理懷疑，向位於朝鮮或伊朗的客戶提供任何服務
tc.explain: 該條例第4條禁止任何人在基於合理理由相信或懷疑服務可能與擴散資金籌集有關的情況下提供服務——這是一項相信／懷疑的驗證標準，並非一概而論的禁止（第1.27及6.10段）。兩用物品出口許可及知會商務及經濟發展局並非第4條本身所禁止的事宜；一概禁止向朝鮮或伊朗客戶提供服務亦錯誤描述了相信／懷疑驗證標準——按國家劃分的《聯合國制裁條例》規例（第6.9段）屬另一制度。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.22; s.25 DTROP & OSCO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.22段；《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條

en.q: Under the DTROP and the OSCO, a person who deals with property knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe it represents proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence faces what maximum penalty on conviction?
options: 14 years' imprisonment and fine of $5 million
2 years' imprisonment and fine of $1 million
3 years' imprisonment and a fine
3 months' imprisonment and a fine of $50,000
en.explain: The dealing offence under s.25 of the DTROP and the OSCO carries a maximum of 14 years' imprisonment and a $5 million fine (¶1.22). 2 years/$1M is the AMLO s.5 offence for knowing contravention; 3 years is tipping-off, whose maximum fine is unspecified in the Guideline; 3 months/$50,000 is failure to disclose.

tc.q: 根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，任何人知道或有合理理由相信財產代表販毒或可公訴罪行的得益而仍處理該財產，一經定罪，最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁14年罰款五百萬
監禁2年及罰款一百萬元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁3個月及罰款五萬元
tc.explain: 兩條例第25條的處理犯罪得益罪行，一經定罪最高可判監禁14年及罰款五百萬元（第1.22段）。監禁2年／罰款一百萬元是《打擊洗錢條例》第5條明知違反的刑罰；監禁3年是「通風報訊」，指引並無訂明其罰款上限；監禁3個月／罰款五萬元是沒有披露的罪行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.24; s.25A DTROP & OSCO, s.12 & 14 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.24段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12及14條

en.q: A person who fails to disclose, as soon as reasonable, his knowledge or suspicion that property represents proceeds of drug trafficking, an indictable offence or terrorist property commits an offence. What is the maximum penalty?
options: 3 months' imprisonment and a fine of $50,000
3 years' imprisonment and a fine
14 years' imprisonment and a fine
A disciplinary fine of $10 million
en.explain: Failure to disclose knowledge or suspicion under s.25A DTROP/OSCO and s.12/14 UNATMO carries a maximum of 3 months' imprisonment and a $50,000 fine (¶1.24). This is why suspicions must be reported promptly (via the MLRO to the JFIU).

tc.q: 任何人知悉或懷疑任何財產代表販毒或可公訴罪行的得益或屬恐怖分子財產，而未能在合理範圍內盡快披露，即屬犯罪。最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁14年及罰款五百萬元
繳付一千萬元紀律罰款
tc.explain: 根據《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12及14條，未有披露知悉或懷疑的罪行最高可判監禁3個月及罰款50,000元（第1.24段）。因此必須盡快（經洗錢報告主任向聯合財富情報組）報告可疑情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.25段

en.q: Which of the following describes the offence of "tipping off"?
options: Knowing or suspecting a disclosure, disclosing matter likely to prejudice investigation
Reporting a suspicion to the MLRO before filing a suspicious transaction report
Telling a customer that their transaction cannot proceed until CDD is completed
Reporting a suspicious transaction to the JFIU without first informing the customer
en.explain: Tipping off is committed when a person, knowing or suspecting that a disclosure (e.g. an STR) has been made, discloses any matter likely to prejudice the ensuing investigation (¶1.25). Internally escalating a suspicion to the MLRO before an STR is filed, declining to proceed with a transaction pending CDD, and filing an STR with the JFIU are all required or permitted conduct, not tipping off.

tc.q: 下列哪項描述「通風報訊」罪行？
options: 知道或懷疑作出披露，披露相當可能損害調查的事宜
在遞交可疑交易報告前，先向洗錢報告主任內部匯報懷疑
告知客戶在完成客戶盡職審查前，其交易不能進行
在未有先通知客戶下，向聯合財富情報組報告可疑交易
tc.explain: 任何人知道或懷疑已曾作出披露（例如可疑交易報告），而仍向其他人披露任何相當可能損害相關調查的事宜，即犯「通風報訊」罪（第1.25段）。在遞交可疑交易報告前先向洗錢報告主任內部匯報懷疑、在完成客戶盡職審查前不進行交易，以及向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，均屬必要或獲許可的行為，並非通風報訊。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5(a); s.6 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(a)段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條

en.q: Under section 6 of the UNATMO, who is empowered to freeze suspected terrorist property?
options: The Secretary for Security
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise
The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
The Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: Section 6 of the UNATMO empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property (¶6.5(a)). The S for S may also licence exceptions so frozen property can be unfrozen, e.g. for reasonable living or legal expenses (¶6.6).

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條，誰獲授權凍結懷疑是恐怖分子的財產？
options: 保安局局長
海關關長
聯合財富情報組
財務行動特別組織
tc.explain: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑是恐怖分子的財產（第6.5(a)段）。保安局局長亦可批予特許，准許已凍結財產解凍，例如支付合理生活或法律開支（第6.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1及7.19段

en.q: In Hong Kong's AML/CFT regime, suspicious transaction reports (STRs) should be made to which body?
options: The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU)
The Financial Action Task Force (FATF)
The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Companies Registry
en.explain: STRs are made to the JFIU. The C&ED/CCE is the MSO regulator and licensing authority, and the FATF is the international standard-setter — neither receives STRs.

tc.q: 在香港的打擊洗錢制度下，可疑交易報告應向哪個機構提交？
options: 聯合財富情報組
財務行動特別組織
商務及經濟發展局
公司註冊處
tc.explain: 可疑交易報告須向聯合財富情報組提交。海關／關長是金錢服務經營者的監管及發牌機構，特別組織則是國際標準制定者——兩者均不接收可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段註57

en.q: "Targeted financial sanctions" refer to which of the following?
options: Asset freezing and prohibitions on making funds available to designated persons
Asset freezing only, without any prohibition on making funds available
Licences from the Chief Executive permitting dealings with designated persons
Travel bans and passport cancellations imposed on designated persons
en.explain: Targeted financial sanctions cover both asset freezing and prohibitions preventing funds or other assets from being made available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities (¶6.7, footnote 57) — freezing alone is not the full picture. No licensing regime under the UNSO permits dealings with designated persons without the Chief Executive's specific authority, and travel bans are not targeted financial sanctions.

tc.q: 「針對性金融制裁」指下列哪項？
options: 凍結資產，以及禁止向被指認人士提供資金
只凍結資產，並無禁止向其提供資金
由行政長官許可，容許與被指認人士交易
對被指認人士實施旅遊禁令及吊銷護照
tc.explain: 針對性金融制裁一併指凍結資產及禁止為被指認的個人及實體的利益而直接或間接提供資金或其他資產（第6.7段註57）——單是凍結資產並非全部內容。除非獲行政長官特別授權，否則《聯合國制裁條例》下並無許可制度容許與被指認人士交易；旅遊禁令及吊銷護照亦非針對性金融制裁。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: To combat proliferation financing, the UN Security Council adopts a two-tiered approach. Which of the following correctly describes it?
options: A global approach under UNSCR 1540, and a country-specific approach against DPRK (1718) and Iran (2231)
A global approach under UNSCR 1267, and a country-specific approach targeting both Al-Qaida and the Taliban
A regional approach uniformly set by the FATF, rather than a local approach led by each member state
A voluntary approach for developed countries but a mandatory approach for developing countries, which differ entirely
en.explain: The UNSC combats PF through (a) a global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and successors, and (b) a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran (¶6.9). UNSCR 1267 and its Al-Qaida/Taliban listings concern terrorism, not PF; PF standards are set by UNSC resolutions, not the FATF alone; and the two-tiered approach is not a voluntary/mandatory split by development status.

tc.q: 為遏止擴散資金籌集，聯合國安理會採取雙層策略。下列哪項描述正確？
options: 全球層面依第1540號決議；國家層面依針對朝鮮的第1718號及針對伊朗的第2231號決議
在全球層面根據安理會第1267號決議；在國家層面則針對基地組織及塔利班兩個組織
由財務行動特別組織主導並統一制訂的地區性策略，而非由各成員國自行主導的本地策略
對已發展國家而言屬自願性質，對發展中國家而言則屬強制性質，兩者要求截然不同
tc.explain: 安理會從兩個層面遏止擴散資金籌集：(a)全球層面——第1540 (2004)號決議及其後續決議；(b)國家層面——針對朝鮮的第1718 (2006)號決議及針對伊朗的第2231 (2015)號決議（第6.9段）。第1267號決議及基地組織／塔利班名單涉及恐怖主義，並非擴散資金籌集；擴散資金籌集的標準由安理會決議訂立，並非單由財務行動特別組織主導；雙層策略亦非按發展程度劃分自願與強制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.1段

en.q: Under which provision of the AMLO is the Guideline on AML/CFT for MSOs published?
options: Section 7
Section 5
Section 23
Section 30
en.explain: ¶1.1 states the Guideline is published under section 7 of the AMLO. Section 5 creates the offence of contravening a specified provision, section 23 of Schedule 2 concerns safeguards, and section 30 concerns the grant of a licence.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》是根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪一條條文發出？
options: 第7條
第5條
第23條
第30條
tc.explain: 第1.1段訂明本指引根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7條發出。第5條訂立違反指明的條文的罪行，附表2第23條關乎防護措施，第30條則關乎批出牌照。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.3段

en.q: Besides disciplinary and other actions under the AMLO, what further consequence may an MSO's non-compliance with the Guideline have?
options: It may reflect adversely on the fitness and properness of its proprietor, partner, director or owner
It automatically cancels the MSO's licence with immediate effect and no right of appeal or review
It requires the MSO to be compulsorily wound up immediately by the Court of First Instance
It transfers all supervision of the MSO from the CCE to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, subject to LegCo approval
en.explain: ¶1.3 states that non-compliance with the Guideline may also reflect adversely on the fitness and properness of the sole proprietor, partner, director and ultimate owner (where applicable) — a separate consequence from AMLO disciplinary action. Automatic cancellation without appeal, compulsory winding-up, and a transfer of supervisory function to the HKMA are not consequences stated in the Guideline.

tc.q: 除《打擊洗錢條例》下的紀律行動及其他行動外，金錢服務經營者不遵從本指引還可能招致甚麼後果？
options: 可能影響其獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或擁有人的適當人選資格
牌照會即時自動被取消，且不設任何上訴或覆核機制
須由原訟法庭即時頒令將該金錢服務經營者強制清盤
其監管職能會由海關關長全數轉移至香港金融管理局，須立法會批准
tc.explain: 第1.3段訂明，金錢服務經營者不遵從本指引，亦可能對其獨資經營者、合夥人、董事及最終擁有人（如適用）的適當人選資格有負面影響——這是有別於《打擊洗錢條例》紀律行動的另一後果。不設上訴或覆核機制而自動取消牌照、強制清盤，以及將監管職能轉移至香港金融管理局，均非指引所述後果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.6段

en.q: In the Guideline, what is the effect of the words “must” and “should” when used in relation to an action, consideration or measure?
options: Both indicate a mandatory requirement
“Must” is mandatory while “should” is merely a recommendation
Both are advisory only and carry no regulatory weight
“Should” is mandatory only for MSOs assessed as high risk
en.explain: ¶1.6 states expressly that the use of the word “must” or “should” indicates that it is a mandatory requirement. The Guideline draws no distinction between the two words, and neither is merely advisory.

tc.q: 在本指引中，「必須」及「應」二詞用於某項行動、考慮或措施時，其效力為何？
options: 兩者均表示該項屬強制性規定
「必須」屬強制性，而「應」僅屬建議
兩者均僅屬指導性質，並無監管效力
「應」只對被評為高風險的金錢服務經營者具強制性
tc.explain: 第1.6段明確訂明，使用「必須」或「應」一詞，即表示該項屬強制性規定。指引並無區分兩者，亦非僅屬建議。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.6段

en.q: Why does the Guideline state that there exists no single set of universally applicable implementation measures?
options: Because of differences in MSOs' organisational, legal, and business structures
Because the Guideline is intended to be an exhaustive list of acceptable measures
Because the FATF Recommendations leave implementation entirely to each MSO's discretion
Because MSOs may lawfully choose whether or not to comply with Schedule 2
en.explain: ¶1.6 explains that significant differences exist in MSOs' organisational, legal and business structures, so no single set of measures fits all; MSOs must use the Guideline as a basis for measures suited to their own structure. The Guideline is expressly NOT intended to be an exhaustive list (contradicting D1); Hong Kong must still implement the FATF Recommendations rather than leaving this entirely to each MSO's discretion (D2); and Schedule 2 compliance is mandatory, not optional (D3).

tc.q: 本指引為何訂明並無一套普遍適用的實施措施？
options: 因不同金錢服務經營者的組織、法律及業務架構存在差異
因本指引旨在成為一份詳盡無遺的可接受措施清單
因特別組織建議將實施方式完全交由金錢服務經營者自行決定
因金錢服務經營者可合法選擇是否遵從附表2
tc.explain: 第1.6段解釋，不同金錢服務經營者的組織、法律及業務架構存在重大差異，故並無一套普遍適用的措施；金錢服務經營者須以本指引為基礎，制定切合本身架構的措施。本指引明確表明並非旨在成為詳盡無遺的清單；香港仍須實施特別組織建議，並非完全交由個別經營者自行決定；遵從附表2屬強制性而非可選擇。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.8; s.7 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.8段；《打擊洗錢條例》第7條

en.q: What is the legal status of the Guideline in proceedings under the AMLO before a court?
options: It is admissible in evidence; any relevant provision must be considered
It is binding on the court and decides the outcome of the proceedings
It is inadmissible because it is not subsidiary legislation
It may be referred to only if both parties to the proceedings agree
en.explain: ¶1.8 provides that a failure to comply with the Guideline does not by itself render a person liable to judicial or other proceedings, but in any proceedings under the AMLO the Guideline is admissible in evidence, and any relevant provision must be considered by the court in determining the question arising.

tc.q: 在法庭進行的《打擊洗錢條例》法律程序中，本指引具有甚麼法律地位？
options: 可獲接納為證據，任何相關條文法庭須予考慮
對法庭具約束力，並決定該法律程序的結果
因並非附屬法例，故不獲接納為證據
只有在法律程序雙方同意下方可援引
tc.explain: 第1.8段訂明，任何人不遵從本指引本身並不會令該人須承擔司法或其他法律程序的法律責任；但在《打擊洗錢條例》下的任何法律程序中，本指引可獲接納為證據，任何相關條文法庭在裁定有關問題時均須予以考慮。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.8段

en.q: In considering whether a person has contravened a provision of Schedule 2 to the AMLO, what must the CCE do?
options: Have regard to the relevant provision in the Guideline
Refer the matter to the Court of First Instance before reaching a view
Obtain the prior consent of the Financial Action Task Force
Disregard the Guideline, because it does not form part of the AMLO
en.explain: ¶1.8 states that in considering whether a person has contravened a provision of Schedule 2, the CCE must have regard to the relevant provision in the Guideline. There is no requirement to refer the matter to a court first or to obtain FATF consent.

tc.q: 在考慮某人是否違反《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的條文時，海關關長必須怎樣做？
options: 須顧及本指引的相關條文
須先將事宜轉交原訟法庭方可作出結論
須先取得財務行動特別組織的同意
須不予理會本指引，因其並非《打擊洗錢條例》的一部分
tc.explain: 第1.8段訂明，在考慮某人是否違反附表2的條文時，海關關長必須顧及本指引的相關條文。並無須先轉交法庭或取得財務行動特別組織同意的規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.11段

en.q: A person collects funds intending that they be used to commit a terrorist act, but the funds are in the event never used for that purpose. Does this fall within the statutory definition of terrorist financing?
options: Yes — the definition applies whether or not the property is actually so used
No — the definition requires the property to have been actually used
No — the definition covers the provision of property, not its collection
Yes, but only if the amount collected exceeds HK$120,000
en.explain: Limb (a) of the definition in section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 covers the provision or collection of property with the intention that it be used, or knowing that it will be used, to commit terrorist acts, expressly “whether or not the property is actually so used”. Collection is covered, and no monetary threshold applies.

tc.q: 某人籌集資金，意圖用於進行恐怖主義行為，但該筆資金最終從未如此使用。這是否屬「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義範圍？
options: 屬於——不論該財產實際上有否如此使用，定義均適用
不屬於——定義規定該財產須實際已被使用
不屬於——定義只涵蓋提供財產，不涵蓋籌集財產
屬於，但只限於所籌集款額超過120,000港元
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條定義的(a)項涵蓋以任何方式提供或籌集財產，而意圖是該財產會被使用，或知道該財產將會被使用以進行恐怖主義行為，並明文訂明「不論該財產實際上是否如此使用」。籌集行為亦在涵蓋之列，且並無款額下限。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.11(b)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.11(b)段

en.q: Under limb (b) of the statutory definition of terrorist financing, what mental element must a person have when providing property or services to another person?
options: Knowing or reckless if the recipient is a terrorist or associate
Actual knowledge only; mere recklessness or suspicion is insufficient
Negligence in failing to screen the recipient against a sanctions list
An intention to assist a specific terrorist act that later actually occurs
en.explain: Limb (b) covers making property or financial (or related) services available, directly or indirectly, to or for the benefit of a person knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, the person is a terrorist or terrorist associate. Recklessness therefore suffices — actual knowledge is not required, screening negligence is a different (lesser) fault standard, and no completed terrorist act is required.

tc.q: 根據「恐怖分子資金籌集」法定定義的(b)項，任何人向他人提供財產或服務時，須具備甚麼心理要素？
options: 知道或罔顧接受者是否恐怖分子或聯繫者
只限實際知情；罔顧或懷疑並不足夠
疏忽而未有將接受者與制裁名單作篩查
意圖協助某項其後確實發生的恐怖主義行為
tc.explain: (b)項涵蓋以任何方式直接或間接向某人或為其利益提供財產或財務（或相關）服務，而知道或罔顧該人是否恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者。因此罔顧已屬足夠——毋須達到實際知情的程度；篩查疏忽屬另一種（較低的）過錯標準；亦不要求恐怖主義行為其後實際發生。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.12段

en.q: Why does the Guideline say terrorist groups must find ways to launder funds even where those funds come from a legitimate source?
options: So they can use funds without attracting authorities' attention
Because terrorist funds are always derived from illegitimate or unlawful sources
Because the AMLO exempts funds of legitimate origin from all reporting obligations
Because legitimate funds only become subject to freezing after going through laundering
en.explain: ¶1.12 explains that terrorists need to obscure or disguise links between them and their funding sources, so they must launder funds regardless of whether the funds are from a legitimate or illegitimate source, in order to use them without attracting the attention of the authorities. TF funds are not always illegitimate in origin (¶1.12, ¶6.1); the AMLO does not exempt legitimate-origin funds from reporting; and freezing under targeted financial sanctions turns on a person or entity being designated, not on whether laundering has occurred.

tc.q: 本指引為何指出，即使資金來自合法來源，恐怖分子組織仍須設法清洗該等資金？
options: 以便在不引起當局注意下使用資金
因恐怖分子的資金必然源自非法或不法來源
因《打擊洗錢條例》豁免合法資金的一切匯報責任
因合法資金只有在經清洗程序後才須被凍結
tc.explain: 第1.12段解釋，恐怖分子須隱藏或掩飾其本身與資金來源之間的關連，故不論資金屬合法或非法來源，均須設法清洗，以便在不引起當局注意的情況下使用。恐怖分子資金籌集所涉資金並非必然源自非法來源（第1.12、6.1段）；《打擊洗錢條例》並無豁免合法來源資金的匯報責任；針對性金融制裁下的資產凍結取決於有關人士或實體是否被指認，而非資金有否經清洗。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: According to ¶1.13, what do the FATF Recommendations represent?
options: The international standard for combating ML, TF and PF
A binding multilateral treaty ratified by the Hong Kong SAR Government
A set of licensing conditions imposed directly on individual MSOs by the FATF
A list of countries prohibited from conducting remittance business with Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶1.13 states that the FATF Recommendations are recognised as the international standard for combating ML, TF and PF, forming the basis for a coordinated response and a level playing field. They are recommendations issued by an inter-governmental body, not a ratified treaty; the FATF does not license individual MSOs; and it does not prohibit countries from remittance business with Hong Kong — country-specific sanctions are a separate regime (¶6.9).

tc.q: 根據第1.13段，特別組織建議代表甚麼？
options: 獲承認為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的國際標準
獲香港特區政府正式簽署及批准的具法律約束力多邊條約
由特別組織直接向個別金錢服務經營者施加並執行的發牌條件
一份禁止香港與若干國家進行匯款業務往來的國家名單
tc.explain: 第1.13段訂明，特別組織建議獲承認為打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的國際標準，為協調應對相關威脅提供基礎，並有助營造公平競爭的環境。這些建議由跨政府組織訂立，並非經批准的條約；特別組織並不直接向個別金錢服務經營者發牌；亦不會禁止某些國家與香港進行匯款業務往來（按國家劃分的制裁屬另一制度，見第6.9段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: How does the FATF seek to ensure full and effective implementation of its standards at the global level?
options: By conducting evaluations and stringent follow-up
By issuing regulations that apply directly in member jurisdictions
By publishing the FATF Recommendations without any follow-up on implementation
By issuing licences to money service operators in member jurisdictions
en.explain: ¶1.13 states that the FATF monitors compliance by conducting evaluations on jurisdictions and undertaking stringent follow-up, including identifying high-risk and other monitored jurisdictions which could be subject to enhanced scrutiny or counter-measures. The FATF issues Recommendations, not directly-applicable regulations; it does not merely publish without follow-up; and it does not licence MSOs — that is the CCE's role.

tc.q: 財務行動特別組織如何確保其標準在全球層面得到全面及有效的實施？
options: 透過評估各地並嚴格跟進
透過發出直接適用於各成員司法管轄區的規例
只發布特別組織建議，並無任何執行跟進工作
向成員司法管轄區的金錢服務經營者發出牌照
tc.explain: 第1.13段訂明，特別組織透過對各地進行評估以監察遵行情況，並作出嚴格跟進，包括識別可能須接受加強審查或反制措施的高風險及其他受監察司法管轄區。特別組織訂立的是建議而非直接適用的規例；它並非只發布建議而不作跟進；亦不會向金錢服務經營者發牌——發牌是海關關長的職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.27段

en.q: What does the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance (WMD(CPS)O) control?
options: Services that may assist the development, production, acquisition or stockpiling of weapons of mass destruction
Statutory customer due diligence and transaction record-keeping requirements on financial institutions
Creating a money laundering offence for proceeds of indictable offences, with confiscation powers
Imposing sanctions against places outside the PRC, arising from Chapter 7 of the UN Charter
en.explain: ¶1.27 states the WMD(CPS)O controls the provision of services that will or may assist the development, production, acquisition or stockpiling of weapons capable of causing mass destruction (or their means of delivery). CDD/record-keeping duties are imposed by the AMLO (¶1.15); the money laundering offence and confiscation powers belong to the OSCO (¶1.20); and sanctions against places outside the PRC are imposed under the UNSO (¶1.26) — none of these is a WMD(CPS)O function.

tc.q: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》管制甚麼？
options: 管制提供可能協助發展、生產、取得或貯存大規模毀滅武器服務
對金融機構施加客戶盡職審查及備存交易紀錄的法定規定
增訂有關可公訴罪行得益的洗錢罪行，並賦予調查及沒收權力
對中華人民共和國以外地方施加源自聯合國憲章第七章的制裁
tc.explain: 第1.27段訂明，《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》管制提供將會或可能協助發展、生產、取得或貯存大規模毀滅武器（或其投射工具）的服務。客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定屬《打擊洗錢條例》（第1.15段）；洗錢罪行及沒收權力屬《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》（第1.20段）；對中華人民共和國以外地方實施制裁則屬《聯合國制裁條例》（第1.26段）——三者均非《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》的功能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: According to ¶1.14, why is it important for MSOs and their officers and staff to understand the various pieces of AML/CFT/PF/sanctions-related legislation?
options: Because they have respective responsibilities under each separate piece of legislation
Because only the AMLO is legally binding; the rest are non-binding guidance
Because non-compliance with any of them is punishable only by a private civil claim
Because the Guideline consolidates all six ordinances into a single set of rules that replaces them
en.explain: ¶1.14 states it is very important that MSOs and their officers and staff fully understand their respective responsibilities under the different pieces of legislation — each ordinance imposes its own obligations, and compliance with one does not substitute for the others. All six are actual ordinances creating real criminal offences and regulatory powers, not non-binding guidance; contravention is not merely a civil matter; and the Guideline does not consolidate or replace them.

tc.q: 根據第1.14段，金錢服務經營者及其主管人員和職員為何須了解各條與洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集及金融制裁有關的法例？
options: 因彼等在各條不同法例下均有各自的相應責任
因只有《打擊洗錢條例》具約束力，其餘屬非約束性指引
因違反當中任何一條，均只可循民事索償途徑追究
因本指引已將六條條例合併為單一套取代它們的規則
tc.explain: 第1.14段訂明，金錢服務經營者及其主管人員和職員均須充分了解他們在不同法例下的各種責任，這點至為重要——每條條例均施加其本身的責任，遵從其中一條並不能取代遵從其餘各條。六條條例均為訂立真實刑事罪行及監管權力的條例，並非不具約束力的指引；違反者亦不僅屬民事索償事宜；本指引亦沒有將六條條例合併或取代。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.15; s.23 Sch. 2 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.15段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條

en.q: Section 23 of Schedule 2 to the AMLO requires an MSO to take all reasonable measures to do which of the following?
options: Ensure safeguards exist against contravening Schedule 2, and mitigate ML/TF risks
Verify the identity documents of every customer in every transaction, regardless of amount
Appoint a compliance officer who has received the CCE's prior written approval and endorsement
Apply to the court for a confiscation order to recover all proceeds of crime passing through the MSO
en.explain: ¶1.15 summarises section 23 of Schedule 2: an MSO must take all reasonable measures (a) to ensure that proper safeguards exist to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, and (b) to mitigate ML/TF risks. Verifying identity for every transaction regardless of amount overstates the CDD thresholds; there is no requirement that the CCE pre-approve a compliance officer's appointment; and recovering proceeds of crime through a confiscation order is a court function, not an MSO obligation.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條規定金錢服務經營者須採取一切合理措施，作出下列哪項？
options: 確保有防護措施防止違反附表2的規定，並減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
驗證每一宗交易中每一名客戶的身分證明文件，不論交易金額多寡
委任一名須事先獲海關關長書面批准及認可的合規主任
代表政府向法院申請沒收令，追討經該經營者流轉的所有犯罪得益
tc.explain: 第1.15段概述附表2第23條：金錢服務經營者須採取一切合理措施，(a)確保設有適當防護措施以防止違反附表2下的任何規定；及(b)減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。不論金額多寡驗證每宗交易的身分證明文件，誇大了客戶盡職審查的門檻規定；並無規定合規主任的委任須事先獲海關關長書面批准；而透過沒收令追討犯罪得益屬法院的職能，並非金錢服務經營者的責任。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.16–1.18; s.5 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.16至1.18段；《打擊洗錢條例》第5條

en.q: An MSO knowingly contravenes a specified provision of the AMLO. What is the maximum penalty on conviction?
options: Imprisonment for 2 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million
A pecuniary penalty of $10 million with no term of imprisonment
en.explain: ¶1.17 provides that where an MSO knowingly contravenes a specified provision it is liable to a maximum of 2 years' imprisonment and a fine of $1 million. The 7-year maximum applies where the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the CCE; 14 years and $5 million is the section 25 DTROP/OSCO dealing offence.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者在知情下違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明的條文。一經定罪，最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁2年及罰款100萬元
監禁7年及罰款100萬元
監禁14年及罰款500萬元
罰款1,000萬元而無監禁
tc.explain: 第1.17段訂明，金錢服務經營者如在知情下違反指明的條文，一經定罪，最高可處監禁2年及罰款100萬元。7年的最高刑期適用於意圖欺騙海關關長而違反的情況；監禁14年及罰款500萬元則為《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條的處理財產罪行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.16; s.5(6) AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.16段；《打擊洗錢條例》第5(6)條

en.q: An MSO contravenes a specified provision of the AMLO with the intent to defraud the CCE. What is the maximum term of imprisonment on conviction?
options: 7 years
2 years
3 years
14 years
en.explain: ¶1.16 provides that where the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the CCE, the MSO is liable to a maximum of 7 years' imprisonment and a fine of $1 million. Two years applies to a knowing contravention without that intent.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者意圖欺騙海關關長而違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明的條文。一經定罪，最高監禁刑期為何？
options: 7年
2年
3年
tc.explain: 第1.16段訂明，如屬意圖欺騙海關關長而作出的違反，該金錢服務經營者一經定罪，最高可處監禁7年及罰款100萬元。2年適用於並無該意圖的知情違反。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.17; s.5(7) AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.17段；《打擊洗錢條例》第5(7)條

en.q: Under the AMLO, which persons commit an offence by knowingly causing or permitting an MSO to contravene a specified provision?
options: An MSO employee, someone employed to work for it, or concerned in its management
Only the sole proprietor, partners or directors of the MSO, excluding ordinary staff
Only the MSO's appointed compliance officer or money laundering reporting officer
Any person who deals with the MSO, including its customers and counterparties
en.explain: ¶1.17 states the offence applies to a person who is an employee of an MSO, is employed to work for an MSO, or is concerned in the management of an MSO, and who knowingly, or with intent to defraud the MSO or the CCE, causes or permits the MSO to contravene a specified provision (s.5(7) AMLO). It is not confined to senior office-holders, to the compliance/MLRO function, or to outsiders dealing with the MSO.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，哪些人如在知情下導致或准許金錢服務經營者違反指明的條文，即屬犯罪？
options: 屬該金錢服務經營者的僱員、受僱為其工作或參與其管理的人
只限該金錢服務經營者的獨資經營者、合夥人或董事，不包括一般員工
只限該金錢服務經營者委任的合規主任或洗錢報告主任
任何與該金錢服務經營者有往來的人，包括其客戶及業務夥伴
tc.explain: 第1.17段訂明，該罪行適用於屬金錢服務經營者的僱員、受僱為金錢服務經營者工作，或參與金錢服務經營者管理的人，而該人在知情下，或意圖欺騙該金錢服務經營者或海關關長，導致或准許該金錢服務經營者違反指明的條文（《打擊洗錢條例》第5(7)條）。該罪行並不限於高級管理人員、合規／洗錢報告主任職能，或與經營者有往來的外部人士。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.18; s.21 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.18段；《打擊洗錢條例》第21條

en.q: What is the maximum pecuniary penalty the CCE may order an MSO to pay for a contravention of a specified provision?
options: The greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained or avoided
A fixed sum of $10 million regardless of the profit gained
The greater of $1 million or 2 times the profit gained
The greater of $5 million or the value of the transactions
en.explain: ¶1.18 states that disciplinary actions available to the CCE include ordering the MSO to pay a pecuniary penalty not exceeding the greater of $10 million or 3 times the amount of profit gained, or costs avoided, as a result of the contravention. It is not a fixed $10 million regardless of profit, and the lower figures and multiples belong to other, lesser sanctions.

tc.q: 就違反指明的條文，海關關長可命令金錢服務經營者繳付的罰款上限為何？
options: 1,000萬元，或利潤或避免成本3倍，以較高者為準
不論違反情節輕重，均為定額1,000萬元
100萬元，或該行為所獲利潤的2倍，以較高者為準
500萬元，或有關全部交易的總值，以較高者為準
tc.explain: 第1.18段訂明，海關關長可對違反指明的條文的金錢服務經營者採取的紀律行動，包括命令其繳付罰款，款額不超過1,000萬元，或該違反行為為其帶來的利潤或所避免的成本的3倍，以較高者為準。並非不論情節輕重一律定額1,000萬元；其餘較低款額或倍數屬其他較輕的處分。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.18; s.21 AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.18段；《打擊洗錢條例》第21條

en.q: Which of the following is a disciplinary action the CCE may take against an MSO for contravening a specified provision in the AMLO?
options: Publicly reprimanding the MSO
Sentencing the MSO's directors to a term of imprisonment
Ordering the immediate liquidation of the MSO's assets
Referring the MSO to the FATF for evaluation
en.explain: ¶1.18 lists the disciplinary actions as publicly reprimanding the MSO, ordering it to take action to remedy the contravention, and ordering it to pay a pecuniary penalty. Imprisonment is a criminal sanction imposed by a court, not a disciplinary action of the CCE.

tc.q: 就違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明的條文，海關關長可對金錢服務經營者採取下列哪項紀律行動？
options: 公開譴責該金錢服務經營者
判處該金錢服務經營者的董事監禁
命令即時變賣該金錢服務經營者的資產
將該金錢服務經營者轉介財務行動特別組織進行評估
tc.explain: 第1.18段列出的紀律行動為公開譴責該金錢服務經營者、命令其採取行動糾正違反事項，以及命令其繳付罰款。監禁屬法庭判處的刑事制裁，並非海關關長的紀律行動。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.22; s.25 DTROP & OSCO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.22段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條

en.q: Under section 25 of the DTROP and the OSCO, what mental element is required for the offence of dealing with property that represents the proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence?
options: Knowing or reasonably believing the property represents such proceeds
Actual knowledge only, proved beyond reasonable doubt
An intention to permanently deprive the true owner of the property
Negligence in failing to carry out adequate customer due diligence
en.explain: ¶1.22 states that a person commits the offence if he deals with any property knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe it to represent any person's proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence. This objective 'reasonable grounds' limb means actual knowledge beyond reasonable doubt is not required; an intent permanently to deprive is a different, theft-related concept; and CDD negligence is a distinct, lesser AML failing.

tc.q: 根據《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條，處理代表販毒得益或可公訴罪行得益的財產的罪行，須具備甚麼心理要素？
options: 知道或有合理理由相信該財產代表得益
只限實際知情，在無合理疑點下證明
意圖永久剝奪該財產真正擁有人的權利
疏忽而未有進行足夠的客戶盡職審查
tc.explain: 第1.22段訂明，任何人處理任何財產，而知道或有合理理由相信該財產代表任何人的販毒得益或可公訴罪行得益，即屬犯罪。這項客觀的「合理理由相信」標準，意味毋須達到在無合理疑點下證明的實際知情程度；意圖永久剝奪財產真正擁有人的權利屬（盜竊相關的）另一概念；而客戶盡職審查疏忽則屬另一項較輕的打擊洗錢缺失。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.22段

en.q: What is the highest penalty on conviction for the dealing offence under section 25 of the DTROP and the OSCO?
options: Imprisonment for 14 years and a $5 million fine
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 2 years and a fine of $1 million
en.explain: ¶1.22 states the highest penalty for the section 25 dealing offence upon conviction is imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million. The lesser penalties listed relate to AMLO specified-provision offences, tipping off and failure to disclose.

tc.q: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條的處理財產罪行，一經定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁14年罰款500萬
監禁7年及罰款100萬元
監禁3年及罰款5萬元
監禁2年及罰款100萬元
tc.explain: 第1.22段訂明，第25條處理財產罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為監禁14年及罰款500萬元。其餘較輕刑罰分別關乎《打擊洗錢條例》指明的條文罪行、洩密罪行及沒有披露的罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.24段

en.q: What is the maximum penalty for failing to disclose, as soon as it is reasonable to do so, knowledge or suspicion that property represents the proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence, or is terrorist property?
options: Imprisonment for 3 months and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $500,000
en.explain: ¶1.24 states that this failure-to-disclose offence carries a maximum term of imprisonment of 3 months and a fine of $50,000 upon conviction. Three years is the maximum for tipping off; 14 years and $5 million is the section 25 dealing offence.

tc.q: 任何人沒有在合理範圍內盡快披露其知道或懷疑某財產代表販毒得益、可公訴罪行得益或屬恐怖分子財產，最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
監禁3年及罰款50,000元
監禁14年及罰款500萬元
監禁7年及罰款500,000元
tc.explain: 第1.24段訂明，此項沒有披露的罪行一經定罪，最高可處監禁3個月及罰款50,000元。3年為洩密罪行的最高刑期；監禁14年及罰款500萬元則為第25條處理財產罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.25段

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction for the offence of “tipping off” under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO?
options: Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine
Imprisonment for 3 months and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million
Imprisonment for 2 years and a fine of $1 million
en.explain: ¶1.25 states that the maximum penalty for tipping off upon conviction is imprisonment for 3 years and a fine. Three months and $50,000 is the failure-to-disclose offence; 14 years and $5 million is the section 25 dealing offence.

tc.q: 根據《販毒條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，「洩密」罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁3年及罰款
監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
監禁14年及罰款500萬元
監禁2年及罰款100萬元
tc.explain: 第1.25段訂明，洩密罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為監禁3年及罰款。監禁3個月及罰款50,000元屬沒有披露的罪行；監禁14年及罰款500萬元則為第25條處理財產罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.25段

en.q: A staff member of an MSO, knowing that a colleague has filed a suspicious transaction report, telephones the customer and warns him that his account is being examined. Which offence does this most directly illustrate?
options: Tipping off
Failure to disclose knowledge or suspicion
Dealing with property representing the proceeds of an indictable offence
Providing services connected to proliferation financing
en.explain: ¶1.25 defines tipping off: a person commits the offence if, knowing or suspecting that a disclosure has been made, he discloses to any other person any matter likely to prejudice any investigation that might be conducted following that disclosure. Warning the customer is the paradigm case.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者的職員知道同事已提交可疑交易報告，遂致電客戶，警告其帳戶正被審查。這最直接說明哪一項罪行？
options: 洩密
沒有披露所知或所懷疑的事宜
處理代表可公訴罪行得益的財產
提供與大規模毀滅武器擴散資金籌集有關的服務
tc.explain: 第1.25段界定洩密罪行：任何人知道或懷疑已作出披露，而向另一人披露相當可能會損害因該項披露而可能進行的調查的事宜，即屬犯罪。警告客戶正是典型例子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.26段

en.q: The United Nations Sanctions Ordinance provides for the imposition of sanctions arising from which part of the Charter of the United Nations?
options: Chapter 7
Chapter 2
Chapter 11
Chapter 15
en.explain: ¶1.26 states that the UNSO provides for the imposition of sanctions against persons and against places outside the People's Republic of China arising from Chapter 7 of the Charter of the United Nations, and that most UNSCRs are implemented in Hong Kong under the UNSO.

tc.q: 《聯合國制裁條例》就實施因《聯合國憲章》哪一章而產生的制裁作出規定？
options: 第7章
第2章
第11章
第15章
tc.explain: 第1.26段訂明，《聯合國制裁條例》就針對中華人民共和國以外的人及地方、因《聯合國憲章》第7章而產生的制裁的實施作出規定，而大部分聯合國安理會決議均透過該條例在香港實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: Which UNSCR calls on all member states to act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts?
en.explain: ¶6.2 identifies UNSCR 1373 (2001) as the resolution calling on all member states to act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts. UNSCR 1540 is the global counter-proliferation resolution, while 1718 and 2231 are country-specific to the DPRK and Iran.

tc.q: 哪一項聯合國安理會決議呼籲所有成員國採取行動防止及制止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集？
tc.explain: 第6.2段指出第1373號決議（2001年）呼籲所有成員國採取行動防止及制止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集。第1540號決議屬全球性打擊擴散資金籌集決議，而第1718及2231號決議則分別針對朝鮮及伊朗。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: Where the UN publishes the names of individuals and organisations linked to Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban, what are all UN member states required to do?
options: Freeze named persons' funds or assets, and report suspected matches
Prosecute the named persons in their domestic courts within 30 days
Expel any national of the country in which a named person resides
Report the names to the FATF for inclusion in evaluation reports
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that all UN member states are required to freeze any funds, or other financial assets, or economic resources of any person(s) named in these lists and to report any suspected name matches to the relevant authorities. Prosecuting domestically within a fixed deadline, expelling nationals, and reporting to the FATF are not what ¶6.2 requires.

tc.q: 當聯合國公布與蓋達組織、伊斯蘭國（Da'esh）及塔利班有關連的個人及組織名單時，所有聯合國成員國須怎樣做？
options: 凍結名單資金或資產，報告懷疑名稱吻合
於30日內在本國法院檢控名單上的人
驅逐名單上的人所居住國家的任何國民
通報財務行動特別組織以載入評估報告
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明，所有聯合國成員國須凍結該等名單上任何人的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，並須向有關當局報告任何懷疑名稱吻合的個案。第6.2段並無要求在限期內於本國提出檢控、驅逐國民，或向財務行動特別組織作出報告。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.4; s.4 & 5 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.4段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4及5條

en.q: Under section 5 of the UNATMO, to which body may the Chief Executive apply for an order specifying a person as a terrorist or terrorist associate?
options: The Court of First Instance
The Legislative Council
The Security Bureau
The United Nations Security Council
en.explain: ¶6.4 states that under section 5 of the UNATMO the Chief Executive may apply to the Court of First Instance for an order specifying a person or property, and that any such order will also be published in the Gazette. Section 4 concerns publication of a Gazette notice following a designation by a UNSC Committee.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第5條，行政長官可向哪一機構申請頒令指明某人為恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者？
options: 原訟法庭
立法會
保安局
聯合國安全理事會
tc.explain: 第6.4段訂明，根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第5條，行政長官可向原訟法庭申請頒令指明某人或某財產，而該命令亦會在憲報公布。第4條則關乎在聯合國安理會委員會作出指定後於憲報刊登公告。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5; s.6 & 7 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6及7條

en.q: Which section of the UNATMO prohibits the provision or collection of property for use to commit terrorist acts?
options: Section 7
Section 6
Section 8A
Section 11L
en.explain: ¶6.5 lists the relevant UNATMO provisions: section 6 empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property; section 7 prohibits the provision or collection of property for use to commit terrorist acts; section 8A prohibits dealing with specified terrorist property; and section 11L concerns financing terrorist travel.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》哪一條禁止提供或籌集財產以用於進行恐怖主義行為？
options: 第7條
第6條
第8A條
第11L條
tc.explain: 第6.5段列出相關條文：第6條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑屬恐怖分子財產的財產；第7條禁止提供或籌集財產以用於進行恐怖主義行為；第8A條禁止處理指明恐怖分子財產；第11L條則關乎資助恐怖分子旅行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5(e); s.11L UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(e)段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第11L條

en.q: Section 11L of the UNATMO prohibits providing or collecting property to finance the travel of a person between states for a specified purpose connected with terrorist acts. Which of the following is NOT a required element of the section 11L offence, as described in ¶6.5(e)?
options: That a terrorist act results from the travel or the training
Providing or collecting property to finance the travel between states
Intention or knowledge that the travel is for a terrorist purpose
The travel of a person between two or more states for that purpose
en.explain: ¶6.5(e) states that section 11L prohibits providing or collecting property to finance travel between states with the intention or knowledge that the travel is for the perpetration, planning or preparation of, or participation in, terrorist acts, or for related training — expressly “even if no terrorist act actually occurs”. An actual resulting terrorist act is therefore not required; providing or collecting property, travel between states, and the requisite intention or knowledge all are required elements.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第11L條禁止提供或籌集財產，以資助某人於國家之間旅行，藉以達致與恐怖主義行為有關的指明目的。根據第6.5(e)段所述，以下何者並非第11L條罪行的必要構成要素？
options: 恐怖主義行為因該旅行或訓練而發生
提供或籌集財產以資助國家之間的旅行
意圖或知道該旅行是為恐怖主義目的
某人於兩個或以上國家之間的旅行
tc.explain: 第6.5(e)段訂明，第11L條禁止任何人提供或籌集財產，意圖或知道該旅行是為施行、策劃或籌備恐怖主義行為或參與其中而資助某人於國家之間旅行，或為提供或接受有關訓練，並明文訂明「即使並無恐怖主義行為因而實際發生」亦然。因此，恐怖主義行為因而實際發生並非必要構成要素；提供或籌集財產、國家之間的旅行，以及相關意圖或知悉，則均屬必要構成要素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.4段

en.q: According to ¶1.4(b), what is the purpose of the practical guidance given in the AML/CFT Guideline?
options: To help MSOs design and implement AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls
To give MSOs a published list of licensees that have had their licences revoked
To supply template policies and procedures that every MSO must adopt without change
To set out the fees payable to the Commissioner for licence applications and renewals
en.explain: ¶1.4(b) states that the Guideline provides practical guidance to assist MSOs and their senior management in designing and implementing their own policies, procedures and controls in the relevant operational areas, taking into account their special circumstances. It does not publish a list of disciplined MSOs, prescribe verbatim templates (¶1.6 says the Guideline is not exhaustive and MSOs must adapt it to their own structure), or set out licence fees (those are fixed by AMLO Schedule 3).

tc.q: 根據第1.4(b)段，《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》所提供的實務指引，目的為何？
options: 協助金錢服務經營者制定及推行政策、程序及管控措施
向金錢服務經營者提供已被撤銷牌照的持牌人公開名單
提供每間金錢服務經營者均須原封不動採用的範本政策及程序
訂明須向關長繳付的牌照申請及續期費用
tc.explain: 第1.4(b)段訂明本指引提供實務指引，協助金錢服務經營者及其高級管理層在顧及本身特殊情況下，制定及推行本身業務範疇的政策、程序及管控措施。本指引並無刊發被紀律處分的經營者名單、規定必須原封不動採用範本（第1.6段訂明本指引並非詳盡無遺，經營者須按本身架構調整），亦無訂立牌照費用（費用載於《打擊洗錢條例》附表3）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.6段

en.q: How should an MSO treat the measures described in the Guideline when designing its own controls?
options: As a basis for developing measures appropriate to its own structure and business activities
As an exhaustive checklist which, once completed, discharges every statutory obligation
As a minimum set of measures that must be adopted verbatim regardless of size or structure
As optional guidance, since 'must' and 'should' in the Guideline are not mandatory
en.explain: ¶1.6 states that the content of the Guideline is not intended to be an exhaustive list of the means of meeting the statutory and regulatory requirements — there is no single set of universally applicable implementation measures — so MSOs should use the Guideline as a basis to develop measures appropriate to their own structure and business activities. The same paragraph makes clear that 'must' or 'should' indicates a mandatory requirement, so the Guideline is neither optional guidance nor a verbatim minimum standard, and completing a checklist does not by itself discharge every statutory obligation.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在設計本身的管控措施時，應如何看待本指引所述的措施？
options: 以本指引為基礎，制定切合其本身架構及業務活動的措施
視為詳盡的核對清單，一經完成即已履行所有法定責任
視為不論規模或架構，均須原封不動採納的最低限度措施
視為可有可無的建議，因「必須」及「應」並非強制性
tc.explain: 第1.6段訂明，本指引的內容並非符合法定及監管規定的方法的詳盡清單——並不存在放諸四海皆準的單一套實施措施——故金錢服務經營者應以本指引為基礎，制定切合其本身架構及業務活動的措施。同段亦訂明「必須」或「應」表示屬強制性規定，故本指引並非可有可無的建議，也不是可原封不動採納的最低標準；完成核對清單本身亦不代表已履行所有法定責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.7段

en.q: The Guideline provides guidance in relation to the operation of the provisions of which part of the AMLO?
options: Schedule 2
Schedule 1
Part 6
Schedule 3
en.explain: ¶1.7 states that the Guideline provides guidance in relation to the operation of the provisions of Schedule 2 to the AMLO, which will assist MSOs to meet their legal and regulatory obligations when tailored to their particular business risk profile. Schedule 1 is interpretation and Schedule 3 deals with fees.

tc.q: 本指引就《打擊洗錢條例》哪一部分條文的運作提供指引？
options: 附表2
附表1
第6部
附表3
tc.explain: 第1.7段訂明本指引就《打擊洗錢條例》附表2條文的運作提供指引；金錢服務經營者按其特定業務風險狀況加以調適後，有助其履行法律及監管責任。附表1為釋義，附表3則關乎費用。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.9段

en.q: Conduct occurring outside Hong Kong generates proceeds. When do those proceeds fall within the statutory definition of money laundering in the AMLO?
options: Where that conduct, had it occurred in Hong Kong, would be an indictable offence
Only where that conduct is also an indictable offence in the jurisdiction where it occurred
Only where the resulting proceeds are subsequently remitted into Hong Kong
Never — the statutory definition applies only to offences actually committed in Hong Kong
en.explain: The definition in section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 covers proceeds obtained from an indictable offence under the laws of Hong Kong, or from conduct that would be an indictable offence under Hong Kong law had it occurred in Hong Kong. Dual criminality (an offence in the jurisdiction where it occurred) and remittance into Hong Kong are not required by the definition.

tc.q: 在香港以外發生的行為產生得益。該等得益在何情況下屬《打擊洗錢條例》中「洗錢」的法定定義範圍？
options: 該行為假使在香港發生，將屬可公訴罪行
只有在該行為於其發生地亦屬可公訴罪行的情況下
只有在有關得益其後匯入香港境內的情況下
永不屬於——法定定義只涵蓋在香港實際干犯的罪行
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條的定義涵蓋因干犯香港法律下的可公訴罪行而獲得的得益，或因任何行為而獲得的得益，而該行為假使在香港發生便會構成香港法律下的可公訴罪行。定義並不要求雙重犯罪（即在發生地亦屬罪行），也不要求得益匯入香港。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.9(b)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.9(b)段

en.q: A launderer deals with an asset bought partly with legitimate funds and partly with the proceeds of drug trafficking, so as to disguise its criminal origin. Does the AMLO's money laundering definition capture that asset?
options: Yes — the definition covers property that in whole or in part represents such proceeds
No — the definition requires the property to be wholly composed of criminal proceeds
No — mixed-source property is a matter for OSCO confiscation orders, not the AMLO definition
Yes, but only after a court has traced and quantified the criminal proportion of the asset
en.explain: Limb (b) of the AMLO definition covers property that in whole or in part, directly or indirectly, represents the proceeds of an indictable offence, so a mixed-source asset is caught. The definition does not require the property to be wholly criminal in origin, is not confined to OSCO confiscation proceedings, and does not require prior judicial tracing or quantification.

tc.q: 洗錢者處理一項資產，該資產部分以合法資金、部分以販毒得益購買，藉以掩飾其犯罪來源。《打擊洗錢條例》的洗錢定義是否涵蓋該資產？
options: 涵蓋——定義涵蓋全部或部分、直接或間接代表該等得益的財產
不涵蓋——定義規定該財產須全部由犯罪得益構成
不涵蓋——混合來源財產只屬《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》充公令範疇
涵蓋，但須待法院追查並量化該資產的犯罪成分後方可
tc.explain: 《打擊洗錢條例》定義中的(b)項涵蓋全部或部分、直接或間接代表可公訴罪行得益的財產，因此混合來源的資產亦屬定義範圍。定義並不要求財產須全屬犯罪來源，亦不限於《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》的充公程序，更不要求須經法院預先追查及量化。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(c)段

en.q: Where the layering process has succeeded, what does an integration scheme achieve?
options: It returns the laundered proceeds to the general financial system, appearing legitimate
It removes the proceeds permanently from the financial system and holds them as untraceable cash
It converts the proceeds into a foreign currency to avoid exchange controls and audit trails
It splits the proceeds into amounts below the reporting threshold to avoid detection at placement
en.explain: ¶1.10(c) describes integration as creating the impression of apparent legitimacy for criminally derived wealth: where layering succeeds, integration schemes return the laundered proceeds to the general financial system so they appear to result from, or be connected to, legitimate business activities. Holding proceeds as cash outside the system, currency conversion to defeat audit trails, and structuring below a reporting threshold are placement and layering techniques (¶1.10(a)-(b)), not integration.

tc.q: 當分層交易過程成功後，「整合」安排達致甚麼效果？
options: 將已清洗的得益送回一般金融體系，使其呈現合法外表
將得益永久移離金融體系，並以無法追蹤的現金形式持有
將得益兌換為外幣，以規避外匯管制及審計線索
將得益拆細至低於申報門檻的款額，以避免在存放階段被發現
tc.explain: 第1.10(c)段將「整合」描述為為犯罪得來的財富製造表面合法性：當分層交易過程成功後，整合安排會把已清洗的得益送回一般金融體系，令該等得益看似源自合法商業活動或與之有關。以現金形式將得益移離金融體系、兌換外幣以規避審計線索，以及拆細至低於申報門檻，均屬存放及分層階段的手法（第1.10(a)-(b)段），並非整合。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10段

en.q: Funds already inside the banking system are moved rapidly through a chain of accounts in several jurisdictions, each transfer having no apparent commercial purpose. Which stage of money laundering does this best illustrate?
options: Layering
Placement
Integration
Structuring
en.explain: Layering separates illicit proceeds from their source by creating complex layers of financial transactions designed to disguise the source, subvert the audit trail and provide anonymity (¶1.10(b)). Placement is the first entry of cash into the system; integration gives the funds apparent legitimacy.

tc.q: 已在銀行體系內的資金，經多個司法管轄區的一連串帳戶迅速轉移，而每次轉帳均無明顯商業目的。這最能說明洗錢的哪一階段？
options: 分層交易
存放
整合
拆細
tc.explain: 分層交易透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益與其來源分開，以隱藏款項來源、掩飾審計線索及提供匿名性（第1.10(b)段）。存放是現金首次進入體系；整合則為資金製造表面合法性。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10段

en.q: What does the Guideline say about the number of transactions typically involved in the laundering of money?
options: The three stages frequently involve numerous transactions, and an MSO should stay alert to any such sign
Money laundering is normally completed in a single high-value transaction, not many smaller ones
Only transactions of $120,000 or more trigger due diligence, so smaller amounts are never relevant to laundering
The number of transactions stops mattering once customer due diligence has been completed for that customer
en.explain: ¶1.10 states that there are three common stages in the laundering of money and that they frequently involve numerous transactions, so an MSO should be alert to any such sign for potential criminal activities. The $120,000 figure is the CDD threshold for occasional transactions (¶4.2.1), not a cut-off below which laundering becomes irrelevant, and ¶1.10 draws no link between transaction count and whether CDD has been completed.

tc.q: 本指引就清洗黑錢一般涉及的交易宗數有何說明？
options: 三個階段往往涉及大量交易，金錢服務經營者應對此等跡象保持警覺
清洗黑錢通常以單一宗大額現金交易完成，而非多宗較小額交易
只有達120,000港元的交易才觸發盡職審查，較小額交易與清洗黑錢無關
一旦已為該名客戶完成客戶盡職審查程序，交易宗數便不再重要
tc.explain: 第1.10段訂明清洗黑錢有三個常見階段，而該等階段往往涉及大量交易；金錢服務經營者應對任何此等潛在犯罪活動的跡象保持警覺。120,000港元是非經常交易觸發客戶盡職審查的門檻（第4.2.1段），並非低於此數即與清洗黑錢無關的分界線，第1.10段亦沒有將交易宗數與客戶盡職審查是否完成拉上關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.19段

en.q: Which ordinance provides for the investigation of assets suspected to derive from drug trafficking, freezing of assets on arrest, and confiscation of proceeds upon conviction?
options: The Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance (DTROP)
The Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (OSCO), covering organised crime
The United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (UNATMO)
The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (AMLO)
en.explain: ¶1.19 states that the DTROP contains provisions for the investigation of assets suspected to be derived from drug trafficking activities, the freezing of assets on arrest, and the confiscation of the proceeds from drug trafficking upon conviction. The OSCO targets organised and serious crime generally (¶1.20), the UNATMO targets terrorist property and terrorist financing (¶6.5), and the AMLO imposes CDD and record-keeping duties (¶1.15) -- none of the other three is about drug-trafficking proceeds specifically.

tc.q: 下列哪一條例就調查懷疑源自販毒活動的資產、在拘捕時凍結資產，以及在定罪後沒收得益作出規定？
options: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》（DTROP）
《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》（OSCO）
《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（UNATMO）
《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（AMLO）
tc.explain: 第1.19段訂明《販毒（追討得益）條例》載有條文，就調查懷疑源自販毒活動的資產、在拘捕時凍結資產，以及在定罪後沒收販毒得益作出規定。《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》針對一般有組織及嚴重罪行（第1.20段），《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》針對恐怖分子財產及資金籌集（第6.5段），《打擊洗錢條例》則施加客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存責任（第1.15段）——三者均非專門處理販毒得益。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20(b)段

en.q: Under the OSCO, which orders may the Courts issue in relation to the property of a defendant charged with a specified offence?
options: Restraint orders and charging orders
Freezing notices issued by the Secretary for Security
Licences permitting dealings with designated property
Gazette notices specifying terrorist property
en.explain: ¶1.20(b) states that the OSCO gives the Courts jurisdiction to confiscate the proceeds of organized and serious crimes and to issue restraint orders and charging orders in relation to the property of a defendant of an offence specified in the OSCO. Freezing by the Secretary for Security and Gazette specification are UNATMO mechanisms.

tc.q: 根據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，就被控犯該條例指明罪行的被告人的財產，法庭可頒發哪類命令？
options: 限制令及押記令
由保安局局長發出的凍結通知
准許處理指明財產的許可證
指明恐怖分子財產的憲報公告
tc.explain: 第1.20(b)段訂明《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予法庭司法管轄權，沒收有組織及嚴重罪行的得益，並就該條例所指明罪行的被告人的財產頒發限制令及押記令。由保安局局長凍結財產及憲報指明均屬《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》的機制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20(a)段

en.q: Which officers does the OSCO empower to investigate organized crime and triad activities?
options: Officers of the Hong Kong Police and the Customs and Excise Department
Officers of the Securities and Futures Commission, Hong Kong's securities regulator
Officers of the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit, which receives suspicious transaction reports
Officers of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau, which gazettes sanctions designations
en.explain: ¶1.20(a) states that the OSCO gives officers of the Hong Kong Police and the Customs and Excise Department powers to investigate organized crime and triad activities. The SFC is Hong Kong's securities regulator, the JFIU is the body that receives suspicious transaction reports (¶6.18), and the CEDB publishes sanctions designations (¶6.7) -- none of them holds the OSCO investigative power.

tc.q: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》授權哪些人員調查有組織罪行及三合會活動？
options: 香港警務處及香港海關的人員，即負責日常執法的兩個部門
證券及期貨事務監察委員會的人員，即香港的證券監管機構
聯合財富情報組的人員，即負責接收可疑交易報告的機構
商務及經濟發展局的人員，即負責刊憲公布制裁指定名單的機構
tc.explain: 第1.20(a)段訂明《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》賦予香港警務處及香港海關人員權力，調查有組織罪行及三合會活動。證券及期貨事務監察委員會是香港的證券監管機構，聯合財富情報組是接收可疑交易報告的機構（第6.18段），商務及經濟發展局則刊憲公布制裁指定名單（第6.7段）——三者均無《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》下的調查權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20(d)段

en.q: Under the OSCO, in what circumstances may the Courts receive information about an offender and an offence in order to consider imposing a greater sentence?
options: Where the offence amounts to an organised crime, triad-related, or other serious offence
Where the offender has previously been the subject of a suspicious transaction report to the JFIU
Where the offence involves property exceeding HK$5 million in value, regardless of its nature
Where the offender is a licensed money service operator convicted of a summary offence
en.explain: ¶1.20(d) states that the OSCO enables the Courts, in appropriate circumstances, to receive information about an offender and an offence to determine whether a greater sentence is appropriate where the offence amounts to an organised crime/triad-related offence or other serious offence. Nothing in ¶1.20(d) ties this power to a prior STR, to a property-value figure, or to the offender's status as a licensed MSO.

tc.q: 根據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，法庭在甚麼情況下可接收有關犯罪者及罪行的資料，以考慮判處更重刑罰？
options: 當該罪行屬有組織罪行、與三合會有關的罪行，或其他嚴重罪行
當該犯罪者此前曾為向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告的對象
當該罪行涉及價值超過500萬港元的財產，不論財產性質為何
當該犯罪者是曾被裁定觸犯簡易程序罪行的持牌金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第1.20(d)段訂明《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》使法庭在適當情況下可接收有關犯罪者及罪行的資料，以決定當該罪行屬有組織罪行╱與三合會有關的罪行或其他嚴重罪行時，判處更重刑罰是否恰當。第1.20(d)段並無將此權力，與此前的可疑交易報告、財產價值數字，或犯罪者屬持牌金錢服務經營者的身分掛鈎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21及6.3段

en.q: Besides preventing the financing of terrorist acts, which further threat is the UNATMO directed towards combating?
options: The threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters
The laundering of proceeds of drug trafficking
The proliferation of weapons of mass destruction by state actors
The evasion of exchange controls by cross-border remitters
en.explain: ¶1.21 states that the UNATMO is principally directed towards implementing decisions in relevant UNSCRs aimed at preventing the financing of terrorist acts and combating the threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters. ¶6.3 adds that it implements UNSCR 2178 (2014) on travel for terrorist purposes.

tc.q: 除防止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集外，《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》還針對打擊哪一項威脅？
options: 外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員所構成的威脅
販毒得益的清洗
國家行為者擴散大規模毀滅武器
跨境匯款商規避外匯管制
tc.explain: 第1.21段訂明《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》主要旨在實施相關聯合國安理會決議中的決定，以防止恐怖主義行為的資金籌集及打擊外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員所構成的威脅。第6.3段補充該條例實施關乎恐怖主義目的旅行的第2178號決議（2014年）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.23段

en.q: What is the highest penalty on conviction under the UNATMO for the provision or collection of property, or making property or financial (or related) services available, to terrorists or terrorist associates?
options: Imprisonment for 14 years and a fine
Imprisonment for 7 years and a fine of $1 million
Imprisonment for 3 years and a fine
Imprisonment for 3 months and a fine of $50,000
en.explain: ¶1.23 states that the highest penalty for the offence upon conviction is imprisonment for 14 years and a fine, and that the UNATMO also permits terrorist property to be frozen and subsequently forfeited.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，向恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者提供或籌集財產，或提供財產或財務（或相關）服務，一經定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁14年及罰款
監禁7年及罰款100萬元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
tc.explain: 第1.23段訂明該罪行一經定罪的最高刑罰為監禁14年及罰款；該條例亦准許凍結恐怖分子財產並其後予以充公。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.6; s.6(1), 8 & 8A(1) UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6(1)、8及8A(1)條

en.q: An MSO wishes to apply for a licence permitting a payment to be made for the benefit of a designated party under the UNATMO. To whom should it write?
options: The Security Bureau
The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
The Customs and Excise Department
en.explain: ¶6.6 states that the Secretary for Security can licence exceptions to the UNATMO prohibitions, and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Security Bureau. Licences under the UNSO are a matter for the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau (¶6.8).

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者擬申請許可證，以便根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》為某被指定方的利益作出付款。它應向哪一機構提出？
options: 保安局
商務及經濟發展局
聯合財富情報組
香港海關
tc.explain: 第6.6段訂明保安局局長可就該條例的禁止規定發出許可證作為例外，而尋求該等許可證的金錢服務經營者應致函保安局。《聯合國制裁條例》下的許可證則由商務及經濟發展局處理（第6.8段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段

en.q: Which of the following is given in the Guideline as an example of a payment that the Secretary for Security may licence in favour of a designated party under the UNATMO?
options: Reasonable living/legal expenses, and payments due under the Employment Ordinance
Repayment of a commercial loan that was advanced to the designated party before designation
Dividends payable on shares that are held by the designated party in a listed company
Any payment to the designated party not exceeding HK$8,000 in aggregate per licence
en.explain: ¶6.6 gives reasonable living/legal expenses and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance as the Guideline's examples of what the Secretary for Security may licence. Pre-designation loan repayments, dividends, and a HK$8,000 aggregate payment are not among the examples given, and ¶6.6 sets no such monetary cap.

tc.q: 本指引就保安局局長可根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》發出許可證，准許向被指定方作出的付款，舉出下列哪項為例？
options: 合理的生活或法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項
償還在被指定前已批出予該被指定方的商業貸款
被指定方於某上市公司所持股份應付的股息，並非生活或法律開支
向被指定方作出而合計不超過8,000港元的付款
tc.explain: 第6.6段以合理的生活╱法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項，作為保安局局長可發出許可證的例子。被指定前已批出貸款的還款、股息，以及合計8,000港元的付款，均非該段所舉的例子，第6.6段亦沒有訂立這樣的款額上限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段

en.q: Where are persons and entities designated under the UNSO specified?
options: By notice published in the Gazette or on the CEDB website
In a register maintained at the Customs and Excise Department's MSO licensing office
In the Guideline's Glossary of defined terms, rather than in any published notice
On the website of the Financial Action Task Force, the international AML/CFT standard-setter
en.explain: ¶6.7 states that designated persons and entities are specified by notice published in the Gazette or on the website of the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau. The CCE's licensing office keeps MSO licence records, not sanctions designations; the Guideline's Glossary defines terms but is not itself a notice of designation; and the FATF sets international standards (¶1.13) but does not itself designate persons under the UNSO.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》被指定的人及實體，在何處指明？
options: 以憲報公告或於商務及經濟發展局網站公布的公告指明
於香港海關的金錢服務經營者發牌辦事處備存的登記冊內
於本指引的詞彙表內界定用詞，而非透過任何公告
於財務行動特別組織的網站，即國際標準制定機構
tc.explain: 第6.7段訂明被指定的人及實體是以憲報公告或於商務及經濟發展局網站公布的公告指明。海關的金錢服務經營者發牌辦事處備存的是牌照紀錄，而非制裁指定名單；本指引的詞彙表只界定用詞，本身並非指定公告；財務行動特別組織制定國際標準（第1.13段），但並不根據《聯合國制裁條例》指定人士。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(a)段

en.q: Under the UNSO, the prohibition on making funds available extends beyond designated persons themselves. To whom else does it apply?
options: Persons or entities acting for, or owned or controlled by, designated persons, and entities they own
Only entities wholly owned by designated persons -- not persons acting on their behalf or at their direction
Only connected parties as defined in paragraph 4.3.19, not persons acting at a designated person's direction
Only entities incorporated in the jurisdiction that is the subject of the sanctions, wherever controlled
en.explain: ¶6.7(a)(ii)-(iii) extends the prohibition to persons or entities acting on behalf of or at the direction of designated persons or entities, or owned or controlled by them, and to entities owned by those persons -- not to one of these categories alone. 'Connected parties' under ¶4.3.19 is a separate, narrower concept used for the screening obligations in ¶6.17, not the definition of who falls within the ¶6.7(a) prohibition; and the prohibition does not turn on where an entity is incorporated.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》，禁止提供資金的規定除適用於被指定人士本身外，還適用於何人？
options: 代被指定人士行事、按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制者，其擁有的實體
只限被指定人士全資擁有的實體——不包括代其行事或按其指示行事的人
只限第4.3.19段所界定的有關連人士，不包括按被指定人士指示行事的人
只限在受制裁司法管轄區註冊成立的實體，不論實際由誰擁有或控制
tc.explain: 第6.7(a)(ii)至(iii)段將禁止規定延伸至代被指定的人或實體行事或按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的人或實體，以及由上述者擁有的實體——並非只限其中一類。第4.3.19段所界定的「有關連人士」是另一項較狹窄的概念，用於第6.17段的篩查責任，並非第6.7(a)段禁止規定所適用的定義；該禁止規定亦與實體的註冊成立地點無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(b)段

en.q: Apart from making funds available, what second category of conduct is an offence under the UNSO absent a licence?
options: Dealing, directly or indirectly, with funds or resources owned or controlled by designated persons or entities
Providing financial services to any person resident in the country that is the subject of the sanctions
Failing to report a name match to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau within a reasonable time
Holding frozen funds without applying to the Secretary for Security for a UNATMO licence to release them
en.explain: ¶6.7(b) makes it an offence, absent a licence from the Chief Executive, to deal directly or indirectly with funds or other financial assets or economic resources belonging to, or owned or controlled by, designated persons or entities. The UNSO targets designated persons and entities specifically, not every resident of a sanctioned country; ¶6.18 requires suspicions to be reported to the JFIU, not the CEDB; and a UNSO licence to deal with designated funds is sought from the Chief Executive via the CEDB (¶6.8), not from the Security Bureau under the UNATMO (¶6.6), which is a different ordinance with a different licensing route.

tc.q: 除提供資金外，在無許可證的情況下，《聯合國制裁條例》還將哪一類行為訂為罪行？
options: 直接或間接處理屬於被指定人士或實體，或由其擁有或控制的資金或經濟資源
向任何居於受制裁國家的人士提供金融服務，而非只向被指定人士提供
在識別出可能的名稱吻合後，未有在合理時間內向商務及經濟發展局報告
凍結資金後，沒有向保安局申請《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》許可證
tc.explain: 第6.7(b)段訂明，在無行政長官許可證的情況下，直接或間接處理屬於被指定人士或實體，或由其擁有或控制的資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，即屬犯罪。《聯合國制裁條例》針對的是特定的被指定人士及實體，並非受制裁國家的所有居民；第6.18段規定須向聯合財富情報組（而非商務及經濟發展局）報告懷疑個案；而處理受《聯合國制裁條例》指定資金的許可證，應向行政長官經商務及經濟發展局申請（第6.8段），並非向保安局根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》申請（第6.6段）——後者是另一條例下的另一申請途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.8段

en.q: An MSO seeks a licence under a regulation made under the UNSO to deal with funds owned by a designated entity. To whom should it write?
options: The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Security Bureau, which handles UNATMO licence applications instead
The Customs and Excise Department, the AMLO's supervisory authority
The United Nations Security Council, which decides on designations
en.explain: ¶6.8 states that the Chief Executive may grant a licence under the relevant UNSO regulation, and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau. The Security Bureau instead handles UNATMO licence applications (¶6.6); the Customs and Excise Department supervises AMLO compliance generally (¶1.15) but is not the UNSO licensing addressee; and the UNSC decides on designations (¶6.7) but does not itself process licence applications.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者根據《聯合國制裁條例》下訂立的規例，尋求許可證以處理某被指定實體所擁有的資金。它應向哪一機構提出？
options: 商務及經濟發展局——《聯合國制裁條例》許可證申請的接收機構
保安局——處理《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》下的許可證申請
香港海關——《打擊洗錢條例》的一般監管及發牌機構
聯合國安全理事會——負責議決被指定人士及實體的名單
tc.explain: 第6.8段訂明行政長官可根據《聯合國制裁條例》下的相關規例批出許可證，而尋求該等許可證的金錢服務經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局。保安局處理的則是《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》下的許可證申請（第6.6段）；香港海關是《打擊洗錢條例》的一般監管機構（第1.15段），但並非《聯合國制裁條例》許可證申請的接收機構；聯合國安全理事會議決指定名單（第6.7段），但本身並不處理許可證申請。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: Which UNSCR represents the global limb of the UN Security Council's two-tiered approach to combating proliferation financing?
en.explain: ¶6.9 states that the UNSC adopts a two-tiered approach: a global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successor resolutions, and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran. UNSCR 1373 concerns terrorist financing.

tc.q: 聯合國安理會打擊擴散資金籌集的雙層方針中，哪一項決議屬全球性的一環？
tc.explain: 第6.9段訂明聯合國安理會採取雙層方針：根據第1540號決議（2004年）及其後續決議的全球性方針，以及根據針對朝鮮的第1718號決議（2006年）及針對伊朗的第2231號決議（2015年）的國別方針。第1373號決議關乎恐怖分子資金籌集。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: UNSCR 1718 (2006) and its successor resolutions form the country-specific limb of the counter-proliferation approach in respect of which country?
options: North Korea (the DPRK)
Iran (the Islamic Republic)
Russia (the Russian Federation)
Iraq (the Republic of Iraq)
en.explain: ¶6.9 identifies the country-specific approach as UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK (North Korea) and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran, together with their successor resolutions. Iran is named in ¶6.9 but under UNSCR 2231, not 1718; Russia and Iraq are not named in ¶6.9 at all.

tc.q: 第1718號決議（2006年）及其後續決議所構成的打擊擴散資金籌集國別方針，是針對哪一個國家？
options: 朝鮮（朝鮮民主主義人民共和國）
伊朗（伊朗伊斯蘭共和國，位於中東）
俄羅斯（俄羅斯聯邦，位於東歐及北亞）
伊拉克（伊拉克共和國，位於中東）
tc.explain: 第6.9段指出國別方針為針對朝鮮（朝鮮民主主義人民共和國）的第1718號決議（2006年）及針對伊朗的第2231號決議（2015年），連同其後續決議。伊朗雖見於第6.9段，但所涉的是第2231號決議而非第1718號；俄羅斯及伊拉克則完全未見於第6.9段。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: Under which Chapter of the UN Charter does the UN Security Council adopt the resolutions imposing mandatory counter-proliferation obligations on member states?
