Members of the public may inspect the register only after first paying the $260 fee prescribed for a copy under Schedule 3A.
The register is an internal Customs and Excise database that is not open to public inspection.
The register of licensees is maintained by the Companies Registry rather than the Commissioner.
en.explain: Section 27(2)-(4) requires the Commissioner to keep the register at his office and lets the public inspect it free of charge during normal office hours; a certified copy of an entry costs the Schedule 3 fee of $160 under section 28(1). The $260 figure belongs to the different register kept under Schedule 3A for Part 5A, inspection is not confined to Customs staff, and the register is kept by the Commissioner, not the Companies Registry.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者持牌人登記冊，下列哪項正確？
options: 關長須備存持牌人登記冊，供公眾於辦公時間內免費查閱
公眾須先繳付附表3A訂明的260元費用，方可查閱登記冊
登記冊屬海關內部資料庫，不對公眾開放查閱
持牌人登記冊由公司註冊處備存，而非由關長備存
tc.explain: 第27(2)至(4)條規定關長須在其辦事處備存登記冊，並供公眾於一般辦公時間內免費查閱；根據第28(1)條，登記冊記項的核證副本則須繳付附表3訂明的160元費用。260元屬附表3A就第5A部登記冊所訂的費用，並非本登記冊的費用；查閱亦不限於海關人員；登記冊由關長備存，並非由公司註冊處備存。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第2(1)條

en.q: Where in the AMLO are the interpretation provisions that apply to the Ordinance set out?
options: Schedule 1
Schedule 2
Part 1, section 3
Schedule 3
en.explain: Section 2(1) provides that Schedule 1 contains interpretation provisions that apply to the Ordinance in accordance with their terms. Schedule 2 sets out the CDD and record-keeping requirements, and Schedule 3 specifies fees.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》中，適用於該條例的釋義條文載於何處？
options: 附表1
附表2
第1部第3條
附表3
tc.explain: 第2(1)條訂明附表1載有按其條款適用於本條例的釋義條文。附表2訂立客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定，附表3則訂明費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第2(2)條

en.q: Who may amend Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO, and by what means?
options: The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, by notice in the Gazette
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, using the section 6 power to amend Schedule 2
The Chief Executive in Council, by subsidiary legislation published in the Gazette
The Review Tribunal, by a determination made on a licensee's application for review
en.explain: Section 2(2) empowers only the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury to amend Part 2 of Schedule 1 by Gazette notice. Section 6 gives the Secretary - not the Commissioner - the parallel power to amend Schedule 2; the Chief Executive in Council and the Review Tribunal have no role in amending either Schedule.

tc.q: 何人可以何種方式修訂《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部？
options: 財經事務及庫務局局長，以憲報公告方式
關長，以第6條修訂附表2的權力方式
行政長官會同行政會議，以憲報刊登附屬法例方式
覆核審裁處，以就持牌人覆核申請作出的裁定方式
tc.explain: 第2(2)條只賦權財經事務及庫務局局長以憲報公告修訂附表1第2部。第6條賦予局長（並非關長）修訂附表2的相應權力；行政長官會同行政會議及覆核審裁處均無權修訂任何一份附表。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第3條

en.q: Does the AMLO apply to the Government?
options: Yes — it applies to the Government except as otherwise expressly provided
No — the Government is wholly exempt from the Ordinance
Only the provisions in Part 2 apply to the Government
It applies to the Government only with the Financial Secretary's consent
en.explain: Section 3 states that the Ordinance applies to the Government, except as otherwise expressly provided. An example of an express exception is section 25, under which Part 5 does not apply to the Government.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》是否適用於政府？
options: 適用——除另有明文規定外，該條例適用於政府
不適用——政府完全獲豁免
只有第2部的條文適用於政府
須經財政司司長同意方適用於政府
tc.explain: 第3條訂明除另有明文規定外，本條例適用於政府。明文例外的一個例子是第25條，據此第5部並不適用於政府。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4(1)條

en.q: In what circumstances does section 4 of the AMLO protect a relevant authority from civil liability?
options: For anything done or omitted in good faith while performing a function conferred or imposed under the Ordinance
For anything done in the performance of its functions, whether or not it was done in good faith or with reasonable care
Only for acts done with the prior written approval of the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
Only for acts done in the course of a routine inspection conducted under section 9 of the Ordinance
en.explain: Section 4(1) protects a relevant authority or any other person from civil liability only for anything done or omitted in good faith in the performance or purported performance of a function conferred or imposed under the Ordinance. Good faith is the sole condition - there is no requirement of prior approval by the Secretary and no limitation to section 9 inspections, and the protection does not extend to acts done without good faith.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4條在甚麼情況下保障有關當局免負民事法律責任？
options: 就其真誠地執行本條例所授予或委予的職能時作出或不作出的任何事情
就其執行職能時作出或不作出的任何事情，不論是否真誠或是否小心謹慎
只限經財經事務及庫務局局長事先書面批准而作出的作為
只限在根據第9條進行的例行視察過程中作出的作為
tc.explain: 第4(1)條規定，有關當局或任何其他人就其真誠地執行或看來是執行本條例所授予或委予的職能時所作出或不作出的任何事情，均不招致民事法律責任；「真誠」是唯一條件，並不視乎該人是否小心謹慎。條文並無局長事先批准或僅限例行視察的限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4(2)條

en.q: What is the effect of the immunity in section 4(1) on the Government's own liability for acts of a public officer?
options: It does not affect the Government's liability for a public officer's act or omission in performing that function
It extinguishes the Government's liability for the officer's act or omission entirely
It transfers the Government's liability for the act to the individual public officer personally
It suspends the Government's liability for the act until the Tribunal determines the matter under section 61
en.explain: Section 4(2) provides that the protection conferred by subsection (1) does not affect any liability of the Government for the thing done or omitted by a public officer in the performance or purported performance of the relevant function. The immunity shields the individual officer only - it does not extinguish, transfer, or suspend the Government's own liability, and section 61 (Review Tribunal powers) has no role here.

tc.q: 第4(1)條的免責保障，對政府就公職人員的作為所負的法律責任有何影響？
options: 並不影響政府就公職人員在執行該職能時作出或不作出的事情所負的法律責任
完全免除政府就該公職人員作為或不作為所負的法律責任
將政府因該作為所負的法律責任轉移予該名公職人員個人承擔
暫緩政府的法律責任，直至覆核審裁處根據第61條就該事宜作出裁定為止
tc.explain: 第4(2)條訂明第(1)款所給予的保障，並不影響政府就公職人員在執行或看來是執行有關職能時作出或不作出的事情所負的任何法律責任——保障只及於該名公職人員個人，法律責任並非被免除、轉移或暫緩；第61條（覆核審裁處的權力）與此無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(2)條

en.q: In relation to an authorized insurer, Schedule 2 has effect only in relation to what?
options: Long term business carried on by the insurer
General insurance business carried on by the insurer
Reinsurance contracts entered into by the insurer
Business written through licensed insurance brokers
en.explain: Section 5(2) provides that Schedule 2 has effect with respect to an authorized insurer only in relation to long term business carried on by the insurer, as defined by section 2(1) of the Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41).

tc.q: 就認可保險人而言，附表2只就甚麼具有效力？
options: 該保險人所經營的長期業務
該保險人所經營的一般保險業務
該保險人訂立的再保險合約
透過持牌保險經紀承保的業務
tc.explain: 第5(2)條訂明，就認可保險人而言，附表2只就該保險人所經營的長期業務具有效力；「長期業務」的涵義見《保險業條例》（第41章）第2(1)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(4)條

en.q: Schedule 2 applies to the issue of a stored value facility by an SVF licensee or a bank only if which conditions are met?
options: The maximum storable value exceeds $3,000, and it is a physical device on which the issuer stores the value
The maximum storable value exceeds $8,000, and the facility is issued only to a corporate customer
The facility is issued to a customer not ordinarily resident in Hong Kong, regardless of the value
The facility can be used to make cross-border payments, regardless of its maximum storable value
en.explain: Section 5(4) provides that Schedule 2 applies to the issue of a stored value facility only if (a) the maximum value that can be stored on it exceeds $3,000, and (b) it is a physical device provided by the issuer to the user with the value stored on the device. $8,000 is not the statutory threshold, and section 5(4) does not turn on the customer's residence or on cross-border payment capability.

tc.q: 附表2只在符合哪些條件時，方適用於儲值支付工具持牌人或銀行發行儲值支付工具？
options: 該工具可儲存的最高價值超過3,000元，且屬發行人在其上儲存價值的實物裝置
該工具可儲存的最高價值超過8,000元，且屬發行人只提供予公司客戶的裝置
該工具發行予的客戶並非通常居於香港，不論其可儲存的價值多寡
該工具可用作跨境付款或本地付款，不論其可儲存的最高價值多寡
tc.explain: 第5(4)條訂明，附表2只在下列情況下適用於發行儲值支付工具：(a)可儲存的最高價值超過3,000元；及(b)屬發行人提供予用戶、並在其上儲存價值的實物裝置。8,000元並非條文所訂的門檻；條文沒有將適用範圍限於公司客戶、非香港居民客戶，或可作跨境付款的工具。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(5)(b)條

en.q: A financial institution knowingly contravenes a specified provision and is dealt with on summary conviction. What is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment
A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 3 months
en.explain: Section 5(5) provides two penalty limbs: on conviction on indictment, a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years; on summary conviction, a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months. The $500,000 and 1-year limb applies on summary conviction to the intent-to-defraud offence under section 5(6).

tc.q: 某金融機構在知情下違反指明的條文，並循簡易程序被定罪。最高刑罰為何？
options: 第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款500,000元及監禁1年
第5級罰款及監禁3個月
tc.explain: 第5(5)條訂明兩項刑罰：循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年；循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。罰款500,000元及監禁1年一項，適用於第5(6)條意圖欺騙罪行的簡易程序定罪。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(6)(b)條

en.q: A financial institution contravenes a specified provision with intent to defraud a relevant authority and is dealt with on summary conviction. What is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
en.explain: Section 5(6) provides that where the contravention is with intent to defraud a relevant authority, the penalty on conviction on indictment is a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years, and on summary conviction a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.

tc.q: 某金融機構意圖欺騙有關當局而違反指明的條文，並循簡易程序被定罪。最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款500,000元及監禁1年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
tc.explain: 第5(6)條訂明，如屬意圖欺騙有關當局而作出的違反，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年，循簡易程序定罪則可處罰款500,000元及監禁1年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(9)條

en.q: What statutory defence is available to an employee charged under section 5(7) with knowingly causing or permitting a financial institution to contravene a specified provision?
options: That the person acted under the institution's compliance policies and procedures
That the person was acting on the express instructions of a senior manager of the institution
That the person had completed AML/CFT training within the preceding 12 months
That the person derived no personal financial benefit or other advantage from the contravention
en.explain: Section 5(9) provides that in proceedings under subsection (7) against an employee, it is a defence for the person to prove that he or she acted in accordance with the policies and procedures established and maintained by the financial institution for the purpose of ensuring compliance with the relevant specified provision. Acting on a manager's instructions, prior training, or absence of personal gain are not defences recognised by section 5(9).

tc.q: 僱員如被控違反第5(7)條，即在知情下導致或准許金融機構違反指明的條文，可援引甚麼法定免責辯護？
options: 該人是按照該機構為確保合規而設的政策及程序行事
該人當時是按照該機構一名高級經理就此發出的明確指示行事
該人在緊接之前的12個月內已完成打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓
該人並無從有關違反行為中獲得任何個人經濟利益或其他好處
tc.explain: 第5(9)條訂明，在針對僱員而根據第(7)款提起的法律程序中，如該人證明其是按照該金融機構為確保遵守有關指明的條文而制定及維持的政策及程序行事，即可作為免責辯護。按上級指示行事、曾接受培訓或未獲個人利益，均非第5(9)條承認的免責辯護。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(10)條

en.q: Where a partnership is convicted of an offence under section 5, out of what is the fine to be paid?
options: Out of the funds of the partnership itself
Out of the personal assets of all the partners, held jointly and severally
Out of the personal assets of the partner who committed the offence
Out of the personal assets of the partnership's managing partner alone
en.explain: Section 5(10) provides that a fine imposed on a partnership on its conviction of an offence under that section is to be paid out of the funds of the partnership — not out of any partner's personal assets, whether that of all partners jointly, the partner responsible, or the managing partner alone.

tc.q: 合夥被裁定犯第5條所訂罪行時，罰款須從何處支付？
options: 該合夥本身的資金
所有合夥人的個人資產，共同及各別承擔
犯罪的合夥人的個人資產
該合夥的管理合夥人的個人資產
tc.explain: 第5(10)條訂明，合夥因犯該條所訂罪行而被定罪時所判處的罰款，須從該合夥的資金中支付——並非從任何合夥人的個人資產支付，不論是全體合夥人共同承擔、犯罪的合夥人，或管理合夥人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第6條

en.q: Who may amend Schedule 2 to the AMLO?
options: The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, by notice
The Financial Secretary, by notice published in the Gazette
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, by written direction to licensees
The Review Tribunal, upon an application made by a licensee
en.explain: Section 6 provides that the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Schedule 2 — the same officer and mechanism used in section 2(2) to amend Part 2 of Schedule 1. The Financial Secretary is a distinct office that appoints investigators under section 11(2)(a); it has no power under section 6.

tc.q: 何人可修訂《打擊洗錢條例》附表2？
options: 財經事務及庫務局局長，以憲報
財政司司長，以憲報公告方式
海關關長，以書面指示方式知會持牌人
覆核審裁處，應持牌人提出的申請
tc.explain: 第6條訂明財經事務及庫務局局長可藉憲報公告修訂附表2，與第2(2)條就附表1第2部所用的官員及方式相同。財政司司長是另一個職位，只在第11(2)(a)條下根據《外匯基金條例》委任調查員，並無第6條下的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第7(1)條

en.q: Under section 7(1) of the AMLO, what may a relevant authority or regulatory body publish in the Gazette?
options: Any guideline appropriate for the operation of Schedule 2
A list of every licensee subject to disciplinary action
The names of persons refused a licence in the past year
The minutes of the Review Tribunal's proceedings on licence refusals
en.explain: Section 7(1) provides that a relevant authority or a regulatory body may publish in the Gazette any guideline that it considers appropriate for providing guidance in relation to the operation of any provision of Schedule 2 — the basis for the AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs. Section 7 does not empower publication of disciplinary lists, refusal names, or tribunal minutes; those are not guidelines on the operation of Schedule 2.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7(1)條，有關當局或監管團體可在憲報公布甚麼？
options: 就附表2的運作提供指引的指引
曾被採取紀律行動的每名持牌人的名單
上一年度被拒發牌照的人的姓名
覆核審裁處就拒絕發牌個案聆訊的紀錄
tc.explain: 第7(1)條訂明，有關當局或監管團體可在憲報公布其認為適合就附表2任何條文的運作提供指引的任何指引——《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》即據此發出。第7條並無授權公布紀律行動名單、拒發牌照名單或覆核審裁處聆訊紀錄；該等資料並非就附表2運作發出的指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(1A)(a)條；第8條

en.q: At what time may an authorized person enter the business premises of an inspection subject for a routine inspection?
options: At any reasonable time
Only between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. on a business day
Only after giving the inspection subject 14 days' written notice
Only when accompanied by a police officer
en.explain: Section 9(1A) provides that, for the purpose of ascertaining compliance with a prescribed requirement, an authorized person may at any reasonable time enter the business premises of the inspection subject, inspect and copy specified business records, and make inquiries. No advance notice period is prescribed.

tc.q: 獲授權人可在甚麼時間進入視察對象的業務處所進行例行視察？
options: 任何合理時間
只限營業日上午9時至下午5時
只限向視察對象發出14日書面通知後
只限在警務人員陪同下
tc.explain: 第9(1A)條訂明，為確定是否遵從訂明規定，獲授權人可在任何合理時間進入視察對象的業務處所、視察及複製指明業務紀錄，以及作出查詢。條文並無訂明預先通知期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(15)(f)條

en.q: For the purposes of section 9, what are the “business premises” of a licensed money service operator?
options: Any premises where the licensee may operate a money service
Its premises as approved by the Securities and Futures Commission under the SFO
Any premises the operator uses in connection with its business generally
The operator's principal place of business in Hong Kong, wherever situated
en.explain: Section 9(15)(f) defines business premises, for a licensed MSO, as any premises at which the licensee may operate a money service as shown in the register maintained under section 27 — not simply any premises it uses or occupies. The other options describe how ‘business premises’ is defined for different regulated persons under the same subsection: paragraph (b) for a licensed corporation (SFC-approved premises), paragraph (c) for an authorized insurer (any premises used in connection with its business), and paragraph (a) for an authorized institution (its principal place of business). None of those definitions applies to an MSO.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，持牌金錢服務經營者的「業務處所」指甚麼？
options: 登記冊所示，該持牌人可經營金錢服務的處所
根據《證券及期貨條例》經證監會批准作為其處所
該經營者在一般業務上使用的任何處所
該經營者在香港的主要營業地點，不論位於何處
tc.explain: 第9(15)(f)條就持牌金錢服務經營者界定「業務處所」，指根據第27條備存的登記冊所顯示，該持牌人可經營金錢服務的處所——並非其使用或占用的任何處所。其餘選項描述的是同一款下其他受規管人士的「業務處所」定義：(b)項為持牌法團（經證監會批准的處所）、(c)項為認可保險人（在業務上使用的任何處所）、(a)項為認可機構（其主要營業地點）。該等定義均不適用於金錢服務經營者。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(6)條

en.q: When may an authorized person make inquiries of an information holder rather than of the inspection subject itself?
options: Only if the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe it cannot be obtained from the inspection subject
At any time, entirely at the authorized person's own discretion and without any threshold
Only where the inspection subject has already been convicted of an offence under section 5 or 10 within the last year
Only with the inspection subject's prior written consent to the making of the inquiry
en.explain: Section 9(6) provides that an authorized person may only exercise the power to make inquiries of an information holder if the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe that the information sought cannot be obtained from the inspection subject; section 9(7) applies the same limitation to record production. There is no unfettered discretion, no conviction requirement, and no consent requirement in section 9(6).

tc.q: 獲授權人在甚麼情況下方可向資料持有人（而非視察對象本身）作出查詢？
options: 只限獲授權人有合理因由相信有關資料無法從視察對象取得
任何時間，由獲授權人自行酌情決定，並無任何門檻限制
只限視察對象已被裁定犯第5或10條所訂罪行
只限事先取得視察對象對該項查詢的書面同意
tc.explain: 第9(6)條訂明，獲授權人只有在有合理因由相信所尋求的資料無法從視察對象取得時，方可行使向資料持有人作出查詢的權力；第9(7)條就交出紀錄施加相同限制。第9(6)條並無賦予不受限制的酌情權，亦無須視察對象被定罪或同意。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(9)條

en.q: After a person gives an answer to a requirement imposed under section 9, what further step may the authorized person require in writing?
options: That the person verify the answer by statutory declaration within a specified time
That the person declare by statutory declaration they lack the relevant knowledge
That the person produce the original record used to prepare the answer
That the person publish a correction of the answer in the Gazette
en.explain: Section 9(9) provides that if a person gives an answer under subsection (3) or (5), the authorized person may in writing require the person to verify the answer by statutory declaration within the specified time. That is a different power from section 9(10), which lets the authorized person require a statutory declaration of the fact and reason where a person does NOT give an answer because the information is outside their knowledge; section 9(9) applies only once an answer has actually been given.

tc.q: 某人就第9條下施加的規定作出答覆後，獲授權人可以書面要求該人再採取甚麼步驟？
options: 在指明時間內以法定聲明核實該答覆
以法定聲明聲明並不知悉有關資料
交出用以擬備該答覆的紀錄正本
在憲報刊登該答覆的更正
tc.explain: 第9(9)條訂明，如某人按照第(3)或(5)款所施加的規定作出答覆，獲授權人可以書面要求該人在指明時間內以法定聲明核實該答覆。這與第9(10)條不同——第(10)款適用於某人因有關資料非其所知悉而未能作出答覆的情況，容許獲授權人要求以法定聲明核實該事實及理由；第9(9)條則只適用於已實際作出答覆的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(14)條

en.q: What must an authorized person do when exercising a power under section 9?
options: Produce a copy of the relevant authority's authorization
Obtain a warrant from a magistrate before entering any premises
Give the inspection subject written notice seven days in advance
Notify the Review Tribunal in writing that the power is being exercised
en.explain: Section 9(14) requires an authorized person, when exercising a power under the section, to produce a copy of the relevant authority's authorization for inspection as soon as reasonably practicable; section 9(13) requires the relevant authority to have provided that authorization in the first place. Section 9 contains no warrant requirement, no fixed notice period, and no duty to notify the Review Tribunal — inspections are administrative, not judicial or tribunal-supervised.

tc.q: 獲授權人在行使第9條下的權力時，必須怎樣做？
options: 出示有關當局的授權書副本
在進入任何處所前取得裁判官手令
向視察對象發出7日書面預先通知
以書面通知覆核審裁處正在行使該權力
tc.explain: 第9(14)條規定獲授權人在行使該條下的權力時，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快出示有關當局的授權書副本；第9(13)條則規定有關當局須先向獲授權人提供該授權書。第9條並無手令規定、並無固定通知期，亦無須知會覆核審裁處——視察屬行政性質，並非司法或由覆核審裁處監督的程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(1)及(2)條

en.q: A person, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9. On conviction on indictment, what is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
en.explain: Section 10(2)(a) sets the penalty for the section 10(1) offence at a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 5 and 6 months' imprisonment on summary conviction. The heavier penalties apply to the false-information and intent-to-defraud offences.

tc.q: 某人無合理辯解而沒有遵從第9條下施加的規定。循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
tc.explain: 第10(2)(a)條就第10(1)條罪行訂明，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款200,000元及監禁1年；循簡易程序定罪則可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。較重刑罰適用於提供虛假資料及意圖欺騙的罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(3)及(4)條

en.q: A person produces a record that is false or misleading in a material particular in purported compliance with a section 9 requirement. What mental element must be proved?
options: That the person knew or was reckless that the record was false or misleading
That the person had no reasonable excuse for failing to comply with the requirement
That the person acted with intent to defraud the relevant authority
Nothing — section 10(3) creates an offence of strict liability
en.explain: Section 10(3) requires proof that the person knew that, or was reckless as to whether, the record, document or answer was false or misleading in a material particular — it is not a strict liability offence. ‘No reasonable excuse for failing to comply’ is the mental element of the separate, lesser offence under section 10(1) (simple non-compliance); ‘intent to defraud’ belongs to the more serious offence under section 10(6), which carries up to 7 years’ imprisonment rather than 2.

tc.q: 某人在看來是遵從第9條規定的情況下，交出在要項上虛假或具誤導性的紀錄。須證明甚麼心理要素？
options: 該人知道或罔顧該紀錄是否虛假或具誤導性
該人沒有合理辯解而未有遵從有關規定
該人意圖欺騙有關當局而行事
無須證明——第10(3)條訂立的是嚴格責任罪行
tc.explain: 第10(3)條規定須證明該人知道或罔顧該紀錄、文件或答覆是否在要項上虛假或具誤導性——並非嚴格責任罪行。「沒有合理辯解而未有遵從規定」是第10(1)條另一項較輕罪行（單純不遵從規定）的心理要素；「意圖欺騙」則屬第10(6)條下更嚴重的罪行，最高可處監禁7年，而非2年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(5)至(9)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for failing to comply with a section 9 requirement with intent to defraud?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Section 10(9) provides that a person who commits an offence under subsection (5), (6), (7) or (8) — the intent-to-defraud offences — is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years, and on summary conviction to a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 意圖欺騙而沒有遵從第9條規定，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款500,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第10(9)條訂明，犯第(5)、(6)、(7)或(8)款所訂罪行（即意圖欺騙的罪行）的人，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(11)條

en.q: For the purposes of the section 10 offences, who is a “related person” of an obligated person?
options: A person who is an employee of, employed to work for, or concerned in the management of, that person
Any person entitled to or controlling more than 25% of that person's capital or profits
Any information holder as defined in section 9 in relation to that person
Any person appointed as an investigator under section 11 in relation to that person in the past 12 months
en.explain: Section 10(11) defines a related person, in relation to a first-mentioned person, as a person who is an employee of that person, is employed to work for that person, or is concerned in the management of that person; sections 10(7) and (8) create offences for such persons who, with intent to defraud, cause or allow non-compliance. Holding more than 25% of capital or profits is instead the section 24 threshold for an ‘ultimate owner’; an ‘information holder’ is a section 9 term for someone who may hold relevant records; and an investigator is appointed under section 11 — none of these is a ‘related person’ under section 10.

tc.q: 就第10條的罪行而言，何人屬有責任的人的「相關人士」？
options: 屬該人的僱員、受僱為該人工作，或參與該人管理的人
有權享有或控制該人超過25%資本或利潤的任何人
根據第9條就該人而言屬資料持有人的任何人
根據第11條在12個月內就該人獲委任為調查員的任何人
tc.explain: 第10(11)條就首述的人界定「相關人士」，指屬該人的僱員、受僱為該人工作，或參與該人的管理的人；第10(7)及(8)條就該等人意圖欺騙而導致或容許不遵從規定訂立罪行。持有超過25%資本或利潤則是第24條「最終擁有人」的門檻；「資料持有人」是第9條下可能持有相關紀錄的人的用詞；調查員則根據第11條獲委任——三者均非第10條下的「相關人士」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(2)(d)條

en.q: In relation to the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, who are the persons who may be directed to investigate a matter under section 11?
options: Any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department
Any public officer, whichever government department employs him or her
Only Customs and Excise officers of the rank of inspector or above
Persons appointed by the Financial Secretary under the Exchange Fund Ordinance
en.explain: Section 11(2)(d) specifies that, in relation to the Commissioner, the persons who may be directed to investigate are public officers employed in the Customs and Excise Department — there is no restriction to a particular rank, and the power is not open to public officers generally. Paragraph (a) instead specifies persons appointed by the Financial Secretary under the Exchange Fund Ordinance, which applies only to the Monetary Authority.

tc.q: 就海關關長而言，根據第11條可獲指示調查事宜的是哪些人？
options: 任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員
任何公職人員，不論受僱於哪個政府部門
只限職級為督察或以上的海關人員
財政司司長根據《外匯基金條例》委任的人
tc.explain: 第11(2)(d)條訂明，就海關關長而言，可獲指示進行調查的是受僱於香港海關的公職人員——並無職級限制，亦不開放予一般公職人員。(a)項則就金融管理專員訂明是財政司司長根據《外匯基金條例》委任的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(1)條

en.q: Whose consent is required before a relevant authority may appoint a person other than a specified public officer to investigate a matter under section 11?
options: The Financial Secretary
The Chief Executive in Council
The Review Tribunal
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
en.explain: Section 11(1) provides that the relevant authority may in writing direct one or more of the persons specified in subsection (2) or, with the consent of the Financial Secretary, appoint one or more other persons to investigate the matter. Section 11(3) allows the costs of such an appointee to be met out of moneys provided by the Legislative Council.

tc.q: 有關當局根據第11條委任第(2)款所指明公職人員以外的人進行調查前，須取得何人同意？
options: 財政司司長
行政長官會同行政會議
審裁處
財經事務及庫務局局長
tc.explain: 第11(1)條訂明，有關當局可以書面指示第(2)款所指明的一名或多於一名人士，或在取得財政司司長同意下，委任一名或多於一名其他人調查有關事宜。第11(3)條准許該等獲委任者的費用由立法會撥款支付。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「最終擁有人」的定義）

en.q: In relation to a partnership, what threshold makes an individual an “ultimate owner” for the purposes of Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: Directly or indirectly entitled to or controlling more than 25% of the capital or profits
Entitlement to or control of at least 10% of the capital or profits of the partnership
Being named as a partner in the partnership agreement, whatever the share
Entitlement to exercise or control exactly 25% of the voting rights for at least twelve months
en.explain: The definition of ultimate owner in section 24 covers, for a partnership, an individual entitled to or controlling directly or indirectly more than a 25% share of the capital or profits, entitled to exercise or control more than 25% of the voting rights, or exercising ultimate control over management. Exactly 25% of the voting rights does not cross the ‘more than 25%’ threshold, a 10% share is too low, and being named a partner does not by itself meet any of the three limbs.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，個人須符合甚麼門檻方屬合夥的「最終擁有人」？
options: 直接或間接有權享有或控制超過25%的資本或利潤
有權享有或控制至少10%的資本或利潤
在合夥協議中被列名為合夥人，不論份額多少
有權行使或控制恰好25%的投票權，為期須達12個月
tc.explain: 第24條「最終擁有人」的定義就合夥而言，涵蓋直接或間接有權享有或控制超過25%資本或利潤份額的個人、有權行使或控制超過25%投票權的個人，或對該合夥的管理行使最終控制權的個人。恰好25%的投票權未達「超過25%」的門檻，10%的份額過低，而僅在協議中被列名為合夥人本身並不符合三項條件中的任何一項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「最終擁有人」的定義）

en.q: In relation to a corporation, which of the following makes an individual an “ultimate owner” under Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: Owning or controlling more than 25% of the issued share capital
Owning more than 10% of the corporation's issued share capital, directly or indirectly
Being entitled to exercise exactly 25% of the voting rights at the corporation's general meetings
Holding any shareholding at all through a trust, regardless of its proportional size
en.explain: The section 24 definition covers, for a corporation, an individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly and including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital; is entitled to exercise or control more than 25% of the voting rights at general meetings; or exercises ultimate control over management. A 10% shareholding and a trust holding ‘of any size’ both fall below the more-than-25% threshold, and exactly 25% of the voting rights does not exceed it either — the threshold applies regardless of how the interest is held.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，下列何者令個人成為法團的「最終擁有人」？
options: 直接或間接擁有或控制超過25%的已發行股本
直接或間接擁有該法團超過10%的已發行股本
在該法團股東大會上行使恰好25%的投票權
透過信託持有任何比例的股份，不論比例多寡
tc.explain: 第24條的定義就法團而言，涵蓋直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本的個人、有權在股東大會上行使或控制超過25%投票權的個人，或對管理行使最終控制權的個人。10%的股權及「不論比例多寡」的信託持股均未達超過25%的門檻，恰好25%的投票權同樣未超過該門檻——不論權益以何種方式持有，門檻要求不變。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「董事」的定義）

en.q: How is “director” defined for the purposes of Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: It includes any person occupying the position of director by whatever name called
It is confined to persons registered as directors at the Companies Registry
It excludes non-executive directors
It means only the director nominated to sit the Competence Assessment
en.explain: Section 24 provides that director includes any person occupying the position of director by whatever name called. The substance of the role, not the formal title or registration, determines whether a person is a director for Part 5 purposes.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，「董事」如何界定？
options: 包括擔任董事職位的任何人，不論其職銜為何
只限在公司註冊處正式登記為董事的人
不包括非執行董事
只指獲提名參加能力評核的董事
tc.explain: 第24條訂明「董事」包括擔任董事職位的任何人，不論其職銜為何。就第5部而言，決定某人是否董事的是其職位的實質，而非正式職銜或登記。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第25條

en.q: A licensed corporation operates a money service that is ancillary to its principal business. What is its position under Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: Part 5 does not apply to it
It must obtain an MSO licence in addition to its existing licence
It must obtain the Commissioner's written exemption each year
Part 5 applies to it only in respect of remittance, not money changing
en.explain: Section 25 provides that Part 5 does not apply to the Government, nor to an authorized institution, nor to a licensed corporation, authorized insurer, licensed insurance broker company, licensed individual insurance agent, licensed insurance agency, SVF licensee or certain other bodies that operate a money service ancillary to their principal business.

tc.q: 某持牌法團經營附屬於其主要業務的金錢服務。就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部而言，其處境為何？
options: 第5部並不適用於該法團
除現有牌照外，還須取得金錢服務經營者牌照
須每年取得海關關長的書面豁免
第5部只就匯款（而非貨幣兌換）適用於該法團
tc.explain: 第25條訂明第5部並不適用於政府，亦不適用於認可機構，以及經營附屬於其主要業務的金錢服務的持牌法團、認可保險人、持牌保險經紀公司、持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構、儲值支付工具持牌人及若干其他團體。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第26條

en.q: To whom may the Commissioner of Customs and Excise delegate functions under the AMLO, and which functions may not be delegated?
options: To any Customs and Excise public officer, except the section 26 and 51 functions
To any Customs and Excise public officer, with no exceptions at all
To any Customs and Excise public officer, except the power to grant or renew licences
To Customs and Excise or Police officers, except the sections 26 and 51 functions
en.explain: Section 26(1) permits the Commissioner to delegate in writing any function under the Ordinance to any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department — not to the Police — while section 26(2) prohibits delegation only of the functions under section 26 itself and under section 51 (regulations). It does not carve out the power to grant or renew licences, and it is not an unlimited power with no exceptions at all.

tc.q: 海關關長可將《打擊洗錢條例》下的職能轉授何人？哪些職能不得轉授？
options: 可轉授予任何海關公職人員，但第26及51條的職能除外
可轉授予任何海關公職人員，並無任何例外
可轉授予任何海關公職人員，但批出或續期牌照的權力除外
可轉授予海關或警務人員，但第26及51條的職能除外
tc.explain: 第26(1)條准許海關關長以書面將本條例下的任何職能轉授予任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員——並非警務人員；第26(2)條則只禁止轉授第26條本身及第51條（訂立規例）下的職能，並無將批出或續期牌照的權力剔除，也並非全無例外的無限權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27(3)及(4)條

en.q: On what terms may a member of the public inspect the register of licensees?
options: Without charge, during normal office hours, for verification purposes
On payment of the Schedule 3 fee, at any time of day or night
Only with the written permission of the licensee whose entry is inspected
Only if the person is a party to a transaction currently under investigation
en.explain: Section 27(3) requires the register to be made available for public inspection so that a member of the public can ascertain whether he or she is dealing with a licensee, and section 27(4) entitles members of the public to inspect it without charge during normal office hours only. The Schedule 3 fee under section 28 is charged for copies or certificates, not for inspecting the register itself, and no licensee consent or investigation involvement is required.

tc.q: 公眾人士可按甚麼條件查閱持牌人登記冊？
options: 可在正常辦公時間內免費查閱，以核實
須繳付附表3訂明的費用，任何時候均可查閱
須取得該查閱所涉持牌人的書面許可
只限屬正接受調查的交易的一方人士
tc.explain: 第27(3)條規定登記冊須供公眾查閱，使公眾人士能確定其是否正與持牌人交易；第27(4)條則賦予公眾人士只在正常辦公時間內免費查閱的權利。第28條下的附表3費用是就取得副本或證明書而繳付，並非查閱登記冊本身；亦無須持牌人同意或涉及調查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27(1)條

en.q: What must the register of licensees contain in respect of a licensee who is licensed to operate a money service at specified premises?
options: The address of every premises where the licensee may operate a money service
Only the licensee's correspondence address under section 33, not any premises address
The names of all the licensee's directors and its ultimate owner(s)
The conditions endorsed on the licensee's licence under section 33
en.explain: Section 27(1) requires the register to contain the name of every licensee and, for a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises, the address of every premises at which it may operate a money service; the correspondence address applies only ‘in any other case’ — not where specified premises exist. Directors' and ultimate owners' names are not register content under section 27, and licence conditions are endorsed on the licence itself under section 33, not recorded in the register.

tc.q: 就獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務的持牌人而言，持牌人登記冊須載有甚麼？
options: 該持牌人可經營金錢服務的每一處所的地址
只有該持牌人的通訊地址，並無處所地址
該持牌人所有董事及其最終擁有人的姓名
根據第33條批註於該持牌人牌照上的條件
tc.explain: 第27(1)條規定登記冊須載有每名持牌人的名稱，以及就獲發牌在指明處所經營的持牌人而言，其可經營金錢服務的每一處所的地址；通訊地址只適用於「其他情況」——並非適用於已有指明處所的持牌人。董事及最終擁有人的姓名並非第27條下的登記冊內容；牌照條件則是根據第33條批註於牌照上，並非登記冊的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(4)條

en.q: What evidential weight does a certificate signed by the Commissioner stating that a person's name has been entered on or removed from the register carry?
options: Admissible on production without further proof, as conclusive evidence
Admissible on production, but rebuttable by contrary oral evidence
Admissible as evidence only in civil, not criminal, proceedings
No evidential value unless the Commissioner personally attends to give evidence
en.explain: Section 28(4) provides that such a certificate is admissible in evidence in any criminal or civil proceedings on production without further proof and is conclusive evidence of the facts stated — it is not merely rebuttable, is not limited to civil proceedings, and requires no attendance by the Commissioner. By contrast, a certified copy of the register under section 28(2) is only evidence, not conclusive evidence, of the facts stated.

tc.q: 由海關關長簽署、述明某人的姓名已列入或已從登記冊剔除的證明書，具有甚麼證據效力？
options: 一經出示即可獲接納為證據而無須再加證明，並為確證
一經出示可獲接納為證據，但可由相反的口頭證據推翻
只可在民事法律程序中獲接納為證據，刑事程序不可
除非海關關長親自出庭作證，否則並無任何證據價值
tc.explain: 第28(4)條訂明該等證明書在任何刑事或民事法律程序中一經出示即可獲接納為證據而無須再加證明，並為其所述事實的確證——並非僅屬可被推翻的證據，亦不限於民事程序，更無須海關關長出庭。相對而言，第28(2)條下經核證的登記冊副本只屬所述事實的證據，而非確證。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(3)條

en.q: A certified copy of the register does not show a particular person's name. What does that establish?
options: Evidence that the person was not licensed on the date the copy was certified
Conclusive proof the person committed an offence under section 29(2)(a)
A trigger requiring the Commissioner to commence disciplinary proceedings
No evidential effect at all, in any proceedings whatsoever
en.explain: Section 28(3) provides that the fact that a person's name does not appear on a copy of the register purporting to be certified by the Commissioner is evidence — not conclusive proof of an offence, and not a trigger for disciplinary action — that the person was not, at the date on which the copy is so certified, licensed. Unlike the conclusive-evidence certificate under section 28(4), a section 28(3) absence-of-entry copy is merely evidence that can be weighed with other evidence.

tc.q: 經核證的登記冊副本並無顯示某人的姓名。這確立了甚麼？
options: 屬證據，證明該人在獲核證當日並非持牌人
確證該人已犯第29(2)(a)條罪行
觸發海關關長必須展開紀律程序的規定
在任何法律程序中均無任何證據效力
tc.explain: 第28(3)條訂明，某人的姓名並無出現在看來是由海關關長核證的登記冊副本上，即屬證據——並非罪行的確證，亦不會觸發紀律程序——證明該人在該副本獲如此核證的日期並非持牌人。與第28(4)條下具確證效力的證明書不同，第28(3)條下未列名的副本只屬可與其他證據一併衡量的證據。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(3)條

en.q: In addition to any fine or imprisonment, what further order may a court make against a person convicted of operating a money service without a licence?
options: An order disqualifying the person from holding a licence for a period
An order requiring the person to pay a pecuniary penalty to the Commissioner
An order publicly reprimanding the person for the offence
An order confiscating any proceeds of the unlicensed operation
en.explain: Section 29(3) provides that, in addition to any fine or imprisonment, the court or magistrate may order that the person is to be disqualified from holding a licence for a period specified in the order. A pecuniary penalty and public reprimand are disciplinary tools used elsewhere in the Ordinance (for example under section 21, in relation to financial institutions), not orders available under section 29(3); confiscation of proceeds is likewise not a power this section confers.

tc.q: 除罰款或監禁外，法庭可對無牌經營金錢服務而被定罪的人另行作出甚麼命令？
options: 命令該人被取消持有牌照的資格
命令該人向海關關長繳付罰款，存檔
命令公開譴責該人所犯的罪行
命令沒收無牌經營所得的得益
tc.explain: 第29(3)條訂明，除罰款或監禁外，法庭或裁判官可命令該人自命令日期起，在命令所指明的期間內被取消持有牌照的資格。罰款及公開譴責是本條例其他條文（例如第21條，就金融機構而言）所用的紀律工具，並非第29(3)條下可作出的命令；沒收得益同樣不是本條賦予的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(1)條

en.q: What must accompany an application for the grant of an MSO licence?
options: The Schedule 3 fee, made in the form and manner the Commissioner specifies
The Schedule 3 fee, lodged not later than 45 days before the intended start date
A banker's guarantee for the applicant's expected annual turnover
An audited balance sheet for the preceding three financial years
en.explain: Section 30(1) requires an application for the grant of a licence to be made to the Commissioner in the form and manner specified by the Commissioner and to be accompanied by the fee specified in Schedule 3 — there is no 45-day pre-commencement deadline for a first grant. The 45-day rule instead applies to a renewal application under section 31(2)(a), which must be made not later than 45 days before the existing licence expires. No banker's guarantee or audited accounts are required by either section.

tc.q: 申請批出金錢服務經營者牌照時，須連同甚麼一併提交？
options: 附表3訂明的費用，並須按海關關長指明的格式及方式提出
附表3訂明的費用，須不遲於擬開業日期前45日提交
相當於申請人預期年度營業額的銀行擔保
過去三個財政年度的經審計資產負債表
tc.explain: 第30(1)條規定，批出牌照的申請須按海關關長指明的格式及方式向關長提出，並須連同附表3訂明的費用一併提交——首次批出牌照的申請並無45日的開業前限期。45日的規定屬第31(2)(a)條就續期申請而設，須不遲於現有牌照屆滿前45日提出。兩條均無須銀行擔保或經審計帳目。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(b)條

en.q: Where an applicant applies to operate a money service at domestic premises, what additional matter must the Commissioner be satisfied of?
options: That every occupant has given written consent for an authorized person to enter
That the applicant has secured the written consent of the premises' owner or landlord
That the applicant has secured the consent of a majority of the occupants
That the applicant has undertaken that the premises will cease to be used as a residence
en.explain: Section 30(3)(b) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that the premises are suitable for operating a money service and, where they are domestic premises, that the applicant has secured the written consent of every occupant — not merely the owner, landlord, or a majority — for an authorized person as defined by section 8 to enter for the purpose of exercising the powers under section 9. There is no requirement that the premises stop being used as a residence.

tc.q: 如申請人申請在住宅處所經營金錢服務，海關關長須另行信納甚麼事項？
options: 每名佔用人已就獲授權人進入處所作出書面同意
申請人已取得該處所業主或包租人經見證的書面同意
申請人已取得該處所過半數佔用人的同意
申請人已承諾該處所將不再作住宅用途
tc.explain: 第30(3)(b)條規定海關關長須信納該處所適合用作經營金錢服務；如屬住宅處所，申請人已取得該處所每名佔用人（並非僅業主、包租人或過半數佔用人）的書面同意，讓第8條所界定的獲授權人進入該處所行使第9條下的權力。並無規定該處所須不再作住宅用途。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(d)及(e)條

en.q: Which of the following must the Commissioner have regard to in determining whether a person is a fit and proper person under section 30?
options: Whether the individual is an undischarged bankrupt or subject to bankruptcy proceedings
Whether the person holds a recognised professional accounting qualification obtained recently
Whether the person has resided continuously in Hong Kong for at least seven years
Whether the person has previously operated a money service business outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 30(4) lists the mandatory considerations for fitness and propriety: convictions for specified offences (paragraph (a)), overseas convictions (paragraph (b)), persistent non-compliance with the Ordinance (paragraph (c)), whether an individual is an undischarged bankrupt or subject to bankruptcy proceedings (paragraph (d)), and whether a corporation is in liquidation, subject to a winding-up order, or in receivership (paragraph (e)). Accounting qualifications, length of residence, and prior overseas operation are not among the listed factors.

tc.q: 在根據第30條斷定某人是否適當人選時，海關關長須顧及下列哪項？
options: 該人未獲解除破產令或受破產程序規限
該人是否持有認可的專業會計資格
該人是否已在香港連續居住至少七年
該人此前有否在香港以外經營金錢服務業務
tc.explain: 第30(4)條列出評核適當人選資格的必須顧及事項：就指明罪行的定罪（(a)項）、海外定罪（(b)項）、持續沒有遵從本條例的規定（(c)項）、個人是否未獲解除破產令的破產人或正受破產法律程序所規限（(d)項），以及法團是否正在清盤、受清盤令或接管所規限（(e)項）。會計資格、居港年期及此前有否在海外經營，均非上述列明的事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(b)條

en.q: Which convictions outside Hong Kong must the Commissioner have regard to when assessing fitness and propriety?
options: Convictions for equivalent HK offences, ML/TF, or offences of fraud, corruption or dishonesty
Only convictions for acts that would themselves have constituted an offence under the AMLO
Convictions for any offence committed abroad that carries a term of imprisonment, whatever its nature
Only convictions handed down by a court in a jurisdiction that is a FATF member
en.explain: Section 30(4)(b) requires regard to be had to an overseas conviction for an act that would have constituted a specified Hong Kong offence, for an offence relating to money laundering or terrorist financing, or for an offence requiring a finding of fraud, corruption or dishonesty. It is not limited to acts that are themselves AMLO offences (the specified offences include ones under other ordinances too), it is not simply any imprisonable offence, and there is no FATF-membership requirement for the convicting jurisdiction.

tc.q: 在評估適當人選資格時，海關關長須顧及哪些香港以外的定罪？
options: 同等罪行、洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，或欺詐貪污不誠實罪行的定罪
只限本身已構成《打擊洗錢條例》下罪行的作為的定罪
在海外被定罪的任何可處監禁的罪行，不論其性質為何
只限由財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區的法院核實後作出的定罪
tc.explain: 第30(4)(b)條規定須顧及在香港以外地方的定罪，包括就假使在香港作出便會構成指明罪行的作為而被定罪、就與洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集有關的罪行被定罪，或就必須裁定該人欺詐地、貪污地或不誠實地行事的罪行被定罪。並不限於本身即屬《打擊洗錢條例》罪行的作為（指明罪行亦包括其他條例下的罪行），亦非泛指任何可處監禁的罪行，定罪的司法管轄區也無須為財務行動特別組織成員。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(10)條

en.q: For how long is a licence granted under section 30 valid?
options: 2 years, or any other period the Commissioner determines appropriate
2 years, or any shorter period the Commissioner determines
5 years, renewable indefinitely at the Commissioner's discretion
Until revoked or suspended, with no fixed term at all
en.explain: Section 30(10) provides that, subject to section 34, a licence granted under the section is valid for 2 years or, if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in a particular case, any OTHER period determined by the Commissioner. ‘Any shorter period’ is instead the formula used for a RENEWAL under section 31(12) — on a first grant the Commissioner may extend as well as shorten the term, not merely shorten it.

tc.q: 根據第30條批出的牌照有效期為多久？
options: 2年，或海關關長決定屬適當的任何其他期間
2年，或海關關長決定屬適當的任何較短期間
5年，並可由海關關長酌情無限次續期
直至被撤銷或暫時吊銷為止，並無固定年期
tc.explain: 第30(10)條訂明，在第34條的規限下，根據該條批出的牌照有效期為2年；如海關關長在個別情況下認為適當，則為關長決定的任何其他期間。「任何較短期間」則是第31(12)條就續期所用的字眼——首次批出牌照時，關長可延長亦可縮短期間，並非只能縮短。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(9)條

en.q: What must a notice of the Commissioner's decision to refuse to grant a licence include?
options: Reasons, and the right to apply to the Review Tribunal
The deciding officer's name and the date of the next appeal hearing
An automatic refund of the application fee paid under Schedule 3
A direction barring the applicant from re-applying for two years
en.explain: Section 30(9) requires a notice of refusal under subsection (6) or (8) to include a statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the applicant may apply to the Review Tribunal (覆核審裁處) for a review of the decision — not the deciding officer's name, an appeal-hearing date, a fee refund, or a re-application ban. Sections 31(9), 32(3) and 34(5) impose equivalent requirements.

tc.q: 海關關長拒絕批出牌照的決定通知，須載有甚麼？
options: 拒絕的理由，以及可向覆核審裁處申請覆核
作出決定的人員姓名及下次上訴聆訊日期
自動退還根據附表3已繳付的申請費用
指示申請人在兩年內不得再次申請
tc.explain: 第30(9)條規定，根據第(6)或(8)款發出的拒絕通知須載有決定理由的陳述，以及申請人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述——並非決定人員的姓名、上訴聆訊日期、退還費用或再次申請的禁令。第31(9)、32(3)及34(5)條訂有相應規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(10)條

en.q: A licensee applies to renew its licence, but the licence expires before the Commissioner determines the application. What happens to the licence?
options: It remains in force until renewed or, if refused, until the refusal takes effect
It lapses immediately on the expiry date, with no continuation
Under s.31 it is automatically renewed for a further two years, without any application
It remains in force for a maximum of 14 days after the expiry date
en.explain: Section 31(10) provides that a licence for which a renewal application has been made and which expires before determination remains in force until the licence is renewed or, if renewal is refused, until the Commissioner's decision takes effect — unless the application is withdrawn or the licence is revoked or suspended under section 34. It does not simply lapse, is not automatically renewed, and is not capped at 14 days.

tc.q: 持牌人申請續牌，但牌照在海關關長裁定申請前已屆滿。該牌照會怎樣？
options: 繼續有效，直至續期；或拒絕生效為止
於屆滿日即時失效，不獲任何延續
無須申請，自動續期兩年，每次均可
於屆滿後最多繼續有效14日
tc.explain: 第31(10)條訂明，已提出續期申請而在裁定前已屆滿的牌照，繼續有效直至牌照獲續期，或如續期被拒，直至海關關長拒絕續期的決定生效為止——除非該申請被撤回，或牌照根據第34條被撤銷或暫時吊銷。牌照並非即時失效，亦非自動續期，更沒有14日的上限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(11)條

en.q: When does a renewal granted under section 31 take effect?
options: On the day following the expiry of the licence
On the date the Commissioner signs the renewal document
On the first day of the calendar month following renewal
On the Commissioner's receipt of the renewal application
en.explain: Section 31(11) provides that a renewal takes effect on the day following the expiration of the licence or, where section 31(10) applied because the licence continued in force pending determination, on the day following the day on which the licence would have expired but for that subsection. It does not take effect on signature, on a fixed calendar date, or on mere receipt of the application.

tc.q: 根據第31條批出的續期何時生效？
options: 於牌照屆滿翌日
於海關關長簽署續期文件當日
於續期後緊接的下一個月首日
於海關關長接獲續期申請當日
tc.explain: 第31(11)條訂明，續期於牌照屆滿翌日生效；如因第31(10)款而牌照在裁定前繼續有效，則於若非該款牌照本應屆滿之日的翌日生效。續期並非於簽署時、固定月曆日期或僅於接獲申請時生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(12)條

en.q: For how long is a licence renewed under section 31 valid?
options: 2 years, or any shorter period considered appropriate
2 years in every case, with no discretion to vary it
3 years, or any longer period the Commissioner determines appropriate
The same period as the original licence, however long that was
en.explain: Section 31(12) provides that, subject to section 34, a renewed licence is valid for 2 years or, if the Commissioner considers it appropriate in a particular case, any SHORTER period determined by the Commissioner — the Commissioner has no power on renewal to extend beyond 2 years, unlike on a first grant under section 30(10), where 'any other period' (shorter or longer) may be set.

tc.q: 根據第31條續期的牌照有效期為多久？
options: 2年，或海關關長認為適當的任何較短期間
在任何情況下均為2年，並無酌情變動的權力
3年，或海關關長決定屬適當的任何較長期間
與原有牌照的期間相同，不論原有期間有多長
tc.explain: 第31(12)條訂明，在第34條的規限下，續期牌照的有效期為2年；如海關關長在個別情況下認為適當，則為關長決定的任何較短期間——關長在續期時無權將期間延長至超過2年，這與首次根據第30(10)條批出牌照時可訂定「任何其他期間」（不論較長或較短）不同。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(5)條

en.q: What may the Commissioner do to the conditions of a licence at the point of renewal?
options: Amend or remove any condition, or impose any new condition, as appropriate
Only remove existing conditions; new conditions require a separate section 32 process
Nothing at all — conditions are fixed for the entire life of the licence
Amend conditions only with the licensee's prior written agreement
en.explain: Section 31(5) provides that on renewing a licence the Commissioner may amend or remove any condition previously imposed on the licensee, or impose any new condition that the Commissioner thinks fit — the same renewal-time power covers both removing and adding conditions, without needing a separate section 32 process or the licensee's agreement. Section 32 provides a separate power to do so at other times, outside renewal.

tc.q: 海關關長在牌照續期時，可對牌照條件作出甚麼處理？
options: 修訂或移除任何條件，或施加任何新條件
只可移除現有條件；新條件須另循第32條程序施加
完全不可作任何處理——條件在牌照有效期內一律固定不變
只有在取得持牌人的事先書面同意下方可修訂條件
tc.explain: 第31(5)條訂明，海關關長在為牌照續期時，可修訂或移除先前對持牌人施加的任何條件，或施加關長認為合適的任何新條件——同一項續期時的權力已涵蓋移除及新增條件，無須另循第32條程序，亦無須持牌人同意。第32條則就在續期以外的其他時間作出上述處理另設權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第32(1)條

en.q: On what basis may the Commissioner amend, remove or impose a licence condition under section 32, outside the grant or renewal process?
options: If satisfied that it is reasonable to do so in the circumstances
Only if the licensee has been convicted of an offence under the Ordinance
Only if the Review Tribunal has directed the Commissioner to do so
Only if the licensee concerned formally requests it
en.explain: Section 32(1) permits the Commissioner, in relation to a licence, to amend or remove any condition previously imposed or impose any new condition if satisfied that it is reasonable to do so in the circumstances. No conviction, Review Tribunal (覆核審裁處) direction, or request from the licensee is required — the Commissioner may act on his or her own initiative.

tc.q: 在批出或續期程序以外，海關關長可基於甚麼理由根據第32條修訂、移除或施加牌照條件？
options: 如信納在有關情況下這樣做是合理的
只限持牌人已被裁定犯本條例所訂罪行
只限覆核審裁處已指示海關關長這樣做
只限應有關持牌人的正式要求
tc.explain: 第32(1)條准許海關關長如信納在有關情況下這樣做是合理的，即可就某牌照修訂或移除先前施加的任何條件，或施加任何新條件。並不需要有定罪、覆核審裁處的指示，或持牌人的要求——海關關長可主動行使此權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第32(4)條；第30(7)條

en.q: When does an amendment, removal or imposition of a licence condition take effect?
options: When the licensee receives the notice, or at any later time stated in it
Immediately when the Commissioner decides, before any notice is given
Fourteen days after the notice is posted to the licensee's last known address
On the next anniversary date of the original grant of the licence, not on notice
en.explain: Section 32(4), mirroring sections 30(7) and 31(7), provides that the amendment, removal or imposition of a condition takes effect at the time the notice is received by the licensee, or at the time specified in the notice, whichever is the later — not on the Commissioner's internal decision, a fixed 14-day posting period, or a licence anniversary.

tc.q: 修訂、移除或施加牌照條件何時生效？
options: 於持牌人接獲通知時，或通知指明的較遲時間
於海關關長作出決定時即時生效，毋須待通知發出
於通知寄往持牌人最後為人所知的地址後14日
於原有牌照批出日期的下一個周年日，而非通知日
tc.explain: 第32(4)條（與第30(7)及31(7)條相同）訂明，該項修訂、移除或施加於持牌人接獲通知時，或通知所指明的時間生效，以較遲者為準——並非於海關關長內部作出決定時、固定的14日郵寄期，或牌照的周年日生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第33條

en.q: Which of the following must a licence specify or be endorsed with under section 33?
options: The conditions imposed or amended under sections 30-32, and the validity period
The names of the licensee's ultimate owners and each one's percentage shareholding
The maximum value of transactions the licensee may lawfully handle each year
The identity of the authorized officer specially assigned to supervise the licensee
en.explain: Section 33 requires a licence to be in a form specified by the Commissioner and to specify the address of every premises (or the correspondence address), to be endorsed with the conditions imposed or amended under sections 30, 31 or 32, and to specify the period for which the licence is valid. It does not record ultimate owners' shareholdings, a transaction value cap, or a named supervising officer.

tc.q: 根據第33條，牌照須指明或批註下列哪項？
options: 第30至32條施加或修訂的條件及有效期
持牌人最終擁有人的姓名及持股百分比
持牌人每年可合法處理交易的最高價值
獲專責指派監管該持牌人的獲授權人員身分
tc.explain: 第33條規定牌照須採用海關關長指明的格式，並須指明每一處所的地址（或通訊地址）、批註根據第30、31或32條施加或修訂的條件，以及指明牌照的有效期。牌照上並不會記錄最終擁有人的持股量、交易價值上限，或獲指派的監管人員姓名。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(b)及(2)條

en.q: A licensee operates a money service at domestic premises and a new occupant refuses to give written consent for an authorized person to enter. What may the Commissioner do?
options: Revoke the licence, or suspend it for a specified period or until a specified event
Nothing, because consent is needed only from the premises' original occupants
Order the licensee to pay a pecuniary penalty of up to $10 million
Apply to the Court of First Instance to compel the occupant to consent
en.explain: Section 34(1)(b) makes the revocation or suspension powers in section 34(2) available where an occupant of domestic premises revokes previously given written consent, or a new occupant refuses to give such consent, for an authorized person to enter for the purposes of section 9. Consent from a new occupant matters too, not just the original ones; section 34 gives no pecuniary-penalty power and requires no court application — the Commissioner acts directly.

tc.q: 某持牌人在住宅處所經營金錢服務，而新佔用人拒絕給予書面同意讓獲授權人進入。海關關長可怎樣做？
options: 撤銷該牌照，或在指明期間內或直至指明事件發生前暫時吊銷該牌照
無可作為，因同意只須來自該處所的原有佔用人
命令該持牌人繳付最高1,000萬元的罰款
向原訟法庭申請命令，強制該佔用人給予同意
tc.explain: 第34(1)(b)條訂明，凡住宅處所的佔用人撤回先前給予的書面同意，或新佔用人拒絕給予該書面同意，讓獲授權人為第9條的目的進入處所，海關關長即可行使第34(2)條的撤銷或暫時吊銷權力。新佔用人的同意同樣重要，並非只限原有佔用人；第34條並無罰款權力，也無須向法庭申請——海關關長可直接行使權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(3)條

en.q: What procedural safeguard must the Commissioner observe before revoking or suspending a licence under section 34?
options: The Commissioner must give the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard
The Commissioner must obtain the Review Tribunal's prior approval
The Commissioner must publish a notice in the Gazette at least 30 days in advance
The Commissioner must refer the matter to the Financial Secretary
en.explain: Section 34(3) provides that the Commissioner may only exercise a power under section 34(1) after giving the licensee a reasonable opportunity to be heard — no prior approval from the Review Tribunal (覆核審裁處) is required (the licensee may apply to it only after the decision, under section 34(5)), and there is no 30-day Gazette notice or referral to the Financial Secretary. Section 44(1) imposes the same hearing safeguard before disciplinary powers under section 43 are exercised.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第34條撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照前，須遵守甚麼程序保障？
options: 海關關長須給予持牌人合理的陳述機會
海關關長須事先取得覆核審裁處的批准
海關關長須至少提前30日在憲報刊登公告
海關關長須將事宜轉交財政司司長
tc.explain: 第34(3)條訂明，海關關長只可在給予持牌人合理的陳述機會後，方可行使第34(1)條下的權力——無須事先取得覆核審裁處的批准（持牌人只可在決定作出後，根據第34(5)條向該處申請覆核），亦無30日憲報公告或轉交財政司司長的規定。第44(1)條就行使第43條的紀律權力前訂有相同的聆訊保障。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(7)條；第41(3)條

en.q: A licence is revoked under section 34. What happens to the licence fee already paid?
options: No licence fee paid for the grant or renewal is refunded
The unexpired portion of the fee is refunded on a pro-rata basis
The whole fee is refunded once the licence is surrendered
The fee is credited against any pecuniary penalty imposed
en.explain: Section 34(7) provides that if a licence is revoked or suspended, no licence fee paid in respect of the grant or renewal of the licence is to be refunded — not pro-rata, not in full on surrender, and not credited against a penalty. Section 41(3) applies the identical rule where a licence is returned for cancellation on cessation of business.

tc.q: 牌照根據第34條被撤銷。已繳付的牌照費用會怎樣？
options: 就批出或續期而繳付的牌照費用不獲退還
按未屆滿部分按比例退還
一經交回牌照即全數退還
用以抵銷所施加的任何罰款
tc.explain: 第34(7)條訂明，如牌照被撤銷或暫時吊銷，就批出或續期而繳付的牌照費用一概不獲退還——並非按比例退還、並非於交回牌照時全數退還，亦不會用以抵銷罰款。第41(3)條就因停止營業而交回牌照註銷的情況訂有完全相同的規則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(8)條

en.q: A person whose licence is revoked fails to surrender it within the time specified in the Commissioner's notice. What is the consequence?
options: The person commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5
The person is automatically disqualified from holding a licence for five years
The Commissioner may impose a pecuniary penalty of up to $1 million
The Court of First Instance may commit the person for contempt
en.explain: Section 34(8) provides that if a person whose licence is revoked does not surrender the licence within the time specified in the notice given under subsection (4), the person commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5.

tc.q: 牌照被撤銷的人沒有在海關關長通知所指明的時間內交回牌照，後果為何？
options: 該人即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款
該人自動被取消持有牌照資格五年
關長可施加最高100萬元的罰款
原訟法庭可就藐視法庭而將該人交付羈押
tc.explain: 第34(8)條訂明，如牌照被撤銷的人沒有在根據第(4)款發出的通知所指明的時間內交回牌照，該人即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35(1)條

en.q: In relation to a licensee that is a corporation, what must happen before a person becomes a director?
options: The Commissioner must have given written approval on the licensee's application
The licensee must notify the Commissioner within one month afterwards
The person must have personally sat and passed the Competence Assessment
The Review Tribunal must have confirmed the person's fitness and propriety
en.explain: Section 35(1) provides that a person must not become a director of a licensee corporation unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing. Prior written approval is required before appointment — notifying the Commissioner afterwards, personally sitting the Competence Assessment, and Review Tribunal confirmation are not substitutes and are not what section 35(1) requires.

tc.q: 就屬法團的持牌人而言，某人成為董事前須先發生甚麼？
options: 海關關長須應持牌人的申請給予書面批准
持牌人須於其後一個月內以書面通知關長
該人須親自應考並通過能力評核
審裁處須事先確認該人的適當人選資格
tc.explain: 第35(1)條訂明，除非海關關長應持牌人的申請以書面給予批准，否則任何人不得成為持牌法團的董事。必須事先取得書面批准方可就任——事後通知、自行應考能力評核，或審裁處確認均不能代替，也並非第35(1)條所規定。

en.q: What is the penalty for a person who, without reasonable excuse, becomes a licensee's director, ultimate owner or partner without the Commissioner's prior approval?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 2 years
A pecuniary penalty of up to $1 million imposed by the Commissioner
A fine at level 5 only, with no possibility of imprisonment
en.explain: Sections 35(7), 36(7) and 37(7) each provide that a person who without reasonable excuse contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 任何人無合理辯解而在未獲海關關長事先批准下成為持牌人的董事、最終擁有人或合夥人，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁2年
由關長施加最高100萬元的罰款
只處第5級罰款，不可判處監禁
tc.explain: 第35(7)、36(7)及37(7)條均訂明，任何人無合理辯解而違反第(1)款，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第36(1)條

en.q: Whose prior written approval is required before a person becomes an ultimate owner of a licensee?
options: The Commissioner's, on an application made by the licensee
The Companies Registry's, on an application by the incoming owner
The Review Tribunal's, on an application by the licensee
No approval is required, provided the change is notified within one month
en.explain: Section 36(1) provides that a person must not become an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given approval in writing. Note that the application is made by the licensee, not by the incoming ultimate owner.

tc.q: 任何人成為持牌人的最終擁有人前，須事先取得何人的書面批准？
options: 海關關長的批准，並須由持牌人提出申請
公司註冊處的批准，並須由新任擁有人提出申請
審裁處的批准，並須由持牌人提出申請
無須批准，只要於一個月內通知變更即可
tc.explain: 第36(1)條訂明，除非海關關長應持牌人的申請以書面給予批准，否則任何人不得成為持牌人的最終擁有人。留意申請須由持牌人（而非新任最終擁有人）提出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第37(3)條；第35(3)條

en.q: The fitness-and-propriety test differs slightly between the approval sections. Under section 37, of what must the Commissioner be satisfied about a proposed new partner?
options: That the person is a fit and proper person to operate a money service
That the person is a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee's money service business
That the person has at least three years' experience in the money service industry
That the person holds no directorship in any other licensed MSO
en.explain: Section 37(3) requires satisfaction that a proposed partner is a fit and proper person to operate a money service, mirroring section 30(3)(a)(ii)(A) for partnerships. Sections 35(3) and 36(3), dealing with directors and ultimate owners, use the formula “to be associated with the licensee's money service business”.

tc.q: 各項批准條文的適當人選準則略有不同。根據第37條，海關關長須就擬任新合夥人信納甚麼？
options: 該人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選
該人是適合與該持牌人的金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選
該人在金錢服務行業擁有至少三年經驗
該人並無在任何其他持牌金錢服務經營者擔任董事
tc.explain: 第37(3)條規定須信納擬任合夥人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選，與第30(3)(a)(ii)(A)條就合夥的規定相對應。第35(3)及36(3)條就董事及最終擁有人則採用「適合與該持牌人的金錢服務業務有聯繫」的表述。

en.q: In deciding whether to approve a proposed director, ultimate owner or partner, which matters must the Commissioner have regard to?
options: The section 30(4)(a) to (e) matters, plus any other matter the Commissioner considers relevant
Only the section 30(4)(a) to (c) matters — bankruptcy and liquidation are not relevant to approvals
The section 30(4) matters, plus a mandatory pass of the Competence Assessment
Only whether the person has been convicted of an offence under the AMLO
en.explain: Sections 35(4), 36(4) and 37(4) each require the Commissioner, in addition to any other relevant matter, to have regard to the matters specified in section 30(4)(a) to (e) — covering listed criminal convictions, persistent non-compliance, and, in paragraphs (d) and (e), bankruptcy and liquidation. Those two paragraphs are expressly included, not excluded, and a Competence Assessment pass is not one of the listed matters; convictions under the AMLO are only part of paragraph (a), which itself is only one of five paragraphs.

tc.q: 海關關長在決定是否批准擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人時，須顧及哪些事項？
options: 第30(4)(a)至(e)條的事項，以及關長認為相關的其他事項
只限第30(4)(a)至(c)條的事項——破產及清盤與批核無關
第30(4)條的事項，另加須通過能力評核的規定
只限該人有否被裁定犯《打擊洗錢條例》所訂的罪行
tc.explain: 第35(4)、36(4)及37(4)條均規定海關關長除顧及任何其他相關事項外，亦須顧及第30(4)(a)至(e)條所指明的事項——包括列明的刑事定罪、持續不遵從，以及(d)及(e)段的破產及清盤。該兩段是明文列入而非剔除的事項，而通過能力評核並非該清單所列的事項；犯《打擊洗錢條例》罪行只是(a)段的一部分，而(a)段又只是五個段落之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(1)條

en.q: A licensee licensed to operate at premises specified in its licence wishes to open an additional branch. What must it do first?
options: Apply to the Commissioner to have the new premises added to the licence
Notify the Commissioner in writing within one month of opening
Obtain the landlord's written consent and file it with the register
Apply for a separate second licence for the new premises
en.explain: Section 38(1) provides that such a licensee must not operate a money service at any premises other than those specified unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, added the new premises to the licence. Section 38(3) requires payment of the Schedule 3 fee.

tc.q: 獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營的持牌人擬開設額外分行。它須先怎樣做？
options: 向海關關長申請將新處所加入牌照內
於開業後一個月內以書面通知關長
取得業主的書面同意並存檔於登記冊
就新處所另行申請第二個牌照
tc.explain: 第38(1)條訂明，除非海關關長應持牌人的申請將新處所加入牌照內，否則該持牌人不得在指明處所以外的任何處所經營金錢服務。第38(3)條規定須繳付附表3的費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(7)條；第39(7)條

en.q: After granting an application to add new business premises, what must the Commissioner do?
options: Add the relevant particulars to the register as soon as reasonably practicable
Publish a notice of the new premises in the Gazette within seven days
Issue an entirely new licence to replace the existing one immediately
Inspect the new business premises within 30 days of the grant
en.explain: Section 38(7) requires the Commissioner, as soon as reasonably practicable after granting an application, to add the relevant particulars to the register — there is no Gazette notice, no reissued licence, and no inspection duty imposed by this subsection. Section 39(7) correspondingly requires the register to be amended where premises are added under that section.

tc.q: 海關關長批准新增業務處所的申請後，須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將有關詳情加入登記冊
須於批准後七日內在憲報刊登新增業務處所的公告
須立即發出一份全新的牌照以取代現有牌照
須於批准後30日內派員視察新的業務處所
tc.explain: 第38(7)條規定海關關長須在批准申請後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將有關詳情加入登記冊——並無憲報公告、重發牌照或視察處所的規定。第39(7)條就根據該條新增處所的情況，相應規定須修訂登記冊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(8)條；第39(8)條

en.q: What is the penalty for a licensee that, without reasonable excuse, operates a money service at premises that have not been added to its licence?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 5 only
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
Automatic revocation of the licence without a hearing
en.explain: Sections 38(8) and 39(8) each provide that a licensee who without reasonable excuse contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months. Note that the section 39A display offence carries a level 5 fine only.

tc.q: 持牌人無合理辯解而在未加入其牌照的處所經營金錢服務，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
只處第5級罰款
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
無須聆訊即自動撤銷牌照
tc.explain: 第38(8)及39(8)條均訂明，持牌人無合理辯解而違反第(1)款，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。留意第39A條的展示牌照罪行只可處第5級罰款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39A(2)條

en.q: What is the penalty for a licensee that, without reasonable excuse, fails to display the original of its licence in a conspicuous place at the specified premises?
options: A fine at level 5, with no term of imprisonment
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A pecuniary penalty of up to $1,000,000
en.explain: Section 39A(2) provides for a fine at level 5 only. This is lighter than the sections 38(8) and 39(8) premises offences, which also carry up to 6 months' imprisonment.

tc.q: 持牌人無合理辯解而沒有在指明處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款，並無監禁
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
最高1,000,000元的罰款
tc.explain: 第39A(2)條只訂明可處第5級罰款。這較第38(8)及39(8)條的處所罪行為輕，後者另可判處最高6個月監禁。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(2)條

en.q: Do the particulars that must be kept up to date under section 40 include particulars previously notified to the Commissioner as changes?
options: Yes — later notifications under section 40(1) form part of the original application
No — only particulars in the original application count; later notifications do not
Only if the Commissioner expressly requests a further update
Only where the later change concerns a director or an ultimate owner
en.explain: Section 40(2) provides that, for the purposes of subsection (1), particulars provided in connection with a licensee's application under section 30 or 31 include particulars notified under that subsection. Later notifications therefore feed back into the application and must themselves be kept up to date — the duty is not limited to the original application, is not conditional on an express Commissioner request, and is not confined to director or ultimate-owner changes.

tc.q: 第40條下須保持更新的詳情，是否包括先前已作為變更通知海關關長的詳情？
options: 包括——第40(1)款通知的變更，視為原申請的一部分
不包括——只計原本申請中的詳情；其後的通知不算
只有在關長明確要求進一步更新時方須更新
只限其後的變更是涉及董事或最終擁有人的變更
tc.explain: 第40(2)條訂明，就第(1)款而言，就持牌人根據第30或31條提出的申請所提供的詳情，包括根據該款通知的詳情。因此其後的通知會納入申請詳情之內，本身亦須保持更新——此責任並不限於原申請、無須關長明確要求，亦不只限於董事或最終擁有人的變更。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(4)條

en.q: What is the penalty for a licensee that, without reasonable excuse, fails to notify the Commissioner of a change in its particulars?
options: A fine at level 5, with no term of imprisonment
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 1 year
Revocation of the licence under section 34
en.explain: Section 40(4) provides for a fine at level 5 on conviction, with no term of imprisonment — the same penalty as under sections 39A(2) and 41(4). A contravention of section 40(1) is also a ground for disciplinary action under section 43(1)(c).

tc.q: 持牌人無合理辯解而沒有將其詳情的變更通知海關關長，刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款，並無監禁
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁12個月
根據第34條撤銷牌照
tc.explain: 第40(4)條訂明一經定罪可處第5級罰款，並無監禁——與第39A(2)及41(4)條的刑罰相同。違反第40(1)條亦屬第43(1)(c)條下採取紀律行動的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)(b)條

en.q: Within what period after the date of cessation must a licensee return its licence to the Commissioner for cancellation or amendment?
options: Within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation
Within 14 days beginning on the date of cessation
Within one month beginning on the date of cessation
Within 45 days before the date of cessation
en.explain: Section 41(1) requires the licensee to notify the Commissioner in writing of the intention and the date of cessation before that date, and to return the licence for cancellation or amendment within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation.

tc.q: 持牌人須於停止營業日期後多久內，將牌照交回海關關長註銷或修訂？
options: 自停止營業日期起計7日內
自停止營業日期起計14日內
自停止營業日期起計一個月內
於停止營業日期前45日內
tc.explain: 第41(1)條規定持牌人須在停止營業日期前以書面將該意向及日期通知海關關長，並須於自停止營業日期起計7日內將牌照交回註銷或修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(2)條

en.q: On receiving a licence returned on cessation of business, what must the Commissioner do?
options: Cancel or amend the licence and remove the particulars from the register
Cancel the licence but keep the particulars on the register for six years
Refund the unexpired portion of the licence fee to the licensee
Publish notice of the cessation in the Gazette before amending the register
en.explain: Section 41(2) requires the Commissioner, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving a licence under subsection (1)(b), to cancel or amend the licence and remove the relevant particulars from the register — the particulars are removed, not kept on the register for six years. Section 41(3) confirms that no fee is refunded, and there is no Gazette-publication precondition to amending the register.

tc.q: 海關關長接獲因停止營業而交回的牌照後，須怎樣做？
options: 註銷或修訂該牌照，並從登記冊剔除有關詳情
註銷該牌照，但將詳情保留在登記冊上六年
向持牌人退還牌照費用中未屆滿的部分
在修訂登記冊前於憲報公布該項停業通知
tc.explain: 第41(2)條規定海關關長須在接獲根據第(1)(b)款交回的牌照後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快註銷或修訂該牌照，並從登記冊剔除有關詳情——詳情會被剔除，而非保留六年。第41(3)條確認費用不獲退還，亦無須先於憲報公布方可修訂登記冊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第42條

en.q: When does a licence held by a partnership cease to be valid under section 42?
options: On the dissolution of the partnership
On the retirement of any one partner
On the expiry of 12 months after any change in the partners
Only when the Commissioner formally revokes it
en.explain: Section 42 provides that a licence ceases to be valid on the death of an individual licensee, on the dissolution of a partnership, or on the commencement of winding up of a corporation. No act of the Commissioner is required.

tc.q: 根據第42條，合夥持有的牌照何時停止有效？
options: 於該合夥解散時
於任何一名合夥人退出時
於合夥人有任何變動後滿12個月時
只有在海關關長正式撤銷時
tc.explain: 第42條訂明，牌照於個人持牌人去世時、合夥解散時，或法團展開清盤時停止有效。無須海關關長作出任何行為。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第42條

en.q: A corporate licensee commences winding up. What is the effect on its MSO licence?
options: The licence ceases to be valid on the commencement of the winding up
The licence remains valid until the winding up is completed
The licence transfers to the liquidator for the duration of the winding up
The licence remains valid until its stated expiry date
en.explain: Section 42(c) provides that where the licensee is a corporation, the licence ceases to be valid on the commencement of winding up of the corporation. Note also that section 30(4)(e) makes liquidation a relevant consideration in assessing fitness and propriety.

tc.q: 某法團持牌人展開清盤。其金錢服務經營者牌照有何影響？
options: 牌照於清盤展開時停止有效
牌照維持有效直至清盤完成
牌照在清盤期間轉予清盤人
牌照維持有效直至其所述屆滿日期
tc.explain: 第42(c)條訂明，如持牌人是法團，牌照於該法團展開清盤時停止有效。另留意第30(4)(e)條將清盤列為評估適當人選資格時的相關考慮事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(2)(c)條

en.q: What is the maximum pecuniary penalty the Commissioner may order a licensee to pay under section 43?
options: The greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained
en.explain: Section 43(2)(c) caps the pecuniary penalty at $1,000,000. The much larger cap — the greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained or costs avoided — applies under section 21 in Part 4 to contraventions of specified provisions of Schedule 2, which is a different disciplinary route.

tc.q: 根據第43條，海關關長可命令持牌人繳付的最高罰款為何？
options: 1,000萬元或所獲利潤的3倍，以較高者為準
tc.explain: 第43(2)(c)條將罰款上限訂為1,000,000元。上限高得多的款額（1,000萬元或所獲利潤或所避免成本的3倍，以較高者為準）適用於第4部第21條下違反附表2指明的條文的情況，屬另一紀律途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(1)條

en.q: Which of the following is a ground on which the Commissioner may take disciplinary action under section 43?
options: The licensee contravenes any regulation made under section 51
The licensee's turnover falls below a level specified by the Commissioner
The licensee employs a person who has not passed the Competence Assessment
The licensee changes its auditors without prior approval
en.explain: Section 43(1) lists three grounds: contravention of any regulation made under section 51, contravention of any condition of the licence, and contravention of sections 35(1), 36(1), 37(1), 38(1), 39(1), 39A(1), 40(1) or 41(1).

tc.q: 下列何者屬海關關長可根據第43條採取紀律行動的理由？
options: 持牌人違反根據第51條訂立的任何規例
持牌人的營業額低於關長指明的水平
持牌人聘用未通過能力評核的人
持牌人未經事先批准更換核數師
tc.explain: 第43(1)條列出三項理由：違反根據第51條訂立的任何規例、違反牌照的任何條件，以及違反第35(1)、36(1)、37(1)、38(1)、39(1)、39A(1)、40(1)或41(1)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(3)條

en.q: Within what period must a licensee pay a pecuniary penalty ordered under section 43?
options: Within 30 days after the order takes effect, or any longer period specified by notice
Within 7 days of the order being made, running from the date of the decision itself
Within 30 days of the order being made, extendable only by order of the Tribunal
Within 12 months after the order takes effect, with no possibility of any extension
en.explain: Section 43(3) requires payment within 30 days, or any longer period specified by the Commissioner by notice under section 44(2), running from when the order takes effect as a specified decision under section 75 — not from the date the order was simply made. Any extension is granted by the Commissioner, not the Review Tribunal, and 12 months (with no extension) is not the statutory figure.

tc.q: 持牌人須於多久內繳付根據第43條命令繳付的罰款？
options: 自命令生效後30日內，或通知指明的較長期間內
自命令作出之日起計7日內，並非自生效日起計
自命令作出後30日內，只可由審裁處命令延長
自命令生效後12個月內，並不可有任何延長
tc.explain: 第43(3)條規定須於命令根據第75條作為指明決定生效後30日內，或海關關長根據第44(2)條以通知指明的任何較長期間內繳付；期間並非自命令作出之日起計。延長期間由關長決定，並非由審裁處決定，而12個月（並不可延長）也並非法定期間。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(4)條

en.q: A licensee fails to comply with an order to take remedial action made under section 43. What further order may the Commissioner make?
options: An order to pay a daily penalty not exceeding $10,000 for each day the failure continues
An order to pay a daily penalty not exceeding $1,000 for each day the failure continues
An order to pay a daily penalty of up to $100,000 for each day the failure continues
An order to pay a one-off further penalty not exceeding $1,000,000
en.explain: Section 43(4) empowers the Commissioner, where an MSO licensee fails to comply with a remedial order, to further order the licensee to pay a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $10,000 for each day the failure continues after the specified date. $100,000 is the equivalent daily cap for financial institutions generally under section 21(4), not for MSO licensees under section 43; $1,000 is not the statutory figure, and section 43(4) imposes a daily penalty, not a one-off further penalty.

tc.q: 持牌人沒有遵從根據第43條作出的採取糾正行動命令。海關關長可另行作出甚麼命令？
options: 命令就該項不遵從持續的每一日，繳付不超過10,000元的每日罰款
命令就該項不遵從持續的每一日，繳付不超過1,000元的每日罰款
命令就該項不遵從持續的每一日，繳付不超過100,000元的罰款
命令另行一次過繳付不超過1,000,000元的罰款
tc.explain: 第43(4)條授權海關關長在金錢服務經營者持牌人沒有遵從糾正命令時，可另行命令該持牌人就該項不遵從在指明日期後持續的每一日，繳付不超過10,000元的每日罰款。100,000元是第21(4)條下一般金融機構的相應每日上限，並非第43條下金錢服務經營者持牌人適用的款額；並無1,000元的款額，而第43(4)條規定的是每日罰款，而非一次過的另行罰款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(5)及(6)條

en.q: How may the Commissioner enforce an unpaid pecuniary penalty ordered under section 43?
options: By registering the order in the Court of First Instance as a civil money judgment
By registering the order in the District Court instead of the Court of First Instance
By recovering it directly as a civil debt, without any need for court registration
By enforcing the order as a criminal fine imposed by a magistrate
en.explain: Section 43(5) permits the Court of First Instance, on the Commissioner's application made in the manner specified in section 43(6), to register the order, after which it is regarded for all purposes as a civil judgment of that Court for the payment of money. Registration must be with the Court of First Instance, not the District Court; recovery as a civil debt without registration and enforcement as a magistrate's criminal fine are not the mechanism the Ordinance provides.

tc.q: 海關關長可如何強制執行根據第43條命令繳付而未繳付的罰款？
options: 將該命令在原訟法庭登記，視為民事付款判決
將該命令在區域法院登記，而非在原訟法庭
直接作為民事債項追討，無須經法庭登記
由裁判官作為刑事罰款強制執行該命令
tc.explain: 第43(5)條準許原訟法庭應海關關長按第43(6)條所訂方式提出的申請，將該命令登記；登記後，該命令就一切目的而言，視為該法庭作出的付款民事判決。登記須在原訟法庭進行，而非區域法院；本條例並無無須登記即可作為民事債項追討，或由裁判官作為刑事罰款強制執行的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(7)條

en.q: After exercising a disciplinary power under section 43, what may the Commissioner disclose to the public?
options: The decision, the reasons for it, and any material facts relating to the case
Only the licensee's name and the amount of any pecuniary penalty imposed
Nothing at all, unless the licensee first consents to disclosure in writing
Only the fact that a disciplinary decision has been made, without any further detail
en.explain: Section 43(7) provides that if the Commissioner has exercised the powers under subsection (1) in respect of a licensee, the Commissioner may disclose to the public the decision, the reasons for which it was made, and any material facts relating to the case — not merely the licensee's name and penalty amount, and not only bare notice that a decision was made. No consent from the licensee is required.

tc.q: 海關關長行使第43條的紀律權力後，可向公眾披露甚麼？
options: 決定、決定的理由，以及與該個案有關的任何要項事實
只限持牌人的名稱及所施加任何罰款的款額
完全不可披露，除非持牌人先以書面同意
只限已作出紀律決定一事，而不披露任何進一步詳情
tc.explain: 第43(7)條訂明，海關關長如已就某持牌人行使第(1)款下的權力，可向公眾披露該決定、作出該決定的理由，以及與該個案有關的任何要項事實——不只限於持牌人名稱及罰款款額，也不只限於已作出決定一事。並無須先取得持牌人同意。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第44(3)條

en.q: Which of the following must a notice of a section 43 disciplinary decision include?
options: A statement of reasons for the decision, and that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal
A statement of reasons, and that the licensee may appeal to the Court of First Instance
Only the amount of any pecuniary penalty imposed and the date it is due for payment
The name of the officer who investigated the alleged contravention in the case
en.explain: Section 44(3) requires the notice to include, among other things, a statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review — not appeal to the Court of First Instance, which has no such role under section 44. The amount of any penalty and its payment date are only part of what must be included, and the investigating officer's name is never a required element of the notice.

tc.q: 第43條紀律決定的通知須載有下列哪項？
options: 決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核的陳述
決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人可向原訟法庭上訴的陳述
只限任何已施加罰款的款額及其繳付到期日
調查該項違反行為的人員在該個案中的姓名
tc.explain: 第44(3)條規定該通知須載有（其中包括）決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述——而非向原訟法庭提出上訴，第44條並未賦予原訟法庭這個角色。罰款款額及繳付日期只是通知須載內容的一部分，而調查人員的姓名從不是必須載入的事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第45(1)條

en.q: What must the Commissioner do before first exercising the power to impose a pecuniary penalty under section 43(2)(c)?
options: Publish in the Gazette guidelines on how the power is to be exercised
Publish in the Gazette a fixed scale of penalties approved by the Financial Secretary
Lay draft guidelines before the Legislative Council for negative vetting
Consult every individual licensee affected by the proposed guidelines
