en.explain: Section 45(1) requires the Commissioner, before first exercising the pecuniary penalty power, to publish guidelines in the Gazette (and in any other manner considered appropriate) indicating how the power is proposed to be exercised. There is no fixed scale requiring the Financial Secretary's approval, no Legislative Council vetting procedure, and no duty to consult individual licensees. Section 45(2) requires the Commissioner to have regard to those guidelines when exercising the power.

tc.q: 海關關長首次行使第43(2)(c)條施加罰款的權力前，須怎樣做？
options: 在憲報公布指引，說明擬如何行使該權力
在憲報公布經財政司司長批准的固定罰款級別
將指引草案提交立法會，以先訂立後審議方式省覽
諮詢每名受擬議指引影響的持牌人
tc.explain: 第45(1)條規定海關關長在首次行使施加罰款的權力前，須在憲報（及以其認為適當的任何其他方式）公布指引，說明關長擬以何種方式行使該權力。並無須財政司司長批准的固定罰款級別，亦無立法會省覽程序，或諮詢個別持牌人的規定。第45(2)條規定關長行使該權力時須顧及該等指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第45(3)條

en.q: What is the legal status of guidelines published by the Commissioner under section 45(1)?
options: They are not subsidiary legislation
They are subsidiary legislation subject to negative vetting by the Legislative Council
They have the same force as a provision of Schedule 2
They are binding on the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 45(3) states expressly that guidelines published under subsection (1) are not subsidiary legislation. The Commissioner must nevertheless have regard to them when exercising the pecuniary penalty power, under section 45(2).

tc.q: 海關關長根據第45(1)條公布的指引具有甚麼法律地位？
options: 並非附屬法例
屬附屬法例，須經立法會先訂立後審議程序
與附表2條文具同等效力
對審裁處具約束力
tc.explain: 第45(3)條明確訂明根據第(1)款公布的指引並非附屬法例。然而，根據第45(2)條，海關關長在行使施加罰款的權力時仍須顧及該等指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第46條

en.q: Whom may the Commissioner appoint in writing to be an authorized officer for the purposes of Part 5?
options: Any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department
Any person the Commissioner considers suitably qualified, whether or not a public officer
Only officers of the rank of Superintendent or above
Only officers seconded from the Hong Kong Police Force
en.explain: Section 46 provides that the Commissioner may appoint in writing any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department to be an authorized officer for the purposes of Part 5. This is distinct from the authorized persons appointed under section 9(12) for inspection purposes.

tc.q: 就第5部而言，海關關長可以書面委任何人為獲授權人員？
options: 任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員
關長認為具備適當資格的任何人，不論是否公職人員
只限總監級或以上的人員
只限由香港警務處借調的人員
tc.explain: 第46條訂明海關關長可以書面委任任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員，就第5部而言為獲授權人員。這有別於根據第9(12)條為視察目的而委任的獲授權人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(1)條

en.q: On what basis may a magistrate issue a warrant authorising an authorized officer to enter and search premises under section 47?
options: If satisfied by information on oath of reasonable grounds to suspect a section 29 offence
If the Commissioner certifies in writing that a licensee has breached a condition of its licence
If the licensee has failed to pay a pecuniary penalty within the required 30 days
If an authorized officer has been refused entry during a routine compliance inspection
en.explain: Section 47(1) empowers a magistrate, if satisfied by information on oath that there are reasonable grounds to suspect that an offence under section 29 (operating a money service without a licence) has been or is being committed on any premises, to issue a warrant to enter, search, and seize evidence. A certified licence-condition breach, an unpaid penalty, and a refused routine inspection are grounds for other action under the Ordinance, not for a section 47 warrant.

tc.q: 裁判官可基於甚麼理由根據第47條發出手令，授權獲授權人員進入及搜查處所？
options: 經宣誓的告發信納有合理理由懷疑有第29條罪行
海關關長書面證明某持牌人已違反牌照的其中一項條件
持牌人未有按規定於30日內繳付罰款
獲授權人員在一次例行合規視察中被拒進入處所
tc.explain: 第47(1)條授權裁判官如因經宣誓而作的告發信納有合理理由懷疑第29條所訂罪行（即無牌經營金錢服務）已在或正在任何處所發生，即可發出手令進入、搜查及檢取證據。經證明的違反牌照條件、未繳罰款，或於例行視察中被拒進入，均屬本條例下其他行動的理由，並非第47條手令的發出依據。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(4)條

en.q: What is the penalty for obstructing an authorized officer exercising a power conferred by a warrant under section 47?
options: A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 4 only
en.explain: Section 47(4) provides that a person who obstructs an authorized officer exercising a power conferred by a warrant or by section 47(2) commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine at level 6 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 阻礙獲授權人員行使第47條手令所授予的權力，刑罰為何？
options: 第6級罰款及監禁6個月
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
只處第4級罰款
tc.explain: 第47(4)條訂明，任何人阻礙獲授權人員行使手令或第47(2)條所授予的權力，即屬犯罪，一經定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(1)及(4)條

en.q: An authorized officer arrests a person without warrant on suspicion of an offence under section 29. For how long may that person be detained without being charged and brought before a magistrate?
options: Not more than 48 hours
Not more than 24 hours
Not more than 72 hours
Not more than 7 days
en.explain: Section 48(1) permits arrest or detention without warrant where there are reasonable grounds to suspect a section 29 offence, and section 48(4) provides that a person, whether arrested or not, must not be detained for more than 48 hours without being charged and brought before a magistrate.

tc.q: 獲授權人員因懷疑某人犯第29條所訂罪行而無手令將其拘捕。該人在未被落案控告及帶往裁判官席前的情況下，可被扣留多久？
options: 不超過48小時
不超過24小時
不超過72小時
不超過7日
tc.explain: 第48(1)條准許在有合理理由懷疑第29條罪行時無手令拘捕或扣留；第48(4)條則訂明任何人（不論是否已被拘捕）在未被落案控告及帶往裁判官席前的情況下，被扣留的時間不得超過48小時。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(7)條

en.q: What restriction applies to the searching of a person arrested under section 48?
options: A person may be searched only by an authorized officer of the same sex
A person may be searched only with a legal representative present
A person may be searched only after being brought to a police station
A person may be searched only with a magistrate's written authority
en.explain: Section 48(7) provides that a person may be searched only by an authorized officer of the same sex. Section 48(6) sets out the scope of the search power following arrest, covering the person, the place of arrest and its surrounding areas.

tc.q: 根據第48條被拘捕的人接受搜查時，有何限制？
options: 只可由同性別的獲授權人員搜查
只可在法律代表在場下搜查
只可在被帶往警署後搜查
只可在裁判官書面授權下搜查
tc.explain: 第48(7)條訂明只可由同性別的獲授權人員搜查有關人士。第48(6)條則訂明拘捕後搜查權力的範圍，涵蓋該人、其被拘捕的地方及周圍地方。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(5)條

en.q: What must an investigator do before first imposing a requirement on a person under section 12?
options: Produce a copy of the relevant authority's direction or appointment
Produce evidence of appointment only if the person requests it
Serve a written notice on the person at least 14 days in advance
Obtain a warrant from a magistrate before imposing any requirement
en.explain: Section 11(5) requires an investigator, before first imposing any requirement under section 12(2), (3), (4) or (5), to produce a copy of the relevant authority's direction or appointment to that person for inspection — this duty is unconditional. It is section 48(2), governing an authorized officer who arrests or detains a person, that only requires evidence of appointment to be produced if requested; no warrant or 14-day notice is required for an investigator's document-production power.

tc.q: 調查員首次根據第12條向某人施加規定前，必須怎樣做？
options: 出示有關當局的指示或委任書副本
只在受涵蓋的人提出要求時，方出示委任證明
須至少提前14日向該人送達書面通知
在施加任何規定前，須先向裁判官取得手令
tc.explain: 第11(5)條規定調查員在首次根據第12(2)、(3)、(4)或(5)款施加任何規定前，須向該人出示有關當局的指示或委任書副本以供查閱——此責任是無條件的。第48(2)條規管的是逮捕或拘留某人的獲授權人員，該款才規定只在應要求時方須出示委任證明；調查員行使交出紀錄的權力，無須手令，亦無14日通知的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(1)條

en.q: Who is a “covered person” against whom an investigator may exercise powers under section 12?
options: A person under investigation, or reasonably believed to possess relevant records or information
A person under investigation, or any related person of that person as defined in section 10(11)
Only the financial institution that is formally the subject of the investigation
Only a customer of the financial institution under investigation
en.explain: Section 12(1) defines a covered person as a person under investigation, a person reasonably believed to be in possession of a record or document relevant to the investigation, or a person reasonably believed to be otherwise in possession of relevant information. 'Related person' is a different, narrower concept defined in section 10(11) for the tipping-off offence, not the test for who a section 12 power may be exercised against; the power also reaches individuals beyond the institution itself and beyond its customers.

tc.q: 調查員可根據第12條對何人行使權力（即「受涵蓋的人」）？
options: 受調查的人，或合理地相信管有相關紀錄或資料的人
受調查的人，或屬該人根據第10(11)條的相關人士
只限正式被列為調查對象的該金融機構本身
只限受調查的金融機構的現有客戶，不包括其他人
tc.explain: 第12(1)條界定「受涵蓋的人」為：受調查的人、調查員有合理因由相信管有與調查相關的紀錄或文件的人，或調查員有合理因由相信以其他方式管有相關資料的人。「相關人士」是第10(11)條為「洩密」罪行所界定的另一個較狹義的概念，並非用以判斷可根據第12條向何人行使權力；該權力所及的人亦不限於機構本身或其客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(2)(d)條

en.q: Besides producing records and answering questions, what further obligation may an investigator impose on a covered person under section 12(2)?
options: To give the investigator all other reasonable assistance with the investigation
To attend before the relevant authority, rather than before the investigator
To verify every record produced under section 12 by statutory declaration
To produce records that a third party holds outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 12(2)(d) allows an investigator to require a covered person to give all other assistance in connection with the investigation that the person is reasonably able to give, in addition to producing records, attending to answer questions, and responding to written questions. Attendance under section 12(2)(b) is before the investigator, not the relevant authority itself; a statutory declaration under section 12(4) verifies an answer or explanation already given, not every record produced; and Part 3 imposes no requirement to produce records a third party holds outside Hong Kong.

tc.q: 除交出紀錄及回答問題外，調查員可根據第12(2)條向受涵蓋的人施加甚麼進一步責任？
options: 向調查員提供就該項調查而言合理地能提供的一切其他協助
須親自出席於有關當局席前，而非調查員席前
須以法定聲明方式核實根據第12條交出的每一項紀錄
須交出第三方在香港以外地方所管有的紀錄
tc.explain: 第12(2)(d)條准許調查員規定受涵蓋的人，除交出紀錄、出席回答問題及回應書面問題外，就該項調查提供該人合理地能提供的一切其他協助。第12(2)(b)款規定的出席，是在調查員席前，並非有關當局席前；第12(4)條的法定聲明是用以核實已作出的答覆或解釋，並非核實每一項交出的紀錄；第3部亦無規定須交出第三方在香港以外地方管有的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(3)條

en.q: After a covered person produces a record under section 12(2)(a), what further requirement may the investigator impose?
options: A requirement to give an explanation or further particulars about the record
A requirement to have the record certified by an independent auditor
A requirement to translate the record into both official languages
A requirement to surrender the original record permanently
en.explain: Section 12(3) provides that if a covered person produces a record or document in accordance with a requirement under subsection (2)(a), the investigator may, subject to section 12A, require the person to give an explanation or further particulars in respect of the record or document — there is no power to demand independent audit certification, bilingual translation, or permanent surrender of the original.

tc.q: 受涵蓋的人根據第12(2)(a)條交出紀錄後，調查員可施加甚麼進一步規定？
options: 規定就該紀錄作解釋或提供進一步詳情
規定由獨立核數師核證該項紀錄
規定將該項紀錄翻譯成兩種法定語文
規定將該紀錄的正本永久交予調查員
tc.explain: 第12(3)條訂明，如受涵蓋的人按照第(2)(a)款的規定交出紀錄或文件，調查員可在第12A條的規限下，規定該人就該紀錄或文件作出解釋或提供進一步詳情——並無權力規定由獨立核數師核證真確性、翻譯成兩種法定語文，或永久交出正本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(9)條

en.q: What must an investigator do after completing an investigation under section 12?
options: Make a final report on the investigation to the relevant authority
Publish the final report, with the consent of the Secretary for Justice
Refer the matter directly to the Secretary for Justice for prosecution
Destroy all working papers within six months of completion
en.explain: Section 12(9) requires an investigator, as soon as reasonably practicable after completing the investigation, to make a final report to the relevant authority. Publishing the report is a separate, discretionary power of the relevant authority under section 12(10), exercisable only with the consent of the Secretary for Justice — it is not the investigator's own duty, and the Ordinance imposes no duty to refer matters directly for prosecution or to destroy working papers.

tc.q: 調查員根據第12條完成調查後，須怎樣做？
options: 向有關當局提交該項調查的最終報告
在律政司司長同意下發表最終報告
將事宜直接轉交律政司司長以作檢控
須於完成後六個月內銷毀所有工作底稿
tc.explain: 第12(9)條規定調查員須在完成調查後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快向有關當局提交最終報告。發表報告是有關當局根據第12(10)條另行擁有的酌情權力，須經律政司司長同意方可行使——並非調查員本身的責任；本條例亦無規定須直接將事宜轉交檢控，或銷毀工作底稿。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(10)條

en.q: Whose consent is required before a relevant authority may publish a report made under section 12?
options: The Secretary for Justice
The Financial Secretary
The Chief Executive in Council
The person who was the subject of the investigation
en.explain: Section 12(10) provides that a relevant authority may, with the consent of the Secretary for Justice, publish a report made under that section. Contrast section 11(1), where the Financial Secretary's consent is needed to appoint an outside investigator.

tc.q: 有關當局刊登根據第12條提交的報告前，須取得何人同意？
options: 律政司司長
財政司司長
行政長官會同行政會議
受調查的人
tc.explain: 第12(10)條訂明有關當局可在取得律政司司長同意下，刊登根據該條提交的報告。與此對照，第11(1)條下委任外聘調查員則須取得財政司司長同意。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(1)及(2)條

en.q: A person without reasonable excuse fails to comply with a requirement imposed by an investigator under section 12. On summary conviction, what is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment
en.explain: Section 13(2) provides for a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction. This mirrors the section 10(2) penalties for non-compliance with section 9 requirements.

tc.q: 某人無合理辯解而沒有遵從調查員根據第12條施加的規定。循簡易程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
tc.explain: 第13(2)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款200,000元及監禁1年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。這與第10(2)條就不遵從第9條規定所訂的刑罰相對應。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第14(1)及(2)條

en.q: Where a person fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9 or 12, what alternative to prosecution is available?
options: An inquiry by the Court of First Instance, punishable as contempt of court
A referral to the Review Tribunal for a determination of the alleged failure
An application to a magistrate for a warrant of committal against the person
A direction by the relevant authority imposing an immediate pecuniary penalty
en.explain: Section 14(1) allows the authorized person or investigator to apply by originating summons to the Court of First Instance for an inquiry into the failure. Under section 14(2) the Court may order compliance and, if satisfied the failure was without reasonable excuse, punish the person and anyone knowingly involved as if guilty of contempt of court — the Review Tribunal, a magistrate's committal warrant, and a direct pecuniary penalty by the relevant authority are not the mechanism this section provides.

tc.q: 如某人沒有遵從第9或12條下施加的規定，除檢控外還有甚麼途徑？
options: 由原訟法庭研訊，可按藐視法庭罪懲罰
將個案轉交審裁處，以裁定是否存在該項不遵從
向裁判官申請羈押令狀，以拘押不遵從的人
由有關當局作出指示，即時施加罰款作為制裁
tc.explain: 第14(1)條准許獲授權人或調查員藉原訴傳票向原訟法庭申請，要求對該項不遵從進行研訊。根據第14(2)條，法庭可命令遵從，並如信納該項不遵從並無合理辯解，可猶如該人及任何在知情下涉及該項不遵從的其他人犯藐視法庭罪般懲罰他們——審裁處、裁判官的羈押令狀，或有關當局直接施加罰款，均非本條所訂的機制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第14(4)條

en.q: What prevents a person from being punished twice for the same failure to comply with a section 9 or 12 requirement?
options: No contempt proceedings if earlier criminal proceedings are pending or bar prosecution
No criminal proceedings may be brought once a contempt application over the same conduct has been made
The Review Tribunal must first consolidate all proceedings arising from the same conduct
The Secretary for Justice must elect in advance between criminal and civil routes taken
en.explain: Section 14(4) provides that no proceedings may be instituted for the purposes of section 14(2)(b) where criminal proceedings under section 10 or 13 have previously been instituted in respect of the same conduct and remain pending, or where their previous institution bars further prosecution — it is the earlier criminal proceedings that block contempt proceedings, not the reverse, so a prior contempt application does not itself bar criminal proceedings. Section 14 imposes no consolidation duty on the Review Tribunal and no advance-election duty on the Secretary for Justice.

tc.q: 甚麼規定防止某人就同一項不遵從第9或12條規定的行為被雙重懲罰？
options: 刑事程序待決或不能再檢控時，不得提起藐視程序
一旦就同一行為提起藐視法庭申請，即不得再提起刑事程序
審裁處須先合併同一行為引起的所有法律程序
律政司司長須預先在刑事及民事途徑間作出選擇
tc.explain: 第14(4)條訂明，如先前已就同一行為根據第10或13條提起刑事法律程序，而該程序仍待決，或因先前已提起該程序而不能再合法提起檢控，則不得為第14(2)(b)條的目的提起法律程序——是在先的刑事法律程序阻卻藐視法庭程序，並非相反；提起藐視法庭申請本身並不會阻卻刑事法律程序。第14條並無規定審裁處須合併程序，也無規定律政司司長須預先選擇途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第15(2)條

en.q: When are answers given to an investigator under compulsion inadmissible against the person in criminal proceedings?
options: Where the answer might incriminate the person, if claimed before it is given
In all circumstances, without any need for the person to raise the point
Only where the person was not legally represented at the time of answering
Only where the investigator failed first to obtain a magistrate's warrant
en.explain: Section 15(2) makes the requirement, question and answer inadmissible in criminal proceedings only where the answer might tend to incriminate the person and the person claims this before giving the answer — the protection is not automatic, is not conditional on the person being unrepresented, and has nothing to do with whether the investigator held a magistrate's warrant (an investigator needs no warrant to exercise section 12 powers). Section 15(1) obliges the investigator to inform or remind the person of these limitations first.

tc.q: 在何種情況下，在強制下向調查員作出的答覆不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人的證據？
options: 該答覆可能導致入罪，並在作答前聲稱
在任何情況下均可，該人無須提出此項聲稱
只限該人在作答時並無法律代表的情況
只限調查員事先未有取得裁判官手令的情況
tc.explain: 第15(2)條訂明，只有在該答覆相當可能會導致該人入罪，而該人在作出答覆前提出此項聲稱時，該規定、問題及答覆方不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人的證據——此項保障並非自動適用，也不取決於該人有否法律代表，更與調查員有否取得裁判官手令無關（調查員行使第12條的權力，本來就無須手令）。第15(1)條規定調查員須先告知或提醒該人此等限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第15(3)條

en.q: In which proceedings does the protection against use of incriminating answers under section 15(2) NOT apply?
options: Proceedings under section 13, or Part V of the Crimes Ordinance, regarding the answer
Proceedings for any offence under Schedule 2 of the AMLO in which the answer is relied on
Proceedings for an offence under section 10 in respect of a record produced under section 9
Civil proceedings brought against the person by a customer of the institution
en.explain: Section 15(3) disapplies the section 15(2) protection in criminal proceedings in which the person is charged with an offence under section 13(1), (3), (5), (6), (7) or (8), or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance (Cap. 200), in respect of the answer, response, explanation or further particulars — a false answer can still be prosecuted. Schedule 2 offences generally, and section 10 proceedings over a section 9 record, are different, wider or unrelated categories, not the precise carve-out in section 15(3); a customer's civil claim is not a criminal proceeding at all.

tc.q: 第15(2)條就使用會導致入罪的答覆所提供的保障，在哪類法律程序中並不適用？
options: 根據第13條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部而涉及該答覆的法律程序
根據《打擊洗錢條例》附表2所訂罪行而依賴該答覆提出的法律程序
根據第10條而就根據第9條交出的紀錄提出的法律程序
由該機構的一名客戶向該人提起的民事法律程序
tc.explain: 第15(3)條訂明，如該人被控就該答覆、回應、解釋或進一步詳情而犯第13(1)、(3)、(5)、(6)、(7)或(8)條或《刑事罪行條例》（第200章）第V部所訂罪行，第15(2)條的保障即不適用——換言之，虛假答覆仍可被檢控。附表2所訂罪行整體而言，以及涉及第9條紀錄的第10條法律程序，均是不同、更廣泛或無關的類別，並非第15(3)條所訂的確切例外；客戶的民事申索則根本不屬刑事法律程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第16條

en.q: A person claims a lien on a record required to be produced under Part 3. What is the effect of the lien?
options: The lien does not affect the requirement to produce the record, and no fee is payable for the production
The requirement to produce is suspended until the lien is discharged, and a late-production fee becomes payable
The relevant authority must first pay the amount secured by the lien before the record is produced
The lien is extinguished the moment the record is produced, and the claimant permanently forfeits the right to re-assert it
en.explain: Section 16 provides that where a person claims a lien on a record required to be produced under Part 3: the lien does not affect the requirement to produce it; no fees are payable for or in respect of the production; and the production does not affect the lien. The lien is therefore neither suspending, paid off in advance, nor extinguished by production - it simply continues unaffected.

tc.q: 某人就根據第3部須交出的紀錄申索留置權。該留置權有何效力？
options: 該留置權不影響交出紀錄的規定，交出紀錄無須繳付任何費用
交出紀錄的規定暫緩執行，直至該留置權獲解除，且須繳付逾期費用
有關當局須先清償該留置權所擔保的款額，紀錄方可交出
該留置權於紀錄交出後即告消滅，申索人並永久喪失其再次申索的權利
tc.explain: 第16條訂明，凡有人就根據第3部須交出的紀錄申索留置權——該留置權不影響交出的規定；交出無須繳付費用；而交出亦不影響該留置權本身。留置權因此既不會暫緩執行、也毋須先清償，交出後該留置權仍然存在，並非消滅。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(1)條

en.q: Within what period must a warrant issued under section 17 be executed?
options: Within 7 days beginning on the date of the warrant
Within 24 hours of issue
Within 14 days beginning on the warrant's date
Within one month of issue
en.explain: Section 17(1)(a) authorises entry to the specified premises, if necessary by force, at any time within the period of 7 days beginning on the date of the warrant. Section 47 warrants under Part 5 do not carry the same express period.

tc.q: 根據第17條發出的手令須於多久內執行？
options: 自手令日期起計7日內
發出後24小時內
自手令起計14日內
發出後一個月內
tc.explain: 第17(1)(a)條授權在自手令日期起計7日的期間內，隨時（如有需要可使用武力）進入指明處所。第5部第47條的手令則無同樣的明文期限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(4)條

en.q: For how long may a record removed under a section 17 warrant be retained?
options: Not exceeding 6 months from removal, or longer if required for criminal or Ordinance proceedings
Not exceeding 3 months from the day of removal, or longer if required for criminal or Ordinance proceedings
Not exceeding 28 days from removal in every case, with no possibility of any extension
Indefinitely, at the discretion of the relevant authority conducting the investigation
en.explain: Section 17(4) permits retention for a period not exceeding 6 months beginning on the day of removal, or for any longer period necessary where the record is or may be required for criminal proceedings or proceedings under the Ordinance. 3 months and 28 days are both wrong figures, and retention is not indefinite or unconditional even where proceedings are in view.

tc.q: 根據第17條手令移走的紀錄可保留多久？
options: 自移走日起計不超過6個月；如刑事法律程序或本條例下的法律程序有需要，則可較長
自移走當日起計不超過3個月；如刑事法律程序或本條例下的法律程序有需要，則可較長
在任何情況下均不超過自移走日起計28日，並無任何延長的可能
可無限期保留，全由進行調查的有關當局酌情決定，不設上限
tc.explain: 第17(4)條准許自移走當日起計保留不超過6個月；如該紀錄就刑事法律程序或本條例下的法律程序屬需要或可能需要，則可保留該等程序所需的較長期間。3個月及28日均非條文所訂的期限，保留亦非由有關當局無限期酌情決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(5)及(6)條

en.q: What must an authorized person do after removing a record under a section 17 warrant?
options: Give a receipt for the record as soon as reasonably practicable after the removal
Must permit anyone otherwise entitled to inspect the record to do so within 24 hours of the removal
Lodge the record with the Registrar of the High Court within 48 hours of the removal
Publish a notice of the removal in the Gazette within 7 days of the record being taken
en.explain: Section 17(5) makes it a mandatory duty to give a receipt as soon as reasonably practicable after removal. Section 17(6) only empowers, but does not require, the authorized person to permit inspection by anyone otherwise entitled, at all reasonable times - there is no fixed 24-hour deadline, and no duty to lodge the record with the High Court or to publish a Gazette notice.

tc.q: 獲授權人根據第17條手令移走紀錄後，須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快就該紀錄發出收據
須准許本有權查閱該紀錄的人在移走後24小時內查閱
須於移走後48小時內將紀錄存放於高等法院司法常務官處
須於移走紀錄後7日內在憲報刊登移走公告
tc.explain: 第17(5)條規定獲授權人須在移走後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快發出收據——這是強制責任。第17(6)條就容許查閱另有規定：獲授權人「可」（並非「須」）准許本有權查閱的人在一切合理時間查閱，並無24小時的規定；條文亦無存放高等法院或憲報公告的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(3)條

en.q: In relation to a record required to be produced on premises entered under a section 17 warrant, what may an authorized person prohibit?
options: Removing the record from the premises, or erasing, adding to or otherwise altering it
Detaining anyone on the premises who might give relevant information, until it is searched
Any communication between persons found on the premises during the search
The continued operation of the business at the premises during the visit
en.explain: Section 17(3)(a) allows the authorized person to prohibit any person found on the premises from removing the record, erasing anything from it, adding to it, or otherwise altering or interfering with it. Detaining a potential informant until the premises have been searched is instead a section 47(2)(d) power available under a warrant to remove evidence of an offence, not a section 17(3) prohibition; the Ordinance does not empower a ban on communication or on continuing business.

tc.q: 就根據第17條手令進入的處所內須交出的紀錄，獲授權人可禁止甚麼？
options: 將該紀錄從處所移走，或刪除、增添或以其他方式更改其內容
扣留處所內可能提供相關資料的任何人，直至處所搜查完畢為止
在處所內發現的任何人之間，於搜查期間進行的任何通訊
該處所業務在視察或搜查期間的繼續正常營運
tc.explain: 第17(3)(a)條准許獲授權人禁止在處所內發現的人將紀錄移走、刪除、增添或以其他方式更改，或以其他方式干預該紀錄。扣留可能提供資料的人直至搜查完畢，是第47(2)(d)條就搜查令下的搜查另設的權力，並非第17條下就交出紀錄可禁止的事項；條文也沒有禁止通訊或禁止繼續營業。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(9)及(10)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for obstructing an authorized person exercising a power under section 17(2) or (3)?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
en.explain: Section 17(10) provides for a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 6 and 6 months' imprisonment on summary conviction, for failing without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement or prohibition under section 17(2) or (3) or obstructing the authorized person.

tc.q: 阻礙獲授權人行使第17(2)或(3)條下的權力，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
tc.explain: 第17(10)條訂明，無合理辯解而沒有遵從第17(2)或(3)條下的規定或禁止，或阻礙獲授權人，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第18條

en.q: Information required to be produced under Part 3 is held only in an information system. What may the person empowered to require production also require?
options: Production of a reproduction of the recording, in a form that lets the information be reproduced legibly
Production of a reproduction already in legible form - the test for information outside an information system
Surrender of the information system itself, including its hardware, for examination
That the information be printed out in full and certified correct by a notary public
en.explain: Section 18(2) empowers a person who may require production of a record held in an information system to also require production of a reproduction in a form that enables the information to be reproduced legibly. Section 18(1), by contrast, applies to information recorded otherwise than legibly but capable of legible reproduction outside an information system - it is the wrong test here. The Ordinance does not require surrender of the system itself or notarial certification.

tc.q: 根據第3部須交出的資料只存放於資訊系統內。有權要求交出的人還可要求甚麼？
options: 交出該項記錄的複製本，其形式須能使該資料可以可閱形式複製
交出已屬可閱形式的複製本——此為資訊系統以外資料適用的標準
交出該資訊系統本身及其硬件全部，以供詳細查驗
須將該資料全部列印成書面文件，並由公證人核證無訛
tc.explain: 第18(2)條授權可要求交出存放於資訊系統內的紀錄的人，同時要求交出複製本，其形式須能使該資料以可閱形式複製。第18(1)條規管的則是以非可閱形式記錄、但於資訊系統以外能複製為可閱形式的資料——套用於本題屬錯誤驗證標準。條文並無交出系統本身或由公證人核證的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第19條

en.q: Where an investigator has taken possession of a record under Part 3, what must the investigator permit?
options: Any otherwise-entitled person to inspect and copy the record, subject to reasonable conditions
Only the record's owner may inspect it, and only while the investigator remains present
Any entitled person may inspect the record, but only within 6 months after it was seized
Inspection is allowed only after the investigation concludes, and only on paying the Schedule 3 fee
en.explain: Section 19(1) requires the investigator to permit any person otherwise entitled to inspect the record to do so and make copies at all reasonable times; section 19(2) allows only reasonable conditions as to security, not a 6-month limit, sole ownership, a fee, or a bar until the investigation ends.

tc.q: 調查員根據第3部管有某紀錄後，須准許甚麼？
options: 本有權查閱者可查閱及複製該紀錄，但須符合合理條件
只准該紀錄的擁有人查閱，且須調查員全程在場方可查閱
任何有權查閱的人可查閱該紀錄，但只限扣押後6個月內
只在調查完結後，並繳付附表3訂明的費用後，方准查閱
tc.explain: 第19(1)條規定調查員須准許任何本有權查閱該紀錄的人在一切合理時間查閱及製作副本；第19(2)條只准許施加合理的保安條件，並無6個月時限、只限擁有人、收費或待調查完結方准查閱等規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第20(1)及(2)條

en.q: What must be proved to establish the offence of destroying documents under section 20?
options: Destroying, falsifying, concealing or disposing of a record required to be produced, with intent to conceal facts
That the person destroyed a record required to be produced, regardless of the person's intention in doing so
That the person was already the subject of a formal investigation at the time of the destruction
That the destruction actually succeeded in preventing the investigation from being concluded
en.explain: Section 20(1) requires destruction, falsification, concealment or disposal (or causing/permitting it) of a record required to be produced under Part 3, with intent to conceal facts capable of being disclosed by it — intent is essential, so destruction regardless of intent, merely being under investigation, or the destruction's actual effect on the inquiry do not establish the offence.

tc.q: 要確立第20條的銷毀文件罪行，須證明甚麼？
options: 銷毀、偽造、隱藏或處置須交出的紀錄，意圖隱瞞事實
該人銷毀了須交出的紀錄，但不論其抱持任何意圖
該人在銷毀該紀錄時，正接受有關當局的正式調查
該項銷毀行為實際上已成功阻止整宗調查完成結案
tc.explain: 第20(1)條規定須有銷毀、偽造、隱藏或處置（或導致或准許此等行為）須交出的紀錄，並意圖隱瞞該紀錄所能披露的事實；意圖是關鍵所在，不論意圖的銷毀、當時正受調查，或銷毀是否成功阻礙調查，均不能確立該罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第20A條

en.q: Which type of institution is excluded from the meaning of “financial institution” in Part 4 of the AMLO?
options: A licensed VAS provider
A licensed money service operator
An authorized institution
A licensed corporation
en.explain: Section 20A provides that in Part 4, financial institution excludes a licensed VAS provider — so the Part 4 disciplinary regime does not apply to licensed virtual asset service providers, which are dealt with under Part 5B.

tc.q: 哪一類機構不屬《打擊洗錢條例》第4部中「金融機構」的涵義範圍？
options: 持牌虛擬資產服務提供者
持牌金錢服務經營者
認可機構
持牌法團
tc.explain: 第20A條訂明，在第4部中，「金融機構」不包括持牌虛擬資產服務提供者——故第4部的紀律制度不適用於持牌虛擬資產服務提供者，該等提供者由第5B部處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(1)條

en.q: What triggers a relevant authority's power to take disciplinary action under section 21?
options: A financial institution contravening a specified provision under section 5(11)
A financial institution breaching a condition attached to its money service licence
A financial institution failing to renew its licence by the prescribed due date
A financial institution being convicted of any criminal offence whatsoever
en.explain: Section 21(1) triggers the relevant authority's powers where a financial institution contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11) — a listed provision of Schedule 2 — not a breach of licence conditions (dealt with under section 43 for MSOs), a late renewal, or a conviction as such.

tc.q: 甚麼情況會觸發有關當局根據第21條採取紀律行動的權力？
options: 金融機構違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文
金融機構違反其經營牌照所附的任何條件
金融機構未有在訂明的期限前為牌照申請續期
金融機構被裁定犯任何刑事罪行，不論性質
tc.explain: 第21(1)條規定，凡金融機構違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文（即附表2所列的條文），有關當局的權力即告觸發；違反牌照條件（金錢服務經營者適用第43條另行處理）、逾期續期或被定罪本身均非觸發要件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(4)條

en.q: A financial institution fails to comply with a remedial order made under section 21. What daily pecuniary penalty may the relevant authority order?
options: Not exceeding $100,000 for each day the failure continues
Not exceeding $10,000 for each day that the failure continues
Not exceeding $1,000,000 in total, regardless of how long the failure lasts
No daily penalty applies; the authority may only make a fresh remedial order
en.explain: Section 21(4) permits a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $100,000 for each day the failure continues after the date specified in the remedial order; the lower $10,000 daily cap belongs to section 43(4) for MSO licensees, there is no fixed $1,000,000 total cap, and a fresh order is not the only recourse.

tc.q: 金融機構沒有遵從根據第21條作出的糾正命令。有關當局可命令繳付甚麼每日罰款？
options: 就不遵從持續的每一日，不超過100,000元
就該項不遵從持續的每一日，不超過10,000元
不論該項不遵從持續多久，總額不超過1,000,000元
並無每日罰款；當局只可另行作出新的糾正命令
tc.explain: 第21(4)條准許就不遵從糾正命令在指明日期後持續的每一日，施加不超過100,000元的每日罰款；10,000元的較低每日上限屬第43(4)條就金錢服務經營者持牌人而設，並無1,000,000元的總額上限，也不是只能另行作出新命令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(7)條

en.q: What must a relevant authority do with a pecuniary penalty it receives under a section 21 order?
options: Pay it into the general revenue
Retain it to fund its supervisory activities
Distribute it among the customers affected by the contravention
Hold it on trust pending any application to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 21(7) requires a relevant authority to pay into the general revenue any pecuniary penalty received by it under an order made under that section.

tc.q: 有關當局根據第21條的命令收取罰款後，須怎樣處理？
options: 繳入政府一般收入
保留作為其監管工作的經費
分發予受該項違反影響的客戶
以信託形式持有，直至任何向審裁處提出的申請有結果
tc.explain: 第21(7)條規定有關當局須將其根據該條所作命令而收取的任何罰款繳入政府一般收入。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21(9)條

en.q: Which of the section 21 powers are NOT exercisable in relation to the Government?
options: The pecuniary penalty and daily pecuniary penalty powers in subsections (2)(c) and (4)
The power to publicly reprimand the financial institution under subsection (2)(a)
The power to order the financial institution to take remedial action under subsection (2)(b)
Every power specified anywhere in section 21, including remedial orders and reprimand
en.explain: Section 21(9) provides that only the powers in subsections (2)(c) and (4) — pecuniary penalty and daily pecuniary penalty — are unavailable against the Government; public reprimand and remedial orders remain exercisable, and it is not true that every section 21 power is barred.

tc.q: 第21條下哪些權力不可就政府行使？
options: 第(2)(c)及(4)款的罰款權力及每日罰款權力
第(2)(a)款所指明的公開譴責金融機構的權力
第(2)(b)款所指明的命令金融機構採取糾正行動的權力
第21條下的一切權力，包括糾正命令及公開譴責
tc.explain: 第21(9)條訂明只有第(2)(c)及(4)款所指明的權力（即罰款及每日罰款的權力）不可就政府行使；公開譴責及糾正命令的權力仍然可用，並非第21條下所有權力均告不可用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第22(1)條

en.q: What must a relevant authority do before exercising its powers under section 21 in respect of a financial institution?
options: Give the financial institution a reasonable opportunity to be heard
Obtain the written consent of the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
Serve a notice of intention at least 30 days beforehand
Refer the proposed action to the Review Tribunal for approval
en.explain: Section 22(1) provides that a relevant authority may only exercise its powers under section 21 after giving the financial institution a reasonable opportunity to be heard. Sections 34(3) and 44(1) impose the same requirement in the MSO context.

tc.q: 有關當局就某金融機構行使第21條下的權力前，須怎樣做？
options: 給予該金融機構合理的陳述機會
取得財經事務及庫務局局長的書面同意
至少提前30日送達擬採取行動的通知
將擬採取的行動轉交審裁處批准
tc.explain: 第22(1)條訂明有關當局只可在給予該金融機構合理的陳述機會後，方可行使第21條下的權力。第34(3)及44(1)條就金錢服務經營者訂有相同規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第23(2)條

en.q: When exercising the power to impose a pecuniary penalty under section 21(2)(c), what must a relevant authority do with its published guidelines?
options: Have regard to the guidelines it has published under section 23(1)
Apply the guidelines as if they were binding subsidiary legislation
Seek the Review Tribunal's confirmation that the guidelines were followed
Republish the guidelines in the Gazette before each exercise of the power
en.explain: Section 23(2) requires the relevant authority, in exercising the pecuniary penalty power, to have regard to the guidelines published under subsection (1). Section 23(3) confirms that those guidelines are not subsidiary legislation.

tc.q: 有關當局行使第21(2)(c)條施加罰款的權力時，須如何處理其已公布的指引？
options: 須顧及其根據第23(1)條公布的指引
須猶如該等指引屬具約束力的附屬法例般加以適用
須尋求審裁處確認已遵從該等指引
須在每次行使該權力前於憲報重新公布該等指引
tc.explain: 第23(2)條規定有關當局在行使施加罰款的權力時，須顧及其根據第(1)款公布的指引。第23(3)條確認該等指引並非附屬法例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(1)(b)及(2)(c)條；參照第21(1)及(2)條

en.q: An MSO contravenes a condition of its licence, rather than a specified provision of Schedule 2. Under which section is disciplinary action taken, and what is the penalty cap?
options: Section 43, with a pecuniary penalty cap of $1,000,000
Section 21, with a cap of the greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained
Section 34, with revocation as the only available sanction
Section 29, with a fine at level 6 imposed by a court
en.explain: Section 43(1)(b) covers a contravention of a licence condition and caps the pecuniary penalty at $1,000,000 under section 43(2)(c). Section 21 applies only to a contravention of a specified provision as defined by section 5(11), and carries the much higher cap.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者違反其牌照條件（而非附表2的指明的條文）。紀律行動根據哪一條採取？罰款上限為何？
options: 第43條，罰款上限為1,000,000元
第21條，上限為1,000萬元或所獲利潤的3倍，以較高者為準
第34條，撤銷牌照為唯一可用制裁
第29條，由法庭判處第6級罰款
tc.explain: 第43(1)(b)條涵蓋違反牌照條件的情況，而第43(2)(c)條將罰款上限訂為1,000,000元。第21條只適用於違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文，其上限則高得多。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52(2)條

en.q: Besides making a false statement, what other conduct is an offence under section 52 in connection with a licence application?
options: Omitting a material particular, so the statement is false or misleading, knowingly or recklessly
Omitting a material particular from a statement, whether or not the person knew of the omission at the time
Making a statement inaccurate in a minor, immaterial particular, without knowledge or recklessness
Carelessly making an inaccurate statement in a notification given under section 41
en.explain: Section 52(2) requires both an omission that renders the statement false or misleading AND knowledge or recklessness as to that omission — an innocent omission (no knowledge either way), an immaterial inaccuracy made without knowledge or recklessness, or carelessness in a section 41 cessation notice do not satisfy these elements.

tc.q: 除作出虛假陳述外，第52條就牌照申請還將哪種行為訂為罪行？
options: 遺漏要項令陳述虛假或具誤導性，而知道或罔顧該遺漏
從陳述中遺漏要項，不論該人當時是否知道有關遺漏
陳述中的非要項有輕微不準確之處，且並無知悉或罔顧
在根據第41條作出的通知中，粗心地作出不準確的陳述
tc.explain: 第52(2)條同時要求陳述因遺漏而變成虛假或具誤導性，以及該人知道或罔顧該項遺漏；無心的遺漏（不論是否知情）、非要項且無知悉或罔顧的輕微失實，或在第41條通知中粗心失實，均不符合此等構成要素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52(3)條

en.q: What is the penalty on conviction for providing false information in connection with a licence application under section 52?
options: A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Section 52(3) provides that a person who commits an offence under subsection (1) or (2) is liable on conviction to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

tc.q: 根據第52條就牌照申請提供虛假資料，一經定罪的刑罰為何？
options: 第5級罰款及監禁6個月
第6級罰款及監禁2年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第52(3)條訂明，犯第(1)或(2)款所訂罪行的人，一經定罪，可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第53條

en.q: Section 53 modifies the ordinary limitation period for prosecutions. From what event does the 12-month period run?
options: From when the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner
From the date on which the underlying offence was originally committed
From the date on which the licence was first granted or most recently renewed
From the date the Commissioner formally completes an investigation under section 11
en.explain: Section 53 runs the 12-month period from when the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner — not from the date of commission, the date of the licence's grant or renewal, or the completion of a section 11 investigation, none of which section 53 uses as the trigger.

tc.q: 第53條修改了一般的檢控時限。該12個月期間自甚麼事件起計？
options: 自海關關長發現該罪行或該罪行引起關長注意時起計
自該罪行實際發生之日期當天起計算，不論何時發現
自牌照首次批出或最近一次續期之日起計算
自關長正式完成第11條下的調查之日起計算
tc.explain: 第53條的12個月期間自該罪行由關長發現或引起關長注意時起計，並非自罪行發生之日、牌照批出或續期之日，或第11條調查完成之日起計，第53條並無以該等事件作為起算點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第53條

en.q: To which offences under Part 5 does the special 12-month time limit in section 53 apply?
options: Offences other than indictable offences
All offences under Part 5 without exception
Only offences carrying a fine at level 5
Only offences committed by a licensee, not by an unlicensed person
en.explain: Section 53 applies to an offence “other than an indictable offence” under Part 5. Indictable offences remain subject to the ordinary position, section 26 of the Magistrates Ordinance being the provision expressly displaced for summary matters.

tc.q: 第53條的12個月特別時限適用於第5部下哪些罪行？
options: 並非可公訴罪行的罪行
第5部下所有罪行，並無例外
只限可處第5級罰款的罪行
只限持牌人所犯的罪行，不包括無牌人士
tc.explain: 第53條適用於第5部下「並非可公訴罪行」的罪行。可公訴罪行仍受一般規定規限；就簡易程序事宜而言，被明文取代的是《裁判官條例》第26條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第50條

en.q: Who may amend Schedule 3 to the AMLO, which specifies the fees payable?
options: The Commissioner, by notice published in the Gazette
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, by notice in the Gazette
The Chief Executive in Council, by regulation
The Financial Secretary, by direction to the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 50 provides that the Commissioner may, by notice published in the Gazette, amend Schedule 3. This contrasts with Schedule 1 Part 2 and Schedule 2, which are amended by the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury under sections 2(2) and 6.

tc.q: 何人可修訂訂明應繳費用的《打擊洗錢條例》附表3？
options: 海關關長，以憲報公告方式
財經事務及庫務局局長，以憲報公告方式
行政長官會同行政會議，以規例方式
財政司司長，以向關長發出指示的方式
tc.explain: 第50條訂明海關關長可藉憲報公告修訂附表3。這與附表1第2部及附表2不同，後者由財經事務及庫務局局長根據第2(2)及6條修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第51條

en.q: What regulation-making power does section 51 confer, and on whom?
options: The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, to make regulations for the better carrying out of Part 5
The Chief Executive in Council, to make regulations for the whole Ordinance under section 77
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, to make regulations for Schedule 2
The Review Tribunal, to make its own rules of procedure and practice for the conduct of review hearings
en.explain: Section 51 gives the Commissioner of Customs and Excise the power to make regulations for the better carrying out of Part 5 alone; the Chief Executive in Council's general regulation-making power for the rest of the Ordinance is in section 77, and neither the Secretary nor the Review Tribunal holds a regulation-making power under section 51.

tc.q: 第51條授予何人甚麼訂立規例的權力？
options: 海關關長，就更佳地實施第5部的條文訂立規例
行政長官會同行政會議，根據第77條就整條條例訂立規例
財經事務及庫務局局長，就附表2訂立規例
覆核審裁處，就覆核聆訊的進行訂立其本身的程序及常規規則
tc.explain: 第51條只授權海關關長就更佳地實施第5部訂立規例；行政長官會同行政會議就本條例其餘部分訂立規例的一般權力載於第77條，局長及覆核審裁處均無第51條下的訂立規例權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第77條（第7部）

en.q: Under section 77, the Chief Executive in Council's power to make regulations for the better carrying out of the Ordinance does NOT extend to which Parts?
options: Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C, which are expressly excepted
Part 7 alone, since that Part contains the power itself
Parts 1 and 2 only, covering definitions and preliminary matters
No Parts are excepted; the power extends to the whole Ordinance
en.explain: Section 77(1) confers the power on the Chief Executive in Council to make regulations for the better carrying out of the Ordinance except Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C — those Parts have their own regulation-making regimes (e.g. section 51 for Part 5). Part 7 itself is not excepted, nor are Parts 1 and 2, and the exception is not empty.

tc.q: 根據第77條，行政長官會同行政會議就更佳地實施本條例訂立規例的權力，不延伸至以下哪些部？
options: 第5、5A、5B及5C部，該等部明文獲得剔除
只有第7部獲剔除，因該部載有有關權力本身
只有第1部及第2部獲剔除，即涉及釋義及導言的部分
並無任何部獲得剔除；該權力延伸至整條條例
tc.explain: 第77(1)條授予行政長官會同行政會議就更佳地實施本條例訂立規例的權力，但明文剔除第5、5A、5B及5C部——該等部另有本身的訂立規例機制（如第5部的第51條）。第7部本身並未獲剔除，第1、2部亦然，而該項剔除亦非空言。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第3部第2分部的結構

en.q: Which of the following powers falls within Division 2 of Part 3 of the AMLO, headed 'Powers to Enter, Inspect and Investigate'?
options: A relevant authority's power to appoint investigators under section 11
International cooperation with a non-Hong Kong regulator, under section 13B
The power to destroy documents seized under a warrant, under section 20
The interpretation of terms used throughout Part 3, under section 8
en.explain: Division 2 (sections 9 to 13) covers powers to enter, inspect and investigate, including the power for a relevant authority to appoint investigators under section 11. International enforcement cooperation with a non-Hong Kong regulator (section 13B) sits in Division 3; destruction of seized documents (section 20) sits in Division 4; and the Part 3 interpretation section (section 8) sits in Division 1.

tc.q: 下列何者屬《打擊洗錢條例》第3部第2分部（進入、視察及調查的權力）所載的權力？
options: 有關當局委任調查員的權力（第11條）
向非香港監管機構提供合作（第13B條）
銷毀根據手令扣押的文件的權力（第20條）
第3部所用詞語的釋義（第8條）
tc.explain: 第2分部（第9至13條）載有進入、視察及調查的權力，包括有關當局根據第11條委任調查員的權力。向非香港監管機構提供國際執法合作（第13B條）屬第3分部；銷毀已扣押文件（第20條）屬第4分部；第3部的釋義條文（第8條）則屬第1分部。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第8條（「訂明規定」的定義）

en.q: For a non-Part 5B prescribed person such as a licensed MSO, what does the “prescribed requirement” in Part 3 mean?
options: The requirement not to contravene the Ordinance, any notice or requirement under it, or any licence, registration or other condition imposed under it
The requirement not to contravene the Ordinance, any published code or guideline, or any licence condition imposed by the Securities and Futures Commission
Only the requirement not to contravene Schedule 2, which sets out customer due diligence and record-keeping duties for financial institutions
Only the requirements set out in guidelines for the operation of Schedule 2 that a relevant authority publishes under section 7
en.explain: Section 8(a) defines prescribed requirement for a non-Part 5B prescribed person (such as a licensed MSO) as the requirement not to contravene the Ordinance, any notice or requirement under it, or any licence, registration or other condition imposed under it. The second option is instead section 8(b), which applies only to licensed VAS providers and their associated entities. Schedule 2 (customer due diligence) and the section 7 guidelines on its operation are narrower, separate obligations, not the Part 3 definition.

tc.q: 就持牌金錢服務經營者等非第5B部訂明人士而言，第3部的「訂明規定」指甚麼？
options: 不得違反本條例、本條例下的任何通知或規定，或本條例下任何牌照、註冊或其他條件的規定
不得違反本條例、公布的守則或指引，或證券及期貨事務監察委員會的牌照條件的規定
只限不得違反附表2的規定，附表2訂明金融機構的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄責任
只限根據第7條就附表2的實施而公布的指引所載的規定
tc.explain: 第8(a)條就非第5B部訂明人士（例如持牌金錢服務經營者）界定「訂明規定」，指不得違反本條例、本條例下的任何通知或規定，或本條例下任何牌照、註冊或其他條件的規定。第二個選項所引述的其實是第8(b)條，只適用於持牌虛擬資產服務提供者及其相聯實體。附表2（客戶盡職審查）及根據第7條就其實施而公布的指引，均屬另外、範圍較窄的責任，並非第3部的定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第8條（「非第5B部訂明人士」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of “non-Part 5B prescribed person” in section 8?
options: The Postmaster General
The Financial Secretary
The Registrar of Companies
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise
en.explain: The section 8 definition lists authorized institutions, licensed corporations, authorized insurers, licensed insurance agents, agencies and broker companies, licensed money service operators, the Postmaster General, SVF licensees, TCSP licensees, PMS registrants and stablecoin licensees. Regulators themselves are not prescribed persons.

tc.q: 下列何者包括在第8條「非第5B部訂明人士」的定義內？
options: 郵政署署長
財政司司長
公司註冊處處長
海關關長
tc.explain: 第8條的定義列出認可機構、持牌法團、認可保險人、持牌保險代理及代理機構及經紀公司、持牌金錢服務經營者、郵政署署長、儲值支付工具持牌人、信託或公司服務提供者持牌人、貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人及穩定幣持牌人。監管機構本身並非訂明人士。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9A(2)條

en.q: An authorized person authorized by a regulator other than the subject person's own relevant authority seeks records about the subject person's customers. What condition applies?
options: The other regulatory authority must be of the opinion, and certify in writing, that disclosure is necessary
The subject person's own relevant authority must first grant written approval before any disclosure is made
A magistrate's warrant must be obtained before any customer records may be sought or produced
Customer records may never be obtained by another regulatory authority under section 9A
en.explain: Section 9A(2) allows disclosure only if the other regulatory authority is of the opinion, and certifies in writing, that the disclosure or production is necessary for the purposes of section 9 — there is no requirement for the subject person's own relevant authority to approve, no magistrate's warrant procedure, and section 9A permits (rather than forbids) disclosure to another regulator.

tc.q: 由並非該對象人士本身有關當局的監管機構所授權的獲授權人，尋求索取該對象人士客戶的紀錄。適用甚麼條件？
options: 該另一監管當局須認為並書面證明該項披露就第9條而言屬必需
須先取得該對象人士本身有關當局的書面批准，方可作出任何披露
須先取得裁判官手令，方可索取或交出任何客戶紀錄
根據第9A條，另一監管當局永不可取得客戶紀錄
tc.explain: 第9A(2)條規定，只有在另一監管當局認為（並以書面證明其認為）該項披露或交出就第9條而言屬必需的情況下，方可披露——該條並無規定須取得對象人士本身有關當局的批准，亦無裁判官手令的程序；第9A條是准許（而非禁止）向另一監管當局披露。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12A(2)條

en.q: Under section 12A(2), an investigator appointed by another regulatory authority wants a subject person's customer records. What must be true?
options: The customer may have relevant information, and the other regulatory authority certifies in writing that disclosure is necessary
The customer may have relevant information, and the subject person's own authority certifies that disclosure is necessary
The customer consents in writing, and a magistrate issues a warrant authorising production of the records
The subject person is under criminal investigation, and the Secretary for Justice approves the disclosure
en.explain: Section 12A(2) requires both that the customer is a person the investigator has reasonable cause to believe may give relevant information, and that the other regulatory authority that appointed the investigator — not the subject person's own relevant authority — certifies in writing that disclosure is necessary. There is no warrant, consent or criminal-investigation gateway in section 12A.

tc.q: 根據第12A(2)條，由另一監管當局委任的調查員欲索取某對象人士客戶的紀錄，須符合甚麼條件？
options: 該客戶可能提供資料，且另一監管當局須書面證明披露屬必需
該客戶可能提供資料，且對象人士的當局須證明披露屬必需
該客戶須書面同意，且裁判官須發出手令授權交出該等紀錄
該對象人士須正受刑事調查，且律政司司長須批准該項披露
tc.explain: 第12A(2)條規定須同時符合：該客戶是調查員有合理因由相信能提供相關資料的人；及委任該調查員的另一監管當局（而非對象人士本身的有關當局）以書面證明該項披露屬必需。第12A條並無手令、同意或刑事調查的途徑規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第55(2)條

en.q: Besides reviewing specified decisions, what other jurisdiction does section 55(2) give the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal?
options: To hear and determine any question or issue arising from a review
To try criminal offences committed by the specified authority's officers
To grant, renew, suspend or revoke money service operator licences
To make regulations for the better carrying out of Part 6 of the Ordinance
en.explain: Section 55(2) gives the Tribunal jurisdiction to review specified decisions and to hear and determine any question or issue arising out of or in connection with a review, under Part 6 and Schedule 4. Criminal trials remain for the courts, licensing decisions remain the Commissioner's under Part 5, and only the Chief Executive in Council (or the Commissioner for Part 5) makes regulations under section 77 — the Tribunal does neither.

tc.q: 除覆核指明決定外，打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處根據第55(2)條還具有甚麼司法管轄權？
options: 聆訊及裁定因覆核而引起的任何問題或爭論點
審理指明當局人員涉嫌所犯的刑事罪行
批出、續期、暫停或撤銷金錢服務經營者牌照
就實施本條例第6部訂立規例
tc.explain: 第55(2)條賦予審裁處司法管轄權，按照第6部及附表4覆核指明決定，並聆訊及裁定因覆核而引起或與之有關的任何問題或爭論點。刑事審訊仍屬法院職權；發牌決定仍屬第5部下海關關長的職權；根據第77條訂立規例則只屬行政長官會同行政會議（第5部則屬關長）的職權——兩者均非審裁處的職權。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第56(1)條

en.q: Except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, of whom does the Review Tribunal consist?
options: A chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary
A single chairperson sitting alone
A chairperson and 4 other members appointed by the Chief Executive
Three judges of the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 56(1) provides that, except as otherwise provided in Schedule 4, the Tribunal consists of a chairperson and 2 other members, appointed by the Secretary.

tc.q: 除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由何人組成？
options: 一名主席及2名其他成員，由局長委任
單獨一名主席
一名主席及4名其他成員，由行政長官委任
三名原訟法庭法官
tc.explain: 第56(1)條訂明，除附表4另有規定外，審裁處由一名主席及2名其他成員組成，並由局長委任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第56(2)條

en.q: What qualification must the chairperson of the Review Tribunal have?
options: Eligibility for appointment as a judge under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance
At least ten years of experience in financial services regulation, plus a professional qualification
Current membership in good standing of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants
Prior service as a serving or retired officer of the Customs and Excise Department at inspector rank or above
en.explain: Section 56(2)(a) requires the chairperson to be a person eligible for appointment as a judge of the High Court under section 9 of the High Court Ordinance (Cap. 4). Financial-regulation experience, accountancy body membership and Customs and Excise service are not the statutory qualification, however plausible they sound.

tc.q: 審裁處主席須具備甚麼資格？
options: 根據《高等法院條例》第9條符合資格獲委任為法官
在金融服務監管方面擁有至少十年經驗，並持專業資格
屬香港會計師公會的現任會員，且會籍良好
曾任或現任香港海關督察或以上職級的人員
tc.explain: 第56(2)(a)條規定主席須為根據《高等法院條例》（第4章）第9條符合資格獲委任為高等法院法官的人。金融監管經驗、會計師公會會籍及海關服務資歷，即使聽來合理，均非法定資格。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第58(2)條

en.q: Who may amend Schedule 4 to the AMLO, which has effect with respect to the Review Tribunal?
options: The Secretary, by notice published in the Gazette
The Chief Justice, by rules
The Commissioner, by notice in the Gazette
The Chief Executive in Council, by regulation
en.explain: Section 58(1) provides that Schedule 4 has effect with respect to the Tribunal, and section 58(2) empowers the Secretary to amend Schedule 4 by notice published in the Gazette. Schedule 3 is amended by the Commissioner under section 50.

tc.q: 就審裁處具有效力的《打擊洗錢條例》附表4，可由何人修訂？
options: 局長，以憲報公告方式
終審法院首席法官，以訂立規則方式
海關關長，以憲報公告方式
行政長官會同行政會議，以規例方式
tc.explain: 第58(1)條訂明附表4就審裁處具有效力，第58(2)條則授權局長藉憲報公告修訂附表4。附表3則由海關關長根據第50條修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(2)及(3)條

en.q: On what conditions may the Tribunal extend the time within which an application for review may be made?
options: Only after giving the applicant and specified authority an opportunity to be heard, and for good cause
Only where the Tribunal finds that the delay in applying was entirely caused by the specified authority
Only where the extension sought does not exceed a further period of 21 days beyond the original time limit
Never — the time limit for applying under section 59(1) is absolute and may not be extended by the Tribunal
en.explain: Section 59(3) permits an extension only after the applicant and the specified authority have been given a reasonable opportunity to be heard, and if the Tribunal is satisfied there is good cause for the extension — there is no requirement that the specified authority caused the delay, and no 21-day cap on the extension itself (21 days is instead the original time limit in section 59(1)).

tc.q: 審裁處可在甚麼條件下延展提出覆核申請的時限？
options: 只有在給予申請人及指明當局陳述機會後，並有充分理由
只限審裁處認定延誤完全是由指明當局造成的情況
只限所要求的延展不超過原有時限後另外21日
不可以——第59(1)條的時限屬絕對，審裁處無權延展
tc.explain: 第59(3)條訂明，只有在給予申請人及指明當局合理的陳述機會後，並且審裁處信納有充分理由給予延展的情況下，方可延展。該條並無規定延誤須由指明當局造成，亦無限制延展本身不得超過21日（21日其實是第59(1)條所訂的原有時限）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(4)條

en.q: What formal requirements apply to an application to the Review Tribunal for a review?
options: It must be in writing and must state the grounds for the application
It may be made orally at a preliminary hearing before the Tribunal
It must be accompanied by the fee specified in Schedule 3 to the Ordinance
It must be certified by a solicitor admitted to practise in Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 59(4) requires an application for review to be in writing and to state the grounds for the application — there is no oral procedure, no prescribed fee under Schedule 3, and no requirement for certification by a solicitor. Section 59(5) then requires the Tribunal to send a copy to the specified authority as soon as reasonably practicable.

tc.q: 向審裁處提出覆核申請，須符合甚麼形式規定？
options: 須以書面提出，並須述明申請理由
可在審裁處席前的預備聆訊中以口頭方式提出
須連同《打擊洗錢條例》附表3訂明的費用一併提交
須由在香港獲認許執業的律師核證
tc.explain: 第59(4)條規定覆核申請須以書面提出，並須述明申請理由——並無口頭程序，亦無附表3訂明的費用，或須由律師核證的規定。第59(5)條繼而規定審裁處須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將副本送交指明當局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(1)條

en.q: In what ways may the Tribunal determine a review of a specified decision?
options: By confirming, varying or setting aside and substituting the decision, or by remitting the matter with directions
By confirming, varying or setting aside the decision, but without power to substitute a different decision
By remitting the matter to the specified authority with directions, but without power to vary the decision itself
By referring the matter directly to the Court of Appeal for determination, bypassing the specified authority
en.explain: Section 60(1)(a) lets the Tribunal confirm, vary or set aside the decision and substitute any other decision it considers appropriate — the power to substitute is not excluded. Section 60(1)(b) lets it remit the matter to the specified authority with directions, which does not exclude the power to vary under limb (a). The Tribunal decides the matter itself; it does not refer it to the Court of Appeal.

tc.q: 審裁處可以哪些方式裁定對指明決定的覆核？
options: 確認、更改或撤銷該決定並以另一決定取代，或將事宜連同指示發回指明當局
只可確認、更改或撤銷該決定，但無權以另一決定取代
只可將事宜連同指示發回指明當局，但無權更改該決定本身
將事宜直接轉交上訴法庭裁定，繞過指明當局
tc.explain: 第60(1)(a)條准許審裁處確認、更改或撤銷該決定，並以其認為適當的另一決定取代——並無排除取代的權力。第60(1)(b)條准許將事宜連同指示發回指明當局，此點並不排除(a)款下更改決定的權力。審裁處本身裁定該事宜，並非轉交上訴法庭。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(2)條

en.q: Where the Tribunal varies or substitutes a specified decision, may the new decision be harsher than the original?
options: Yes — any decision, whether more or less onerous, that the specified authority had power to make
No — the Tribunal may only confirm the decision or reduce its severity, never increase it
Only if the applicant gives written consent to a harsher outcome before the hearing
Only where the applicant has already been convicted of an offence under the Ordinance
en.explain: Section 60(2) allows the varied or substituted decision to be any decision, whether more or less onerous than the original, that the specified authority had power to make — the Tribunal is not limited to confirming or reducing, and neither the applicant's consent nor a prior conviction is a precondition.

tc.q: 審裁處更改或取代指明決定時，新決定可否較原決定為重？
options: 可以——指明當局有權作出的任何決定，不論輕重
不可以——審裁處只可確認原決定或予以減輕，不可加重
只有在申請人於聆訊前書面同意較重結果的情況下方可
只有在申請人已被裁定犯本條例所訂罪行的情況下方可
tc.explain: 第60(2)條容許經更改或取代的決定，可以是指明當局有權作出的任何決定，不論較原決定為重或為輕——審裁處並不限於確認或減輕決定，亦不以申請人同意或已有定罪紀錄為先決條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(4)條

en.q: What standard of proof applies to matters of fact in proceedings before the Review Tribunal?
options: The balance of probabilities
Beyond reasonable doubt
Clear and credible evidence
A prima facie case
en.explain: Section 60(4) provides that for the purposes of proceedings before the Tribunal, matters of fact are to be established on a balance of probabilities — the civil standard. Note that under section 63(3) the criminal-style contempt standard applies when the Tribunal punishes for contempt.

tc.q: 在審裁處席前的法律程序中，事實事宜適用甚麼舉證標準？
options: 相對可能性的衡量
無合理疑點
清晰可信的證據
表面證據
tc.explain: 第60(4)條訂明，就審裁處席前的法律程序而言，事實事宜須按相對可能性的衡量而確立，即民事標準。留意根據第63(3)條，審裁處就藐視行為施加懲罰時，須採用與原訟法庭相同的舉證標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(a)條

en.q: What material may the Tribunal receive and consider for the purposes of a review?
options: Any oral evidence, written statements or documents, whether or not admissible in a court of law
Any material by way of oral evidence, written statements or documents, but only if admissible in a court of law
Only documents that were already before the specified authority when it made the specified decision, with no new material
Only evidence given under oath by way of a sworn affidavit, and no other form of material
en.explain: Section 61(1)(a) allows the Tribunal to receive any material by way of oral evidence, written statements or documents, whether or not it would be admissible in a court of law — admissibility is expressly irrelevant, so restricting it to admissible material inverts the rule. The Tribunal is not limited to documents that were before the specified authority, nor to sworn affidavits alone (which section 61(1)(f) instead lets the Tribunal order for a witness).

tc.q: 就覆核而言，審裁處可接收及考慮甚麼材料？
options: 以口頭證據、書面陳述或文件提交的材料，不論在法院是否可獲接納
以口頭證據、書面陳述或文件提交的任何材料，但須在法院可獲接納為證據
只限指明當局作出該指明決定時已備有的文件，不接受任何新材料
只限以宣誓方式提交的誓章證據，不接受其他形式的材料
tc.explain: 第61(1)(a)條准許審裁處接收以口頭證據、書面陳述或文件形式提交的任何材料，不論該材料在法院是否可獲接納為證據——可否獲接納明確地不是考慮因素，故將範圍限於可獲接納的材料，正是把規則反轉。審裁處並不限於接收指明當局作出決定時已備有的文件，亦不限於宣誓誓章證據（第61(1)(f)條另有規定命令證人以誓章提供證據）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(c)條

en.q: How does the Tribunal require a person to attend before it and give evidence?
options: By notice in writing signed by the chairperson of the Tribunal
By a warrant issued by a magistrate authorising the person's arrest
By an order of the Court of First Instance made on the Tribunal's application
By a written direction given by the specified authority whose decision is under review
en.explain: Section 61(1)(c) empowers the Tribunal itself, by notice in writing signed by its chairperson, to require a person to attend and give evidence. There is no magistrate's warrant, Court of First Instance order, or specified-authority direction involved in compelling attendance before the Tribunal.

tc.q: 審裁處如何規定某人出席其席前作證？
options: 以由審裁處主席簽署的書面通知
以裁判官發出的手令，授權拘捕該人
以原訟法庭應審裁處申請作出的命令
以正接受覆核的指明當局發出的書面指示
tc.explain: 第61(1)(c)條授權審裁處本身，以由其主席簽署的書面通知，規定某人出席並作證。規定出席審裁處席前並不涉及裁判官手令、原訟法庭命令或指明當局的指示。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(4)條

en.q: May a person refuse to comply with a Tribunal order on the ground that compliance might tend to incriminate them?
options: No — that ground alone is no excuse, though section 62 limits later use of the evidence
Yes — a real risk of self-incrimination is a complete answer to any Tribunal order or requirement
Yes, but only after first applying to the Court of First Instance and obtaining its leave to refuse
No, and the evidence may then be freely used against the person in any later criminal prosecution
en.explain: Section 61(4) provides that a person is not excused from complying only on the ground that compliance might tend to incriminate them — that risk alone is not a complete answer, and no leave of the Court of First Instance is needed. Section 62(2) then protects the person by making the evidence inadmissible against them in criminal proceedings (subject to the section 62(3) exception), so it is not freely usable.

tc.q: 某人可否以遵從審裁處命令相當可能會導致其入罪為理由而拒絕遵從？
options: 不可以——僅此理由不能免除遵從，但第62條限制該證據在刑事程序的使用
可以——相當可能會導致入罪的真實風險，是對抗任何審裁處命令或規定的完全理由
可以，但須先向原訟法庭申請並取得其許可，方可拒絕遵從
不可以，而該等證據其後可在任何刑事檢控中自由用作針對該人的證據
tc.explain: 第61(4)條訂明，任何人不得僅以遵從相當可能會導致其入罪為理由而獲免除遵從——此風險本身並非完全理由，亦無須先取得原訟法庭許可。第62(2)條其後訂明該等證據不可用作針對該人的刑事法律程序證據（但須受第62(3)條的例外規定所限），故並非可自由使用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(2)及(3)條

en.q: Which of the following is an offence under section 61(2) in relation to the Tribunal?
options: Threatening, insulting or causing loss to a person because that person attended before the Tribunal
Publishing material received at a public sitting where no non-disclosure order had been made
Leaving the place of attendance with the Tribunal's permission before finishing giving evidence
Failing to pay Tribunal-awarded costs within 30 days of the costs order
en.explain: Section 61(2)(e)-(f) makes it an offence to threaten, insult or cause loss to a person on account of their having attended before the Tribunal. Publishing material from an open sitting where no non-disclosure order was made breaches nothing under section 61(1)(g)-(h). Leaving with the Tribunal's permission is expressly excluded from the section 61(2)(c) offence, which only catches leaving without permission. Failing to pay costs is not listed among the section 61(2) offences at all. The penalty under section 61(3) is a fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment on indictment.

tc.q: 下列何者屬第61(2)條所訂與審裁處有關的罪行？
options: 因某人曾出席審裁處席前而威脅、侮辱該人或導致該人蒙受損失
發布在並無作出不得披露命令的公開聆訊中所接收的材料
在審裁處許可下，於作證完畢前離開出席地點
沒有於訟費命令作出後30日內繳付審裁處判給的訟費
tc.explain: 第61(2)(e)及(f)條將因某人曾出席審裁處席前而威脅、侮辱該人或導致其蒙受損失訂為罪行。在並無作出不得披露命令的公開聆訊中發布材料，並不違反第61(1)(g)或(h)條。在審裁處許可下離開已明確不屬第61(2)(c)條所訂罪行，該罪行只涵蓋未經許可而離開。沒有繳付訟費完全不在第61(2)條所列罪行之內。第61(3)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第63(1)及(3)條

en.q: What powers does the Review Tribunal have in relation to contempt?
options: The same contempt powers as the Court of First Instance, and the same standard of proof
No contempt powers at all; any contempt must instead be referred to the Court of First Instance
Power to impose a fine for contempt, but no power to commit a person to imprisonment
Power to punish for contempt, but only with the prior written consent of the Secretary for Justice
en.explain: Section 63(1) gives the Tribunal the same powers as the Court of First Instance to punish for contempt, and section 63(3) requires it to adopt the same standard of proof as that Court. There is no carve-out that denies the Tribunal contempt powers, limits it to fines only, or requires the Secretary for Justice's consent.

tc.q: 審裁處就藐視行為具有甚麼權力？
options: 與原訟法庭相同的懲罰藐視行為權力及相同舉證標準
並無任何藐視行為權力；任何藐視行為須轉交原訟法庭處理
可就藐視行為判處罰款，但無權判處該人監禁服刑
可懲罰藐視行為，但須先取得律政司司長的書面同意
tc.explain: 第63(1)條賦予審裁處與原訟法庭相同的懲罰藐視行為權力，第63(3)條則規定其須採用與該法庭相同的舉證標準。並無條文剝奪審裁處的藐視行為權力、將其限於罰款，或規定須取得律政司司長同意。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第64條

en.q: What protection does section 64 give to an authorized institution acting as banker or financial adviser to a review applicant?
options: Part 6 and Schedule 4 do not require disclosure about any customer other than the applicant
It need not disclose information relating to the applicant's own affairs, held in its capacity as banker
It is exempt from ever being required to attend and give evidence before the Tribunal
It may refuse to produce any document to the Tribunal without giving any reason at all
en.explain: Section 64 protects information about the authorized institution's other customers, not the applicant's own affairs — since the applicant is the one seeking review, their own banking affairs are not shielded by this section. Section 64 does not exempt the institution from attending, nor from giving reasons for withholding documents; those matters are instead governed by section 61.

tc.q: 第64條為擔任覆核申請人的銀行家或財務顧問的認可機構提供甚麼保障？
options: 第6部及附表4並不規定披露該申請人以外任何客戶的資料
無須披露其以銀行家身分持有的、關於該申請人本身事務的資料
獲豁免於在任何情況下均須出席審裁處席前作證
可拒絕向審裁處交出任何文件，而無須給予任何理由
tc.explain: 第64條保障的是認可機構其他客戶的資料，並非申請人本身的事務——由於申請人正是提出覆核的人，其本身的銀行事務並不受本條保障。第64條並無豁免該機構出席，也無豁免其須就拒絕交出文件說明理由；這些事宜屬第61條規管範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第65(1)及(2)條

en.q: To whom may the Tribunal award costs in relation to a review?
options: To any party to the review, or anyone whose attendance was necessary or required
To any party, but not to a witness whose attendance was merely required, not necessary
Only to whichever party is ultimately successful in the review
Only to the specified authority; costs may never be awarded to the applicant
en.explain: Section 65(1) lets the Tribunal award costs to any party to the review, or to any person whose attendance — whether or not as a witness, and whether necessary or merely required — was needed for the review; the 'merely required' limb is not excluded. The Tribunal is not limited to the successful party, and costs may be awarded to or against either side, not only the specified authority.

tc.q: 就覆核而言，審裁處可向何人判給訟費？
options: 覆核的任何一方，或出席屬必需或被規定出席的任何人
覆核的任何一方，但不包括僅屬被規定出席、並非屬必需的證人
只限覆核中最終勝訴的一方
只限指明當局；訟費永不可判給申請人
tc.explain: 第65(1)條准許審裁處向覆核的任何一方，或向就覆核而言其出席（不論是否作為證人，也不論屬必需或僅屬被規定）屬必需或被規定的任何人判給訟費；「僅屬被規定」的情況並無被排除。審裁處並不限於只向勝訴一方判給，訟費亦可判給或責令任何一方支付，並非只限指明當局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第66(1)條

en.q: What must the Tribunal deliver after completing a review?
options: Its determination and reasons, together with any costs order and its reasons
Only the operative determination itself, without giving any reasons for it
A recommendation to the specified authority, which remains free to depart from it
A confidential report addressed only to the Secretary for Justice and no one else
en.explain: Section 66(1) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after completing a review, to deliver its determination and the reasons for it, and any costs order made under section 65 together with the reasons for that order — not a bare determination, a non-binding recommendation, or a confidential report to the Secretary for Justice.

tc.q: 審裁處完成覆核後須交付甚麼？
options: 其裁定及理由，連同任何訟費命令及其理由
只交付有實效的裁定本身，而不附任何理由
向指明當局提出建議，該當局仍可自由不予採納
只向律政司司長而非任何其他人提交的機密報告
tc.explain: 第66(1)條規定審裁處須在完成覆核後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快交付其裁定及裁定理由，以及根據第65條作出的任何訟費命令連同該命令的理由——並非單純的裁定、不具約束力的建議，或向律政司司長提交的機密報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第67(2)條

en.q: What presumption attaches to a document purporting to be an order of the Tribunal signed by its chairperson?
options: Absent contrary evidence, it is presumed duly made and signed without further proof
It is presumed duly made only once the chairperson's signature has been formally proved
It must be proved genuine by calling the chairperson of the Tribunal personally as a witness
It has effect only once the order has been registered in the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 67(2) presumes such a document duly made and signed, in the absence of contrary evidence, without proof of its making, of the signature, or that the signatory was in fact the chairperson — so requiring the signature to be formally proved first inverts the rule. No witness need be called, and the presumption does not depend on registration in the Court of First Instance.

tc.q: 看來是由審裁處主席簽署的審裁處命令的文件，附有甚麼推定？
options: 在無相反證據下，推定為妥為作出及妥為簽署
須先正式證明主席的簽署後，方推定為妥為作出
須傳召審裁處主席親自作證，方能證明其真確性
須經在原訟法庭登記後，該項命令方有效力
tc.explain: 第67(2)條訂明，在無相反證據的情況下，該文件推定為妥為作出及簽署，無須證明其作出、簽署，或簽署人事實上是主席——故規定須先正式證明簽署，正是把規則反轉。無須傳召主席作證，該推定亦不以在原訟法庭登記為條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第69(1)條

en.q: Does making an application for review automatically suspend the specified decision under challenge?
options: No — the application alone does not stay execution, though a stay may be sought
Yes — the decision is automatically suspended until the Tribunal determines the review
Yes, but only where the specified decision is a revocation or suspension of the person's licence
No, and under no circumstances may the Tribunal ever grant a stay of execution
en.explain: Section 69(1) provides that the making of an application for review does not by itself operate as a stay of execution of the specified decision. Section 69(2) allows the applicant to apply separately to the Tribunal for a stay at any time before determination — so a stay is not automatic, not limited to licence revocations, and not impossible to obtain.

tc.q: 提出覆核申請是否自動暫緩執行受質疑的指明決定？
options: 不會——申請本身並不構成暫緩執行，但可另行申請
會——該決定在審裁處裁定覆核前自動暫緩執行
會，但只限該指明決定屬撤銷或暫時吊銷該人牌照的情況
不會，而審裁處在任何情況下均不可批予暫緩執行
tc.explain: 第69(1)條訂明，提出覆核申請本身並不構成暫緩執行該指明決定。第69(2)條准許申請人在裁定前隨時另行向審裁處申請暫緩執行——故暫緩執行並非自動、並非只限於撤銷牌照的情況，亦非不可能取得。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第71(1)及(2)條

en.q: On what basis may a party dissatisfied with a Tribunal determination appeal to the Court of Appeal?
options: On a question of law, fact, or mixed law and fact, but only with the court's leave
On a question of law only, and as of right without needing the leave of any court
On any ground whatsoever, as of right, provided the appeal is lodged within 21 days
Only where the Tribunal itself certifies that the case raises a point of general importance
en.explain: Section 71(1) allows an appeal on a question of law, a question of fact, or a question of mixed law and fact, and section 71(2) requires the leave of the Court of Appeal — it is not confined to law alone, not available as of right, not simply time-limited to 21 days, and does not depend on the Tribunal's own certification.

tc.q: 對審裁處裁定感到不滿的一方，可基於甚麼理由向上訴法庭上訴？
options: 基於法律、事實或混合法律與事實的問題，但須取得法庭許可
只可基於法律問題，並可作為權利提出，無須取得任何法庭的許可
可基於任何理由，並可作為權利提出，只要在21日內提出上訴
只限審裁處本身證明該案引起一般重要性的爭論點
tc.explain: 第71(1)條准許就法律問題、事實問題或混合法律與事實的問題提出上訴，第71(2)條則要求須取得上訴法庭的許可——並不限於法律問題、不可作為當然權利提出、不只是受21日時限規限，亦不取決於審裁處本身的證明。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第71(4)條

en.q: On what basis may the Court of Appeal grant leave to appeal against a Tribunal determination?
options: Only if the appeal has a reasonable prospect of success, or another reason in the interests of justice
Only if the appeal is on a question of law, and only if the Tribunal itself certifies the point for appeal
Only if the appellant has already paid in full all the costs awarded against them by the Tribunal under section 65
Leave must be granted as of right once the prescribed fee under Schedule 3 has been paid
en.explain: Section 71(4) sets the test as a reasonable prospect of success, or some other reason in the interests of justice — it is not confined to questions of law (section 71(1) covers law, fact, or mixed law and fact) and does not require Tribunal certification, payment of costs, or a fee; leave is a discretionary decision of the Court of Appeal, not an entitlement.

tc.q: 上訴法庭可基於甚麼理由批予針對審裁處裁定的上訴許可？
options: 只有該上訴有合理機會得直，或基於司法公正的利益有其他理由
只限該上訴基於法律問題，並須經審裁處本身就該爭論點發出證明
只限上訴人已悉數繳付審裁處根據第65條判給的全部訟費
一經繳付附表3訂明的費用，即須作為權利批予許可
tc.explain: 第71(4)條所訂的驗證標準為：上訴有合理機會得直，或基於司法公正的利益有其他理由應予聆訊——並不限於法律問題（第71(1)條涵蓋法律、事實或混合法律與事實的問題），亦不須審裁處發出證明、繳付訟費或費用；許可屬上訴法庭酌情決定的事宜，並非當然權利。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第72(1)條

en.q: On an appeal against a determination of the Tribunal, what may the Court of Appeal do?
options: Allow or dismiss the appeal, vary or set aside and substitute the determination, or remit with directions
Remit the matter to the Court of First Instance for a complete fresh hearing on the merits of the case
Substitute a different determination, but only if the specified authority consents to it in writing
Only quash the determination outright, with no power to substitute another decision or remit the matter to the Tribunal
en.explain: Section 72(1) lets the Court of Appeal allow or dismiss the appeal, vary or set aside the determination and substitute any other determination it considers appropriate, or remit the matter to the Tribunal or the specified authority (not the Court of First Instance, which has no role in this appeal) with directions — substitution requires no consent from the specified authority, and quashing is not the only option.

tc.q: 就針對審裁處裁定的上訴，上訴法庭可作出甚麼處置？
options: 裁定上訴得直、駁回、更改、撤銷並取代，或連同指示發回
將事宜發回原訟法庭，就案情實質重新進行完整聆訊
以另一裁定取代，但須取得指明當局的書面同意
只可徹底撤銷該裁定，無權以另一裁定取代或將事宜發回審裁處
tc.explain: 第72(1)條准許上訴法庭裁定上訴得直、駁回上訴、更改或撤銷該裁定並以其認為適當的另一裁定取代，或將事宜連同指示發回審裁處或指明當局（並非原訟法庭，原訟法庭在此上訴中並無角色）——取代裁定無須指明當局同意，撤銷亦非唯一選擇。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第73(1)條

en.q: Does lodging an appeal to the Court of Appeal automatically stay execution of the Tribunal's determination?
options: No — an appeal does not itself stay execution, but the Court of Appeal may order one
Yes — execution of the determination is automatically stayed the moment the appeal is lodged
Yes, but only for determinations that impose a pecuniary or other monetary penalty on the person
No, and the Court of Appeal has no power under the Ordinance to order any stay in any circumstances
en.explain: Section 73(1) provides that lodging an appeal does not by itself operate as a stay of execution. Section 73(2) allows the Court of Appeal, on application by a party, to order a stay, subject under section 73(3) to any conditions it considers appropriate — so the stay is neither automatic, limited to pecuniary penalties, nor unavailable.

tc.q: 向上訴法庭提出上訴，是否自動暫緩執行審裁處的裁定？
options: 不會——上訴本身不構成暫緩執行，但可應申請頒令暫緩
會——一經提出上訴，該裁定的執行即自動暫緩
會，但只限對該人施加罰款或其他金錢處罰的裁定
不會，而上訴法庭根據本條例在任何情況下亦無權頒令暫緩
tc.explain: 第73(1)條訂明，提出上訴本身並不構成暫緩執行。第73(2)條准許上訴法庭應一方的申請頒令暫緩，並根據第73(3)條可附加其認為適當的條件——故暫緩執行既非自動，亦不限於施加罰款的裁定，更非不可能取得。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第74條

en.q: Section 74 makes a Tribunal determination final and not subject to appeal. What limits that finality?
options: It is subject to section 71 and to section 50 of the High Court Ordinance
It is subject to a further review procedure by the Secretary for Justice under section 55
It is subject to a fresh application for review by the same Tribunal under section 59
Nothing limits it — the determination is absolutely final and unappealable in every case
en.explain: Section 74 makes the Tribunal's determination final, subject to section 50 of the High Court Ordinance and to the section 71 right of appeal to the Court of Appeal (which itself requires leave under section 71(2)). There is no separate review by the Secretary for Justice, and section 59 governs the original application for review, not a challenge to the Tribunal's own determination — so, contrary to the fourth option, the determination is not absolutely unappealable.

tc.q: 第74條訂明審裁處的裁定屬最終決定，不得上訴。甚麼限制了這種終局性？
options: 須受第71條及《高等法院條例》第50條所限
須受律政司司長根據第55條進行的進一步覆核程序所限
須受向同一審裁處根據第59條提出的新覆核申請所限
並無任何限制——該裁定在所有情況下均屬絕對最終，不得上訴
tc.explain: 第74條訂明，在《高等法院條例》第50條及第71條向上訴法庭提出上訴的權利（該權利本身須先根據第71(2)條取得許可）的規限下，審裁處的裁定屬最終決定。並無由律政司司長進行的另一項覆核；第59條規管的是原有的覆核申請，並非對審裁處本身裁定提出質疑——故與第四個選項所述相反，該裁定並非在所有情況下都絕對不可上訴。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(b)條

en.q: A person neither notifies the specified authority that they will not seek a review nor applies for one within the 21-day period. When does the specified decision take effect?
options: At the time the 21-day period expires
On the date the decision was originally made
Only once the specified authority issues a further notice
Three months after the notice of the decision was sent
en.explain: Section 75(1)(b) provides that where, within the 21-day period specified in section 59(1), the person neither notifies the specified authority that they will not apply for a review nor applies for one, the decision takes effect at the time the period expires.

tc.q: 某人在21日期間內既無通知指明當局其不會申請覆核，亦無提出覆核申請。該指明決定何時生效？
options: 於該21日期間屆滿時
於該決定原本作出之日
須待指明當局發出進一步通知後
於決定通知寄發後三個月
tc.explain: 第75(1)(b)條訂明，凡在第59(1)條所指明的21日期間內，該人既無通知指明當局其不會申請覆核，亦無提出覆核申請，該決定於該期間屆滿時生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(a)條

en.q: A person notifies the specified authority in writing, before the 21-day period expires, that they will not apply for a review. When does the decision take effect?
options: At the time the person so notifies the specified authority
At the expiry of the 21-day period regardless
On the date the notice of the decision was originally sent
Only after the specified authority confirms receipt
en.explain: Section 75(1)(a) provides that where the person notifies the specified authority in writing, before the 21-day period expires, that they will not apply for a review, the decision takes effect at the time the person so notifies the authority.

tc.q: 某人在21日期間屆滿前，以書面通知指明當局其不會申請覆核。該決定何時生效？
options: 於該人如此通知指明當局時
無論如何均於21日期間屆滿時
於決定通知原本寄發之日
須待指明當局書面確認收妥後
tc.explain: 第75(1)(a)條訂明，凡該人在21日期間屆滿前以書面通知指明當局其不會申請覆核，該決定於該人如此通知該當局時生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(2)條

en.q: In what circumstances may a specified authority set a different time for a specified decision to take effect?
options: Where it considers it appropriate in the public interest, as stated in the decision notice
Only where the person affected has already consented in writing to an earlier effective date
Only where the Review Tribunal has already confirmed the decision on review and given notice of it
Never — the timing rules in section 75(1) are mandatory and cannot be departed from
en.explain: Section 75(2) lets the specified authority itself set a different effective time whenever it considers this appropriate in the public interest, simply by stating that time in the decision notice — no consent from the affected person and no prior confirmation by the Tribunal is needed, and the power is a stated exception to (not an absolute bar under) section 75(1).

tc.q: 指明當局在甚麼情況下可訂定指明決定生效的不同時間？
options: 如其認為基於公眾利益而恰當，並在通知內指明該時間
只限受影響的人已事先以書面同意較早的生效日期
只限覆核審裁處已在覆核中確認該指明決定並發出通知
永不可以——第75(1)條的時間規則屬強制性，不可背離
tc.explain: 第75(2)條容許指明當局在其認為基於公眾利益屬恰當的任何情況下，只須在決定通知內註明該時間，即可自行訂定不同的生效時間——無須受影響的人同意，亦無須審裁處事先確認；此項權力是第75(1)條訂明的例外情況，並非該條所訂的絕對限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76條

en.q: Who may make rules regulating the procedure for the hearing of appeals under section 71?
options: The Chief Justice
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
The chairperson of the Review Tribunal
The Chief Executive in Council
en.explain: Section 76 empowers the Chief Justice to make rules providing for matters relating to the registration of a Tribunal order in the Court of First Instance under section 68(1), and regulating the procedure for the hearing of appeals under section 71.

tc.q: 何人可訂立規則規管第71條下上訴聆訊的程序？
options: 終審法院首席法官
財經事務及庫務局局長
審裁處主席
行政長官會同行政會議
tc.explain: 第76條授權終審法院首席法官訂立規則，就根據第68(1)條在原訟法庭登記審裁處命令的相關事宜作出規定，以及規管第71條下上訴聆訊的程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第68條

en.q: Once an order of the Tribunal is registered in the Court of First Instance under section 68, what is its status?
options: It is regarded for all purposes as an order of that Court made within its own jurisdiction
