It becomes appealable to the Court of Appeal as of right, without needing leave
It may thereafter be enforced only by the specified authority, not by the party awarded it
Execution of the order is automatically stayed pending any further application for review
en.explain: Section 68(2) provides that a registered order is regarded for all purposes as an order of the Court of First Instance made within that Court's jurisdiction — it does not thereby become appealable as of right (appeals against Tribunal determinations remain governed by section 71's leave requirement), it is not restricted to enforcement by the specified authority, and registration does not itself trigger any automatic stay.

tc.q: 根據第68條將審裁處的命令在原訟法庭登記後，該命令具有甚麼地位？
options: 就一切目的而言，視為該法庭在其本身司法管轄權內作出的命令
無須許可即可作為當然權利向上訴法庭提出上訴
其後只可由指明當局強制執行，獲判給的一方不可執行
在任何進一步覆核申請待決期間自動暫緩執行
tc.explain: 第68(2)條訂明，經登記的命令就一切目的而言，視為原訟法庭在其本身司法管轄權內作出的命令——並不會因此當然可向上訴法庭上訴（針對審裁處裁定的上訴仍受第71條的許可規定所規範），亦不限於只可由指明當局強制執行，登記本身也不會觸發任何自動暫緩執行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第77(1)條

en.q: The Chief Executive in Council's power to make regulations under section 77 extends to the whole Ordinance except which Parts?
options: Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C — Part 5's regulations are instead made by the Commissioner
Parts 1 and 2 only, which contain only interpretation and preliminary provisions
Part 6 only, which deals with the Review Tribunal and its procedure
Parts 3 and 4, covering supervision, investigation, disciplinary and prosecution powers
en.explain: Section 77(1) excludes Parts 5, 5A, 5B and 5C from the Chief Executive in Council's general regulation-making power. Part 5 instead has its own regulation-maker: the Commissioner, under section 51. Parts 5A to 5C form the separate virtual asset service provider licensing regime. Parts 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 all remain within the Chief Executive in Council's general power.

tc.q: 第77條下行政長官會同行政會議訂立規例的權力，涵蓋整條條例，但不包括哪幾部？
options: 第5、5A、5B及5C部——第5部的規例改由關長訂立
只限第1及2部——該兩部僅載有釋義及籌備性的條文
只限第6部——該部只涉及覆核審裁處及其程序
第3及4部——涵蓋監督、調查、紀律處分及提出檢控方面的權力
tc.explain: 第77(1)條將第5、5A、5B及5C部排除於行政長官會同行政會議的一般訂立規例權力之外。第5部本身另有訂立規例的主體：根據第51條的海關關長。第5A至5C部則構成獨立的虛擬資產服務提供者發牌制度。第1、2、3、4及6部仍屬行政長官會同行政會議的一般權力範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第77(2)條

en.q: What kinds of provision may regulations made under section 77 include?
options: Savings, transitional, incidental, supplemental, evidential and consequential provisions
Provisions creating indictable offences punishable by more than 7 years' imprisonment
Provisions amending Schedule 2 to the Ordinance
Provisions altering the composition of the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 77(2) provides that, without limiting subsection (1), the regulations may include any savings, transitional, incidental, supplemental, evidential and consequential provisions, whether involving provisions of principal or subsidiary legislation. Schedule 2 is amended under section 6, and Schedule 4 under section 58(2).

tc.q: 根據第77條訂立的規例可包括哪類條文？
options: 保留、過渡、附帶、補充、關乎證據及相應的條文
訂立可判處超過7年監禁的新可公訴罪行的條文
修訂本條例附表2的條文
更改審裁處組成的條文
tc.explain: 第77(2)條訂明，在不局限第(1)款的原則下，規例可包括任何保留、過渡、附帶、補充、關乎證據及相應的條文，不論是否涉及主體法例或附屬法例的條文。附表2由第6條修訂，附表4則由第58(2)條修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第55(3)條

en.q: May more than one review tribunal exist at a time under the AMLO?
options: Yes — the Secretary may establish additional tribunals if considered appropriate
Yes, but only if every additional tribunal shares the same chairperson as the original
Yes, but only to hear reviews of decisions made by different specified authorities
No — the Ordinance permits only a single Tribunal to exist at any one time
en.explain: Section 55(3) lets the Secretary establish additional tribunals whenever considered appropriate, with the Ordinance applying to each with necessary modifications — there is no requirement that additional tribunals share the original chairperson, and no restriction to reviews of different specified authorities' decisions.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，同一時間可否存在多於一個審裁處？
options: 可以——局長如認為恰當，可設立額外審裁處
可以，但每個額外審裁處須與原審裁處共用同一主席
可以，但只限用於聆訊不同指明當局所作決定的覆核
不可以——本條例只准許任何時間存在一個審裁處
tc.explain: 第55(3)條容許局長在認為恰當時設立額外審裁處，而本條例經必要修改後適用於每個該等審裁處——並無規定額外審裁處須與原有審裁處共用同一主席，亦無限制只可用於聆訊不同指明當局所作決定的覆核。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第57(2)條

en.q: How are the fees payable to the chairperson and members of the Review Tribunal met?
options: They are a charge on the general revenue
They are paid out of pecuniary penalties collected under section 21
They are paid by the parties to the review in equal shares
They are met from licence fees paid under Schedule 3
en.explain: Section 57(1) allows the chairperson and other members to be paid a fee for their services in an amount the Secretary considers appropriate, and section 57(2) provides that the amounts payable are a charge on the general revenue.

tc.q: 應付予審裁處主席及成員的費用如何支付？
options: 由政府一般收入撥支
從根據第21條收取的罰款中支付
由覆核各方平均分擔
從根據附表3繳付的牌照費用中支付
tc.explain: 第57(1)條准許向主席及其他成員支付局長認為適當款額的服務費用，第57(2)條則訂明根據本條應付的款額由政府一般收入撥支。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(g)及(h)條

en.q: What control does the Tribunal have over publishing material it has received?
options: It may prohibit publication of material it receives, including from a private sitting
It may prohibit publication of the material, but only after its determination has been delivered
It has no such power; publication control is a matter for the Court of First Instance, not the Tribunal
It may prohibit publication of the material only if both parties to the review consent
en.explain: Section 61(1)(g) lets the Tribunal, at any time, order a person not to publish or disclose material it receives, and section 61(1)(h) lets it prohibit publication of material received at a sitting (or part of one) held in private — neither power is confined to after the determination, reserved to the Court of First Instance, or conditional on both parties' consent.

tc.q: 審裁處對其接收材料的發布具有甚麼管控權？
options: 可禁止發布其接收的材料，包括非公開聆訊的材料
只可在交付其裁定後，才可禁止發布該等材料
並無有關權力；發布管制屬原訟法庭而非審裁處的職權
只有在覆核雙方均同意下，方可禁止發布該等材料
tc.explain: 第61(1)(g)條准許審裁處隨時命令某人不得發布或披露其接收的材料，第61(1)(h)條則准許其禁止發布在非公開聆訊（或聆訊的部分）中接收的材料——兩項權力均不限於在裁定交付後才可行使，也不屬原訟法庭職權，更不以覆核雙方同意為條件。

en.q: Where a Tribunal sitting was held in private, what may the Tribunal order about its determination, and what is the penalty for breach?
options: It may prohibit publication; breach without reasonable excuse carries $1,000,000 and 2 years on indictment
It may prohibit publication, but breach of that order attracts no criminal sanction and no civil consequence
It may prohibit publication; breach without reasonable excuse carries $1,000,000 and 7 years on conviction on indictment
It may prohibit publication; breach without reasonable excuse is punishable only on summary conviction, by a fine at level 6 and 6 months
en.explain: Section 66(2) lets the Tribunal prohibit publication or disclosure of its determination or reasons where a sitting was held in private; section 66(3) makes non-compliance without reasonable excuse an offence, and section 66(4)(a) sets the indictable penalty at $1,000,000 and 2 years — not the 7 years that instead applies to the intent-to-defraud offences under section 13(9), and not merely the level-6/6-month figure, which is section 66(4)(b)'s alternative summary-conviction penalty, not the indictable one.

tc.q: 如審裁處的聆訊以非公開方式進行，審裁處可就其裁定作出甚麼命令？違反的刑罰為何？
options: 可禁止發布；無合理辯解而違反者，循公訴程序可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
可禁止發布，但違反該命令並無任何刑事制裁，亦無民事後果
可禁止發布；無合理辯解而違反者，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
可禁止發布；無合理辯解而違反者，只可循簡易程序定罪，可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月
tc.explain: 第66(2)條准許審裁處在聆訊以非公開方式進行的情況下，禁止發布或披露其裁定或理由；第66(3)條將無合理辯解而不遵從訂為罪行，第66(4)(a)條就公訴程序定罪訂明罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年——並非第13(9)條下欺詐意圖罪行所適用的監禁7年，也不只是第66(4)(b)條所訂的簡易程序（第6級罰款及監禁6個月）另一選擇刑罰。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第62(2)及(3)條

en.q: Evidence given to the Tribunal under compulsion is generally inadmissible against the person in criminal proceedings. In which proceedings does that protection NOT apply?
options: Proceedings for an offence under section 61(2)(a), or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance
Any and all proceedings for any offence whatsoever committed under the AMLO
Disciplinary proceedings brought against the person by the specified authority under section 21
Contempt proceedings brought against the person under the Tribunal's own powers in section 63
en.explain: Section 62(3) disapplies the protection only for proceedings in which the person is charged with an offence under section 61(2)(a) (failing to comply with a Tribunal order) or under Part V of the Crimes Ordinance (perjury-type offences), in respect of that evidence — not for AMLO offences generally, not for section 21 disciplinary proceedings, and not for contempt proceedings under section 63.

tc.q: 在強制下向審裁處提供的證據，一般不可在刑事法律程序中用作針對該人。該保障在哪類法律程序中並不適用？
options: 就該等證據而根據第61(2)(a)條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部提出的罪行的法律程序
根據《打擊洗錢條例》所犯任何罪行的任何及所有法律程序
指明當局根據第21條對該人提起的紀律處分法律程序
根據第63條審裁處本身權力而對該人提起的藐視法律程序
tc.explain: 第62(3)條只在該人因該等證據而被控第61(2)(a)條所訂罪行（沒有遵從審裁處命令）或《刑事罪行條例》第V部所訂罪行（偽證類罪行）的法律程序中，方會撤銷該項保障——並非適用於《打擊洗錢條例》下的一般罪行，也不適用於第21條紀律處分法律程序，或第63條下的藐視法律程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第65(3)條

en.q: Which rules apply to the award and taxation of costs by the Review Tribunal?
options: Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court
Order 14 of the Rules of the District Court
The Legal Aid Regulations
Rules made by the Secretary under section 58(2)
en.explain: Section 65(3) provides that Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court (Cap. 4 sub. leg. A) applies to the award of costs, and to the taxation of any costs awarded, by the Tribunal under section 65(1).

tc.q: 審裁處判給及評定訟費適用哪些規則？
options: 《高等法院規則》第62號命令
《區域法院規則》第14號命令
《法律援助規例》
局長根據第58(2)條訂立的規則
tc.explain: 第65(3)條訂明，《高等法院規則》（第4章，附屬法例A）第62號命令適用於審裁處根據第65(1)條判給訟費，以及評定任何獲判給的訟費。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第70條

en.q: After the Tribunal has determined a review, what may a party apply for under section 70?
options: A stay of execution, on conditions as to costs or payment into the Tribunal
An extension of time to apply for the review itself, under Schedule 4 to the Ordinance
A variation of the costs order already made by the Tribunal, under section 65
A complete refund of all costs and expenses the party has incurred throughout the review
en.explain: Section 70 lets a party apply, after the Tribunal has already determined the review, for a stay of execution of that determination, which the Tribunal may grant subject to conditions as to costs or payment of money into the Tribunal. It is not a route to extend the time for applying for review in the first place (that is section 59(2)-(3)), to vary an existing costs order (section 65), or to obtain a refund of costs incurred.

tc.q: 審裁處裁定覆核後，一方可根據第70條申請甚麼？
options: 暫緩執行該裁定，並可附加訟費或繳存款項條件
根據本條例附表4延展提出覆核申請本身的時限
根據第65條更改審裁處已作出的訟費命令
退還該方在整個覆核過程中所招致的全部訟費及開支
tc.explain: 第70條容許一方在審裁處已裁定覆核後，就該裁定申請暫緩執行，審裁處可附加關於訟費或向審裁處繳存款項的條件而批予暫緩。這並非用以延展最初提出覆核申請的時限（該事宜屬第59(2)至(3)條）、更改現有訟費命令（屬第65條），或退還已招致的訟費。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第59(5)條

en.q: What must the Tribunal do after receiving an application for review?
options: Send a copy of the application to the specified authority, as soon as reasonably practicable
Publish a formal notice about the application in the government Gazette within 7 days
Immediately stay execution of the specified decision pending the hearing and determination of the review
Refer the application to the Secretary for his or her preliminary written view
en.explain: Section 59(5) requires the Tribunal, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving an application for review, to send a copy of the application to the specified authority — not to gazette it, stay the decision itself (section 69(1) says an application does not operate as a stay), or refer it to the Secretary.

tc.q: 審裁處接獲覆核申請後須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將申請副本送交指明當局
在7日內於政府憲報刊登關於該項申請的正式公告
在該項覆核的聆訊及裁定前，立即暫緩執行該指明決定
將該項申請轉交局長，以取得其初步書面意見
tc.explain: 第59(5)條規定審裁處須在接獲覆核申請後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快將申請副本送交指明當局——並非在憲報刊登、自行暫緩執行該決定（第69(1)條訂明申請本身並不構成暫緩執行），或將申請轉交局長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(3)條

en.q: What must the Tribunal give the parties when reviewing a specified decision?
options: A reasonable opportunity to be heard
Written notice at least 28 days before the hearing
Legal representation at public expense
A written indication of its provisional view before the hearing
en.explain: Section 60(3) requires the Tribunal, in reviewing a specified decision, to give the parties to the review a reasonable opportunity to be heard. The same safeguard appears at the earlier decision-making stage in sections 22(1), 34(3) and 44(1).

tc.q: 審裁處覆核指明決定時，須給予各方甚麼？
options: 合理的陳述機會
於聆訊前至少28日發出的書面通知
由公帑支付的法律代表
於聆訊前以書面表明其暫定意見
tc.explain: 第60(3)條規定審裁處在覆核指明決定時，須給予覆核各方合理的陳述機會。同樣的保障亦見於較早階段的第22(1)、34(3)及44(1)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(2)及(3)條

en.q: An applicant satisfies every matter listed in section 30(3). Must the Commissioner grant the licence?
options: No — section 30(2) is permissive: the Commissioner 'may' grant, and is not obliged to
Yes — the Commissioner is obliged to grant a licence once the section 30(3) matters are satisfied
Yes, provided the fee specified in Schedule 3 was paid in full when the application was made
No — the Commissioner must also obtain the prior written approval of the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 30(2) is permissive: the Commissioner 'may' grant a licence. Section 30(3) is only a precondition — the Commissioner may grant a licence only if satisfied of the listed fit-and-proper and premises matters — so satisfying it does not compel a grant. Licensing Guide Q5.10 confirms this: the Commissioner may still refuse for reasons outside section 30(3) altogether, such as missing LPS/LMO information, an incomplete Business Plan or AML Policy, failure to appoint a competent CO/MLRO, or failing to attend or pass the Assessment. There is no Schedule 3 fee-payment guarantee of a grant, and no Review Tribunal pre-approval requirement.

tc.q: 某申請人符合第30(3)條所列的每一項事宜。海關關長是否必須批出牌照？
options: 否——第30(2)條屬賦權性質，關長「可」批出而非必須
是——一旦符合第30(3)條所列事宜，關長即有責任批出牌照
是，只要在提交申請時已悉數繳付附表3訂明的費用
否——關長還須事先取得覆核審裁處的書面批准
tc.explain: 第30(2)條屬賦權性質：關長「可」批出牌照。第30(3)條只是先決條件——關長只有在信納所列的適當人選及處所等事宜後，方可批出牌照——故符合該條並不強制關長批出牌照。《發牌指南》第5.10問確認此點：關長仍可基於第30(3)條以外的理由拒絕批出牌照，例如未能提供LPS／LMO資料、《業務計劃書》或《打擊洗錢政策》不完整、未能委任稱職的合規主任／洗錢報告主任，或未有出席或未能通過評核。繳付附表3的費用並不保證獲批牌照，亦無須事先取得審裁處批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(5)及(6)條

en.q: What may the Commissioner do on granting a licence, and what must follow?
options: Impose any condition thought fit, informing the licensee in writing at the time the licence is granted
Impose any condition thought fit, which then takes effect immediately, whether or not the licensee has received notice
Refuse to grant the licence altogether, informing the applicant in writing of the refusal
Impose conditions only from the list of fees prescribed in Schedule 3, with no notice required
en.explain: Section 30(5) allows the Commissioner, on granting a licence, to impose any condition thought fit; section 30(6) requires notice in writing at the time of grant. A condition's effective date is fixed separately by section 30(7) (receipt of the notice, or the time specified in it, whichever is later) — not immediately regardless of notice. Refusing the licence is the alternative outcome under section 30(8), not what follows a grant with conditions, and Schedule 3 lists fees, not permissible conditions.

tc.q: 海關關長批出牌照時可作出甚麼？其後須怎樣做？
options: 施加其認為合適的任何條件，並須於批出牌照時以書面通知告知持牌人
施加其認為合適的任何條件，該條件不論通知與否即時生效
完全拒絕批出牌照，並以書面通知申請人該項拒絕
只可施加附表3訂明的收費清單內的條件，並無須發出通知
tc.explain: 第30(5)條准許海關關長在批出牌照時施加其認為合適的任何條件；第30(6)條規定須於批出牌照時以書面通知告知持牌人。條件的生效時間則另由第30(7)條規管（以持牌人收到通知的時間，或通知指明的時間，以較後者為準），並非不論通知與否即時生效。拒絕批出牌照是第30(8)條下的另一結果，並非批出附帶條件的牌照時所發生的事；而附表3所列者為費用，並非可施加的條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(4)條

en.q: A licensee due for renewal argues that fitness-and-propriety checks apply only when a licence is first granted, not on renewal. Is that correct?
options: No — section 31(4) applies section 30(3) and (4) to a renewal application as well
Yes — sections 30(3) and (4) apply, by their own terms, only to a first-time application for a licence
No, but only directors appointed since the original grant are reassessed at renewal
No, but reassessment occurs only if the Commissioner first gives written notice of intent to reassess
en.explain: Section 31(4) expressly applies section 30(3) and (4) to a renewal application as it applies to a first application, so fitness and propriety is reassessed at every renewal. Section 30(3) and (4) contain no wording confining them to first applications — that limitation is invented. Renewal reassessment also covers every director and any ultimate owner, not just newly appointed directors, and section 31(4) requires no separate notice-of-intent step.

tc.q: 某持牌人面臨牌照續期，並辯稱適當人選審查只在首次批出牌照時適用，續期時不適用。這說法是否正確？
options: 不正確——第31(4)條使第30(3)及(4)條同樣適用於續期申請
正確——第30(3)及(4)條按其本身字面只適用於首次提出的牌照申請
不正確，但只有在原批出牌照後獲委任的董事才於續期時被重新評估
不正確，但須待關長先發出書面通知表示擬重新評估，方會重新評估
tc.explain: 第31(4)條明文使第30(3)及(4)條適用於續期申請，一如適用於首次申請，故每次續期均須重新評估適當人選資格。第30(3)及(4)條的字面並無限定只適用於首次申請，該限制是虛構的。續期時的重新評估亦涵蓋每名董事及任何最終擁有人，並非只限新獲委任的董事，第31(4)條亦無須另行發出擬重新評估的通知。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(5)(b)及(c)條

en.q: Beyond the reasons and the right of review, what must a notice suspending a licence state, and what must a notice revoking one state?
options: A suspension notice states its duration and terms; a revocation notice states the surrender deadline
Both must state the amount of any pecuniary penalty imposed, and the date on which the licensee must pay it
Both must confirm that the licensee was given a reasonable opportunity to be heard before the decision
A suspension notice must state the appeal deadline; a revocation notice need only state the reasons
en.explain: Section 34(5) requires a suspension notice to state the duration and terms of the suspension, and a revocation notice to state the time within which the licence is to be surrendered — on top of the reasons and review right common to both. A pecuniary penalty is a section 43/44 disciplinary matter, not part of a section 34 notice; the reasonable-opportunity-to-be-heard requirement in section 34(3) is a pre-condition to making the decision, not a required content of the notice; and both notices, not just a suspension notice, carry the review-right statement, with no separate 'appeal deadline'.

tc.q: 除理由及覆核權利外，暫時吊銷牌照的通知須述明甚麼？撤銷牌照的通知又須述明甚麼？
options: 暫時吊銷通知須述明期間及條款；撤銷通知須述明交回期限
兩者均須述明所施加的任何罰款款額，以及持牌人須於何時繳付
兩者均須確認持牌人在作出決定前已獲給予合理的陳詞機會
暫時吊銷通知須述明上訴期限；撤銷通知則只須述明理由
tc.explain: 第34(5)條規定，在兩者共有的理由及覆核權利陳述之外，暫時吊銷通知須述明吊銷的期間及條款，撤銷通知則須述明須於何時內交回牌照。罰款款額屬第43/44條紀律行動的事宜，並非第34條通知的內容；第34(3)條下給予合理陳詞機會的規定，是作出決定前的先決條件，並非通知須載有的內容；而覆核權利的陳述兩種通知均須載有，並非只限暫時吊銷通知，亦無所謂「上訴期限」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(6)條

en.q: When does a revocation or suspension of a licence under section 34 take effect?
options: At the time specified in the notice given under section 34(4)
Immediately on the Commissioner reaching the decision
Twenty-one days after the notice is sent, in every case
Only after any application to the Review Tribunal has been determined
en.explain: Section 34(6) provides that a revocation or suspension takes effect at the time specified in the notice under subsection (4). Note that this differs from the rule for licence conditions in section 30(7), which turns on receipt of the notice or the time specified, whichever is later.

tc.q: 根據第34條撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照，何時生效？
options: 於根據第34(4)條發出的通知所指明的時間
於海關關長作出決定時即時生效
在任何情況下均為通知寄發後21日
須待任何向審裁處提出的申請有裁定後
tc.explain: 第34(6)條訂明撤銷或暫時吊銷於根據第(4)款發出的通知所指明的時間生效。留意這有別於第30(7)條就牌照條件所訂的規則，後者以接獲通知時或通知所指明時間（以較遲者為準）為準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(3)條；第39(3)條

en.q: When granting an application to add premises to a licence, what may the Commissioner do?
options: Grant it on payment of the Schedule 3 fee and impose any condition thought fit
Grant it without any fee, but impose no conditions
Grant it only on the same conditions as attach to the existing premises
Grant it only with the occupants' written consent, even where the new premises are not domestic
en.explain: Sections 38(3) and 39(3) each provide that the Commissioner may grant an application on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3 and may impose any condition that the Commissioner thinks fit. Occupants' written consent is required only where the premises are domestic premises.

tc.q: 海關關長批准將處所加入牌照的申請時，可作出甚麼？
options: 在繳付附表3費用後批准，並可施加其認為合適的任何條件
無須任何費用即可批准，但不可施加條件
只可按現有處所所附的相同條件批准
須取得新處所佔用人的書面同意方可批准，即使該處所並非住宅處所
tc.explain: 第38(3)及39(3)條均訂明海關關長可在繳付附表3訂明的費用後批准申請，並可施加其認為合適的任何條件。佔用人的書面同意只在處所屬住宅處所時方屬必需。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(2)(b)及(c)條

en.q: Which powers does an authorized officer executing a section 47 warrant have in relation to physical entry?
options: To break into and forcibly enter the premises, removing by force anyone obstructing that entry
To enter, if necessary by force, at any time within 7 days of the date of the warrant
To detain any person found on the premises for up to 48 hours without charge
To require the person in charge of the premises to reproduce illegible records in legible form
en.explain: Section 47(2)(b) and (c) allow the authorized officer to break into and forcibly enter the premises, and to remove by force any person or thing obstructing the exercise of those powers. The 7-day entry window is a feature of a section 17 warrant, not a section 47 warrant; the 48-hour figure belongs to detention following an arrest under section 48(4), whereas detention under section 47(2)(d) itself runs only until the premises have been searched; and requiring reproduction of illegible records is a real section 47(2)(e) power, but it has nothing to do with physical entry.

tc.q: 執行第47條手令的獲授權人員，在實際進入方面具有哪些權力？
options: 破門及強行進入處所，並以武力移走阻礙進入的人
可在手令發出日期起計7日內的任何時間進入，如有需要可強行進入
可扣留在處所內發現的任何人，最長48小時，不予落案
可要求處所負責人將不可閱讀的紀錄以可閱讀形式重現
tc.explain: 第47(2)(b)及(c)條准許獲授權人員破門及強行進入處所，並以武力移走阻礙行使該等權力的任何人或物。7日的進入期限是第17條手令的特徵，並非第47條手令；48小時的數字屬根據第48(4)條拘捕後的扣留，而第47(2)(d)條本身的扣留則只維持至處所搜查完畢為止；要求重現不可閱讀的紀錄則確實是第47(2)(e)條的權力，但與實際進入處所無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(2)(d)條

en.q: Whom may an authorized officer detain when executing a section 47 warrant, and for how long?
options: Anyone on the premises who appears able to give relevant information, until the search is complete
Anyone found on the premises, but only for up to 48 hours, as with an arrest under section 48
Only the licensee's directors or the ultimate owner, until they answer all questions put to them
No one on the premises — detaining a person requires a separate arrest under section 48
en.explain: Section 47(2)(d) allows the officer to detain anyone found on the premises who appears to be, or to be likely to be, able to give information relevant to the investigation, until the premises have been searched — an open-ended period tied to completion of the search, not a fixed 48 hours (that limit governs detention following an arrest under section 48(4)). The power is not confined to directors or the ultimate owner, and section 47(2)(d) itself is a distinct detention power that needs no separate arrest under section 48.

tc.q: 獲授權人員執行第47條手令時可扣留何人？可扣留多久？
options: 在處所內看來能提供相關資料的任何人，直至搜查完成為止
在處所內發現的任何人，但最長只可扣留48小時，如同根據第48條拘捕的情況
只限持牌人的董事或最終擁有人，直至其回答所有提問
不可扣留處所內任何人——扣留某人須另行根據第48條拘捕
tc.explain: 第47(2)(d)條准許人員扣留在處所內發現、看來能或相當可能能提供與調查相關資料的任何人，直至該處所已被搜查為止——這是與搜查完成掛鈎、不設固定期限的期間，並非固定的48小時（該限期規管的是根據第48(4)條拘捕後的扣留）。此權力並不限於董事或最終擁有人，而第47(2)(d)條本身是獨立的扣留權力，無須另行根據第48條拘捕。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(3)條；第48(2)條

en.q: What must an authorized officer produce on request when exercising powers under Part 5?
options: The warrant when entering under section 47; evidence of appointment when arresting under section 48
Evidence of appointment when entering under section 47; the warrant itself when arresting under section 48
A copy of the licensee's licence, in both cases, and a copy of the register entry under section 27
Nothing under Part 5 — production of authority is required only for an inspection under section 9
en.explain: Section 47(3) requires an officer entering premises under a section 47 warrant to produce the warrant itself if required; section 48(2) requires an officer arresting or detaining a person under section 48 to produce evidence of appointment as an authorized officer if requested — the reverse pairing is wrong. Neither provision calls for the licence or a section 27 register extract, and the section 9 duty to produce an authorization document is a separate requirement for routine inspections, not the only place production is required under the Ordinance.

tc.q: 獲授權人員行使第5部下的權力時，經要求須出示甚麼？
options: 根據第47條進入處所時出示手令；根據第48條拘捕時出示委任證據
根據第47條進入處所時出示委任證據；根據第48條拘捕時則出示手令本身
兩種情況下均出示持牌人的牌照副本，以及第27條登記冊的紀錄副本
第5部下無須出示——出示授權文件的規定只適用於第9條的視察
tc.explain: 第47(3)條規定根據第47條手令進入處所的人員，如被要求須出示手令本身；第48(2)條則規定根據第48條拘捕或扣留某人的人員，如被要求須出示其獲委任為獲授權人員的證據——兩者對調即屬錯誤。兩條文均無規定須出示牌照或第27條登記冊摘錄，而第9條下出示授權文件的規定，是另一項只適用於例行視察的獨立規定，並非本條例下唯一須出示文件的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(3)條

en.q: Where must an authorized officer take a person arrested under section 48?
options: Immediately to a police station, or first to a Customs and Excise office if enquiries are needed
To a police station, but only if the person can be taken there within 48 hours of the arrest
Before a magistrate as soon as practicable, without going to a police station or anywhere else first
To the licensee's business premises, so that the search under the section 47 warrant can continue
en.explain: Section 48(3) requires the officer to take the arrested person immediately to a police station or, if in the officer's opinion further enquiries are necessary, first to a Customs and Excise office and then to a police station. The 48-hour figure belongs to section 48(4), which caps detention before charge and appearance before a magistrate — it is not a deadline for reaching the police station. Appearing before a magistrate happens later under section 48(4), not as a substitute first step, and returning to the licensee's premises is no part of section 48(3) at all.

tc.q: 獲授權人員須將根據第48條被拘捕的人帶往何處？
options: 立即帶往警署；如需作進一步查訊，則先帶往海關辦事處
帶往警署，但僅須於拘捕後48小時內帶往該處即可
盡快帶往裁判官席前，無須先帶往警署或其他地方
帶往持牌人的業務處所，以便根據第47條手令繼續進行搜查
tc.explain: 第48(3)條規定人員須立即將被拘捕的人帶往警署；如人員認為有需要作進一步查訊，則先帶往香港海關辦事處，然後帶往警署。48小時的數字屬第48(4)條，該條就落案前的扣留及帶到裁判官席前設有上限——並非帶往警署的期限。帶到裁判官席前是第48(4)條下其後的步驟，並非取代首個步驟的做法，而帶回持牌人業務處所則完全不屬第48(3)條的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(6)條

en.q: Following an arrest under section 48, what may the authorized officer search?
options: The person, or the place of arrest and its surrounding areas, for anything related to the suspected offence
Only the person and any pockets or bag, since searching the place of arrest needs a separate warrant
Any premises connected with the licensee's business anywhere in Hong Kong, under the section 47 warrant
Nothing further — a search after arrest requires separate authorization from a magistrate
en.explain: Section 48(6) allows the officer, after an arrest, to search the person, or the place of arrest and its surrounding areas, for anything that may be related to the suspected offence, without needing any further authorization. The broader power to search any business premises rests on a section 47 magistrate's warrant, a separate and more specific power that does not extend the section 48(6) search-on-arrest power; section 48(6) itself needs no additional warrant or authorization.

tc.q: 根據第48條拘捕後，獲授權人員可搜查甚麼？
options: 該人，或該人被拘捕的地方及其周圍地方，以搜尋與所懷疑罪行有關的任何物件
只限該人身上及所攜袋子，因搜查拘捕地點須另有手令
根據第47條手令的權力，搜查與持牌人業務有關連、位於香港任何地方的處所
不可再搜查——拘捕後的搜查須另外取得裁判官授權
tc.explain: 第48(6)條准許人員在拘捕後，無須任何進一步授權，搜查該人，或該人被拘捕的地方及其周圍地方，以搜尋可能與所懷疑罪行有關的任何物件。搜查任何業務處所的較廣泛權力建基於第47條的裁判官手令，屬另一項更具體的權力，並不會擴大第48(6)條拘捕後搜查的權力；第48(6)條本身無須額外手令或授權。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(9)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for failing, with intent to defraud, to comply with a requirement imposed by an investigator under section 12?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
en.explain: Section 13(9) sets the penalty for the intent-to-defraud offences under section 13(5) to (8) at a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years on conviction on indictment. This mirrors section 10(9) for section 9 requirements.

tc.q: 意圖欺騙而沒有遵從調查員根據第12條施加的規定，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
tc.explain: 第13(9)條就第13(5)至(8)款的意圖欺騙罪行訂明，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年。這與第10(9)條就第9條規定所訂者相對應。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(2)(c)及(5)條

en.q: A covered person cannot answer an investigator's question because the information is not within their knowledge. What may the investigator require?
options: Require the person to verify that fact and reason by statutory declaration within a specified time
Require the person to verify, by statutory declaration, any answer the person has already given
Require the person to give an explanation or further particulars, as it may for a document already produced
Nothing — an investigator has no further power once a person pleads lack of knowledge
en.explain: Section 12(5) lets the investigator require in writing that the person verify, within the specified time and by statutory declaration, the fact that the information is not within the person's knowledge or possession, and the reason why. Verifying an answer already given by statutory declaration is instead a section 12(4) power, which presupposes an answer was in fact given; requiring an explanation or further particulars under section 12(3) presupposes a record or document was produced — neither fits a plea of ignorance, and the investigator is not left powerless.

tc.q: 受涵蓋的人因有關資料並非其所知而無法回答調查員的提問。調查員可要求甚麼？
options: 要求該人於指明時間內以法定聲明核實該事實及理由
要求該人以法定聲明核實其已作出的任何答覆
要求該人給予解釋或進一步詳情，如同就已交出的文件所要求的
無權可用——受涵蓋的人一旦聲稱不知情，調查員即無進一步權力
tc.explain: 第12(5)條准許調查員以書面要求該人於指明時間內，以法定聲明核實有關資料並非其所知或所管有的事實及理由。以法定聲明核實已作出的答覆屬第12(4)條的權力，其前提是已作出答覆；根據第12(3)條要求給予解釋或進一步詳情，其前提則是已交出紀錄或文件——兩者均不適用於聲稱不知情的情況，而調查員並非因此無計可施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(8)條

en.q: What is the position on interim reports by an investigator to the relevant authority?
options: The investigator may make them at any time, and must do so once the relevant authority so requires
Interim reports must wait until the investigation is completed, like the final report under section 12(9)
During the investigation, interim reports must be made to the relevant authority at least monthly
Interim reports may be made only with the prior written consent of the Secretary for Justice
en.explain: Section 12(8) allows the investigator to make interim reports at any time, and requires one as soon as reasonably practicable after the relevant authority requires it. Waiting until the investigation is complete describes the separate final-report duty in section 12(9), not interim reports, which by definition come before completion; there is no monthly rule; and the Secretary for Justice's consent under section 12(10) concerns publishing a report, not making one.

tc.q: 調查員向有關當局提交中期報告的規定為何？
options: 調查員可隨時提交中期報告，並須在有關當局提出要求後提交
中期報告須待調查完成後方可提交，如同第12(9)條的最後報告
在調查期間，中期報告須最少每月向有關當局提交一次
中期報告須先取得律政司司長的書面同意，方可提交
tc.explain: 第12(8)條准許調查員隨時提交中期報告，並須在有關當局要求提交後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快提交。須待調查完成方可提交，是第12(9)條下另一項最後報告的規定，並非中期報告——中期報告按定義是在完成前提交的；並無每月提交的規定；而第12(10)條下律政司司長的同意，是關乎刊登報告，並非提交報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35(1)條；第43(1)(c)條

en.q: A licensed corporation appoints a new director and applies for the Commissioner's approval only two weeks afterwards. What is the position?
options: Section 35(1) is contravened, risking prosecution and section 43(1)(c) disciplinary action
No contravention — like a licence renewal under section 31(2)(a), there is a 45-day grace period
No contravention, because approval under section 35(1) may be given retrospectively to the date of appointment
The appointment is automatically void under section 35, and so no prosecution or disciplinary action can follow
en.explain: Section 35(1) requires the Commissioner's written approval before a person becomes a director — approval sought two weeks after the appointment comes too late to prevent the contravention. There is no 45-day grace period under section 35 (that figure belongs to the separate renewal deadline in section 31(2)(a)); section 35(1)'s wording ('unless the Commissioner has ... given his or her approval') requires prior, not retrospective, approval; and a late application does not automatically void the appointment or excuse it from the consequences in section 35(7) and section 43(1)(c).

tc.q: 某持牌法團委任新董事，並於其後兩星期才申請海關關長批准。情況為何？
options: 已違反第35(1)條，可能招致檢控及第43(1)(c)條紀律行動
並無違反——如同第31(2)(a)條牌照續期的規定，設有45日的寬限期
並無違反，因第35(1)條下關長的批准可追溯至委任當日生效
該項委任根據第35條自動無效，因此不會招致檢控或紀律行動
tc.explain: 第35(1)條規定某人成為董事前須先取得關長的書面批准——於委任後兩星期才申請批准，已太遲而無法避免違反。第35條並無45日寬限期（該數字屬另一條文，即第31(2)(a)條的續期期限）；第35(1)條的字面（「除非關長……已給予……批准，否則」）要求批准須於事前作出，而非可追溯生效；遲交申請亦不會令該項委任自動無效，或使其免除第35(7)及第43(1)(c)條下的後果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(2)(a)條

en.q: A licence is due to expire on 30 June. The licensee lodges its renewal application on 1 June. Does the application comply with section 31(2)(a)?
options: No — the application must be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
Yes — section 31(2)(a) only bars an application lodged after the expiry date has already passed
No — but the deadline is 30 days before expiry, the same period allowed to pay a pecuniary penalty
No — but the licensee still had until 90 days before the expiry date to lodge it
en.explain: Section 31(2)(a) requires a renewal application to be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire. An application on 1 June for a licence expiring on 30 June leaves only 29 days and is therefore out of time — the provision does not merely bar applications made after expiry. The 30-day figure belongs to a different matter, the period to pay a pecuniary penalty under section 43(3)(a); there is no 90-day rule anywhere in section 31.

tc.q: 某牌照將於6月30日屆滿。持牌人於6月1日遞交續期申請。該申請是否符合第31(2)(a)條？
options: 不符合——申請須於牌照屆滿前不少於45日提出
符合——第31(2)(a)條只禁止在屆滿日之後才提出申請
不符合——但限期為屆滿前30日，與繳付罰款的期限相同
不符合——但持牌人仍有至屆滿前90日的時間可提出申請
tc.explain: 第31(2)(a)條規定續期申請須於牌照屆滿前不少於45日提出。就6月30日屆滿的牌照而言，於6月1日提出申請僅相距29日，故已逾期——該條文並非只禁止在屆滿後才提出申請。30日的數字屬另一事宜，即第43(3)(a)條下繳付罰款的期限；第31條並無90日的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9條與第46條的比較

en.q: What is the difference between an “authorized person” under section 9 and an “authorized officer” under section 46?
options: An authorized person is authorized by a relevant authority for Part 3; an authorized officer by the Commissioner for Part 5
An authorized officer is authorized by a relevant authority for Part 3; an authorized person is appointed by the Commissioner for Part 5
An authorized person may arrest under section 48; an authorized officer is confined to inspecting records under Part 3
An authorized officer is appointed by a magistrate under a warrant; an authorized person is appointed by the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 9(12) allows a relevant authority to authorize any person as an authorized person for the section 9 routine inspection power in Part 3. Section 46 allows the Commissioner to appoint any Customs and Excise public officer as an authorized officer for Part 5, which includes the section 48 arrest power — a power an authorized person under Part 3 does not have. Neither office is appointed by a magistrate; a magistrate only issues the warrant that a section 47 authorized officer may execute.

tc.q: 第9條的「獲授權人」與第46條的「獲授權人員」有何分別？
options: 獲授權人由有關當局為第3部而授權；獲授權人員則由關長為第5部而委任
獲授權人員由有關當局為第3部而授權；獲授權人則是關長為第5部而委任的人員
獲授權人可根據第48條拘捕；獲授權人員則只限於根據第3部視察紀錄
獲授權人員是裁判官根據手令而委任；獲授權人則是關長委任
tc.explain: 第9(12)條准許有關當局為第3部第9條的例行視察權力，授權任何人為獲授權人。第46條則准許關長委任任何香港海關公職人員為第5部的獲授權人員，其權力包括第48條的拘捕權——這是第3部下獲授權人所沒有的權力。兩個職位均非由裁判官委任；裁判官只是發出第47條獲授權人員可據以執行的手令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17條與第47條的比較

en.q: What distinguishes a warrant issued under section 17 from one issued under section 47?
options: Section 17 targets records producible under Part 3; section 47 targets evidence of a section 29 offence
A section 17 warrant may be issued only by a judge on sworn information; a section 47 warrant only by a magistrate
A section 17 warrant permits arrest of persons found on the premises; a section 47 warrant does not permit entry at all
A section 47 warrant is valid for only 7 days from issue; a section 17 warrant carries no time limit
en.explain: Section 17(1) concerns premises on which there is or is likely to be a record or document that may be required to be produced under Part 3. Section 47(1) concerns premises on which an offence under section 29 — operating a money service without a licence — is suspected. Both warrants are in fact issued by a magistrate on information on oath, not a judge; a section 17 warrant does not itself authorize arrest, and a section 47 warrant plainly authorizes entry; and it is the section 17 warrant, not the section 47 warrant, that carries the 7-day period.

tc.q: 根據第17條發出的手令與根據第47條發出的手令有何分別？
options: 第17條針對第3部下須交出的紀錄；第47條則針對第29條罪行的證據
第17條手令須由法官因經宣誓的告發而發出；第47條手令則須由裁判官發出
第17條手令准許拘捕在處所內發現的人；第47條手令則完全不准許進入處所
第47條手令的有效期只有7日；第17條手令則無時限
tc.explain: 第17(1)條關乎其內存有或相當可能存有根據第3部可能須交出的紀錄或文件的處所。第47(1)條則關乎懷疑有第29條罪行（無牌經營金錢服務）發生的處所。兩者事實上均由裁判官因經宣誓而作的告發而發出，並非由法官發出；第17條手令本身並不授權拘捕，而第47條手令明顯准許進入處所；訂有7日期限的是第17條手令，而非第47條手令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(c)條

en.q: Which pattern of past conduct must the Commissioner have regard to under section 30(4)(c) in assessing fitness and propriety?
options: Whether the person has persistently failed to comply with any requirement under the Ordinance or a section 51 regulation
Whether the person, being an individual, is an undischarged bankrupt or the subject of bankruptcy proceedings
Whether the person, being a corporation, is in liquidation, subject to a winding-up order, or has a receiver appointed
Whether the person has a conviction outside Hong Kong for an offence relating to money laundering or terrorist financing
en.explain: Section 30(4)(c) requires regard to be had to whether the person has persistently failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the Ordinance or a regulation made under section 51 — persistence, not an isolated lapse, is the target. Bankruptcy is a separate matter under section 30(4)(d); liquidation, a winding-up order or a receiver is section 30(4)(e); and an overseas ML/TF conviction is section 30(4)(b) — all real considerations under section 30(4), but not the one paragraph (c) addresses.

tc.q: 在評估適當人選資格時，海關關長須根據第30(4)(c)條顧及哪種過往行為模式？
options: 該人有否持續沒有遵從本條例或根據第51條訂立的規例的任何規定
該人（如屬個人）是否未解除破產人身分，或是否為破產法律程序的對象
該人（如屬法團）是否正在清盤，或是否為清盤令的對象，或是否已有接管人獲委任
該人在香港以外地方有否因與洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集有關的罪行而被定罪
tc.explain: 第30(4)(c)條規定須顧及該人有否持續沒有遵從本條例或根據第51條訂立的規例所施加的任何規定——針對的是持續情況，並非孤立的疏失。破產屬第30(4)(d)條下的另一事宜；清盤、清盤令或接管人屬第30(4)(e)條；而海外洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集定罪則屬第30(4)(b)條——三者均是第30(4)條下的真實考慮因素，但並非(c)段所處理的事宜。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5A(3)條

en.q: An AML/CTF requirement applying to a DNFBP who is an accounting or legal professional is engaged only when that professional does what?
options: By way of business, in Hong Kong, prepares for or carries out for a client a listed transaction
Gives any legal or accounting advice to a client, on any subject, whether or not a listed transaction is involved
Holds or manages a client's money, securities or assets in any capacity, even without a Hong Kong transaction
Handles for a client any single transaction exceeding a prescribed monetary threshold, regardless of its nature
en.explain: Section 5A(3) limits AML/CTF requirements for accounting and legal professionals to circumstances where, by way of business, in Hong Kong, they prepare for or carry out for a client a transaction concerning a listed activity — real estate, client assets, bank accounts, and the others in paragraphs (a) to (g). General advice on any subject is not enough by itself; managing client money is a listed activity, but only within the same by-way-of-business/Hong Kong/transaction framework, not 'in any capacity'; and section 5A(3) is not structured around a monetary threshold at all.

tc.q: 適用於屬會計專業人士或法律專業人士的指定非金融企業及行業的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定，只在該專業人士作出甚麼行為時方適用？
options: 在香港以業務方式為客戶籌備或進行涉及所列活動的交易
向客戶提供任何法律或會計意見，不論主題為何，也不論是否涉及所列交易
以任何身分持有或管理客戶的金錢、證券或資產，即使並無香港交易
為客戶處理任何超過訂明款額門檻的單一交易，不論其性質為何
tc.explain: 第5A(3)條將適用於會計及法律專業人士的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定，限於其在香港以業務方式為客戶籌備或進行涉及所列活動（不動產、客戶資產、銀行帳戶及(a)至(g)段所列其他活動）的交易。單純就任何主題提供意見並不足夠；管理客戶金錢雖屬所列活動之一，但同樣須在以業務方式／在香港／涉及交易的框架下方適用，並非「以任何身分」均適用；而第5A(3)條的結構亦非以款額門檻劃定範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5A(6)條

en.q: For the purposes of section 5A, does it matter whether the subject matter of the transaction is in Hong Kong or elsewhere?
options: No — section 5A(6) provides that it is immaterial where the subject matter is
Yes — the requirement applies only where the subject matter is in Hong Kong
Yes — it applies only where the subject matter is outside Hong Kong
It depends on the type of DNFBP concerned
en.explain: Section 5A(6) states, to avoid doubt, that for the purposes of that section it is immaterial whether the subject matter of a transaction referred to in subsection (3), (4) or (5) is in Hong Kong or elsewhere. What matters is that the professional acts in Hong Kong.

tc.q: 就第5A條而言，交易的標的在香港或在其他地方，是否重要？
options: 不重要——第5A(6)條訂明標的位於何處並不重要
重要——該規定只在標的位於香港時方適用
重要——該規定只在標的位於香港以外時方適用
視乎有關指定非金融企業及行業的類別而定
tc.explain: 第5A(6)條為免生疑問訂明，就該條而言，第(3)、(4)或(5)款所提述的交易的標的位於香港或其他地方，並不重要。關鍵在於該專業人士是在香港行事。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5A(7)條

en.q: What does “AML/CTF requirement” mean for the purposes of section 5A?
options: A requirement set out in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2
Any requirement anywhere in the Ordinance
A requirement set out in a guideline published under section 7
Any condition imposed on a licence under Part 5
en.explain: Section 5A(7) defines AML/CTF requirement as a requirement set out in Part 2, 3 or 4 of Schedule 2. This is narrower than the section 8 concept of a prescribed requirement, which covers the whole Ordinance and licence conditions.

tc.q: 就第5A條而言，「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集規定」指甚麼？
options: 附表2第2、3或4部所列的規定
本條例任何部分的任何規定
根據第7條公布的指引所列的規定
第5部下施加於牌照的任何條件
tc.explain: 第5A(7)條界定「打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集規定」為附表2第2、3或4部所列的規定。這較第8條「訂明規定」的概念為窄，後者涵蓋整條條例及牌照條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)及(2)條

en.q: On summary conviction, what is the maximum penalty for operating a money service without a licence?
options: A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment
A fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Section 29(2) provides for a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction. A disqualification order may also be made under section 29(3).

tc.q: 無牌經營金錢服務，循簡易程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 第6級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
第5級罰款及監禁6個月
罰款500,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第29(2)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。另可根據第29(3)條作出取消資格令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「牌照」的定義）

en.q: What does “licence” mean for the purposes of Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: A licence granted under section 30 or renewed under section 31, including a section 82 deemed licence
A licence granted under section 30 or renewed under section 31, but not one deemed granted under section 82
The register of licensees that the Commissioner maintains under section 27, and any licence recorded in it
A licence granted under section 30, but only until it is first amended by the Commissioner under section 32
en.explain: Section 24 defines licence as a licence granted under section 30 or renewed under section 31, and it expressly includes a licence that is deemed to have been granted under section 82 — the transitional provision for operators licensed under the previous regime. Excluding section 82 licences leaves out that express inclusion; the register under section 27 is a separate defined term in the same section, not the definition of licence itself; and nothing in section 24 or section 32 limits licence to the period before any amendment.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》第5部而言，「牌照」指甚麼？
options: 根據第30條批出或根據第31條續期的牌照，包括第82條下被當作已批出的牌照
根據第30條批出或根據第31條續期的牌照，但不包括根據第82條被當作已批出的牌照
關長根據第27條備存的持牌人登記冊，以及當中所記錄的任何牌照
根據第30條批出的牌照，但只在關長根據第32條首次修訂該牌照之前有效
tc.explain: 第24條界定「牌照」為根據第30條批出或根據第31條續期的牌照，並明文包括根據第82條被當作已批出的牌照——即先前制度下持牌經營者的過渡條文。將第82條牌照剔除，即遺漏了該明文包括的部分；第27條下的登記冊是同一條中另一個獨立界定的詞語，並非「牌照」本身的定義；而第24條或第32條亦無將「牌照」限定於首次修訂之前。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第24條（「最終擁有人」的定義——個人）

en.q: In relation to an individual licensee, who is the “ultimate owner” under section 24?
options: Another individual who ultimately owns or controls the business, or the person the licensee acts for
An individual entitled to, directly or indirectly, more than a 25% share of the capital or profits of that business
An individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the issued share capital of the business
The individual licensee themselves — an individual cannot have a separate ultimate owner under section 24
en.explain: Section 24 defines ultimate owner, in relation to an individual, as another individual who ultimately owns or controls the money service business of the first-mentioned individual, or, if the first-mentioned individual acts on behalf of another person, that other person. The 25%-of-capital-or-profits test is the section 24 test for a partnership's ultimate owner, and the 25%-of-share-capital test is the test for a corporation's — both real, but the wrong limb for an individual licensee, who is by definition a distinct person from anyone who owns or controls their business.

tc.q: 就個人持牌人而言，第24條下的「最終擁有人」是誰？
options: 最終擁有或控制該業務的另一名個人；或該持牌人所代表的另一人
直接或間接有權享有或控制該業務超過25%的資本或溢利份額的個人
直接或間接擁有或控制該業務超過25%已發行股本的個人
該名個人持牌人本身——按第24條，個人不可有另外的最終擁有人
tc.explain: 第24條就個人界定「最終擁有人」，指最終擁有或控制首述個人的金錢服務業務的另一名個人；或如首述個人是代另一人行事，則指該另一人。25%資本或溢利份額的驗證標準，是第24條就合夥的最終擁有人所訂的標準；25%已發行股本的驗證標準，則是就法團所訂的標準——兩者均屬真實條文，但均非適用於個人持牌人的分支；個人持牌人按定義是與擁有或控制其業務的人不同的另一自然人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27(2)條

en.q: Where must the register of licensees be kept?
options: At the office of the Commissioner
At the Companies Registry
At each licensee's principal place of business
At the Review Tribunal's registry
en.explain: Section 27(2) provides that the register is to be kept at the office of the Commissioner. Section 27(1) allows it to be kept in any form the Commissioner thinks fit, and section 27(3) requires it to be available for public inspection.

tc.q: 持牌人登記冊須存放於何處？
options: 海關關長的辦事處
公司註冊處
每名持牌人的主要營業地點
審裁處的登記處
tc.explain: 第27(2)條訂明登記冊須存放於海關關長的辦事處。第27(1)條准許以關長認為合適的任何形式備存，第27(3)條則規定須供公眾查閱。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(3)及(4)條

en.q: What are the “specified acts” an authorized person may require in exercising the inspection power under section 9?
options: To give access to a specified business record, produce it as specified, and answer questions about it
To produce a specified business record within the time specified, but not to answer any question
To give access to any record found on the premises, whether or not it relates to the business
To verify, by statutory declaration under section 9(9), any answer already given about the record
en.explain: Section 9(4) defines the specified acts as giving the authorized person access to any specified business record and producing it within the time and place specified, and answering any question regarding the record — all three elements together, not production without answering questions, and not access to any record regardless of business relevance (the power is confined to specified business records). Verifying an answer by statutory declaration is a further, separate power under section 9(9).

tc.q: 獲授權人行使第9條的視察權力時，可要求作出哪些「指明作為」？
options: 讓獲授權人查閱指明業務紀錄，按指明交出該紀錄，並回答關於該紀錄的問題
在指明時間內交出指明業務紀錄，但無須回答關於該紀錄的任何問題
讓人查閱處所內發現的任何紀錄，不論是否與業務有關
根據第9(9)條以法定聲明核實關於該紀錄已作出的任何答覆
tc.explain: 第9(4)條將「指明作為」界定為：讓獲授權人查閱任何指明業務紀錄，並於指明的時間及地點交出該紀錄，以及回答關於該紀錄的任何問題——三者缺一不可，並非只須交出紀錄而無須回答問題，亦非可查閱任何紀錄而不論是否與業務有關（權力只限於指明業務紀錄）。以法定聲明核實答覆，則是第9(9)條下另一項獨立的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(16)條

en.q: In relation to a licensed MSO, what is a “specified business record” for the purposes of section 9?
options: Any record or document relating to the business carried on, or a transaction carried out
A record kept to satisfy the customer due diligence and record-keeping rules in Schedule 2
A record that the licensee must retain for at least six years under the Schedule 2 record-keeping rules
A record relating to a transaction of a value that triggers customer due diligence, currently HK$8,000
en.explain: Section 9(16)(a) defines specified business record, in relation to a non-Part 5B inspection subject, as any record or document relating to the business carried on, or any transaction carried out, by the inspection subject — a broad definition that is not confined to Schedule 2 CDD/record-keeping documents, to records within a six-year retention window, or to transactions crossing the HK$8,000 occasional-transaction threshold, even though each of those is a real Schedule 2 concept in its own right.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，持牌金錢服務經營者的「指明業務紀錄」指甚麼？
options: 與該視察對象所經營業務或所進行交易有關的任何紀錄或文件
為符合附表2的客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定而保存的紀錄
持牌人須根據附表2的備存紀錄規定保留最少六年的紀錄
與觸發客戶盡職審查的交易款額有關的紀錄，現時門檻為8,000港元
tc.explain: 第9(16)(a)條就非第5B部視察對象界定「指明業務紀錄」，指與該視察對象所經營業務有關，或其所進行的任何交易有關的任何紀錄或文件——這是廣泛的定義，並不限於附表2的客戶盡職審查／備存紀錄文件、六年保留期內的紀錄，或觸及8,000港元非經常交易門檻的交易，儘管以上每一項本身均是附表2下真實的概念。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(15)(g)條

en.q: In relation to the Postmaster General, what constitutes “business premises” for the purposes of section 9?
options: Any premises where the Postmaster General operates a remittance service, and any premises where that service is managed
Any premises at which the Postmaster General may operate a money service, as shown in the register under section 27
Every post office in Hong Kong, without exception, whether or not remittance services are offered there
No premises are prescribed — section 8 does not list the Postmaster General as a prescribed person at all
en.explain: Section 9(15)(g) defines business premises, in relation to the Postmaster General, as any premises at which the Postmaster General operates a remittance service and any premises at which that remittance service is managed. The register-based test in section 9(15)(f) is the real definition, but for a licensed money service operator, not the Postmaster General; not every post office qualifies, only those actually used for the remittance service; and section 8(h) does list the Postmaster General among the non-Part 5B prescribed persons.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，郵政署署長的「業務處所」指甚麼？
options: 郵政署署長經營匯款服務所在的處所，以及管理該項服務所在的處所
郵政署署長根據第27條的登記冊顯示可經營金錢服務所在的處所
香港每一間郵政局，並無例外，不論該處是否有提供匯款服務
並無任何處所——第8條根本沒有將郵政署署長列為訂明人士
tc.explain: 第9(15)(g)條就郵政署署長界定「業務處所」，指郵政署署長經營匯款服務所在的任何處所，以及管理該項匯款服務所在的任何處所。第9(15)(f)條以登記冊為準的驗證標準確實存在，但那是就持牌金錢服務經營者而言，並非郵政署署長；並非每間郵政局都符合資格，只限實際用作匯款服務的處所；而第8(h)條確有將郵政署署長列為非第5B部訂明人士之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第4(1A)條

en.q: Besides a relevant authority, which body is given immunity from civil liability under section 4?
options: A regulatory body, for anything done or omitted in good faith in performing its own function
Any other person acting in good faith, but only if performing a function conferred on that person directly
Any licensed money service operator, provided it acts strictly on written instructions issued by the Commissioner
Any person who files a suspicious transaction report with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit, licensed or not
en.explain: Section 4(1A), added in 2018, provides that a regulatory body does not incur civil liability for anything done or omitted in good faith in performing its own function under the Ordinance. Section 4(1) separately protects a relevant authority or 'any other person', but only where the function performed is one conferred on the relevant authority — not a function conferred on that other person individually, which is what this distractor gets backwards. Neither a licensed MSO acting on instructions nor a person who files a suspicious transaction report is, by that fact alone, given immunity under section 4.

tc.q: 除有關當局外，第4條還賦予哪一機構民事法律責任的豁免？
options: 監管機構，就其真誠地執行本身職能時作出或不作出的任何事情
真誠行事的任何其他人，但只限於執行委予該人本身（而非有關當局）的職能
任何持牌金錢服務經營者，惟須嚴格按照海關關長發出的書面指示行事
向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的任何人，不論是否持牌
tc.explain: 第4(1A)條（2018年加入）訂明，監管機構就其真誠地執行本條例下本身職能時作出或不作出的任何事情，不招致民事法律責任。第4(1)條另行保障有關當局或「任何其他人」，但僅限於所執行的職能是委予該有關當局的職能——並非委予該其他人本身的職能，這正是該項錯誤選項所顛倒之處。持牌金錢服務經營者按指示行事，或有人提交可疑交易報告，單憑此事實本身，均不會因而根據第4條獲得豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(7)及(8)條

en.q: What distinguishes the offence in section 5(7) from that in section 5(8) for an employee of a financial institution?
options: Section 5(7) requires knowingly causing or permitting; section 5(8) also requires an intent to defraud
Section 5(7) applies only to employees; section 5(8) applies only to directors and other managers
Section 5(7) carries the heavier penalty on conviction on indictment — 7 years, against 2 years under section 5(8)
Section 5(8) applies only where the contravention in fact causes the financial institution actual financial loss
en.explain: Section 5(7) covers an employee or manager who knowingly causes or permits the institution to contravene a specified provision, punishable on indictment by $1,000,000 and 2 years. Section 5(8) covers the same class of persons but additionally requires an intent to defraud the institution or a relevant authority, and it is section 5(8), not section 5(7), that carries the heavier penalty of $1,000,000 and 7 years. Both provisions apply to the same range of persons — employees, those employed to work for the institution, and those concerned in its management — and neither is confined to cases of actual financial loss.

tc.q: 就金融機構僱員而言，第5(7)條的罪行與第5(8)條的罪行有何分別？
options: 第5(7)條須知情地導致或准許違反；第5(8)條另須有欺騙意圖
第5(7)條只適用於僱員；第5(8)條則只適用於董事及其他管理人員
第5(7)條循公訴程序定罪的刑罰為監禁7年，較第5(8)條的2年為重
第5(8)條只在該項違反實際令該金融機構蒙受財務損失時方適用
tc.explain: 第5(7)條涵蓋在知情下導致或准許該機構違反指明的條文的僱員或管理人員，循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年。第5(8)條涵蓋同一類人士，但另須有欺騙該機構或有關當局的意圖，而刑罰較重（罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年）的是第5(8)條，並非第5(7)條。兩條文適用於同一範圍的人士——僱員、受僱為該機構工作的人，以及參與其管理的人——亦不限於造成實際財務損失的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(11)條

en.q: Where are the “specified provisions” referred to in section 5 to be found?
options: In Schedule 2 — section 5(11) enumerates the sections of that Schedule concerned
In Schedule 1, Part 1 — the list of designated non-financial businesses and professions
In the guidelines for the operation of Schedule 2 published by a regulatory body under section 7
In regulations made by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise under section 51 for Part 5
en.explain: Section 5(11) defines specified provision by enumerating a list of sections of Schedule 2. Schedule 1, Part 1 lists designated non-financial businesses and professions, an entirely different list; guidelines published under section 7 explain how Schedule 2 is to be applied but are not themselves where the specified provisions are found; and regulations under section 51 are made by the Commissioner for Part 5 (money service operator licensing), unconnected to the Schedule 2 specified provisions engaged by section 5.

tc.q: 第5條所提述的「指明的條文」載於何處？
options: 載於附表2，第5(11)條列舉出所指的各條
載於附表1第1部——指定非金融企業及行業的名單
載於監管機構根據第7條就附表2的施行而公布的指引
載於海關關長根據第51條為第5部而訂立的規例
tc.explain: 第5(11)條藉列舉附表2的一系列條文來界定「指明的條文」。附表1第1部所列的是指定非金融企業及行業，屬完全不同的名單；根據第7條公布的指引是解釋附表2應如何適用，本身並非指明的條文所在之處；而第51條下的規例是由海關關長為第5部（金錢服務經營者發牌）而訂立，與第5條所涉及的附表2指明的條文無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(a)、(f)及(j)條

en.q: Which of the following procedural powers does the Tribunal have for the purposes of a review?
options: To order a witness to provide evidence by affidavit, and to determine the procedure to be followed in the review
To issue a warrant authorising an authorized person to enter and search premises for the purposes of the review
To convict and sentence a person who fails to comply with an order it has made under section 61(1)
To refuse to receive material offered by a party solely because that material would be inadmissible in a court of law
en.explain: Section 61(1)(f) allows the Tribunal to order a witness to provide evidence by affidavit, and section 61(1)(j) allows it to determine the procedure to be followed in the review. It has no power to issue entry and search warrants, which a magistrate grants under section 17; failing to comply with its orders is an offence under section 61(2) that is tried and punished by a court, not by the Tribunal; and section 61(1)(a) expressly lets it receive material “whether or not the material would be admissible in a court of law”.

tc.q: 審裁處為覆核的目的，具有下列哪項程序權力？
options: 命令證人以誓章提供證據，並決定覆核所須依循的程序
就覆核的目的發出手令，授權獲授權人員進入處所搜查
就沒有遵從其根據第61(1)條作出的命令的人定罪及判刑
僅因某方提交的材料在法院中不可獲接納為證據，而拒絕收取該等材料
tc.explain: 第61(1)(f)條准許審裁處命令證人以誓章提供證據；第61(1)(j)條准許其決定覆核所須依循的程序。審裁處無權發出進入及搜查處所的手令（該手令由裁判官根據第17條發出）；沒有遵從其命令屬第61(2)條所訂罪行，由法院審訊及判刑，而非由審裁處判刑；第61(1)(a)條亦明文准許其收取材料，「不論該等材料在法院中是否可獲接納為證據」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(e)條

en.q: What may the Tribunal require of a person attending before it under section 61(1)(e)?
options: To answer truthfully, on oath or otherwise, any question the Tribunal considers appropriate
To produce any article, record or document relating to the review, but not to answer questions about it
To give evidence only by sworn affidavit, without being orally examined by the Tribunal
To administer an oath to themselves, since only the Tribunal may require others to be sworn
en.explain: Section 61(1)(e) allows the Tribunal to examine or cause to be examined on oath or otherwise a person attending before it, and to require the person to answer truthfully any question the Tribunal considers appropriate. Producing documents without answering questions describes section 61(1)(c) taken in isolation, ignoring that (e) adds a separate duty to answer; affidavit evidence under section 61(1)(f) is an alternative the Tribunal may order, not the exclusive mode of giving evidence; and administering oaths under section 61(1)(d) is a power the Tribunal itself exercises over witnesses, not something a witness does to themselves.

tc.q: 根據第61(1)(e)條，審裁處可要求出席其席前的人作出甚麼？
options: 經宣誓或其他方式接受訊問，並就審裁處認為適當的問題如實回答
交出與該覆核有關的物品、紀錄或文件，但無須回答關於它們的問題
只可以經宣誓的誓章提供證據，而不會被審裁處以口頭訊問
在接受訊問前，須自行監誓——因為只有審裁處才可要求他人宣誓
tc.explain: 第61(1)(e)條准許審裁處在經宣誓或以其他方式下訊問或安排訊問出席其席前的人，並規定該人須就審裁處認為屬適當的任何問題如實回答。單獨援引第61(1)(c)條交出文件而不用回答問題，忽略了(e)另加的回答義務；第61(1)(f)條下的誓章證供是審裁處可命令採用的其中一種方式，並非提供證據的唯一方式；而第61(1)(d)條下的監誓，是審裁處對證人行使的權力，並非證人對自己所作的事。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(a)(iii)條

en.q: A licensee is a corporation and one of its several directors ceases to be a fit and proper person. Does that engage the Commissioner's section 34 powers?
options: Yes — the powers arise once any one director ceases to be fit and proper for the business
No — the powers arise only once every director has ceased to be a fit and proper person
No — the powers arise only for the corporation's ultimate owner, not its directors
Only if the director concerned happens also to be the corporation's ultimate owner
en.explain: Section 34(1)(a)(iii)(A) makes the revocation and suspension powers available where any director of the corporation is no longer a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee's business of operating a money service — a single director suffices, not all of them. Sub-paragraph (B) makes separate, equivalent provision for the ultimate owner, so the powers are not confined to the ultimate owner alone, and a director need not also hold that role for the powers to arise in relation to the director.

tc.q: 某持牌人是法團，其多名董事中有一名不再是適當人選。這是否觸發海關關長第34條的權力？
options: 是——只要任何一名董事不再是適合經營該業務的適當人選，該等權力即可行使
否——須所有董事均已不再是適當人選，該等權力方可行使
否——該等權力只在關乎該法團的最終擁有人時方可行使，與董事無關
只有在該名董事恰巧同時是該法團的最終擁有人的情況下方可
tc.explain: 第34(1)(a)(iii)(A)條訂明，凡該法團的任何董事不再是適合與該持牌人的金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選，撤銷及暫時吊銷權力即可行使——單一名董事已足夠，無須全體董事。(B)節就最終擁有人另訂相應的條文，故該等權力並非只限於關乎最終擁有人，而就董事而言，該董事亦無須同時是最終擁有人，權力方會就該董事而觸發。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(a)(iii)條

en.q: Where the applicant for a licence is a corporation, of whose fitness and propriety must the Commissioner be satisfied?
options: Each director of the corporation, and its ultimate owner if any, must be a fit and proper person
Each partner and any ultimate owner, using the test for a partnership applicant
The company secretary and any ultimate owner, but the ordinary directors are not assessed
Only the one director nominated to sit the Competence Assessment on the corporation's behalf
en.explain: Section 30(3)(a)(iii) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that each director of a corporate applicant is a fit and proper person to be associated with the business, and that any ultimate owner is likewise fit and proper. The partner-based test in sub-paragraph (ii) applies to a partnership applicant, not a corporation; the company secretary is not a person section 30(3) requires to be assessed at all; and the requirement covers every director, not only whichever one sits the Competence Assessment.

tc.q: 如牌照申請人是法團，海關關長須信納何人的適當人選資格？
options: 該法團的每名董事，以及其任何最終擁有人，均須是適當人選
每名合夥人及任何最終擁有人，套用合夥申請人的標準
公司秘書及任何最終擁有人，但一般董事無須評核
只限代表該法團獲提名參加能力評核的該名董事
tc.explain: 第30(3)(a)(iii)條規定海關關長須信納法團申請人的每名董事是適合與該業務有聯繫的適當人選，而任何最終擁有人亦同樣須是適當人選。(ii)節以合夥人為基礎的驗證標準，適用於合夥申請人，並非法團；公司秘書並非第30(3)條規定須予評核的人；而有關規定涵蓋每一名董事，並非只限代表法團出席能力評核的該名董事。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(a)(i)條

en.q: Where the applicant is an individual, which statutory formula must the Commissioner be satisfied of in relation to the applicant personally, as distinct from any ultimate owner?
options: That the individual is a fit and proper person to operate a money service
That the individual is a fit and proper person to be associated with the business of operating a money service
That the individual has passed the Competence Assessment
That the individual holds Hong Kong permanent residency
en.explain: Section 30(3)(a)(i)(A) uses the formula “fit and proper person to operate a money service” for an individual applicant and, by sub-paragraph (B), the “associated with the business” formula for that individual's ultimate owner. The same distinction runs through sections 35 to 37.

tc.q: 如申請人是個人，海關關長須就該申請人本人（有別於任何最終擁有人）信納哪一項法定表述？
options: 該個人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選
該個人是適合與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選
該個人已通過能力評核
該個人擁有香港永久居民身分
tc.explain: 第30(3)(a)(i)(A)條就個人申請人採用「適合經營金錢服務的適當人選」的表述；而(B)節就該個人的最終擁有人則採用「適合與該業務有聯繫」的表述。同樣的區分貫穿第35至37條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第44(2)條

en.q: How must the Commissioner communicate a decision made under section 43?
options: By notice in writing informing the licensee of the decision made under section 43, whatever power is exercised
By the discretionary public disclosure permitted under section 43(7), rather than by notice to the licensee
By publication in the Gazette, as with the Commissioner's penalty guidelines under section 45
By entry in the register of licensees maintained by the Commissioner under section 27
en.explain: Section 44(2) requires the Commissioner, on exercising a power under section 43, to inform the licensee of the decision by notice in writing — this is mandatory and distinct from the discretionary public disclosure the Commissioner may separately make under section 43(7). Gazette publication under section 45 is how the Commissioner's penalty guidelines are published, not how an individual decision is communicated to a licensee, and nothing in section 44 ties notification to an entry in the section 27 register.

tc.q: 海關關長須以何種方式傳達根據第43條作出的決定？
options: 以書面通知告知持牌人根據第43條作出的決定，不論行使的是哪一項權力
以第43(7)條下可酌情作出的公開披露方式，而非以通知告知持牌人
以憲報公布方式，如同第45條下關長的罰款指引的公布方式
以在關長根據第27條備存的持牌人登記冊上記項的方式
tc.explain: 第44(2)條規定海關關長行使第43條的權力時，須以書面通知告知持牌人該決定——這是強制規定，有別於關長可另行根據第43(7)條酌情作出的公開披露。第45條下的憲報公布，是關長罰款指引的公布方式，並非向持牌人傳達個別決定的方式；第44條亦無將通知與第27條登記冊的記項掛鈎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39(1)條

en.q: A licensee's licence does not require it to operate at particular premises, but it now wants to start operating a money service from a shop. What must happen first?
options: The Commissioner must first add the shop to the licence, on the licensee's application, before operation begins there
Nothing — since the licence does not specify premises, the licensee may operate anywhere without further steps
The licensee must apply under section 38, since that is the general provision for adding business premises
The licensee need only notify the Commissioner in writing; no application or approval is required
en.explain: Section 39(1) provides that a licensee not required under its licence to operate at particular premises must not operate a money service at any particular premises unless the Commissioner has, on the licensee's application, added the premises to the licence. Not being tied to specified premises is not the same as being free of premises control altogether; section 38(1) is the parallel provision for a licensee already licensed to operate at premises specified in the licence, a different case; and written notice alone, without an application and the Commissioner's act of adding the premises, does not satisfy section 39(1).

tc.q: 某持牌人的牌照並無規定須在特定處所經營，但該持牌人現欲開始在一間店舖經營金錢服務。首先須做甚麼？
options: 關長須先應持牌人的申請，將該店舖加入牌照，該持牌人方可在該處經營
無須採取任何步驟——牌照並無指明處所，持牌人可在任何地方經營
持牌人須根據第38條提出申請，因該條是新增業務處所的一般條文
持牌人只須以書面通知關長；無須申請或批准
tc.explain: 第39(1)條規定，牌照並無規定須在特定處所經營的持牌人，不得在任何特定處所經營金錢服務，除非關長已應該持牌人的申請將該處所加入牌照。不受限於指明處所，並不等於完全不受處所規管；第38(1)條是適用於已獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營的持牌人的相應條文，屬另一種情況；單純的書面通知，而未經申請及關長將處所加入牌照的行動，並不符合第39(1)條的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)條；第25條

en.q: An authorized institution operates a currency exchange counter, and separately an unlicensed individual runs a remittance business from a shop. Which of them commits an offence under section 29?
options: Only the unlicensed individual — section 25 excludes an authorized institution from Part 5 altogether
Both — section 29 binds every person operating a money service, including authorized institutions
Only the authorized institution — it needed its own MSO licence because currency exchange is not banking business
Neither — both may operate for up to one month while a licence application is pending
en.explain: Section 25 excludes an authorized institution from Part 5 altogether, so section 29 cannot bite on it regardless of what service it offers. Section 29(1) is not universal — it is qualified by section 25's exclusions, so 'every person' is too broad. The unlicensed individual operating a remittance business is squarely within section 29(1) and liable to the penalties in section 29(2), and there is no one-month grace period anywhere in section 29 or 25 for an unlicensed operator.

tc.q: 某認可機構經營貨幣兌換櫃檯，另有一名無牌人士在店舖經營匯款業務。何者觸犯第29條所訂罪行？
options: 只有該名無牌人士——第25條將認可機構完全排除於第5部之外
兩者皆是——第29條約束每名經營金錢服務的人，包括認可機構在內
只有該認可機構——因其貨幣兌換櫃檯的業務並非「附帶」於其主要業務
兩者皆否——在牌照申請待決期間，兩者均可經營最多一個月
tc.explain: 第25條將認可機構完全排除於第5部之外，故不論其提供何種服務，第29條均不能適用於它。第29(1)條並非一概適用於「每一個人」——它受第25條的排除條文所限定。無牌經營匯款業務的個人則正落入第29(1)條，須承擔第29(2)條的刑罰，而第29或25條均無所謂的一個月寬限期予無牌經營者。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76A條（「指明人士」的定義）

en.q: Who is a “specified person” bound by the confidentiality requirements in Part 6A?
options: A relevant authority and anyone who is or was its member, employee, consultant or Ordinance appointee
A relevant authority and its current employees only — former employees and consultants are not covered
Every licensed money service operator and its staff, since they too handle information under the Ordinance
Only the members of the Review Tribunal, since only they handle confidential review material
en.explain: Section 76A defines specified person as a relevant authority; a person who is or was a member, employee, consultant, agent or adviser of a relevant authority; or a person who is or was appointed under the Ordinance, performing a function under it, or assisting in that performance. The definition expressly covers former as well as present employees and consultants, so confining it to current employees leaves out real coverage; licensed MSOs and their staff are not specified persons merely for handling information; and Review Tribunal members are only one small part of a much wider definition, not its entirety.

tc.q: 何人屬受第6A部保密規定約束的「指明人士」？
options: 有關當局及其現任或前任成員、僱員、顧問或本條例下的獲委任人
只限有關當局及其現任僱員——前僱員及顧問不受涵蓋
每名持牌金錢服務經營者及其員工，因彼等同樣處理本條例下的資料
只限覆核審裁處的成員，因為只有他們接觸機密的覆核材料
tc.explain: 第76A條界定「指明人士」為有關當局；現時或曾經是有關當局的成員、僱員、顧問、代理人或諮詢人的人；或現時或曾經根據本條例獲委任、執行本條例下職能，或協助他人執行該等職能的人。該定義明文涵蓋前任及現任僱員與顧問，故將其限於現任僱員即遺漏了真實涵蓋的範圍；持牌金錢服務經營者及其員工並不會單純因處理資料而成為指明人士；而覆核審裁處成員只是遠為廣泛的定義中的一小部分，並非定義的全部。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76B(2)條

en.q: What does section 76B prohibit a specified person from doing?
options: Communicating a matter learned under the Ordinance, or allowing access to a record in their possession
Communicating such a matter to a colleague at the authority while performing a function under it
Disclosing information already made available to the public, such as an entry in the register
Accepting employment with a licensed MSO after leaving the relevant authority, without the authority's consent
en.explain: Section 76B(2) provides that a specified person must not communicate a matter referred to in subsection (1)(a) to a person, and must not allow another person to have access to a record or document referred to in subsection (1)(b). Communicating the matter to a colleague at the same authority while performing a function under the Ordinance is not caught at all — section 76C(1)(a) expressly permits disclosure in performing a function under the Ordinance. Disclosing information already made public is likewise expressly permitted by section 76C(1)(b). Section 76B says nothing about retaining records for six months or about post-employment restrictions.

tc.q: 第76B條禁止指明人士作出甚麼？
options: 向他人傳達根據本條例知悉的事宜，或容許查閱其管有的紀錄
在執行本條例下職能的過程中，向同一當局的同事傳達該事宜
披露已經普遍向公眾發放的資料，例如登記冊記項
未經有關當局同意，在離開該當局後受僱於持牌金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第76B(2)條訂明指明人士不得向他人傳達第(1)(a)款所提述的事宜，亦不得容許他人查閱第(1)(b)款所提述的紀錄或文件。在執行本條例下職能的過程中，向同一當局的同事傳達該事宜，根本不受規管——第76C(1)(a)條明文准許為執行本條例下職能而作出的披露。披露已向公眾發放的資料，同樣獲第76C(1)(b)條明文准許。第76B條並無提及保留紀錄六個月，或離職後的僱用限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76B(3)條

en.q: What is the maximum penalty on conviction on indictment for contravening the confidentiality requirement in section 76B(2)?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months
en.explain: Section 76B(3) provides for a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years on conviction on indictment, and a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months on summary conviction.

tc.q: 違反第76B(2)條的保密規定，循公訴程序定罪的最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年
第6級罰款及監禁6個月
tc.explain: 第76B(3)條訂明循公訴程序定罪可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年，循簡易程序定罪則可處第6級罰款及監禁6個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(b)條

en.q: Which of the following disclosures is expressly permitted to a specified person despite section 76B?
options: Disclosing information that has already been made available to the public
Disclosing information to any journalist who requests it
Disclosing information to the licensee's competitors for market monitoring
Disclosing information to any overseas authority without further condition
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(b) permits disclosure of information that has already been made available to the public. Disclosure to overseas authorities is permitted only to a relevant authority under section 76D(1)(i), and then only subject to the section 76D(2) conditions.

tc.q: 即使有第76B條的規定，下列哪項披露獲明文准許指明人士作出？
options: 披露已公開提供的資料
向任何提出要求的記者披露資料
向該持牌人的競爭對手披露資料以作市場監察
無須任何進一步條件即向任何海外當局披露資料
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(b)條准許披露已公開提供的資料。向海外當局披露則只限有關當局根據第76D(1)(i)條作出，並須符合第76D(2)條的條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(c)及(d)條

en.q: For which purposes connected with law enforcement may a specified person disclose information despite section 76B?
options: With a view to, or for the purposes of, criminal proceedings or an investigation in Hong Kong
For any law-enforcement purpose anywhere in the world, not confined to Hong Kong proceedings or investigations
Only in accordance with an order of a court, magistrate or tribunal under section 76C(1)(g)
Only once the person concerned has already been charged, not merely under investigation
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(c) and (d) permit disclosure with a view to the institution of, or for the purposes of, any criminal proceedings in Hong Kong, and with a view to the commencement of, or for the purposes of, an investigation carried out in Hong Kong under the laws of Hong Kong — both confined to Hong Kong, not law enforcement purposes anywhere in the world. Disclosure under a court, magistrate or tribunal order is a separate, further ground in section 76C(1)(g); and paragraphs (c) and (d) apply from the investigation stage onward, not only once a person has already been charged.

tc.q: 即使有第76B條的規定，指明人士可為哪些與執法有關的目的披露資料？
options: 為在香港提起或進行刑事法律程序，或根據香港法律展開或進行調查
為世界任何地方與執法有關的任何目的，不限於在香港的法律程序或調查
只可按照第76C(1)(g)條下法院、裁判官或審裁處的命令披露
只限有關人士已被落案控告的情況，而非僅在被調查階段
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(c)及(d)條准許為在香港提起或進行任何刑事法律程序，以及為在香港根據香港法律展開或進行調查而披露資料——兩者均限於香港範圍內，並非世界任何地方與執法有關的目的。按法院、裁判官或審裁處命令而作的披露，是第76C(1)(g)條下另一項獨立的許可理由；而(c)及(d)段自調查階段起已適用，並非須待有關人士已被落案控告方適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(e)條

en.q: May a specified person disclose information to a solicitor for the purpose of obtaining legal advice?
options: Yes — disclosure to a professional adviser acting in connection with a matter under the Ordinance is permitted
No — section 76C(1) lists no exception for legal advice; only in-house counsel of the relevant authority may be told
Only with the Secretary for Justice's consent, the same consent needed to publish an investigation report under section 12(10)
Only where legal proceedings under the Ordinance have already been commenced against the specified person
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(e) permits disclosure for the purpose of seeking advice from, or the giving of advice by, counsel, a solicitor or other professional adviser who is acting or proposing to act in a professional capacity in connection with any matter arising under the Ordinance — external advisers included, not just in-house counsel. The Secretary for Justice's consent is a real requirement, but for publishing an investigation report under section 12(10), not for this disclosure; and paragraph (e) is available before any proceedings are commenced, since seeking advice typically precedes them.

tc.q: 指明人士可否為取得法律意見而向律師披露資料？
options: 可以——向就本條例事宜行事的專業顧問作出的披露，獲得准許
不可以——第76C(1)條並無就法律意見訂立例外；只可告知有關當局的內部法律顧問
須經律政司司長同意方可——與第12(10)條下刊登調查報告所需的同意相同
只限已針對該指明人士展開本條例下法律程序的情況
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(e)條准許為向就本條例所引起的任何事宜以專業身分行事或擬行事的大律師、律師或其他專業顧問尋求意見，或由其提供意見，而披露資料——包括外聘顧問，並非只限有關當局的內部法律顧問。律政司司長的同意確實是真實的規定，但那是第12(10)條下刊登調查報告所需，並非本項披露所需；而(e)段在任何法律程序展開前已可使用，因為尋求法律意見通常在程序展開之前。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(g)條

en.q: Under what legal compulsion may a specified person disclose information despite section 76B?
options: In accordance with an order of a court, magistrate or tribunal, or under Hong Kong law
Only in accordance with an order of a Hong Kong court, not a tribunal or magistrate
Only in accordance with a direction of the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury
Only in accordance with an order made by a court sitting outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(g) permits disclosure under an order of a court, magistrate OR tribunal (not courts alone), or under a requirement of Hong Kong law — not a ministerial direction, and not limited to orders of courts outside Hong Kong.

tc.q: 即使有第76B條的規定，指明人士可在何種法律強制下披露資料？
options: 按照法院、裁判官或審裁處的命令，或按香港法律的規定
只限按照香港法院的命令，不包括審裁處或裁判官
只限按照財經事務及庫務局局長本人親自的指示
只限按照香港以外的法院所作出的正式命令
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(g)條准許按照法院、裁判官或審裁處（並非只限法院）的命令，或按照香港法律施加的規定而披露資料——並非局長的指示，亦不限於香港以外法院所作的命令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(a)條

en.q: On what condition may a relevant authority disclose information in the form of a summary?
options: The summary must be compiled so no person's business, identity or trading particulars can be ascertained
The summary must omit the person's identity and business details, but may include trading particulars
The summary must first be formally approved by the Review Tribunal before any disclosure
The summary must be published simultaneously in the Gazette for general public notice
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(a) requires the summary to be compiled so as to prevent particulars relating to business, identity, OR trading particulars from being ascertained — trading particulars are not exempted from that protection, no Tribunal approval is required, and no Gazette publication is required.

tc.q: 有關當局可在甚麼條件下以摘要形式披露資料？
options: 該摘要的編製方式須防止從中確定任何人的業務、身分或交易詳情
該摘要須隱去該人的身分及業務詳情，但可包含其交易詳情
該摘要須先經覆核審裁處正式批准，方可對外披露
該摘要須與此同時在憲報刊登，以供公眾人士知悉
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(a)條規定該摘要的編製方式須能防止從中確定任何人的業務、身分或交易詳情——交易詳情同樣受保護而非例外，亦無須經覆核審裁處批准或在憲報刊登。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(f)條

en.q: Where a relevant authority discloses information with consent, whose consent is required when the information relates to a person other than its source?
options: Both the information provider and the person it concerns
Only the person who originally provided the information
Only the person to whom the information actually relates
Consent from either person is not a permitted basis
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(f) requires the consent of both the person from whom the information was obtained and, where it relates to someone else, that other person too — consent from only one of them, or from neither, does not satisfy the section.

tc.q: 有關當局在取得同意下披露資料時，如該資料關乎其來源以外的另一人，須取得何人的同意？
options: 提供資料的人及資料所關乎的人
只需該資料的原提供人的同意
只需該資料實際所關乎的人的同意
任何一方的同意均非獲准許的依據
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(f)條要求取得該資料來源人的同意，以及（如該資料關乎另一人）該另一人的同意兩者兼備——只取得其中一方的同意，或完全不以同意為依據，均不符合該條規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(h)條

en.q: Where information has been obtained by an authorized person under section 9 or an investigator under section 12, to whom may a relevant authority disclose it?
options: The Secretary for Justice, the Commissioner of Police, the ICAC Commissioner or the Tribunal
Any government bureau or department whatsoever, without any statutory restriction
Only the Secretary for Justice and the Commissioner of Police; others need separate consent
Any overseas regulator performing an anti-money-laundering supervisory function
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(h) permits disclosure of information obtained under section 9 or 12 only to these four named recipients — not to government bodies generally, to only some of them, or to overseas regulators, which fall under the separate section 76D(1)(i) instead.

tc.q: 如資料是由獲授權人根據第9條或調查員根據第12條取得，有關當局可向何人披露？
options: 律政司司長、警務處處長、廉政公署專員或審裁處
任何政府決策局或部門，並無任何法定限制
只限律政司司長及警務處處長，其餘須取得同意
任何執行打擊洗錢監管職能的海外監管機構
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(h)條只准許將根據第9或12條取得的資料，披露予這四名指明接收方——並非政府機構一般、其中部分人士，或海外監管機構（後者屬另一條文第76D(1)(i)所涵蓋）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(i)條

en.q: What two conditions must an overseas authority satisfy before a relevant authority may disclose information to it under section 76D(1)(i)?
options: It must perform a similar function or regulate financial services there, subject to adequate secrecy
It must be a member state of the FATF and have a mutual legal assistance treaty in force with Hong Kong
It must give a written undertaking never to disclose the information onwards to any third party at all
It must be located in a jurisdiction that does not appear on any FATF monitoring or grey list at all
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(i) requires the relevant authority to be satisfied the overseas authority performs a similar function or regulates relevant financial or professional services in its own jurisdiction, and is subject to adequate secrecy provisions there — FATF membership, an MLA treaty, a written non-onward-disclosure undertaking, and absence from a monitoring list are none of them the statutory test.

tc.q: 海外當局須符合哪兩項條件，有關當局方可根據第76D(1)(i)條向其披露資料？
options: 須執行類似職能或規管有關金融服務，並受充分保密條文規限
須為財務行動特別組織成員，並與香港訂有生效的司法互助協定
須書面承諾永不將該資料轉披露予任何其他方
須位於並非列於任何財務行動特別組織監察或灰名單的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(i)條要求有關當局信納該海外當局在其本身的司法管轄區執行類似職能或規管有關金融或專業服務，並在當地受充分的保密條文規限——財務行動特別組織成員資格、司法互助協定、書面不轉披露承諾，或不在監察名單之列，均非法定測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(2)條

en.q: Before disclosing information to a listed office-holder or to an overseas authority, of what must a relevant authority be satisfied?
options: That disclosure is desirable, having regard to the public interest and the recipient's need for it
That disclosure serves the public interest, regardless of the recipient's need for the information
That the recipient has paid the fee prescribed in Schedule 3 for the information
That the person to whom the information relates has been notified and consents
