en.explain: Section 76D(2) requires the authority to be satisfied disclosure is desirable or expedient having regard to BOTH the public interest and investing public's interest AND the recipient's need for the information — public interest alone, disregarding the recipient's need, is not enough, and there is no fee or notice-and-consent condition.

tc.q: 有關當局向列明的職位持有人或海外當局披露資料前，須信納甚麼？
options: 顧及公眾利益及接收方對該資料的需要，該項披露屬合宜
該項披露符合公眾利益，而不論接收方是否需要該資料
接收方已就該資料繳付附表3訂明的費用
該資料所關乎的人已獲通知並表示同意
tc.explain: 第76D(2)條要求當局信納披露屬合宜或適當，須同時顧及公眾利益及投資大眾的利益，以及接收方對該資料的需要——單憑公眾利益而不理會接收方的需要並不足夠，亦無收費或通知並取得同意的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(g)條

en.q: Which of the following appears in the list of persons to whom a relevant authority may disclose information under section 76D(1)(g)?
options: The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data
The chairman of any licensed money service operator
Any Member of the Legislative Council
Any auditor engaged in private practice
en.explain: The section 76D(1)(g) list includes the Chief Executive, the Financial Secretary, the Secretary for Justice, the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, the Monetary Authority, the Insurance Authority, the SFC, the Commissioner, the Registrar, the Official Receiver, the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data, The Ombudsman, the ICAC Commissioner, the Law Society and the Estate Agents Authority, among others.

tc.q: 下列何者列於第76D(1)(g)條有關當局可向其披露資料的人的名單內？
options: 個人資料私隱專員
任何持牌金錢服務經營者的主席
任何立法會議員
任何私人執業的核數師
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(g)條的名單包括行政長官、財政司司長、律政司司長、財經事務及庫務局局長、金融管理專員、保險業監管局、證券及期貨事務監察委員會、海關關長、註冊處處長、破產管理署署長、個人資料私隱專員、申訴專員、廉政專員、律師會及地產代理監管局等。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(c)條

en.q: May a relevant authority disclose information to the Review Tribunal despite the confidentiality requirement?
options: Yes — section 76D(1)(c) permits disclosure to the Tribunal
No — the Tribunal must obtain the information from the parties
Only with the consent of the person to whom the information relates
Only where the Tribunal issues a notice under section 61(1)(c)
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(c) expressly permits a relevant authority to disclose information to the Review Tribunal, and section 76D(1)(d) permits disclosure to the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal. The Tribunal also has its own compulsory powers under section 61(1).

tc.q: 即使有保密規定，有關當局可否向審裁處披露資料？
options: 可以——第76D(1)(c)條明文准許向審裁處披露
不可以——覆核審裁處須自行向各方取得資料
須先取得該資料所關乎的人本人的同意方可披露
只限覆核審裁處根據第61(1)(c)條發出通知的情況
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(c)條明文准許有關當局向覆核審裁處披露資料，第76D(1)(d)條則准許向證券及期貨事務上訴審裁處披露。覆核審裁處根據第61(1)條亦有其本身的強制權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76D(1)(b)條

en.q: To which officer appointed under the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance may a relevant authority disclose information?
options: A liquidator
A provisional receiver of the Official Receiver's Office only
A company secretary
An inspector appointed by the Registrar of Companies
en.explain: Section 76D(1)(b) permits a relevant authority to disclose information to a liquidator appointed under the Companies (Winding Up and Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance (Cap. 32). The Official Receiver appears separately in the section 76D(1)(g) list.

tc.q: 有關當局可向根據《公司（清盤及雜項條文）條例》委任的哪一名人員披露資料？
options: 清盤人
只限破產管理署的臨時接管人
公司秘書
公司註冊處處長委任的審查員
tc.explain: 第76D(1)(b)條准許有關當局向根據《公司（清盤及雜項條文）條例》（第32章）委任的清盤人披露資料。破產管理署署長則另見於第76D(1)(g)條的名單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76B(1)條

en.q: To which matters and documents does the confidentiality requirement in section 76B apply?
options: Matters known via appointment, or in performing or assisting a function, plus records obtained
Only matters learned by virtue of appointment, not those learned while assisting others
Only matters that the relevant authority has expressly marked as confidential in writing
Only records relating to a licensee that is currently the subject of an active investigation
en.explain: Section 76B(1) covers matters known by virtue of appointment, or in the course of performing OR assisting another person in performing a function under the Ordinance — the assisting limb is included, not excluded — plus records or documents obtained in any of those circumstances; there is no requirement that matters be marked confidential or limited to licensees under active investigation.

tc.q: 第76B條的保密規定適用於哪些事宜及文件？
options: 因獲委任，或在執行或協助執行職能時知悉的事宜及紀錄
只限因獲委任而知悉的事宜，不包括協助他人時知悉
只限有關當局以書面明文標示為機密的事宜及紀錄
只限關乎正受海關積極調查的持牌人的紀錄
tc.explain: 第76B(1)條涵蓋因獲委任，或在執行本條例下職能的過程中，或在協助他人執行該等職能的過程中知悉的事宜——協助他人一項包括在內，並非被排除——以及在上述任何情況下取得的紀錄或文件；並無須將事宜標示為機密或只限於正受積極調查的持牌人的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(f)條

en.q: Under section 76C(1), in what circumstances connected with legal proceedings may a specified person disclose information?
options: In connection with any judicial or other proceedings to which the specified person is a party
Only in connection with criminal proceedings, and only as a witness for the prosecution
Only where a court has granted the specified person leave to disclose
Only in connection with proceedings to which the Commissioner, not the specified person, is a party
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(f) permits disclosure in connection with any judicial or other proceedings to which the specified person is a party — not limited to criminal proceedings or to testifying for the prosecution, no court leave is required, and it is the specified person's own party status that matters, not the Commissioner's.

tc.q: 根據第76C(1)條，指明人士在與法律程序有關的甚麼情況下可披露資料？
options: 就指明人士作為一方的任何司法或其他法律程序
只限刑事法律程序，且只限作為控方證人的情況
只限法院已批准指明人士披露的情況
只限關長（而非指明人士）作為一方的法律程序
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(f)條准許就指明人士作為一方的任何司法或其他法律程序而披露資料——不限於刑事法律程序或作為控方證人的情況，亦無須法院批准，且須為指明人士本身屬該法律程序的一方，而非關長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第76C(1)(a)條

en.q: For which purposes connected with the Ordinance itself may a specified person disclose information?
options: In performing, carrying into effect, or doing anything required or authorized under it
Only in performing a function under the Ordinance, not for carrying a provision into effect
Only when expressly directed to do so in writing by the Commissioner personally
Only after the relevant investigation has been formally closed and reported
en.explain: Section 76C(1)(a) covers all three limbs — performing a function, carrying a provision into effect, or doing anything required or authorized under the Ordinance — not just the first; no Commissioner direction or closed investigation is required.

tc.q: 指明人士可為與本條例本身有關的哪些目的披露資料？
options: 執行職能、使條文生效，或作出本條例授權的事情
只限執行本條例下的職能，不包括使條文生效的情況
只限關長親自以書面作出明確指示的情況
只限有關調查已正式完結並提交報告之後
tc.explain: 第76C(1)(a)條涵蓋三項情況——執行職能、使條文生效，或作出本條例所規定或授權的任何事情——並非只限第一項；亦無須關長指示或待調查正式完結。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)(a)條

en.q: When must a licensee notify the Commissioner of its intention to cease operating a money service?
options: In writing, before the cessation date, stating the intention and date
Within 7 calendar days after the actual date of cessation itself
Within one full calendar month after the actual date of cessation
At least 45 clear days before the licensee's intended cessation date
en.explain: Section 41(1)(a) requires written notice to the Commissioner before the date of cessation, stating the intention and the date; the separate 7-day period in section 41(1)(b) is for returning the licence and runs AFTER cessation, not before it, and no one-month or 45-day period appears in section 41(1)(a).

tc.q: 持牌人須於何時將其停止經營金錢服務的意向通知海關關長？
options: 須於停止營業日期前以書面通知意向及日期
須於實際停止營業日期之後的7個曆日之內
須於停止營業日期之後一個完整的曆月之內
須於停止營業日期前至少45個清晰日
tc.explain: 第41(1)(a)條規定須於停止營業日期前，以書面將該意向及該日期通知關長；第41(1)(b)條另訂的7日期間是就交回牌照而言，並在停止營業之後起計，並非之前，第41(1)(a)條亦無一個月或45日的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(1)條

en.q: From what date does the one-month period for notifying the Commissioner of a change in particulars run?
options: The date on which the change takes place
The date on which the licensee becomes aware of the change
The date on which the Commissioner requests an update
The date of the licensee's next licence renewal
en.explain: Section 40(1) requires the licensee to notify the Commissioner in writing of the change within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place — not the date of the licensee's awareness of it.

tc.q: 將詳情變更通知海關關長的一個月期間，自哪一日起計？
options: 該項變更發生之日
持牌人知悉該項變更之日
關長要求更新之日
持牌人下次牌照續期之日
tc.explain: 第40(1)條規定持牌人須自該項變更發生之日起計一個月內，以書面將該項變更通知海關關長——而非自持牌人知悉之日起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)條

en.q: Under section 30(4)(a)(ii), a conviction under which other ordinance must the Commissioner take into account?
options: The United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance, for its section 14 offences
The Bankruptcy Ordinance (Cap. 6), for a person's undischarged bankrupt status
The Banking Ordinance, for any offence at all committed under that particular Ordinance
The Police Force Ordinance, for any internal disciplinary offence under that Ordinance
en.explain: Section 30(4)(a)(ii) requires regard to convictions under section 14 of the United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575); the Bankruptcy Ordinance appears elsewhere, in section 30(4)(d), for undischarged bankrupt status rather than convictions, and the Banking and Police Force Ordinances are not mentioned in section 30(4)(a) at all.

tc.q: 根據第30(4)(a)(ii)條，海關關長須顧及在哪條其他條例下的定罪？
options: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，涉及第14條罪行
《破產條例》（第6章），涉及該人的無力償還債務破產狀況
《銀行業條例》，涉及該條例下訂明的任何罪行事宜
《警隊條例》，涉及該條例下訂明的任何紀律罪行事宜
tc.explain: 第30(4)(a)(ii)條規定須顧及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（第575章）第14條下的定罪；《破產條例》則見於另一款第30(4)(d)條，涉及無力償還債務破產狀況而非定罪，《銀行業條例》及《警隊條例》均未見於第30(4)(a)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(1)條與第34(1)條的比較

en.q: A licensee breaches a licence condition, and separately its sole director ceases to be fit and proper. Which powers are engaged?
options: Section 43 for the breach of licence condition, and section 34 for the loss of fitness
Section 43 alone, since that section's disciplinary powers extend to fitness and propriety too
Section 34 alone, since revocation power absorbs all lesser disciplinary sanctions
Section 21, because both events count as contraventions of a specified provision
en.explain: Section 43(1)(b) engages the disciplinary powers in section 43(2) — including a pecuniary penalty of up to $1,000,000 under section 43(2)(c) — for a licence-condition breach. Loss of fitness and propriety by a director instead engages the separate revocation or suspension powers in section 34(1)(a)(iii); section 43's powers do not extend to fitness and propriety, section 34 does not absorb lesser sanctions, and section 21 applies to financial institutions generally, not this MSO-specific pairing.

tc.q: 某持牌人違反牌照條件，而其唯一董事亦不再是適當人選。哪些權力會被觸發？
options: 違反牌照條件觸發第43條；喪失適當人選資格觸發第34條
只觸發第43條，因該條的紀律權力亦延伸至適當人選資格事宜
只觸發第34條，因撤銷權力已吸納一切較輕的紀律制裁
觸發第21條，因兩者均屬違反指明的條文的情況
tc.explain: 第43(1)(b)條就違反牌照條件觸發第43(2)條的紀律權力，包括第43(2)(c)條下最高1,000,000元的罰款。董事喪失適當人選資格則觸發第34(1)(a)(iii)條另設的撤銷或暫時吊銷權力；第43條的權力並不延伸至適當人選資格事宜，第34條亦非吸納較輕制裁，而第21條適用於金融機構的一般情況，並非此處金錢服務經營者特定的配對。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(1)條

en.q: What may a person obtain from the Commissioner on payment of the fee specified in Schedule 3?
options: A certified or uncertified register copy, or a certificate as to a name's entry
An uncertified copy only — certified copies are reserved for use in court proceedings
A certificate only — copies of register entries are not available to the public
A copy of the register, but only if the applicant's own name appears in it
en.explain: Section 28(1) allows any person, on payment of the Schedule 3 fee, to obtain either a certified OR uncertified copy of the register (or an entry/extract), or a certificate as to whether a name has been entered on or removed from it — certified copies are not reserved for courts, copies remain available alongside certificates, and entitlement is not limited to a person searching for their own name.

tc.q: 任何人繳付附表3訂明的費用後，可從海關關長取得甚麼？
options: 登記冊的核證或未核證副本，或姓名是否列入的證明書
只限未經核證的副本——經核證的副本只供法庭程序使用
只限證明書——登記冊記項的副本並不供公眾索取查閱
登記冊的副本，但只限申請人本身姓名列於其中的情況
tc.explain: 第28(1)條准許任何人在繳付附表3費用後，取得登記冊（或其記項或摘錄）的經核證或未經核證副本，或述明某姓名有否列入或已從登記冊剔除的證明書——經核證的副本並非只供法庭使用，副本與證明書兩者均可取得，亦不限於查閱申請人本身的姓名。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第28(2)條

en.q: What is the evidential status of a copy of the register purporting to be certified by the Commissioner?
options: Admissible on production without further proof, and evidence of the facts stated
It is conclusive evidence of the facts stated in it, leaving no room for rebuttal
It is admissible only if the Commissioner personally attends court to prove it
It is inadmissible unless produced in court together with the original register itself
en.explain: Section 28(2) makes a purportedly certified copy admissible without further proof and merely evidence of the facts stated — not conclusive evidence (that stronger status attaches only to a section 28(4) certificate), and no personal attendance or production of the original is required.

tc.q: 看來是由海關關長核證的登記冊副本，具有甚麼證據地位？
options: 出示即獲接納而無須再加證明，並為所述事實的證據
為其所述事實的確證，任何人不得就此提出反駁
只有在關長本人親自出庭作證的情況下方獲接納
除非連同登記冊正本一併呈交法庭，否則一律不獲接納
tc.explain: 第28(2)條使看來經核證的副本一經出示即可獲接納而無須再加證明，並只是所述事實的證據——並非確證（該較強的地位只適用於第28(4)條的證明書），亦無須本人出庭或出示登記冊正本。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(1)條

en.q: For what purpose may an authorized person exercise the routine inspection powers in section 9?
options: To ascertain whether a person is complying or has complied with a requirement
To investigate a suspected offence that has already been formally reported to police
To ascertain whether an offence under section 5 has already been committed by someone
To verify the continuing accuracy of the register maintained under section 27
en.explain: Section 9(1)'s purpose is ascertaining whether a prescribed person is complying, has complied, or is likely to be able to comply with a prescribed requirement — a supervisory purpose distinct from investigating a reported offence, checking whether a section 5 offence has occurred (an investigative matter for section 11), or auditing the section 27 register.

tc.q: 獲授權人可為甚麼目的行使第9條的例行視察權力？
options: 確定某人是否正在遵從或已經遵從規定
調查一宗已正式向警方舉報的懷疑刑事罪案
確定是否已有人干犯第5條所訂的罪行
核實第27條下備存的登記冊是否持續準確
tc.explain: 第9(1)條的目的是確定訂明人士是否正在遵從、是否已經遵從，或是否相當可能有能力遵從訂明規定——此為監管目的，有別於調查已舉報的罪行、確定是否已干犯第5條罪行（屬第11條的調查事宜），或審核第27條登記冊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(1)(a)及(b)條

en.q: Under section 11(1), on what ground may a relevant authority appoint an investigator in relation to a financial institution?
options: It has reasonable cause to believe an Ordinance offence may have been committed
Only where a licensee has failed to apply to renew its licence 45 days before it expires
Only on the express written direction of the Secretary for Justice
Only where the Review Tribunal has remitted a matter for further inquiry
en.explain: Section 11(1)(a) allows a relevant authority to appoint an investigator wherever it has reasonable cause to believe an offence under the Ordinance may have been committed — a separate ground exists under section 11(1)(b) tied to the section 21/43 powers, but a failed renewal, an SJ direction, or a Tribunal remittal are not, by themselves, section 11(1) grounds.

tc.q: 根據第11(1)條，就金融機構而言，有關當局可基於甚麼理由委任調查員？
options: 有合理因由相信可能已犯本條例所訂罪行
只限持牌人未有於牌照屆滿前45日申請續期的情況
只限律政司司長以書面明確指示的情況
只限覆核審裁處將事宜發回作進一步查究的情況
tc.explain: 第11(1)(a)條准許有關當局在有合理因由相信可能已犯本條例所訂罪行時委任調查員；第11(1)(b)條另設與第21或43條權力相關的獨立理由，但未及時續期、律政司司長指示或覆核審裁處發回查究，本身均非第11(1)條下的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第11(3)條

en.q: How may the costs of an investigator appointed with the Financial Secretary's consent, who is not a specified public officer, be met?
options: Out of moneys provided by the Legislative Council
Out of the licence fees paid under Schedule 3
By the person under investigation, in every case
Out of pecuniary penalties under section 21
en.explain: Section 11(3) provides that the costs and expenses incurred by an investigator who is appointed under section 11(1) with the consent of the Financial Secretary, and who is not a person specified in section 11(2), may be paid out of moneys provided by the Legislative Council.

tc.q: 經財政司司長同意而委任、並非指明公職人員的調查員，其費用可如何支付？
options: 由立法會撥款支付
由根據附表3繳付的牌照費用支付
在任何情況下均由受調查的人支付
由根據第21條收取的罰款支付
tc.explain: 第11(3)條訂明，根據第11(1)條經財政司司長同意而委任、並非第11(2)條所指明的人的調查員，其所招致的費用及開支可由立法會撥款支付。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(b)(i)條

en.q: Where an application relates to operating a money service at particular premises, what must the Commissioner be satisfied about the premises themselves?
options: That the premises are suitable for the operation of a money service
That the premises are owned outright by the applicant personally
That the premises are situated within a designated commercial district
That the premises have a floor area of at least the prescribed minimum
en.explain: Section 30(3)(b)(i) requires only that the premises are suitable to be used for operating a money service — ownership, location in a commercial district, and a minimum floor area are not statutory requirements; the additional written-consent requirement in sub-paragraph (ii) applies only to domestic premises.

tc.q: 如申請關乎在特定處所經營金錢服務，海關關長須就該處所本身信納甚麼？
options: 該處所適合用作經營金錢服務
該處所須由申請人本人完全擁有
該處所須位於指定的商業區內
該處所的樓面面積須達訂明的最低標準
tc.explain: 第30(3)(b)(i)條只規定該處所須適合用作經營金錢服務——擁有權、位處商業區或最低樓面面積均非法定規定；(ii)節的額外書面同意規定則只適用於住宅處所。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(2)(b)條

en.q: For how long may the Commissioner suspend a licence under section 34?
options: For a period or until an event specified by the Commissioner
For a fixed maximum period of six months in every single case
Only until the licensee's next scheduled renewal date arrives
Indefinitely, with no requirement to ever specify an end point
en.explain: Section 34(2)(b) allows suspension for a period specified by the Commissioner, or until a specified event occurs — not a fixed six-month cap, not tied to the renewal cycle, and not indefinite without an end point; section 34(5)(b) requires the notice to state the duration and terms.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第34條可將牌照暫時吊銷多久？
options: 關長指明的期間或指明事件發生為止
在任何情況下，一律以六個月為固定上限
只限至該持牌人的下一個預定續期日為止
無限期持續有效，永遠無須指明終結時點
tc.explain: 第34(2)(b)條准許在關長指明的期間內，或直至關長指明的事件發生為止暫時吊銷牌照——並非固定六個月上限，亦與續期周期無關，也非無須指明終結時點的無限期吊銷；第34(5)(b)條規定通知須述明吊銷的期間及條款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第42(a)條

en.q: An individual licensee dies. What happens to the licence, and must the Commissioner act first?
options: The licence ceases to be valid on death, with no Commissioner action needed
The licence remains valid until the deceased's estate is fully administered
The licence passes automatically to the personal representative
The licence stays valid until the Commissioner revokes it under section 34
en.explain: Section 42(a) provides that a licence ceases to be valid, where the licensee is an individual, automatically on death — no administration of the estate, transfer to a personal representative, or revocation under section 34 is needed or occurs.

tc.q: 某個人持牌人去世。牌照會怎樣？海關關長是否須先採取行動？
options: 牌照於去世時停止有效，無須關長作出任何行為
牌照維持有效，直至遺產全面管理完成為止
牌照自動轉予遺產代理人，直至其原有年期屆滿
牌照維持有效，直至關長根據第34條撤銷
tc.explain: 第42(a)條訂明，如持牌人是個人，牌照於該個人去世時自動停止有效——無須待遺產管理完成、轉予遺產代理人，或根據第34條撤銷。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(10)條

en.q: What bars criminal proceedings under section 10 in respect of particular conduct?
options: Where section 14(2)(b) proceedings for the same conduct are pending, or now bar further ones
Where the person has already been disciplined by the relevant authority for exactly the same conduct
Where more than twelve months have already elapsed since the date the conduct occurred
Where the person has already made full voluntary disclosure to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Section 10(10) bars criminal proceedings only where proceedings for the purposes of section 14(2)(b) — the contempt route — were previously instituted for the same conduct and either remain pending or, because of that earlier institution, may no longer lawfully be instituted; prior discipline by the authority, elapse of twelve months, or voluntary disclosure to the Tribunal are not what bars proceedings under this subsection.

tc.q: 甚麼情況會阻止就某特定行為根據第10條提起刑事法律程序？
options: 同一行為的第14(2)(b)條程序仍待決或已不能再提起
該人已就完全相同的行為，早前被有關當局施加正式紀律處分
距該行為實際發生之日起計算，時間已經過超過十二個月之久
該人事後已經主動向覆核審裁處作出全面完整而詳盡的自願披露
tc.explain: 第10(10)條只在先前已就同一行為為第14(2)(b)條的目的（即藐視法庭途徑）提起法律程序，而該程序仍待決，或因該次提起而不能再合法提起時，方阻止提起刑事法律程序；已被當局紀律處分、經過十二個月，或已向覆核審裁處自願披露，均非本款所指的阻卻事由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第63(4)條

en.q: How does the AMLO prevent double punishment where conduct before the Tribunal could be both a section 61(2) offence and a contempt?
options: Section 63(4) blocks contempt while section 61(2) proceedings are pending, and bars those proceedings once the contempt power is used
The Tribunal must apply the same standard of proof as the Court of First Instance under section 63(3) whenever it exercises the contempt power
The Secretary for Justice, rather than the Tribunal, decides under section 63 which of the two routes is to be taken in every case
Both the contempt power and section 61(2) proceedings may be pursued at the same time against the person, with penalties running concurrently
en.explain: Section 63(4) operates in both directions: no contempt power may be exercised where criminal proceedings under section 61(2) have previously been instituted in respect of the same conduct and remain pending, and no section 61(2) proceedings may be instituted where the contempt power has already been exercised in respect of the same conduct. Section 63(3)'s standard-of-proof rule and any role for the Secretary for Justice are separate matters; nothing in section 63 lets both routes run at once.

tc.q: 如審裁處席前的行為既可構成第61(2)條罪行亦可構成藐視行為，《打擊洗錢條例》如何防止雙重處罰？
options: 第61(2)條程序待決時阻止藐視權力；藐視權力一經行使即阻止提起該條程序
審裁處根據第63(3)條，行使藐視權力時須採用與原訟法庭相同的舉證準則
由律政司司長決定每宗個案採取哪一途徑，而非由審裁處決定
藐視權力及第61(2)條法律程序可就同一行為同時進行，並可判處同期執行的刑罰
tc.explain: 第63(4)條雙向運作：如先前已就同一行為根據第61(2)條提起刑事法律程序而該程序仍待決，則不得行使藐視權力；如已就同一行為行使藐視權力，則不得根據第61(2)條提起法律程序。第63(3)條的舉證準則及律政司司長的角色屬另外的事宜；第63條並無容許兩種途徑同時進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(2)(c)及(d)條

en.q: Which of the following conduct in relation to Tribunal proceedings is an offence under section 61(2)?
options: Leaving the place of attendance without permission, or hindering or deterring attendance or testimony
Applying to the Tribunal under section 69 for a stay of execution of the specified decision under review
Appealing the Tribunal's determination to the Court of Appeal on a point of law arising from the review
Applying to the Tribunal under section 70 for a stay of execution of its own determination
en.explain: Section 61(2)(c) and (d) make it an offence to leave the place where attendance was required without the Tribunal's permission, and to hinder or deter any person from attending, giving evidence or producing anything for the purposes of a review. Applying under section 69 or 70 for a stay of execution, or appealing to the Court of Appeal, are legitimate procedural steps available to a party, not offences under section 61(2).

tc.q: 就審裁處的法律程序而言，下列哪種行為屬第61(2)條所訂罪行？
options: 未經准許而離開被規定出席的地方，或阻礙或阻嚇他人出席或作證
根據第69條向審裁處申請暫緩執行覆核中的指明決定
就覆核的法律論點，向上訴法庭提出上訴以針對審裁處的裁定
根據第70條向審裁處申請暫緩執行其本身的裁定
tc.explain: 第61(2)(c)及(d)條將未經審裁處准許而離開被規定出席的地方，以及阻礙或阻嚇任何人為覆核目的出席、作證或交出任何東西，訂為罪行。根據第69或70條申請暫緩執行，或向上訴法庭提出上訴，均屬任何一方可採取的合法程序步驟，並非第61(2)條所訂罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(3)條

en.q: In relation to a licensed insurance broker company, licensed individual insurance agent or licensed insurance agency, Schedule 2 has effect only in relation to what?
options: Transactions involving a contract of insurance in column 3, Part 2, Schedule 1 to the Insurance Ordinance
Long term business carried on by an authorized insurer, not transactions by an agent, agency or broker company
Stored value facilities issued by an SVF licensee or bank, where the maximum storable value exceeds $3,000
Financial institutions' transactions generally, subject only to the qualifications in subsections (2) to (4)
en.explain: Section 5(3) confines Schedule 2's effect for a licensed individual insurance agent, licensed insurance agency or licensed insurance broker company to transactions involving a contract of insurance described in column 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41). Long term business of an authorized insurer is covered separately by section 5(2), stored value facilities exceeding $3,000 by section 5(4), and the general rule for financial institutions is section 5(1).

tc.q: 就持牌保險經紀公司、持牌個人保險代理或持牌保險代理機構而言，附表2只就甚麼具有效力？
options: 涉及《保險業條例》附表1第2部第3欄所描述保險合約的交易
獲授權保險人經營的長期業務，並非代理人、代理機構或經紀公司的交易
由工具持牌人或銀行發行、最高可儲存價值超逾3,000元的儲值支付工具
金融機構的交易一般而言，只受第(2)至(4)款的限制
tc.explain: 第5(3)條將附表2對持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構或持牌保險經紀公司的效力，限於該代理、機構或公司進行的涉及《保險業條例》（第41章）附表1第2部第3欄所描述的保險合約的交易。獲授權保險人的長期業務由第5(2)條另行規管，超逾3,000元的儲值支付工具由第5(4)條規管，金融機構的一般規則則見於第5(1)條。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第7(2)條

en.q: What may a guideline published by the Monetary Authority, the SFC, the Insurance Authority or a regulatory body incorporate or refer to?
options: A guideline or document, or part of one, issued or published by that body under the relevant Ordinance
Any guideline a relevant authority or regulatory body considers appropriate for operating Schedule 2
A guideline or document issued by the Commissioner, the relevant authority, under this Ordinance
Any amendment made to the guideline by that same body under section 7(3) of this Ordinance
en.explain: Section 7(2) permits a guideline published by the Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission, Insurance Authority or a regulatory body to incorporate or refer to a guideline or document, or any part of one, issued or published by that same body under the relevant Ordinance. Section 7(1) describes what such a guideline may generally cover, section 7(3) covers later amendments to it, and the Commissioner — the relevant authority for MSOs — is not among the bodies section 7(2) names.

tc.q: 由金融管理專員、證監會、保險業監管局或監管機構公布的指引，可載入或提述甚麼？
options: 該機構根據有關條例不時發出或公布的指引或文件，或其任何部分
有關當局或監管機構認為對施行附表2屬適當的任何指引
關長作為金錢服務經營者的有關當局所發出的指引或文件
該機構根據第7(3)條對該指引所作的任何修訂內容
tc.explain: 第7(2)條准許由金融管理專員、證券及期貨事務監察委員會、保險業監管局或監管機構公布的指引，收納或提述由同一機構根據有關條例不時發出或公布的指引或文件，或其任何部分。第7(1)條描述有關指引可涵蓋的一般內容，第7(3)條規管其後的修訂，而金錢服務經營者的有關當局——關長——並不在第7(2)條所列的機構之列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第60(1)(b)條

en.q: Instead of substituting its own decision, what may the Tribunal do with a matter under section 60(1)(b)?
options: Remit the matter to the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate
Refer the matter to the Court of First Instance for its own determination of the review
Refer the matter to the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury for a policy decision
Adjourn the review indefinitely pending further evidence from the specified authority
en.explain: Section 60(1)(b) allows the Tribunal to determine a review by remitting the matter to the specified authority with any directions it considers appropriate — an alternative to confirming, varying, setting aside or substituting the decision under section 60(1)(a). Neither the Court of First Instance nor the Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury has any role under section 60, and the Tribunal is not given a power to adjourn a review indefinitely.

tc.q: 審裁處根據第60(1)(b)條，可如何處理事宜以代替以其本身決定取代？
options: 將事宜連同其認為適當的指示發回指明當局
將事宜轉交原訟法庭，由其自行裁定該覆核
將事宜轉交財經事務及庫務局局長作政策決定
無限期押後覆核，以待指明當局提供進一步證據
tc.explain: 第60(1)(b)條准許審裁處藉將事宜連同其認為適當的任何指示發回指明當局，以裁定覆核——這是第60(1)(a)條確認、更改、撤銷或取代決定以外的另一選擇。原訟法庭及財經事務及庫務局局長在第60條下均無任何角色，審裁處亦無獲賦予無限期押後覆核的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(5)條

en.q: When making inquiries under section 9(1A)(c), what may an authorized person require of the person concerned?
options: To give access to any specified business record, produce it at the time and place specified, and answer any question raised
To give the authorized person access to the record only at the person's own premises, regardless of any place the authorized person specifies
To answer questions orally only; the authorized person has no power to require production of any specified business record
To produce specified business records within the time and place specified, but the authorized person has no power to ask any question
en.explain: Section 9(5) provides that, subject to section 9A, an authorized person exercising the inquiry power may require the person to give access to any specified business record and produce it within the time and at the place specified by the authorized person — not merely the person's own premises — and to answer any question raised for the purposes of that subsection. Paragraph (a)'s power over records and paragraph (b)'s power to question both apply together, so neither can be excluded.

tc.q: 獲授權人根據第9(1A)(c)條作出查詢時，可要求有關人士作出甚麼？
options: 讓其查閱指明業務紀錄並於指明時間地點交出，以及回答有關問題
只可於該人本身的處所讓其查閱該紀錄，而不論獲授權人指明何處
只可口頭回答問題；獲授權人無權要求交出任何指明業務紀錄
須於指明時間及地點交出指明業務紀錄，但獲授權人無權提出任何問題
tc.explain: 第9(5)條訂明，在第9A條的規限下，行使查詢權力的獲授權人可要求該人讓其查閱任何指明業務紀錄，並於獲授權人指明的時間及地點（而非僅該人本身的處所）交出該紀錄，以及回答為該款目的而提出的任何問題——(a)款關於紀錄的權力與(b)款關於提問的權力同時適用，兩者缺一不可。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(10)條

en.q: A person cannot answer an authorized person's question under section 9 because the information is not within their knowledge. What may be required?
options: That the person verify, within the time specified, that fact and reason by statutory declaration
That the person verify the answer itself, rather than the reason it could not be given, by statutory declaration
That the declaration be made before a magistrate rather than taken by the authorized person
That nothing further may be required of the person once they say the information is not within their knowledge
en.explain: Section 9(10) allows the authorized person to require in writing that the person verify, within the time specified, the fact that the information is not within their knowledge and the reason, by statutory declaration. This is distinct from section 9(9), which lets the authorized person require verification of an answer that actually was given. Section 9(11) lets either declaration be taken by the authorized person, with no need for a magistrate.

tc.q: 某人因有關資料並非其所知而無法回答獲授權人根據第9條提出的問題。可要求該人作出甚麼？
options: 於指明時間內以法定聲明核實該事實及理由
須以法定聲明核實答覆本身，而非未能作答的事實及理由
該法定聲明須在裁判官席前作出，而非由獲授權人監誓
該人一旦表示有關資料並非其所知，即無須再作任何要求
tc.explain: 第9(10)條准許獲授權人以書面要求該人於指明時間內，以法定聲明核實該資料並非其所知一事及其理由。這有別於第9(9)條——後者是在已作出答覆的情況下，要求以法定聲明核實該答覆本身。第9(11)條准許該法定聲明由獲授權人監誓，毋須裁判官。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第66(1)(b)條

en.q: Besides its determination and reasons, what else must the Tribunal deliver after completing a review?
options: Any order made under section 65, together with the reasons for that order
The order made under section 65 alone, without the reasons for making it
The reasons for the section 65 order alone, without the order itself
Any order under subsection (2) restricting publication
en.explain: Section 66(1)(b) requires the Tribunal to deliver, together with its determination and reasons, both any order made under section 65 (costs) and the reasons for that order — delivering only one half is not enough. A section 66(2) order restricting publication is a separate, discretionary power that arises only where part of the sitting was held in private.

tc.q: 除裁定及理由外，審裁處完成覆核後還須交付甚麼？
options: 就該覆核根據第65條作出的任何命令，連同該命令的理由
根據第65條作出的命令，但不包括作出該命令的理由
根據第65條作出命令的理由，但不包括該命令本身
如聆訊非公開進行，根據第(2)款作出禁止發布的命令
tc.explain: 第66(1)(b)條規定審裁處除交付其裁定及理由外，還須交付就該覆核根據第65條（訟費）作出的任何命令，連同該命令的理由——只交付其中一項並不足夠。第66(2)條下限制發布的命令屬另一項酌情權力，只在聆訊部分以非公開形式進行時方會出現。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第65(2)條

en.q: How are costs awarded by the Review Tribunal recovered?
options: As a civil debt, payable by the party the Tribunal considers appropriate or by the other party to the review
As a civil debt, payable by the other party to the review in every case, regardless of whom the costs were awarded to
By taxation under Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court, with no separate right of recovery as a civil debt
By execution against the licensee's business premises, rather than as an ordinary civil debt
en.explain: Section 65(2) distinguishes two cases: costs awarded to an attending person under section 65(1)(a) are recoverable from any party to the review that the Tribunal considers appropriate, while costs awarded to a party under section 65(1)(b) are recoverable from the other party — both as a civil debt. Section 65(3) separately applies Order 62 of the Rules of the High Court to the award and taxation of costs, but that does not replace civil-debt recovery, and nothing in section 65 ties recovery to the licensee's business premises.

tc.q: 審裁處判給的訟費如何追討？
options: 作為民事債項，由審裁處認為適當的一方或覆核的另一方支付
作為民事債項，一律由覆核的另一方支付，不論訟費原判給何人
按《高等法院規則》第62號命令評定，並無另行作為民事債項追討的權利
以執行程序針對持牌人的業務處所追討，而非作為一般民事債項
tc.explain: 第65(2)條區分兩種情況：如訟費根據第65(1)(a)條判給出席者，可向審裁處認為適當的覆核任何一方追討；如根據第65(1)(b)條判給覆核一方，則可向覆核的另一方追討——兩者均作為民事債項追討。第65(3)條另就訟費的判給及評定，適用《高等法院規則》第62號命令，但這並不取代作為民事債項追討的權利，第65條亦無將追討方式與持牌人的業務處所掛鈎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(1)條

en.q: Who may lay the information on oath on which a magistrate issues a warrant under section 17?
options: An investigator, a person authorized under section 9(12), or a relevant authority's employee or staff member
A person specified in the warrant, a police officer, or any other person necessary to assist in its execution
An investigator only — a person authorized under section 9(12) may not lay the information
The magistrate may issue the warrant on the authorized person's own knowledge, without any information on oath
en.explain: Section 17(1) provides that the magistrate may issue the warrant if satisfied by information on oath laid by an investigator, a person authorized under section 9(12), or an employee or staff member of a relevant authority. That is a different group from the persons named in the warrant to execute it — a person specified in the warrant, a police officer, or anyone else necessary to assist — and section 9(12) persons are expressly included, not excluded, among those who may lay the information.

tc.q: 裁判官根據第17條發出手令所憑藉的、經宣誓而作的告發，可由何人作出？
options: 調查員、第9(12)條獲授權的人，或有關當局的僱員或職員
手令上指明的人、警務人員，或協助執行手令所需的任何其他人
只限調查員——根據第9(12)條獲授權的人不可作出告發
裁判官可憑獲授權人的認知發出手令，毋須經宣誓而作的告發
tc.explain: 第17(1)條訂明，裁判官如因調查員、根據第9(12)條獲授權的人，或有關當局的僱員或職員經宣誓而作的告發，信納有合理理由懷疑，即可發出手令。這與獲手令授權執行手令的人——即手令上指明的人、警務人員，或協助執行所需的其他人——並非同一批人；而根據第9(12)條獲授權的人明文包括在可作出告發的人之內，並非被排除在外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(2)條

en.q: Of whom found on premises entered under a section 17 warrant may an authorized person require production of records?
options: A person the authorized person reasonably believes is employed in a business currently or formerly carried on at the premises
Any person found on the premises, whether or not employed in connection with the business carried on there
Only a person currently employed in connection with the business, excluding anyone formerly employed there
Only a person who is, or is believed to be, in charge of the premises generally, rather than of the business carried on there
en.explain: Section 17(2) allows the authorized person, where there is reasonable cause to believe a person found on the premises is employed in connection with a business that is or has been carried on there, to require that person to produce for examination any record in their possession that may be required to be produced under Part 3. That covers both current and former connections — it is not limited to people currently employed, nor extended to everyone on the premises, nor confined to whoever is in charge of the premises itself (a section 47 concept).

tc.q: 獲授權人可要求在根據第17條手令進入的處所內發現的何人交出紀錄？
options: 獲授權人合理相信是受僱與該處所現正或曾經營業務有關連的人
在場的任何人，不論是否與該處所經營的業務有僱傭關連
只限現時受僱於該業務的人，不包括曾受僱於該業務的人
只限看來是掌管該處所的人，而非與該處所業務有關連的人
tc.explain: 第17(2)條准許獲授權人在有合理理由相信於處所內發現的人是受僱與該處所現正或曾經經營的業務有關連的情況下，要求該人交出其管有而根據第3部可能須交出的任何紀錄以供查驗。這涵蓋現時及過往的關連——並不限於現時受僱的人，亦不擴及處所內的所有人，更非只限於掌管處所本身的人（那是第47條的概念）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第17(8)條

en.q: What does section 17(8) say about property that comes into a relevant authority's possession by virtue of section 17?
options: It is treated, under the Criminal Procedure Ordinance, as if it had come into the possession of the police
It must be returned to its owner within the 7-day period for which the section 17 warrant remains valid
It may only be retained for up to 6 months, or longer if required for related proceedings, with no other consequence
The authorized person need not give a receipt for it, since its treatment is already governed by subsection (8)
en.explain: Section 17(8) provides that section 102 of the Criminal Procedure Ordinance (Cap. 221) applies to property that has by virtue of section 17 come into the possession of a relevant authority, as it applies to property that has come into the possession of the police. The 7-day figure is the warrant's entry window under section 17(1)(a), not a return deadline; the 6-month cap is the separate retention rule in section 17(4); and section 17(5)'s receipt duty still applies regardless of section 17(8).

tc.q: 根據第17(8)條，憑藉第17條而歸有關當局管有的財產，如何處理？
options: 就《刑事訴訟程序條例》而言，該財產猶如已歸警方管有一樣處理
須在第17條手令仍然有效的7天期間屆滿前發還原主，不得逾期保留
只可保留最多6個月，或在有關法律程序需要時保留更長時間
獲授權人無須就該財產發出收據，因其處理方式已由第(8)款規管
tc.explain: 第17(8)條訂明，《刑事訴訟程序條例》（第221章）第102條適用於憑藉第17條而歸有關當局管有的財產，一如其適用於歸警方管有的財產。7天是第17(1)(a)條手令的進入期限，並非發還限期；6個月上限是第17(4)條另訂的保留規則；而第17(5)條的發收據責任，不論第17(8)條為何，仍然適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(1B)條

en.q: How does the section 9 inquiry power differ where the inspection subject is a licensed VAS provider rather than a licensed MSO?
options: Inquiries may also be made of an associated entity and of related corporations of the provider or of its associated entity
For an MSO inspection subject, inquiries may likewise be made of any related corporation of the licensee
Inquiries of an associated entity or related corporation are subject to the same necessity condition as inquiries of an information holder
It does not; inquiries of a VAS provider's related corporations are instead governed by the magistrate's warrant power in section 17
en.explain: Section 9(1B) extends the inquiry power, for a licensed VAS provider or its associated entity, to inquiries of the provider, an associated entity, a related corporation of the provider, or a related corporation of an associated entity, as well as of information holders. Section 9(1A), which covers MSOs, has no such related-corporation extension — it is confined to the inspection subject and, subject to section 9(6), information holders. Section 9(6)'s necessity condition applies only to information-holder inquiries, not to inquiries of an associated entity or related corporation, and section 17's warrant power is a separate matter.

tc.q: 如視察對象是持牌虛擬資產服務提供者而非持牌金錢服務經營者，第9條的查詢權力有何不同？
options: 亦可向該提供者的有聯繫實體，以及該提供者或其有聯繫實體的有關連法團作出查詢
就金錢服務經營者的視察對象而言，同樣可向該持牌人的有關連法團作出查詢
向有聯繫實體或有關連法團作出查詢，須與向資料持有人作出查詢一樣，受相同的必要性條件規限
並非如此；向虛擬資產服務提供者的有關連法團作出查詢，改由第17條的裁判官手令權力規管
tc.explain: 第9(1B)條就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者或其有聯繫實體，將查詢權力擴展至向該提供者、有聯繫實體、該提供者的有關連法團，或有聯繫實體的有關連法團，以及資料持有人作出查詢。涵蓋金錢服務經營者的第9(1A)條並無此有關連法團的擴展——僅限於視察對象，以及在第9(6)條規限下的資料持有人。第9(6)條的必要性條件只適用於向資料持有人作出的查詢，不適用於向有聯繫實體或有關連法團作出的查詢；第17條的手令權力則屬另一事宜。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第12(2)(a)條

en.q: Which records may an investigator require a covered person to produce under section 12(2)(a)?
options: Records specified in the requirement, relevant to the investigation and in the person's possession
Records relevant to the investigation, whether or not they are in the person's own possession or control
Records specified in the requirement, whether or not relevant, provided they are in the person's possession
Any record the person is reasonably able to obtain, whether or not already in their possession
en.explain: Section 12(2)(a) allows an investigator to require production, within the time and at the place specified, of any record or document specified in the requirement that is or may be relevant to the investigation and is in the person's possession — both the relevance and the possession requirements must be met, and neither alone is enough. This differs from the attendance duty in section 12(2)(b) and the general-assistance duty in section 12(2)(d), which are not limited to specified records already in the person's possession.

tc.q: 調查員根據第12(2)(a)條可要求受涵蓋的人交出哪些紀錄？
options: 規定中所指明、與調查有關或可能有關，並且是該人管有的紀錄
與調查有關的紀錄，不論是否由該人本身管有或控制
規定中所指明的紀錄，不論是否與調查有關，惟須是該人管有的紀錄
該人合理地能夠取得的任何紀錄，不論是否已在其管有之中
tc.explain: 第12(2)(a)條准許調查員要求於指明時間及地點交出規定中所指明、與調查有關或可能有關，並且是該人管有的任何紀錄或文件——相關性及管有兩項要求須同時符合，缺一不可。這有別於第12(2)(b)條的出席責任，以及第12(2)(d)條的一般協助責任，該兩項責任並不限於已由該人管有的指明紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(3)條

en.q: What mental element must be proved for a person to commit the section 13(3) false-or-misleading offence?
options: Knowledge or recklessness as to the material being false or misleading
An intent to defraud the relevant authority or the investigator concerned
A failure to take reasonable care when verifying the material's accuracy
No mental element at all — section 13(3) imposes strict liability
en.explain: Section 13(3)(b) requires that the person knows that, or is reckless as to whether, the record, document, answer, response, explanation or further particulars is or are false or misleading in a material particular. Intent to defraud is instead the mental element for the more serious offence in section 13(6); the Ordinance sets no negligence-based or strict-liability offence here.

tc.q: 第13(3)條的虛假或誤導罪行，須證明甚麼犯罪心理元素？
options: 知道材料屬虛假或具誤導性，或罔顧是否如此
意圖欺騙有關當局或調查員，以逃避該規定
未有採取合理謹慎，查核有關材料是否準確
並無心理元素——第13(3)條屬絕對法律責任
tc.explain: 第13(3)(b)條規定，該人須知道有關紀錄、文件、答覆、回應、解釋或進一步詳情在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性，或罔顧其是否如此。意圖欺騙是第13(6)條更嚴重罪行的心理元素；條例並無在此訂立疏忽或絕對法律責任的罪行。

en.q: Which period applies to an application to the Review Tribunal for a review of a specified decision?
options: 21 days after the notice of the decision has been sent to the person
30 days after the order takes effect, for paying a pecuniary penalty
45 days before the licence expires, for a renewal application
One month after a change occurs, for notifying the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 59(1) sets the review application period at 21 days after the notice has been sent. The 30-day period in sections 21(3)/43(3) is instead for paying a pecuniary penalty, not for lodging a review; the 45-day period in section 31(2)(a) is for a renewal application; and the one-month period in section 40(1) is for notifying a change of particulars — none of these is the review period.

tc.q: 就指明決定向審裁處申請覆核，適用哪一期限？
options: 自告知該人該決定的通知發出後21日
自命令生效後30日，用於繳付罰款
自牌照屆滿前45日，用於續期申請
自詳情變更後一個月，用於通知關長
tc.explain: 第59(1)條訂明覆核申請期為通知發出後21日。第21(3)及43(3)條的30日是繳付罰款的期限，並非申請覆核的期限；第31(2)(a)條的45日是續期申請期；第40(1)條的一個月則是通知詳情變更的期限——三者均非覆核申請期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(3)條；參照第21(3)條

en.q: A licensee is ordered to pay a pecuniary penalty under section 43. What is the default period for payment?
options: 30 days after the order takes effect as a specified decision under section 75
21 days after the order is made — the period allowed to apply for review
7 days after the licensee receives written notice of the order
One month after the order is registered in the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 43(3) sets the default payment period at 30 days (or any longer period the Commissioner specifies under section 44(2)), running from when the order takes effect as a specified decision under section 75. The 21-day figure is instead the section 59(1) period for applying to the Review Tribunal, not for payment; the Ordinance ties the payment period to the order's effect, not to receipt of notice or to registration in the Court of First Instance.

tc.q: 持牌人被命令根據第43條繳付罰款。預設繳付期為多久？
options: 自該命令根據第75條作為指明決定生效後30日
自命令作出後21日——另可申請覆核的期限
自持牌人接獲該項命令的書面通知後7日
自該項命令在原訟法庭登記後一個月
tc.explain: 第43(3)條訂明預設繳付期為30日（或海關關長根據第44(2)條以通知指明的任何較長期間），自該命令根據第75條作為指明決定生效時起計。21日是第59(1)條就申請審裁處覆核所訂的期限，並非繳付期限；有關期間是自該命令生效時起計，並非自接獲通知或在原訟法庭登記時起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(6)條；第34(4)及(5)(b)條

en.q: The Commissioner decides under section 34 to suspend a licensee's licence and gives the licensee written notice of the decision. When does the suspension take effect?
options: At the time specified in the notice of the decision given under section 34(4)
On the date the notice is served, whatever time the notice itself states
Only when the licensee surrenders the original licence to the Commissioner
On the expiry of 7 days after the notice, to allow the licensee to make arrangements
en.explain: Section 34(4) requires the Commissioner, when revoking or suspending a licence, to notify the licensee in writing of the decision, and section 34(5)(b) requires a suspension notice to state the duration and terms of the suspension. Section 34(6) then provides that a revocation or suspension “takes effect at the time specified in the notice under subsection (4)”. Surrender of the licence is a requirement of revocation (sections 34(5)(c) and 34(8)), not of suspension, and the Ordinance provides no grace period.

tc.q: 關長根據第34條決定暫時吊銷某持牌人的牌照，並以書面通知該持牌人該決定。該項暫時吊銷何時生效？
options: 在根據第34(4)條發出的決定通知內指明的時間
在該通知送達當日，不論通知本身述明的時間為何
只在該持牌人將牌照正本交回關長時
在通知發出後7日屆滿時，以便持牌人作出安排
tc.explain: 第34(4)條規定關長在撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照時，須藉書面通知將其決定告知持牌人；第34(5)(b)條規定暫時吊銷的通知須述明暫時吊銷的持續期及條款。第34(6)條隨即訂明，根據該條作出的牌照撤銷或暫時吊銷「在第(4)款所指的通知指明的時間生效」。交回牌照是撤銷牌照的規定（第34(5)(c)及34(8)條），並非暫時吊銷的規定；條例亦無訂立任何寬限期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第36(1)條；第24條

en.q: An individual shareholder increases their holding in a licensed corporation from 20% to 30% of the issued share capital. What does the AMLO require?
options: Prior written approval from the Commissioner is required, as the holding exceeds 25%
Nothing is required — Commissioner approval applies only to directors, not shareholders
Notification to the Commissioner within one month is sufficient; no approval is needed
Nothing is required — approval is needed only once the holding exceeds 50%
en.explain: Under section 24(c)(i), an individual who owns or controls more than 25% of a corporation's issued share capital is an ultimate owner. Section 36(1) prohibits a person from becoming an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on the licensee's application, given prior written approval. A one-month notification under section 40(1) covers only a change in particulars, not this approval requirement, and the threshold that matters for anyone with this level of control is 25%, not 50%.

tc.q: 某個人股東將其於持牌法團的持股量由已發行股本的20%增至30%。《打擊洗錢條例》有何規定？
options: 須事先取得關長的書面批准，因持股量超過25%
無須任何行動——批准規定只適用於董事，不適用於股東
只須於一個月內通知關長；無須事先批准
無須任何行動——須待持股量超過50%方須批准
tc.explain: 根據第24(c)(i)條，直接或間接擁有或控制法團超過25%已發行股本的個人即屬最終擁有人。第36(1)條禁止任何人成為持牌人的最終擁有人，除非海關關長已應持牌人的申請事先以書面給予批准。第40(1)條的一個月通知只適用於詳情變更，並非批准規定；觸發門檻是25%而非50%，不論該人是否股東。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第38(1)條；第43(1)(c)條

en.q: A licensee licensed for one shop begins serving customers at a second shop without applying to add it. What follows under the AMLO?
options: An offence under section 38(8), and a ground for disciplinary action under section 43(1)(c)
An offence under section 29(1) for operating with no licence, and a $10,000,000 penalty under section 21
Automatic cessation of the licence under section 42, and a level 5 fine under section 39A
A pecuniary penalty under section 43(2)(c) only — section 38 itself creates no criminal offence
en.explain: Section 38(1) prohibits operating at premises not added to the licence; section 38(8) makes contravention an offence (a fine at level 5 and 6 months' imprisonment), and section 43(1)(c) separately lists a contravention of section 38(1) as a ground for the Commissioner's disciplinary powers under section 43(2), which include a pecuniary penalty up to $1,000,000 under section 43(2)(c) — so an offence is not the only consequence. Section 29(1) and the $10,000,000-scale penalty under section 21 concern different people (operating with no licence at all, and relevant authorities disciplining financial institutions); section 42 concerns a licence ceasing on the licensee's death or incapacity, not this scenario.

tc.q: 某持牌人獲發牌經營一間店舖，卻在第二間店舖開始為客戶提供服務而未有申請新增該處所。根據《打擊洗錢條例》，有何後果？
options: 構成第38(8)條所訂罪行，並構成第43(1)(c)條下針對持牌人的紀律行動理由
構成第29(1)條無牌經營的罪行，並可處第21條下最高1,000萬元的罰款
牌照根據第42條自動終止，並可處第39A條下的第5級罰款
只可根據第43(2)(c)條處以罰款——第38條本身並無訂立刑事罪行
tc.explain: 第38(1)條禁止在未加入牌照的處所經營；第38(8)條將違反訂為罪行（可處第5級罰款及監禁6個月），第43(1)(c)條另行將違反第38(1)條列為海關關長根據第43(2)條行使紀律權力的理由，當中包括第43(2)(c)條下最高1,000,000元的罰款，故罪行並非唯一後果。第29(1)條及第21條下1,000萬元的罰款針對的是完全沒有牌照的經營，以及有關當局對金融機構的紀律處分，均非本個案的適用條文；第42條則涉及持牌人死亡或喪失行為能力後牌照失效，與本個案無關。

en.q: A licensee applies to renew its licence before it expires. The Commissioner refuses the renewal and, within the 21 days allowed, the licensee applies to the Review Tribunal; the notice of refusal specified no other time for the decision to take effect. May the licensee keep operating while the review is pending?
options: Yes — section 31(10)(b) keeps the licence in force until the refusal takes effect; section 75(1)(c) delays that until the review is decided or withdrawn
No — under section 69(1) the review application does not itself stay the refusal, so the licensee must stop operating unless the Tribunal grants a stay under section 69(2)
No — the licence lapsed on its expiry date, and section 31(11) provides that only a renewal actually granted by the Tribunal can revive it
Yes, but only during the 21 days that section 59(1) allows for lodging the application; once that period ends the refusal takes effect whether or not a review is pending
en.explain: Section 31(10)(b) provides that a licence whose renewal has been applied for, and which expires before the application is determined, remains in force — if renewal is refused — until the Commissioner's decision to refuse takes effect. A refusal to renew is a specified decision, and section 75(1)(c) provides that where the person applies for a review within the 21 days allowed by section 59(1), the decision takes effect only when the Tribunal confirms, varies or substitutes it, or the application is withdrawn. Section 69(1) does say an application is not itself a stay of execution, but that is beside the point: the refusal has not yet taken effect, so there is nothing to stay.

tc.q: 某持牌人在牌照有效期屆滿前申請續期。關長拒絕續期，而該持牌人在准許的21日內向覆核審裁處申請覆核；拒絕通知並無指明該決定於其他時間生效。在覆核有待裁定期間，該持牌人可否繼續經營？
options: 可以——第31(10)(b)條下牌照在拒絕決定生效前仍然有效；第75(1)(c)條訂明須待審裁處裁定覆核或申請被撤回，該決定才生效
不可以——根據第69(1)條，覆核申請本身並不具有暫緩執行該拒絕決定的效力，故除非審裁處根據第69(2)條批准暫緩執行，否則該持牌人須停止經營
不可以——該牌照已於有效期屆滿當日失效，而根據第31(11)條，須經審裁處批出續期方可恢復有效
可以，但只限於第59(1)條准許提出申請的21日內；該期限屆滿後，不論覆核是否有待裁定，該拒絕決定即告生效
tc.explain: 第31(10)(b)條訂明，如已就某牌照提出續期申請，而該牌照在關長作出決定前屆滿，則（如續期申請遭拒絕）在關長拒絕續期的決定生效前，該牌照仍然有效。拒絕續期屬指明決定；第75(1)(c)條訂明，如該人在第59(1)條指明的21日內提出覆核申請，該決定只在審裁處確認、更改或取代該決定，或該申請被撤回時才生效。第69(1)條固然訂明覆核申請本身不具暫緩執行的效力，但此點在此並不相干：該拒絕決定尚未生效，無可暫緩。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(9)條；第10(11)條

en.q: The section 5(9) defence is available to which persons charged under section 5(7)?
options: An employee of a financial institution, or a person employed to work for one
Any person concerned in the management of the institution, including its directors
The financial institution itself, rather than any individual connected with it
Any person at all, provided that they did not personally benefit from the breach
en.explain: Section 5(9) makes the defence available, in proceedings under section 5(7), only to a person who is an employee of a financial institution or is employed to work for one. It does not extend on its terms to a person merely concerned in the institution's management, to the institution itself, or to anyone at all regardless of personal benefit.

tc.q: 第5(9)條的免責辯護可供根據第5(7)條被控的哪些人援引？
options: 金融機構的僱員，或受僱為金融機構工作的人
參與該機構管理的任何人，包括其董事
該金融機構本身，而非與其有關連的任何個人
任何人士，只要其並無從該項違反中取得個人利益
tc.explain: 第5(9)條訂明，該免責辯護只可在根據第5(7)條提起的法律程序中，供屬金融機構僱員或受僱為金融機構工作的人援引。按其字面，並不延伸至僅參與該機構管理的人、該機構本身，或不論是否取得個人利益的任何人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第20(1)條

en.q: What mental element must be proved for the section 20 offence of destroying, falsifying or concealing a record?
options: Intent to conceal facts the record could disclose from the authorized person or investigator
Recklessness as to whether the record would later be required for an investigation
An intent to defraud the relevant authority or the Commissioner of Customs, as under section 13(5)
No mental element at all — this is a strict-liability offence under section 20
en.explain: Section 20(1) requires intent to conceal, from the authorized person or the investigator, facts or matters capable of being disclosed by the record or document — this applies to destroying, falsifying, concealing or otherwise disposing of it, or to causing or permitting any of those things. Recklessness is not enough; intent to defraud is instead the standard for a different set of offences (e.g. sections 10(5)/(6) and 13(5)/(6)); and section 20 is not a strict-liability offence.

tc.q: 第20條就銷毀、偽造或隱藏紀錄的罪行，須證明甚麼犯罪心理元素？
options: 意圖向獲授權人或調查員隱瞞該紀錄可能披露的事實
罔顧該紀錄日後是否會為調查所需，並非蓄意隱瞞
意圖欺騙有關當局或海關關長，猶如第13(5)條規定一樣
並無任何心理元素——第20條屬絕對法律責任罪行
tc.explain: 第20(1)條規定須具有向獲授權人或調查員隱瞞該紀錄或文件可能披露的事實或事宜的意圖——適用於銷毀、偽造、隱藏或以其他方式處置該紀錄，或導致或准許上述任何行為。單憑罔顧並不足夠；意圖欺騙是另一組罪行（例如第10(5)/(6)及13(5)/(6)條）的標準；第20條並非絕對法律責任的罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第18(1)條

en.q: Information required under Part 3 is stored otherwise than in readable form, but can be converted into a readable form. What may be required?
options: A reproduction of the recording, or the relevant part, in a legible form
The original physical storage medium itself, not a reproduction
A sworn statement confirming that the information cannot be produced
Nothing more, unless the original information was already in writing
en.explain: Section 18(1) provides that where information required under Part 3 is recorded otherwise than in a legible form but is capable of being reproduced legibly, any person empowered to require production of the record is also empowered to require production of a reproduction of the recording, or the relevant part, in a legible form — not the storage medium itself, a sworn statement of impossibility, or nothing at all.

tc.q: 根據第3部須提供的資料以非可直接閱讀的形式儲存，但可轉換為可閱讀的形式。可要求提供甚麼？
options: 該項記錄或其有關部分的複製本，以可閱形式提供
原有的儲存媒體本身，而非該項記錄的複製本
確認該資料完全無法提供的一份宣誓陳述
不可另有要求，除非原有資料已屬書面形式
tc.explain: 第18(1)條訂明，凡根據第3部須提供的資料以非可閱形式記錄，但可以可閱形式複製，任何根據第3部有權要求交出該紀錄的人，亦有權要求以可閱形式交出該資料的記錄或其有關部分的複製本——而非儲存媒體本身、無法提供的宣誓陳述，或完全不予提供。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第19(2)條

en.q: When permitting inspection of a record it has taken possession of, what may an authorized person or investigator impose?
options: Any reasonable condition as to security or otherwise that the person thinks fit
A fee calculated by reference to the licence-application fees specified in Schedule 3
A requirement that inspection take place only at a sitting of the Review Tribunal
A blanket ban on copying, though section 19(1) requires copies to be permitted at reasonable times
en.explain: Section 19(2) provides that a person who gives a permission under section 19(1) may impose any reasonable condition as to security or otherwise that the person thinks fit. Section 19(1) itself requires inspection and copying to be permitted at all reasonable times, so a blanket ban on copying, a Schedule 3 licence fee, and a Tribunal-only inspection venue are all outside that power.

tc.q: 獲授權人或調查員准許查閱其所管有的紀錄時，可施加甚麼？
options: 該人認為合適的任何合理保安或其他條件
按附表3所訂的牌照申請費用計算的費用
規定查閱只可在審裁處席前進行，不得在其他地方進行
全面禁止複製，惟第19(1)條規定須准許複製
tc.explain: 第19(2)條訂明，根據第19(1)條給予准許的人，可施加其認為合適的任何合理的保安或其他條件。第19(1)條本身規定須在合理時間內准許查閱及複製，故全面禁止複製、附表3的牌照申請費用，以及只限審裁處席前查閱，均超出該項權力範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(a)(i)條

en.q: Where the licensee is an individual, on what basis relating to the licensee personally may the Commissioner revoke or suspend the licence?
options: That the individual is no longer a fit and proper person to operate a money service
That the individual's ultimate owner is no longer fit and proper to be associated with the business
That an occupant of the licensee's domestic premises has revoked consent for entry under section 9
That the individual has changed their residential address since the licence was granted
en.explain: Section 34(1)(a)(i)(A) makes the powers available where the Commissioner is of the opinion that an individual licensee is no longer a fit and proper person to operate a money service. Sub-paragraph (B) is a different ground concerning the individual's ultimate owner, not the individual personally, and section 34(1)(b) is a separate trigger about domestic-premises consent, not personal fitness at all.

tc.q: 如持牌人是個人，海關關長可基於與該持牌人本人有關的甚麼理由撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照？
options: 該個人不再是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選
該個人的最終擁有人不再是適當人選
住宅處所佔用人已撤回第9條的進入同意
該個人自獲發牌以來已更改住址及聯絡方法
tc.explain: 第34(1)(a)(i)(A)條訂明，凡海關關長認為個人持牌人不再是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選，即可行使該等權力。(B)節是另一項理由，關乎該個人的最終擁有人而非該個人本身；第34(1)(b)條則是另一項獨立的觸發條件，關乎住宅處所的同意事宜，與個人是否適當人選完全無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43(2)(b)條

en.q: What form does a remedial order under section 43(2)(b) take?
options: An order requiring the licensee to take, by a specified date, action remedying the contravention
A public reprimand of the licensee, made by the Commissioner for the same contravention
An order that the licensee pay a pecuniary penalty not exceeding $1,000,000
A daily penalty not exceeding $10,000 for every day that the contravention continues
en.explain: Section 43(2)(b) empowers the Commissioner to order the licensee to take, by a specified date, any action specified for the purpose of remedying the contravention. It is one of three separate specified powers in section 43(2): paragraph (a) is a public reprimand and paragraph (c) is a pecuniary penalty up to $1,000,000, while the daily penalty of up to $10,000 in section 43(4) applies only to non-compliance with a remedial order, not to the order itself.

tc.q: 第43(2)(b)條下的糾正命令採取甚麼形式？
options: 命令持牌人於關長指明的日期前，採取糾正該項違反的行動
就同一項違反，由關長對持牌人作出公開譴責
命令持牌人就該項違反繳付不超過1,000,000元的罰款
該項違反持續的每一天，可處以不超過10,000元的罰款
tc.explain: 第43(2)(b)條授權海關關長命令持牌人於指明日期前，採取為糾正該項違反而指明的任何行動。這是第43(2)條下三項獨立的指明權力之一：(a)節為公開譴責，(c)節為不超過1,000,000元的罰款；而第43(4)條下最高每日10,000元的罰款，只適用於不遵從糾正命令的情況，並非該命令本身。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第48(5)條

en.q: What may an authorized officer do if a person forcibly resists or attempts to evade arrest under section 48?
options: Use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest or detention
Produce evidence of appointment as an authorized officer, if the person so requests
Search the person, but only using an authorized officer of the same sex
Use force only if a police officer is present to assist in the arrest
en.explain: Section 48(5) provides that if a person forcibly resists or attempts to evade arrest or detention under that section, the authorized officer may use any force that is reasonably necessary to effect the arrest or detention — with no precondition that a police officer be present. Producing evidence of appointment is a separate duty under section 48(2), and the same-sex requirement in section 48(7) governs searches, not the use of force to complete an arrest.

tc.q: 如某人強行抗拒或企圖逃避根據第48條的拘捕，獲授權人員可怎樣做？
options: 使用合理需要的武力以進行該項拘捕或扣留
如該人要求，出示其獲委任為獲授權人員的證明
搜查該人，但只可由同性別的獲授權人員進行
只在有警務人員在場協助拘捕時，方可使用武力
tc.explain: 第48(5)條訂明，如某人強行抗拒或企圖逃避該條下的拘捕或扣留，獲授權人員可使用合理需要的武力以進行該項拘捕或扣留——並無須有警務人員在場的先決條件。出示委任證明屬第48(2)條下的另一項獨立責任，而第48(7)條的同性別規定規管的是搜查，並非以武力完成拘捕。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第47(2)(e)及(f)條

en.q: Records found on premises entered under a section 47 warrant are held in an information system. Whom may the authorized officer require to produce a legible reproduction?
options: A person who appears to be in charge of the premises, or who appears able to produce a reproduction
Only the person who appears to be in charge of the premises, not anyone else able to produce a reproduction
Only a person who appears able to produce a reproduction, even if no one appears to be in charge of the premises
Detain the person until the premises have been fully searched, rather than requiring any reproduction
en.explain: Section 47(2)(f) allows the officer to require a person who appears to be in charge of the premises, or who appears to be or to be likely to be able to produce a reproduction, to produce it in a form enabling the information to be reproduced in a legible form — either limb is enough on its own, so neither person alone is the exclusive answer. Section 47(2)(d) is the separate power to detain a person able to give relevant information until the premises have been searched.

tc.q: 在根據第47條手令進入的處所內發現的紀錄存放於資訊系統。獲授權人員可要求何人交出可閱形式的複製本？
options: 看來是掌管該處所的人，或看來能製作該項記錄複製本的人
只限看來是掌管該處所的人，不包括其他看來能製作複製本的人
只限看來能製作複製本的人，即使沒有人看來是掌管該處所
扣留該人直至處所搜查完畢，而非要求交出任何複製本
tc.explain: 第47(2)(f)條准許人員要求看來是掌管該處所的人，或看來能或相當可能能製作複製本的人，以能使該資料以可閱形式複製的形式交出該複製本——兩個條件其中之一已足夠，並非只限其中一種人。第47(2)(d)條則是另一項獨立權力，即扣留看來能提供相關資料的人直至處所搜查完畢。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(1)條

en.q: What is the basic effect of section 5(1) of the AMLO?
options: Schedule 2 has effect for financial institutions, subject to subsections (2) to (4)
Schedule 2 has effect for every person who carries on business in Hong Kong
Schedule 1, not Schedule 2, has effect with respect to financial institutions
Schedule 3, not Schedule 2, has effect with respect to financial institutions
en.explain: Section 5(1) provides that, subject to subsections (2), (3) and (4), Schedule 2 has effect with respect to financial institutions. It is Schedule 2 — not Schedule 1 or Schedule 3 — that carries the customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements, and section 5(1) applies only to financial institutions, not to every business in Hong Kong; section 5A separately extends Schedule 2 to DNFBPs.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(1)條的基本效力為何？
options: 附表2就金融機構有效力，受(2)至(4)款所限
附表2就在香港經營任何業務的每一個人具有效力
就金融機構而言，具有效力的是附表1，並非附表2
就金融機構而言，具有效力的是附表3，並非附表2
tc.explain: 第5(1)條訂明，在第(2)、(3)及(4)款的規限下，附表2就金融機構具有效力。訂有客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄規定的是附表2，並非附表1或附表3；而第5(1)條只適用於金融機構，並非香港的每一項業務；第5A條則另行將附表2的適用範圍擴展至指定非金融企業及行業。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第1(1)條

en.q: What is the full short title of Cap. 615, as amended in 2018?
options: The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance
The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (Financial Institutions) Ordinance
The Money Service Operators Licensing Ordinance
The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Ordinance
en.explain: Section 1(1) provides that the Ordinance may be cited as the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, the words “(Financial Institutions)” having been removed by amendment in 2018 when the regime was extended to DNFBPs.

tc.q: 第615章經2018年修訂後的完整簡稱為何？
options: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》
《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集（金融機構）條例》
《金錢服務經營者發牌條例》
《打擊洗錢及打擊恐怖主義融資條例》
tc.explain: 第1(1)條訂明本條例可引稱為《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》；「（金融機構）」等字已於2018年制度擴展至指定非金融企業及行業時經修訂刪去。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(12)及(13)條

en.q: How is an authorized person for the purposes of section 9 appointed, and what must follow?
options: A relevant authority authorizes the person in writing, and must provide a copy of the authorization
A relevant authority authorizes the person in writing, but need not provide a copy
A magistrate issues the person a warrant of appointment, valid for one year from issue
The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury appoints the person by Gazette notice
en.explain: Section 9(12) allows a relevant authority to authorize in writing any person, or any person belonging to a class of persons, as an authorized person for the purposes of section 9. Section 9(13) then requires the authority to provide that person with a copy of the authorization - this is mandatory, not optional - and section 9(14) requires its production when powers are exercised. There is no magistrate's warrant of appointment and no Secretary-by-Gazette procedure for section 9 authorized persons.

tc.q: 就第9條而言，獲授權人如何獲委任？其後須怎樣做？
options: 由有關當局以書面授權該人，並須向其提供授權書文本
由有關當局以書面授權該人，惟毋須向其提供授權書
由裁判官向該人發出委任手令，有效期一年
由財經事務及庫務局局長以憲報公告委任該人
tc.explain: 第9(12)條准許有關當局以書面授權任何人或屬某類別的任何人，作為第9條所指的獲授權人。第9(13)條規定當局須向該獲授權人提供授權書文本——此為強制責任，並非可有可無；第9(14)條並規定行使權力時須出示該文本。第9條下的獲授權人並非由裁判官發出委任手令，亦非由財經事務及庫務局局長以憲報公告委任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(c)條

en.q: A person applies for a review within 21 days and the Tribunal confirms the decision. When does the specified decision take effect?
options: At the time the decision is so confirmed
At the expiry of the original 21-day period
On the date the application for review was lodged
Only after any appeal to the Court of Appeal is determined
en.explain: Section 75(1)(c)(i) provides that where a review is applied for within the 21-day period and the decision is confirmed by the Tribunal, the decision takes effect at the time it is so confirmed. Sub-paragraphs (ii) and (iii) deal with variation or substitution and with withdrawal of the application.

tc.q: 某人於21日內申請覆核，而審裁處確認該決定。該指明決定何時生效？
options: 於該決定獲如此確認時
於原本的21日期間屆滿時
於覆核申請提交之日
須待任何向上訴法庭的上訴有裁定後
tc.explain: 第75(1)(c)(i)條訂明，凡在21日期間內申請覆核而該決定獲審裁處確認，該決定於獲如此確認時生效。(ii)及(iii)節則分別處理更改或取代，以及撤回申請的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第75(1)(c)(iii)條

en.q: A person applies for a review and then withdraws the application. When does the specified decision take effect?
options: At the time the application is withdrawn
At the expiry of the original 21-day period
Retrospectively, from the date the decision was made
Only if the specified authority issues a fresh notice
en.explain: Section 75(1)(c)(iii) provides that where the person applies for a review within the 21-day period and the application is withdrawn, the decision takes effect at the time the application is withdrawn.

tc.q: 某人申請覆核後撤回申請。該指明決定何時生效？
options: 於該申請被撤回時
於原本的21日期間屆滿時
追溯至該決定作出之日
須待指明當局重新發出通知
tc.explain: 第75(1)(c)(iii)條訂明，凡該人在21日期間內申請覆核而該申請被撤回，該決定於該申請被撤回時生效。

en.q: What must accompany an application for the Commissioner's approval of a proposed director, ultimate owner or partner?
options: The Schedule 3 fee, with the application made in the form and manner the Commissioner specifies
The Schedule 3 fee, lodged with the Commissioner at least 45 days before the appointment is to take effect
A sworn declaration by the proposed appointee describing their personal financial position
A police certificate confirming the proposed appointee has no criminal conviction
en.explain: Sections 35(2), 36(2) and 37(2) each require the application to be made in the form and manner the Commissioner specifies and to be accompanied by the Schedule 3 fee. There is no 45-day pre-lodgement deadline for these approvals - that 45-day rule instead applies to a licence renewal application under section 31 - and no sworn declaration or police certificate is required.

tc.q: 就擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人向海關關長申請批准時，須連同甚麼一併提交？
options: 附表3訂明的費用，並須按關長指明的格式及方式提出申請
附表3訂明的費用，並須於委任生效前45日提出申請
擬任者就其本人財政狀況所作的宣誓聲明書
確認擬任者並無任何刑事定罪紀錄的警方證明書
tc.explain: 第35(2)、36(2)及37(2)條均規定申請須按關長指明的格式及方式提出，並須連同附表3訂明的費用一併提交。這類批核申請並無45日的提前遞交期限——該45日規定屬第31條牌照續期申請的規定——亦無須提交宣誓聲明或警方證明書。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35(5)及(6)條

en.q: If the Commissioner refuses approval of a proposed director, whom must the Commissioner inform, and what must the notice contain?
options: The licensee, by notice in writing stating the reasons and that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal
The licensee, by notice stating the reasons and the date by which the licence must be surrendered to the Commissioner
The proposed director personally, by a notice in writing stating only the outcome of the application
Both the licensee and the Companies Registry, by a notice in writing published in the Gazette
en.explain: Section 35(5) requires the Commissioner to inform the licensee by notice in writing, and section 35(6) requires that notice to state the reasons for the decision and that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review; sections 36 and 37 mirror this for ultimate owners and partners. A surrender date instead belongs to a revocation notice under section 34(5) - refusing a proposed director does not involve surrendering the licence, and the proposed director and the Companies Registry are not the addressees.

tc.q: 如海關關長拒絕批准擬任董事，須通知何人？通知須載有甚麼？
options: 以書面通知持牌人，並須載有理由及可向覆核審裁處申請覆核的陳述
以書面通知持牌人，並須載有理由及須將牌照交回關長的指明日期及方式
以只述明結果的簡短書面通知，親自通知該名擬任董事本人
以刊登於憲報公告的書面通知，一併通知持牌人及公司註冊處
tc.explain: 第35(5)條規定關長須以書面通知持牌人；第35(6)條規定該通知須載有決定理由，以及持牌人可向覆核審裁處申請覆核的陳述；第36及37條就最終擁有人及合夥人訂有相同規定。須交回牌照的日期屬第34(5)條撤銷牌照通知的內容——拒批擬任董事並不涉及交回牌照，通知對象亦非該名擬任董事本人或公司註冊處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第61(1)(i)條

en.q: On what basis may the Tribunal stay proceedings in a review?
options: On any grounds and terms it considers appropriate, having regard to the interests of justice
Only where a party has applied under section 69 for a stay of execution of the decision under review
Only where both parties to the review give their written consent to a stay
The Tribunal has no power to stay its own proceedings once a review has begun
en.explain: Section 61(1)(i) allows the Tribunal to stay any of the proceedings in the review on any grounds and on any terms and conditions it considers appropriate, having regard to the interests of justice - a broad discretion exercisable on its own initiative, not one that requires a party's application. That contrasts with a stay of execution of a decision under section 69, which does require an application; the Tribunal's power is not conditioned on both parties' consent, and is not lost once a review begins.

tc.q: 審裁處可基於甚麼理由擱置覆核中的法律程序？
options: 顧及司法公正，基於其認為適當的任何理由及任何條款和條件
只限一方已根據第69條就覆核中的決定提出書面申請以暫緩執行
只限覆核雙方以書面明確同意方可擱置法律程序
覆核一經展開，覆核審裁處即無權擱置其本身的法律程序
tc.explain: 第61(1)(i)條准許覆核審裁處顧及司法公正的利益，基於其認為適當的任何理由及任何條款和條件，擱置覆核中的任何法律程序——這是廣泛的酌情權，覆核審裁處可主動行使，並非須待一方申請方可行使。相對而言，第69條下暫緩執行決定則須由一方提出申請；擱置權亦不取決於雙方同意，也不會因覆核已經展開而喪失。

en.q: What distinguishes the offences in sections 10(5) and 10(6) from those in sections 10(1) and 10(3)?
options: Sections 10(5) and (6) require intent to defraud and carry a 7-year maximum; sections 10(1) and (3) do not
Sections 10(5) and (6) carry a $1,000,000 fine but only a 2-year maximum, not section 10(9)'s 7 years
Sections 10(5) and (6) apply only to corporate licensees, not to individuals or partners
Sections 10(1) and (3) require intent to defraud, while sections 10(5) and (6) do not
en.explain: Section 10(1) covers failure to comply without reasonable excuse, and section 10(3) covers knowingly or recklessly producing false material - neither requires intent to defraud. Sections 10(5) and (6) cover the same conduct but committed with intent to defraud, and section 10(9) sets the maximum for offences under subsections (5)-(8) at $1,000,000 and 7 years on indictment, not 2 years; there is no restriction to corporate licensees.

tc.q: 第10(5)及10(6)條的罪行與第10(1)及10(3)條的罪行有何分別？
options: 第10(5)及(6)條須具有欺騙意圖，最高刑期為7年；第10(1)及(3)條則不須具備該意圖
第10(5)及(6)條可處罰款1,000,000元，最高刑期2年，並非第10(9)條的7年
第10(5)及(6)條只適用於法團持牌人，並不適用於個人或合夥人本人
第10(1)及(3)條須具有欺騙意圖，而第10(5)及(6)條則完全不須
tc.explain: 第10(1)條涵蓋無合理辯解而不遵從規定，第10(3)條涵蓋在知情或罔顧下提供虛假材料——兩者均不須具備欺騙意圖。第10(5)及(6)條涵蓋相同行為，惟具有欺騙意圖；第10(9)條就第(5)至(8)款的罪行訂明循公訴程序定罪最高可處罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年，並非2年；亦無只適用於法團持牌人的限制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第10(7)及(8)條

en.q: Sections 10(7) and 10(8) create offences for a related person. What conduct do they target?
options: With intent to defraud, causing or allowing an obligated person to fail to comply with a section 9 requirement
Personally and knowingly producing a false or misleading record in purported compliance with their own section 9 requirement
Failing personally to answer a question put by an authorized person during an inspection
Attending an inspection of the obligated person's premises without the authorized person's permission
en.explain: Sections 10(7) and (8) apply where a related person - an employee of, employed to work for, or concerned in the management of the obligated person under section 10(11) - with intent to defraud causes or allows the obligated person to fail to comply with a requirement, or to produce a false or misleading record or answer. Personally producing a false record about one's own requirement is instead the section 10(3) offence, which needs no intent to defraud and no related-person relationship.

tc.q: 第10(7)及10(8)條就相關人士訂立罪行。所針對的是甚麼行為？
options: 意圖欺騙而導致或容許義務人不遵從第9條的規定
本人知情下就自己的第9條規定，作出虛假或具誤導性紀錄
本人沒有回答獲授權人在視察期間提出的任何問題
未經獲授權人許可，擅自出席義務人處所的視察
tc.explain: 第10(7)及(8)條適用於相關人士（即第10(11)條所指屬義務人的僱員、受僱為其工作或參與其管理的人）意圖欺騙而導致或容許該義務人不遵從規定，或提供虛假或具誤導性的紀錄或答覆。本人就自己的規定作出虛假紀錄，屬第10(3)條的罪行，不須具備欺騙意圖，亦不涉及相關人士的關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第13(7)及(8)條

en.q: Do the “related person” offences also apply to requirements imposed by an investigator under section 12?
options: Yes - sections 13(7) and (8) mirror sections 10(7) and (8) for requirements imposed under section 12
No - related-person liability applies only to section 9 requirements, not section 12
Yes, but only where the related person is a director of the obligated corporation
No - a requirement imposed under section 12 binds only the covered person named in it
en.explain: Sections 13(7) and (8) create the equivalent related-person offences for requirements imposed under section 12, and section 13(9) applies the same $1,000,000 fine and 7-year maximum on indictment as section 10(9) does for section 9. Related-person liability is not confined to section 9, is not limited to directors, and a section 12 requirement is not enforceable only against the named covered person.

tc.q: 「相關人士」罪行是否亦適用於調查員根據第12條施加的規定？
options: 不適用——相關人士的法律責任只適用於第9條的規定，並不及於第12條
適用，但只限該相關人士屬義務法團的董事的情況，其餘僱員不受規管
不適用——第12條施加的規定只約束當中列名的受涵蓋的人本人
tc.explain: 第13(7)及(8)條就第12條下施加的規定訂立相對應的相關人士罪行；第13(9)條並適用與第10(9)條就第9條所訂相同的循公訴程序最高罰款1,000,000元及監禁7年。相關人士的法律責任並不限於第9條的規定，也不限於董事身分；第12條的規定亦非只約束其中列名的受涵蓋的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)(a)(ii)條

en.q: Where the applicant for a licence is a partnership, whose fitness and propriety must the Commissioner be satisfied of?
options: Each partner in the partnership, and the ultimate owner if the partnership has one
Each director of the partnership, and any ultimate owner, as required for a corporate applicant
Only the managing partner and the partnership's ultimate owner, not the other partners
The partnership as a single entity, rather than its individual partners
en.explain: Section 30(3)(a)(ii) requires the Commissioner to be satisfied that each partner in the partnership is a fit and proper person, and that any ultimate owner of the partnership is fit and proper to be associated with the business. 'Each director' is instead the test for a corporate applicant under section 30(3)(a)(iii) - a partnership has partners, not directors - and the test is not confined to the managing partner or to the partnership as an abstract entity.

tc.q: 如牌照申請人是合夥，海關關長須信納何人的適當人選資格？
options: 該合夥的每名合夥人，以及最終擁有人（如有）
該合夥的每名董事，以及最終擁有人——法團申請人的規定
只限管理合夥人及該合夥的最終擁有人，不包括其他合夥人
該合夥須作為單一實體看待，而非個別合夥人
tc.explain: 第30(3)(a)(ii)條規定關長須信納該合夥的每名合夥人是適合經營金錢服務的適當人選，而該合夥的任何最終擁有人是適合與該業務有聯繫的適當人選。「每名董事」是第30(3)(a)(iii)條就法團申請人所訂的規定——合夥只有合夥人，並無董事；規定亦不只限於管理合夥人，或視合夥為抽象實體。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(b)(i)條

en.q: An occupant of domestic premises who had consented to entry by an authorized person later revokes that consent. What may follow?
options: The Commissioner may revoke or suspend the licence under the section 34(2) powers
The consent, once given, is irrevocable for the remaining life of the licence
The occupant who revoked consent commits an offence under section 47(4)
The Commissioner must instead apply to a magistrate under section 17 for a warrant to enter
en.explain: Section 34(1)(b)(i) makes the section 34(2) revocation and suspension powers available where an occupant of domestic premises revokes written consent previously given for a section 8 authorized person to enter for section 9 purposes. Consent is not irrevocable, revoking it is not itself an offence under section 47(4) (a fabricated reference - section 47 concerns warrants to remove evidence of an offence), and the Commissioner does not need a section 17 warrant to exercise the section 34(2) powers.

tc.q: 曾同意獲授權人進入的住宅處所佔用人其後撤回該同意。可能有甚麼後果？
options: 關長可根據第34(2)條的權力撤銷或暫時吊銷該牌照
該同意一經給予，在牌照有效期內即不可撤回
該佔用人因撤回同意而觸犯第47(4)條所訂罪行
關長須改為根據第17條向裁判官申請手令進入該處所
tc.explain: 第34(1)(b)(i)條訂明，凡住宅處所的佔用人撤回其先前給予、讓第8條所界定的獲授權人為行使第9條權力而進入處所的書面同意，關長即可行使第34(2)條的撤銷及暫時吊銷權力。同意並非不可撤回；撤回同意本身並不構成第47(4)條的罪行（該引述純屬虛構——第47條規管的是移走罪行證據的手令）；關長行使第34(2)條的權力，亦毋須先根據第17條向裁判官申請手令。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39A(1)條

en.q: Which licensees are subject to the duty to display the original of the licence, and where must it be displayed?
options: Licensees operating at premises specified in the licence, displayed conspicuously at those premises
All licensees, including those with no specified premises at all, displayed at their correspondence address
All licensees, displayed at the office of the Commissioner of Customs and Excise
Only licensees operating at more than one premises, displayed at their principal place of business
en.explain: Section 39A(1) applies only to a licensee licensed to operate at premises specified in the licence, and requires the original licence to be displayed in a conspicuous place at those specified premises. A licensee with no specified premises is not caught by the duty at all, so it cannot apply to 'all licensees'; there is no display duty at the Commissioner's office, and the duty is not confined to licensees with more than one premises.

tc.q: 哪些持牌人須履行展示牌照正本的責任？須展示於何處？
options: 獲發牌在指明處所經營的持牌人，須展示於該處所的顯眼位置
所有持牌人，包括並無指明處所者，須展示於其通訊地址
所有持牌人，一律須展示於關長的辦事處當眼位置
只限在多於一個處所經營的持牌人，須展示於其主要營業處所
tc.explain: 第39A(1)條只適用於獲發牌在牌照指明處所經營金錢服務的持牌人，並規定須在該等指明處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本。並無指明處所的持牌人根本不受該項責任約束，故不可能適用於「所有持牌人」；條文並無須於關長辦事處展示的規定，責任亦不限於在多於一個處所經營的持牌人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(2)(b)條

en.q: When a licence is returned on cessation of business, what must the Commissioner do to the register?
options: Remove the relevant particulars from the register
Mark the entry as dormant but retain it indefinitely
Transfer the entry to a separate register of former licensees
Leave the register unchanged until the licence would have expired
en.explain: Section 41(2) requires the Commissioner, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving the returned licence, to cancel or amend the licence and to remove the relevant particulars from the register. Sections 38(7) and 39(7) deal with additions and amendments to the register when premises are added.

tc.q: 因停止營業而交回牌照時，海關關長須對登記冊作出甚麼處理？
options: 從登記冊剔除有關詳情
將該記項標示為不活躍但無限期保留
將該記項轉移至前持牌人的另一登記冊
在牌照本應屆滿前保持登記冊不變
tc.explain: 第41(2)條規定海關關長須在接獲交回的牌照後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快註銷或修訂該牌照，並從登記冊剔除有關詳情。第38(7)及39(7)條則處理新增處所時登記冊的加入及修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第14(1)及(2)(b)條

en.q: Under section 14 of the AMLO, if a person fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9 or 12, who may apply to the Court of First Instance, and what may the Court do if satisfied the failure was without reasonable excuse?
options: The authorized person or investigator applies by originating summons; the Court may punish the person as for contempt of court
The Commissioner alone applies by originating motion; the Court may instead impose a fine at level 6
Any person may apply directly to a magistrate, who may then issue a warrant for the person's arrest
The investigator alone may apply under s.34 to the District Court, which may suspend the person's business licence for up to 6 months
en.explain: Section 14(1) allows the authorized person or investigator (not the Commissioner alone, any person, or the investigator alone) to apply by originating summons (not motion) to the Court of First Instance (not a magistrate or the District Court). Under section 14(2)(b), if satisfied the failure was without reasonable excuse, the Court may punish the person as if for contempt of court — not a fine, an arrest warrant, or licence suspension, which are mechanisms found elsewhere in the Ordinance.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》第14條，如有人沒有遵從根據第9或12條施加的要求，何人可向原訟法庭提出申請？如信納該項不遵從並無合理辯解，原訟法庭可作出甚麼？
options: 獲授權人或調查員可藉原訟傳票申請；法庭可如犯藐視法庭罪般懲罰該人
只有關長可藉原訟動議提出申請；法庭可改為判處第6級罰款
任何人均可直接向裁判官提出申請，裁判官可其後發出拘捕令
只有調查員可向區域法院提出申請，該法院可暫時吊銷該人的牌照，為期6個月
tc.explain: 第14(1)條規定，獲授權人或調查員（並非只有關長、任何人或只有調查員）可藉原訟傳票（並非動議）向原訟法庭（並非裁判官或區域法院）提出申請。根據第14(2)(b)條，如信納該項不遵從並無合理辯解，法庭可懲罰該人，猶如其犯藐視法庭罪一樣——並非罰款、拘捕令或吊銷牌照，那些屬條例其他條文的機制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第15(1)條

en.q: Before requiring an answer or explanation under section 12(2) or (3), what must an investigator ensure?
options: That the person has been informed or reminded of the section 15(2) limits on admissibility of the answer
That the person has personally claimed the section 15(2) protection before being required to answer
That the protection applies even where the person is later charged under section 13 or Part V of the Crimes Ordinance
That the person has been cautioned in the same terms as a formal police caution
en.explain: Section 15(1) requires the investigator to ensure the person has first been informed or reminded of the section 15(2) limits on admissibility of the requirement, question and answer. Section 15(2)'s protection itself operates only once the person claims it before answering — a duty on the person, not something the investigator must ensure in advance. Section 15(3) disapplies the protection for charges under section 13(1), (3), (5), (6), (7) or (8), or Part V of the Crimes Ordinance. No police-style caution is required by the Ordinance.
