tc.q: 調查員根據第12(2)或(3)條要求作出答覆或解釋前，須確保甚麼？
options: 該人已獲告知或獲提醒第15(2)條就答覆的可接納性所施加的限制
該人在被正式要求作答前，已親自主張第15(2)條的保障
即使其後被控以第13條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部罪行，保障仍適用
該人已按與正式警誡辭相同的措辭，獲得警誡
tc.explain: 第15(1)條規定調查員須確保該人已事先獲告知或獲提醒第15(2)條就該規定、問題及答覆的可接納性所施加的限制。第15(2)條的保障須待該人在作答前主張方適用——這是該人的責任，並非調查員須預先確保的事。第15(3)條訂明，如該人其後被控以第13(1)、(3)、(5)、(6)、(7)或(8)條或《刑事罪行條例》第V部所訂罪行，則該保障不適用。條例並無規定須按正式警誡辭作出警誡。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9(7)條

en.q: When may an authorized person require an information holder, rather than the inspection subject, to produce a specified business record?
options: Only if they reasonably believe the record cannot be obtained from the inspection subject
At any time, provided the information holder is given 7 days' written notice of the request
Only where the inspection subject has refused in writing to co-operate with the inspection
Only with the prior approval of a magistrate, as for a warrant under section 17
en.explain: Section 9(7) allows the power to require an information holder to produce a record to be exercised only if the authorized person has reasonable cause to believe the specified business record or information cannot be obtained by exercising the power against the inspection subject first. There is no fixed notice period, no requirement that the inspection subject refuse in writing, and no magistrate's involvement — a magistrate's warrant is a separate mechanism under section 17.

tc.q: 獲授權人在甚麼情況下可要求資料持有人（而非視察對象）交出指明業務紀錄？
options: 只限獲授權人合理相信該紀錄無法從視察對象取得
任何時間均可，只要向資料持有人發出7日書面通知
只限視察對象已書面拒絕配合視察
只限事先取得裁判官批准，猶如根據第17條發出手令
tc.explain: 第9(7)條規定，只有在獲授權人有合理因由相信該指明業務紀錄或所尋求的資料，無法藉對視察對象行使權力而取得時，方可向資料持有人行使有關權力。條文並無訂明固定的通知期，亦不要求視察對象須以書面拒絕配合，更與裁判官無關——裁判官手令是第17條下的另一機制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第32(2)及(3)條

en.q: When the Commissioner amends a licence condition under section 32, what must the notice to the licensee include?
options: The reasons for the decision, and that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal
The time within which the licence must be surrendered to the Commissioner following revocation
The duration and terms of any suspension imposed on the licence under section 34
A copy of the pecuniary-penalty guidelines the Commissioner published under section 45
en.explain: Section 32(3) requires the notice to include a statement of the reasons for the decision and a statement that the licensee may apply to the Review Tribunal for a review. The surrender-time and suspension-duration items are instead required, under section 34(5), in the notice for a licence revocation or suspension decision — a different decision under a different section. A copy of the section 45 pecuniary-penalty guidelines is not part of either notice.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第32條修訂牌照條件時，致持牌人的通知須載有甚麼？
options: 決定理由，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核
撤銷牌照後須將牌照交回關長的期限
根據第34條對牌照施加暫時吊銷的期限及條款
關長根據第45條發布的罰款款額指引副本
tc.explain: 第32(3)條規定通知須載有決定理由的陳述，以及持牌人可向審裁處申請覆核該決定的陳述。交回牌照的期限及暫時吊銷的期限與條款，是第34(5)條就撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照這項不同決定所須載入通知的內容，屬另一條文。第45條的罰款款額指引副本並非上述任何一種通知的內容。

en.q: Failing to notify the Commissioner of a change in particulars within one month is an offence under section 40(1). Under section 53, within what period after the Commissioner discovers this offence must proceedings be instituted?
options: 12 months after the offence is discovered by or comes to the notice of the Commissioner
6 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner
12 months after the offence is committed, regardless of when it is discovered
24 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 53 provides that, despite section 26 of the Magistrates Ordinance, proceedings for a Part 5 offence other than an indictable offence — such as the section 40(1) notification offence, which section 40(4) punishes only on conviction — may be instituted within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner. The clock runs from discovery, not from when the offence was committed, and the period is 12 months, not 6 or 24.

tc.q: 沒有在一個月內以書面向關長具報詳情的改變，即屬第40(1)條所訂罪行。根據第53條，關長發現該罪行後，須在甚麼期間內提出法律程序？
options: 關長發現或知悉該罪行後12個月內
關長發現或知悉該罪行後6個月內
該罪行發生後12個月內，不論何時被發現
關長發現或知悉該罪行後24個月內
tc.explain: 第53條訂明，即使《裁判官條例》第26條有任何規定，就第5部所訂罪行（可公訴罪行除外）——例如第40(1)條的具報罪行，該罪行只按第40(4)條循定罪程序處罰——而提出的法律程序，可於關長發現或知悉有關罪行後12個月內提出。時限的起算點是發現之時，而非罪行發生之時，且期間為12個月，並非6個月或24個月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2及3部

en.q: What kinds of requirements does Schedule 2 to the AMLO impose on a financial institution such as an MSO?
options: Customer due diligence requirements and record-keeping requirements
Licence fees and the particulars to be entered in the register of licensees
The maximum pecuniary penalties a relevant authority may impose
The composition and procedure of the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Schedule 2 is the core operational schedule for AML/CFT compliance: Part 2 sets out the customer due diligence requirements and Part 3 the record-keeping requirements that apply to a financial institution such as an MSO. Licence fees and the register of licensees, the maximum pecuniary penalties a relevant authority may impose, and the Review Tribunal are all dealt with elsewhere in the Ordinance, not in Schedule 2.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2對金錢服務經營者等金融機構施加甚麼類型的規定？
options: 客戶盡職審查規定及備存紀錄規定
牌照費用及須載入持牌人登記冊的詳情
有關當局可施加的最高罰款款額
覆核審裁處的組成及程序
tc.explain: 附表2是打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集合規的核心運作附表：第2部訂立適用於金融機構（包括金錢服務經營者）的客戶盡職審查規定，第3部訂立備存紀錄規定。牌照費用及持牌人登記冊、有關當局可施加的最高罰款款額，以及覆核審裁處，均由條例其他部分訂明，並非附表2的內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條

en.q: Where in the AMLO are the statutory definitions of "money laundering" and "terrorist financing" found?
options: Section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1
Section 1 of Part 2 of Schedule 1
Part 5 of the main body of the Ordinance
Schedule 3, which lists the licensing fees
en.explain: The definitions of ML and TF (and of money service, money changing service and remittance service) are in Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1. Part 2 of Schedule 1 is a separate interpretation section covering different terms (such as Commissioner and business day). Part 5 of the main body regulates money service operation; Schedule 3 lists fees.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》中「洗錢」及「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義載於何處？
options: 附表1第1部第1條
附表1第2部第1條
條例正文第5部
附表3，即費用表
tc.explain: 「洗錢」及「恐怖分子資金籌集」的定義（以及金錢服務、貨幣兌換服務及匯款服務的定義）載於附表1第1部第1條。附表1第2部是另一條獨立的釋義條文，涵蓋不同的詞語（例如「關長」及「營業日」）。條例正文第5部規管金錢服務的經營；附表3則列明費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3（經修訂，2026年5月15日生效）

en.q: Schedule 3 to the AMLO sets out what?
options: The fees payable for MSO licence applications and related matters
Maximum pecuniary penalties for contraventions of specified provisions
The particulars required to be entered in the register of licensees
The composition and procedure of the AMLO's Review Tribunal
en.explain: Schedule 3 prescribes the fees for licensing matters — for example, applications for the grant or renewal of a licence, adding business premises, and director/ultimate owner/partner approvals. The maximum pecuniary penalties for contraventions of specified provisions, the particulars kept in the register of licensees, and the Review Tribunal's composition and procedure are all dealt with elsewhere in the Ordinance, not in Schedule 3.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3載列甚麼？
options: 金錢服務經營者牌照申請等事項的費用
違反指明的條文所招致的最高罰款款額
須根據規定載入持牌人登記冊的詳情
《打擊洗錢條例》下覆核審裁處的組成及程序
tc.explain: 附表3訂明發牌事項的費用——例如牌照批給或續期申請、增加營業處所，以及董事／最終擁有人／合夥人批准的申請。違反指明的條文的最高罰款款額、持牌人登記冊所載的詳情，以及覆核審裁處的組成及程序，均由條例其他部分訂明，並非附表3的內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條

en.q: Under the AMLO, “money service” means what?
options: A money changing service or a remittance service
Any service involving the handling of cash
Banking and deposit-taking services
Securities dealing and asset management services
en.explain: Schedule 1 defines money service as (a) a money changing service, or (b) a remittance service. Banking, securities and insurance activities are regulated separately under their own regimes.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「金錢服務」指甚麼？
options: 貨幣兌換服務或匯款服務
任何涉及處理現金的服務
銀行及接受存款服務
證券交易及資產管理服務
tc.explain: 附表1將金錢服務界定為(a)貨幣兌換服務；或(b)匯款服務。銀行、證券及保險業務由各自的制度另行規管。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of remittance service)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（匯款服務的定義）

en.q: Which statement about the statutory definition of a "remittance service" is CORRECT?
options: It covers sending money out of Hong Kong AND receiving money from outside Hong Kong, as a business
It only covers sending money to a place outside Hong Kong, not receiving money from abroad
It only covers arranging transfers between two Hong Kong bank accounts, not cross-border transfers
It covers electronic payments between Hong Kong bank accounts, even if no money crosses a border
en.explain: The Schedule 1 definition covers a service operated in Hong Kong as a business of sending, or arranging the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong; receiving, or arranging the receipt of, money from a place outside Hong Kong; and arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong. Both directions are covered; it is not limited to transfers between two Hong Kong accounts, and being electronic does not itself bring a purely domestic payment within the definition.

tc.q: 關於「匯款服務」的法定定義，下列哪項正確？
options: 涵蓋在香港經營的業務：將款項匯出香港，及自海外收取款項
只涵蓋將款項匯出香港，不包括收取來自海外的款項
只涵蓋在兩個香港銀行戶口之間安排轉帳，不包括跨境轉帳
涵蓋香港銀行戶口之間的電子支付，即使款項並無跨越邊界
tc.explain: 附表1的定義涵蓋在香港作為業務經營的下述服務：將款項傳送或安排傳送至香港以外地方；自香港以外地方收取或安排收取款項；以及安排在香港以外地方收取款項。匯出與匯入兩個方向均涵蓋在內，並不限於兩個香港戶口之間的轉帳，純屬電子形式亦不會使純本地支付納入該定義範圍。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of money changing service)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（貨幣兌換服務的定義）

en.q: A hotel operates a currency exchange counter inside the hotel primarily for the convenience of its guests, and the counter only buys non-Hong Kong currencies from guests in exchange for Hong Kong currency. Is this a “money changing service” under the AMLO?
options: No — the counter is within the hotel for guests' convenience, AND it only buys foreign currency for Hong Kong currency
No — a currency exchange counter run within a hotel for guests' convenience is excluded no matter what currencies it buys or sells
Yes — the exclusion applies only if the counter is run for the hotel by a person who already holds an MSO licence
Yes — the exclusion applies only if the counter serves registered guests exclusively and charges no commission
en.explain: Sch. 1 Pt 1 s.1 excludes a hotel-operated service only where BOTH (a) it is operated within the hotel primarily for guests' convenience AND (b) it consists solely of buying non-Hong Kong currencies for Hong Kong currency. Option 2 supplies only condition (a) and would wrongly excuse a counter that also sold foreign currency. The definition sets no licensing, guest-registration or commission requirement.

tc.q: 一間酒店在店內設貨幣兌換櫃位，主要為方便住客，而該櫃位只以港幣向住客購買非香港貨幣。這是否《打擊洗錢條例》所指的「貨幣兌換服務」？
options: 不是——該櫃位在酒店內為方便住客而設，並只以港幣購買非港幣
不是——在酒店內為方便住客而經營的貨幣兌換櫃位，不論其買賣何種貨幣均獲豁除
是——只有該櫃位由已持有金錢服務經營者牌照的人為酒店經營，方獲豁除
是——只有該櫃位僅供已登記住客使用並不收取佣金，方獲豁除
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條只在兩項條件同時符合時，方獲豁除由管理酒店的人經營的服務：(a) 在酒店內主要為方便住客而經營；及(b) 只包括以港幣購買非港幣的交易。選項二只滿足條件(a)，若該櫃位同時出售外幣即不符合。定義並未提及牌照、限於已登記住客或佣金等要求。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1 (definition of business relationship)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條（業務關係的定義）

en.q: Under Schedule 2, what distinguishes a “business relationship” from an occasional dealing?
options: A business, professional or commercial relationship that has or is expected to have duration
A relationship in which the MSO carries out ten or more transactions for the customer within a year
A relationship that exists only once the customer has signed a written account-opening contract
Any relationship in which the MSO carries out a transaction of $120,000 or more for the customer
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.1: a business relationship is a business, professional or commercial relationship that has an element of duration, or that the MSO expects to have an element of duration when the person first contacts it as a potential customer. Nothing in the definition counts transactions, requires a written contract, or turns on the $120,000 occasional-transaction CDD threshold (that figure comes from s.3(1)(b), a different test).

tc.q: 根據附表2，「業務關係」與非經常交易的分別在於什麼？
options: 具有（或預期具有）持續性的業務、專業或商業關係
金錢服務經營者在一年內為該客戶進行十宗或以上的交易
需待客戶簽署開戶書面合約後，方成立的關係
金錢服務經營者為該客戶進行120,000元或以上交易的關係
tc.explain: 附表2第1條：業務關係指具持續元素的業務、專業或商業關係，或在該人首次以潛在客戶身份接觸金融機構時，該機構預期具持續元素。定義並未計算交易宗數、要求書面合約，也不取決於120,000元門檻——那是第3(1)(b)條非經常交易盡職審查門檻的另一規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1 (definition of occasional transaction); AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.2.3
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條（非經常交易的定義）；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.3段

en.q: Under Schedule 2 to the AMLO, an “occasional transaction” is:
options: A transaction between an MSO and a customer who does NOT have a business relationship
Any transaction under $8,000, regardless of whether a business relationship exists
A transaction with a customer whose business relationship has lasted less than a year
A transaction carried out for a customer outside the MSO's normal business hours
en.explain: An occasional transaction is a transaction between the MSO and a customer who does not have a business relationship with it (e.g. a walk-in exchange or remittance customer). $8,000/$120,000 are CDD thresholds that attach to occasional transactions (s.3(1)(b), (1A)) — they are not part of the definition itself, and relationship duration and business hours are irrelevant to it.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》附表2，「非經常交易」是指：
options: 金錢服務經營者與並無業務關係的客戶進行的交易
不論有否業務關係，低於8,000元的交易
與客戶的業務關係建立不足一年的交易
在金錢服務經營者正常營業時間以外進行的交易
tc.explain: 非經常交易的定義是金錢服務經營者與跟它並無業務關係的客戶之間的交易（例如街客的兌換或匯款交易）。120,000元／8,000元的盡職審查門檻是附於非經常交易之上的另一規定（第3(1)(b)、(1A)條），並非定義本身的一部分；關係長短及營業時間與定義無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.4至4.2.5段

en.q: A walk-in customer sends three wire transfers of $3,000 each to the same recipient within an hour. What does Schedule 2 require?
options: CDD must be carried out — the $8,000 threshold applies to linked transfers, which total $9,000
Nothing is required — each individual transfer is below the $8,000 threshold
Only a record of the final transfer needs to be kept, since it completes the pattern
CDD is required only if the transfers reach the $120,000 threshold for non-wire transactions
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.3(1A): CDD applies to a wire transfer of $8,000 or more, whether carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear linked (¶4.2.4–4.2.5). Three linked $3,000 transfers total $9,000, above the threshold, so CDD is triggered even though no single transfer reaches it. The $120,000 figure in option 4 is the separate s.3(1)(b) threshold for non-wire occasional transactions and does not apply to wire transfers.

tc.q: 一名街客在一小時內向同一收款人先後發出三筆各 3,000 元的電傳轉帳。附表2有何規定？
options: 必須執行盡職審查——8,000元門檻適用於合計9,000元的關連轉帳
毋須任何行動——每筆交易均低於8,000元，該門檻由關長每年釐定
只須記錄最後一筆轉帳，因它完成了該模式，猶如第20條的紀錄規定
只有在轉帳合計達到非電傳轉帳的120,000元門檻時，才需盡職審查
tc.explain: 附表2第3(1A)條：8,000元門檻適用於單一項或在經營者看來有關連的多項電傳轉帳（第4.2.4至4.2.5段）。三筆有關連的3,000元轉帳合計達9,000元，已超過門檻，即使沒有單筆轉帳達到門檻亦然。選項四的120,000元是第3(1)(b)條就非電傳轉帳非經常交易而設的另一門檻，不適用於電傳轉帳。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)至(b)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.4.1及4.4.3段

en.q: Under Schedule 2, how do the verification standards differ between a customer and a beneficial owner?
options: The customer must be verified; a beneficial owner needs only reasonable measures to confirm identity
Both must be verified to the identical standard, using government-issued documents in every case
The beneficial owner must be verified to a higher standard than the customer, including independent audit
Only the beneficial owner needs verification; the customer need only be identified, not verified
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.2(1): the customer must be identified and verified from the listed reliable sources; for a beneficial owner the MSO need only identify them and take reasonable measures — a lower, risk-sensitive standard (¶4.4.3) — to be satisfied it knows who they are, including understanding ownership and control structures for legal persons and trusts. Neither limb is dropped, and no audit requirement exists.

tc.q: 根據附表2，對客戶與對實益擁有人的身分核實標準有何分別？
options: 客戶身分必須核實；實益擁有人則只需採取合理措施核實身分
兩者均須以相同標準核實，並在任何情況下都須使用政府簽發的文件
實益擁有人需以比客戶更高的標準核實，包括進行獨立審計
只有實益擁有人需要核實；客戶只需識別，無需核實
tc.explain: 附表2第2(1)條：客戶必須依所列可靠來源識別及核實身分；對實益擁有人，經營者只需識別並採取合理措施——一項較低、按風險而定的標準（第4.4.3段），包括了解法人或信託的擁有權及控制權架構。兩項措施都不可省略，法例也無獨立審計要求。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.8.10段

en.q: For which customer may an MSO choose NOT to identify and verify the beneficial owners under section 4 of Schedule 2?
options: A corporation listed on a stock exchange
Any private company incorporated in Hong Kong
Any customer introduced by an existing customer
A company whose director is personally known to the MSO's owner
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.4(3) permits skipping beneficial-owner identification/verification for specific customers: an FI as defined in the AMLO (or equivalent overseas institution), a corporation listed on any stock exchange, certain investment vehicles, the Government or a public body in Hong Kong, and equivalent-jurisdiction governments/public bodies (¶4.8.10). Ordinary private companies enjoy no such exemption.

tc.q: 根據附表2第4條，金錢服務經營者可就哪類客戶選擇不識別及核實其實益擁有人？
options: 在證券市場上市的法團
任何在香港註冊成立的私人公司
任何由現有客戶介紹的客戶
其董事與經營者東主相熟的公司
tc.explain: 附表2第4(3)條准許就特定客戶不識別／核實實益擁有人：《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構（或對等司法管轄區的類似機構）、在任何證券市場上市的法團、若干投資工具、香港政府或公共機構，以及對等司法管轄區的政府／公共機構（第4.8.10段）。一般私人公司並無此豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)條

en.q: Besides examining unusual transactions, what must an MSO do under section 5(1)(a)-(b) of Schedule 2 as part of continuously monitoring a business relationship?
options: Keep CDD documents current, and scrutinise transactions against customer knowledge
Re-verify the customer's identification documents every time a transaction is carried out
Take reasonable measures to establish the customer's source of wealth and source of funds
Obtain senior management approval before continuing the business relationship
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.5(1)(a)-(b) requires reviewing CDD documents, data and information from time to time to ensure they stay up-to-date and relevant, and scrutinising transactions for consistency with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, business and risk profile. Re-verifying documents on every transaction is not required; source-of-wealth checks and senior-management approval are the PEP/high-risk duties under s.10 and s.15, not the general continuous-monitoring duty in s.5.

tc.q: 除審查異常交易外，附表2第5(1)(a)至(b)條對金錢服務經營者持續監察業務關係還有何規定？
options: 覆核文件以保持現況，並按客戶認識審察交易
每進行交易就重新核實客戶的身分證明文件
採取合理措施確立客戶的財富來源及資金來源
在繼續業務關係前取得高級管理層批准
tc.explain: 附表2第5(1)(a)至(b)條規定需不時覆核所取得的盡職審查文件、數據及資料以確保它們反映現況及切合需要，並審察交易是否與經營者對客戶及其業務、風險狀況的認識相符。每筆交易都重新核實並非規定；財富來源審查與高級管理層批准則屬第10、15條針對政治人物或高風險情況的要求，非第5條一般持續監察的要求。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.12.1段

en.q: When must CDD be carried out for a PRE-EXISTING customer (relationship established before the AMLO commenced on 1 April 2012)?
options: Unusual transaction, account-operation change, ML/TF suspicion, or doubted ID information
Never — pre-existing customers are permanently exempt from CDD under section 4
Only when the customer volunteers new documents on their own initiative at annual review
Only once cumulative transactions in a year exceed $120,000, confirmed in writing by the Commissioner
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.6 (¶4.12.1): CDD applies to pre-existing customers when an unusual/suspicious transaction inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer occurs, a material change occurs in how the account is operated, ML/TF is suspected, or the MSO doubts previously obtained identification information. There is no permanent exemption, no need for the customer to volunteer documents, and no separate cumulative-turnover trigger — $120,000 is the unrelated s.3(1)(b) occasional-transaction threshold.

tc.q: 就「先前客戶」（在《打擊洗錢條例》2012年4月1日生效前已建立關係的客戶），何時必須執行盡職審查？
options: 交易異常、帳戶有變、涉洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，或資料有疑問時
永遠無需——先前客戶根據第4條的規定永久豁免盡職審查
只有客戶在每次年度覆核時自行主動書面提供新文件時
只有一年內累計交易超過120,000元，並經關長書面確認時
tc.explain: 附表2第6條（第4.12.1段）：就先前客戶，在以下情況必須執行盡職審查：出現與經營者對客戶認識不符的異常或可疑交易；帳戶運作方式出現重大改變；懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集；或對先前取得的識別資料的真實性或充分性有疑問。並無永久豁免，也無需客戶主動提供文件；120,000元是第3(1)(b)條非經常交易門檻，與先前客戶的盡職審查觸發點無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)至(2)條

en.q: Section 9(1) of Schedule 2 deals with customers not physically present for identification. Which statement is CORRECT?
options: At least one measure is required, unless verified via a recognised digital ID system
Non-face-to-face customers are prohibited entirely, whatever measures are taken
All three of the measures listed in section 9(1) must be carried out together, not just one
The additional measures are recommended good practice only, not a legal requirement
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.9(1) requires at least one of three additional measures (further verification from unused sources; supplementary verification; or first payment through a named account at an authorized institution or equivalent) — not all three, contrary to option 3. Section 9(2) dispenses with them where identity was verified via a recognised digital identification system. Non-face-to-face onboarding is not banned, and the measures are a legal requirement, not mere guidance.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)條處理並非親身在場接受身分識別的客戶。下列哪項正確？
options: 須採取一項措施減低風險——除非透過認可數碼系統核實身分
不論採取何種措施，完全禁止接受非親身在場的客戶
必須同時執行第9(1)條的三項措施，並非只需其中一項
額外措施只屬建議性質的良好做法，並非法定要求
tc.explain: 附表2第9(1)條規定，就並非親身在場的客戶，需執行三項措施中的最少一項（以未用過的來源進一步核實身分；採取補充核實措施；或首筆付款經以客戶名義在認可機構等開立的帳戶進行），而非同時執行三項，選項三錯。第9(2)條則規定若已透過認可數碼識別系統核實身分，則無需額外措施。非親身在場並非禁止，而額外措施也屬法定要求，非僅建議。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10及15條

en.q: Before establishing a business relationship with a customer who is (or whose beneficial owner is) a politically exposed person, what does section 10 of Schedule 2 require?
options: Obtain senior management approval, AND establish the source of wealth and funds involved
Obtain senior management approval only — establishing the source of wealth is optional
Either establish the source of wealth and funds, or take additional measures to mitigate the risk
File a report with the JFIU before the business relationship may proceed
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.10(1)(a)-(b) requires BOTH senior management approval AND reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds — conjunctive, not optional. Option 3 describes s.15's discretionary either/or structure for general high-risk situations, not the mandatory PEP duty in s.10. PEP status alone does not itself trigger a JFIU report; that arises separately from suspicion of ML/TF.

tc.q: 在與屬政治人物（或其實益擁有人屬政治人物）的客戶建立業務關係前，附表2第10條有何規定？
options: 取得高級管理層批准，並採取合理措施確立所涉財富及資金來源
只需取得高級管理層批准——確立財富來源屬可選事項
由經營者自行決定：或確立財富及資金來源，或採取額外措施減低風險
在建立業務關係前向聯合財富情報組提交報告
tc.explain: 附表2第10(1)(a)至(b)條規定需同時：取得高級管理層批准；並採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源——兩者皆屬必須，非可選。選項三描述的是第15條就一般高風險情況而設、任擇其一的做法，並非第10條對政治人物的強制性規定。單純屬政治人物本身並不自動觸發向聯合財富情報組申報；申報義務源自對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，是另一事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第10.4段

en.q: To which of the following does the wire-transfer information regime in section 12 of Schedule 2 NOT apply?
options: Transfers between institutions each acting for itself, or card use not for person-to-person transfer
Any wire transfer of less than $50,000, regardless of the parties involved, under section 12(3A)
Wire transfers sent to the customer's own family members, as section 11 provides for insurance beneficiaries
Wire transfers denominated in a foreign currency rather than Hong Kong dollars, per section 13(1)
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.12(2) (¶10.4) excludes only (a) transfers between an MSO and an FI, or (b) an MSO and a foreign institution, each acting on its own behalf, and (c) card-based transactions not used for person-to-person transfer. There is no exemption based on the transfer amount, the recipient being a family member, or the currency used — all such transfers remain within the s.12 regime.

tc.q: 附表2第12條的電傳轉帳資料規定不適用於下列哪項？
options: 機構間各自代表本身行事的轉賬，或並非用作人對人轉帳的卡交易
不論交易對方為何，任何低於50,000元的電傳轉賬，見第12(3A)條
匯給客戶本身家庭成員的電傳轉賬，猶如第11條就保險受益人的規定
以外幣而非港幣結算的電傳轉賬，根據第13(1)條
tc.explain: 附表2第12(2)條（第10.4段）只排除：(a) 金錢服務經營者與金融機構之間、或(b) 與外地機構之間、各自代表本身行事的電傳轉帳；以及(c) 並非用作人對人轉帳的卡別交易。並無基於金額、收款人為家庭成員或交易貨幣的豁免，這些情況仍屬第12條規定的範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第11.3及11.6段

en.q: Under section 13(2) of Schedule 2, if the originator's identification document for a remittance transaction is a travel document, what additional particular must the MSO record alongside the document number?
options: The place of issue of the travel document
The document's date of expiry
The originator's nationality as shown on the document
The name of the officer who issued the document
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.13(2)(c)(ii) requires recording the originator's identification document number and, if that document is a travel document, the place of issue — no other requirement. Expiry date, nationality and issuing officer are plausible travel-document details but are not among the particulars s.13(2) requires the MSO to record.

tc.q: 根據附表2第13(2)條，如匯款交易中匯款人的身分證明文件為旅行證件，金錢服務經營者除記錄文件號碼外，還需另外記錄什麼資料？
options: 該旅行證件的簽發地點
該文件的到期日期
文件上匯款人的國籍
簽發該文件的官員姓名
tc.explain: 附表2第13(2)(c)(ii)條規定，需記錄匯款人的身分證明文件號碼，若該文件為旅行證件，還需記錄簽發地點——別無其他要求。到期日期、國籍及簽發官員姓名雖是旅行證件上可能出現的資料，但並非第13(2)條要求經營者記錄的項目。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13A條

en.q: Under section 13A(3) of Schedule 2, below what amount is an ordering institution NOT required to obtain the originator's address, customer identification number or identification document number for a virtual asset transfer?
options: Virtual assets amounting to less than $8,000
Virtual assets amounting to less than $120,000
Virtual assets amounting to less than $50,000
There is no such exemption — the particulars must always be obtained
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.13A(3): the requirement in s.13A(2)(c) to obtain the originator's address, customer identification number or identification document number does not apply to a virtual asset transfer involving virtual assets amounting to less than $8,000 — the same figure as the wire-transfer CDD threshold in s.3(1A), not the $120,000 general threshold or any $50,000 figure, and the exemption does exist.

tc.q: 根據附表2第13A(3)條，轉移機構就低於多少金額的虛擬資產轉移，無需取得匯款人的地址、客戶識別號碼或身分證明文件號碼？
options: 低於8,000元的虛擬資產
低於120,000元的虛擬資產
低於50,000元的虛擬資產
並無此豁免——上述資料必須一律取得
tc.explain: 附表2第13A(3)條：第13A(2)(c)條要求取得匯款人地址、客戶識別號碼或身分證明文件號碼的規定，不適用於涉及低於8,000元虛擬資產的轉移——與第3(1A)條電傳轉帳盡職審查門檻相同，而非120,000元的一般門檻或任何50,000元的數字，而且該豁免確實存在。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20及21條（第3部）

en.q: Under Part 3 of Schedule 2, in what form may required records be kept?
options: The original, or a copy on microfilm or in a computer database; data records likewise
Any electronic format is acceptable, provided the original document is destroyed afterward
The original document only — microfilm or computer-database copies are not permitted
Whatever form the relevant authority specifies by written notice under section 20(4)
en.explain: Section 21 requires that where a record consists of a document, either the original or a copy on microfilm or in a computer database must be kept; where it consists of data or information, it must be kept on microfilm or in a computer database — not any electronic format, and originals need not be destroyed. Section 20(4) is a different provision: it lets a relevant authority or regulatory body require a longer retention period by notice, but it does not govern the form of the record.

tc.q: 根據附表2第3部，規定備存的紀錄可以何種形式保存？
options: 正本，或縮微膠卷／電腦數據庫副本；數據紀錄方式相同
任何電子格式均可接受，惟其後須銷毀文件正本
只可保存文件正本——不准以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存副本
以有關當局根據第20(4)條書面通知指明的任何形式
tc.explain: 第21條規定：如紀錄屬文件，須保存正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存副本；如紀錄屬數據或資料，須以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存——並非任何電子格式皆可，亦無須銷毀正本。第20(4)條是另一條文：容許有關當局或規管機構以通知指明較長的保存期，但並不規管紀錄的形式。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22及23條

en.q: If the law of the place where a financial institution's overseas branch operates does not permit application of the CDD/record-keeping procedures required by Schedule 2, what must the institution do?
options: Inform the relevant authority, and take measures to mitigate its ML/TF risk
Notify the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit and promptly file a suspicious transaction report
Cease all operations at that branch within one month of discovering the gap
Apply to the Commissioner for a formal exemption from Schedule 2 under section 4
en.explain: Section 22(2) provides that if local law does not permit the application of the Schedule 2 Parts 2 and 3 procedures, the financial institution must inform the relevant authority and take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risk faced by the branch or subsidiary as a result of its inability to comply. There is no JFIU/STR trigger here, no fixed one-month closure deadline, and section 4 (simplified due diligence) creates no Commissioner exemption mechanism.

tc.q: 如金融機構的外地分行所在地的法律，不准許應用附表2規定的客戶盡職審查／備存紀錄程序，該機構須怎樣做？
options: 通知有關當局，並減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
通知聯合財富情報組，並依規定從速提交可疑交易報告
在發現未能遵從的情況後一個月內，停止該分行的所有業務
根據第4條的簡化盡職審查機制，向關長申請正式豁免
tc.explain: 第22(2)條訂明，如當地法律不准許應用附表2第2及3部的程序，該金融機構須通知有關當局，並採取額外措施，以有效減低該分行或附屬企業因未能遵從而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。條文並無涉及聯合財富情報組或可疑交易報告的機制，也無一個月的固定停業期限；第4條（簡化盡職審查）亦沒有設立由關長批准的豁免機制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「貨幣」的定義）

en.q: For the purposes of the AMLO, what does “currency” include?
options: A cheque and a traveller's cheque
Only banknotes and coins in circulation
Only Hong Kong legal tender
Stored value facilities and virtual assets
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that currency includes a cheque and a traveller's cheque. The separate definition of money is money in whatever form or currency.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「貨幣」包括甚麼？
options: 支票及旅行支票
只限流通的鈔票及硬幣
只限香港法定貨幣
儲值支付工具及虛擬資產
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「貨幣」包括支票及旅行支票。另有「金錢」的定義，指任何形式或任何貨幣的金錢。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「金錢」的定義）

en.q: How is “money” defined in Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: Money in whatever form or currency
Hong Kong dollars and other freely convertible currencies only
Physical cash, excluding funds held in accounts
Any medium of exchange recognised by the Monetary Authority
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 defines money as money in whatever form or currency. The breadth of this definition matters because the definition of remittance service turns on the sending or receiving of money.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1如何界定「金錢」？
options: 任何形式或任何貨幣的金錢
只限港元及其他可自由兌換的貨幣
實物現金，不包括帳戶內的資金
金融管理專員認可的任何交易媒介
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條界定「金錢」為任何形式或任何貨幣的金錢。此定義的廣泛程度十分重要，因「匯款服務」的定義取決於金錢的寄出或收取。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “money changing service”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「貨幣兌換服務」的定義）

en.q: For the hotel exception to the definition of "money changing service" to apply, the service must be operated within the hotel premises primarily for guests' convenience. What is the second required condition?
options: It consists solely of buying non-Hong Kong currency with Hong Kong currency
It consists solely of the manager selling non-Hong Kong currency for Hong Kong currency
The transactions must not exceed $8,000 per guest, per day, in total
The service is provided only by a person licensed under section 24
en.explain: The hotel exception under paragraph (b) of the "money changing service" definition requires that the service consists solely of transactions for the purchase by the hotel manager of non-Hong Kong currencies in exchange for Hong Kong currency — a one-way purchase, not a sale — with no monetary cap and no licensing requirement stated in the text.

tc.q: 「貨幣兌換服務」定義下的酒店例外須同時符合兩項條件。除該服務在酒店處所內主要為住客提供方便而經營外，第二項條件是甚麼？
options: 純粹包括該酒店管理人以港幣購買非港幣的交易
純粹包括該酒店管理人以港幣出售非港幣的交易
交易款額每名住客每日不得超過8,000元
該服務只可由根據第24條領有牌照的人提供
tc.explain: 「貨幣兌換服務」定義(b)段的酒店例外規定：該服務純粹包括該酒店管理人以港幣購買非港幣的交易——僅限單向購買，並非出售——條文並無訂明款額上限，亦無發牌規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “remittance service”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「匯款服務」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is expressly one of the limbs of the definition of “remittance service”?
options: Arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong
Exchanging one non-Hong Kong currency for another in Hong Kong
Holding customer funds on deposit in Hong Kong
Issuing stored value facilities to customers in Hong Kong
en.explain: The definition covers a service, operated in Hong Kong as a business, of sending or arranging for the sending of money to a place outside Hong Kong; receiving or arranging for the receipt of money from a place outside Hong Kong; or arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong. Currency exchange falls under money changing service instead.

tc.q: 下列何者明文屬「匯款服務」定義的其中一項？
options: 安排在香港以外地方收取金錢
在香港境內將一種非港幣貨幣兌換為另一種
在香港為客戶持有存款
在香港向客戶發行儲值支付工具
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋在香港以業務方式經營的下列一項或多於一項服務：將金錢寄往香港以外地方或安排寄往；從香港以外地方收取金錢或安排收取；或安排在香港以外地方收取金錢。貨幣兌換則屬「貨幣兌換服務」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第3條

en.q: A company provides financial institutions with a messaging system for transmitting funds, but handles no money itself. Is it regarded as operating a remittance service?
options: No — section 3 of Schedule 1 excludes a person who only provides such systems
Yes — any participation at all in transmitting funds makes a person operate a remittance service
Yes, but only where the messaging system is used for cross-border fund transfers
No, but only provided the company has registered the system with the Commissioner
en.explain: Section 3 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 provides that a person who only provides to financial institutions a message system or other support systems for transmitting funds is not, for the purposes of the Ordinance, to be regarded as a person operating a remittance service. This exclusion is not limited to domestic-only systems, is not confined to cross-border use, and does not depend on any registration with the Commissioner.

tc.q: 某公司向金融機構提供傳送資金的訊息系統，但本身並不處理金錢。它是否被視為經營匯款服務？
options: 否——附表1第3條排除只提供該等系統的人
是——只要參與任何資金傳送環節，即構成經營匯款服務
是，但只限該訊息系統用於跨境資金轉帳的情況
否，但條件是該公司已向海關關長登記該系統
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第3條訂明，只向金融機構提供傳送資金的訊息系統或其他支援系統的人，就本條例而言，不視為經營匯款服務的人。此排除並不限於本地系統，也不只限於跨境使用的情況，更與有否向關長登記該系統無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「財產」的定義）

en.q: What does "property" include under Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: Money, goods, choses in action and land anywhere, with related interests
Only tangible, physical assets that are located within the territory of Hong Kong itself
Only assets that are capable of being registered in a public register or land registry
Only money and goods; choses in action such as debts and cheques are expressly excluded
en.explain: The definition covers money, goods, choses in action and land, whether in Hong Kong or elsewhere, together with obligations, easements and every description of estate, interest and profit arising out of them. It is not limited to tangible assets physically in Hong Kong, is not limited to registrable assets, and does not exclude choses in action.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1下的「財產」包括甚麼？
options: 金錢、貨品、據法權產及土地，不論何處，連同相關權益
只限實際位於香港境內、可觸摸的有形資產
只限可在公共登記冊或土地註冊處正式登記的資產
只限金錢及貨品；據法權產（如債務及支票）明文被排除在外
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋金錢、貨品、據法權產及土地（不論在香港或其他地方），連同因該等財產而產生或附帶的義務、地役權及各種產業權、權益及收益。定義並不限於實際位於香港的有形資產，也不限於可登記的資產，更沒有將據法權產排除在外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第2條

en.q: Where do the terms "terrorist", "terrorist act" and "terrorist associate" used in the definition of terrorist financing take their meaning from?
options: Section 2(1) of the United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance
Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO, which defines terms such as 'Commissioner'
Section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Securities and Futures Ordinance
The FATF Recommendations on combating terrorist financing
en.explain: Section 2 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 provides that, in the definition of terrorist financing, terrorist, terrorist act and terrorist associate have the meaning given by section 2(1) of the United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (Cap. 575) — not Part 2 of Schedule 1 (which defines unrelated terms like Commissioner), not the Securities and Futures Ordinance, and not the FATF Recommendations, which are not themselves incorporated into the statutory definition.

tc.q: 「恐怖分子資金籌集」定義中所用的「恐怖分子」、「恐怖主義行為」及「與恐怖分子有聯繫者」，其涵義源自何處？
options: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第2(1)條
《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部，也界定「恐怖分子」
《證券及期貨條例》附表1第1部第1條
財務行動特別組織有關打擊資助恐怖主義的建議
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第2條訂明，在「恐怖分子資金籌集」的定義中，「恐怖分子」、「恐怖主義行為」及「與恐怖分子有聯繫者」具有《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》（第575章）第2(1)條所給予的涵義——並非附表1第2部（該部界定「關長」等不相關詞語）、《證券及期貨條例》，也不是財務行動特別組織的建議，該等建議本身並未納入法定定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「關長」的定義）

en.q: Whom does "Commissioner" include under Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, deputies/assistants, or an s.26 delegate
Only the Commissioner of Customs and Excise personally, excluding any deputy
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise, and separately the Commissioner of Police
Any public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department, regardless of rank
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines Commissioner as the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, any Deputy Commissioner, any Assistant Commissioner, or a person to whom the Commissioner has delegated a function under section 26 — it does not include the Commissioner of Police, and it is not limited to the Commissioner personally or to any Customs and Excise officer regardless of rank.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部下的「關長」包括何人？
options: 關長、副／助理關長，或第26條獲轉授的人
只限海關關長本人，不包括任何副關長或助理關長
海關關長，以及另行包括警務處處長在內
任何受僱於香港海關的公職人員，不論職級高低
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「關長」為海關關長、任何海關副關長、任何海關助理關長，或海關關長根據第26條向其轉授職能的人——並不包括警務處處長，亦不限於關長本人或不論職級的任何海關人員。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「營業日」的定義）

en.q: Which days are excluded from the definition of "business day" in Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: A public holiday, a gale warning day, or a black rainstorm warning day
Saturdays and Sundays only, regardless of any public holiday
Any day on which the Customs and Excise Department is closed to the public
Any day on which the Hong Kong Stock Exchange does not trade securities
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines business day as any day other than a public holiday, a gale warning day, or a black rainstorm warning day (as defined by section 71(2) of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance) — it is not simply Saturdays and Sundays, a Customs closure day, or a day the Stock Exchange does not trade.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1「營業日」的定義不包括哪些日子？
options: 公眾假期、烈風警告日或黑色暴雨警告日
只限星期六及星期日，不論是否公眾假期
香港海關不對外開放的任何日子
香港交易所不進行證券買賣的任何日子
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「營業日」為公眾假期，或《釋義及通則條例》第71(2)條所界定的烈風警告日或黑色暴雨警告日以外的任何日子——並非單純指星期六及星期日、海關不開放的日子，或交易所不進行買賣的日子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「指定非金融企業及行業」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is a DNFBP under Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: An estate agent
A licensed money service operator
An authorized institution
An SVF licensee
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines DNFBP as an accounting professional, an estate agent, a legal professional, a TCSP licensee or a Category B PMS registrant. Money service operators, authorized institutions and SVF licensees are financial institutions, not DNFBPs.

tc.q: 下列何者屬《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部下的指定非金融企業及行業？
options: 地產代理
持牌金錢服務經營者
認可機構
儲值支付工具持牌人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「指定非金融企業及行業」為會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士、信託或公司服務提供者持牌人，或B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人。金錢服務經營者、認可機構及儲值支付工具持牌人均屬金融機構，而非指定非金融企業及行業。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「金融機構」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of “financial institution” in Schedule 1?
options: The Postmaster General
The Estate Agents Authority
A licensed estate agent
A certified public accountant
en.explain: The Schedule 1 Part 2 definition of financial institution lists authorized institutions, licensed corporations, authorized insurers, licensed individual insurance agents, licensed insurance agencies, licensed insurance broker companies, licensed money service operators, the Postmaster General, SVF licensees, licensed VAS providers and stablecoin licensees.

tc.q: 下列何者包括在附表1「金融機構」的定義內？
options: 郵政署署長
地產代理監管局
持牌地產代理
執業會計師
tc.explain: 附表1第2部「金融機構」的定義列出認可機構、持牌法團、認可保險人、持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構、持牌保險經紀公司、持牌金錢服務經營者、郵政署署長、儲值支付工具持牌人、持牌虛擬資產服務提供者及穩定幣持牌人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 2 (definition of “licensed money service operator”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「持牌金錢服務經營者」的定義）

en.q: How is “licensed money service operator” defined in Schedule 1?
options: The holder of a licence as defined by section 24
Any person operating a money service in Hong Kong
A person registered with the Commissioner under section 27
Any person who has applied for a licence under section 30
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines licensed money service operator as the holder of a licence as defined by section 24 — that is, a licence granted under section 30, renewed under section 31, or deemed granted under section 82.

tc.q: 附表1如何界定「持牌金錢服務經營者」？
options: 第24條所界定的牌照的持有人
在香港經營金錢服務的任何人
根據第27條在海關關長處登記的人
根據第30條已提出牌照申請的任何人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「持牌金錢服務經營者」為第24條所界定的牌照的持有人——即根據第30條批出、根據第31條續期，或根據第82條被當作已批出的牌照。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「客戶」的定義）

en.q: What does the definition of “customer” in Part 2 of Schedule 1 expressly include?
options: A client
Any beneficial owner of the person dealing with the institution
Any person purporting to act on behalf of another
Only a person with whom a business relationship has been established
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that customer includes a client, and, in relation to a Category B PMS registrant, includes a person who is a party to a transaction carried out by the registrant in the course of a precious metals and stones business. Beneficial owners and persons purporting to act are dealt with separately in Schedule 2.

tc.q: 附表1第2部「客戶」的定義明文包括甚麼？
options: 委託人
與該機構交易的人的任何實益擁有人
聲稱代另一人行事的任何人
只限已建立業務關係的人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「客戶」包括委託人；就B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人而言，並包括該註冊人在經營貴金屬及寶石業務過程中所進行交易的一方。實益擁有人及聲稱代其行事的人則在附表2另行處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「法律專業人士」的定義）

en.q: Who is a "legal professional" for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: A solicitor or foreign lawyer per the Legal Practitioners Ordinance
A solicitor or a barrister who is admitted to practise in Hong Kong
Any person who provides legal advice to others by way of business
A solicitor only — foreign lawyers are expressly excluded
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines legal professional as a solicitor, or a foreign lawyer, each as defined by section 2(1) of the Legal Practitioners Ordinance (Cap. 159) — it does not turn on being a barrister, on merely giving legal advice for business, and it does not exclude foreign lawyers.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，何人屬「法律專業人士」？
options: 《法律執業者條例》的律師或外地律師
在香港獲認許執業的律師或大律師
以業務方式向他人提供法律意見的人
只限律師；外地律師明文被排除在外
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「法律專業人士」為《法律執業者條例》（第159章）第2(1)條所界定的律師，或該條所界定的外地律師——並不取決於是否大律師，也不只是以業務方式提供法律意見，更沒有將外地律師排除在外。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “trust or company service”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「信託或公司服務」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following falls within the definition of "trust or company service"?
options: Providing a registered office for a corporation, partnership or trust
Independently auditing a corporation's annual financial statements
Acting as a corporation's external legal adviser in civil litigation matters
Providing general insurance broking or agency services to a corporation
en.explain: The definition covers, among other things, providing a registered office, business address, correspondence or administrative address for a corporation, partnership or other legal person or arrangement. Auditing accounts, acting as litigation counsel, and insurance broking or agency work are all separate professional services that fall outside the definition.

tc.q: 下列何者屬「信託或公司服務」定義的範圍？
options: 為法團、合夥或信託提供註冊辦事處
獨立審計法團的周年財務報表
民事訴訟中擔任法團對外法律顧問
向法團提供一般保險經紀或代理服務
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋（其中包括）為法團、合夥或任何其他法人或法律安排提供註冊辦事處、業務地址、通訊或行政地址。審計帳目、在訴訟中擔任法律顧問，以及保險經紀或代理工作，均屬定義範圍以外的獨立專業服務。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)條

en.q: Under section 2(1)(a) of Schedule 2, which of the following is NOT one of the permitted sources for verifying a customer's identity?
options: A reference letter from the customer's employer
A governmental body recognized for this purpose
A recognized digital identification system
An authority outside Hong Kong with similar functions
en.explain: Section 2(1)(a) lists the permitted sources as a governmental body; the relevant authority or any other relevant authority; an authority outside Hong Kong performing similar functions; a recognized digital identification system; or any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority. A reference letter from an employer is not among them.

tc.q: 根據附表2第2(1)(a)條，下列何者並非核實客戶身分的可接受來源？
options: 客戶僱主發出的推薦信
為此目的而獲認可的政府機構
獲認可數碼身分識別系統
職能相類的境外當局
tc.explain: 第2(1)(a)條列出的可接受來源為：政府機構；有關當局或任何其他有關當局；職能類似的境外當局；獲認可數碼身分識別系統；或有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立來源。僱主發出的推薦信並非其中之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(b)條

en.q: If a customer is a legal person or a trust, what must the section 2(1)(b) beneficial-ownership measure enable the institution to understand?
options: Its ownership and control structure
Obtain a certified copy of the constitutional documents in every case
Verify each beneficial owner to the same standard as the customer
Identify every shareholder, regardless of the size of their holding
en.explain: Section 2(1)(b) requires identifying the beneficial owner and taking reasonable measures to verify their identity so the institution is satisfied it knows who the beneficial owner is, including, where the customer is a legal person or trust, measures to enable it to understand its ownership and control structure — not a certified-copy rule for every case, not owner-level verification to the customer's own standard, and not a size-blind shareholder census.

tc.q: 如客戶是法人或信託，附表2第2(1)(b)條的實益擁有人措施須使該機構能夠了解甚麼？
options: 了解其擁有權及控制權的結構
在任何情況下均取得憲章文件核證副本
以與客戶相同的標準核實每名實益擁有人
識別每名股東，不論其持股量多少
tc.explain: 第2(1)(b)條規定須識別實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分，以令機構信納其知悉實益擁有人為何人；如客戶是法人或信託，並須包括使機構能了解其擁有權及控制權結構的措施——並非在任何情況下均須取得經核證副本，也不是要求以核實客戶本身的相同標準核實每名實益擁有人，更不是不論持股量多少都要識別每名股東。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(c)條

en.q: When must an institution obtain information on the purpose and intended nature of a business relationship?
options: Before establishing it, unless the purpose and nature are obvious
In every case without exception, including occasional transactions
Only where the customer is assessed as posing a high ML/TF risk
Only where the customer is a legal person rather than an individual
en.explain: Section 2(1)(c) requires the institution, before establishing a business relationship, to obtain information on the purpose and intended nature of that relationship, unless it is already obvious — not in every case (occasional transactions are covered by section 3(1)(b) instead), not only for high-ML/TF-risk customers, and not only for legal-person customers.

tc.q: 機構須於何時取得有關業務關係的目的及擬有性質的資料？
options: 建立業務關係前，除非目的及性質已屬明顯
在任何情況下均須，包括非經常交易
只限客戶具高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
只限客戶是法人而非個人的情況
tc.explain: 第2(1)(c)條規定，機構在建立業務關係前，須取得有關該業務關係的目的及擬有性質的資料，除非該目的及性質已屬明顯——並非在任何情況下均須（非經常交易另由第3(1)(b)條規管），也不只限於被評為高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶，更不只限於客戶是法人的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(d)條

en.q: Where a person purports to act on behalf of the customer, what must the institution do in addition to identifying and verifying that person's identity?
options: Verify that person's authority to act for the customer
Obtain a power of attorney formally witnessed by a solicitor
Refuse to proceed with the transaction unless the customer attends in person
Treat that person automatically as the beneficial owner of the customer
en.explain: Section 2(1)(d) requires identifying the person purporting to act and taking reasonable measures to verify their identity on the basis of the listed sources, and, under sub-paragraph (ii), verifying that person's authority to act on behalf of the customer — not a solicitor-witnessed power of attorney, not refusing unless the customer attends personally, and not automatically treating that person as a beneficial owner.

tc.q: 如有人聲稱代客戶行事，除識別及核實該人身分外，機構還須作出甚麼？
options: 核實該人是否確有代客戶行事的權限
取得由律師正式見證的授權書
除非客戶親身到場，否則拒絕進行該交易
自動將該人視為該客戶的實益擁有人
tc.explain: 第2(1)(d)條規定須識別聲稱代客戶行事的人，並依據所列來源採取合理措施核實其身分；並根據(ii)節核實該人是否確有代客戶行事的權限——並非要求由律師見證的授權書，也不是除非客戶親身到場否則拒絕交易，更不是自動將該人視為實益擁有人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(b)條

en.q: At what threshold does an occasional transaction (other than a wire transfer) trigger the CDD requirement under section 3(1)(b) of Schedule 2?
options: $120,000 or more, or an equivalent amount in any other currency
An amount equal to or above $8,000, the wire-transfer threshold
An amount above $20,000 in any single operation or linked series
Any amount at all, since Schedule 2 sets no minimum threshold here
en.explain: Section 3(1)(b) requires CDD before carrying out an occasional transaction involving an amount equal to or above $120,000 or the equivalent in any other currency, whether in a single operation or in several operations that appear to be linked. Section 3(1A) instead sets the lower $8,000 threshold for wire transfers, $20,000 is not a threshold used anywhere in Schedule 2, and there is in fact a minimum threshold here.

tc.q: 根據附表2第3(1)(b)條，非經常交易（電傳轉賬除外）在甚麼門檻會觸發客戶盡職審查規定？
options: 120,000元或以上，或任何其他貨幣的等值款額
款額相等於或高於8,000元，即電傳轉賬的門檻
在單一或有關連的操作中，款額高於20,000元
任何款額，因附表2並無就此設下限
tc.explain: 第3(1)(b)條規定在進行涉及款額相等於或高於120,000元（或任何其他貨幣等值款額）的非經常交易前，須進行客戶盡職審查，不論該交易以單一項或看來有關連的多項操作進行。第3(1A)條則就電傳轉賬訂明較低的8,000元門檻；20,000元並非附表2任何地方採用的門檻；而且此處其實設有最低門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1A)條

en.q: What threshold applies to an occasional wire transfer under section 3(1A) of Schedule 2?
options: $8,000 or more, or an equivalent amount in any other currency
An amount equal to or above $120,000, the CDD threshold
An amount above $20,000 for a single wire transfer
An amount equal to or above $50,000 in Hong Kong currency
en.explain: Section 3(1A) requires a financial institution to carry out CDD before carrying out an occasional transaction that is a wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, or a virtual asset transfer involving virtual assets amounting to no less than $8,000, whether in a single operation or in linked operations. $120,000 is instead the general section 3(1)(b) threshold, and $20,000 and $50,000 are not thresholds used in Schedule 2 at all.

tc.q: 根據附表2第3(1A)條，單次電傳轉賬適用甚麼門檻？
options: 8,000元或以上，或任何其他貨幣的等值款額
120,000元或以上，是一般的盡職審查門檻
單次電傳轉賬款額高於20,000元
款額相等於或高於50,000港元
tc.explain: 第3(1A)條規定金融機構在為客戶進行屬電傳轉賬而涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元的非經常交易，或涉及不少於8,000元虛擬資產的虛擬資產轉移前，須進行客戶盡職審查，不論該交易以單一項或有關連的多項操作進行。120,000元其實是第3(1)(b)條的一般門檻；20,000元及50,000元則並非附表2採用的任何門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(e)條

en.q: Which circumstance, unrelated to any transaction threshold, triggers the CDD requirement under section 3(1)(e) of Schedule 2?
options: When it doubts the veracity or adequacy of information about the customer
When the customer merely changes their registered correspondence address
When the customer has held an account with the institution for over five years
When the customer simply requests to transact in a foreign currency instead
en.explain: Section 3(1)(e) requires CDD when the institution doubts the veracity or adequacy of any information previously obtained for identifying the customer or verifying the customer's identity — not a mere address change, not simply having banked with the institution for years, and not simply requesting a foreign-currency transaction. Section 3(1)(d) separately covers suspicion of ML/TF.

tc.q: 附表2第3(1)(e)條下，哪一項與交易門檻無關的情況會觸發客戶盡職審查規定？
options: 懷疑客戶資料的真確性或充分性
客戶僅更改其登記的通訊地址而已
客戶與機構已維持賬戶關係超過五年
客戶僅要求以外幣進行交易而已
tc.explain: 第3(1)(e)條規定，當機構懷疑先前為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的任何資料的真確性或充分性時，須進行客戶盡職審查——並非單純更改通訊地址，也不是單純已維持賬戶關係多年，更不是單純要求以外幣交易。第3(1)(d)條則另行涵蓋懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(2)條

en.q: On what two conditions may an institution verify a customer's identity after, rather than before, establishing a business relationship?
options: Necessary to avoid interrupting business, and ML/TF risk is managed
The customer is a corporation, and the transaction amount is below $120,000
The customer consents in writing, and a director of the institution approves
The relevant authority has granted a written exemption in advance
en.explain: Section 3(2) permits post-establishment verification only where it is necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business with the customer, and any ML/TF risk caused by deferring verification is effectively managed — not because the customer is a corporation and the amount is below $120,000, not customer consent plus director approval, and not a relevant-authority exemption.

tc.q: 機構可在符合哪兩項條件下，於建立業務關係後（而非之前）核實客戶身分？
options: 為免打斷正常業務往來；及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險受管理
客戶是根據公司條例註冊的法團；及所涉款額低於120,000元
客戶已親自書面同意進行核實；及機構的一名董事已批准
有關當局已事先給予明確的正式書面豁免
tc.explain: 第3(2)條只在下列情況下准許事後核實：為免打斷與該客戶的正常業務往來而有此需要；及因延後核實而可能引致的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險獲有效管理——並非因為客戶是法團且款額低於120,000元，也不是客戶書面同意加董事批准，更不是有關當局給予豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(3)條

en.q: Where verification is deferred under section 3(2), by when must it be completed?
options: As soon as reasonably practicable after establishing the relationship
Within 30 calendar days of establishing the business relationship
Before the customer's first transaction that exceeds $8,000
Within one month, or any longer period the relevant authority allows
en.explain: Section 3(3) requires an institution that carries out verification after establishing a business relationship under section 3(2) to complete the verification as soon as reasonably practicable after establishing the relationship — no fixed 30-day period, no link to an $8,000 transaction, and no one-month-plus-extension rule; those are not what section 3(3) says.

tc.q: 如根據第3(2)條延後核實，須於何時完成？
options: 在建立業務關係後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快完成
在建立業務關係後30個公曆日內完成
在客戶首次超過8,000元的交易前完成
在一個月內，或有關當局容許的較長期間內完成
tc.explain: 第3(3)條規定，根據第3(2)條在建立業務關係後方進行核實的機構，須在建立業務關係後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快完成核實——並無固定的30日期限，也與8,000元的交易無關，更沒有「一個月加延長」的規則；第3(3)條並無這些規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(4)條

en.q: An MSO cannot complete the required CDD measures for a walk-in customer. What must it do?
options: Not carry out the transaction, and terminate any existing relationship promptly
It may proceed with the transaction provided it later files a suspicious transaction report
It may proceed as normal if the transaction amount is below $120,000
It must refer the customer to another licensed MSO for the transaction
en.explain: Section 3(4) provides that an institution unable to comply with section 3(1), (1A), (1B) or (3) must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction with the customer, or, where a business relationship already exists, must terminate it as soon as reasonably practicable — filing an STR afterward does not permit the transaction to proceed, there is no $120,000 carve-out, and referring the customer elsewhere is not an option the Ordinance provides.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者無法就一名即場客戶完成所需的客戶盡職審查措施。它須怎樣做？
options: 不得進行該交易，並盡快終止現有業務關係
可繼續進行該交易，只要其後提交可疑交易報告
如交易款額低於120,000元，可照常進行
須將該客戶轉介予另一持牌金錢服務經營者處理該交易
tc.explain: 第3(4)條訂明，機構如無法遵從第3(1)、(1A)、(1B)或(3)款，不得與該客戶建立業務關係或進行任何非經常交易；如已與該客戶建立業務關係，則須盡快終止該關係——其後提交可疑交易報告並不能令交易得以進行，亦沒有120,000元以下的例外，條例也沒有提供將客戶轉介他處的選項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(1)條

en.q: Which CDD measures may be omitted when simplified due diligence is applied under section 4(1) of Schedule 2?
options: Only the beneficial-ownership measure in section 2(1)(b)
All CDD measures may be omitted entirely under simplified due diligence
Only the measure in section 2(1)(c) concerning purpose and intended nature
All measures except identifying the customer's name may be omitted
en.explain: Section 4(1) allows an institution, instead of carrying out all the CDD measures, to carry out only the measures set out in section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d) — meaning the measure omitted is the section 2(1)(b) beneficial-ownership measure. It does not allow omitting everything, it is not limited to omitting only the purpose-and-nature measure, and it is not simply 'name only'.

tc.q: 根據附表2第4(1)條採用簡化盡職審查時，可省略哪些客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 只可省略第2(1)(b)條的實益擁有人措施
在簡化盡職審查下，可完全省略所有措施
只可省略第2(1)(c)條的目的性質措施
除核實客戶姓名外，其餘措施均可省略
tc.explain: 第4(1)條准許機構不進行所有客戶盡職審查措施，而只進行第2(1)(a)、(ab)、(c)及(d)條所列的措施——即獲省略的是第2(1)(b)條的實益擁有人措施。條文並不容許完全省略所有措施，也不是只可省略目的及擬有性質的措施，更不是「只核實姓名」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)(c)條

en.q: Which of the following customers falls within section 4(3) of Schedule 2, permitting simplified due diligence?
options: A corporation listed on any stock exchange
Any corporation with paid-up capital exceeding $10 million
Any customer introduced by an existing customer
Any customer resident in an equivalent jurisdiction
en.explain: Section 4(3) lists a financial institution; an institution in an equivalent jurisdiction carrying on a similar business with similar compliance measures and supervision; a corporation listed on any stock exchange; certain investment vehicles; the Government or a public body in Hong Kong; and the government or an equivalent public body of an equivalent jurisdiction.

tc.q: 下列哪類客戶屬附表2第4(3)條範圍，因而可採用簡化盡職審查？
options: 在任何證券市場上市的法團
實繳股本超過1,000萬元的任何法團
由現有客戶引介的任何客戶
居於同等司法管轄區的任何客戶
tc.explain: 第4(3)條列出金融機構；在同等司法管轄區成立、經營類似業務並設有類似合規措施及受監督的機構；在任何證券市場上市的法團；若干投資工具；政府或香港任何公共機構；以及同等司法管轄區的政府或執行類似公共機構職能的團體。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(5)(c)條

en.q: A life insurance policy qualifies for simplified due diligence under section 4(5)(c) of Schedule 2 at what premium levels?
options: An annual premium of no more than $8,000, or a single premium of no more than $20,000
An annual premium of no more than $20,000, or a single premium of no more than $8,000
An annual premium of no more than $120,000 in either case
Any premium level, provided the policy has no surrender value
en.explain: Section 4(5)(c) covers a life insurance policy in respect of which an annual premium of no more than $8,000, or a single premium of no more than $20,000, or the equivalent in any other currency, is payable.

tc.q: 人壽保險保單在甚麼保費水平下符合附表2第4(5)(c)條的簡化盡職審查資格？
options: 每年保費不超過8,000元，或整筆保費不超過20,000元
每年保費不超過20,000元，或整筆保費不超過8,000元
兩種情況下每年保費均不超過120,000元
任何保費水平，只要該保單並無退保價值
tc.explain: 第4(5)(c)條涵蓋須繳付每年保費不超過8,000元，或整筆保費不超過20,000元（或任何其他貨幣等值款額）的人壽保險保單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(6)條

en.q: Where a financial institution's customer is a solicitor or firm of solicitors, in relation to which account is the beneficial ownership measure not required?
options: An account in the customer's name mingling clients' moneys or securities, managed as their agent
Any account the solicitor holds, whether it contains client money or the firm's own office money
An account holding the identified funds of a single client only, kept separate and not mingled with others
An account used exclusively for conveyancing transactions, even though moneys in it are mingled
en.explain: Section 4(6) removes the section 2(1)(b) beneficial-owner measure for an account kept in the customer's name that mingles clients' moneys or securities and is managed by the customer as those clients' agent — the pooled client account. The exemption does not reach the firm's own office money, a single-client account, or accounts limited to one type of transaction.

tc.q: 如金融機構的客戶是律師或律師行，就哪類帳戶無須進行實益擁有人措施？
options: 以客戶名義、混合存放委託人款項／證券，以代理人身分管理的帳戶
該律師本人持有的任何帳戶，不論屬委託人款項或屬事務所本身的款項
只持有單一已識別委託人的獨立款項、並無與他人款項混合存放的帳戶
專用於物業轉易交易、即使當中的款項屬混合存放的帳戶
tc.explain: 第4(6)條就以客戶名義開立、混合存放委託人款項或證券，並由客戶以該等委託人代理人身分管理的帳戶（即匯集委託人帳戶），免除第2(1)(b)條的實益擁有人措施。此豁免並不及於事務所本身的款項、單一委託人帳戶，或只限某類交易的帳戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(c)條

en.q: Which transactions must an institution identify and examine under section 5(1)(c) of Schedule 2, and what must it do with its findings?
options: Complex, unusually large or patterned transactions with no apparent lawful purpose; findings in writing
All transactions exceeding $120,000 in value; the findings must be reported at once to the relevant authority
Transactions carried out in a foreign currency; the findings must instead be retained for six years
Transactions only with customers new to the institution; the findings must be reviewed and signed by a director
en.explain: Section 5(1)(c) requires identifying transactions that are complex, unusually large in amount or of an unusual pattern and that have no apparent economic or lawful purpose, examining their background and purpose, and setting out the findings in writing. The text sets no value threshold, currency trigger, reporting duty, new-customer limitation, or director sign-off.

tc.q: 根據附表2第5(1)(c)條，機構須識別及審查哪些交易？並須如何處理其結論？
options: 複雜、異常龐大或模式異常，無明顯合法目的交易；結論須書面列明
所有超過120,000元的交易；結論須立即向有關當局呈報
以外幣進行的所有交易；結論須改為保存六年，而非以書面列明
只限與新客戶進行的交易；結論須經一名董事覆核並簽署確認
tc.explain: 第5(1)(c)條規定機構須識別複雜、金額異常龐大或模式異常，且並無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易，審查該等交易的背景及目的，並以書面列明結論——條文並無金額門檻、貨幣觸發、呈報責任、新客戶限制或董事簽署的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(b)條

en.q: Against what must an institution scrutinise transactions carried out for a customer under section 5(1)(b) of Schedule 2?
options: Its knowledge of the customer, their business and risk profile, and the source of their funds
Whether the documents, data and information it holds on the customer remain up-to-date and relevant
Whether the transaction is complex, unusually large, or of an unusual pattern with no apparent lawful purpose
Whether the customer was physically present for identification purposes when the relationship began
en.explain: Section 5(1)(b) requires appropriate scrutiny of transactions carried out for the customer to ensure they are consistent with the institution's knowledge of the customer and the customer's business and risk profile, and with its knowledge of the source of the customer's funds. Checking that documents remain current is the separate section 5(1)(a) duty; flagging complex or unusual transactions with no apparent purpose is section 5(1)(c); and physical presence at identification is a trigger for additional measures under section 5(3)(a), not the test in section 5(1)(b).

tc.q: 根據附表2第5(1)(b)條，機構須參照甚麼審視為客戶進行的交易？
options: 其對客戶、客戶業務及風險狀況的認識，以及資金來源的認識
其所持有的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料是否仍然最新及切合所需
該交易是否複雜、款額異常龐大，或屬不尋常模式，且沒有明顯的合法目的
該客戶在建立業務關係時是否曾親身出席以供識別
tc.explain: 第5(1)(b)條規定須對為該客戶進行的交易作適當審視，以確保該等交易與該機構對該客戶及該客戶的業務及風險狀況的認識，以及與其對該客戶資金來源的認識相符。檢查文件是否最新是另一項獨立責任，見第5(1)(a)款；識別沒有明顯目的的複雜或異常交易是第5(1)(c)款；而客戶是否曾親身出席以供識別，則是第5(3)(a)條採取額外措施的觸發條件，並非第5(1)(b)款的審視準則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(3)條

en.q: In which three situations must an institution take additional measures when monitoring a business relationship under section 5(3) of Schedule 2?
options: Not physically present for identification; a known politically exposed person; or a section 15 high-risk situation
The customer is itself a financial institution, an equivalent overseas institution, or listed on a stock exchange
Transactions of $8,000, $20,000 or $120,000 respectively for wire transfers, insurance premiums and occasional transactions
The institution suspects money laundering or terrorist financing, or doubts previously obtained information
en.explain: Section 5(3) requires additional measures to compensate for ML/TF risk where the customer has not been physically present for identification, where the customer or a beneficial owner is known to be a politically exposed person, or where the customer or beneficial owner is involved in a situation referred to in section 15 of Schedule 2. The section 4(3) categories describe customers eligible for simplified due diligence, not this trigger; $8,000/$20,000/$120,000 are thresholds used elsewhere for wire transfers, insurance premiums and occasional transactions; and suspicion of ML/TF or doubt about prior information are the separate section 3(1)(d)-(e) triggers for carrying out CDD at all.

tc.q: 根據附表2第5(3)條，機構在監察業務關係時，須在哪三種情況下採取額外措施？
options: 客戶並未親身出席以供識別；客戶或實益擁有人已知屬政治人物；或涉及第15條的高風險情況
客戶本身是金融機構、同等海外司法管轄區的機構，或於證券市場上市的法團
電傳轉賬8,000元、保費20,000元、非經常交易120,000元的門檻
機構懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，或對先前取得的資料的真實性存疑
tc.explain: 第5(3)條規定，如客戶並未親身出席以供識別、客戶或其實益擁有人已知屬政治人物，或客戶或實益擁有人涉及附表2第15條所指的情況，機構須採取額外措施，以抵銷可能因此而引致的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。第4(3)條所列類別是符合簡化盡職審查資格的客戶，並非本項觸發條件；8,000元、20,000元及120,000元是電傳轉賬、保險保費及非經常交易在其他條文下使用的門檻；而懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集或對現有資料存疑，則是第3(1)(d)至(e)條規定須進行客戶盡職審查的一般觸發條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(4)條

en.q: In what circumstance does the "not physically present" trigger for additional monitoring measures NOT apply?
options: Where it identified and verified the customer using data from a recognized digital identification system
Where it instead takes supplementary measures to verify information already obtained about the customer
Where it is satisfied the customer is a former politically exposed person posing no high ML/TF risk
Where the customer's first payment is routed through an account opened in their name with an authorized institution
en.explain: Section 5(4), added in 2022, disapplies section 5(3)(a) where the institution has carried out the measure referred to in section 2(1)(a) or (ab) on the basis of data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system. Taking supplementary verification measures is the section 9(1)(b) alternative for non-face-to-face customers, not this exception; the former-PEP test belongs to section 5(5); and routing the first payment through a named account is the section 9(1)(c) alternative measure — both are different responses to non-physical-presence, not this ground for disapplying section 5(3)(a).

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下，「並未親身出席」這項須採取額外監察措施的觸發條件並不適用？
options: 機構是依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的數據或資料，進行識別及核實
機構改為採取補充措施，以核實已取得的關於該客戶的資料
機構信納該客戶屬前政治人物，且不構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該客戶的首筆付款透過以其名義在認可機構開立的帳戶進行
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第5(4)條訂明，如機構是依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的數據或資料，進行第2(1)(a)或(ab)條所述的措施，則第5(3)(a)款並不適用。採取補充措施核實資料是第9(1)(b)條就非面對面客戶而設的另一選擇，並非本項例外；前政治人物的驗證屬第5(5)條；而透過指定帳戶處理首筆付款則是第9(1)(c)條的另一措施——兩者都是應對非親身出席的不同做法，並非本項令第5(3)(a)款不適用的理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(5)條

en.q: Under section 5(5) of Schedule 2, when does the additional-measures requirement triggered by a customer's PEP status stop applying?
options: Where satisfied they are a former PEP with no high ML/TF risk, per an appropriate risk assessment
Automatically two years after the person leaves public office, with no separate risk assessment
Where the person provides the institution a written declaration that they no longer hold public office
Where the person's country of origin is removed from the Financial Action Task Force's monitoring list
en.explain: Section 5(5), added in 2022, disapplies section 5(3)(b) where the institution is satisfied both that the customer or beneficial owner is a former politically exposed person, and that the former PEP does not present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing based on an appropriate risk assessment. There is no automatic time bar, no self-declaration mechanism, and no FATF country-list test in section 5(5) itself — the institution must always form its own risk assessment.

tc.q: 根據附表2第5(5)條，因客戶屬政治人物而觸發的額外措施規定，在甚麼情況下不再適用？
options: 信納該人屬前政治人物，經評估不構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該人自願離任所有公職並滿兩年後，規定即自動失效，無須另作風險評估
該人主動向機構提交書面聲明，確認其本人已不再擔任任何政治性公職
該人原任職所在的國家或地區，已從財務行動特別組織的監察名單中剔除
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第5(5)條訂明，如機構信納該客戶或實益擁有人屬前政治人物，並且根據適當的風險評估，該前政治人物不構成洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的高風險，則第5(3)(b)款並不適用。第5(5)條本身並無自動兩年期限、書面聲明機制，或財務行動特別組織國家名單的測試——機構必須自行作出風險評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(2)條

en.q: When reviewing documents for a pre-existing customer before first carrying out CDD, what is the institution required to review?
options: Only documents, data and information it holds on the customer at review time
All documents that could reasonably be obtained from public registers or governmental bodies
A full set of fresh identification documents newly obtained from the customer under section 2(1)(a)
Nothing, since no review obligation arises until customer due diligence is first carried out
en.explain: Section 5(2) provides that where the institution carries out the section 5(1)(a) duty in relation to a pre-existing customer before first carrying out CDD measures in accordance with Part 2, it is only required to review the documents, data and information relating to the customer that it holds at the time of the review — not fresh section 2(1)(a) identification documents or public-register material, and the duty is not waived altogether.

tc.q: 就先前客戶而言，在首次進行客戶盡職審查前檢視文件時，機構須檢視甚麼？
options: 只須檢視其當時所持有的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料
從公共登記冊或政府機構合理地可取得的所有文件
根據第2(1)(a)條向該客戶重新取得的一整套身分識別文件
無須檢視，因為在首次進行客戶盡職審查前並無檢視責任
tc.explain: 第5(2)條訂明，如機構在按第2部規定首次就先前客戶進行客戶盡職審查措施前，履行第5(1)(a)款的責任，則只須檢視其在進行該項檢視時所持有的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料——並非根據第2(1)(a)條重新取得的身分識別文件或公共登記冊資料，該責任亦非完全獲豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6(1)(a)條

en.q: Which kind of transaction with a pre-existing customer triggers the CDD requirement under section 6(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: A transaction unusual or suspicious in amount or nature, or inconsistent with its knowledge of the customer or funds
A material change in the way the customer's account is operated, even without any specific transaction taking place
An occasional transaction involving an amount equal to or above $120,000 or its equivalent in another currency
The institution suspects money laundering, or doubts the veracity of information obtained about the customer
en.explain: Section 6(1)(a) applies where a transaction takes place that is, by virtue of its amount or nature, unusual or suspicious, or that is not consistent with the institution's knowledge of the customer, the customer's business or risk profile, or the source of the customer's funds. A material change in how the account is operated is the separate section 6(1)(b) trigger; the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold comes from section 3(1)(b); and suspicion of ML/TF or doubt about existing information are the general section 3(1)(d)-(e) triggers for carrying out CDD at all, not the pre-existing-customer trigger in section 6(1)(a).

tc.q: 與先前客戶進行哪類交易會觸發附表2第6(1)(a)條的客戶盡職審查規定？
options: 因款額或性質而屬不尋常或可疑，或與其對客戶或資金來源的認識不符的交易
該客戶帳戶的運作方式出現重大改變，即使並無任何具體交易發生
涉及款額相等於或高於120,000元（或其他貨幣等值）的非經常交易
機構懷疑涉及洗錢，或對先前取得的關於該客戶的資料的真實性存疑
tc.explain: 第6(1)(a)條適用於下列交易：因其款額或性質而屬不尋常或可疑；或與機構對該客戶、該客戶的業務或風險狀況，或該客戶資金來源的認識不符。帳戶運作方式的重大改變是另一項觸發條件，見第6(1)(b)條；120,000元的非經常交易門檻來自第3(1)(b)條；而懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集或對現有資料的真實性存疑，則是第3(1)(d)至(e)條規定須進行客戶盡職審查的一般觸發條件，並非第6(1)(a)條所指、先前客戶專屬的觸發條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6(2)條

en.q: An institution cannot carry out the required CDD measures on a pre-existing customer when a section 6(1) trigger arises. What must it do?
options: Terminate the business relationship with the customer as soon as reasonably practicable
Apply the section 3(4)(a) remedy: refuse to establish the relationship or carry out the transaction
Continue the relationship, but restrict all transactions to below $8,000 until the position is resolved
Report the matter to the relevant authority and await its instructions before taking any action
en.explain: Section 6(2) provides that if the institution is unable to comply with section 6(1), it must terminate the business relationship with the customer as soon as reasonably practicable — the same consequence as under section 3(4)(b). Refusing to establish the relationship is the section 3(4)(a) remedy for a customer with whom no relationship yet exists, not a pre-existing customer; restricting transaction size and awaiting the relevant authority's instructions are not remedies found in the Ordinance.

tc.q: 當第6(1)條的觸發情況出現時，機構無法就先前客戶進行所需的客戶盡職審查措施。它須怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行的範圍內，盡快終止與該客戶的業務關係
根據第3(4)(a)條的補救方法，拒絕建立業務關係或進行交易
繼續該關係，但將所有交易限於8,000元以下，直至問題解決
向有關當局報告該事宜，並在採取任何行動前等候其指示
tc.explain: 第6(2)條訂明，機構如無法遵從第6(1)款，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止與該客戶的業務關係——與第3(4)(b)條的後果相同。拒絕建立業務關係是第3(4)(a)條就尚未建立關係的客戶而設的補救方法，並不適用於先前客戶；限制交易金額或等候有關當局指示，均非本條例訂明的補救方法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(2)條

en.q: A customer that does not itself qualify for simplified due diligence has, in its beneficial ownership chain, an entity that does. What follows under section 4(2) of Schedule 2?
options: It need not identify or verify the beneficial owners of that entity, or anyone further along the chain
The entire customer relationship becomes eligible for simplified due diligence under section 4(1)
The institution must apply enhanced due diligence to every person in the beneficial ownership chain
The institution must first obtain the relevant authority's written confirmation before relying on the exemption
en.explain: Section 4(2) provides that where such an entity appears in the beneficial ownership chain, the institution is not required, when carrying out the section 2(1)(b) measure in respect of beneficial owners in that chain, to identify or verify the identities of that entity's beneficial owners or of any person in the chain beyond that entity. It narrows one specific step of due diligence, not the customer's overall eligibility for simplified treatment under section 4(1); it does not require enhanced due diligence, which is the opposite of section 4(2)'s effect; and no written confirmation from the relevant authority is called for.

tc.q: 某客戶本身不符合簡化盡職審查資格，但其實益擁有權鏈中有一實體符合資格。根據附表2第4(2)條有何後果？
options: 機構無須識別或核實該實體的實益擁有人，或該鏈中該實體以外任何人的身分
根據第4(1)條，該客戶的整段業務關係均符合簡化盡職審查的資格
機構須對該實益擁有權鏈中的每一名人士採取加強盡職審查措施
機構須先取得有關當局發出的書面確認，方可倚賴該項豁免規定
tc.explain: 第4(2)條訂明，如該實益擁有權鏈中出現該等實體，機構在就該鏈中的實益擁有人進行第2(1)(b)條措施時，無須識別或核實該實體的實益擁有人，或該鏈中在該實體以外的任何人的身分。此條文只是收窄盡職審查其中一個步驟，並非令客戶整體符合第4(1)條簡化盡職審查資格；亦不要求採取加強盡職審查——恰與第4(2)條的效果相反；也無須取得有關當局的書面確認。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(5)(a)條

en.q: Which feature must a retirement scheme have to fall within the simplified due diligence product category in section 4(5)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: Contributions are deducted from employment income, and the scheme rules do not permit assigning a member's interest
It is an insurance policy for retirement purposes that has no surrender clause and cannot be used as collateral
It is a life insurance policy with an annual premium of no more than $8,000, or the equivalent in another currency
It is a life insurance policy with a single premium of no more than $20,000, or the equivalent in another currency
en.explain: Section 4(5)(a) covers a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme providing retirement benefits to employees, where contributions are made by way of deduction from income from employment and the scheme rules do not permit the assignment of a member's interest under the scheme. The no-surrender-clause insurance policy is the separate section 4(5)(b) product, and the $8,000 annual-premium and $20,000 single-premium life policies are section 4(5)(c)(i) and (ii) — alternative, not additional, qualifying products.

tc.q: 退休計劃須具備甚麼特徵，方屬附表2第4(5)(a)條的簡化盡職審查產品類別？
options: 供款須從受僱工作收入中扣減，且計劃規則不准許轉讓成員在計劃下的權益
屬為退休計劃目的而購買、不載有退回條款且不可用作抵押品的保險單
屬人壽保險單，每年保費不多於8,000元（或其他貨幣的等值款額）
屬人壽保險單，整付保費不多於20,000元（或其他貨幣等值款額）
tc.explain: 第4(5)(a)條涵蓋向僱員提供退休福利的公積金、退休金、退休或離職金計劃（不論如何描述），而其供款以從受僱收入中扣除的方式作出，且計劃規則不准許轉讓成員在該計劃下的權益。不載退回條款的保險單是另一項產品，見第4(5)(b)條；年繳保費8,000元及整付保費20,000元的人壽保險單則分別是第4(5)(c)(i)及(ii)條——均為替代而非附加的合資格產品。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(a)條

en.q: What is the purpose of the periodic review of customer documents required by section 5(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: To ensure documents, data and information obtained for Part 2 compliance remain up-to-date and relevant
To scrutinise transactions against the institution's knowledge of the customer's business and risk profile
To identify complex or unusually large transactions with no apparent lawful purpose, and record the findings
To satisfy the record-keeping retention period that section 20 of Schedule 2 separately prescribes
en.explain: Section 5(1)(a) requires the institution to review from time to time the documents, data and information relating to the customer obtained for the purpose of complying with the requirements imposed under Part 2, to ensure that they are up-to-date and relevant. Scrutinising transactions against the institution's customer knowledge is the separate section 5(1)(b) duty; flagging complex or unusual transactions is section 5(1)(c); and the section 20 retention period governs how long records are kept, not why documents are periodically reviewed.

tc.q: 附表2第5(1)(a)條所規定的定期檢視客戶文件，目的為何？
options: 確保為遵從第2部規定而取得的文件、數據及資料保持最新及切合所需
審視為該客戶進行的交易，是否與機構對其業務及風險狀況的認識相符
識別沒有明顯經濟或合法目的的複雜或異常龐大交易，並記錄調查結果
符合附表2第20條就文件紀錄保存期另行作出的規定
tc.explain: 第5(1)(a)條規定機構須不時檢視為遵從第2部下規定而取得的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料，以確保其保持最新及切合所需。審視交易是否與機構對客戶的認識相符是另一項責任，見第5(1)(b)條；識別複雜或異常交易是第5(1)(c)條；而第20條所訂的紀錄保存期規管的是紀錄須保存多久，並非定期檢視文件的目的。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第8條

en.q: What is the relationship between the special requirements in Division 2 of Part 2 of Schedule 2 and the general requirements in sections 3 and 5?
options: Division 2 requirements are additional to those in sections 3 and 5, which still apply
The Division 2 requirements replace those in sections 3 and 5 wherever they apply
Division 2 applies only in cases where sections 3 and 5 cannot be complied with
Division 2 applies only to DNFBPs, and not at all to financial institutions
en.explain: Section 8 provides that, in addition to complying with the requirements under sections 3 and 5 of Schedule 2, a financial institution or DNFBP must also comply with the requirements under Division 2. The special requirements layer on top of the general ones — they do not replace them, are not conditional on an inability to comply with sections 3 and 5, and apply to financial institutions as much as to DNFBPs.

tc.q: 附表2第2部第2分部的特別規定，與第3及5條的一般規定有何關係？
options: 第2分部的規定是在第3及5條的規定以外另加的，該等規定仍然適用
在第2分部適用之處，其規定即取代第3及5條的一般規定
第2分部的規定只在無法遵從第3及5條的情況下方才適用
第2分部只適用於指定非金融企業及行業，完全不適用於金融機構
tc.explain: 第8條訂明，金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業除須遵從附表2第3及5條的規定外，亦須遵從第2分部下的規定。特別規定是疊加於一般規定之上——並非取代一般規定，亦非只在無法遵從第3及5條時方才適用；第2分部同樣適用於金融機構，並非只適用於指定非金融企業及行業。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)條

en.q: Where a customer has not been physically present for identification, how many of the section 9(1) measures must be carried out?
options: At least one of the three listed measures
All three of the listed measures
At least two of the three listed measures
None, provided the customer is assessed as low risk
en.explain: Section 9(1) requires the institution to carry out at least one of the listed measures: further verification using documents not previously used; supplementary measures to verify information already obtained; or ensuring the first payment is made through an account in the customer's name with a qualifying institution.

tc.q: 如客戶並未親身出席以供識別，須進行第9(1)條下多少項措施？
options: 所列三項措施中至少一項
所列三項措施全部
所列三項措施中至少兩項
無須進行，只要該客戶被評為低風險
tc.explain: 第9(1)條規定機構須進行所列措施中至少一項：以先前未曾使用的文件進一步核實身分；就已取得的資料採取補充措施核實；或確保首筆付款是透過以該客戶名義在合資格機構開立的帳戶作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(a)條

en.q: What is distinctive about the documents used for the further verification measure in section 9(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: Of the kind referred to in section 2(1)(a) or (ab), but not previously used to verify that customer's identity
They must be supplementary measures that verify information about the customer already obtained by the institution
They must relate to routing the customer's first payment through a named account with an authorized institution
They must be original documents issued within the preceding three months, not photocopies
en.explain: Section 9(1)(a) requires further verification of the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information referred to in section 2(1)(a) or (ab), but not previously used for the purposes of verification of that customer's identity under that section — independent corroboration from a fresh source. Verifying already-obtained information through supplementary measures is the alternative section 9(1)(b) measure; routing the first payment through a named account is the alternative section 9(1)(c) measure; and the Ordinance sets no three-month or originals-only rule.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)(a)條的進一步核實措施所用的文件，有何特別之處？
options: 屬第2(1)(a)或(ab)條所指、先前未用於核實該客戶身分的資料
須屬補充措施，用以核實機構已經取得的關於該客戶身分的相關背景資料
須關乎將該客戶的首筆付款，透過認可機構開立的指定帳戶處理
須為在過去三個月內新近簽發的身分識別正本文件，而非影印本
tc.explain: 第9(1)(a)條規定須依據第2(1)(a)或(ab)條所述、但先前未曾根據該條用於核實該客戶身分的文件、數據或資料，進一步核實該客戶的身分——即取得來自新來源的獨立佐證。以補充措施核實已取得的資料，是第9(1)(b)條的另一措施；將首筆付款透過指定帳戶處理，是第9(1)(c)條的另一措施；本條例並無三個月期限或只限正本的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(c)條

en.q: What does the payment-routing measure in section 9(1)(c) of Schedule 2 require?
options: The payment, or first of several, must go through an account in their name with an authorized institution
The customer's identity must be further verified using section 2(1)(a) or (ab) documents not previously used
The institution must take supplementary measures to verify information already obtained about the customer
All payments must be made in cash at the institution's premises, regardless of the amount involved
en.explain: Section 9(1)(c) requires the institution to ensure that the payment, or where there is more than one the first payment, in relation to the customer's account is carried out through an account opened in the customer's name with an authorized institution, or with an institution in an equivalent jurisdiction meeting the four stated criteria.
