Further verification using fresh section 2(1)(a)/(ab) documents is the alternative section 9(1)(a) measure; supplementary verification of existing information is section 9(1)(b); neither cash-only payment nor any other rule of that kind appears anywhere in section 9.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)(c)條的付款途徑措施有何規定？
options: 該筆付款（或首筆付款）須透過以該客戶名義在認可機構開立的帳戶進行
須依據第2(1)(a)或(ab)條所述、先前未用的文件進一步核實身分
機構須採取補充措施，核實已取得的關於該客戶的相關資料
所有付款不論款額多寡，一律須在機構處所以現金方式作出
tc.explain: 第9(1)(c)條規定機構須確保就該客戶帳戶的付款（如有多於一筆，則為首筆付款），是透過以該客戶名義在認可機構，或在符合四項訂明準則的同等司法管轄區機構開立的帳戶進行。以第2(1)(a)或(ab)條的新文件進一步核實身分，是第9(1)(a)條的另一措施；核實已取得資料的補充措施則是第9(1)(b)條；第9條並無一律以現金支付之類的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(2)條

en.q: When do the section 9(1) special requirements for non-face-to-face customers NOT apply?
options: Where it carried out the s.2(1)(a)/(ab) measure using data from a recognized digital ID system
Where the institution is satisfied the customer is a former PEP posing no high ML/TF risk
Where the customer's first payment is routed through an account opened in their name with an authorized institution
Where the transaction amount is below $8,000, the wire-transfer CDD threshold in section 3(1A)
en.explain: Section 9(2), added in 2022, provides that section 9(1) does not apply where the institution has carried out the identification and verification measure in section 2(1)(a) or (ab) on the basis of data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system. Section 5(4) makes the parallel exception for ongoing monitoring. The former-PEP test belongs to section 5(5); routing the first payment through a named account is itself one of the section 9(1)(c) measures, not a ground for exempting the customer from section 9(1) altogether; and $8,000 is the separate wire-transfer CDD threshold in section 3(1A).

tc.q: 第9(1)條就非面對面客戶的特別規定，在甚麼情況下不適用？
options: 依據認可數碼識別系統的數據，進行第2(1)(a)或(ab)條的措施
機構信納該客戶屬前政治人物，且不構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該客戶的首筆付款透過以其名義在認可機構開立的帳戶進行
交易額低於8,000元，即第3(1A)條電傳轉賬客戶盡職審查門檻
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第9(2)條訂明，如機構是依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的數據或資料，進行第2(1)(a)或(ab)條的識別及核實措施，則第9(1)條並不適用。第5(4)條就持續監察訂有相對應的例外。前政治人物的驗證屬第5(5)條；透過指定帳戶處理首筆付款本身正是第9(1)(c)條所指的其中一項措施，並非豁免整個第9(1)條的理由；而8,000元則是第3(1A)條就電傳轉賬另行訂立的客戶盡職審查門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(1)條

en.q: Before establishing a business relationship with a customer known to be a politically exposed person, what two steps must an institution take?
options: Obtain senior management approval, and take reasonable measures to establish their source of wealth and funds involved
Obtain senior management approval, and either establish the source of wealth or take measures to mitigate ML/TF risk
Obtain a written declaration of financial status signed by the customer, and cap the amount of each transaction
Verify identity twice, using two separate documents issued by government agencies
en.explain: Section 10(1) requires the institution, before establishing the relationship, to obtain approval from senior management and to take reasonable measures to establish the customer's or beneficial owner's source of wealth and the source of the funds that will be involved in the proposed business relationship — both steps are mandatory. Section 15(a)'s general high-risk-situation rule offers an alternative (source-of-wealth measures or risk-mitigation measures); section 10 does not. No written asset declaration, transaction ceiling, or double identity verification appears in section 10.

tc.q: 與已知屬政治人物的客戶建立業務關係前，機構須採取哪兩項步驟？
options: 取得高級管理層的批准，並採取合理措施，確定客戶的財富來源及所涉資金來源
取得高級管理層批准，並確定財富來源或減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
取得該客戶親自簽署的書面資產狀況聲明，並設定每宗交易款額的上限
以兩份不同的政府機構發出的身分證明文件，分別核實其身分兩次
tc.explain: 第10(1)條規定機構在建立該關係前，須取得高級管理層的批准，並採取合理措施確定該客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源，以及擬建立的業務關係將涉及的資金來源——兩項步驟均屬強制。第15(a)條就一般高風險情況所訂的規則設有替代選擇（確定財富來源的措施，或減低風險的措施，二者擇一）；第10條並無此選擇，亦無書面資產聲明、交易上限或兩次身分核實的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(2)條

en.q: An existing customer becomes a politically exposed person. What does section 10(2) of Schedule 2 require?
options: It continues only if senior management approved and wealth/funds sources are established
It must terminate the business relationship immediately, with no possibility of continuing it
It must report the customer's change of status to the relevant authority within 7 business days
No action is required until the customer's next scheduled periodic review under section 5(1)(a)
en.explain: Section 10(2) provides that where the institution comes to know that an existing customer or a beneficial owner is or has become a politically exposed person, it must not continue the business relationship unless it has obtained senior management approval and taken reasonable measures to establish the source of wealth and the source of the funds involved — continuation on those conditions, not automatic termination, a reporting deadline, or a wait for the next section 5(1)(a) review.

tc.q: 現有客戶成為政治人物。附表2第10(2)條有何規定？
options: 除非高級管理層已批准，並確定財富及資金來源，不得繼續關係
須立即終止該業務關係，並無任何可以繼續維持該關係的可能性
須於接獲通知後7個營業日內，將該客戶的身分變動報告有關當局
在根據第5(1)(a)條進行下次定期檢視前，無須採取任何行動
tc.explain: 第10(2)條訂明，如機構得悉現有客戶或其實益擁有人屬政治人物或已成為政治人物，除非該機構已取得高級管理層批准，並已採取合理措施確定該客戶或實益擁有人的財富來源，以及該業務關係所涉的資金來源，否則不得繼續該業務關係——條文容許在符合條件下繼續關係，並非一律即時終止、設有報告期限，或待下次第5(1)(a)條檢視時方處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(1)及(2)條（觸發條件）

en.q: From what sources of knowledge does the politically exposed person requirement in section 10 of Schedule 2 arise?
options: Publicly known information, or information in the institution's own possession
Only a formal designation of the person published in the Gazette
Only information supplied to the institution by the relevant authority
Only a declaration that the customer itself makes when opening the account
en.explain: Sections 10(1) and (2) are engaged where the institution knows, from publicly known information or information in its own possession, that a customer or beneficial owner is or has become a politically exposed person. The same formulation appears in section 5(3)(b). There is no requirement of a formal Gazette designation, a supply of information specifically by the relevant authority, or a customer's own account-opening declaration.

tc.q: 附表2第10條的政治人物規定，源自哪些知悉途徑？
options: 公眾已知的資料，或該機構本身管有的資料
只限在憲報正式刊登的指定公告
只限由有關當局正式向機構提供的資料
只限客戶本身在開立帳戶時所作的聲明
tc.explain: 第10(1)及(2)條在機構從公眾已知的資料，或其本身管有的資料，而知悉客戶或實益擁有人屬政治人物或已成為政治人物時適用。第5(3)(b)條採用相同的表述。條文並無規定須有憲報正式刊登的指定、由有關當局正式提供的資料，或客戶本身在開戶時所作的聲明。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10(3)條

en.q: On what two conditions do the politically exposed person requirements in section 10 cease to apply?
options: Satisfied the person is a former PEP with no high ML/TF risk, per an appropriate risk assessment
The person has been out of public office for at least five years and holds no further public appointment
The person's country of origin has been removed from the Financial Action Task Force's monitoring list
The person's account with the institution has been dormant for a continuous period of twelve months
en.explain: Section 10(3), added in 2022, disapplies subsections (1) and (2) where the institution is satisfied both that the customer or beneficial owner is a former politically exposed person, and that the former PEP does not present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing based on an appropriate risk assessment. There is no fixed five-year bar, FATF country-list test, or dormancy period in section 10(3) — the institution must make its own risk assessment.

tc.q: 第10條的政治人物規定在符合哪兩項條件下不再適用？
options: 信納該人屬前政治人物，經評估不構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該人已連續離任所有公職職務，至少滿五年，並無擔任任何進一步的公職任命
該人原任職所在的國家或地區，已從財務行動特別組織的監察名單中正式剔除
該人在該機構開立的帳戶，已連續處於不活躍狀態長達十二個月之久
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第10(3)條訂明，如機構信納該客戶或實益擁有人屬前政治人物，並且該前政治人物根據適當的風險評估不構成洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的高風險，則第(1)及(2)款並不適用。第10(3)條並無固定五年期限、財務行動特別組織國家名單測試，或帳戶不活躍期的規定——機構必須自行作出風險評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(1)條

en.q: Where the beneficiary of an insurance policy is designated by description rather than by name, what must the financial institution do?
options: Obtain enough information to identify them by the earlier of rights exercise or payout
Simply record the beneficiary's name, exactly as it would for a beneficiary identified by name
Treat the policy holder itself as the beneficiary for the purposes of customer due diligence
Verify the identity of every individual who could possibly fall within that description
en.explain: Section 11(1)(b) requires the institution, where the beneficiary is designated by description or other means, to obtain sufficient information about the beneficiary to satisfy itself that it will be able to establish the beneficiary's identity at the time rights are exercised or at the time of the first payout, whichever is the earlier. Simply recording a name is the section 11(1)(a) treatment for a beneficiary identified by name, not one designated by description; treating the policy holder as the beneficiary, and verifying every person who might fit the description, both go further than section 11(1)(b) requires.

tc.q: 如保險保單的受益人是以描述而非姓名指定，金融機構須怎樣做？
options: 取得資料以能在較早行使權利或首次派款時，確定受益人身分
只須記錄該受益人的姓名，猶如以姓名獲識別的受益人一樣
就客戶盡職審查而言，一律視保單持有人本身為該受益人
須核實所有可能符合該項描述的每一個人的實際身分
tc.explain: 第11(1)(b)條規定，如受益人是以描述或其他方式指定，機構須取得關於該受益人的充分資料，以令其信納能在該受益人行使保單所賦予的權利時，或按保單條款首次派款時（以較早者為準）確定該受益人的身分。單純記錄姓名是第11(1)(a)條就以姓名識別的受益人所作的處理，並不適用於以描述指定的受益人；視保單持有人為受益人，或核實每一個可能符合描述的人的身分，均超出第11(1)(b)條的實際規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(2)條

en.q: At what point must a financial institution verify the identity of an insurance policy beneficiary under section 11(2) of Schedule 2?
options: When the beneficiary exercises a policy right, or at first payout, whichever is earlier
Only once the payout amount exceeds $120,000, the occasional-transaction CDD threshold
At the time the insurance policy is first issued to the policy holder, in every case
Within 30 days after the beneficiary is designated or identified by the policy holder
en.explain: Section 11(2) requires the specified measures to be carried out at the time the beneficiary exercises a right vested in them under the policy, or at the time of payout (or the first payout where there is more than one), whichever is the earlier. $120,000 is the unrelated section 3(1)(b) occasional-transaction threshold; policy issuance and a 30-day window after designation are not the trigger the Ordinance uses.

tc.q: 根據附表2第11(2)條，金融機構須於何時核實保險保單受益人的身分？
options: 該受益人行使保單權利時，或首次派款時，以較早者為準
只在派款超過120,000元（非經常交易門檻）時
在任何情況下，一律於保單首次向持有人簽發之時
於保單持有人首次指定或識別該受益人之後30日內
tc.explain: 第11(2)條規定須於該受益人行使保單所賦予其的權利時，或於派款時（如有多於一次派款，則為首次派款時），以較早者為準，進行所指明的措施。120,000元是第3(1)(b)條就非經常交易另行訂立、與本條無關的門檻；保單簽發時或指定後30日內，均非本條例採用的觸發時點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(3)(b)條

en.q: Where an insurance policy beneficiary is a legal person or trust, when must the institution verify the beneficial owners' identities?
options: Where there is high ML/TF risk given the beneficial owners' circumstances; identification alone otherwise
Using documents, data or information provided by a governmental body or other source recognized by the relevant authority
Never — identifying the legal person or trust itself is always sufficient on its own
Only where the payout to the beneficiary exceeds $8,000, the wire-transfer CDD threshold
en.explain: Section 11(3)(b) requires identifying the beneficial owners of a beneficiary that is a legal person or trust and, if there is a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing having regard to the particular circumstances of the beneficial owners, taking reasonable measures to verify their identities so that the institution knows who they are. Verifying the beneficiary itself using governmental-body documents is the separate section 11(3)(a) limb; identification of the legal person is always required, not merely sufficient on its own; and $8,000 is the unrelated wire-transfer threshold.

tc.q: 如保險保單受益人是法人或信託，機構須於何時核實實益擁有人的身分？
options: 當顧及該等實益擁有人的特定情況而存在高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險時；否則只須識別
依據政府機構，或有關當局認可的其他來源所提供的文件、數據或資料
永不需要——單獨識別該法人或信託本身已經足夠
只在向受益人的派款超過8,000元（電傳轉賬的客戶盡職審查門檻）時
tc.explain: 第11(3)(b)條規定須識別屬法人或信託的受益人的實益擁有人；如顧及該等實益擁有人的特定情況而存在高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，則須採取合理措施核實其身分，以令該機構知悉他們是何人。以政府機構文件核實受益人本身，是另一項規定，見第11(3)(a)款；識別該法人本身是必然要求，並非單獨已經足夠；而8,000元則是與本條無關的電傳轉賬門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)(a)及(b)條

en.q: Which wire transfers are excluded from section 12 of Schedule 2 on the basis of who the parties are?
options: Between two financial institutions, or a financial institution and a foreign institution, each on its own behalf
A transfer arising from a credit, debit or prepaid card transaction, where the card number is included in the payment message
Any wire transfer between two institutions physically located in Hong Kong
Any wire transfer involving an amount below $8,000, whatever the parties' identity
en.explain: Section 12(2)(a) and (b) exclude a wire transfer between two financial institutions if each acts on its own behalf, and a wire transfer between a financial institution and a foreign institution if each acts on its own behalf. Acting on one's own behalf, rather than for a customer, is the key. The card-transaction exclusion is the separate section 12(2)(c) limb; being located in Hong Kong describes a 'domestic wire transfer' under section 12(11), not an exclusion from section 12 altogether; and there is no blanket $8,000 exclusion — the threshold instead determines which recording duties apply.

tc.q: 按照交易各方的身分，哪些電傳轉賬不受附表2第12條規管？
options: 兩間金融機構之間，或金融機構與外地機構之間的電傳轉賬，而各方均為其本身行事
因信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡交易而產生的電傳轉賬，且卡號已載於付款訊息內
任何在兩間位於香港的機構之間進行的電傳轉賬
任何款額低於8,000元的電傳轉賬，不論各方身分為何
tc.explain: 第12(2)(a)及(b)條將兩間金融機構之間（各方均為其本身行事）的電傳轉賬，以及金融機構與外地機構之間（各方均為其本身行事）的電傳轉賬排除在外。關鍵在於各方是為其本身而非為客戶行事。信用卡交易的排除是另一項規定，見第12(2)(c)款；位於香港只是第12(11)條「本地電傳轉賬」的定義元素，並非令第12條完全不適用的理由；本條亦無一律豁免8,000元以下轉賬的規定——該門檻只是決定適用哪些記錄責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)(c)條

en.q: Three conditions must all be met for the card-transaction exclusion in section 12(2)(c) of Schedule 2. Which is one of them?
options: The card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer
The transaction is carried out within Hong Kong only
The cardholder has been subject to full CDD within the preceding twelve months
The transaction amount is below $8,000
en.explain: Section 12(2)(c) requires that the transfer arises from a credit, debit or prepaid card transaction such as an ATM withdrawal, cash advance or payment for goods or services; that the card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer; and that the card number or equivalent unique identifier accompanies the transfer.

tc.q: 附表2第12(2)(c)條的信用卡交易例外須同時符合三項條件。下列何者為其中一項？
options: 該卡並非用作支付系統以進行人對人轉帳
該交易只在香港境內進行
該持卡人於過去十二個月內已接受全面客戶盡職審查
交易款額低於8,000元
tc.explain: 第12(2)(c)條規定：該轉帳源自信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡交易（例如自動櫃員機提款、信用卡透支現金或以卡支付貨品或服務）；該卡並非用作支付系統以進行人對人轉帳；及該卡的號碼（或等同的獨有識別碼）載於隨附該轉帳的訊息或付款表格內。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3)條

en.q: Which items must an ordering institution record before carrying out a wire transfer under section 12(3) of Schedule 2?
options: Originator's name, account/ref number and address; recipient's name and account number
Only the originator's name, the transfer amount, and the prevailing exchange rate applied
Only the recipient's name, their residential address, and their stated occupation
The originator's name, the stated purpose of the transfer, and the originator's occupation
en.explain: Section 12(3) requires the ordering institution to record the originator's name; the number of the originator's account from which the money is paid or a unique reference number; the originator's address, customer identification number or identification document number or, for an individual, date and place of birth; the recipient's name; and the recipient's account number or a unique reference number. The transfer amount and exchange rate, the recipient's address or occupation, and the originator's stated purpose or occupation are not items section 12(3) requires to be recorded.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(3)條，匯出機構在進行電傳轉賬前須記錄哪些項目？
options: 匯款人姓名、帳戶號碼、地址；收款人姓名及帳戶
只需匯款人姓名、該電傳轉賬的金額，以及所採用的現行匯率
只需收款人姓名、其居住地址，以及其所述職業
匯款人姓名、該項轉賬所述的目的，以及匯款人的職業
tc.explain: 第12(3)條規定匯出機構須記錄匯款人姓名；支付該電傳轉賬款項的匯款人帳戶號碼，或（如無該帳戶）該機構為該電傳轉賬編配的獨有參考編號；匯款人地址、客戶識別編號或身分證明文件號碼，或（如匯款人是個人）其出生日期及地點；收款人姓名；以及收款人帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號。轉賬金額及匯率、收款人的地址或職業，以及匯款人所述的目的或職業，均非第12(3)條要求記錄的項目。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(3A)條

en.q: Which recording requirement does NOT apply to a wire transfer below $8,000?
options: Section 12(3)(c) — address, ID number, or date/place of birth
Section 12(3)(a) — the originator's name, which must always be recorded
Section 12(3)(d) — the recipient's name, which must always be recorded
Section 12(3)(e) — the recipient's account or reference number, always required
en.explain: Section 12(3A) provides that section 12(3)(c) does not apply to a wire transfer involving an amount below $8,000 or the equivalent in another currency. The name and account details of both originator and recipient — section 12(3)(a), (d) and (e) — must still be recorded regardless of amount.

tc.q: 就低於8,000元的電傳轉賬，哪一項記錄規定並不適用？
options: 第12(3)(c)條——地址、身分文件號碼，或出生日期地點
第12(3)(a)條——匯款人姓名，此項須一律記錄
第12(3)(d)條——收款人姓名，此項須一律記錄
第12(3)(e)條——收款人帳戶或參考編號，此項須記錄
tc.explain: 第12(3A)條訂明，第12(3)(c)款不適用於涉及款額低於8,000元（或另一貨幣等值款額）的電傳轉賬。匯款人及收款人的姓名及帳戶詳情——即第12(3)(a)、(d)及(e)款——不論款額多寡，仍須記錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(5)(b)條

en.q: For a wire transfer below $8,000, which recorded information must accompany the transfer in the message or payment form?
options: Under section 12(3)(a), (b), (d) and (e) — names and account numbers of originator and recipient
All the information recorded under section 12(3), including the originator's address under paragraph (c)
Only the originator's name recorded under section 12(3)(a), and nothing else
No accompanying information at all is required below the $8,000 threshold
en.explain: Section 12(5)(b) requires, for a transfer below $8,000, the information recorded under section 12(3)(a), (b), (d) and (e) to accompany the transfer. Section 12(5)(a) requires the full set including paragraph (c) for transfers of $8,000 or above; below the threshold, paragraph (c) is dropped but the rest is not, and some accompanying information is always required regardless of amount.

tc.q: 就低於8,000元的電傳轉賬，訊息或付款表格內須隨附哪些已記錄的資料？
options: 根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(d)及(e)款記錄的資料——即匯款人及收款人的姓名及帳戶號碼
根據第12(3)條記錄的所有資料，包括第(c)款的匯款人地址
只需根據第12(3)(a)款記錄的匯款人姓名，其他一概不需要
低於8,000元的門檻，完全無須隨附任何資料
tc.explain: 第12(5)(b)條規定，就低於8,000元的電傳轉賬，須隨附根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(d)及(e)款記錄的資料。第12(5)(a)條則就8,000元或以上的電傳轉賬，規定須隨附包括(c)款在內的全套資料；低於門檻時只是略去(c)款，其餘資料並非一概免除，亦非完全無須隨附任何資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(6)條

en.q: A financial institution includes only the originator's account number with a domestic wire transfer. What must it then be able to do?
options: Provide the originator's name and address within 3 business days of a request
Automatically provide the full section 12(3) information to every institution in the payment chain
Obtain the relevant authority's prior written approval before using the abbreviated format
Repeat the wire transfer in full format within 24 hours of the original transfer
en.explain: Section 12(6) permits a domestic wire transfer to carry only the section 12(3)(b) account information, but requires the institution, on request by the institution to which it passes the transfer instruction or by the relevant authority, to provide the section 12(3)(a) and (c) information within 3 business days after receiving the request — not to every institution automatically, not subject to prior approval, and not by repeating the transfer.

tc.q: 某金融機構就本地電傳轉賬只附上匯款人的帳戶號碼。它其後須能夠作出甚麼？
options: 在接獲要求後3個營業日內，提供匯款人的姓名及地址
自動向付款鏈上的每一間機構提供第12(3)條的全套資料
事先取得有關當局的書面批准，方可使用該簡化格式
於原轉賬後24小時內，以完整格式重新進行該電傳轉賬
tc.explain: 第12(6)條准許本地電傳轉賬只附上第12(3)(b)款的帳戶資料，但規定該機構須應其傳遞轉賬指示的機構或有關當局的要求，在接獲要求後3個營業日內提供第12(3)(a)及(c)款的資料——並非自動向每一間機構提供、亦非須事先取得批准，亦非須重新進行該電傳轉賬。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(7)條

en.q: Several individual wire transfers from a single originator are bundled in a batch file for recipients outside Hong Kong. On what conditions is the ordering institution relieved of the full accompanying-information requirement for each transfer?
options: Section 12(3)(b) details accompany each transfer, and the batch file carries s.12(3) info
The batch contains no more than 100 individual wire transfers from that single originator
Each individual transfer in the batch involves an amount below $8,000 or its currency equivalent
All the recipients are located at institutions in an equivalent overseas jurisdiction
en.explain: Section 12(7) relieves the institution from complying with section 12(5) for each individual transfer in a cross-border batch file if the information recorded under section 12(3)(b) is included in the message or payment form accompanying each transfer, and the batch file contains the information recorded under section 12(3). There is no 100-transfer cap, no universal below-$8,000 requirement, and no requirement that every recipient be in an equivalent jurisdiction.

tc.q: 來自單一匯款人的多筆個別電傳轉賬，被匯集於一個批次檔案內以轉送香港以外的收款人。匯出機構在甚麼條件下可獲免除就每筆轉賬附上全套資料的規定？
options: 每筆附12(3)(b)款資料，批次載12(3)條資料
該批次包含不多於100筆來自該匯款人的個別電傳轉賬
批次內每筆個別電傳轉賬均低於8,000元或其貨幣等值款額
所有收款人均位於同等海外司法管轄區的機構
tc.explain: 第12(7)條訂明，如隨附每筆轉賬的訊息或付款表格載有根據第12(3)(b)款記錄的資料，而該批次檔案載有根據第12(3)條記錄的資料，則機構無須就跨境批次檔案內的每筆電傳轉賬遵從第12(5)條。條文並無100筆的上限、亦非規定每筆均須低於8,000元，亦非規定每名收款人均須位於同等司法管轄區。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(8)條

en.q: What is the obligation of a financial institution acting as an intermediary institution in a wire transfer?
options: It must pass on all the information it receives to the next institution in the chain
It must independently verify the originator's identity before passing the transfer instruction on
It must re-record all the transfer information afresh in its own institutional format
It must retain the information it receives, but pass on only the account numbers involved
en.explain: Section 12(8) requires a financial institution acting as an intermediary institution in a wire transfer to transmit all of the information that it receives with the transfer to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction. Stripping, re-recording, or independently re-verifying information along the chain is not permitted — the intermediary simply passes everything on unchanged.

tc.q: 在電傳轉賬中擔任中介機構的金融機構有何責任？
options: 須將收到的所有資料，傳送予收取轉賬指示的機構
須在傳遞轉賬指示前，獨立核實匯款人的身分
須以其本身機構的格式，將全部轉賬資料重新記錄
須保留其收到的資料，但只傳遞涉及的帳戶號碼
tc.explain: 第12(8)條規定，在電傳轉賬中擔任中介機構的金融機構，須將其連同該項轉賬一併收到的所有資料，傳送予收取它轉賬指示的機構。在傳遞鏈中刪減、重新記錄或獨立重新核實資料，均不獲准許——中介機構只須將所有資料原封不動地傳遞。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(10)(a)條

en.q: A beneficiary institution receives a cross-border wire transfer missing required information and cannot obtain it from the sending institution. What are its options?
options: Consider restricting or terminating the relationship with it, or take measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk
Immediately return the funds to the originator, and notify the originator's bank of the deficiency
Complete the transfer as normal, and record the deficiency for the next scheduled annual audit
Report the sending institution to the relevant authority, and suspend all future transfers from it
en.explain: Section 12(10)(a)(ii) requires the institution, where missing information cannot be obtained, either to consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with the institution from which it received the transfer instruction, or to take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved. Returning funds with a bank notification, completing the transfer for later audit, and reporting with a suspension are all plausible-sounding but fictitious two-step procedures — none appears in section 12(10)(a).

tc.q: 收款機構收到一筆缺少所需資料的跨境電傳轉賬，並且無法從匯出機構取得該等資料。它有哪些選擇？
options: 考慮限制／終止業務關係，或採取措施減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
立即將款項退回匯款人，並另行通知匯款人的銀行有關資料不足之處
照常完成該電傳轉賬，並將該項不足之處記錄下來，留待年度審計處理
向有關當局舉報該匯出機構，並暫停接收該機構日後的所有轉賬
tc.explain: 第12(10)(a)(ii)條規定，如無法取得欠缺的資料，機構須考慮限制或終止與其接獲轉賬指示的機構的業務關係，或採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。退款並通知銀行、完成轉賬留待年度審計，以及舉報並暫停轉賬，均屬似是而非的兩步驟做法，第12(10)(a)條並無此等規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(10)(b)條

en.q: A beneficiary institution notices that the information accompanying a cross-border wire transfer is incomplete or meaningless. What must it do?
options: As soon as practicable, take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk
Complete the transfer without further action, since some information was after all provided
Automatically reject the transfer in every case, regardless of the deficiency's nature
Refer the matter to the Review Tribunal for a determination before proceeding
en.explain: Section 12(10)(b) requires the institution, where it is aware that accompanying information purporting to be the required information is incomplete or meaningless, to take reasonable measures as soon as reasonably practicable to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved. Completing the transfer regardless, an automatic rejection rule, and a mandatory referral to the Review Tribunal before acting are not what section 12(10)(b) provides.

tc.q: 收款機構察覺隨附跨境電傳轉賬的資料不完整或無意義。它須怎樣做？
options: 須盡快採取措施，減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
既已提供部分資料，即可照常完成轉賬，無須再採取任何行動
不論不足之處的性質為何，一律自動拒絕該項電傳轉賬
須先將事宜轉交審裁處作出裁定，然後方可繼續處理
tc.explain: 第12(10)(b)條規定，如機構察覺看來是所需資料的隨附資料並不完整或無意義，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。不論資料是否足夠即照常完成轉賬、一律自動拒絕，或須先轉交審裁處裁定，均非第12(10)(b)條的規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.12(11) (definition of “domestic wire transfer”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(11)條（「本地電匯」的定義）

en.q: What makes a wire transfer a "domestic wire transfer" under section 12(11) of Schedule 2?
options: The ordering, beneficiary and any intermediary institution are all financial institutions in Hong Kong
The originator and the recipient are both individuals holding Hong Kong identity cards
The transfer is denominated in Hong Kong dollars and settled through the local clearing system
The transfer amount is below $8,000, the CDD threshold that applies to wire transfers generally
en.explain: Section 12(11) defines domestic wire transfer as a wire transfer in which the ordering institution and the beneficiary institution and, if one or more intermediary institutions are involved, the intermediary institution or all the intermediary institutions are financial institutions located in Hong Kong. The definition turns on where the institutions are located, not on the originator's and recipient's residency, the currency used, or the transfer amount.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(11)條，甚麼令一筆電傳轉賬成為「本地電傳轉賬」？
options: 匯出機構、收款機構，每一間中介機構，均為香港的金融機構
匯款人及收款人均為持有香港身分證的個人
該電傳轉賬以港元計值，並透過港元結算系統結算
該轉賬款額低於8,000元，即電傳轉賬的盡職審查門檻
tc.explain: 第12(11)條界定「本地電傳轉賬」為：匯出機構及收款機構，以及（如涉及一間或多於一間中介機構）該中介機構或所有中介機構，均為位於香港的金融機構的電傳轉賬。定義的關鍵在於有關機構的所在地，並非匯款人及收款人的居籍、所用貨幣，或轉賬款額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(11)條（「匯款人」的定義）

en.q: Who is the "originator" of a wire transfer under section 12(11) of Schedule 2?
options: The person from whose account with the ordering institution the money is paid or, absent such an account, who instructs the transfer
The person who benefits from the funds, or if unknown, whoever the receiving institution identifies as the likely beneficiary
The financial institution that initiates the transfer, or if more than one is involved, the first in the chain
The person named as sender in the accompanying message, or if unnamed, the account holder shown in the payment form
en.explain: Section 12(11) defines originator, in relation to a wire transfer, as the person from whose account with the ordering institution the money for the wire transfer is paid, or, in the absence of such an account, the person who instructs the ordering institution to carry out the wire transfer — always a person on the paying side, never the ultimate beneficiary, the initiating institution, or whoever a message happens to name.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(11)條，電傳轉賬的「匯款人」是誰？
options: 支付該款項的、在匯出機構開立帳戶的人；如無該帳戶，則為指示該項轉賬的人
最終從該筆資金得益的人；如不能確定，則為收款機構認定的相關受益人
發起該轉賬的金融機構；如涉及多於一間，則為該鏈中的第一間機構
隨附訊息內列為寄款人的人；如未有列明，則為付款表格所示的帳戶持有人
tc.explain: 第12(11)條就電傳轉賬界定「匯款人」為：支付該電傳轉賬款項的、在匯出機構開立帳戶的人；或如無該帳戶，則為指示匯出機構進行該電傳轉賬的人——「匯款人」始終是付款一方的人，並非最終得益人、發起轉賬的機構，或訊息碰巧列明的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(11)條（「外地機構」的定義）

en.q: How is a "foreign institution" defined for the purposes of section 12 of Schedule 2?
options: Located outside Hong Kong, and carrying on a business similar to that of a financial institution
Incorporated outside Hong Kong, and licensed by that jurisdiction's own securities regulator
Supervised by an authority outside Hong Kong, and listed on a recognized stock market
Not an authorized institution, and not itself supervised by the Monetary Authority
en.explain: Section 12(11) defines foreign institution as an institution that is located in a place outside Hong Kong and that carries on a business similar to that carried on by a financial institution. The definition matters for the section 12(2)(b) exclusion. Where it is incorporated, who supervises it, and whether it is listed or itself an authorized institution are not part of this two-part test.

tc.q: 就附表2第12條而言，「外地機構」如何界定？
options: 位於香港以外地方，並經營與金融機構所經營者類似的業務
在香港以外註冊成立，並獲該司法管轄區本身的證券監管機構發牌
受香港以外的當局監管，並於認可證券市場上市
並非認可機構，本身亦不受金融管理專員監管
tc.explain: 第12(11)條界定「外地機構」為位於香港以外地方，並經營與金融機構所經營者類似業務的機構。此定義對第12(2)(b)條的例外規定十分重要。在何處註冊成立、由誰監管，以及是否上市或本身是否屬認可機構，均非此兩部分定義的內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(1)條

en.q: To which transactions does section 13 of Schedule 2 apply?
options: A remittance transaction (not a wire transfer) of $8,000 or more, carried out by a licensed money service operator
Any remittance transaction of any amount, carried out by any financial institution whatsoever
Only remittance transactions involving $120,000 or more, the occasional-transaction CDD threshold
All wire transfers, of any amount, carried out by a licensed money service operator
en.explain: Section 13(1) applies to a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, involving an amount equal to or above $8,000 or the equivalent in any other currency, that is carried out by a licensed money service operator. $120,000 is the unrelated section 3(1)(b) occasional-transaction threshold; wire transfers are excluded from section 13 altogether and instead governed by section 12; and the section only applies to licensed MSOs, not financial institutions generally.

tc.q: 附表2第13條適用於哪些交易？
options: 由持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及款額8,000元或以上、並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易
任何金融機構進行的、任何款額的任何匯款交易
只限涉及120,000元或以上的匯款交易，即非經常交易的客戶盡職審查門檻
持牌金錢服務經營者進行的所有電傳轉賬，不論款額多寡
tc.explain: 第13(1)條適用於由持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元（或任何其他貨幣等值款額）、並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易。120,000元是第3(1)(b)條就非經常交易另行訂立、與本條無關的門檻；電傳轉賬完全不受第13條規管，而是由第12條規管；本條亦只適用於持牌金錢服務經營者，並非一般金融機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)(b)條

en.q: By reference to what must a licensed MSO verify the identity of the originator of a section 13 remittance transaction?
options: The originator's identification document
A written declaration signed by the originator
A reference from another licensed money service operator
A record of the originator's previous transactions with the MSO
en.explain: Section 13(2) requires the licensed MSO, before carrying out the remittance transaction, to identify the originator and to verify the originator's identity by reference to the originator's identification document, and then to record the specified particulars.

tc.q: 持牌金錢服務經營者須參照甚麼核實第13條匯款交易的匯款人身分？
options: 該匯款人的身分證明文件
該匯款人簽署的書面聲明
另一持牌金錢服務經營者的推薦
該匯款人過往與該經營者的交易紀錄
tc.explain: 第13(2)條規定持牌金錢服務經營者在進行該匯款交易前，須識別匯款人，並參照該匯款人的身分證明文件核實其身分，繼而記錄所指明的詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)(c)(ii)條

en.q: Where the originator's identification document is a travel document, what additional particular must a licensed MSO record?
options: The place of issue of the travel document
The expiry date of the travel document
The originator's nationality as stated in the document
The visa status of the originator
en.explain: Section 13(2)(c)(ii) requires the MSO to record the originator's identification document number and, if the identification document is a travel document, the place of issue of the travel document.

tc.q: 如匯款人的身分證明文件是旅行證件，持牌金錢服務經營者須另行記錄甚麼詳情？
options: 該旅行證件的簽發地點
該旅行證件的屆滿日期
該旅行證件所載國籍
該匯款人的簽證狀況
tc.explain: 第13(2)(c)(ii)條規定該經營者須記錄匯款人的身分證明文件號碼；如該身分證明文件是旅行證件，並須記錄該旅行證件的簽發地點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)(c)(v)條

en.q: Which of the following must a licensed MSO record under section 13(2)(c)(v) of Schedule 2?
options: The date and time instructions were received, the recipient's name and address, and delivery method
The currency and amount involved, and the exchange rate applied to the transaction
The originator's occupation, employer, and the purpose of the remittance
The purpose of the remittance, and the relationship between the originator and recipient
en.explain: Section 13(2)(c) requires recording the originator's name; identification document number and, for a travel document, place of issue; address; the currency and amount involved under paragraph (iv); and, under paragraph (v), the date and time of receipt of the instructions, the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery. Currency and amount is a real but different item (paragraph (iv), not (v)); occupation, employer, purpose and the parties' relationship are not items section 13(2)(c) requires at all.

tc.q: 根據附表2第13(2)(c)(v)條，持牌金錢服務經營者須記錄下列哪項？
options: 接獲指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及交付方法
所涉的貨幣及款額，以及該宗交易所採用的匯率
匯款人的職業、僱主，以及匯款目的
匯款目的，以及匯款人與收款人之間的關係
tc.explain: 第13(2)(c)條規定須記錄匯款人姓名；身分證明文件號碼，及（如屬旅行證件）簽發地點；地址；第(iv)節所指的所涉貨幣及款額；以及第(v)節所指的接獲指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址和交付方法。貨幣及款額是真實但屬另一項目（第(iv)節，並非第(v)節）；職業、僱主、匯款目的及雙方關係，均非第13(2)(c)條要求記錄的項目。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(3)條（「匯款交易」的定義）

en.q: How is “remittance transaction” defined for the purposes of section 13 of Schedule 2?
options: A transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong
A transaction for receiving, or arranging for the receiving of, money from a place outside Hong Kong
A transaction carried out by an institution to make virtual assets available to a recipient at another institution
Any transfer of money between two parties within Hong Kong, exceeding $8,000 in value
en.explain: Section 13(3) defines remittance transaction as a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong. It does not extend to receiving money from outside Hong Kong — that broader coverage belongs to the Schedule 1 definition of "remittance service". It is also distinct from a "virtual asset transfer" under section 13A(1), and it carries no monetary threshold.

tc.q: 就附表2第13條而言，「匯款交易」如何界定？
options: 將金錢寄往香港以外地方或安排寄往香港以外地方的交易
從香港以外地方收取金錢，或安排收取金錢的交易
由機構進行，旨在使虛擬資產在另一機構供收款人取用的交易
香港境內兩方之間超過8,000元的金錢轉移
tc.explain: 第13(3)條界定「匯款交易」為將金錢寄往香港以外地方或安排寄往香港以外地方的交易。此定義並不涵蓋從香港以外地方收取金錢——後者屬附表1「匯款服務」定義的範圍。此定義亦有別於第13A(1)條的「虛擬資產轉移」，且並無設定任何金額門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(3)條（「匯款人」的定義）

en.q: Who is the “originator” of a remittance transaction carried out by a licensed MSO?
options: The person from whose account with the MSO the money is paid or, absent such an account, the person who instructs the MSO to carry out the transaction
The person from whose account with the ordering institution the wire-transfer money is paid or, absent that, whoever instructs the wire transfer
The person named as recipient in the instruction, or, if none is named, the person who collects the money at the counter
The MSO's staff member who processes the transaction, or, in their absence, the branch manager who authorises it
en.explain: Section 13(3) defines originator, in relation to a remittance transaction carried out by a licensed MSO, as the person from whose account with the MSO the money is paid, or, absent such an account, the person who instructs the MSO to carry it out. The near-identical wording elsewhere in Schedule 2 applies the same test to the 'originator' of a wire transfer through the ordering institution — a different provision for a different transaction type. The recipient named in the instruction and the staff member who processes the transaction are not the originator.

tc.q: 持牌金錢服務經營者進行的匯款交易的「匯款人」是誰？
options: 支付該匯款款項的、在該經營者開立帳戶的人；如無該帳戶，則為指示該經營者進行該交易的人
支付電傳轉賬款項的、在匯出機構開立帳戶的人；如無該帳戶，則為指示進行該電傳轉賬的人
指示中列為收款人的人；如指示中無列明收款人，則為在櫃檯實際收取該筆款項的人
負責處理該宗交易的該經營者職員；如該職員不在場，則為批准該交易的分行經理
tc.explain: 第13(3)條就持牌金錢服務經營者進行的匯款交易，將「匯款人」界定為：支付該匯款款項的、在該經營者開立帳戶的人；或如無該帳戶，則為指示該經營者進行該交易的人。附表2其他部分幾乎相同的字眼，是將同一測試套用於電傳轉賬透過匯出機構認定的「匯款人」——屬另一條文規管的另一種交易。指示中列明的收款人及處理交易的職員均非「匯款人」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13A(1)條

en.q: What are the two essential elements of a “virtual asset transfer” under section 13A(1) of Schedule 2?
options: Carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator by transferring virtual assets, with a view to making them available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution
Carried out by a beneficiary institution on behalf of a recipient by receiving virtual assets, with a view to returning them to an originator at an ordering institution
Carried out directly between two individuals with absolutely no institution involved at any point, and must exceed $8,000 in value to qualify
Involves converting virtual assets into fiat currency at the prevailing market rate, and requires at least one intermediary institution to participate throughout
en.explain: Section 13A(1) requires both elements: the transfer is carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator by transferring virtual assets, and it is made with a view to making those virtual assets available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution. Reversing those roles (a beneficiary institution acting for a recipient to return assets to an originator) describes no provision in the Ordinance. A no-institution peer-to-peer transfer with a value threshold, and a currency-conversion transaction requiring an intermediary institution, are also absent from section 13A(1) — intermediary institutions are optional ('whether or not... participate').

tc.q: 根據附表2第13A(1)條，「虛擬資產轉移」的兩項要素是甚麼？
options: 由匯出機構代匯款人以轉移虛擬資產的方式進行，並旨在使該等虛擬資產可在收款機構供收款人取用
由收款機構代收款人以接收虛擬資產的方式進行，並旨在將該等虛擬資產交回在匯出機構的匯款人
在兩名個人之間直接進行，完全沒有機構參與，且須超過8,000元的價值方符資格
涉及將虛擬資產兌換為法定貨幣，並須全程至少有一間中介機構參與
tc.explain: 第13A(1)條規定兩項要素缺一不可：該轉移須由匯出機構代匯款人以轉移虛擬資產的方式進行，並須旨在使該等虛擬資產可在收款機構供收款人取用。將角色對調（由收款機構代收款人將資產交回在匯出機構的匯款人）並非本條例任何條文所訂。條文亦沒有規定必須無機構參與並設有金額門檻的直接交易，或須兌換為法定貨幣並須有中介機構全程參與——中介機構是否參與純屬可有可無（「不論是否有中介機構參與」）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(1)(a)條

en.q: Where the beneficiary of an insurance policy is identified by name, what must the financial institution do at that point?
options: Record the name of the beneficiary
Verify the beneficiary's identity immediately
Obtain senior management approval for the designation
Notify the relevant authority of the designation
en.explain: Section 11(1)(a) requires the institution, whenever a beneficiary or new beneficiary is identified or designated by the policy holder, to record the name of the beneficiary where the beneficiary is identified by name. Verification comes later, under section 11(2).

tc.q: 如保險保單的受益人是以姓名識別，金融機構當時須怎樣做？
options: 記錄該受益人的姓名
即時核實該受益人的身分
就該項指定取得高級管理層批准
將該項指定通知有關當局
tc.explain: 第11(1)(a)條規定，每當保單持有人識別或指定受益人或新受益人時，如該受益人是以姓名識別，機構須記錄該受益人的姓名。核實則按第11(2)條在較後階段進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(b)條

en.q: What is the supplementary measure available under section 9(1)(b) of Schedule 2 for a non-face-to-face customer?
options: Taking supplementary measures to verify information relating to the customer that the institution has already obtained
Further verifying the customer's identity using documents or information not previously used for that purpose
Ensuring the first payment is made through an account opened in the customer's name with an authorized institution
Obtaining senior management approval before establishing the business relationship with the customer
en.explain: Section 9(1)(b) is one of three alternative measures for a non-face-to-face customer: further verification under paragraph (a), the supplementary-measures option in paragraph (b), or routing the first payment through an authorized institution account under paragraph (c). The further-verification and payment-routing options describe paragraphs (a) and (c), not (b). Senior management approval before establishing a relationship is instead a section 15 high-risk-situation requirement, not a section 9 non-face-to-face measure.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)(b)條就非面對面客戶提供甚麼補充措施？
options: 採取補充措施，核實該機構已取得的、關於該客戶的資料
進一步核實該客戶的身分，使用先前未曾用於該目的的文件或資料
確保首次付款透過以該客戶名義在認可機構開立的帳戶進行
在與該客戶建立業務關係前，先取得高級管理層的批准
tc.explain: 第9(1)(b)條是非面對面客戶三項可選措施之一：(a)款的進一步核實、(b)款的補充措施，或(c)款透過認可機構帳戶處理首次付款。「進一步核實身分」及「透過認可機構帳戶付款」分別是(a)及(c)款的做法，並非(b)款。至於在建立業務關係前取得高級管理層批准，則屬第15條高風險情況的規定，並非第9條非面對面客戶的措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(9)(a)條

en.q: A beneficiary institution in a domestic wire transfer finds the section 12(3)(b) account information missing. What must it do first?
options: As soon as reasonably practicable, obtain the information from the institution that sent the transfer instruction
Consider restricting or terminating its relationship with the institution that sent the transfer instruction
Take reasonable measures to mitigate the money laundering or terrorist financing risk involved
Report the omission to the relevant authority within 3 business days of discovering it
en.explain: Section 12(9)(a)(i) requires the beneficiary institution, as soon as reasonably practicable, to obtain the missing information from the institution that sent the transfer instruction — the mandatory first step. Only if the information cannot be obtained does sub-paragraph (ii) come into play, offering a choice between restricting or terminating the relationship or mitigating the ML/TF risk; neither is available as a first response. Section 12(9) contains no 3-business-day reporting duty.

tc.q: 本地電傳轉賬的收款機構發現欠缺第12(3)(b)款的帳戶資料。它須首先怎樣做？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快，向發出該轉帳指示的機構取得該資料
考慮限制或終止與發出該轉帳指示的機構的業務關係
採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
在發現遺漏後3個營業日內向有關當局報告該項遺漏
tc.explain: 第12(9)(a)(i)條規定收款機構須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快，向發出該轉帳指示的機構取得欠缺的資料——此為必須採取的第一步。只有在無法取得該資料時，方會引用(ii)節，在限制或終止關係，或減低洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險之間作出選擇；兩者均不可作為第一步的回應。第12(9)條並無3個營業日的舉報規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(5)(a)條

en.q: For a wire transfer of $8,000 or above, which information must accompany the transfer?
options: All the information recorded under section 12(3)(a), (b), (c), (d) and (e)
Only the originator's and recipient's names
Only the account numbers of originator and recipient
Information recorded under section 12(3) except the recipient's details
en.explain: Section 12(5)(a) requires, for a wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000 or the equivalent in another currency, that the information recorded under section 12(3)(a), (b), (c), (d) and (e) accompanies the transfer in the message or payment form.

tc.q: 就8,000元或以上的電傳轉賬，須隨附哪些資料？
options: 根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(c)、(d)及(e)款記錄的所有資料
只需匯款人及收款人的姓名
只需匯款人及收款人的帳戶號碼
根據第12(3)條記錄的資料，但收款人詳情除外
tc.explain: 第12(5)(a)條規定，就涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元（或另一貨幣等值款額）的電傳轉賬，須在訊息或付款表格內隨附根據第12(3)(a)、(b)、(c)、(d)及(e)款記錄的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)(c)(i)條

en.q: Which of the following is given in section 12(2)(c)(i) as an example of a card transaction potentially outside section 12?
options: Withdrawing money from a bank account through an automated teller machine with a debit card
Transferring funds from one cardholder to another using a card-based application
Loading value onto a prepaid card directly from the cardholder's own bank account
Settling a monthly credit card statement in full by an online bank transfer
en.explain: Section 12(2)(c)(i) gives three examples: withdrawing money from a bank account through an ATM with a debit card, obtaining a cash advance on a credit card, and paying for goods or services with a credit, debit or prepaid card. Loading a prepaid card from a bank account and settling a card statement by bank transfer are not among the examples given. A person-to-person transfer is expressly excluded from the exception by sub-paragraph (ii), regardless of the card used.

tc.q: 第12(2)(c)(i)條舉出下列哪項作為可能不受第12條規管的卡交易例子？
options: 以扣賬卡透過自動櫃員機從本人的銀行帳戶提取現金
以卡類應用程式將資金由持卡人轉至另一名持卡人
直接從持卡人本身的銀行帳戶為其名下的預付卡增值
以網上銀行轉帳方式全數清繳客戶每月的信用卡結單
tc.explain: 第12(2)(c)(i)條舉出三個例子：以扣賬卡透過自動櫃員機從銀行帳戶提款、以信用卡透支現金，以及以信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡支付貨品或服務。從銀行帳戶為預付卡增值或以銀行轉帳清繳卡結單均不屬條文所舉例子。不論使用哪種卡，(ii)節明文將人對人轉帳排除於該例外之外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13(2)條

en.q: At what point must a licensed MSO carry out the section 13 identification, verification and recording steps?
options: Before carrying out the remittance transaction
Within 24 hours after carrying out the transaction
At the end of the business day on which the transaction is carried out
Only if the transaction is later queried by the relevant authority
en.explain: Section 13(2) requires the licensed money service operator, before carrying out a remittance transaction to which section 13 applies, to identify the originator, verify the originator's identity by reference to their identification document, and record the specified particulars.

tc.q: 持牌金錢服務經營者須於何時進行第13條的識別、核實及記錄步驟？
options: 在進行該匯款交易之前
在進行該交易後24小時內
在進行該交易當日的營業時間結束前
只在該交易其後被有關當局查詢時
tc.explain: 第13(2)條規定持牌金錢服務經營者在進行第13條適用的匯款交易之前，須識別匯款人、參照其身分證明文件核實其身分，並記錄所指明的詳情。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第11(3)(a)條

en.q: On the basis of documents from which sources must a financial institution verify an insurance beneficiary's identity under section 11(3)(a)?
options: A governmental body, the relevant authority, a similar overseas authority, or another reliable and independent source it recognizes
Identifying the beneficiary's beneficial owners and, only where there is a high risk of ML/TF, verifying those owners' identities as well
Only documents provided directly by the policy holder in person, certified by the insurer's own compliance officer as authentic
Only documents issued within the preceding six months and countersigned by a legal professional practising in Hong Kong
en.explain: Section 11(3)(a) allows verification on the basis of documents, data or information from any of four sources: a governmental body; the relevant authority or any other relevant authority; a similar overseas authority; or any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority. Identifying (and, where high-risk, verifying) beneficial owners is instead the section 11(3)(b) requirement, which applies only where the beneficiary is a legal person or trust. No six-month limit, compliance-officer certification, or lawyer's countersignature appears anywhere in section 11.

tc.q: 根據第11(3)(a)條，金融機構須依據來自哪些來源的文件核實保險受益人的身分？
options: 政府機構、有關當局、職能類似的境外當局，或該當局認可為可靠而獨立的其他來源
識別該受益人的實益擁有人身分，並只在洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險高的情況下核實該等實益擁有人的身分
只限由保單持有人親自提供、並經該保險人本身的合規主任核證為真確的文件
只限在過去六個月內簽發、並經在香港執業的法律專業人士副署的文件正本
tc.explain: 第11(3)(a)條准許依據下列四類來源之一提供的文件、數據或資料進行核實：政府機構；有關當局或任何其他有關當局；職能類似的境外當局；或有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立來源。識別實益擁有人（並在高風險時核實）則是第11(3)(b)條的規定，只適用於受益人屬法人或信託的情況。第11條並無六個月期限、合規主任核證或律師副署的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)(c)(ii)條

en.q: Where the payment-routing measure uses an overseas institution rather than an authorized institution, which conditions must that institution meet?
options: Incorporated in an equivalent jurisdiction, carries on business similar to an authorized institution, has compliance measures similar to Schedule 2, and is supervised by an authority performing functions similar to the Monetary Authority

Licensed as a money service operator by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, carries on business similar to a DNFBP, has measures similar to Part 3 of Schedule 2, and is supervised by the Securities and Futures Commission

A wholly owned subsidiary of an authorized institution, carries on business similar to an insurer, has measures to ensure compliance with the Insurance Ordinance, and is supervised by the Insurance Authority
A member of an international banking group with a physical presence in Hong Kong, is listed on a recognized stock market in an equivalent jurisdiction, and reports annually to the relevant authority
en.explain: Section 9(1)(c)(ii) sets four cumulative conditions for an overseas institution used in place of an authorized institution: incorporation in an equivalent jurisdiction; a business similar to an authorized institution's; compliance measures similar to Schedule 2; and supervision by an authority performing functions similar to the Monetary Authority — not the Commissioner of Customs and Excise, the Securities and Futures Commission or the Insurance Authority, which supervise different classes of business under different ordinances. Banking-group membership, a stock market listing, or being a subsidiary of an authorized institution are not among the four conditions.

tc.q: 如付款途徑措施採用境外機構而非認可機構，該機構須符合哪些條件？
options: 在同等司法管轄區成立或設立、經營與認可機構類似的業務、設有措施確保遵從與附表2類似的規定，並由職能與金融管理專員類似的當局監督
由海關關長發牌為金錢服務經營者、經營與指定非金融企業及行業類似的業務、設有措施確保遵從附表2第3部，並受證券及期貨事務監察委員會監督
屬認可機構的全資附屬公司、經營與保險人類似的業務、設有措施確保遵從《保險業條例》，並受保險業監管局監督
屬在香港設有實體存在的國際銀行集團成員、在同等司法管轄區的認可證券市場上市，並每年向有關當局報告
tc.explain: 第9(1)(c)(ii)條就取代認可機構的境外機構訂明四項須同時符合的累積條件：在同等司法管轄區成立或設立；經營與認可機構類似的業務；設有措施確保遵從與附表2類似的規定；及由職能與金融管理專員類似的當局監督——並非海關關長、證券及期貨事務監察委員會或保險業監管局，此三者監管的是受不同條例規範的不同業務類別。國際銀行集團成員身分、證券市場上市地位，或作為認可機構附屬公司的關係，均不在該四項條件之列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15條

en.q: What two kinds of situation engage the special requirements in section 15 of Schedule 2?
options: A situation specified by the relevant authority in a written notice, and any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of ML/TF
A situation specified by the relevant authority in a written notice, and any situation involving a customer who is not resident in Hong Kong
A situation where the customer is not physically present for identification, and any situation flagged by the institution's internal audit
A situation in which a suspicious transaction report has already been filed, and any occasional transaction of $120,000 or more
en.explain: Section 15 applies in a situation specified by the relevant authority (or, for certain DNFBPs, the relevant regulatory body) in a written notice, and, separately, in any other situation that by its nature may present a high risk of money laundering or terrorist financing — the second limb is self-executing and needs no notice. Non-residence, non-face-to-face identification (which instead triggers section 9), an existing STR, and the $120,000 occasional-transaction CDD threshold in section 3 are none of them the section 15 trigger.

tc.q: 哪兩類情況會觸發附表2第15條的特別規定？
options: 有關當局以書面通知指明的情況，以及按其性質可能構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險的任何其他情況
有關當局以書面通知指明的情況，以及涉及並非通常居於香港的客戶的任何情況
客戶為身分識別目的而未能親身到場的情況，以及該機構內部審計部門標記的任何情況
已就該客戶提交可疑交易報告的情況，以及涉及金額達120,000元或以上的任何非經常交易
tc.explain: 第15條適用於有關當局（或就若干指定非金融企業及行業而言，有關監管團體）以書面通知指明的情況，以及另外，按其性質可能構成高洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險的任何其他情況——第二項屬自動適用，毋須任何通知。非香港居民、非面對面身分識別（其觸發的是第9條）、已提交可疑交易報告，以及第3條120,000元非經常交易客戶盡職審查門檻，均非第15條的觸發點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15(a)條

en.q: In a high-risk situation where a business relationship is to be established, what must an institution do under section 15(a) of Schedule 2?
options: Obtain senior management approval, and either establish source of wealth and funds or take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk
Take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved, with no senior management approval required
Obtain senior management approval to continue the relationship, and verify the beneficial owner's identity if there is one
Decline to establish the relationship in every case, regardless of the customer's source of wealth or funds
en.explain: Section 15(a) applies where a business relationship is to be established: senior management must approve establishing it, and the institution must either establish the source of wealth and funds or take additional risk-mitigating measures. Approving continuation and verifying a beneficial owner's identity are instead section 15(b) duties, which apply only once the relationship already exists. Mitigating risk with no senior management approval describes section 15(c), which governs occasional transactions, not relationships being established. Declining outright is not required by section 15 at all.

tc.q: 在擬建立業務關係的高風險情況下，機構須根據附表2第15(a)條作出甚麼？
options: 取得高級管理層批准，並須確定財富及資金來源，或採取額外措施減低洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
採取額外措施，以減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險，而無須事先取得高級管理層批准
取得高級管理層批准以繼續該業務關係，並在存在實益擁有人時採取合理措施核實其身分
在任何情況下均一律拒絕建立該業務關係，不論該客戶的財富來源或資金來源為何
tc.explain: 第15(a)條適用於擬建立業務關係的情況：須經高級管理層批准建立該關係，並須確定財富及資金來源，或採取額外的減低風險措施。批准繼續該關係及核實實益擁有人身分則屬第15(b)條的責任，只適用於關係已經存在的情況。無須高級管理層批准而僅減低風險，描述的是規管非經常交易的第15(c)條，並非擬建立的關係。第15條並無一律拒絕建立關係的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15(b)(ii)條

en.q: Where a high-risk situation arises after a business relationship has been established and there is a beneficial owner, what does section 15(b)(ii) of Schedule 2 require?
options: Taking reasonable measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity so the institution is satisfied it knows who they are
Obtaining senior management approval to continue the business relationship, whether or not there is a beneficial owner
Taking reasonable measures to establish the beneficial owner's source of wealth and source of funds only
Terminating the business relationship with the beneficial owner immediately, without further inquiry or notice
en.explain: Section 15(b) applies once a business relationship has already been established: senior management approval to continue it is sub-paragraph (i); reasonable measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity, if there is one, is sub-paragraph (ii) — the key; and establishing source of wealth/funds or additional risk-mitigating measures is sub-paragraph (iii). The continuation-approval duty and the source-of-wealth measure both belong to the other sub-paragraphs, not (ii). Terminating the relationship outright is not a section 15 requirement at all.

tc.q: 如業務關係建立後才出現高風險情況，而存在實益擁有人，附表2第15(b)(ii)條有何規定？
options: 採取合理措施核實該實益擁有人的身分，以令機構信納知悉其是何人
取得高級管理層批准以繼續該業務關係，並不論該客戶是否存在實益擁有人
只須採取合理措施確定該實益擁有人的財富來源及資金來源，而無須核實身分
立即終止與該實益擁有人的業務關係，而無須任何進一步查詢或事先通知
tc.explain: 第15(b)條適用於業務關係已經建立的情況：(i)取得高級管理層批准以繼續該關係；(ii)如存在實益擁有人，須採取合理措施核實其身分（即答案）；及(iii)須確定財富及資金來源，或採取額外的減低風險措施。繼續批准及財富來源措施分別屬其他分節，並非(ii)節。第15條並無一律終止關係的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15(c)條

en.q: What does section 15(c) of Schedule 2 require where a high-risk occasional transaction is to be carried out?
options: Taking additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved
Obtaining senior management approval and establishing source of wealth
Refusing to carry out the transaction
Reporting the transaction to the relevant authority before executing it
en.explain: Section 15(c) requires, where an occasional transaction is to be carried out in a high-risk situation, that the institution take additional measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved. The senior management approval and source of wealth steps apply to business relationships under paragraphs (a) and (b).

tc.q: 如擬進行高風險的非經常交易，附表2第15(c)條有何規定？
options: 採取額外措施，減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
取得高級管理層批准並確定財富來源
拒絕進行該交易
在執行前將該交易報告有關當局
tc.explain: 第15(c)條規定，如在高風險情況下擬進行非經常交易，機構須採取額外措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。高級管理層批准及財富來源等步驟則按(a)及(b)款適用於業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第16條

en.q: What does section 16 of Schedule 2 prohibit?
options: Opening or maintaining an anonymous account, or an account in a fictitious name, for a customer
Establishing or continuing a correspondent banking relationship with a shell bank
Opening any account for a customer who is not resident in Hong Kong, without verification
Maintaining any account that has been dormant or inactive for more than five consecutive years
en.explain: Section 16 provides that a financial institution or DNFBP must not open, or maintain, any anonymous account or account in a fictitious name for any customer — covering both opening and continuing to maintain such accounts. Correspondent banking with a shell bank is prohibited separately, by section 17, in the same 'Prohibitions' division. Section 16 says nothing about non-resident customers or dormant accounts.

tc.q: 附表2第16條禁止甚麼？
options: 為任何客戶開立或維持任何匿名帳戶或以虛構名稱開立的帳戶
與空殼銀行建立或維持代理銀行業務關係，不論是否已終止
為並非通常居於香港的客戶開立帳戶，而不進一步核實其身分
維持任何已連續不活躍超過五年、且客戶未曾聯絡的帳戶
tc.explain: 第16條訂明金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業不得為任何客戶開立或維持任何匿名帳戶或以虛構名稱開立的帳戶——同時涵蓋開立及繼續維持該等帳戶。與空殼銀行的代理銀行業務關係則由同屬「禁止事項」部的第17條另行禁止。第16條並無提及非香港居民客戶或不活躍帳戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(2)條

en.q: When does a corporation have a “physical presence” in a place for the purposes of the shell bank prohibition?
options: When it carries on banking business at premises and at least one full-time employee performs banking-related duties there
When it is a subsidiary of another corporation carrying on banking business in that place, or shares a common controller with it
When it maintains a registered office address in that place, regardless of whether it carries on any business there
When it holds a banking licence issued by the authorities of that place, even without any staff or premises there
en.explain: Section 17(2) provides that a corporation has a physical presence in a place if it carries on banking business at premises there and at least one full-time employee performs banking-related duties at those premises — a mailing address or a licence alone is not enough. Being a subsidiary of, or sharing a controller with, another corporation carrying on banking business there is instead the section 17(3) test for whether two corporations are 'affiliates', a different concept.

tc.q: 就空殼銀行禁止規定而言，法團在何時方在某地方有「實體存在」？
options: 當其在該地方處所經營銀行業務，並有至少一名全職僱員執行銀行相關職務
當其為在該地方經營銀行業務的另一法團的附屬公司，或與之共有控權人
當其在該地方設有註冊辦事處地址，但並不在當地經營任何實質業務
當其持有該地方當局發出的銀行牌照，即使在當地並無任何員工或處所
tc.explain: 第17(2)條訂明，如法團在某地方的處所經營銀行業務，並有該法團至少一名全職僱員在該等處所執行與銀行業務有關的職務，該法團即在該地方有實體存在——僅有郵寄地址或牌照並不足夠。屬於在該地方經營銀行業務的另一法團的附屬公司，或與其共有控權人，是第17(3)條判斷兩間法團是否屬「聯屬公司」的測試，屬另一概念。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(3)條

en.q: When is one corporation an “affiliate” of another for the purposes of section 17 of Schedule 2?
options: Where it is a subsidiary of the other, or the two corporations share at least one common controller
Where it carries on banking business at premises in the same place as the other corporation, with a full-time employee there
Only where the two corporations share the same registered office address in that place or jurisdiction
Only where one corporation holds more than 25% of the other's issued shares, regardless of voting rights
en.explain: Section 17(3) provides that a corporation is an affiliate of another if it is a subsidiary of the other, or if at least one of its controllers is at the same time a controller of the other corporation. Carrying on banking business at premises with a full-time employee is instead the section 17(2) 'physical presence' test. A shared registered office, or a shareholding above 25% rather than the >50% voting-rights 'controller' test in section 17(4), are not the statutory test for 'affiliate'.

tc.q: 就附表2第17條而言，法團在何時屬另一法團的「聯屬公司」？
options: 當其為另一法團的附屬公司，或兩法團有至少一名共同控權人
當其與另一法團在同一地方的處所經營銀行業務，並有全職僱員在該處
只限兩間法團在該地方或司法管轄區共用同一註冊辦事處地址
只限其中一間法團持有另一間超過25%的已發行股份，不論投票權為何
tc.explain: 第17(3)條訂明，如某法團是另一法團的附屬公司，或該法團的至少一名控權人同時是另一法團的控權人，則該法團屬另一法團的聯屬公司。在處所經營銀行業務並有全職僱員在場，是第17(2)條的「實體存在」測試，並非本條的測試。共用註冊辦事處，或持股超過25%（而非第17(4)條逾50%投票權的「控權人」測試），均非本條的法定測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(4)條（「控權人」的定義）

en.q: Under section 17(4) of Schedule 2, what voting threshold makes a person a “controller” of a corporation?
options: Entitlement, alone or with associates, to exercise or control more than 50% of the voting rights at any general meeting
A person in accordance with whose directions the corporation's directors are accustomed to act, other than a professional adviser
Entitlement, alone or with associates, to exercise more than 25% of the voting rights at any general meeting
Holding more than 50% of the issued share capital of the corporation, regardless of actual voting rights
en.explain: Section 17(4)'s 'controller' definition has two disjunctive limbs: a person whose directions the directors are accustomed to follow (excluding professional advisers) — which involves no voting percentage at all — or a person who, alone or with associates, is entitled to exercise or control more than 50% of the voting rights at any general meeting. Only the second limb turns on a voting threshold, and it is set at more than 50%, not 25% or a share-capital measure that ignores voting rights.

tc.q: 根據附表2第17(4)條，何種投票權門檻令某人成為法團的「控權人」？
options: 單獨或連同相聯者，有權行使或控制行使該法團任何股東大會超過50%的投票權
該法團的董事一直慣常按其指示或指令行事的人，但以專業身分提供意見者除外
單獨或連同一名或多於一名相聯者，有權行使超過25%的投票權的人
持有該法團超過50%的已發行股本的人，不論其實際投票權為何
tc.explain: 第17(4)條「控權人」的定義設有兩個互為替代的部分：該法團董事慣於按其指示行事的人（不包括專業顧問）——完全不涉及投票權百分比；或單獨或連同相聯者，有權行使或控制行使任何股東大會超過50%投票權的人。只有第二部分涉及投票權門檻，且門檻定於超過50%，而非25%或不論投票權的股本測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(1)條

en.q: What two conditions must be satisfied before an institution may carry out CDD measures by means of an intermediary?
options: The intermediary consents in writing to act as such, and the institution is satisfied it will provide copies of documents and records on request
The intermediary has adequate procedures in place to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing, and is licensed to provide services in Hong Kong
The intermediary is licensed to operate in Hong Kong, and holds professional indemnity insurance covering the engagement in question
The relevant authority approves the arrangement in writing in advance, and the customer separately consents to it in writing
en.explain: Section 18(1) permits reliance on a specified intermediary only if the intermediary consents in writing to act as such, and the institution is satisfied it will provide copies of documents and records on request without delay. 'Adequate procedures to prevent ML/TF' is instead the section 18(3)(a) test for whether certain professionals (accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional, TCSP licensee) can even be a specified intermediary in the first place — a related but different precondition. Neither prior written approval from the relevant authority nor professional indemnity insurance appears in section 18(1).

tc.q: 機構藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施前，須符合哪兩項條件？
options: 該中介人以書面同意擔任該角色；及機構信納其會應要求提供文件副本及紀錄
該中介人設有充分程序以防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集，並在香港持有牌照經營服務
該中介人須在香港持牌經營相關服務，並持有涵蓋有關委聘的專業彌償保險
有關當局須事先以書面批准該項安排，並須由客戶另行以書面方式同意
tc.explain: 第18(1)條規定，只有在以下情況方可倚賴指明中介人：該中介人以書面同意擔任該機構的中介人；及該機構信納該中介人會應要求毫不延遲地提供文件副本及紀錄。「設有充分程序以防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集」是第18(3)(a)條就會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士及信託或公司服務提供者持牌人可否成為指明中介人所定的另一項相關但不同的先決條件。有關當局事先書面批准或專業彌償保險，均沒有在第18(1)條出現。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(2)條

en.q: Who remains liable if a CDD measure carried out through an intermediary is not properly performed?
options: The institution remains liable under the Ordinance for failing to carry out that measure
The intermediary alone is liable, and the institution bears no responsibility under the Ordinance
Liability is shared equally between the institution and the intermediary under the Ordinance
Neither party is liable, provided the written consent required by section 18(1)(a) was obtained
en.explain: Section 18(2) provides that an institution that carries out a CDD measure by means of an intermediary remains liable under the Ordinance for a failure to carry out that measure — liability is not transferred to the intermediary, shared equally, or extinguished by obtaining the intermediary's written consent under section 18(1)(a). Section 18(6) applies the same non-delegable rule to CDD carried out by an agent.

tc.q: 如藉中介人進行的客戶盡職審查措施未有妥善執行，何人須負法律責任？
options: 該機構就沒有進行該措施一事，仍須根據本條例負上法律責任
只有該中介人須就沒有妥善進行該項措施一事負上法律責任，該機構完全毋須負責
該機構與該中介人須根據本條例的規定，就該項失責平均分擔所有法律責任
兩者均無須負上任何法律責任，只要已事先取得第18(1)(a)條所規定的書面同意
tc.explain: 第18(2)條訂明，藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施的機構，就沒有進行該措施一事，仍須根據本條例負上法律責任——法律責任並不會轉移予中介人、平均分擔，或因取得第18(1)(a)條所規定的書面同意而獲豁免。第18(6)條就藉代理人進行的客戶盡職審查，訂有相同、不可轉授的規則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3)(a)條

en.q: Which additional condition must an accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional or TCSP licensee satisfy to act as a specified intermediary?
options: They must be able to satisfy the institution they have adequate procedures to prevent ML/TF
They must be required under the law of an equivalent jurisdiction to be registered, licensed or regulated
They must have been ordinarily resident in Hong Kong for at least three consecutive years
They must have acted for the same customer continuously for at least twelve months already
en.explain: Section 18(3)(a) lists an accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional and TCSP licensee as specified intermediaries only where the person can satisfy the institution that they have adequate procedures in place to prevent ML/TF. Being required to register, be licensed or be regulated under an equivalent jurisdiction's law is instead the section 18(3)(c) test for overseas professionals, not the domestic professionals covered by paragraph (a). No residence period or minimum-engagement duration appears in section 18(3).

tc.q: 會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士或信託或公司服務提供者持牌人，須另行符合甚麼條件方可擔任指明中介人？
options: 須能令該機構信納其設有充分程序以防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集
須根據同等司法管轄區的法律被規定註冊、領牌，或受該法律規管
須已在香港境內連續通常居住至少三年之久
須已連續不間斷地為該同一客戶行事至少十二個月
tc.explain: 第18(3)(a)條將會計專業人士、地產代理、法律專業人士及信託或公司服務提供者持牌人列為指明中介人，但須以該人能令機構信納其設有充分程序以防止洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集為條件。根據同等司法管轄區法律須註冊、領牌或受規管，是第18(3)(c)條就境外專業人士所定的測試，並非適用於(a)款所涵蓋的本地專業人士。第18(3)條並無居住年期或最短委聘期的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3)(c)條

en.q: Which three conditions must a professional practising in an equivalent jurisdiction meet to be a specified intermediary under section 18(3)(c)?
options: Required to be registered, licensed or regulated under its law; has measures ensuring compliance similar to Schedule 2; and is supervised for compliance by a similar authority
Being a member of an internationally recognized professional body; carrying professional indemnity insurance of an adequate level; and maintaining a representative office in Hong Kong
Being formally nominated in writing by the customer; consenting in writing to act as intermediary; and providing an annual compliance certificate to the institution
Being incorporated or established in the equivalent jurisdiction; employing at least five staff members there; and being independently audited on an annual basis
en.explain: Section 18(3)(c) requires the overseas professional or institution to be required under the law of that jurisdiction to be registered or licensed or to be regulated under that law; to have measures in place ensuring compliance with requirements similar to Schedule 2; and to be supervised for compliance by an authority performing functions similar to a relevant authority or regulatory body. Professional-body membership with insurance and a Hong Kong office, customer nomination with an annual certificate, and incorporation with staffing and audit requirements are all plausible-sounding but appear nowhere in section 18(3)(c).

tc.q: 在同等司法管轄區執業的專業人士，須符合第18(3)(c)條的哪三項條件方可成為指明中介人？
options: 根據該法律須註冊、領牌或受規管；有措施確保遵從附表2類似規定；並由職能相似當局監督
屬獲廣泛認可的國際專業團體正式成員；持有充分水平的專業彌償保險；並在香港設有代表辦事處
經客戶正式以書面方式提名；以書面同意擔任該機構的中介人；並向該機構提供年度合規證明書
在該同等司法管轄區註冊成立或設立；在當地聘用至少五名全職員工；並每年接受獨立外部審計
tc.explain: 第18(3)(c)條規定該境外專業人士或機構須：根據該司法管轄區的法律須註冊或領牌，或根據該法律受規管；設有措施確保遵從與附表2類似的規定；並由該司法管轄區內職能類似有關當局或監管團體的當局，監督其遵從情況。國際專業團體成員資格連同保險及香港辦事處、客戶提名連同年度證明書，以及註冊成立連同員工人數及審計規定，聽來合理，但均沒有在第18(3)(c)條出現。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(4)(a)條

en.q: Immediately after an intermediary carries out a CDD measure, what must the relying institution obtain?
options: The data or information the intermediary obtained, but not necessarily document copies at the same time
Copies of every document the intermediary holds, within the record-keeping period under section 20
A written certificate from the intermediary confirming that the measure was properly carried out
Nothing at all, until the relevant authority specifically requests the information in writing
en.explain: Section 18(4)(a) requires the institution, immediately after the intermediary carries out the measure, to obtain the data or information the intermediary obtained, but expressly does not require obtaining a copy of any document at the same time. Providing copies of documents within the section 20 record-keeping period is instead the section 18(4)(b) duty, which is triggered by request, not immediate. Neither a written certificate nor a rule of 'nothing until requested' appears in section 18(4).

tc.q: 中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施後，倚賴的機構須即時取得甚麼？
options: 該中介人所取得的數據或資料，但不一定須同時取得相關文件的副本
中介人持有的每份文件副本，須在第20條的紀錄保存期內提供
一份由該中介人發出、確認該措施已妥善進行的書面證明書
完全無須取得任何東西，直至有關當局特別作出要求
tc.explain: 第18(4)(a)條規定機構須在該中介人進行該措施後即時取得其所取得的數據或資料，但明文訂明無須同時取得任何文件副本。在第20條紀錄保存期內提供文件副本，是須應要求方觸發的第18(4)(b)條責任，並非即時責任。書面證明書或「直至有要求方須取得」的規則，均沒有在第18(4)條出現。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(4)(b)條

en.q: Within what period must the relying institution request copies of documents from its intermediary, under section 18(4)(b) of Schedule 2?
options: Within the period referred to in section 20(2) or (3) of Schedule 2
Within six months from the date the CDD measure was carried out, regardless of the record-keeping period
At any time up until the business relationship with the customer has formally come to an end
Within twelve months from the date of the intermediary's written consent under section 18(1)(a)
en.explain: Section 18(4)(b) requires the institution to ensure the intermediary will, if requested within the period referred to in section 20(2) or (3) of Schedule 2, provide a copy of any document or record obtained in carrying out the measure — so the institution itself must make its request within that record-keeping window; the intermediary then supplies it as soon as reasonably practicable afterwards. There is no fixed six-month or twelve-month period, and the right to request does not run only until the relationship ends.

tc.q: 根據附表2第18(4)(b)條，倚賴的機構須在多長期間內向其中介人要求取得文件副本？
options: 附表2第20(2)或(3)條所述的期間——即適用的紀錄保存期
自進行該項客戶盡職審查措施之日起計六個月內，不論紀錄保存期為何
直至與該客戶的業務關係正式終止為止的任何時間
自該中介人根據第18(1)(a)條作出書面同意之日起計十二個月內
tc.explain: 第18(4)(b)條規定機構須確保該中介人在其於附表2第20(2)或(3)條所述期間內提出要求時，會提供其在進行該措施過程中所取得的任何文件副本或紀錄——換言之，機構本身須在該紀錄保存期內提出要求，中介人其後須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快提供。並無固定的六個月或十二個月期限，要求的權利亦不限於業務關係終止之前。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(1)條

en.q: What procedures does section 19(1) of Schedule 2 require an institution to establish and maintain?
options: Effective procedures for determining whether a customer or beneficial owner is a politically exposed person
Effective procedures for identifying and handling wire transfers that do not comply with section 12(5)
Effective procedures, for each customer and product, for the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9 and 15
Procedures for reporting suspicious transactions to the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit without delay
en.explain: Section 19(1) requires effective procedures for determining whether a customer or a beneficial owner of a customer is a politically exposed person — the operational counterpart to the section 10 special requirements. Procedures for wire transfers that breach section 12(5), and procedures for carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15, are the separate section 19(2) and 19(3) duties, not section 19(1). STR reporting to the JFIU is not a Schedule 2 procedure requirement at all.

tc.q: 附表2第19(1)條規定機構須建立及維持甚麼程序？
options: 有效程序，以斷定某客戶或該客戶的實益擁有人是否為政治人物
有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從附表2第12(5)條規定的所有電傳轉賬
就每種客戶及產品而言的有效程序，以履行第3、4、5、9及15條下的責任
須在毫不延遲的情況下向聯合財富情報組舉報可疑交易的程序
tc.explain: 第19(1)條規定須有有效程序，以斷定客戶或客戶的實益擁有人是否政治人物——即第10條特別規定在運作層面的對應安排。識別及處理未有遵從第12(5)條的電傳轉賬，以及履行第3、4、5、9、10及15條下責任的程序，分別屬另外的第19(2)及19(3)條規定，並非第19(1)條。向聯合財富情報組舉報可疑交易並非附表2的程序規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(2)條

en.q: What procedures must a financial institution that carries out wire transfers establish under section 19(2) of Schedule 2?
options: Effective procedures for identifying and handling wire transfers that do not comply with section 12(5)
Effective procedures for determining whether a customer or beneficial owner is a politically exposed person
Effective procedures, for each kind of customer and product, for the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9 and 15
Procedures for converting foreign currency at the institution's prevailing market rate
en.explain: Section 19(2) requires a financial institution that carries out wire transfers to establish effective procedures for identifying and handling wire transfers in relation to which section 12(5) — the accompanying-information requirement — has not been complied with. Determining PEP status and carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9 and 15 are the separate section 19(1) and 19(3) procedures. Currency conversion is not addressed by section 19 at all.

tc.q: 根據附表2第19(2)條，進行電傳轉賬的金融機構須建立甚麼程序？
options: 有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從附表2第12(5)條規定的所有電傳轉賬
有效程序，以斷定某客戶或該客戶的實益擁有人是否為政治人物
就每種客戶及產品的有效程序，以履行第3、4、5、9及15條下的責任
須按該機構本身現行採用的市場匯率兌換外幣的程序
tc.explain: 第19(2)條規定進行電傳轉賬的金融機構須建立有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從第12(5)條（即隨附資料規定）的電傳轉賬。斷定政治人物身分，以及履行第3、4、5、9及15條下的責任，分別屬另外的第19(1)及19(3)條程序。兌換外幣並非第19條所規管的事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(3)條

en.q: In respect of what must an institution establish effective procedures under section 19(3) of Schedule 2, and for which duties?
options: For each kind of customer, relationship, product and transaction, under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15
Effective procedures for determining whether a customer or beneficial owner is a politically exposed person
Effective procedures for identifying and handling wire transfers that do not comply with section 12(5)
In respect of each business premises, effective procedures for the record-keeping duties under section 20
en.explain: Section 19(3) requires the institution, in respect of each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction, to establish effective procedures for carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15 of Schedule 2. PEP determination and wire-transfer procedures are the separate section 19(1) and 19(2) duties. Section 19(3) is organised around kinds of customer/relationship/product/transaction, not business premises.

tc.q: 根據附表2第19(3)條，機構須就甚麼、為履行哪些責任而建立有效程序？
options: 就每種客戶、關係、產品及交易，第3、4、5、9、10及15條的責任
有效程序，以斷定某客戶或該客戶的實益擁有人是否確實為政治人物
有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從附表2第12(5)條規定的電傳轉賬
就每個業務處所而言的有效程序，以履行第20條下的紀錄保存相關責任
tc.explain: 第19(3)條規定機構須就每種客戶、業務關係、產品及交易，建立有效程序，以履行第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任。斷定政治人物身分及電傳轉賬程序，分別屬另外的第19(1)及19(2)條責任。第19(3)條是按客戶／關係／產品／交易的種類組織，並非按業務處所。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(1)(b)(ii)條

en.q: Besides identification documents, what customer records must be kept under section 20(1)(b) of Schedule 2?
options: The original or copy of files relating to the customer's account and correspondence with them and any beneficial owner
The original or a copy of the documents obtained in connection with each transaction the institution carries out
Only the customer's signed application form, kept on file solely for the institution's own internal reference purposes
Only records of transactions exceeding $8,000 in value, kept in a separate dedicated transaction file
en.explain: Section 20(1)(b)(ii) requires keeping the original or a copy of the files relating to the customer's account and business correspondence with the customer and any beneficial owner — this is in addition to the identification documents required by (b)(i). Documents and data obtained in connection with each transaction are instead the section 20(1)(a) transaction-record duty, a different paragraph. A signed application form alone and an $8,000 threshold are not what section 20(1)(b) requires.

tc.q: 除身分識別文件外，附表2第20(1)(b)條規定須保存哪些客戶紀錄？
options: 與客戶帳戶有關的檔案，及與其及實益擁有人往來函件正本或副本
與該機構所進行的每一宗交易均有關的文件及數據的正本或副本紀錄
只須該客戶已簽署的申請表格，僅供該機構本身內部參考之用而保存
只須超過8,000元的交易紀錄，並須存放於獨立的專用交易檔案
tc.explain: 第20(1)(b)(ii)條規定須保存與該客戶帳戶有關的檔案，以及與該客戶及任何實益擁有人的業務往來函件的正本或副本——此為(b)(i)身分識別文件規定以外另加的規定。與每宗交易有關的文件及數據，則屬另一段的第20(1)(a)條交易紀錄責任。只保存已簽署申請表格，或只保存超過8,000元的交易紀錄，均非第20(1)(b)條的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(2)條

en.q: For how long must transaction records be kept under section 20(2) of Schedule 2, and from when?
options: At least 5 years from completion of the transaction, even if the relationship ends meanwhile
At least 6 years beginning on the date the transaction is initiated, not when completed
At least 5 years beginning on the date the business relationship with the customer ends
At least 7 years beginning on the date the record is first created by the institution
en.explain: Section 20(2) requires transaction records kept under section 20(1)(a) to be kept for at least 5 years beginning on the date the transaction is completed, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period. Starting the clock at initiation rather than completion, or counting from when the relationship ends (that is instead the section 20(3) rule for customer-identity records) or from when the record is created, all misstate either the period or its starting point.

tc.q: 根據附表2第20(2)條，交易紀錄須保存多久？自何時起計？
options: 自交易完成日起計至少5年，不論業務關係是否終止
自該交易展開之日起計至少6年，而非自完成之日
自該客戶的業務關係終止之日起計至少5年
自該機構首次製備該紀錄之日起計至少7年
tc.explain: 第20(2)條規定根據第20(1)(a)款保存的交易紀錄，須自該交易完成之日起計保存至少5年，不論該業務關係是否於該期間內終止。以展開之日（而非完成之日）起計、以業務關係終止之日起計（此為第20(3)條就客戶身分紀錄所定的規則），或以紀錄製備之日起計，均錯誤陳述保存期或其起算點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(3)條

en.q: For how long must customer identity and account records be kept under section 20(3) of Schedule 2?
options: Throughout the business relationship, and for at least 5 years from the date it ends
For at least 5 years from the date the customer was first identified, not from when the relationship ends
For as long as the institution holds a licence to operate, regardless of the customer relationship
For at least 5 years from the date of the customer's last transaction with the institution
en.explain: Section 20(3) requires records kept under section 20(1)(b) — customer identity and account records — to be kept throughout the continuance of the business relationship and for at least 5 years beginning on the date the relationship ends. That is different from section 20(2), which times the 5-year period for transaction records from completion of the transaction, and from section 20(3A), which times it from completion of an occasional transaction. Counting from first identification, from the last transaction, or tying retention to the licence's duration all misstate the trigger.

tc.q: 根據附表2第20(3)條，客戶身分及帳戶紀錄須保存多久？
options: 在業務關係持續期間內，並自該關係終止之日起計至少5年
自首次識別該客戶之日起計至少5年，而非自該關係終止之日起計
只要該機構持有牌照經營業務，不論客戶關係狀況為何
自該客戶與該機構的最後一次交易之日起計至少5年
tc.explain: 第20(3)條規定根據第20(1)(b)款保存的紀錄（即客戶身分及帳戶紀錄），須在業務關係持續期間內保存，並自該業務關係終止之日起計保存至少5年。這有別於第20(2)條（交易紀錄自交易完成之日起計5年）及第20(3A)條（非經常交易自完成之日起計5年）。以首次識別、最後一次交易，或牌照存續期作為起算點，均錯誤陳述觸發點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(3A)條

en.q: For how long must the section 20(1)(b) records be kept where the dealing was an occasional transaction rather than a business relationship?
options: At least 5 years beginning on the date the occasional transaction is completed
At least 5 years beginning on the date of the next occasional transaction
Only until the transaction has been fully reconciled against the institution's internal records
There is no requirement to keep such records for occasional transactions
en.explain: Section 20(3A), added in 2022, provides that records required under section 20(1)(b) for an occasional transaction carried out in any of the circumstances in section 3(1)(b), (1A) and (1B) must be kept for a period of at least 5 years beginning on the date the occasional transaction is completed — not from the next occasional transaction, and not merely until internal reconciliation. There is no exemption for occasional transactions.

tc.q: 如該項交易屬非經常交易而非業務關係，第20(1)(b)款的紀錄須保存多久？
options: 自該非經常交易完成之日起計至少5年
自下一宗非經常交易之日起計至少5年
只須保存至該交易與該機構的內部紀錄完成對帳為止
就非經常交易而言並無保存該等紀錄的規定
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第20(3A)條訂明，就在第3(1)(b)、(1A)及(1B)條任何情況下進行的非經常交易，根據第20(1)(b)款須保存的紀錄，須自該非經常交易完成之日起計保存至少5年——並非自下一宗非經常交易起計，亦不僅保存至內部對帳完成為止。非經常交易並無獲豁免保存紀錄的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(4)及(5)條

en.q: On what grounds may a relevant authority require records to be kept for longer than the statutory minimum?
options: Where satisfied the records relate to an ongoing investigation, or other purposes specified in the notice
Only where criminal proceedings have already been formally commenced against the customer concerned
Only where the customer has already been determined to be a politically exposed person by the institution
Only with the written approval of the Review Tribunal established under the Ordinance for that purpose
en.explain: Section 20(4) permits a relevant authority or regulatory body, by written notice, to require longer retention where it is satisfied that the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other investigation it is carrying out, or where they are relevant to any other purpose specified in the notice; section 20(5) makes compliance with the notice mandatory.
