Already-commenced criminal proceedings, PEP status, and prior Review Tribunal approval are not the statutory grounds — the Review Tribunal reviews specified decisions elsewhere in the Ordinance, not record-retention notices.

tc.q: 有關當局可基於甚麼理由要求將紀錄保存超過法定最短年期？
options: 其信納紀錄與進行中調查有關，或與通知指明目的有關
只限已就該客戶正式展開刑事法律程序的情況
只限該機構已斷定該客戶屬政治人物的情況
只限事先取得覆核審裁處書面批准的情況
tc.explain: 第20(4)條准許有關當局或監管團體以書面通知，於信納有關紀錄與其正進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或與通知內指明的其他目的有關時，要求延長保存期；第20(5)條規定必須遵從該通知。已展開的刑事法律程序、政治人物身分，或事先取得覆核審裁處批准，均非法定理據——覆核審裁處是就本條例下其他指明決定進行覆核，並非就紀錄保存通知進行覆核。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第21(a)條

en.q: Where a record required under section 20 consists of a document, in what manner may it be kept?
options: Either the original is kept, or a copy is kept on microfilm or in a computer database
A record of the data or information must be kept either on microfilm or in the database of a computer
Only the original of the document may be kept; no copy is permitted under any circumstances
Only a certified true copy of the document may be kept, notarised by a solicitor
en.explain: Section 21(a) provides that if the record consists of a document, either the original must be kept, or a copy must be kept either on microfilm or in the database of a computer. Requiring only microfilm or computer-database records — with no 'keep the original' option — is instead the section 21(b) rule for records that consist of data or information, not documents. Section 21 permits copies; it does not require the original in every case, and does not require notarisation.

tc.q: 如第20條規定的紀錄由文件構成，可以何種方式保存？
options: 須保存該文件的正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫方式保存副本
須以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫方式保存該數據或資料的紀錄
只可保存正本，在任何情況下均不得保存副本
只可保存經律師公證的核證真實副本
tc.explain: 第21(a)條訂明，如紀錄由文件構成，須保存該文件的正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫方式保存副本。只可以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫方式保存、而無「保存正本」的選擇，是第21(b)條就由數據或資料構成的紀錄（而非文件）所定的規則。第21條容許保存副本；並非在所有情況下均須保存正本，亦無須經公證。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)條

en.q: A Hong Kong-incorporated MSO has an overseas branch and an overseas subsidiary in a different line of business. Under section 22(1) of Schedule 2, which of these must have compliance procedures in place?
options: The branch always; the subsidiary only if it carries on the same business
Both of them, but only if the institution owns more than half the shares in each
Neither of them; section 22(1) only requires a group-wide AML/CFT policy instead
The subsidiary unconditionally; the branch only if it employs local staff there
en.explain: Section 22(1) applies to 'its branches' without qualification but limits the subsidiary limb to 'subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as a financial institution' outside Hong Kong, so a subsidiary in an unrelated line of business falls outside section 22(1). There is no shareholding-percentage test, no alternative of a group-wide policy, and the branch/subsidiary treatment is not reversed.

tc.q: 某在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，在境外設有一間分支機構及一間經營不同業務的附屬公司。根據附表2第22(1)條，以下何者須設有合規程序？
options: 分支機構一律須有；附屬公司只在經營與金融機構相同業務時才須有
兩者皆須有，但只限該機構持有超過百分之五十股權的情況
兩者皆不須有；第22(1)條只要求訂立集團洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策
附屬公司一律須有；分支機構則只在僱用當地員工時才須有
tc.explain: 第22(1)條對「其分支機構」的適用並無附帶條件，但就附屬公司而言，則只限於「在香港以外地方經營與金融機構相同業務的附屬企業」——故經營不同業務的附屬公司不屬第22(1)條範圍。條文並無股權百分比的測試，亦無以集團政策代替的選項，分支機構與附屬公司的處理方式亦沒有互換。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(2)條

en.q: Local law at an overseas branch does not permit the application of a Schedule 2-equivalent procedure. What must the financial institution do?
options: Inform the relevant authority, and take additional measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk
Close the overseas branch immediately, since continuing to operate it would breach Schedule 2
Apply the Hong Kong Schedule 2 requirement in full, regardless of what the local law permits
Take no further action, since the local law of that place prevails over Schedule 2
en.explain: Section 22(2) applies where local law does not permit application of a Schedule 2-equivalent procedure: the institution must inform the relevant authority accordingly and take additional measures to effectively mitigate the resulting ML/TF risk. It need not close the branch, may not simply override local law, and cannot treat local law as an excuse for inaction.

tc.q: 某境外分支機構所在地的法律不准許實施與附表2相若的程序。該金融機構須怎樣做？
options: 通知有關當局，並採取額外措施減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
立即結束該境外分支機構，因為繼續經營即屬違反附表2規定
不論當地法律准許與否，一律全面適用香港附表2的所有條文規定
無須採取任何進一步行動，因當地法律必然凌駕於附表2規定之上
tc.explain: 第22(2)條適用於當地法律不准許實施與附表2相若程序的情況：機構須據此通知有關當局，並採取額外措施，有效減低因此而面對的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。機構無須結束該分支機構，亦不能逕自凌駕當地法律，或以當地法律為由不採取行動。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(3)條（「分支機構」的定義）

en.q: How is "branch" defined for the purposes of section 22 of Schedule 2?
options: An overseas branch with business similar to the institution's, whether or not limited by local law or called an agency
Only an overseas office formally registered as a branch in that place's companies registry, regardless of the business it does
Only an overseas office employing more than five staff, even if it carries on a wholly different business from the institution
Any overseas office that merely displays the institution's name or logo, whether or not it conducts any business there
en.explain: Section 22(3) defines 'branch' as an overseas branch at which the institution carries on a business similar to its own, whether or not that business is limited by local law and whether or not the branch is called an agency there. Local companies-registry registration, a staff headcount, an unrelated business, or merely displaying the institution's name are not part of the statutory test.

tc.q: 就附表2第22條而言，「分支機構」如何界定？
options: 香港以外、業務與該機構類似的分支機構，不論受當地法律限制或稱代理處
只限在當地公司註冊處正式登記為分支機構的境外辦事處，不論其經營何種業務
只限僱用超過五名員工的境外辦事處，即使其經營與該機構完全不同的業務
只要展示該機構名稱或標誌的任何境外辦事處，不論是否在當地經營任何業務
tc.explain: 第22(3)條將「分支機構」界定為位於香港以外、該機構在該處經營與其類似業務的分支機構，不論該業務是否受當地法律限制，亦不論在當地是否稱為代理處。當地公司註冊處的登記、員工人數、經營不同業務，或僅僅展示該機構名稱，均非該法定定義的要素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條

en.q: Section 23 of Schedule 2 requires all reasonable measures for two purposes. What are they?
options: Ensuring proper safeguards to prevent a contravention of Part 2 or 3, and mitigating ML/TF risks
Establishing procedures to determine PEP status, and to identify non-compliant wire transfers
Keeping transaction and customer records for at least 5 years in their original or copied form
Ensuring proper safeguards to prevent contravention of Part 1 or 2, and mitigating general operational risks
en.explain: Section 23 requires all reasonable measures (a) to ensure proper safeguards exist to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2, and (b) to mitigate ML/TF risks. Determining PEP status and identifying non-compliant wire transfers is the section 19 procedures duty; keeping records for 5 years is the section 20/21 record-keeping duty; and the safeguards duty concerns Parts 2 and 3 and ML/TF risk specifically, not Parts 1 and 2 or operational risk generally.

tc.q: 附表2第23條規定須為兩個目的採取一切合理措施。該兩個目的是甚麼？
options: 確保設有適當防護措施以防止違反附表2第2或3部；並減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
訂立及維持有效程序以斷定政治人物身分，並識別不符規定的電傳轉賬
保存所有交易及客戶紀錄至少5年，另須以文件正本或副本形式妥為保存
確保設有適當防護措施以防止違反附表2第1或2部；並減低一般營運風險
tc.explain: 第23條規定須採取一切合理措施：(a)確保設有適當防護措施，以防止違反附表2第2或3部下的任何規定；及(b)減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。斷定政治人物身分及識別不符規定的電傳轉賬屬第19條的程序責任；保存紀錄5年屬第20/21條的紀錄保存責任；而防護措施責任所防範的是第2及3部（並非第1及2部），所減低的是洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險（並非一般營運風險）。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, item 4; Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2026 (13 Mar 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第4項；通函MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: What is the fee for an application for the grant of an MSO licence under Schedule 3, as it stands from 15 May 2026?
en.explain: Item 4 of Schedule 3 sets the fee for an application for the grant of a licence at $3,810, plus $2,440 for each additional business premises and $945 for each person subject to the fit and proper person test. The previous figure of $3,310 was revised with effect from 15 May 2026.

tc.q: 自2026年5月15日起，附表3就申請批出金錢服務經營者牌照訂明的費用為何？
tc.explain: 附表3第4項訂明批出牌照的申請費為3,810元，另每個額外業務處所2,440元，以及每名須接受適當人選測試的人945元。原有的3,310元已於2026年5月15日起修訂。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第4及5項

en.q: How does the Schedule 3 renewal application fee compare with the fee for a first grant, as both stand from 15 May 2026?
options: Renewal $910, versus $3,810 for a first grant
Renewal and grant are both charged at $3,810
Renewal is $3,810, versus $910 for a first grant
Renewal is $945, versus $2,440 for a first grant
en.explain: Item 5 of Schedule 3 sets the renewal application fee at $910 (plus $410 per additional business premises and $945 per person subject to the fit and proper person test); item 4 sets the fee for a first grant at $3,810 (plus $2,440 per additional premises and $945 per person). The renewal fee is markedly lower than the grant fee, and the figures are not identical, reversed, or drawn from the wrong line of the table.

tc.q: 自2026年5月15日起，附表3的續期申請費用與首次批出牌照的費用相比如何？
options: 續期申請費910元，首次批出則3,810元
續期與批出的申請費均為3,810元
續期申請費為3,810元，首次批出則為910元
續期申請費為945元，首次批出則為2,440元
tc.explain: 附表3第5項訂明續期申請費為910元（另每個額外業務處所410元，以及每名須接受適當人選測試的人945元）；第4項則訂明首次批出牌照的費用為3,810元（另每個額外業務處所2,440元，以及每名須接受適當人選測試的人945元）。續期費用明顯低於批出費用，數字不可相同、倒轉，或取自該費用表的錯誤項目。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, items 6, 7 & 8 (as amended, effective 15 May 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第6、7及8項（2026年5月15日生效的修訂）

en.q: What fee is payable for an application for approval to become a licensee's director, ultimate owner or partner?
options: $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made
$945 for the whole application, whatever the number of persons
$2,440 for each person
$410 for each person
en.explain: Items 6, 7 and 8 of Schedule 3 each set the fee at $945 for each person in relation to whom the application is made. The fee is per person, not per application.

tc.q: 就申請批准成為持牌人的董事、最終擁有人或合夥人，須繳付甚麼費用？
options: 就每名有關申請所關乎的人繳付945元
不論人數多少，整份申請繳付945元
每人410元
tc.explain: 附表3第6、7及8項均訂明就每名有關申請所關乎的人繳付945元。該費用按人數計算，而非按申請份數計算。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, items 9 & 10 (as amended, effective 15 May 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第9及10項（2026年5月15日生效的修訂）

en.q: What fee applies to an application to add new business premises, or to operate a money service at particular premises?
options: $2,440 for each business premises
$945 for each business premises
$3,810 for the application, whatever the number of premises
$410 for each business premises
en.explain: Items 9 and 10 of Schedule 3 each set the fee at $2,440 for each new business premises or each business premises concerned. The same figure appears as the additional-premises component of the grant fee under item 4.

tc.q: 就申請新增業務處所，或申請在特定處所經營金錢服務，適用甚麼費用？
options: 每個業務處所2,440元
每個業務處所945元
不論處所數目多少，整份申請3,810元
每個業務處所410元
tc.explain: 附表3第9及10項均訂明就每個新業務處所或每個有關業務處所繳付2,440元。同一數額亦出現於第4項批出牌照費用中的額外處所部分。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 3, item 2; Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2026 (13 Mar 2026)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3第2項；通函MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: What is the fee for providing an uncertified copy of an entry in, or extract from, the register of licensees?
options: $1.5 per page or portion of a page
$160 per copy
$1 per page or portion of a page
No fee is payable for an uncertified copy
en.explain: Item 2 of Schedule 3 sets the fee for an uncertified copy at $1.5 per page or portion of a page, revised from $1 with effect from 15 May 2026. Certifying a copy of an entry or extract, and providing a section 28(1)(b) certificate, are each $160 per copy under items 1 and 3.

tc.q: 提供持牌人登記冊記項或摘錄的未經核證副本，費用為何？
options: 每頁或每部分頁1.5元
每份160元
每頁或每部分頁1元
未經核證副本無須繳費
tc.explain: 附表3第2項訂明未經核證副本的費用為每頁或每部分頁1.5元，自2026年5月15日起由1元修訂。核證記項或摘錄的副本，以及提供第28(1)(b)條的證明書，則按第1及3項各為每份160元。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3（旁註）

en.q: Under the fee table in Schedule 3 to the AMLO, what fee is payable for certifying a copy of an entry in or extract from the register?
options: $160 per copy, the fee for a certified copy of a register entry or extract
$1.5 per page or portion of a page, the fee for an uncertified copy of a register entry
$3,810, the fee for an application for the grant of a licence
$945, the fee for each person subject to the fit and proper person test on an application
en.explain: Item 1 of the Schedule 3 fee table sets the fee for certifying a copy of an entry in or extract from the register at $160 per copy. Item 2 charges $1.5 per page for an uncertified copy — a cheaper, different service. Item 4 is the $3,810 fee for a licence-grant application, and the $945 figure is the per-person fit-and-proper-test charge added to grant and renewal applications — neither applies to certifying a register entry.

tc.q: 根據附表3的費用表，核證登記冊內記項或其摘錄的複本，須繳付的費用是甚麼？
options: 每份$160，即核證登記冊記項或摘錄複本的費用
每頁或每頁的部分$1.5，即登記冊記項未經核證複本的費用
$3,810，即申請批給牌照的費用
$945，即申請中每一個須判定是否適當人選的人的費用
tc.explain: 附表3費用表項目1訂明核證登記冊內記項或其摘錄的複本，費用為每份$160。項目2的未經核證複本費用是每頁$1.5，屬不同（較廉宜）的服務。項目4的$3,810是申請批給牌照的費用，而$945則是批給及續期申請中就每一個須判定是否適當人選的人所加收的費用——兩者均不適用於核證登記冊記項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1（旁註）

en.q: How does Schedule 1 to the AMLO define 'money service'?
options: A money changing or remittance service, operated in Hong Kong as a business
Only a service for exchanging currencies operated in Hong Kong as a business
Only a service of sending or receiving money to or from a place outside Hong Kong
The meaning given to 'stored value facility' under Cap. 584
en.explain: Schedule 1 defines money service as (a) a money changing service or (b) a remittance service operated in Hong Kong as a business. Option 2 states only the money-changing branch and omits remittance; option 3 states only the remittance branch and omits money changing. Option 4 describes 'stored value facility', a separate term defined by cross-reference to the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584), not 'money service'.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1如何界定「金錢服務」？
options: 指在香港以經營業務方式運作的貨幣兌換服務，或匯款服務
只指在香港以經營業務方式運作的貨幣兌換服務
只指從香港以外地方付予或收取金錢的服務
《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》給予「儲值支付工具」的涵義
tc.explain: 附表1將「金錢服務」界定為（a）貨幣兌換服務，或（b）匯款服務，兩者均須在香港以經營業務方式運作。選項2只述及貨幣兌換部分，遺漏匯款部分；選項3只述及匯款部分，遺漏貨幣兌換部分。選項4描述的是「儲值支付工具」——另一個以參照《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）界定涵義的詞，並非「金錢服務」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(1)(a)條

en.q: What must be kept in relation to each transaction an institution carries out, under section 20(1)(a) of Schedule 2?
options: The original or a copy of the transaction documents, and a record of the data and information obtained under Part 2
The original or a copy of documents obtained in identifying and verifying the customer or beneficial owner's identity
The original or a copy of files relating to the customer's account and correspondence with the customer or beneficial owner
Effective procedures for identifying wire transfers not complying with section 12(5)
en.explain: Section 20(1)(a) requires records of the documents, data and information obtained in connection with each transaction, kept under Part 2 of Schedule 2. Options 2 and 3 instead describe the section 20(1)(b) duty to keep customer/beneficial-owner identity and account records — a related but separate record-keeping duty. Option 4 describes the section 19(2) duty to establish wire-transfer procedures, a different type of obligation entirely.

tc.q: 根據附表2第20(1)(a)條，機構就其進行的每宗交易須保存甚麼？
options: 按附表2第2部就該交易取得的文件正本或複本，以及數據及資料的紀錄
在識別及核實客戶或實益擁有人身分時取得的文件正本或複本
關乎客戶戶口及與客戶或實益擁有人的業務通訊的檔案正本或複本
識辨不符合第12(5)條的電傳轉賬的有效程序
tc.explain: 第20(1)(a)條規定須就每宗交易，保存按附表2第2部取得的文件正本或複本，以及數據及資料的紀錄。選項2及3所述的分別是第20(1)(b)條下就客戶或實益擁有人身分及帳戶所備存的紀錄——屬相關但不同的備存紀錄責任。選項4所述的是第19(2)條設立電傳轉賬程序的責任，屬完全不同性質的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(6)條

en.q: Does section 18 prevent an institution from carrying out CDD measures through an agent rather than a specified intermediary?
options: No — the institution may use an agent but remains liable for failing to carry out the measure
Yes — a CDD measure may be carried out only through a specified intermediary
Yes, unless the agent consents in writing to act as the institution's intermediary
No, but liability instead passes to the agent for any failure to carry out the measure
en.explain: Section 18(6) confirms that nothing in section 18 stops an institution using an agent, but the institution remains liable under the Ordinance for any failure — the same liability rule as section 18(2) applies to specified intermediaries. Option 3 wrongly imports the written-consent condition that section 18(1)(a) applies to intermediaries, not agents. Option 4 wrongly shifts liability to the agent, when section 18(6) keeps it on the institution.

tc.q: 第18條是否阻止機構藉代理人（而非指明中介人）進行客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 否——機構可用代理人，仍須就失責負法律責任
是——客戶盡職審查措施只可藉指明中介人進行
是，除非該代理人以書面同意擔任該機構的中介人
否，但沒有進行該措施的法律責任轉由代理人承擔
tc.explain: 第18(6)條確認第18條並不阻止機構使用代理人，但該機構仍須根據本條例就沒有進行該措施負法律責任——與第18(2)條就指明中介人所定的責任規則相同。選項3錯誤地將第18(1)(a)條適用於中介人的書面同意規定，套用於代理人。選項4則錯誤地將法律責任轉移至代理人，而第18(6)條實際上是由機構繼續承擔。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(3A)條

en.q: What conditions must a related foreign financial institution meet to act as a specified intermediary under section 18(3)(d)?
options: Required under group policy to have compliance measures, supervised at group level
Wholly owned by the Hong Kong financial institution that treats it as an intermediary
Authorized to carry on banking business in that place, with a physical presence there
Located in a jurisdiction that is a member of the Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: Section 18(3A) requires the related foreign financial institution to be required under group policy to have measures ensuring Schedule 2-like compliance and AML/CFT programmes, and to be supervised for compliance at group level. Option 3 instead borrows the physical-presence and banking-authorization test that section 17(1) uses to define a shell bank — a different concept. Options 2 and 4 (ownership, FATF membership) appear nowhere in section 18(3A).

tc.q: 有關連的外地金融機構須符合甚麼條件，方可根據第18(3)(d)條擔任指明中介人？
options: 根據集團政策設有合規措施，並在集團層面受監督
由該香港金融機構全資擁有，並被視為其中介人
在當地獲授權經營銀行業務，並設有實體存在
位於財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第18(3A)條規定有關連的外地金融機構須根據集團政策設有措施，確保遵從與附表2類似的規定並推行打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集計劃，並須在集團層面受監督其遵從情況。選項3所述其實是第17(1)條界定空殼銀行時所用的實體存在及銀行業務授權標準，屬不同的概念。選項2（全資擁有）及選項4（財務行動特別組織成員）在第18(3A)條中均未提及。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18(4)(c)條

en.q: Where a financial institution relies on a related foreign financial institution as its specified intermediary, what additional step is required?
options: Taking reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk involved
Obtaining the relevant authority's written approval for each customer
Duplicating the CDD measure in Hong Kong within 30 days
Obtaining the customer's consent to the cross-border arrangement
en.explain: Section 18(4)(c) requires a financial institution, where the intermediary is a specified intermediary under section 18(3)(d) — a related foreign financial institution — to take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved, in addition to the general obligations in paragraphs (a) and (b).

tc.q: 如金融機構倚賴有關連的外地金融機構作為其指明中介人，須另行採取甚麼步驟？
options: 採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險
就每名客戶取得有關當局的書面批准
於30日內在香港重複進行該客戶盡職審查措施
取得該客戶對該跨境安排的同意
tc.explain: 第18(4)(c)條規定，如該中介人屬第18(3)(d)條的指明中介人（即有關連的外地金融機構），金融機構除須履行(a)及(b)款的一般責任外，還須採取合理措施減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第17(1)條

en.q: Which four characteristics together identify a corporation as a shell bank for the purposes of section 17(1) of Schedule 2?
options: Incorporated outside Hong Kong, authorized to carry on banking business, without a physical presence there, and not affiliated with a bank that has one
Incorporated outside Hong Kong, authorized to carry on banking business there, with a physical presence there, and not affiliated with a bank
Incorporated outside Hong Kong, not authorized to carry on banking business there, without a physical presence there, and not affiliated with a bank
Incorporated outside Hong Kong, authorized to carry on banking business, without a physical presence there, but affiliated with a bank that has one
en.explain: Section 17(1) defines a shell bank by four elements together: incorporated outside Hong Kong, authorized to bank there, without a physical presence there, and not an affiliate of a corporation that is incorporated, authorized to bank, and physically present in some jurisdiction. Option 2 wrongly gives the corporation a physical presence (element (c) fails). Option 3 wrongly denies it banking authorization (element (b) fails). Option 4 wrongly makes it an affiliate of a bank with a presence (element (d) fails) — any one of these takes the corporation outside the shell-bank definition.

tc.q: 哪四項特徵合起來令某法團就附表2第17(1)條而言屬空殼銀行？
options: 在香港以外註冊成立、在當地獲授權經營銀行業務、並無實體存在，且非在某司法管轄區設有實體存在的銀行的聯屬公司
在香港以外註冊成立、在當地獲授權經營銀行業務、在當地設有實體存在，且並非任何銀行的聯屬公司
在香港以外註冊成立、在當地並無獲授權經營銀行業務、在當地並無實體存在，且並非任何銀行的聯屬公司
在香港以外註冊成立、在當地獲授權經營銀行業務、並無實體存在，但屬某司法管轄區設有實體存在的銀行的聯屬公司
tc.explain: 第17(1)條以四項要素合起來界定空殼銀行：在香港以外註冊成立、在當地獲授權經營銀行業務、在當地並無實體存在，且並非某法團（在某司法管轄區註冊成立、獲授權經營銀行業務並設有實體存在）的聯屬公司。選項2錯誤地令該法團在當地設有實體存在（要素(c)不成立）。選項3錯誤地令該法團未獲授權經營銀行業務（要素(b)不成立）。選項4錯誤地令該法團成為設有實體存在的銀行的聯屬公司（要素(d)不成立）——只要其中一項要素不成立，該法團即不屬空殼銀行的定義範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(2A)條

en.q: Section 19(2A) of Schedule 2 imposes a procedures duty on a financial institution that carries out virtual asset transfers. What must those procedures cover?
options: Identifying and handling virtual asset transfers where section 13A(4) has not been complied with
Identifying and handling wire transfers where section 12(5) has not been complied with
Valuing virtual assets at the time of transfer for the institution's risk management purposes
Converting virtual assets into Hong Kong dollars before the transfer can proceed
en.explain: Section 19(2A), added in 2022, requires effective procedures for identifying and handling virtual asset transfers in relation to which section 13A(4) of Schedule 2 has not been complied with. Option 2 describes section 19(2)'s parallel duty for wire transfers, which cross-refers to section 12(5) instead — a different transfer type. Options 3 and 4 (valuation, currency conversion) are not duties imposed by section 19(2A) at all.

tc.q: 附表2第19(2A)條規定進行虛擬資產轉移的金融機構須設立程序。該等程序須涵蓋甚麼？
options: 識別及處理未有遵從第13A(4)條的虛擬資產轉移
識辨及處理不符合第12(5)條的電傳轉賬
為機構本身的風險管理目的，於轉移時為虛擬資產估值
在轉移前將虛擬資產兌換為港元
tc.explain: 2022年加入的第19(2A)條規定須有有效程序，以識別及處理未有遵從附表2第13A(4)條的虛擬資產轉移。選項2所述是第19(2)條就電傳轉賬所定的對應責任，該條文援引的是第12(5)條——屬不同的轉移類型。選項3及4（估值、貨幣兌換）均非第19(2A)條所施加的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4（旁註）

en.q: What is the subject matter of Schedule 4 to the AMLO?
options: Provisions on the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal
Fees payable under the licensing regime, as set out in Schedule 3 to the Ordinance
Customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements set out in Schedule 2 to the Ordinance
Interpretation provisions applying to the whole Ordinance, set out in Schedule 1
en.explain: Schedule 4 is headed 'Provisions Relating to Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal'. Fees are dealt with in Schedule 3, customer due diligence and record-keeping in Schedule 2, and interpretation in Schedule 1 — each a distinct Schedule from Schedule 4.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4的主題為何？
options: 關於打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審裁處的條文
發牌制度下應繳的費用，載於本條例附表3
客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存，載於本條例附表2
適用於本條例整體的釋義條文，載於附表1
tc.explain: 附表4的標題為「關於打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審裁處的條文」。費用事宜載於附表3，客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存載於附表2，釋義則載於附表1——三者均為有別於附表4的獨立附表。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(1)條

en.q: Who appoints the panel of persons from whom ordinary members of the Review Tribunal are drawn, and what disqualifies a person from that panel?
options: The Secretary appoints the panel, and public officers may not be appointed
The Chief Justice appoints the panel, and solicitors may not be appointed
The Commissioner appoints the panel, and former licensees may not be appointed
The Chief Executive appoints the panel, and non-residents may not be appointed
en.explain: Section 2(1) of Schedule 4 requires the Secretary to appoint a panel of persons whom the Secretary considers suitable for appointment as ordinary members of the Tribunal and who are not public officers.

tc.q: 審裁處普通成員從何處挑選的小組由何人委任？何種身分令某人不合資格加入該小組？
options: 由局長委任該小組，而公職人員不得獲委任加入
由終審法院首席法官委任該小組，而律師不得獲委任
由海關關長委任該小組，而前持牌人不得獲委任
由行政長官委任該小組，而非居民不得獲委任
tc.explain: 附表4第2(1)條規定局長須委任一個小組，其成員為局長認為適合獲委任為審裁處普通成員，並且並非公職人員的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(5)條

en.q: On which grounds may the Secretary remove a panel member from office?
options: Incapacity, bankruptcy, neglect of duty, conflict of interest, or misconduct
Only misconduct that has been proved in formal disciplinary proceedings
Only bankruptcy or conviction for an indictable offence in Hong Kong
Any ground that the Secretary alone considers appropriate
en.explain: Section 2(5) of Schedule 4 lists exactly these five grounds — incapacity, bankruptcy, neglect of duty, conflict of interest or misconduct — the same grounds used for the chairperson under section 3(5)(b). The Secretary's power is not open-ended (ruling out option 4), and is not confined to misconduct alone or to bankruptcy/conviction alone (ruling out options 2 and 3).

tc.q: 局長可基於哪些理由將小組成員免任？
options: 無能力履行職責、破產、疏於職守、利益衝突或行為失當
只限經正式紀律程序審訊後證明成立的行為失當
只限破產或被裁定於香港干犯可公訴罪行
局長個人認為適當而不受任何限制的任何理由
tc.explain: 附表4第2(5)條列明正正是這五項理由——無能力履行職責、破產、疏於職守、利益衝突或行為失當，與第3(5)(b)條就主席所定的理由相同。局長的權力並非漫無限制（故選項4不成立），亦不限於單單行為失當，或單單破產或定罪（故選項2及3不成立）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第3(1)條

en.q: What is the maximum term of appointment of the chairperson of the Review Tribunal?
options: 3 years, with reappointment permitted after expiry
5 years, with no reappointment permitted under any circumstance
2 years, renewable once only upon the Secretary's approval
There is no statutory maximum term for the chairperson
en.explain: Section 3(1) of Schedule 4 caps the chairperson's term at 3 years, and section 3(2) allows reappointment after expiry. Options 2 and 3 invent wrong term lengths and wrong reappointment rules; option 4 is wrong because subsection (1) does fix a maximum.

tc.q: 審裁處主席的最長任期為多久？
options: 3年，任期屆滿後可獲再度委任
5年，任期屆滿不可再度委任
2年，經局長批准可續任一次
並無任何法律規定的最長任期
tc.explain: 附表4第3(1)條將主席任期上限定為3年，第3(2)條則准許任期屆滿後再度委任。選項2及3捏造了錯誤的任期長度及再度委任規則；選項4則錯誤，因為第(1)款確實訂有上限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第3(5)條

en.q: Besides the general grounds of incapacity, bankruptcy, neglect of duty, conflict of interest or misconduct, on what further ground may the chairperson be removed?
options: That the chairperson is no longer qualified for appointment under section 56(2)
That the chairperson has determined more reviews than a number fixed by the Secretary
That a party to the review has formally objected to the chairperson
That the chairperson has reached the retirement age set for a High Court judge
en.explain: Section 3(5)(a) of Schedule 4 adds the further ground that the chairperson is no longer qualified for appointment under section 56(2) — broadly, no longer eligible as a High Court judge or improperly holding another public office. No provision sets a case quota, allows party objection, or fixes a retirement-age trigger for removal.

tc.q: 除無能力履行職責、破產、疏於職守、利益衝突或行為失當等一般理由外，主席還可基於甚麼理由被免任？
options: 該主席不再符合第56(2)條的資格
該主席已裁定的覆核數目超過局長所定的數目
覆核的一方已正式就該主席提出反對
該主席已達到高等法院法官的退休年齡
tc.explain: 附表4第3(5)(a)條加入的進一步理由，是該主席已不再符合第56(2)條下獲委任為主席的資格——大致即不再符合資格獲委任為高等法院法官，或不當地兼任其他公職。並無條文設有案件數量上限、容許一方反對，或以退休年齡作為免任的觸發點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第4(1)條

en.q: How are the two ordinary members of the Tribunal appointed for the purpose of determining a particular review?
options: By the Secretary, on the chairperson's recommendation, from the panel
By the chairperson alone, selecting from among the panel members
By the parties to the review, each nominating one panel member
By the Chief Justice, selecting from among serving or retired judges
en.explain: Section 4(1) of Schedule 4 requires the Secretary to appoint the 2 ordinary members, but only on the chairperson's recommendation — a shared role, not the chairperson acting alone (option 2), the parties nominating (option 3), or the Chief Justice appointing (option 4, whose role under section 9(5) is limited to appointing a judge to sit when the chairperson cannot).

tc.q: 為裁定某項覆核，審裁處的兩名普通成員如何獲委任？
options: 由局長按主席的推薦，從小組成員中委任
由主席自行從小組成員中揀選委任
由覆核各方各自提名一名小組成員
由終審法院首席法官從退休法官中揀選
tc.explain: 附表4第4(1)條規定由局長委任該兩名普通成員，但須按主席的推薦而行——屬局長與主席共同參與的角色，並非主席獨自行事（選項2）、由各方提名（選項3），或由終審法院首席法官委任（選項4——其在第9(5)條下的角色僅限於在主席不能行事時委任法官署任）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第4(5)條

en.q: What is the consequence if an ordinary member ceases to be a panel member during a review?
options: He or she ceases to be an ordinary member
He or she may continue as an ordinary member until the review is determined
The review must be discontinued automatically
The Secretary must appoint a replacement without the chairperson's recommendation
en.explain: Section 4(5) of Schedule 4 provides that if an ordinary member ceases to be a panel member, he or she ceases to be an ordinary member. Section 5(2) then governs whether proceedings may continue despite the change in membership.

tc.q: 如普通成員在覆核期間不再是小組成員，有何後果？
options: 該人隨即不再是普通成員
該人可繼續擔任普通成員直至該覆核獲裁定
該項覆核須自動終止
局長須在無主席推薦下委任替補人選
tc.explain: 附表4第4(5)條訂明，如普通成員不再是小組成員，該人即不再是普通成員。第5(2)條繼而規管在成員組成有變的情況下，法律程序可否繼續進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第5(1)條

en.q: The chairperson's term of appointment expires after a review has begun but before it is determined. What may happen?
options: The person may continue as chairperson for that review until it is determined
The review must start afresh before a newly appointed chairperson
The two ordinary members alone must determine the review between them
The review must be transferred to the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 5(1) of Schedule 4 lets the chairperson finish a review already underway despite the term expiring, rather than requiring a restart (option 2), leaving it to the ordinary members alone (option 3, contrary to section 6(3)'s requirement that the chairperson be present at every sitting), or transferring it out of the Tribunal altogether (option 4).

tc.q: 主席的任期在覆核開始後但在裁定前屆滿。可能會怎樣？
options: 該人可繼續署任主席，直至裁定為止
該項覆核須在新委任的主席席前重新開始
須只由兩名普通成員自行裁定該項覆核
該項覆核須移交原訟法庭處理及裁定
tc.explain: 附表4第5(1)條容許主席在任期屆滿時，就已在進行的覆核繼續署任，而無須重新開始（選項2）、單獨交由兩名普通成員裁定（選項3——與第6(3)條規定主席須出席每次聆訊相違）,或將案件移交審裁處以外的原訟法庭（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第5(2)及(3)條

en.q: The membership of the Tribunal changes during proceedings for a review. On what basis may the proceedings continue?
options: Only if the parties consent; otherwise proceedings must be discontinued
Only with the leave of the Court of First Instance, on the chairperson's application
Automatically, since the Tribunal continues in being regardless of its membership
Only if the change concerns an ordinary member rather than the chairperson
en.explain: Sections 5(2) and (3) of Schedule 4 make continuation depend solely on party consent; without it the proceedings are discontinued but may begin anew. No leave of court is required (option 2), continuation is not automatic (option 3), and the rule does not distinguish between a change of chairperson and a change of ordinary member (option 4).

tc.q: 審裁處的成員組成在覆核的法律程序期間有變。該法律程序可基於甚麼繼續進行？
options: 只有各方同意方可；否則須終止，但可重新開始
只可經原訟法庭應主席的申請而批准許可
自動繼續，因審裁處不論成員如何均延續存在
只限有關變動涉及普通成員而非主席
tc.explain: 第5(2)及(3)條規定法律程序可否繼續進行，純粹取決於各方是否同意；如不同意，該法律程序須終止，但可重新開始。並無須經法庭許可的規定（選項2）、並非自動繼續（選項3），且該規則並無區分主席與普通成員的變動（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(3)及(4)條

en.q: What is the minimum composition required for a Tribunal sitting, and who has the right to preside?
options: Chairperson and 2 ordinary members; chairperson presides at every sitting
Any two members, who then elect one of themselves to preside
The chairperson sitting alone is sufficient in every case
The chairperson and one ordinary member, with either free to preside
en.explain: Sections 6(3) and (4) of Schedule 4 require the chairperson and both ordinary members to be present, with the chairperson presiding at every sitting — not an elected presider (option 2), not the chairperson alone (option 3, which is only permitted under section 9's separate sole-member procedure), and not a partial bench of one ordinary member (option 4).

tc.q: 審裁處聆訊所需的最低成員組合為何？何人有權主持？
options: 主席及2名普通成員；並由主席主持每次聆訊
任何兩名成員，並由他們互選其中一人主持
在任何情況下均只須主席獨自出席已足夠
主席及一名普通成員，由各方屬意的人主持
tc.explain: 第6(3)及(4)條規定主席及兩名普通成員均須出席，並由主席主持每次聆訊——並非由成員互選主持人（選項2）、並非只須主席獨自出席（選項3——此做法只在第9條另訂的唯一成員程序下方獲准許）,亦非只須一名普通成員出席的不完整組合（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(5)條

en.q: How is a question of law before the Review Tribunal determined?
options: By the chairperson alone; other questions by a majority of votes cast
By a majority of the votes cast by the chairperson and the ordinary members together
By unanimous agreement of the chairperson and both ordinary members
By referral of the question to the Court of First Instance for a ruling
en.explain: Section 6(5) of Schedule 4 carves out questions of law as the one exception the chairperson decides alone; every other question needs a majority of votes cast by all three members (option 2's rule, wrongly applied here to law questions), not unanimity (option 3) or referral to a court (option 4, which section 6(5) does not provide for).

tc.q: 審裁處席前的法律問題如何裁定？
options: 主席獨自裁定；其他多數票裁定
以主席及普通成員的過半數票裁定
須經主席及兩名普通成員一致同意
將有關問題轉交原訟法庭裁定
tc.explain: 第6(5)條將法律問題定為唯一由主席獨自裁定的例外；所有其他問題均須以三名成員所投票數的過半數裁定（選項2的規則，卻被錯誤套用於法律問題）,而非一致同意（選項3）或轉交法庭（選項4——第6(5)條並無此規定）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(6)及(7)條

en.q: What is the default position on whether Tribunal sittings are held in public, and when may that change?
options: Public, unless the Tribunal finds otherwise justified in the interests of justice
Private, unless a party applies for and is granted leave for a public hearing instead
Private in every case, since Schedule 4 gives the Tribunal no power to sit in public
Decided case-by-case by the chairperson alone, without any statutory test to apply
en.explain: Section 6(6) of Schedule 4 makes public sittings the default, displaced under section 6(7) only where the Tribunal — on its own initiative or a party's application — finds a private sitting justified in the interests of justice. Schedule 4 does not make private sittings the default (options 2 and 3, and option 3 is additionally wrong that the Tribunal has no public-sitting power at all), and the chairperson does not decide without applying that statutory test (option 4).

tc.q: 審裁處聆訊是否公開進行的預設立場為何？在甚麼情況下可有改變？
options: 公開進行，除非審裁處基於司法公正的利益裁定須非公開進行
非公開進行，除非有一方申請並獲批准以公開方式進行聆訊
在任何情況下均以非公開方式進行，因附表4無賦予公開聆訊的權力
由主席按個別情況獨自決定，無須應用任何法定準則
tc.explain: 第6(6)條以公開聆訊為預設安排，只有在第6(7)條下，經審裁處自行或應一方申請，裁定基於司法公正的利益而有理由非公開進行時，方會改變。附表4並非以非公開聆訊為預設安排（選項2及3，選項3更錯誤地指審裁處完全無公開聆訊的權力），主席作出決定時亦須應用該法定準則（選項4錯誤地略去此準則）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(8)條

en.q: An application is made for a sitting to be held in private. How must the hearing of that application itself be conducted?
options: It must be held in private
It must be held in public, since the substantive sitting is presumed public
It must be determined on the papers without any hearing
It must be referred to the Court of First Instance
en.explain: Section 6(8) of Schedule 4 provides that if an application is made under subsection (7) for a private sitting, any hearing of the application must be held in private — otherwise the very matter to be protected would be aired publicly.

tc.q: 如有人申請以非公開方式進行聆訊，該項申請本身的聆訊須如何進行？
options: 須以非公開方式進行
須公開進行，因實體聆訊推定為公開
須僅按書面文件裁定，無須進行聆訊
須轉交原訟法庭
tc.explain: 附表4第6(8)條訂明，如根據第(7)款提出以非公開方式進行聆訊的申請，該項申請的任何聆訊須以非公開方式進行——否則擬受保護的事宜本身即會被公開。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(9)條

en.q: Through whom is a partnership entitled to be heard at a sitting of the Review Tribunal?
options: Through a partner, solicitor or counsel, or with leave, anyone else
Only through a solicitor or counsel formally instructed for the hearing
Only through the partnership's managing partner, appearing in person
Only through a representative pre-approved by the Secretary in writing
en.explain: Section 6(9) of Schedule 4 lets a partnership be heard through a partner (matching how a corporation is heard through an officer or employee), and — like every party — through a solicitor or counsel or, with the Tribunal's leave, through any other person. It is not confined to solicitor/counsel alone (option 2), to the managing partner alone (option 3), or to a Secretary-approved representative, a concept this section does not use (option 4).

tc.q: 合夥有權透過何人在審裁處聆訊中陳詞？
options: 透過合夥人、律師、大律師或經許可的他人
只可透過正式獲聘代表該次聆訊的律師或大律師
只可由合夥的管理合夥人親自出席陳詞
只可透過事先經局長書面批准的代表
tc.explain: 第6(9)條容許合夥透過合夥人陳詞（與法團透過高級人員或僱員陳詞相對應），並如同任何一方般，可透過律師或大律師，或經審裁處許可透過任何其他人陳詞。並不限於只可透過律師或大律師（選項2）、只可由管理合夥人（選項3），或本條並無使用的「經局長事先批准的代表」概念（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(11)條（「代表」的定義）

en.q: In relation to the Commissioner, who is a "representative" for the purposes of appearing before the Review Tribunal?
options: A public officer employed in Customs and Excise
Appointed by the Financial Secretary under Cap. 66
An employee of the Securities and Futures Commission
A public officer employed in the Companies Registry
en.explain: Section 6(11) of Schedule 4 defines representative, for the Commissioner, as a public officer employed in the Customs and Excise Department. The same subsection separately defines it for the Monetary Authority (option 2, a Financial Secretary appointee under the Exchange Fund Ordinance), the Securities and Futures Commission (option 3, its own employee), and the Registrar (option 4, a Companies Registry officer) — each a different authority's representative, not the Commissioner's.

tc.q: 就在審裁處席前出庭而言，關長的「代表」指何人？
options: 受僱任職於香港海關的公職人員
由財政司司長依《外匯基金條例》委任
證券及期貨事務監察委員會的僱員
受僱任職於公司註冊處的公職人員
tc.explain: 第6(11)條就關長將「代表」界定為受僱任職於香港海關的公職人員。同一款分別就金融管理專員（選項2，由財政司司長根據《外匯基金條例》委任的人）、證監會（選項3，其僱員），以及處長（選項4，受僱任職於公司註冊處的公職人員）界定「代表」——三者均為其他當局的代表，並非關長的代表。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(10)條

en.q: Who must prepare a record of the proceedings of every sitting of the Review Tribunal?
options: The chairperson, who includes any particulars considered appropriate
The Secretary, using a form prescribed by regulation
A court reporter appointed by the Chief Justice for the sitting
Each party, who exchange their records at the close of the sitting
en.explain: Section 6(10) of Schedule 4 places the record-keeping duty on the chairperson, who decides what particulars to include — not the Secretary using a prescribed form (option 2, and no such form is prescribed by Schedule 4), not a court reporter (option 3, a role Schedule 4 does not create), and not the parties themselves (option 4).

tc.q: 何人須為審裁處每次聆訊的法律程序備存紀錄？
options: 主席，並可載有其認為適當的任何詳情
局長，並須採用規例訂明的格式
由終審法院首席法官委任的法庭紀錄員
各方，須於聆訊結束時互相交換紀錄
tc.explain: 第6(10)條將備存紀錄的責任放於主席身上，並由主席決定須載有哪些詳情——並非由局長採用訂明格式（選項2，而附表4亦無訂明此等格式）、並非由法庭紀錄員（選項3，附表4並無設立此角色），亦非由各方自行備存（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(1)條

en.q: For what purposes may the chairperson direct that a preliminary conference be held?
options: Preparing the parties, assisting on issues, and securing just, economical conduct
Attempting to settle the review completely, so that the Tribunal need never determine it
Assessing whether the applicant can afford the costs of pursuing the review to a hearing
Determining whether the application for review under section 59 was made within time
en.explain: Section 7(1) of Schedule 4 lists three purposes for a preliminary conference: preparing the parties, assisting the Tribunal to determine issues, and securing just, expeditious and economical conduct generally. It is not a full settlement mechanism (option 2), a means-testing exercise (option 3), or a forum for ruling on timeliness — that question is instead decided under section 59(2), which section 9(2)(a) lets the chairperson determine alone (option 4).

tc.q: 主席可為哪些目的指示舉行預備會議？
options: 使各方能作準備、協助決定爭論點，並確保公正經濟地進行
嘗試將該項覆核完全和解，使審裁處無須就此作出裁定
評估申請人能否負擔將覆核進行至聆訊所需的費用
裁定根據第59條提出的覆核申請是否於時限內提出
tc.explain: 第7(1)條列出預備會議的三項目的：使各方能為進行覆核作準備、協助審裁處決定爭論點，以及大體上確保覆核公正、迅速及經濟地進行。這並非完全和解機制（選項2）、經濟能力審查（選項3），或裁定時限的場合——後者是根據第59(2)條裁定的問題，而第9(2)(a)條容許主席就此獨自裁定（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(2)條

en.q: What condition must be met before the chairperson may direct that a preliminary conference be held?
options: The parties to the review must agree to the giving of the direction
The Secretary must approve the holding of the conference
At least 14 days must have elapsed since the application for review
The specified authority must have filed its response
en.explain: Section 7(2) of Schedule 4 provides that the chairperson may only give a direction under subsection (1) if the parties to the review agree to the giving of the direction. Section 7(3) permits the chairperson to consider material already submitted before giving the direction.

tc.q: 主席可指示舉行預備會議前，須符合甚麼條件？
options: 覆核各方須同意作出該項指示
局長須批准舉行該會議
自覆核申請提出後須已過至少14日
指明當局須已提交回應
tc.explain: 附表4第7(2)條訂明，主席只有在覆核各方同意作出該項指示的情況下，方可根據第(1)款作出指示。第7(3)條准許主席在作出指示前考慮已提交的材料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第8(1)條

en.q: On what conditions may the Tribunal or the chairperson make a consent order under section 8 of Schedule 4?
options: The parties request and agree to the order, and consent to all of its terms
The parties have exchanged written submissions and the chairperson approves them
The specified authority alone requests that the order be made
The Secretary certifies in writing that the order serves the public interest
en.explain: Section 8(1) of Schedule 4 conditions a consent order on the parties requesting and agreeing to the order and consenting to all its terms — not on an exchange of submissions (option 2), a request from the specified authority alone without the applicant (option 3), or Secretary certification, a step section 8 does not require (option 4).

tc.q: 審裁處或主席可在甚麼條件下根據附表4第8條作出同意令？
options: 各方要求並同意該命令，並同意其所有條款
各方已交換書面陳詞，並經主席批准
只由指明當局單方面要求作出該命令
局長以書面證明該命令符合公眾利益
tc.explain: 第8(1)條規定作出同意令的條件，是各方要求並同意作出該命令，並同意該命令的所有條款——並非陳詞交換（選項2）、由指明當局單方面要求而無申請人參與（選項3），或第8條並無規定的局長證明程序（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第8(2)及(3)條

en.q: What status does a consent order under section 8 of Schedule 4 have, and what does "order" include for this purpose?
options: Treated as an order in compliance with usual requirements; 'order' includes any finding or determination
Binding only on the parties who consented, with no wider effect; 'order' means a monetary order only
Provisional until it is confirmed at a full sitting; 'order' means only a final determination
Advisory only, with no binding effect at all; 'order' includes non-binding recommendations
en.explain: Section 8(2) of Schedule 4 treats a consent order for all purposes as an order made in compliance with the requirements otherwise applicable, and section 8(3) defines 'order' broadly to include any finding, determination and any other decision. It is not merely binding on consenting parties (option 2), not provisional pending confirmation (option 3, a step section 8 does not require), and not merely advisory (option 4) — it has the same full effect as any other order.

tc.q: 附表4第8條下的同意令具有甚麼地位？就此而言「命令」包括甚麼？
options: 視為符合通常適用規定而作出的命令；「命令」包括任何裁斷或裁定
只對同意的各方具約束力，並無廣泛效力；「命令」只指金錢命令
在全體聆訊確認前屬臨時性質；「命令」只指最終裁定
只屬諮詢性質，完全並無約束力；「命令」包括不具約束力的建議
tc.explain: 第8(2)條訂明同意令就一切目的而言，視為符合通常適用規定而作出的命令，第8(3)條則將「命令」廣義界定為包括任何裁斷、裁定及任何其他決定。同意令並非只對同意的各方具約束力（選項2）、並非須待全體聆訊確認的臨時決定（選項3——第8條並無此規定），亦非只屬諮詢性質（選項4）——其效力與任何其他命令相同。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(1)條

en.q: What must happen before a review can be decided by the chairperson alone, without the two ordinary members?
options: The parties must notify the Tribunal in writing before a sitting that they agree
The amount in dispute must fall below a threshold that the Secretary has set
There must be no ordinary members available for appointment to the panel
The specified authority must confirm in writing that it has no objection
en.explain: Section 9(1) of Schedule 4 requires the parties, before any sitting is held to determine the review, to inform the Tribunal in writing that they have agreed the chairperson may decide it alone. Nothing turns on the amount in dispute (option 2), the availability of panel members (option 3), or written confirmation from the specified authority (option 4) — none of these are conditions this section imposes.

tc.q: 在覆核由主席獨自裁定（無須兩名普通成員參與）之前，須先發生甚麼事？
options: 各方須於聆訊前書面通知審裁處同意
爭議款額須低於局長所定的門檻
須並無普通成員可供委任加入小組
指明當局須以書面確認並無反對
tc.explain: 第9(1)條規定，在舉行任何裁定該覆核的聆訊之前，各方須以書面通知審裁處他們已同意由主席獨自裁定該覆核。這與爭議款額（選項2）、小組成員是否有空（選項3），或指明當局的書面確認（選項4）均無關——本條並無訂立這些條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(2)條

en.q: Which two kinds of application may the chairperson determine alone, without the parties' agreement?
options: An application under section 59(2) for more time, or under section 69(2) for a stay
An application for costs, and an application to adduce further evidence
An application for a private sitting, and an application for a preliminary conference
An application to appeal to the Court of Appeal, and an application for leave to appeal
en.explain: Section 9(2) of Schedule 4 lets the chairperson alone determine only two kinds of application: an extension of time under section 59(2), and a stay of execution under section 69(2). Costs and evidence applications (option 2), private-sitting and conference applications (option 3, both decided under section 6(7) and section 7(1) by different means) and appeal-related applications (option 4) are not among them.

tc.q: 主席可在無須各方同意下獨自裁定哪兩類申請？
options: 根據第59(2)條延展時限，或第69(2)條暫緩執行申請
要求裁定訟費的申請，以及要求提交進一步證據的申請
要求以非公開方式聆訊的申請，以及要求舉行預備會議的申請
要求向上訴法庭提出上訴的申請，以及要求批予上訴許可的申請
tc.explain: 第9(2)條准許主席以唯一成員身分裁定的申請只有兩類：根據第59(2)條延展時限的申請，以及根據第69(2)條暫緩執行的申請。訟費及證據申請（選項2）、非公開聆訊及預備會議申請（選項3——兩者分別按第6(7)及第7(1)條以不同方式裁定），以及上訴相關的申請（選項4）均不在此列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(3)條

en.q: What is the status of the Tribunal when the chairperson determines a matter as its sole member?
options: Regarded as a Tribunal also constituted by 2 ordinary members
Its determination is provisional until ratified by 2 ordinary members
Its determination binds only the applicant, not the specified authority
Its determination may be appealed without the leave of the Court of Appeal
en.explain: Section 9(3) of Schedule 4 provides that where the chairperson determines a review as sole member under subsection (1) or (2), the Tribunal so constituted is to be regarded for all purposes as the Tribunal constituted also by 2 ordinary members.

tc.q: 當主席以審裁處唯一成員身分裁定事宜時，審裁處具有甚麼地位？
options: 視為亦由2名普通成員組成的審裁處
其裁定屬臨時性質，直至獲2名普通成員追認
其裁定只對申請人具約束力，對指明當局則否
其裁定可無須上訴法庭許可即提出上訴
tc.explain: 附表4第9(3)條訂明，如主席根據第(1)或(2)款以唯一成員身分裁定覆核，則如此組成的審裁處就一切目的而言，視為亦由2名普通成員組成的審裁處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(5)條

en.q: The chairperson is unable, or considers it undesirable, to determine a stay application under section 69(2). Who then determines it?
options: A Court of First Instance judge appointed by the Chief Justice for the purpose
The two ordinary members, determining the stay application jointly
The Secretary, acting on a formal recommendation from the whole panel
The application lapses automatically and must be renewed at the next sitting
en.explain: Section 9(5) of Schedule 4 has the Chief Justice appoint a Court of First Instance judge or deputy judge to determine the application as if duly appointed chairperson — not the two ordinary members acting alone (option 2, which is not among their powers), the Secretary (option 3, who appoints panel members but does not decide applications), or a lapsed application (option 4, a consequence this section does not impose).

tc.q: 如主席無法裁定第69(2)條的暫緩申請，或認為不宜由其裁定，該申請由何人裁定？
options: 由終審法院首席法官為此委任的原訟法庭法官
由兩名普通成員共同裁定該暫緩申請
由局長按整個小組的正式推薦行事
該申請自動失效，須於下次聆訊重新提出
tc.explain: 第9(5)條由終審法院首席法官委任一名原訟法庭法官或暫委法官，猶如該法官是妥為委任的主席般裁定該申請——並非由兩名普通成員自行裁定（選項2，此非彼等的權力範圍）、由局長行事（選項3，局長只負責委任小組成員，並不裁定申請），或申請失效（選項4，本條並無此後果）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第9(4)條

en.q: After determining a stay application alone, what must the chairperson report to the Tribunal?
options: The determination made, its reasons, and other matters considered appropriate
Only the bare outcome reached, without giving any supporting reasons for it
Nothing, since a determination made alone is treated as final and binding
A recommendation as to how the wider review should ultimately be decided
en.explain: Section 9(4) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson to report the making of the determination and the reasons for it, plus any other matters considered appropriate — not just the bare outcome (option 2), nor is reporting excused because the determination stands (option 3), and section 9(4) calls for a report on the stay determination itself, not a recommendation on the underlying review (option 4).

tc.q: 主席獨自裁定暫緩申請後，須向審裁處報告甚麼？
options: 該裁定、理由，以及主席認為適當的其他事宜
只需報告結果，無須說明任何支持該結果的理由
完全無須報告，因獨自作出的裁定屬最終且具約束力
就整體覆核最終應如何作出裁決提出具體建議
tc.explain: 第9(4)條規定主席須報告該項裁定的作出及其理由，以及主席認為適當的任何其他事宜——並非只報告結果（選項2），亦不會因裁定屬最終而獲豁免報告（選項3），而第9(4)條要求報告的是該項暫緩裁定本身，並非就整體覆核提出建議（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第10條

en.q: What privileges and immunities do the Tribunal, its members, the parties and witnesses have in respect of a review?
options: The same as if the review were civil proceedings before the Court of First Instance
The same as apply in criminal proceedings before the District Court
Absolute immunity from all civil and criminal liability, without any exception whatsoever
None at all, unless specifically conferred by an order of the Tribunal itself
en.explain: Section 10 of Schedule 4 gives the Tribunal, its members, the parties and witnesses the same privileges and immunities they would have if the review were civil proceedings before the Court of First Instance — not District Court criminal proceedings (option 2), not absolute immunity (option 3, which overstates the civil-proceedings benchmark), and not something requiring a Tribunal order to exist (option 4).

tc.q: 就覆核而言，審裁處、其成員、各方及證人享有甚麼特權及豁免權？
options: 與該覆核假若是原訟法庭民事法律程序時所享有者相同
與區域法院刑事法律程序中適用者相同
對所有民事及刑事責任享有絕對豁免，並無任何例外
完全沒有，除非經審裁處本身特別頒令授予
tc.explain: 第10條賦予審裁處、其成員、各方及證人的特權及豁免權，與該覆核假若是原訟法庭席前的民事法律程序時所享有者相同——並非區域法院的刑事法律程序（選項2）、並非絕對豁免（選項3，誇大了民事法律程序這一基準），亦非須經審裁處頒令方存在（選項4）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(2)條

en.q: What directions may the chairperson give to the parties after an application for review has been received?
options: Directions on procedural matters, and the time to comply with them
Directions revealing the outcome the Tribunal is minded to reach on the review
Directions requiring the parties to settle the review between themselves
Directions transferring the review to the Court of First Instance for hearing
en.explain: Section 6(2) of Schedule 4 permits the chairperson, at any time after an application for review has been received, to give directions concerning procedural matters to be complied with by any party, and the time within which those matters are to be complied with — not directions that pre-judge the outcome, compel settlement, or transfer the matter to a court.

tc.q: 接獲覆核申請後，主席可向各方發出甚麼指示？
options: 關於各方須遵從的程序事宜及時限的指示
關於審裁處傾向就該覆核達致何種結果的指示
要求各方自行和解，以解決該覆核的指示
將該覆核事宜移交原訟法庭聆訊的指示
tc.explain: 附表4第6(2)條准許主席在接獲覆核申請後隨時，就任何一方須遵從的程序事宜，以及須於何時內遵從該等程序事宜，向覆核各方發出指示——並非預示結果、強逼和解或移交法院的指示。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(5)條

en.q: What may the chairperson do at a preliminary conference held under section 7 of Schedule 4?
options: Direct the review's just, expeditious and economical conduct, and try to secure agreements
Determine the review summarily against any party that fails, without excuse, to attend the conference
Impose costs sanctions on any party that unreasonably refuses a proposed settlement offer
Take evidence on oath from any witness present, and treat that evidence as conclusive proof
en.explain: Section 7(5) of Schedule 4 permits the chairperson at such a conference to give any direction considered necessary or desirable for the review's just, expeditious and economical conduct, and to try to get the parties to make all agreements they ought reasonably to have made — not to decide the review summarily for non-attendance, impose costs sanctions, or treat a witness's oral evidence as conclusive.

tc.q: 主席在根據附表4第7條舉行的預備會議上可作出甚麼？
options: 發出為該覆核公正、迅速及經濟進行的指示，並促使各方達成合理協議
如任何一方無合理解釋而不出席會議，即以簡易程序裁定不利於該方
對無合理理由拒絕同意建議和解方案的一方施加訟費制裁
向在場的任何證人錄取經宣誓的證據，並將其一律視為決定性的證據
tc.explain: 附表4第7(5)條准許主席在該等會議上發出其認為為確保覆核得以公正、迅速及經濟地進行而屬必需或合宜的任何指示，並嘗試促使各方達成其理應合理地達成的協議——並非因缺席而簡易裁定、施加訟費制裁，或將證人的口頭證據視為決定性證據。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第7(6)條

en.q: What must the chairperson do after a preliminary conference has been held?
options: Report to the Tribunal on conference matters deemed appropriate
Publish a full note of the conference proceedings in the Gazette
Provide each party with a verbatim transcript of the conference
Refer any issues left unresolved at the conference to the Secretary
en.explain: Section 7(6) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson, after a conference held under a section 7(1) direction, to report to the Tribunal on any matters relating to the conference the chairperson considers appropriate — not to gazette a note, hand out a verbatim transcript, or refer unresolved issues to the Secretary.

tc.q: 預備會議舉行後，主席須怎樣做？
options: 就認為適當會議事宜向審裁處報告
在憲報刊登會議過程的完整紀要
向出席各方提供該會議的逐字謄本
將會議中未解決的爭論點轉交局長
tc.explain: 附表4第7(6)條規定主席在按第7(1)款的指示舉行會議後，須就其認為適當的關於該會議的任何事宜，向審裁處報告——並非在憲報刊登紀要、提供逐字謄本，或將未解決事宜轉交局長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第1(1)條（定義）

en.q: How is an “ordinary member” of the Review Tribunal defined in Schedule 4?
options: A member of the Tribunal other than the chairperson
A member of the panel appointed under section 2(1)
A member who is not legally qualified
A member appointed for a term not exceeding 3 years
en.explain: Section 1(1) of Schedule 4 defines ordinary member as a member of the Tribunal other than the chairperson, and panel member as a member of the panel of persons appointed under section 2(1) of Schedule 4. Not every panel member is an ordinary member of a given Tribunal.

tc.q: 附表4如何界定審裁處的「普通成員」？
options: 審裁處中主席以外的成員
第2(1)條小組成員
並無法律專業資格的成員
任期不超過3年的成員
tc.explain: 附表4第1(1)條界定「普通成員」為審裁處中主席以外的成員，並界定「小組成員」為根據附表4第2(1)條委任的小組的成員。並非每名小組成員都是某一審裁處的普通成員。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(2)及(3)條

en.q: For what term may a panel member be appointed, and may they be reappointed?
options: Any term the Secretary considers appropriate, and reappointment after expiry is allowed
For a fixed term of exactly 3 years, with no possibility of reappointment at all
For a term determined solely by the chairperson, renewable once only
For life, removable only on the statutory grounds set out elsewhere in the Schedule
en.explain: Section 2(2) of Schedule 4 permits appointment for any term the Secretary considers appropriate (subject to the resignation and removal provisions), and section 2(3) allows a person whose term has expired to be reappointed — there is no fixed 3-year term, no chairperson-set term, and no life tenure.

tc.q: 小組成員可獲委任的任期為何？可否再度獲委任？
options: 由局長認為適當的任何任期委任；任期屆滿的人可再度獲委任
任期固定為3年，屆滿後一律不可再度獲委任
任期完全由主席一人決定，並只可續任一次而已
終身任職，只可基於附表所訂明的法定理由而被免任
tc.explain: 附表4第2(2)條准許以局長認為適當的任何任期委任（並須受辭職及免任條文規限）；第2(3)條訂明任期屆滿的人可再度獲委任——並非固定3年任期、由主席決定的任期，或終身任職。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第3(4)條

en.q: When does a chairperson's notice of resignation take effect?
options: On the date the Secretary receives it, or a later date if the notice specifies one
Immediately upon the chairperson signing the notice of resignation
Exactly three months after the notice is given, regardless of circumstances
Only once the Secretary has accepted the resignation in writing
en.explain: Section 3(4) of Schedule 4 provides that a notice of resignation takes effect on the date the Secretary receives it, or on a later date if the notice specifies one — not on signature, not on a fixed three-month delay, and not on the Secretary's written acceptance.

tc.q: 主席的辭職通知何時生效？
options: 於局長接獲通知之日生效，或如通知指明較後日期於該日生效
於主席在該辭職通知上正式簽署的時刻即時生效
不論任何情況，一律於發出通知後滿三個整月方生效
須待局長以書面形式正式接納辭職後方告生效
tc.explain: 附表4第3(4)條訂明辭職通知於局長接獲該通知之日生效；如該通知指明較後日期，則於該較後日期生效——並非於簽署時、固定三個月後，或須待局長書面接納後方生效。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第6(1)條

en.q: Who convenes sittings of the Review Tribunal, and how often?
options: The chairperson, as often as necessary to enable the Tribunal to determine a review
The Secretary, whenever a member is appointed to the Tribunal under section 2(1)
The chairperson, but only within 3 years of his or her own appointment
Two ordinary members, once a quorum for that Tribunal sitting is present
en.explain: Section 6(1) of Schedule 4 requires the chairperson to convene sittings of the Tribunal as often as necessary to enable the Tribunal to determine a review; there is no prescribed calendar. The Secretary's role under section 2(1) is to appoint the panel, not to convene sittings; the chairperson's own tenure is capped at 3 years under section 3(1), which is unrelated to sitting frequency; and section 6(3) merely requires 2 ordinary members to be present alongside the chairperson at each sitting.

tc.q: 審裁處的聆訊由何人召開？頻次為何？
options: 由主席召開，並須按使審裁處能裁定覆核所需的頻次召開
由局長召開，因局長根據第2(1)條委任委員團成員
由主席召開，但僅限於其獲委任後三年內召開
由兩名普通成員召開，待法定人數達到後即可
tc.explain: 附表4第6(1)條規定主席須按使審裁處能裁定覆核所需的頻次，召開審裁處的聆訊，條文並無訂明固定時間表。局長根據第2(1)條的職能是委出委員團，並非召開聆訊；主席本身的任期上限為3年（第3(1)條），與聆訊頻次無關；第6(3)條則只規定2名普通成員須連同主席一同出席每次聆訊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表4第2(6)條

en.q: Where additional tribunals are established under section 55(3), how many panels must be appointed?
options: Only one — section 55(3) is not read as requiring appointment to more than one panel
One panel for each additional tribunal established under section 55(3)
Two panels — one for financial institutions and one for DNFBPs
A new panel for each review, as with the 2 members appointed per review under section 4(1)
en.explain: Section 2(6) of Schedule 4 states, to avoid doubt, that section 55(3) — which allows the Secretary to establish additional tribunals — does not require the appointment of persons to more than one panel under section 2(1). Only one panel need ever be appointed. Section 4(1) separately requires 2 panel members to be appointed as ordinary members for each individual review — a different, per-review appointment of individuals that does not create a new panel.

tc.q: 如根據第55(3)條設立額外審裁處，須委任多少個小組？
options: 只需一個——第55(3)條並不要求委任多於一個小組
根據第55(3)條每設立一個額外審裁處，即須委任一個小組
兩個小組——分別就金融機構及指定非金融企業及行業
每項覆核設立一個新小組，猶如第4(1)條就每項覆核委任的2名成員
tc.explain: 附表4第2(6)條為免生疑問訂明，第55(3)條（准許局長設立額外審裁處）並不要求根據第2(1)條就多於一個小組委任人選。因此只須委任一個小組。第4(1)條另行規定須為每項覆核委任2名委員為普通成員，屬個別覆核中對個人的委任，並非設立新的小組。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(d)條

en.q: A long-standing customer's transaction pattern gives rise to a suspicion of money laundering, though no threshold is crossed. What does section 3(1)(d) of Schedule 2 require?
options: Customer due diligence must be carried out, because suspicion of ML/TF is itself a trigger, independent of amount
No CDD is required unless the transaction also reaches the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold
The relationship must simply be terminated at once, without carrying out any CDD measures
The suspicion must be reported to the relevant authority, which then decides whether CDD is needed
en.explain: Section 3(1)(d) of Schedule 2 requires CDD measures when the institution suspects the customer or the customer's account is involved in money laundering or terrorist financing — the suspicion itself is the trigger, independent of the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold in paragraph (b). Termination without enquiry and reporting instead of CDD are not what paragraph (d) requires; CDD must still be carried out.

tc.q: 某長期客戶的交易模式引起洗錢懷疑，但並未超越任何門檻。附表2第3(1)(d)條有何規定？
options: 須進行客戶盡職審查措施，因洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集懷疑本身即屬獨立於款額的觸發條件
除非該筆交易的款額同時達到120,000元的非經常交易門檻，否則無須進行任何客戶盡職審查措施
須立即終止與該客戶的整段業務關係，無須進行任何客戶盡職審查措施或進一步查究
須將該項懷疑匯報予有關當局，改由該當局決定是否仍須進行客戶盡職審查措施
tc.explain: 附表2第3(1)(d)條規定，當機構懷疑客戶或客戶的帳戶涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集時，須進行客戶盡職審查措施——該項懷疑本身即屬觸發條件，與(b)段所指120,000元非經常交易門檻無關。第(d)段並無規定須無故終止關係，或以匯報當局代替進行客戶盡職審查；仍須進行客戶盡職審查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(b)條

en.q: What phrase in section 3(1)(b) of Schedule 2 prevents a customer from avoiding CDD by splitting a large occasional transaction?
options: “Whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to be linked”
“Subject to subsection (2), before establishing a business relationship with the customer”
“Subject to section 4 of this Schedule, a financial institution or a DNFBP must carry out customer due diligence measures”
“Involving an amount equal to or above $120,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency”
en.explain: Section 3(1)(b) applies the $120,000 threshold 'whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to be linked' — this is the anti-structuring phrase. The other quoted phrases are real text from elsewhere in section 3(1): paragraph (a)'s trigger for establishing a business relationship, the chapeau, and the threshold amount itself — none of them is the anti-structuring wording.

tc.q: 附表2第3(1)(b)條中哪一句用語防止客戶藉拆細大額非經常交易而規避客戶盡職審查？
options: 「不論該交易是以單一項操作進行，或是以看來屬有關連的多項操作進行」
「（除第(2)款另有規定外）在與該客戶建立業務關係之前」
「除本附表第4條另有規定外，金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業須執行客戶盡職審查措施」
「涉及相等於120,000元或以上的款額（或折算為任何其他貨幣的相同款額）」
tc.explain: 第3(1)(b)條規定120,000元門檻的適用「不論該交易是以單一項操作進行，或是以看來屬有關連的多項操作進行」——這是防止拆細交易的用語。其餘引文均為第3(1)條其他部分的真實條文：(a)段中與建立業務關係有關的觸發條件、引言部分，以及門檻款額本身——均非防止拆細交易的用語。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)(iiia)條

en.q: Which source of identity verification was added to section 2(1)(a) of Schedule 2 by the 2022 amendments?
options: A recognized digital identification system
An authority in a place outside Hong Kong performing similar functions
A governmental body
Any other reliable and independent source recognized by the relevant authority
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (iiia), added by 15 of 2022, permits verification on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a recognized digital identification system. Its addition also underpins the exceptions in sections 5(4) and 9(2).

tc.q: 2022年的修訂在附表2第2(1)(a)條加入了哪一項身分核實來源？
options: 獲認可數碼身分識別系統
在香港以外地方執行類似職能的當局
政府機構
有關當局認可的任何其他可靠而獨立的來源
tc.explain: 由2022年第15號條例加入的(iiia)節，准許依據獲認可數碼身分識別系統所提供的文件、數據或資料進行核實。此項加入亦是第5(4)及9(2)條例外規定的基礎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)(b)條

en.q: Which four conditions must an overseas institution satisfy to fall within section 4(3)(b) of Schedule 2 for simplified due diligence?
options: Incorporation in an equivalent jurisdiction; a similar business; similar compliance measures; and similar supervision there
Being a corporation listed on any stock exchange — paragraph (c) imposes no jurisdiction, business or supervision requirement at all
Being an investment vehicle whose investors' due diligence is carried out by an institution incorporated in Hong Kong, with similar compliance measures and supervision
Being the Government or a public body in Hong Kong, or the government of an equivalent jurisdiction or an equivalent public body there
en.explain: Section 4(3)(b) requires all four conditions cumulatively: incorporation in an equivalent jurisdiction, a business similar to a financial institution's, compliance measures similar to Schedule 2, and supervision by a similar authority there. A stock-exchange listing is a separate, simpler route under paragraph (c); the investment-vehicle look-through test is paragraph (d); and government/public-body status is paragraph (e)/(f) — none of these substitutes for the four-part test in paragraph (b).

tc.q: 境外機構須符合哪四項條件，方屬附表2第4(3)(b)條的簡化盡職審查範圍？
options: 在同等司法管轄區成立或設立；經營類似業務；設有類似合規措施；並受當地類似當局監督
屬在任何證券市場上市的法團——(c)段完全無須符合司法管轄區、業務類型或監督方面的任何規定
屬投資工具，其投資者的盡職審查由在香港成立、設有類似合規措施並受監督的機構執行
屬香港的政府或公共機構，或同等司法管轄區的政府或當地同等的公共機構
tc.explain: 第4(3)(b)條要求同時符合四項條件：在同等司法管轄區成立或設立、經營與金融機構類似的業務、設有與附表2類似的合規措施，以及由當地類似當局監督。在證券市場上市是(c)段下另一條更簡單的途徑；投資工具透視測試屬(d)段；政府或公共機構身分則屬(e)/(f)段——均不能取代(b)段的四項測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(5)(b)條

en.q: Which two features must an insurance policy taken out for a retirement scheme have to qualify for simplified due diligence under section 4(5)(b)?
options: It does not contain a surrender clause and cannot be used as collateral
It has a term of at least ten years and a fixed premium
It is issued by an authorized insurer and payable in Hong Kong dollars
It covers at least twenty scheme members and is reviewed annually
en.explain: Section 4(5)(b) covers an insurance policy for the purposes of a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme, however described, that does not contain a surrender clause and cannot be used as a collateral — both features that limit its usefulness for laundering.

tc.q: 為退休計劃而購買的保險保單，須具備哪兩項特徵方符合第4(5)(b)條的簡化盡職審查資格？
options: 並無退保條款，且不能用作抵押品
年期至少十年，並有固定保費
由認可保險人簽發，並以港元計值
成員至少二十名，並每年檢討
tc.explain: 第4(5)(b)條涵蓋為公積金、退休金、退休或離職金計劃（不論如何描述）而購買的保險保單，而該保單並無退保條款，且不能用作抵押品——這兩項特徵均限制其被用作清洗黑錢的作用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第7(1)條

en.q: To which customers does section 7 of Schedule 2 apply?
options: A respondent bank outside Hong Kong with a correspondent banking relationship pre-dating the Ordinance
Any pre-existing customer whose account shows a material change in how it is operated
Any customer of an authorized institution located outside Hong Kong, regardless of when the relationship began
Any pre-existing customer of a licensed money service operator, however the relationship arose
en.explain: Section 7(1) applies only to a respondent bank: a customer located outside Hong Kong carrying on a business similar to that of an authorized institution, with which the authorized institution established a correspondent banking relationship before the Ordinance commenced. The general pre-existing customer trigger in section 6 (unusual transactions or material changes in how the account is operated) is a different, broader provision; an ordinary overseas customer or an MSO's pre-existing customer does not fall within section 7.

tc.q: 附表2第7條適用於哪些客戶？
options: 位於香港以外、與認可機構在本條例生效前已建立代理銀行關係的代理銀行
任何先前客戶，只要其帳戶的操作方式其後出現重大改變即屬適用
認可機構任何位於香港以外的客戶，不論該關係建立於何時
持牌金錢服務經營者的任何先前客戶，不論該關係如何建立或何時建立
tc.explain: 第7(1)條只適用於代理銀行：位於香港以外、經營與認可機構類似業務的客戶，並且認可機構在本條例生效前已與其建立代理銀行關係。第6條的一般先前客戶觸發條件（不尋常交易或帳戶操作方式的重大改變）是另一項較廣泛的條文；一般境外客戶或金錢服務經營者的先前客戶均不屬第7條範圍。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, corporation)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——法團）

en.q: In relation to a corporation, which shareholding threshold makes an individual a "beneficial owner" under Schedule 2?
options: Owning or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the issued share capital
Owning or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than 10% of the issued share capital
Owning or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than 50% of the issued share capital
Owning, directly or indirectly, any share in the corporation, however small
en.explain: The corporation limb of the beneficial owner definition sets the threshold at more than 25% of the issued share capital, owned or controlled directly or indirectly (including through a trust or bearer share holding). 10% and 50% are the wrong thresholds, and merely owning any share, however small, does not meet the test.

tc.q: 就法團而言，何種持股門檻令個人成為附表2下的「實益擁有人」？
options: 直接或間接擁有或控制超過25%的已發行股本
直接或間接擁有或控制超過10%的已發行股本
直接或間接擁有或控制超過50%的已發行股本
直接或間接擁有該法團的任何股份，不論多寡
tc.explain: 「實益擁有人」定義中關於法團的一項，將門檻定為直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%的已發行股本。10%及50%均為錯誤門檻，僅擁有任何股份（不論多寡）亦不符合該測試。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, corporation)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——法團）

en.q: An individual holds no more than 25% of a corporation's shares or voting rights but exercises ultimate control over its management. Is that enough to make them a beneficial owner?
options: Yes — ultimate control over the corporation's management is an independent limb of the definition
No — only the 25% share capital and voting-rights limbs create a beneficial owner
Only if that control is also exercised through a trust or bearer share holding
Only if the individual is also a director or company secretary of the corporation
en.explain: The definition includes, as a separate limb, an individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of the corporation — this does not depend on meeting the 25% shareholding or voting-rights limbs. It also does not require the control to be exercised through a trust or bearer shares (that phrase belongs to the shareholding limb), and holding no directorship or company-secretary role does not matter.

tc.q: 某個人持有某法團的股本及投票權均不超遒25%，但對該法團的管理行使最終控制權。這是否足以令該個人成為實益擁有人？
options: 是——對法團的管理行使最終控制權是該定義的一項獨立條件
否——只有25%股本及投票權兩項條件可構成實益擁有人
只限該控制權亦透過信託或持有不記名股份行使
只限該個人同時是該法團的董事或公司秘書
tc.explain: 該定義將對該法團的管理行使最終控制權的個人列為獨立一項，無須符合25%持股或投票權兩項限額。定義亦無規定該控制權須透過信託或持有不記名股份行使（該用語屬持股一項），亦不取決於該個人是否擔任董事或公司秘書。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, corporation acting for another)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——代另一人行事的法團）

en.q: A corporate customer is acting on behalf of another person. Who is the beneficial owner under Schedule 2?
options: That other person
The corporation's largest shareholder in any event
The corporation itself
The corporation's board of directors collectively
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (a)(ii) of the definition provides that if the corporation is acting on behalf of another person, beneficial owner means that other person. The same structure appears for partnerships in (b)(ii) and for other persons in (d)(ii).

tc.q: 某公司客戶是代另一人行事。就附表2而言，誰是實益擁有人？
options: 該另一人
無論如何均為該法團的最大股東
該法團本身
該法團的董事會全體
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)(ii)節訂明，如該法團是代另一人行事，則「實益擁有人」指該另一人。合夥的(b)(ii)節及其他人的(d)(ii)節採用相同結構。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, trust)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——信託）

en.q: Which of the following is a beneficial owner in relation to a trust under Schedule 2?
options: The settlor of the trust
Any person who has ever received a distribution from the trust
The trust's legal adviser
Any creditor of the trust
en.explain: For a trust, the definition covers a beneficiary or class of beneficiaries entitled to a vested interest in the trust property, the settlor, the trustee, a protector or enforcer of the trust, and an individual who has ultimate control over the trust.

tc.q: 就信託而言，下列何者屬附表2下的實益擁有人？
options: 該信託的財產授予人
曾從該信託獲得分派的任何人
該信託的法律顧問
該信託的任何債權人
tc.explain: 就信託而言，該定義涵蓋有權享有信託財產既得權益的受益人或某類受益人、財產授予人、受託人、信託的保護人或執行人，以及對該信託有最終控制權的個人。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, trust)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——信託）

en.q: Which party was added to the trust limb of the “beneficial owner” definition by the 2022 amendments?
options: The trustee of the trust
The settlor of the trust
A protector or enforcer of the trust
An individual who has ultimate control over the trust
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (c)(iia), added by 15 of 2022, adds the trustee of the trust to the list, alongside the beneficiary with a vested interest, the settlor, a protector or enforcer, and an individual with ultimate control.

tc.q: 2022年的修訂在「實益擁有人」定義的信託一項中加入了哪一方？
options: 該信託的受託人
該信託的財產授予人
該信託的保護人或執行人
對該信託有最終控制權的個人
tc.explain: 由2022年第15號條例加入的(c)(iia)節，將該信託的受託人加入名單，與有既得權益的受益人、財產授予人、保護人或執行人及有最終控制權的個人並列。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, trust beneficiaries)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——信託受益人）

en.q: Which trust beneficiaries fall within the "beneficial owner" definition in Schedule 2?
options: A beneficiary entitled to a vested interest, whether in possession, remainder or reversion, defeasible or not
Only the settlor and the trustee of the trust — beneficiaries themselves are a separate category
Only a beneficiary who also acts as the trust's protector or enforcer
Only beneficiaries whose interest is vested in possession, excluding remainder or reversion interests
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (c)(i) covers a beneficiary or class of beneficiaries entitled to a vested interest in the trust property, whether in possession, remainder or reversion, and whether defeasible or not. The settlor and trustee are covered separately under (c)(ii) and (iia); the protector or enforcer under (c)(iii) — these are additional categories, not substitutes for the beneficiary limb. Vested interests in remainder or reversion are expressly included, not excluded.

tc.q: 哪些信託受益人屬附表2「實益擁有人」定義的範圍？
options: 有權享有信託財產既得權益的受益人，不論該權益屬管有、剩餘或復歸權益，亦不論是否可被剝奪
只限該信託的財產授予人及受託人享有既得權益——受益人本身屬完全獨立的另一類別，並不涵蓋在內
只限同時擔任該信託保護人或執行人的受益人，其他受益人一概不獲涵蓋
只限權益屬管有的受益人，不包括享有剩餘權益或復歸權益的受益人在內
tc.explain: (c)(i)節涵蓋有權享有信託財產既得權益的受益人或某類受益人，不論該權益屬管有、剩餘或復歸權益，亦不論是否可被剝奪。財產授予人及受託人分別由(c)(ii)及(iia)節涵蓋，保護人或執行人則由(c)(iii)節涵蓋——此等屬額外類別，並非取代受益人一項。剩餘或復歸權益明文包括在內，並非被剔除。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「業務關係」的定義）

en.q: What makes a relationship a "business relationship" under Schedule 2?
options: A business, professional or commercial relationship with, or expected at first contact to have, an element of duration
Any relationship with a customer who does not have a business relationship with the institution
A relationship recorded in a written contract signed by both the institution and the customer
A relationship involving transactions that in aggregate exceed the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold
en.explain: The definition covers a business, professional or commercial relationship that has, or that the institution at first contact expects to have, an element of duration. The absence of a business relationship is instead the definition of 'occasional transaction' — the opposite concept. A written contract and an aggregate transaction value are not required; expectation of duration at the outset is enough.

tc.q: 何種關係構成附表2下的「業務關係」？
options: 具有持續性元素，或在初次接觸時已預期會具有持續性元素的業務、專業或商業關係
該機構與並無與其建立任何業務關係的客戶之間的任何一項關係
任何以該機構及客戶雙方共同簽署的書面合約正式記錄在案的關係
任何涉及的交易款額合計超過120,000元非經常交易門檻的一段關係
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋具有持續性元素，或機構在初次接觸時已預期會具有持續性元素的業務、專業或商業關係。與客戶並無業務關係，反而是「非經常交易」的定義——即相反的概念。書面合約及交易金額合計均非必要條件；初次接觸時已有持續性預期即已足夠。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「單次交易」的定義）

en.q: What single feature distinguishes an "occasional transaction" under Schedule 2?
options: It is a transaction with a customer who does not have a business relationship with the institution
It is a transaction carried out only once by a customer who does have a business relationship with the institution
It is a transaction below the $120,000 occasional-transaction CDD threshold in section 3(1)(b)
It is a transaction carried out wholly in cash rather than by electronic transfer
en.explain: An occasional transaction is a transaction with a customer who does not have a business relationship with the institution — the presence or absence of a business relationship is the distinguishing feature, not how many times the customer transacts, the transaction's size, or whether it is in cash.

tc.q: 附表2下的「非經常交易」以哪一項特徵區別？
options: 該交易的客戶與該機構並無業務關係
該客戶雖與該機構有業務關係，但只進行過一次的交易
低於第3(1)(b)條120,000元非經常交易客戶盡職審查門檻的交易
完全以現金而非以電子轉帳方式進行的交易
tc.explain: 「非經常交易」指與並無業務關係的客戶之間的交易——關鍵在於是否存在業務關係，而非該客戶交易的次數、交易金額或是否以現金進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「同等司法管轄區」的定義）

en.q: What are the two limbs of the definition of "equivalent jurisdiction" in Schedule 2?
options: A FATF member jurisdiction other than Hong Kong, or one imposing requirements similar to Schedule 2
A jurisdiction with a mutual legal assistance treaty with Hong Kong, or a member of the United Nations
A jurisdiction not listed by the FATF as high risk, or one with a reciprocal licensing arrangement with Hong Kong
Any FATF member jurisdiction, including Hong Kong, or any Commonwealth jurisdiction
en.explain: The definition covers a jurisdiction that is a member of the FATF, other than Hong Kong, or a jurisdiction that imposes requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2. Mutual legal assistance treaties, UN membership, FATF high-risk listings, reciprocal licensing and Commonwealth membership are not part of either limb of the definition.

tc.q: 附表2「同等司法管轄區」定義的兩項條件是甚麼？
options: 屬財務行動特別組織成員（香港除外）的司法管轄區，或施加與附表2類似規定的司法管轄區
與香港訂有司法互助協定的司法管轄區，或聯合國成員
並未被財務行動特別組織列為高風險的司法管轄區，或與香港訂有互惠發牌安排的司法管轄區
任何財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區（包括香港），或任何英聯邦司法管轄區
tc.explain: 該定義涵蓋屬財務行動特別組織成員（香港除外）的司法管轄區，或施加與附表2類似規定的司法管轄區。司法互助協定、聯合國成員資格、財務行動特別組織的高風險名單、互惠發牌安排及英聯邦成員資格均非該定義任何一項條件。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “Financial Action Task Force”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「財務行動特別組織」的定義）

en.q: How does Schedule 2 define the Financial Action Task Force?
options: The Financial Action Task Force on Money Laundering, established by the G-7 Summit in Paris in 1989
A specialized agency of the United Nations, established in 1989 to combat money laundering
A standing committee of the Bank for International Settlements, formed in Basel in 1989
An inter-governmental body established by the OECD in Paris in 1990 to monitor tax evasion
en.explain: Section 1(1) of Schedule 2 defines the FATF as the Financial Action Task Force on Money Laundering, established by the G-7 Summit held in Paris in 1989. It is not a United Nations agency, a Bank for International Settlements committee, or an OECD body — those are different international organisations entirely.

tc.q: 附表2如何界定財務行動特別組織？
options: 由1989年在巴黎舉行的七國集團高峰會設立的打擊清洗黑錢財務行動特別組織
聯合國轄下於1989年設立、專責打擊全球洗錢活動的專門機構
國際結算銀行轄下於1989年在巴塞爾成立的常設委員會
經濟合作暨發展組織於1990年在巴黎設立、監察逃稅活動的跨政府組織
tc.explain: 附表2第1(1)條將財務行動特別組織界定為由1989年在巴黎舉行的七國集團高峰會設立的打擊清洗黑錢財務行動特別組織。它並非聯合國機構、國際結算銀行轄下委員會，亦非經濟合作暨發展組織轄下團體——該等均屬完全不同的國際組織。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）

en.q: Where must the prominent public function be held for an individual to be a “politically exposed person” under Schedule 2?
options: In a place outside Hong Kong
In Hong Kong or anywhere else
Only in a jurisdiction subject to United Nations sanctions
Only in a jurisdiction that is not a FATF member
en.explain: Paragraph (a) of the definition covers an individual who is or has been entrusted with a prominent public function in a place outside Hong Kong. The definition is directed at foreign public functions.

tc.q: 個人須在何處擔任顯赫公職，方屬附表2下的「政治人物」？
options: 在香港以外的地方
在香港或任何其他地方
只限受聯合國制裁的司法管轄區
只限並非財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)段涵蓋現時或曾經在香港以外地方擔任顯赫公職的個人。該定義針對的是外地公職。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is expressly included in the categories of prominent public function in the “politically exposed person” definition?
options: A senior executive of a state-owned corporation
A middle-ranking government official
A junior judicial officer
Any civil servant of the jurisdiction concerned
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (a)(i) includes a head of state, head of government, senior politician, senior government, judicial or military official, senior executive of a state-owned corporation and an important political party official. Sub-paragraph (a)(ii) expressly excludes middle-ranking or more junior officials.

tc.q: 「政治人物」定義的顯赫公職類別中，明文包括下列何者？
options: 國有企業的高級行政人員
中級政府官員
初級司法人員
有關司法管轄區的任何公務員
tc.explain: (a)(i)節包括國家元首、政府首長、高級從政者、高級政府官員、司法或軍方官員、國有企業的高級行政人員及重要政黨官員。(a)(ii)節則明文剔除中級或更低級的官員。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）

en.q: Which family members of a politically exposed person are themselves within the definition?
options: A spouse, a partner, a child or a parent, and a spouse or partner of such a child
Only a spouse and children of the individual, not parents or partners
Every relative within three degrees of consanguinity of the individual
Only those family members who share a household with the individual
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the definition covers a spouse, a partner, a child or a parent of an individual falling within paragraph (a), or a spouse or a partner of a child of such an individual. It is not limited to spouse and children only, does not extend to every relative within three degrees of consanguinity, and does not depend on sharing a household — paragraph (c) separately covers close associates.

tc.q: 政治人物的哪些家庭成員本身亦在該定義範圍內？
options: 配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，以及該等子女的配偶或伴侶
只限該個人的配偶及親生子女，不包括父母或伴侶在內
與該個人有三親等內血親或姻親關係的每一名親屬
只限與該個人同住在同一戶的家庭成員
tc.explain: 該定義的(b)段涵蓋屬(a)段所述個人的配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，或該等個人的子女的配偶或伴侶。範圍並非只限配偶及子女，亦不延伸至三親等內的每一名親屬，亦不取決於是否同住一戶——(c)段則另行涵蓋密切聯繫人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(2)條

en.q: When is a person a "partner" of an individual for the purposes of the politically exposed person definition?
options: If considered by the law of the place where they live together as equivalent to a spouse
If the person is a business partner of the individual in a commercial venture
If the person shares a joint bank account or household expenses with the individual
If the person has cohabited with the individual for at least two continuous years
en.explain: Section 1(2) of Schedule 2 provides that a person is a partner of an individual if considered by the law of the place where they live together as equivalent to a spouse. A business partnership, a shared bank account or household expenses, and cohabitation for a set period are not the statutory test.

tc.q: 就政治人物的定義而言，某人在何時屬某個人的「伴侶」？
options: 按該人與該個人共同居住地方的法律，被視為等同該個人的配偶
該人只是該個人在某商業項目上長期合作的業務合夥人而已
該人與該個人共用聯名銀行帳戶或共同承擔各項家庭開支
該人與該個人已在同一居所連續同居至少兩整年
