tc.explain: 附表2第1(2)條訂明，如按該人與該個人共同居住地方的法律，該人被視為等同該個人的配偶，則該人屬該個人的伴侶。業務合夥關係、共用銀行帳戶或家庭開支，以及同居特定年期均非法定測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(3)條

en.q: Who is a "close associate" of a politically exposed person under Schedule 2?
options: An individual with close business relations with the PEP, including a fellow beneficial owner of a legal person or trust
Any spouse, partner, child or parent of the PEP, or the spouse or partner of such a child, whether or not in business with them
Any individual who is merely a business competitor of the PEP within the same regulated industry
Any employee of a public body, state-owned corporation or political party the PEP is connected with
en.explain: Section 1(3) of Schedule 2 defines close associate as an individual with close business relations with the PEP, including a fellow beneficial owner of a legal person or trust — or, under paragraph (b), the beneficial owner of a legal person or trust set up for the PEP's benefit. Family members fall under a separate paragraph (b) of the politically exposed person definition itself, not under 'close associate'; being a business competitor or an employee of a body connected with the PEP is not mentioned in either limb.

tc.q: 就附表2而言，何人屬政治人物的「密切聯繫人」？
options: 與該政治人物有密切業務關係的個人，包括與其同為某法人或信託實益擁有人的個人
該政治人物的配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，或該等子女的配偶或伴侶，不論有否與其有業務往來
在同一受規管行業中純粹與該政治人物構成業務競爭關係的個人
與該政治人物有關連的公共機構、國有企業或政黨屬下的任何僱員
tc.explain: 附表2第1(3)條將「密切聯繫人」界定為與該政治人物有密切業務關係的個人，包括與其同為某法人或信託實益擁有人的個人；或根據(b)段，為該政治人物的利益而設立的法人或信託的實益擁有人。家庭成員屬「政治人物」定義本身另一項(b)段，並非「密切聯繫人」；屬業務競爭者或與該政治人物有關連團體的僱員，則不屬該定義任何一項。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “former politically exposed person”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「前政治人物」的定義）

en.q: What distinguishes a "former politically exposed person" from a politically exposed person?
options: The individual has been, but is not currently, entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong
The individual has never at any time held any prominent public function, in or outside Hong Kong
The individual's family members and close associates are no longer covered by either definition
The individual has been out of office and out of public life for at least three continuous years
en.explain: The definition, added in 2022, covers an individual who, being a PEP, has been but is not currently entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong. It does not mean someone who never held such a function, and the same family members and close associates as the PEP definition remain covered. No fixed period out of office is prescribed.

tc.q: 「前政治人物」與「政治人物」有何分別？
options: 曾在香港以外地方擔任顯赫公職，但現時並無擔任
該個人從未在香港內外擔任過任何顯赫公職
該個人的家庭成員及密切聯繫人不再受任何一項定義涵蓋
該個人已連續離任至少三年
tc.explain: 2022年加入的該定義涵蓋屬政治人物、曾在香港以外地方擔任但現時並無擔任顯赫公職的個人。並非指從未擔任該等公職的人，而與政治人物定義相同的家庭成員及密切聯繫人仍然受涵蓋。條文並無訂明固定的離任年期。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, individual)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——個人）

en.q: What counts as an "identification document" in relation to an individual under Schedule 2?
options: An identity card, certificate or document of identity, or travel document, under the Immigration Ordinance
Any document bearing the individual's photograph and signature, such as a membership card
A driving licence or any other government-issued card not covered by the Immigration Ordinance
A recent bank statement showing the individual's name and residential address
en.explain: Paragraph (a) of the definition covers, for an individual, an identity card, certificate of identity, document of identity or travel document as defined by the Immigration Ordinance. A photograph-and-signature document, a driving licence, or a bank statement are not identification documents for this purpose.

tc.q: 就附表2而言，甚麼屬個人的「身分證明文件」？
options: 《入境條例》所界定的身分證、身分證明書、身分證明文件或旅行證件
載有該個人相片及親筆簽署等資料的任何文件，例如會員證或圖書證
駕駛執照或《入境條例》未有涵蓋的任何其他政府簽發證件
載有該個人姓名及現時居住地址的近期銀行月結單
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)段就個人涵蓋《入境條例》所界定的身分證、身分證明書、身分證明文件或旅行證件。載有相片及簽署的文件、駕駛執照或銀行結單均非此處所指的身分證明文件。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, partnership)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——合夥）

en.q: What is the "identification document" of a partnership that carries on business in Hong Kong?
options: Its business registration certificate issued under the Business Registration Ordinance
Its written partnership agreement, signed and dated by all the partners
A certificate of incorporation issued by the Registrar of Companies
The identity cards of each of its individual partners, collected together
en.explain: Paragraph (e) of the definition covers, for a partnership carrying on business in Hong Kong, its business registration certificate under the Business Registration Ordinance. A partnership agreement, a certificate of incorporation (which applies to companies, not partnerships), and the partners' individual identity cards are not the prescribed document.

tc.q: 在香港經營業務的合夥，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 根據《商業登記條例》發出的商業登記證
由所有合夥人簽署及註明日期的書面合夥協議
由公司註冊處處長發出的公司註冊證明書
其所有個別合夥人的身分證，一併收集
tc.explain: 該定義的(e)段就在香港經營業務的合夥，涵蓋根據《商業登記條例》發出的商業登記證。合夥協議、公司註冊證明書（適用於公司而非合夥）及各合夥人的個人身分證均非訂明的文件。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, partnership)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——合夥）

en.q: What is the "identification document" of a partnership that does NOT carry on business in Hong Kong?
options: Its partnership agreement, or a document evidencing its formation issued by a governmental body
Its Hong Kong business registration certificate, even though it carries on no business here
A certificate of incorporation issued by the Registrar of Companies in Hong Kong
A sworn declaration by all the partners attesting to the partnership's existence
en.explain: Paragraph (f) of the definition covers, for a partnership that does not carry on business in Hong Kong, its partnership agreement or any document evidencing its formation or registration issued by a governmental body. A Hong Kong business registration certificate applies only to a partnership that does carry on business here (paragraph (e)); a Companies Registry certificate applies to companies; a sworn declaration is not mentioned.

tc.q: 並非在香港經營業務的合夥，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 其合夥協議，或由政府機構發出、證明其組成的文件
其香港商業登記證，即使它並無在香港經營任何業務
由香港公司註冊處處長發出的公司註冊證明書
全體合夥人就該合夥的存在所作的宣誓聲明
tc.explain: 該定義的(f)段就並非在香港經營業務的合夥，涵蓋其合夥協議，或由政府機構發出、證明其組成或註冊的任何文件。香港商業登記證只適用於在香港經營業務的合夥（(e)段）；公司註冊處證明書適用於公司；宣誓聲明則未獲提及。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, company)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——公司）

en.q: What is the "identification document" of a company as defined by section 2(1) of the Companies Ordinance?
options: Its certificate of incorporation, or its certificate of re-domiciliation
Its most recent annual return filed with the Companies Registry
Its memorandum and articles of association, as last amended
Its business registration certificate issued under the Business Registration Ordinance
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the definition covers the certificate of incorporation issued in respect of the company under the Ordinance under which it was formed and registered, or the certificate of re-domiciliation. An annual return, the memorandum and articles, and a business registration certificate are different documents the company may also hold, but they are not the identification document under paragraph (b).

tc.q: 《公司條例》第2(1)條所界定的公司，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 其公司註冊證明書，或其遷冊證明書
其向公司註冊處提交的最新周年申報表
其組織章程大綱及細則，以最後經修訂者為準
根據《商業登記條例》發出的商業登記證
tc.explain: 該定義的(b)段涵蓋根據該公司據以組成及註冊的條例發出的公司註冊證明書，或其遷冊證明書。周年申報表、組織章程大綱及細則，以及商業登記證均為該公司可能另外持有的文件，但並非(b)段所指的身分證明文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「過渡期客戶」的定義）

en.q: For a financial institution other than a licensed VAS provider, before what date must a business relationship have been established for the customer to be a “pre-existing customer”?
options: 1 April 2012
1 March 2018
1 June 2023
1 April 2023
en.explain: Paragraph (a) of the definition sets the date at 1 April 2012 for financial institutions other than licensed VAS providers. The other dates are 1 June 2023 for licensed VAS providers, 1 March 2018 for DNFBPs other than Category B PMS registrants, and 1 April 2023 for Category B PMS registrants.

tc.q: 就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者以外的金融機構而言，業務關係須在哪一日期前建立，該客戶方屬「先前客戶」？
tc.explain: 該定義的(a)段就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者以外的金融機構，訂明日期為2012年4月1日。其他日期為持牌虛擬資產服務提供者的2023年6月1日、B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人以外指定非金融企業及行業的2018年3月1日，以及B類註冊人的2023年4月1日。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「過渡期客戶」的定義）

en.q: For a DNFBP other than a Category B PMS registrant, what is the cut-off date for a customer to be a “pre-existing customer”?
options: 1 March 2018
1 April 2012
1 June 2023
1 January 2018
en.explain: Paragraph (c) of the definition sets the date at 1 March 2018 for a DNFBP other than a Category B PMS registrant, reflecting the commencement of the extension of the regime to designated non-financial businesses and professions.

tc.q: 就B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人以外的指定非金融企業及行業而言，客戶屬「先前客戶」的截止日期為何？
tc.explain: 該定義的(c)段就B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人以外的指定非金融企業及行業，訂明日期為2018年3月1日，反映該制度擴展至指定非金融企業及行業的生效日期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(4)條

en.q: What are the essential elements of a "wire transfer" under section 1(4) of Schedule 2?
options: A transaction by an ordering institution, by electronic means, to make money available to a person at a beneficiary institution
A transaction by a customer, by any means including cash, to make money available at any institution of the recipient's choice
A transaction between two individuals, by electronic means, that does not involve any institution as intermediary
A transaction by an ordering institution, by electronic means, to make money available only to that same person at another branch of the same institution
en.explain: Section 1(4) defines a wire transfer as a transaction carried out by an institution (the ordering institution) on behalf of a person by electronic means, with a view to making money available to that person or another person at an institution (the beneficiary institution). It need not be initiated directly by a customer without an institution, need not be confined to individuals with no institution involved at all, and is not limited to transfers to the same person within the same institution — the recipient may be another person at another institution.

tc.q: 根據附表2第1(4)條，「電傳轉賬」的要素是甚麼？
options: 由匯出機構以電子方式進行的交易，旨在使款項可在收款機構供某人取用
由客戶以任何方式（包括現金）進行的交易，旨在使款項可在收款人選擇的任何機構取用
兩名個人之間以電子方式進行、並無任何機構作為中介參與其中的交易
由匯出機構以電子方式進行、僅旨在使款項於同一機構的另一分行供該人本身取用的交易
tc.explain: 第1(4)條界定「電傳轉賬」為由某機構（匯出機構）代某人以電子方式進行的交易，並旨在使一筆款項可在某機構（收款機構）供該人或另一人取用。電傳轉賬毋須由客戶在沒有機構參與下直接發起，亦不限於個人之間且完全無機構參與的情況，更不限於同一機構內轉予同一人——收款人可以是另一機構的另一人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「代理銀行業務」的定義）

en.q: How is "correspondent banking" defined in Schedule 2?
options: Banking services by an authorized institution to another, enabling it to serve its own customers
Any banking relationship between two authorized institutions located in different jurisdictions
The provision of clearing and settlement services between banks within Hong Kong
Any arrangement under which one bank simply holds an account with another bank
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition is the provision of banking services by an authorized institution to another institution to enable that other institution to provide services and products to its own customers. A cross-jurisdiction relationship, Hong Kong clearing and settlement services, or simply holding an account with another bank do not by themselves capture the nested-customer element that defines correspondent banking.

tc.q: 附表2如何界定「代理銀行業務」？
options: 認可機構向另一機構提供銀行服務，使該機構能向其本身客戶提供服務
位於不同司法管轄區的任何兩間認可機構之間存在的銀行業務關係
香港境內任何銀行彼此之間提供的結算及交收服務安排
一間銀行單純在另一間銀行開立戶口的任何安排，不論規模
tc.explain: 附表2的定義為認可機構向另一機構提供銀行服務，使該另一機構能向其本身客戶提供服務及產品。跨司法管轄區的銀行關係、香港境內的結算及交收服務，或單純在另一銀行開立帳戶，本身均未能反映界定代理銀行業務的「客戶之客戶」元素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「法人」的定義）

en.q: What does "legal person" include under Schedule 2?
options: Any public body and any body of persons, corporate or unincorporate
Only companies formally incorporated under the Companies Ordinance
Only bodies that have separate legal personality under Hong Kong law
Only bodies formally registered with a Hong Kong financial regulator
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition provides that legal person includes any public body and any body of persons, corporate or unincorporate. It is not confined to companies incorporated under the Companies Ordinance, bodies with separate legal personality, or bodies registered with a regulator — the definition is deliberately broader than any of those.

tc.q: 就附表2而言，「法人」包括甚麼？
options: 任何公共機構及任何人的團體，不論是否屬法團
只限根據《公司條例》正式註冊成立的公司
只限根據香港法律具有獨立法人資格的團體
只限已在香港金融監管機構正式登記的團體
tc.explain: 附表2的定義訂明「法人」包括任何公共機構及任何人的團體，不論屬法團或非法團。定義並不限於根據《公司條例》註冊成立的公司、具有獨立法人資格的團體，或已向監管機構登記的團體——該定義的涵蓋範圍刻意較這些都更廣。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「公共機構」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of "public body" in Schedule 2?
options: Any board, commission or committee appointed by the Chief Executive or the Government, paid or unpaid
Any board, commission or committee appointed by the Financial Secretary or the Legislative Council, paid or unpaid
Only bodies formally established by an Ordinance enacted by the Legislative Council
Only Government bureaux, departments and statutory undertakings, excluding advisory committees
en.explain: Paragraph (d) of the definition includes any board, commission or committee appointed by the Chief Executive or the Government, paid or unpaid. It is the Chief Executive or the Government that appoints under paragraph (d) — not the Financial Secretary or the Legislative Council. The definition is also not confined to bodies established by an Ordinance, or to Government bureaux, departments and statutory undertakings alone; paragraphs (a) to (e) extend well beyond that.

tc.q: 附表2「公共機構」的定義包括下列何者？
options: 由行政長官或政府委任的任何委員會、公署或小組，不論是否受薪
由財政司司長或立法會委任的任何委員會、公署或小組，不論是否受薪
只限根據立法會制定的條例正式設立的團體
只限政府決策局、部門及法定機構，不包括諮詢委員會
tc.explain: 該定義的(d)段包括由行政長官或政府委任的任何委員會、公署或小組，不論是否受薪。根據(d)段作出委任的是行政長官或政府——並非財政司司長或立法會。定義亦不限於根據條例設立的團體，或只限政府決策局、部門及法定機構；(a)至(e)段的涵蓋範圍遠超於此。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “recognized digital identification system”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「獲認可數碼身分識別系統」的定義）

en.q: Under Schedule 2, whose recognition qualifies a digital identification system for a financial institution, and whose recognition applies instead for a DNFBP who is an accounting professional, estate agent or legal professional?
options: The relevant authority for a financial institution; the relevant regulatory body for those DNFBP professionals
The relevant regulatory body for a financial institution; the relevant authority for those DNFBP professionals
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority in every case, regardless of the type of institution or DNFBP
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise in every case, regardless of the type of institution or DNFBP
en.explain: The definition, added in 2022, provides that for a financial institution, a TCSP licensee or a Category B PMS registrant, recognition comes from the relevant authority; for other DNFBPs (accounting professionals, estate agents and legal professionals), recognition instead comes from the relevant regulatory body. The two bodies are not interchangeable, and neither the Monetary Authority nor the Commissioner is named as the sole recognizing body for every case.

tc.q: 根據附表2的定義，就金融機構而言，數碼身分識別系統須獲哪個團體認可方符合資格？就屬會計專業人士、地產代理或法律專業人士的指定非金融企業及行業而言，則須獲哪個團體認可？
options: 就金融機構而言為有關當局；就上述指定非金融企業及行業專業人士而言則為有關監管團體
就金融機構而言為有關監管團體；就上述指定非金融企業及行業專業人士而言則為有關當局
不論機構或指定非金融企業及行業的類型為何，一律為香港金融管理局
不論機構或指定非金融企業及行業的類型為何，一律為關長
tc.explain: 2022年加入的該定義訂明，就金融機構、信託或公司服務提供者持牌人或B類貴金屬及寶石交易商註冊人而言，認可由有關當局作出；就其他指定非金融企業及行業（會計專業人士、地產代理及法律專業人士）而言，則由有關監管團體作出。兩者不可互換，而金融管理局或關長均非在所有情況下均獲指定為唯一的認可團體。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, partnership)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——合夥）

en.q: Which of the following makes an individual a beneficial owner in relation to a partnership under Schedule 2?
options: More than 25% entitlement to or control of the partnership's capital or profits, direct or indirect
Being formally named as a partner in the partnership's written partnership agreement
Being entitled to any share at all of the partnership's profits, however small
Being the partnership's appointed compliance officer or money laundering reporting officer
en.explain: For a partnership, the definition covers an individual entitled to or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the capital or profits. Simply being named as a partner, holding any share of profits below that threshold, or being the compliance officer or MLRO does not by itself meet the 25% test.

tc.q: 就合夥而言，下列何者令個人成為附表2下的實益擁有人？
options: 直接或間接有權享有或控制該合夥超過25%的資本或利潤
在該合夥的書面合夥協議中被正式列明為合夥人之一
有權享有該合夥利潤的任何份額，不論多少均可
擔任該合夥所委任的合規主任或洗錢報告主任一職
tc.explain: 就合夥而言，該定義涵蓋直接或間接有權享有或控制超過25%資本或利潤的個人。單純在合夥協議中列名為合夥人、享有低於該門檻的利潤份額，或擔任合規主任或洗錢報告主任，本身並不符合25%的測試。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “beneficial owner”, other persons)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「實益擁有人」的定義——其他人）

en.q: For a customer that is neither a corporation, a partnership nor a trust, who is the beneficial owner?
options: An individual who ultimately owns or controls the person, or, if it acts for another, that other person
An individual owning or controlling more than 25% of its issued share capital, as for a corporation
An individual entitled to more than 25% of its capital or profits, as for a partnership
A beneficiary entitled to a vested interest in its property, as for a trust
en.explain: Paragraph (d) of the definition is the residual limb: for a person not falling within paragraphs (a), (b) or (c), beneficial owner means an individual who ultimately owns or controls the person, or, if the person acts for another, that other person. The 25% shareholding test applies to corporations under paragraph (a), the 25% capital-or-profits test to partnerships under paragraph (b), and the vested-interest test to trusts under paragraph (c) — none of those apply to a customer that is none of these.

tc.q: 如客戶既非法團、合夥亦非信託，誰是實益擁有人？
options: 最終擁有或控制該人的個人；或如該人是代另一人行事，則為該另一人
直接或間接擁有或控制其已發行股本超過25%的個人，如就法團而言
有權享有其超過25%資本或利潤的個人，如就合夥而言
有權享有其財產既得權益的受益人，如就信託而言
tc.explain: 該定義的(d)段是餘下情況的條文：就不屬(a)、(b)或(c)段的人而言，「實益擁有人」指最終擁有或控制該人的個人；或如該人是代另一人行事，則指該另一人。25%持股測試適用於(a)段所指的法團，25%資本或利潤測試適用於(b)段所指的合夥，既得權益測試則適用於(c)段所指的信託——這些均不適用於既非法團、合夥亦非信託的客戶。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “customer due diligence measures”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「客戶盡職審查措施」的定義）

en.q: Where does Schedule 2 locate the content of “customer due diligence measures”?
options: In section 2(1) of Schedule 2
In section 3(1) of Schedule 2
In Part 1 of Schedule 1
In guidelines published under section 7 of the AMLO
en.explain: The Schedule 2 definition provides that customer due diligence measures means the measures set out in section 2(1) of that Schedule — identification and verification of the customer, beneficial owner measures, purpose and intended nature of the relationship, and measures relating to persons purporting to act.

tc.q: 附表2將「客戶盡職審查措施」的內容置於何處？
options: 附表2第2(1)條
附表2第3(1)條
附表1第1部
根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7條公布的指引
tc.explain: 附表2的定義訂明「客戶盡職審查措施」指該附表第2(1)條所列的措施——識別及核實客戶身分、實益擁有人措施、業務關係的目的及擬有性質，以及關於聲稱代客戶行事的人的措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「過渡期客戶」的定義）

en.q: Which commencement date does the “pre-existing customer” definition tie to licensed VAS providers, reflecting when their licensing regime began?
options: 1 June 2023
1 April 2012
1 March 2018
1 April 2023
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the definition, as replaced in 2022, sets the date at 1 June 2023 for a licensed VAS provider — the commencement of the virtual asset service provider licensing regime.

tc.q: 「先前客戶」的定義就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者採用哪一個生效日期？該日期反映其發牌制度何時開始？
tc.explain: 經2022年重訂的該定義(b)段就持牌虛擬資產服務提供者訂明日期為2023年6月1日，即虛擬資產服務提供者發牌制度的生效日期。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “identification document”, overseas corporation)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「身分證明文件」的定義——境外法團）

en.q: What is the "identification document" of a corporation incorporated outside Hong Kong that is not a registered non-Hong Kong company?
options: Its certificate of incorporation or registration, issued by an authority like the Registrar of Companies
Its business registration certificate, issued under the Business Registration Ordinance, Cap. 310
A certified English translation of its memorandum and articles of association
A letter of good standing or reference issued by its principal bankers
en.explain: Paragraph (d) of the definition covers a corporation incorporated outside Hong Kong that is neither a re-domiciled company nor a registered non-Hong Kong company: its certificate of incorporation or registration, or any other document evidencing incorporation, issued by an authority performing functions similar to the Registrar of Companies. A Hong Kong business registration certificate, a translated constitutional document, or a bank reference letter are not what paragraph (d) requires.

tc.q: 在香港以外註冊成立、並非註冊非香港公司的法團，其「身分證明文件」是甚麼？
options: 由執行與公司註冊處處長類似職能的當局發出的公司註冊或登記證明書
根據香港《商業登記條例》（第310章）發出的商業登記證明文件
其組織章程大綱及細則的核證英文譯本文件一份
其往來主要銀行發出的信譽良好證明書或推薦信函一封
tc.explain: 該定義的(d)段涵蓋在香港以外註冊成立、既非遷冊公司亦非註冊非香港公司的法團：由執行與公司註冊處處長類似職能的當局發出的公司註冊或登記證明書，或證明其註冊成立的任何其他文件。香港商業登記證、憲章文件譯本或銀行推薦信均非(d)段的規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.3(1)(b); s.1(1) (definition of “occasional transaction”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(b)條；第1(1)條（「非經常交易」的定義）

en.q: A walk-in customer with no ongoing relationship with the MSO hands over $150,000 in cash for a single remittance, not by any electronic transfer. Which Schedule 2 concepts are engaged?
options: An occasional transaction, requiring CDD under section 3(1)(b) because it is at or above $120,000
A business relationship, requiring CDD under section 3(1)(a) before the relationship is established
An occasional transaction, but CDD is required only once the customer's transactions in a year exceed $120,000 in aggregate
An occasional transaction, but no CDD is required because the amount is below the $8,000 threshold in section 3(1A)
en.explain: With no business relationship, the dealing is an occasional transaction as defined in section 1(1) of Schedule 2. Section 3(1)(b) requires CDD before carrying out for the customer an occasional transaction involving an amount equal to or above $120,000, so a single $150,000 cash remittance is squarely within it. The $8,000 threshold in section 3(1A) applies to wire transfers, which this is not, and the $120,000 test looks at the transaction, not at a yearly aggregate.

tc.q: 某即場客戶與該金錢服務經營者並無持續關係，以現金交付150,000元辦理一次過匯款，並非以任何電子方式轉賬。這觸發附表2的哪些概念？
options: 屬非經常交易，因款額達到或超過120,000元而須按第3(1)(b)條進行客戶盡職審查
屬業務關係，須按第3(1)(a)條在建立關係前進行客戶盡職審查
屬非經常交易，但只有該客戶一年內交易總額超過120,000元後，方須進行客戶盡職審查
屬非經常交易，但因款額低於第3(1A)條的8,000元門檻，故無須進行客戶盡職審查
tc.explain: 由於並無業務關係，該項往來屬附表2第1(1)條所界定的非經常交易。第3(1)(b)條規定，在為客戶進行涉及款額達到或超過120,000元的非經常交易前，須進行客戶盡職審查，故該筆150,000元現金匯款正落入其範圍。第3(1A)條的8,000元門檻適用於電傳轉賬，而本交易並非電傳轉賬；120,000元的準則亦是就個別交易而言，並非按年計算總額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及3(1A)條的應用

en.q: A walk-in customer asks an MSO to make an electronic transfer of $10,000 to a recipient at an overseas institution. Which threshold applies?
options: The $8,000 wire-transfer threshold in section 3(1A), since this is a wire transfer
The general $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold in section 3(1)(b)
The $20,000 annual-premium threshold applicable to certain insurance policies
No CDD threshold at all, because a walk-in customer has no business relationship
en.explain: Section 1(4) defines a wire transfer as an electronic transaction by an ordering institution to make money available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution — this transfer qualifies. Section 3(1A) then requires CDD before an occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or above, displacing the general $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold in section 3(1)(b). The $20,000 figure is real, but it applies to certain life insurance premiums under section 4(5)(c), not to wire transfers; and a threshold still applies even though the customer has no business relationship, because this is an occasional transaction.

tc.q: 某即場客戶要求金錢服務經營者以電子方式將10,000元轉予境外機構的收款人。適用哪一門檻？
options: 第3(1A)條的8,000元電傳轉賬門檻，因該交易屬電傳轉賬
第3(1)(b)條所指一般120,000元非經常交易門檻
適用於若干保險保單的20,000元周年保費門檻
完全無須任何門檻，因該即場客戶並無業務關係
tc.explain: 第1(4)條界定「電傳轉賬」為匯出機構以電子方式進行、旨在使款項可在收款機構供收款人取用的交易——本交易符合此定義。第3(1A)條繼而規定在進行8,000元或以上的單次電傳轉賬前須進行客戶盡職審查，取代第3(1)(b)條的一般120,000元非經常交易門檻。20,000元是真實門檻，但適用於第4(5)(c)條下若干人壽保險保費，並非電傳轉賬；而即使客戶並無業務關係，門檻仍然適用，因這屬非經常交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及13條的應用

en.q: An MSO arranges a cash-based remittance of $9,000 to a place outside Hong Kong, not by electronic means. Which provision governs the information it must record?
options: Section 13 — a remittance of $8,000 or more, other than a wire transfer, by a licensed MSO
Section 12, which applies only to electronic wire transfers by an ordering institution
Section 11, which applies only to beneficiaries designated under insurance policies
Section 13A, which applies only to transfers of virtual assets
en.explain: Because the transfer is not carried out by electronic means, it is not a wire transfer within section 1(4), so section 12 does not apply. Section 13 applies instead to a remittance transaction other than a wire transfer involving $8,000 or more carried out by a licensed money service operator. Section 11 concerns insurance beneficiaries and section 13A concerns virtual asset transfers — neither applies to a cash remittance.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者安排一筆9,000元的現金匯款至香港以外地方，並非以電子方式進行。其須記錄的資料受哪一條文規管？
options: 第13條——持牌金錢服務經營者進行、8,000元或以上而並非電傳轉賬的匯款
第12條，只適用於匯出機構以電子方式進行的電傳轉賬，並非現金匯款交易
第11條，只適用於保險保單項下獲指定的受益人身分核實事宜
第13A條，只適用於虛擬資產的轉移交易，並非現金匯款交易
tc.explain: 由於該項轉帳並非以電子方式進行，故不屬第1(4)條所指的電傳轉賬，第12條並不適用。第13條則適用於持牌金錢服務經營者進行、涉及8,000元或以上而並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易。第11條涉及保險保單的受益人，第13A條涉及虛擬資產轉移——兩者均不適用於現金匯款。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及10條的應用

en.q: An MSO's prospective customer is the adult child of a serving foreign cabinet minister. What is the customer's status under Schedule 2?
options: A politically exposed person, since paragraph (b) covers a child of the individual
Not a politically exposed person, because the child does not personally hold any public function
A politically exposed person only if the child lives in the same household as the minister
A close associate under paragraph (c), rather than a politically exposed person under paragraph (b)
en.explain: Paragraph (b) of the politically exposed person definition covers a spouse, partner, child or parent of an individual within paragraph (a), and a spouse or partner of such a child — the child need not personally hold public office or live with the parent. Section 10's senior management approval and source-of-wealth requirements therefore apply. 'Close associate' under paragraph (c) is a separate category for people with close business relations, not for family members.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者的擬開戶客戶，是一名現任外國內閣部長的成年子女。就附表2而言，該客戶的身分為何？
options: 屬政治人物，因該個人的子女落入該定義的(b)段
並非政治人物，因該子女本人並無擔任任何公職
只有在該子女與該部長同住一戶的情況下方屬政治人物
屬(c)段所指的密切聯繫人，而非(b)段所指的政治人物
tc.explain: 「政治人物」定義的(b)段涵蓋屬(a)段所述個人的配偶、伴侶、子女或父母，以及該等子女的配偶或伴侶——該子女本人無須擔任公職或與父母同住。因此第10條的高級管理層批准及財富來源規定即告適用。(c)段所指的「密切聯繫人」是另一類別，適用於有密切業務關係的人，並非家庭成員。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及2(1)(b)條的應用

en.q: A corporate customer's shares are held 30% by an individual through a bearer share holding. Is that individual a beneficial owner?
options: Yes — indirect ownership or control via bearer shares is expressly covered
No — bearer share holdings are expressly excluded from the beneficial owner definition
Only if that individual also personally sits on the corporation's board of directors
Only if those bearer shares also carry full voting rights at general meetings
en.explain: The corporation limb of the beneficial owner definition covers an individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital. A 30% bearer holding is squarely within it — bearer shares are expressly included, not excluded, and neither a board seat nor voting rights attached to the shares is a separate precondition.

tc.q: 某公司客戶的股份中，有30%由一名個人透過持有不記名股份持有。該個人是否實益擁有人？
options: 是——間接行使的擁有權或控制權（含不記名股份）明文獲涵蓋
否——不記名股份的持有量明文不在實益擁有人定義的範圍之內
只限該個人亦親自出任該法團董事會的其中一名成員
只限不記名股份在股東大會上亦附有完整而不受限制的投票權
tc.explain: 「實益擁有人」定義中關於法團的一項，涵蓋直接或間接（包括透過信託或持有不記名股份）擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本的個人。30%的不記名股份持有量正落入其範圍——不記名股份明文獲納入，並非被剔除，董事會議席或股份是否附有投票權均非獨立的先決條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)及4(3)條的應用

en.q: An MSO's customer is a bank incorporated in a FATF member jurisdiction and supervised there. Which Schedule 2 route is available?
options: Simplified due diligence under section 4, since the bank is in an equivalent jurisdiction
Enhanced due diligence under section 15, since any foreign customer is automatically high risk
No due diligence at all, since authorized institutions are exempt from Schedule 2
Section 14 correspondent banking measures, since the customer will operate an account for its own customers
en.explain: A FATF member jurisdiction other than Hong Kong is an equivalent jurisdiction under the section 1(1) definition. Section 4(3)(b) then permits simplified due diligence for an institution incorporated there that carries on a similar business, has similar compliance measures and is supervised for compliance. Being foreign does not automatically trigger enhanced due diligence under section 15; authorized institutions are not exempt from Schedule 2 altogether; and section 14 applies only where the MSO itself is the correspondent bank for that customer's own customers, not simply because the customer happens to be a bank.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者的客戶是在財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區註冊成立並在當地受監管的銀行。附表2下有哪一途徑可用？
options: 第4條的簡化盡職審查，因該客戶可能屬同等司法管轄區的機構
第15條的加強盡職審查，因任何外地客戶均自動被視為高風險
完全無須盡職審查，因認可機構獲豁免於附表2以外
第14條的代理銀行業務措施，因該客戶將為其客戶操作帳戶
tc.explain: 香港以外的財務行動特別組織成員司法管轄區，屬第1(1)條定義下的同等司法管轄區。第4(3)(b)條繼而准許對在當地註冊成立、經營類似業務、設有類似合規措施並受監督的機構採用簡化盡職審查。屬外地機構本身不會自動觸發第15條的加強盡職審查；認可機構亦非完全獲豁免於附表2以外；而第14條只適用於金錢服務經營者本身就該客戶本身的客戶擔任代理銀行的情況，並非單純因客戶是銀行而適用。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “business relationship”) applied
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「業務關係」的定義）的應用

en.q: A customer opens an account with an MSO intending to remit monthly to family overseas. At what point does a business relationship arise?
options: At first contact, since the institution already expects duration
Only after the second monthly remittance has actually been completed
Only once twelve continuous months of remittances have elapsed
Only once the aggregate of the remittances exceeds the $120,000 threshold
en.explain: Limb (b) of the definition covers a relationship that the institution, at first contact with a potential customer, expects to have an element of duration. The expectation at first contact is sufficient; no second transaction, waiting period, or aggregate transaction value is required.

tc.q: 某客戶在金錢服務經營者開立帳戶，擬每月向海外家人匯款。業務關係於何時產生？
options: 於初次接觸時，因該機構當時已預期具有持續性元素
須待第二筆每月匯款實際完成之後方告產生
須待連續十二個月的匯款期屆滿之後方告產生
須待匯款總額超過120,000元之後方告產生
tc.explain: 該定義的(b)項涵蓋機構在與潛在客戶初次接觸時，已預期會具有持續性元素的關係。初次接觸時的預期已屬足夠，無須第二筆交易、等待期或交易總額。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1(1) (definition of “politically exposed person”) applied
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1(1)條（「政治人物」的定義）的應用

en.q: A prospective customer is a middle-ranking official in a foreign government ministry. Does the politically exposed person definition apply?
options: No — sub-paragraph (a)(ii) excludes middle-ranking or junior officials
Yes — sub-paragraph (a)(i) covers any government official in a place outside Hong Kong
Yes, but only because the ministry has oversight of a state-owned corporation
Only if the official has held the ministerial post for more than five years
en.explain: Sub-paragraph (a)(i) lists the senior categories covered (head of state, senior politician, senior government/judicial/military official, senior executive of a state-owned corporation, important political party official), and sub-paragraph (a)(ii) expressly excludes a middle-ranking or more junior official of any of those categories. No years-in-post threshold exists, and the state-owned-corporation category concerns senior executives, not ministry oversight.

tc.q: 某擬開戶客戶是外國政府部門的中級官員。「政治人物」的定義是否適用？
options: 否——(a)(ii)節剔除中級或更低級官員
是——(a)(i)節涵蓋香港以外的任何政府官員
是，但只因該官員所屬部門監管一間國有企業
只限該官員已擔任該部長級職位超過五年之久
tc.explain: (a)(i)節列出所涵蓋的高級類別（國家元首、高級政治家、高級政府／司法／軍事官員、國有企業高級行政人員、重要政黨官員），而(a)(ii)節明文剔除該等類別中任何中級或更低級的官員。年資並無任何門檻規定，而國有企業類別針對的是高級行政人員，並非部門的監管關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(1)(a)條

en.q: Before establishing a correspondent banking relationship, what information must an authorized institution collect about the proposed respondent bank?
options: Sufficient information to understand fully the respondent bank's business
Only the respondent bank's audited financial statements, without further inquiry
Only written confirmation that the respondent bank holds a valid banking licence
Only a list of the respondent bank's current directors and controllers
en.explain: Section 14(1)(a) of Schedule 2 requires collecting sufficient information about the proposed respondent bank to enable the institution to understand fully the nature of that bank's business — not merely one document type — alongside determining its reputation under paragraph (b) and assessing its AML/CFT controls under paragraph (c).

tc.q: 在建立代理銀行關係前，認可機構須就擬議代理銀行收集甚麼資料？
options: 足夠資料，使其能全面了解該擬議代理銀行的業務
只限該代理銀行的經審計財務報表，不再查詢
只限書面確認該代理銀行持有有效銀行牌照
只限該代理銀行現任董事及控制人的名單
tc.explain: 附表2第14(1)(a)條規定須收集關於該擬議代理銀行的足夠資料，使其能全面了解該銀行業務的性質——不僅限於單一文件——此外第(b)款須確定其聲譽，第(c)款須評估其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(1)(b)條

en.q: From what source must an authorized institution determine the reputation of a proposed respondent bank and the quality of its supervision?
options: Publicly available information
Information supplied by the respondent bank itself
A report commissioned from an independent consultant
Confidential intelligence provided by the Monetary Authority
en.explain: Section 14(1)(b) requires the authorized institution to determine, from publicly available information, the reputation of the proposed respondent bank and the quality of its supervision by authorities in that place performing functions similar to those of the Monetary Authority.

tc.q: 認可機構須從甚麼來源確定擬議代理銀行的聲譽及其所受監管的質素？
options: 公開可得的資料
該代理銀行本身提供的資料
委聘獨立顧問撰寫的報告
金融管理專員提供的機密情報
tc.explain: 第14(1)(b)條規定認可機構須從公開可得的資料，確定該擬議代理銀行的聲譽，以及該地方執行與金融管理專員類似職能的當局對其監管的質素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(2)條

en.q: Which of the following must an authorized institution do before establishing a correspondent banking relationship?
options: Obtain senior management approval, and document both parties' responsibilities
Obtain the Monetary Authority's prior written approval for the relationship
Obtain a guarantee from the respondent bank's home regulator covering its liabilities
Obtain the written consent of the respondent bank's own account-holding customers
en.explain: Section 14(2) requires senior management approval; satisfaction, after complying with section 14(1), that the respondent bank's AML/CFT controls are adequate and effective; documentation of the responsibilities of both institutions; and satisfaction as to the respondent bank's handling of customers who can directly operate the accounts. The Monetary Authority's approval, a regulator's guarantee, and customer consent are not among the four conditions.

tc.q: 認可機構在建立代理銀行關係前，須作出下列哪項？
options: 取得高級管理層批准，並記錄雙方各自的責任
事先取得金融管理專員的書面批准函件
取得該代理銀行所屬監管機構的擔保，涵蓋其負債
取得該代理銀行本身開戶客戶的書面同意
tc.explain: 第14(2)條規定須取得高級管理層批准；在遵從第14(1)款後信納該代理銀行的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集管控措施充分有效；以文件記錄雙方機構的責任；並就該代理銀行如何處理可直接操作帳戶的客戶感到信納。金融管理專員的批准、監管機構的擔保，以及客戶同意，均不在該四項條件之列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第14(2)(d)條

en.q: In relation to a respondent bank's customers who will be able to directly operate the accounts maintained for the respondent bank, of what must the authorized institution be satisfied?
options: That the bank will verify and monitor those customers, and provide documents on request
That the bank will verify those customers' identities, with no ongoing monitoring obligation
That those customers will each be individually approved by the authorized institution
That the number of such customers will not exceed a limit fixed by the authorized institution
en.explain: Section 14(2)(d) requires satisfaction on two combined points: that the respondent bank will verify and continuously monitor those customers to standards similar to Schedule 2, and that it will provide the resulting documents, data or information on request. Verification alone, without the monitoring limb, does not satisfy the sub-section — the two are joined by 'and', which is why distractor 1 is wrong despite being half right.

tc.q: 就將可直接操作為代理銀行維持的帳戶的該代理銀行客戶，認可機構須信納甚麼？
options: 該代理銀行會核實並監察該等客戶，並應要求提供文件
該代理銀行會核實客戶的身分，但無持續監察的責任
該等客戶均須先經該認可機構逐一審批同意
該等客戶的數目不會超過該認可機構所定的上限
tc.explain: 第14(2)(d)條規定須信納兩項合併要點：該代理銀行會按與附表2相若的標準核實並持續監察該等客戶，並會應要求提供所取得的文件、數據或資料。單憑核實而不包括監察部分，並不符合該款規定——兩者以「並」字連接，這正是選項2雖然說對一半卻仍然錯誤的原因。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第7(2)條

en.q: What was an authorized institution required to do on the commencement of the Ordinance in relation to a pre-existing correspondent banking relationship?
options: Terminate the relationship, unless the three section 7(2) conditions were met
Continue the relationship regardless, since it predated the Ordinance's commencement
Apply to the Monetary Authority in writing for permission to continue the relationship
Convert the relationship into an ordinary customer account relationship automatically
en.explain: Section 7(2) required termination on the commencement date unless, before that date, the institution had carried out the section 14(1) measures and was satisfied the respondent bank's controls were adequate and effective; had documented both parties' responsibilities; and was satisfied as to the respondent bank's handling of directly-operating customers. No application to the Monetary Authority or automatic conversion is provided for.

tc.q: 就本條例生效前已存在的代理銀行關係，認可機構在本條例生效時須怎樣做？
options: 終止該關係，除非三項法定條件已獲符合
不論如何均可繼續該關係，因其早於本條例生效
以書面向金融管理專員申請准許繼續該關係
自動將該關係轉為一般客戶帳戶關係
tc.explain: 第7(2)條規定須於生效日期終止該關係，除非該機構在該日期前已進行第14(1)款的措施並信納該代理銀行的管控措施充分有效；已以文件記錄雙方的責任；並就該代理銀行如何處理可直接操作帳戶的客戶感到信納。條文並無向金融管理專員申請或自動轉換的安排。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「職能」的定義）

en.q: What does “function” include under Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: Power and duty
Power only, not duty
Duty only, not power
Only functions expressly conferred by the Ordinance
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that function includes power and duty. The breadth matters for provisions such as section 4 immunity and section 26 delegation, both of which are framed in terms of functions.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》附表1而言，「職能」包括甚麼？
options: 權力及職責
只包括權力，不包括職責
只包括職責，不包括權力
只包括本條例明文授予的職能
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「職能」包括權力及職責。此定義的廣泛程度對第4條的免責保障及第26條的職能轉授等條文十分重要，因兩者均以「職能」表述。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definitions of “document” and “record”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「文件」及「紀錄」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance do the definitions of “document” and “record” in Schedule 1 to the AMLO take their meaning?
options: The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571), Sch. 1 Part 1 s.1
The Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) — defines corporation and director
The Evidence Ordinance (Cap. 8) — governs the admissibility of business records
The Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553) — defines information system
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that document and record each have the meaning given by section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571). Corporation and director are defined by reference to the Companies Ordinance; information system is separately defined by reference to the Electronic Transactions Ordinance — a different term from document or record.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1中「文件」及「紀錄」的定義，源自哪一條例？
options: 《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條
《公司條例》（第622章）——界定法團及董事
《證據條例》（第8章）——規管商業紀錄的可接納性
《電子交易條例》（第553章）——界定「資訊系統」
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「文件」及「紀錄」各具有《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條所給予的涵義。「法團」及「董事」則參照《公司條例》界定；「資訊系統」則另行參照《電子交易條例》界定——與「文件」或「紀錄」屬不同用詞。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「資訊系統」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does “information system” take its meaning for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: The Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553), section 2(1)
The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) — defines document and record
The Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486) — regulates data users
The Telecommunications Ordinance (Cap. 106) — regulates carrier licensing
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that information system has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553). Document and record instead take their meaning from the Securities and Futures Ordinance; the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance and Telecommunications Ordinance are not the source of any Schedule 1 definition.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「資訊系統」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《電子交易條例》（第553章）第2(1)條
《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）——界定「文件」及「紀錄」
《個人資料（私隱）條例》（第486章）——規管資料使用者
《電訊條例》（第106章）——規管電訊牌照發放
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「資訊系統」具有《電子交易條例》（第553章）第2(1)條所給予的涵義。「文件」及「紀錄」則參照《證券及期貨條例》界定；《個人資料（私隱）條例》及《電訊條例》均非附表1任何定義的出處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「法團」的定義）

en.q: How is “corporation” defined in Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: A Companies Ordinance company, or a body corporate incorporated anywhere
Only a company incorporated in Hong Kong under the Companies Ordinance
Only a company whose shares are listed for trading on a recognized stock market
Any public body, or any body of persons, whether corporate or unincorporate
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines corporation as a company as defined by section 2(1) of the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) or other body corporate incorporated either in Hong Kong or elsewhere — it is not limited to Hong Kong incorporation or stock market listing. 'Any public body, or any body of persons, whether corporate or unincorporate' is instead the Schedule 2 definition of the wider term legal person.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部如何界定「法團」？
options: 《公司條例》的公司，或在任何地方成立的法團
只限根據《公司條例》在香港成立為法團的公司
只限股份在認可證券市場買賣的公司
公共機構，或任何人的團體，不論是否屬法團
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「法團」為《公司條例》（第622章）第2(1)條所界定的公司，或在香港或其他地方成立為法團的其他法人團體——並不限於在香港成立或於證券市場上市。「任何公共機構，或任何人的團體，不論是否屬法團」則是附表2中涵蓋範圍更廣的「法人」一詞的定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「董事」的定義）

en.q: How is “director” defined in Part 2 of Schedule 1 for a corporation that is not itself a company under the Companies Ordinance?
options: A person, whatever their title, who fills a role like a company director's
Only a person registered as a director in the place of incorporation
Only an executive officer with day-to-day management responsibility
Only a person appointed to the post by a shareholders' resolution
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines director, for a Companies Ordinance company, by reference to that Ordinance's own definition, and for any other corporation as a person (by whatever name called) who occupies a position similar to that of such a director — substance over formal title, registration, executive function or method of appointment. Section 24 uses a comparable substance-over-form formula for Part 5.

tc.q: 就本身並非《公司條例》公司的法團而言，附表1第2部如何界定「董事」？
options: 不論職銜為何，擔任類似公司董事角色的人
只限在成立為法團的地方登記為董事的人
只限在該法團中負責日常管理的行政人員
只限由股東決議委任出任該職位的人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部就《公司條例》公司，參照該條例本身的定義界定「董事」；就任何其他法團，則界定為不論職銜為何、在該法團中擔任類似該等董事職位的人——重實質而非正式職銜、登記、行政職能或委任方式。第24條就第5部採用可比的重實質而非形式的表述。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「地產代理」的定義）

en.q: Who is an “estate agent” for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: A licensed estate agent or licensed salesperson per the Estate Agents Ordinance
Only a licensed estate agent, not a licensed salesperson
Any person arranging property transactions by way of business, licensed or not
Only an estate agent who is also a member of a professional body
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines estate agent as a licensed estate agent as defined by section 2(1) of the Estate Agents Ordinance (Cap. 511), or a licensed salesperson as defined by that section — both categories are covered, and both require a licence. Both are DNFBPs.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，何人屬「地產代理」？
options: 《地產代理條例》所指的持牌地產代理或營業員
只限持牌地產代理，不包括持牌營業員
以業務方式安排物業交易的人，不論是否持牌
只限同時屬某專業團體會員的地產代理人
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「地產代理」為《地產代理條例》（第511章）第2(1)條所界定的持牌地產代理，或該條所界定的持牌營業員——兩個類別均包括在內，且均須持牌。兩者均屬指定非金融企業及行業。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 2 (definition of “Estate Agents Authority”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「地產代理監管局」的定義）

en.q: What is the significance, under the AMLO, of a person being a “licensed estate agent” or “licensed salesperson” regulated by the Estate Agents Authority?
options: They fall within “estate agent,” a DNFBP subject to Schedule 2's duties
They are exempt from Schedule 2, since real estate transactions carry no money laundering risk
They become a “financial institution,” supervised by the Monetary Authority
They are treated as TCSP licensees, and may act only as a section 18 intermediary
en.explain: Estate agent is one of the five DNFBP categories listed in Part 2 of Schedule 1 (with accounting professional, legal professional, TCSP licensee and Category B PMS registrant), so licensed estate agents and salespersons are subject to the Schedule 2 duties that apply to a financial institution or a DNFBP. They are not within the separate financial institution list, and being a DNFBP is distinct from voluntarily acting as a section 18 intermediary.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，受地產代理監管局規管的「持牌地產代理」或「持牌營業員」有何重要意義？
options: 屬「地產代理」，亦須遵從附表2的指定非金融企業及行業責任
他們獲豁免遵從附表2，因物業交易並無洗錢風險
他們成為「金融機構」，受金融管理專員監管
他們屬信託或公司服務持牌人，只可根據第18條擔任中介人
tc.explain: 「地產代理」是附表1第2部所列五類指定非金融企業及行業之一（其餘為會計專業人士、法律專業人士、信託或公司服務持牌人及貴金屬及寶石B類註冊人），因此持牌地產代理及持牌營業員須遵從適用於「金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業」的附表2責任。他們並不在另一份「金融機構」名單之內，而作為指定非金融企業及行業亦有別於自願根據第18條擔任中介人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「保險業監管局」的定義）

en.q: Under Schedule 1 to the AMLO, for which financial institutions does the Insurance Authority act as the “relevant authority”?
options: Authorized insurers and licensed insurance agents, agencies or brokers
Authorized institutions, SVF licensees and stablecoin licensees
Licensed money service operators and the Postmaster General
Licensed corporations, and licensed VAS providers and their associated entities
en.explain: Schedule 1's definition of relevant authority assigns the Insurance Authority to authorized insurers, licensed individual insurance agents, licensed insurance agencies and licensed insurance broker companies. The Monetary Authority covers authorized institutions, SVF and stablecoin licensees; the Commissioner covers licensed money service operators and the Postmaster General; and the Securities and Futures Commission covers licensed corporations and licensed VAS providers.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》附表1，保險業監管局就哪些金融機構擔任「有關當局」？
options: 獲授權保險人及持牌保險代理、代理機構或經紀公司
認可機構、儲值支付工具持牌人及穩定幣持牌人
持牌金錢服務經營者及郵政署署長
持牌法團、持牌虛擬資產服務提供者及其相聯實體
tc.explain: 附表1「有關當局」的定義將保險業監管局指定為獲授權保險人、持牌個人保險代理、持牌保險代理機構及持牌保險經紀公司的有關當局。金融管理專員負責認可機構、儲值支付工具持牌人及穩定幣持牌人；關長負責持牌金錢服務經營者及郵政署署長；證券及期貨事務監察委員會則負責持牌法團及持牌虛擬資產服務提供者。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「香港會計師公會」的定義）

en.q: Is the AFRC always the “regulatory body” for an accounting professional under Schedule 1, or does HKICPA ever take that role?
options: Not always — HKICPA takes that role for specified purposes
Always — the AFRC is the regulatory body for every purpose, with no exception
Never the AFRC — HKICPA alone is always the regulatory body
It depends on entity type — HKICPA for corporate practices, AFRC for individuals
en.explain: Schedule 1 makes the AFRC the regulatory body for an accounting professional generally, subject to two exceptions: for the purposes of section 4 it is the AFRC or HKICPA, and for the purposes of section 7(1) to (3) it is HKICPA as overseen by the AFRC under section 9(b) of the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council Ordinance. The distinction turns on which section applies, not on whether the professional is a corporate practice or an individual.

tc.q: 就會計專業人士而言，附表1下的「監管機構」是否一律為會財局，抑或香港會計師公會有時也擔任該角色？
options: 並非一律——就指明目的，香港會計師公會或在會財局監督下擔任該角色
一律如此——監管機構就任何目的而言均為會財局，並無例外
一律並非會財局——監管機構一律單獨為香港會計師公會
視乎實體類別而定——法團執業由香港會計師公會規管，個人則由會財局規管
tc.explain: 附表1一般以會財局作為會計專業人士的監管機構，但有兩項例外：就第4條而言，監管機構為會財局或香港會計師公會；就第7(1)、(2)及(3)條而言，則為根據《會計及財務匯報局條例》第9(b)條由會財局監督的香港會計師公會。分野在於所適用的條文，而非該會計專業人士屬法團執業抑或個人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「認可機構」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does “authorized institution” take its meaning for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: The Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155), section 2(1)
The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571)
The Insurance Ordinance (Cap. 41)
The Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584)
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that authorized institution has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155). The concept matters because section 25 excludes authorized institutions from Part 5 altogether.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「認可機構」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《銀行業條例》（第155章）第2(1)條
《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）
《保險業條例》（第41章）
《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「認可機構」具有《銀行業條例》（第155章）第2(1)條所給予的涵義。此概念十分重要，因第25條將認可機構完全排除於第5部之外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「持牌法團」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does “licensed corporation” take its meaning for the purposes of the AMLO?
options: The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571), Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1
The Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) — defines corporation and director in Schedule 1
The Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155) — defines authorized institution
The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance itself
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 provides that licensed corporation has the meaning given by section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) — the same source as document and record. Corporation and director are instead defined by reference to the Companies Ordinance, and authorized institution by reference to the Banking Ordinance.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》而言，「持牌法團」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條
《公司條例》（第622章）——於附表1界定「法團」及「董事」
《銀行業條例》（第155章）——界定「認可機構」
《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》本身
tc.explain: 附表1第2部訂明「持牌法團」具有《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）附表1第1部第1條所給予的涵義——與「文件」及「紀錄」的定義出處相同。「法團」及「董事」則參照《公司條例》界定，而「認可機構」則參照《銀行業條例》界定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “stored value facility”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「儲值支付工具」的定義）

en.q: From which Ordinance does the AMLO's definition of “SVF” take its meaning under Schedule 1?
options: The Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584), s.2A
The Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155) — defines authorized institution
The Electronic Transactions Ordinance (Cap. 553) — defines information system
The Securities and Futures Ordinance (Cap. 571) — defines document and record
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that stored value facility has the meaning given by section 2A of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (Cap. 584). Information system instead comes from the Electronic Transactions Ordinance, and document and record from the Securities and Futures Ordinance.

tc.q: 附表1下「儲值支付工具」的涵義源自哪一條例？
options: 《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第2A條
《銀行業條例》（第155章）——界定「認可機構」
《電子交易條例》（第553章）——界定「資訊系統」
《證券及期貨條例》（第571章）——界定「文件」及「紀錄」
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「儲值支付工具」具有《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第2A條所給予的涵義。「資訊系統」則源自《電子交易條例》，而「文件」及「紀錄」則源自《證券及期貨條例》。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “Review Tribunal”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「審裁處」的定義）

en.q: How is “Review Tribunal” defined in Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Tribunal as defined by section 54
A tribunal established by the Chief Justice under section 76
Any tribunal established under Part 6 or Schedule 4
The Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 provides that Review Tribunal means the Tribunal as defined by section 54 — the interpretation provision for Part 6, which establishes the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1如何界定「審裁處」？
options: 第54條所界定的審裁處
終審法院首席法官根據第76條設立的審裁處
根據第6部或附表4設立的任何審裁處
證券及期貨事務上訴審裁處
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條訂明「審裁處」指第54條所界定的審裁處——即第6部的釋義條文，而第6部設立打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審裁處。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「會計專業人士」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included in the definition of “accounting professional” in Schedule 1?
options: A certified public accountant, corporate practice, or CPA firm
Only a certified public accountant who practises alone, not within a firm
Any person who holds a recognized accounting degree or professional diploma
Only a member of an overseas accounting body who happens to practise in Hong Kong
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1 defines accounting professional as a certified public accountant (or certified public accountant (practising)) as defined by the Professional Accountants Ordinance or the AFRC Ordinance; a corporate practice as defined by the AFRC Ordinance; or a CPA firm as defined by that Ordinance. Sole practice, an academic qualification and overseas body membership are not, by themselves, the statutory test.

tc.q: 附表1「會計專業人士」的定義包括下列何者？
options: 執業會計師、法團執業或會計師事務所
只限獨資執業、並非在事務所執業的執業會計師
任何持有認可會計學位或專業文憑的人
只限碰巧在香港執業的海外會計團體會員
tc.explain: 附表1第2部界定「會計專業人士」為《專業會計師條例》或《會計及財務匯報局條例》所界定的執業會計師（或執業會計師（執業中））；該條例所界定的法團執業；或該條例所界定的會計師事務所。獨資執業、學歷資格或海外團體會員身分，本身並非法定驗證標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「會財局」的定義）

en.q: What is the AFRC's role under the AMLO in relation to accounting professionals?
options: The default regulatory body for accounting professionals, unless HKICPA applies
It regulates every DNFBP category, not just accounting professionals
It has no supervisory role for accounting professionals; only HKICPA does
It shares equal, undivided authority with HKICPA for every purpose, with no exceptions
en.explain: Schedule 1 makes the AFRC the regulatory body for an accounting professional in general (subject to subparagraphs (ii) and (iii)), with HKICPA taking that role only for the purposes of section 4 (as an alternative) or section 7(1) to (3) (as overseen by the AFRC). The AFRC's Schedule 1 role is limited to accounting professionals — estate agents have the Estate Agents Authority and legal professionals have the Law Society.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，會財局就會計專業人士擔當甚麼角色？
options: 會計專業人士的預設監管機構，除非指明改由香港會計師公會擔任
規管所有指定非金融企業及行業類別，不僅限於會計專業人士
對會計專業人士並無監管角色；只有香港會計師公會有
就任何目的均與香港會計師公會共同擁有對等、不可分割的權力，並無例外
tc.explain: 附表1一般以會財局作為會計專業人士的監管機構（除第(ii)及(iii)節另有規定外），香港會計師公會只在第4條的情況（作為替代選項）或第7(1)、(2)及(3)條的情況（受會財局監督）下擔任該角色。會財局在附表1下的角色只限於會計專業人士——地產代理由地產代理監管局規管，法律專業人士則由律師會規管。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部（「律師會」的定義）

en.q: What does “Law Society” mean in Part 2 of Schedule 1 to the AMLO?
options: The Law Society of Hong Kong
The Hong Kong Bar Association
Any professional body regulating legal practitioners in Hong Kong
The Legal Practitioners Registration Committee
en.explain: Part 2 of Schedule 1, added in 2018, defines Law Society as The Law Society of Hong Kong. It is one of the bodies to which a relevant authority may disclose information under section 76D(1)(g).

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第2部中「律師會」指甚麼？
options: 香港律師會
香港大律師公會
在香港規管法律執業者的任何專業團體
法律執業者登記委員會
tc.explain: 2018年加入的附表1第2部界定「律師會」為香港律師會。該會是有關當局可根據第76D(1)(g)條向其披露資料的團體之一。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of “designated retail payment system”)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（「指定零售支付系統」的定義）

en.q: Which of the following is included within the Schedule 1 definition of “money service”?
options: Either a money changing service or a remittance service, per Schedule 1
Only currency exchange; remittance is treated as a separate, unrelated activity
Banking deposit-taking services offered by authorized institutions
Currency exchange conducted by a hotel for the convenience of its guests
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, section 1 defines money service as (a) a money changing service or (b) a remittance service — both are covered, not just currency exchange. Money changing service itself carries a narrow carve-out for a hotel operator's guest-convenience currency purchases, which is why that scenario falls outside the definition; deposit-taking is a Banking Ordinance activity, not a Schedule 1 money service.

tc.q: 附表1「金錢服務」的定義包括下列何者？
options: 附表1所界定的貨幣兌換服務或匯款服務
只限貨幣兌換；匯款服務屬另一項獨立而無關的活動
認可機構提供的銀行存款服務
酒店為方便住客而進行的貨幣兌換
tc.explain: 附表1第1部第1條界定「金錢服務」為(a)貨幣兌換服務或(b)匯款服務——兩者均包括在內，不僅限於貨幣兌換。「貨幣兌換服務」本身就酒店經營者為方便住客而進行的貨幣購買設有狹窄的例外情況，因此該情況不屬定義範圍；存款服務屬《銀行業條例》規管的活動，並非附表1所指的金錢服務。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.3(1)(a) and s.3(2) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)(a)條與第3(2)條的比較

en.q: What is the relationship between section 3(1)(a) and section 3(2) of Schedule 2?
options: Section 3(1)(a) requires CDD first; section 3(2) narrowly allows verification afterwards
Section 3(2) repeals section 3(1)(a); CDD before establishing a relationship is no longer required
Section 3(2) applies only to DNFBPs; section 3(1)(a) applies only to financial institutions
Section 3(2) allows CDD to be skipped entirely in urgent cases; section 3(1)(a) does not apply then
en.explain: Section 3(1)(a) is expressly subject to subsection (2), which permits verification of the customer and any beneficial owner after establishing the relationship, but only where necessary not to interrupt normal business conduct and any resulting risk is effectively managed — a narrow, conditional deferral, not a repeal, a sectoral carve-out, or an urgency-based exemption from CDD altogether.

tc.q: 附表2第3(1)(a)條與第3(2)條有何關係？
options: 第3(1)(a)條規定須先進行客戶盡職審查；第3(2)條則狹義容許其後核實
第3(2)條廢除第3(1)(a)條；建立業務關係前無須再進行客戶盡職審查
第3(2)條只適用於指定非金融企業及行業；第3(1)(a)條只適用於金融機構
第3(2)條容許在緊急情況下完全略過客戶盡職審查；第3(1)(a)條屆時不適用
tc.explain: 第3(1)(a)條明文受第(2)款規限，該款准許在建立關係後方核實客戶及任何實益擁有人的身分，但只限為免打斷正常業務往來而有此需要，且因此產生的風險獲有效管理——這是狹窄、附條件的延後安排，並非廢除規定、業別劃分，或在緊急情況下完全豁免客戶盡職審查。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.4 and s.15 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4條與第15條的比較

en.q: How do sections 4 and 15 of Schedule 2 relate to one another?
options: Section 4 permits simplified CDD in lower-risk situations; section 15 adds requirements in high-risk situations
Both sections impose additional requirements; section 15's requirements are simply the stricter of the two
Section 4 applies only to financial institutions; section 15 applies only to DNFBPs
Section 15 displaces section 4 whenever both could otherwise apply to the same customer
en.explain: Section 4 allows an institution, in defined lower-risk cases, to carry out only the section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d) measures instead of full CDD. Section 15 works in the opposite direction: in specified high-risk situations it adds senior management approval and either source of wealth/funds enquiries or additional mitigating measures. Both sections apply to financial institutions and DNFBPs alike, and nothing in the text makes one displace the other.

tc.q: 附表2第4條與第15條有何關係？
options: 第4條在較低風險情況下准許簡化客戶盡職審查；第15條則在高風險情況下加入額外規定
兩條均施加額外規定；第15條的規定只是兩者中較嚴格的一項
第4條只適用於金融機構；第15條只適用於指定非金融企業及行業
凡兩條均可能適用於同一客戶時，第15條取代第4條
tc.explain: 第4條在界定的較低風險情況下，准許機構只進行第2(1)(a)、(ab)、(c)及(d)條的措施，以代替完整的客戶盡職審查。第15條方向相反：在指明的高風險情況下，加入高級管理層批准，以及財富及資金來源查究或額外減低風險措施兩者之一。兩條同樣適用於金融機構及指定非金融企業及行業，文本中並無一條取代另一條的規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.20 and s.21 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20條與第21條的比較

en.q: What is the division of subject matter between sections 20 and 21 of Schedule 2?
options: Section 20 governs what must be kept and for how long; section 21 governs the form of keeping
Section 20 applies to financial institutions only, and section 21 applies to DNFBPs only
Section 20 covers transaction records only, and section 21 covers customer records only
Section 21 sets a materially longer retention period than section 20 requires
en.explain: Section 20 sets out the duty to keep records — what must be kept under subsection (1) and the retention periods under subsections (2), (3), (3A) and any extension under (4). Section 21 addresses the manner of keeping: originals, or copies on microfilm or in a computer database. Neither section is confined to one type of institution or one type of record, and section 21 does not itself set any retention period.

tc.q: 附表2第20條與第21條在主題上如何分工？
options: 第20條規管須保存哪些紀錄及保存多久；第21條規管保存的形式
第20條只限金融機構，第21條只限指定非金融企業及行業
第20條只涵蓋交易紀錄，第21條只涵蓋客戶紀錄
第21條訂明的保存期，較第20條所訂者明顯更長
tc.explain: 第20條訂明保存紀錄的責任——第(1)款訂明須保存甚麼，第(2)、(3)、(3A)款訂明保存期，第(4)款則訂明延長。第21條則處理保存方式：正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存的副本。兩條均不限於單一類別的機構或單一類別的紀錄，第21條本身亦無訂明任何保存期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4部（雜項）第22及23條

en.q: Under Part 4 of Schedule 2, what must a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO do about its overseas branches and subsidiaries, and what further duty applies on top of that?
options: Ensure overseas branches and same-business subsidiaries have compliance procedures, and take all reasonable measures against contravention and ML/TF risk
Close any overseas branch immediately if local law does not permit an identical Hong Kong procedure, since Schedule 2 allows no lesser alternative measures
Ensure compliance procedures only for overseas subsidiaries that are wholly owned, while branches and partly-owned subsidiaries remain entirely unregulated
Apply Schedule 2's requirements overseas in full only where the local law of that place has expressly adopted the equivalent Hong Kong standard
en.explain: Section 22 requires the institution to ensure its branches, and its subsidiary undertakings carrying on the same business, outside Hong Kong have procedures in place to ensure compliance to the extent local law permits. Section 23 separately requires all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards against contravention of Part 2 or 3 and to mitigate ML/TF risk. Section 22(2) already answers the local-law-conflict case (inform the relevant authority and take additional measures) — an outright closure duty, an ownership-only limitation, and a local-law-adoption precondition are all false.

tc.q: 根據附表2第4部，在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者須就其境外分支機構及附屬公司做甚麼？在此之上另須負有甚麼責任？
options: 確保境外分支機構及同業附屬企業設有合規程序；並須另採取一切合理措施防止違反規定，減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
任何未能完全符合香港程序的境外分支機構，一律須立即結束該分支機構的業務，別無其他替代選擇
只須確保由該機構全資擁有的境外附屬公司設有合規程序，分支機構及非全資附屬公司則完全不受規管，亦無須通知有關當局或採取額外措施
只有在當地法律明文採納與香港相同標準的情況下，方須在境外全面適用附表2的所有有關規定
tc.explain: 第22條規定機構須確保其境外分支機構，以及在當地經營相同業務的附屬企業，在當地法律准許的範圍內設有程序以確保合規。第23條另規定須採取一切合理措施，確保設有防護措施以防止違反第2或3部，並減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。第22(2)條已就當地法律衝突訂明做法（通知有關當局並採取額外措施）——立即結束、只限全資附屬公司，或須當地法律明文採納香港標準等說法均屬錯誤。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2部第3分部（禁制）第16及17條

en.q: What is the subject matter of Division 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 2?
options: Prohibitions — anonymous accounts, and correspondent banking relationships with shell banks
Special requirements that apply to higher-risk customers and transactions generally
General customer due diligence obligations that apply to every customer relationship
Record-keeping requirements governing the documents, data and information obtained
en.explain: Division 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 2 is headed Prohibitions and contains section 16 (anonymous accounts and accounts in fictitious names) and section 17 (an authorized institution's correspondent banking relationships with shell banks). Division 2 contains the special requirements for higher-risk situations, Division 1 the general CDD obligations, and Part 3 the record-keeping requirements — each a different part of the Schedule from Division 3.

tc.q: 附表2第2部第3分部的主題為何？
options: 禁止事項——匿名帳戶，以及與空殼銀行的代理銀行服務關係
適用於所有較高風險客戶及交易的特別規定
適用於每段客戶關係本身的一般客戶盡職審查責任
規管所取得的有關文件、數據及資料的紀錄保存規定
tc.explain: 附表2第2部第3分部標題為「禁止事項」，載有第16條（匿名帳戶及以虛構名稱開立的帳戶）及第17條（認可機構與空殼銀行的代理銀行服務關係）。第2分部載有較高風險情況的特別規定，第1分部載有一般客戶盡職審查責任，第3部則載有紀錄保存規定——各屬附表中不同於第3分部的部分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2部第4分部（雜項）第18及19條

en.q: Under Division 4 of Part 2 of Schedule 2, what must an MSO do before relying on an intermediary for CDD, and what must it separately establish for determining PEP status?
options: The intermediary must consent in writing and be able to provide records on request; the MSO must separately establish PEP-determination procedures
Obtain the intermediary's oral agreement only; separately obtain the intermediary's approval of its own PEP determinations
Confirm the intermediary is licensed specifically in Hong Kong for this purpose; separately review PEP status only once every year
Confirm the intermediary has never been convicted of an offence; separately delegate PEP determination entirely to it
en.explain: Section 18(1) permits reliance on a specified intermediary only if the intermediary consents in writing and the MSO is satisfied it will provide copies of CDD documents or records on request; section 18(2) keeps the MSO liable for any CDD failure regardless of reliance. Section 19(1) separately requires the MSO to establish and maintain effective procedures for determining PEP status. Oral consent, Hong-Kong-only licensing, a clean-record test, and delegating PEP determination away are not part of either section.

tc.q: 根據附表2第2部第4分部，金錢服務經營者在倚賴中介人進行客戶盡職審查前須做甚麼？並須另行訂立甚麼以斷定政治人物身分？
options: 中介人須以書面同意，並須能夠應要求提供紀錄；該經營者另須訂立程序以斷定政治人物身分
只須取得中介人的口頭同意即可；另須由中介人批准其自行斷定的政治人物身分結果
確認中介人專為此目的於香港持牌；另須每年僅一次覆核政治人物身分
確認中介人從未曾被定罪；另須將政治人物的斷定完全交由中介人負責
tc.explain: 第18(1)條規定，只有在中介人以書面同意，並令經營者信納其將應要求提供客戶盡職審查文件或紀錄的副本時，方可倚賴指明中介人；第18(2)條訂明不論是否倚賴中介人，經營者仍須就未能履行該項客戶盡職審查措施負責。第19(1)條另規定經營者須訂立及維持有效程序以斷定政治人物身分。口頭同意、只限香港持牌、無案底測試，或將政治人物身分斷定完全轉交中介人，均非兩條條文的規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.5 and s.6 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5條與第6條的比較

en.q: How do the termination consequences in sections 5 and 6 of Schedule 2 differ?
options: Section 6(2) requires termination if a pre-existing customer fails the section 6(1) trigger; section 5 has no termination duty
Both sections require termination on identical terms whenever ongoing monitoring reveals any discrepancy
Section 5 requires termination for suspicious transactions, while section 6 imposes no termination duty at all
Neither section provides for termination, since only section 3(4) contains a rule of that kind
en.explain: Section 5 sets out the continuous monitoring duty and, in subsection (3), additional measures for higher-risk customers, but contains no termination provision of its own. Section 6(2) requires termination as soon as reasonably practicable where the institution cannot carry out CDD on a pre-existing customer once a section 6(1) trigger arises. Section 3(4) separately contains a parallel termination rule for other circumstances — that rule exists alongside sections 5 and 6, and does not mean section 6(2) itself lacks one.

tc.q: 附表2第5條與第6條的終止關係後果有何不同？
options: 第6(2)條規定，先前客戶如未能符合第6(1)款的觸發要求，須終止關係；第5條並無終止條文
只要在持續監察期間發現任何輕微差異，兩條均一律規定須按完全相同的條款終止關係
第5條規定機構一旦發現任何可疑交易即須終止關係，而第6條則完全無任何終止責任
兩條均完全無終止規定；此類終止規則其實只見於第3(4)條之中而已
tc.explain: 第5條訂明持續監察責任，並在第(3)款訂明就較高風險客戶的額外措施，但本身並無終止條文。第6(2)條規定，如第6(1)款的觸發情況出現而機構無法就先前客戶進行客戶盡職審查，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止關係。第3(4)條就其他情況另訂有相對應的終止規則——該規則是在第5、6條以外並存的規定，並不代表第6(2)條本身沒有終止規定。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.12 and s.13 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12條與第13條的比較

en.q: Which institutions are subject to section 13 of Schedule 2, and how does that differ from section 12?
options: Section 13 applies to licensed MSOs' non-wire remittances; section 12 applies to institutions generally for wire transfers
Section 13 applies to authorized institutions, while section 12 applies only to money service operators
Both sections apply identically to every financial institution, without any distinction between them
Section 13 applies only to virtual asset transfers carried out by any financial institution at all
en.explain: Section 13(1) applies to a remittance transaction other than a wire transfer, of $8,000 or above, carried out by a licensed money service operator. Section 12 applies to financial institutions generally in relation to wire transfers, subject to the exclusions in section 12(2) — the institution and transfer-type coverage of the two sections is not reversed, identical, or limited to virtual assets.

tc.q: 附表2第13條適用於哪些機構？與第12條有何分別？
options: 第13條適用於持牌經營者的非電傳轉賬匯款交易；第12條則就電傳轉賬適用於金融機構
第13條特別適用於認可機構的匯款交易，第12條則只適用於金錢服務經營者
不論交易性質為何，第12條及第13條兩者均不加區別地一律適用於每一間金融機構
第13條的適用範圍其實只限於任何金融機構進行的虛擬資產轉移交易
tc.explain: 第13(1)條適用於持牌金錢服務經營者進行、8,000元或以上而並非電傳轉賬的匯款交易。第12條則就電傳轉賬一般適用於金融機構，並受第12(2)款的例外規定所限——兩條所涵蓋的機構及轉賬類型並非互換、並非完全相同，亦不限於虛擬資產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20條的應用

en.q: An MSO's customer relationship ends in June 2026, having begun in 2019. Until when must the customer identity records be kept?
options: Until at least June 2031 — 5 years measured from the date the relationship ends
Until at least 2024 — treating the 5-year period as running from when the relationship began
Only until June 2026, since records serve no further purpose once the relationship ends
Until at least June 2032 — treating the retention period as 6 years rather than 5
en.explain: Section 20(3) requires records under section 20(1)(b) to be kept throughout the business relationship and for at least 5 years beginning on the date it ends — the 2019 start date is irrelevant, the relationship's end does not itself close the retention duty, and the period is 5 years, not 6. A relationship ending in June 2026 therefore carries a retention obligation until at least June 2031.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者與客戶的關係於2019年開始，並於2026年6月終止。客戶身分紀錄須保存至何時？
options: 至少至2031年6月——自業務關係終止之日起計5年
至少至2024年——將5年期當作自關係開始起計
只須保存至2026年6月關係終止，因其後已無用途
至少至2032年6月——將保存期當作6年而非5年
tc.explain: 第20(3)條規定第20(1)(b)款的紀錄須在業務關係持續期間保存，並自關係終止之日起計至少5年——2019年的開始日期並不相干，關係終止本身並不會終結保存責任，而保存期為5年而非6年。因此，於2026年6月終止的關係，其保存責任至少延續至2031年6月。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(2)條的應用

en.q: A customer completes a transaction in March 2026 and closes the relationship in September 2026. Until when must the transaction record be kept?
options: Until at least March 2031 — the 5-year period runs from the transaction's completion, not the relationship's end
Until at least September 2031 — treating the period as running from when the relationship ended instead
Only until September 2026 — treating the relationship's end as closing the retention duty
Until at least March 2032 — treating the retention period as 6 years rather than 5
en.explain: Section 20(2) requires transaction records to be kept for at least 5 years beginning on the date the transaction is completed, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period. The transaction date, not the relationship's end date, governs, and the period is 5 years, not 6.

tc.q: 某客戶於2026年3月完成一宗交易，並於2026年9月終止關係。該交易紀錄須保存至何時？
options: 至少至2031年3月——5年期自交易完成之日起計，並非自關係終止起計
至少至2031年9月——將該期間當作自關係終止時起計
只須保存至2026年9月關係終止為止，當作保存責任隨即完結
至少至2032年3月——即將保存期錯誤當作6年而非5年
tc.explain: 第20(2)條規定交易紀錄須自該交易完成之日起計保存至少5年，不論該業務關係是否在該期間內終止。以交易日期而非關係終止日期為準，保存期為5年而非6年。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.2(1)(a) and s.2(1)(b) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)條與第2(1)(b)條的比較

en.q: How does the verification standard for a beneficial owner differ from that for the customer under section 2(1) of Schedule 2?
options: The customer must be verified against listed documentary sources; a beneficial owner needs only reasonable measures so the institution knows who they are
Both the customer and the beneficial owner must be verified against exactly the same list of documentary sources, with no exceptions
The beneficial owner must be verified to a stricter documentary standard than the customer, using sources the customer's own verification cannot rely on
No verification of a beneficial owner is required in any circumstances, even where the customer is a legal person or trust
en.explain: Section 2(1)(a) requires identifying the customer and verifying identity on the basis of documents, data or information from the listed sources. Section 2(1)(b) requires identifying the beneficial owner and taking reasonable measures to verify identity, so that the institution is satisfied it knows who the beneficial owner is — a risk-sensitive standard, not the same documentary list, not a stricter standard, and not one waived even for a legal person or trust.

tc.q: 根據附表2第2(1)條，核實實益擁有人身分的標準與核實客戶身分的標準有何不同？
options: 客戶身分須按所列來源的文件核實；實益擁有人只須採合理措施核實，令機構信納知悉其身分
在任何情況下，客戶及實益擁有人均須依據完全相同的文件來源清單核實
實益擁有人須按較客戶更嚴格的文件標準核實，並須使用客戶核實時不可倚賴的來源
在任何情況下，即使客戶是法人或信託，亦無須核實實益擁有人身分
tc.explain: 第2(1)(a)條規定須識別客戶並依據所列來源的文件、數據或資料核實其身分。第2(1)(b)條則規定須識別實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分，以令機構信納其知悉該實益擁有人是何人——屬按風險而定的標準，並非同一份文件清單，亦非較客戶更嚴格的標準，即使客戶是法人或信託亦不獲豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第16條的應用

en.q: An MSO discovers that an account it has maintained for two years is in a fictitious name. What does section 16 of Schedule 2 require?
options: The prohibition covers maintaining as well as opening, so the MSO must not continue to maintain the account
Nothing at all, since the prohibition only bites at the point the account was first opened
The MSO may keep maintaining the account, provided it now identifies the true underlying customer
The MSO must file a report about the account but may otherwise continue to operate it as before
en.explain: Section 16 provides that an institution must not open, or maintain, any anonymous account or account in a fictitious name for any customer. Because maintaining is prohibited as well as opening, discovering the position mid-relationship does not cure the contravention — the MSO cannot simply identify the true customer and carry on, file a report and carry on, or treat the duty as spent once the account was opened.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者發現其維持了兩年的一個帳戶是以虛構名稱開立。附表2第16條有何規定？
options: 該禁止規定同時涵蓋開立及維持該等帳戶，故該經營者不得繼續維持該帳戶
完全無須採取行動，因該禁止規定只在最初開立該帳戶時適用
只要現時識別出真正的相關客戶，該經營者即可繼續維持該帳戶
該經營者須就該帳戶提交報告，但其後仍可如常繼續操作該帳戶
tc.explain: 第16條訂明機構不得為任何客戶開立或維持任何匿名帳戶或以虛構名稱開立的帳戶。由於「維持」與「開立」同受禁止，在關係中途發現此情況並不能補救該項違反——該經營者不能單靠現在識別出真正客戶便繼續維持帳戶，也不能提交報告後如常操作，或視該責任在帳戶開立後已經完結。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.5(1)(a) and s.5(2) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)(a)條與第5(2)條的比較

en.q: How is the section 5(1)(a) review duty modified for a pre-existing customer before CDD is first carried out?
options: The institution need only review documents, data and information it holds, without obtaining fresh material
The review duty does not apply at all until CDD has first been carried out on the customer
The institution must obtain a complete fresh set of identification documents before any review
The review must instead be carried out annually rather than from time to time as usual
en.explain: Section 5(2) limits the section 5(1)(a) duty, for a pre-existing customer before CDD measures are first carried out under Part 2, to reviewing the documents, data and information relating to the customer that the institution already holds at the time of the review — the duty is not suspended altogether, does not require fresh documents, and does not change the review's frequency to annual.

tc.q: 就先前客戶而言，在首次進行客戶盡職審查前，第5(1)(a)條的檢視責任如何調整？
options: 機構只須檢視其已持有的文件、數據及資料，而無須另行取得新材料
在對該客戶首次進行客戶盡職審查前，該檢視責任完全不適用
機構須在進行任何檢視前，重新取得一整套身分識別文件
檢視須改為每年進行一次，而非按平常做法不時進行
tc.explain: 第5(2)條將第5(1)(a)款的責任加以限制：就先前客戶而言，在按第2部首次進行客戶盡職審查措施前，只須檢視該機構在進行該項檢視時已持有的、關於該客戶的文件、數據及資料——該責任並非完全暫停，亦不須取得新文件，檢視頻率亦不會改為每年一次。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.9 and s.5(3)(a) compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9條與第5(3)(a)條的比較

en.q: A customer is not physically present for identification. Which two distinct obligations does Schedule 2 impose?
options: Section 9 requires one special verification measure at the outset; section 5(3)(a) requires extra ongoing monitoring measures
Only section 9 applies at the outset; ongoing monitoring under section 5 is completely unaffected by this at all
Only section 5(3)(a) applies during monitoring; no special measure is needed at the outset at all
Both sections require the proposed business relationship to be refused outright in every case
en.explain: Section 9(1) addresses the point of identification, requiring at least one of three listed measures. Section 5(3)(a) addresses the ongoing relationship, requiring additional measures in monitoring to compensate for the risk. Both are disapplied where a recognized digital identification system was used — neither obligation is switched off by the other, and neither requires outright refusal of the relationship.

tc.q: 某客戶並未親身出席以供識別。附表2施加哪兩項不同的責任？
options: 第9條規定開始時須進行三項核實措施之一；第5(3)(a)條規定持續監察時須採取額外措施
只有第9條在客戶開始關係時適用；第5條下的持續監察完全不受此情況絲毫影響
只有第5(3)(a)條在其後的監察期間適用；在開始時完全無須任何特別措施
兩條均規定不論任何情況為何，均須一律徹底拒絕建立該擬議業務關係
tc.explain: 第9(1)條處理識別環節，規定須進行所列三項措施中至少一項。第5(3)(a)條則處理持續關係，規定在監察時須採取額外措施以抵銷風險。如已使用獲認可數碼身分識別系統，兩者均不適用——兩項責任並不會互相排除，亦不會要求一律拒絕建立該關係。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.10 and s.15 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10條與第15條的比較

en.q: What do the politically exposed person requirements in section 10 and the high-risk requirements in section 15 have in common?
options: Both require senior management approval; only section 10 makes source-of-wealth measures mandatory
Both sections require the proposed business relationship to be terminated before it may even be established
Both sections apply only to isolated occasional transactions, and never to any ongoing business relationship at all
Both may instead always be satisfied simply by taking additional risk-mitigating measures, with no exception whatsoever
en.explain: Section 10(1) requires senior management approval and reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds before establishing a relationship with a PEP — both elements mandatory. Section 15(a) requires senior management approval, but then only either the same source enquiries or additional mitigating measures — an alternative section 10 does not offer. The two provisions share the senior-management-approval requirement, but not an identical source-of-wealth mandate; neither requires outright termination, neither is confined to occasional transactions, and section 10 offers no mitigating-measures alternative.

tc.q: 第10條的政治人物規定與第15條的高風險規定有何共通之處？
options: 兩者均須取得高級管理層批准；但只有第10條的財富來源措施屬強制
兩條均規定須在該擬議業務關係得以正式建立之前，先行終止該關係
兩條均只適用於單次的非經常交易本身，而從不適用於任何持續的業務關係
兩者均可一律只須改為採取額外的減低風險措施，即當作已符合規定
tc.explain: 第10(1)條規定在與政治人物建立關係前，須取得高級管理層批准，並須採取合理措施確定財富來源及資金來源——兩項均屬強制規定。第15(a)條則規定須取得高級管理層批准，其後則只須作出相同的來源查究或採取額外的減低風險措施——此替代選項第10條並無提供。兩條的共通點在於須取得高級管理層批准，而非完全相同的財富來源強制規定；兩者均不要求終止關係，亦不限於非經常交易，而第10條亦無提供減低風險措施的替代選項。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.18 and s.22 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18條與第22條的比較

en.q: An MSO relies on an overseas office for part of its compliance work. Which Schedule 2 provisions may be engaged?
options: Section 18, if the office is an intermediary doing CDD; section 22, if it is a branch or subsidiary
Only section 18, since section 22 under Schedule 2 applies only to authorized institutions incorporated overseas
Only section 22, since section 18 applies only to intermediaries based in Hong Kong itself
Neither - an MSO's Schedule 2 duties stop at its own Hong Kong premises and never reach any overseas office
en.explain: Section 18 lets a financial institution or DNFBP carry out CDD measures through an intermediary, which under section 18(3) can include a related foreign financial institution acting for the MSO overseas. Section 22 instead requires a Hong Kong-incorporated institution to ensure its own overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings maintain compliance procedures - a different relationship from an intermediary. Section 22 is not limited to authorized institutions, and Schedule 2 duties do reach overseas offices in both these ways.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者倚賴海外辦事處處理部分合規工作。附表2的哪些條文可能適用？
options: 辦事處作中介人進行盡職審查，適用第18條；屬分支或附屬企業，則適用第22條
只適用第18條，因附表2第22條只適用於在海外註冊成立的認可機構
只適用第22條，因第18條只適用於設於香港本地的中介人
兩者皆不適用——經營者的附表2責任只及於其香港處所，不涉任何海外辦事處
tc.explain: 第18條容許金融機構或指定非金融企業及行業藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施，而根據第18(3)條，中介人可包括代該經營者於海外行事的有關連外地金融機構。第22條則規定在香港註冊成立的機構須確保其本身的境外分支機構及附屬企業設有合規程序——這是與中介人不同的關係。第22條並不限於認可機構，附表2的責任亦確實以這兩種方式伸延至海外辦事處。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.23 and s.19 compared
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第23條與第19條的比較

en.q: How do the obligations in sections 19 and 23 of Schedule 2 differ in character?
options: Section 19 sets specific procedures, e.g. PEP determination; section 23 is a general safeguards and risk-mitigation duty
Section 19 applies only to financial institutions, while section 23 applies only to DNFBPs, with no overlap
Section 23 is narrower than section 19 and is limited to record-keeping obligations under Part 3
The two sections are alternative routes to compliance, so satisfying one discharges the other
en.explain: Section 19 prescribes particular procedures for identified matters - determining PEP status, handling non-compliant wire and virtual asset transfers, and carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15. Section 23 is instead a general duty to take all reasonable measures to ensure safeguards against any Part 2 or 3 contravention and to mitigate ML/TF risk.
