Section 19 is not confined to financial institutions, section 23 is not confined to record-keeping, and the two duties are cumulative, not alternatives.

tc.q: 附表2第19條與第23條的責任在性質上有何不同？
options: 第19條就個別事項訂明具體程序（如政治人物身分）；第23條為一般防護責任
第19條只適用於金融機構，第23條則只適用於指定非金融企業及行業，兩者互不重疊
第23條較第19條為窄，只限於第3部下的紀錄保存責任及相關安排
兩條屬達致合規的替代途徑，遵從當中其一即已履行另一項規定
tc.explain: 第19條就已識別的事項訂明特定程序——斷定政治人物身分、處理不符規定的電傳轉賬及虛擬資產轉移，以及履行第3、4、5、9、10及15條的責任。第23條則是一般責任，須採取一切合理措施防止違反第2或3部的任何規定，並減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。第19條不只限於金融機構，第23條亦不只限於紀錄保存，兩者屬並行責任，並非二擇其一的替代方案。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的結構（第1至4部）

en.q: How is Schedule 2 to the AMLO structured?
options: Part 1 interpretation, Part 2 customer due diligence, Part 3 record-keeping, Part 4 miscellaneous
Part 1 customer due diligence, Part 2 record-keeping requirements, Part 3 fees, Part 4 the Review Tribunal
A single undivided set of sections numbered 1 to 23, with no Part headings at all
Part 1 general requirements and Part 2 special requirements only, with no further Parts
en.explain: Schedule 2 comprises Part 1 (Interpretation, section 1), Part 2 (Customer Due Diligence Requirements, sections 2-19), Part 3 (Record-keeping Requirements, sections 20-21), and Part 4 (Miscellaneous, sections 22-23). There is no Part headed 'fees' or 'the Review Tribunal' in Schedule 2, the sections are grouped under named Parts rather than left undivided, and there are four Parts, not two.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2的結構為何？
options: 第1部釋義、第2部客戶盡職審查規定、第3部紀錄保存規定、第4部雜項
第1部客戶盡職審查、第2部紀錄保存、第3部費用、第4部覆核審裁處
由第1至23條組成的單一不分部條文，完全沒有部的標題
只有第1部一般規定及第2部特別規定，並無其他部
tc.explain: 附表2由第1部（釋義，第1條）、第2部（客戶盡職審查規定，第2至19條）、第3部（紀錄保存規定，第20至21條）及第4部（雜項，第22至23條）組成。附表2並無稱為「費用」或「覆核審裁處」的部；條文是按命名的部分組編排，並非不分部；附表2共有四部，並非只有兩部。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第1.1段

en.q: Since when has the Customs and Excise Department been the authority regulating money service operators, and under which ordinance?
options: Since 1 April 2012, under the Anti-Money Laundering Ordinance (Cap. 615)
Since 1997, when the Banking Ordinance first covered remittance agents
Since 2018, under the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance
Since 2022, under the Stored Value Facilities Ordinance
en.explain: Licensing Guide §1.1: the C&ED has been the authority for regulating MSOs with effect from 1 April 2012, with the relevant powers provided under the AMLO (Cap. 615). The Banking Ordinance, the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance and the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance are all real ordinances but none of them is the source of the Commissioner's MSO-licensing powers or the 2012 start date.

tc.q: 香港海關自何時起成為規管金錢服務經營者的當局？依據哪條條例？
options: 自2012年4月1日起，依據《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）
自1997年起，當時《銀行業條例》已涵蓋匯款代理人
自2018年起，依據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》
自2022年起，依據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》第1.1段訂明，海關自2012年4月1日起成為規管金錢服務經營者的當局，相關權力由《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）賦予。《銀行業條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》均是真實的條例，但都不是關長規管金錢服務經營者發牌的權力來源，亦與2012年的起始日期無關。

en.q: What is the normal validity period of an MSO licence, and when does a licence otherwise cease to be valid?
options: Normally 2 years, ceasing early on death, dissolution, or winding up
Normally 1 year, renewable monthly, and unaffected by the licensee's death, dissolution or winding up
Normally 5 years, with the licence renewing automatically and no early-cessation events at all
Valid indefinitely once granted, and surrender is the only way it can ever cease to be valid
en.explain: §2.10: a licence is normally valid for 2 years and must be renewed before expiry to continue operating; it otherwise ceases to be valid on the death of an individual licensee, the dissolution of a partnership, or the commencement of winding up of a corporate licensee. It is not a 1-year, monthly-renewable licence, not a 5-year automatically-renewing licence, and not indefinite - the distractors invent cessation rules the Guide does not contain.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者牌照一般的有效期是多久？牌照在其他哪些情況下失效？
options: 一般為2年；如身故、解散或開始清盤，牌照即告失效
一般為1年，按月自動續期，並不受持牌人身故、解散或清盤影響
一般為5年，牌照自動續期，並無任何提早失效的情況
一經批出即無限期有效，只有交回牌照方可令其失效
tc.explain: 第2.10段訂明，牌照一般有效期為2年，如欲繼續經營須在期滿前申請續期；另外，個人持牌人身故、合夥解散或法團持牌人開始清盤時，牌照即告失效。牌照並非1年期並按月續期，亦非5年期並自動續期，更非無限期有效——這些均屬《牌照指引》未有訂明的失效規則。

en.q: If the CCE refuses an application for the grant of an MSO licence, what happens to the application fee and fit-and-proper test fee already paid?
options: No refund is made, whether application is approved or refused
Both fees are refunded to the applicant in full
Half of each fee paid is refunded to the applicant
The fees are carried forward to the next application
en.explain: §2.8: no refund of the application fee is made irrespective of whether the application is approved or refused. §4.14: the fit-and-proper person test fee is likewise non-refundable — a full refund, a half refund, and carrying the fee forward to a future application are all contrary to this rule.

tc.q: 如關長拒絕批出金錢服務經營者牌照，已繳付的申請費及適當人選審查費會如何處理？
options: 不論批准或拒絕，概不退還
兩項費用會全數退還申請人
已繳的每項費用各退還一半
費用會撥入下一次的申請
tc.explain: 第2.8段：不論申請其後獲批准或被拒絕，已收取的申請費概不退還。第4.14段：適當人選審查費同樣不獲退還——全額退還、退還一半及撥入下次申請均與此規定相違。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.3段

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, which of the following does NOT count as a licensable money changing service?
options: A retail shop accepting foreign currency incidental to its business
A dedicated street-level shop set up specifically to exchange currency
An office that exchanges currency for walk-in customers as its business
A company whose business is buying and selling foreign banknotes to the public
en.explain: §2.3: a money changing service is currency exchange operated in Hong Kong as a business, but excludes a service incidental to the main business (e.g. a retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions) and a qualifying hotel service. A dedicated exchange shop, a walk-in exchange office, and a banknote-trading company all run currency exchange AS the business itself, so each is a licensable money changing service.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪項不屬須領牌的貨幣兌換服務？
options: 零售商店在交易中附帶接受外幣
專門經營貨幣找換的臨街店舖
以兌換貨幣為業務、接待街客的辦事處
以向公眾買賣外幣鈔票為業務的公司
tc.explain: 第2.3段：貨幣兌換服務指在香港作為業務經營的兌換貨幣服務，但不包括附帶於主要業務的服務（例如零售商在交易中接受外幣），亦不包括合資格的酒店服務。臨街找換店、接待街客的兌換辦事處，以及買賣外幣鈔票的公司，均以兌換貨幣本身作為業務，因此均屬須領牌的貨幣兌換服務。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) §4.3; Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety (Apr 2018)
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.3段；《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）

en.q: In determining whether a person is fit and proper, the CCE must have regard to all of the following EXCEPT:
options: The person's academic qualifications in finance
Convictions for ML/TF-related offences (in Hong Kong or elsewhere)
Whether the person is an undischarged bankrupt or subject to bankruptcy proceedings
Whether a corporate applicant is in liquidation or subject to a winding-up order
en.explain: §4.3 (and the F&P Guideline): the CCE must consider convictions for specified AMLO/UNATMO/DTROP/OSCO offences and overseas equivalents (including ML/TF and fraud/dishonesty offences), persistent non-compliance with the AMLO, bankruptcy (individuals), liquidation/receivership (corporations), and any other relevant matter. Academic qualifications are not a listed criterion.

tc.q: 關長在決定某人是否屬適當人選時，必須考慮下列各項，但不包括：
options: 該人的金融學歷
（在香港或其他地方）因洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集相關罪行被定罪
該人是否未獲解除破產的破產人或破產程序的對象
法團申請人是否正在清盤或屬清盤令的對象
tc.explain: 第4.3段（及《適當人選準則指引》）：關長須考慮：因《打擊洗錢條例》／《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》／《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》指明罪行（及海外同類罪行，包括洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及涉欺詐、貪污、不誠實的罪行）被定罪；持續不遵守條例；個人破產情況；法團清盤／接管情況；以及其他有關事宜。學歷並非所列準則。

en.q: An applicant intends to operate a money service with no particular premises (e.g. purely via mobile devices). What must it provide?
options: An LMO, a correspondence address, and a local place to store records
The residential address of its sole proprietor, partner or director
The address of a service provider, such as its company secretary
Only a correspondence address, without maintaining any local office
en.explain: §4.5/§4.7: an applicant with no particular premises must provide a local management office (LMO) — a physical office reachable in person and by phone by C&ED, staffed by the sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or CO — plus a correspondence address and an LPS. Residential addresses and service providers' premises (company secretarial, accounting, solicitor firms) are expressly NOT accepted as the LMO, and a correspondence address alone does not satisfy the requirement for a physical office.

tc.q: 申請人擬在沒有特定處所的情況下經營金錢服務（例如純以流動裝置進行交易）。它必須提供甚麼？
options: 本地管理辦事處、通訊地址及儲存紀錄
東主、合夥人或董事本人的住宅地址
服務供應商（例如公司秘書）的地址
只提供通訊地址，不設本地實體辦事處
tc.explain: 第4.5及4.7段：無特定處所經營者必須提供本地管理辦事處（海關人員可親身及以電話聯絡的實體辦公室，人員須為獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人及／或合規主任）、通訊地址及本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點。住宅地址及服務供應商（如公司秘書行）的處所明文不獲接納作為本地管理辦事處，單憑通訊地址亦不能滿足須設實體辦事處的規定。

en.q: Which statement about the local place for storage of books and records (LPS) is CORRECT?
options: Every applicant must maintain an LPS in Hong Kong for its full records
Only applicants operating more than one business premises need an LPS
Records may be kept at the licensee's accounting or solicitor firm
Overseas cloud storage of records satisfies the LPS requirement
en.explain: §4.10–4.11: ALL applicants — not only multi-premises ones — must have an LPS in Hong Kong: a physical place under the licensee's control keeping the full set of money service records, accessible to C&ED officers. Service providers' premises (accounting or solicitor firms) and overseas/cloud storage are not accepted; failing to maintain the LPS can lead to suspension/revocation.

tc.q: 關於本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，下列哪項正確？
options: 所有申請人均須在香港設有儲存紀錄的地點
只有經營多於一間營業處所的申請人才需要
紀錄可存放於持牌人的會計師行或律師行
只以海外雲端方式儲存紀錄即符合要求
tc.explain: 第4.10至4.11段：所有申請人（不論處所數目）均須提供位於香港的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點——存放整套金錢服務交易簿冊及紀錄的實體地點，且須由持牌人控制，方便海關人員查閱。服務供應商（會計師行、律師行）的處所及海外／雲端儲存均不獲接納。未能維持該地點可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷。

en.q: Which of the following premises would be considered SUITABLE for registration as MSO business premises?
options: Mixed-use premises with every occupant's written consent to inspection
Premises located in a wholly residential building, with no commercial element
Premises already used by another MSO to operate its money service
Premises whose signboard name differs from the Business Registration Certificate
en.explain: §4.6: premises must be accessible to C&ED officers; in a mixed commercial/residential building the written consent of every occupant is needed for entry to inspect. NOT suitable: premises in a wholly residential building, premises already used or declared by another MSO, premises accessible only through another party's area, and premises whose signboard name differs from the registered Business Registration Certificate name.

tc.q: 下列哪類處所會被視為適合登記為金錢服務經營者的營業處所？
options: 商住混合大廈處所，經每名佔用人書面同意查察
位於純住宅、沒有任何商業用途成分的大廈的處所
已被另一金錢服務經營者用作經營金錢服務的處所
招牌商號名稱與商業登記證上名稱不符的處所
tc.explain: 第4.6段：處所須讓海關人員可進入執行職務；位於商住混合大廈的處所，須取得每名佔用人的書面同意。不適合的處所包括：位於純住宅大廈、已被其他經營者使用或申報作經營金錢服務、須經他人範圍才能進入，以及招牌名稱與商業登記證登記名稱不符的處所。

en.q: Which statement about the appointment of the CO and MLRO as a licensing requirement is CORRECT?
options: Unless an owner, partner or director, CO/MLRO must be an employee
The CO and MLRO may be freelance consultants paid per assignment
The CO and MLRO roles may be left vacant for up to twelve months
The CO must hold a law degree and the MLRO an accounting one
en.explain: §4.15(a): an applicant must appoint a competent CO and MLRO; except where the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also the CO/MLRO, they must be the applicant's employee under the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57) — not a freelance consultant. Failing to appoint or maintain a competent CO/MLRO (there is no year-long grace period) is a ground for refusing, suspending or revoking a licence (§5.10(g), §7.1(i)); the Guideline sets no professional-qualification rule such as CO-as-lawyer or MLRO-as-accountant.

tc.q: 關於委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任作為發牌規定，下列哪項正確？
options: 除東主、合夥人或董事兼任外，須為僱員
可委任按項目收費的自由顧問擔任
有關職位可懸空長達十二個月
二者須分別為律師及會計師
tc.explain: 第4.15(a)段：申請人須委任稱職的合規主任及洗錢報告主任；除由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人兼任外，兩者必須是申請人按《僱傭條例》（第57章）定義的僱員，而非自由顧問。未能委任或維持稱職的合規主任／洗錢報告主任（並無長達一年的寬限期）是拒絕批出、暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的理由（第5.10(g)及7.1(i)段）；指引並無規定合規主任須為律師、洗錢報告主任須為會計師等專業資格。

en.q: Which statement about the Competence Assessment as a licensing requirement is CORRECT?
options: The proprietor, partner or director must pass; one fitness factor
Every employee of the applicant, not just senior management, must pass
Passing the Assessment automatically guarantees the grant of a licence
The Assessment is voluntary and carries no bearing on licensing at all
en.explain: §4.15(b): the sole proprietor, any one of the partners and directors must pass the Competence Assessment, which ensures senior management understands ML/TF risks and can implement effective AML/CFT systems — ordinary employees need not sit it. §5.4: the result is one factor relevant to the fit-and-proper determination, so passing does not by itself guarantee a licence, and the Assessment is mandatory, not voluntary.

tc.q: 關於能力評核作為發牌規定，下列哪項正確？
options: 東主、任一合夥人或董事須通過評核；結果只是其中一項因素
僱員均須通過評核，不限於高級管理層
通過評核即自動保證必然獲批牌照
評核純屬自願性質，與牌照審批完全無關，亦不影響適當人選的評估
tc.explain: 第4.15(b)段：獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人及董事必須在海關舉行的能力評核取得合格成績，以確保高級管理層了解洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險並有能力推行有效制度——一般僱員毋須應考。第5.4段：評核結果只是關長釐定申請人是否適當人選的考慮因素之一，故通過本身不保證獲批牌照，而評核屬強制性質，並非自願。

en.q: Under the Licensing Guide, which of the following is an express example of a situation where the CCE may REFUSE to grant a licence?
options: None of senior management attends or passes the Assessment
The applicant's projected profits are considered too low by C&ED
The applicant has fewer than three full-time staff members
The applicant's office measures less than 200 square feet
en.explain: §5.10 lists refusal examples: failing the fit-and-proper test, unsuitable premises, missing occupant consents, no LPS/LMO information, no compliant Business Plan/AML Policy, no competent CO/MLRO, incomplete applications, none of the senior management attending (i) or passing (j) the Assessment, and exempted persons. Profitability, headcount and office size are not listed grounds.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪項是關長可拒絕批出牌照的明文例子？
options: 高級管理層無人出席或通過指定評核
海關認為申請人的預計利潤太低
申請人的全職僱員少於三人
申請人的辦公室小於200平方呎
tc.explain: 第5.10段列出可拒絕批出牌照的例子：未能通過適當人選審查、處所不適合、未取得佔用人同意書、未提供儲存紀錄地點／本地管理辦事處資料、未按指引提交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策、未委任稱職的合規主任或洗錢報告主任、申請不完整、高級管理層無人出席（第(i)項）或無人通過（第(j)項）評核，以及屬獲豁免人士。利潤、人手及辦公室面積並非所列理由。

en.q: Which statement about the licence renewal process is CORRECT?
options: The 45-day renewal deadline stays the licensee's duty despite the 90-day reminder
The licensee must nominate a person within 30 days, attending within 7 days
Renewal happens automatically unless the CCE objects in writing
The Competence Assessment is waived for licensees who are renewing
en.explain: §6.2: a reminder with the Assessment invitation is sent 90 days before expiry, but it remains the licensee's own legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before expiry regardless. The correct sequence is nomination within 7 days of receiving the invitation and attendance within 30 days — option 2 reverses these two figures. §6.4: renewal is not automatic, and the Assessment remains a renewal requirement, not waived.

tc.q: 關於牌照續期程序，下列哪項正確？
options: 90日提示信不免除45日續期責任
須於30日內提名，7日內應考
除非關長書面反對，牌照會自動續期
持牌人續期時可獲豁免能力評核
tc.explain: 第6.2段：海關會在期滿前90日發出提示信連同評核邀請信，但在期滿前45日申請續期仍是持牌人本身的法律責任，不因提示信而免除。正確次序為接獲邀請信後7日內提名、30日內應考——選項二調轉了這兩個期限。第6.4段：續期並非自動進行，能力評核仍是續期規定之一，不獲豁免。

en.q: Which of the following is an express example in the Licensing Guide of a ground on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence?
options: Holding the licence without ever providing a money service
The licensee changed its business opening hours without notice
The licensee declined to sponsor a local community event
The licensee relocated to a cheaper office within the same building
en.explain: §7.1 examples include: loss of fit-and-proper status; occupants revoking consent; failure to maintain the LPS or LMO; failure to submit periodic returns on time; holding the licence without providing a money service; non-compliance with AMLO requirements; and failure to appoint or maintain a competent CO or MLRO. Changing hours, declining to sponsor an event, or moving to cheaper premises are not listed grounds. The licensee gets an opportunity to be heard (§7.2) and may appeal to the Review Tribunal within 21 days (§7.3).

tc.q: 下列哪項是《牌照指引》明文所載、關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由例子？
options: 持牌人持有牌照，從未提供金錢服務
持牌人未經通知更改營業時間
持牌人拒絕贊助本區社區活動
持牌人遷往同一大廈較便宜辦公室
tc.explain: 第7.1段的例子包括：不再屬適當人選；佔用人撤回同意書；未能維持儲存紀錄地點或本地管理辦事處；未能按時遞交定期申報表；持有牌照而未能符合發牌目的（例如從未提供金錢服務）；不遵守條例規定；及未能委任或維持稱職的合規主任或洗錢報告主任。更改營業時間、拒絕贊助活動或遷往較便宜的辦公室均非所列理由。持牌人有陳詞機會（第7.2段），並可在21日內向覆核審裁處上訴（第7.3段）。

en.q: Which of the following correctly matches the C&ED forms with their purposes?
options: Form 4: director/owner/partner approval; Form 5: premises; Form 6: change; Form 7: cessation
Form 4 — cessation; Form 5 — change of particulars; Form 6 — new premises; Form 7 — new directors
Form 4 — licence application; Form 5 — renewal; Form 6 — periodic return; Form 7 — appeal
Form 4 — periodic return; Form 5 — STR; Form 6 — appeal; Form 7 — renewal
en.explain: Per the Licensing Guide: Form 1 is the licence application, Form 2 renewal, Forms 3A/3B fit-and-proper declarations, Form 4 the application for prior approval of a proposed director/ultimate owner/partner (§8.1–8.3), Form 5 adding premises (§8.4), Form 6 notification of changes in particulars (§9.1), and Form 7 notification of cessation of business (§10.2). Each distractor shuffles these purposes onto the wrong form numbers.

tc.q: 下列哪項正確配對海關表格及其用途？
options: 表4——董事／擁有人／合夥人；表5——處所；表6——變更；表7——停業
表格4——停業；表格5——資料變更；表格6——新處所；表格7——新董事
表格4——牌照申請；表格5——續期；表格6——定期申報表；表格7——上訴
表格4——定期申報表；表格5——可疑交易報告；表格6——上訴；表格7——續期
tc.explain: 根據《牌照指引》：表格1為牌照申請；表格2為續期；表格3A／3B為適當人選聲明；表格4為擬任董事／最終擁有人／合夥人的事先批准申請（第8.1至8.3段）；表格5為增加營業處所（第8.4段）；表格6為資料變更通知（第9.1段）；表格7為停業通知（第10.2段）。各錯誤選項均將這些用途配對到錯誤的表格編號。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.5段；《打擊洗錢條例》第35(7)條

en.q: A person becomes a director of a licensed MSO corporation without the CCE's prior written approval. What is the criminal penalty on conviction?
options: A fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of HK$1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment
A fine of HK$10,000,000
Community service only
en.explain: §8.5: contravening s.35(1) without reasonable excuse is an offence with a fine of HK$50,000 and 6 months' imprisonment on conviction; the same penalty applies for contraventions of ss.36(1), 37(1), 38(1) and 39(1). The CCE may additionally take disciplinary action under s.43(1)(c) — and suspend or revoke the licence.

tc.q: 某人未經關長事先書面批准便成為持牌金錢服務經營者（法團）的董事。一經定罪，刑罰為何？
options: 罰款50,000元及監禁6個月
罰款100萬元及監禁2年
罰款1,000萬元
只須社會服務令
tc.explain: 第8.5段：無合理辯解而違反第35(1)條即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處罰款50,000元及監禁6個月；違反第36(1)、37(1)、38(1)及39(1)條的刑罰相同。關長另可根據第43(1)(c)條採取紀律行動，並可暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照。

en.q: How often, and by when, must a licensee lodge periodic returns with the CCE?
options: Within 2 weeks each half year, unless CCE specifies
Once a year, within 3 months of the financial year end
Monthly, within 5 working days of the following month
Only when specifically requested by the CCE in writing
en.explain: §11.2: a licensee must lodge a periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year (unless the CCE specifies otherwise by notice in writing), in the form and manner the CCE specifies — not annually, not monthly, and not only on ad hoc request. Failure to submit on time may result in suspension and/or revocation of the licence — it is also an express revocation example in §7.1(f).

tc.q: 持牌人須多久及在何時前向關長遞交定期申報表？
options: 除關長指明外，每半年2星期內遞交
每年一次，於財政年結後3個月內
每月一次，於翌月首5個工作天內
只在關長以書面明確要求時
tc.explain: 第11.2段：持牌人須在每半年開始起計2星期內（除非關長以書面通知另行指明），按指明格式及方式遞交定期申報表——並非按年、按月，也不是只在關長個別要求時才遞交。未能按時遞交可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷——這亦是第7.1(f)段明文所載的撤銷理由例子。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) §11.1(j); Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (12/2019), item 8
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第11.1(j)段；《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12-2019版）第8項

en.q: Which statement about bank accounts used for operating the money service business is CORRECT?
options: The account must be in the licensee's own name, not a third party's
Any account may be used, including a friend's or associate's
Bank accounts are strictly prohibited for all MSOs to hold
Only an overseas bank account may lawfully be used
en.explain: §11.1(j): where bank accounts are used for the money service business, they must be in the name of the licensee's company, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner — no third-party bank account is allowed. The Business Plan guidelines confirm this and require an explanation of how the business will operate if no bank account is used; MSOs are not barred from holding bank accounts, and there is no rule limiting them to overseas accounts.

tc.q: 關於用於經營金錢服務業務的銀行戶口，下列哪項正確？
options: 戶口須用持牌人本身名義，不得為第三者戶口
任何戶口均可使用，包括朋友或夥伴的戶口
金錢服務經營者一律不得持有銀行戶口
只可合法使用海外銀行戶口
tc.explain: 第11.1(j)段：如以銀行戶口經營金錢服務業務，戶口必須以持牌人公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立——不容許使用第三者銀行戶口。《遞交業務計劃的指引》同樣訂明此點，並要求不使用銀行戶口的申請人詳述業務如何運作；金錢服務經營者並非一律禁止持有銀行戶口，亦無規定只可使用海外戶口。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2026 (13 Mar 2026); Circular MSSB/MIS_03/2026 (15 May 2026)

en.q: According to the 2026 circulars on fee revision, which statement is CORRECT?
options: Twelve licensing fees rose under the user-pays principle
All licensing fees were abolished from 15 May 2026
Licensing fees were halved across the board to support the industry
Only the fit-and-proper test fee changed, falling from $945 to $860
en.explain: The 13 March 2026 circular announced the gazettal of the Amendment of Schedule 3 Notice 2026 revising 12 fees effective 15 May 2026: e.g. grant $3,310→$3,810, renewal $790→$910, F&P test $860→$945 (an increase, not the reverse) — plus additional-premises and director/owner/partner-approval fees. Fees were not abolished or halved, and more than just the F&P test fee changed.

tc.q: 根據2026年有關費用調整的通函，下列哪項正確？
options: 12項牌照費用調升，符合用者自付原則
所有牌照費用自2026年5月15日起取消
牌照費用全面減半以支援業界
只有適當人選審查費有變，由945降至860
tc.explain: 2026年3月13日的通函公布政府刊憲修訂附表3，12項費用於2026年5月15日起生效：例如批給申請3,310→3,810元、續期790→910元、適當人選審查860→945元（是調升，並非下調）；另加額外處所及董事／東主／合夥人批准申請費用。費用並非取消或減半；有變的亦不止適當人選審查費一項。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 — Trade-based Money Laundering (20 Jan 2026)
source.tc: 通函MSSB/MIS_01/2026——打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動指引（2026年1月20日）

en.q: What does the January 2026 C&ED circular on trade-based money laundering (TBML) warn MSOs about?
options: Falsified documents and shell companies disguise funds as trade income
STRs need only be filed once the transaction amount exceeds a set threshold
EDD is required only for politically exposed persons, not other high-risk customers
TM alerts should be closed quickly to avoid a backlog, even without further analysis
en.explain: The circular highlights TBML typologies: falsified trade documents creating bogus transaction records, and shell companies obscuring beneficial owners or the source of illicit funds, with MSOs' cross-boundary remittance services exploitable as a conduit; MSOs are directed to FATF's TBML risk indicators. It also reminds MSOs that STR obligations apply irrespective of the amount involved (not only above a threshold) and cover attempted transactions; that EDD applies to ALL customers assessed as high ML/TF risk, not just PEPs; and that TM alerts must be investigated with sufficient justification and analysis, never closed quickly to avoid a backlog.

tc.q: 海關2026年1月有關以貿易為基礎的洗錢活動的通函提醒金錢服務經營者甚麼？
options: 利用虛假貿易文件及空殼公司，將資金偽裝成貿易收入
只有交易金額超過某一款額，才須提交可疑交易報告
只有政治人物才須進行更嚴格審查，其他高風險客戶毋須
應盡快結束交易監察警示以免積壓，即使未經進一步分析
tc.explain: 通函指出以貿易為基礎的洗錢手法：利用虛假貿易文件製造虛假交易紀錄，並以空殼公司隱藏實益擁有人或非法資金來源；經營者的跨境匯款服務可能被利用作轉移渠道。通函引導經營者參考特別組織的風險指標，並提醒：提交可疑交易報告的責任不論金額多寡（並非只在超過某款額時）均適用，且涵蓋未完成的交易；更嚴格審查適用於所有被評為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集高風險的客戶，不限於政治人物；交易監察警示須經充分理據及分析處理，不應為免積壓而盡快結束。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018); Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）

en.q: According to the C&ED's disciplinary fining guidelines, which principles guide the imposition of pecuniary penalties?
options: Penalties deter, and avoid putting the licensee in financial jeopardy
Fines are always set at the statutory maximum, regardless of the contravention's seriousness
Fines are calculated purely as a fixed percentage of the licensee's annual turnover
Fining decisions are kept strictly confidential and are never publicised by the CCE
en.explain: Both guidelines (published under s.45(1) for s.43(2)(c) penalties and s.23(1) for s.21(2)(c) penalties) state: a penalty acts as a specific and general deterrent; the more serious the contravention the larger the likely penalty (considering intent, duration, damage to Hong Kong's reputation, systemic weaknesses, etc. — not a fixed statutory maximum); a penalty should not put the licensee in financial jeopardy, having regard to its size and resources (not a fixed percentage of turnover); and the CCE will usually publicise fining decisions, not keep them confidential.

tc.q: 根據海關的紀律罰款指引，施加罰款時遵循哪些原則？
options: 罰款須具阻嚇作用，並避免令持牌人陷入財政困境
罰款一律按法定最高款額徵收，不論嚴重程度
罰款按持牌人年度營業額的固定百分比計算
罰款決定嚴格保密，關長從不公開
tc.explain: 兩份指引（分別根據第45(1)條就第43(2)(c)條罰款、及第23(1)條就第21(2)(c)條罰款發出）訂明：罰款須對有關持牌人及其他持牌人起阻嚇作用；違反越嚴重，罰款可能越高（考慮是否蓄意、持續時間、對香港聲譽的損害、制度性缺失等——並非劃一按法定最高款額徵收）；罰款不應令持牌人陷入財政困境，會考慮其規模及財政資源（並非按營業額的固定百分比計算）；關長通常會公開施加罰款的決定，並非嚴格保密。

source.en: Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety (Apr 2018), cover
source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）封面

en.q: According to its cover page, what does the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety set out?
options: The criteria the CCE applies in determining fitness and propriety for an MSO licence
The factors the CCE considers in imposing a pecuniary penalty on a licensee
The principles guiding the amount of a fine imposed under the Disciplinary Fining Guideline
The requirements for applicants operating a money service without particular premises
en.explain: The F&P Guideline's cover states it is issued for the grant of a licence under section 30, in Part 5, of the AMLO — i.e. it sets out the criteria for determining fitness and propriety for licensing purposes. It is not the pecuniary-penalty guideline (issued under s.45(1)), the fining guideline (issued under s.23(1)), or the Licensing Guide's rules on operating without particular premises.

tc.q: 根據封面所載，《有關適當人選準則的指引》訂立的是甚麼？
options: 海關關長就批出牌照而釐定適當人選所依據的準則
海關關長對持牌人施加罰款時考慮的因素
《紀律處分罰款指引》下釐定罰款款額所依據的原則
無特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人須符合的規定
tc.explain: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》封面訂明其為批出牌照而根據《打擊洗錢條例》第5部第30條發出——即訂立就發牌釐定適當人選所依據的準則。它並非《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（根據第45(1)條發出）、《紀律處分罰款指引》（根據第23(1)條發出），也不是《牌照指引》中關於無特定處所經營的規定。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第4段

en.q: To whom does the F&P Guideline apply?
options: Every applicant, and the person who will hold the licence
Only to corporate applicants, never to individual applicants
Only to individuals nominated to sit the Competence Assessment
Only to applicants who have previously been refused a licence
en.explain: Paragraph 4: the Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence under section 30 of the AMLO, and is applicable both to the applicant for a licence and to the person who will hold the licence — individuals and corporations alike, not just corporate applicants, Assessment nominees, or previously-refused applicants.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》適用於何人？
options: 每名牌照申請人及將持有牌照的人
只限公司申請人，個人申請人不適用
只限獲提名參加能力評核的個人
只限此前曾被拒發牌照的申請人
tc.explain: 第4段訂明本指引適用於每名根據《打擊洗錢條例》第30條申請牌照的人，並同時適用於牌照申請人及將持有該牌照的人——個人及公司申請人皆適用，並非只限公司申請人、能力評核獲提名人，或此前被拒的申請人。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第5(a)段

en.q: Which of the following factors does the F&P Guideline list as relevant to assessing fitness and propriety?
options: Failure to comply with any AMLO requirement or CCE regulation
Whether the person holds a professional qualification in finance
Whether the person has operated a money service for at least three years
Whether the person holds a Hong Kong permanent identity card
en.explain: Paragraph 5 lists the factors, beginning with whether the person has failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the AMLO or any regulation made by the CCE, and continuing with bankruptcy, winding up or receivership, failure to comply with licence conditions, and certain criminal convictions. Professional qualifications, years of experience and residency status are not listed factors.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》列出下列哪項為評估適當人選資格的相關因素？
options: 未能遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或規例
該人有否持有金融方面的專業資格
該人有否經營金錢服務至少三年
該人是否已持有香港永久性居民身份證
tc.explain: 第5段列出各項因素，首項為該人有否沒有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或海關關長訂立的任何規例所施加的任何規定；其後包括破產、清盤或接管、沒有遵從牌照條件，以及某些刑事定罪。專業資格、年資及居留身分均非第5段所列因素。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第5(e)段

en.q: How does the F&P Guideline treat criminal convictions that are NOT listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO?
options: Offences seriously harming honesty, integrity or reliability are relevant
They are disregarded entirely, since the statutory list is exhaustive
They are relevant only if the sentence exceeded twelve months
They are relevant only if the conviction occurred in Hong Kong
en.explain: Paragraph 5(e) makes relevant whether the person has been convicted of a criminal offence which is not listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO but which has a significant and negative bearing on his or her honesty, integrity and reliability — the statutory list is not exhaustive, and no twelve-month sentence threshold or Hong-Kong-only limitation applies.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》如何處理並未列於《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)及(b)條的刑事定罪？
options: 嚴重損害誠信及可靠性的罪行仍屬相關
完全不予理會，因法定清單已屬詳盡無遺
只有在刑期超過十二個月監禁時方屬相關
只有在該定罪發生於香港時方屬相關
tc.explain: 第5(e)段訂明，該人有否被裁定犯並非列於《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)及(b)條、但對其誠實、正直及可靠性有重大負面影響的刑事罪行，屬相關因素——法定清單並非詳盡無遺，亦無十二個月刑期門檻或只限香港定罪的規定。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第6及7段

en.q: What status does the F&P Guideline assign to itself?
options: It gives non-exhaustive, advisory guidance
It is exhaustive and binding on the CCE
It has the force of subsidiary legislation
It overrides the criteria in the AMLO
en.explain: Paragraph 6 states that the Guideline provides general guidance and is not intended to be exhaustive or comprehensive, each case being considered on its own merits. Paragraph 7 states, for avoidance of doubt, that the Guideline is advisory, and recommends legal advice where there are concerns — it is not binding on the CCE, has no force of subsidiary legislation, and does not override the AMLO's own criteria.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》為其本身賦予甚麼地位？
options: 提供一般、非詳盡的諮詢性指引
屬詳盡無遺並對海關關長具約束力
具有附屬法例的法律效力
凌駕《打擊洗錢條例》所訂的準則
tc.explain: 第6段訂明本指引提供一般指引，並非旨在詳盡無遺，每宗個案均按其本身情況考慮。第7段為免生疑問訂明本指引屬諮詢性質，並建議如有疑慮應尋求法律意見——本指引對海關關長並無約束力，亦無附屬法例的效力，更不會凌駕《打擊洗錢條例》本身的準則。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第5段

en.q: Beyond applications for the grant of a licence, to what else does the Supplementary F&P Guideline apply?
options: Renewal applications under s.31, and post-grant licensees
Only to applications refused in the past twelve months
Only to corporate licensees, not individuals
Only to licensees under active investigation
en.explain: Paragraph 5 states that the Guideline applies to every applicant for a licence under section 30 and for renewal under section 31, as well as to licensees who must satisfy and continue to satisfy after the grant that they are fit and proper persons. It is not limited to recently-refused applications, corporate licensees only, or licensees currently under investigation.

tc.q: 除批出牌照的申請外，《補充指引》還適用於甚麼？
options: 第31條續期申請，及批牌後的持牌人
只限過去十二個月內被拒絕的申請
只限公司持牌人，不包括個人持牌人
只限正接受調查中的持牌人
tc.explain: 第5段訂明本指引適用於每名根據第30條申請牌照及根據第31條申請續期的人，以及在獲批牌照後須符合並持續符合適當人選資格的持牌人。並非只限過去十二個月內被拒的申請、只限公司持牌人，或只限正受調查的持牌人。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第5段

en.q: What consequence does the Supplementary F&P Guideline identify if a licensee fails to meet the fit and proper criteria after the licence has been granted?
options: Harms fit-and-proper status; grounds s.34 suspension or revocation
It would automatically trigger a pecuniary penalty under section 43
It has no consequence at all until the licence falls due for renewal
It requires the licensee to retake and pass the designated Assessment
en.explain: Paragraph 5 states that failure of any licensee to meet the fit and proper criteria may reflect adversely on the fit and proper person status and would be a ground for suspension or revocation of the licence by virtue of section 34, in Part 5, of the AMLO — not an automatic section 43 pecuniary penalty, not something with no consequence until renewal, and not a re-sit of the Assessment.

tc.q: 《補充指引》指出持牌人在獲批牌照後不符合適當人選準則，會有甚麼後果？
options: 適當人選資格可能受損，屬第34條吊銷理由
將自動觸發《打擊洗錢條例》第43條的罰款程序
在牌照到期辦理續期之前，並不會有任何後果
須重新參加並通過指定的能力評核
tc.explain: 第5段訂明，任何持牌人未能符合適當人選準則，可能對其適當人選資格有負面影響，並憑藉《打擊洗錢條例》第5部第34條構成暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的理由——並非自動觸發第43條罰款、並非在續期前毫無後果，也不是須重新應考評核。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(f)段

en.q: Which example does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of a person lacking genuine intention and readiness to carry on the proposed money service business?
options: The person provided nil money service for a prolonged period after grant
The person operated from premises smaller than those described in the application
The person changed its business name after the licence was granted
The person appointed a compliance officer from outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Paragraph 6(f) makes relevant whether the person has genuine intention and readiness to carry on the money service business proposed in the licence application, giving as an example a person who provided nil money service for a prolonged period after the grant of the licence — not smaller premises, a later name change, or a non-local CO, none of which is the example given.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就某人欠缺經營所建議金錢服務業務的真正意向及準備，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 該人獲批牌照後長期無提供金錢服務
該人在較申請所述為小的處所經營
該人在獲批牌照後更改業務名稱
該人委任來自香港以外的合規主任
tc.explain: 第6(f)段訂明該人有否真正意向及準備經營其在牌照申請中所建議的金錢服務業務屬相關因素，並以該人在獲批牌照後長期並無提供任何金錢服務為例——並非處所較小、其後改名，或合規主任並非本地人士。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(g)段

en.q: What example does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of having established effective AML/CFT systems?
options: A senior compliance officer overseeing AML/CFT systems
Having an external auditor certify the systems annually
Having a written AML/CFT policy of at least twenty pages
Having systems approved in advance by the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 6(g) makes relevant whether the person has established effective AML/CFT systems to ensure compliance with all applicable requirements, giving as an example that the person must have a competent compliance officer of sufficient seniority and authority to oversee the establishment and maintenance of those systems — not an annual external audit, a minimum policy page count, or CCE pre-approval, none of which is the example given.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就已建立有效的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 具足夠資歷的合規主任監督系統
每年由外部核數師核證該等系統
備有至少二十頁的書面打擊洗錢政策
該等系統事先獲海關關長批准
tc.explain: 第6(g)段訂明該人有否建立有效的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統以確保遵從所有適用規定屬相關因素，並以該人必須在其內有一名具備足夠資歷及權限的稱職合規主任，監督該等系統的建立及維持為例——並非每年外聘核數師核證、政策頁數門檻，或事先獲關長批准。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(h)段

en.q: Which example does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of a person not being equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism?
options: A person who skipped or failed C&ED's test during licence processing
A person with under five years' experience in financial services
A person who has not attended an external AML/CFT training course
A person who holds no tertiary qualification
en.explain: Paragraph 6(h) makes relevant whether the person is equipped with the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism necessary to perform the business's functions, and gives as an example a person who did not take or failed to pass the relevant test, if any, conducted by C&ED in the course of processing the licence application — the Competence Assessment — not years of experience, external training attendance, or tertiary qualifications.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就某人並不具備所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業水平，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 該人未參加或未通過牌照測試
該人的金融業經驗少於五年
該人無參加外間打擊洗錢培訓
該人並無專上學歷
tc.explain: 第6(h)段訂明該人是否具備有效履行業務職能所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業水平屬相關因素，並以該人在處理牌照申請過程中並無參加或未能通過香港海關進行的有關測試（即能力評核）為例——並非年資、外間培訓，或專上學歷。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(k)段

en.q: For what three purposes must a person provide the necessary infrastructure and internal control systems, according to the Supplementary F&P Guideline?
options: To manage risk, avoid conflicts of interest, and give an audit trail
To maximise profitability, satisfy shareholders and reduce staffing costs
To satisfy the external auditor, the CCE and the Review Tribunal
To process transactions quickly, retain customers and expand market share
en.explain: Paragraph 6(k) makes relevant whether the person has failed to provide the necessary infrastructure and internal control systems to manage risk effectively, avoid conflict of interest and provide a proper audit trail — not profitability, external validation, or transaction speed/market share.

tc.q: 根據《補充指引》，某人須為哪三個目的提供必需的基礎設施及內部監控系統？
options: 有效管理風險、避免利益衝突及審計線索
盡量提高盈利、滿足股東及減低人手成本
滿足外部核數師、海關關長及審裁處
快速處理交易、留住客戶及擴大市場佔有率
tc.explain: 第6(k)段訂明該人有否未能提供必需的基礎設施及內部監控系統，以有效管理風險、避免利益衝突及提供適當的審計線索，屬相關因素。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(l)段

en.q: Which examples does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of criminal offences with a significant and negative bearing on honesty, integrity and reliability?
options: Fraud, dishonesty or malpractice offences
Offences relating to traffic and public order
Offences under the Employment Ordinance
Offences relating to environmental protection
en.explain: Paragraph 6(l) makes relevant a conviction for a criminal offence not listed in section 30(4)(a) and (b) of the AMLO but with a significant and negative bearing on honesty, integrity and reliability, giving offences relating to fraud, dishonesty and malpractice as examples — not traffic/public-order, employment, or environmental offences.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就對誠實、正直及可靠性有重大負面影響的刑事罪行，舉出哪些例子？
options: 欺詐、不誠實或失當的罪行
與交通及公眾秩序有關的罪行
《僱傭條例》下的罪行
與環境保護有關的罪行
tc.explain: 第6(l)段訂明就並非列於《打擊洗錢條例》第30(4)(a)及(b)條、但對誠實、正直及可靠性有重大負面影響的刑事罪行的定罪屬相關因素，並以與欺詐、不誠實及失當行為有關的罪行為例——並非交通／公眾秩序、僱傭條例，或環保罪行。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(q)段

en.q: What examples does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of a lack of financial integrity?
options: An unpaid judgment debt, or a compromise with creditors
Reporting a loss in any financial year
Holding fewer liquid assets than a similar-sized rival
Failing to distribute a dividend to shareholders
en.explain: Paragraph 6(q) makes relevant whether the person has financial integrity to ensure adequate financial resources for the nature and scale of its operations, and whether its financial position or solvency would undermine customers' or the public's interests, giving as examples failure to satisfy a judgment debt under a court order, or making a compromise or arrangement with creditors — not an ordinary trading loss, holding fewer liquid assets than a peer, or withholding a dividend.

tc.q: 《補充指引》就欠缺財政操守舉出哪些例子？
options: 欠判定債項或重整債務
在任何財政年度錄得虧損
流動資產少於同規模對手
未有向股東派發股息
tc.explain: 第6(q)段訂明該人是否具備財政操守，以確保就其營運的性質及規模有足夠財政資源，以及其財政狀況或償債能力會否損害客戶及公眾的利益，屬相關因素；並以未有清償法庭命令下的判定債項，或與債權人達成債務重整或安排為例——並非普通年度虧損、流動資產較同業少，或不派股息。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(r)段

en.q: Why is the state of affairs of a person's other businesses relevant to fitness and propriety?
options: Because another business may create ML risk or harm financial integrity
Because the CCE licenses all businesses operated by an MSO
Because other businesses must also pass the Competence Assessment
Because profits from other businesses may not fund the money service
en.explain: Paragraph 6(r) makes relevant the state of affairs of any other business which the person carries on, proposes to carry on or has any business relationship with, giving as examples another business that exposes the person to the potential risk of money laundering or affects adversely the person's financial integrity — not CCE licensing of other businesses, a separate Assessment requirement, or a ring-fencing rule on profits.

tc.q: 某人其他業務的狀況為何與適當人選資格有關？
options: 另一業務可致洗錢風險或損害財政操守
因關長為經營者的所有業務發牌
因其他業務亦須通過能力評核
因其他業務的利潤不得用於金錢服務
tc.explain: 第6(r)段訂明該人所經營、擬經營或與之有業務關係的任何其他業務的狀況屬相關因素，並以令該人面對潛在洗錢風險，或對該人的財政操守有不利影響的其他業務為例——並非關長為其他業務發牌、其他業務也須通過評核，或利潤不得用於金錢服務業務。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(i)段

en.q: Which conduct towards the CCE or the C&ED does the Supplementary F&P Guideline treat as relevant to fitness and propriety?
options: Untruthful or giving false information, or uncooperative with C&ED on an AMLO function
Failing to comply with any condition that the CCE has imposed on the applicant's or licensee's licence
Having a record of non-compliance with the AMLO that led to administrative action or prosecution
Being convicted of a fraud or dishonesty offence not listed in section 30(4)(a) or (b)
en.explain: Paragraph 6(i) makes relevant whether the person has been untruthful, provided false or misleading information to the CCE, or been uncooperative with C&ED in performing a function under the AMLO. The distractors are other paragraph 6 matters that are false answers here: 6(a) licence conditions, 6(b) an AMLO non-compliance record, and 6(l) a fraud/dishonesty conviction outside section 30(4)(a)/(b).

tc.q: 《補充指引》將對海關關長或香港海關的哪種行為視為與適當人選資格有關？
options: 曾不誠實或提供虛假資料，或在海關執行職能時不合作
曾不遵從關長就批出或續期牌照時所施加的任何條件或規定
有不遵從《打擊洗錢條例》或相關規例的紀錄，以致遭採取行政制裁行動或檢控
曾被裁定犯了不屬於第30(4)(a)或(b)條所列的詐騙或不誠實罪行
tc.explain: 第6(i)段訂明該人有否對關長不誠實、提供虛假或具誤導性資料，或在海關執行《打擊洗錢條例》職能時不予合作，屬相關因素。三個錯誤答案分別取自第6(a)、6(b)及6(l)段，涉及牌照條件、不遵從紀錄及未列於第30(4)(a)或(b)條的罪行，均非本題所問的行為。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(c)段

en.q: Which guidelines does the Supplementary F&P Guideline name as ones with which compliance is relevant to fitness and propriety?
options: The Licensing Guide and the Guideline on AML/CFT issued for money service operators
The Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment and the Business Plan Guidelines, both issued by the CCE
The Supplementary F&P Guideline and the Disciplinary Action Guideline, both issued by the CCE
The Disciplinary Fining Guideline and the AML/CFT Policy Guidelines, both issued by the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 6(c) makes relevant whether the person is in compliance with guidelines promulgated for MSOs, naming the Licensing Guide and the Guideline on AML/CFT issued for MSOs. The distractors each pair other real MSO-regime documents that paragraph 6(c) does not name.

tc.q: 《補充指引》指名哪些指引的遵從情況與適當人選資格有關？
options: 《牌照指引》及為金錢服務經營者發出的《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》
海關關長發出的《能力評核指引須知》及《遞交業務計劃的指引》
海關關長發出的《補充適當人選資格指引》及《紀律處分行動指引》
海關關長發出的《罰款指引》及《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》
tc.explain: 第6(c)段訂明該人有否遵從為金錢服務經營者頒布的指引屬相關因素，並指名《牌照指引》及《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》。三個錯誤答案均為監管制度下真實存在的其他文件，但並非第6(c)段所指名者。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(d)段

en.q: What examples does the Supplementary F&P Guideline give of an inability to carry on the money service business competently, honestly and fairly?
options: Contravening a consumer-protection law, or a good-faith complaint about its conduct
Providing nil money service for a prolonged period after the licence was granted
Being uncooperative with the C&ED when it performs a function under the AMLO
Failing to satisfy a judgment debt entered against the person under a court order
en.explain: Paragraph 6(d) gives as examples of an inability to carry on business competently, honestly and fairly: contravening a consumer-protection law, or being the subject of a reasonable, good-faith complaint about the licensee's conduct of business. The distractors are genuine examples from other limbs of paragraph 6 — nil service (6(f)), uncooperativeness with the C&ED (6(i)), and an unsatisfied judgment debt (6(q)) — not examples under 6(d).

tc.q: 《補充指引》就無能力稱職、誠實及公平地經營金錢服務業務，舉出哪些例子？
options: 違反消費者保障法律，或成為合理真誠投訴的對象
獲批給牌照後長時間完全未有提供金錢服務
在海關執行《打擊洗錢條例》職能時態度不合作
未能按法庭命令償還判決債項的全部款額
tc.explain: 第6(d)段就無能力稱職、誠實及公平地經營業務所舉的例子，是違反為保障消費者而定的法律，或成為就業務行為合理及真誠地作出的投訴的對象。其餘選項均為第6段其他分項的真實例子——長時間沒有提供服務(6(f))、對海關不合作(6(i))、未能償還判決債項(6(q))——並非6(d)所舉的例子。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(n)及(o)段

en.q: Which regulatory histories outside Hong Kong does the Supplementary F&P Guideline treat as relevant?
options: Being censured or disciplined by a regulator or professional body, and refused a licensed trade or profession
Being disqualified by a court of competent jurisdiction anywhere from acting as a company director
Being the subject of unresolved criminal charges in Hong Kong or in any other jurisdiction
Failing to establish an organizational structure and personnel that comply with regulatory requirements
en.explain: Paragraphs 6(n) and (o) make relevant censure, discipline or public criticism by a regulator or professional body in Hong Kong or elsewhere, and refusal or restriction of the right to carry on a licensed trade, business or profession. The distractors are genuine but different limbs of paragraph 6 — director disqualification (6(p)), unresolved criminal charges (6(m)), and failure to establish organizational structure (6(j)).

tc.q: 《補充指引》將香港以外的哪些監管紀錄視為相關？
options: 曾被監管當局譴責或紀律處分，並被拒經營須領牌行業
曾被具司法管轄權的法院取消擔任董事的資格
在香港或其他地方成為未了結刑事控罪的對象
未能確立符合法例或監管規定的組織架構及人事安排
tc.explain: 第6(n)及(o)段將在香港或其他地方被監管當局或專業團體譴責、紀律處分或公開批評，以及被拒絕或限制經營須領牌的行業、業務或專業，列為相關事宜。其餘選項均屬第6段其他分項的真實例子——取消董事資格(6(p))、未了結刑事控罪(6(m))、未能確立組織架構(6(j))——並非6(n)及(o)所指的事宜。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(m)及(p)段

en.q: Which two further matters does the Supplementary F&P Guideline treat as relevant, even in the absence of a conviction?
options: Unresolved criminal charges anywhere, and disqualified as a director by a competent court
Having been convicted of a criminal offence with a significant, negative bearing on honesty and integrity
Having been censured, disciplined or publicly criticized by a regulatory authority or professional body
Having failed to provide the necessary infrastructure and internal control systems to manage risk
en.explain: Paragraph 6(m) makes relevant unresolved criminal charges, and paragraph 6(p) court disqualification from being a director — neither requires a conviction. By contrast, the closest-looking distractor, a criminal conviction bearing on honesty (6(l)), expressly requires a conviction, which is exactly what this question excludes. The other two options are real but different limbs (6(n) and 6(k)).

tc.q: 即使並無定罪，《補充指引》仍將哪兩項事宜視為相關？
options: 涉及未了結刑事控罪，並被法院取消董事資格
曾被裁定犯有對其誠實及誠信有重大負面影響的刑事罪行
曾被監管當局或專業團體譴責、紀律處分或公開批評
未能備妥所需的基礎設施及內部監控系統以管理風險
tc.explain: 第6(m)段將在香港或其他地方未了結的刑事控罪列為相關事宜，第6(p)段將被法院取消董事資格列為相關事宜；兩者均不要求有定罪。最相似的選項——對誠實有負面影響的刑事定罪(6(l))——恰恰要求有定罪，正是本題所排除的情況。其餘選項為第6段其他分項的真實例子(6(n)及6(k))，並非本題所指的兩項事宜。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第7段

en.q: Does failure to comply with an individual element of paragraph 6 of the Supplementary F&P Guideline necessarily mean the CCE will not be satisfied that a person is fit and proper?
options: No — failing an element may not mean the CCE is not satisfied; each case turns on its merits
Yes — under paragraph 7 each element listed in paragraph 6 is a mandatory pass/fail requirement
Yes, unless the person first obtains the CCE's prior written waiver of the paragraph 6 criteria
No — paragraph 6 is purely illustrative and paragraph 7 gives it no weight in the CCE's assessment
en.explain: Paragraph 7 states that the criteria in paragraph 6 are likely to give rise to concerns about fitness and propriety, but failure to comply with individual elements may not result in the CCE not being satisfied — each case is considered on its own merits taking into account all relevant factors, including but not limited to paragraph 6. There is no written-waiver mechanism, and paragraph 6 is not weightless — it is 'likely to give rise to concerns'.

tc.q: 不符合《補充指引》第6段的個別項目，是否必然導致海關關長不信納某人是適當人選？
options: 否——不符合個別項目未必令關長不信納；個案按情況考慮
是——根據第7段，第6段所列每一項目均屬強制的及格規定
是，除非該人事先取得關長就第6段準則作出的書面豁免
否——第6段純屬舉例，第7段賦予其在關長評估中毫無分量
tc.explain: 第7段訂明第6段所列準則相當可能引起對適當人選資格的疑慮，但不符合個別項目未必導致關長不予信納；每宗個案均按其本身情況並顧及所有相關因素（包括但不限於第6段）考慮。並無書面豁免機制，第6段亦非全無分量——它「相當可能引起疑慮」。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Imposition of Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶1
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第1段

en.q: Under which section of the AMLO does the Disciplinary Action Guideline on Imposition of Pecuniary Penalty address the CCE's power?
options: Section 43 — licensees contravening s.51 regulations, a licence condition, or ss.35(1)-41(1)
Section 21, applying to MSOs contravening a specified provision as defined by section 5(11)
Section 34, applying where the CCE opines a director or owner is no longer fit and proper
Section 30, applying to the CCE's power to grant a licence to an applicant
en.explain: Paragraph 1 explains that under section 43 of the AMLO the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty on a licensee that contravenes any section 51 regulation, any licence condition, or sections 35(1) to 41(1). Section 21 is the separate MSO fining power addressed by the Disciplinary Fining Guideline; section 34 is the suspension/revocation power; section 30 is the grant-of-licence power.

tc.q: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》處理海關關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪一條的權力？
options: 第43條——適用於違反第51條規例、牌照條件，或第35至41條
第21條——適用於違反第5(11)條指明的條文的金錢服務經營者
第34條——適用於關長認為董事或擁有人不再屬適當人選的情況
第30條——適用於關長批出牌照予申請人的權力
tc.explain: 第1段解釋，根據《打擊洗錢條例》第43條，海關關長可對違反第51條規例、牌照任何條件，或第35(1)至41(1)條的持牌人施加罰款。第21條是《紀律處分罰款指引》所處理的另一項針對金錢服務經營者的罰款權力；第34條是暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的權力；第30條是批出牌照的權力。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶4; Disciplinary Fining Guideline (May 2018) ¶3; AMLO s.43(7)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第4段；《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第3段；《打擊洗錢條例》第43(7)條

en.q: What is the CCE's stated policy on publicising decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty?
options: The CCE will usually publicise all such decisions
The CCE will publicise a decision only if the licensee consents
The CCE will never publicise such decisions
The CCE will publicise only decisions exceeding $1 million
en.explain: Both guidelines state, as a matter of policy, that the CCE will usually publicise all his decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty. Section 43(7) of the AMLO separately permits disclosure of the decision, the reasons and any material facts.

tc.q: 海關關長就公開施加罰款的決定，訂明的政策為何？
options: 關長通常會公開其所有該等決定
只有在持牌人同意下方會公開
永不會公開該等決定
只會公開超過100萬元的決定
tc.explain: 兩份指引均訂明，作為政策，海關關長通常會公開其所有施加罰款的決定。《打擊洗錢條例》第43(7)條另行准許披露該決定、其理由及任何要項事實。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶6
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第6段

en.q: What twofold purpose is a pecuniary penalty imposed by the CCE intended to serve?
options: To deter the licensee concerned, and as a general deterrent to other licensees
To compensate affected customers, and to help fund the CCE's supervisory work
To recover the costs of investigation, and to reflect public opinion on the case
To punish the individual directors, and to signal a warning to overseas regulators
en.explain: Paragraph 6 states that any pecuniary penalty imposed by the CCE is intended to act as a deterrent to the licensee concerned and as a general deterrent to other licensees — not compensation, cost recovery, reflecting public opinion, punishing individuals, or signalling overseas.

tc.q: 海關關長施加的罰款旨在達致哪兩重目的？
options: 對該持牌人及對其他持牌人起阻嚇作用
賠償受影響的客戶，並協助資助關長的監管工作
收回調查費用，並反映公眾對個案的意見
懲罰個別董事，並向海外監管機構發出警告訊息
tc.explain: 第6段訂明海關關長施加的任何罰款，旨在對有關持牌人起阻嚇作用，並對其他持牌人起一般阻嚇作用——並非為賠償、收回費用、反映公眾意見、懲罰個人或向海外發出訊息。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶7
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第7段

en.q: What limit does the guideline place on the size of a pecuniary penalty, and what does the CCE take into account?
options: Must not risk financial jeopardy for licensee; CCE weighs size and resources
A penalty must never exceed 10 per cent of the licensee's annual turnover
The penalty must not exceed three times the profit gained from the contravention
The penalty must be fixed at the statutory maximum unless the licensee cooperates
en.explain: Paragraph 7 states that a pecuniary penalty should not have the likely effect of putting the licensee in financial jeopardy, and that the CCE will take into account the licensee's size and financial resources. There is no 10% turnover cap; the three-times-profit figure is instead the alternative maximum used under the separate Disciplinary Fining Guideline's section 21(2)(c)(ii) power, not this guideline; there is no cooperation-linked statutory maximum.

tc.q: 指引就罰款金額設下甚麼限制？海關關長會顧及甚麼？
options: 罰款不應令持牌人陷財政危機，須顧規模資源
罰款一律不得超過該持牌人年度營業額的10%
罰款不得超過因該項違反所獲利潤的三倍
除非該持牌人合作，否則罰款須訂於法定上限
tc.explain: 第7段訂明罰款不應相當可能令持牌人陷入財政危機，關長在考慮此因素時會顧及該持牌人的規模及財政資源。並無10%營業額上限；三倍利潤的數字是另一份《紀律處分罰款指引》第21(2)(c)(ii)條權力下的替代上限，並非本指引所訂；亦無與合作與否掛鈎的法定上限。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第6段

en.q: Although section 21(2)(c)(ii) allows a fine of up to three times the profit gained or costs avoided, what does the Disciplinary Fining Guideline say about that measure?
options: The CCE will not automatically link the fine to profit gained or costs avoided
The CCE will always fix the fine at exactly three times the profit gained
The CCE will apply the three-times multiple only where profit exceeds $10 million
The CCE will treat the three-times figure as a minimum rather than a maximum fine
en.explain: Paragraph 6 states that although section 21(2)(c)(ii) provides one alternative maximum level of fine as three times the profit gained or costs avoided, the CCE will not automatically link the fine imposed in a particular case with that profit or those costs avoided. There is no $10 million threshold, and the three-times figure is a maximum, not a minimum.

tc.q: 雖然第21(2)(c)(ii)條容許罰款高達所獲利潤或所避免成本的三倍，《紀律處分罰款指引》就該計算基準有何說明？
options: 關長不會自動把罰款與所獲利潤或所避免成本掛鈎
關長無論如何都會按所獲利潤的三倍訂定罰款
只有利潤超過1,000萬元，關長才會用三倍計算
關長會將該三倍數額視為罰款的下限而非上限
tc.explain: 第6段訂明，雖然第21(2)(c)(ii)條訂明罰款的其中一個替代上限為所獲利潤或所避免成本的三倍，但海關關長不會自動將個別個案的罰款與該利潤或成本掛鈎。並無1,000萬元的門檻，而三倍的數字是上限，並非下限。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(i)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(i)段

en.q: How does the guideline treat a contravention resulting from negligence, or conduct amounting only to a technical breach?
options: It is generally treated as less serious than an intentional contravention
It is treated the same as an intentional or reckless contravention
It is not regarded as a contravention at all, so no penalty applies
It automatically triggers a fixed 50 per cent reduction in the penalty
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(i) lists whether the contravention is intentional or results from recklessness or negligence, and states that a contravention resulting from negligence or conduct which only results in a technical breach is generally regarded as less serious — it is not equated with intentional conduct, is still a contravention, and there is no fixed 50% discount anywhere in the guideline.

tc.q: 指引如何看待因疏忽而引致的違反，或僅構成技術性違規的行為？
options: 一般被視為較故意或罔顧後果引致的違反為輕
與故意或罔顧後果的違反被同等看待處理
根本不構成違反，因此不會被施加任何罰款
會自動觸發罰款減半的固定50%扣減
tc.explain: 第9(a)(i)段列出該項違反是故意作出，抑或因罔顧後果或疏忽而引致，並訂明因疏忽而引致的違反或僅構成技術性違規的行為，一般視為較輕——並非與故意行為同等看待，仍然構成違反，指引中亦無任何固定的50%扣減。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(iii)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(iii)段

en.q: Which reputational consideration does the pecuniary penalty guideline list among the seriousness factors?
options: Damage to HK's money-services integrity, or its reputation as a financial centre
Whether the contravention has already been reported in Hong Kong's local or overseas press
Whether the licensee's own commercial reputation has already been damaged by the conduct
Whether overseas customers have already been deterred from using any Hong Kong MSO at all
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(iii) of the pecuniary penalty guideline asks whether the contravention is potentially damaging or detrimental to the integrity of the operation of money services in Hong Kong or the reputation of Hong Kong as an international financial centre — a forward-looking, systemic test, not whether it was reported in the press, damaged the licensee's own reputation, or actually deterred customers.

tc.q: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》在嚴重程度因素中列出哪一項聲譽考慮？
options: 是否可能損害香港金錢服務健全性，或作為國際金融中心的聲譽
該項違反是否已被香港本地傳媒或海外傳媒廣泛報道並引起公眾關注
該持牌人本身的商業聲譽是否已因該項違反行為而在業界受損
海外客戶是否已因該項違反而完全卻步不再使用任何香港的金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》第9(a)(iii)段詢問該項違反是否可能損害香港金錢服務營運的健全性，或香港作為國際金融中心的聲譽——這是着眼於潛在及整體影響的測試，並非該行為有否見報、有否損害持牌人本身的聲譽，或有否實際令客戶卻步。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(vi)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(vi)段

en.q: Which systemic consideration does the guideline list among the factors bearing on the seriousness of a contravention?
options: Whether it shows serious or systemic weaknesses in customer due diligence or record-keeping
Whether the licensee's senior management team has changed since the contravention took place
Whether the licensee relies on an off-the-shelf software package for its compliance function
Whether the licensee operates its money service from more than one business premises
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(vi) asks whether the contravention reveals serious or systemic weaknesses in the management system or internal controls in respect of customer due diligence and record-keeping procedures relating to all or part of a licensee's business — a systemic-weakness test, not a question about management changes, software choice, or number of premises.

tc.q: 指引在影響違反嚴重程度的因素中，列出哪一項系統性考慮？
options: 是否顯示客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存存在嚴重或系統性弱點
該持牌人的高級管理團隊是否已在該項違反發生後更換
該持牌人的合規職能是否純粹依賴一套現成的合規軟件套裝
該持牌人是否在多於一個業務處所經營其金錢服務業務
tc.explain: 第9(a)(vi)段詢問該項違反是否顯示該持牌人全部或部分業務的管理系統或內部監控，在客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存程序方面存在嚴重或系統性弱點——這是系統性弱點的測試，並非關於管理層變動、軟件選擇或處所數目的問題。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(a)(viii)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(a)(viii)段

en.q: How does the guideline treat a series of smaller issues that individually would not justify a pecuniary penalty?
options: They may justify a penalty when taken collectively
They are disregarded unless each independently justifies a penalty
They are dealt with by written warning only
They are aggregated only if they occurred within the same calendar year
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(viii) asks whether there are a number of smaller issues which individually may not justify a pecuniary penalty, but which do so when taken collectively.

tc.q: 指引如何看待一連串個別而言不足以構成施加罰款理由的較小事項？
options: 合起來考慮時可能構成施加罰款的理由
除非每項本身足以構成理由，否則不予理會
只以書面警告處理
只有在同一曆年內發生方會合併計算
tc.explain: 第9(a)(viii)段詢問是否有若干較小事項，個別而言未必足以構成施加罰款的理由，但合起來考慮時則足以構成該理由。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(b)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(b)段

en.q: Which aspects of a licensee's conduct AFTER a contravention does the guideline take into account?
options: Whether it concealed the contravention, took remedial steps, cooperated, and may reoffend
Only whether the licensee has a relevant previous disciplinary record, including past similar contraventions
Only whether the CCE has issued guidelines in line with the conduct at the time in question
Only whether the contravention was committed by the licensee alone or as part of a group
en.explain: Paragraph 9(b) lists conduct after the contravention: attempted concealment; remedial steps and action against those involved; the degree of cooperation with the CCE and other authorities; and the likelihood of recurrence. The distractors describe real factors from paragraph 9(c) (previous record), 9(d)(i) (guidance in force at the time), and 9(a)(v) (acting alone or in a group) — none of which is a post-contravention conduct factor.

tc.q: 指引會顧及持牌人在違反「之後」行為的哪些方面？
options: 有否試圖隱瞞、糾正步驟、與關長的合作程度，以及再犯可能
只顧及該持牌人有否相關過往紀律紀錄，包括過往同類違反
只顧及關長有否就有關行為發出當時適用的指引
只顧及該項違反是由該持牌人單獨作出，抑或屬集團行為的一部分
tc.explain: 第9(b)段列出違反後的行為：有否試圖隱瞞、已採取的糾正步驟及對涉事者的行動、與關長及其他當局的合作程度，以及再犯的可能性。其餘選項均為第9(c)段（過往紀錄）、第9(d)(i)段（當時適用的指引）及第9(a)(v)段（單獨或集團行事）的真實因素，並非違反後行為的因素。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(c)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(c)段

en.q: Which elements of a licensee's history does the guideline take into account?
options: Its relevant previous disciplinary record, and other authorities' action on the incident
Only whether the contravention was committed intentionally, recklessly, or merely negligently
Only whether the licensee attempted to conceal the contravention once it had occurred
Only the amount of benefit gained or costs avoided by the licensee from the contravention
en.explain: Paragraph 9(c) lists the licensee's relevant previous disciplinary record including similar contraventions, any previous undertaking not to engage in the conduct, and punishment or regulatory action taken by other authorities on the same incident. The distractors are real factors from 9(a)(i) (intent/negligence), 9(b)(i) (concealment), and 9(d)(iii) (benefit gained) — different limbs of paragraph 9.

tc.q: 指引會顧及持牌人過往紀錄的哪些方面？
options: 其相關的過往紀律紀錄，以及其他當局就同一事件的行動
只顧及該項違反是故意作出，抑或因罔顧後果或純粹疏忽而引致
只顧及該持牌人在該項違反發生後有否試圖將其隱瞞
只顧及該持牌人因該項違反所獲得的利益或所避免的開支數額
tc.explain: 第9(c)段列出持牌人相關的過往紀律紀錄（包括同類違反）、此前有否承諾不作出該行為，以及其他有關當局就同一事件所施加的懲罰或監管行動。其餘選項為第9(a)(i)段（故意／疏忽）、第9(b)(i)段（隱瞞）及第9(d)(iii)段（所獲利益）的真實因素，屬第9段其他分項。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(d)(i)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(d)(i)段

en.q: What does the guideline say about conduct that was in line with guidance current at the time?
options: Generally the CCE won't discipline for conduct that matched current guidance
Such conduct provides the licensee with a complete statutory defence to liability
Such conduct is treated as a mitigating factor that automatically halves the penalty
Guidance current at the time of the conduct is irrelevant to the CCE's decision
en.explain: Paragraph 9(d)(i) asks whether the CCE has issued any guidelines in relation to the conduct in question, and states that generally the CCE will not take disciplinary action against a licensee for conduct that is in line with guidance which was current at the time of the conduct — that is a policy of restraint, not a statutory defence, not an automatic 50% reduction, and current guidance plainly is relevant.

tc.q: 指引就符合當時有效指引的行為有何說明？
options: 若行為符合當時指引，關長不會採取紀律行動
該等行為賦予持牌人完全的法定免責辯護
該等行為屬減輕因素，會自動將罰款減半
有關行為當時有效的指引，與關長的決定完全無關
tc.explain: 第9(d)(i)段詢問海關關長有否就有關行為發出任何指引，並訂明就符合有關行為當時有效指引的行為，關長一般不會對持牌人採取紀律行動——這是克制的政策，並非法定免責辯護，亦非自動罰款減半；當時有效的指引明顯屬相關考慮。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(d)(ii)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(d)(ii)段

en.q: What consistency principle does the guideline state in relation to previous similar cases?
options: Similar cases are treated consistently, considering prior CCE and other-authority action
Each case must be decided in total isolation, without any reference to earlier cases
Previous cases are only relevant if they happened to involve the very same licensee
The consistency principle applies only to cases decided within the same calendar year
en.explain: Paragraph 9(d)(ii) asks what action the CCE and/or other relevant authorities have taken in previous similar cases, and states that in general similar cases should be treated in a consistent manner — cases are not decided in isolation, are not limited to the same licensee, and consistency is not confined to a single calendar year.

tc.q: 指引就過往同類個案訂明甚麼一致性原則？
options: 同類個案一般應一致處理，並顧及關長過往行動
每宗個案須完全獨立裁定，不得參照先前個案
過往個案只在剛好涉及同一持牌人時方屬相關
一致性原則只適用於在同一曆年內裁定的個案
tc.explain: 第9(d)(ii)段詢問海關關長及／或其他有關當局在過往同類個案中採取過甚麼行動，並訂明一般而言同類個案應以一致方式處理——個案並非獨立裁定，亦不限於同一持牌人，一致性原則亦不限於同一曆年內的個案。

source.en: Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty (Apr 2018) ¶9(d)(iv)
source.tc: 《施加罰款紀律行動指引》（2018年4月）第9(d)(iv)段

en.q: Which mitigating factor does the guideline expressly identify?
options: Whether the licensee promptly and completely reported the contravention
Whether the licensee has held its licence for more than ten consecutive years
Whether the licensee has never previously been inspected by the CCE
Whether the licensee has offered to make a voluntary financial contribution
en.explain: Paragraph 9(d)(iv) identifies as a mitigating factor whether the licensee has promptly, effectively and completely brought the contravention or possible contravention to the attention of the CCE — self-reporting is expressly rewarded. Length of licensing, inspection history and voluntary contributions are not listed factors.

tc.q: 指引明文指出哪一項減輕因素？
options: 該持牌人有否迅速完整通知違反
該持牌人是否已持續持牌超過十年
該持牌人此前有否從未被關長視察
該持牌人有否提出作出自願經濟捐獻
tc.explain: 第9(d)(iv)段將該持牌人有否迅速、有效及完整地將該項違反或可能的違反提請關長注意，列為減輕因素——主動申報獲明文肯定。持牌年期、視察紀錄及自願捐獻均非指引所列的因素。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第1段

en.q: Under which section of the AMLO is the Disciplinary Fining Guideline published, and which fining power does it address?
options: Section 23(1) — the s.21(2)(c) power over MSOs contravening a s.5(11) provision
Section 45(1), addressing the section 43(2)(c) pecuniary penalty power over licensees
Section 34, addressing the CCE's power to suspend or revoke a licence
Section 51, addressing regulations the CCE may make for money service operators
en.explain: Paragraph 1 states that the guideline is published under section 23(1) of the AMLO to indicate how the CCE will exercise the section 21(2)(c) fining power, which applies where an MSO contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11). Section 45(1)/43(2)(c) is the separate Disciplinary Action Guideline on Pecuniary Penalty's basis; section 34 is suspension/revocation; section 51 is the CCE's regulation-making power.

tc.q: 《紀律處分罰款指引》根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪一條發出？處理哪一項罰款權力？
options: 第23(1)條——處理第21(2)(c)條指明的條文的罰款權力
第45(1)條——處理第43(2)(c)條對持牌人施加罰款的權力
第34條——處理關長暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的權力
第51條——處理關長可為金錢服務經營者訂立的規例
tc.explain: 第1段訂明本指引根據《打擊洗錢條例》第23(1)條發出，以說明海關關長將如何行使第21(2)(c)條的罰款權力；該權力適用於金錢服務經營者違反第5(11)條所界定指明的條文的情況。第45(1)條／第43(2)(c)條是另一份《施加罰款紀律行動指引》的依據；第34條是暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的權力；第51條是關長訂立規例的權力。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第1段

en.q: May the CCE impose a pecuniary penalty under section 21 together with other disciplinary sanctions?
options: Yes — the penalty may be imposed alone or with other disciplinary sanctions
No — the Disciplinary Fining Guideline requires a pecuniary penalty to be imposed alone
Only where the Review Tribunal has first approved the combined sanctions
Only where the MSO has consented in advance to the combined sanction
en.explain: Paragraph 1 of the Disciplinary Fining Guideline states that under section 21 the CCE may impose a pecuniary penalty either on its own or together with other disciplinary sanctions on an MSO that contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11). No Review Tribunal pre-approval or MSO consent is required.

tc.q: 海關關長可否在施加第21條罰款的同時，一併施加其他紀律制裁？
options: 可以——罰款可單獨或連同其他紀律制裁一併施加
不可以——《紀律處分罰款指引》規定罰款必須單獨施加
只限覆核審裁處已預先批准合併制裁的情況
只限該金錢服務經營者已預先同意合併制裁的情況
tc.explain: 《紀律處分罰款指引》第1段訂明，根據第21條，海關關長可對違反第5(11)條所界定指明的條文的金錢服務經營者，單獨施加罰款，或連同其他紀律制裁一併施加，無須覆核審裁處預先批准，亦無須該金錢服務經營者預先同意。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第9(a)(iii)段

en.q: How does the reputational factor in the Disciplinary Fining Guideline differ in wording from that in the pecuniary penalty guideline?
options: Cites only HK's reputation as a financial centre, not money-services integrity
The Fining Guideline omits any reputational factor from its list entirely
The Fining Guideline refers only to the MSO's own commercial reputation
The two guidelines use exactly identical wording for this factor
en.explain: Paragraph 9(a)(iii) of the Disciplinary Fining Guideline asks only whether the contravention is potentially damaging to the reputation of Hong Kong as an international financial centre. The corresponding paragraph of the pecuniary penalty guideline (doc 08, ¶9(a)(iii)) additionally refers to the integrity of the operation of money services in Hong Kong — the Fining Guideline is narrower, not silent, not MSO-specific, and not identically worded.

tc.q: 《紀律處分罰款指引》的聲譽因素在措辭上與《施加罰款紀律行動指引》有何不同？
options: 本指引只提及香港作為金融中心的聲譽，未提金錢服務健全性
《紀律處分罰款指引》完全沒有列出任何聲譽方面的因素
《紀律處分罰款指引》只提及金錢服務經營者的商業聲譽
兩者在此因素的措辭上完全一模一樣，並無分別
tc.explain: 《紀律處分罰款指引》第9(a)(iii)段只詢問該項違反是否可能損害香港作為國際金融中心的聲譽。《施加罰款紀律行動指引》的對應段落（第9(a)(iii)段）則另加香港金錢服務營運的健全性——《紀律處分罰款指引》的範圍較窄，並非完全沒有聲譽因素，亦非只限於個別經營者本身，措辭亦非完全相同。

source.tc: 《紀律處分罰款指引》（2018年5月）第9段

en.q: How does the Disciplinary Fining Guideline describe the list of seriousness factors it sets out?
options: Not exhaustive; some may not apply, others may be relevant
Exhaustive and legally binding, with every factor mandatorily scored
Applicable only to a licensee's first-ever contravention of the AMLO
Applicable only where the contravention was proven to be intentional
en.explain: Paragraph 9 states that the CCE will consider all the circumstances and the relevant factors listed, that the factors are not exhaustive, that some may not apply in a particular case, and that there may be other relevant factors not listed — there is no scoring system, no first-contravention limit, and the factors apply regardless of intent.

tc.q: 《紀律處分罰款指引》如何描述其所列的嚴重程度因素清單？
options: 並非詳盡——部分因素未必適用，亦有未列因素
詳盡無遺並具法律約束力，每項因素均須強制評分
只適用於持牌人首次違反《打擊洗錢條例》的情況
只適用於經證實屬故意作出的違反行為
tc.explain: 第9段訂明，海關關長會考慮所有情況及所列的相關因素；所列因素並非詳盡無遺，某些在個別個案中可能不適用，亦可能有其他未列出的相關因素——並無評分制度，亦不限於首次違反，各項因素不論故意與否均適用。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）第2段；《補充指引》（2020年1月）第2段

en.q: Both fitness-and-propriety guidelines emphasise the same statutory point about section 30(4). What is it?
options: Beyond required matters, the CCE may weigh any other relevant matter
Section 30(4) is a complete and exhaustive list of all relevant matters
Section 30(4) applies only to corporate licence applicants, not individuals
Section 30(4) may be waived by the CCE in an appropriate particular case
en.explain: Paragraph 2 of both guidelines states that section 30(4) details the matters the CCE must have regard to, and that in addition the CCE may take into account any other matter it considers relevant — it is not an exhaustive list, is not limited to corporate applicants, and section 30(4) is a statutory requirement the CCE cannot simply waive.

tc.q: 兩份適當人選指引均強調關於第30(4)條的同一法定要點。該要點是甚麼？
options: 除須顧及的事宜外，關長亦可考慮相關的其他事宜
第30(4)條是所有相關事宜的完整詳盡清單
第30(4)條只適用於公司申請人，不適用於個人
關長可在適當的個別個案中豁免第30(4)條的適用
tc.explain: 兩份指引的第2段均訂明第30(4)條詳列關長必須顧及的事宜，而除該等事宜外，關長可考慮其認為相關的任何其他事宜——並非詳盡清單，亦不限於公司申請人；第30(4)條屬法定規定，關長不能隨意豁免。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）前言

en.q: How must the Supplementary F&P Guideline be read?
options: In conjunction with the Guideline on Criteria for Fitness and Propriety
As a free-standing replacement for the earlier Fitness and Propriety Guideline
Only alongside the Licensing Guide issued for money service operators
Only alongside the AML/CFT Guideline issued for money service operators
en.explain: The preamble states that the Supplementary Guideline must be read in conjunction with the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety, to give examples of the CCE's power to have regard to any other relevant matter — it does not replace that guideline, and is not confined to the Licensing Guide or the AML/CFT Guideline alone.

tc.q: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》須如何閱讀？
options: 須與《有關適當人選準則的指引》一併閱讀
屬取代較早前適當人選指引的獨立文件，毋須一併閱讀
只須與為金錢服務經營者發出的《牌照指引》一併閱讀
只須與《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》一併閱讀
tc.explain: 前言訂明本補充指引須與《有關適當人選準則的指引》一併閱讀，以就關長可顧及任何其他相關事宜的權力提供例子——並非取代該指引，亦不只限於與《牌照指引》或《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》一併閱讀。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: What is the stated purpose of the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan?
options: So the MSSB gains a full understanding of its business and operation
To prescribe the minimum paid-up capital required of every licence applicant
To set out the statutory fees payable when lodging a licence application
To specify the format and frequency of the licensee's periodic returns
en.explain: The introduction states that the guidelines set out key elements so the Money Service Supervision Bureau has a comprehensive understanding of the applicant's proposed business and its mode of operation — there is no stated minimum capital, no application fee, and no periodic-return format in this guideline.

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》訂明的目的為何？
options: 使監理科全面了解擬經營業務及運作模式
訂明每名牌照申請人須具備的最低實繳資本水平
訂明遞交牌照申請時須繳付的法定費用款額
指明持牌人定期申報表的格式及頻密程度
tc.explain: 引言訂明本指引列出業務計劃應包括的主要元素，使金錢服務監理科能全面了解申請人擬經營的金錢服務業務及其運作模式——本指引並無訂明最低資本、申請費用，或定期申報表格式。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: What must an applicant confirm in writing in the business plan?
options: That it will notify the Commissioner in writing within one month of a change
That it will not alter its proposed business model for at least the next two years
That it has never previously applied for a money service licence elsewhere
That it will submit independently audited accounts to the Commissioner every six months
en.explain: The introduction requires the applicant to confirm in writing that it is aware of and will comply with the requirement to notify the Commissioner in writing within one month beginning on the date of any change in the particulars provided for grant or renewal of an MSO licence — not a freeze on the business model, prior-application history, or a six-monthly audit requirement.

tc.q: 申請人須在業務計劃中以書面確認甚麼？
options: 其會自詳情變更起一個月內書面通知關長
其在未來至少兩年內不會更改擬經營的業務模式
其從未在其他地方申請過金錢服務牌照
其會每六個月向關長提交獨立審計帳目
tc.explain: 引言規定申請人須在業務計劃中以書面確認，其充分知悉並會遵從以下規定：所提供的詳情如有變更，須自變更發生之日起計一個月內以書面通知關長——並非凍結業務模式、從未在他處申請的紀錄，或每六個月審計的規定。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: What consequence does the Business Plan guideline attach to failing to provide the necessary information?
options: It may delay or hinder the application process
The application is automatically refused
The applicant is liable to a pecuniary penalty
The application goes to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: The introduction states that it is important that the applicant provides all necessary information to the MSSB and has the resources to execute the business plan, and that failure to provide this information may delay or hinder the processing of the application — the guideline does not say the application is automatically refused, that a penalty applies, or that it is referred to the Review Tribunal.

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》就未有提供所需資料訂明甚麼後果？
options: 可能延誤或阻礙處理
申請自動被拒絕
申請人須繳付罰款
申請會轉交審裁處
tc.explain: 引言訂明申請人向金錢服務監理科提供所有必需資料及具備執行業務計劃的資源十分重要；未有提供該等資料可能延誤或阻礙申請的處理——指引並無訂明申請會自動被拒絕、須繳付罰款，或會轉交覆核審裁處。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 8
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第8項

en.q: What rule does the Business Plan guideline state about bank accounts used for the money service business?
options: No third-party bank account allowed; give the account number and owner
Any bank account may be used, provided the applicant discloses its existence
Only accounts held with authorized institutions in Hong Kong may be used
At least two separate bank accounts must be maintained for the business
en.explain: Item 8 requires information on bank accounts used for the business, such as the account number and owner, and states expressly that no third-party bank account is allowed — disclosure alone does not make a third-party account acceptable, there is no authorized-institution restriction, and no two-account minimum.

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》就用於金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶訂明甚麼規則？
options: 不容許第三方帳戶，提供號碼及擁有人
只要申請人有披露，任何銀行帳戶均可使用
只可使用在香港認可機構開立的帳戶
業務須維持至少兩個獨立銀行帳戶
tc.explain: 第8項規定須提供用於業務的銀行帳戶資料，例如帳戶號碼及帳戶擁有人，並明文訂明不容許使用第三方銀行帳戶——單憑披露不能令第三方帳戶變得可以接受，亦無只限認可機構的規定，或最少兩個帳戶的規定。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 8 note
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第8項註

en.q: An applicant considers it does not need a bank account for the business. What does the Business Plan guideline require?
options: Detail how it will provide money service without a bank account
The application cannot proceed at all unless a bank account is opened
The applicant must use a director's personal bank account instead
The applicant must obtain the Commissioner's prior written exemption
en.explain: The note to item 8 states that if the applicant considers there is no need to open a bank account, it must provide details on how the company will provide money service without one — a bank account is not an absolute precondition, a director's personal account is not prescribed, and no written exemption from the Commissioner is required.

tc.q: 某申請人認為其業務無須開立銀行帳戶。《遞交業務計劃的指引》有何規定？
options: 須詳述沒有銀行帳戶下如何提供金錢服務
除非開立銀行帳戶，否則申請完全不能進行
申請人須改用董事的個人銀行帳戶
申請人須事先取得關長的書面豁免
tc.explain: 第8項的註訂明，如申請人認為業務無須開立銀行帳戶，申請人須提供詳情，說明公司在沒有銀行帳戶的情況下如何提供金錢服務——銀行帳戶並非絕對先決條件，亦無規定須改用董事個人帳戶，或須取得關長的書面豁免。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 6
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第6項

en.q: What must the description of business operation in Hong Kong detail, according to the Business Plan guideline?
options: The entire transaction process: order, fund movement, compliance, record-keeping
Only the expected profit margin and turnover for each product over the next two years
Only the location where the applicant's key business decisions are made
Only the geographical location and nationality of potential customers
en.explain: Item 6 requires the business operation description to detail the entire transaction process, including placing and processing the order, movement of funds, compliance function, and accounting and record-keeping function — profitability (item 9), the location of key management (item 4), and customer location (item 5) are separate items.

tc.q: 根據《遞交業務計劃的指引》，香港業務運作的描述須詳述甚麼？
options: 整個交易流程：落單、資金流動、合規及紀錄保存
只需未來兩年內每類產品及服務的預期利潤率及營業額
只需申請人作出重要業務決策所在的地點
只需潛在客戶及預期客戶的地理位置及國籍
tc.explain: 第6項規定業務運作須詳述整個交易流程，包括落交易指示、處理指示、資金流動、合規職能，以及會計及紀錄保存職能——盈利能力（第9項）、主要管理層位置（第4項）及客戶位置（第5項）均屬其他獨立項目。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 7
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第7項

en.q: Where foreign agents or foreign MSOs are used to transfer or receive funds, what must the business plan provide?
options: All agents and overseas MSOs, their agreement, measures to protect funds if one fails
Only the type of product and service offered, and the timeline for launching them
Only the delivery channel processing orders and fund flows through each jurisdiction
Only whether the applicant's international group is subject to supervision elsewhere
en.explain: Item 7 requires information on all agents and overseas MSOs together with the service agreement, plus the measures taken to protect customer funds against loss if an agent or MSO fails to perform — product/service type and timeline, the delivery-channel description, and other supervision (item 17) are separate, related requirements in the same guideline.

tc.q: 如使用外地代理或外地金錢服務經營者轉移或收取資金，業務計劃須提供甚麼？
options: 代理海外經營者連同協議，失責保障資金措施
只需所提供產品及服務的類別，以及推出時間表
只需處理指令及資金經過不同司法管轄區的交付渠道
只需申請人的國際集團有否受其他形式的監管
tc.explain: 第7項規定須提供所有代理及海外金錢服務經營者的資料連同服務協議，以及在代理或經營者未能履行時保障客戶資金免受損失的措施——產品及服務類別和推出時間表、交付渠道的描述，以及是否受其他監管（第17項），均屬本指引下其他相關但獨立的規定。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 9
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第9項

en.q: Over what period must the business plan project profitability, and what else must it cover?
options: Profit margin, turnover per product for 2 years, plus daily running capital
The next five years' projected profit, together with a break-even analysis
The next twelve months only, excluding any running-capital information
The preceding two years' actual audited profit and turnover results
en.explain: Item 9 requires information on the expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years, and the running capital for daily operation — not a five-year projection, a twelve-month-only figure, or historical audited results.

tc.q: 業務計劃須就多長期間預測盈利能力？還須涵蓋甚麼？
options: 未來兩年產品預期利潤率及營業額，營運資金
未來五年的預期利潤，連同收支平衡分析
只限未來十二個月，不包括營運資金資料
過去兩年的實際經審計利潤及營業額業績
tc.explain: 第9項規定須提供未來兩年每類產品及服務的預期利潤率及營業額，以及業務日常營運的營運資金的資料——並非五年預測、只限十二個月的資料，或過去的經審計業績。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 10
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第10項

en.q: What must the business plan include about organizational structure?
options: Organizational charts of the HK company group and the international group, with a brief description of each entity's business
The applicant's expected profit margin and turnover for each product and service over the next two years
Whether the applicant's local business or international group is subject to supervision by another regulator or competent authority
