The bank accounts used for the business, including the account number and the owner of each account
en.explain: Item 10 requires an organizational chart of both the Hong Kong group of companies and the international group, each with a brief description of every entity and the business it carries out. The distractors are drawn from other business plan items: item 9 (profitability), item 17 (subject to other supervision) and item 8 (bank account).

tc.q: 業務計劃就組織架構須包括甚麼？
options: 香港公司集團及國際集團的組織圖，並附各實體簡介及業務
申請人未來兩年內每項產品及服務的預計利潤率及營業額
申請人本地業務或所屬國際集團是否受其他監管或主管當局監管
業務所使用的銀行帳戶，包括帳戶號碼及帳戶擁有人
tc.explain: 第10項規定須附上香港公司集團及國際集團的組織圖，並就集團內每個實體提供簡介及其所經營的業務。三個錯誤答案分別取自第9項（盈利能力）、第17項（受其他監管）及第8項（銀行帳戶）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 11
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第11項

en.q: Where the applicant's business premises are shared with other businesses, what must the business plan elaborate?
options: The nature of the other businesses, whether owned by the applicant, its director, partner or staff, and any business relationship
The organizational charts of both the Hong Kong company group and the international group to which the applicant belongs, with a description of each entity
The total number, positions, roles and responsibilities, and reporting lines of the applicant's management team and employees
The name of the company or person involved, if the applicant's business involves local or cross-boundary physical cash movement
en.explain: Item 11 requires the applicant to elaborate the nature of the other businesses sharing its premises, whether those businesses are also owned by the applicant, its director, partner or staff, and whether they have any business relationship with the applicant. The distractors are drawn from item 10 (organizational structure), item 12 (local human resources) and item 16 (other business relationships).

tc.q: 如申請人的業務處所與其他業務共用，業務計劃須詳述甚麼？
options: 其他業務性質、是否由申請人董事合夥人或員工擁有，有否關係
香港公司集團及申請人所屬國際集團的組織圖，並附各實體的簡介
管理團隊及僱員的總人數、職位、角色及職責，以及匯報層級
如業務涉及本地或跨境的實物現金移動活動，有關公司或人士的名稱
tc.explain: 第11項規定申請人須詳述與其共用處所的其他業務的性質、該等業務是否亦由申請人、其董事、合夥人或員工擁有，以及有否任何業務關係。三個錯誤答案分別取自第10項（組織架構）、第12項（本地人力資源）及第16項（其他業務關係）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 12
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第12項

en.q: What details must the business plan give about the applicant's management team and employees?
options: Total number, positions, roles, full-time or part-time status, and reporting lines of team and employees
The nationality, employment history, qualification and education level of the key executives of senior management
The location where key business decisions are made, and the function and whereabouts of any back-end office
The expected profit margin and turnover for each product and service over the next two years, and the daily running capital
en.explain: Item 12 requires elaboration of the composition of the management team and employees: total numbers, positions, roles and responsibilities, full time/part time status, and reporting lines. The distractors are drawn from item 3 (key executives), item 4 (location of key management) and item 9 (profitability and financial information).

tc.q: 業務計劃就申請人的管理團隊及僱員須提供甚麼詳情？
options: 管理團隊及僱員總人數、職位角色職責、全職或兼職及匯報層級
管理層主要行政人員的國籍、僱傭經歷、資歷及教育程度
作出主要業務決策的地點，以及任何後勤辦公室的職能及所在位置
未來兩年每項產品及服務的預計利潤率及營業額，以及日常營運資金
tc.explain: 第12項規定須詳述管理團隊及僱員的組成：總人數、職位、角色及職責、屬全職或兼職，以及匯報層級。三個錯誤答案分別取自第3項（主要行政人員）、第4項（管理層所在地點）及第9項（盈利能力及財務資料）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 13; AMLO Sch. 2, s.18
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第13項；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18條

en.q: Which examples does the Business Plan guideline give of outsourced services used for AML/CFT purposes?
options: An external audit function, and any specified intermediary under Schedule 2
The commercial service or database provider used for automated AML solutions and sanction screening
Any foreign agent or overseas MSO used to transfer or receive funds on the applicant's behalf
Any other regulator or competent authority that also supervises the applicant's business
en.explain: Item 13 requires the name and nature of any outsourced services used for AML/CFT purposes, giving as examples an external audit function and any specified intermediary - the concept defined in Schedule 2, section 18 of the AMLO. The distractors belong to other items: the database provider example is item 14 (computerized/screening systems), foreign agents are item 7 (delivery channels), and other regulators are item 17 (subject to other supervision).

tc.q: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》就為打擊洗錢用途而外判的服務舉出哪些例子？
options: 外部審計職能，以及附表2所指的指明中介人
用於自動化打擊洗錢方案及制裁篩查的商業服務或資料庫供應商
代申請人轉出或收取款項的任何海外代理或海外金錢服務經營者
亦有監管申請人業務的任何其他監管機構或主管當局
tc.explain: 第13項規定須提供為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集用途而外判的任何服務的名稱及性質，並以外部審計職能及任何指明中介人為例——後者即《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18條所指的概念。三個錯誤答案分別取自第14項（電腦化／篩查系統）、第7項（分銷渠道）及第17項（受其他監管）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 14
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第14項

en.q: What must the business plan state about computerized and screening systems?
options: The computerized and automation systems used in the business, e.g. the sanction-screening database provider
The name and nature of outsourced services used for AML/CFT purposes, such as an external audit function
The role of any third-party payment platform or network used in the business, such as a digital wallet
The entire transaction process in Hong Kong, including order placement, fund movement, and record keeping
en.explain: Item 14 requires elaboration of the computerized systems and other automation systems used in the business, giving as an example the database provider for automated AML solutions and sanction screening. The distractors are drawn from item 13 (outsourced services), item 16 (other business relationships) and item 6 (business operation in Hong Kong).

tc.q: 業務計劃就電腦化系統及篩查系統須說明甚麼？
options: 業務中的電腦化及自動化系統，例如制裁篩查的資料庫供應商等
為打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集用途而外判的服務名稱及性質，例如外部審計職能
業務中所使用的第三方支付平台或網絡（例如電子錢包）所擔當的角色
在香港的整個交易流程，包括落盤、訂單處理、資金流動及紀錄保存
tc.explain: 第14項規定須詳述業務中使用的電腦化系統及其他自動化系統，並以自動化打擊洗錢方案及制裁篩查的資料庫供應商為例。三個錯誤答案分別取自第13項（外判服務）、第16項（其他業務關係）及第6項（在香港的業務運作）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: Which two situations must be addressed under "other types of business relationships" in the business plan?
options: A third-party payment platform (e.g. a digital wallet), and local or cross-boundary cash movement
Acting as agent for another local MSO, or as principal for an overseas company
Use of outsourced services, such as an external audit function or a specified intermediary
Business premises shared with a business owned by the applicant's director, partner or staff
en.explain: Item 16 covers third-party payment platforms/networks (e.g. a digital wallet) and local/cross-boundary physical cash movement. Acting as agent or principal is item 15, outsourced services is item 13, and shared business premises is item 11 — different items in the same business plan.

tc.q: 業務計劃「其他類型業務關係」一項須處理哪兩種情況？
options: 使用第三方支付平台（例如電子錢包），以及本地或跨境實物現金運送
為另一間本地金錢服務經營者擔任代理，或為海外公司擔任委託人
使用外判服務，例如外部審計職能或指明中介人
與申請人董事、合夥人或員工擁有的其他業務共用的業務處所
tc.explain: 第16項涵蓋第三方支付平台／網絡（例如電子錢包）及本地／跨境實物現金運送活動。擔任代理或委託人屬第15項，外判服務屬第13項，共用業務處所則屬第11項——同屬業務計劃，但為不同項目。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (Ver 12/2019), item 17
source.tc: 《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12/2019版）第17項

en.q: What must the business plan disclose about other supervision?
options: Whether the applicant's local business or international group is subject to other supervision, e.g. a licence, and if so that regulator's name
Whether the applicant uses any outsourced services for AML/CFT purposes, such as an external audit function or a specified intermediary
Whether the applicant's computerized or automation systems used in the business are supplied by a commercial database or screening provider
Whether the applicant's business involves use of a third party's payment platform or network, such as a digital wallet, in its operations
en.explain: Item 17 requires disclosure of whether the applicant's local business, or its international group, is also subject to other supervision (e.g. a licence from another regulator), and if so the regulator's name. Outsourced services (item 13), computerized systems (item 14) and payment platforms (item 16) are separate disclosures in the same business plan.

tc.q: 業務計劃就其他監管須披露甚麼？
options: 申請人的本地業務或國際集團是否受其他監管（例如另一牌照），如是則該機構的名稱
申請人是否有為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集用途使用任何外判服務，例如外部審計職能或指明中介人
申請人於業務中使用的電腦化或自動化系統，是否由指名的商業資料庫或篩查服務供應商提供
申請人的業務營運是否涉及使用第三方的支付平台或網絡，例如電子錢包
tc.explain: 第17項規定須披露申請人的本地業務或其所屬國際集團，是否亦受其他類型的監管（例如持有其他監管機構批出的牌照）；如是，須提供該監管機構的名稱。外判服務（第13項）、電腦化系統（第14項）及支付平台（第16項）屬同一業務計劃內的其他獨立披露事項。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: On what must an applicant's AML/CFT policy be based, according to the submission guidelines?
options: The applicant's own self AML/CFT risk assessment, matching its business risk profile
A model policy template issued by the Money Service Supervision Bureau for all applicants
The published policy of an already-licensed MSO in the same business sector
The FATF Recommendations, reproduced in full without local adaptation
en.explain: The introduction states each applicant must complete its own self AML/CFT risk assessment, and that the policy must be based on that assessment to meet its particular business risk profile — not a regulator-issued template, another licensee's policy, or an unadapted copy of the FATF Recommendations.

tc.q: 根據遞交指引，申請人的打擊洗錢政策須以甚麼為基礎？
options: 申請人自我打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估
由金錢服務監理科發出、供所有申請人採用的統一範本政策
同一業務範疇內另一已持牌金錢服務經營者所公布的政策
財務行動特別組織的建議，原文全文照錄而未作本地調整
tc.explain: 引言訂明每名申請人須自行完成打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，並以該評估為基礎制定政策，以切合其特定業務風險狀況——並非以監管機構發出的範本、另一持牌人的政策，或未經調整而全文照錄的財務行動特別組織建議為基礎。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 1; AMLO Sch. 2, ss.19(3) & 23
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第1項；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(3)及23條

en.q: What must item 1 of the AML/CFT Policy guideline require the introduction to the policy to state the applicant will do?
options: Take reasonable measures to prevent a Schedule 2 Part 2/3 breach, and maintain effective procedures
Confirm the applicant meets the grant requirements in section 30 and the renewal requirements in section 31
Set out the disciplinary actions under section 43 and the pecuniary penalty guidelines under section 45
Explain the Review Tribunal established under section 55 and the review application procedure under section 59
en.explain: Item 1 requires the introduction to state that the applicant must take all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards against a breach of Schedule 2 Part 2 or 3 (Schedule 2 s.23), and must maintain effective procedures for its Schedule 2 duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15 (s.19(3)). Sections 30/31 (grant/renewal), 43/45 (disciplinary action/penalty guidelines) and 55/59 (Review Tribunal/review application) are real but unrelated AMLO provisions.

tc.q: 根據《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第1項，政策引言須訂明申請人會採取甚麼行動？
options: 採取合理措施防止違反附表2第2或3部，並維持有效程序
確認申請人符合《打擊洗錢條例》第30條批出牌照及第31條續期牌照的相關規定
訂明關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第43條可採取的紀律行動及第45條施加罰款的指引
說明申請人根據《打擊洗錢條例》第55條設立的覆核審裁處及第59條申請覆核的程序
tc.explain: 第1項規定政策引言須訂明申請人必須採取一切合理措施，確保設有適當防護措施以防止違反附表2第2或3部（附表2第23條）；並須根據第19(3)條，就附表2第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任維持有效程序。第30／31條（批出／續期牌照）、第43／45條（紀律行動／罰款指引）及第55／59條（覆核審裁處／申請覆核）均為真實但不相關的《打擊洗錢條例》條文。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 1
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第1項

en.q: Which officers must the policy's introduction name, and what must it state about them?
options: A named Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer, with reporting line stated
Only a named Compliance Officer, with no requirement to state a reporting line
Only a named Money Laundering Reporting Officer, with no need to state a reporting line
A named external auditor and company secretary, with the reporting line stated
en.explain: Item 1 requires the policy to name a qualified Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer, employed to implement AML/CFT policies and procedures including STR, with the line of reporting clearly stated — both officers, not one alone, and not the external auditor or company secretary, who are not mentioned in item 1.

tc.q: 政策引言須列出哪些人員？就他們須說明甚麼？
options: 具名的合規主任及洗錢報告主任，須訂明匯報層級
只需具名的合規主任，毋須訂明匯報層級
只需具名的洗錢報告主任，毋須訂明匯報層級
具名的外部核數師及公司秘書，須訂明匯報層級
tc.explain: 第1項規定政策須列出合資格的合規主任及洗錢報告主任（均須具名），以實施打擊洗錢政策及程序（包括可疑交易報告），並須清楚訂明匯報層級——兩名人員缺一不可，並非外部核數師或公司秘書，此二者並非第1項所述人員。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 2
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第2項

en.q: Which topics must the AML/CFT framework section of the policy cover?
options: What ML, TF and PF are; MSO's legal obligations under different legislation; and what STR and tipping off are
CDD thresholds for walk-in customers, Customer Risk Assessment, and source of funds/source of wealth measures
Screening against targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism, proliferation, and politically exposed persons
Staff's personal statutory obligations, new and emerging ML/TF techniques, and the training records kept
en.explain: Item 2 requires the AML/CFT framework section to cover what ML, TF and PF are; the MSO's legal obligations under different legislation; why an AML/CFT system matters; the three stages of ML; typical signs; STRs and the obligations they carry; and tipping off. CDD thresholds/CRA/SOF-SOW belong to item 3, sanctions screening to item 11, and training scope/records to item 16 — different items in the same policy.

tc.q: 政策中的打擊洗錢框架部分須涵蓋哪些課題？
options: 何謂洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集；經營者責任；可疑交易報告及洩密
即場客戶的客戶盡職審查門檻、客戶風險評估，以及資金來源／財富來源措施
針對與恐怖主義、擴散及政治人物有關的定向金融制裁的篩查
員工的個人法定責任、洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的新興技巧，以及所備存的培訓紀錄
tc.explain: 第2項規定打擊洗錢框架部分須涵蓋何謂洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集；金錢服務經營者在不同法例下的法律責任；為何須設立相關系統；洗錢的三個階段；典型跡象；可疑交易報告及其責任；以及洩密。客戶盡職審查門檻／客戶風險評估／資金來源與財富來源屬第3項，制裁篩查屬第11項，培訓範圍／紀錄屬第16項——同屬政策內的不同項目。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: What must the policy state about transaction thresholds for carrying out CDD?
options: Transaction thresholds for CDD, including a walk-in customer's one-off transaction
Only the statutory $120,000 threshold for occasional transactions other than wire transfers
Only the statutory $8,000 threshold for occasional wire transfer transactions
That transaction thresholds are a matter for the CCE, not something the applicant's policy need address
en.explain: Item 3 requires the policy to state the company's own policy on different transaction thresholds for CDD, including how a walk-in customer's one-off transaction is treated. The statutory $120,000 (non-wire-transfer) and $8,000 (wire transfer) occasional-transaction thresholds are real figures under the AML/CFT Guideline, but item 3 asks for the company's policy, not the bare statutory figures, and it is the applicant, not the CCE, who must set that policy.

tc.q: 政策須就進行客戶盡職審查的交易門檻說明甚麼？
options: 客戶盡職審查交易門檻，包括即場客戶一次性交易
只需非電傳轉帳非經常交易的法定120,000元門檻
只需電傳轉帳非經常交易的法定8,000元門檻
交易門檻屬關長的事宜，並非申請人政策須處理的事項
tc.explain: 第3項規定政策須訂明公司就進行客戶盡職審查的不同交易門檻的政策，包括如何處理即場客戶的一次性交易。法定的120,000元（非電傳轉帳）及8,000元（電傳轉帳）非經常交易門檻雖屬真實數字，但第3項要求的是公司政策，並非單純的法定數字；而且須由申請人（並非關長）訂立該政策。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Which paragraphs of the AML/CFT Guideline must an MSO indicate compliance with when describing regular CDD in its policy?
options: Paragraphs 4.2.1 to 4.2.6, and how linked transactions are dealt with
Paragraphs 1.1 to 1.10, in the Overview chapter of the AML/CFT Guideline
Paragraphs 6.1 to 6.19, in the terrorist financing and sanctions chapter
Paragraphs 9.1 to 9.7, in the staff training chapter of the AML/CFT Guideline
en.explain: Item 3 states that in describing regular CDD, the MSO should indicate how paragraphs 4.2.1 to 4.2.6 of the AML/CFT Guideline (Chapter 4, Customer Due Diligence) will be complied with, and how linked transactions will be dealt with — not the Overview (Chapter 1), terrorist financing/sanctions (Chapter 6), or staff training (Chapter 9, where paragraph 9.7 is the cross-reference used in item 16) chapters.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在政策中描述一般客戶盡職審查時，須說明遵從《打擊洗錢指引》哪些段落？
options: 第4.2.1至4.2.6段，連同如何處理關連交易
第1.1至1.10段，即《打擊洗錢指引》概覽一章
第6.1至6.19段，即恐怖分子資金籌集及制裁一章
第9.1至9.7段，即《打擊洗錢指引》員工培訓一章
tc.explain: 第3項訂明，在描述一般客戶盡職審查時，金錢服務經營者應說明將如何遵從《打擊洗錢指引》第4.2.1至4.2.6段（第4章，客戶盡職審查），以及將如何處理有關連交易——並非概覽（第1章）、恐怖分子資金籌集及制裁（第6章），或員工培訓（第9章，當中第9.7段正是第16項所引用的交叉參照）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Which example of a self-assessed high-risk situation does the AML/CFT Policy guideline give?
options: A walk-in customer remitting HK$200,000 in cash to the Mainland
A walk-in customer remitting HK$8,000 in cash to the Mainland
A walk-in customer remitting HK$120,000 in cash to the Mainland
A walk-in customer remitting HK$200,000 in cash locally
en.explain: Item 3 gives the example of a walk-in customer remitting HK$200,000 in cash to the Mainland as a self-assessed high-risk situation. HK$8,000 and HK$120,000 are real statutory CDD thresholds for wire transfers and other occasional transactions respectively, but neither is the figure used in this example, and the example specifies a cross-boundary remittance to the Mainland, not a transfer within Hong Kong.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》就申請人自行評估為高風險的情況舉出甚麼例子？
options: 即場客戶以現金匯款200,000港元至內地
即場客戶以現金匯款8,000港元至內地
即場客戶以現金匯款120,000港元至內地
即場客戶以現金在港匯款200,000港元
tc.explain: 第3項以即場客戶以現金匯款200,000港元至內地為自行評估高風險情況的例子。8,000元及120,000元分別是電傳轉帳及其他非經常交易的真實法定客戶盡職審查門檻，但均非本例所用的金額；而且本例所指是匯往內地的跨境匯款，並非香港境內的匯款。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Which four EDD sub-topics precede the self-assessed high-risk item in item 3 of the AML/CFT Policy guideline?
options: What a PEP is, its domestic/foreign/international PEP policy, non-face-to-face channels, and high-risk countries
Cash transactions, cheque transactions, card and virtual asset transactions accepted by the applicant
Individual customers, corporate customers, trusts, and partnerships forming the applicant's customer base
New customers, dormant customers, high-turnover customers, and overseas customers of the applicant
en.explain: Item 3's EDD list has five numbered sub-items: (1) what a PEP is, (2) the MSO's policy on domestic, foreign and international organization PEPs, (3) non-face-to-face channels, (4) FATF-identified high-risk countries, and (5) any situation the applicant itself assesses as high risk (e.g. the $200,000 cash-to-Mainland example in m4-82). This question asks for the first four, which precede the self-assessed example. Payment types, customer categories and customer segments are not part of this list.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第3項在自行評估的高風險情況之前，列出哪四項加強盡職審查子課題？
options: 政治人物（本地、外地、國際組織）、非面對面渠道及高風險國家
申請人接受的現金交易、支票交易、信用卡交易及虛擬資產交易
構成申請人整體客戶基礎的個人客戶、公司客戶、信託及合夥
申請人的新客戶、不活躍客戶、高交易量客戶及海外客戶群組
tc.explain: 第3項的加強盡職審查清單共有五個編號子項：(1)何謂政治人物、(2)經營者就本地、外地及國際組織政治人物的政策、(3)非面對面渠道、(4)財務行動特別組織識別的高風險國家，以及(5)申請人自行評估為高風險的任何情況（例如m4-82中200,000港元現金匯款至內地的例子）。本題所問為緊接於自行評估例子之前的首四項。付款方式、客戶類別及客戶群組並非此清單的內容。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: Where funding is provided by a third party, what does the AML/CFT Policy guideline require the policy to address?
options: Identifying and verifying the ultimate beneficial owner, including a legal person, partnership or trust
How source of funds and source of wealth measures are incorporated into the EDD process
The procedures for carrying out the Customer Risk Assessment and the applicant's obligation to do so
The consequences of failure to carry out CDD measures generally
en.explain: Item 3 states that funding provided by a third party requires the applicant to identify and verify its ultimate beneficial owner, including legal persons, partnerships, trusts and other legal arrangements, with the policy setting out the procedures and steps taken to comply. SOF/SOW in the EDD process, CRA procedures, and general CDD-failure consequences are separate sub-topics of the same item 3.

tc.q: 如資金由第三方提供，《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》要求政策處理甚麼？
options: 識別及核實最終實益擁有人的程序，包括法人、合夥或信託
資金來源及財富來源措施如何納入加強盡職審查程序
進行客戶風險評估的程序，以及申請人就此的法定責任
一般未能進行客戶盡職審查措施的後果
tc.explain: 第3項訂明由第三方提供資金，須由申請人識別及核實其最終實益擁有人，包括法人、合夥、信託及其他法律安排；並規定政策須載明為遵從該等規定所採取的程序及步驟。加強盡職審查中的資金來源／財富來源措施、客戶風險評估程序，以及一般未能進行客戶盡職審查的後果，均屬第3項下的其他子課題。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: What retrieval standard does the AML/CFT Policy guideline suggest for record-keeping systems?
options: Whether the system can retrieve records within a reasonable timeframe, say one day
Whether the system can retrieve records within one hour
Whether the system retains only CDD, transaction and screening records
Whether the system is hosted on servers located in Hong Kong
en.explain: Item 3 requires the policy to elaborate how CDD, transaction, screening and CRA records will be recorded and kept, and whether the system can retrieve those records within a reasonable timeframe, say one day — not within an hour, and all four listed record types (CDD, transaction, screening and CRA) must be covered, not the first three alone.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》就紀錄保存系統建議甚麼檢索標準？
options: 該系統能否在合理時限內（例如一日）檢索該等紀錄
該系統能否在一小時內檢索紀錄
該系統是否只保存客戶盡職審查、交易及篩查紀錄
該系統是否寄存於位於香港的伺服器
tc.explain: 第3項規定政策須詳述客戶盡職審查、交易、篩查及客戶風險評估紀錄將如何記錄及保存，以及該系統能否在合理時限內（例如一日）檢索該等紀錄——並非一小時內；而所列的四類紀錄（客戶盡職審查、交易、篩查及客戶風險評估）均須涵蓋，並非只涵蓋首三類。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 5; AMLO Sch. 2, s.9
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第5項；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9條

en.q: What must the policy state about distribution channels?
options: The distribution channels, and the percentage of face-to-face vs non-face-to-face transactions
The main types of currencies provided in the money service business, e.g. major or minor currencies
The target customers of the applicant's money service business and their typical profile
The way the applicant makes profit, e.g. a percentage of each transaction or a handling charge
en.explain: Item 5 requires the applicant to elaborate the distribution channels — for example counter service, internet or mobile — and the percentage of face-to-face and non-face-to-face transactions, which bears on the section 9 Schedule 2 special requirements for non-face-to-face customers. Currencies (item 6), target customers (item 7) and the revenue model (item 9) are separate items in the same policy.

tc.q: 政策就分銷渠道須說明甚麼？
options: 所使用的分銷渠道，以及面對面與非面對面交易的百分比
金錢服務業務中提供的主要貨幣種類，例如主要或次要貨幣
申請人金錢服務業務的目標客戶及其典型狀況
申請人的獲利方式，例如按每宗交易的某百分比或手續費收費
tc.explain: 第5項規定申請人須詳述分銷渠道（例如櫃檯服務、互聯網或流動裝置），以及面對面與非面對面交易的百分比；此與附表2第9條就非面對面客戶的特別規定有關。貨幣種類（第6項）、目標客戶（第7項）及獲利方式（第9項）則屬同一政策內的其他項目。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 8
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第8項

en.q: What must the policy specify about target jurisdictions for remittance?
options: Both the source jurisdictions of inward remittances and the destination jurisdictions of outward remittances
All jurisdictions in which the applicant, its group companies and its agents operate, whether or not remittance-related
The main types of currencies used for inward and outward remittance transactions
The percentage-based or handling-charge revenue model applied to remittance transactions
en.explain: Item 8 requires the applicant to elaborate the target jurisdictions for inward remittance transactions and for outward remittance transactions — both directions, since geographical risk attaches to each — not every jurisdiction the group operates in regardless of remittance activity, nor the currencies (item 6) or revenue model (item 9) used, which are separate items.

tc.q: 政策就匯款的目標司法管轄區須指明甚麼？
options: 匯入匯款的來源司法管轄區，以及匯出匯款的目的地司法管轄區兩者
申請人、其集團公司及代理經營業務的所有司法管轄區，不論是否涉及匯款
匯入及匯出匯款交易所使用的主要貨幣種類
匯款交易所採用的百分比或手續費獲利模式
tc.explain: 第8項規定申請人須詳述「匯入匯款交易」及「匯出匯款交易」的目標司法管轄區——兩個方向均須說明，因地域風險在兩者均存在——並非不論是否涉及匯款的所有經營司法管轄區，也不是貨幣種類（第6項）或獲利模式（第9項），此二者屬其他項目。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 10
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第10項

en.q: Which Schedule 2 provisions does item 10 of the AML/CFT Policy guideline expressly link to the payment systems and procedures it requires?
options: Section 13 for remittance transactions, and section 12 for wire transfers
Section 20 for record-keeping, and section 21 for the manner of keeping
Section 10 for politically exposed persons, and section 15 for high risk situations
Section 16 for anonymous accounts, and section 17 for shell banks
en.explain: Item 10 requires elaboration of the relevant payment systems and AML/CFT procedures in remittance transactions — expressly cited as section 13 in Schedule 2 — and wire transfers, cited as section 12 in Schedule 2.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第10項明文將其所要求的支付系統及程序，連繫至附表2哪些條文？
options: 匯款交易的第13條，以及電傳轉帳的第12條
紀錄保存的第20條，以及保存方式的第21條
政治人物的第10條，以及高風險情況的第15條
匿名帳戶的第16條，以及空殼銀行的第17條
tc.explain: 第10項規定須詳述匯款交易（明文援引附表2第13條）及電傳轉帳（援引附表2第12條）中的相關支付系統及打擊洗錢程序。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 10
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第10項

en.q: Which risk-mitigation procedures does item 10 require the policy to describe for remittance and wire transfer transactions?
options: Identifying the source of funds and the identity/legality of counterparts, and monitoring compliance
Elaborating the relevant payment system, fund flow and settlement system, e.g. bank transfer or cash
Screening customers for targeted financial sanctions and PEP risk, applied only to transactions below $8,000
The risk assessment methodology for customer, product and service risk, reviewed only at licence renewal
en.explain: Item 10 requires the policy to cover the relevant payment system/fund flow/settlement system; procedures for other reasonable ML/TF risk-mitigation measures such as identifying the source of funds and the identity/legality of counterparts or related parties; and procedures for monitoring compliance with the AML/CFT policy. The payment-system description (a different clause of item 10 itself), sanctions/PEP screening (item 11, which is not gated by any $8,000 transaction-size threshold) and risk assessment methodology (item 12, an ongoing exercise, not one confined to licence renewal) are related but distinct requirements.

tc.q: 第10項規定政策須就匯款及電傳轉帳交易描述哪些減低風險程序？
options: 識別資金來源及交易對手的身分／合法性，並監察合規情況
詳述相關支付系統、資金流動及結算系統，例如銀行轉帳或現金
就定向金融制裁及政治人物風險篩查客戶，只適用於8,000元以下交易
就客戶、產品及服務風險的風險評估方法，只於續牌時檢討
tc.explain: 第10項規定政策須涵蓋相關支付系統、資金流動及結算系統；為減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險而採取其他合理措施的程序，例如識別資金來源，以及在處理交易時識別交易對手／關連方的身分及合法性；以及監察公司遵從打擊洗錢政策的程序。支付系統描述（第10項本身的另一分句）、制裁／政治人物篩查（第11項，並非以任何8,000元交易金額門檻為篩查條件）及風險評估方法（第12項，屬持續進行的工作，並非只限於續牌時進行）均屬相關但不同的規定。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 11
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第11項

en.q: Against which three risks does the AML/CFT Policy guideline say sanctions screening should be directed?
options: Targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism/TF or proliferation, and PEPs
Credit risk, market risk, and operational risk in the applicant's overall risk framework
Fraud, forgery, and theft affecting the applicant's cash handling operations for amounts below $120,000
Tax evasion, smuggling, and bribery risks in cross-border remittance above the $8,000 threshold
en.explain: Item 11 requires elaboration of sanctions screening procedures, giving as an example screening customers for (a) targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism and TF, (b) targeted financial sanctions related to proliferation, and (c) PEPs — not the generic credit/market/operational risk triad, cash-handling crime risks (which item 11 does not gate by any $120,000 transaction threshold), or cross-border tax/smuggling/bribery risks (which item 11 does not gate by the $8,000 wire-transfer threshold either) — none of which are the three risks item 11 names.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》指出制裁篩查應針對哪三項風險？
options: 與恐怖主義／恐怖分子資金籌集或擴散有關的定向金融制裁，以及政治人物
申請人整體風險架構中的信貸風險、市場風險及營運風險
影響申請人現金處理運作、涉及金額低於120,000元的欺詐、偽造及盜竊
跨境匯款中超過8,000元交易涉及的逃稅、走私及賄賂風險
tc.explain: 第11項規定須詳述進行制裁篩查的程序，並以就下列風險篩查客戶為例：(a)與恐怖主義及恐怖分子資金籌集有關的定向金融制裁；(b)與擴散有關的定向金融制裁；及(c)政治人物——並非一般的信貸／市場／營運風險、現金處理犯罪風險（第11項並無以120,000元交易金額作為門檻），或跨境逃稅／走私／賄賂風險（第11項亦無以8,000元電傳轉帳門檻作為條件）——此三者並非第11項所指的風險。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 15
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第15項

en.q: What is the stated object of the AML/CFT audit function that the policy must describe?
options: Ensuring the AML/CFT systems and programmes match the up-to-date business risk profile
Providing management oversight of the compliance department and any relevant committee or panel
Assessing customer, product and service risk under the applicant's risk assessment methodology
Confirming that all relevant staff have passed the Competence Assessment
en.explain: Item 15 requires the applicant to elaborate its AML/CFT audit function to ensure that its AML/CFT systems and programmes are commensurate with the up-to-date business risk profile, whether by internal or external audit. Management oversight of compliance (item 13) and risk assessment methodology (item 12) are separate items, and passing the Competence Assessment is a licensing requirement for individuals, not the object of the item 15 audit function.

tc.q: 政策須描述的打擊洗錢審計職能，其訂明目的為何？
options: 確保打擊洗錢系統及計劃與最新的業務風險狀況相稱
為合規部門及任何相關委員會或小組提供管理層監督
根據申請人的風險評估方法評估客戶、產品及服務的風險
確認所有相關員工已通過能力評核
tc.explain: 第15項規定申請人須詳述其打擊洗錢審計職能，以確保其打擊洗錢系統／計劃與最新的業務風險狀況相稱，不論以內部或外部審計方式進行。合規監督（第13項）及風險評估方法（第12項）屬其他項目，而通過能力評核是個人的發牌規定，並非第15項審計職能的目的。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: Which four substantive matters must the scope of AML/CFT training cover under item 16 of the policy guideline, apart from the cross-reference to para. 9.7 of the AML Guideline?
options: Staff's STR duties; the MSO's statutory obligations; AML/CFT policies and procedures; and new/emerging ML/TF techniques
Product knowledge, sales technique, customer service standards, and complaint-handling procedures for retail staff, per item 5 (Distribution Channels)
Accounting standards, tax filing rules, employment law obligations, and data privacy compliance for back-office staff, per item 12 (risk assessment procedures)
Cash handling procedures, counterfeit-note detection, till reconciliation, and shift scheduling for counter staff, per item 10 (remittance AML procedures)
en.explain: Item 16 lists the training scope as: (1) staff's personal statutory obligations re STRs; (2) the MSO's statutory obligations; (3) the MSO's AML/CFT policies and procedures; (4) new and emerging ML/TF techniques; and (5) other issues in paragraph 9.7 of the AML Guideline. This question asks for the first four substantive matters, excluding the paragraph 9.7 cross-reference. Each distractor also falsely claims to be drawn from a real item of the same guideline (item 5 Distribution Channels, item 12 risk assessment procedures, item 10 remittance AML procedures) — none of which actually covers retail sales, back-office, or counter-staff training topics.

tc.q: 根據政策指引第16項，除《打擊洗錢指引》第9.7段的交叉參照外，打擊洗錢培訓的範圍須涵蓋哪四項實質事宜？
options: 可疑交易報告責任；經營者的法定責任；政策及程序；以及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集新興技巧
零售員工的產品知識、銷售技巧、客戶服務標準及投訴處理程序，屬政策指引第5項分銷渠道所定
後勤員工的會計準則、報稅規則、僱傭法責任及資料私隱合規，屬政策指引第12項風險評估程序所定
櫃檯員工的現金處理程序、偽鈔識別、櫃檯對帳及輪班編排，屬政策指引第10項匯款程序所定
tc.explain: 第16項列出培訓範圍為：(1)員工就可疑交易報告的個人法定責任；(2)金錢服務經營者的法定責任；(3)該經營者的打擊洗錢政策及程序；(4)洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的新興技巧；以及(5)《打擊洗錢指引》第9.7段所列的其他事項。本題所問為首四項實質事宜，不包括第9.7段的交叉參照。三個錯誤答案亦分別虛稱取自同一指引的真實項目（第5項分銷渠道、第12項風險評估程序、第10項匯款程序）——但該等項目實際上並不涵蓋零售銷售、後勤或櫃檯員工培訓的內容。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: How must an MSO monitor the effectiveness of its AML/CFT training, according to the policy guideline?
options: Testing staff's understanding and ability to spot suspicious transactions
Counting the hours of AML/CFT training delivered to each staff member
Surveying staff satisfaction with the training venue and materials
Comparing the applicant's training spend against industry benchmarks
en.explain: Item 16 states that the MSO will monitor the effectiveness of training by testing staff's understanding of the listed issues and their ability to recognize suspicious transactions, and will separately monitor and maintain records of who has been trained, when, and what type of training was provided — not by counting hours, surveying satisfaction, or benchmarking spend.

tc.q: 根據政策指引，金錢服務經營者須如何監察其打擊洗錢培訓的成效？
options: 測試員工理解及識別可疑交易的能力
計算每名員工所接受打擊洗錢培訓的總時數
調查員工對培訓場地及教材的滿意程度
將申請人的培訓開支與業界基準比較
tc.explain: 第16項訂明金錢服務經營者會透過測試員工對所列事項的理解及其識別可疑交易的能力，監察培訓成效；並會另行監察及備存紀錄，記錄何人接受培訓、何時接受培訓及所提供培訓的類型——並非計算時數、調查滿意度或比較開支基準。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 16
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第16項

en.q: Which three particulars must an MSO record about training delivered?
options: Who was trained, when they received the training, and the type of training provided
The cost of the course, the training venue, and the trainer's professional qualifications
The training duration in hours, the pass rate, and the scheduled retest date
The language of delivery, the materials used, and the staff attendance rate
en.explain: Item 16 requires the MSO to monitor and maintain records of who has been trained, when the staff received the training, and the type of training provided — not cost/venue/trainer credentials, duration/pass-rate/retest scheduling, or delivery language/materials/attendance, none of which the guideline lists as required particulars.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須就所提供的培訓記錄哪三項詳情？
options: 何人接受培訓、員工何時接受培訓，以及所提供培訓的類型
課程費用、培訓地點，以及導師的專業資歷
以小時計的培訓時數、合格率，以及已編排的重考日期
授課語言、所用教材，以及員工的出席率
tc.explain: 第16項規定金錢服務經營者須監察及備存紀錄，記錄何人接受培訓、員工何時接受培訓，以及所提供培訓的類型——並非課程費用／地點／導師資歷、培訓時數／合格率／重考日期，或授課語言／教材／出席率，指引並無規定須記錄這些詳情。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 13
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第13項

en.q: What must the policy elaborate about the compliance function?
options: Management oversight, the compliance department's role, any relevant committee/panel, and the CO and compliance staff's duties
The company's procedures for reporting suspicious transactions, the reporting lines, and the roles of the money laundering reporting officer
The AML/CFT audit function, such as internal or external audit, to ensure systems match the current business risk profile
The applicant's risk assessment methodology, including relevant risk factors and procedures for assessing customers, products and services
en.explain: Item 13 requires elaboration of the AML/CFT compliance function, giving as examples management oversight, the roles of the compliance department, any relevant committee or panel, and the duties of the compliance officer and compliance staff. The distractors are drawn from item 14 (reporting of suspicious transactions), item 15 (AML/CFT audit function) and item 12 (risk assessment procedures).

tc.q: 政策就合規職能須詳述甚麼？
options: 管理層監督、合規部門角色、相關委員會或小組，以及合規主任及人員職責
公司匯報可疑交易的程序、匯報層級，以及洗錢報告主任的角色
打擊洗錢審計職能，例如內部或外部審計，以確保制度配合最新業務風險狀況
申請人的風險評估方法，包括相關風險因素及評估客戶、產品及服務的程序
tc.explain: 第13項規定須詳述打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集合規職能，並以管理層監督、合規部門的角色、任何相關委員會／小組，以及合規主任及合規人員的職責為例。三個錯誤答案分別取自第14項（匯報可疑交易）、第15項（打擊洗錢審計職能）及第12項（風險評估程序）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 14
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第14項

en.q: What must the policy elaborate about the reporting of suspicious transactions?
options: The company's procedures for reporting, the reporting lines, and the roles of the MLRO and relevant staff
Management oversight of compliance, the roles of the compliance department, and any relevant committee or panel
What tipping off means under the AML/CFT framework, and the applicant's legal obligations in this regard
The names of the Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer, and their reporting line
en.explain: Item 14 requires the company's procedures in the reporting process, the relevant reporting lines, and the roles of the money laundering reporting officer and relevant staff. The distractors are drawn from item 13 (compliance function), item 2 (tipping off, under the AML/CFT framework) and item 1 (introduction: appointment of CO and MLRO).

tc.q: 政策就可疑交易的匯報須詳述甚麼？
options: 公司匯報過程的程序、相關匯報層級，以及洗錢報告主任及有關員工的角色
合規職能的管理層監督、合規部門的角色，以及任何相關委員會或小組
何謂《打擊洗錢條例》下的「通風報訊」，以及申請人在這方面的法定責任
合規主任及洗錢報告主任的姓名、聯絡方法及其匯報層級
tc.explain: 第14項規定須詳述公司在匯報可疑交易過程中的程序、相關匯報層級，以及洗錢報告主任及有關員工的角色。三個錯誤答案分別取自第13項（合規職能）、第2項（打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集框架下的「通風報訊」）及第1項（引言：委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 19
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第19項

en.q: What commitment must the policy record regarding regulators and law enforcement?
options: That the applicant will cooperate with C&ED and other law enforcement agencies, where required
That the applicant will notify the C&ED in writing of every transaction exceeding $8,000
That the applicant will grant law enforcement agencies unsupervised access to its systems
That the applicant will submit a compliance report to the Review Tribunal every year
en.explain: Item 19 requires the policy to record that the applicant will cooperate with C&ED on routine inspection or investigation, and with other law enforcement agencies wherever required under the laws of Hong Kong. The distractors misapply a real CDD threshold ($8,000 for occasional transactions), invent a systems-access commitment not required by item 19, and misname the Review Tribunal (an appeal body, not a recipient of routine reports) as the reporting recipient.

tc.q: 政策須就監管機構及執法機關記錄甚麼承諾？
options: 申請人會與香港海關及其他執法機關合作，按香港法律規定
申請人會就超過8,000元的交易以書面通知香港海關
申請人會讓執法機關直接及不受監督地查閱其系統
申請人會每年向覆核審裁處提交合規報告
tc.explain: 第19項規定政策須記錄申請人會就例行視察或調查與香港海關合作，並會在香港法律規定的情況下與其他執法機關合作。三個錯誤答案分別套用了一個真實但不相關的門檻（非經常交易的8,000元）、虛構的系統查閱承諾，以及把覆核審裁處（上訴機構，並非例行報告的對象）誤作匯報對象。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 12
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第12項

en.q: What must the policy elaborate under “risk assessment procedures”?
options: The applicant's risk assessment methodology, including relevant risk factors and assessment procedures
The procedures for conducting sanctions screening, such as screening for targeted financial sanctions and PEPs
The compliance function, including management oversight and the duties of the compliance officer
The AML/CFT audit function, to ensure systems match the applicant's up-to-date business risk profile
en.explain: Item 12 requires elaboration of the applicant's risk assessment methodology for AML/CFT purposes, giving as examples relevant risk factors and the procedures for assessing the risk of customers, products and services. The distractors are drawn from item 11 (AML/CFT screening process), item 13 (compliance function) and item 15 (AML/CFT audit function).

tc.q: 政策在「風險評估程序」下須詳述甚麼？
options: 申請人為打擊洗錢採用的風險評估方法，包括風險因素及評估程序
進行制裁篩查的程序，例如針對相關的定向金融制裁及政治人物的篩查
合規職能，包括管理層監督、合規部門角色及合規主任的職責
打擊洗錢審計職能，以確保制度配合申請人最新的業務風險狀況
tc.explain: 第12項規定須詳述申請人為打擊洗錢用途所採用的風險評估方法，並以相關風險因素及評估客戶、產品及服務風險的程序為例。三個錯誤答案分別取自第11項（打擊洗錢篩查程序）、第13項（合規職能）及第15項（打擊洗錢審計職能）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 3
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第3項

en.q: What question does the AML/CFT Policy guideline pose as the core of transaction monitoring?
options: What is a "normal" level of business activity, and is it consistent with knowledge of the customer
Whether the customer's KYC information remains up to date, which is the focus of customer monitoring
The way the applicant makes profit from the business, such as a percentage of each transaction or a handling charge
The company's procedures for record keeping and retrieval of CDD and transaction records within a reasonable timeframe
en.explain: Item 3, under on-going monitoring, distinguishes customer monitoring from transaction monitoring and frames the latter around what is a normal level of business activity and what is not, and whether the transaction is consistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer and profile. The distractors are drawn from a different part of item 3 (customer monitoring; record keeping) and from item 9 (revenue model).

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》將哪一問題列為交易監察的核心？
options: 何謂「正常」業務活動水平，以及交易是否與其對客戶的認識相符
客戶的「認識你的客戶」資料是否維持最新，此為客戶監察的重點
申請人從業務中獲利的方式，例如按每宗交易收取某百分比或手續費
公司就客戶盡職審查及交易紀錄的備存及在合理時限內查閱的程序
tc.explain: 第3項在持續監察下區分客戶監察與交易監察，並將後者的核心界定為：何謂「正常」的業務活動水平、何謂不正常，以及該交易是否與經營者對該客戶及其狀況的認識相符。三個錯誤答案分別取自第3項下的另一子項目（客戶監察、紀錄備存）及第9項（收益模式）。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), introduction
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）引言

en.q: How does the AML/CFT Policy guideline describe the list of items it tabulates?
options: By no means exhaustive - the applicant must consider other issues peculiar to its business model
Exhaustive and mandatory - an applicant satisfies its AMLO obligations by completing every listed item
Applicable only to applicants intending to offer remittance rather than money changing services
Applicable only to applicants that propose to employ more than ten full-time staff members
en.explain: The introduction states that the items tabulated are by no means exhaustive and that the applicant must consider any other important issues peculiar to its business model, so as to facilitate a practical and effective policy. The distractors invert this (treating the list as exhaustive and self-sufficient) or invent scope limits - by service type or headcount - that the introduction does not impose.

tc.q: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》如何描述其列表所載的項目？
options: 絕非詳盡無遺，申請人須考慮其業務特有的其他事項
詳盡無遺並具強制性——填妥項目即符合法定規定
只適用於擬提供匯款服務而非貨幣兌換服務的申請人
只適用於擬僱用超過十名全職員工的申請人
tc.explain: 引言訂明列表所載項目絕非詳盡無遺，申請人仍須考慮其業務模式特有的其他重要事項，以有助制定切實可行而有效的政策。三個錯誤答案將此說法倒轉（視列表為詳盡無遺且本身已足夠），或虛構引言並無訂明的服務類型或員工人數限制。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第1.2段

en.q: What does the Licensing Guide set out, besides the licensing requirements and application procedures?
options: Information on the on-going obligations of an MSO licensee, and possible actions C&ED may take
The detailed syllabus and format of the Competence Assessment conducted by C&ED
The customer due diligence measures that a licensee must carry out under Schedule 2 to the AMLO
The procedure for a licensee to apply to the Review Tribunal for review of a decision of the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 1.2 states that the guide sets out notes on the licensing requirements and explains the application procedures, and also provides information on the on-going obligations for licensees and possible actions taken by C&ED for improper acts. The distractors describe the content of other real documents - the Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment, Schedule 2 to the AMLO, and the Review Tribunal appeal procedure - none of which paragraph 1.2 says the Licensing Guide itself sets out.

tc.q: 除發牌規定及申請程序外，《牌照指引》還載述甚麼？
options: 持牌人的持續責任資料，以及香港海關可能採取的行動
香港海關進行能力評核所採用的詳細課程綱要及考核格式
持牌人須根據《打擊洗錢條例》附表2進行的客戶盡職審查措施
持牌人向覆核審裁處就關長的決定申請覆核的程序
tc.explain: 第1.2段訂明本指引載述發牌規定的說明並詳細解釋申請程序，亦提供持牌人持續責任的資料，以及香港海關就不當行為可能採取的行動。三個錯誤答案描述其他真實文件的內容——能力評核指引須知、《打擊洗錢條例》附表2，以及向覆核審裁處提出的上訴程序——皆非第1.2段所指《牌照指引》本身載述的內容。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.3段

en.q: Besides the hotel exception, which activity does the Licensing Guide say is NOT a money changing service?
options: A currency exchange service incidental to the main business, e.g. accepting foreign currency in retail transactions
Any currency exchange service provided to fewer than ten walk-in customers in a single day
Any currency exchange transaction below $8,000, the threshold for occasional transactions under Schedule 2
Any currency exchange service operated by a company incorporated outside Hong Kong but registered locally
en.explain: Paragraph 2.3 states that a money changing service does not include a currency exchange service incidental to the main business - for example a retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions - or the hotel service meeting the two stated conditions. The distractors invent a customer-count threshold, misapply the real $8,000 occasional-transaction CDD threshold from Schedule 2, and invent a place-of-incorporation exception, none of which paragraph 2.3 recognizes.

tc.q: 除酒店例外情況外，《牌照指引》指出哪一項活動並非貨幣兌換服務？
options: 附帶於主要業務的貨幣兌換服務，例如零售接受外幣
每日為少於十名現場客戶提供的貨幣兌換服務
涉及款額低於8,000元的兌換交易——附表2非經常交易門檻
由在香港以外註冊成立但於本地登記的公司經營的貨幣兌換服務
tc.explain: 第2.3段訂明貨幣兌換服務不包括附帶於主要業務的該等服務（例如零售業務在交易中接受外幣），亦不包括符合兩項訂明條件的酒店服務。三個錯誤答案分別虛構客戶人數門檻、將附表2非經常交易的真實8,000元門檻誤用於此，以及虛構註冊地點的例外情況。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.6段

en.q: During an application for the grant of a licence, must an applicant make a separate application for each additional premises at which money service will be operated?
options: No — each additional premises must be included in the same application, with a fee paid
Yes — a separate application form must be submitted for each additional premises
Yes, but only where the additional premises is located in a different district
No — and no additional fee is payable, since the principal premises fee covers every extra premises
en.explain: Paragraph 2.6 states that a separate application is not required: the applicant must include each additional premises in the licence application and pay a fee for each additional business premises to be registered. The distractors invert the no-separate-application answer, invent a district-based exception, and misstate the fee position.

tc.q: 在申請批出牌照時，申請人是否須就每個將經營金錢服務的額外處所另行提出申請？
options: 否——每個額外處所須包括在同一份申請內
是——每個額外處所均須另行填妥並提交一份獨立申請表格
是，但只限該額外處所位於不同地區，須個別提出申請
否——而且無須繳付額外費用，因主要處所費用已涵蓋全部
tc.explain: 第2.6段訂明無須另行提出申請：申請人須將每個額外處所包括在牌照申請內，並須為每個擬登記的額外業務處所繳付費用。三個錯誤答案分別倒轉「無須另行申請」的答案、虛構按地區劃分的例外，以及誤述費用安排。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.8及4.14段；《打擊洗錢條例》第34(7)條

en.q: What is the position on refunds of the application fee and the fit and proper person test fee?
options: Neither fee is refunded, irrespective of whether the application is approved or refused
Both fees are refunded in full if the application is ultimately refused by the CCE
The application fee is refunded, but the fit and proper person test fee is not
Both fees are refunded if the applicant withdraws the application before the interview
en.explain: Paragraph 2.8 states that no refund is made for the application fee irrespective of whether the application is later approved or refused, and paragraph 4.14 states that the fit and proper person test fee is non-refundable; section 34(7) of the AMLO applies the same no-refund principle where a licence is revoked. The distractors invent refund triggers (refusal, withdrawal before interview) and a false distinction between the two fees, none of which the source recognizes.

tc.q: 申請費用及適當人選測試費用的退款安排為何？
options: 兩者均不獲退還，不論申請獲批准或被拒絕
如申請最終被關長拒絕，兩項費用均會全數退還
申請費用獲退還，但適當人選測試費用不獲退還
如申請人在面談前撤回申請，兩項費用均獲退還
tc.explain: 第2.8段訂明不論申請其後獲批准或被拒絕，已收取的申請費用概不退還；第4.14段訂明適當人選測試費用不獲退還；《打擊洗錢條例》第34(7)條就撤銷牌照訂有相同的不獲退還原則。三個錯誤答案虛構了退款觸發情況（被拒絕、面談前撤回）及兩項費用的錯誤區分，均非來源所載。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.11段；《打擊洗錢條例》第29(2)(b)條

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, what is the penalty on summary conviction for operating a money service without a licence?
options: A fine of $100,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment
A fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year
en.explain: Paragraph 2.11 states the section 29(2) penalties as, on conviction on indictment, a fine of HK$1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years; or on summary conviction, a fine of $100,000 and imprisonment for 6 months. The $100,000 figure corresponds to a fine at level 6 in the AMLO's own wording.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，無牌經營金錢服務循簡易程序定罪的刑罰為何？
options: 罰款100,000元及監禁6個月
罰款50,000元及監禁6個月
罰款1,000,000元及監禁2年
罰款200,000元及監禁1年
tc.explain: 第2.11段訂明第29(2)條的刑罰為：循公訴程序定罪，罰款1,000,000港元及監禁2年；或循簡易程序定罪，罰款100,000元及監禁6個月。該100,000元相當於《打擊洗錢條例》本身表述的第6級罰款。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第3.1段

en.q: What does the Licensing Guide say the CCE will do if an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing requirements?
options: The CCE will not accept any application for the grant or renewal of a licence
The CCE will grant a licence on simplified terms
The CCE will refer the applicant to the relevant alternative regulator for a licence
The CCE will grant a licence subject to additional conditions
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 lists the exempt categories — the Government, authorized institutions, and various licensed bodies operating a money service ancillary to their principal business — and states that the CCE will not accept any application for the grant or renewal of a licence if an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing requirements.

tc.q: 如申請人已獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌規定，《牌照指引》訂明海關關長會怎樣做？
options: 關長不會接受任何批出或續期牌照的申請
關長會按簡化條款批出牌照
關長會將申請人轉介相關的另一監管機構申領牌照
關長會附加額外條件批出牌照
tc.explain: 第3.1段列出獲豁免類別——政府、認可機構，以及經營附屬於其主要業務的金錢服務的各類持牌團體——並訂明如申請人已獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌規定，關長不會接受任何批出或續期牌照的申請。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide define an SVF licensee?
options: A person who is granted a licence under section 8F of Cap. 584
A person granted a licence under section 2A of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance
Any issuer of a stored value facility in Hong Kong, whether or not the issuer is licensed
Any person licensed by the Monetary Authority for any purpose whatsoever, whether or not under Cap. 584
en.explain: Paragraph 3.7 states that an SVF licensee means a person granted a licence under section 8F of the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance, Cap. 584. The distractors misstate the section number (section 2A defines stored value facility, not the licensee), drop the licensing requirement entirely, and misstate the licensing body's scope.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何界定儲值支付工具持牌人？
options: 根據第584章第8F條獲批給牌照的人
根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》第2A條獲批給牌照的人
在香港發行儲值支付工具的任何人，不論該人是否持牌
獲金融管理專員就第584章下為任何目的而發牌的任何人
tc.explain: 第3.7段訂明儲值支付工具持牌人指根據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》（第584章）第8F條獲批給牌照的人。三個錯誤答案分別誤引條文編號（第2A條界定的是儲值支付工具，而非持牌人）、完全略去持牌規定，以及誤述發牌機構的權限範圍。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.4段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of particular premises that must be registered?
options: Premises advertised, including by a signboard, for meeting customers there
Premises that the licensee visits only as a customer of a bank
An accountant's office used only to process the licensee's accounting documents
A dining establishment where the licensee occasionally meets business contacts
en.explain: Paragraph 4.4 gives as an example of particular premises those advertised, including by a signboard on display, for meeting customers there. The distractors are the paragraph's own examples of premises that are NOT particular premises: a bank visited as a customer, an accountant's office used only to process documents, and a dining establishment visited as a customer.

tc.q: 下列何者屬須登記的特定處所例子？
options: 有作宣傳（招牌）以在該處會見客戶的處所
持牌人僅以銀行客戶身分到訪的處所
僅用作處理該持牌人會計文件的會計師辦事處
持牌人偶爾在該處會見業務聯絡人的餐飲場所
tc.explain: 第4.4段舉出的特定處所例子包括有作宣傳（包括展示招牌）以在該處會見客戶的處所。三個錯誤答案正是同一段訂明並非特定處所的例子：以銀行客戶身分到訪、僅為處理文件而到訪的會計師辦事處，以及以顧客身分到訪的餐飲場所。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.4段

en.q: Are premises treated as particular premises where the licensee attends only as a visitor or customer?
options: No — dining establishments, banks, or accountant/solicitor firms visited to process documents
Yes — any premises where the licensee meets a customer or discusses business must be registered
Yes, but only if the licensee attends those premises more than once a month specifically to meet customers
Only if the licensee's own signboard or registered business name is displayed at those premises
en.explain: Paragraph 4.4 states that premises are not treated as particular premises if the licensee is only a visitor or a customer at premises such as dining establishments or banks, or at accountant or solicitor firms merely for processing documents. The distractors invent an over-broad registration duty, a frequency threshold, and a signboard condition, none of which paragraph 4.4 imposes on visitor/customer premises.

tc.q: 如持牌人僅以訪客或顧客身分到訪某處所，該處所是否視為特定處所？
options: 否——僅為處理文件而到訪的餐飲場所、銀行或專業行號
是——任何持牌人會見客戶或商討業務的處所，一律均須登記
是，但只限持牌人每月到訪該處所多於一次，專門用作會見客戶
只限該處展示持牌人本身的招牌或已登記的商號名稱
tc.explain: 第4.4段訂明，如持牌人僅以訪客或顧客身分到訪餐飲場所或銀行等處所，或僅為處理會計或法律文件而到訪會計師或律師行，該等處所不視為特定處所。三個錯誤答案分別虛構過寬的登記責任、到訪頻次門檻，以及招牌展示的條件，均非第4.4段就訪客／顧客處所訂明的規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.5段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of NOT operating a money service at particular premises?
options: Conducting transactions with the use of mobile electronic devices
Operating from a leased shopfront with a signboard
Operating from an office regularly controlled by the licensee as tenant
Operating from premises shared with a clearly partitioned other business
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 gives three examples of not operating at particular premises: operating without any fixed premises, such as a door-to-door service; meeting customers at a customer's office; and conducting transactions with the use of mobile electronic devices.

tc.q: 下列何者屬「並非在特定處所經營金錢服務」的例子？
options: 使用流動電子裝置進行交易
在租用並設有招牌的地舖經營
在持牌人以租客身分經常控制的辦公室經營
在與其他業務共用但已清楚間隔的處所經營
tc.explain: 第4.5段舉出三個並非在特定處所經營的例子：並無任何固定處所而經營（例如上門服務）；在客戶辦公室會見客戶；以及使用流動電子裝置進行交易。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.5段

en.q: What three items must an applicant with no particular business premises provide in the application form?
options: A local management office, correspondence address, and a place to store books and records
A registered office address, a banker's reference letter, and a copy of the business plan
A residential address, a mobile telephone number, and a personal email address
A service provider's address, a tenancy agreement, and a floor plan of the premises
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 states that if there are no particular premises for operating the money service, the applicant must provide a local management office, a correspondence address, and a local place for storage of books and records in the application form. The distractors substitute other plausible-sounding but unrequired items - none of which paragraph 4.5 asks for.

tc.q: 並無特定業務處所的申請人，須在申請表格中提供哪三項？
options: 本地管理辦事處、通訊地址，以及本地存放簿冊紀錄處
註冊辦事處地址、銀行證明信，以及業務計劃副本
住址、流動電話號碼，以及個人電郵地址
服務供應商地址、租約，以及處所的樓面平面圖
tc.explain: 第4.5段訂明，如並無經營金錢服務的特定處所，申請人須在申請表格中提供本地管理辦事處、通訊地址，以及本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方。三個錯誤答案均以其他看似合理但第4.5段並無要求的項目取代。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Which of the following is expressly listed as NOT suitable to be registered for operating a money service?
options: Particular premises situated in a wholly residential building
Particular premises situated in a mixed commercial and residential building where written consent has been secured
Particular premises accessible by C&ED officers
Particular premises on the ground floor of a commercial building
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 lists as not suitable: premises in a wholly residential building; premises being used by another MSO or declared by another applicant; premises not accessible without permission of the occupant of another business sharing them; and premises whose signboard business name differs from that on the Business Registration Certificate submitted.

tc.q: 下列何者明文列為不適合登記用作經營金錢服務？
options: 位於純住宅樓宇的特定處所
位於商住混合樓宇並已取得書面同意的特定處所
香港海關人員可進入的特定處所
位於商業大廈地下的特定處所
tc.explain: 第4.6段列為不適合的包括：位於純住宅樓宇的處所；正由其他金錢服務經營者使用或已由其他申請人申報的處所；未經共用處所的其他業務佔用人准許或協助便無法進入的處所；以及招牌上的業務名稱與所提交商業登記證上的業務名稱不同的處所。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Why are premises not accessible without the permission of the occupant of another business considered unsuitable?
options: Because the area occupied by another party becomes the de facto entrance to the particular premises
Because the premises would then be situated in a wholly residential building
Because the signboard would display a business name different from the Business Registration Certificate
Because the premises might already be declared by another applicant for an MSO licence
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 gives this as one of four examples of unsuitable premises, because the area occupied or owned by another party becomes, in effect, the entrance to the particular premises. The distractors are the paragraph's other three unsuitability examples - a wholly residential building, a mismatched signboard name, and premises already declared by another applicant - each a real but different reason under the same paragraph.

tc.q: 為何未經共用處所的其他業務佔用人准許便無法進入的處所被視為不適合？
options: 因另一方佔用或擁有的範圍實際上成為該特定處所的入口
因該處所將因而座落於完全用作住宅用途的樓宇內
因招牌顯示的商號名稱與商業登記證上登記的名稱不同
因該處所可能已由另一名申請人為申請金錢服務經營者牌照而申報
tc.explain: 第4.6段將此列為不適合登記處所的其中一個例子，原因是另一方佔用或擁有的範圍實際上成為該特定處所的入口。三個錯誤答案是同一段所列的其餘三個不適合例子——完全住宅樓宇、招牌名稱與商業登記證不符，以及已由另一申請人申報——各屬同段下不同的理由。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Why is a mismatch between the signboard name and the Business Registration Certificate a ground for treating premises as unsuitable?
options: Because the signboard shows a business name different from the one on the Business Registration Certificate
Because the premises are located in a wholly residential building, not a mixed commercial and residential one
Because the premises are already being used by another MSO for its money service, or declared by another applicant for a licence
Because the premises cannot be accessed without the permission of another occupant sharing the premises
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6(d) lists as not suitable premises where the business name displayed on the signboard differs from the business name registered in the Business Registration Certificate submitted for the licence application or notification of changes. The three wrong answers are the other not-suitable grounds in paragraph 4.6(a)-(c) — wholly residential, already used/declared by another MSO, or inaccessible without another occupant's permission — none of which concerns the signboard/BRC mismatch.

tc.q: 為何招牌名稱與商業登記證不符會構成處所不適合的理由？
options: 因招牌所示業務名稱，與就申請提交的商業登記證業務名稱不同
因處所位於純住宅樓宇內，而非商住混合樓宇
因處所現由另一經營者經營金錢服務，或已被另一申請人申報
因未經共用處所的其他業務佔用人同意，便不能進入該處所
tc.explain: 第4.6(d)段將下列處所列為不適合：處所招牌上展示的業務名稱，與就牌照申請或詳情變更通知所提交的商業登記證上登記的業務名稱不同。三個錯誤答案分別是第4.6(a)至(c)段所列的其餘不適合理由——純住宅樓宇、已由其他經營者使用或申報，或未經其他業務佔用人同意不能進入——均與招牌／商業登記證不符無關。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.7段

en.q: Who must the personnel in a licensee's local management office be?
options: The sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or Compliance Officer
The licensee's Money Laundering Reporting Officer, acting alone without the Compliance Officer
Any staff member of the licensee authorized in writing by the board of directors to represent it
A representative of the licensee's company secretarial firm, accounting firm or solicitor firm
en.explain: Paragraph 4.7 states that personnel in the LMO must be the sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or Compliance Officer of the licensee — not the MLRO acting alone (who is not named in this list), not staff merely authorized by the board (that is the paragraph 5.5 test for who attends the licensing interview), and not a representative of a service provider such as a company secretarial, accounting or solicitor firm, which paragraph 4.7 expressly excludes.

tc.q: 持牌人本地管理辦事處的人員必須是何人？
options: 獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人或合規主任
該持牌人的洗錢報告主任單獨擔任，而沒有合規主任在場
經該持牌人董事會書面授權，代表該持牌人的任何職員
該持牌人的公司秘書事務所、會計師行或律師行的代表
tc.explain: 第4.7段訂明本地管理辦事處的人員必須是該持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人及／或合規主任——並非單獨擔任的洗錢報告主任（該人員清單並無提及洗錢報告主任），也不是僅經董事會書面授權的職員（那是第5.5段就何人須出席發牌面談所訂的規定），亦不是公司秘書事務所、會計師行或律師行等服務供應商的代表，第4.7段明文將其剔除。

en.q: Which addresses will the CCE NOT accept as an MSO's local management office or local place for storage of books and records?
options: The MSO's residential address, and its service-provider's address (company secretarial, accounting or solicitor firm)
Any premises situated in a wholly residential building, which is unsuitable for particular premises generally
Any premises being used by another MSO to operate its money service business, or declared by another applicant
Any premises in a mixed commercial and residential building where occupants' written consent has not been secured
en.explain: Paragraphs 4.7 and 4.11 state that the residential address/premises of an MSO, or the address/premises of its service provider — such as a company secretarial firm, accounting firm or solicitor firm — will not be accepted by the CCE as the LMO or LPS. The distractors describe separate rules: a wholly residential building relates to the general suitability of particular premises (paragraph 4.6(a)), shared use by another MSO is paragraph 4.6(b)/4.8, and occupants' written consent is paragraph 4.6(b)/4.10 — none of which is the LMO/LPS address exclusion.

tc.q: 關長不會接受哪些地址作為金錢服務經營者的本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方？
options: 該經營者的住址及服務供應商地址（如公司秘書、會計或律師行）
位於純住宅樓宇內的處所，此類處所一般不適合作特定處所之用
已由另一經營者用以經營金錢服務，或被另一申請人申報的處所
位於商住混合樓宇但未取得每名佔用人書面同意的處所
tc.explain: 第4.7及4.11段均訂明，金錢服務經營者本身的住址／住宅處所，或其服務供應商（例如公司秘書事務所、會計師行或律師行）的地址／處所，不會獲關長接納為該經營者的本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方。三個錯誤答案分別描述其他規定：純住宅樓宇涉及特定處所的一般適合性（第4.6(a)段）、由另一經營者共用涉及第4.6(b)／4.8段，而佔用人書面同意則涉及第4.6(b)／4.10段——均非本地管理辦事處／存放地方的地址剔除規定。

en.q: What must the landlord of an LMO or LPS do, and how must it be evidenced?
options: Grant permission to use the premises, recorded in the tenancy agreement or a landlord's letter
Confirm in writing to C&ED that the premises are not situated in a wholly residential building
Give a personal undertaking to the CCE that the premises will remain available for inspection at all times
Register the signed tenancy agreement with the Land Registry before the application is submitted
en.explain: Both paragraphs state that the landlord of the LMO or LPS must grant permission to the licensee to use the premises for money service business, recorded in the tenancy agreement or in a letter from the landlord to the applicant. Confirming the building type is a paragraph 4.6 suitability matter for the CCE (not a landlord duty), a personal undertaking of continuous availability is not required, and Land Registry registration of the tenancy is not mentioned anywhere in the Licensing Guide.

tc.q: 本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方的業主須作出甚麼？須如何證明？
options: 批准將處所用於業務，並記載於租約內或業主發出的信件中
向海關書面確認該處所並非位於純住宅樓宇內，而是商住混合樓宇
向關長作出個人承諾，保證該處所在任何時候均可供視察及查閱
在遞交申請前，將已簽署的租約正本於土地註冊處註冊備案
tc.explain: 兩段均訂明本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方的業主，必須批准持牌人將該處所用於金錢服務業務，並記載於該處所的租約內，或由業主向申請人發出的信件中。確認樓宇類別屬第4.6段關長考慮處所適合性的事宜（並非業主的責任），保證處所隨時可供視察並非規定，而《牌照指引》亦無提及須將租約於土地註冊處註冊。

en.q: What are the consequences of failing to submit LMO or LPS information, and of failing to maintain them once licensed?
options: Failure to submit invalidates the application; failure to maintain leads to suspension or revocation of the licence
Both attract a pecuniary penalty of up to HK$1,000,000 under section 29 of the AMLO for operating without a licence
Both constitute a criminal offence under section 52 of the AMLO, punishable by a fine of up to $50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
Both result in automatic referral to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal for a fresh decision
en.explain: Paragraphs 4.7 and 4.11 state that failure to submit LMO or LPS information renders the application invalid, unprocessed and possibly refused, while failure to maintain them once licensed results in suspension and/or revocation — these are administrative consequences, not the section 29 offence (which punishes operating without any licence) or the section 52 offence (which punishes omitting a material particular from an application), and the Review Tribunal only hears appeals brought by an applicant, it is not an automatic referral mechanism.

tc.q: 未有提交本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方的資料，以及領牌後未能維持該等處所，各有甚麼後果？
options: 未有提交會令申請無效；未能維持則會導致牌照被暫時吊銷或撤銷
兩者均會招致根據《打擊洗錢條例》第29條就無牌經營處以最高100萬港元的罰款
兩者均構成《打擊洗錢條例》第52條所訂罪行，最高可處罰款5萬元及監禁6個月
兩者均會自動轉交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處重新作出決定
tc.explain: 第4.7及4.11段訂明，未有提交本地管理辦事處或本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方的資料，會令申請被視為無效、不獲處理，並可能導致拒發牌照；而領牌後未能維持該等處所，則會導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷——這些均屬行政後果，並非第29條（懲處無牌經營）或第52條（懲處在申請中遺漏要項）所訂的罪行，而覆核審裁處只受理由申請人提出的上訴，並非自動轉介機制。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.8段

en.q: Where another business is run on the same premises as the applicant's money service, what does the Licensing Guide require?
options: The money service must be partitioned; sharing premises with another MSO is not accepted
The other business sharing the premises must relocate within 90 days of the licence being granted
The applicant must obtain and retain a copy of the other business's Business Registration Certificate
The other business operating on the premises must also hold a valid MSO licence
en.explain: Paragraph 4.8 states that where other business is run on the same premises, the money service business must be clearly partitioned and distinguished from the other business, and that sharing the premises with another MSO to operate money service business will not be accepted. No 90-day relocation period, BRC-copy requirement, or licensing of the other business is mentioned; the 90-day figure instead belongs to the renewal reminder in paragraph 6.2.

tc.q: 如申請人的金錢服務與其他業務在同一處所經營，《牌照指引》有何規定？
options: 金錢服務須與其他業務分隔；與經營者共用處所不獲接受
共用處所的其他業務須在牌照批出後90日內遷離
申請人須取得並保留該其他業務的商業登記證副本
在該處所經營的其他業務亦須持有有效的金錢服務經營者牌照
tc.explain: 第4.8段訂明，如同一處所經營其他業務，金錢服務業務必須與其他業務清楚間隔及區分，而與另一金錢服務經營者共用處所以經營金錢服務業務不獲接受。第4.8段並無提及90日遷離期、須取得商業登記證副本，或該其他業務須領牌等規定；90日這數字其實屬於第6.2段的續牌提示通知期。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.9段

en.q: An applicant omits from its application premises that are required to be registered. Which offence is engaged?
options: Section 52(2) of the AMLO — omitting a material particular, knowingly or recklessly
Section 29(1) of the AMLO — operating a money service without holding a licence at all
Section 40(1) of the AMLO — failing to notify the CCE of a change in particulars within one month
Section 38(1) of the AMLO — operating at premises not added to the licence by the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 4.9 states that section 52(2) makes it an offence to omit a material particular in connection with a licence application, knowing or reckless as to the omission, punishable under section 52(3) by a fine of up to $50,000 and imprisonment for up to 6 months. Sections 29(1), 40(1) and 38(1) are real but distinct offences — operating without any licence, failing to notify a change within a month, and operating at unregistered premises — none of which describes omitting premises from the original application.

tc.q: 申請人在申請書中遺漏須登記的處所。這觸犯哪一項罪行？
options: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52(2)條——遺漏要項，而知道或罔顧
《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)條——在完全沒有牌照的情況下經營金錢服務
《打擊洗錢條例》第40(1)條——未有在一個月內將詳情變更以書面通知關長
《打擊洗錢條例》第38(1)條——在未經關長加入牌照的處所經營
tc.explain: 第4.9段訂明，第52(2)條將在牌照申請中遺漏要項（而知道或罔顧該要項是否被遺漏）訂為罪行，並可根據第52(3)條處以最高罰款5萬元及監禁6個月。第29(1)、40(1)及38(1)條均屬真實但截然不同的罪行——分別是完全無牌經營、未能在一個月內通知變更，以及在未加入牌照的處所經營——皆不是指在原申請中遺漏處所。

en.q: What must a local place for storage of books and records hold, and under whose control must it be?
options: The full set of books and records for the MSO's money service transactions, controlled by the licensee
The correspondence address and personnel who serve as C&ED's point of contact, controlled by the sole proprietor, partner or director
The company's AML/CFT policies, procedures and controls in its operational areas, controlled by the Compliance Officer
Photocopies of the requisite supporting documents listed in the application form, controlled by the landlord
en.explain: Paragraph 4.11 states that the LPS is a physical place for keeping the full set of books and records relating to the MSO's money service transactions, which must be under the control of the licensee so C&ED officers can access them. The first wrong answer describes the LMO (paragraph 4.7), the second describes the AML Policy (paragraph 5.2), and the third describes the application checklist (paragraph 5.1) — all real requirements, but none of them is what the LPS itself must hold.

tc.q: 本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方須存放甚麼？須由何人控制？
options: 該經營者金錢服務交易的全套簿冊及紀錄，由持牌人控制
作為海關聯絡點的通訊地址及人員，由獨資經營者、合夥人或董事控制
打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策、程序及管控措施，由合規主任控制
申請表格所列所需證明文件的影印本，由業主控制
tc.explain: 第4.11段訂明，本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方是用以存放該經營者金錢服務交易全套簿冊及紀錄的實體地方，須由持牌人控制，以便海關人員查閱。第一個錯誤答案描述的是本地管理辦事處（第4.7段），第二個描述的是打擊洗錢政策（第5.2段），第三個描述的是申請文件核對清單（第5.1段）——三者均為真實規定，但都不是本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方本身須存放的內容。

en.q: Who is the 'authorized person' referred to in the Licensing Guide's requirement for occupants' written consent?
options: Any person authorized by the CCE under section 9(12) of the AMLO
Any officer of the Customs and Excise Department, regardless of rank
Any authorized officer appointed under section 46 of the AMLO for Part 5 purposes
Any police officer accompanying a C&ED inspection of the premises
en.explain: Paragraph 4.12 defines an authorized person as any person authorized by the CCE under section 9(12) of the AMLO. This is narrower than every C&ED officer, and is distinct from an 'authorized officer' appointed by the Commissioner under section 46 for Part 5 investigatory purposes (a different, enforcement-related role); a police officer has no role under this provision at all.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》要求取得佔用人書面同意時所指的「獲授權人」是何人？
options: 關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第9(12)條授權的任何人
海關的任何人員，不論其職級或職務為何
根據《打擊洗錢條例》第46條委任的第5部獲授權人員
陪同海關人員視察處所的任何警務人員或保安人員
tc.explain: 第4.12段將「獲授權人」界定為關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第9(12)條授權的任何人。這比「海關的任何人員」的範圍窄，亦有別於關長根據第46條為第5部調查目的而委任的「獲授權人員」（屬另一執法相關的角色）；警務人員在本條文下並無任何角色。

en.q: Must the Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer be employees of the applicant?
options: Yes, unless the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also CO and MLRO
No — the CO and MLRO may instead be engaged as external consultants under a service agreement with the applicant
Yes, without exception — neither may ever be the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the applicant
Yes, but the employee requirement under the Employment Ordinance applies to the MLRO only, not the Compliance Officer
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(a) states that, except where the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the applicant is also the CO and MLRO, both must be the applicant's employee under the Employment Ordinance, Cap. 57 — they cannot simply be external consultants, the owner-officer exception is real (so 'without exception' is wrong), and the requirement applies equally to the CO and the MLRO, not the MLRO alone.

tc.q: 合規主任及洗錢報告主任是否必須是申請人的僱員？
options: 是，除非該獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任該兩職
否——合規主任及洗錢報告主任可改為根據服務協議聘用的外聘顧問，毋須是僱員
是，且沒有例外——兩者均永不可以是申請人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人
是，但《僱傭條例》的僱員規定只適用於洗錢報告主任，不適用於合規主任
tc.explain: 第4.15(a)段訂明，除非申請人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，否則兩者均須為根據香港法例第57章《僱傭條例》定義下該申請人的僱員——他們不能只是外聘顧問，東主兼任的例外情況確實存在（故「沒有例外」是錯的），而僱員規定同樣適用於合規主任及洗錢報告主任，並非只適用於洗錢報告主任。

en.q: What are the respective roles of the CO and the MLRO as stated in the Licensing Guide?
options: The CO oversees the AML/CFT systems and compliance measures; the MLRO is the STR reference point
The MLRO oversees the AML/CFT systems and compliance measures, while the CO reports suspicious transactions to the JFIU
Both the CO and the MLRO act solely as the licensee's point of contact for interfacing with C&ED, with no other oversight function
The CO is responsible for preparing and submitting the licensee's Business Plan, while the MLRO is responsible for its AML Policy
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(a) requires an applicant to appoint a competent CO and MLRO to act respectively as the focal point for oversight of the applicant's AML/CFT systems and compliance measures, and the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions. The first wrong answer simply swaps the two roles, the second describes the LMO's function under paragraph 4.7 (not the CO/MLRO's roles), and the third confuses the officers with the Business Plan and AML Policy documents described in paragraph 5.2, which are prepared by the applicant, not assigned to either officer individually.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》訂明合規主任與洗錢報告主任的角色分別為何？
options: 合規主任是監督打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統及合規措施的統籌點；洗錢報告主任則是可疑交易的匯報點
洗錢報告主任監督打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統及合規措施，合規主任向聯合財富情報組匯報可疑交易
合規主任及洗錢報告主任均只擔任持牌人與香港海關聯絡溝通的接觸點，並無其他監督職能
合規主任負責擬備並提交持牌人的業務計劃，而洗錢報告主任則負責其打擊洗錢政策
tc.explain: 第4.15(a)段規定申請人須委任稱職的合規主任及洗錢報告主任，分別擔任監督申請人打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集系統及合規措施的統籌點，以及匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點。第一個錯誤答案只是將兩個角色對調；第二個描述的是第4.7段本地管理辦事處的功能（並非合規主任／洗錢報告主任的角色）；第三個則將兩名主任與第5.2段所述、由申請人（而非個別主任）擬備的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策混淆。

en.q: What is the consequence of an applicant or licensee not having a valid Business Registration Certificate?
options: The application will not be processed, or a licence already granted may be suspended and/or revoked
A pecuniary penalty of up to HK$1,000,000 is imposed under section 29 of the AMLO
The licence is granted on condition that a Business Registration Certificate is obtained within 30 days
The applicant may appeal the requirement to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(c) states that an applicant or licensee must have a valid Business Registration Certificate, otherwise the application will not be processed by C&ED, or if a licence has been granted, it will be subject to suspension and/or revocation by the CCE. There is no $1,000,000 penalty for this (that figure belongs to the section 29 unlicensed-operation offence), no 30-day conditional grant, and no right of appeal to the Review Tribunal over a BRC requirement — the Tribunal only hears appeals against a refusal to grant a licence.

tc.q: 申請人或持牌人並無有效商業登記證，有何後果？
options: 申請不會獲處理；如已批出牌照，該牌照可被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷
根據《打擊洗錢條例》第29條施加最高100萬港元的罰款
牌照獲批出，但附加須於30日內取得商業登記證的條件
申請人可就此規定向打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處提出上訴
tc.explain: 第4.15(c)段訂明，申請人或持牌人必須持有有效商業登記證，否則申請不會獲海關處理；如已批出牌照，該牌照可被關長暫時吊銷及／或撤銷。此規定並無100萬元的罰款（該數字屬第29條無牌經營罪行所訂的罰款），亦沒有30日附條件批出牌照的安排，更沒有可就商業登記證規定向覆核審裁處上訴的權利——審裁處只受理針對拒絕批給牌照決定的上訴。

en.q: What is the stated purpose of requiring senior management to pass the Competence Assessment?
options: To ensure senior management understands the ML/TF risks faced and can implement effective AML/CFT systems
To verify that senior management has appointed a competent CO and MLRO, as paragraph 4.15(a) requires
To confirm that the business holds a valid Business Registration Certificate, as paragraph 4.15(c) requires
To determine directly whether senior management is a fit and proper person under section 30(3) of the AMLO
en.explain: Paragraph 4.15(b) states the purpose is to ensure senior management has a clear understanding of the ML/TF risks to which the business is exposed and is capable of implementing effective AML/CFT systems to manage and mitigate them. The first wrong answer and second wrong answer are the stated purposes of the neighbouring sub-paragraphs 4.15(a) and 4.15(c), not (b); the third overstates the link — paragraph 5.4 says the Assessment result is only 'one of the factors' the CCE considers in the section 30(3) fit and proper determination, not a direct determination in itself.

tc.q: 要求高級管理層通過能力評核的訂明目的為何？
options: 確保高級管理層了解所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並能實施有效系統
核實高級管理層已按第4.15(a)段的規定委任稱職的合規主任及洗錢報告主任
確認業務按第4.15(c)段的規定持有有效商業登記證
直接根據《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)條斷定高級管理層是否適當人選
tc.explain: 第4.15(b)段訂明其目的是確保高級管理層清楚了解業務所面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並有能力實施有效系統加以管理及減低該等風險。第一及第二個錯誤答案分別是相鄰的第4.15(a)及4.15(c)段（而非(b)段）的訂明目的；第三個則誇大了關連——第5.4段指出評核成績只是關長在根據第30(3)條斷定是否適當人選時考慮的「其中一項因素」，並非直接的斷定本身。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.1段

en.q: Under the Licensing Guide's summary of section 30(3), whose fitness and propriety must be established where the applicant is a partnership?
options: Each partner in the partnership and each ultimate owner of the partnership
The sole proprietor and each ultimate owner, as for an individual applicant
Each director and each ultimate owner of the partnership
The partnership as an entity, without regard to its individual partners or owners
en.explain: Paragraph 4.1(b) states that where the applicant is a partnership, the CCE may grant or renew a licence only if satisfied that each partner and each ultimate owner in the partnership is a fit and proper person. The first wrong answer is instead the test for an individual applicant (paragraph 4.1(a)), and the second wrongly uses 'director' — a term that applies only where the applicant is a corporation (paragraph 4.1(c)); a partnership has partners, not directors.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》就第30(3)條的概述，如申請人是合夥，須確立何人的適當人選資格？
options: 該合夥的每名合夥人及該合夥的每名最終擁有人
獨資經營者及每名最終擁有人，即個人申請人的情況
該合夥的每名董事及每名最終擁有人
該合夥作為一個實體，而不論其個別合夥人或擁有人
tc.explain: 第4.1(b)段訂明，如申請人是合夥，關長只有在信納該合夥的每名合夥人及每名最終擁有人均是適當人選時，方可批出或續期牌照。第一個錯誤答案是適用於個人申請人的測試（第4.1(a)段），而第二個錯誤使用「董事」一詞——此詞只適用於申請人屬法團的情況（第4.1(c)段）；合夥的成員是合夥人，並非董事。

en.q: How is the fit and proper person test fee charged?
options: It is a one-off fee for each applicant subject to the test
It is charged annually for the life of the licence
It is charged once per licence application, whatever the number of persons
It is charged only where the person has not previously been tested
en.explain: Paragraph 4.13 states that there is a one-off fee for each applicant subject to the fit and proper person test, and the Schedule 3 fee table charges $945 for each person who is subject to the test. Paragraph 4.14 confirms the fee is non-refundable.

tc.q: 適當人選測試費用如何收取？
options: 就每名須接受測試的申請人收取一次性費用
在牌照有效期內按年收取
每份牌照申請收取一次，不論人數多少
只就此前未接受過測試的人收取
tc.explain: 第4.13段訂明就每名須接受適當人選測試的申請人收取一次性費用；附表3費用表就每名須接受測試的人收取945元。第4.14段確認該費用不獲退還。

en.q: Which requirement applies to ALL applicants, whether or not they operate at particular premises?
options: All applicants, regardless of premises, must have a local place for storage of books and records
Only applicants without particular premises must have a local management office
Only applicants in a mixed commercial and residential building must secure occupants' written consent
Only licensees operating at premises specified in the licence must display the original licence there
en.explain: Paragraph 4.10 states that all applicants are required to have a local place for storage of books and records, regardless of whether they operate at particular premises. By contrast, the LMO requirement (paragraphs 4.5/4.7) applies only to applicants without particular premises, the occupants' written consent requirement (paragraphs 4.6/4.10) applies only to mixed commercial/residential premises, and displaying the original licence applies only to licensees operating at premises specified in the licence — each of these is correctly scoped as narrower, not universal.

tc.q: 哪一項規定適用於「所有」申請人，不論其是否在特定處所經營？
options: 不論處所為何，所有申請人須有本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方
只有並非在特定處所經營的申請人，才須設有本地管理辦事處
只有處所位於商住混合樓宇的申請人，才須取得佔用人的書面同意
只有在牌照指明處所經營的持牌人，才須在該處展示牌照正本
tc.explain: 第4.10段訂明，不論是否在特定處所經營，所有申請人均須設有本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方。相比之下，本地管理辦事處的規定（第4.5／4.7段）只適用於並無特定處所的申請人，佔用人書面同意的規定（第4.6／4.10段）只適用於商住混合樓宇的處所，而展示牌照正本的規定則只適用於在牌照指明處所經營的持牌人——三者均正確地屬於範圍較窄、而非普遍適用的規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: From what perspective does the C&ED consider the suitability of particular premises, beyond the statutory requirements?
options: Appropriateness and legitimacy in operating the money service, without infringing consumers' rights
Whether the premises are accessible by C&ED officers to carry out their functions under the MSO regime
Whether the premises are situated in a wholly residential building, rather than an acceptable mixed one
The statutory requirements stipulated in the AMLO alone, without considering any other factor
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 states that, in addition to the statutory requirement under the AMLO, C&ED considers suitability from the perspective of appropriateness and legitimacy of the licensee in operating a money service, e.g. without infringing consumers' rights. The first two wrong answers are specific examples drawn from the suitable/not-suitable lists, not the overarching perspective itself, and the third directly contradicts the stem — the whole point of paragraph 4.6 is that C&ED looks beyond the bare statutory requirement, not at it 'alone'.

tc.q: 除法定規定外，海關從甚麼角度考慮特定處所的適合性？
options: 經營金錢服務的恰當性及合法性，不侵犯適用法律下消費者的權利
處所是否可讓海關人員進入，以執行金錢服務經營者監管制度下的職能
處所是否位於純住宅樓宇之內，而非可接受的商住混合樓宇
