《打擊洗錢條例》訂明的法定規定本身，而不考慮其他任何因素
tc.explain: 第4.6段訂明，除《打擊洗錢條例》訂明的法定規定外，海關亦會從持牌人經營金錢服務的恰當性及合法性角度考慮適合性，例如不侵犯消費者根據適用法律享有的權利。首兩個錯誤答案只是適合／不適合清單中的個別例子，並非該整體考慮角度本身；第三個則與題幹直接矛盾——第4.6段的重點正是海關會考慮超越單純法定規定的因素，而非「只」考慮法定規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.6段

en.q: Which two features are given as examples of premises SUITABLE for registration?
options: Being accessible by C&ED officers for their functions, and having occupants' written consent for entry where in a mixed-use building
Being situated in a wholly residential building, and currently being used by another MSO to operate its own money service business
Having a signboard name different from the one on the Business Registration Certificate submitted with the licence application
Being accessible by C&ED officers for their functions, yet situated entirely within a wholly residential building
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 lists as suitable: premises accessible by C&ED officers for carrying out their functions, and, where in a mixed commercial and residential building, the applicant having secured every occupant's written consent for entry. The first two wrong answers each combine grounds from the NOT-suitable list (paragraph 4.6(a),(b),(d)) instead; the third mixes one genuinely suitable feature with a not-suitable one (wholly residential), testing whether both correct limbs are recalled precisely.

tc.q: 哪兩項特徵獲舉為「適合」登記的處所例子？
options: 可讓海關人員進入以執行職能；以及如位於商住混合樓宇，已取得每名佔用人的書面同意讓其進入
位於純住宅樓宇內，並現正由另一名經營者用以經營其金錢服務
招牌所示的業務名稱，與就申請提交的商業登記證上的業務名稱不同
可讓海關人員進入以執行職能，但位於純住宅樓宇內
tc.explain: 第4.6段列為適合的例子包括：處所可讓海關人員進入以執行職能；以及如處所位於商住混合樓宇，申請人已取得每名佔用人的書面同意讓其進入。首兩個錯誤答案分別組合了不適合清單（第4.6(a)、(b)、(d)段）的理由；第三個則將一項真正適合的特徵與一項不適合的特徵（純住宅樓宇）混合，測試考生能否準確記住兩項正確的限定條件。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.7段

en.q: Why must an applicant operating without particular premises maintain a local management office?
options: To give the licensee a local office and personnel as its point of contact with C&ED
To satisfy the registration requirement under the Business Registration Ordinance, Cap. 310
To provide a place advertised, including by signboard, for meeting customers there
To store the full set of books and records relating to the MSO's money service transactions
en.explain: Paragraph 4.7 explains that the LMO requirement is necessary to provide a local office and personnel of the licensee as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED, for effective supervision of the money service business. The first wrong answer confuses this with the separate Business Registration Certificate requirement (paragraph 4.15(c)); the second describes 'particular premises' under paragraph 4.4(b), the opposite scenario of an applicant WITH particular premises; the third describes the LPS's function under paragraph 4.11, not the LMO's.

tc.q: 並非在特定處所經營的申請人，為何須維持本地管理辦事處？
options: 為持牌人提供本地辦事處及人員，作為與海關的聯絡點
為符合《商業登記條例》（第310章）的登記規定
為提供一個包括以招牌宣傳、用作會見客戶的地方
為存放該經營者金錢服務交易的全套簿冊及紀錄
tc.explain: 第4.7段解釋，設立本地管理辦事處的規定，是為了提供該持牌人的本地辦事處及人員，作為與海關聯絡的接觸點，以有效監管其金錢服務業務。第一個錯誤答案將此與另一項獨立規定——商業登記證規定（第4.15(c)段）混淆；第二個描述的是第4.4(b)段的「特定處所」，情況正好相反（即有特定處所的申請人）；第三個描述的則是第4.11段本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方的功能，並非本地管理辦事處的功能。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.7段

en.q: When must a person apply for an MSO licence?
options: Before he or she operates a money service
Within one month of starting to operate a money service
Within 45 days of starting to operate a money service
At any time, provided operations cease pending the decision
en.explain: Paragraph 2.7 states that a person must apply for a licence from the CCE before he or she operates a money service. Operating without a licence is an offence under section 29(1) of the AMLO.

tc.q: 某人須於何時申請金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 在其經營金錢服務之前
在開始經營金錢服務後一個月內
在開始經營金錢服務後45日內
任何時間均可，只要在決定作出前暫停營運
tc.explain: 第2.7段訂明任何人須在經營金錢服務之前，向海關關長申請牌照。無牌經營屬《打擊洗錢條例》第29(1)條所訂罪行。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第3.1段

en.q: On what condition are a licensed corporation, authorized insurer, insurance broker, insurance agent or SVF licensee exempt from the MSO licensing requirement?
options: Only where the money service is ancillary to their principal business
Only where they notify the CCE annually of their money service activities
Only where their money service turnover is below a prescribed threshold
Unconditionally exempt by virtue of holding an existing licence or authorization
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 lists these bodies as exempt only where they operate a money service that is ancillary to their principal business. There is no annual notification requirement, no turnover threshold, and the exemption is not unconditional for these bodies — that unconditional treatment (without the ancillary qualification) applies only to an authorized institution and the Government under paragraph 3.1.

tc.q: 持牌法團、認可保險人、保險經紀、保險代理或工具持牌人，在甚麼條件下獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌規定？
options: 只限其所經營的金錢服務附屬於其主要業務
只限其每年就其金錢服務活動通知關長
只限其金錢服務營業額低於訂明門檻
無條件獲豁免，純粹憑其現有牌照或授權
tc.explain: 第3.1段將該等團體列為只在其所經營的金錢服務附屬於其主要業務時，方獲豁免。當中並無每年通知的規定，亦無營業額門檻，而且對這些團體而言豁免並非無條件——無附加「附屬」條件的無條件豁免，只適用於第3.1段所指的認可機構及政府。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide describe an ultimate owner of a corporate applicant?
options: An individual who owns or controls more than 25% of the issued share capital or of the voting rights at general meetings, or who exercises ultimate control over the corporation's management
An individual entitled to or controlling more than 25% of the capital or profits of a partnership, or of its voting rights, or who exercises ultimate control over its management
Another individual who ultimately owns or controls the applicant's money service business, or the other person on whose behalf the applicant acts
Any shareholder holding more than 10% of the issued share capital, or any person entitled to appoint a majority of the corporation's directors
en.explain: Paragraph 4.2.3 defines an ultimate owner of a corporation using the three limbs in the key (25% share capital, 25% voting rights, or ultimate management control), mirroring section 24 of the AMLO. The first wrong answer is instead the paragraph 4.2.2 definition for a partnership (capital/profits and voting rights in the partnership, not share capital), and the second is the paragraph 4.2.1 definition for an individual applicant — both real but for the wrong type of applicant. The third uses the wrong threshold (10% instead of 25%) and an unsourced 'appoint a majority of directors' test.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何描述公司申請人的最終擁有人？
options: 擁有或控制超過25%已發行股本或投票權，或對該法團的管理行使最終控制權的個人
攤分或控制合夥超過25%資本、利潤或投票權，或對其管理行使最終控制權的個人
最終擁有或控制申請人金錢服務業務的另一名個人，或該申請人代其行事的另一人
持有超過10%已發行股本的任何股東，或有權委任該法團過半數董事的任何人
tc.explain: 第4.2.3段以關鍵答案所列的三項條件（超過25%已發行股本、超過25%投票權，或對管理的最終控制權）界定法團的最終擁有人，與《打擊洗錢條例》第24條相對應。第一個錯誤答案其實是第4.2.2段就合夥所訂的定義（合夥的資本／利潤及投票權，而非股本），第二個則是第4.2.1段就個人申請人所訂的定義——兩者均真實存在，但均適用於錯誤的申請人類別。第三個使用了錯誤的門檻（10%而非25%），並附加一項並無出處的「委任過半數董事」測試。

en.q: Besides the five specified matters, what final item does the Licensing Guide list among the fit and proper considerations?
options: Any other matter that the CCE considers relevant
The applicant's projected profitability
The applicant's length of residence in Hong Kong
The applicant's membership of an industry association
en.explain: Paragraph 4.3 lists the section 30(4) matters and closes with paragraph (f), any other matter that the CCE considers relevant, and refers licence applicants and licensees to the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety and its Supplementary Guideline for further details.

tc.q: 除五項指明事項外，《牌照指引》在適當人選考慮因素中列出最後哪一項？
options: 海關關長認為相關的任何其他事項
申請人的預期盈利能力
申請人在香港居住的年期
申請人是否業界協會會員
tc.explain: 第4.3段列出第30(4)條的事項，並以(f)項「海關關長認為相關的任何其他事項」作結，並指引牌照申請人及持牌人參閱《有關適當人選準則的指引》及其《補充指引》以了解詳情。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.9段

en.q: Under which sections of the AMLO are the conditions endorsed on an MSO licence imposed or amended?
options: Sections 30, 31 or 32
Sections 34, 35 or 36
Sections 43, 44 or 45
Sections 38, 39 or 39A
en.explain: Paragraph 2.9 states that a licence must be endorsed with the conditions imposed or amended under section 30, 31 or 32 of the AMLO — the grant, renewal and amendment provisions respectively — and must specify the premises address or correspondence address and the validity period.

tc.q: 批註於金錢服務經營者牌照上的條件，是根據《打擊洗錢條例》哪些條文施加或修訂？
tc.explain: 第2.9段訂明牌照須批註根據《打擊洗錢條例》第30、31或32條（分別為批出、續期及修訂條文）施加或修訂的條件，並須指明處所地址或通訊地址及有效期。

en.q: Who is the ultimate owner in relation to an applicant or licensee that is an individual?
options: Another individual who ultimately owns or controls that individual's money service business; or, if the first individual acts on behalf of another person, that other person
An individual entitled to, or controlling, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the capital or profits of the business, or exercising ultimate control over its management
An individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, more than 25% of the issued share capital or voting rights of the business, or who exercises ultimate control over its management
The individual's spouse or a relative who has provided financial or other support to that person's business
en.explain: Paragraph 4.2.1 mirrors the section 24 definition: in relation to an individual, ultimate owner means another individual who ultimately owns or controls the first individual's money service business, or, if that individual acts on behalf of another person, that other person. The distractors are paragraph 4.2.2's partnership test and paragraph 4.2.3's corporation test (both wrong for an individual applicant), and an invented family-relationship claim.

tc.q: 就屬個人的申請人或持牌人而言，最終擁有人是誰？
options: 最終擁有或控制該個人金錢服務業務的另一名個人；或如該首述個人是代另一人行事，則為該另一人
直接或間接有權享有或控制該業務超過25%資本或利潤的個人，或對其管理行使最終控制權的個人
直接或間接擁有或控制該業務超過25%已發行股本或投票權的個人，或對其管理行使最終控制權的個人
該個人的配偶，或曾向該人的業務提供財政或其他支援的親屬
tc.explain: 第4.2.1段與第24條的定義相對應：就個人而言，最終擁有人指最終擁有或控制該首述個人的金錢服務業務的另一名個人；或如該首述個人是代另一人行事，則指該另一人。三個錯誤答案分別是第4.2.2段的合夥業務準則及第4.2.3段的法團準則（兩者均不適用於個人申請人），以及虛構的親屬關係說法。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第1.3段

en.q: To whom does the Licensing Guide apply?
options: An applicant for the grant or renewal of an MSO licence, or a licensee
Every individual or corporation in Hong Kong, whether or not it operates a money service
The Customs and Excise Department, in its capacity as the authority regulating MSOs
Any person who has been refused a licence and wishes to appeal to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Paragraph 1.3 states that the licensing guide applies to an applicant for grant or renewal of an MSO licence, or a licensee, as the case may be. The distractors over-broaden the scope beyond paragraph 1.2's operate-or-wish-to-operate qualifier, misidentify C&ED (the regulator that issues the guide) as its intended audience, and invent a narrower appeal-only scope.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》適用於何人？
options: 申請批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照的人，或持牌人
香港任何個人或法團，不論其是否經營金錢服務業務
以監管金錢服務經營者的主管當局身分行事的香港海關本身
任何被拒絕發給牌照並擬向覆核審裁處提出上訴的人
tc.explain: 第1.3段訂明本牌照指引適用於申請批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照的人，或持牌人（視屬何情況）。三個錯誤答案分別將範圍擴大至超出第1.2段「經營或擬經營」的限制、把發出本指引的監管機構（香港海關）誤作指引的適用對象，以及虛構只適用於上訴個案的較窄範圍。

en.q: For which premises must an applicant secure the written consent of every occupant for an authorized person to enter for routine inspection?
options: Premises belonging to a mixed commercial and residential building
All premises without exception
Only premises used as a place for storage of books and records
Only premises shared with another business
en.explain: Paragraph 4.10 states that where the premises in respect of which an application is made belong to a mixed commercial and residential building, the applicant should secure the written consent of every occupant of the premises for any authorized person to enter the premises for routine inspection.

tc.q: 申請人須就哪類處所取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人進入進行例行視察？
options: 屬商住混合樓宇的處所
所有處所，並無例外
只限用作本地存放簿冊及紀錄的處所
只限與其他業務共用的處所
tc.explain: 第4.10段訂明，如申請所關乎的處所屬商住混合樓宇，申請人應取得該處所每名佔用人的書面同意，讓任何獲授權人進入該處所進行例行視察。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: Which documents must accompany a completed Form 1, supplementary information sheet and annex on a new licence application?
options: A Business Plan and AML/CFT policies, with photocopies of the requisite supporting documents
Audited financial accounts for each of the preceding three consecutive financial years, submitted annually
A reference letter from the applicant's own bank, and a certificate of good standing from a practising solicitor
A police certificate of no criminal conviction for every director and every shareholder of the applicant
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 requires the applicant to submit a Business Plan and AML/CFT policies, together with photocopies of the requisite documents listed in the checklist of supporting documents in the application form. The distractors name other plausible corporate-application documents that paragraph 5.1 does not list.

tc.q: 新牌照申請中，已填妥的表格1、補充資料表及附件須連同哪些文件一併提交？
options: 業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，連同所需證明文件的影印本
申請人過去連續三個完整財政年度、每年提交的經審計財務帳目
申請人開戶銀行的證明書，以及執業律師出具的良好信譽證明書
申請人每名董事及每名股東的警方無刑事犯罪紀錄證明書
tc.explain: 第5.1段規定申請人須提交業務計劃及打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策，連同申請表格內證明文件核對表所列所需文件的影印本。三個錯誤答案均為其他看似合理的公司申請文件，但並非第5.1段所列的規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: In which language may an applicant complete the application form, supplementary information sheet and annex?
options: Either English or Chinese, or both if the circumstances require
English only, as C&ED does not accept applications completed in Chinese
Chinese only, as the application form is not available in English
Whichever language the C&ED specifies for that particular applicant
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the applicant may complete the form, supplementary information sheet and annex in either English or Chinese, or both if the case requires. The distractors invent a single-language restriction in each direction and a case-by-case C&ED mandate, none of which paragraph 5.1 imposes.

tc.q: 申請人可以哪種語文填寫申請表格、補充資料表及附件？
options: 英文或中文均可；如情況需要，亦可兩者兼用
只限英文，因海關不接受以中文填寫的申請
只限中文，因申請表格並無英文版本
由香港海關就個別申請人指定的語文
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明申請人可以英文或中文填寫表格、補充資料表及附件；如情況需要，亦可兩者兼用。三個錯誤答案分別虛構了單一語文的限制（兩個方向）及由香港海關逐案指定語文的安排，均非第5.1段所載。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: What photographs must accompany a new application to operate a money service at particular premises?
options: At least two photographs, 102x152 mm size, showing the inner part (counter) and the outer part (signboard)
A single photograph of the building's exterior, sized at least 152x203 mm (5R), showing the full frontage
Four photographs of 89x127 mm (3R) size, one taken from each of the four compass directions
At least two photographs of 102x152 mm (4R) size showing only the exterior signboard from different angles
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 requires at least two photographs of size 102x152 mm (4R-size), one showing the inner part such as the counter or office and one showing the outer part such as the signboard. The distractors invent wrong sizes (5R, 3R) and a wrong count, and one keeps the correct 4R size but wrongly requires both photographs to show only the exterior.

tc.q: 在特定處所經營金錢服務的新申請，須附上甚麼照片？
options: 至少兩張102x152毫米照片，顯示內部（櫃檯）及外部（招牌）
只須一張顯示大廈外觀的照片，尺寸至少為152x203毫米（5R）
四張89x127毫米（3R）尺寸的照片，分別從四個羅盤方向拍攝
至少兩張102x152毫米（4R）尺寸的照片，惟只顯示不同角度的外部招牌
tc.explain: 第5.1段規定須附上至少兩張102x152毫米（4R尺寸）的照片，一張顯示內部（例如櫃檯或辦公室），另一張顯示外部（例如招牌）。三個錯誤答案分別虛構錯誤的尺寸（5R、3R）及錯誤的張數，其中一項雖保留正確的4R尺寸，卻誤將規定局限於只顯示外部。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: What photograph requirement applies where an applicant has separate premises serving as an LPS or LMO?
options: At least two photographs for each additional LPS or LMO, per the particular-premises requirement
No photographs are required for an LPS or LMO, only for the principal particular premises
One photograph only, showing the exterior signboard of the LPS or LMO
Photographs are required only where the LPS and LMO are located at different addresses from each other
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that where an applicant also has separate premises serving as LPS and/or LMO, at least two photographs must also be attached for each additional LPS and/or LMO, on the same requirements as particular premises. The distractors invent an exemption, a single-photograph rule, and a same-address exemption, none of which paragraph 5.1 states.

tc.q: 如申請人另有處所用作存放紀錄地方或本地管理辦事處，照片規定為何？
options: 每個額外的該等處所須附上至少兩張照片，規定與特定處所相同
本地存放地點或本地管理辦事處無須照片，只有特定處所才須附上
只須一張顯示該處所外部招牌的近距離照片
只有在本地存放地點及本地管理辦事處地址不同時，才須附上照片
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明，如申請人另有處所用作本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方及／或本地管理辦事處，每個該等額外處所亦須附上至少兩張照片，規定與特定處所的規定相同。三個錯誤答案分別虛構豁免、只須一張照片的規定，以及地址相同與否的條件，均非第5.1段所載。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.2段

en.q: Which components does the Licensing Guide say a Business Plan should comprehensively cover?
options: Detailed operation mode, organizational structure, payment system, target customer, staffing, and finance
The company's mechanism for sanction screening and for high-risk customer screening, per the AML Policy
The applicant's projected revenue and expenditure, and the identity and background of its directors
The products and services to be offered, and the launch timeline for each product and service
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 states that the Business Plan should be a comprehensive overview of the business, including but not limited to detailed operation mode, organizational structure, payment system, target customer, staffing, and finance of the company. The distractors are drawn from elsewhere in paragraph 5.2 (the AML Policy's own sanction-screening example) and from Business Plan Guideline item 7 (delivery channels), plus an invented pairing of unrelated details.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》指出業務計劃應全面涵蓋哪些部分？
options: 營運模式、組織架構、支付系統、目標客戶、人手及財務
根據打擊洗錢政策，制裁篩查及高風險客戶篩查機制
申請人的預計收入及支出，以及董事的身分及背景
將提供的產品及服務，以及各項產品及服務的推出時間表
tc.explain: 第5.2段訂明業務計劃應是業務的全面概覽，包括但不限於詳細營運模式、組織架構、支付系統、目標客戶、人手編制及公司財務等部分。三個錯誤答案分別取自第5.2段中屬於打擊洗錢政策的制裁篩查例子，以及《遞交業務計劃的指引》第7項（分銷渠道），並虛構一項不相關細節的組合。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.2段

en.q: Which two examples does the Licensing Guide give of matters an AML Policy must elaborate?
options: Its payment or settlement system for remittance, and sanction/high-risk-customer screening mechanism
The company's detailed operation mode, organizational structure, and its target customers, per the Business Plan
The compliance function's management oversight, and the company's staff training programme
The company's AML/CFT audit function, and its procedures for reporting suspicious transactions
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 gives as examples of what the AML Policy must elaborate the company's payment/settlement system for remittance transactions and its mechanism for sanction screening and screening of high-risk customers. The distractors are the Business Plan's own components (also named in paragraph 5.2) and other real AML/CFT Policy Guideline items (13, 16, 15 and 14) that paragraph 5.2 itself does not cite as its two examples.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就打擊洗錢政策須詳述的事項舉出哪兩個例子？
options: 匯款支付／結算系統，制裁及高風險客戶篩查機制
公司的詳細營運模式、組織架構，以及其目標客戶群
合規職能的管理層監督，以及公司的整體員工培訓計劃
公司的打擊洗錢審計職能，以及其匯報可疑交易的程序
tc.explain: 第5.2段舉出打擊洗錢政策須詳述的事項例子，包括公司就匯款交易的支付／結算系統，以及其制裁篩查及高風險客戶篩查機制。三個錯誤答案分別是同段中屬於業務計劃的組成部分，以及《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》中其他真實項目（第13、16、15及14項），但並非第5.2段本身所舉的兩個例子。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What does an applicant receive once all the requisite documents have been submitted?
options: An interview notice, a demand note for fees, and an invitation letter to nominate eligible persons
An acknowledgment receipt of the application, together with a reminder if any documents remain outstanding
An appointment letter fixing the date, time and centre to attend the Competence Assessment
A briefing given at interview on the statutory licensing and compliance requirements for MSOs
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that when all the requisite documents are submitted, the applicant receives a notice for an interview together with a demand note for the licence and fit and proper person test fees, and an invitation letter for nominating the eligible persons to attend the Assessment. The acknowledgment receipt (with any reminder) is issued earlier, on mere receipt of the application; the appointment letter for the Assessment and the briefing on licensing requirements both occur later, at or after the interview.

tc.q: 申請人在提交所有所需文件後會收到甚麼？
options: 面談通知、費用繳費通知書，以及提名合資格人士的邀請信
收妥申請的通知；如有需要，並會發出提示要求提交欠交的文件
預約應考能力評核的信件，訂明應考的日期、時間及試場
面談時獲簡介適用於金錢服務經營者的法定發牌及合規規定
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明，當所有所需文件已提交，申請人會收到面談通知，連同就牌照申請及適當人選測試費用的繳費通知書，以及提名合資格人士參加能力評核的邀請信。收妥申請的通知（連同提示）較早發出，在僅收到申請時已發出；預約能力評核的信件及對發牌規定的簡介則在面談時或之後才發生。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What takes place during the licensing interview?
options: The original documents and payment record are verified, and the applicant signs the application
The nominated eligible person or persons sit the Competence Assessment at the specified date, time and centre
The licence is issued on the spot once the original documents are confirmed to be in order
The business premises are inspected on-site by C&ED officers as part of processing the application
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that during the interview the original documents and payment record are verified and the applicant signs the application for an MSO licence in the presence of C&ED officers. The Assessment is a separate session attended at its own specified date, time and centre; the Licensing Guide does not provide for on-the-spot issuance of a licence at the interview; and on-site inspection of the premises is listed in paragraph 5.6 as a factor affecting processing time, not as part of the interview itself.

tc.q: 發牌面談期間會進行甚麼？
options: 核實文件正本及付款紀錄，申請人在海關人員面前簽署申請
獲提名合資格人士於指明日期、時間及試場應考能力評核
文件經確認齊備後，牌照會即場發出
香港海關人員在處理申請期間會到業務處所進行實地視察
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明面談期間會核實文件正本及付款紀錄，申請人須在香港海關人員面前於金錢服務經營者牌照申請上簽署。能力評核是另一場獨立的考核，於其本身指明的日期、時間及試場進行；《牌照指引》並無規定可於面談即場發牌；業務處所的實地視察則見於第5.6段，屬影響處理時間的因素，並非面談的一部分。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.5段

en.q: Who must attend the licensing interview where the applicant is a corporation?
options: The directors, or staff members authorized in writing by its board
The sole proprietor, with no further authorization required
The partners, or staff members authorized in writing by every partner
The compliance officer or money laundering reporting officer, acting alone
en.explain: Paragraph 5.5(c) requires the directors, or staff members of the applicant authorized in writing by the board of directors, to attend where the applicant is a corporation. The sole-proprietor and partner options describe paragraph 5.5(a) and (b), which apply to sole proprietorships and partnerships respectively, not corporations; paragraph 5.5 does not name the CO or MLRO as the required attendee.

tc.q: 如申請人是法團，何人須出席發牌面談？
options: 董事，或經董事會書面授權的職員
獨資經營者，無須另行授權
合夥人，或經每名合夥人授權的職員
合規主任或洗錢報告主任，單獨出席即可
tc.explain: 第5.5(c)段規定如申請人屬法團，出席面談的須是董事，或經董事會書面授權的申請人職員。獨資經營者及合夥人的選項分別是第5.5(a)及(b)段的規定，適用於獨資經營及合夥，並非法團；第5.5段並無訂明合規主任或洗錢報告主任可作為出席人。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.5段

en.q: Where the applicant is a partnership, whose written authorization must a staff member attending the interview hold?
options: That of every partner
That of the managing partner only
That of a majority of the partners
That of the compliance officer
en.explain: Paragraph 5.5 requires, for a partnership, that the person attending be the partner or partners, or a staff member of the applicant authorized in writing by every partner. For a corporation the authorization comes from the board of directors.

tc.q: 如申請人是合夥，出席面談的職員須持有何人的書面授權？
options: 每名合夥人的授權
只需管理合夥人的授權
過半數合夥人的授權
合規主任的授權
tc.explain: 第5.5段就合夥規定，出席者須為合夥人，或經每名合夥人書面授權的申請人職員。就法團而言，授權則來自董事會。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.6段

en.q: Which factors does the Licensing Guide identify as affecting the time taken to process an application?
options: Time to collect documents, on-site inspection, and obtaining fit-and-proper records from other authorities
The number of premises the applicant intends to operate, regardless of documents or inspection required
The applicant's projected turnover and the scale of its proposed money service business
The calendar season in which the application happens to be submitted to C&ED
en.explain: Paragraph 5.6 states that processing time may vary depending on factors including the time taken to collect requisite documents, on-site inspection at the business premises, and the time required to obtain records from other authorities for the fit and proper person test (as well as time to complete the Assessment). It does not identify the number of premises, projected turnover, or the season of application as factors.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》指出哪些因素會影響處理申請所需的時間？
options: 收集文件、實地視察，以及為適當人選測試索取紀錄的時間
申請人擬經營的處所數目，不論所須文件或視察為何
申請人的預期營業額及其擬經營金錢服務業務的規模
申請碰巧遞交予香港海關的曆法季節
tc.explain: 第5.6段訂明處理時間可能因多項因素而異，包括收集所需文件的時間、業務處所的實地視察，以及為進行適當人選測試而向其他當局索取紀錄所需的時間（還有完成能力評核所需的時間）。並未將處所數目、預期營業額或提交申請的季節列為因素。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.8段

en.q: Which forms are used for the fit and proper person declaration?
options: Form 3A with App. I & II for individual, and Form 3B for a corporation
Form 1 for the licence application and Form 2 for the renewal application
Form 4, used to seek the CCE's prior approval of a new director or owner
Form 6, used to notify the CCE of a change in particulars
en.explain: Paragraph 5.8 states that the fit and proper person declaration form is Form 3A with Appendices I and II for an individual, and Form 3B for a corporation. Forms 1 and 2 are the licence application and renewal forms (paragraphs 5.1 and 6.3), Form 4 is for prior approval of a new director, ultimate owner or partner (paragraphs 8.1-8.3), and Form 6 notifies a change in particulars (paragraph 9.1) — none is the fit and proper declaration.

tc.q: 適當人選聲明使用哪些表格？
options: 個人用表格3A連同附錄I及II，法團用表格3B
表格1用於牌照申請，表格2用於續期申請
表格4，用於尋求海關關長事先批准新董事或最終擁有人
表格6，用於向海關關長具報詳情變更
tc.explain: 第5.8段訂明適當人選聲明表格為個人用的表格3A（連同附錄I及II）及法團用的表格3B。表格1及表格2分別是牌照申請及續期表格（第5.1及6.3段），表格4用於申請新董事、最終擁有人或合夥人的事先批准（第8.1至8.3段），表格6則用於具報詳情變更（第9.1段）——均非適當人選聲明表格。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.8段

en.q: Before whom must the declarant sign Appendix I to Form 3A?
options: An authorized C&ED officer, a practising professional, a notary public, or a Justice of the Peace
Two adult witnesses, provided both countersign the declarant's identity document within 7 days
A director of the applicant company, authorized to certify documents on its behalf
An officer of the applicant's bank, required to verify the declarant's signature
en.explain: Paragraph 5.8 requires the declarant to sign Appendix I in the presence of a witness who is an authorized officer of the C&ED, a practising professional (e.g. solicitor, accountant or auditor), a notary public, or a Justice of the Peace. Two lay witnesses, a company director, and a bank officer are not among the qualifying witness categories the paragraph lists.

tc.q: 聲明人須在何人面前簽署表格3A的附錄I？
options: 香港海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士、公證人，或太平紳士
兩名成年見證人，惟兩人須在聲明人的身分證明文件上聯署
申請人公司的一名董事，獲授權代表公司核證文件
申請人往來銀行的職員，負責核實聲明人的簽署
tc.explain: 第5.8段規定聲明人須在見證人面前簽署附錄I，該見證人須為香港海關的獲授權人員、執業專業人士（例如律師、會計師或核數師）、公證人，或太平紳士。兩名普通見證人、公司董事及銀行職員均不屬第5.8段所列的合資格見證人類別。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.8段

en.q: What must the witness to Appendix I of Form 3A certify?
options: That the personal particulars are true and correct, checked against original identity documents
That the declarant is a fit and proper person under s.36 to be associated with operating a money service
That the declarant has no criminal record in Hong Kong or any other jurisdiction
That the declarant understands and will comply with the requirements of the AMLO
en.explain: Paragraph 5.8 states that the witness must check the personal particulars in Appendix I against the declarant's original identity documents and certify that they are true and correct (and that the declarant signed in the witness's presence). Fitness and propriety is determined by the CCE under paragraph 5.9's vetting process, not certified by this witness; a clean criminal record and understanding of the AMLO are never mentioned as certifications the witness must give.

tc.q: 表格3A附錄I的見證人須核證甚麼？
options: 已核對聲明人的身分證明文件正本，證明所述個人資料真實無誤
證明聲明人是適合與經營金錢服務有聯繫的適當人選（根據第36條）
證明聲明人在香港或其他司法管轄區均無犯罪紀錄
證明聲明人明白《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》的規定
tc.explain: 第5.8段訂明見證人須將附錄I所述的個人資料與聲明人的身分證明文件正本核對，並核證所述資料真實無誤（以及聲明人是在其面前簽署）。是否屬適當人選由關長按第5.9段的查驗程序斷定，並非由見證人核證；聲明人有否犯罪紀錄或是否明白《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》，第5.8段均未有提及須由見證人核證。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.9段

en.q: How does the CCE process a fit and proper person declaration form?
options: By verifying the declared information against records held by the department, other government and law enforcement agencies
By treating the witness's certification under Appendix I as sufficient, without further vetting by the department
By referring every declaration to the Review Tribunal for independent verification before a decision is made
By requiring the declarant to attend the licensing interview together with every partner or director, under paragraph 5.5
en.explain: Paragraph 5.9 states that on receipt of a fit and proper person declaration form, the CCE undertakes checks to confirm the accuracy of the information provided, including vetting details against information held by the department, other government agencies and law enforcement agencies. The witness's certification under paragraph 5.8 is only a signing formality and does not substitute for the department's own vetting; the Review Tribunal (paragraph 5.11) hears appeals, not declarations; and paragraph 5.5 governs who attends the licensing interview, a separate step.

tc.q: 海關關長如何處理適當人選聲明表格？
options: 查核所提供資料的準確性，並與該部門、其他政府及執法機構所持有的資料核對
視見證人根據附錄I作出的證明已經足夠，毋須該部門再作查核
將每份聲明轉交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處核實，然後才作決定
根據第5.5段，要求聲明人與每名合夥人或董事一同出席發牌面談
tc.explain: 第5.9段訂明，海關關長在接獲適當人選聲明表格後，會查核所提供資料的準確性，包括將詳情與該部門、其他政府部門及執法機構所持有的資料核對。第5.8段的見證人證明僅屬簽署手續，不能取代該部門本身的查核；第5.11段所指的覆核審裁處是處理上訴，並非處理聲明表格；第5.5段規範的是出席發牌面談的人選，屬另一獨立步驟。

en.q: Which consent-related failure is listed as a ground on which the CCE may refuse to grant a licence?
options: The applicant cannot obtain every occupant's written consent for entry to mixed commercial-residential premises for routine inspection
The applicant fails to appoint a competent compliance officer or money laundering reporting officer for the money service business within 3 months
None of the applicant's senior management, i.e. sole proprietor, partner or director, attends the Assessment designated by the C&ED
The applicant submits an application to the C&ED that is incomplete or otherwise invalid in a material respect
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(c) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant cannot obtain the written consent from every occupant of the particular premises which are situated in a mixed commercial and residential building, for any authorized person to enter for routine inspection. Failure to appoint a CO/MLRO is the separate ground at paragraph 5.10(g), non-attendance at the Assessment is ground (i), and an incomplete or invalid application is ground (h) — all real grounds, but none is about occupant consent.

tc.q: 哪一項與同意有關的未能符合事項，列為海關關長可拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人未能就位於商住混合樓宇的處所，取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人員進入作例行視察
申請人未能為經營金錢服務的業務委任合資格合規主任或洗錢報告主任（於發牌後3個月內完成）
申請人的高級管理層，即獨資經營者、合夥人或董事，沒有成員應考海關指定的能力評核
申請人向海關遞交的申請書欠缺所需資料，在重大方面屬不完整或無效的申請
tc.explain: 第5.10(c)段將下述情況列為拒發理由：申請人未能就位於商住混合樓宇的特定處所，取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓任何獲授權人員進入進行例行視察。委任合規主任或洗錢報告主任的失責屬第5.10(g)段的另一獨立理由；未有應考能力評核屬第5.10(i)段；申請不完整或無效則屬第5.10(h)段——三者均為真實理由，但均與佔用人同意無關。

en.q: Which documentary failure is listed as a ground for refusing to grant a licence?
options: An applicant fails to provide a Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the guidelines promulgated by the C&ED
An applicant fails to provide the required information of a local place for storage of books and records
An applicant cannot obtain the written consent of every occupant for entry to mixed commercial-residential premises (30 days)
An applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing regime under section 25 of the AMLO
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(f) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant fails to provide a Business Plan and AML Policy in accordance with the relevant guidelines promulgated by C&ED (the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan and of AML Policy). Failure to provide LPS information is the separate ground at (d), lack of occupant consent is ground (c), and the section 25 exemption is ground (k) — real grounds, but none concerns the Business Plan or AML Policy.

tc.q: 哪一項文件方面的缺失列為拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人未有按香港海關頒布的相關指引，提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策
申請人未能提供本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點的所需資料
申請人未能就位於商住混合樓宇的處所，取得每名佔用人的書面同意，30日
申請人根據《打擊洗錢條例》第25條，已獲豁免遵守發牌制度
tc.explain: 第5.10(f)段將申請人未有按香港海關頒布的相關指引（即《遞交業務計劃的指引》及《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》）提供業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策，列為拒發理由。未能提供本地儲存紀錄地點資料屬第5.10(d)段的另一理由；欠缺佔用人同意屬第5.10(c)段；獲豁免發牌制度則屬第5.10(k)段——三者均為真實理由，但均與業務計劃或打擊洗錢政策無關。

en.q: Which appointment failure is listed as a ground for refusing to grant a licence?
options: An applicant fails to appoint a competent CO or MLRO
An applicant fails to appoint an external auditor
An applicant fails to appoint a company secretary
An applicant fails to appoint a local legal representative
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(g) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant fails to appoint a competent Compliance Officer or Money Laundering Reporting Officer. Paragraph 7.1(i) makes the same failure a ground for revocation or suspension after the licence is granted.

tc.q: 哪一項委任方面的缺失列為拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人未有委任稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任
申請人未有委任外部核數師
申請人未有委任公司秘書
申請人未有委任本地法律代表
tc.explain: 第5.10(g)段將申請人未有委任稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任列為拒發理由。第7.1(i)段則將同樣缺失列為批出牌照後撤銷或暫時吊銷的理由。

en.q: Which statutory exemption is listed as a ground on which the CCE may refuse to grant a licence?
options: The applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing regime under section 25 of the AMLO
The applicant or an applicant within the business fails to satisfy the fit and proper person test
The premises to be used are not suitable for the operation of a money service
An applicant choosing to operate without particular premises fails to provide local management office information
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(k) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing regime by virtue of section 25 of the AMLO (paragraph 3.1 correspondingly bars the CCE from accepting an application from an exempt person). Failing the fit and proper test is ground (a), unsuitable premises is ground (b), and missing LMO information is ground (e) — real grounds, but none concerns a statutory exemption.

tc.q: 哪一項法定豁免列為海關關長可拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人已根據《打擊洗錢條例》第25條，獲豁免遵守發牌制度
申請人或申請人業務中的申請人未能通過適當人選判定
申請人擬用作經營金錢服務的處所並不適合作該用途
選擇不設特定處所經營的申請人未能提交本地管理辦事處的資料
tc.explain: 第5.10(k)段將申請人已根據《打擊洗錢條例》第25條獲豁免遵守金錢服務經營者發牌制度，列為拒發理由（第3.1段相應訂明關長不會接受獲豁免人士的申請）。未能通過適當人選判定屬第5.10(a)段；處所不適合經營屬第5.10(b)段；未能提交本地管理辦事處資料則屬第5.10(e)段——三者均為真實理由，但均與法定豁免無關。

en.q: By when must an applicant appeal to the Review Tribunal against a refusal to grant a licence?
options: Within the period ending 21 days after the notice of refusal is given to the applicant
Within the period ending 30 days after the notice of refusal is given to the applicant
Within the period ending 45 days after the notice of refusal is given to the applicant
Within one month beginning on the date on which the refusal decision is made, unless extended by the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 5.11 states that the applicant may appeal against the CCE's decision to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the applicant of the refusal of grant of an MSO licence, mirroring section 59(1) of the AMLO. Thirty days does not appear in the Guide; 45 days is instead the deadline for a renewal application under paragraph 6.1; and the period runs from the notice being given, not from the date the decision is made.

tc.q: 申請人須於甚麼時限內，就拒發牌照的決定向覆核審裁處提出上訴？
options: 於告知拒發決定的通知發出後21日內
於告知拒發決定的通知發出後30日內
於告知拒發決定的通知發出後45日內
於作出拒發決定當日起計一個月內（可延長）
tc.explain: 第5.11段訂明申請人可於告知其拒發金錢服務經營者牌照的通知發出後21日內，就海關關長的決定向打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處提出上訴——與《打擊洗錢條例》第59(1)條相對應。30日並非《牌照指引》所載期限；45日則是第6.1段所訂續牌申請的期限，並非上訴期限；而期間應由通知發出日起計，並非由作出決定當日起計。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.2段

en.q: How far before the expiry of a licence does the C&ED send a renewal reminder, and what does it enclose?
options: 90 days before expiry, enclosing the invitation letter to nominate eligible persons for the Assessment
45 days before expiry, enclosing the application form and supplementary information sheet (Form 6)
30 days before expiry, enclosing a demand note for the non-refundable renewal fees
One month before expiry, enclosing a written notice of the outstanding renewal documents
en.explain: Paragraph 6.2 states that the department sends a reminder enclosing the invitation letter for nominating eligible persons to attend the Assessment to each licensee 90 days before the expiry of the licence. The 45-day figure is instead the licensee's own deadline to apply for renewal (also in paragraph 6.2), not the timing of the department's reminder or its enclosure.

tc.q: 香港海關在牌照屆滿前多久發出續期提示？該提示附有甚麼？
options: 屆滿前90日，並附有提名合資格人士參加能力評核的邀請信
屆滿前45日，並附有申請表格及補充資料表（表格6）
屆滿前30日，並附有續期費用（不獲退還）的繳費通知書
屆滿前一個月，並附有欠交續期文件的書面通知
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明該部門會在每個牌照屆滿前90日，向持牌人發出提示，並附有提名合資格人士參加能力評核的邀請信。45日則是持牌人本身須申請續期的期限（同見第6.2段），並非該部門發出提示的時間或其附件。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.2段

en.q: Within what period of receiving the invitation letter must a licensee nominate eligible persons for the Assessment, and within what period must they attend?
options: Nominate within seven days of receiving the invitation letter, and attend within 30 days of receiving it
Nominate within 30 days of receiving the invitation letter, and attend within 90 days of receiving it
Nominate within one month of receiving the letter, and attend within two months of receiving it
Nominate within 14 days of receiving the invitation letter, and attend within 45 days of receiving it
en.explain: Paragraph 6.2 states that the licensee must nominate the eligible persons for the Assessment within seven days of receiving the invitation letter, and that the nominated persons must attend within 30 days of receiving it. Ninety days is instead how far before expiry the reminder itself is sent, and 45 days is the licensee's separate deadline to apply for renewal — neither is the nomination or attendance window.

tc.q: 持牌人須於接獲邀請信後多久內提名合資格人士參加能力評核？該等人士須於多久內出席？
options: 接獲邀請信後七日內提名，並於接獲邀請信後30日內出席
接獲邀請信後30日內提名，並於接獲邀請信後90日內出席
接獲邀請信後一個月內提名，並於接獲邀請信後兩個月內出席
接獲邀請信後14日內提名，並於接獲邀請信後45日內出席
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明持牌人須於接獲邀請信後七日內提名合資格人士參加能力評核，而獲提名人士須於接獲邀請信後30日內出席評核。90日是該部門發出提示的時間（即屆滿前90日），45日則是持牌人申請續期的期限，兩者皆非提名或出席評核的期限。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.2段

en.q: What is the consequence of failing to attend the designated Assessment session for a renewal application?
options: Rejection of the corresponding application
A written warning, after which the application is processed as normal
A further session must be arranged within 30 days of the missed one
Suspension of the existing licence until the Assessment is passed
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that failure to attend the designated session of the Assessment may result in refusal of the licence application, while paragraph 6.2 states that on renewal, failure to attend will result in rejection of the corresponding application — a firmer, non-discretionary formulation. Neither paragraph makes the consequence automatic on a grant application, reduces it to a warning on renewal, or excuses renewal applicants from attending altogether.

tc.q: 就續期申請而言，未能在指定的時段應考能力評核會有甚麼後果？
options: 有關申請會被拒絕
只會收到書面警告，申請其後仍會如常處理
須在錯過該時段後30日內另行安排應考
現有牌照會被暫時吊銷，直至通過評核為止
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明未有出席指定場次的能力評核，可能導致牌照申請被拒；第6.2段則訂明在續期時，未有出席將會導致有關申請被拒——措辭較為肯定，並非酌情性質。兩段均沒有將批出申請的後果定為自動被拒，也沒有將續期的後果降為警告，更沒有豁免續期申請人出席的責任。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.3段

en.q: Which form is used for an application to renew an MSO licence, and what must accompany it?
options: Form 2, with the supplementary information sheet, the relevant annex, fit and proper declaration forms, the Business Plan and AML Policy
Form 1, together with the supplementary information sheet, the relevant annex and photocopies of the requisite documents
Form 5, together with a Business Plan and an updated AML Policy to notify the CCE of a change in operation mode within 14 days
Form 6, together with the fit and proper person declaration forms and a demand note for non-refundable fees
en.explain: Paragraph 6.3 requires a licensee to submit its renewal application (Form 2), the supplementary information sheet and relevant annex, together with the fit and proper person declaration forms, Business Plan, AML Policy and photocopies of requisite documents. Form 1 is instead used for a new licence application (paragraph 5.1); Form 5 with a Business Plan and updated AML Policy is the real requirement for changing to operation at particular premises under paragraph 8.4, not renewal; and Form 6 is the Notification of Change in Particulars under paragraph 9.1, not a renewal form.

tc.q: 續期金錢服務經營者牌照的申請使用哪一表格？須連同甚麼一併提交？
options: 表格2，連同補充資料表、附件、適當人選聲明表格、業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策
表格1，連同補充資料表、相關附件及所需文件的整套影印本
表格5，連同業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策，以通知營運模式的改變（14日內）
表格6，連同適當人選聲明表格及不獲退還費用的繳費通知書
tc.explain: 第6.3段訂明持牌人須提交續期申請（表格2）、補充資料表及相關附件，連同適當人選聲明表格、業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策。表格1實為新申請牌照所用（第5.1段）；以表格5連同業務計劃及更新打擊洗錢政策，是第8.4段轉為在特定處所經營時的真實規定，並非續期規定；表格6則是第9.1段的詳情變更通知，同樣不是續期表格。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.4段

en.q: Which three circumstances make a renewal application invalid so that C&ED will not process it further?
options: Late submission of Form 2 and its documents 45 days before expiry; failure to produce documents within the specified period; or failure to nominate eligible persons within seven days
Failing to pay the renewal fee within 30 days of the demand note; failing to display the licence within 90 days of grant; or failing to lodge a periodic return within one month
Failing to attend the licensing interview within 45 days of the notice; failing to pass the Assessment within 30 days of nomination; or failing to maintain a LPS within seven days of approval
Failing to notify a change of address within one month; failing to appoint a CO within 90 days of grant; or failing to keep records for at least 2 weeks
en.explain: Paragraph 6.4 lists three grounds on which a renewal application is deemed invalid: late submission of the completed Form 2, supplementary information sheet and annex 45 days before expiry; failure to produce outstanding supporting documents within the specified period after a reminder; and failure to nominate eligible persons for the Assessment within seven days of the invitation letter. The distractors borrow real figures used elsewhere in the guide (30/90 days, one month, two weeks) but attach them to obligations paragraph 6.4 does not mention.

tc.q: 哪三種情況會令續期申請成為無效申請，使香港海關不作進一步處理？
options: 未能於屆滿前45日提交表格2及隨附文件；未能於指明期間內提交欠交文件；或未能於七日內提名合資格人士
未能於30日內繳付續期費用；未能於90日內展示牌照；或未能於一個月內遞交定期申報表
未能於45日內出席發牌面談；未能於30日內通過能力評核；或未能於七日內維持存放紀錄的地方
未能於一個月內通知地址變更；未能於90日內委任合規主任；或未能保存紀錄達兩星期
tc.explain: 第6.4段列出三項會令續期申請被視為無效的理由：未能於屆滿前45日提交填妥的表格2、補充資料表及附件；在獲發提示後未能於指明期間內提交欠交的證明文件；或未能於接獲邀請信後七日內提名合資格人士參加評核。其餘三項則借用《牌照指引》其他地方的真實數字（30日、90日、一個月、兩星期），但套用於第6.4段並無提及的事項上。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.4段

en.q: What happens if a licensee submits an invalid renewal application that cannot be processed?
options: The existing licence lapses automatically on expiry, and the licensee must cease money service operation
The licence is automatically extended until the licensee corrects and resubmits the application
C&ED will process the application after the 45-day deadline on payment of a late fee
The licence is suspended, pending the licensee's appeal to the Review Tribunal
en.explain: Paragraph 6.4 states that if a licensee submits an invalid renewal application which cannot be processed by C&ED, the existing licence lapses automatically upon expiry of the validity period, and the licensee must cease money service operation. The Licensing Guide does not provide for automatic extension, late processing on payment of a fee, or suspension pending appeal — the appeal right in paragraph 7.3 applies to revocation or suspension decisions, not to an automatic lapse.

tc.q: 如持牌人提交無效的續期申請而不獲處理，會有甚麼後果？
options: 現有牌照於屆滿時自動失效，該持牌人必須停止經營金錢服務
牌照會自動延續，直至持牌人更正並重新遞交申請為止
香港海關會在45日後於持牌人繳付逾期費用後處理該申請
牌照會被暫時吊銷，待持牌人向覆核審裁處提出上訴
tc.explain: 第6.4段訂明，如持牌人提交無效的續期申請而香港海關無法處理，現有牌照會於有效期屆滿時自動失效，該持牌人必須停止經營金錢服務。《牌照指引》並無訂明可自動延續、於繳付逾期費用後仍獲處理，或暫時吊銷以待上訴——第7.3段的上訴權只適用於撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的決定，並非自動失效的情況。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What happens if an applicant fails to provide requisite information or documents within the specified period?
options: The application will be considered invalid and will not be processed by the C&ED
The application will be processed based on the information already on file
The application will be suspended for six months pending further documents
The applicant will be fined HK$50,000 and the application will be processed
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that if the applicant fails to provide requisite information or documents within the specified period, the application will be considered invalid and will not be processed by the C&ED. Processing on incomplete information, a six-month suspension, and a HK$50,000 fine (the offence penalty under provisions like sections 35(7)-38(8) of the AMLO, not §5.4) are not what the paragraph provides.

tc.q: 如申請人未能於指明期間內提供所需資料或文件，會有甚麼後果？
options: 該申請會被視為無效，並不獲香港海關處理
該申請會按現有存檔資料處理
該申請會暫緩六個月，以待提交進一步文件
申請人會被罰款5萬元，而申請仍獲處理
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明，如申請人未能於指明期間內提供所需資料或文件，該申請會被視為無效，並不獲香港海關處理。按現有資料處理、暫緩六個月，或罰款港幣5萬元（此為條例第35(7)至38(8)等條文的罪行罰則，並非第5.4段的後果）仍獲處理，均非第5.4段所訂的後果。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What weight does the Licensing Guide give to the result of the Competence Assessment?
options: It is one of the factors the CCE considers relevant to the applicant's fitness and propriety
It is conclusive proof of the applicant's fitness and propriety, without further review
It is relevant only where the applicant has no previous licensing history with C&ED under s.5.9 review
It is disregarded once the applicant has passed the licensing interview
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that the result of the Assessment is one of the factors the CCE considers relevant in determining whether the applicant is fit and proper to operate the business of a money service — not conclusive, not limited to first-time applicants, and not disregarded once the interview is passed. Paragraph 6.2 applies the same formulation on renewal.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》賦予能力評核結果甚麼分量？
options: 屬關長斷定申請人是否適當人選的相關因素之一
屬申請人適當人選資格的確證，無須進一步審查
只限申請人並無過往申請紀錄時方屬相關（5.9段）
一旦申請人通過發牌面談，即不予理會
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明評核結果是關長在斷定申請人是否適合經營金錢服務業務時，認為相關的其中一項因素——並非確證、並不限於首次申請人，亦不會在通過面談後即不予理會。第6.2段就續期採用相同表述。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.3段

en.q: May an applicant submit a licence application by electronic means?
options: Yes — an applicant may access the C&ED's website and follow the instructions provided
No — an application may only be made by post or delivered in person under s.5.1, unless waived
Yes, but electronic submission is available only for renewal, not new applications
Yes, but only with the CCE's prior written approval obtained in advance
en.explain: Paragraph 5.3 states that an applicant can access the C&ED's website and follow the instructions to submit the licence application, referring applicants to Section XVI for the supporting documents required. Paragraph 5.1 lists post, the website and in person as channels for both new and renewal applications alike; no prior CCE approval is required to use the website.

tc.q: 申請人可否以電子方式提交牌照申請？
options: 可以——申請人可登入香港海關網站並按指示提交申請
不可以——申請只可以郵遞或親身方式提出（第5.1段）
可以，但電子提交只適用於續期申請，新申請不適用
可以，但須事先取得海關關長的書面批准
tc.explain: 第5.3段訂明申請人可登入香港海關網站並按指示提交牌照申請，並指引申請人參閱第XVI節了解所需的證明文件。第5.1段列出郵遞、網站及親身提交為新申請及續期申請均適用的途徑；使用網站毋須事先取得關長批准。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.7段

en.q: Where the applicant is a corporation, who must apply for the fit and proper person test?
options: Each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation associated with the money service business
The individual applicant and, under s.5.9, each ultimate owner where the applicant is a sole proprietorship
Each partner and each ultimate owner, where the applicant is a partnership
The compliance officer and the money laundering reporting officer of the corporation
en.explain: Paragraph 5.7 requires each director and each ultimate owner of the corporation to be associated with the money service business to apply for the fit and proper person test, where the applicant is a corporation. The individual/ultimate-owner and partner/ultimate-owner options describe the same paragraph's rules for a sole proprietorship and a partnership respectively; the CO and MLRO are not named in paragraph 5.7 at all.

tc.q: 如申請人是法團，何人須申請適當人選測試？
options: 該法團的每名董事及每名與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的最終擁有人
該個人申請人本身及每名最終擁有人（如申請人屬獨資經營）（5.9段）
該合夥的每名合夥人及每名最終擁有人（如申請人屬合夥）
該法團的合規主任及洗錢報告主任，而非董事或最終擁有人
tc.explain: 第5.7段訂明如申請人是法團，須申請適當人選測試的是該法團的每名董事及每名與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的最終擁有人。個人及最終擁有人、合夥人及最終擁有人的選項分別是同一段就獨資經營及合夥所訂的規定；合規主任及洗錢報告主任則完全未見於第5.7段。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: To which office must a paper application be submitted in person or by post?
options: The Money Service Supervision Bureau, C&ED, Units 402-403, 4/F, Centre Parc, Kowloon Bay
The Licensing and Registration Section, Customs HQ Building, 222 Java Road, North Point (Room 402)
The Companies Registry, 14/F, Queensway Government Offices, 66 Queensway, Admiralty
The Business Registration Office, 2/F, Revenue Tower, 5 Gloucester Road, Wan Chai
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the completed form, supplementary information sheet and annex, with photocopies of the requisite documents, must be submitted by post, via C&ED's website, or in person to the Money Service Supervision Bureau, C&ED, Units 402-403, 4/F, Centre Parc, 11 Sheung Yuet Road, Kowloon Bay. Customs Headquarters, the Companies Registry and the Business Registration Office are real Hong Kong government offices, but none handles MSO licence applications.

tc.q: 紙本申請須親身或以郵遞方式提交至哪一辦事處？
options: 九龍灣常悅道11號4樓402-403室香港海關金錢服務監理科
北角渣華道222號海關總部大樓4樓牌照及註冊組辦事處（402室）
金鐘道66號金鐘政府合署14樓公司註冊處總部辦事處
灣仔告士打道5號稅務大樓2樓商業登記署總部辦事處
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明填妥的表格、補充資料表及附件連同所需文件的影印本，須以郵遞、經香港海關網站或親身提交至九龍灣常悅道11號企業廣場4樓402-403室香港海關金錢服務監理科。海關總部、公司註冊處及商業登記署均是真實的香港政府機關，但均不負責處理金錢服務經營者牌照申請。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.3段

en.q: What does the C&ED issue when all requisite renewal documents are found to be in order?
options: A notice for an interview and a demand note for fees, which are non-refundable
The renewed licence, issued immediately without an interview
A provisional renewal permit valid for 90 days pending the interview
A written confirmation under s.6.3 that no interview is required for renewal
en.explain: Paragraph 6.3 states that when all the requisite documents are found to be in order, the CCE will issue a notice for an interview together with a demand note for payment of the respective fees, which are non-refundable. There is no immediate renewal without interview, no 90-day provisional permit (90 days is instead the reminder period before expiry under paragraph 6.2), and no confirmation waiving the interview.

tc.q: 當所有所需的續期文件齊備妥當時，香港海關會發出甚麼？
options: 面談通知，連同繳付有關費用（不獲退還）的繳費通知書
即時發出已續期的牌照，完全無須進行面談
發出有效期90日的臨時續期許可證，以待安排面談
發出書面確認，訂明毋須進行續期面談（第6.3段）
tc.explain: 第6.3段訂明，當所有所需文件齊備妥當時，關長會向持牌人發出面談通知，連同繳付有關費用的繳費通知書；該等費用不獲退還。並無即時無須面談的續期、並無90日臨時許可（90日其實是第6.2段牌照屆滿前發出提示的期間），亦無豁免面談的書面確認。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.3段

en.q: Do the photograph requirements apply to renewal applications as well as new applications?
options: Yes — the same photograph requirements for particular premises, LPS and LMO apply on renewal
No — photographs are required only for new licence applications, not renewals under section 6.3(a)
Yes, but only a single photograph showing the exterior signboard is required
Yes, but only where the premises have changed since the last application
en.explain: Paragraph 6.3 repeats the same photograph requirement for renewal applications as for new ones: at least two photographs of size 102x152 mm (4R-size), one showing the inner part and one the outer part, for particular premises and for each additional LPS and LMO. It is not limited to new applications, is not satisfied by one exterior photograph, and does not depend on whether the premises have changed.

tc.q: 照片規定是否同樣適用於續期申請及新申請？
options: 是——續期申請適用與新申請相同的照片規定
否——根據牌照指引，只有新牌照申請才須附上相關照片
是，但只須附上一張顯示處所外部招牌的照片
是，但只限於自上次提出申請以來處所已有變更的情況
tc.explain: 第6.3段就續期申請重申與新申請相同的照片規定：特定處所須附上至少兩張102x152毫米（4R尺寸）的照片，一張顯示內部，一張顯示外部；每個額外的存放紀錄地方及本地管理辦事處亦適用相同規定。並不限於新申請、並非只需一張外部照片，亦不取決於處所是否已有變更。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What does an applicant receive on the C&ED's receipt of a licence application?
options: An acknowledgment receipt, with a reminder issued if any documents are outstanding
A notice for an interview, together with a demand note for the licence fee within 45 days
An invitation letter to nominate eligible persons to attend the Assessment
An appointment letter fixing the date, time and centre for the Assessment
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that on receipt of a licence application, C&ED issues an acknowledgment receipt of the application, with a reminder for outstanding documents issued where necessary. The interview notice and demand note, the invitation letter to nominate eligible persons, and the Assessment appointment letter are all issued at later stages of the same paragraph's process — once all requisite documents are submitted, or after the interview — not on mere receipt.

tc.q: 香港海關接獲牌照申請後，申請人會收到甚麼？
options: 申請的收妥通知；如有需要，並發提示要求提交欠交文件
面談通知，連同繳付牌照及測試費用的繳費通知書（14日）
邀請提名合資格人士出席應考能力評核的邀請信
預約應考能力評核的日期、時間及試場的信件
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明，香港海關接獲牌照申請後，會向申請人發出收妥通知；如有需要，並會發出提示要求提交任何欠交的文件。面談通知連同繳費通知書、提名合資格人士的邀請信，以及預約能力評核的信件，均屬同一段所述較後階段（提交所有所需文件後或面談後）才發出的文件，並非接獲申請時即發出。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.4段

en.q: What must an applicant bring to the licensing interview?
options: The notice, the payment record, and the relevant original documents
Only the notice for interview, without the payment record or documents
Only photocopies of the supporting documents, not the originals
A cheque for the full amount of the licence fee, made payable to C&ED
en.explain: Paragraph 5.4 states that the applicant will be required to bring along the notice, payment record, and the relevant original documents when attending the interview at the allotted time. The notice alone, photocopies alone, and a cheque for the fee are all incomplete or unsupported by the paragraph.

tc.q: 申請人出席發牌面談時須攜帶甚麼？
options: 通知、付款紀錄，以及有關文件的正本
只需面談通知，毋須付款紀錄或文件
只需證明文件的影印本，毋須正本
以支票繳付牌照費用，抬頭付予海關
tc.explain: 第5.4段訂明申請人須攜帶通知、付款紀錄及有關文件正本，於指定時間出席與該部門人員的面談。只帶通知、只帶影印本，或以支票繳付費用，均不符合第5.4段的規定。

en.q: Which procedural failure by an applicant is listed as a ground for refusing to grant a licence?
options: The applicant submits an incomplete or invalid application
The applicant submits the application by post rather than online
The applicant submits the application in Chinese only
The applicant submits the application more than six months before commencing business
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(h) lists as a refusal ground that an applicant submits an incomplete or invalid application. Paragraph 5.4 explains when an application is treated as invalid — where requisite information or documents are not provided within the specified period.

tc.q: 申請人哪一項程序上的缺失列為拒發牌照的理由？
options: 申請人提交不完整或無效的申請
申請人以郵遞而非網上方式提交申請
申請人只以中文提交申請
申請人在開業前超過六個月提交申請
tc.explain: 第5.10(h)段將申請人提交不完整或無效的申請列為拒發理由。第5.4段則說明何時申請會被視為無效——即未有於指明期間內提供所需資料或文件。

en.q: How do the LPS and LMO refusal grounds differ in scope?
options: LPS failure is a ground for any applicant; LMO failure applies only to an applicant without particular premises
Both grounds apply only to applicants who choose to operate without particular premises
Both grounds apply only to applicants operating at particular premises, not those without
Failure to provide LMO information applies to all applicants, and LPS only to those without premises under s.5.10(d)
en.explain: Paragraph 5.10(d) lists failure to provide LPS information as a ground for any applicant, consistent with paragraph 4.10's requirement that every applicant maintain an LPS. Paragraph 5.10(e) confines the LMO ground to an applicant who chooses to operate without particular premises. Neither ground is confined the other way round, and the two are not simply interchangeable.

tc.q: 存放紀錄地方與本地管理辦事處這兩項拒發理由，適用範圍有何不同？
options: 存放紀錄地方適用於任何申請人；本地管理辦事處則只適用於不設處所經營者
兩項理由均只適用於選擇不設特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人
兩項理由均只適用於在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請人，不適用於不設處所者
本地管理辦事處適用於所有申請人，存放紀錄地方則只適用於不設處所者
tc.explain: 第5.10(d)段將未有提供存放紀錄地方的資料，列為任何申請人均適用的拒發理由，與第4.10段規定所有申請人均須設有該地方一致。第5.10(e)段則將本地管理辦事處的理由，限於選擇不設特定處所經營的申請人。兩項理由的適用範圍並非相反，亦非可以互換。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第5.1段

en.q: From where may the application form, annex, supplementary information sheet and submission guidelines be obtained?
options: From the Money Service Supervision Bureau, or C&ED's MSOS eServices website
Only at the Government Publications Centre in Queensway Government Offices
Only by written request addressed personally to the CCE's office
Only from the registry of the Review Tribunal, on written request
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the application form, annex, supplementary information sheet and submission guidelines can be obtained from the Money Service Supervision Bureau's address or downloaded from C&ED's website at the MSOS eServices address. The Government Publications Centre, a written request to the CCE, and the Review Tribunal registry are real Hong Kong bodies, but none is where the Guide says these documents can be obtained.

tc.q: 申請表格、附件、補充資料表及遞交指引可從何處取得？
options: 金錢服務監理科，或從香港海關牌照系統網址下載
只可從金鐘政府合署的政府刊物銷售處索取
只可親自以書面向海關關長辦公室提出索取
只可以書面向覆核審裁處的登記處提出索取
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明申請表格、附件、補充資料表及遞交指引，可從金錢服務監理科的地址取得，或從香港海關網站的金錢服務經營者牌照系統網址下載。政府刊物銷售處、向海關關長辦公室書面索取，以及覆核審裁處登記處，均是真實機構，但《牌照指引》並無訂明可從該等途徑取得這些文件。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.1段

en.q: By when must a licensee apply to renew its MSO licence?
options: Not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
Not later than 90 days before the licence is due to expire
Not later than 30 days before the licence is due to expire
At any time before the licence expires, subject to a grace period
en.explain: Paragraph 6.1 states that a licensee is required to renew the MSO licence not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire, mirroring section 31(2)(a) of the AMLO. The 90-day period in paragraph 6.2 is when the department sends its reminder.

tc.q: 持牌人須於何時前申請續期金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 於牌照到期屆滿前不少於45日
於牌照到期屆滿前不少於90日
於牌照到期屆滿前不少於30日
於牌照屆滿前任何時間（寬限14日）
tc.explain: 第6.1段訂明持牌人須於牌照到期屆滿前不少於45日申請續期，與《打擊洗錢條例》第31(2)(a)條相對應。第6.2段的90日則是該部門發出提示的時間。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第6.2段

en.q: Whose legal responsibility is it to apply for renewal on time, notwithstanding the reminder sent by the department?
options: The licensee's own legal responsibility, which the reminder does not remove
The department's, since C&ED itself issues the 90-day reminder under s.6.2, within 14 days
The compliance officer's personally, distinct from the licensee's own duty
The Review Tribunal's, once it is notified that the licence has expired
en.explain: Paragraph 6.2 states that although the department sends a reminder 90 days before expiry, it remains the licensee's legal responsibility to apply for renewal 45 days before the licence expires. The reminder does not shift that duty to the department, to the compliance officer personally, or to the Review Tribunal.

tc.q: 即使該部門已發出提示，及時申請續期是何人的法律責任？
options: 持牌人本身的法律責任，該提示並不會免除此責任
該部門的責任，因海關會發出屆滿前90日提示
合規主任個人的責任，有別於持牌人本身的責任
覆核審裁處的責任，一旦獲通知牌照已屆滿
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明，雖然該部門會在牌照屆滿前90日發出提示，但持牌人仍有法律責任於牌照屆滿前45日申請續期。該提示並不會將此責任轉移至該部門、合規主任個人，或覆核審裁處。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1段

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide describe its list of circumstances in which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence?
options: As a non-exhaustive list of examples
As an exhaustive statutory list
As applicable only to corporate licensees
As applicable only after a first written warning
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1 introduces the grounds as a non-exhaustive list of examples on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence, and refers licensees to the Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety and its Supplementary Guideline for more detail on the fit and proper criteria.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何描述其所列海關關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的情況？
options: 屬並非詳盡無遺的例子清單
屬詳盡無遺的法定清單
只適用於公司持牌人
只在首次書面警告後方適用
tc.explain: 第7.1段將該等理由列為並非詳盡無遺的例子清單，說明海關關長可據此撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照，並指引持牌人參閱《有關適當人選準則的指引》及其《補充指引》，以了解適當人選準則的詳情。

en.q: Which reporting failure is listed as a ground on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence?
options: Where a licensee fails to submit a periodic return on time
Where a licensee fails to file its audited annual accounts with C&ED
Where a licensee fails to report a change of its external auditor
Where a licensee fails to make its AML Policy publicly available
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(f) lists as a ground where a licensee fails to submit a periodic return on time; paragraph 11.2 correspondingly warns that any such failure may result in suspension and/or revocation of the licence. Audited accounts, a change of auditor, and publishing the AML Policy are not among the reporting failures paragraph 7.1 lists.

tc.q: 哪一項匯報缺失列為海關關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 持牌人未有準時提交定期申報表
持牌人未有向香港海關提交經審計的周年帳目
持牌人未有匯報其外聘核數師的更換
持牌人未有將其打擊洗錢政策公開提供
tc.explain: 第7.1(f)段將持牌人未有準時提交定期申報表列為理由，第11.2段亦相應警告，未有準時提交定期申報表可能導致暫時吊銷及／或撤銷牌照。經審計帳目、更換核數師的匯報，以及公開打擊洗錢政策，均不屬第7.1段所列的匯報缺失。

en.q: Which example does the Licensing Guide give of a licensee's holding of a licence failing to fulfil the purpose for which it was issued?
options: A money service has never been provided by the licensee
The licensee has changed the range of currencies it deals in
The licensee has reduced its business premises' opening hours
The licensee has relocated to smaller business premises
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(g) lists as a ground where a licensee's holding of the licence fails to fulfil the purpose — the provision of money service — for which the licence was issued, giving as its example that a money service has never been provided by the licensee. This is consistent with the separate concern in paragraph 6(f) of the Supplementary F&P Guideline, which treats nil money service for a prolonged period as evidence against genuine intention to operate — though that guideline speaks of prolonged nil activity, not 'never'. Changing currencies dealt in, reducing hours, or moving premises are not the example paragraph 7.1(g) gives.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就持牌人持有牌照未能達致發牌目的，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 該持牌人從未提供任何金錢服務
該持牌人更改了經營兌換的貨幣種類
該持牌人縮減了其業務處所的營業時間
該持牌人遷往較小的業務處所
tc.explain: 第7.1(g)段將持牌人持有牌照未能達致發牌目的（即提供金錢服務）列為撤銷或暫時吊銷理由，並以該持牌人從未提供任何金錢服務為例。此與《適當人選補充指引》第6(f)段的另一項相關關注一致——該段將獲批牌照後長期未提供金錢服務，視為缺乏真正經營意圖的證據；惟該段所述為「長期沒有」，而非「從未」。更改貨幣種類、縮減營業時間或遷往較小處所，均非第7.1(g)段所舉的例子。

en.q: Which appointment failure is listed as a ground for revoking or suspending a licence after it has been granted?
options: Where a licensee fails to appoint or maintain a competent CO or MLRO
Where a licensee fails to appoint a new director within 30 days of a vacancy
Where a licensee fails to appoint an internal auditor
Where a licensee fails to appoint a local legal representative
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(i) lists as a ground where a licensee fails to appoint or maintain a competent Compliance Officer or Money Laundering Reporting Officer. Note the word “maintain”: an appointment made at the licensing stage must be kept in place.

tc.q: 批出牌照後，哪一項委任缺失列為撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 持牌人未有委任或維持稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任
持牌人未有於出缺後30日內委任新董事
持牌人未有委任內部核數師
持牌人未有委任本地法律代表
tc.explain: 第7.1(i)段將持牌人未有委任或維持稱職的合規主任或打擊洗錢報告主任列為理由。留意「維持」一詞：在發牌階段作出的委任必須持續維持。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.2段

en.q: What procedural protection does a licensee have before its licence is revoked or suspended?
options: The CCE must give notice in writing and an opportunity to be heard before revoking or suspending the licence
The licensee may appeal directly to the Review Tribunal instead of being given a hearing by the CCE within 21 days
The licensee is entitled to 90 days' written notice before the proposed revocation or suspension
The licensee may require an independent auditor's report before any revocation or suspension
en.explain: Paragraph 7.2 states that the CCE will inform the licensee of the revocation or suspension by notice in writing and give the licensee an opportunity to be heard before revoking or suspending the licence, reflecting section 34(3) of the AMLO. The Guide gives both a hearing before the decision and, under paragraph 7.3, a right of appeal after it — not appeal instead of a hearing; it does not specify 90 days' notice; and it does not require an independent auditor's report.

tc.q: 在牌照被撤銷或暫時吊銷前，持牌人有甚麼程序保障？
options: 海關關長須以書面通知，並在撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照前給予持牌人陳述機會
持牌人可直接向覆核審裁處上訴，而無須經海關關長給予陳述機會
持牌人有權在擬議撤銷或暫時吊銷前獲得90日書面通知
持牌人可要求在撤銷或暫時吊銷前取得獨立核數師報告
tc.explain: 第7.2段訂明關長會就撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照一事以書面通知持牌人，並在撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照前給予持牌人陳述機會，反映《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》第34(3)條的規定。《牌照指引》同時提供決定前的陳述機會，以及第7.3段決定後的上訴權——並非以上訴取代陳述機會；亦無訂明90日通知期，或須取得獨立核數師報告的規定。

en.q: Which form does a licensee use to seek the CCE's prior approval for a person proposing to become its director, ultimate owner or partner?
options: Form 4, with a fit and proper declaration from the proposing person
Form 5, which is used to seek approval to add business premises
Form 6, which is used to notify the CCE of a change in particulars
Form 2, submitted together with the next renewal application
en.explain: Paragraphs 8.1, 8.2 and 8.3 each state that the licensee must make an application in Form 4, and that the proposing director, ultimate owner or partner must submit the fit and proper person declaration form. Form 5 is for adding premises (paragraph 8.4), Form 6 notifies a change in particulars (paragraph 9.1), and Form 2 is the renewal form (paragraph 6.3) — none is used to seek prior approval of a new director, owner or partner.

tc.q: 持牌人就擬成為其董事、最終擁有人或合夥人的人尋求海關關長事先批准，須使用哪一表格？
options: 表格4，並由擬任人士提交適當人選聲明
表格5，用於申請批准新增業務處所
表格6，用於向海關關長具報詳情變更
表格2，於下次續期申請時一併提交
tc.explain: 第8.1、8.2及8.3段均訂明持牌人須以表格4提出申請，而該擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人須提交適當人選聲明表格。表格5用於新增處所（第8.4段），表格6用於具報詳情變更（第9.1段），表格2則是續期表格（第6.3段）——均非用於申請新董事、最終擁有人或合夥人的事先批准。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.4段

en.q: A licensee operating without particular premises wishes to change to operating at particular premises. What must it submit?
options: An application in Form 5, together with a Business Plan and updated AML Policy
Form 5 alone, with no Business Plan or AML Policy update required
Form 6, as a notification of change in particulars, within one month
A fresh licence application in Form 1, as though applying for the first time (s.8.4)
en.explain: Paragraph 8.4 states that a licensee operating without particular premises who wishes to change to operating at particular premises must, apart from submitting an application in Form 5, also submit a Business Plan and updated AML Policy to notify the CCE of the change in operation mode. Form 5 alone is insufficient; Form 6 is used for other changes in particulars (paragraph 9.1), not this one; and no fresh Form 1 application is required.

tc.q: 並非在特定處所經營的持牌人擬改為在特定處所經營。它須提交甚麼？
options: 以表格5提出申請，並連同業務計劃及更新的打擊洗錢政策
只需表格5，毋須提交業務計劃或更新打擊洗錢政策
以表格6作為詳情變更通知，於一個月內提交
以表格1重新提出牌照申請，猶如首次申請（8.4段）
tc.explain: 第8.4段訂明，並非在特定處所經營金錢服務的持牌人擬改為在特定處所經營，除須提交表格5申請外，還須提交業務計劃及更新的打擊洗錢政策，以通知關長其營運模式的改變。單憑表格5並不足夠；表格6用於第9.1段所列的其他詳情變更，並非此情況；亦無須重新以表格1提出申請。

en.q: Besides criminal sanction, what other consequences may follow a contravention of sections 35(1), 36(1), 37(1), 38(1), 39(1) or 39A(1)?
options: Disciplinary or administrative sanctions such as suspension and revocation of the licence
A further fine of HK$50,000 and up to 6 months' imprisonment, in addition to the first
A mandatory increase in the licence fee payable on the next renewal
Referral of the matter to the Companies Registry for striking off under s.43(1)(c) within 30 days
en.explain: Paragraph 8.10 states that apart from criminal sanction, a licensee who contravenes sections 35(1), 36(1), 37(1), 38(1), 39(1) or 39A(1) of the AMLO may also be subject to disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions such as suspension and revocation of licence. The HK$50,000 fine and 6 months' imprisonment is itself the criminal sanction the question excludes, not a separate consequence; a fee increase and referral to the Companies Registry are not mentioned in paragraph 8.10.

options: 紀律及／或行政制裁，例如暫時吊銷及撤銷牌照
另加5萬元罰款及監禁6個月，在原罰則之外
下次續期時須強制上調的牌照費用
將事宜轉交公司註冊處以撤銷公司註冊（30日內）
tc.explain: 第8.10段訂明，除刑事制裁外，違反《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》第35(1)、36(1)、37(1)、38(1)、39(1)或39A(1)條的持牌人，亦可能受到紀律及／或行政制裁，例如暫時吊銷及撤銷牌照。港幣5萬元罰款及監禁6個月本身正是題目所指、獲排除在外的刑事制裁，並非另一項後果；上調牌照費用及轉交公司註冊處，第8.10段均未有提及。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.1段

en.q: Which form does a licensee use to notify the CCE of a change in particulars?
options: Form 6 — Notification of Change in Particulars
Form 4 — application for approval
Form 5 — application to add premises
Form 7 — Notification of Cessation of Business
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1 states that a licensee needs to notify the CCE of the listed changes by completing the Notification of Change in Particulars (Form 6). Form 7 is the Notification of Cessation of Business under paragraph 10.2.

tc.q: 持牌人以哪一表格通知海關關長詳情變更？
options: 表格6——詳情變更通知
表格4——批准申請
表格5——新增處所申請
表格7——停止營業通知
tc.explain: 第9.1段訂明持牌人須填寫「詳情變更通知」（表格6），將所列的變更通知海關關長。表格7則是第10.2段所指的停止營業通知。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.1段

en.q: Which of the following is listed among the changes in particulars that must be notified to the CCE?
options: Change in the local place for storage of books and records
Change in the licensee's insurance broker or insurance arrangements
Change in the licensee's external auditor or accounting firm
Change in the licensee's advertising agency or marketing consultant
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1(m) lists change in the local place for storage of books and records among the fourteen categories a licensee must notify to the CCE using Form 6. A change of insurance broker, external auditor, or advertising agency are not among the fourteen categories paragraph 9.1 lists.

tc.q: 下列何者列於須通知海關關長的詳情變更之中？
options: 本地存放簿冊及紀錄地方的變更
持牌人保險經紀或保險安排的變更
持牌人外部核數師或會計師行的變更
持牌人廣告代理或市場推廣顧問的變更
tc.explain: 第9.1(m)段將本地存放簿冊及紀錄地方的變更，列為持牌人須以表格6向關長具報的十四類詳情變更之一。保險經紀、外部核數師或廣告代理的變更，均不屬第9.1段所列的十四類變更。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.1段

en.q: What warning does the Licensing Guide give about the effect of certain changes in particulars?
options: Certain changes, e.g. in fit and proper status, may trigger a review of the licence's validity
Every change in particulars invalidates the licence under s.9.4 automatically and with immediate effect
No change in particulars can ever affect the validity of a licence during its term
Only a change of the licensee's business address can affect the licence's validity
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1 warns that licensees should be aware that some changes in particulars may result in a review of the validity of an MSO licence, giving as an example a change in the fit and proper status of the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner — a review, not automatic invalidation, and not confined to a change of business address; nor is it true that no change can ever affect validity.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就某些詳情變更的影響作出甚麼提醒？
options: 適當人選狀況變更等若干變更，可能引致牌照有效性被檢視
任何詳情變更均會即時自動令牌照失效（30日內生效）
在牌照有效期內，任何詳情變更均不會影響其有效性
只有持牌人的業務地址變更會影響牌照的有效性
tc.explain: 第9.1段提醒持牌人注意，某些詳情變更可能導致金錢服務經營者牌照的有效性被檢視，並以獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的適當人選狀況變更為例——是被檢視，並非自動失效，亦不限於業務地址變更；並非任何變更都不會影響有效性。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.4段

en.q: A licensee intends to change the legal entity through which it operates. What does the Licensing Guide require?
options: A fresh licence application, for the CCE to reassess fitness and propriety
A notification in Form 6, filed within one month of the change
An application in Form 4 for the CCE's prior approval
An updated Business Plan alone, with no fresh application (s.9.4)
en.explain: Paragraph 9.4 states that as far as a change of legal entity is concerned, the licensee must submit a fresh licence application, for the CCE to consider whether the fit and proper status of the legal entity concerned meets the eligibility criteria for the grant of an MSO licence. A Form 6 notification, a Form 4 application, and a Business Plan submitted alone are all real Licensing Guide mechanisms, but none is what paragraph 9.4 requires for a change of legal entity.

tc.q: 持牌人擬更改其經營所用的法律實體。《牌照指引》有何規定？
options: 須重新提出牌照申請，供關長評估新實體的適當人選狀況
須於變更後一個月內以表格6向關長作出通知
須以表格4向關長申請事先批准，猶如新增董事
只須提交更新的業務計劃，毋須再申請（第9.4段）
tc.explain: 第9.4段訂明，就法律實體的變更而言，持牌人須重新提出牌照申請，以便關長考慮有關法律實體的適當人選狀況，是否符合批出金錢服務經營者牌照的資格準則。以表格6具報、以表格4申請，以及只提交業務計劃，均是《牌照指引》中真實存在的機制，但均非第9.4段就法律實體變更所訂的要求。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.4段

en.q: A licensee wishes to change the nature of its money service business, for example from money changing to remittance. What must it file?
options: A written submission to the CCE with an updated Business Plan and AML Policy
A fresh licence application in Form 1, as though applying anew
An application in Form 5, as for a change of business premises
Nothing — the change need only be mentioned at the next renewal under s.9.4 notice
en.explain: Paragraph 9.4 states that if a licensee wishes to change the nature of its money service business — e.g. money changing to remittance, or vice versa — it must file a written submission with the CCE, including the updated Business Plan and AML Policy and any relevant supporting documents, for a review of its fit and proper status for the proposed service. A fresh Form 1 application and a Form 5 premises application are the wrong mechanism, and the change cannot simply wait until the next renewal.

tc.q: 持牌人擬更改其金錢服務業務的性質，例如由貨幣兌換改為匯款。它須提交甚麼？
options: 須向關長提交書面呈交，包括更新業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策
以表格1重新提出牌照申請，猶如首次申請一樣
以表格5提出申請，猶如業務處所出現變更一樣
無須提交任何文件，只須在下次續期時提及（9.4段）
tc.explain: 第9.4段訂明，如持牌人擬更改金錢服務業務的性質（例如由貨幣兌換服務改為匯款服務或相反），須向關長提交書面呈交，包括更新的業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策，以及任何相關證明文件，以便檢視其就提供擬議服務的適當人選狀況。重新以表格1申請或以表格5申請均非正確途徑，亦不可待下次續期才提及。

en.q: A licensee operating at particular premises wishes to change to operating without particular premises. What must it do?
options: Notify the CCE of the cessation of its existing business and reapply for a licence without particular premises
Submit an application in Form 5 to add the new premises, without notifying any cessation
Notify the change of operating mode in Form 6, and continue under the existing licence
Return the existing licence under Form 7, and wait for a replacement to issue automatically under section 10.1 notice
en.explain: Paragraph 10.1 states that if a licensee operating at particular premises wishes to change to operation without particular premises, it needs to submit an application notifying the CCE of the cessation of its existing business and submit a new application for a licence without particular premises. Form 5 (§8.4) only adds premises to an existing licence, Form 6 (§9.2) only notifies a change in particulars, and Form 7 (§10.2) alone only records cessation and licence return — none of these substitutes for the two-step notify-and-reapply process §10.1 requires.

tc.q: 在特定處所經營的持牌人擬改為不設特定處所經營。它須怎樣做？
options: 先通知關長停止現有業務，再申領不設特定處所的新牌照
以表格5申請加入新的經營處所，完全無須具報停止現有業務
以表格6通知經營模式變更，並可繼續使用現有牌照經營業務
以表格7交回現有牌照，並靜候關長自動發出替代牌照
tc.explain: 第10.1段訂明，如在特定處所經營金錢服務的持牌人擬改為不設特定處所經營，該持牌人須提交申請通知海關關長停止其現有業務，並重新提出申請，申領在無特定處所下經營金錢服務的牌照。表格5（第8.4段）只用於為現有牌照加入處所；表格6（第9.2段）只用於通知詳情變更；單獨使用表格7（第10.2段）亦只用於具報停業及交回牌照——三者均不能取代第10.1段所要求「具報停業並重新申請」的雙重程序。

en.q: Which form is used to notify the CCE of a cessation of business, and what must be returned?
options: Form 7; the licence must be returned within 7 days of the cessation or expiry date
Form 6; the change need only be notified in writing within one month, with no licence returned
Form 4; the licence must instead be returned within 7 days of the director's approval
Form 2; the existing licence is retained in full until the renewed licence is issued
en.explain: Paragraph 10.2 requires the licensee to notify the CCE before the date of cessation, including expiry of the licence, by completing Form 7, and to return the valid or expired licence for cancellation within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation or expiry as the case may be. Form 6 (§9.2) notifies a change in particulars, Form 4 (§8.1) seeks approval for a new director, and Form 2 is the renewal application — none of these applies to cessation.

tc.q: 通知海關關長停止營業使用哪一表格？須交回甚麼？
options: 表格7；須於停止營業或屆滿後7日內交回牌照
表格6；有關改變只須於一個月內以書面具報，無須交回牌照
表格4；牌照須改為於董事獲批准後7日內交回
表格2；現有牌照獲悉數保留，直至續期牌照發出為止
tc.explain: 第10.2段規定持牌人須於停止營業日期（包括牌照屆滿）前，以表格7通知海關關長；並須自停止營業或屆滿日期（視屬何情況）起計7日內，將有效或已屆滿的牌照交回關長註銷。表格6（第9.2段）用於通知詳情變更，表格4（第8.1段）用於申請批准新董事，表格2為續牌申請表格——均與停業無關。

en.q: If a licensee cancels its licence within the validity period, is any part of the fees paid refunded?
options: No
Yes, in proportion to the unexpired period
Yes, but only the fit and proper test fee
Yes, but only if cancellation is within the first six months
en.explain: Paragraph 10.3 answers the question with a simple “No”, consistent with section 34(7) and section 41(3) of the AMLO, under which no licence fee paid in respect of the grant or renewal is refunded where a licence is revoked, suspended or returned for cancellation.

tc.q: 如持牌人在牌照有效期內註銷牌照，已繳費用是否有任何部分獲退還？
options: 否
是，按未屆滿期間按比例退還
是，但只退還適當人選測試費用
是，但只限首六個月內註銷
tc.explain: 第10.3段以「否」作答，與《打擊洗錢條例》第34(7)及41(3)條一致；據該等條文，牌照被撤銷、暫時吊銷或交回註銷時，就批出或續期而繳付的牌照費用概不退還。

en.q: Besides the criminal penalty, what further consequence does the Licensing Guide identify for contravening the cessation notification requirement?
options: It adversely affects the person's fitness and propriety to operate or be associated with the business
The Review Tribunal will open its own independent investigation into the licensee's conduct
The licensee becomes entitled under s.10.4 to a partial refund of the fees it has paid to the CCE
It becomes the sole statutory ground on which the CCE may revoke a licensee's licence
en.explain: Paragraph 10.4 sets out the section 41 obligations and the section 41(4) fine of HK$50,000, and adds that such contravention will adversely affect the fitness and propriety of the person concerned to operate a money service or to be associated with the business, on top of possible disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions. The Review Tribunal (§7.3) only hears a licensee's own appeal, not an independent investigation; §10.3 confirms fees paid are never refunded; and §7.1 lists this alongside eight other, independent revocation grounds, so it is not the sole one.

tc.q: 除刑事罰則外，《牌照指引》就違反停業通知規定指出甚麼進一步後果？
options: 該項違反會對其適當人選資格造成不利影響
覆核審裁處會就該項違反展開獨立調查並作出裁定
持牌人可就其已繳付的牌照費用獲發部分退款
該項違反成為關長撤銷牌照的唯一法定理由
tc.explain: 第10.4段列出第41條的責任及第41(4)條的50,000港元罰款，並補充該項違反會對有關人士經營金錢服務或與該業務有聯繫的適當人選資格造成不利影響，海關關長亦可就該項違反採取紀律及／或行政制裁。覆核審裁處（第7.3段）只負責聆聽持牌人自己提出的上訴，並非展開獨立調查；第10.3段訂明已繳費用一律不獲退還；而第7.1段將此連同另外八項理由並列，故並非唯一的撤銷理由。

en.q: Which continuing obligation does the Licensing Guide impose on the individual, partners, directors and ultimate owners in relation to a licensee?
options: They must remain fit and proper at all times
They must each attend the Competence Assessment annually
They must each be resident in Hong Kong
They must each hold a separate approval from the CCE every two years
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(c) lists among a licensee's obligations that the individual, any partner, any director and ultimate owner in relation to a licensee must remain fit and proper at all times — the continuing counterpart to the section 30(3) entry test and the basis for the section 34 revocation power.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就與持牌人有關的個人、合夥人、董事及最終擁有人，施加甚麼持續責任？
options: 他們須時刻保持適當人選資格
他們須每年各自參加能力評核
他們須各自為香港居民
他們須每兩年各自取得海關關長的獨立批准
tc.explain: 第11.1(c)段在持牌人的責任中列明，與持牌人有關的個人、任何合夥人、任何董事及最終擁有人，須時刻保持適當人選資格——這是第30(3)條入場測試的持續對應要求，亦是第34條撤銷權力的基礎。

en.q: What continuing obligation does the Licensing Guide impose in relation to the Competence Assessment?
options: At least one senior management member — sole proprietor, partner or director — must have attended the Assessment
Every member of senior management, not merely one, must have passed rather than attended the Assessment within 30 days
The compliance officer, rather than the sole proprietor, partner or director, must have attended the Assessment
All staff, not only senior management, must attend the Assessment within 30 days of the C&ED interview
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(h) lists among a licensee's obligations that it must ensure at least one of the members of the senior management — that is, the sole proprietor, partner or director — has attended the Assessment.
