The Guidance Notes require passing (not merely attending) by at least one member, not every member; the compliance officer is not part of this senior-management list; and the 30-day/interview timeline (Guidance Notes ¶4.5) governs eligible persons for a new licence application, not all staff.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就能力評核施加甚麼持續責任？
options: 高級管理層（獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）中至少一名成員須曾參加能力評核
高級管理層每名成員（而非僅一名）均須通過（而非只曾參加）能力評核（30日內）
須曾參加能力評核的是合規主任，而非獨資經營者、合夥人或董事
全體員工（而非只限高級管理層）均須於與海關會面後30日內參加能力評核
tc.explain: 第11.1(h)段在持牌人的責任中列明，持牌人須確保其高級管理層（即獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）中至少一名成員曾參加能力評核。《須知》要求的是至少一名成員「通過」（而非只是參加）評核，並非每名成員；合規主任並不屬於此處的高級管理層名單；而《須知》第4.5段所訂的30日／會面時限，規管的是新申請的合資格人士，並非所有員工。

en.q: In whose name must a bank account used for operating the money service business be held?
options: The licensee's company, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner
A third-party account nominated in writing, as the Business Plan Guidelines permit
The compliance officer or MLRO appointed by the licensee to oversee AML/CFT
A client trust account operated by the licensee's solicitors on its behalf
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(j) states that where a bank account is used for operation of the money service business, the account must be in the name of the licensee's company, the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner of the licensee. The Business Plan Guidelines reinforce this by prohibiting, not permitting, third-party accounts; neither the compliance officer/MLRO nor the licensee's solicitors' trust account is a permitted account holder.

tc.q: 用於營運金錢服務業務的銀行帳戶須以何人名義開立？
options: 持牌人的公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人
《遞交業務計劃的指引》容許以書面提名的第三方帳戶
持牌人委任負責監督打擊洗錢的合規主任或洗錢報告主任
由持牌人的律師行代為經營的客戶信託帳戶
tc.explain: 第11.1(j)段訂明，凡使用銀行帳戶營運金錢服務業務，該帳戶必須以持牌人的公司，或該持牌人的獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立。《遞交業務計劃的指引》禁止（而非容許）第三方帳戶，亦印證此點；合規主任／洗錢報告主任或持牌人律師行的信託帳戶均非許可的帳戶持有人。

en.q: What must a licensee operating without particular premises ensure about its local management office?
options: That it maintains the LMO as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED
That records are physically stored at the LMO, in place of a separate storage location
That the original licence is displayed in a conspicuous place at the LMO
That the LMO is registered separately under the Business Registration Ordinance
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(g) lists among a licensee's obligations that, where a licensee operates without particular premises, it must maintain an LMO and ensure the LMO can serve as a point of contact for interfacing with C&ED. Physical storage of records is the separate LPS obligation under §11.1(f); displaying the original licence applies only to licensees with specified premises under §11.1(e); and no Business Registration Ordinance registration is required for the LMO.

tc.q: 並非在特定處所經營的持牌人，須就其本地管理辦事處確保甚麼？
options: 維持該辦事處，並確保其能作為與海關聯絡的接觸點
將紀錄實體存放於該辦事處，以取代另設的存放地方
在該辦事處顯眼地方展示牌照正本
該辦事處須另行根據《商業登記條例》登記
tc.explain: 第11.1(g)段在持牌人的責任中列明，如持牌人在無特定處所下經營金錢服務，須維持本地管理辦事處，並確保該辦事處能作為與海關聯絡的接觸點。實體存放紀錄是第11.1(f)段獨立的存放地方責任；展示牌照正本只適用於有指明處所的持牌人（第11.1(e)段）；本地管理辦事處亦無須根據《商業登記條例》另行登記。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide characterise the list of licensee's obligations it sets out?
options: As a non-exhaustive list; the licensee is obliged to comply with all applicable AMLO provisions and CCE guidelines
As a list confined, under s.11.1, to the suspicious-transaction reporting and AML Policy duties in paragraphs (a) and (b)
As a list applying only to licensees at particular premises, excluding those without particular premises
As a list applying only until the licensee's first renewal application is approved by the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1 states that a licensee is obliged to comply with all the applicable provisions of the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE, and that what follows is a non-exhaustive list of obligations — not confined to items (a)-(b), not limited to licensees with specified premises (item (g) in fact addresses those without), and with no expiry at first renewal.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何描述其所列的持牌人責任清單？
options: 屬並非詳盡無遺的清單，須遵從條例所有適用條文及關長指引
只限於(a)及(b)段所訂的匯報可疑交易及打擊洗錢政策責任
只適用於在牌照指明處所經營金錢服務的持牌人，不包括無處所經營者
只適用至關長批准該持牌人首次續期申請當日為止
tc.explain: 第11.1段訂明持牌人有責任遵從《打擊洗錢條例》所有適用條文及海關關長發出的指引，而其後所列的責任清單並非詳盡無遺——並非只限於(a)、(b)兩項，亦非只適用於有指明處所的持牌人（事實上(g)項正是針對無指明處所的持牌人），且沒有於首次續期屆滿的規定。

en.q: Why does the C&ED require a licensee to submit supplementary information forms?
options: To notify the C&ED of the appointment of a CO and an MLRO, as required by the AML Guideline
To satisfy the separate obligation to lodge a periodic return within 2 weeks of each half year
To notify a change in the CO or MLRO already on file, as with any other change in particulars
To confirm that the CO and the MLRO have each attended the Competence Assessment
en.explain: Paragraph 11.3 explains that a licensee is required to notify the C&ED of the appointment of a CO and an MLRO to act respectively as the focal point for the oversight of compliance measures and the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions, as required by the AML Guideline. This is distinct from the periodic return under §11.2, from a later change to an already-notified CO/MLRO under Form 6 (§9.1(n)), and from the Assessment-attendance duty for senior management under §11.1(h)/§11.4.

tc.q: 香港海關為何要求持牌人提交補充資料表？
options: 以通知海關委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，此乃《打擊洗錢指引》規定
以履行另一項責任，即須於每半年開始後兩星期內遞交定期申報表
以通知已存檔的合規主任或洗錢報告主任出現變更，如同其他詳情變更一樣
以確認合規主任及洗錢報告主任均已參加能力評核
tc.explain: 第11.3段解釋，按《打擊洗錢指引》的規定，持牌人須通知香港海關其委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，分別擔任監督合規措施的統籌點及匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點。這有別於第11.2段的定期申報表、日後透過表格6（第9.1(n)段）具報已存檔的合規主任／洗錢報告主任變更，以及第11.1(h)／11.4段高級管理層參加能力評核的責任。

en.q: Which statutory and regulatory requirement does the Assessment requirement for senior management give effect to?
options: The requirement on senior management oversight prescribed under the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE
The requirement to appoint a CO and an MLRO as the compliance and suspicious-transaction reporting focal points
The requirement to lodge a periodic return with the CCE within 2 weeks of each half year
The requirement that the individual, partners, directors and ultimate owner remain fit and proper at all times
en.explain: Paragraph 11.4 explains that the requirement for senior management to attend the Assessment gives effect to the relevant statutory and regulatory AML/CFT requirement on senior management oversight prescribed under the AMLO and guidelines issued by the CCE — a distinct obligation from appointing a CO/MLRO (§11.3), lodging a periodic return (§11.2), or the general fit-and-proper duty (§11.1(c)).

tc.q: 高級管理層須參加能力評核的規定，是為落實哪一項法定及監管規定？
options: 《打擊洗錢條例》及海關關長發出的指引所訂明關於高級管理層監督的規定
委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任，分別作為合規及匯報可疑交易統籌點的規定
須於每半年開始後兩星期內向關長遞交定期申報表的規定
個人、合夥人、董事及最終擁有人須在任何時間均維持適當人選資格的規定
tc.explain: 第11.4段解釋，高級管理層須參加能力評核的規定，是為落實《打擊洗錢條例》及海關關長發出的指引所訂明、關於高級管理層監督的相關法定及監管打擊洗錢規定——有別於委任合規主任／洗錢報告主任（第11.3段）、遞交定期申報表（第11.2段），或一般的適當人選責任（第11.1(c)段）。

en.q: In what form and manner must a periodic return be submitted?
options: In the form and manner specified by the CCE
In any form the licensee considers appropriate
In the form prescribed by regulation under section 51
In the same form as the original licence application
en.explain: Paragraph 11.2 states that a licensee shall lodge a periodic return to the CCE within 2 weeks beginning from each half year unless specified by the CCE by notice in writing, and that the periodic return must be submitted in the form and manner specified by the CCE.

tc.q: 定期申報表須以甚麼格式及方式提交？
options: 按海關關長指明的格式及方式
持牌人認為適當的任何格式
按第51條規例訂明的格式
與原有牌照申請相同的格式
tc.explain: 第11.2段訂明持牌人須在每半年開始起計兩星期內向海關關長提交定期申報表（除非關長以書面通知另作指明），而該申報表須按關長指明的格式及方式提交。

en.q: Which consent obligation continues to bind a licensee after the licence is granted?
options: Written consent of occupants in mixed commercial-residential premises for routine inspection
Neighbouring businesses' written consent to the display of a company signboard
Each customer's written consent to the retention of their transaction records
The landlord's written consent before submitting each licence renewal application
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(d) lists among a licensee's continuing obligations that it must secure the written consent of the occupants in premises situated in a mixed commercial and residential building for an authorized person to conduct routine inspection. Consent from neighbouring businesses, from customers, or from a landlord before renewal are not obligations found anywhere in the Licensing Guide.

tc.q: 哪一項同意責任在批出牌照後仍持續約束持牌人？
options: 就商住混合樓宇處所，取得佔用人書面同意讓獲授權人例行視察
取得鄰近商戶的書面同意，讓持牌人在處所展示公司招牌
取得每名客戶的書面同意，讓持牌人保存其交易紀錄
在向關長提交每次續期申請前，取得業主的書面同意
tc.explain: 第11.1(d)段在持牌人的持續責任中列明，持牌人須就位於商住混合樓宇的處所，取得佔用人的書面同意，讓獲授權人進行例行視察。取得鄰近商戶、客戶或業主同意的做法，均非《牌照指引》所載的責任。

en.q: Which two AML-related obligations head the Licensing Guide's list of licensee's obligations?
options: Reporting suspicious transactions, and maintaining an effective AML Policy
Screening every customer against sanctions lists, and filing quarterly statistics with the CCE
Training staff annually, and appointing an external auditor to certify compliance
Retaining transaction records for ten years, and insuring the business against fraud losses
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1 opens its non-exhaustive list with (a) a licensee must report on suspicious transactions, and (b) a licensee must develop and maintain an effective AML Policy to mitigate ML/TF risks. Sanctions screening, staff training, external audits, ten-year retention and fraud insurance are not among the Guide's listed obligations.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》持牌人責任清單以哪兩項與打擊洗錢有關的責任開首？
options: 匯報可疑交易；以及維持有效的打擊洗錢政策
就制裁名單篩查每名客戶；以及向關長提交季度統計數字
每年為員工提供培訓；以及委任外部核數師核證合規
保存交易紀錄十年；以及為業務投購保障欺詐損失的保險
tc.explain: 第11.1段的非詳盡清單以下列兩項開首：(a)持牌人必須匯報可疑交易；及(b)持牌人必須制定及維持有效的打擊洗錢政策，以減低洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。制裁名單篩查、員工培訓、委任外部核數師、保存紀錄十年及投購欺詐保險，均非《牌照指引》所列的責任。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1(d)及(e)段

en.q: How do the LPS and LMO revocation grounds differ in their conditions?
options: The LPS ground applies to any licensee; the LMO ground applies only to those without premises
Both apply only to licensees operating a money service at particular premises specified in the licence
Both apply only where the premises have been inspected by C&ED officers and found non-compliant
The LMO ground applies to everyone; the LPS ground applies only to those without premises
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(d) applies where any licensee fails to maintain an LPS or the LPS falls foul of the guide's requirements, without qualification. Paragraph 7.1(e) is expressly limited to a licensee that operates without particular premises — the reverse of paragraph (d)'s universal scope, not a premises-only or inspection-triggered rule.

tc.q: 存放紀錄地方與本地管理辦事處這兩項撤銷理由，條件有何不同？
options: 存放紀錄地方一項適用於任何持牌人；本地管理辦事處一項只適用於不設處所者
兩者均只適用於在牌照上指明的特定處所經營金錢服務的持牌人
兩者均只適用於處所經海關人員視察後被認為不合格的情況
本地管理辦事處一項適用於所有人；存放紀錄地方一項只適用於不設處所者
tc.explain: 第7.1(d)段適用於任何持牌人未有維持存放紀錄地方，或該地方不符本指引所載規定的情況，並無附加條件。第7.1(e)段則明文限於持牌人在無特定處所下經營金錢服務的情況——與(d)段的普遍適用範圍剛好相反，並非只限有處所或須經視察觸發。

en.q: Which broad compliance failure is listed as a ground for revoking or suspending a licence?
options: Where a licensee fails to comply with any AMLO requirement, including those in Part 5
Where a licensee fails to comply with any requirement stipulated in Part 2 of the AMLO
Where a licensee fails to comply with any requirement stipulated in the Schedules to the AMLO
Where a licensee fails to comply with any guideline issued by a body other than the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(h) lists as a ground where a licensee fails to comply with any requirements provided under the AMLO, including requirements stipulated in Part 5 of the AMLO — a catch-all alongside the specific grounds listed. Part 2 of the AMLO and the AMLO's Schedules are real but different parts of the same ordinance not cited here, and guidelines are specifically CCE-issued, not issued by any other body.

tc.q: 哪一項廣泛的合規缺失列為撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 持牌人未有遵從條例下的任何規定，包括第5部的規定
持牌人未有遵從條例第2部所訂明的任何規定
持牌人未有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》附表所訂明的任何規定
持牌人未有遵從並非由關長發出的任何指引
tc.explain: 第7.1(h)段將持牌人未有遵從《打擊洗錢條例》下的任何規定（包括該條例第5部所訂明的規定）列為理由——這是與其他具體理由並列的概括條文。《打擊洗錢條例》第2部及其附表均屬同一條例下真實但並非本段所指的部分；而指引須由關長發出，並非由其他機構發出。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.3段

en.q: Within what period may a licensee appeal against a revocation or suspension decision?
options: Within 21 days after the notice informing the licensee of the decision is sent
Within 21 days after the CCE's revocation or suspension decision takes legal effect
Within 30 days after the licensee actually receives the written notice
Within 45 days after the CCE first makes its revocation or suspension decision
en.explain: Paragraph 7.3 states that the licensee may appeal against the CCE's decision to the Review Tribunal within the period ending 21 days after the notice informing the licensee of the decision has been sent — the period runs from despatch of the notice, not from when the decision takes legal effect, not from actual receipt, and not from when the CCE first makes the decision.

tc.q: 持牌人可於甚麼期限內就撤銷或暫時吊銷決定提出上訴？
options: 須自告知該決定的通知發出當日起計21日內
於關長撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的決定生效後21日內
於持牌人實際接獲書面通知後30日內
於關長首次作出撤銷或暫時吊銷決定後45日內
tc.explain: 第7.3段訂明持牌人可於告知其該決定的通知發出後21日內，就海關關長的決定向審裁處提出上訴——該期間自通知發出時起計，並非自決定生效時、實際接獲通知時，或關長作出決定時起計。

en.q: Within what period must a licensee notify the CCE of a change in particulars, and from when does it run?
options: Within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place
Within one month of the licensee becoming aware of the change, not the date of change
Within one month of the CCE's written request, not automatically from the date of change
Within 7 days of the change, as with returning the licence on cessation
en.explain: Paragraphs 9.2 and 9.3 both state that the licensee must notify the CCE in writing of the change within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place, reflecting section 40(1) of the AMLO. The clock runs from the change itself — not from the licensee's awareness of it, not from a CCE request, and the 7-day period belongs to returning the licence on cessation (§10.2/§10.4), not to this notification.

tc.q: 持牌人須於甚麼期限內將詳情變更通知海關關長？該期間自何時起計？
options: 須自變更發生當日起計一個月內具報
自持牌人知悉該變更當日起計一個月內
自關長書面要求當日起計一個月內
自變更發生當日起計7日內，同交回牌照限期
tc.explain: 第9.2及9.3段均訂明持牌人須自變更發生之日起計一個月內，以書面將變更通知海關關長，反映《打擊洗錢條例》第40(1)條的規定。計時自變更本身起計——並非自持牌人知悉起計，亦非待關長書面要求後起計；7日的期限則屬第10.2／10.4段停業交回牌照的期限，並非此項具報期限。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第9.3段

en.q: Besides the fine, what further consequence follows a licensee's failure to notify a change in particulars?
options: The licensee may also face disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions such as suspension or revocation
The licensee must instead submit a fresh licence application, as when changing its legal entity within 21 days
The licence is automatically suspended for one month while the CCE reviews the change
The compliance officer must personally notify the Review Tribunal within 21 days
en.explain: Paragraph 9.3 sets out the section 40(1) duty and the section 40(4) fine of HK$50,000, and adds that apart from criminal sanction, a licensee who contravenes section 40(1) may also be subject to disciplinary and/or administrative sanctions such as suspension and revocation of licence. A fresh application is required only for a legal-entity change under §9.4, not for late notice; nothing in §9.3 automatically suspends the licence for a month; and it is the licensee, not the compliance officer, who may appeal to the Review Tribunal under §7.3, not 'notify' it.

tc.q: 除罰款外，持牌人未有通知詳情變更還會招致甚麼後果？
options: 持牌人亦可能受到紀律或行政制裁，如暫時吊銷或撤銷
持牌人須改為提交新的牌照申請，如同更改法律實體一樣
牌照會於關長審視有關改變期間自動暫時吊銷一個月
合規主任須親自於21日內通知審裁處，而非持牌人
tc.explain: 第9.3段列出第40(1)條的責任及第40(4)條的50,000港元罰款，並補充除刑事制裁外，違反第40(1)條的持牌人亦可能受到紀律及／或行政制裁，例如暫時吊銷及撤銷牌照。提交新牌照申請只適用於第9.4段的法律實體變更，並非遲交通知的後果；第9.3段並無牌照自動暫時吊銷一個月的規定；而根據第7.3段，可向審裁處提出上訴的是持牌人本身，並非由合規主任「通知」審裁處。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.4段

en.q: Which form must a licensee use to apply to add premises at which to operate a money service?
options: Form 5
Form 4 (s39)
Form 6
Form 7
en.explain: Paragraph 8.4 states that if a licensee wishes to add premises to operate a money service, the licensee needs to make an application in Form 5 to add the premises. Form 4 is for approvals of directors, ultimate owners and partners; Form 6 notifies changes; Form 7 notifies cessation.

tc.q: 持牌人申請新增經營金錢服務的處所，須使用哪一表格？
options: 表格5
表格6
表格7
tc.explain: 第8.4段訂明，如持牌人擬新增經營金錢服務的處所，須以表格5提出申請新增該處所。表格4用於董事、最終擁有人及合夥人的批准；表格6用於通知變更；表格7則用於通知停止營業。

en.q: What penalty does the Licensing Guide state for contravening the prior-approval requirements in sections 35(1) to 39(1)?
options: A HK$50,000 fine and 6 months' imprisonment, plus possible s.43(1)(c) disciplinary action
A fine of HK$100,000 and imprisonment for 12 months imposed on a first conviction
A pecuniary penalty of up to HK$1,000,000 imposed under s.8.9 by the Review Tribunal
A written warning only is issued, with no fine, for a first-time contravention
en.explain: Paragraphs 8.5 to 8.9 each state that a person who without reasonable excuse contravenes the relevant subsection commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months, and that the CCE may also take disciplinary action under section 43(1)(c). There is no HK$100,000/12-month tier, no HK$1,000,000 pecuniary penalty imposed by the Review Tribunal (whose role under §7.3 is only to hear appeals), and no warning-only regime for a first contravention.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》就違反第35(1)至39(1)條的事先批准規定，訂明甚麼刑罰？
options: 一經定罪可處罰款5萬元及監禁6個月，另可紀律處分
一經首次定罪可處罰款100,000港元及監禁12個月
可處由審裁處直接施加的罰款，最高達1,000,000港元
首次違反只發書面警告，不會處以任何罰款
tc.explain: 第8.5至8.9段均訂明，任何人無合理辯解而違反有關條款即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處罰款50,000港元及監禁6個月；海關關長亦可根據第43(1)(c)條採取紀律行動。並無100,000港元及監禁12個月的罰則，亦無由審裁處直接施加、最高1,000,000港元的罰款（審裁處按第7.3段的角色只負責聆聽上訴），首次違反亦非只發書面警告了事。

en.q: Must a licensee notify the CCE if it ceases to operate a money service at only some of the premises specified in its licence?
options: Yes — the duty covers both full cessation of business and cessation at any specified premises
No — notification is required only when the licensee ceases business entirely
No — a Form 6 change-of-particulars notice suffices for individual premises
Yes, but only where the premises being given up are the principal premises
en.explain: Paragraph 10.1 states that the licensee needs to notify the CCE of the cessation of business or the cessation of operating a money service at any specified premises, mirroring section 41(1) of the AMLO which covers both situations — not full cessation alone, not a Form 6 notice, and not only the principal premises.

tc.q: 如持牌人只是停止在牌照指明處所中的部分處所經營金錢服務，是否須通知海關關長？
options: 須通知——責任涵蓋停止營業及停止在任何指明處所經營
無須——只有持牌人完全停止營業才須具報通知
無須——個別處所的變更以表格6作出通知即已足夠
須通知，但只限被放棄的處所屬主要處所的情況
tc.explain: 第10.1段訂明持牌人須將停止營業或停止在任何指明處所經營金錢服務一事通知海關關長，與《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)條涵蓋兩種情況相對應——並非只限完全停業，也不能單以表格6通知代替，更非只限主要處所的情況。

en.q: Does the cessation notification requirement extend to the expiry of a licence?
options: Yes — notification, including expiry, is required, and licence returned within 7 days
No — expiry is automatic and needs no notification or return of the licence
Yes, but only where the licensee has no intention of ever applying again
No — only a voluntary decision to cease business requires notification
en.explain: Paragraph 10.2 states that the licensee must notify the CCE before the date of cessation, expressly including expiry of the licence, by completing Form 7, and must return the valid or expired licence for cancellation within 7 days beginning on the date of cessation or expiry as the case may be — not automatically, not conditioned on future re-application, and not limited to voluntary cessation.

tc.q: 停業通知規定是否延伸至牌照屆滿的情況？
options: 是——須於停業或屆滿前通知，並於7日內交回牌照
否——屆滿屬自動生效，完全無須通知或交回牌照
是，但只限持牌人並無意圖重新提出申請的情況
否——只有屬自願性質的停業才須作出通知
tc.explain: 第10.2段訂明持牌人須於停止營業日期（明文包括牌照屆滿）前填寫表格7通知海關關長，並須自停止營業或屆滿日期（視屬何情況）起計7日內交回有效或已屆滿的牌照以作註銷——並非自動生效，也不取決於是否有意重新申請，更不限於自願停業的情況。

en.q: Which record-storage obligation applies to every licensee, whether or not it operates at particular premises?
options: A licensee must maintain a local place for storage of books and records
A licensee must maintain a local management office instead
A licensee must store records under s.11.1 only at its principal business premises
A licensee must lodge copies of its records with the C&ED on request
en.explain: Paragraph 11.1(f) lists among a licensee's obligations that a licensee must maintain an LPS, without qualification. The LMO obligation in paragraph 11.1(g) applies only where the licensee operates without particular premises; the guide does not confine the LPS to the principal business premises; and there is no requirement to lodge copies with the C&ED.

tc.q: 哪一項紀錄存放責任適用於每名持牌人，不論其是否在特定處所經營？
options: 持牌人須維持本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方
持牌人須改為維持本地管理辦事處
持牌人須只將紀錄存放於其主要業務處所（限）
持牌人須應要求向香港海關存放紀錄副本
tc.explain: 第11.1(f)段在持牌人的責任中列明持牌人須維持本地存放簿冊及紀錄的地方，並無附加條件。第11.1(g)段的本地管理辦事處責任，則只適用於在無特定處所下經營的持牌人；本指引亦沒有將存放地方限於主要業務處所，更沒有應要求向海關存放副本的規定。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第7.1(b)及(c)段

en.q: Which two consent-related events are listed as grounds for revoking or suspending a licence?
options: Any occupant revoking consent previously given for routine inspection, and any new occupant refusing it
The landlord withdrawing permission to use the premises, and the licensee's bank closing its account
The licensee itself withdrawing consent to inspection, and the compliance officer resigning from post
A customer withdrawing consent to retention of their transaction records, and a staff member resigning
en.explain: Paragraphs 7.1(b) and (c) list as grounds where any occupant of the premises revokes his or her written consent previously given for any authorized officer to enter the premises for routine inspection, and where any new occupant of the premises refuses to give such a written consent — mirroring section 34(1)(b) of the AMLO. A landlord's permission, the licensee's own consent, a customer's consent and staff resignations are not among the grounds listed.

tc.q: 哪兩項與同意有關的事件列為撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由？
options: 任何佔用人撤回就視察給予的同意；新佔用人拒絕給予該同意
業主撤回使用處所的許可；以及持牌人的往來銀行結束其帳戶
持牌人本身撤回接受視察的同意；以及合規主任辭職離任
客戶撤回保存其交易紀錄的同意；以及一名員工辭職離任
tc.explain: 第7.1(b)及(c)段將下列情況列為理由：處所的任何佔用人撤回其先前給予、讓任何獲授權人員進入處所進行例行視察的書面同意；以及處所的任何新佔用人拒絕給予該書面同意——與《打擊洗錢條例》第34(1)(b)條相對應。業主的許可、持牌人本身的同意、客戶的同意及員工辭職，均非當中所列的理由。

en.q: Who makes the application for approval, and who submits the fit and proper person declaration, when a new director, ultimate owner or partner is proposed?
options: The licensee applies in Form 4; the proposing person submits the fit and proper person declaration
The proposing director, owner or partner submits both the Form 4 application and the declaration
The licensee alone submits both the Form 4 application and the fit and proper person declaration
The C&ED initiates the approval process once notified informally of the proposal within 21 days
en.explain: Paragraphs 8.1 to 8.3 each state that the licensee needs to make an application in Form 4 and that the proposing director, ultimate owner or partner needs to submit the fit and proper person declaration form — a split of responsibility, not a task for the proposing person alone, the licensee alone, or something the C&ED initiates itself.

tc.q: 擬委任新董事、最終擁有人或合夥人時，由何人提出批准申請？由何人提交適當人選聲明？
options: 由持牌人以表格4提出申請；由該擬任人士提交適當人選聲明表格
擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人須同時提交表格4申請及聲明表格
持牌人須獨自提交表格4申請及適當人選聲明表格
海關在非正式接獲提議通知後，會自行展開審批程序（7日內）
tc.explain: 第8.1至8.3段均訂明持牌人須以表格4提出申請，而該擬任董事、最終擁有人或合夥人須提交適當人選聲明表格——申請與聲明分由不同人士辦理，並非全由擬任人士、全由持牌人辦理，亦非由香港海關自行展開程序。

en.q: Whose loss of fit and proper status is listed first among the grounds for revoking or suspending a licence?
options: The licensee, the individual, any partner, any director or ultimate owner, once the licence is granted
Only the sole proprietor, or the managing director where the licensee is a corporation
Only the ultimate owner, excluding the licensee itself, its partners, and its directors under paragraph 7.1(a)
Only the compliance officer and the money laundering reporting officer, not the owner
en.explain: Paragraph 7.1(a) lists as the first ground that the licensee, the individual, any partner, any director and any ultimate owner in relation to the licensee is no longer a fit and proper person to operate a money service or to be associated with the business of operating a money service after the grant of a licence — a broad list, not confined to the sole proprietor/managing director, the ultimate owner alone, or the CO/MLRO.

tc.q: 在撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由中，何人喪失適當人選資格被列為首項？
options: 批出牌照後，持牌人、個人、任何合夥人、董事及最終擁有人
只限獨資經營者；如屬法團，則只限擔任董事總經理的董事
只限最終擁有人，不包括持牌人本身、合夥人及董事（有限公司）
只限合規主任及洗錢報告主任，不包括最終擁有人
tc.explain: 第7.1(a)段將下述情況列為首項理由：在批出牌照後，與該持牌人有關的持牌人、個人、任何合夥人、任何董事及任何最終擁有人，不再是適合經營金錢服務或適合與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的適當人選——範圍廣泛，並非只限獨資經營者／董事總經理、只限最終擁有人，或只限合規主任及洗錢報告主任。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶1.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第1.1段

en.q: What is the stated aim of implementing the Competence Assessment?
options: To ensure senior management has fundamental AML/CFT knowledge to duly oversee the AML/CFT systems
To standardise the professional qualifications of all money service industry staff
To replace, rather than feed into, the fit and proper person test for senior management
To generate additional licence-fee revenue for the CCE's licensing regime
en.explain: Paragraph 1.1 states that the implementation of the Assessment aims at ensuring that the senior management of a licensed MSO has a fundamental knowledge and clear understanding of AML/CFT to duly oversee all aspects of the AML/CFT systems set out for operating the money service business. It does not standardise staff qualifications generally, does not replace the F&P test (the Assessment result instead feeds into it, per ¶3.1), and generates no separate fee revenue.

tc.q: 推行能力評核的訂明目的為何？
options: 確保高級管理層對洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集有認識，以監督相關系統
統一金錢服務業界內所有前線及後勤員工必須持有的專業資格
取代而非只是補充高級管理層須通過的適當人選測試安排
為關長的發牌制度帶來額外的牌照申請及續期費收入
tc.explain: 第1.1段訂明推行評核旨在確保持牌金錢服務經營者的高級管理層具備打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的基本知識及清晰理解，以妥善監督為經營金錢服務業務而設的相關系統各方面。評核並非統一全體員工的專業資格，亦非取代（而是按第3.1段補充）適當人選測試，更不會帶來額外的費用收入。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶1.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第1.1段

en.q: Beyond the individual MSO, what wider purpose does the Guidance Notes say the Assessment serves?
options: Uplifting the compliance level of the MSO sector and safeguarding the integrity of the AML/CFT regime
Ensuring each MSO's senior management understands ML/TF well enough to oversee its own systems
Constituting a substantial weighting in evaluating each applicant's own fit and proper status
Providing candidates with detailed information on the examination format so they can prepare
en.explain: Paragraph 1.1 states that the Assessment is conducive to uplifting the compliance level of the MSO sector and safeguarding the integrity of the AML/CFT regime under the AMLO. The individual-MSO knowledge aim is the same paragraph's earlier, narrower point; the F&P weighting is paragraph 3.1's point about a single application; and informing candidates about the exam format is paragraph 1.2's description of the Guidance Notes themselves — none is the 'wider' purpose asked for.

tc.q: 除個別金錢服務經營者外，《須知》指出評核還具備甚麼更廣泛目的？
options: 提升金錢服務經營者業界的合規水平，並維護打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集制度的健全性
確保個別經營者的高級管理層理解洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集，以監督其本身系統
在評估每名申請人本身的適當人選資格時，佔相當重要的比重，屬個別考慮因素
向應考者提供有關考試形式及能力評核準則方面的詳細資料，讓他們可以做好備試準備
tc.explain: 第1.1段訂明評核有助提升金錢服務經營者業界的合規水平，並維護《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》下打擊洗錢制度的健全性。個別經營者的知識目的是同一段較前、範圍較窄的重點；適當人選資格的比重屬第3.1段就個別申請而言的重點；而向應考者提供考試形式資料則是第1.2段對《須知》本身的描述——三者均非題目所問的「更廣泛目的」。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶3.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第3.1段

en.q: What weight does the Guidance Notes say the Assessment result carries in the licensing decision?
options: It constitutes a substantial weighting in the F&P evaluation, as one factor the CCE has regard to
It is fully determinative of the licensing decision, on its own and without more
It is taken into account only where other F&P factors are evenly balanced under the Guidance Notes s.3.1
It carries no weight at all beyond simply confirming the candidate's attendance
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 states that the result of the Assessment will constitute a substantial weighting in the evaluation of the overall F&P person status and thus be one of the factors that the CCE will have regard to in considering the grant or renewal of an MSO licence — a substantial factor among others, not the sole determinant, not a tie-breaker only, and not a mere attendance check.

tc.q: 《須知》指出評核結果在發牌決定中佔有甚麼分量？
options: 在整體適當人選評估中佔重要比重，屬關長須顧及的因素之一
單憑評核結果本身，即可完全決定批出或續期牌照的結果
只有在其他適當人選因素旗鼓相當時，才會被考慮在內（附加）
除確認候選人已經出席評核外，並無任何額外分量
tc.explain: 第3.1段訂明評核結果在評估整體適當人選資格時佔重要比重，因而成為海關關長在考慮批出或續期金錢服務經營者牌照時須顧及的其中一項因素——是眾多因素之一而非唯一決定因素，並非只在其他因素旗鼓相當時才考慮，也不只是確認出席而已。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶3.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第3.1段

en.q: Why were the Licensing Guide's application procedures for grant/renewal of an MSO licence revised, per the Guidance Notes?
options: To tie in with the implementation of the Competence Assessment for senior management
To provide greater clarity to applicants on the criteria for determining fitness and propriety
To implement new customer due diligence requirements for occasional transactions
To follow amendments made to sections 30 and 31 of the AMLO
en.explain: Paragraph 3.1 states that to tie in with the implementation of the Assessment, the application procedures for the grant/renewal of an MSO licence stipulated in the Licensing Guide are revised accordingly. Providing clarity on F&P criteria is instead why the F&P Guideline and Supplementary F&P Guideline were promulgated (¶2.2); customer due diligence for occasional transactions is a different AML/CFT Guideline topic; and no amendment to AMLO sections 30/31 is cited as the trigger.

tc.q: 根據《須知》，《牌照指引》有關批出／續期金錢服務經營者牌照的申請程序，因何修訂？
options: 為配合推行高級管理層能力評核而作出修訂
為向申請人更清楚闡釋斷定適當人選資格的準則
為推行適用於非經常交易的新客戶盡職審查規定
為配合《打擊洗錢條例》第30及31條的修訂
tc.explain: 第3.1段訂明，為配合推行能力評核，《牌照指引》所載有關批出／續期金錢服務經營者牌照的申請程序已作相應修訂。向申請人闡釋適當人選準則，是頒布《適當人選指引》及《適當人選補充指引》的原因（第2.2段）；非經常交易的客戶盡職審查規定屬《打擊洗錢指引》的另一課題；條文亦沒有提及《打擊洗錢條例》第30及31條有任何修訂觸發是次修改。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.1段

en.q: Which three criteria must an eligible person for the Assessment satisfy?
options: Senior management overseeing the business, involved in policy decisions, and accountable for compliance
Holding a professional qualification, having five years' relevant experience, and being ordinarily resident in Hong Kong
Being a director, being a registered shareholder, and being personally resident at the business premises
Being nominated by the CCE itself, passing a preliminary screening test, and paying the assessment fee
en.explain: Paragraph 4.1 defines an eligible person as one who must be the senior management of the licence applicant or licensee in overseeing the operation of the money service business; has a direct involvement in making decisions on company policy and governance arrangements; and is held accountable in the compliance functions and systems of the company — not professional-qualification/experience/residency criteria, not director/shareholder/premises-residency criteria, and not a CCE-nomination or preliminary-test process.

tc.q: 參加評核的合資格人士須符合哪三項準則？
options: 屬監督業務的高級管理層、參與政策決策，並就合規負責
持有專業資格、擁有五年相關經驗，並為香港永久居民
擔任董事、持有登記股份，並親身居於業務處所
由關長親自提名、通過初步篩選測試，並繳付評核費用
tc.explain: 第4.1段界定合資格人士為：必須是牌照申請人／持牌人中監督金錢服務業務營運的高級管理層；直接參與制定公司政策及管治安排的決策；並就公司的合規職能及系統負責——並非專業資格／經驗／居港年期的準則，也不是董事／股東／居於處所的準則，更非由關長提名或初步測試的程序。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.2段

en.q: Where the MSO licence applicant or licensee is a partnership, how many partners may be nominated to participate in the Assessment?
options: Not more than three partners
Only one partner
All partners must participate
Any number, at the partnership's discretion
en.explain: Paragraph 4.2(i) defines senior management, where the applicant or licensee is a natural person, as the sole proprietor or the partners in the partnership, with not more than three partners able to be nominated to participate in the Assessment. The same limit of three applies to directors of a corporation under paragraph 4.2(ii).

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者牌照申請人／持牌人是合夥，可提名多少名合夥人參加評核？
options: 不多於三名合夥人
只限一名合夥人
所有合夥人均須參加
任何數目，由該合夥自行決定
tc.explain: 第4.2(i)段界定，如申請人／持牌人是自然人，高級管理層指獨資經營者或合夥的合夥人，而可獲提名參加評核的合夥人不多於三名。第4.2(ii)段就法團董事訂有相同的三名上限。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.3段

en.q: Because the Assessment is conducted on a company basis, what follows for candidates from the same company?
options: They must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances
They may choose to attend different sessions of the Assessment, to spread the risk
They must attend the Assessment on consecutive days, one candidate per day
Only the three most senior of them need attend, per the cap on nominated candidates
en.explain: Paragraph 4.3 states that, given the Assessment is conducted on a company basis, the candidates of the same company or corporation under an application or an MSO licence must attend the same session of the Assessment in all circumstances — not different sessions, not on separate consecutive days, and the three-candidate cap in paragraph 4.2 governs how many may be nominated, not who among them must attend.

tc.q: 由於評核以公司為單位進行，同一公司的考生須怎樣做？
options: 在任何情況下，同一公司考生均須出席同一場次的評核
可選擇出席不同場次的評核，以分散合規風險
須連續數日出席評核，每日一名考生應考
按獲提名考生人數上限，當中只須最資深的三人出席
tc.explain: 第4.3段訂明，由於評核以公司為單位進行，同一申請／金錢服務經營者牌照下同一公司／法團的考生，在任何情況下均須出席同一場次的評核——並非可選擇不同場次，也不是分開連續數日應考；第4.2段的三人提名上限規管的是可提名的人數，並非規定當中何人須出席。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.4
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.4段

en.q: In which three circumstances may a licence applicant or licensee nominate eligible persons to attend the Assessment?
options: New application; within 90 days of expiry with no eligible passer; or on deleting sole passer
The applicant or licensee may nominate at any time and any number of times
Only when a new licence application is first filed; never again for the life of that licence
Automatically once every two years, regardless of whether an eligible person has passed
en.explain: Paragraph 4.4 states that nomination would be made only once and in the following circumstances: a new licence application is filed; within 90 days before the expiry of the licence where the licensee has no eligible person who has passed the Assessment; and upon notification by a licensee of the deletion of the only eligible person who has passed — not an unrestricted right, not confined to the new-application case alone, and not an automatic biennial event.

tc.q: 牌照申請人／持牌人可在哪三種情況下提名合資格人士參加評核？
options: 提交新申請時；屆滿前90日內未有人通過評核時；或通知刪除唯一通過者時
申請人或持牌人可自行選擇任何時間、不限次數地向關長提出提名，並無限制
只限於首次提交新牌照申請時可提名，牌照有效期內任何情況均不得再提名
不論持牌人是否已有合資格人士通過評核，一律每兩年自動提名一次
tc.explain: 第4.4段訂明提名只會作出一次，並限於下列情況：提交新牌照申請時；在牌照屆滿前90日內而該持牌人並無已通過評核的合資格人士時；以及持牌人通知刪除唯一已通過評核的合資格人士時——並非不受限制、不只限新申請一種情況，也不是每兩年自動提名一次。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.5段

en.q: For the grant of a licence, within what period must the eligible persons attend the Assessment?
options: Within 30 days of the interview with C&ED officers
Within 30 days of submitting the licence application
Within 90 days of attending the interview with C&ED officers
Within 30 days of the issue of the renewal reminder letter
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 states that for granting an MSO licence, the eligible persons of the licence applicant shall attend the Assessment within 30 days of attending the interview with the officers of the C&ED — the period is 30 days, not 90, and it runs from the interview, not from submitting the application or from a reminder letter, which is instead the trigger for renewal under paragraph 4.6.

tc.q: 就批出牌照而言，合資格人士須於甚麼期限內參加評核？
options: 與香港海關人員面談後30日內
於提交牌照申請後30日內
於與香港海關人員面談後90日內
於發出續期提示信後30日內
tc.explain: 第4.5段訂明就批出金錢服務經營者牌照而言，牌照申請人的合資格人士須於與香港海關人員面談後30日內參加評核——期限為30日而非90日，並由面談起計，而非由提交申請起計；提示信發出則是第4.6段續牌時的觸發事件。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.5段

en.q: If the eligible persons of a licence applicant fail the Assessment, when may they re-take it?
options: After 30 days upon notification of the result
Immediately, at the next available session (s.4.5)
After 90 days upon notification of the result
Only at the next renewal cycle
en.explain: Paragraph 4.5 states that if the eligible persons of the applicant fail the Assessment, the applicant will be given another opportunity to arrange the eligible persons to re-take the Assessment after 30 days upon the notification of result, and that the licence application could be refused where the CCE considers the applicant not fit and proper.

tc.q: 如牌照申請人的合資格人士未能通過評核，何時可以重考？
options: 在獲通知結果後30日後
即時，在下一個可供的場次
在獲通知結果後90日後
只可在下一個續期周期
tc.explain: 第4.5段訂明如申請人的合資格人士未能通過評核，申請人會獲另一次機會，安排合資格人士在獲通知結果後30日後重考；如海關關長認為該申請人並非適合經營金錢服務業務的適當人選，有關牌照申請可被拒絕。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.6
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.6段

en.q: For renewing a licence, from what event does the 30-day period for attending the Assessment run?
options: At the issue of the reminder letter
At the submission of the renewal application
At the interview with C&ED officers
At the expiry of the existing licence
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 states that for renewing an MSO licence, the eligible persons of the licensee shall attend the Assessment within 30 days upon the issue of the reminder letter, delivered 90 days before the licence's expiry. The interview with C&ED officers is instead the trigger for a first grant under paragraph 4.5; submitting the renewal application and the licence's eventual expiry are not the trigger.

tc.q: 就續期牌照而言，出席評核的30日期間自哪一事件起計？
options: 提示信發出之時
提交續期申請之時
與海關人員面談之時
現有牌照屆滿之時
tc.explain: 第4.6段訂明就續期金錢服務經營者牌照而言，持牌人的合資格人士須於提示信發出後30日內參加評核，該信會在牌照屆滿前90日送達。與海關人員面談是第4.5段批出新牌照的觸發事件，並非續期的觸發事件；提交續期申請及牌照屆滿本身均非觸發事件。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶4.6
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第4.6段

en.q: On a renewal, by when must any re-take of the Assessment occur?
options: After 30 days from result notification, before licence expires
Within 30 days of the first attempt, whatever the expiry date
At any time within twelve months of the first attempt
Only after the licence has expired and an application is made
en.explain: Paragraph 4.6 states that if the eligible persons of the licensee fail, the licensee will be given another opportunity to arrange them to re-take the Assessment after 30 days upon notification of the result and before the expiry of the licence — not simply 30 days after the first attempt regardless of expiry, not any time within twelve months, and not only after the licence has already expired.

tc.q: 就續期而言，重考評核須於何時進行？
options: 獲通知結果後30日後，須在牌照屆滿前
在首次應考後30日內，不論何時屆滿
在首次應考後十二個月內任何時間
只可在牌照屆滿並重新提出申請後
tc.explain: 第4.6段訂明如持牌人的合資格人士未能通過評核，持牌人會獲另一次機會，安排他們在獲通知結果後30日後、並在牌照屆滿之前重考——並非首次應考後30日內不論屆滿日期，也非首次應考後十二個月內任何時間，更非只可在牌照屆滿並重新申請後。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.1段

en.q: How many questions does the Assessment comprise, and how long is allowed?
options: 35 multiple-choice questions in 75 min
40 multiple-choice questions in 2 hours
35 multiple-choice questions in 1 hour
50 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes
en.explain: Paragraph 5.1 states that the Assessment comprises 35 multiple-choice questions in Chinese or English, with only one correct answer for each question, and that candidates are required to complete the Assessment in 1 hour and 15 minutes — not 1 hour flat, and not 40 or 50 questions.

tc.q: 評核由多少條題目組成？限時多久？
options: 35條選擇題，限時75分
40條選擇題，限時2小時正
35條選擇題，限時1小時正
50條選擇題，限時90分鐘
tc.explain: 第5.1段訂明評核由35條中文或英文多項選擇題組成，每題只有一個正確答案；考生須於1小時15分鐘內完成評核——並非僅1小時整，題目數目亦非40條或50條。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.3段

en.q: What are the two requirements a candidate must satisfy to obtain a pass?
options: Not more than two mistakes per module, and 25 or above
A total score of 25 or above, with no per-module limit
Not more than five mistakes in total, regardless of score
A total score of 28 or above, with no module requirement
en.explain: Paragraph 5.3 requires both conditions together: not more than two mistakes in each module, and a total score of 25 or above for the entire paper. A high total score with a module blowout still fails, five total mistakes is not the real per-module limit, and 28 is not the pass mark.

tc.q: 考生須符合哪兩項要求方可取得及格？
options: 每單元錯題不超兩題，總分25分以上
只需總分達25分或以上，單元不設上限
總錯題不多於五題，不論分數
總分達28分或以上，並無單元要求
tc.explain: 第5.3段訂明必須同時符合兩項條件：每個單元錯題不多於兩題，並在整份評核試卷取得25分或以上的總分。即使總分達標，若某單元錯題過多仍不及格；五題並非總錯題上限；及格分數亦非28分。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.2段

en.q: How is the Assessment structured across modules?
options: Seven modules of five questions each
Five modules of seven questions each
Seven modules of varying length
Three modules of twelve questions
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 states the Assessment is composed of seven modules and each module consists of five multiple-choice questions — not five modules of seven questions, not seven modules of unspecified varying length, and not three modules of twelve questions.

tc.q: 評核在單元方面如何編排？
options: 七個單元，每單元五條選擇題
五個單元，每個單元七條題目
七個單元，長度不一
三個單元，每單元十二條題目
tc.explain: 第5.2段訂明評核由七個單元組成，每個單元包含五條多項選擇題——並非五個單元、每單元七題，也非長度不一的七個單元，更非三個單元、每單元十二題。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶5.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第5.2段

en.q: Which of the following is one of the seven modules of the Assessment?
options: Systems and controls (iii): compliance monitoring
Systems and controls (i): AML/CFT control areas
Schedules to the AMLO and Parts 1 to 7
Guidelines and circulars both issued by the C&ED
en.explain: Paragraph 5.2 lists the seven modules, including MSO's systems and controls (iii): demonstrating and monitoring compliance. Systems and controls (i) is institutional governance and strategy, not AML/CFT control areas — that is module (ii); Schedules to the AMLO and Part 1-7 of the AMLO are two separate modules, not one; and circulars are listed in paragraph 6.1 as suggested reference material, not as one of the seven modules alongside guidelines.

tc.q: 下列何者屬評核七個單元之一？
options: 系統及監控（三）：展示及監察合規
系統及監控（一）：打擊洗錢監控範疇
《打擊洗錢條例》附表及第1至7部
海關向金錢服務經營者發出的指引及通函
tc.explain: 第5.2段列出七個單元，包括系統及監控（三）：展示及監察合規情況。系統及監控（一）是機構管治及策略，並非打擊洗錢監控範疇——後者是（二）；《打擊洗錢條例》附表與第1至7部是兩個獨立單元，並非合併為一；通函則是第6.1段所列的建議參考資料，並非與指引同屬七個單元之一。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶6.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第6.1段

en.q: On which publicly available materials are the Assessment questions mainly based?
options: The AMLO; the AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs; the Licensing Guide; and guidelines and circulars issued by the C&ED to MSOs
Textbooks and study guides published by commercial examination-preparation providers, none of which the C&ED endorses as reference material
The FATF Recommendations and the mutual evaluation reports on Hong Kong's AML/CFT regime published by the FATF
Past Assessment question papers and the corresponding correct answers released by the C&ED after each sitting
en.explain: Paragraph 6.1 restricts the Assessment questions to five named, publicly available sources: the AMLO; the AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs; the Licensing Guide; guidelines issued by C&ED to MSOs; and circulars issued by C&ED to MSOs. General AML/CFT material such as the FATF Recommendations and mutual evaluation reports, commercial textbooks, and past Assessment papers are not among them — and paragraph 12.4 confirms the C&ED will never disclose past questions or the corresponding correct answers.

tc.q: 評核題目主要根據哪些公開資料擬定？
options: 《打擊洗錢條例》、海關打擊洗錢指引、牌照指引、海關發出的指引及通函
由商業性評核備考機構出版、海關從未認可作為官方參考資料的教科書及溫習指南
財務行動特別組織發出的打擊洗錢建議，以及組織就香港打擊洗錢制度發表的相互評估報告
海關應考生要求，在覆核程序中向其發還的歷屆評核試題及正確答案
tc.explain: 第6.1段將評核題目的資料來源限於五項指明的公開資料：《打擊洗錢條例》、海關的《打擊洗錢指引》、《牌照指引》，以及海關向金錢服務經營者發出的指引及通函。財務行動特別組織的建議及相互評估報告等一般打擊洗錢資料、商業教科書，以及歷屆試題均不在其中；而且第12.4段訂明，海關在任何情況下均不會披露過往試題或相應的正確答案。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.1段

en.q: How does the CCE characterise a pass in the Assessment?
options: A company-based qualification, and one of the F&P person statuses associated with operating a money service
A personal qualification belonging to the individual, valid after leaving the licensee's senior management
A licence in its own right, issued directly by the CCE under section 30 of the AMLO
A qualification valid for five years from the date of the result, renewable on written application
en.explain: Paragraph 8.1 states that a pass in the Assessment is considered by the CCE to be a company-based qualification, which is also one of the F&P person statuses to be associated with the business of operating a money service — it is not a personal qualification that survives the holder's departure (paragraph 8.2 voids it automatically), not a licence in its own right, and not subject to any five-year or renewal rule.

tc.q: 海關關長如何界定通過評核的性質？
options: 屬以公司為單位的資格，亦是與金錢服務經營業務有聯繫的其中一項適當人選資格
屬應考個人的個人資格，即使該人其後不再屬持牌人的高級管理層，資格仍然有效
本身即屬一種牌照，由關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第30條直接發出
屬自結果日期起計五年內有效的資格，可憑書面申請續期
tc.explain: 第8.1段訂明海關關長視通過評核為以公司為單位的資格，該資格亦是與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的其中一項適當人選資格——並非在該人離任後仍然有效的個人資格（第8.2段訂明會自動失效），本身亦不是一種牌照，更沒有五年有效期或續期安排。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.2段

en.q: When does the validity of the company-based Assessment qualification become void automatically?
options: When it no longer has a senior manager (sole proprietor/partner/director) who passed
Two years after the date of the result, regardless of any change in senior management
When the licensee changes its business name as shown on the Business Registration Certificate
When the licensee opens an additional business premises without notifying the C&ED
en.explain: Paragraph 8.2 states that when the licensee no longer has at least one member of senior management — the sole proprietor, partner or director — who passed the Assessment, the company-based qualification becomes void automatically. There is no fixed two-year term; a mere change of business name or opening extra premises does not trigger voidance.

tc.q: 以公司為單位的評核資格何時自動失效？
options: 當該持牌人不再有已通過評核的高級管理層成員
結果日期起計兩年後，不論高級管理層有否變動
當該持牌人更改商業登記證上所示的業務名稱
當該持牌人在未通知海關的情況下開設額外業務處所
tc.explain: 第8.2段訂明，當持牌人不再有至少一名已通過評核的高級管理層成員（即獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）時，該以公司為單位的資格會自動失效。並無固定的兩年期限；單純更改業務名稱或開設額外處所均不會觸發失效。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.2段

en.q: Which type of licensee is NOT given a further opportunity to arrange eligible persons to sit the Assessment when the qualification becomes void?
options: A licensee belonging to a sole proprietorship
A licensee that under s.8.2 belongs to a partnership
A licensee that is a corporation
All licensees are given a further opportunity
en.explain: Paragraph 8.2 states that, except for the licensee belonging to sole proprietorship, a licensee belonging to partnership or corporation will be given an opportunity to arrange any eligible persons of its senior management to take the Assessment within 30 days upon notification to the C&ED of the change in partnership or directorship.

tc.q: 當該資格失效時，哪一類持牌人不獲另一次安排合資格人士應考的機會？
options: 屬獨資經營的持牌人
屬合夥的持牌人（例外）
屬法團的持牌人
所有持牌人獲另一次機會
tc.explain: 第8.2段訂明，除屬獨資經營的持牌人外，屬合夥及法團的持牌人會獲機會，於向香港海關通知合夥或董事變動後30日內，安排其高級管理層的任何合資格人士參加評核。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.2段

en.q: Which arrangement applies where a licensee whose qualification has become void is due for renewal within 180 days?
options: The paragraph 4.6 renewal timetable applies
The licence is suspended pending a fresh Assessment
The licensee must submit a fresh licence application
The 30-day period is extended to 90 days
en.explain: Paragraph 8.2 states that for licensees due for renewal within 180 days, the Assessment arrangement will follow paragraph 4.6 — the renewal timetable running from the reminder letter issued 90 days before expiry — rather than a suspension, a fresh application, or an extended 90-day period.

tc.q: 如資格已失效的持牌人須於180日內續期，適用甚麼安排？
options: 依照第4.6段（續牌安排）辦理
牌照暫時吊銷，直至重新完成評核
該持牌人須重新提出牌照申請
該30日期間延長至90日
tc.explain: 第8.2段訂明，就須於180日內續期的持牌人而言，評核安排會依照第4.6段辦理——即自牌照屆滿前90日發出提示信起計的續期時間表，而非暫時吊銷牌照、重新申請牌照，或將30日期間延長至90日。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶8.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第8.3段

en.q: May the CCE allow a licensee to continue its money service business where none of its eligible persons has passed the Assessment?
options: Yes — the CCE may exercise discretion on the merits, imposing necessary conditions
No — where no eligible person has passed, the licence must be revoked without exception
Yes, but the CCE's discretion to allow this is limited to a maximum of 30 days
Yes, but this discretion is available only where the licensee is a sole proprietorship
en.explain: Paragraph 8.3 states that, having considered the merits of each case, the CCE may exercise discretion to allow the licensee to continue its money service business when none of its eligible persons passed the Assessment, imposing licensing conditions it deems appropriate and necessary — the licence need not be revoked, the discretion is not capped at 30 days, and it is not limited to sole proprietorships.

tc.q: 如持牌人並無合資格人士通過評核，海關關長可否准許其繼續經營金錢服務業務？
options: 可以——關長可按個案情況行使酌情權，施加所需發牌條件
不可以——只要並無合資格人士通過評核，牌照必須一律撤銷
可以，但關長行使酌情權的期限最長只限30日
可以，但此酌情權只適用於屬獨資經營的持牌人
tc.explain: 第8.3段訂明海關關長在考慮每宗個案的具體情況後，可行使酌情權，在持牌人並無合資格人士通過評核時准許其繼續經營金錢服務業務，並施加其認為恰當及必需的發牌條件——牌照毋須一律撤銷，酌情權亦非以30日為限，更不限於獨資經營的持牌人。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶9.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第9.1段

en.q: Which documents must a candidate present for inspection when attending the Assessment?
options: A Hong Kong Identity Card, authorization letter (partnership/corporation only), and invitation letter
A Hong Kong Identity Card, the invitation letter, and a valid Business Registration Certificate
The invitation letter, an authorization letter for all candidates, and a valid travel document
The MSO licence and Business Registration Certificate issued by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue
en.explain: Paragraph 9.1 requires candidates to present a Hong Kong Identity Card (or an alternative photo ID), an authorization letter — only for a partnership company and corporation — and the Assessment invitation letter. A Business Registration Certificate and the MSO licence are documents used in the licensing process, not for admission to the Assessment, and the authorization letter is not required of all candidates.

tc.q: 考生出席評核時須出示哪些文件以供查驗？
options: 香港身分證、授權書（只限合夥公司及法團）及邀請信
香港身分證、評核邀請信，以及有效的商業登記證
評核邀請信、適用於所有考生的授權書，以及有效旅行證件
金錢服務經營者牌照，以及由稅務局局長發出的商業登記證
tc.explain: 第9.1段規定考生須出示香港身分證（或附有相片的替代身分證明文件）、授權書（只限合夥公司及法團），以及評核邀請信。商業登記證及金錢服務經營者牌照屬發牌程序所需的文件，並非出席評核所需；授權書亦非所有考生均須出示。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶9.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第9.3段

en.q: What does the Guidance Notes say about damaged or defaced identification documents?
options: The candidate may not be allowed to attend; inspect documents carefully beforehand
A photocopy of the identification document will be accepted at the invigilator's discretion
The candidate may still attend but must produce a replacement document within seven days
The invigilator may verify the candidate's identity by other reasonable means instead
en.explain: Paragraph 9.3 states that if the identification document presented by a candidate is damaged or defaced, the candidate may not be allowed to attend the Assessment, so candidates are recommended to carefully inspect their identification documents beforehand — the Guidance Notes do not offer a photocopy option, a seven-day grace period, or alternative verification as a fallback.

tc.q: 《須知》就損毀或污損的身分證明文件有何說明？
options: 該考生可能不獲准出席；宜於評核前小心檢查證件
監考員可酌情接受身分證明文件的影印本
該考生仍可出席，但須於七日內補交替代證明文件
監考員可改以其他合理方式核實考生身分
tc.explain: 第9.3段訂明，如考生出示的身分證明文件已損毀或污損，該考生可能不獲准出席評核；因此建議考生在評核前小心檢查其身分證明文件——《須知》並無提供接受影印本、七日內補交，或以其他方式核實身分等替代安排。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.1段

en.q: What is the consequence of violating the rules or acting dishonestly during the Assessment?
options: Liable to disqualification, and may be asked to leave immediately
The candidate receives a written warning from the invigilator and may continue
The candidate's score for that module is reduced by five marks
The candidate must re-sit the Assessment at the next available session
en.explain: Paragraph 10.1 states that candidates must follow the rules in the Guidance Notes and the invigilators' instructions, and that anyone who violates the rules or acts dishonestly in any way during the Assessment is liable to disqualification and may also be asked to leave the Assessment centre immediately — not a mere warning, a marks deduction, or deferral to a later sitting.

tc.q: 在評核期間違反規則或以任何方式作出不誠實行為，有何後果？
options: 可被取消資格，並可能被要求即時離開
該考生會獲監考員書面警告，並可繼續應考
該考生該單元的分數會被扣減五分
該考生須於下一個可供應考的評核場次重考
tc.explain: 第10.1段訂明考生必須遵守《須知》所載規則及監考員的指示；任何人在評核期間違反規則或以任何方式作出不誠實行為，均可被取消資格，並可能被要求即時離開評核中心——並非僅屬書面警告、扣減分數，或延至下一場次重考。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.2段

en.q: What is the position on requests to change the Assessment date, time or centre, and on late arrival?
options: Not considered; no entry once the Assessment has begun
Requests for change are considered on payment of a fee
Late arrivals are admitted within the first fifteen minutes
Changes are permitted once per candidate
en.explain: Paragraph 10.2 states that candidates must take the Assessment at the time and place in the invitation letter, that any request for change of date, time or centre will not be considered, and that once the Assessment has started a candidate will not be allowed to enter the premises — there is no fee-based exception, no fifteen-minute grace period, and no one-time change allowance.

tc.q: 就更改評核日期、時間或中心的要求，以及遲到，有何規定？
options: 更改要求不獲考慮；評核開始後不得進場
繳付指定費用後，更改要求方獲考慮
遲到考生可於評核開始後首十五分鐘內入場
每名考生可更改評核日期、時間或中心一次
tc.explain: 第10.2段訂明考生必須在邀請信指明的時間及地點應考；任何更改評核日期／時間／中心的要求均不獲考慮；評核一經開始，考生不獲准進入該處所——並無繳費更改、十五分鐘遲到寬限，或一次更改的安排。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.6
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.6段

en.q: What are candidates strictly forbidden to do in relation to the question book and answer sheet?
options: To take any question book or answer sheet, used or unused, out of the centre
To write personal notes or annotations on the question book
To read the question book before the invigilator says the Assessment may start
To return the answer sheet to the invigilator before the time allowed expires
en.explain: Paragraph 10.6 states that candidates must not leave the Assessment centre without permission, that early leavers must ensure their answer scripts have been collected by the invigilator on the spot, and that candidates are strictly forbidden to take away any question book or answer sheet, whether used or unused, out of the Assessment centre — writing on, reading early, or returning materials early are separate matters, not the prohibition this paragraph describes.

tc.q: 就試題冊及答題紙，考生被嚴格禁止作出甚麼？
options: 將試題冊或答題紙（已用或未用）攜離中心
在試題冊上書寫個人筆記、劃線或註解
在監考員宣布評核正式開始前閱讀試題冊內容
在評核時限屆滿前將答題紙交回監考員
tc.explain: 第10.6段訂明考生未經監考員准許不得離開評核中心；提早離場者須確保答卷已由監考員即場收回；並嚴禁考生將任何試題冊或答題紙（不論已用或未用）攜離評核中心——在試題冊上書寫、提早閱讀，或提早交回答題紙均屬另一回事，並非本段所禁止的事項。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.7
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.7段

en.q: What must a candidate do with a mobile phone during the Assessment?
options: Under the chair, uncovered, visible, off
Hand it to the invigilator at the entrance
Leave it outside the Assessment centre
Keep it switched to silent mode in a pocket
en.explain: Paragraph 10.7 requires all personal belongings, including electronic devices, to be put under the candidate's chair; mobile phones must not be covered and should be clearly seen by the invigilators; and mobile phones and other devices that can emit sound must be switched off throughout the examination. Handing it in, leaving it outside, or keeping it silenced in a pocket are all contrary to this — the paragraph expressly bars unauthorized articles on the body or in pockets.

tc.q: 考生在評核期間須如何處理流動電話？
options: 座椅下、不遮蓋、監考員可見、關掉
步入評核中心時，於入口處交予監考員保管
須留在評核中心範圍以外的地方，不得帶入
調校至靜音模式，並放於身上衣物或口袋內
tc.explain: 第10.7段規定所有個人物品（包括電子裝置）須放於考生座椅下；流動電話不得被遮蓋，並應讓監考員清楚看見；流動電話及其他可發出聲響的裝置在整個考試期間必須關掉——交予監考員保管、留在評核中心範圍外，或調至靜音放在身上或口袋內，均與此規定不符；本段明文禁止將未獲准許的物品放在身上或口袋內。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶10.9
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第10.9段

en.q: Where must a candidate mark answers, and what is the consequence of marking them elsewhere?
options: On the answer sheet provided; elsewhere unmarked
On the question book, which is collected and marked
On either the question book or answer sheet, candidate's choice
On the invitation letter, which is collected with the script
en.explain: Paragraph 10.9 states that candidates must mark the answers on the multiple-choice answer sheet provided, and that answers not written on the answer sheet will not be marked — the question book is never collected for marking, there is no free choice of where to answer, and the invitation letter plays no part in scoring (candidates must not even copy onto it).

tc.q: 考生須在何處填寫答案？在其他地方填寫有何後果？
options: 須填在提供的答題紙上；別處不予評分
在試題冊上填寫，該試題冊會被收回評分
可由考生自行選擇寫在試題冊或答題紙上
在邀請信上填寫，該信會連同答卷一併收回
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明考生必須在所提供的多項選擇答題紙上填寫答案；並非寫在答題紙上的答案不予評分——試題冊從不會被收回評分，考生亦無自行選擇作答位置的餘地，邀請信更與評分無關（考生甚至不得將內容抄寫其上）。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶11.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第11.5段

en.q: What happens if a candidate marks two or more answers to the same question?
options: No marks will be scored for that question
The first answer marked is taken
The question is treated as unanswered but does not count against the module limit
Half a mark is awarded
en.explain: Paragraph 11.5 states that a candidate will score no marks for marking two or more answers to the same question. Paragraph 11.4 requires wrong answers to be erased thoroughly and the answer sheet not to be folded.

tc.q: 如考生就同一題填寫兩個或以上的答案，會有甚麼後果？
options: 該題不獲任何分數
以最先填寫的答案為準
該題視為未作答，但不計入單元錯題上限
獲給予半分
tc.explain: 第11.5段訂明考生就同一題填寫兩個或以上的答案，該題不獲任何分數。第11.4段規定須徹底擦去錯誤答案，並不得摺疊答題紙。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶11.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第11.2段

en.q: Which particulars must a candidate write on the multiple-choice answer sheet before starting the questions?
options: Company name, application number, candidate's name, status, date and signature
The candidate's Hong Kong Identity Card number and the invitation letter
Name of company and name of candidate only, both in block letters
The candidate's Hong Kong Identity Card number and signature only
en.explain: Paragraph 11.2 requires the candidate to write the name of the company, the application number from the invitation letter, the candidate's name, the candidate's position (status) in the company, the date of the Assessment, and the candidate's signature — the answer sheet does not call for an identity card number or the invitation letter itself, and none of the six particulars may be skipped.

tc.q: 考生在作答前須在多項選擇答題紙上填寫哪些個人資料？
options: 公司名稱、申請編號、姓名、職位、評核日期及簽署
考生的香港身分證號碼，以及供查核身分用的邀請信副本
只須以正楷填寫的公司全名及考生全名，其餘欄目留空
只需填寫考生的香港身分證號碼及簽署，其餘欄目留空
tc.explain: 第11.2段規定考生須在答題紙上填寫公司名稱、邀請信所示的申請編號、考生姓名、考生在公司的職位、應考評核的日期及考生簽署——答題紙並不要求填寫身分證號碼或邀請信本身，六項資料亦缺一不可。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.1段

en.q: How and within what period are candidates notified of the Assessment result?
options: By e-mail only, within 14 days
By post, within 30 days after the Assessment
By telephone, within 7 days after the Assessment
In person at the Assessment centre on the day
en.explain: Paragraph 12.1 states that candidates will only be notified of the results — that is, PASS or FAIL — by e-mail only, within 14 days after the Assessment, and that the notification should be kept as a certification of the result.

tc.q: 考生會以何種方式及在多久內獲通知評核結果？
options: 只以電郵通知，並於14日內
以郵遞方式，於評核後30日內
以電話通知，於評核後7日內
於評核當日在評核中心即場通知
tc.explain: 第12.1段訂明考生只會以電郵獲通知結果（即及格或不及格），並於評核後14日內通知；該通知應保留作為評核結果的證明。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.2段

en.q: Within what period may a candidate dissatisfied with the result request a re-checking, and what happens to late requests?
options: Seven days from the result notification; late, not considered
Within 14 days; late requests are considered on payment of a fee
Within 30 days; late requests are considered at the CCE's discretion
There is no time limit at all for requesting a re-checking
en.explain: Paragraph 12.2 states that candidates not satisfied with their results may, within seven days after the date of issuance of the result notification, request a re-checking; late submission will not be considered — there is no fee-based extension to 14 days, no discretionary 30-day extension, and no unlimited time to ask.

tc.q: 對結果不滿的考生可於多久內要求覆核？逾期提出的要求會如何處理？
options: 通知後七日內；逾期不獲考慮
14日內；逾期繳費可獲考慮
30日內；逾期由關長酌情考慮
覆核要求並無任何時限規定
tc.explain: 第12.2段訂明對評核結果不滿的考生，可於結果通知發出日期後七日內要求覆核；逾期提交者不獲考慮——並無繳費延至14日的安排、由關長酌情延至30日的安排，或不設時限的安排。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.3段

en.q: What does the re-checking of an answer sheet involve, and within what period is the result sent?
options: Technical-error checks (e.g. wrong mark entries); written result within 14 days
A full re-marking by a different examiner, with the result sent within 30 days
A review of the question paper for errors, with the result sent within 7 days
An interview with the candidate, followed by a written decision within a month
en.explain: Paragraph 12.3 states that the C&ED will re-check the candidate's answers on the answer sheet and send the result in writing within 14 days after receipt of the re-checking request, and that the answer sheet will be re-checked for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries and data inconsistencies — not a full re-mark, a review of the question paper, or an interview, and not within 30 days, 7 days or one month.

tc.q: 覆核答題紙涉及甚麼？結果會於多久內發出？
options: 覆核填錯答案格等技術錯誤，14日內書面發出結果
由另一名評卷員重新評卷，並於30日內發出結果
檢查試卷是否有錯誤，並於7日內發出結果
與考生面談，其後於一個月內作出書面決定
tc.explain: 第12.3段訂明香港海關會就填錯答案格及數據不一致等技術錯誤，覆核考生在答題紙上的答案，並於接獲覆核要求後14日內以書面發出結果——並非由另一評卷員全面重評、檢查試卷本身有否錯誤，或與考生面談後才作決定，亦非30日、7日或一個月內。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.4
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.4段

en.q: What does the C&ED say about disclosing exact scores, questions and correct answers?
options: Final; never discloses scores, questions or answers
Scores are disclosed on request after re-checking
Questions and answers are published annually
Scores are disclosed but questions are not
en.explain: Paragraph 12.4 states that the result of the re-checking is final, and that the C&ED will not disclose the exact scores, the Assessment questions or the corresponding correct answers in any case — not on request, not annually, and not selectively (scores but not questions).

tc.q: 香港海關就披露確實分數、試題及正確答案有何說明？
options: 為最終決定；海關永不披露分數、試題及答案
只要考生提出要求，覆核後海關會披露分數
評核試題及正確答案會於每年年底公開
海關會披露確實分數，但不會披露評核試題
tc.explain: 第12.4段訂明覆核結果為最終決定；海關在任何情況下均不會披露確實分數、評核試題及相應的正確答案——並非應要求披露、並非於每年年底公開，亦非只披露分數而不披露試題。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶12.5
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第12.5段

en.q: What does the Guidance Notes emphasise about the relationship between passing the Assessment and obtaining a licence?
options: Not necessarily eligible; must meet AMLO and Licensing Guide requirements
A pass automatically guarantees the grant of a licence with no further review
A pass exempts the applicant from the fit and proper person test entirely
A pass entitles the applicant to a provisional licence pending full vetting
en.explain: Paragraph 12.5 is marked VERY IMPORTANT and states that a pass in the Assessment does not necessarily mean the candidate is eligible for a licence, because applicants are also required to meet the licensing requirements stipulated in the AMLO and the licensing guide promulgated by the C&ED — a pass does not itself guarantee a licence, exempt the fit and proper test, or entitle the holder to a provisional licence.

tc.q: 《須知》就通過評核與取得牌照的關係強調甚麼？
options: 非必然符合牌照資格；仍須符合《打擊洗錢條例》牌照指引規定
通過能力評核即自動保證必定獲海關批出牌照，毋須再經任何審批
通過能力評核可完全豁免適當人選準則的相關規定
通過能力評核可獲發臨時牌照，待日後完成全面審核
tc.explain: 第12.5段標明「非常重要」，訂明通過評核並不必然表示該考生符合取得牌照的資格，因為申請人亦須符合《打擊洗錢條例》及海關頒布的《牌照指引》所訂明的發牌規定——通過評核本身並不保證獲批牌照、不豁免適當人選測試，亦不賦予臨時牌照。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶13.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第13.1段

en.q: Under which severe weather conditions will the Assessment be suspended?
options: Signal No. 8+ and/or black rainstorm warning still up at 8am on the day
Where typhoon signal No. 3 is hoisted at any time on the scheduled date
Where only the amber rainstorm warning is issued, with no typhoon signal
Where any typhoon signal was hoisted the evening before but is later lowered
en.explain: Paragraph 13.1 states that the Assessment will be held as scheduled when typhoon signal No. 3 or lower, and/or rainstorm signal amber or red, is issued, but if typhoon signal No. 8 or above and/or the black rainstorm warning is still hoisted at or after 8:00 a.m. on the scheduled date, the Assessment will be suspended — signal 3 alone, an amber warning alone, or a signal already lowered by the morning do not trigger suspension.

tc.q: 在哪種惡劣天氣情況下評核會暫停？
options: 上午8時後，8號以上信號及／或黑雨警告仍生效
原定日期任何時間懸掛3號颱風信號即可
只發出黃色暴雨警告，並無懸掛任何颱風信號
前一晚曾懸掛颱風信號，其後已除下
tc.explain: 第13.1段訂明一般而言，如發出3號或以下颱風信號及／或黃色或紅色暴雨警告，評核會如期舉行；但如在原定日期上午8時或之後，8號或以上颱風信號及／或黑色暴雨警告仍然生效，評核會暫停——單是3號信號、單是黃色暴雨警告，或信號已於當日早上除下，均不會觸發暫停。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶14.1
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第14.1段

en.q: What does the Guidance Notes say about the significance of receiving an invitation to the Assessment?
options: Not proof of meeting licensing requirements; vetting in progress
It confirms the applicant has satisfied the fit and proper test
It guarantees the candidate an interview with C&ED officers
It confirms that the premises have been approved
en.explain: Paragraph 14.1 states that the invitation to the Assessment does not imply that a candidate has fully met the licensing requirements, as the vetting process is still in progress; applicants or licensees who do not meet the licensing requirements will not be further considered irrespective of their Assessment results — an invitation does not itself confirm the fit and proper test, guarantee an interview, or confirm approval of premises.

tc.q: 《須知》就獲邀參加評核的意義有何說明？
options: 不代表已完全符合發牌規定；審核在進行
確認該申請人已完全通過適當人選測試
保證可獲安排與香港海關人員面談
確認其經營處所已獲海關批准
tc.explain: 第14.1段訂明獲邀參加評核並不表示考生已完全符合發牌規定，因審核程序仍在進行中；不符合發牌規定的申請人／持牌人，不論其評核結果如何，均不會獲進一步考慮——獲邀本身並不確認已通過適當人選測試、不保證獲安排面談，亦不確認處所已獲批准。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶14.3
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第14.3段

en.q: What arrangement is available for candidates with disabilities?
options: Contact the C&ED; medical proof may be required to arrange suitable support
No special arrangements of any kind are available to candidates with disabilities
Arrangements are made automatically on the basis of the application form
Candidates must apply to the Review Tribunal for accommodations
en.explain: Paragraph 14.3 states that as regards facilitating arrangements for persons with disabilities, candidates may contact the C&ED for enquiries, and the C&ED may require, as appropriate, medical proof to confirm the disability in order to make suitable arrangements — arrangements are neither unavailable altogether, nor automatic from the application form, nor a matter for the Review Tribunal, which under the AMLO reviews the CCE's licensing decisions, not Assessment accommodation requests.

tc.q: 殘疾考生可獲甚麼安排？
options: 可致電海關查詢；海關可要求醫學證明以作安排
任何種類的特別安排均概不提供予殘疾考生使用
純粹按申請表格內容自動作出相關安排
考生須向覆核審裁處提出申請以獲便利安排
tc.explain: 第14.3段訂明就殘疾人士可獲的便利安排，考生可致電海關查詢；海關可視乎情況要求考生提交醫學證明以確認其殘疾，以便作出合適安排——並非一概不設安排、並非純粹按申請表格自動安排，亦非須向覆核審裁處申請（該處根據《打擊洗錢條例》處理的是關長發牌決定的覆核，並非評核的便利安排）。

source.en: Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment (Dec 2022) ¶2.2
source.tc: 《能力評核須知》（2022年12月）第2.2段

en.q: Which fitness-and-propriety criterion does the Guidance Notes quote as the link between the F&P Guidelines and the Assessment?
options: Whether the person has the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism
Whether the person has adequate financial resources to support the business
Whether the person has been convicted of an offence bearing on integrity
Whether the person maintains a local place for storage of books and records
en.explain: Paragraph 2.2 quotes from the F&P Guidelines the criterion of whether the person is equipped with the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism necessary to perform the business's functions efficiently and effectively, giving the example of a person who did not take or failed to pass the C&ED's test. Financial resources, criminal convictions and local storage of books and records are all separate F&P criteria found elsewhere in the F&P and Supplementary F&P Guidelines, not the one paragraph 2.2 quotes as the Assessment's link.

tc.q: 《須知》引述哪一項適當人選準則，作為適當人選指引與評核之間的連繫？
options: 該人是否具備技能、知識、經驗及專業
該人是否具備足夠財政資源以支持業務運作
該人有否因觸犯刑事罪行而影響其誠信
該人有否在本地維持存放簿冊及紀錄的地方
tc.explain: 第2.2段引述適當人選指引中的準則：該人是否具備有效率及有效地履行業務職能所需的技能、知識、經驗及專業水平；並舉出未有參加或未能通過香港海關有關測試的人為例。財政資源、刑事罪行紀錄及本地存放簿冊紀錄的地方，均是《適當人選指引》及其補充指引中另列的準則，並非第2.2段引述作為評核連繫的該項準則。

en.q: Where may a member of the public inspect the Register of Licensees?
options: At the C&ED's office in Kowloon Bay, and via the MSOS eServices website
Only at the Companies Registry, which maintains company incorporation records
By written application to the Commissioner, or at the Inland Revenue Department
Only at the premises of each licensee, on request to that licensee
en.explain: Paragraph 12.2 states that the register is available for inspection by members of the public at the office of the C&ED at Units 402-403, 4/F, Centre Parc, 11 Sheung Yuet Road, Kowloon Bay, and is accessible through the C&ED's website at the MSOS eServices address — not at the Companies Registry (which keeps company incorporation, not MSO licensee, records), not by written application to the Commissioner or at the Inland Revenue Department, and not only at each licensee's own premises.

tc.q: 公眾人士可在何處查閱持牌人登記冊？
options: 海關九龍灣辦事處，以及金錢服務經營者牌照系統網站
只可在負責公司註冊登記事宜的公司註冊處查閱
以書面向海關關長申請查閱，或到稅務局查閱
只可在每名持牌人的營業處所，向該持牌人查詢
tc.explain: 第12.2段訂明登記冊可供公眾人士在九龍灣常悅道11號企業廣場4樓402-403室香港海關辦事處查閱，亦可透過香港海關的金錢服務經營者牌照系統網站查閱——並非在負責公司註冊登記的公司註冊處（該處備存的是公司註冊紀錄，並非金錢服務經營者持牌人紀錄）、以書面向關長申請或到稅務局，也非只可在每名持牌人的處所查閱。

en.q: How does the Licensing Guide distinguish the two disciplinary regimes it describes?
options: Section 21(2) applies where a financial institution contravenes a specified provision under section 5(11); section 43(2) where a licensee commits a section 43(1) act
Section 21(2) applies only where the financial institution is an individual, and section 43(2) only where the licensee is a corporation, regardless of what was contravened
Section 21(2) applies to a first contravention, and section 43(2) applies only after a written warning for a repeat contravention of the same kind
The two regimes are alternative routes the CCE may elect between for the same contravention, at its own discretion, rather than being fixed by statute
en.explain: Paragraph 13.1 gives section 21(2) powers where a financial institution contravenes a specified provision under section 5(11), and separately section 43(2) powers where an MSO licensee commits an act under section 43(1) - contravening a section 51 regulation, a licence condition, or sections 35(1)-41(1). The regimes are not distinguished by individual/corporate status, offence count, or CCE election.

tc.q: 《牌照指引》如何區分其所述的兩套紀律制度？
options: 第21(2)條適用於金融機構違反第5(11)條指明的條文；第43(2)條適用於持牌人作出第43(1)條所述作為
第21(2)條只適用於金融機構屬個人的情況；第43(2)條只適用於持牌人屬法團的情況，不論違反的是甚麼
第21(2)條適用於首次違反；第43(2)條則只在同類違反收到書面警告後再次發生時適用
兩套制度是關長可就同一違反行為自行選擇適用其一的替代途徑，並非由法例明確劃分
tc.explain: 第13.1段列出第21(2)條的權力（於金融機構違反第5(11)條所界定的指明的條文時產生），以及第43(2)條的權力（於金錢服務經營者持牌人作出第43(1)條所述作為時產生，包括違反第51條規例、牌照條件，或第35(1)至41(1)條）；兩套制度並非按個人／法團身分、違反次數或由關長自行選擇區分。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XIV節費用表

en.q: How does the fee for each additional business premises differ between a grant application and a renewal application?
options: $2,440 for each additional premises on a grant application, $410 on a renewal application
$2,440 for each additional premises, charged identically on both a grant and a renewal application
$410 for each additional premises, charged identically on both a grant and a renewal application
$945 for each additional premises on a grant application, and $160 on a renewal application
en.explain: The Licensing Guide's fee schedule, matching Schedule 3 as amended from 15 May 2026, charges $2,440 for each additional business premises on a grant application and $410 on a renewal application. $945 is the separate fit-and-proper-person-test fee and $160 is the fee for a certified copy of a register entry - neither applies to additional premises.

tc.q: 每個額外業務處所的費用，在批出申請與續期申請之間有何不同？
options: 批出申請每額外處所收2,440元，續期申請則收410元
批出及續期申請的每個額外處所，均一律收費2,440元
批出及續期申請的每個額外處所，均一律收費410元
批出申請每額外處所收945元，續期申請則收160元
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》的費用表（與自2026年5月15日起經修訂的附表3一致）就批出申請的每個額外業務處所收取2,440元，續期申請則收取410元。945元是另一項適當人選測試費用，160元則是登記冊記項核證副本的費用，兩者均不適用於額外處所。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第XIV節費用表

en.q: How is the fit and proper person test fee charged on both grant and renewal applications?
options: $945 per person tested, on a grant or renewal application alike
$945 per application in total, regardless of the number of persons tested
$945 on a grant application and $410 on a renewal application
It is charged only on a grant application, not on a renewal application
en.explain: The fee schedule charges $945 for each person who is subject to the fit and proper person test, identically on a grant and a renewal application. $410 is the different additional-premises fee on a renewal, not the per-person test fee, and the test fee is not waived on renewal.

tc.q: 適當人選測試費用在批出及續期申請中如何收取？
options: 兩類申請均就每名接受測試的人收取945元
不論人數多少，每份申請只收取945元
批出申請收取945元，續期申請收取410元
只在批出申請時收取，續期申請無須收取
tc.explain: 費用表就每名須接受適當人選測試的人收取945元，批出及續期申請的收費相同。410元是續期申請下額外處所的另一項（不同）收費，並非適當人選測試費用，而續期申請亦無豁免該項測試費用。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: How many fees under the MSO licensing regime were revised by the Notice gazetted on 13 March 2026?
options: 20, 15 June
en.explain: The circular of 13 March 2026 states that the government gazetted the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Amendment of Schedule 3) Notice 2026 to revise 12 fees under the licensing regime for Money Service Operators Licence, with the new fees taking effect on 15 May.

tc.q: 2026年3月13日刊憲的公告修訂了金錢服務經營者發牌制度下多少項費用？
options: 7項
5項
20項，6月生效
tc.explain: 2026年3月13日的通函訂明政府當日刊憲頒布《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例（修訂附表3）公告2026》，修訂金錢服務經營者牌照發牌制度下的12項費用，新費用於5月15日生效。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: On what policy principle does the C&ED say government fees should generally be set?
options: The user-pays principle: fees are set at levels adequate to recover the full cost of the service
An efficiency principle: fees are set to reflect Hong Kong Customs' streamlined procedures and contained costs
The ability-to-pay principle: fees are set to vary with the size and turnover of each licensee
A cost-plus principle: fees are set high enough to generate a surplus for the Government
en.explain: The circular states that in line with the user-pays principle, fees should generally be set at levels adequate to recover the full cost of the public services provided. The efficiency and streamlining commitment that follows in the same circular is a separate undertaking to contain costs, not the principle on which fee levels are set.

tc.q: 香港海關指出政府費用一般應按甚麼政策原則釐定？
options: 用者自付原則——費用須足以收回所提供服務的全部成本
效率原則——費用反映香港海關簡化程序及控制成本的表現
負擔能力原則——費用須隨持牌人的規模及營業額而異
成本加成原則——費用須訂得為政府帶來盈餘
tc.explain: 通函訂明，按照用者自付原則，費用水平一般須訂於足以收回所提供公共服務全部成本的水平。通函其後提及的效率及簡化程序承諾，是另一項控制成本的承諾，並非釐定費用水平所依據的原則。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）

en.q: What commitment does Hong Kong Customs give alongside the fee revision?
options: To continue enhancing efficiency and streamlining procedures to contain costs
To keep fees fixed at the revised levels without review for the next five years
To refund every licensee the difference between the old and new fee levels in full
To set fees at levels that recover the full cost of the services, per the user-pays principle
en.explain: The circular states that Hong Kong Customs will continue to enhance efficiency and streamline procedures so as to contain the costs of providing the services - a separate commitment from the user-pays principle used to justify the fee levels themselves. The circular gives no five-year freeze and no refund of the difference.

tc.q: 香港海關在調整費用的同時作出甚麼承諾？
options: 繼續提升效率及簡化程序，以控制提供服務的成本
承諾在其後五年維持經修訂的收費水平不變
向已繳付舊費用水平的持牌人退還新舊費用的差額
按用者自付原則，將收費水平訂於足以收回服務全部成本
tc.explain: 通函訂明香港海關會繼續提升效率及簡化程序，以控制提供服務的成本——這是有別於用作釐定收費水平理據的用者自付原則的另一項承諾。通函並無提及五年凍結費用，亦無提及退還新舊差額。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_03/2026（2026年5月15日）

en.q: What did the circular of 15 May 2026 tell MSOs about the revised Licensing Guide?
options: It comes into immediate effect and applies to a grant or renewal applicant, or a licensee, as the case may be
It applies only to a new applicant for the grant of a licence, not to a renewal applicant or a licensee
It takes effect three months after the 15 May 2026 fee revision, on 15 August 2026
It is circulated as a consultation draft and does not take effect until the consultation closes
en.explain: The circular of 15 May 2026 states that the new fees under the licensing regime took effect that day, and that the revised Licensing Guide comes into immediate effect, applying to a grant or renewal applicant, or a licensee, as the case may be - not only to new grant applicants, with no three-month delay and no consultation stage.

tc.q: 2026年5月15日的通函就經修訂的《牌照指引》向金錢服務經營者說明甚麼？
options: 即時生效，並適用於申請批出或續期牌照的人，或持牌人（視屬何情況）
只適用於申請批出牌照的新申請人，不適用於續期申請人或現有持牌人
在2026年5月15日的收費修訂三個月後，即8月15日起生效
以諮詢文件草稿形式發出，須待諮詢結束後方會生效
tc.explain: 2026年5月15日的通函訂明，發牌制度下的新費用已於當日生效，經修訂的《牌照指引》即時生效，並適用於申請批出或續期牌照的人，或持牌人（視屬何情況）——並非只適用於新的批出申請人，亦無三個月延遲，亦無諮詢階段。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）——費用表

en.q: By how much did the fee for an application for the grant of a licence rise on 15 May 2026?
options: From $860 to $945
From $790 to $910
en.explain: The circular's fee table shows the application for the grant of a licence rising from $3,310 to $3,810. The other figures listed are the additional business premises fee on a grant ($2,220 to $2,440), the fit and proper person test fee ($860 to $945) and the renewal fee ($790 to $910).

tc.q: 批出牌照申請的費用於2026年5月15日調升了多少？
options: 由860元增至945元
由790元增至910元
tc.explain: 該通函的費用表顯示批出牌照的申請費由3,310元增至3,810元。其他所列數字為批出時的額外業務處所費用（2,220元增至2,440元）、適當人選測試費用（860元增至945元）及續期費用（790元增至910元）。

source.tc: 通函 MSSB/MIS_02/2026（2026年3月13日）——費用表

en.q: How did the fee for providing an uncertified copy of an entry in, or extract from, the register change?
options: From $1 per page or portion of a page to $1.5 per page or portion of a page
From $2,220 to $2,440, the same change as for additional business premises
From $790 to $910, the same change as for the renewal application base fee
It was not among the 12 revised fees and remains unchanged
