The FATF Recommendations alone provide the basis, with complexity fixed by the compliance officer's personal judgement rather than the MSO's risk profile
The customer's own self-declared risk category provides the basis, with complexity set according to what that customer requests
en.explain: ¶2.15 states that an MSO should adopt an RBA in designing its customer risk assessment framework: the framework should be designed based on the results of the MSO's institutional ML/TF risk assessment, and its complexity should be commensurate with the nature and size of the MSO's business — not a CCE model, the FATF Recommendations alone, or the customer's own say-so.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的客戶風險評估框架應以甚麼為基礎？其複雜程度應與甚麼相稱？
options: 以該經營者機構層面風險評估的結果為依據，複雜程度應與其業務的性質及規模相符
以海關關長發出的範本風險框架為依據，不論個別經營者規模大小，全行複雜程度劃一
只以財務行動特別組織的建議為依據，複雜程度由合規主任個人判斷
以客戶自行申報的風險類別為依據，複雜程度純粹按該客戶的要求而定
tc.explain: 第2.15段訂明金錢服務經營者在設計其客戶風險評估框架時應採用風險為本方式：該框架應根據其機構層面風險評估的結果設計，複雜程度應與其業務的性質及規模相稱——並非海關關長的範本、單憑財務行動特別組織的建議，或由客戶自行申報而定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.15段

en.q: Which categories of risk factor will a customer risk assessment framework generally include?
options: Customer risk factors; country risk factors; and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors
Customer risk factors; country risk factors; delivery or distribution channel risk factors; and other risk factors
Country risk factors and product or service risk factors only, since customer risk factors are addressed separately under CDD
Customer risk factors and transaction risk factors only, determined solely by the customer's nationality and occupation
en.explain: ¶2.15 states that, in general, the customer risk assessment framework will include customer risk factors; country risk factors; and product, service, transaction or delivery channel risk factors — a three-category grouping distinct from the institutional assessment's finer breakdown in ¶2.4, which separates out delivery/distribution channel and other risk factors.

tc.q: 客戶風險評估框架一般會包括哪些類別的風險因素？
options: 客戶風險因素；國家風險因素；以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道風險因素
客戶風險因素；國家風險因素；交付或分銷渠道風險因素；以及其他風險因素
只限國家風險因素及產品或服務風險因素，因客戶風險因素已於客戶盡職審查中另行處理
只限客戶風險因素及交易風險因素，並純粹按客戶的國籍及職業釐定
tc.explain: 第2.15段訂明客戶風險評估框架一般包括客戶風險因素、國家風險因素，以及產品、服務、交易或交付渠道風險因素——此三類分組有別於第2.4段機構層面評估較細緻的分類（將交付或分銷渠道風險因素及其他風險因素獨立列出）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13段註腳6

en.q: What approach does the Guideline say an MSO should adopt when conducting customer risk assessments and applying CDD measures?
options: A balanced and common sense approach, which should not pose an unreasonable barrier to bona fide business and individuals accessing the MSO's services
The most restrictive approach available in every case, so as to eliminate ML/TF risk entirely regardless of customer profile
An approach that automatically declines any customer presenting an identified risk factor, irrespective of the overall risk assessment, reviewed by the CCE annually
An approach determined solely by the customer's transaction volume, since higher-volume customers are inherently higher risk
en.explain: Footnote 6 to ¶2.13 states that an MSO should adopt a balanced and common sense approach when conducting a customer risk assessment and applying CDD measures, which should not pose an unreasonable barrier to bona fide business and individuals accessing services offered by the MSO — not a blanket most-restrictive stance, an automatic decline on any risk factor, or a volume-only test.

tc.q: 本指引指出金錢服務經營者在進行客戶風險評估及採取客戶盡職審查措施時，應採取甚麼取態？
options: 平衡而合乎常理的取態，不應對真誠的商戶及個人使用該經營者所提供服務造成不合理障礙
在任何情況下均採取最嚴格的取態，務求完全消除洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，不論客戶背景為何
自動拒絕任何呈現已識別風險因素的客戶，不論整體風險評估結果為何
純粹按客戶的交易量而定的取態，因交易量愈高的客戶必然風險愈高
tc.explain: 第2.13段註腳6訂明金錢服務經營者在進行客戶風險評估及採取客戶盡職審查措施時，應採取平衡而合乎常理的取態，不應對真誠的商戶及個人使用該經營者所提供的服務造成不合理障礙——並非一律採取最嚴格取態、對任何風險因素一律拒絕，或純粹按交易量而定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.14段註腳7

en.q: By what other name is the finalised customer risk assessment sometimes known?
options: A customer risk profile
A customer due diligence file
A know-your-customer certificate
A customer acceptance policy
en.explain: Footnote 7 to ¶2.14 notes that the finalised customer risk assessment is sometimes also called a customer risk profile. The term is used throughout the Guideline, for example in the ongoing monitoring provisions.

tc.q: 最終確定的客戶風險評估有時亦稱為甚麼？
options: 客戶風險狀況
客戶盡職審查檔案
認識你的客戶證明書
客戶接納政策
tc.explain: 第2.14段註腳7指出，最終確定的客戶風險評估有時亦稱為「客戶風險狀況」。該詞在本指引中通用，例如見於持續監察的條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.2(b)及(c)段

en.q: Besides having senior-management-approved AML/CFT Systems, what two further things should an MSO do under ¶3.2?
options: Monitor implementation of the Systems, enhancing them if necessary, and take enhanced measures where higher risks are identified
Implement compliance management arrangements and an independent audit function, and provide an ongoing training programme
Identify the lower risks forming the basis for simplification, and have the simplified Systems approved by senior management
Take all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards exist, and prevent any contravention of Schedule 2 Part 2 or 3
en.explain: ¶3.2(b)-(c) requires an MSO to monitor the implementation of its AML/CFT Systems and enhance them if necessary, and to take enhanced measures to manage and mitigate risks where higher risks are identified — distinct from the System elements listed in ¶3.4, the simplification conditions in ¶3.3, or the general safeguards duty in ¶3.1.

tc.q: 除須設有經高級管理層批准的打擊洗錢系統外，第3.2段還要求金錢服務經營者作出哪兩項？
options: 監察該等系統的實施情況，在必要時加以強化，並在識別出較高風險時採取加強措施
備有合規管理安排及獨立審計職能，並提供持續的僱員培訓計劃
識別作為簡化依據的較低風險，並由高級管理層批准簡化後的系統
採取一切合理措施確保設有合適保障措施，並防止違反附表2第2或3部
tc.explain: 第3.2(b)及(c)段規定金錢服務經營者須監察打擊洗錢系統的實施情況，並在必要時加以強化，以及在識別出較高風險時採取加強措施管理及減低風險——有別於第3.4段所列的系統要素、第3.3段的簡化條件，或第3.1段的一般保障措施責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.3段

en.q: Which three conditions must be satisfied before an MSO may simplify the nature, scale and complexity of its AML/CFT Systems?
options: Compliance with Schedule 2 and the MSO's other risk-assessment duties; identification of lower risk through an appropriate risk assessment; and senior management approval, reviewed from time to time

That the CO and MLRO are appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge, independent of all operational and business functions subject to the MSO's size, and normally based in Hong Kong and CCE-registered
Compliance management arrangements, an independent audit function, employee screening procedures, and an ongoing employee training programme covering all AML/CFT staff
A turnover below a threshold set by the CCE, fewer than ten full-time staff, a single business premises, and no history of suspicious transaction reports
en.explain: ¶3.3 permits simplification only where the MSO complies with Schedule 2 and its duties under ¶¶2.2, 2.3 and 3.2; the lower ML/TF risks have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment; and the simplified Systems, approved by senior management, are reviewed from time to time — not the CO/MLRO qualities in ¶3.8, the System elements in ¶3.4, or any invented turnover or staff-count threshold.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須符合哪三項條件，方可簡化其打擊洗錢系統的性質、規模及複雜程度？
options: 遵從附表2的規定及其他風險評估責任；透過適當評估識別出較低風險；以及經高級管理層批准，不時接受檢視
合規主任及洗錢報告主任具備充足打擊洗錢知識，在規模限制下獨立於營運及業務職能，並通常駐於香港，並經關長登記
合規管理安排、獨立審計職能、僱員甄別程序，以及涵蓋全體員工的持續打擊洗錢培訓計劃
營業額低於海關關長就其行業訂定的門檻、全職員工少於十人，並無任何可疑交易報告紀錄
tc.explain: 第3.3段准許簡化的條件為：該經營者遵從附表2的法定規定及第2.2、2.3及3.2段的規定；作為依據的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險已透過適當的風險評估識別；以及經高級管理層批准的簡化系統須不時接受檢視——並非第3.8段的合規主任／洗錢報告主任特質、第3.4段的系統要素，或任何虛構的營業額或人手門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.3段

en.q: Paragraph 3.3 allows simplified AML/CFT Systems only if certain conditions are met. On what basis must the lower ML/TF risks relied on have been identified?
options: Through an appropriate risk assessment, such as an institutional ML/TF risk assessment
Through the customer's own written declaration of the risks arising from its business
Through a review carried out by the CCE at the MSO's most recent routine inspection
Through a comparison with the systems operated by other MSOs of a comparable size
en.explain: ¶3.3(b) permits simplification only where the lower ML/TF risks that form the basis for it have been identified through an appropriate risk assessment, for example an institutional ML/TF risk assessment. The other conditions are compliance with Schedule 2 and ¶¶2.2, 2.3 and 3.2 (¶3.3(a)), and senior-management approval with review from time to time (¶3.3(c)). Nothing in ¶3.3 lets an MSO rely on the customer's own declaration, on a CCE inspection, or on what comparable MSOs do.

tc.q: 第3.3段訂明只有在符合若干條件下方可簡化打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度。作為簡化基礎的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，須以何種方式識別？
options: 透過適當的風險評估識別，例如機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估
透過客戶就其業務所產生的風險而自行作出的書面聲明識別
透過關長在該經營者最近一次例行視察中所作的檢視識別
透過與其他規模相若的金錢服務經營者所實施的制度作比較識別
tc.explain: 第3.3(b)段訂明，只有在作為簡化基礎的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，是基於適當的風險評估（例如機構層面的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估）而識別出來時，方可簡化。其餘條件為符合附表2及第2.2、2.3及3.2段的規定（第3.3(a)段），以及不時覆核經高級管理層審批的簡化制度（第3.3(c)段）。第3.3段並無准許該經營者依賴客戶自行聲明、關長的視察，或與其他經營者的比較。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.5段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of an MSO's compliance management arrangements?
options: To facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations and to manage ML/TF risks effectively
To act as the focal point for oversight of ML/TF prevention and detection activities, and to provide support and guidance to senior management, reviewed biennially
To ensure proper safeguards exist to mitigate ML/TF risks and prevent any contravention of Schedule 2 Part 2 or 3
To give the board of directors and senior management a clear understanding of the MSO's ML/TF risks so the risks are adequately managed
en.explain: ¶3.5 states that an MSO should have appropriate compliance management arrangements that facilitate the MSO to implement AML/CFT Systems to comply with relevant legal and regulatory obligations as well as to manage ML/TF risks effectively — distinct from the CO's focal-point function in ¶3.9, the general safeguards duty in ¶3.1, and the governance purpose in ¶3.6.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的合規管理安排，其訂明目的為何？
options: 促使該經營者實施打擊洗錢系統，以遵從相關法律及監管責任，並有效管理洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
作為監督防止及偵察洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集活動的中心點，並向高級管理層提供支援及導引
確保設有合適保障措施以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並防止違反附表2第2或3部
讓董事會及高級管理層清楚了解該經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，以確保風險獲妥善管理，每兩年一次
tc.explain: 第3.5段訂明金錢服務經營者應設有適當的合規管理安排，促使其實施打擊洗錢系統，以遵從相關法律及監管責任，並有效管理洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險——有別於第3.9段合規主任作為中心點的職能、第3.1段的一般保障措施責任，以及第3.6段的管治目的。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.6段

en.q: In what manner must management information on ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems be communicated to the board and senior management?
options: In a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner, so that they are equipped to make informed decisions
Through the Compliance Officer communicating key AML/CFT issues, including significant compliance deficiencies only where appropriate
On a timely basis only, drawing on internal sources such as CDD records and external sources such as CCE circulars
Only when a material breach of the AML/CFT Systems has occurred, rather than as part of routine governance reporting
en.explain: ¶3.6 states that management information regarding ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems should be communicated to the board and senior management in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner so that they are equipped to make informed decisions — not merely through the CO's ¶3.9(c) deficiency reporting, the CO/MLRO's own ¶3.8(g) information access, or only after a material breach.

tc.q: 有關洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢系統的管理資訊，須以何種方式傳達予董事會及高級管理層？
options: 以及時、完整、易於理解及準確的方式傳達，使他們能作出知情的決定
由合規主任溝通打擊洗錢的關鍵事宜，當中只在適當情況下才述及重大合規缺失
只須及時提供，資料來源包括內部的客戶盡職審查紀錄及外部的海關關長通函
只在打擊洗錢系統發生重大違規時傳達，而非作為日常管治匯報的一部分
tc.explain: 第3.6段訂明有關洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢系統的管理資訊，須以及時、完整、易於理解及準確的方式向董事會及高級管理層傳達，使他們能作出知情的決定——並非僅透過第3.9(c)段合規主任的缺失匯報、第3.8(g)段合規主任／洗錢報告主任本身的資料取覽，或只在發生重大違規後才傳達。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(b)段

en.q: How far must the CO and MLRO be free of operational and business functions within the MSO?
options: Independent of all operational and business functions, subject to the constraint of the size of the MSO
Wholly independent of all operational and business functions in every case, whatever the size or structure of the MSO
Independence is not required, provided the CO and MLRO are appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge
Independent of operational functions only where the MSO has more than ten employees, with no such requirement for smaller MSOs
en.explain: ¶3.8(b) states that senior management should, as far as practicable, ensure that the CO and MLRO are, subject to constraint of size of the MSO, independent of all operational and business functions — a qualified standard, not an absolute one, an exemption for qualified staff, or a headcount threshold.

tc.q: 合規主任及洗錢報告主任須在多大程度上脫離該經營者的營運及業務職能？
options: 獨立於所有營運及業務職能，惟受該經營者規模的限制
不論該經營者規模或架構為何，在任何情況下均須完全獨立於所有營運及業務職能
無須獨立，只要合規主任及洗錢報告主任擁有合適資格及充足打擊洗錢知識即可
只有在該經營者僱員超過十人時，方須獨立於營運職能；規模較小者則無此規定
tc.explain: 第3.8(b)段訂明高級管理層應在切實可行範圍內，確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任在該經營者規模的限制下，獨立於所有營運及業務職能——此為附有限制的標準，並非絕對規定、並非因具備資格而獲豁免，亦無僱員人數門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(c)及(h)段

en.q: Where should the CO and MLRO normally be based, and what cover should be provided for their absence?
options: Normally based in Hong Kong, with an alternate or deputy CO and MLRO who should, where practicable, have the same status
Anywhere within the group's overseas offices, with cover provided by the group's external auditor during any absence
Normally based in Hong Kong, with no cover arrangement required even during an extended absence of the CO or MLRO
At the group's head office outside Hong Kong, with cover provided by the group compliance department
en.explain: ¶3.8(c) states that the CO and MLRO should normally be based in Hong Kong, and ¶3.8(h) requires appropriate cover for their absence — an alternate or deputy CO and MLRO who should, where practicable, have the same status — not cover by an external auditor, no cover at all, or basing them at an overseas group head office.

tc.q: 合規主任及洗錢報告主任通常應駐於何處？其缺席時應有甚麼替代安排？
options: 通常應駐於香港；並應設有署理或副合規主任及洗錢報告主任，而在切實可行範圍內應具備相同地位
可駐於集團轄下任何海外辦事處，缺席期間須由集團的外部核數師代理，並具備審計專業資格
通常應駐於香港，即使合規主任或洗錢報告主任長期缺席，亦無須設有任何特定的替代安排
應駐於香港以外的集團總部，缺席期間須由集團合規部門代理，並向當地監管機構負責
tc.explain: 第3.8(c)段訂明合規主任及洗錢報告主任通常應駐於香港；第3.8(h)段則規定須為其缺席提供適當替代安排，即署理或副合規主任及洗錢報告主任，而在切實可行範圍內應具備相同地位——並非由外部核數師代理、無須任何替代安排，或駐於香港以外的集團總部。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(e)段

en.q: Why should the CO and MLRO have regular contact with, and when required direct access to, senior management?
options: So that senior management can satisfy itself that statutory obligations are being met and the business is taking sufficiently effective measures against ML/TF risks
So that senior management can personally review and approve every suspicious transaction report before it is filed with the JFIU, within three business days
So that the CO and MLRO's individual performance can be appraised by senior management for remuneration and promotion purposes each year
So that senior management can delegate its statutory AML/CFT obligations to the CO and MLRO and thereby be relieved of responsibility
en.explain: ¶3.8(e) requires senior management to ensure the CO and MLRO have regular contact with, and when required direct access to, senior management, so that senior management can satisfy itself that statutory obligations are being met and the business is taking sufficiently effective measures against ML/TF risks — not to approve each STR personally, to appraise their performance, or to offload its own statutory responsibility (contrary to ¶3.7).

tc.q: 為何合規主任及洗錢報告主任應與高級管理層保持定期接觸，並在需要時可直接聯絡？
options: 使高級管理層能信納法定責任正獲履行，並信納業務正採取足夠有效措施以防範洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
使高級管理層能在向財富情報組提交每份可疑交易報告前，親自審閱及批准，並須於三個工作天內完成
使高級管理層能每年就合規主任及洗錢報告主任的個人表現進行評核，以釐定薪酬及晉升
使高級管理層可將其法定打擊洗錢責任轉授合規主任及洗錢報告主任，藉此獲免除責任
tc.explain: 第3.8(e)段規定高級管理層須確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任可與高級管理層保持定期接觸，並在需要時直接聯絡，以使高級管理層能信納法定責任正獲履行，並信納業務正採取足夠有效措施以防範洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險——並非為親自批准每份可疑交易報告、評核表現，或卸除高級管理層本身的法定責任（第3.7段訂明責任在高級管理層）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(g)段

en.q: What information access should the CO and MLRO have?
options: Timely access to all available information, both from internal sources such as CDD records and external sources such as circulars from the CCE
Access to internal CDD records only, since external circulars are addressed to senior management rather than the CO and MLRO directly, as senior management may direct
Access to external circulars from the CCE only, since internal CDD records fall under the sole custody of frontline operational staff
Access only to information relating to customers assessed as high risk, since lower risk customers fall outside AML/CFT oversight
en.explain: ¶3.8(g) requires the CO and MLRO to be capable of accessing, on a timely basis, all available information — both from internal sources such as CDD records and external sources such as circulars from the CCE — not one source to the exclusion of the other, and not confined to high-risk customers only.

tc.q: 合規主任及洗錢報告主任應可取得甚麼資料？
options: 可及時取得所有可得資料，包括內部來源（例如客戶盡職審查紀錄）及外部來源（例如海關關長的通函）
只可取得內部客戶盡職審查紀錄，因外部通函是發予高級管理層而非直接發予合規主任及洗錢報告主任，須經批准
只可取得海關關長發出的外部通函，因內部客戶盡職審查紀錄純屬前線營運員工保管
只可取得與被評為高風險客戶有關的資料，因低風險客戶不在打擊洗錢監督範圍之內
tc.explain: 第3.8(g)段規定合規主任及洗錢報告主任須能及時取得所有可得資料，包括內部來源（例如客戶盡職審查紀錄）及外部來源（例如海關關長的通函）——並非只限其中一種來源，也不僅限於高風險客戶的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9(a)段

en.q: Which responsibility of the Compliance Officer relates to keeping the AML/CFT Systems current?
options: Developing and continuously reviewing the Systems, including group-wide Systems for a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, to keep them up-to-date, compliant and effective
Communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including significant compliance deficiencies where appropriate to raise, within five business days
Reporting suspicious transactions to the JFIU as the MSO's central reference point and main contact with law enforcement agencies
Conducting independent reviews of the AML/CFT Systems' adequacy as part of the MSO's separately-established independent audit function
en.explain: ¶3.9(a) makes the CO responsible for developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including any group-wide Systems in the case of a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO, to ensure they remain up-to-date, meet current statutory and regulatory requirements and are effective — distinct from the CO's own communication duty in ¶3.9(c), the MLRO's JFIU role in ¶3.10, and the separate independent audit function in ¶3.11.

tc.q: 合規主任的哪一項職責關乎保持打擊洗錢系統與時並進？
options: 制定及持續檢視該等系統（在香港註冊成立者包括集團層面系統），以確保保持最新、符合規定並有效
與高級管理層溝通打擊洗錢的關鍵事宜，並在適當情況下，向其述及已識別的重大合規缺失
以該經營者中央聯絡點的身分，向聯合財富情報組匯報可疑交易，並作為與執法機構的主要聯絡點
作為該經營者獨立審計職能的一部分，定期對打擊洗錢系統的充分性進行獨立檢視及提交報告
tc.explain: 第3.9(a)段訂明合規主任須負責制定及／或持續檢視該經營者的打擊洗錢系統（就在香港註冊成立的經營者而言，包括任何集團層面系統），以確保其保持最新、符合現行法定及監管規定，並能有效管理其業務所產生的風險——有別於第3.9(c)段合規主任本身的溝通職責、第3.10段洗錢報告主任向財富情報組匯報的角色，以及第3.11段另設的獨立審計職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9(c)及(d)段

en.q: Which two further responsibilities does the Guideline assign to the Compliance Officer?
options: Communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management, including significant deficiencies as appropriate; and ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate and effective
Developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including group-wide Systems where the MSO is Hong Kong-incorporated
Overseeing all aspects of the AML/CFT Systems, including monitoring their effectiveness and enhancing controls and procedures where necessary, with quarterly reporting to the CCE
Establishing an independent audit function with a direct line of communication to the MSO's senior management and sufficient resources
en.explain: ¶3.9 lists the CO's responsibilities as (a) developing and reviewing the Systems, (b) overseeing all aspects of them including monitoring effectiveness and enhancing controls, (c) communicating key AML/CFT issues with senior management including significant deficiencies where appropriate, and (d) ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate, appropriate and effective — (a) and (b) are real CO duties but the wrong pair, and establishing the audit function in ¶3.11 is a separate function.

tc.q: 本指引還賦予合規主任哪兩項職責？
options: 與高級管理層溝通打擊洗錢的關鍵事宜，適當情況下包括重大合規缺失；並確保員工打擊洗錢培訓充分有效
制定及／或持續檢視該經營者的打擊洗錢系統，就在香港註冊成立的經營者而言包括集團層面系統
監督打擊洗錢系統的各方面，包括監察其成效，並在有需要時強化相關管控措施及程序
設立獨立審計職能，該職能須與該經營者的高級管理層保持直接溝通渠道，並具備充足專業知識及資源，每季匯報
tc.explain: 第3.9段列出合規主任的職責包括：(a)制定及檢視該等系統；(b)監督該等系統的各方面，包括監察成效及在必要時強化管控措施及程序；(c)與高級管理層溝通打擊洗錢的關鍵事宜，在適當情況下包括重大合規缺失；及(d)確保員工的打擊洗錢培訓充分、適當及有效——(a)及(b)雖屬合規主任的真實職責，但並非本題所問的一對，而設立獨立審計職能（第3.11段）則屬另一獨立職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10段

en.q: Besides being the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions, what other role does the MLRO have?
options: The main point of contact with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit and law enforcement agencies
Reviewing internal disclosures and exception reports to determine whether a report to the JFIU is necessary
Acting as the focal point for oversight of all AML/CFT prevention and detection activities within the MSO
Establishing and leading the MSO's independent audit function with a direct line to senior management
en.explain: ¶3.10 states that an MSO should appoint an MLRO as a central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and also as the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies — the review of internal disclosures in ¶3.10(a) is a function, not this 'other role', the focal-point description in ¶3.9 belongs to the CO, and the independent audit function in ¶3.11 is separate.

tc.q: 除擔任匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點外，洗錢報告主任還有甚麼角色？
options: 與聯合財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點
覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，以決定是否有需要向聯合財富情報組作出報告
作為該經營者內監督一切打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集防止及偵察活動的中心點
設立並領導該經營者的獨立審計職能，與高級管理層有直接溝通渠道
tc.explain: 第3.10段訂明金錢服務經營者應委任洗錢報告主任，擔任匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點，並擔任與聯合財富情報組及執法機構的主要聯絡點——第3.10(a)段的內部披露覆核屬職能而非本題所問的「另一角色」，第3.9段的中心點描述屬合規主任的角色，而第3.11段的獨立審計職能則屬另一獨立職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10(c)段

en.q: Which guidance function is listed among the principal functions of the MLRO?
options: Provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off
Review of internal disclosures and exception reports
Maintenance of records related to internal reviews
Ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate and effective
en.explain: ¶3.10 lists the MLRO's principal functions as (a) review of internal disclosures and exception reports and determining whether a report to the JFIU is necessary, (b) maintenance of records related to such internal reviews, and (c) provision of guidance on how to avoid tipping off — only (c) is a guidance function; (a) and (b) are the MLRO's other two functions, and staff training is the CO's duty under ¶3.9(d).

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任的主要職能中，列出哪一項指引職能？
options: 就如何避免洩密提供指引
覆核內部披露及例外情況報告
備存與內部覆核有關的紀錄
確保打擊洗錢員工培訓充分且有效
tc.explain: 第3.10段列出洗錢報告主任的主要職能為：(a)覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並決定是否須向聯合財富情報組作出報告；(b)備存與該等內部覆核有關的紀錄；及(c)就如何避免洩密提供指引——只有(c)屬指引職能；(a)及(b)是洗錢報告主任的另外兩項職能，而員工培訓則是第3.9(d)段合規主任的職責。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.11段

en.q: What two features must an MSO's independent audit function have?
options: A direct line of communication to senior management, and sufficient expertise and resources to carry out its responsibilities
Being normally based in Hong Kong, and having a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO
Frequency and extent of review commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the business, and a review from external parties where appropriate
Coverage of the adequacy of the Systems and the ML/TF risk assessment framework, and of the effectiveness of the compliance function
en.explain: ¶3.11 states that an MSO should establish an independent audit function which should have a direct line of communication to the senior management of the MSO, and should have sufficient expertise and resources to enable it to carry out its responsibilities — not the CO/MLRO qualities in ¶3.8, the review-frequency standard in ¶3.13, or the review's scope of coverage in ¶3.12.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的獨立審計職能須具備哪兩項特徵？
options: 與高級管理層有直接溝通渠道，並具備足夠專業知識及資源以履行其職責
通常駐於香港，並在該經營者內具有一定的資歷及權力
檢視的頻次及範圍須與業務性質、規模及複雜程度相稱，並適時由外部人士檢視
涵蓋該等系統及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估框架的充分性，以及合規職能的成效
tc.explain: 第3.11段訂明金錢服務經營者應設立獨立審計職能，該職能應與該經營者的高級管理層有直接溝通渠道，並應具備足夠的專業知識及資源以履行其職責——並非第3.8段的合規主任／洗錢報告主任特質、第3.13段的檢視頻次標準，或第3.12段檢視範圍所涵蓋的事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.12段

en.q: What four matters must the audit function cover when it regularly reviews the AML/CFT Systems?
options: Adequacy of the Systems and risk assessment framework and RBA application; effectiveness of STR-reporting systems and of the compliance function; and staff awareness of AML/CFT duties
Developing and reviewing the Systems; overseeing all aspects of them; communicating key issues with senior management; and ensuring staff training is adequate; reviewed by the CCE every two years
Documenting the risk assessment process; considering all relevant risk factors; obtaining senior management approval; and keeping the assessment up-to-date
Appropriate qualification with AML/CFT knowledge; independence from operational functions; being based in Hong Kong; and sufficient seniority and authority
en.explain: ¶3.12 states that the audit function's regular review of the AML/CFT Systems should include, but not be limited to: adequacy of the Systems, the ML/TF risk assessment framework and application of the RBA; effectiveness of suspicious transaction reporting systems; effectiveness of the compliance function; and the level of staff awareness of AML/CFT responsibilities — not the CO's ¶3.9 duties, the ¶2.3 risk-assessment steps, or the CO/MLRO qualities in ¶3.8.

tc.q: 審計職能定期檢視打擊洗錢系統時，須涵蓋哪四項事宜？
options: 該等系統、風險評估框架及風險為本方式應用的充分性；可疑交易匯報系統及合規職能的成效；以及員工對打擊洗錢職責的認知水平
制定及持續檢視該等系統；監督該等系統的各方面；與高級管理層溝通關鍵事宜；以及確保員工培訓充分有效，並每兩年提交獨立審計報告
記錄風險評估的整個程序；考慮所有相關的風險因素；取得高級管理層的批准；以及使風險評估持續反映現況
擁有合適資格及充足打擊洗錢知識；獨立於所有營運及業務職能；通常駐於香港；以及具備足夠資歷及權力
tc.explain: 第3.12段訂明審計職能對打擊洗錢系統的定期檢視應包括但不限於：該經營者打擊洗錢系統、洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估框架及風險為本方式應用的充分性；可疑交易匯報系統的成效；合規職能的成效；以及負有打擊洗錢職責員工的認知水平——並非第3.9段合規主任的職責、第2.3段的風險評估步驟，或第3.8段的合規主任／洗錢報告主任特質。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.13段

en.q: To what should the frequency and extent of the independent audit review be commensurate, and what further step may be appropriate?
options: Commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the business and its ML/TF risks; and where appropriate, a review from external parties
Commensurate with the MSO's annual turnover alone; and an external review is mandatory for every MSO regardless of risk
Fixed at once every calendar year for all MSOs regardless of size; and no external review of the audit function is ever permitted; conducted every two years
Determined case-by-case by the CCE upon application; and any external review requires the CCE's prior written approval
en.explain: ¶3.13 states that the frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's business and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses, and that where appropriate the MSO should also seek a review from external parties — not turnover alone with mandatory external review, a fixed annual cycle with an external-review ban, or case-by-case CCE determination.

tc.q: 獨立審計檢視的頻次及範圍應與甚麼相稱？還可採取甚麼進一步步驟？
options: 與業務性質、規模及複雜程度，以及所生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱；並適時尋求外部人士檢視
只與該經營者的周年營業額相稱；且不論風險高低，所有經營者均須強制每年進行一次外部檢視，並須知會關長
一律固定每個曆年進行一次，不論經營者規模大小；且絕不准許對審計職能進行外部檢視
由海關關長按個別經營者的申請逐案決定；任何外部檢視均須事先取得關長的書面批准
tc.explain: 第3.13段訂明檢視的頻次及範圍應與該經營者業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱；在適當情況下，該經營者亦應尋求外部人士進行檢視——並非只按周年營業額並強制外部檢視、一律固定每年一次並禁止外部檢視，或由海關關長逐案決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.14段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of an MSO's employee screening procedures?
options: To ensure high standards when hiring employees
To verify employees' entitlement to work in Hong Kong
To assess employees' training needs
To determine employees' remuneration levels
en.explain: ¶3.14 states that an MSO should have adequate and appropriate screening procedures in order to ensure high standards when hiring employees. Employee screening procedures are one of the four components of AML/CFT Systems listed at ¶3.4.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者僱員甄別程序的訂明目的為何？
options: 確保在聘用僱員時維持高標準
核實僱員在香港工作的資格
評估僱員的培訓需要
釐定僱員的薪酬水平
tc.explain: 第3.14段訂明金錢服務經營者應設有充分及適當的甄別程序，以確保在聘用僱員時維持高標準。僱員甄別程序是第3.4段所列打擊洗錢系統四項組成部分之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.7段

en.q: At what level within the MSO should the CO be appointed, and what is the CO's overall responsibility?
options: At the management level, with overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems
At any level the MSO considers suitable, acting as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting, CCE-notified
At board level only, with responsibility for approving the entry into new customer relationships
At operational level, with responsibility for the day-to-day checking of individual transactions
en.explain: ¶3.7 states that senior management should appoint a CO at the management level to have the overall responsibility for the establishment and maintenance of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, and separately a senior staff member as the MLRO to act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting — the reporting role belongs to the MLRO, not the CO, and no board-only or operational-level rule is stated.

tc.q: 合規主任應在該經營者的哪一層級獲委任？其整體職責為何？
options: 在管理層級獲委任，並就該經營者打擊洗錢系統的建立及維持負整體責任
在該經營者認為合適的任何層級獲委任，擔任匯報可疑交易的中央聯絡點
只可在董事會層級獲委任，並負責批准建立新客戶關係，並須每年重新審批
在營運層級獲委任，並負責個別交易的日常查核
tc.explain: 第3.7段訂明高級管理層應在管理層級委任合規主任，就該經營者打擊洗錢系統的建立及維持負整體責任；並另行委任一名高級員工為洗錢報告主任，擔任可疑交易匯報的中央聯絡點——匯報角色屬洗錢報告主任而非合規主任，且本段並無只限董事會層級或營運層級的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.4段

en.q: Which four elements should an MSO's AML/CFT Systems include under ¶3.4?
options: Compliance management arrangements, an independent audit function, employee screening procedures, and an ongoing training programme
A board risk committee, an external auditor, a legal adviser and an insurance policy against ML/TF losses
A customer acceptance policy, a pricing policy, a complaints-handling policy and a records-retention policy
A sanctions screening database, a transaction monitoring system, a reporting hotline and a whistleblowing channel, registered with the CCE
en.explain: ¶3.4 states that an MSO should implement AML/CFT Systems having regard to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses and the ML/TF risks arising from those businesses, and that the Systems should include compliance management arrangements, an independent audit function, employee screening procedures, and an ongoing employee training programme.

tc.q: 根據第3.4段，金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢系統應包括哪四項要素？
options: 合規管理安排、獨立審計職能、僱員甄別程序，以及持續的僱員培訓計劃
董事會風險委員會、外部核數師、法律顧問，以及防範洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集損失的保險單
客戶接納政策、定價政策、投訴處理政策及紀錄保存政策
制裁篩查資料庫、交易監察系統、舉報熱線及舉報渠道
tc.explain: 第3.4段訂明金錢服務經營者應顧及其業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及該等業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，實施打擊洗錢系統；該等系統應包括合規管理安排、獨立審計職能、僱員甄別程序，以及持續的僱員培訓計劃。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.7段註腳9

en.q: Can one individual hold both the CO and MLRO functions at an MSO?
options: Yes — depending on the size of the MSO, the same individual may perform both the CO and MLRO functions
No — the CO and MLRO must always be held by two different individuals, regardless of the MSO's size or structure
Yes, but only where the CCE has granted prior written approval for the two functions to be combined
Yes, but only where the MSO has no overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings of any kind
en.explain: Footnote 9 to ¶3.7 states that, depending on the size of an MSO, the functions of CO and MLRO may be performed by the same person — there is no rule requiring separate individuals in every case, no stated CCE approval requirement for combining the roles, and no condition tied to overseas operations. The Licensing Guide ¶4.15(a) contemplates the same, for a sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner who is also the CO and MLRO.

tc.q: 一名人士可否同時擔任合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能？
options: 可以——視乎該經營者的規模，同一人可同時履行該兩項職能
不可以——不論該經營者規模或架構為何，兩職須一律由不同人士出任
可以，但須事先取得海關關長就合併該兩項職能的書面批准
可以，但只限該經營者並無任何形式的境外分支機構或附屬企業
tc.explain: 第3.7段註腳9訂明，視乎金錢服務經營者的規模，合規主任與洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人擔任——並無規定一律須由不同人士出任，亦無訂明須取得海關關長批准方可合併該兩職，或以並無境外業務為條件。《牌照指引》第4.15(a)段亦有相同考量，訂明獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人同時擔任該兩個職位的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.15段

en.q: Which overseas entities must a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO cover with its group-wide AML/CFT Systems?
options: Its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as a financial institution as defined in the AMLO
All its branches or subsidiaries located outside Hong Kong, regardless of the type of business they carry on, dormant or otherwise
Every company in which the MSO holds any shareholding, however small, wherever that company is located
Only its wholly-owned overseas subsidiaries, excluding any overseas branches or partly-owned undertakings
en.explain: ¶3.15 states that a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO with overseas branches or subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as a financial institution as defined in the AMLO should implement group-wide AML/CFT Systems covering all of them — a narrower FI-business test than the group-wide risk assessment duty in ¶2.7, which covers all overseas branches or subsidiaries regardless of business type; not any shareholding, and not wholly-owned subsidiaries only.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，其集團層面打擊洗錢系統須涵蓋哪些境外實體？
options: 其境外分支機構及經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的附屬企業
其位於香港以外的所有分行或附屬企業，不論它們經營何種業務
該經營者持有任何股權（不論多寡）的每一間公司，不論位於何地
只限其全資擁有的境外附屬公司，不包括境外分支機構或非全資擁有的企業
tc.explain: 第3.15段訂明在香港註冊成立而設有境外分支機構或經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的附屬企業的金錢服務經營者，應對所有該等分支機構及附屬企業實施集團層面打擊洗錢系統——此「相同業務」限制比第2.7段集團層面風險評估責任（涵蓋所有境外分行或附屬企業，不論業務類型）更為狹窄；並非任何股權，也不僅限於全資擁有的附屬公司。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.16段

en.q: What must a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO ensure, through its group-wide Systems, about its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings?
options: That they have procedures ensuring compliance with CDD and record-keeping requirements similar to Schedule 2 Parts 2 and 3, as local law permits
That they apply the higher of the Hong Kong and host-jurisdiction AML/CFT requirements, to the extent the host jurisdiction's laws permit, checked by the CO each year
That, where local law does not permit compliance, they inform the CCE of the failure and take additional measures to mitigate the risk
That they use the same information technology systems and transaction-monitoring software as the Hong Kong head office
en.explain: ¶3.16 states that a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO should, through its group-wide Systems, ensure that its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings have procedures in place to ensure compliance with CDD and record-keeping requirements similar to those under Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2, to the extent permitted by local law — the higher-of-two-standards rule belongs to ¶3.18, the failure-to-comply steps to ¶3.19, and shared IT systems are not mentioned.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，須透過其集團層面系統確保其境外分支機構及附屬企業具備甚麼？
options: 設有程序確保遵從附表2第2及3部類似的客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定，以當地法律准許範圍為限
就香港與所在地打擊洗錢規定有分歧之處，須執行兩者中較嚴格的規定，以所在地法律准許的範圍為限
如所在地法律不准許遵從，須將不能遵從的情況通知海關關長，並採取額外措施減低風險
須使用與香港總部完全相同的資訊科技系統及交易監察軟件，並由總部統一管理
tc.explain: 第3.16段訂明在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者須透過其集團層面系統，確保其境外分支機構及附屬企業設有程序，以在該地方法律准許的範圍內，確保遵從與附表2第2及3部類似的客戶盡職審查及紀錄保存規定——兩者取較嚴格標準的規則屬第3.18段、未能遵從時的應對步驟屬第3.19段，而共用資訊科技系統則並無提及。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17段

en.q: Subject to what safeguards should a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO implement group-wide information-sharing measures?
options: Adequate safeguards on confidentiality and use of the shared information, including safeguards against tipping off, as the laws of the jurisdictions involved permit
The written consent of each individual customer whose customer, account or transaction information is to be shared with the MSO's group-level functions, renewed every two years
The CCE's prior written approval for each individual transfer of customer, account or transaction information between group-level entities
A data-sharing agreement registered with the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data before any such information may be shared
en.explain: ¶3.17 states that, to the extent permitted by the laws and regulations of the jurisdictions involved and subject to adequate safeguards on the protection of confidentiality and use of information being shared — including safeguards to prevent tipping off — a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO should implement group-wide information-sharing measures; it does not require each customer's individual consent, CCE pre-approval for each transfer, or Privacy Commissioner registration.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者實施集團層面資料分享措施時，須受哪些保障規限？
options: 就所分享資料的保密及使用設有充分保障，包括防止洩密，並以所涉司法管轄區法律准許者為限
每名客戶、帳戶或交易資料被分享予集團層面職能前，須取得該客戶的書面同意
海關關長就集團層面實體之間每次個別傳送客戶、帳戶或交易資料的事先書面批准
在分享任何該等資料前，須先向個人資料私隱專員登記有關的資料分享協議並取得確認，每兩年更新一次
tc.explain: 第3.17段訂明，在所涉司法管轄區的法律及規例准許的範圍內，並在就所分享資料的保密及使用設有充分保障（包括防止洩密的保障）的前提下，在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者應實施集團層面資料分享措施——並非須取得每名客戶的個別同意、每次傳送均須海關關長事先批准，或須向個人資料私隱專員登記。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17(b)段

en.q: What must a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO's group-wide Systems provide to its group-level compliance, audit or AML/CFT functions?
options: Customer, account and transaction information from its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings that carry on FI business, when necessary for AML/CFT purposes
Information required for the purposes of CDD and ML/TF risk management, shared between the MSO and its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings, refreshed every 30 days
Only aggregate statistical data on transaction volumes and customer numbers, with no customer-identifiable or account-level detail included
Only information that has already been the subject of a suspicious transaction report separately filed with the JFIU by the MLRO
en.explain: ¶3.17(b) requires measures for provision to the MSO's group-level compliance, audit and/or AML/CFT functions of customer, account and transaction information from its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings that carry on the same business as an FI, when necessary for AML/CFT purposes — distinct from the ¶3.17(a) information-sharing-for-CDD limb, and not limited to aggregate statistics or already-reported STR information.

tc.q: 在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者，其集團層面系統須向其集團層面合規、審計或打擊洗錢職能提供甚麼資料？
options: 在打擊洗錢用途有需要時，來自經營金融機構業務的境外分支機構及附屬企業的客戶、帳戶及交易資料
該經營者與其境外分支機構及附屬企業之間，為客戶盡職審查及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險管理目的而分享的資料
只需交易量及客戶數目等匯總統計數據，不包括任何可識別客戶身分或帳戶層面的細節
只需已由洗錢報告主任另行向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告的相關資料
tc.explain: 第3.17(b)段規定須設有措施，在打擊洗錢用途有需要時，向該經營者的集團層面合規、審計及／或打擊洗錢職能提供來自其經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構相同業務的境外分支機構及附屬企業的客戶、帳戶及交易資料——有別於第3.17(a)段為客戶盡職審查而分享資料的一項，亦不僅限於匯總統計數據或已匯報的可疑交易資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.17段註腳11

en.q: What may the information shared with group-level functions include, according to footnote 11?
options: Analysis of transactions or activities that appear unusual, which could include a suspicious transaction report or its underlying information
Customer, account, and transaction information that overseas branches and subsidiaries generally supply for AML/CFT purposes
Copies of the customer's identification documents obtained during CDD, forwarded routinely to the group's compliance function, filed with the CCE each quarter
The MSO's own internal audit findings, as routinely reported up to the group's compliance and audit functions
en.explain: Footnote 11 to ¶3.17 states that the information shared with group-level functions should include analysis of transactions or activities which appear unusual, and could include a suspicious transaction report, its underlying information, or the fact that one has been submitted. This is narrower than the general sharing of information for CDD/risk-management purposes under ¶3.17(a), and is not simply routine copies of identification documents or internal audit findings.

tc.q: 根據註腳11，與集團層面職能分享的資料可包括甚麼？
options: 看來屬不尋常的交易或活動的資料及分析；並可包括可疑交易報告或其所依據的資料
由境外分行及附屬企業為打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集目的而一般地提供的客戶、帳戶及交易資料
在客戶盡職審查過程中取得的身分識別文件副本，按慣常做法轉交集團合規部門
該經營者本身的內部審計發現，按慣常做法呈報予集團的合規及審核職能
tc.explain: 第3.17段註腳11訂明，與集團層面職能分享的資料應包括看來屬不尋常的交易或活動的資料及分析，並可包括可疑交易報告、其所依據的資料，或已提交可疑交易報告一事。這較第3.17(a)段一般的盡職審查／風險管理資料共用責任更為具體，並非單純的慣常身分識別文件副本或內部審計發現。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.18段

en.q: Where the host jurisdiction's AML/CFT requirements differ from Hong Kong's, which set must the overseas branch or subsidiary apply?
options: The higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent the host jurisdiction's laws and regulations permit
The host jurisdiction's requirements in every case, even where Hong Kong's are more stringent than the local standard
Hong Kong's requirements in every case, regardless of whether the host jurisdiction's law permits this
Whichever set of requirements the group's head office selects for its group-wide AML/CFT Systems
en.explain: ¶3.18 states that if the AML/CFT requirements in the host jurisdiction differ from those referred to in ¶3.15, the MSO should require that branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher of the two sets of requirements, to the extent that the host jurisdiction's laws and regulations permit — not simply the local rules, not simply Hong Kong's rules, and not a choice left to the group's head office.

tc.q: 如所在地司法管轄區的打擊洗錢規定與香港的規定有異，該境外分支機構或附屬企業須適用哪一套規定？
options: 在所在地司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內，執行兩套規定中較嚴格者
一律適用所在地司法管轄區的規定，即使香港的規定較為嚴格
一律適用香港的規定，不論所在地司法管轄區法律是否准許
由集團總部為其集團層面打擊洗錢制度而選定的一套規定
tc.explain: 第3.18段訂明，如所在地司法管轄區的打擊洗錢規定與第3.15段所述的相關規定有異，該經營者應要求該分支機構或附屬企業在該司法管轄區法律及規例准許的範圍內，適用兩套規定中較嚴格者——並非單純適用當地規定、單純適用香港規定，或交由集團總部自行選擇。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.19段

en.q: Where host jurisdiction law does not permit an overseas branch to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements, what must the MSO do?
options: Inform the CCE of the failure, and take steps to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks the branch faces as a result
Apply the higher AML/CFT requirements in any event, since host jurisdiction law cannot override the Guideline, regardless of cost
Apply the standard AML/CFT requirements that apply generally under the Guideline, without notifying the CCE
Inform the CCE of the failure, and close the branch or subsidiary undertaking immediately
en.explain: ¶3.19 states that if the laws and regulations of the host jurisdiction do not permit the branch or subsidiary undertaking to apply the higher AML/CFT requirements, the MSO should inform the CCE of such failure and take additional measures to effectively mitigate the ML/TF risks faced as a result. The higher standard cannot simply override local law, and closing the branch is not the response the paragraph states.

tc.q: 如所在地司法管轄區的法律不准許境外分支機構適用較高的打擊洗錢規定，該經營者須怎樣做？
options: 將該情況通知海關關長，並採取措施減低該分支機構因此而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
不論所在地司法管轄區的法律規例有否准許，該經營者均須一律適用較高的打擊洗錢規定，並須存檔
該經營者應適用本指引下一般適用的標準打擊洗錢規定，無需通知海關關長
該經營者須將該情況通知海關關長，並須將該分支機構或附屬企業立即結束
tc.explain: 第3.19段訂明，如所在地司法管轄區的法律不准許該分支機構或附屬企業適用較高的打擊洗錢規定，該經營者應將該情況通知海關關長，並採取額外措施有效減低因此而面對的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。不能不理會當地法律而一律適用較高規定，本段亦沒有訂明須結束該分支機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第19(3)條；《打擊洗錢指引》第3.2段

en.q: How does the statutory duty in section 19(3) of Schedule 2 relate to the Guideline's requirements on an MSO's AML/CFT Systems in paragraph 3.2?
options: Section 19(3) requires effective procedures for the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15 of Schedule 2; paragraph 3.2 requires senior management to approve the resulting AML/CFT Systems

Section 19(3)'s procedural duty is superseded by the broader duty in section 23 of Schedule 2, which paragraph 3.1 says an MSO meets through a risk-based AML/CFT System, certified by the CO within 14 days
Paragraph 3.2's requirement that senior management approve the AML/CFT Systems applies only where section 22(1)'s duty on overseas branches is also engaged
Both impose the identical requirement in identical wording, so the statutory minimum and the Guideline's expectations are simply the same provision restated
en.explain: Section 19(3) of Schedule 2 requires an institution, for each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction, to establish effective procedures not inconsistent with the Ordinance for carrying out the duties under sections 3, 4, 5, 9, 10 and 15. Paragraph 3.2 of the Guideline separately requires that the resulting AML/CFT Systems be approved by senior management, monitored and enhanced if necessary — a distinct, complementary requirement, not one displaced by section 23/paragraph 3.1, and not conditional on the overseas-branch duty in section 22(1).

tc.q: 附表2第19(3)條的法定責任，與本指引第3.2段就打擊洗錢系統的規定有何關係？
options: 第19(3)條規定須設有有效程序，以履行附表2第3、4、5、9、10及15條的責任；第3.2段規定所得的打擊洗錢系統須經高級管理層批准
第19(3)條這項程序責任已被第23條規定的更廣泛責任取代，第3.1段訂明須以風險為本方式建立打擊洗錢系統以符合第23條，並須每年由合規主任確認
第3.2段規定打擊洗錢系統須經高級管理層批准，惟此規定只在第22(1)條的境外分行及附屬企業責任同時適用時方適用
兩者以完全相同的措辭，就完全相同的事宜施加完全相同的法定責任，法定最低要求與本指引期望之間並無任何分別
tc.explain: 附表2第19(3)條規定機構須就每種客戶、業務關係、產品及交易，建立與本條例並無抵觸的有效程序，以履行第3、4、5、9、10及15條下的責任。本指引第3.2段另行規定所得的打擊洗錢系統須經高級管理層批准、監察及在必要時強化——此為獨立而互補的規定，並非被第23條／第3.1段取代，亦非以第22(1)條的境外分行責任為前提。

source.tc: 《有關適當人選準則的補充指引》（2020年1月）第6(j)段

en.q: Which shortcoming concerns the person's organizational structure and personnel, rather than its systems or the person's own conduct?
options: Failure to establish an organizational structure and personnel that comply with the relevant legislative or regulatory requirements
Failure to be equipped with the skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism to perform the business's functions efficiently
Failure to provide the necessary infrastructure and internal control systems to manage risk, avoid conflict of interest, and provide an audit trail
Being untruthful, or providing false or misleading information, or omitting material information, to the CCE
en.explain: Paragraph 6(j) of the Supplementary F&P Guideline makes relevant whether the person has failed to establish an organizational structure and personnel that comply with the relevant legislative or regulatory requirements. This is a distinct governance criterion from paragraph 6(h) (skills, knowledge, experience and professionalism), 6(k) (infrastructure and internal controls), and 6(i) (untruthfulness to the CCE), which are separate matters listed elsewhere in paragraph 6.

tc.q: 哪一項缺失涉及該人的組織架構及人事安排，而非其系統或該人本身的操守？
options: 未能確立一套符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構及人事安排
未具備足以有效及竭誠地執行金錢服務業務職能的技能、知識、經驗及專業意識
未有備妥所需的基礎設施及內部監控系統，以管理風險、避免利益衝突及提供審計線索
曾不誠實或向海關關長提供虛假或具誤導性的資料，或遺漏要項資料
tc.explain: 《適當人選補充指引》第6(j)段將該人有否未能確立符合相關法例或監管規定的組織架構及人事安排列為相關事宜。此為獨立的管治準則，有別於第6(h)段（技能、知識、經驗及專業意識）、第6(k)段（基礎設施及內部監控）及第6(i)段（向關長不誠實），該三項屬第6段下的其他事宜。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 13
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第13項

en.q: Which of the following IS given as an example of the AML/CFT compliance function that item 13 requires the applicant's policy to elaborate?
options: Management oversight and the roles of the compliance department in overseeing AML/CFT compliance
Relevant risk factors and the procedures to conduct a customer, product and service risk assessment
Reporting lines for suspicious transactions and the roles of the money laundering reporting officer
Screening against customers for targeted financial sanctions related to terrorism, proliferation, and PEP status
en.explain: Item 13 requires the policy to elaborate the AML/CFT compliance function, giving management oversight and the roles of the compliance department as examples, alongside any relevant committee/panel and the duties of the CO and compliance staff. Risk factors and risk-assessment procedures belong to item 12, suspicious-transaction reporting lines and the MLRO's role to item 14, and sanctions/PEP screening to item 11 — none of which is the compliance-function item.

tc.q: 以下何者是第13項要求申請人的政策詳述的打擊洗錢合規職能的例子？
options: 管理層的監督，以及合規部門的角色，這兩者均屬合規職能一項下的例子
相關風險因素，以及對客戶、產品及服務進行風險評估的相關程序
舉報可疑交易的相關報告流程，以及洗錢報告主任與相關職員的角色
篩查客戶以減低恐怖分子資金籌集、武器擴散及政治人物的針對性金融制裁風險
tc.explain: 第13項規定政策須詳述打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的合規職能，並以管理層的監督及合規部門的角色為例，連同任何相關委員會／小組及合規主任與合規職員的職務。相關風險因素及風險評估程序屬第12項；舉報可疑交易的報告流程及洗錢報告主任的角色屬第14項；制裁及政治人物篩查則屬第11項——皆非合規職能一項。

source.en: C&ED Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 (20 Jan 2026) — Understanding of ML/TF risks
source.tc: 香港海關通函 MSSB/MIS_01/2026（2026年1月20日）——了解洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險

en.q: What governance step does the TBML circular require where multiple risk indicators are present on a customer?
options: Flagging and escalating the case to the MSO's senior management, supported by adequate staff training and guidance
Applying stricter CDD requirements to the customer, and obtaining the customer's source-of-funds and source-of-wealth information
Examining the transaction's background and purpose, and seeking additional CDD information from the customer
Filing a suspicious transaction report, together with the matters on which the knowledge or suspicion is based
en.explain: Section 1 of the circular ('Understanding of ML/TF risks') states that particular attention should be given to flagging and escalating cases to MSOs' senior management where multiple risk indicators are present, supported by adequate staff training and guidance. Stricter CDD/SoF-SoW enquiries belong to section 2 (CDD), examining transaction background belongs to section 3 (TM), and filing an STR belongs to section 4 — related but distinct steps in the same circular.

tc.q: 當客戶身上出現多項風險指標時，打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動的通函要求採取甚麼管治步驟？
options: 將個案標示並上報至高級管理層，並輔以足夠的員工培訓及指導
對客戶施加更嚴格的盡職審查要求，並索取其資金來源及財富來源的資料
審查該等交易的背景及目的，並向客戶索取額外的盡職審查資料
提交可疑交易報告，連同該項知悉或懷疑所根據的任何事宜
tc.explain: 通函第1節（關於了解洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險）訂明，當客戶出現多項風險指標時，應特別注意將個案標示並上報至高級管理層，並輔以足夠的員工培訓及指導。更嚴格的盡職審查／資金及財富來源查詢屬第2節（客戶盡職調查）；審查交易背景屬第3節（監察交易）；提交可疑交易報告則屬第4節——均為同一通函下相關但不同的步驟。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9段

en.q: What must happen to the results of a review of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: They should be documented, and approved by the MSO's senior management
They should be provided to the CCE within 30 days of completion of the review
They should be certified by an internal or external auditor before being finalised
They should be communicated to the board of directors or its delegated committee
en.explain: ¶2.9 requires an MSO to conduct its institutional ML/TF risk assessment every two years and upon material trigger events, and states that the results of the review should be documented and approved by the MSO's senior management — not merely filed with the CCE on a fixed timetable (that mischaracterises ¶2.3(e)'s 'when required' rule), certified by audit (¶2.4(e) lists audit results only as a risk factor), or routed to the board in place of senior management (¶3.6 addresses the board's separate oversight role).

tc.q: 機構層面洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的檢視結果須如何處理？
options: 須以文件記錄，並經該經營者的高級管理層批准
須於檢視完成後30日內提交海關關長
須經內部或外部審計核證後方告完成
須知會董事會或其獲授權委員會，而非高級管理層
tc.explain: 第2.9段規定金錢服務經營者須每兩年並在出現重大觸發事件時進行機構層面洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估，並訂明檢視結果須以文件記錄，並經該經營者的高級管理層批准——並非按固定時間表提交海關關長（第2.3(e)段訂明的僅為『在被要求時』提供）、經審計核證（第2.4(e)段只將審計結果列為風險因素之一），或改為知會董事會而非高級管理層（董事會的獨立監督角色見第3.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.5段

en.q: What kind of risk assessment process is required where an MSO's products and services are more varied and complex, or its customers have more diverse risk profiles?
options: A more sophisticated risk assessment process
The same process, applied more frequently
A process designed by an external consultant
A process approved in advance by the CCE
en.explain: ¶2.5 states that the scale and scope of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the MSO's business: a simpler approach might suffice for smaller or less complex businesses, whereas where products and services are more varied and complex, or customers have more diverse risk profiles, a more sophisticated process will be required.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者的產品及服務較多元及複雜，或其客戶的風險狀況較多樣，須採用哪種風險評估程序？
options: 較精細的風險評估程序
相同的簡單程序，但更頻密地進行
由外部顧問設計的程序
事先經海關關長批准的程序
tc.explain: 第2.5段訂明機構層面風險評估的規模及範圍應與該經營者業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱：業務規模較小或性質較簡單者，較簡單的評估方式或已足夠；相反，如產品及服務較多元及複雜，或客戶的風險狀況較多樣，則須採用較精細的評估程序。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.12段

en.q: At what point must an MSO undertake the risk assessment for a new product, business practice or technology, and what must follow?
options: Prior to the launch or use, taking appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the risks identified
Within 30 days after the launch or use, reporting the risks identified to the CCE
At the next scheduled institutional ML/TF risk assessment, which is conducted every two years, per CCE guidance
Only if the customer risk assessment first identifies the product or technology as high-risk
en.explain: ¶2.12 states that an MSO should undertake the risk assessment prior to the launch of new products, new business practices, or the use of new or developing technologies, and should take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate the risks identified — not after launch on a 30-day clock, not deferred to the next two-yearly institutional assessment under ¶2.9, and not conditional on the product first being flagged high-risk.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須於何時就新產品、新業務常規或新科技進行風險評估？其後須怎樣做？
options: 須在推出或使用之前進行，並須採取適當而足夠的措施管理及減低所識別的風險
須在推出或使用後30日內進行，並須向海關關長匯報所識別的相關風險詳情
須於下一次定期機構層面洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估時進行，該評估每兩年進行一次
只在客戶風險評估首先將該項新產品或科技識別為高風險時，方須進行評估
tc.explain: 第2.12段訂明金錢服務經營者應在推出新產品、新業務常規或使用新或發展中科技之前進行風險評估，並應採取適當措施管理及減低所識別的風險——並非在推出後30日內進行、押後至第2.9段所指每兩年一次的機構層面風險評估，或以該產品先被界定為高風險為前提。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.16段

en.q: What two things must an MSO be able to demonstrate to the CCE from its customer risk assessment records?
options: How it assesses the customer's ML/TF risks, and that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on those risks
That senior management has approved the customer risk assessment, and that a copy has been provided to the CCE when required
How the risk assessment differentiates between individual customers, and how CDD measures are simplified for lower-risk relationships, reported to the CCE quarterly
When the institution's last risk assessment was reviewed, and which trigger events under paragraph 2.9 prompted that review
en.explain: ¶2.16 requires an MSO to keep records of its customer risk assessments so it can demonstrate to the CCE, among others: (a) how it assesses the customer's ML/TF risks; and (b) that the extent of CDD measures and ongoing monitoring is appropriate based on those risks. Senior management approval and CCE provision (¶2.3(c) and (e)), simplifying measures for lower risk (¶2.13), and the institutional review's trigger events (¶2.9) are real but different requirements found elsewhere in the Guideline.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須能從其客戶風險評估紀錄向海關關長證明哪兩項？
options: 其如何評估客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險；以及盡職審查措施及持續監察程度是否與該風險相稱
高級管理層已批准該客戶風險評估，並在海關關長有要求時已向其提供評估的副本
該客戶風險評估如何區分不同客戶的風險，以及較低風險的業務關係如何簡化盡職審查措施
該機構的機構層面風險評估上次於何時檢視，以及第2.9段下促使該次檢視的觸發事件為何，並須每季申報
tc.explain: 第2.16段規定金錢服務經營者須備存其客戶風險評估的紀錄，以便向海關關長證明（其中包括）：其如何評估該客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險；以及客戶盡職審查措施及持續監察的程度按該客戶的風險而言是否屬適當。高級管理層批准及向海關關長提供評估（第2.3(c)、(e)段）、就較低風險簡化措施（第2.13段），以及機構層面檢視的觸發事件（第2.9段），均為本指引下真實但不同的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.13段註腳5

en.q: Does a risk-based approach permit an MSO to omit CDD measures for low-risk customers?
options: No — except for certain situations specified in Chapter 4, all CDD measures must always be applied
Yes — CDD may be omitted for any customer that the MSO's own risk assessment rates as low risk
Yes, provided the MSO's senior management approves the omission in writing beforehand
Yes, for any occasional transaction below the $8,000 wire transfer threshold
en.explain: Footnote 5 to ¶2.13 states that, except for certain situations specified in Chapter 4, an MSO should always apply all the CDD measures set out in paragraph 4.1.3 and conduct ongoing monitoring of its customers. The RBA calibrates the extent of measures according to risk — it does not let low risk, a senior management sign-off, or a small transaction size excuse an MSO from CDD altogether.

tc.q: 風險為本方式是否准許金錢服務經營者就低風險客戶省略客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 否——除第4章指明的情況外，所有盡職審查措施必須一律採取
可以——只要屬該經營者評為低風險的客戶，可省略盡職審查
可以，只要該經營者的高級管理層已以書面批准該項省略
可以，只要屬低於8,000元的非經常交易
tc.explain: 第2.13段註腳5訂明，除第4章指明的若干情況外，金錢服務經營者應一律採取第4.1.3段所列的所有客戶盡職審查措施，並對其客戶進行持續監察。風險為本方式按風險調校措施的程度——不會因低風險、高級管理層批准或交易金額細小而容許完全不採取客戶盡職審查。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4段註腳2

en.q: Which FATF publication does the Guideline suggest MSOs may reference for risk indicators?
options: Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Money or Value Transfer Services (FATF, Feb 2016)
The FATF Recommendations — International Standards on Combating ML/TF, 2012 as revised
The FATF paper on Trade-Based Money Laundering: Risk Indicators, issued in 2021
The FATF Mutual Evaluation Report on Hong Kong's AML/CFT regime
en.explain: Footnote 2 to ¶2.4 identifies the February 2016 FATF paper Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach for Money or Value Transfer Services as the reference for the risk indicators in paragraphs 2.4 and 2.15. The FATF Recommendations, the trade-based ML paper, and Hong Kong's mutual evaluation report are all genuine FATF-related documents, but none is the one footnote 2 points MSOs to.

tc.q: 本指引建議金錢服務經營者可參考財務行動特別組織的哪一份刊物以了解風險指標？
options: 財務行動特別組織於2016年2月發出的《金錢或價值轉移服務風險為本方式指引》
財務行動特別組織建議——《打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集國際標準》，2012年
財務行動特別組織於2021年發出的《以貿易進行洗錢活動：風險指標》文件
財務行動特別組織就香港打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的相互評估報告
tc.explain: 第2.4段註腳2指明財務行動特別組織於2016年2月發出的《金錢或價值轉移服務風險為本方式指引》，為第2.4及2.15段所述風險指標的參考文件。財務行動特別組織建議、貿易洗錢文件及香港相互評估報告均為真實存在的相關文件，但均非註腳2所指向的文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.1段

en.q: How does ¶3.1 link the statutory duty in section 23 of Schedule 2 to the risk-based approach?
options: To comply with the section 23 duty, the MSO should implement internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA
Section 23 displaces the RBA whenever internal AML/CFT Systems and the statutory duty conflict with each other
The RBA only becomes relevant once the MSO has already fully complied with section 23
Section 23 of Schedule 2 applies only to MSOs that have chosen to adopt an RBA
en.explain: ¶3.1 states that an MSO must take all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards exist to mitigate ML/TF risks and to prevent a contravention of any requirement under Part 2 or 3 of Schedule 2, and that to ensure compliance with this requirement the MSO should implement appropriate internal AML/CFT Systems following the RBA in ¶2.1. Section 23 and the RBA operate together — neither displaces, postpones, nor is conditional on the other in the way the distractors describe.

tc.q: 第3.1段如何將附表2第23條的法定責任與風險為本方式連繫起來？
options: 為遵從第23條的責任，該經營者應按風險為本方式實施內部打擊洗錢系統
每當內部系統與第23條的法定責任有所衝突，第23條即凌駕風險為本方式
風險為本方式只在該經營者已完全遵從第23條的規定後，方屬適用
附表2第23條只適用於已選擇採用風險為本方式的經營者
tc.explain: 第3.1段訂明金錢服務經營者必須採取一切合理措施，確保設有適當防護措施以減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險並防止違反附表2第2或3部下的任何規定；為確保遵從此項規定，該經營者應按第2.1段所述的風險為本方式，實施適當的內部打擊洗錢系統。第23條與風險為本方式是相輔相成的，並非如各干擾項所述般互相凌駕、延後適用或互為條件。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 1
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第1項

en.q: Which strategic approach must the policy's introduction state that the applicant adopts?
options: A risk-based approach to designing and implementing AML/CFT policies, to manage and mitigate ML/TF risks
A zero-tolerance approach that excludes all customers assessed as higher risk
A rules-based approach that applies identical CDD measures to every customer irrespective of risk
An approach determined afresh each year by the applicant's external auditor
en.explain: Item 1 of the AML/CFT Policy submission guidelines requires the introduction to state that the applicant adopts a risk-based approach — not a zero-tolerance or rules-based approach — in the design and implementation of the AML/CFT policies with a view to managing and mitigating ML/TF risks, alongside the section 23 and section 19(3) duties and the appointment of a qualified CO and MLRO. The RBA is set by the applicant's own risk assessment, not redetermined annually by an external auditor.

tc.q: 政策引言須訂明申請人採取哪一種策略取態？
options: 在設計及實施政策時採用風險為本方式，以管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
零容忍取態，一律將所有被評為較高風險的客戶排除在該經營者的業務之外
規則為本取態，不論風險狀況如何，對每名客戶採取相同的盡職審查措施
由申請人的外聘核數師每年重新釐定的取態
tc.explain: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第1項規定引言須訂明申請人在設計及實施打擊洗錢政策時採用風險為本方式（並非零容忍或規則為本取態），以管理及減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險；並須連同第23條及第19(3)條的責任，以及委任合資格合規主任及洗錢報告主任等事項一併載明。風險為本方式是按申請人本身的風險評估釐定，並非由外聘核數師每年重新釐定。

source.en: Guidelines for Submission of AML/CFT Policy (Ver 12/2019), item 15
source.tc: 《遞交打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集政策的指引》（12/2019版）第15項

en.q: Through what means may the AML/CFT audit arrangement described in the policy be discharged?
options: Through an internal or external audit arrangement, with relevant policy and procedures
Through the compliance department's management oversight, under the compliance function alone
Through the money laundering reporting officer's suspicious transaction reporting line
Through the applicant's staff training programme on AML/CFT duties
en.explain: Item 15 of the AML/CFT Policy submission guidelines requires the applicant to elaborate its AML/CFT audit function to ensure its systems and programmes are commensurate with the up-to-date business risk profile, giving as an example an internal or external audit function with relevant policy and procedures. Items 13, 14 and 16 of the same guidelines cover the separate compliance function, STR reporting line, and training programme — real parts of the policy, but not how the audit function itself is discharged.

tc.q: 政策所述的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審核安排，可透過甚麼方式履行？
options: 透過內部或外部審核安排履行，並配以相關政策及程序
透過合規部門在合規職能下的持續管理層監督（僅此而已）履行
透過洗錢報告主任的可疑交易舉報流程履行
透過申請人職員的打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集培訓計劃履行
tc.explain: 《遞交打擊洗錢政策的指引》第15項規定申請人須詳述其打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集審核職能，以確保其系統及計劃與最新業務風險狀況相稱，並以內部或外部審核安排及相關政策及程序為例。同一指引第13、14及16項分別涵蓋獨立的合規職能、可疑交易舉報流程及培訓計劃——同屬政策的真實部分，但並非審核職能本身的履行方式。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.9(b)段

en.q: What does the CO's oversight of all aspects of the AML/CFT Systems include?
options: Monitoring effectiveness and enhancing controls and procedures where necessary
Communicating key AML/CFT issues, including compliance deficiencies, to senior management
Ensuring AML/CFT staff training is adequate, appropriate and effective
Developing and continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, including group-wide systems
en.explain: ¶3.9(b) makes the CO responsible for overseeing all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, which include monitoring effectiveness and enhancing the controls and procedures where necessary. Communicating issues to senior management is ¶3.9(c), staff training is ¶3.9(d), and developing/reviewing the Systems is ¶3.9(a) — the CO's other, separate functions under ¶3.9.

tc.q: 合規主任監督打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度各方面的職責包括甚麼？
options: 監察成效，並在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序
與高級管理層溝通打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的主要問題，包括合規不足情況
確保打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面的職員培訓充足、適當及有效
制訂及持續覆核該經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，包括集團層面制度
tc.explain: 第3.9(b)段訂明合規主任須負責全方位監督該經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，包括監察成效及在有需要時執行更嚴格的管控及程序。與高級管理層溝通（第3.9(c)段）、職員培訓（第3.9(d)段）及制訂／覆核制度（第3.9(a)段）則是合規主任在第3.9段下的其他職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.10(a)及(b)段

en.q: Which two record-related functions does the MLRO have oversight of?
options: Review of internal disclosures and exception reports, and keeping records of those internal reviews
Maintenance of customer identification records and transaction records under Schedule 2's record-keeping requirements
Carrying out the independent audit of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems and reporting to senior management
Ensuring the CO and MLRO functions are equipped with sufficient staff and resources, including cover for their absence
en.explain: ¶3.10 gives the MLRO oversight of (a) review of internal disclosures and exception reports (and deciding whether a report to the JFIU is needed) and (b) keeping records of those internal reviews. Maintaining customer/transaction records is a general AMLO record-keeping duty, the independent audit of the AML/CFT Systems is a separate function under ¶3.11, and ensuring adequate CO/MLRO staffing and cover for absence is a senior-management duty under ¶3.8(h).

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任監督哪兩項與紀錄有關的職能？
options: 覆核內部披露及例外情況報告，並備存該等內部覆核的紀錄
根據附表2的備存紀錄規定，備存客戶身分識別紀錄及交易紀錄
對該經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度進行獨立審核，直接向高級管理層匯報
確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任職能配備充足的職員及資源，包括他們缺勤時的替補人選
tc.explain: 第3.10段訂明洗錢報告主任監督：(a)覆核內部披露及例外情況報告（並決定是否須向財富情報組作出報告）；及(b)備存該等內部覆核的所有紀錄。備存客戶身分識別及交易紀錄屬《打擊洗錢條例》下的一般備存紀錄責任；對打擊洗錢制度進行獨立審核屬第3.11段下的獨立審核職能；確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任職能配備充足職員及缺勤替補則屬第3.8(h)段高級管理層的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.8(a)及(f)段

en.q: What does the Guideline require of the CO's and MLRO's knowledge?
options: Appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge, and conversant with the MSO's requirements and ML/TF risks
They must, as the MSO's proprietor, partner or director, personally pass the Competence Assessment
Capable of accessing all available information on a timely basis, and equipped with sufficient staff and cover for absence
Normally based in Hong Kong, of sufficient seniority and authority, and in regular contact with senior management
en.explain: ¶3.8(a) requires the CO and MLRO to be appropriately qualified with sufficient AML/CFT knowledge, and ¶3.8(f) requires them to be conversant with the MSO's statutory/regulatory requirements and the ML/TF risks arising from its business. The Competence Assessment is a personal requirement of the sole proprietor, partners and directors under Licensing Guide ¶4.15(b), not of the CO/MLRO as such. Timely access to information and adequate staff/cover (¶3.8(g)-(h)) and being Hong Kong-based with seniority and access to senior management (¶3.8(c)-(e)) are separate requirements under ¶3.8.

tc.q: 本指引就合規主任及洗錢報告主任的知識有何要求？
options: 擁有合適資格及具備打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識，並熟悉法定監管規定及風險
他們必須以經營者東主、合夥人或董事身分，親自通過關長就經營者的整體風險認知而進行的能力評核
能及時取得內部及外部一切可得資料，並配備充足職員及合規主任、洗錢報告主任缺勤時的適當替補人選
通常長駐香港，具一定資歷及權力，並與高級管理層保持定期聯絡，於有需要時可直接聯絡高級管理層
tc.explain: 第3.8(a)段規定合規主任及洗錢報告主任須擁有合適資格及具備充足的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集知識；第3.8(f)段則規定他們須熟悉該經營者的法定及監管規定，以及其業務所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。能力評核屬《發牌指南》第4.15(b)段對經營者東主、合夥人及董事的個人規定，並非合規主任／洗錢報告主任本身的規定。及時取得資料及充足資源／替補（第3.8(g)-(h)段）與長駐香港、具資歷權力及可聯絡高級管理層（第3.8(c)-(e)段）則屬第3.8段下的其他規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)條；《打擊洗錢指引》第3.16段

en.q: How do section 22(1) of Schedule 2 and ¶3.16 of the Guideline align on overseas operations?
options: Both require overseas branches/subsidiaries to match Schedule 2 Parts 2 and 3, where local law permits
Section 22(1) applies to branches only; the Guideline extends the same duty to subsidiaries only
Both require procedures matching Schedule 2 Part 2 only; Part 3 record-keeping is not covered
The Guideline's provision imposes a considerably stricter standard than section 22(1) and displaces it entirely
en.explain: AMLO Sch. 2 s.22(1) and ¶3.16 of the Guideline (not ¶3.15, which only states the general group-wide AML/CFT Systems obligation) impose the same duty: a Hong Kong-incorporated MSO must ensure its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings carrying on the same business have procedures to comply, to the extent local law permits, with requirements similar to Parts 2 and 3 of Schedule 2 (CDD and record-keeping). The duty covers both branches and subsidiaries together, covers both Parts 2 and 3, and the Guideline provision implements rather than displaces the statutory duty.

tc.q: 附表2第22(1)條與本指引第3.16段就境外業務如何相互配合？
options: 兩者規定境外分支及附屬企業須設有符合附表2第2、3部的程序，以當地法律准許為限
第22(1)條只適用於分支機構；本指引則只將同一責任擴展至附屬企業
兩者均只規定設有符合附表2第2部的程序，並不涵蓋第3部的備存紀錄規定，範圍較窄
本指引的條文施加比第22(1)條更嚴格的標準，並完全取代該條文
tc.explain: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22(1)條與本指引第3.16段（而非第3.15段——該段只訂明推行集團層面打擊洗錢制度的一般責任）訂明同一責任：在香港註冊成立的金錢服務經營者須確保其經營相同業務的境外分支機構及附屬企業，在當地法律准許範圍內設有程序以遵從與附表2第2及3部（盡職審查及備存紀錄）類似的規定。該責任同時涵蓋分支機構及附屬企業，也同時涵蓋第2及3部，而本指引條文是落實而非取代該法定責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.9段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of a trigger event requiring a review of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: The acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels
The MSO's licence renewal, with no change to its business
The retirement of a senior staff member after long service
A routine internal compliance check that finds no issues
en.explain: ¶2.9 states that trigger events may include a significant breach of the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, the acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels, the launch of new products and services, or any significant changes of the MSO's operational processes, target customers and business counterparts. Licence renewal with no business change, ordinary staff retirement, and a clean compliance check are not listed trigger events.

tc.q: 下列何者獲舉為須檢視機構層面洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估的觸發事件例子？
options: 取得新客戶分部或新交付渠道
該經營者例行續領牌照，業務並無變動
一名長期服務的資深員工退休
例行內部合規檢查，並無發現問題
tc.explain: 第2.9段訂明觸發事件可包括該經營者打擊洗錢制度的重大違規、取得新客戶分部或新交付渠道、推出新產品及服務，或營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手出現重大變動。並無業務變動的續領牌照、常規員工退休及未發現問題的合規檢查，均非第2.9段所列的觸發事件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.4(a)段

en.q: Which two customer risk factors are given as examples in the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: The MSO's target market and customer segments, and the proportion of high-risk customers
The countries or jurisdictions the MSO is exposed to, especially those with greater ML/TF vulnerability
The nature, scale, diversity and complexity of the MSO's business, and its products' vulnerability to ML/TF abuse
The distribution channels through which the MSO distributes its products, including reliance on third parties
en.explain: ¶2.4(a) gives as examples of customer risk factors the MSO's target market and customer segments, and the number/proportion of customers identified as high risk. Country risk factors (¶2.4(b)), product/service/transaction risk factors (¶2.4(c)), and delivery/distribution channel risk factors (¶2.4(d)) are separate categories under the same paragraph.

tc.q: 機構層面風險評估就客戶風險因素舉出哪兩個例子？
options: 該經營者的目標市場及客戶類別，以及高風險客戶的比例
該經營者所面對的國家或司法管轄區，尤其是洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集漏洞較大者
該經營者業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以及產品的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
該經營者藉以分銷其產品的分銷渠道，包括依賴第三者的程度
tc.explain: 第2.4(a)段就客戶風險因素舉出的例子為：該經營者的目標市場及客戶類別，以及被識別為高風險的客戶數目及比例。國家風險因素（第2.4(b)段）、產品、服務或交易風險因素（第2.4(c)段）及交付或分銷渠道風險因素（第2.4(d)段）則是同一段下的其他類別。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第2.3(b)及(d)段

en.q: Which two further steps does ¶2.3 require in conducting the institutional ML/TF risk assessment?
options: Considering all risk factors before setting the risk level and mitigation, and keeping the assessment current
Documenting the process using only quantitative analysis, and obtaining the CCE's prior approval of the results
Benchmarking the assessment against guidance issued by industry competitors, rather than the FATF or government sources
Having mechanisms to provide the risk assessment to the JFIU, rather than the CCE, when required
en.explain: ¶2.3 lists the appropriate steps as: (a) documenting the process, supported by both qualitative and quantitative analysis (not quantitative alone); (b) considering all relevant risk factors before determining the overall risk level and mitigation; (c) obtaining senior management's — not the CCE's — approval of the results; (d) having a process to keep the assessment up-to-date; and (e) having mechanisms to provide the assessment to the CCE — not the JFIU — when required. The key combines steps (b) and (d).

tc.q: 第2.3段就進行機構層面風險評估，還要求哪兩項步驟？
options: 在釐定整體風險水平及緩減措施前考慮所有風險因素，並使評估保持最新
只利用定量分析記錄評估過程，並須取得關長對評估結果的事先批准
以業界競爭對手發出的指引作為基準，而非參考特別組織或政府機構的資料
設有機制在有需要時向財富情報組（而非關長）提供風險評估
tc.explain: 第2.3段列出的適當步驟包括：(a)以文件記錄評估過程，並輔以定質與定量分析（並非只用定量分析）；(b)在釐定整體風險水平及緩減措施前考慮所有相關風險因素；(c)取得高級管理層（而非關長）對評估結果的批准；(d)設有程序使評估保持最新；及(e)設有適當機制在關長（而非財富情報組）要求時提供評估。答案結合(b)及(d)兩項步驟。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.6段

en.q: Which bodies within an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks and ensure they are adequately managed?
options: The board of directors or its delegated committee, and senior management
The compliance officer alone, without informing the board or senior management
The independent audit function alone, as part of its periodic review
Every member of staff individually, regardless of seniority or role
en.explain: ¶3.6 states that the board of directors or its delegated committee (where applicable), and senior management, should have a clear understanding of the MSO's ML/TF risks and ensure they are adequately managed — not the compliance officer alone, the independent audit function alone (¶3.11-3.13), or all staff individually.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者內哪些機構應清楚了解其洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險並確保該等風險獲充分管理？
options: 董事會或其獲授權委員會，以及高級管理層
只限合規主任，毋須知會董事會或高級管理層
只限獨立審核職能，作為其定期覆核的一部分
每名員工個別負責，不論其資歷或職級
tc.explain: 第3.6段訂明該經營者的董事會或其獲授權委員會（如適用），以及高級管理層，應清楚了解其洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險並確保該等風險獲充分管理——並非只限合規主任、只限獨立審核職能（第3.11至3.13段），或由每名員工個別負責。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.1.3; s.2(1), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.1.3段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)條

en.q: Which of the following correctly lists the four CDD measures applicable to an MSO?
options: Identify/verify the customer; identify/verify beneficial owners; obtain the relationship's purpose; identify/verify anyone acting for the customer
Verify the customer's income and employment; check the customer's credit record and bank references; obtain two personal referees; conduct a home visit
Photograph the customer at the counter; record full details of the transaction; issue a numbered receipt; report the transaction to the CCE
Screen the customer against sanctions and PEP lists; file a suspicious transaction report; keep the records for five years; train frontline staff annually
en.explain: ¶4.1.3 (s.2(1) Sch. 2) lists the four CDD measures as: (a) identify and verify the customer; (b) identify and take reasonable measures to verify any beneficial owner; (c) obtain information on the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship (unless obvious); and (d) identify and verify any person purporting to act on behalf of the customer, and verify that person's authority.

tc.q: 下列哪項正確列出適用於金錢服務經營者的四項客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 識別及核實客戶身分；識別及核實實益擁有人；了解業務關係的目的；識別及核實代表客戶行事的人
核實客戶入息及職業；查閱客戶信貸紀錄及銀行往來紀錄；索取兩名個人諮詢人；進行家訪
在櫃檯為客戶拍照；詳細記錄交易資料；發出編號收據；向海關關長報告該筆交易
對客戶進行制裁及政治人物名單篩查；提交可疑交易報告；備存紀錄五年；每年培訓前線職員
tc.explain: 第4.1.3段（附表2第2(1)條）列出四項盡職審查措施：(a)識別及核實客戶身分；(b)識別實益擁有人並採取合理措施核實其身分；(c)了解業務關係的目的及擬具有的性質（明顯者除外）；及(d)識別及核實看似代表客戶行事的人的身分，並核實其權限。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.2.1; s.3, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.2.1段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3條

en.q: Before carrying out an occasional transaction for a customer, at what amounts must an MSO carry out CDD measures?
options: $120,000 for general transactions; $8,000 for wire or virtual asset transfers
$8,000 or above for all types of transactions, whether single or linked operations
$120,000 or above for all types of transactions, including wire transfers below $8,000
$500,000 or above for general transactions; $120,000 or above for wire transfers
en.explain: CDD must be carried out before an occasional transaction of $120,000 or above (or foreign-currency equivalent), or a wire transfer / virtual asset transfer of $8,000 or above — whether in a single operation or several operations that appear linked (¶4.2.1(b)).

tc.q: 在為客戶進行非經常交易前，涉及金額達到多少時金錢服務經營者必須執行客戶盡職審查措施？
options: 一般交易達120,000元；電傳轉帳或虛擬資產轉移達8,000元
所有類別交易達8,000元或以上，不論以單一或有關連的操作進行
所有類別交易達120,000元或以上，包括低於8,000元的電傳轉帳
一般交易達500,000元或以上；電傳轉帳達120,000元或以上
tc.explain: 第4.2.1(b)段規定在進行非經常交易前，一般交易達120,000元或以上（或等值外幣），或電傳轉帳／虛擬資產轉移達8,000元或以上時，即須執行盡職審查——不論以單一或多項看來有關連的操作進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.2.1(c)至(d)段

en.q: A customer asks an MSO to remit $5,000 by wire transfer — below the CDD threshold. The MSO suspects the customer is involved in money laundering. Must CDD be carried out?
options: Yes — CDD is required whenever ML/TF is suspected, whatever the transaction amount
No — the $8,000 wire-transfer threshold in ¶4.2.1(b)(ii) has not been reached
No — CDD under ¶4.2.1 only applies to customers with an established business relationship
Only if the customer is also identified as a politically exposed person
en.explain: CDD must be carried out whenever the MSO suspects the customer or the customer's account is involved in ML/TF — this applies irrespective of the $120,000/$8,000 occasional-transaction thresholds (¶4.2.1(c)) and irrespective of whether a business relationship has been established. PEP status under ¶4.9 is a separate, additional trigger, not a precondition for this one.

tc.q: 客戶要求金錢服務經營者以電傳轉帳匯出5,000元（低於盡職審查門檻），但經營者懷疑該客戶涉及洗錢。是否須執行客戶盡職審查？
options: 須要——凡懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，不論交易金額多少均須執行盡職審查
不須——尚未達到第4.2.1(b)(ii)段所訂明的8,000元電傳轉帳門檻
不須——第4.2.1段的盡職審查僅適用於已建立業務關係的客戶
只有在該客戶同時被識別為政治人物的情況下，才須執行盡職審查
tc.explain: 當金錢服務經營者懷疑客戶或客戶的帳戶涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集時，即須執行盡職審查——不論120,000元／8,000元的非經常交易門檻（第4.2.1(c)段），也不論是否已建立業務關係。第4.9段的政治人物身分是另一項獨立的額外觸發條件，並非本項規定的前提。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.2段

en.q: For a customer who is a natural person, an MSO should obtain at least which identification information?
options: Full name; date of birth; nationality; and a unique identification number with document type
Full name; residential address; date of birth; and the customer's stated occupation or profession
Full name; telephone number; email address; and monthly income or salary range
Full name; educational background; employer's name; and current marital status
en.explain: ¶4.3.2 requires at least (a) full name, (b) date of birth, (c) nationality, and (d) a unique identification number and document type. Residential address is a separate requirement under ¶4.3.5, not part of this minimum set, and occupation, contact details, income, education and marital status are not identification information under ¶4.3.2 at all.

tc.q: 對於屬自然人的客戶，金錢服務經營者最少應取得哪些識別資料？
options: 全名；出生日期；國籍；及獨有識別號碼連文件類別
全名；住址資料；出生日期；及客戶所申報的職業或專業
全名；電話號碼；電郵地址；及每月入息或薪金範圍
全名；學歷；僱主名稱；及現時的婚姻狀況
tc.explain: 第4.3.2段：最少應取得(a)全名、(b)出生日期、(c)國籍及(d)獨有識別號碼連文件類別。住址資料是第4.3.5段另訂的規定，並非此最低識別資料的一部分；職業、聯絡方式、入息、學歷及婚姻狀況均非第4.3.2段所指的識別資料。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.4.6; s.1, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.6段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條

en.q: Under the AMLO, a beneficial owner of a corporation includes an individual who owns or controls, directly or indirectly, more than what percentage of the corporation's issued share capital?
options: 10% (voting)
en.explain: A beneficial owner of a corporation includes an individual who owns or controls (directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding) more than 25% of the issued share capital, or more than 25% of the voting rights, or who exercises ultimate control over the management (¶4.4.6).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，法團的實益擁有人包括直接或間接擁有或控制該法團已發行股本超過百分之多少的個人？
options: 10%的投票權
tc.explain: 法團的實益擁有人包括直接或間接（包括透過信託或持票人股份持有）擁有或控制已發行股本超過25%、或有權行使或控制行使股東大會超過25%表決權，或對法團管理層行使最終控制權的個人（第4.4.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.9段

en.q: A corporate customer's shares are dispersed such that no natural person meets the definition of a beneficial owner. What should the MSO do?
options: Identify the natural persons who hold the position of senior managing official and verify their identities
Treat the company as having no beneficial owner at all, and skip the identification measure entirely
Refuse outright to establish the business relationship with the company
Report the company to the JFIU as a suspicious transaction, without any further identification steps
en.explain: ¶4.4.9: where no natural person falls within the beneficial owner definition, the MSO should identify the relevant natural persons holding the position of senior managing official and take reasonable measures to verify their identities. Dispersed ownership is not a basis to skip the measure entirely, refuse the relationship outright, or jump straight to an STR.

tc.q: 某法團客戶股權分散，沒有自然人符合實益擁有人的定義。金錢服務經營者應怎樣做？
options: 識別擔任高級管理人員職位的相關自然人，並核實其身分
視該公司為完全沒有實益擁有人，並完全略過識別措施
直接拒絕與該公司建立任何業務關係
將該公司舉報予聯合財富情報組，不採取任何識別步驟
tc.explain: 第4.4.9段：如沒有自然人符合實益擁有人定義，金錢服務經營者應識別擔任高級管理人員職位的相關自然人，並採取合理措施核實他們的身分。股權分散並非完全略過此措施、直接拒絕建立關係或逕行作出可疑交易報告的理由。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.4.10; s.1, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.10段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條

en.q: In relation to a trust, the AMLO's definition of beneficial owner includes all of the following EXCEPT:
options: The trust's external auditor
The settlor of the trust
The trustee of the trust
A protector or enforcer of the trust
