en.explain: ¶4.4.10: beneficial owners of a trust are (a) beneficiaries or a class of beneficiaries with a vested interest, (b) the settlor, (c) the trustee, (d) a protector or enforcer, and (e) any individual with ultimate control over the trust. An external auditor is not a beneficial owner.

tc.q: 就信託而言，《打擊洗錢條例》的實益擁有人定義包括下列各項，但不包括：
options: 信託的外聘核數師
信託的財產授予人
信託的受託人
信託的保護人或執行人
tc.explain: 第4.4.10段：信託的實益擁有人為(a)對信託財產享有既得權益的受益人或某類受益人；(b)財產授予人；(c)受託人；(d)保護人或執行人；及(e)對信託有最終控制權的個人。外聘核數師並非實益擁有人。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.7.1; s.3(2)-(3), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.1段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(2)至(3)條

en.q: When may an MSO exceptionally verify a customer's identity AFTER establishing the business relationship?
options: Only if delayed-verification risk is effectively managed, interruption is necessary to avoid, and verification finishes as soon as practicable
Whenever the customer merely promises in writing to provide the outstanding documents within the next thirty days, regardless of the ML/TF risk involved
Whenever the transaction amount is below the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold and the customer is not a suspected PEP
Never — verification must always be fully completed before or during establishment of the business relationship, without exception
en.explain: ¶4.7.1: verification should occur before or during establishment of the relationship, but may exceptionally be completed after, only if all three conditions are met together: (a) risk from delayed verification can be effectively managed; (b) it is necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business; and (c) verification is completed as soon as reasonably practicable. A customer's own promise, a transaction-size cut-off, and a flat 'never' each substitute a different, easier test for the real three-part one.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在何種情況下可例外地在建立業務關係後才核實客戶身分？
options: 僅當延遲核實的風險能有效管理、須避免干擾業務進行，且盡快完成核實
只要客戶書面承諾在三十日內補交所欠文件，不論所涉洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險為何
只要交易金額低於120,000元的非經常交易門檻，且客戶並非懷疑的政治人物
任何情況下都不可以——必須在建立業務關係之前或期間完全完成身分核實，沒有例外
tc.explain: 第4.7.1段：核實身分應在建立業務關係之前或期間進行；只有同時符合三項條件方可例外延後：(a)延遲核實所產生的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險能有效管理；(b)有必要不干擾與客戶業務的正常進行；及(c)在合理切實可行範圍內盡快完成核實。客戶的書面承諾、交易金額門檻或一律不可的講法，均以另一項較寬鬆的測試取代真正的三部分測試。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.13.1; s.3(1) & (4), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.13.1段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)及(4)條

en.q: An MSO is unable to satisfactorily complete the required CDD measures for a prospective customer. What must it do?
options: Not establish the relationship or transaction, and consider an STR to the JFIU
Proceed with the transaction, but impose a reduced transaction limit until CDD can be completed later
Establish the relationship on a probationary basis for three months, subject to later CDD
Charge the customer a higher fee to compensate for the additional, unverified risk
en.explain: ¶4.13.1: where CDD cannot be satisfactorily completed, the MSO must not establish the business relationship or carry out the occasional transaction (or must terminate an existing relationship as soon as reasonably practicable), and should make an STR to the JFIU where there is relevant knowledge or suspicion. Proceeding on a limit, a trial period, or a risk premium are not permitted substitutes for that duty.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者未能圓滿完成對準客戶所需的盡職審查措施。它必須怎樣做？
options: 不得建立業務關係或進行交易，並考慮作出可疑交易報告
照常進行交易，但設定較低的交易限額，待日後完成盡職審查
以三個月觀察期形式建立關係，並待日後補做盡職審查
向客戶收取較高費用，以抵銷未經核實所帶來的額外風險
tc.explain: 第4.13.1段：如未能圓滿完成盡職審查，金錢服務經營者不得與該客戶建立業務關係或進行非經常交易（如屬現有關係，須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止），並在有相關知悉或懷疑時向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。設定限額、觀察期或收取較高費用均非此項責任的合法替代做法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.3及4.8.6段

en.q: Which statement about simplified due diligence (SDD) is CORRECT?
options: SDD must stop where the MSO suspects ML/TF, and monitoring of the relationship continues while SDD applies
Once SDD applies, the MSO need not conduct ongoing CDD or transaction monitoring under Schedule 2
SDD may continue after the MSO suspects ML/TF, provided the customer is reviewed on an annual basis, per senior management
SDD exempts the MSO from all CDD and record-keeping duties once a customer is assessed as low risk
en.explain: SDD must stop being applied where the MSO's risk assessment changes, it suspects ML/TF, or it doubts previously obtained information (¶4.8.3). Even while SDD applies, the MSO must still continuously monitor the relationship under s.5 of Schedule 2 (¶4.8.6) — an annual review does not excuse a live ML/TF suspicion, and a low-risk assessment under ¶4.8.2 triggers SDD, it never removes CDD or record-keeping duties entirely.

tc.q: 關於簡化盡職審查，下列哪項正確？
options: 如懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，須停止採用簡化盡職審查；即使已採用，仍須持續監察業務關係
一經採用簡化盡職審查，經營者便無須按附表2進行持續盡職審查或交易監察
即使懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，只要每年為客戶進行覆核，仍可繼續採用簡化盡職審查，並知會高層
簡化盡職審查一經評為低風險客戶，便可豁免所有盡職審查及備存紀錄責任
tc.explain: 如經營者的風險評估改變、懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，或對先前取得的資料有疑問，須停止採用簡化盡職審查（第4.8.3段）。即使採用簡化措施，仍須按附表2第5條持續監察業務關係（第4.8.6段）——每年覆核並不能免除對現行洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集懷疑的處理；而低風險評估（第4.8.2段）只是採用簡化盡職審查的觸發條件，並非可完全豁免盡職審查或備存紀錄責任。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.9.1, ¶4.9.3; s.15, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.1及4.9.3段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第15條

en.q: Which statement about enhanced due diligence (EDD) is CORRECT?
options: EDD must be applied where a situation by its nature presents high ML/TF risk, or where the CCE specifies it in a written notice
EDD is required only once senior management has approved the business relationship; it is not required before that approval; reviewed twice yearly
EDD applies automatically once a customer's transactions exceed $120,000, regardless of the assessed risk
EDD is required only when the customer is identified as a Hong Kong PEP; other high-risk situations need no such measures
en.explain: ¶4.9.1: EDD must be applied in a situation that by its nature presents high ML/TF risk (having regard to the higher-risk factors in ¶4.9.5) or a situation the CCE specifies in a written notice — these are what trigger EDD. Senior management approval (¶4.9.3) is a separate, later requirement for establishing or continuing a high-risk relationship, not the trigger for applying EDD. $120,000 is the occasional-transaction threshold (¶4.2.1), not an EDD trigger, and Hong Kong PEP status (¶4.9.16-4.9.17) is only one example of a high-risk situation, not the only one.

tc.q: 關於更嚴格的盡職審查，下列哪項正確？
options: 在按性質屬高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的情況，或關長以書面通知指明的情況，須採取更嚴格的盡職審查
只有在高級管理層已批准業務關係後，才須採取更嚴格的盡職審查——批准之前無須採取
只要客戶的交易總額超過120,000元，不論風險評估結果如何，均須自動採取更嚴格的盡職審查，並須存檔記錄
只有在客戶被識別為香港政治人物時，才須對其採取更嚴格的盡職審查，其他高風險情況一概無須
tc.explain: 第4.9.1段：在按性質屬高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的情況（須考慮第4.9.5段所列的較高風險因素），或關長以書面通知指明的情況，均須採取更嚴格的盡職審查——觸發措施的是這些情況。高級管理層批准（第4.9.3段）是其後另一項規定，適用於建立或維持高風險業務關係，並非採取更嚴格盡職審查的觸發點。120,000元是非經常交易的門檻（第4.2.1段），並非其觸發點；而香港政治人物身分（第4.9.16至4.9.17段）只是高風險情況的其中一例，並非唯一情況。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.9.7; s.1, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.7段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條

en.q: Which of the following persons does NOT fall within the definition of a non-Hong Kong PEP?
options: A middle-ranking official of a government department outside Hong Kong
A head of state of a place outside Hong Kong
The spouse of a senior judicial official of a place outside Hong Kong
A close associate of a senior executive of a state-owned corporation outside Hong Kong
en.explain: A non-Hong Kong PEP covers individuals entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong (head of state, head of government, senior politician, senior government/judicial/military official, senior executive of a state-owned corporation, important political party official), their spouses, partners, children, parents and children's spouses/partners, and close associates — but expressly NOT middle-ranking or more junior officials (¶4.9.7).

tc.q: 下列哪類人不屬「非香港政治人物」的定義範圍？
options: 香港以外地方政府部門的中級官員
香港以外地方的國家元首
香港以外地方高級司法官員的配偶
香港以外地方國有企業高級行政人員的關係密切的人
tc.explain: 非香港政治人物涵蓋在香港以外地方擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人（國家元首、政府首長、資深從政者、高級政府／司法／軍事官員、國有企業高級行政人員及重要政黨幹事）、其配偶、伴侶、子女、父母及子女的配偶或伴侶，以及關係密切的人——但明文不包括中級或更低級官員（第4.9.7段）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.9.10; s.10, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.10段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10條

en.q: An MSO discovers a customer is a non-Hong Kong PEP. Before establishing or continuing the business relationship, which EDD measures must ALL be applied?
options: Senior management approval; reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds; and enhanced ongoing monitoring of the relationship
Senior management approval; screening the customer against sanctions lists; and filing a suspicious transaction report with the JFIU
Obtaining additional information on the customer's occupation; requiring the first payment through a bank account; and sanctions screening
Reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds; enhanced ongoing monitoring; and immediate termination of the relationship; reported to the CCE within 7 days
en.explain: ¶4.9.10: for a non-Hong Kong PEP (customer or beneficial owner), before establishing or continuing the relationship the MSO must apply ALL of: (a) senior management approval; (b) reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds; and (c) enhanced ongoing monitoring. Sanctions screening (¶6.16) and an STR to the JFIU are separate duties triggered by a list match or actual suspicion, not by PEP status alone; occupation checks and routing the first payment through a bank are general EDD examples (¶4.9.6) for high-risk relationships generally, not this specific list; and termination is not required merely because a customer is a PEP.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者發現某客戶屬非香港政治人物。在建立或維持業務關係前，必須執行哪些更嚴格的盡職審查措施（全部）？
options: 取得高級管理層批准；採取合理措施確立其財富來源及資金來源；並對該業務關係執行更嚴格的持續監察
取得高級管理層批准；將客戶與制裁名單進行篩查；並向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，並於七日內完成
取得客戶職業等額外資料；規定首筆付款須經銀行帳戶進行；並進行制裁名單篩查
採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源；執行更嚴格的持續監察；並立即終止業務關係
tc.explain: 第4.9.10段：就非香港政治人物（客戶或實益擁有人）而言，在建立或維持業務關係前，該經營者須執行全部三項措施：(a)取得高級管理層批准；(b)採取合理措施確立財富來源及資金來源；及(c)執行更嚴格的持續監察。制裁名單篩查（第6.16段）及向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，是由名單相符或實際懷疑等不同事實觸發的獨立責任，並非單憑政治人物身分即須履行；查核職業等資料或規定首筆付款經銀行進行，屬一般高風險關係的加強盡職審查例子（第4.9.6段），並非第4.9.10段訂明的特定清單；而僅因客戶屬政治人物，並不須終止業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.12段

en.q: How should an MSO handle a customer who is a FORMER non-Hong Kong PEP?
options: With senior management approval and a risk assessment confirming no continuing high ML/TF risk, the MSO may decide not to apply the PEP EDD measures
It must always apply the full PEP EDD measures for as long as the customer relationship lasts, even where a risk assessment shows no continuing high ML/TF risk
It may stop applying the PEP EDD measures once a fixed period has elapsed since the person left office, without needing any fresh risk assessment
It must terminate the business relationship, as it would for any customer where CDD cannot be completed
en.explain: ¶4.9.12: following an RBA, the MSO may decide not to apply the ¶4.9.10 EDD measures to a former non-Hong Kong PEP, but only with senior management approval and a risk assessment confirming the person no longer poses high ML/TF risk (considering remaining influence, seniority held, and links to current roles). Footnote 37 confirms this must rest on genuine risk assessment, never merely on a fixed time period having passed. Termination is instead the ¶4.13.1 consequence when CDD cannot be completed at all — it does not apply here, where risk has been properly reassessed.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應如何處理屬「前非香港政治人物」的客戶？
options: 經高級管理層批准，並經評估確認不再構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險後，可不採用政治人物更嚴格措施
必須終身對該客戶採用全套政治人物更嚴格盡職審查措施，即使風險評估顯示該人已不再構成持續的高風險
一旦該人卸任滿一段既定時間，即可停止採用政治人物更嚴格盡職審查措施，無須另作風險評估
必須終止業務關係，如同無法完成盡職審查的任何其他客戶一樣
tc.explain: 第4.9.12段：按風險為本方式，金錢服務經營者可決定不對前非香港政治人物採用第4.9.10段的更嚴格盡職審查措施，但須經高級管理層批准，並基於評估確認該人不再構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險（須考慮其仍可行使的影響力、曾任職位的資歷，以及與現時職能有否關連）。註腳37確認有關決定須基於真正的風險評估，不得僅以既定時限經過作準。終止業務關係則是第4.13.1段在無法完成盡職審查時的後果，並不適用於已妥為重新評估風險的情況。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.10.1–4.10.2; s.9, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.10.1至4.10.2段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9條

en.q: A customer establishes a business relationship over the internet and is never physically present for identification. What must the MSO do?
options: Carry out at least one additional measure to mitigate impersonation risk, unless identity was already verified via a CCE-recognised digital identification system
Refuse to establish the relationship, since the AMLO does not permit MSOs to establish business relationships with customers who are not physically present, under section 9
Apply simplified due diligence measures instead, on the basis that non-face-to-face customers are inherently low ML/TF risk
Obtain a selfie photo compared against the identification document, which by itself satisfies the CCE's digital identification system exception
en.explain: ¶4.10.1: except where ¶4.10.2 applies, an MSO must carry out at least one additional measure (e.g. further identity verification using new documents, supplementary measures to verify information already obtained, or ensuring the first payment runs through an account in the customer's own name) to mitigate impersonation risk. ¶4.10.1 confirms the AMLO permits non-face-to-face relationships, so refusal is wrong. Non-face-to-face is a higher, not lower, risk factor, so SDD is the wrong tool. The ¶4.10.2 exception requires a digital identification system recognised by the CCE as a reliable and independent source — an ad hoc selfie comparison does not by itself meet that bar.

tc.q: 某客戶透過互聯網建立業務關係，從未親身到場接受身分識別。金錢服務經營者必須怎樣做？
options: 執行最少一項額外措施以減低冒充風險，除非已透過關長認可的數碼識別系統核實身分
拒絕建立業務關係，因為條例並不容許經營者與未親身到場的客戶建立業務關係
改為採用簡化盡職審查，理由是非親身到場的客戶本質上洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險較低
只須取得與身分證明文件比對的自拍照，即已符合關長認可數碼識別系統的例外規定
tc.explain: 第4.10.1段：除第4.10.2段所述情況外，該經營者必須執行最少一項額外措施（例如以先前未用過的文件進一步核實身分、採取補充措施核實已取得的資料，或確保首筆付款經以客戶名義開立的帳戶進行），以減低冒充身分的風險。第4.10.1段訂明條例容許非親身到場的業務關係，故拒絕建立關係並不正確。非親身到場屬較高而非較低風險因素，故簡化盡職審查並非合適做法。第4.10.2段的例外情況須透過關長認可、屬可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統核實身分——單憑自拍照比對並不足以符合此例外規定。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.11.1; s.18, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.1段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第18條

en.q: An MSO relies on a law firm (a permitted intermediary) to perform CDD on a customer. Who bears the ultimate responsibility for ensuring the CDD requirements are met?
options: The MSO itself — responsibility for CDD requirements cannot be delegated to an intermediary
The law firm — once it agrees to act as intermediary, responsibility shifts to it, by written agreement
The customer — the customer bears responsibility for its own CDD compliance
The CCE — as regulator, the CCE bears responsibility for the MSO's CDD compliance
en.explain: ¶4.11.1 and s.18(2) of Schedule 2: an MSO may rely on an intermediary (e.g. a law firm) to perform CDD measures, but it 'remains liable under this Ordinance' for a failure to carry them out — the ultimate responsibility for meeting CDD requirements stays with the MSO and cannot shift to the intermediary. It is not the customer's own duty, and the CCE is the regulator that supervises compliance, not the party responsible for performing it.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者依賴一間律師行（獲准許的中介人）為客戶執行盡職審查。誰對確保符合盡職審查規定負上最終責任？
options: 金錢服務經營者本身——盡職審查的最終責任不可轉移予中介人
該律師行——一經同意擔任中介人，責任即轉移至該律師行
該客戶——客戶須為其本身的盡職審查合規負責
關長——身為規管機構，關長須為經營者的盡職審查合規負責，須審核
tc.explain: 第4.11.1段及附表2第18(2)條：金錢服務經營者可依賴中介人（例如律師行）執行盡職審查措施，但該經營者仍須「根據本條例就未能執行該項客戶盡職審查措施承擔法律責任」——確保符合盡職審查規定的最終責任仍在該經營者本身，不會轉移至中介人。這並非客戶本身的責任，而關長是負責監督合規的規管機構，並非負責執行的一方。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶4.14.1; s.16, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第16條

en.q: Which statement about anonymous accounts is CORRECT?
options: An MSO must not open or maintain any anonymous account or fictitious-name account
Anonymous accounts are allowed for cash transactions below the $8,000 threshold
Anonymous accounts are allowed for any customer if approved by senior management, per section 16(2)
Accounts in fictitious names are allowed for VIP customers who request privacy
en.explain: s.16 of Schedule 2 prohibits opening or maintaining anonymous accounts or accounts in fictitious names for any customer (¶4.14.1), with no threshold, senior-management-approval, or VIP exception. Confidential numbered accounts must not function as anonymous accounts either — identity must still be verified and subject to the same CDD and controls.

tc.q: 關於匿名戶口，下列哪項正確？
options: 金錢服務經營者不得開立或維持匿名戶口或虛構姓名戶口
現金交易金額低於8,000元門檻，可使用匿名戶口，經核准
任何客戶經高級管理層批准，均可開立匿名戶口
要求私隱的貴賓客戶，可以虛構姓名開立戶口
tc.explain: 附表2第16條禁止為任何客戶開立或維持匿名戶口或以虛構姓名開立的戶口（第4.14.1段），並無金額門檻、高級管理層批准或貴賓客戶的例外情況。保密編號戶口同樣不得作匿名戶口使用——仍須核實客戶身分，並受相同的盡職審查及管控措施規限。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶5.1, ¶5.3; s.5, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.1及5.3段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5條

en.q: Ongoing monitoring of a business relationship comprises which two aspects?
options: Ongoing CDD — keeping customer records up-to-date — and transaction monitoring — examining unusual transactions with no apparent purpose
Reviewing jurisdictional equivalence assessments on a regular basis, and maintaining an up-to-date sanctions and terrorist database, updated monthly
Conducting an annual independent audit of the AML/CFT systems, and giving staff regular AML/CFT training
Screening customers and their beneficial owners against sanctions lists, and updating the business risk assessment once a year
en.explain: ¶5.1: ongoing monitoring has two aspects — (a) ongoing CDD: reviewing customer documents, data and information from time to time to keep them up-to-date and relevant; and (b) transaction monitoring: scrutinising transactions for consistency with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, and examining complex, unusually large or unusual-pattern transactions with no apparent purpose. High-risk customers need at least an annual review (¶5.3). Jurisdictional equivalence review (¶4.16.3), the sanctions/terrorist database (¶6.13), independent audit and staff training, and sanctions screening (¶6.16) are all real MSO duties, but none of them is what 'ongoing monitoring' of a business relationship means.

tc.q: 對業務關係的持續監察包括哪兩方面？
options: 持續的盡職審查——確保客戶資料反映現況——及交易監察——審查無明顯目的異常交易
定期覆核司法管轄區等效評估，並維持最新的恐怖分子及受制裁者資料庫
每年為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集系統進行獨立審計，並定期為員工提供相關培訓，每月更新
將客戶及其實益擁有人與制裁名單進行篩查，並每年更新業務風險評估
tc.explain: 第5.1段：持續監察包括兩方面——(a)持續的盡職審查：不時覆核客戶的文件、數據及資料，確保其反映現況及切合需要；及(b)交易監察：審察交易是否與經營者對客戶的認識相符，並審查複雜、異常龐大或模式異常而無明顯目的的交易。高風險客戶最少須每年覆核一次（第5.3段）。司法管轄區等效評估的定期覆核（第4.16.3段）、制裁及恐怖分子資料庫（第6.13段）、獨立審計及員工培訓，以及制裁篩查（第6.16段），均是經營者的真實責任，但均不是「持續監察」業務關係的意思。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.14及6.16段

en.q: Which statement about an MSO's sanctions screening obligations is CORRECT?
options: Screen customers and beneficial owners at establishment and against new or updated designations, and screen all parties in a cross-border wire transfer before executing it
Screening is required only for customers the MSO has assessed as high risk; low-risk customers and their beneficial owners may be excluded from the checks
Names only need to be added to the screening database once Hong Kong legislation has formally implemented the relevant UN Security Council Resolution
Screening cross-border wire transfer parties after the transfer has already been executed is acceptable, provided any name matches are then reported to the JFIU within 24 hours of detection
en.explain: ¶6.16: the screening mechanism must cover (a) customers and beneficial owners at establishment, (b) new/updated designations as soon as practicable, and (c) all relevant parties in a cross-border wire transfer BEFORE executing it. Footnote 58 confirms screening applies irrespective of the customer's risk profile, so there is no low-risk carve-out. ¶6.14 requires names to be added to the database as soon as practicable after UNSC promulgation, regardless of whether Hong Kong legislation has implemented the sanctions — waiting for local legislation is wrong. Reporting a genuine hit to the JFIU (¶6.18) does not cure screening that happens only after the transfer was already executed.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者的制裁篩查責任，下列哪項正確？
options: 應在建立關係時及有新增或更新指認時對客戶及實益擁有人進行篩查，並在執行跨境電傳轉帳前對相關方進行篩查
只須對經評為高風險的客戶進行篩查；低風險客戶及其實益擁有人可獲豁免有關數據庫核對
只須待香港透過立法正式實施有關聯合國安全理事會決議後，才須將名單加入篩查數據庫
在跨境電傳轉帳執行後才對相關各方進行篩查亦可接受，只要其後將任何名單相符個案向聯合財富情報組匯報，並限時
tc.explain: 第6.16段：篩查機制須包括(a)建立關係時對客戶及實益擁有人進行篩查；(b)在切實可行範圍內盡快因應新增及更新的指認進行篩查；及(c)在執行跨境電傳轉帳前根據當時的數據庫對所有相關方進行篩查。註58確認不論客戶的風險狀況為何均須篩查，並無低風險豁免。第6.14段規定應在安理會頒布名單後盡快將其收錄數據庫，不論有關制裁是否已透過香港立法實施——待香港立法後才處理並不正確。即使其後將名單相符個案向聯合財富情報組匯報（第6.18段），亦不能彌補轉帳執行後才進行篩查的缺失。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶10.5, ¶11.2–11.3; s.12 & 13, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5及11.2至11.3段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12及13條

en.q: As an ordering institution, an MSO carries out a wire transfer of $50,000. Which information must accompany the transfer?
options: The originator's name, account/reference number and address, plus the recipient's name and account/reference number
The originator's name and account or reference number, plus the recipient's name and account or reference number — no address or ID information is needed
Only verification of the originator's identity — no accompanying originator or recipient information needs to travel with the transfer
Only the originator's account or reference number, provided the transfer is bundled into a batch file or sent as a domestic transfer
en.explain: ¶10.5: for a wire transfer of $8,000 or more, the ordering institution must ensure it is accompanied by the originator's name, account/reference number, and address (or customer ID number, identification document number, or — for individuals — date and place of birth), plus the recipient's name and account/reference number; ¶10.8 requires this originator information to be accurate. The reduced list without address (¶10.6) applies only to transfers BELOW $8,000 — not this $50,000 transfer. Verifying the originator's identity (¶10.9) is a separate duty from ensuring the accompanying information travels with the transfer (¶10.5). The reduced batch-file or domestic-transfer information rules (¶10.10-10.11) apply only in those specific situations, which are not stated here.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者作為匯款機構執行一筆50,000元的電傳轉帳。哪些資料必須附隨該轉帳？
options: 匯款人姓名、帳戶／參考號碼、地址，以及收款人姓名及帳戶／參考號碼
匯款人姓名及帳戶／參考號碼，以及收款人姓名及帳戶／參考號碼——無須地址資料
只須核實匯款人的身分——無須有任何匯款人或收款人資料隨轉帳附送
只須匯款人的帳戶或參考號碼，前提是該轉帳以批量檔案處理或屬本地轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.5段：金額達8,000元或以上的電傳轉帳，匯款機構須確保附隨：匯款人姓名、帳戶或參考號碼，以及地址（或客戶識別號碼、身分證明文件號碼；如屬個人可用出生日期及地點），以及收款人姓名及帳戶或參考號碼；第10.8段規定有關匯款人資料必須準確。不含地址的簡化清單（第10.6段）只適用於金額低於8,000元的轉帳——並不適用於本題50,000元的轉帳。核實匯款人身分（第10.9段）與確保隨附資料伴隨轉帳（第10.5段）是兩項不同責任。批量轉帳或本地轉帳的簡化資料規定（第10.10至10.11段）只適用於該等特定情況，而本題並無提及。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.1.2段

en.q: How should the extent of CDD measures relate to the ML/TF risks of a business relationship?
options: It should be commensurate with those risks — EDD for high-risk relationships, SDD permitted for low-risk ones
It should be identical for every customer, regardless of the ML/TF risk the relationship presents
It should depend on the size and profitability of the MSO, rather than on the customer's risk profile, set annually
It should be fixed by the CCE in a table applicable to each customer category
en.explain: ¶4.1.2: an MSO should apply an RBA when conducting CDD measures, and the extent of CDD should be commensurate with the ML/TF risks of the relationship — EDD where risk is high (¶4.9), SDD permitted where risk is low (¶4.8). It does not depend on treating every customer identically, on the MSO's own size or profitability, or on a fixed category table set by the CCE.

tc.q: 客戶盡職審查措施的程度，應與業務關係的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險有何關係？
options: 應與該等風險相稱——風險高時須加強審查，低風險時可簡化審查
對每名客戶均應相同，不論其洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險高低，須經核准
應取決於該經營者的規模及盈利能力，而非客戶的風險狀況
應由關長按每個客戶類別另行訂定劃一標準，逐一適用
tc.explain: 第4.1.2段：金錢服務經營者在進行客戶盡職審查措施時應採用風險為本方式，措施的程度應與業務關係所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險相稱——風險高時進行加強盡職審查（第4.9段），低風險情況下可採用簡化盡職審查（第4.8段）。措施程度並非取決於劃一對待每名客戶、該經營者本身的規模或盈利能力，也非由關長按類別訂定的劃一標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.1.5段

en.q: In an outward wire transfer, does the ordering MSO regard the beneficiary as its customer?
options: No — customer generally excludes third parties to a transaction, so a beneficiary with no other relationship to the MSO is not its customer
Yes — the AMLO defines customer to include every party involved in carrying out a transaction, whether or not they have any other relationship with the MSO
Yes, but only where the beneficiary is a natural person rather than a legal person, since individuals always count as customers under the AMLO
Yes, once the wire transfer reaches the $8,000 threshold that triggers the ordering institution's information requirements
en.explain: ¶4.1.5: the term customer generally refers to the party or parties with whom a business relationship is established, or for whom a transaction is carried out, and generally excludes third parties to a transaction — for example, an ordering MSO in an outward wire transfer does not regard the beneficiary, who has no other relationship with the MSO, as its customer. The wire-transfer information requirements (¶10.5, triggered at $8,000) concern what must accompany the transfer, not who counts as the MSO's customer, and this exclusion is not limited to legal-person beneficiaries.

tc.q: 在匯出電傳轉帳中，匯出的金錢服務經營者是否視收款人為其客戶？
options: 否——「客戶」一詞一般不包括交易的第三方，故與該經營者並無其他關係的收款人並非其客戶
是——條例將「客戶」定義為包括執行交易的每一方，不論其與該經營者有否其他關係
是，但只限收款人屬自然人而非法人的情況，因為個人在條例下必然視為客戶
是，一旦電傳轉帳達到觸發匯款機構資料規定的8,000元門檻，收款人即屬客戶
tc.explain: 第4.1.5段：「客戶」一詞一般指與該經營者建立業務關係，或該經營者為其進行交易的一方或多方，並一般不包括交易的第三方——例如在匯出電傳轉帳交易中，匯出的金錢服務經營者不會視與其並無其他關係的收款人為其客戶。電傳轉帳的資料規定（第10.5段，於8,000元門檻觸發）關乎轉帳須附隨的資料，與誰是該經營者的客戶無關；而此項不包括第三方的原則，亦不限於收款人屬法人的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.2.1段註腳13

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of an occasional transaction?
options: Purchase of cashier orders or gift cheques
Opening a business relationship with a corporate customer
A periodic review of an existing customer's records
An internal transfer between the MSO's own accounts
en.explain: Footnote 13 to ¶4.2.1 states that occasional transactions may include, for example, wire transfers, virtual asset transfers, remittance service, currency exchanges, and the purchase of cashier orders or gift cheques.

tc.q: 下列何者獲舉為非經常交易的例子？
options: 購買銀行本票或禮券支票
與公司客戶建立業務關係
定期檢視現有客戶的紀錄
該經營者自身帳戶之間的內部轉帳
tc.explain: 第4.2.1段註腳13訂明非經常交易可包括（例如）電傳轉帳、虛擬資產轉移、匯款服務、貨幣兌換，以及購買銀行本票或禮券支票。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.2.5段

en.q: Which patterns does the Guideline give as inherent factors linking occasional transactions?
options: Several payments to one recipient over a short period, or a customer regularly transferring funds to one or more destinations
Payments that each individually exceed the $120,000 or $8,000 occasional-transaction threshold on their own, per section 13A of Schedule 2
Transactions that separately trigger the special remittance requirements under section 13A of Schedule 2
Transactions carried out for a customer who already has an ongoing business relationship with the MSO
en.explain: ¶4.2.5: the factors linking occasional transactions are inherent in their characteristics — e.g. several payments to the same recipient from one or more sources over a short period, or a customer regularly transferring funds to one or more destinations — assessed against the timeframe in which they occur. Footnote 15 confirms this linking test applies irrespective of the $120,000/$8,000 thresholds, so requiring each payment to individually exceed them (D1) is wrong. Section 13A remittance requirements (footnote 14) are a separate cross-reference, not the linking factors themselves. And occasional transactions are, by definition (¶4.2.3), transactions with a customer who does NOT have a business relationship with the MSO.

tc.q: 本指引就非經常交易之間的內在關連因素舉出哪些模式？
options: 在短時間內向同一收款人付款多次，或客戶經常轉款至多個地點
每筆付款均個別超過120,000元或8,000元門檻
個別觸發附表2第13A條匯款交易特別規定的交易，須經核實記錄
為與該經營者已有持續業務關係的客戶進行的交易
tc.explain: 第4.2.5段：非經常交易之間的關連因素內在於交易本身的特徵——例如在短時間內從一個或多個來源向同一收款人作出多筆付款，或客戶經常向一個或多個目的地轉移資金——須對照交易進行的時間框架加以考慮。註腳15確認此關連準則不論120,000元／8,000元門檻為何均適用，故要求每筆付款須個別超過門檻（D1）並不正確。附表2第13A條的匯款交易特別規定（註腳14）是另一項參照條文，並非關連因素本身。而根據定義（第4.2.3段），非經常交易正是與並無業務關係的客戶進行的交易。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.2.6段

en.q: A cash transaction of $120,000 or more is undertaken by a person whose name does not appear on the mandate of an account. What should the MSO do?
options: Ask for the person's identity document and retain a copy, to support ongoing monitoring of the account
Refuse to process the transaction outright, since third-party cash transactions are not permitted under the Guideline
Treat the person as the MSO's customer for all CDD purposes, since anyone conducting a transaction becomes a customer
Report the transaction to the JFIU automatically, without needing any actual knowledge or suspicion of ML/TF
en.explain: ¶4.2.6: third-party cash transactions may represent an increased ML risk, especially where a large cash deposit is inconsistent with the customer's risk profile. Where such a transaction of $120,000 or more is made by a person not on the account mandate, the MSO should ask for that person's identity document and retain a copy to facilitate ongoing monitoring — the Guideline does not prohibit third-party cash transactions outright. Per ¶4.1.5, a person conducting a transaction does not automatically become the MSO's customer, and an STR to the JFIU is only required where there is actual knowledge or suspicion of ML/TF (Chapter 7), not automatically for every third-party transaction.

tc.q: 某項120,000元或以上的現金交易，由姓名並無列於帳戶授權書上的人進行。該經營者應怎樣做？
options: 索取該人的身分證明文件並保留副本，以支援對該帳戶的持續監察
直接拒絕處理該交易，理由是本指引不容許第三方現金交易
就所有盡職審查目的視該人為該經營者的客戶，因為進行交易者即屬客戶
自動向聯合財富情報組匯報該交易，無須實際知悉或懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集
tc.explain: 第4.2.6段：第三方現金交易可能構成較高的洗錢風險，尤其當大額現金存款與客戶的風險狀況不符時。當該等涉及款額達120,000元或以上的現金交易，由姓名並無列於帳戶授權書上的人進行時，該經營者應索取該人的身分證明文件並保留副本，以支援持續監察——本指引並無全面禁止第三方現金交易。根據第4.1.5段，進行交易的人並不會自動成為該經營者的客戶；而向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，只在實際知悉或懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集時才須進行（第7章），並非每宗第三方交易均須自動匯報。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.1段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as a reliable and independent source for verifying a customer's identity?
options: A digital identification system recognized by the CCE as reliable and independent
Any commercial database that the MSO happens to subscribe to, regardless of CCE recognition
A written reference or introduction from another existing customer of the MSO
A statutory declaration made and signed by the customer themselves
en.explain: ¶4.3.1 lists the reliable and independent sources as: a governmental body; the CCE or another relevant authority; an authority outside Hong Kong performing similar functions; a digital identification system recognized by the CCE; or another source recognized by the CCE. A commercial database is not automatically reliable and independent unless the CCE recognizes it; a reference from another customer and a customer's own statutory declaration are not independent third-party sources at all.

tc.q: 下列何者列為核實客戶身分的可靠而獨立來源？
options: 獲海關關長認可屬可靠而獨立來源的數碼身分識別系統
該經營者所訂用的商業資料庫，不論是否獲關長認可
該經營者另一名現有客戶提供的書面推薦或介紹
由客戶本人簽署作出的法定聲明
tc.explain: 第4.3.1段列出的可靠而獨立來源包括：政府機構；關長或其他有關當局；在香港以外執行類似職能的當局；獲關長認可的數碼身分識別系統；或獲關長認可的其他來源。商業資料庫並非自動屬可靠而獨立來源，除非獲關長認可；而另一客戶的推薦及客戶本人的法定聲明，均非獨立的第三方來源。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.3段

en.q: Which four particulars of a natural person customer must be verified against a reliable and independent source?
options: Name, date of birth, unique identification number and document type
Name, residential address, nationality and current occupation
Name, nationality, occupation and source of the customer's funds
Name, date of birth, residential address and name of employer
en.explain: ¶4.3.3 states that in verifying the identity of a natural person, an MSO should verify the name, date of birth, unique identification number and document type by reference to documents, data or information from a reliable and independent source — examples being a Hong Kong or other national identity card, a valid travel document, or other documents from a reliable and independent source. Nationality is collected under ¶4.3.2, and address, occupation, employer and source of funds are collected or assessed elsewhere, but none of them is in this specific verification list.

tc.q: 就屬自然人的客戶，須依據可靠而獨立來源核實哪四項資料？
options: 姓名、出生日期、獨有身分識別號碼及文件類型
姓名、住址、國籍及現時的職業狀況
姓名、國籍、職業及客戶的資金來源詳情
姓名、出生日期、住址及僱主的正式名稱
tc.explain: 第4.3.3段訂明在核實自然人身分時，該經營者應依據可靠而獨立來源的文件、數據或資料，核實客戶的姓名、出生日期、獨有身分識別號碼及文件類型——例子包括香港身分證或其他國民身分證、有效旅行證件，或來自可靠而獨立來源的其他文件。國籍按第4.3.2段收集；住址、職業、僱主及資金來源則在其他地方收集或評估，但均不在此項核實清單之內。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.4段

en.q: Must an identification document obtained by an MSO always contain a photograph of the customer?
options: It should; in exceptional circumstances where none can be obtained, one without a photograph may be accepted if the risks are properly assessed and mitigated
Yes, without exception — the CCE will never accept a document lacking a photograph, however unusual the customer's circumstances
No, a photograph is never required, since the other identification particulars are always sufficient to verify identity on their own
Only where the customer is not physically present — for a customer who attends in person, a photograph is always mandatory without exception, per a 2024 CCE circular
en.explain: ¶4.3.4: the identification document obtained should contain a photograph of the customer; only in exceptional circumstances where an MSO is unable to obtain one with a photograph may it accept one without, provided the associated risks have been properly assessed and mitigated. This is a risk-based exception, not a blanket rule in either direction — so a strict 'always, no exception' stance, a blanket 'never required' stance, and a face-to-face-only reading are all wrong.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者取得的身分證明文件是否必須載有客戶相片？
options: 應載有；在例外情況下未能取得時，如已妥為評估及減低相關風險，可接受並無相片的文件
是，並無例外——即使客戶情況如何特殊，關長亦絕不接受無相片的文件
否——從不需要相片，因為其他身分資料本身已足以核實客戶身分
只在客戶並未親身到場時方需要——凡客戶親身到場，相片均屬必須，並無例外，詳見有關通函
tc.explain: 第4.3.4段：該經營者取得的身分證明文件應載有客戶的相片；只在例外情況下，即未能取得載有相片的身分證明文件時，如相關風險已獲妥為評估及減低，方可接受並無相片的文件。這是按風險為本的例外安排，並非「一律必須」或「一律無須」的硬性規定，也不限於客戶未親身到場的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.5段註腳18

en.q: An MSO requires verification, as well as collection, of a natural person customer's residential address for group or overseas regulatory purposes. What does the Guideline say?
options: The MSO should communicate clearly to the customer the reasons for requiring verification of address
Verification of address is prohibited in all circumstances, since Schedule 2 requires only collection of address information, never verification
Verification of address is required by the Guideline in every case, not only where a group or overseas regulatory requirement calls for it
The MSO must first obtain the CCE's written approval before it may verify a customer's residential address for any purpose
en.explain: Footnote 18 to ¶4.3.5: an MSO may, in certain circumstances (e.g. group requirements or other local or overseas legal/regulatory requirements), require verification — on top of collection — of a customer's residential address; in such circumstances the MSO should communicate clearly to the customer the reasons for requiring it. ¶4.3.5 itself requires collection of address information in every case, so a blanket verification ban is wrong; but verification is needed only in these certain circumstances, not every case; and no CCE approval is required for it.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者因集團或海外監管要求，除收集外亦要求核實自然人客戶的住址。本指引有何說明？
options: 該經營者應向客戶清楚說明要求核實地址的理由
在任何情況下均禁止核實地址，因為附表2只要求收集地址資料，從不要求核實
本指引在任何情況下均要求核實地址，並非只在集團或海外監管要求下才須核實
該經營者須先取得關長的書面批准，方可基於任何目的核實客戶的住址
tc.explain: 第4.3.5段註腳18：金錢服務經營者在若干情況下（例如集團規定或其他本地或海外法律及監管規定），可要求在收集之外亦核實客戶的住址；在該等情況下，該經營者應向客戶清楚說明要求核實地址的理由。第4.3.5段本身規定在任何情況下均須收集地址資料，故全面禁止核實並不正確；但核實只在該等若干情況下才需要，並非每宗個案皆須；此舉亦無須先取得關長批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.6段

en.q: Which identification information should an MSO obtain for a customer that is a legal person?
options: Full name; date and place of incorporation; unique identification number and document type; and principal place of business if different
Full name; business registration number; the names of all directors; and the company's total issued share capital
Full name; date of incorporation; the names and shareholdings of all shareholders; and the company's principal bankers
Full name; the identity and nationality of the ultimate beneficial owner; and the company's annual turnover
en.explain: ¶4.3.6 lists the identification information for a legal person as: full name; date of incorporation, establishment or registration; place of incorporation, establishment or registration (including registered office address); unique identification number (e.g. incorporation or business registration number) and document type; and principal place of business if different from the registered office. Directors, share capital, shareholders, bankers, turnover, and the beneficial owner's identity/nationality (a separate exercise under ¶4.4) are not on this specific list.

tc.q: 就屬法人的客戶，金錢服務經營者應取得哪些身分識別資料？
options: 全名；註冊成立的日期及地點；獨有身分識別號碼及文件類型；以及主要營業地點
全名；商業登記號碼；全體董事的姓名；以及公司的已發行股本總額
全名；註冊成立日期；全體股東的姓名及持股量；以及公司的主要往來銀行
全名；最終實益擁有人的身分及國籍；以及公司的年度營業額
tc.explain: 第4.3.6段列出法人的身分識別資料為：全名；註冊成立、設立或登記的日期；註冊成立、設立或登記的地點（包括註冊辦事處地址）；獨有身分識別號碼（例如公司註冊編號或商業登記號碼）及文件類型；以及主要營業地點（如與註冊辦事處地址不同）。董事、股東、往來銀行、營業額，以及實益擁有人的身分／國籍（屬第4.4段的另一項工作），均不在此清單之內。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.7段

en.q: Which four matters should normally be verified for a customer that is a legal person?
options: Its name, legal form, current existence at the time of verification, and the powers that regulate and bind it
Its name, date of incorporation, unique identification number and principal place of business
Its certificate of incorporation, registry record, certificate of incumbency and certificate of good standing
Whether it is a well-known, reputable organisation with a long history and substantial public information available
en.explain: ¶4.3.7: in verifying a legal person's identity, an MSO should normally verify its name, legal form, current existence (at the time of verification), and the powers that regulate and bind it — by reference to documents such as a certificate of incorporation, registry record, certificate of incumbency, or certificate of good standing (¶4.3.7(a)-(d)), which are the DOCUMENTS used, not the matters verified. Name/date of incorporation/unique identification number/principal place of business (¶4.3.6) is the separate identification-information list. The well-known/long-history/public-information test (¶4.3.8) is a different, narrower shortcut available only for partnerships or unincorporated bodies confirming membership of a professional association.

tc.q: 就屬法人的客戶，通常應核實哪四項事宜？
options: 其名稱、法律形式、核實時的現存狀況，以及規管及約束該法人的權力
其名稱、註冊成立日期、獨有身分識別號碼及主要營業地點
其公司註冊證明書、公司登記冊紀錄、在職證明書及良好狀況證明書
是否屬知名而信譽良好的機構、在其行業有悠久歷史，並有大量公開資料
tc.explain: 第4.3.7段：在核實法人身分時，該經營者通常應核實其名稱、法律形式、核實時的現存狀況，以及規管及約束該法人的權力——依據的文件包括公司註冊證明書、公司登記冊紀錄、在職證明書或良好狀況證明書等（第4.3.7(a)至(d)段），但這些是用以核實的文件，並非須核實的事項。名稱、註冊成立日期、獨有身分識別號碼及主要營業地點屬第4.3.6段另一份「身分識別資料」清單。而知名信譽機構／悠久歷史／大量公開資料的驗證方式（第4.3.8段），是另一項較狹窄的捷徑，只適用於合夥或非法團團體確認專業協會會籍的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.7段註腳20

en.q: Why may an MSO need more than one document to verify a legal person's identity?
options: Because a certificate of incorporation usually verifies only the name and legal form, not current existence
Because every document obtained for CDD purposes must always be independently corroborated by a second reliable source
Because documents used for verification must be obtained in both of Hong Kong's official languages
Because the CCE requires an MSO to obtain at least two documents for every legal person customer
en.explain: Footnote 20 to ¶4.3.7: in some instances an MSO may need more than one document because, for example, a certificate of incorporation can usually verify only the name and legal form of a legal person, but cannot act as proof of current existence — a different document (e.g. a certificate of good standing) is needed for that. There is no general rule requiring independent corroboration of every document, bilingual documentation, or a fixed CCE two-document minimum.

tc.q: 為何金錢服務經營者核實法人身分時可能需要多於一份文件？
options: 因公司註冊證明書通常只能核實名稱及法律形式，不能證明現存狀況
因所有用於盡職審查的文件，均須經第二個可靠來源獨立佐證
因用於核實身分的文件，須以香港兩種法定語文一併取得
因關長規定每名法人客戶均須取得最少兩份文件
tc.explain: 第4.3.7段註腳20：在某些情況下，該經營者可能須取得多於一份文件，原因是（舉例而言）公司註冊證明書通常只能核實法人的名稱及法律形式，不能作為其現存狀況的證明——須以另一份文件（例如良好狀況證明書）證明此點。並無規定所有文件均須經第二來源獨立佐證、須以兩種法定語文取得，或關長規定劃一的兩份文件下限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.8段

en.q: On what three conditions may confirmation of a partnership's membership of a professional or trade association suffice to verify its identity?
options: The customer is a well-known, reputable organisation; has a long history; and there is substantial public information about it, its partners and controllers
The customer has more than ten partners; has been profitable for the past three years; and is independently audited annually
The customer is registered in Hong Kong; maintains a bank account with an authorized institution; and holds a valid business registration certificate; per CCE note 4
The customer consents in writing to be verified; provides a signed partnership deed; and names a designated contact person for enquiries
en.explain: ¶4.3.8: for a partnership or unincorporated body, confirmation of membership of a relevant professional or trade association is likely to be sufficient to verify identity, provided (a) the customer is a well-known, reputable organisation; (b) it has a long history in its industry; and (c) there is substantial public information about the customer, its partners and controllers. Partner count, profitability, audits, Hong Kong registration, banking, business registration, written consent, a partnership deed, and a named contact are not this three-part test.

tc.q: 在哪三項條件下，確認合夥為專業或行業協會會員足以核實其身分？
options: 該客戶是知名而信譽良好的機構；有悠久歷史；並有大量關於其合夥人及控權人的公開資料
該客戶有超過十名合夥人；過去三年持續錄得盈利；並每年接受獨立審計
該客戶在香港註冊；於認可機構設有銀行帳戶；並持有有效的商業登記證
該客戶書面同意接受核實；提供經簽署的合夥契據；並指定專責聯絡人以便查詢，並經第三方核實
tc.explain: 第4.3.8段：就屬合夥或非法團團體的客戶，確認其為相關專業或行業協會會員，相當可能足以核實其身分，前提是：(a)該客戶是知名而信譽良好的機構；(b)在其行業有悠久歷史；及(c)有大量關於該客戶、其合夥人及控權人的公開資料。合夥人數目、盈利能力、審計、香港註冊、銀行往來、商業登記、書面同意、合夥契據及指定聯絡人，均非此三項條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.9段

en.q: What should an MSO satisfy itself of in the case of associations, clubs, societies, charities and similar bodies?
options: The legitimate purpose of the organisation — for example, by requesting sight of its constitution
The organisation's annual income and expenditure, verified against its latest audited financial statements
The identity of every individual member of the organisation, each verified to the same standard as a natural person customer
The organisation's tax-exempt status, confirmed by a certificate issued by the Inland Revenue Department
en.explain: ¶4.3.9: for associations, clubs, societies, charities, religious bodies, institutes, mutual and friendly societies, co-operative and provident societies, an MSO should satisfy itself as to the legitimate purpose of the organisation, e.g. by requesting sight of the constitution. The Guideline does not require verifying income/expenditure against audited accounts, identifying every individual member, or confirming tax-exempt status with the Inland Revenue Department.

tc.q: 就協會、會所、社團、慈善團體及類似團體，金錢服務經營者應信納甚麼？
options: 該組織的合法目的——例如要求查閱其章程
該組織的年度收支，並須對照其最新的經審計財務報表核實
該組織每名成員的身分，並須按自然人客戶的相同標準核實
該組織的免稅地位，並須以稅務局發出的證明書確認
tc.explain: 第4.3.9段：就協會、會所、社團、慈善團體、宗教團體、學會、互助及友愛社、合作社及公積金社而言，該經營者應信納該組織的合法目的，例如要求查閱其章程。本指引並無規定須對照經審計財務報表核實收支、識別每名個別成員的身分，或以稅務局證明書確認免稅地位。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.10段

en.q: When should an MSO regard the trustee of a trust as its customer as well?
options: Where the trustee enters a relationship or occasional transaction on the trust's behalf — usually where it lacks separate legal personality
In no circumstances — even where the trustee acts on the trust's behalf, the customer is always the trust itself
Only where the trustee is a professional trust company acting in the course of a business that administers trusts for its clients, per Schedule 2
Only where the trust is established outside Hong Kong and governed by the law of an equivalent jurisdiction
en.explain: ¶4.3.10: the MSO should also regard the trustee as its customer if the trustee enters into a business relationship or carries out occasional transactions on behalf of the trust — generally the case where the trust does not possess a separate legal personality — and should then identify and verify the trustee as a natural or legal person, as applicable. This is not limited to professional trust companies, and it applies regardless of where the trust is established.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在何時亦應視信託的受託人為其客戶？
options: 當受託人代信託建立關係或進行非經常交易時，多屬信託無獨立法律人格的情況
在任何情況下均不應——即使受託人代信託行事，客戶仍只是信託本身，見附表2
只限該受託人是以業務方式為客戶管理信託的專業信託公司
只限該信託在香港以外設立，並受某個等同司法管轄區的法律規管
tc.explain: 第4.3.10段：如受託人代該信託建立業務關係或進行非經常交易，該經營者亦應視該受託人為其客戶——如該信託並無獨立法律人格，一般即屬此情況——屆時應按適用於自然人或法人的規定，識別及核實該受託人的身分。此規定並不限於專業信託公司，亦不論該信託在何地設立。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.11段

en.q: Which identification information should an MSO obtain for a customer that is a trust?
options: The trust's name; date of establishment; its governing jurisdiction; unique identification number; and registered office address if applicable
The names of all beneficiaries and their respective entitlements; the trust's investment strategy; and its annual distribution policy; filed yearly
The value of the trust property; its investment policy; the identity of the investment manager; and the custodian bank
The name of the trust; the identity and nationality of the settlor; and the trust's governing law only
en.explain: ¶4.3.11 lists the identification information for a trust as: the name of the trust or arrangement; date of establishment or settlement; the jurisdiction whose laws govern it; any unique identification number granted by an applicable official body and document type (e.g. a tax identification number or registered charity number); and the registered office address if applicable. Beneficiaries, investment strategy, distribution policy, property value, investment manager, custodian, and the settlor's identity/nationality are not on this list (relevant beneficial-ownership information may be gathered separately under Chapter 4.4).

tc.q: 就屬信託的客戶，金錢服務經營者應取得哪些身分識別資料？
options: 信託名稱；設立日期；規管的法律所屬管轄區；獨有身分識別號碼；以及註冊辦事處地址
所有受益人的姓名及其各自的應得權益；信託的投資策略；以及其年度分派政策，每年存檔
信託財產的價值；其投資政策；投資經理的身分；以及託管銀行
信託的名稱；財產授予人的身分及國籍；以及規管該信託的法律，僅此而已
tc.explain: 第4.3.11段列出信託的身分識別資料為：該信託或法律安排的名稱；設立或成立日期；規管該信託或法律安排的法律所屬司法管轄區；由任何適用官方機構給予的獨有身分識別號碼（如有）及文件類型（例如稅務識別號碼或註冊慈善團體編號）；以及註冊辦事處地址（如適用）。受益人、投資策略、分派政策、財產價值、投資經理、託管銀行，以及財產授予人的身分／國籍，均不在此清單之內（相關實益擁有權資料或須按第4.4段另行收集）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.12段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of a document for verifying a trust's identity?
options: Written confirmation from a lawyer who has reviewed the relevant trust instrument
A bank statement issued in the name of the trust showing its account balance
A list of the trust's current investment holdings and their market value
A letter from any beneficiary of the trust confirming their entitlement under it, notarised
en.explain: ¶4.3.12 gives as examples: a trust deed or similar instrument; a record of an appropriate register in the country of establishment; written confirmation from a trustee acting in a professional capacity; written confirmation from a lawyer who has reviewed the relevant instrument; or written confirmation from a trust company within the same financial group as the MSO. A bank statement, an investment list, and a beneficiary's letter are not among these examples.

tc.q: 下列何者獲舉為核實信託身分的文件例子？
options: 曾審閱有關信託文書的律師所發出的書面確認
以該信託名義發出、載有帳戶結餘的銀行結單，經公證
列明該信託現時投資組合及其市值的清單
該信託任何受益人確認其應得權益的來信
tc.explain: 第4.3.12段所舉例子包括：信託契據或類似文書；設立地所在國家適當登記冊的紀錄；以專業身分行事的受託人所發出的書面確認；曾審閱有關文書的律師所發出的書面確認；或（如該信託由與該經營者屬同一金融集團的信託公司管理）該信託公司所發出的書面確認。銀行結單、投資清單及受益人的來信，均不在這些例子之列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.13段

en.q: Must an MSO establish the accuracy of every piece of identification information it collects?
options: No — accuracy is only required for items verified under ¶4.3.3, 4.3.7 and 4.3.12
Yes — every item collected, including nationality and occupation, must be independently verified for accuracy
Yes, but only where the customer is assessed as posing a low ML/TF risk
Yes, but only where the customer is physically present during the CDD process
en.explain: ¶4.3.13: in verifying a customer's identity, an MSO need not establish the accuracy of every piece of identification information collected under ¶4.3.2 (natural persons), ¶4.3.6 (legal persons) and ¶4.3.11 (trusts) — those are broader collection lists. What must actually be verified for accuracy is the narrower set in ¶4.3.3, ¶4.3.7 and ¶4.3.12 (e.g. name, date of birth, unique identification number and document type for a natural person — not nationality or occupation). This applies regardless of the customer's risk rating or physical presence.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者是否須確定其所收集每一項身分識別資料的準確性？
options: 是——包括國籍及職業在內，所有已收集項目均須獨立核實準確性
是，但只限客戶被評為低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的情況
是，但只限客戶在盡職審查過程中親身到場的情況
tc.explain: 第4.3.13段：在核實客戶身分時，該經營者無須確定按第4.3.2段（自然人）、第4.3.6段（法人）及第4.3.11段（信託）所收集每一項身分識別資料的準確性——這些屬較廣泛的收集清單。實際須核實準確性的，是第4.3.3、4.3.7及4.3.12段所列較窄的項目（例如自然人的姓名、出生日期、獨有身分識別號碼及文件類型——不包括國籍或職業）。此規定不論客戶的風險評級或是否親身到場，均一體適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.14段

en.q: What requirement applies to the currency of documents used for identity verification?
options: They should be current — valid and up-to-date — at the time they are provided to or obtained by the MSO
They must have been issued within three months immediately preceding the CDD process, per CCE Note 1
They must remain valid for at least a further twelve months after verification
They must be re-obtained and re-verified by the MSO on an annual basis
en.explain: ¶4.3.14: an MSO should ensure that documents, data or information obtained for verifying identity under ¶4.3.3, 4.3.7 and 4.3.12 are current at the time they are provided to or obtained by the MSO. The Guideline sets no fixed three-month issue window, no twelve-month forward validity requirement, and no fixed annual re-verification cycle; the test is simply currency at the time of provision or collection.

tc.q: 用於核實身分的文件在時效方面有何規定？
options: 在提供予該經營者或由其取得時，應屬有效及最新
須於進行盡職審查前的三個月內簽發，詳見通函
經核實後須至少再維持十二個月有效
該經營者須每年重新取得並重新核實一次
tc.explain: 第4.3.14段：該經營者應確保按第4.3.3、4.3.7及4.3.12段為核實身分而取得的文件、數據或資料，在提供予該經營者或由其取得時屬有效及最新。本指引並無訂明三個月的簽發時限、十二個月的有效期規定，或劃一的每年重新核實周期；準則純粹是在提供或取得時是否屬最新。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.15段

en.q: What should an MSO consider applying, given that some documents are more easily forged or may be reported lost or stolen?
options: Anti-fraud procedures commensurate with the risk profile of the person being verified
A blanket policy of refusing any document type that could conceivably be forged by a sophisticated criminal
Mandatory verification of every document by two independent staff members, regardless of risk
Automatic referral of every identification document received to an external forensic examiner
en.explain: ¶4.3.15: when using documents for verification, an MSO should be aware that some document types are more easily forged, lost or stolen than others, and should therefore consider applying anti-fraud procedures commensurate with the risk profile of the person being verified — a risk-based response, not a blanket document ban, a fixed two-staff rule, or automatic forensic referral for every document.

tc.q: 鑑於某些文件較易被偽造或可能已被報失或報稱被盜，金錢服務經營者應考慮採用甚麼？
options: 與被核實者的風險狀況相稱的反欺詐程序
全面拒絕接受任何有可能被老練罪犯偽造的文件類型
不論風險為何，一律規定由兩名獨立員工核實每份文件
將所收到的每份身分證明文件一律轉交外部法證專家鑑定
tc.explain: 第4.3.15段：該經營者在使用文件核實身分時，應留意某些類型的文件較其他文件易被偽造、遺失或報稱被盜，因此應考慮採用與被核實者的風險狀況相稱的反欺詐程序——這是按風險而定的做法，並非全面拒收特定文件、劃一規定兩名員工核實，或將每份文件一律轉交法證專家鑑定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.16段

en.q: Where a customer is physically present during the CDD process, what should the MSO's staff generally do with the identification document?
options: Have sight of the original identification document by its staff and retain a copy of it
Retain the original document itself on file rather than making any copy of it
Photograph the document on a personal device and return it without keeping any copy, per office policy
Record only the document's number and type without sighting the document itself
en.explain: ¶4.3.16: if a natural person customer, or a person representing a legal person or trust, is physically present during the CDD process, the MSO should generally have sight of the original identification document by its staff and retain a copy of the document (with appropriate measures for the rarer cases where an original truly cannot be produced, e.g. an electronic original). Filing only the original without a copy, photographing it without keeping a copy, or recording only the document number/type does not meet this requirement.

tc.q: 如客戶在客戶盡職審查過程中親身到場，該經營者的員工一般應如何處理身分證明文件？
options: 由其員工查閱身分證明文件正本並保留該文件的副本
將文件正本存檔保留，而不製作任何副本
以個人裝置為文件拍照後交還，不保留任何副本，按慣例
只記錄文件的號碼及類型，不查閱文件本身
tc.explain: 第4.3.16段：如自然人客戶或代表法人或信託的人在客戶盡職審查過程中親身到場，該經營者一般應由其員工查閱身分證明文件正本並保留該文件的副本（如原件確實無法提供，例如電子正本等罕見情況，則須採取適當措施）。單純將正本存檔而不留副本、為文件拍照後交還而不留副本，或只記錄文件的號碼及類型而不查閱文件本身，均不符合此規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.16段

en.q: What should an MSO do where an original identification document cannot be produced, for example because it exists only in electronic form?
options: Take appropriate measures to ensure the documents obtained are reliable
Decline to proceed with the customer relationship altogether
Accept the electronic document without taking any further steps, per office rules
Require the customer to obtain and produce a paper original
en.explain: ¶4.3.16 recognises that there are occasions where an original identification document cannot be produced by customers — for example where the original is in electronic form — and states that in such a case the MSO should take appropriate measures to ensure the reliability of the identification documents obtained; declining the relationship, accepting the document with no checks at all, or insisting on a paper original are not what the paragraph requires.

tc.q: 如無法出示身分證明文件正本（例如該正本只以電子形式存在），該經營者應怎樣做？
options: 採取適當措施，確保識別文件屬可靠
一概拒絕與該客戶建立業務關係
無須任何進一步步驟即接受電子文件，即可
要求客戶另行取得並出示紙本正本
tc.explain: 第4.3.16段認識到在若干情況下客戶無法出示身分證明文件正本（例如該正本以電子形式存在）；在該等情況下，該經營者應採取適當措施，確保所取得識別文件的可靠性；拒絕建立關係、不作任何查核即接受文件，或堅持要求紙本正本，均非該段的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.17段

en.q: What should an MSO do where identification documents are in a foreign language?
options: Take appropriate steps to be reasonably satisfied the documents evidence the customer's identity
Refuse to accept any document written in a language other than Chinese or English, per section 4.3.17
Obtain a certified translation of every single document in every single case
Accept the foreign-language documents without taking any further steps at all
en.explain: ¶4.3.17 states that where the documents, data or information used for identification are in a foreign language, appropriate steps should be taken by the MSO to be reasonably satisfied that they in fact provide evidence of the customer's identity — the Guideline does not bar non-Chinese/English documents, does not mandate a certified translation in every case, and does not permit acceptance without any further steps.

tc.q: 如身分識別文件以外文書寫，金錢服務經營者應怎樣做？
options: 採取適當步驟，合理信納該等文件提供身分證據
拒絕接受並非以中文或英文書寫的任何文件
在任何情況下均須取得每份文件的經核證譯本，見指引
無須任何進一步步驟即接受該等外文文件
tc.explain: 第4.3.17段訂明，如用於身分識別的文件、數據或資料以外語書寫，該經營者應採取適當步驟，合理地信納該等文件、數據或資料確實提供該客戶身分的證據；本指引並無禁止使用中英文以外的文件，亦無規定在任何情況下均須取得經核證的譯本，更不容許無須任何步驟即予接受。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.18段

en.q: What must an MSO obtain in relation to the connected parties of a customer that is a legal person or trust?
options: Their names
Their full identification information and verified identities
Their residential addresses and occupations
Their shareholdings and voting rights
en.explain: ¶4.3.18 states that where a customer is a legal person, a trust or other similar legal arrangement, an MSO should identify all the connected parties of the customer by obtaining their names. Footnote 26 adds that if a connected party is also a customer, beneficial owner or PPTA, the fuller requirements for that capacity apply.

tc.q: 就屬法人或信託的客戶，金錢服務經營者須就其有關連人士取得甚麼？
options: 他們的姓名
他們的完整身分識別資料及經核實的身分
他們的住址及職業
他們的持股量及投票權
tc.explain: 第4.3.18段訂明，如客戶是法人、信託或其他類似法律安排，該經營者應藉取得其有關連人士的姓名，識別該等人士。註腳26補充，如有關連人士同時符合客戶、實益擁有人或聲稱代客戶行事的人的定義，則須按該身分的較全面規定辦理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.19段

en.q: Who is a “connected party” in relation to a customer that is a corporation, and in relation to a trust?
options: A director of the corporation, and a trustee or equivalent of the trust
A registered shareholder of the corporation, and a beneficiary of the trust
An auditor of the corporation, and a protector of the trust
An employee of the corporation, and a settlor of the trust
en.explain: ¶4.3.19 defines a connected party as, in relation to a corporation, a director of the customer, and in relation to a trust or similar arrangement, a trustee or equivalent — shareholders and beneficiaries, auditors and protectors, and employees and settlors are all beneficial-owner or unrelated roles under ¶¶4.4.6-4.4.10, not the connected-party test.

tc.q: 就屬法團的客戶及屬信託的客戶而言，何人是「有關連人士」？
options: 該法團的董事；以及該信託的受託人（或同等者）
該法團的登記股東；以及該信託的受益人
該法團的核數師；以及該信託的保護人
該法團的僱員；以及該信託的財產授予人
tc.explain: 第4.3.19段界定有關連人士為：就法團而言，指該客戶的董事；就信託或類似法律安排而言，指該客戶的受託人（或同等職位者）；股東與受益人、核數師與保護人、僱員與財產授予人，均屬第4.4.6至4.4.10段實益擁有人定義下的角色，並非有關連人士的定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.1段

en.q: How does the Guideline describe a beneficial owner in general terms?
options: The natural person who ultimately owns or controls the customer, or transacts on their behalf
Any natural person formally named as a shareholder in the company's register
Any natural person authorised to give instructions to operate the customer's account, per section 4.5.1
The individual who physically attends the MSO's premises to open the account
en.explain: ¶4.4.1 states that beneficial owner refers to the natural person(s) who ultimately own or control the customer, or on whose behalf a transaction or activity is conducted. Being named as a shareholder, being authorised to give instructions (the PPTA test in ¶4.5.1), or physically attending the premises (¶4.3.16) are each different concepts, not the beneficial-owner definition.

tc.q: 本指引一般如何描述實益擁有人？
options: 最終擁有或控制該客戶，或代其進行交易的自然人
在公司股東名冊上正式列名的任何自然人
獲正式授權發出指示以操作客戶帳戶的任何人，見指引
親身到該經營者的處所開立帳戶的個人
tc.explain: 第4.4.1段訂明實益擁有人指最終擁有或控制該客戶的自然人，或某項交易或活動是代其進行的自然人。在股東名冊上列名、獲授權發出操作帳戶指示（第4.5.1段看似代客戶行事的人的判斷標準），或親身到處所開戶（第4.3.16段），均屬不同概念，並非實益擁有人的定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.2段

en.q: What identification information should an MSO endeavour to obtain when identifying a beneficial owner?
options: As far as possible, the same information as required for a natural person customer
Only the beneficial owner's full name and date of birth are required
Only the beneficial owner's percentage shareholding in the customer matters, per section 4.4.2
The beneficial owner's source of wealth and source of funds in every case
en.explain: ¶4.4.2 states that when identifying a beneficial owner an MSO should endeavour to obtain the same identification information as at ¶4.3.2 — full name, date of birth, nationality, and unique identification number and document type — as far as possible; name and date of birth alone omits nationality and the ID number, a bare percentage holding is not identification information, and source of wealth/funds is a separate EDD concept, not this baseline requirement.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在識別實益擁有人時，應盡量取得甚麼身分識別資料？
options: 在可能範圍內，取得與自然人客戶相同的身分識別資料
只需該實益擁有人的姓名及出生日期已足夠
只需該實益擁有人在客戶中的持股百分比即可，見4.4.2段
在任何情況下均須提供的財富來源及資金來源
tc.explain: 第4.4.2段訂明該經營者在識別實益擁有人時，應盡可能取得與第4.3.2段相同的身分識別資料——即全名、出生日期、國籍，以及獨有身分識別號碼及文件類型；只取姓名及出生日期遺漏了國籍及識別號碼，持股百分比本身並非身分識別資料，而財富來源及資金來源屬另一項加強盡職審查的概念，並非此項基本規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.3段

en.q: Which approaches may constitute reasonable measures to verify a beneficial owner's identity?
options: Public-domain records, independent customer documents, or corroborating the declaration with public information
Always obtaining a certified copy of the beneficial owner's passport as the only ever acceptable method, per CCE guidance
Always obtaining a statutory declaration from the beneficial owner as the only ever acceptable method
Always obtaining confirmation from the customer's bankers as the only ever acceptable method
en.explain: ¶4.4.3 states that it is for the MSO to consider whether to make use of records of a beneficial owner available in the public domain, request the customer to provide documents or information obtained from a reliable and independent source, or corroborate the customer's undertaking or declaration with publicly available information — none of these is prescribed as the single mandatory method, so treating a passport copy, a statutory declaration, or a banker's confirmation as the only acceptable approach is incorrect.

tc.q: 哪些做法可構成核實實益擁有人身分的合理措施？
options: 使用公開紀錄、要求客戶提供獨立來源文件，或以公開資料佐證聲明
一律只可取得該實益擁有人護照的核證副本作為唯一可接受方法，見指引
一律只可取得該實益擁有人的法定聲明作為唯一可接受方法
一律只可取得該客戶往來銀行的確認作為唯一可接受方法
tc.explain: 第4.4.3段訂明，該經營者可自行考慮是否使用公開範疇可得的實益擁有人紀錄、要求客戶提供從可靠而獨立來源取得的文件或資料，或以公開可得資料佐證客戶的承諾或聲明——當中並無任何一項被訂為唯一必須採用的方法，故將護照核證副本、法定聲明或銀行確認視為唯一可接受的方法均屬不正確。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.3段

en.q: In an exceptionally low ML/TF risk situation such as a charitable trust, what may be reasonable for verifying a beneficial owner?
options: Confirming identity using the customer's information, with a verified trustee, plus confirmation the owner is known to them
Confirming identity from the customer's information alone, without confirming the owner is known to the customer, per section 4.4.3
Relying on the customer's unverified assertion alone, regardless of the ML/TF risk level involved
Verifying the beneficial owner to the same independent standard required in high-risk situations
en.explain: ¶4.4.3 states that in an exceptionally low ML/TF risk situation, such as a charitable trust, it may be reasonable for the MSO to confirm the beneficial owner's identity based on information provided by the customer, including a trustee whose identity has been verified, together with confirmation that the beneficial owner is known to the customer; omitting that confirmation, treating any unverified assertion as sufficient regardless of risk, or requiring the full independent-verification standard used for high-risk situations all go beyond or fall short of what this paragraph actually permits.

tc.q: 在極低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的情況（例如慈善信託）下，核實實益擁有人可採取甚麼合理做法？
options: 根據客戶提供的資料（包括身分已核實的受託人）確認身分，並確認其為客戶所認識
只根據客戶提供的資料確認身分，而不確認該實益擁有人是否為客戶所認識，詳見指引
純粹倚賴客戶未經核實的陳述，不論洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險高低
以適用於高風險情況的相同獨立核實標準核實該實益擁有人
tc.explain: 第4.4.3段訂明在極低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的情況（例如慈善信託）下，該經營者根據客戶（包括身分已獲核實的受託人）所提供的資料確認實益擁有人的身分，並確認該實益擁有人為客戶所認識，可屬合理；略去該項確認、不論風險高低一律接受未經核實的陳述，或要求適用於高風險情況的獨立核實標準，均超出或未達該段實際容許的範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.4段

en.q: Where a customer's ownership structure involves different types of legal persons or arrangements, to what should an MSO pay attention?
options: Who has ultimate ownership or control, or is the controlling mind and management
The company secretary who handles the customer's various statutory filings
The external auditor who signs off the customer's annual financial statements, per policy
The registered agent who helped complete the customer's incorporation
en.explain: ¶4.4.4 states that where the ownership structure of a customer involves different types of legal persons or legal arrangements, an MSO should pay attention to who has ultimate ownership or control over the customer, or who constitutes the controlling mind and management of the customer — a company secretary, an external auditor and a registered agent are all administrative or professional roles, not the ownership/control test itself.

tc.q: 如客戶的擁有權架構涉及不同類型的法人或法律安排，金錢服務經營者應留意甚麼？
options: 何人有最終擁有權或控制權，或屬主導思想及管理層
負責處理該客戶各項法定備案事宜的公司秘書，按慣例
負責簽署該客戶年度財務報表的外聘核數師
協助該客戶完成註冊成立的註冊代理人
tc.explain: 第4.4.4段訂明，如客戶的擁有權架構涉及不同類型的法人或法律安排，該經營者在斷定何人是實益擁有人時，應留意何人對該客戶擁有最終擁有權或控制權，或何人構成該客戶的主導思想及管理層；公司秘書、外聘核數師及註冊代理人均屬行政或專業角色，並非擁有權／控制權的判斷標準本身。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.5段

en.q: Where the customer is a natural person, who is the beneficial owner, and what must the MSO do?
options: The customer is the beneficial owner unless indicated otherwise; the MSO should enquire only where indications exist
The customer is always the beneficial owner, even where a third party actually pays for the transaction, per section 4.4.5
A third party is always the beneficial owner whenever the account is used for business purposes
The MSO should make proactive searches only once a transaction exceeds the CDD reporting threshold
en.explain: ¶4.4.5 states that in respect of a customer that is a natural person, the customer is the beneficial owner unless the characteristics of the transactions or other circumstances indicate otherwise; there is no requirement to make proactive searches for beneficial owners, but the MSO should make appropriate enquiries where there are indications the customer is not acting on their own behalf — a third-party-payment rule, a business-purpose rule, and a threshold-triggered search rule are none of them what ¶4.4.5 actually says.

tc.q: 如客戶是自然人，誰是實益擁有人？該經營者須怎樣做？
options: 除非另有顯示，否則客戶即為實益擁有人；只在有跡象時才查詢
即使有第三方實際支付交易款項，該客戶仍一律為實益擁有人
凡帳戶用於任何業務用途，第三方即一律為實益擁有人
該經營者只須在交易超過盡職審查申報門檻後才主動搜尋實益擁有人
tc.explain: 第4.4.5段訂明就屬自然人的客戶而言，除非交易的特徵或其他情況另有顯示，否則該客戶即為實益擁有人；該經營者無須主動搜尋該客戶的實益擁有人，但如有跡象顯示該客戶並非代自己行事，則應作出適當查詢；第三方付款規則、業務用途規則，以及門檻觸發搜尋規則，均非第4.4.5段的實際規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.3段註腳27

en.q: Which Hong Kong register does the Guideline mention as a possible aid to identifying a corporate customer's beneficial owners?
options: The significant controllers register kept under the Companies Ordinance
The register of licensees maintained under section 27 of the AMLO, updated monthly
The Business Registration Office's index of registered businesses
The Land Registry's register of owners of immovable property
en.explain: Footnote 27 to ¶4.4.3 gives the significant controllers register maintained in accordance with the Companies Ordinance of Hong Kong as an example of a register an MSO may refer to when identifying beneficial owners; the AMLO licensee register, the Business Registration Office index, and the Land Registry are all real Hong Kong registers, but none of them is the one footnote 27 names for this purpose.

tc.q: 本指引提及香港哪一個登記冊，可能有助識別公司客戶的實益擁有人？
options: 按《公司條例》備存的重要控制人登記冊
《打擊洗錢條例》第27條的持牌人登記冊
商業登記署備存的註冊商業索引
土地註冊處備存的不動產業主登記冊
tc.explain: 第4.4.3段註腳27以按香港《公司條例》備存的重要控制人登記冊為例，說明該經營者在識別實益擁有人時可參閱的登記冊；《打擊洗錢條例》持牌人登記冊、商業登記署索引及土地註冊處登記冊均為香港真實存在的登記冊，但均非註腳27就此目的所指明的登記冊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.1.3(b)段註腳12

en.q: How does the Guideline define a trust for its own purposes?
options: An express trust, or a similar arrangement with a legally binding document in place
Any informal arrangement under which one person holds property for another, per common law
Any arrangement formally registered as a trust with a government body
Any arrangement that the customer itself chooses to describe as a trust
en.explain: Footnote 12 to ¶4.1.3(b) states that for the purpose of the Guideline, a trust means an express trust or any similar arrangement for which a legally binding document — a trust deed or in any other form — is in place; an informal arrangement with no such document, a mere government registration, and the customer's own label are each insufficient on their own to satisfy this definition.

tc.q: 就本指引本身而言，如何界定信託？
options: 明示信託，或設有具法律約束力文件的類似安排
任何一人非正式地為另一人持有財產的安排，依慣例
任何已正式向政府機構登記為信託的安排
任何純粹由客戶本身稱為信託的安排
tc.explain: 第4.1.3(b)段註腳12訂明，就本指引而言，信託指明示信託，或任何設有具法律約束力文件（即信託契據或任何其他形式）的類似安排；沒有該等文件的非正式安排、純粹向政府機構登記，或純粹由客戶自行稱為信託，均不足以符合此定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.1.1段

en.q: In respect of what must an MSO establish and maintain effective AML/CFT Systems for complying with the CDD requirements?
options: Each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction
Each business premises that the MSO currently operates in Hong Kong
Each individual member of staff that the MSO employs, vetted by the CO annually
Each overseas jurisdiction to which the MSO remits funds
en.explain: ¶4.1.1 states that an MSO should, in respect of each kind of customer, business relationship, product and transaction, establish and maintain effective AML/CFT Systems for complying with the CDD requirements set out in Chapter 4 — echoing section 19(3) of Schedule 2; premises, individual staff members, and remittance jurisdictions are not the units the paragraph specifies.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須就甚麼建立及維持有效的打擊洗錢系統，以遵從客戶盡職審查規定？
options: 每種客戶、業務關係、產品及交易
其在香港經營的每個業務處所
其僱用的每一名個別員工，每年審核
其匯款所至的每個海外司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第4.1.1段訂明該經營者應就每種客戶、業務關係、產品及交易，建立及維持有效的打擊洗錢系統，以遵從第4章所載的客戶盡職審查規定——與附表2第19(3)條相呼應；業務處所、個別員工及匯款所至的司法管轄區，均非該段指明的單位。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.1.4段

en.q: How should the meaning of “customer” and “client” be determined under the Guideline?
options: Inferred from their everyday meaning, read in the context of industry practice
Solely from the definition in Schedule 2, treated as exhaustive
By reference to the customer's own description of the relationship, per office practice
By reference solely to the wording of the contractual documents
en.explain: ¶4.1.4 states that the term customer is defined in the AMLO to include a client, and that the meaning of customer and client should be inferred from its everyday meaning and in the context of the industry practice — Schedule 2 does not itself provide an exhaustive definition, and the terms are not determined solely by the customer's own description or by contract wording alone.

tc.q: 根據本指引，「客戶」及「委託人」的涵義應如何確定？
options: 按其日常涵義，並參照業界慣常做法推斷
只按附表2的定義確定，並視為詳盡無遺
按客戶本身對該關係的描述確定，並經公證
只按合約文件的字面措辭確定
tc.explain: 第4.1.4段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》界定「客戶」包括「委託人」；而「客戶」及「委託人」的涵義，應按其日常涵義並參照業界的慣常做法推斷——附表2本身並非詳盡無遺的定義，亦不能只按客戶本身的描述或合約文件的字面措辭確定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.2.4段

en.q: What should an MSO do when it becomes aware that a series of linked occasional transactions has met or exceeded the CDD thresholds?
options: Carry out CDD measures
Report the series to the JFIU without further enquiry
Refuse all further transactions from that customer
Apply the threshold to each transaction separately
en.explain: ¶4.2.4 states that an MSO should be vigilant to the possibility that a series of linked occasional transactions could meet or exceed the CDD thresholds of $8,000 for wire transfers or virtual asset transfers and $120,000 for other types of transactions, and that where the MSO becomes aware that these thresholds are met or exceeded, CDD measures should be carried out.

tc.q: 當金錢服務經營者察覺一連串有關連的非經常交易已達到或超過客戶盡職審查門檻時，應怎樣做？
options: 進行客戶盡職審查措施
無須進一步查究即向聯合財富情報組匯報該系列交易
拒絕該客戶其後的所有交易
就每宗交易分別適用該門檻
tc.explain: 第4.2.4段訂明該經營者應警覺一連串有關連的非經常交易可能達到或超過客戶盡職審查門檻（電傳轉帳或虛擬資產轉移為8,000元，其他類型交易為120,000元）；當該經營者察覺該等門檻已達到或超過時，應進行客戶盡職審查措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.2.1(d)段

en.q: Which trigger for CDD arises from doubt about information already obtained, rather than from suspicion of ML/TF or from a transaction?
options: When the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of previously obtained information
When the MSO is about to establish a business relationship with the customer, in writing
When an occasional transaction reaches $120,000, irrespective of any doubt
When the MSO suspects that the customer's account is involved in ML/TF
en.explain: ¶4.2.1(d) requires CDD when the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of any information previously obtained for identifying the customer or verifying the customer's identity. Establishing a business relationship is the separate trigger at ¶4.2.1(a); the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold is the separate trigger at ¶4.2.1(b)(i); and suspicion of ML/TF is the separate trigger at ¶4.2.1(c), which footnote 15 confirms applies irrespective of the thresholds — none of these is the 'doubt' trigger the stem asks about.

tc.q: 哪一項客戶盡職審查觸發條件源自對先前已取得資料的疑問，而非源自對洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑或某項交易？
options: 當該經營者懷疑先前為識別客戶而取得的資料的真確性或充分性時
當該經營者即將與客戶建立業務關係時
當某項非經常交易達到120,000元，不論是否有任何懷疑
當該經營者懷疑該客戶或其帳戶涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集活動時
tc.explain: 第4.2.1(d)段規定，當該經營者懷疑先前為識別客戶或核實客戶身分而取得的任何資料的真確性或充分性時，須進行客戶盡職審查。建立業務關係是第4.2.1(a)段另一項觸發條件；120,000元非經常交易門檻是第4.2.1(b)(i)段另一項觸發條件；懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集則是第4.2.1(c)段另一項觸發條件（註腳15確認該項不受門檻所限）——三者均非本題所問、源自該經營者本身疑問的觸發條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.6段註腳19

en.q: What entities does “legal person” cover for the purposes of the Guideline's CDD chapter?
options: Any entity other than a natural person able to form a permanent customer relationship or own property
A governmental body, one of the reliable and independent verification sources
A natural person who operates a business as a sole proprietor, in his or her own name
A trust or similar legal arrangement, which the Guideline treats as a separate customer type
en.explain: Footnote 19 defines legal person as any entity other than a natural person that can establish a permanent customer relationship with an MSO or otherwise own property (e.g. companies, bodies corporate, foundations, anstalt, partnerships and associations). A governmental body is listed elsewhere, in ¶4.3.1(a), as a source for verification; a sole proprietor is still a natural person; and a trust is dealt with under its own separate heading at ¶¶4.3.10-4.3.12, not as a 'legal person'.

tc.q: 就本指引客戶盡職審查一章而言，「法人」涵蓋哪些實體？
options: 自然人以外、能建立長期客戶關係或擁有財產的任何實體
政府機構，即用作核實身分的可靠及獨立來源之一
以其本人名義經營獨資業務的自然人
信託或類似法律安排，本指引將其視為獨立的客戶類別
tc.explain: 註腳19將「法人」界定為自然人以外、能與金錢服務經營者建立長期客戶關係或以其他方式擁有財產的任何實體（例如公司、法人團體、基金會、機構（anstalt）、合夥及協會）。政府機構是第4.3.1(a)段所列的核實來源之一；以本人名義經營獨資業務者仍屬自然人；信託則在第4.3.10至4.3.12段另行按獨立客戶類別處理，並非「法人」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.12段註腳25

en.q: What does “trustees acting in their professional capacity” mean in the context of verifying a trust's identity?
options: Acting in a profession or business that includes trust administration services
Trustees who hold formal qualifications as lawyers or accountants
Trustees who have been formally appointed to the role by a court order, per the register
Trustees who receive any form of remuneration for their services
en.explain: Footnote 25 to ¶4.3.12 states that trustees acting in their professional capacity means that they act in the course of a profession or business which consists of or includes the provision of services in connection with the administration or management of trusts; holding a legal or accounting qualification, being court-appointed, or simply being paid are none of them the test the footnote actually sets.

tc.q: 在核實信託身分的情境中，「以專業身分行事的受託人」指甚麼？
options: 在包含信託管理服務的專業或業務過程中行事
具備律師或會計師正式資格的受託人
正式獲法院命令委任出任該職的受託人
因提供服務而收取任何形式報酬的受託人，須登記
tc.explain: 第4.3.12段註腳25訂明「以專業身分行事的受託人」，指其在包含或包括提供與信託的管理或管治有關的服務的專業或業務過程中行事；具備律師或會計師資格、由法院命令委任，或純粹收取任何報酬，均非該註腳實際訂明的標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.3.12段註腳24

en.q: What should an MSO have regard to in determining whether a register of trusts is “appropriate” for verification purposes?
options: Adequate transparency, e.g. central registration of trust details, kept up-to-date
Whether the register records only current ownership and omits historical changes, per CCE guidance
Whether the register is open to searches by the general public free of charge
Whether the register covers trusts only, and excludes other legal arrangements
en.explain: Footnote 24 to ¶4.3.12 states that in determining whether a register is appropriate, the MSO should have regard to adequate transparency — for example a system of central registration where a national registry records trust details, kept up-to-date — not whether historical changes are omitted, whether public searches are free, or whether the register's scope is limited to trusts alone.

tc.q: 在斷定某信託登記冊就核實用途是否「適當」時，金錢服務經營者應顧及甚麼？
options: 是否有足夠透明度，例如設有中央登記並保持資料最新
該登記冊是否只記錄現有擁有權，而略去過往變動記錄
該登記冊是否可供公眾人士免費查閱
該登記冊是否只涵蓋信託，而不包括其他法律安排，須確認
tc.explain: 第4.3.12段註腳24訂明，在斷定某登記冊是否適當時，該經營者應顧及是否有足夠透明度——例如設有中央登記制度，由國家登記處記錄該國信託詳情，並保持最新——並非該登記冊是否略去過往變動記錄、是否可供公眾免費查閱，或是否只涵蓋信託而不包括其他法律安排。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.8段

en.q: How is the beneficial owner defined in relation to an unincorporated body other than a partnership?
options: An individual who ultimately owns or controls it, or the person it is acting on behalf of
Every registered member of the unincorporated body, regardless of role
The chairperson or president who represents the unincorporated body publicly
Whoever physically signs the account-opening documents on the body's behalf under paragraph 4.4.9
en.explain: ¶4.4.8 states that in relation to an unincorporated body other than a partnership, beneficial owner means an individual who ultimately owns or controls the unincorporated body, or, if the unincorporated body is acting on behalf of another person, that other person; every member, the chairperson, and the person who signs the paperwork are not the statutory test.

tc.q: 就合夥以外的非法團團體而言，實益擁有人如何界定？
options: 最終擁有或控制團體的個人，或其代表行事的另一人
該非法團團體所有登記在冊的成員，不論職級高低
公開對外代表該非法團團體的主席或會長
代表該團體在開立帳戶文件上簽署的人（經授權簽署）
tc.explain: 第4.4.8段訂明就合夥以外的非法團團體而言，實益擁有人指最終擁有或控制該非法團團體的個人；或如該團體是代另一人行事，則指該另一人；所有成員、主席或會長，以及在文件上簽署的人，均非法定測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.9段

en.q: For a customer that is a legal person, which two categories of natural person should an MSO identify?
options: Any natural person with more than 25% ownership, and any exercising control of the legal person
Any natural person holding any shares at all, and, under s.4.4.9, any employee with signing authority
Any natural person named in the constitutional documents, and any external auditor
Any natural person resident in Hong Kong, and any director based overseas
en.explain: ¶4.4.9 requires an MSO, for a customer that is a legal person, to identify any natural person who ultimately has a controlling ownership interest — more than 25% — in the legal person, and any natural person exercising control of the legal person or its management; a bare shareholder plus a signing employee, a named-in-documents person plus an auditor, and a residency/overseas-director pairing are all incorrect substitutes.

tc.q: 就屬法人的客戶，金錢服務經營者應識別哪兩類自然人？
options: 持有超過25%擁有權權益，或對該法人行使控制權的自然人
持有任何股份的任何自然人，以及具簽署權的任何僱員（董事）
憲章文件中列名的任何自然人，以及任何外聘核數師
居於香港的任何自然人，以及任何海外董事
tc.explain: 第4.4.9段規定就屬法人的客戶，該經營者應識別最終在該法人中持有控制性擁有權權益（即超過25%）的任何自然人，以及對該法人或其管理層行使控制權的任何自然人；持股股東加具簽署權僱員、憲章列名者加核數師，以及居港人士加海外董事，均非正確的替代組合。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.9段

en.q: Where no natural person falls within the beneficial owner definition for a legal person customer, what should the MSO do?
options: Identify the senior managing officials and verify their identities
Treat the legal person itself as its own beneficial owner
Decline to proceed with the customer relationship entirely
Record that there is no beneficial owner and take no further step at all
en.explain: ¶4.4.9 states that if there is no natural person falling within the definitions of beneficial owner in ¶¶4.4.6-4.4.8, the MSO should identify the relevant natural persons who hold the position of senior managing official, and take reasonable measures to verify their identities — the Guideline does not allow the legal person to stand in as its own beneficial owner, does not require declining the relationship, and does not permit simply recording an absence and stopping there.

tc.q: 如就法人客戶而言並無自然人符合實益擁有人的定義，該經營者應怎樣做？
options: 識別高級管理人員並核實其身分
視該法人本身為其自身的實益擁有人
完全拒絕與該客戶建立業務關係
記錄並無實益擁有人，且不再採取步驟
tc.explain: 第4.4.9段訂明，如並無自然人符合第4.4.6至4.4.8段所載實益擁有人的定義，該經營者應識別擔任高級管理人員職位的有關自然人，並採取合理措施核實其身分；本指引並不容許以該法人本身作為其自身的實益擁有人，亦不要求拒絕該客戶關係，更不容許純粹記錄並無實益擁有人後即不再採取任何步驟。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.11段

en.q: For a customer that is a trust, whom should an MSO identify as beneficial owners?
options: The settlor, the trustee, any protector or enforcer, the beneficiaries, and any other controller
The settlor, trustee and beneficiaries, but not, under s.4.4.11, any protector or enforcer
