Only the beneficiaries who are currently receiving actual distributions from the trust fund
Only the trustee, because it is treated as the sole legal owner of the trust property
en.explain: ¶4.4.11 requires an MSO, for a customer that is a trust, to identify the settlor, the trustee, any protector, any enforcer, the beneficiaries or class of beneficiaries, and any other natural person exercising ultimate control including through a chain of control or ownership; a list that leaves out the protector and enforcer is incomplete, and narrowing the group to only current distributees or only the trustee falls well short of the full ¶4.4.11 list.

tc.q: 就屬信託的客戶，金錢服務經營者應識別何人為實益擁有人？
options: 財產授予人、受託人、保護人或執行人、受益人及其他控制人
財產授予人、受託人、受益人，但不包括保護人或執行人
只需現時實際正在收取信託基金分派的受益人
只需受託人，因其被視為信託財產的唯一法律擁有人
tc.explain: 第4.4.11段規定就屬信託的客戶，該經營者應識別財產授予人、受託人、保護人（如有）、執行人（如有）、受益人或某類受益人，以及對該信託行使最終控制權（包括透過控制或擁有權鏈）的任何其他自然人；遺漏保護人及執行人的名單並不完整，只限現時受分派的受益人或只限受託人，均遠遠未達第4.4.11段所列的完整範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.12段

en.q: Where a trust beneficiary is designated by characteristics or by class, what must the MSO obtain?
options: Sufficient information to establish the beneficiary's identity at payout or when rights vest
The full identification details of every conceivable beneficiary, obtained immediately (s.4.4.6)
A court order formally naming each beneficiary of the class
Nothing further at this stage, since the class of beneficiaries is not yet ascertained
en.explain: ¶4.4.12 states that for a beneficiary of a trust designated by characteristics or by class, an MSO should obtain sufficient information concerning the beneficiary to satisfy itself that it will be able to establish the beneficiary's identity at the time of payout or when the beneficiary intends to exercise vested rights — footnote 29 gives ascertaining and naming the scope of the class as an example; full details up front, a court order, and doing nothing at all are all incorrect.

tc.q: 如信託受益人是以特徵或類別指定，該經營者須取得甚麼？
options: 充分資料，確定受益人於派款或行使權利時的身分
即時取得每名可能受益人的完整身分識別詳情（甲）
一份正式列明每名受益人的法院命令
現階段無須再取得任何資料，因該類別尚未確定
tc.explain: 第4.4.12段訂明，如信託受益人是以特徵或類別指定，該經營者應取得關於該受益人的充分資料，以令其信納能在派款時或該受益人擬行使既得權利時確定該受益人的身分；註腳29以確定並列明該類受益人的範圍為例；即時取得完整詳情、取得法院命令，或完全不再取得資料，均非正確做法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.13段

en.q: What is the stated objective of understanding a non-natural-person customer's ownership and control structure?
options: To trace the chain of ownership to the customer's beneficial owners
To identify the customer's single largest registered shareholder
To assign an ML/TF risk rating to the ownership structure itself
To confirm the structure matches the customer's constitutional documents
en.explain: ¶4.4.13 states that where a customer is not a natural person, an MSO should understand its ownership and control structure, including identification of any intermediate layers, and that the objective is to follow the chain of ownership to the beneficial owners of the customer — not to find the single largest shareholder, assign a risk rating to the structure itself, or check the structure against constitutional documents, none of which this paragraph mentions.

tc.q: 了解非自然人客戶的擁有權及控制權架構，其訂明目的為何？
options: 沿整條擁有權鏈追溯至該客戶的實益擁有人
識別該客戶名冊上登記的最大單一股東
為該架構評定洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險級別
確認該架構是否完全符合客戶的憲章文件
tc.explain: 第4.4.13段訂明，如客戶並非自然人，該經營者應了解其擁有權及控制權架構，包括識別任何中間層級；其目的是沿擁有權鏈追溯至該客戶的實益擁有人——並非找出最大單一股東、為該架構本身評定風險級別，或核對該架構是否符合憲章文件，這些均非該段所述的目的。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.14段

en.q: What should an MSO obtain where a customer has a complex ownership or control structure?
options: Enough information to be satisfied there is a legitimate reason for it
A formal legal opinion on the structure's validity
The specific tax rulings applicable to each entity in the structure
An undertaking from the customer to simplify the structure
en.explain: ¶4.4.14 states that where a customer has a complex ownership or control structure, an MSO should obtain sufficient information for the MSO to satisfy itself that there is a legitimate reason behind the particular structure employed — not a formal legal opinion, tax rulings for each entity, or an undertaking to simplify, none of which the paragraph requires.

tc.q: 如客戶的擁有權或控制權架構複雜，該經營者應取得甚麼？
options: 充分資料以信納該架構有合法理由
就該架構的有效性取得法律意見
適用於架構中每個實體的稅務裁定
客戶承諾將簡化該架構的正式保證
tc.explain: 第4.4.14段訂明，如客戶的擁有權或控制權架構複雜，該經營者應取得充分資料，以令其信納採用該特定架構背後有合法理由；並非正式法律意見、每個實體的稅務裁定，或客戶簡化架構的保證，該段並無此等規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.15段

en.q: Why do bearer shares present a particular difficulty for beneficial ownership, and what should an MSO do?
options: Ownership follows possession of the certificate, with no traceability; the MSO should identify owners and require notice of changes
Because they are automatically converted to registered shares after one year; the MSO should treat them as ordinary shares
Because they carry no voting rights and no dividend entitlement; the MSO should disregard such shares entirely
Because they are always held through an overseas custodian; the MSO should automatically apply enhanced due diligence
en.explain: ¶4.4.15 explains that bearer shares are negotiable instruments that accord ownership in a legal person to whoever possesses the physical certificate, and any similar instrument without traceability, making it harder to establish beneficial ownership; the MSO should adopt procedures to establish the identities of the beneficial owners of such shares and ensure it is notified of any change of beneficial owner. The Guideline provides for no automatic conversion to registered shares, does not say bearer shares carry no voting or dividend rights, and does not say they are always held overseas.

tc.q: 不記名股份為何在實益擁有權方面構成特別困難？該經營者應怎樣做？
options: 擁有權隨實物證書管有而定，缺乏可追溯性；經營者須識別實益擁有人並獲悉變更
因其在一年後會自動轉換為記名股份；該經營者應將其視為普通記名股份處理
因其並無投票權及股息權；該經營者應完全不予理會此等股份
因其一律透過海外託管人持有；該經營者應自動採取加強盡職審查
tc.explain: 第4.4.15段解釋不記名股份是將法人的擁有權賦予持有實物不記名股票的人的可轉讓票據，以及任何其他缺乏可追溯性的類似票據，因此較難確定其實益擁有權；該經營者應採用程序確定該等股份實益擁有人的身分，並確保在有變更時獲通知。本指引並無規定不記名股份會於一年後自動轉換為記名股份，亦無指其一律無投票權或股息權，或一律經海外託管人持有。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.16段

en.q: Where bearer shares have been deposited with an authorised or registered custodian, what should an MSO seek?
options: Independent evidence of the custody, plus the custodian's and rights-holder's identities
A copy of the physical bearer share certificate itself, and nothing more
A statutory declaration signed by the customer under s.4.4.16, without any external confirmation
Nothing further, since deposit with a custodian by itself removes all risk
en.explain: ¶4.4.16 states that where bearer shares have been deposited with an authorised/registered custodian, an MSO should seek independent evidence of this — for example confirmation from the registered agent that a custodian holds the shares — together with the identities of the custodian and the person who has the right to the entitlements carried by the share, and should obtain evidence to confirm the custodian as part of its ongoing periodic review; a bare certificate copy, a customer-only declaration, or doing nothing further are each insufficient.

tc.q: 如不記名股份已存放於獲授權／註冊託管人處，該經營者應尋求甚麼？
options: 存放的獨立證據，連同託管人及權益持有人的身分
該不記名股份股票本身的副本，僅此而已
僅由客戶簽署的法定聲明，不涉任何外部確認
無須再取得任何東西，因存放於託管人已消除所有風險
tc.explain: 第4.4.16段訂明，如不記名股份已存放於獲授權／註冊託管人處，該經營者應尋求就此事的獨立證據（例如註冊代理人確認該託管人持有該等股份），連同該託管人的身分及有權享有該股份所附權益的人的身分，並應在持續定期檢視中取得證據以確認該託管人；只取股票副本、只取客戶聲明，或不再採取任何步驟，均屬不足夠。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.17段

en.q: Where bearer shares are NOT deposited with an authorised or registered custodian, what should an MSO obtain?
options: Declarations from each beneficial owner before account opening and annually thereafter
A single declaration obtained under s.4.4.16, only at the time the account is opened
Confirmation obtained from the company's external auditors every year
The MSO taking physical custody of the share certificates itself
en.explain: ¶4.4.17 states that where the shares are not deposited with an authorised/registered custodian, an MSO should obtain declarations prior to account opening and annually thereafter from each beneficial owner of such shares, and should also require the customer to notify it immediately of any changes in the ownership of the shares; a one-off declaration, yearly auditor confirmation, and the MSO taking custody itself are each not what this paragraph requires.

tc.q: 如不記名股份「並無」存放於獲授權／註冊託管人處，該經營者應取得甚麼？
options: 在開戶前及其後每年向實益擁有人取得聲明
只在開立帳戶當刻一次性取得聲明
每年取得該公司外聘核數師的確認
由該經營者本身實物保管該等股票
tc.explain: 第4.4.17段訂明，如該等股份並無存放於獲授權／註冊託管人處，該經營者應在開立帳戶前及其後每年，向每名該等股份的實益擁有人取得聲明；亦應要求客戶在該等股份的擁有權有任何變更時即時通知該經營者；只在開戶時取得一次聲明、每年取得核數師確認，或由該經營者本身保管股票，均非該段的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.18段

en.q: What should an MSO obtain where a customer's ownership structure includes nominee shareholders?
options: Evidence of the nominees' identities, who they act for, and their arrangement details
Only satisfactory evidence of the identities of the nominees themselves
Only a signed copy of the nominee agreement, without further evidence
Written confirmation from the company secretary that nominees are used under section 4.4.17
en.explain: ¶4.4.18 states that for a customer identified to have nominee shareholders in its ownership structure, an MSO should obtain satisfactory evidence of the identities of the nominees, and the persons on whose behalf they are acting, as well as the details of arrangements in place, in order to determine who the beneficial owner is; the identities of the nominees alone, a bare agreement copy, or a company secretary's confirmation each capture only part, or none, of what this paragraph requires.

tc.q: 如客戶的擁有權架構包含代名股東，該經營者應取得甚麼？
options: 代名人及背後人士的身分證據，以及安排詳情
只需證明該等代名人身分本身的證據
只需已簽署的代名協議副本，不涉其他證據
公司秘書確認有使用代名人的書面文件（副本）
tc.explain: 第4.4.18段訂明，如客戶被識別為其擁有權架構中有代名股東，該經營者應取得令人信納的證據，證明該等代名人的身分及其代其行事的人的身分，以及現行安排的詳情，以斷定何人是實益擁有人；只證明代名人身分、只取協議副本，或只取公司秘書確認，均只涵蓋部分或完全未涵蓋該段的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.5.1段

en.q: On what basis should an MSO determine whether a person is a person purporting to act on behalf of the customer?
options: Based on the nature of the person's role, the activities authorised, and the ML/TF risks involved
Based, under s.4.5.1, on the person's job title and the length of the business relationship with the customer
Based on the transaction amount involved and whether the person is a Hong Kong resident
Based on whether the person holds a power of attorney and the customer's own risk rating
en.explain: ¶4.5.1 states that whether a person is considered to be a PPTA should be determined based on the nature of that person's roles and the activities which the person is authorised to conduct, as well as the ML/TF risks associated with these roles and activities, under clear policies and procedures; job title and relationship length, transaction amount and residency, and power of attorney plus the customer's risk rating are each not the test this paragraph sets.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應按甚麼基準斷定某人是否聲稱代客戶行事的人？
options: 按該人角色性質、獲授權活動及相關洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險而定
按該人的職銜高低，以及其與客戶業務關係持續的年期而定（4.5.1段）
按有關交易涉及的金額多寡，以及該人是否香港居民而定
按該人是否持有書面授權書，以及客戶本身的風險評級而定
tc.explain: 第4.5.1段訂明，某人是否被視為聲稱代客戶行事的人，應按該人角色的性質及其獲授權進行的活動，以及與該等角色及活動相關的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險而定，並須有清晰的政策及程序；職銜高低及關係年期、交易金額及居民身分，以及授權書及客戶風險評級，均非該段訂明的判斷基準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.5.4段

en.q: How should an MSO verify the authority of a person purporting to act on behalf of a customer?
options: By appropriate documentary evidence, such as a board resolution
By accepting the person's own oral confirmation alone
By reference to the person's identity document alone, with nothing more
By way of a telephone confirmation obtained from the customer
en.explain: ¶4.5.4 states that an MSO should verify the authority of each PPTA by appropriate documentary evidence, giving a board resolution or similar written authorization as an example. ¶4.5.3 separately requires identification and verification of the PPTA's own identity in line with the requirements for a natural or legal person — oral confirmation, an identity document alone, or a telephone call to the customer are not what ¶4.5.4 itself requires to verify authority.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應如何核實聲稱代客戶行事的人的權限？
options: 以適當的文件證據核實，例如董事會決議
純粹接受該人本身的口頭確認
只憑該人的身分證明文件，不涉其他證據
以向客戶取得的電話確認核實
tc.explain: 第4.5.4段訂明該經營者應以適當的文件證據核實每名聲稱代客戶行事的人的權限，並以董事會決議或類似的書面授權為例。第4.5.3段則另行規定須按適用於自然人或法人的規定，識別及核實該人本身的身分——口頭確認、只憑身分證明文件，或向客戶取得的電話確認，均非第4.5.4段核實權限本身的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.6.1段

en.q: To what should the information obtained about the purpose and intended nature of a business relationship be commensurate, and what additional step applies to non-natural persons?
options: Commensurate with the customer's risk profile and relationship's nature; also business if non-natural
Commensurate with the total transaction amount alone; no additional step applies to non-natural persons
Commensurate with how long the relationship has lasted; the MSO should also obtain audited annual accounts
Commensurate with the MSO's own size and resources; the MSO should also obtain a written business plan
en.explain: ¶4.6.1 states that an MSO must understand the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship; that in some instances this will be self-evident but in many cases information must be obtained; that the information obtained should be commensurate with the risk profile of the customer and the nature of the business relationship; and that where a customer is not a natural person, the MSO should also understand the nature of the customer's business.

tc.q: 就業務關係的目的及擬有性質所取得的資料，應與甚麼相稱？就非自然人另有甚麼步驟？
options: 與客戶的風險狀況及業務關係性質相稱；非自然人另須了解其業務
只與該筆交易的金額相稱；對非自然人並無任何額外步驟
與業務關係維持的年期相稱；該經營者亦須取得經審計的年度帳目
與該經營者本身的規模及資源相稱；該經營者亦須取得書面業務計劃
tc.explain: 第4.6.1段訂明該經營者必須了解業務關係的目的及擬有性質；在某些情況下此屬不言而喻，但在許多情況下須取得資料；所取得的資料應與該客戶的風險狀況及該業務關係的性質相稱；如客戶並非自然人，該經營者亦應了解該客戶業務的性質。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.2段

en.q: Which two examples does the Guideline give of situations where it may be necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business?
options: Securities transactions requiring rapid execution; and life insurance, verifying the beneficiary
Currency exchange conducted at a busy counter during peak hours; and remittances sent just before a public holiday
Transactions for long-standing pre-existing customers; and any single transaction below the $8,000 threshold
Transactions conducted entirely online; and any transaction settled entirely in a foreign currency
en.explain: ¶4.7.2 gives as examples securities transactions, where companies and intermediaries may be required to perform transactions very rapidly according to market conditions at the time the customer contacts them; and life insurance business, in relation to identification and verification of the beneficiary under the policy, which may take place after the relationship with the policy holder is established but must occur at or before payout or the exercise of vested rights.

tc.q: 本指引就「為免打斷正常業務往來而有此需要」舉出哪兩個例子？
options: 證券交易——須按市況迅速執行；以及人壽保險——核實受益人
繁忙櫃檯高峰時段的貨幣兌換；以及在公眾假期前夕寄出的匯款
先前客戶的長期交易；以及任何低於8,000元門檻的單一交易
完全在網上進行的交易；以及完全以外幣結算的交易
tc.explain: 第4.7.2段所舉例子為：證券交易——證券業的公司及中介人可能須按客戶接觸他們時的市場情況極迅速地執行交易，而交易的執行可能須在完成身分核實之前進行；以及人壽保險業務——就保單受益人的識別及核實而言，該等程序可在與保單持有人建立業務關係後進行，但在所有該等情況下，均須於派款時或受益人擬行使保單既得權利時或之前進行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.3(a)段

en.q: What must an MSO's risk management policies establish where verification is deferred?
options: A reasonable timeframe for completing verification, with follow-up action if exceeded
A fixed period of five years, matching the minimum record-retention period under Schedule 2
A fixed period of three years, matching the minimum retention period for staff training records
No fixed timeframe at all — action is required only once the MSO actually knows of ML/TF
en.explain: ¶4.7.3(a) requires the MSO's risk management policies and procedures to include establishing a reasonable timeframe for the completion of the identity verification measures and the follow-up actions if the timeframe is exceeded — for example to suspend or terminate the business relationship concerned. This timeframe is set by the MSO's own policy; the Guideline does not tie it to the separate 5-year document-retention period (Schedule 2, s.20) or the 3-year training-record retention period, and the duty to set it does not depend on the MSO first acquiring actual knowledge of ML/TF.

tc.q: 如核實身分延後進行，該經營者的風險管理政策須訂立甚麼？
options: 完成核實身分的合理時限；以及超逾時限的跟進行動
訂為固定五年期限，與附表2所定的最低保存紀錄期完全相同
訂為固定三年期限，與員工培訓紀錄的最低保存期完全相同
並無固定時限——只在確實知悉洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集時方須行動
tc.explain: 第4.7.3(a)段規定該經營者的風險管理政策及程序須包括訂立完成身分核實措施的合理時限，以及超逾該時限時的跟進行動（例如暫停或終止有關業務關係）。該時限由該經營者自行按政策訂定；本指引並無將其與附表2第20條所訂的5年文件保存期，或員工培訓紀錄的3年保存期掛鈎，而訂立時限的責任亦不以該經營者已實際知悉洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集為前提。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.3(b)、(c)及(d)段

en.q: Which three further controls should apply while verification remains outstanding?
options: Limits on transaction number, type and amount; monitoring large or complex transactions outside the norm; and periodic updates to senior management
A reasonable timeframe for completing verification; limits on the number, type and amount of transactions; and ensuring funds are not paid to third parties
A reasonable timeframe for completing verification; monitoring large or complex transactions outside the expected norm; and periodic updates to senior management
Limits on the number, type and amount of transactions; periodic updates to senior management; and the CCE's prior written approval for each transaction
en.explain: ¶4.7.3 requires the policies to include placing appropriate limits on the number, types and/or amount of transactions that can be performed; monitoring of large and complex transactions being carried out outside the expected norms for that type of relationship; and keeping senior management periodically informed of any pending completion cases — sub-paragraphs (b), (c) and (d). Each distractor substitutes a real requirement from a neighbouring sub-paragraph — (a)'s reasonable timeframe, or (e)'s rule on not paying third parties — for one of the correct three.

tc.q: 在核實仍未完成期間，應施加哪三項進一步管控？
options: 就交易的數目、類型及金額設定限制；監察超出常規的大額或複雜交易；以及定期向高級管理層通報
訂立完成核實的合理時限；就交易的數目、類型及金額設定限制；以及確保不向第三方支付款項
訂立完成核實的合理時限；監察超出預期常規的大額或複雜交易；以及定期向高級管理層通報
就可進行的交易數目、種類及金額設定限制；定期向高級管理層彙報；以及每宗交易均須事先取得關長的書面批准
tc.explain: 第4.7.3段規定該等政策須包括（b）就可進行交易的數目、類型及／或金額設定適當限制；（c）監察超出該類關係預期常規的大額及複雜交易；以及（d）定期向高級管理層通報任何尚待完成的個案。三個錯誤選項各以鄰近條文的真實規定——(a)的合理時限，或(e)的不得向第三方付款規定——取代三項正確規定之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.3(e)段

en.q: While verification remains outstanding, what is the general rule about paying funds to third parties, and on what conditions may an exception be made?
options: No payment to any third party, except with no ML/TF suspicion, an assessed low risk, senior management approval, and no watch-list match
Payments to third parties are permitted without restriction, provided the MSO records the recipient's name and address
Payments to third parties are permitted for any amount up to $8,000, without senior management approval
Payments to third parties are permitted once the customer gives written consent and the MSO's compliance officer is notified within 3 business days
en.explain: ¶4.7.3(e) requires ensuring that funds are not paid out to any third party, with exceptions permitted only where there is no suspicion of ML/TF; the risk of ML/TF is assessed to be low; the transaction is approved by senior management taking account of the nature of the customer's business; and the names of recipients do not match watch lists such as those for terrorist suspects and PEPs. Recording a recipient's details, an $8,000 cap, and written consent to the CO are none of them a stated basis for the exception.

tc.q: 在核實仍未完成期間，就向第三方付款的一般規則為何？在甚麼條件下可作例外？
options: 不得向第三方付款，除非無洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集懷疑、風險屬低、經高級管理層批准，且不在監察名單上
可無限制地向任何第三方付款，惟該經營者須記錄收款人的姓名、住址、聯絡電話及付款原因
可向第三方支付最多8,000元的款項，且無須經高級管理層事先批准或留存任何紀錄
只要客戶已就此事書面同意並須於3個工作日內以書面方式通知該經營者的合規主任，任何金額均可向第三方付款
tc.explain: 第4.7.3(e)段規定須確保不會向任何第三方支付款項；只有在下列情況下方可作例外：並無洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑；有關風險經評估為低；該交易經高級管理層批准（批准前應顧及該客戶業務的性質）；以及收款人姓名並無與懷疑恐怖分子及政治人物等監察名單吻合。記錄收款人資料、8,000元上限，或知會合規主任並取得書面同意，均非該段所定的例外基礎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.4段

en.q: If verification cannot be completed within the reasonable timeframe, what must the MSO do?
options: End the relationship promptly; stop transactions except to return funds or assets in original form
Continue the relationship as normal, but cap the amount of all further transactions at $8,000 per transaction
Suspend further activity and formally refer the customer to another licensed MSO to complete verification
Grant the customer one further extension of the timeframe, provided senior management approves it in writing
en.explain: ¶4.7.4 states that if verification cannot be completed within the reasonable timeframe set in the MSO's risk management policies, the MSO should terminate the business relationship as soon as reasonably practicable and refrain from carrying out further transactions, except to return funds or other assets in their original forms as far as possible. Capping transactions, referring the customer elsewhere, and a senior-management-approved extension are none of them the stated response.

tc.q: 如未能在合理時限內完成核實，該經營者須怎樣做？
options: 在合理可行範圍內盡快終止關係並停止交易，惟可退還原有形式的資產
照常繼續該關係，但將所有進一步交易的金額上限定為每宗8,000元正
暫停進一步活動，並正式將客戶轉介另一持牌經營者以完成核實
給予客戶一次時限延長，惟須經高級管理層書面批准
tc.explain: 第4.7.4段訂明，如未能在該經營者風險管理政策及程序所訂的合理時限內完成核實，該經營者應在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止該業務關係，並停止進行進一步交易（但可在盡可能範圍內以原有形式退還資金或其他資產）。將交易設限、轉介客戶，或經批准延長時限，均非該段所定的做法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.4段

en.q: In which circumstances does the Guideline particularly flag the need to consider filing an STR after a failed verification?
options: Where the customer asks for funds sent to a third party or 'transformed' without reason
Where the customer structures one large transaction into many smaller transactions to stay under the CDD threshold
Where the customer simply stops responding to any of the MSO's further correspondence or requests
Where the transaction is a 'U-turn' remittance back to the very same foreign jurisdiction it came from
en.explain: ¶4.7.4 states that the MSO should assess whether the failure to complete verification provides grounds for knowledge or suspicion of ML/TF and consider making an STR to the JFIU, particularly if the customer requests that funds or other assets be transferred to a third party or be transformed — for example from cash into a cashier order — without a justifiable reason. Structuring and 'U-turn' remittances are suspicious-transaction indicators discussed elsewhere in the Guideline, not the specific trigger ¶4.7.4 names.

tc.q: 核實失敗後，本指引特別提示在哪種情況下須考慮提交可疑交易報告？
options: 客戶無理由下要求將資金轉予第三方或「轉化」（如現金轉本票）
客戶將一宗大額交易拆細為多宗小額交易，以規避客戶盡職審查門檻
客戶對該經營者其後的所有查詢及要求一概不再回應
該宗交易屬「回轉」匯款，即匯回資金原先來自的同一境外司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第4.7.4段訂明該經營者應評估未能完成核實一事是否構成知悉或懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的理由，並考慮向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告；尤其當客戶在並無合理理由下，要求將資金或其他資產轉予第三方或加以「轉化」（例如由現金轉為銀行本票）時。拆細交易及「回轉」匯款屬本指引其他部分所述的可疑交易指標，並非第4.7.4段特別指明的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.3段

en.q: In which three circumstances should simplified due diligence measures not be applied, or not continue to be applied?
options: Where risk assessment changes and low risk no longer applies; where ML/TF is suspected; and where doubts arise about documents' accuracy
Where the customer is a corporation; where the customer is based overseas; and where any single transaction exceeds $8,000
Where the customer has held the account under a year; where the customer deals mainly in cash; and where an agent introduced them
Where the MSO changes its compliance officer; where the licence is renewed; and where the Commissioner conducts an inspection
en.explain: ¶4.8.3 states that SDD measures should not be applied or continue to be applied where the MSO's risk assessment changes and it no longer considers there is a low degree of ML/TF risk; where the MSO suspects ML or TF; or where there are doubts about the veracity or accuracy of documents or information previously obtained for identification or verification purposes.

tc.q: 在哪三種情況下不應採用或不應繼續採用簡化盡職審查措施？
options: 風險有變致不再認為低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險；懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集；文件準確性存疑
客戶是在海外註冊的法團；客戶本身身處海外；以及單一交易金額超過8,000元正
客戶開立帳戶未滿一年；客戶主要以現金方式交易；以及客戶由收取佣金的代理引介
該經營者近期更換其合規主任一職；牌照剛獲續期；以及關長剛完成一次視察
tc.explain: 第4.8.3段訂明在下列情況下不應採用或不應繼續採用簡化盡職審查措施：該經營者的風險評估有變，不再認為屬洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集低風險；該經營者懷疑涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集；或對先前為識別或核實而取得的文件或資料的真確性或準確性存疑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.6段

en.q: What obligation, if any, does an MSO retain after applying simplified due diligence measures?
options: It must still continuously monitor the relationship (ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring) under Schedule 2
It has no further monitoring obligation at all while the SDD measures remain in place
It must monitor the relationship, but only once the customer's own risk category later changes at the annual review
It must monitor the relationship, but only once a year, under Schedule 2 to the AMLO
en.explain: ¶4.8.6 states that when an MSO applies SDD measures, it is still required to continuously monitor its business relationship — that is, ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring — in accordance with section 5 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 5 of the Guideline. Monitoring is not suspended, is not conditional on a later change in risk category, and is not merely annual.

tc.q: 採用簡化盡職審查後，金錢服務經營者仍保留甚麼責任？
options: 仍須按附表2持續監察業務關係，即持續客戶盡職審查及交易監察
在採用簡化盡職審查期間，並無任何進一步的監察責任
只在客戶的風險類別於每年一度周年檢視時有變，方須監察該業務關係
按《打擊洗錢條例》附表2，只須每年監察該業務關係一次
tc.explain: 第4.8.6段訂明，當該經營者採用簡化盡職審查措施時，仍須按附表2第5條及本指引第5章，持續監察其業務關係（即進行持續客戶盡職審查及交易監察）；監察並非暫停進行，亦不以風險類別其後有變為前提，更非僅屬每年一次。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.7(a)段

en.q: Which of the following is given as a potentially lower risk customer factor?
options: A corporation listed on an exchange, subject to rules ensuring beneficial-ownership transparency
Any corporation registered in Hong Kong that employs more than 100 staff
Any customer who has held an account with the MSO continuously for over five years, no late repayment
Any customer who was personally introduced to the MSO by an existing customer
en.explain: ¶4.8.7(a) gives as potentially lower risk customer factors a government entity or public body in Hong Kong or an equivalent jurisdiction; a corporation listed on a stock exchange and subject to disclosure requirements ensuring adequate transparency of beneficial ownership; an FI as defined in the AMLO or another FI in an equivalent jurisdiction supervised for AML/CFT compliance consistent with FATF standards; and a collective investment scheme authorised for public offering in Hong Kong or an equivalent jurisdiction.

tc.q: 下列何者獲舉為可能屬較低風險的客戶因素？
options: 在證券市場上市、受披露規定規限以確保實益擁有權透明的法團
任何在香港註冊成立、僱員人數超過100人的私人法團
任何在該經營者處持續開立帳戶已超過五年、從未逾期還款的客戶
任何由現有客戶親自引介予該經營者的全新客戶
tc.explain: 第4.8.7(a)段所舉可能屬較低風險的客戶因素包括：香港或同等司法管轄區的政府實體或公共機構；在證券市場上市並受確保實益擁有權有足夠透明度的披露規定所規限的法團；《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構，或在同等司法管轄區成立並按財務行動特別組織標準受監管的其他金融機構；以及獲認可可在香港或同等司法管轄區公開發售的集體投資計劃。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.7(c)段

en.q: Which country risk factors are given as potentially lower risk?
options: Countries credible sources identify as having effective AML/CFT systems, or lower corruption or crime
Countries that have signed and formally ratified a double taxation agreement with the Hong Kong government
Countries in which the MSO already has an established local agent or branch office
Countries whose local currency is freely and fully convertible on every world foreign-exchange market
en.explain: ¶4.8.7(c) gives as potentially lower risk country factors countries or jurisdictions identified by credible sources — such as mutual evaluation or detailed assessment reports — as having effective AML/CFT Systems, or identified by credible sources as having a lower level of corruption or other criminal activity. A tax treaty, an established agent, or currency convertibility are not the stated factors.

tc.q: 哪些國家風險因素獲舉為可能屬較低風險？
options: 經可信來源識別為具備有效打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集系統，或貪污罪案較低的國家
與香港政府已正式簽署並且已互相批准避免雙重徵稅協定的國家或地區
該經營者本身已在當地長期設有委任代理人或分行辦事處的國家或地區
當地法定貨幣可在國際外匯市場自由及全面地兌換的任何國家或地區
tc.explain: 第4.8.7(c)段所舉可能屬較低風險的國家因素為：經可信來源（例如相互評估或詳細評估報告）識別為具備有效打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集系統的國家或司法管轄區；或經可信來源識別為貪污或其他犯罪活動程度較低的國家或司法管轄區。避免雙重徵稅協定、已設代理，或貨幣可自由兌換，均非本段所定的因素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.8段

en.q: Which of the following is given as an example of a possible simplified due diligence measure?
options: Reducing the frequency of updates to customer ID information
Omitting identification of the customer entirely, in every single case
Dispensing with all transaction records for that particular customer
Waiving the requirement to screen the customer against sanctions lists
en.explain: ¶4.8.8 gives as examples of possible SDD measures accepting other documents for customers in the listed categories; adopting simplified CDD in relation to beneficial owners; reducing the frequency of updates of customer identification information; reducing the degree of ongoing monitoring and scrutiny of transactions based on a reasonable monetary threshold; and inferring the purpose and intended nature from the type of transactions or relationship rather than collecting specific information.

tc.q: 下列何者獲舉為可行的簡化盡職審查措施例子？
options: 減低更新客戶身分識別資料的頻次
在任何情況下均完全不識別該客戶
完全免除該特定客戶的所有交易紀錄
豁免將該客戶與制裁名單進行篩查的規定
tc.explain: 第4.8.8段所舉可行的簡化盡職審查措施例子包括：就所列類別的客戶接受其他文件；就實益擁有人採用簡化客戶盡職審查；減低更新客戶身分識別資料的頻次；按合理的金額門檻減低持續監察及審視交易的程度；以及不另行收集特定資料，而從交易或業務關係的類型推斷其目的及擬有性質。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.11段

en.q: A customer that does not itself qualify for the beneficial ownership exemption has, in its ownership chain, an entity that does. What is the MSO's obligation?
options: Need not verify that entity's beneficial owners, only other unconnected chain members
The whole customer automatically qualifies for the beneficial-ownership exemption, chain-wide
The MSO must apply enhanced due diligence to every entity throughout the entire ownership chain
The MSO must decline to establish the business relationship with the customer altogether
en.explain: ¶4.8.11 states that if a customer not falling within ¶4.8.10 has in its ownership chain an entity that does fall within it, the MSO is not required to identify or verify the beneficial owners of that entity in that chain when establishing a business relationship with or carrying out an occasional transaction for the customer, but should still identify and take reasonable measures to verify the identity of beneficial owners in the ownership chain that are not connected with that entity.

tc.q: 某客戶本身不符合實益擁有人豁免資格，但其擁有權鏈中有一實體符合。該經營者有何責任？
options: 無須核實實體的實益擁有人，但仍須核實鏈中與實體無關連的其他實益擁有人
整名客戶均自動符合實益擁有人豁免資格，涵蓋其整條擁有權鏈在內
該經營者須對整條擁有權鏈中的每一個實體一律採取加強盡職審查程序
該經營者須完全拒絕與該名客戶建立任何形式的業務關係，不論風險評估結果如何
tc.explain: 第4.8.11段訂明，如不屬第4.8.10段範圍的客戶，其擁有權鏈中有屬該段範圍的實體，該經營者在與該客戶建立業務關係或為其進行非經常交易時，無須識別或核實該鏈中該實體的實益擁有人；但仍應識別並採取合理措施核實該擁有權鏈中與該實體並無關連的實益擁有人的身分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.12段

en.q: Before relying on the listed-corporation exemption from beneficial ownership identification, what should an MSO assess?
options: Whether the customer is subject to rules ensuring beneficial-ownership transparency
Whether the customer's shares are actively and regularly traded on the exchange
Whether the customer's market capitalisation exceeds a prescribed threshold
Whether the customer is listed in Hong Kong specifically, rather than overseas
en.explain: ¶4.8.12 states that where a customer is a corporation listed on any stock exchange, an MSO may choose not to identify or verify its beneficial owners, and that for this purpose the MSO should assess whether the customer is subject to any disclosure requirements — either by stock exchange rules, or through law or enforceable means — which impose requirements to ensure adequate transparency of beneficial ownership of the customer.

tc.q: 在倚賴上市法團的實益擁有人識別豁免前，該經營者應評估甚麼？
options: 客戶是否受確保實益擁有權透明的披露規定所限
該客戶的股份在交易所是否活躍及經常交投
該客戶的市值是否超過訂明的監管門檻
該客戶是否在香港交易所（而非海外）上市
tc.explain: 第4.8.12段訂明，如客戶是在任何證券市場上市的法團，該經營者可選擇不識別或不採取合理措施核實其實益擁有人；為此，該經營者應評估該客戶是否受任何披露規定（透過交易所規則，或透過法律或可強制執行的方式）所規限，而該等規定確保該客戶的實益擁有權有足夠透明度。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.13段

en.q: Where a financial institution customer opens an account in the name of a nominee company or an investment vehicle, on what two conditions may the MSO omit beneficial ownership identification?
options: The FI has conducted CDD on the underlying customers or the vehicle, and is authorised to operate the account
The FI is incorporated in Hong Kong and has been profitable for five consecutive financial years, per its latest audit
The account balance is below a prescribed threshold and the account is currently dormant
The FI provides a written indemnity and the nominee company is publicly listed somewhere
en.explain: ¶4.8.13 permits the omission where the customer is an FI as defined in the AMLO opening an account in the name of a nominee company holding fund units, or in the name of an investment vehicle in the capacity of a service provider, provided the FI has conducted CDD on its underlying customers or on the investment vehicle as the case requires, and is authorised to operate the account as evidenced by contractual document or agreement.

tc.q: 如屬金融機構的客戶以代名公司或投資工具名義開立帳戶，該經營者在哪兩項條件下可省略識別實益擁有人？
options: 該金融機構已就相關客戶或該投資工具進行客戶盡職審查，並獲授權操作該帳戶
該金融機構在香港註冊成立已逾十五年，並按最新核數報告連續五年錄得可觀盈利
帳戶結餘一直低於訂明門檻，且該帳戶現時已處於不活躍狀態
該金融機構提供書面彌償保證，並且該代名公司在某地已公開上市
tc.explain: 第4.8.13段准許在下列情況省略：客戶是《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構，並以代名公司名義（為其本身或其相關客戶持有基金單位）或以服務提供者身分（例如經理人或託管人）就投資工具開立帳戶；前提是該金融機構已按情況就其相關客戶或該投資工具進行客戶盡職審查，並有合約文件或協議證明其獲授權操作該帳戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.1段

en.q: What is the general rule about carrying out CDD measures, before the simplified due diligence exceptions apply?
options: All four CDD measures before any relationship/occasional transaction, plus RBA-based monitoring
Select which of the four CDD measures to apply, case by case, at the MSO's own discretion
Carry out CDD only where a single transaction's value exceeds $120,000 in total
CDD obligations only arise once the business relationship has already been formally established
en.explain: ¶4.8.1 states that in general an MSO should carry out all four CDD measures set out in ¶4.1.3 before establishing any business relationship, before carrying out a specified occasional transaction, and continuously monitor its business relationship — with the extent of those measures and of ongoing monitoring determined using an RBA.

tc.q: 在簡化盡職審查例外情況適用之前，進行客戶盡職審查措施的一般規則為何？
options: 建立業務關係或非經常交易前須進行四項盡職審查措施，並按風險監察
該經營者可自行決定每宗個案採用四項措施中的哪幾項，全由其酌情決定
只在單一交易的總金額超過120,000元時，方須進行客戶盡職審查
客戶盡職審查的責任，只在業務關係已經正式建立後方告產生
tc.explain: 第4.8.1段訂明一般而言，該經營者應在建立任何業務關係前、進行指明非經常交易前，進行第4.1.3段所列全部四項客戶盡職審查措施，並持續監察其業務關係；如第2章所述，四項措施及持續監察的程度應以風險為本方式決定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.4及4.8.5段

en.q: What must support an assessment of low risk, and to what should the SDD measures applied be commensurate?
options: MSO's own adequate ML/TF risk analysis; measures commensurate with risk nature/level, per identified lower-risk factors
The customer's own signed and lawyer-witnessed declaration; measures should be applied uniformly across all low-risk customers
An external independent audit report renewed every year, needing no separate analysis; measures should be the statutory minimum permitted by law
Written confirmation from the Commissioner within 14 days of request; measures should be set directly by the Commissioner
en.explain: ¶4.8.4 states that the assessment of low risks should be supported by an adequate analysis of ML/TF risks by the MSO, and ¶4.8.5 states that the SDD measures applied should be commensurate with the nature and level of ML/TF risk, based on the lower ML/TF risk factors identified by the MSO.

tc.q: 低風險評估須有甚麼支持？所採用的簡化盡職審查措施應與甚麼相稱？
options: 經營者就洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的分析；措施按較低風險因素與風險相稱
客戶本身簽署並經律師見證及蓋章的聲明；措施應對所有低風險客戶劃一採用
每年更新一次的獨立外部審計報告；措施應為法律准許的最低限度，無須另行分析
海關關長於接獲申請後30個曆日內發出的書面確認；措施應由關長直接訂定
tc.explain: 第4.8.4段訂明低風險的評估應有該經營者就洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險所作的充分分析支持；第4.8.5段訂明所採用的簡化盡職審查措施，應按該經營者所識別的較低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險因素，與洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的性質及程度相稱。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.6段

en.q: Where a corporation is acting on behalf of another person, who is the beneficial owner?
options: That other person
The corporation's largest shareholder
The corporation's board of directors
The corporation itself
en.explain: ¶4.4.6 reproduces the AMLO definition: beneficial owner in relation to a corporation means an individual meeting one of the three control tests, or, if the corporation is acting on behalf of another person, that other person. ¶4.4.7 makes the same provision for partnerships.

tc.q: 如某法團是代另一人行事，誰是實益擁有人？
options: 該另一人
該法團的最大股東
該法團的董事會
該法團本身
tc.explain: 第4.4.6段轉載《打擊洗錢條例》的定義：就法團而言，實益擁有人指符合三項控制權測試之一的個人；或如該法團是代另一人行事，則指該另一人。第4.4.7段就合夥訂有相同規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.5.2段

en.q: On the basis of documents from which sources must a person purporting to act on behalf of a customer be verified?
options: A governmental body; CCE or an RA; a similar overseas authority; or a CCE-recognised source
Only documents that the customer itself chooses to provide by personal email, without independent verification
Only documents that have been certified true by a practising Hong Kong solicitor of over five years' standing
Only documents that were originally issued by an authority within Hong Kong within the past three months
en.explain: ¶4.5.2 requires the MSO to identify the PPTA and take reasonable measures to verify their identity on the basis of documents, data or information provided by a governmental body; the CCE or any other RA; an authority outside Hong Kong performing similar functions; or any other reliable and independent source recognised by the CCE — and separately to verify the person's authority to act.

tc.q: 核實聲稱代客戶行事的人的身分時，須依據來自哪些來源的文件？
options: 政府機構；關長或有關當局；相似境外當局；或認可來源
只限由客戶自行以私人電郵選擇提供的文件，未經獨立核實
只限經執業超過五年的香港律師核證屬實的文件
只限最初由香港境內當局於三個月內簽發的文件
tc.explain: 第4.5.2段規定該經營者須識別聲稱代客戶行事的人，並依據下列來源提供的文件、數據或資料，採取合理措施核實其身分：政府機構；海關關長或任何其他有關當局；在香港以外執行類似職能的當局；或關長認可的任何其他可靠而獨立來源；並須另行核實該人代客戶行事的權限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.7.1段

en.q: When should verification of a customer's and beneficial owner's identity normally take place?
options: At or before relationship setup, or for occasional transactions
Only after the customer's first transaction has fully settled
Within a fixed 30 days of establishing the relationship, in every case
Only at the time of the relationship's first scheduled periodic review
en.explain: ¶4.7.1 states that an MSO should verify the identity of a customer and any beneficial owner before or during the course of establishing a business relationship or conducting transactions for occasional customers, and that verification after establishment is exceptional and subject to the three stated conditions.

tc.q: 核實客戶及實益擁有人身分通常應於何時進行？
options: 在建立關係前或過程中或為非經常交易時
只在客戶首宗交易完全結算之後
在任何情況下須於建立關係後固定30日內
只在該關係首次定期檢視時進行
tc.explain: 第4.7.1段訂明該經營者應在建立業務關係或為單次客戶進行交易之前或過程中，核實客戶及其任何實益擁有人的身分；在建立關係後方核實屬例外情況，並須符合三項訂明條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.7(b)段

en.q: Which product-related factor is given as potentially lower risk?
options: Life insurance: premium up to $8,000/year, or $20,000 single
Any insurance policy issued in writing in the past year by a locally authorized insurer
Any product denominated and settled in Hong Kong dollars for an approved five-year term
Any product that is sold exclusively through a licensed agent, face-to-face
en.explain: ¶4.8.7(b) gives as potentially lower risk product factors a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme meeting the stated conditions; an insurance policy for such a scheme with no surrender clause and which cannot be used as collateral; and a life insurance policy with an annual premium of no more than $8,000 or a single premium of no more than $20,000.

tc.q: 哪一項與產品有關的因素獲舉為可能屬較低風險？
options: 人壽：年保費上限8,000元，或躉繳上限20,000元
任何由本地認可保險人於過去一年內以書面新簽發的保險保單
任何以港元計值並以港元結算、為期不少於五年並經核准的產品
任何只透過持牌代理人面對面渠道銷售的產品
tc.explain: 第4.8.7(b)段所舉可能屬較低風險的產品因素包括：符合訂明條件的公積金、退休金、退休或離職金計劃；為該等計劃而設、並無退保條款且不能用作抵押品的保險保單；以及每年保費不超過8,000元或整筆保費不超過20,000元的人壽保險保單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.9段

en.q: In relation to which three situations may an MSO choose not to identify or verify a beneficial owner?
options: A ¶4.8.10-listed customer; a ¶4.8.17-listed product transaction; or a solicitor meeting the ¶4.8.19 criteria
Any customer the MSO assesses as low risk; any transaction below $8,000; and any customer viewed as long-standing
Any corporate customer; any customer introduced by an overseas intermediary; and any customer with audited annual accounts
A life insurance policy with a single premium above $20,000; an employer-funded pension scheme; and a solicitor's personal account
en.explain: ¶4.8.9 lets an MSO skip beneficial-owner identification/verification only for: a customer listed in ¶4.8.10 (e.g. an FI, a listed corporation, an investment vehicle, or a government/public body); a transaction relating to a product listed in ¶4.8.17 (small-premium insurance and certain pension/retirement schemes); or a solicitor's client account meeting the ¶4.8.19 criteria. A generic low-risk or long-standing label, corporate/overseas/audited status, and a premium or funding pattern that runs the wrong way from ¶4.8.17 are not the three carve-outs.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者可就哪三種情況選擇不識別或不核實實益擁有人？
options: 4.8.10段客戶；4.8.17段產品交易；或符合4.8.19段準則的律師
該經營者評為低風險的客戶；任何低於8,000元的交易；以及被視為長期客戶的客戶
任何法團客戶；由海外中介人引介的客戶；以及備有經審計周年帳目及良好紀錄的客戶
單次保費超過20,000元的人壽保險單；僅由僱主供款的退休計劃；以及律師的個人帳戶
tc.explain: 第4.8.9段訂明該經營者可就下列情況選擇不識別或不核實實益擁有人：屬第4.8.10段所列的客戶（例如金融機構、上市法團、投資工具或政府／公共機構）；與第4.8.17段所列產品有關的交易（小額保費保險及若干退休計劃）；或符合第4.8.19段準則的律師客戶帳戶。籠統的低風險或長期客戶標籤、法團／海外／經審計狀況，以及與第4.8.17段方向相反的保費或供款模式，均非該三種情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.7(a)(iii)段

en.q: For an overseas financial institution to be a potentially lower risk customer, what must it be subject to?
options: Incorporated in an equivalent jurisdiction, subject to FATF-consistent AML/CFT requirements
Holding a banking licence from the central bank or monetary authority of any jurisdiction
Being listed on a recognised stock exchange and subject to public disclosure requirements
Having a correspondent banking relationship with an authorized institution in Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶4.8.7(a)(iii) lists as a potentially lower risk customer factor an FI as defined in the AMLO, or another FI incorporated or established in an equivalent jurisdiction that is subject to and supervised for compliance with AML/CFT requirements consistent with FATF standards. A banking licence from anywhere, a stock-exchange listing (the separate ¶4.8.7(a)(ii) factor), and a correspondent relationship are not this factor's test.

tc.q: 境外金融機構須受甚麼規限，方屬可能較低風險的客戶？
options: 在同等司法管轄區註冊成立及受監管，並符合財務行動特別組織標準
持有由任何司法管轄區的中央銀行或金融管理當局發出的銀行牌照
在認可證券市場上市，並須遵守披露規定以確保實益擁有權透明
與香港的認可機構設有代理銀行往來關係，並定期接受合規審查
tc.explain: 第4.8.7(a)(iii)段將下列情況列為可能較低風險的客戶因素：《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構，或在同等司法管轄區註冊成立或設立、並受符合財務行動特別組織所訂標準的打擊洗錢規定所規限及監管的其他金融機構。任何地方發出的銀行牌照、證券市場上市（屬另一項第4.8.7(a)(ii)因素）及代理銀行關係，均非此項因素的準則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.15段註腳30

en.q: Beyond bearer shares themselves, what else must the same beneficial-ownership controls cover?
options: Bearer share warrants, and other similar warrants or instruments lacking traceability
Registered share certificates held by a nominee shareholder on the customer's behalf
Convertible bonds issued by the customer that have not yet been exercised or converted into shares
Share options granted by the customer to its own directors and senior employees
en.explain: Footnote 30 to ¶4.4.15 extends the bearer-share beneficial-ownership controls to bearer share warrants — negotiable instruments according entitlement to ownership to whoever holds the physical warrant certificate — and any other similar warrants or instruments without traceability. Registered certificates held by a nominee, unconverted convertible bonds, and share options are all traceable to a named holder, so they fall outside this extension.

tc.q: 除不記名股份本身外，相同的實益擁有權管控措施還須涵蓋甚麼？
options: 不記名認股權證，以及其他缺乏可追溯性的類似票據
由代名人股東代表該客戶持有的記名股票證書
該客戶發行但至今尚未獲行使或轉換為股份的可換股債券
該客戶授予其董事及高級僱員的購股權
tc.explain: 第4.4.15段註腳30訂明相同的管控措施亦應適用於不記名認股權證；該等權證指將法人的擁有權權利賦予持有實物不記名認股權證的人的可轉讓票據，以及任何其他缺乏可追溯性的類似認股權證或票據。代名人持有的記名證書、尚未轉換的可換股債券及購股權均可追溯至指名的持有人，故不屬此項延伸範圍。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.7段註腳31

en.q: How should an MSO treat the lower risk factors when assessing the ML/TF risk of a business relationship?
options: By weighing a range of factors together, in a holistic approach
By applying each individual factor on its own as a stand-alone, determinative test
By relying solely on the country risk factors identified elsewhere in ¶2.4
By applying only the customer risk factors in ¶4.8.7(a), ignoring product factors
en.explain: Footnote 31 to ¶4.8.7 states that in assessing the ML/TF risk of a business relationship, an MSO should consider a range of factors in a holistic approach — no single lower risk factor, whether a stand-alone factor, a country factor from ¶2.4, or only the customer-risk half of ¶4.8.7, is determinative by itself.

tc.q: 在評估業務關係的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險時，金錢服務經營者應如何看待各項較低風險因素？
options: 應以整體方式一併考慮一系列因素
應將每項個別因素單獨視為具決定性的獨立測試
應只單獨依賴第2.4段所述的國家風險因素
應只採用第4.8.7(a)段的客戶風險因素
tc.explain: 第4.8.7段註腳31訂明，在評估業務關係的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險時，該經營者應以整體方式考慮一系列因素——不論是獨立因素、第2.4段所述的國家因素，或只屬第4.8.7段兩個範疇之一的客戶風險因素，任何單一的較低風險因素本身均非決定性。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.4.3段與第4.3.1段的比較

en.q: Why are the verification requirements for a customer and for a beneficial owner different under the AMLO?
options: A customer must be verified against reliable, independent-source documents; a beneficial owner needs only reasonable, risk-calibrated measures
Because beneficial owners are, by statutory definition, always treated as posing low ML/TF risk, regardless of the nature of the business relationship involved
Because a beneficial owner's identity is verified by the customer's own declaration alone, with the MSO playing no role at all
Because a beneficial owner need not be identified or verified at all once the customer's own identity has been confirmed
en.explain: ¶4.4.3 states that the verification requirements for a customer and a beneficial owner are different under the AMLO: ¶4.3.1 requires a customer's identity to be verified by reference to documents, data or information from a reliable and independent source, whereas for a beneficial owner an MSO need only take reasonable measures calibrated to the ML/TF risks posed by the customer and the relationship — which may include public-domain records or corroborating the customer's own declaration, not a statutory low-risk label, self-verification with no MSO role, or no identification at all.

tc.q: 為何《打擊洗錢條例》就客戶與實益擁有人的核實規定有所不同？
options: 客戶身分須依據可靠獨立來源文件核實，實益擁有人則只須採取按風險調校的合理措施
因實益擁有人按法定定義一律被視為低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，不論業務關係性質
因實益擁有人的身分僅由客戶自行聲明核實，該經營者毋須參與其中
因客戶本身的身分一經核實，實益擁有人便完全毋須識別或核實
tc.explain: 第4.4.3段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》就客戶與實益擁有人的核實規定並不相同：第4.3.1段規定客戶身分須依據可靠而獨立來源的文件、數據或資料核實；而就實益擁有人，該經營者只須採取按該客戶及該業務關係所涉洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險調校的合理措施——包括參考公開資料或印證客戶本身的聲明，而非法定的低風險標籤、由客戶自行核實而該經營者毋須參與，或完全毋須識別。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.8.7(a)(i)段註腳32

en.q: Which bodies fall within the Schedule 2 definition of “public body” referred to in the lower risk factors?
options: Executive, legislative, municipal or urban councils; Government departments; local or public authorities; bodies appointed by the Chief Executive or Government; and bodies with power to act in a public capacity under any enactment

An individual entrusted with a prominent public function outside Hong Kong — including a head of state, senior politician, senior government, judicial or military official, or senior executive of a state-owned corporation — together with their spouse, child, parent, or close associate

An individual entrusted with a prominent public function in Hong Kong — including a senior politician, senior government or judicial official, or senior executive of a government-owned corporation — together with their spouse, child, parent, or close associate

An individual with close business relations with a PEP, including a person who is a beneficial owner of the same legal person or trust as that PEP, or who is the beneficial owner of a legal person or trust set up for the PEP's benefit
en.explain: Footnote 32 to ¶4.8.7(a)(i) reproduces the Schedule 2 definition of public body: any executive, legislative, municipal or urban council; any Government department or undertaking; any local or public authority or undertaking; any board, commission, committee or other body appointed by the Chief Executive or the Government (paid or unpaid); and any body with power to act in a public capacity under any enactment. The three distractors are genuine AMLO definitions too — non-Hong Kong PEP, Hong Kong PEP, and close associate — but each defines a politically exposed person, not a public body.

tc.q: 較低風險因素中所提述的附表2「公共機構」定義涵蓋哪些團體？
options: 行政、立法、市政或區域議會；政府部門；地方或公共當局；由行政長官或政府委任的團體；以及根據成文法則有權以公職身分行事的團體
在香港以外地方擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人——包括國家元首、資深從政者、高級政府、司法或軍事官員，或國有企業高級行政人員——連同其配偶、子女、父母或關係密切的人
在香港擔任或曾擔任重要公職的個人——包括資深從政者、高級政府或司法官員，或政府持有公司的高級行政人員——連同其配偶、子女、父母或關係密切的人
與政治人物有密切業務關係的個人，包括與該政治人物同為同一法人或信託實益擁有人的人，或是為該政治人物的利益而設立的法人或信託的實益擁有人
tc.explain: 第4.8.7(a)(i)段註腳32轉載附表2「公共機構」的定義：任何行政、立法、市政或區域議會；任何政府部門或企業；任何地方或公共當局或企業；由行政長官或政府委任的任何委員會或其他團體（不論受薪與否）；以及根據任何成文法則有權以公職身分行事的任何團體。三個干擾項同屬《打擊洗錢條例》的真實定義——非香港政治人物、香港政治人物及關係密切的人——但界定的都是政治人物，並非公共機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.9段

en.q: What does section 19(1) of Schedule 2 require of an MSO in relation to non-Hong Kong PEPs, and what examples does the Guideline give?
options: Effective procedures for determining PEP status — e.g. referring to public information or screening commercial databases
A written declaration obtained from every customer at onboarding confirming that they are not a PEP, renewed annually thereafter
Annual written confirmation from the CCE of the PEP status of each of the MSO's customers
Outright refusal to serve any customer from a jurisdiction with a high corruption perception index
en.explain: ¶4.9.9 states that an MSO must establish and maintain effective procedures — for example by making reference to publicly available information and/or screening against commercially available databases — for determining whether a customer or a beneficial owner is a non-Hong Kong PEP. A blanket self-declaration renewed yearly, an annual CCE sign-off, and refusing an entire jurisdiction are not what section 19(1) or ¶4.9.9 calls for.

tc.q: 就非香港政治人物，附表2第19(1)條對金錢服務經營者有何規定？本指引舉出甚麼例子？
options: 須設有有效程序以斷定政治人物身分，例如參考公開資料或商業數據庫核對
於建立業務關係時取得每名客戶的書面聲明，確認並非政治人物，並須每年更新
每年取得關長就其每名客戶政治人物身分的書面確認
一律拒絕向來自貪污感知指數高的司法管轄區的任何客戶提供服務
tc.explain: 第4.9.9段訂明該經營者必須建立及維持有效程序（例如參考公開可得資料及／或與商業資料庫作篩查），以斷定客戶或客戶的實益擁有人是否非香港政治人物。逐年更新的書面自我聲明、關長每年的書面確認，或拒絕整個司法管轄區的客戶，均非第19(1)條或第4.9.9段的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.10段

en.q: Which three EDD measures must an MSO apply where it knows a customer or beneficial owner is a non-Hong Kong PEP?
options: Senior management approval; reasonable measures on source of wealth and funds; and enhanced ongoing monitoring
Termination of the relationship; a mandatory report to the JFIU; and formal notification of the CCE
Doubling the frequency of identity verification; imposing a fixed transaction cap; and a cash-only payment restriction
An external legal opinion; a full external audit of the relationship; and a board resolution approving it
en.explain: ¶4.9.10 requires an MSO, before establishing or continuing a relationship where the customer or beneficial owner is a non-Hong Kong PEP, to apply all three EDD measures together: senior management approval, reasonable measures to establish source of wealth and source of funds, and enhanced ongoing monitoring. Termination-and-reporting, tighter transaction controls, and a legal/audit/board sign-off are not the three measures ¶4.9.10 lists.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者知悉客戶或實益擁有人是非香港政治人物，須採取哪三項加強盡職審查措施？
options: 取得高級管理層批准；採取合理措施確定財富及資金來源；以及進行加強持續監察
終止該關係；強制向聯合財富情報組舉報；以及正式通知關長
將身分核實頻次加倍；設定固定交易上限；以及實施僅限現金付款的限制
取得外聘法律意見；對該業務關係進行全面的外部審計；以及取得批准該關係的董事會決議
tc.explain: 第4.9.10段規定該經營者在建立或繼續與非香港政治人物（或其實益擁有人屬非香港政治人物）的業務關係前，須同時採取全部三項加強盡職審查措施：取得高級管理層批准；採取合理措施確定財富來源及資金來源；以及對該業務關係進行加強持續監察。終止並舉報、收緊交易管控，或法律意見／審計／董事會批核，均非第4.9.10段所列的三項措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.12段

en.q: On what basis, and with whose approval, may an MSO decide not to apply EDD measures to a former non-Hong Kong PEP?
options: Only with senior management approval and an assessment showing the PEP no longer poses a high ML/TF risk
On the compliance officer's own decision alone, once two years have passed since the individual left
Automatically and without any assessment, the moment the individual leaves public office
Only with the CCE's written confirmation that the individual is no longer a PEP
en.explain: ¶4.9.12 states that following an RBA an MSO may decide not to apply or continue to apply the EDD measures to a customer who is or whose beneficial owner is a former non-Hong Kong PEP, but such a decision can only be made with the approval of the MSO's senior management and on the basis that the PEP no longer presents a high risk of ML/TF, determined by an appropriate assessment — not by the compliance officer alone, a fixed time period, or CCE sign-off.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者可基於甚麼理由、經何人批准，決定不對前非香港政治人物採取加強盡職審查措施？
options: 只可經高級管理層批准，並經評估認定該政治人物不再構成高風險
僅由合規主任決定，毋須經高級管理層批准，並須待離任滿兩年
該個人一離任公職，即自動生效，毋須進行任何評估
只可憑關長發出書面確認該個人已不再是政治人物
tc.explain: 第4.9.12段訂明，該經營者可按風險為本方式決定不對屬前非香港政治人物或其實益擁有人屬前非香港政治人物的客戶採取或繼續採取加強盡職審查措施；但該決定只可經該經營者高級管理層批准，並須以該政治人物不再構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險為基礎，該基礎須經適當評估確定——並非僅由合規主任決定、待滿固定期限，或憑關長確認。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.12段

en.q: Which three risk factors should an MSO take into account in assessing whether a former PEP still presents a high ML/TF risk?
options: Informal influence still exercised; seniority of the PEP position held; and any link between past and current functions
The individual's exact age at the time of leaving office; their nationality; and their country of current residence, taken alone
The size of the individual's bank account balance; their occupation; and their declared annual income
Only the length of time that has passed since the individual left public office, viewed on its own
en.explain: ¶4.9.12 lists the risk factors as, but not limited to: the level of informal influence the individual could still exercise; the seniority of the position held as the PEP; and whether the individual's previous and current functions are linked in any way — formally, by appointment of the PEP's successor, or informally, by continuing to deal with the same substantive matters. Age, nationality, residence, account size, occupation, income, and elapsed time alone are not the factors the Guideline lists, and footnote 37 specifically warns against relying on a time limit alone.

tc.q: 在評估前政治人物是否仍構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險時，金錢服務經營者應顧及哪三項風險因素？
options: 非正式影響力程度；擔任政治人物時職位資歷；以及先前現時職能有否關連
該個人離任時的確實年齡；其國籍及出生地背景；以及其現時所居住的國家詳情
該個人的銀行帳戶結餘多寡；其職業狀況；以及其申報的年度入息
僅計算該個人離任公職後所經過的時間長短，不看其他因素
tc.explain: 第4.9.12段列出的風險因素（包括但不限於）為：該個人仍可行使的（非正式）影響力程度；該個人擔任政治人物時所任職位的資歷；以及該個人先前及現時的職能是否有任何關連（例如正式方面由該政治人物委任其繼任人，或非正式方面該政治人物繼續處理同一實質事務）。年齡、國籍、居住地、帳戶結餘、職業、入息及僅計時間長短，均非本指引所列的因素；註腳37更明確警告不應僅按時限判斷。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.12段註腳37

en.q: On what should the handling of a former non-Hong Kong PEP be based?
options: An assessment of risk, not prescribed time limits
A two-year period after leaving public office
Approval from the MSO's senior management alone
The customer's own declaration of retirement
en.explain: Footnote 37 to ¶4.9.12 states that the handling of a former non-Hong Kong PEP should be based on an assessment of risk and not merely on prescribed time limits. Senior management approval is a separate precondition for the decision, and a fixed period or the customer's own say-so are exactly what the footnote says is not enough.

tc.q: 處理前非香港政治人物應以甚麼為基礎？
options: 基於風險評估，非以訂明時限為據
離任後一律劃一計算的兩年固定期間
純粹單憑該經營者高級管理層的批准
純粹憑該客戶本身聲明其已卸任退休
tc.explain: 第4.9.12段註腳37訂明處理前非香港政治人物應以風險評估為基礎，而非僅以訂明的時限為據。高級管理層的批准是另一項獨立的先決條件，而劃一的固定期間或客戶自行聲明，正是註腳明確指出並不足夠的做法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.12段註腳38

en.q: What is the consequence of not applying EDD to a former non-Hong Kong PEP without conducting an appropriate risk assessment?
options: The MSO will be considered by the CCE as contravening section 10(1) or 10(2) of Schedule 2
The MSO will be considered by the CCE as contravening section 15(a) or 15(b) of Schedule 2
The MSO must file a suspicious transaction report with the JFIU without delay
The MSO will be considered by the CCE as contravening section 19(1) of Schedule 2, a screening duty
en.explain: Footnote 38 to ¶4.9.12 states that if an MSO does not apply EDD measures to a former non-Hong Kong PEP without conducting an appropriate risk assessment, the MSO will be considered by the CCE as contravening section 10(1) or 10(2) of Schedule 2. Section 15(a)/15(b) is the equivalent provision for former Hong Kong or international organisation PEPs (footnote 42), section 19(1) governs non-Hong Kong PEP identification procedures generally (¶4.9.9), and no STR filing is mentioned in footnote 38.

tc.q: 如未有進行適當風險評估即不對前非香港政治人物採取加強盡職審查，有何後果？
options: 關長會視該經營者為違反附表2第10(1)或10(2)條
關長會視該經營者為違反附表2第15(a)或15(b)條
該經營者須毫不延誤向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
關長會視該經營者為違反附表2第19(1)條，即一般篩查責任
tc.explain: 第4.9.12段註腳38訂明，如該經營者未有進行適當風險評估即不對前非香港政治人物採取加強盡職審查措施，在適當情況下關長會視其為違反附表2第10(1)或10(2)條。第15(a)或15(b)條是就前香港或國際組織政治人物而設的相應條文（見註腳42），第19(1)條規管的是非香港政治人物識別程序的一般規定（第4.9.9段），註腳38並無提及須提交可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.13段與第4.9.7段的比較

en.q: How does the definition of a Hong Kong PEP differ from that of a non-Hong Kong PEP in the categories listed?
options: The Hong Kong list omits head of state and refers to a government-owned, not state-owned, corporation
The non-Hong Kong list omits head of state and refers to a state-owned, not government-owned, corporation
The Hong Kong PEP list additionally includes military officials, unlike the non-Hong Kong list
Both lists cover the same categories of officials and use identical wording for family members and close associates
en.explain: ¶4.9.13 defines a Hong Kong PEP without a head of state or military official, referring to a government-owned corporation; ¶4.9.7 for non-Hong Kong PEPs includes a head of state and a military official, and refers to a state-owned corporation instead. Paragraphs (b) and (c) — family members and close associates — are worded identically in both definitions, so it is only the list of officials in (a)(i) that differs, not "the same categories" as option 4 claims.

tc.q: 香港政治人物與非香港政治人物的定義，在所列類別上有何不同？
options: 香港政治人物的清單沒有國家元首，並提及政府持有公司（非國有企業）的高級行政人員
非香港政治人物的清單沒有國家元首，並提及政府持有公司（非國有企業）的高級行政人員
香港政治人物的清單另包括軍事官員，而非香港政治人物的清單則沒有此類別
兩份清單所列官員類別完全相同，就家庭成員及密切聯繫人的措辭亦完全一致
tc.explain: 第4.9.13段界定的香港政治人物並不包括國家元首或軍事官員，並提及政府持有公司；第4.9.7段就非香港政治人物則包括國家元首及軍事官員，並改為提及國有企業。兩定義的(b)及(c)段——家庭成員及密切聯繫人——措辭完全相同，只有(a)(i)所列官員類別有所不同，並非如第四個選項所稱類別完全相同。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.14段

en.q: Which individuals are within the definition of an international organisation PEP?
options: Senior management — directors, deputy directors and board members — excludes junior officials
Any employee entrusted with a function by the organisation, however junior their rank
Only the individual holding the single most senior post in the whole organisation
Individuals formally seconded to the organisation by a member State's government, regardless of rank
en.explain: ¶4.9.14 defines an international organisation PEP as senior management — directors, deputy directors and board members or equivalent — excluding middle-ranking or more junior officials of the organisation. It is not every employee, not only the single head, and secondment by a member State's government is not the test the Guideline applies.

tc.q: 哪些個人屬國際組織政治人物的定義範圍？
options: 高級管理層成員，即總監、副總監及理事會成員，不包括中級或更低級人員
任何獲該國際組織委以職能的僱員，即使職級中等或更低亦包括在內
只限擔任該國際組織單一最高職位的首長個人，不包括其他高級管理層成員
由某成員國政府正式借調至該組織任職的人員，不論其職級高低
tc.explain: 第4.9.14段界定國際組織政治人物為高級管理層成員——即總監、副總監及理事會成員或同等職能者——不包括該國際組織的中級或更低級官員。並非該組織的任何僱員，也不限於單一首長，而由成員國政府借調亦非本指引所採用的準則。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.15段

en.q: What characterises the international organisations referred to in the PEP definition?
options: Entities established by formal political agreements between States with treaty status
Any body whose members include more than one country's central bank, regardless of treaty status
Any non-governmental organisation that operates across more than one national border
Any body that a member State unilaterally designates as an international organisation
en.explain: ¶4.9.15 defines international organisations as entities established by formal political agreements between States that have the status of international treaties — not a body of multiple central banks, an NGO operating across borders, or a State's own unilateral designation, none of which the Guideline uses as the test. Examples given include the United Nations, the Council of Europe, NATO and the WTO.

tc.q: 政治人物定義中所指的國際組織有何特徵？
options: 由成員國根據具有國際條約地位的正式政治協議所成立的實體
任何成員包括逾一個國家中央銀行的團體，不論是否具條約地位
任何在多於一個國家境內跨境運作的非政府慈善組織
任何由某一成員國單方面自行指定為國際組織的團體
tc.explain: 第4.9.15段將國際組織界定為由成員國根據具有國際條約地位的正式政治協議所成立的實體——並非由多間中央銀行組成的團體、跨境運作的非政府組織，或由某成員國單方面自行指定，本指引並無採用該等準則。所舉例子包括聯合國、歐洲理事會、北大西洋公約組織及世界貿易組織。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.16段與第4.9.9段的比較

en.q: What different standards govern an MSO's duty to identify a customer as a PEP, comparing non-Hong Kong PEPs with Hong Kong or international organisation PEPs?
options: Non-Hong Kong PEPs need effective s.19(1) procedures; Hong Kong/international-organisation PEPs need only reasonable measures
Both categories require the MSO to establish and maintain effective screening procedures under section 19(1) of Schedule 2
Hong Kong and international organisation PEPs require effective procedures; non-Hong Kong PEPs need only reasonable measures
Neither category requires more than the MSO's ordinary risk-based CDD measures under section 5 of Schedule 2
en.explain: ¶4.9.9 requires an MSO to establish and maintain effective procedures under section 19(1) of Schedule 2 for determining whether a customer or beneficial owner is a non-Hong Kong PEP — a systemic, mandatory standard. ¶4.9.16 requires only that the MSO take reasonable measures to determine Hong Kong or international organisation PEP status, a lighter case-by-case standard; the two are not reversed, identical, or reducible to ordinary section 5 CDD.

tc.q: 在識別客戶是否政治人物的責任上，非香港政治人物與香港或國際組織政治人物所適用的標準有何不同？
options: 非香港政治人物須按第19(1)條設有效程序；香港／國際組織政治人物只須採取合理措施
兩者均須按附表2第19(1)條，就客戶身分設有有效的篩選及核對程序
香港及國際組織政治人物須按第19(1)條設有效程序；非香港政治人物則只須合理措施
兩者均只須按附表2第5條，對客戶採取一般以風險為本的盡職審查措施
tc.explain: 第4.9.9段規定該經營者須按附表2第19(1)條設有有效程序，以斷定客戶或實益擁有人是否非香港政治人物——這是系統性的強制標準。第4.9.16段則只要求該經營者採取合理措施，以斷定其是否香港政治人物或國際組織政治人物，屬較寬鬆的個別個案標準；兩者的規定並非互換、並非完全相同，也不能簡化為附表2第5條的一般盡職審查措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.17段

en.q: In which situations must an MSO apply the ¶4.9.10 EDD measures to a Hong Kong PEP or an international organisation PEP?
options: Before a high risk relationship begins; when one becomes high risk; or PEP found once high risk
In every case, regardless of risk level, in exactly the same way as for non-Hong Kong PEPs
Only where a single transaction reaches the $120,000 occasional-transaction CDD threshold
Only where the customer is also separately and independently identified as a non-Hong Kong PEP
en.explain: ¶4.9.17 requires the ¶4.9.10 EDD measures in three situations: before establishing a high risk relationship with such a PEP; when an existing relationship with such a PEP subsequently becomes high risk; or when an existing high risk relationship is continued and the MSO later learns of the PEP status. The trigger is the high risk business relationship, not the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold, dual PEP status, or an unconditional duty as for non-Hong Kong PEPs.

tc.q: 在哪些情況下，金錢服務經營者須對香港政治人物或國際組織政治人物採取第4.9.10段的加強盡職審查措施？
options: 在高風險關係前；現有關係其後變高風險時；或高風險關係後得悉政治人物身分時
在任何情況下均須執行加強盡職審查，與非香港政治人物相同，不論風險高低
只在單一宗交易達到120,000元的一般非經常交易盡職審查適用門檻時
只在該客戶亦被獨立識別為非香港政治人物時方適用
tc.explain: 第4.9.17段就三種情況規定須採取第4.9.10段的加強盡職審查措施：與該等政治人物建立高風險業務關係前；與該等政治人物的現有關係其後變為高風險時；或現有高風險關係中其後得悉客戶屬該等政治人物時。觸發點是高風險業務關係本身，並非120,000元的非經常交易門檻、客戶須同時屬非香港政治人物，也不是像非香港政治人物般不論風險一律適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.18段註腳42

en.q: What happens if an MSO relieves a former Hong Kong or international organisation PEP of EDD without first conducting an appropriate risk assessment?
options: The MSO will be considered by the CCE as contravening section 15(a) or 15(b) of Schedule 2
The MSO will be considered by the CCE as contravening section 10(1) or 10(2) of Schedule 2
There is no consequence, provided the MSO's senior management approved the original decision
The MSO must immediately obtain all CDD information from the PEP as if from an intermediary
en.explain: Footnote 42 to ¶4.9.18 states that if an MSO does not apply EDD to a former Hong Kong or international organisation PEP without conducting an appropriate risk assessment, the MSO will be considered by the CCE as contravening section 15(a) or 15(b) of Schedule 2. Section 10(1)/10(2) is the equivalent provision for former non-Hong Kong PEPs (footnote 38) — the wrong regime here. Senior management approval is a precondition for the original RBA decision, not an excuse for skipping the risk assessment, and the intermediary hand-back duty in ¶4.11.7 has no bearing on PEP EDD relief.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者未經適當風險評估，即免除前香港或國際組織政治人物的加強盡職審查，會有何後果？
options: 關長會視該經營者為違反附表2第15(a)或15(b)條
關長會視該經營者為違反附表2第10(1)或10(2)條
並無後果，只要該經營者高級管理層已批准原有決定即可
該經營者須即時從該政治人物取得所有資料，猶如中介人一樣
tc.explain: 第4.9.18段註腳42訂明，如該經營者未有進行適當風險評估即不對前香港或國際組織政治人物採取加強盡職審查措施，在適當情況下關長會視其為違反附表2第15(a)或15(b)條。第10(1)或10(2)條是就前非香港政治人物而設的相應條文（見註腳38）——用於本題屬錯誤制度。高級管理層的批准只是原有風險為本決定的先決條件，並非略去風險評估的藉口；而第4.11.7段中介人交還資料的責任，與政治人物加強盡職審查的豁免亦無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.19段

en.q: What twin dangers does the Guideline identify in classifying PEPs?
options: Under-classification raises the MSO's ML risk; over-classification burdens the MSO and its customers
Under-classification breaches the AMLO; over-classification breaches the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance
Under-classification attracts a disciplinary penalty; over-classification attracts none at all
Both risks are treated by the CCE as equally serious, regardless of circumstances
en.explain: ¶4.9.19 states that under-classification of PEPs poses a higher ML risk to the MSO, whilst over-classification leads to an unnecessary compliance burden on the MSO and its customers — not a breach of the AMLO or the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance, not a disciplinary penalty on one side only, and not something the CCE treats as equally serious regardless of direction.

tc.q: 本指引指出在界定政治人物時有哪兩種危險？
options: 界定不足會令該經營者承受較高洗錢風險；界定過寬則加重該經營者及客戶合規負擔
界定不足屬違反打擊洗錢條例；界定過寬則屬違反個人資料（私隱）條例的規定
界定不足會招致紀律處分，而界定過寬則完全不會招致任何處分
不論是界定不足還是界定過寬，關長一律視為同等嚴重的違規行為
tc.explain: 第4.9.19段訂明，界定不足會令該經營者承受較高的洗錢風險，而界定過寬則會為該經營者及其客戶帶來不必要的合規負擔——並非違反《打擊洗錢條例》或《個人資料（私隱）條例》，也不是只有一方會招致紀律處分，關長亦沒有將兩者一律視為同等嚴重。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.20段

en.q: Which factors should an MSO consider in determining what constitutes a prominent public function?
options: Powers and responsibilities of the function; the organisation's framework; and jurisdiction concerns
The salary attaching to the office; the length of the appointment; and the individual's formal education
The size of the jurisdiction's economy; its total population; and its official currency
The individual's media profile; their social connections; and their personal wealth
en.explain: ¶4.9.20 states that in determining what constitutes a prominent public function, an MSO should consider factors such as the powers and responsibilities of the function, the organisational framework of the relevant government or international organisation, and any specific concerns connected to the jurisdiction — not salary, tenure or education; not the jurisdiction's economic size; and not the individual's media profile or wealth, which are not factors this paragraph lists.

tc.q: 在斷定何謂顯赫公職時，金錢服務經營者應考慮哪些因素？
options: 與公職相關的權責；有關政府或組織的架構；以及司法管轄區的關注
該職位所附帶的薪酬；委任任期的長短；以及該個人所受的正規教育程度
該司法管轄區的經濟規模大小；其總人口數目；以及其所用的官方貨幣
該個人在媒體上的知名程度；其社交聯繫網絡；以及其個人財富狀況
tc.explain: 第4.9.20段訂明，在判斷何謂重要（公）職時，該經營者應考慮的因素包括與該公職相關的權力及職責、有關政府或國際組織的組織架構，以及與有關司法管轄區相關的特定關注——並非薪酬、任期或學歷；並非該司法管轄區的經濟規模；也並非該個人的媒體知名度或財富，這些均非本段所列的因素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.21段

en.q: What is the Guideline's position on the use of commercially available PEP databases?
options: Never replace traditional CDD; note their limits and use only as a support tool
They are comprehensive and reliable, so may safely replace traditional CDD entirely
They must never be used at all, as the CCE treats them as inherently unreliable
Each database must be individually approved by the CCE before any MSO may use it
en.explain: ¶4.9.21 states that the use of commercially available databases should never replace traditional CDD processes, and the MSO should be aware of their limitations — they are not necessarily comprehensive or reliable, the providers' PEP definitions may not align with the MSO's, and technical incapability may hinder identification — using them only as a support tool. The Guideline does not ban their use outright, treat them as inherently reliable enough to replace CDD, or require CCE pre-approval of each database.

tc.q: 本指引就使用商業政治人物資料庫的立場為何？
options: 不能取代傳統盡職審查；應留意限制，只用作支援工具
數據庫全面而可靠，因此可完全取代傳統的盡職審查程序
絕對不可使用，因關長視這類數據庫為本質上不可靠的來源
每個數據庫必須先經關長個別批准，該經營者方可使用
tc.explain: 第4.9.21段訂明使用商業資料庫絕不應取代傳統的客戶盡職審查程序，該經營者應留意其局限——該等資料庫未必全面或可靠、其對政治人物的定義未必與該經營者一致，以及技術上的不足可能妨礙識別成效——只應將其用作輔助工具。本指引並無完全禁止使用、視這類資料庫為足夠可靠而可取代盡職審查，也沒有要求每個資料庫須經關長個別批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.22段

en.q: What does the Guideline note about the risks associated with a PEP's family members and close associates?
options: EDD applies to them too, but risk may vary with the PEP's jurisdiction
They present no additional risk at all and are wholly excluded from EDD measures
They always present a materially higher risk than the PEP does personally
They are only relevant to EDD where they share a household with the PEP
en.explain: ¶4.9.22 states that although EDD requirements also apply to family members and close associates of the PEP, the risks associated with them may vary depending to some extent on the socio-economic and cultural structure of the PEP's jurisdiction — they are not excluded, not automatically higher risk than the PEP, and not relevant only when sharing a household.

tc.q: 本指引就政治人物的家庭成員及密切聯繫人所涉風險有何說明？
options: 加強盡職審查適用於他們，惟風險視乎該政治人物所屬司法管轄區而異
他們完全不會構成任何額外的洗錢風險，故完全不納入加強盡職審查的範圍
他們的洗錢風險一律遠高於該政治人物本身所構成的風險
只有在與該政治人物同住一個居所的情況下，方與加強盡職審查相關
tc.explain: 第4.9.22段訂明，雖然加強盡職審查規定同樣適用於政治人物的家庭成員及密切聯繫人，但與他們相關的風險可能因該政治人物所屬司法管轄區的社會經濟及文化結構而有所不同——他們並非獲豁免、並非風險一律高於該政治人物本身，亦非只在與其同住時方屬相關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.23段

en.q: Which factors should an MSO take into account in determining the extent of EDD measures for a PEP?
options: The PEP's functions; jurisdiction risk; relationship nature; and former-PEP factors
The customer's account balance and transaction frequency, without other factors
The MSO's own size and resources alone, regardless of the PEP's own circumstances
The total number of other PEP customers the MSO already happens to serve
en.explain: ¶4.9.23 states that since not all PEPs pose the same level of ML risk, an MSO should adopt an RBA taking into account the nature of the PEP's prominent public functions, the geographical risk of the jurisdiction, the nature of the business relationship, and — for a former PEP — the risk factors in ¶4.9.12/4.9.18. Account balance or transaction frequency alone, the MSO's own size, and the number of other PEP customers it happens to serve are not among the listed factors.

tc.q: 在決定就政治人物採取加強盡職審查措施的程度時，金錢服務經營者應顧及哪些因素？
options: 政治人物公職性質；地區風險；業務關係性質；以及前政治人物風險因素
只考慮該客戶的銀行帳戶結餘及交易頻密程度，完全不理會其他任何因素
只考慮該經營者本身業務的規模及資源，不論該政治人物的實際情況
只考慮該經營者現時碰巧已服務的其他政治人物客戶的總數目
tc.explain: 第4.9.23段訂明，由於並非所有政治人物構成同等程度的洗錢風險，該經營者應採用風險為本方式，並顧及該政治人物所任公職的性質、有關司法管轄區的地區風險、業務關係的性質，以及（如屬前政治人物）第4.9.12及4.9.18段所訂的風險因素。單看客戶的帳戶結餘或交易頻次、該經營者本身的規模，以及其現時已服務的其他政治人物客戶數目，均非本段所列的因素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.24段

en.q: How does the Guideline define source of wealth?
options: The origin of an individual's entire wealth (total assets) and how it was acquired
The origin of the particular funds or assets involved in the current business relationship
The individual's total annual income from employment over the past year
The current value of assets the individual holds with the MSO itself
en.explain: ¶4.9.24 defines source of wealth as the origin of an individual's entire body of wealth (total assets), giving an indication of the size of wealth expected and how it was acquired. The origin of particular funds in the current relationship is source of funds under ¶4.9.25 — a different concept — not annual employment income or the value of assets held with the MSO alone.

tc.q: 本指引如何界定「財富來源」？
options: 個人全部財富（即總資產）的源頭，以及該人如何取得此等財富
該名個人與該經營者現有業務關係中所涉及的特定資金或資產源頭
該名個人過去一整年從受僱工作所得的年薪總額
該名個人目前在該經營者處所持有資產的現時價值
tc.explain: 第4.9.24段將「財富來源」界定為個人全部財富（即總資產）的源頭，可顯示預計該人擁有的財富規模及其如何取得。現有業務關係所涉特定資金或資產的源頭，是第4.9.25段「資金來源」的概念——屬不同定義——並非受僱年薪或該人在該經營者處所持資產的現值。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.25段

en.q: Beyond knowing from where funds were transferred, what must source of funds information establish?
options: The activity generating funds, and substantive proof of provenance
Only the name of the bank that transferred the funds to the MSO
Only the calendar date on which the MSO received the funds
Only the currency denomination in which the funds were originally held
en.explain: ¶4.9.25 states that source of funds information should not simply be limited to knowing from where the funds may have been transferred, but also the activity that generates the funds, and that the information obtained should be substantive and establish a provenance or reason for the funds having been acquired — not merely the transferring bank's name, the receipt date, or the currency held.

tc.q: 除得知資金從何處轉入外，資金來源的資料還須確立甚麼？
options: 產生資金的活動以及足以確立來源的實質資料
只需知道該等資金原本是從哪間銀行轉出的名稱
只需知道該經營者實際收到該等資金的曆日日期
只需知道該等資金原本以何種貨幣單位持有
tc.explain: 第4.9.25段訂明「資金來源」的資料不應僅限於得知資金從何處轉入，亦須包括產生該等資金的活動；所取得的資料應具實質內容，並確立該等資金的來源出處或取得原因——並非僅是轉出銀行的名稱、收款日期，或資金原以何種貨幣持有。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.26段

en.q: What practical approach does the Guideline describe for establishing a PEP's source of funds and source of wealth?
options: Obtaining PEP information, checked against public asset/income declarations
Always requiring the PEP to produce independently audited financial accounts
Relying solely on commercially available screening databases, without any other check
Requiring formal written confirmation from the PEP's own home government
en.explain: ¶4.9.26 states that in practical terms establishing source of funds and wealth will often amount to obtaining information from the PEP and verifying it against publicly available sources such as asset and income declarations — while noting that not all declarations are public and a PEP may have legitimate reasons for not providing a copy. It is not a blanket audited-accounts requirement, reliance on commercial databases alone, or confirmation from the PEP's own government.

tc.q: 本指引就確定政治人物的資金來源及財富來源，描述甚麼實務做法？
options: 向政治人物取得資料，並與公開資產及入息聲明核對
在任何情況下均要求該政治人物提交經獨立審計的財務帳目
純粹倚賴商業篩選數據庫，完全不作任何其他核實
要求該政治人物所屬本國政府作出正式書面確認
tc.explain: 第4.9.26段訂明，實務上通常是向該政治人物取得資料，並與公開可得的資料來源（例如資產及收入申報）核對；但指出並非所有申報均公開可得，而政治人物客戶亦可能有正當理由不提供副本。並非一律要求提交經審計帳目、純粹倚賴商業數據庫，也不是要求該政治人物本國政府作出確認。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.26段

en.q: What restriction on PEPs does the Guideline remind MSOs to be aware of?
options: Some jurisdictions bar PEPs holding foreign bank accounts or paid roles
Some jurisdictions prohibit PEPs from using money service operators
Some jurisdictions require PEPs to obtain approval before every transaction
Some jurisdictions prohibit their PEPs from holding any assets abroad at all
en.explain: ¶4.9.26 states that the MSO should be aware that some jurisdictions impose restrictions on their PEPs' ability to hold foreign bank accounts or to hold other office or paid employment — relevant when assessing the plausibility of a declared source of wealth or funds. It does not say jurisdictions bar PEPs from using money service operators, require pre-transaction approval, or ban holding any assets abroad.

tc.q: 本指引提醒金錢服務經營者留意就政治人物的甚麼限制？
options: 司法管轄區限政治人物持有外地銀行戶口或受薪職務
某些司法管轄區禁止政治人物使用金錢服務經營者
某些司法管轄區要求政治人物每宗交易前均須先取得批准
某些司法管轄區完全禁止政治人物在海外持有任何資產
tc.explain: 第4.9.26段訂明該經營者亦應留意某些司法管轄區限制其政治人物持有外地銀行戶口或擔任其他受薪職務的能力——此點與評估政治人物所申報財富及資金來源的可信程度相關。並非指有關司法管轄區禁止政治人物使用金錢服務經營者、規定每宗交易前須先批准，或完全禁止其在海外持有任何資產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.10.2段

en.q: In what circumstance is an MSO relieved of the additional measures for a customer not physically present?
options: Where identity is verified via a digital ID system the CCE recognises as reliable
Where the first payment is made through the customer's own account with an authorized institution
Where an independent and appropriate person has certified the customer's identification documents
Where the customer has been identified using a digital system the MSO itself considers reliable
en.explain: ¶4.10.2 states that if an MSO has verified the identity of the customer on the basis of data or information provided by a digital identification system that is a reliable and independent source recognised by the CCE, it need not carry out any additional measures under ¶4.10.1. Routing the first payment through an authorized-institution account (¶4.10.1(c)) and independent certification of documents (¶4.10.4(a)) are alternative ¶4.10.1 measures used when relief does not apply — and a digital system the MSO alone considers reliable, without CCE recognition, does not qualify.

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下，金錢服務經營者可免除就並未親身到場的客戶採取額外措施？
options: 已按獲關長認可、屬可靠來源數碼識別系統核實身分
首次付款須經由該客戶本身於認可機構開立的戶口進行
由獨立而適當的人核證該客戶的身分識別文件即可
只憑該經營者自行認為可靠的數碼識別系統核實身分
tc.explain: 第4.10.2段訂明，如該經營者已依據獲海關關長認可、屬可靠而獨立來源的數碼識別系統所提供的數據或資料核實客戶身分，則無須採取第4.10.1段所列的任何額外措施。經由認可機構戶口作首次付款（第4.10.1(c)款）及由獨立人士核證文件（第4.10.4(a)款）是在不獲豁免時所用的其他第4.10.1段措施；而僅由該經營者自行認為可靠、未獲關長認可的數碼系統，並不符合豁免條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.10.4段

en.q: Which methods does the Guideline give as possible supplementary measures for a non-face-to-face customer?
options: Independent certification; checking data vs databases; or suitable technology
Requiring the customer to physically attend the branch in person within 30 days
Obtaining a formal written guarantee from another authorized financial institution
Permanently limiting the whole business relationship to a single transaction only
en.explain: ¶4.10.4 states that ¶4.10.1(b) allows an MSO to utilise different methods to mitigate the risk, including certification of identification documents by an independent and appropriate person, checking relevant data against reliable databases or registries, or using appropriate technology — not a mandatory 30-day branch visit, a guarantee from another institution, or a permanent single-transaction limit, none of which ¶4.10.4 lists.

tc.q: 本指引就非面對面客戶舉出哪些可行的補充措施方法？
options: 獨立人選認證文件；核對數據庫；或用適當科技
要求該客戶必須於30日內親身到訪分行報到登記
取得另一間認可財務機構出具的正式書面擔保
永久將整個業務關係限制於單一宗交易之內處理
tc.explain: 第4.10.4段訂明第4.10.1(b)款容許該經營者採用不同方法減低風險，可包括：由獨立而適當的人核證身分證明文件；將有關數據與可靠資料庫或登記冊核對；或使用適當科技——並非規定客戶須於30日內親身到分行報到、取得另一機構的擔保，或將業務關係永久限於單一宗交易，這些均非第4.10.4段所列的方法。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.10.4段

en.q: What must an MSO be able to demonstrate to the CCE about its supplementary measures for non-face-to-face customers?
options: That the supplementary measures adequately guard against impersonation risk
That the measures are proportionate, appropriate and justifiable to the CCE
That the measures suit the nature and characteristics of the product or service offered
That the measures were assessed on a case-by-case basis before being adopted
