en.explain: ¶4.10.4 states that the MSO should ensure and be able to demonstrate to the CCE that the supplementary measures taken can adequately guard against impersonation risk — the specific risk ¶4.10.1 identifies for non-face-to-face customers. Proportionality/justifiability to the CCE is the general EDD standard in ¶4.9.2, suiting the product or service is the ¶4.10.3 test for the extent of measures, and case-by-case assessment (also in ¶4.10.4) concerns choosing the measure, not what must be demonstrated about it.

tc.q: 就非面對面客戶的補充措施，金錢服務經營者須能向海關關長證明甚麼？
options: 所採取的補充措施能充分防範假冒身分的風險
該等措施合乎比例、適當，並能向關長提供理據
該等措施切合所提供產品或服務的性質和特徵
該等措施在採用前已按個別情況逐一評估
tc.explain: 第4.10.4段訂明該經營者應確保並能向關長證明，其所採取的補充措施能充分防範假冒身分的風險——即第4.10.1段就客戶並未親身到場所指出的特定風險。「合乎比例並能向關長提供理據」是第4.9.2段就一般加強盡職審查的標準；「切合產品或服務的性質特徵」是第4.10.3段釐定措施程度的準則；而「按個別情況評估」（同見於第4.10.4段）針對的是揀選措施本身，並非須向關長證明的事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.10.5段

en.q: When may the non-face-to-face additional measures also be relevant to a customer that is not a natural person?
options: Where the natural person acting for it is not physically present, or only copies are provided
Never - the additional measures apply exclusively to customers who are natural persons, not legal ones
Only where the customer is a legal person incorporated outside Hong Kong's jurisdiction
Only where the legal person customer holds no Hong Kong bank account of its own at all
en.explain: ¶4.10.5 states that while additional measures generally apply to a natural person customer, an MSO should also mitigate increased risk where a non-natural-person customer uses a non-face-to-face channel — arising where the natural person acting on its behalf is not physically present for identification, or where the MSO is provided only with copies of identifying documents. The measures are not limited to natural persons, and overseas incorporation or the absence of a Hong Kong bank account are not the trigger ¶4.10.5 names.

tc.q: 就並非自然人的客戶，非面對面的額外措施在何時亦屬相關？
options: 代表客戶行事的自然人未親身到場識別，或只獲提供複本
從不適用——額外措施只適用自然人客戶，不適用於法人客戶
只限該客戶屬於在香港特別行政區境外註冊成立的法人
只限該法人客戶本身完全並無任何香港銀行帳戶
tc.explain: 第4.10.5段訂明，雖然採取額外措施的規定一般適用於屬自然人的客戶，但如並非自然人的客戶透過非面對面渠道與該經營者建立業務關係，該經營者亦應減低任何增加的風險；該等風險可能源於代該客戶行事的自然人並未親身到場以供識別，或該經營者只獲提供身分文件的複本而非正本。有關措施並非只適用於自然人，而在海外註冊成立或並無香港銀行帳戶亦非第4.10.5段所指的觸發點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.1段註腳44

en.q: Which CDD obligation can an MSO never delegate to an intermediary?
options: Continuous monitoring of customer relationship under section 5
Basic identification of who the customer claims to be
Verification of the customer's claimed identity documents
Obtaining information on the purpose of the relationship
en.explain: Footnote 44 to ¶4.11.1 states, for the avoidance of doubt, that an MSO cannot rely on an intermediary to continuously monitor its business relationship with a customer for the purposes of section 5 of Schedule 2. Basic identification, verification of identity documents, and obtaining the purpose of the relationship are CDD measures that ¶4.11.1 does allow an MSO to delegate to an intermediary.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者絕不可將哪一項客戶盡職審查責任交由中介人代辦？
options: 按附表2第5條對客戶關係的持續監察
識別客戶聲稱本人身分的基本資料
核實客戶所聲稱身分的證明文件是否屬實
取得有關該業務關係擬定用途及目的的資料
tc.explain: 第4.11.1段註腳44為免生疑問訂明，該經營者不可倚賴中介人為遵從附表2第5條的規定，而對其與客戶的業務關係進行持續監察。識別客戶基本身分、核實身分證明文件，以及取得業務關係目的的資料，均屬第4.11.1段容許該經營者交由中介人執行的客戶盡職審查措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.1段

en.q: What typically distinguishes a third-party reliance scenario from other arrangements?
options: The third party has its own customer relationship, independent of the MSO's
The third party is paid a per-customer fee by the relying MSO for its services
The third party is always a wholly-owned subsidiary of the relying MSO
The third party is formally appointed by the customer rather than by the MSO
en.explain: ¶4.11.1 states that in a third-party reliance scenario, the third party will usually already have an existing business relationship with the customer, independent from the relationship to be formed with the relying MSO. A fee arrangement, common ownership as a subsidiary, or appointment by the customer rather than the MSO are not what the paragraph identifies as the distinguishing feature.

tc.q: 第三方倚賴安排通常以甚麼與其他安排區別？
options: 第三方與客戶有關係，獨立於倚賴方經營者的關係
該第三方就其每名客戶均向倚賴方經營者收取服務費用
該第三方一律是倚賴方經營者全資擁有的附屬公司機構
該第三方是正式由客戶委任的，而非由該經營者所委任
tc.explain: 第4.11.1段訂明，在第三方倚賴的情況下，該第三方通常已與該客戶有既存業務關係，該關係獨立於客戶與倚賴方經營者將建立的關係。收取服務費用的安排、屬該經營者全資附屬公司，或由客戶而非該經營者正式委任，均非該段所指的區別特徵。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.2段

en.q: Does the intermediary reliance regime apply to outsourcing or agency relationships?
options: No - outsourced entity or agent applies CDD for the MSO, under its procedures and control
Yes - outsourcing and agency both satisfy the section 18 reliance criteria for intermediaries
Yes, provided the outsourced entity gives the written confirmation required under ¶4.11.3
Only where the agent operates under a domestic intermediary category listed in ¶4.11.8
en.explain: ¶4.11.2 states, for the avoidance of doubt, that reliance on intermediaries does not apply to outsourcing or agency relationships, in which the outsourced entity or agent applies the CDD measures on behalf of the MSO, in accordance with the MSO's procedures and subject to the MSO's control of effective implementation. The section 18 reliance criteria, the ¶4.11.3 written confirmation, and the ¶4.11.8 domestic intermediary categories all govern genuine intermediary reliance — a separate regime that outsourcing and agency fall outside of, regardless of these details.

tc.q: 中介人倚賴制度是否適用於外判或代理關係？
options: 否——外判實體或代理代經營者、按程序控制下進行盡職審查
是——外判及代理均符合附表2第18條所定的中介人倚賴準則
是，只要受外判實體按第4.11.3段規定作出書面確認即可
只限該代理人屬於第4.11.8段所列的本地中介人類別
tc.explain: 第4.11.2段為免生疑問訂明，倚賴中介人並不適用於外判或代理關係；在該等關係中，受外判實體或代理人是代該經營者、按該經營者的程序並在該經營者對該等程序有效實施的控制下，進行客戶盡職審查措施。附表2第18條的倚賴準則、第4.11.3段的書面確認，以及第4.11.8段的本地中介人類別，規管的都是真正的中介人倚賴——外判及代理屬另一制度，不論是否符合這些細節均不受其規範。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.3段

en.q: What must the written confirmation obtained from an intermediary specify?
options: That the intermediary agrees to act and which CDD part it performs
Only the intermediary's business contact details and address
The fee schedule payable to the intermediary for its services
The identity of every customer the intermediary will personally handle
en.explain: ¶4.11.3 requires the MSO, when relying on an intermediary, to obtain written confirmation that the intermediary agrees to act as the MSO's intermediary and which part of the section 2 CDD measures it will perform. The intermediary's contact details, its fee, and the identity of every customer it will handle are not what this written confirmation must specify.

tc.q: 從中介人取得的書面確認須訂明甚麼？
options: 中介人同意擔任中介人，並訂明所執行盡職審查措施部分
只須訂明該中介人的聯絡方式、辦公地址及電郵地址等資料
須訂明應付予該中介人的具體服務費用總金額詳情
該中介人本身將會親自處理的每一名客戶身分資料
tc.explain: 第4.11.3段規定該經營者在倚賴中介人時，須從該中介人取得書面確認，訂明其同意擔任該經營者的中介人，並訂明其將進行附表2第2條所指明客戶盡職審查措施的哪一部分。該中介人的聯絡方式、應付予其的費用，以及其將親自處理的每名客戶身分，均非該書面確認須訂明的內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.5段

en.q: For how long should an MSO obtain an undertaking from its intermediary to keep the underlying CDD information?
options: Throughout the relationship and for at least five years from the date it ends, or until such time as the CCE may specify
For at least five years beginning on the date the underlying transaction was completed, regardless of when the relationship ends
For as long as the intermediary agreement between the MSO and the intermediary remains contractually in force
For two years beginning on the date the intermediary itself performed the CDD measure
en.explain: ¶4.11.5 states that where these documents and records are kept by the intermediary, the MSO should obtain an undertaking from the intermediary to keep all underlying CDD information throughout the continuance of the MSO's business relationship with the customer and for at least five years beginning on the date the relationship ends, or until such time as may be specified by the CCE. Five years from transaction completion is the real trigger for transaction records under AMLO Schedule 2 section 20(2) — a different record, with a different start date.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應要求其中介人承諾保存相關客戶盡職審查資料多久？
options: 在該業務關係持續期間，並自關係終止之日起計至少五年；或直至關長指明的時間
自有關交易完成的日期起計至少五年期間內，不論業務關係其後於何時終止均須保存
只要該經營者與該中介人之間所簽訂的中介協議仍然具有合約效力
自該中介人進行有關的客戶盡職審查措施之日起計兩年為止
tc.explain: 第4.11.5段訂明，如有關文件及紀錄由該中介人保存，該經營者應取得該中介人的承諾，在該經營者與客戶的業務關係持續期間，並自該業務關係終止之日起計至少五年，或直至關長指明的時間，保存所有相關客戶盡職審查資料。自交易完成之日起計五年，是附表2第20(2)條就交易紀錄訂明的觸發點——屬另一類紀錄，起算日亦不同。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.5段

en.q: What further undertaking should an MSO obtain from an intermediary about the intermediary's own future?
options: An undertaking to supply copies of all CDD information if it stops trading or stops acting for the MSO
An undertaking to give the MSO twelve months' advance written notice of any decision to cease trading altogether
An undertaking to transfer all of the intermediary's own customers directly to the MSO
An undertaking to maintain a minimum level of professional indemnity insurance at all times
en.explain: ¶4.11.5 states that the MSO should also obtain an undertaking from the intermediary to supply copies of all underlying CDD information in circumstances where the intermediary is about to cease trading or does not act as an intermediary for the MSO anymore. A notice period, a customer transfer, and an insurance requirement are not what this further undertaking covers.

tc.q: 就中介人本身日後的狀況，金錢服務經營者還應取得甚麼承諾？
options: 承諾在該中介人即將停業或不再擔任其中介人時，提供所有相關資料的副本
承諾在其停止經營業務之前最少十二個月，以書面形式向經營者發出事先通知
承諾將該中介人本身名下的所有客戶，直接轉移予該經營者
承諾一直維持不低於指定水平的專業彌償保險保額
tc.explain: 第4.11.5段訂明該經營者亦應取得該中介人的承諾：在該中介人即將停業，或不再擔任該經營者的中介人的情況下，提供所有相關客戶盡職審查資料的副本。通知期、客戶轉移或保險規定，均非此項進一步承諾所涵蓋的內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.6段

en.q: What testing should an MSO conduct in relation to its intermediary?
options: Sample tests from time to time, ensuring CDD information is produced without undue delay
A full annual audit covering every aspect of the intermediary's business operations
A criminal record check on each of the intermediary's individual staff members
A financial solvency review of the intermediary's balance sheet each year
en.explain: ¶4.11.6 states that an MSO should conduct sample tests from time to time to ensure CDD information and documentation is produced by the intermediary upon demand and without undue delay — the practical check on the ¶4.11.3(b) requirement. A full business audit, staff criminal checks, and a solvency review are different kinds of scrutiny, not this sample-testing duty.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應就其中介人進行甚麼測試？
options: 不時進行抽樣測試，以確保該中介人應要求毫不無理延誤地提供資料
每年對該中介人整體業務營運進行全面審計，範圍與盡職審查無關
對該中介人每名個別員工進行犯罪紀錄查核
每年檢視該中介人資產負債表所反映的整體財務償債能力狀況
tc.explain: 第4.11.6段訂明該經營者應不時進行抽樣測試，以確保該中介人會應要求毫不無理延誤地提供客戶盡職審查資料及文件——這是對第4.11.3(b)款規定的實務查核。全面業務審計、員工犯罪紀錄查核及償債能力檢視均屬不同類型的審視，並非此項抽樣測試的職責。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.7段

en.q: What should an MSO do if it has doubts about the reliability of its intermediary, and if it decides to terminate that relationship?
options: Review the intermediary's CDD ability; if terminating, immediately obtain its CDD information
Continue the arrangement unchanged until the next regularly scheduled periodic review takes place
Report the intermediary to the CCE and take no further step of its own
Require the intermediary to fully indemnify the MSO against any resulting loss
en.explain: ¶4.11.7 states that whenever an MSO has doubts as to the reliability of the intermediary it should take reasonable steps to review the intermediary's ability to perform its CDD duties; if it intends to terminate the relationship it should immediately obtain all CDD information from the intermediary; and if it doubts CDD previously carried out it should perform the required CDD itself as soon as reasonably practicable. Waiting for the next scheduled review, reporting to the CCE with no further step, and an indemnity clause are not this obligation.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者對其中介人的可靠性存疑，以及決定終止該關係時，應怎樣做？
options: 檢視中介人履行盡職審查職責的能力；如擬終止，須即時取得盡職審查資料
維持該安排不變，直至下一次按原定計劃進行的定期檢視為止，暫不採取行動
向關長舉報該中介人，而不再採取任何其他步驟
要求該中介人就任何因此而生的損失向該經營者作出全面彌償
tc.explain: 第4.11.7段訂明，每當該經營者對中介人的可靠性存疑時，應採取合理步驟檢視該中介人履行客戶盡職審查職責的能力；如擬終止與該中介人的關係，應即時從該中介人取得所有客戶盡職審查資料；如對該中介人此前所進行的客戶盡職審查措施存疑，則應在合理切實可行範圍內盡快自行進行所需的客戶盡職審查。等待下次定期檢視、僅舉報關長而不採取其他步驟，或彌償條款，均非此項責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.11.4段

en.q: What must an MSO obtain from an intermediary immediately after the intermediary has carried out a CDD measure?
options: The data obtained in carrying out that measure, not necessarily a document copy too
A certified true copy of every underlying document obtained by the intermediary
A full written report explaining the CDD process the intermediary followed
Nothing at all, until the MSO makes a specific written request for it
en.explain: ¶4.11.4 states that an MSO carrying out a CDD measure by means of an intermediary must, immediately after the intermediary has carried out that measure, obtain from the intermediary the data or information obtained in the course of carrying it out, but nothing in the paragraph requires the MSO to obtain at the same time a copy of the document or record obtained by the intermediary. A certified document copy, a written process report, and 'nothing until requested' all get this immediate obligation backwards or wrong.

tc.q: 中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施後，金錢服務經營者須即時從其取得甚麼？
options: 該中介人進行該措施時所取得的數據或資料，但無須同時取得文件的副本
該中介人在進行該項措施時所取得的每一份相關文件的經核證真實副本
一份詳述該中介人所遵循的盡職審查程序的完整書面報告
完全無須取得任何東西，直至該經營者提出特定的書面要求為止
tc.explain: 第4.11.4段訂明藉中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施的該經營者，須在該中介人進行該措施後即時從其取得該中介人在進行過程中所取得的數據或資料；但該段並不要求該經營者同時取得該中介人所取得文件的副本或紀錄。經核證文件副本、書面程序報告，或「未提出要求前無須取得」，均是把這項即時義務的內容說錯或說反了。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.10.1段

en.q: Which specific risk does the Guideline identify as arising from customers not physically present for identification?
options: Impersonation risk
Customer risk factors
Country risk factors
Product risk factors
en.explain: ¶4.10.1 states that the AMLO permits MSOs to establish business relationships through both face-to-face and non-face-to-face channels, but that an MSO should take additional measures to mitigate the risk — giving impersonation risk as the example — associated with customers not physically present for identification purposes. Customer, country and product risk factors are the broader categories set out in the neighbouring ¶4.9.5, not the specific risk named here.

tc.q: 本指引指出客戶並未親身到場以供識別會產生哪一項特定風險？
options: 假冒身分的風險
客戶風險因素
國家風險因素
產品風險因素
tc.explain: 第4.10.1段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》容許金錢服務經營者透過面對面及非面對面渠道建立業務關係；但該經營者應採取額外措施，減低與客戶並未親身到場以供識別相關的風險（並以假冒身分的風險為例）。客戶、國家及產品風險因素是相鄰的第4.9.5段所列的較廣泛類別，並非本段所指的特定風險。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.10.3段

en.q: On what does the extent of the additional non-face-to-face measures depend?
options: The nature and characteristics of requested product or service, and customer's assessed ML/TF risk
Whether the measures are proportionate, appropriate and discriminating, and justifiable to the CCE
The nature, size and complexity of the MSO's own business, the standard used for audit review frequency
The nature of the PEP's prominent public function and the geographical risk of their jurisdiction
en.explain: ¶4.10.3 states that the extent of the additional measures set out in ¶4.10.1 depends on the nature and characteristics of the product or service requested and the assessed ML/TF risks presented by the customer. The proportionality/CCE-justification test belongs to ¶4.9.2, the audit-review standard to ¶3.13, and the PEP-specific factors to ¶4.9.23 — each real, but governing a different question.

tc.q: 非面對面額外措施的程度取決於什麼？
options: 所需產品或服務性質及特點，以及客戶經評估的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險
有關措施是否合乎比例、適當及因情況而異，並能否向關長提供理據
該經營者本身業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，如同內部審計覆核頻密程度的標準
政治人物所擔任重要公職的性質，以及其所處司法管轄區的地區風險
tc.explain: 第4.10.3段訂明第4.10.1段所列額外措施的程度，取決於所要求產品或服務的性質及特點，以及該客戶經評估的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。第4.9.2段的相稱性測試、第3.13段的審計覆核標準，以及第4.9.23段政治人物的特定因素，均屬真實規定，但分別適用於不同事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.7(a)(ii)段

en.q: Which officials are expressly excluded from the non-Hong Kong PEP categories?
options: Middle-ranking or more junior officials of the listed categories
Senior state-owned corporation executives and political party officials
Senior government, judicial or military officials
Heads of state, heads of government and senior politicians
en.explain: ¶4.9.7(a)(ii) expressly excludes a middle-ranking or more junior official of any of the categories listed in sub-paragraph (i). Those categories — heads of state/government and senior politicians; senior government, judicial or military officials; and senior executives of state-owned corporations and important political party officials — are themselves included in the non-Hong Kong PEP definition when held at senior rank.

tc.q: 哪些官員被明文剔除於非香港政治人物的類別之外？
options: 所列任何類別的中級或更低級官員
國有企業的高級行政人員及政黨官員
高級政府、司法或軍方官員
國家元首、政府首長及高級從政者
tc.explain: 第4.9.7(a)(ii)段明文剔除(i)節所列任何類別中的中級或更低級官員。該等類別——國家元首、政府首長及高級從政者；高級政府、司法或軍方官員；以及國有企業的高級行政人員及重要政黨官員——在屬高級別時，本身均包含在非香港政治人物的定義之內。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.8段

en.q: Which two limbs make up the definition of a close associate of a PEP?
options: Close business relations with the PEP; or beneficial ownership of a legal person/trust for the PEP's benefit
A spouse, partner, child or parent of the PEP; or a spouse or partner of a child of the PEP
An individual who permanently resides with the PEP; or one formally employed in the PEP's household or office
An individual who has carried out a transaction with the PEP; or one who shares the same nationality as the PEP
en.explain: ¶4.9.8 defines a close associate as (a) an individual who has close business relations with the PEP, including a co-beneficial owner of a legal person or trust; or (b) an individual who is the beneficial owner of a legal person or trust set up for the PEP's benefit. The spouse/child/parent limb belongs to the separate family-member definition in ¶4.9.7(b), not to 'close associate'; residence, employment, past transactions and nationality play no part in either definition.

tc.q: 政治人物「密切聯繫人」的定義由哪兩部分組成？
options: 與政治人物有密切關係者；或為其利益設立的法人／信託實益擁有人
該政治人物的配偶、伴侶、子女或父母；或該政治人物子女的配偶或伴侶
與該政治人物永久同住的個人；或受雇於該政治人物家庭或辦公室的個人
曾與該政治人物進行交易的個人；或與該政治人物國籍相同的個人
tc.explain: 第4.9.8段將密切聯繫人界定為：(a)與該政治人物有密切業務關係的個人，包括與其同為法人或信託實益擁有人者；或(b)為該政治人物的利益而設立的法人或信託的實益擁有人。配偶／子女／父母一項屬第4.9.7(b)段另一項家庭成員的定義，並非「密切聯繫人」；同住、受雇、曾交易或國籍相同均非兩項定義的要素。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.17段註腳40

en.q: For the purposes of ¶4.9.17, what must an MSO take into account in determining whether a business relationship presents a high ML/TF risk?
options: All risk factors relevant to the business relationship, including those set out in ¶4.9.5
Only the customer's PEP status, without regard to the other risk factors in ¶4.9.5
Only the transaction size, assessed under the transaction-monitoring rules in Chapter 5
Only the customer's jurisdiction of residence, per the country risk factors in ¶4.9.5(c)
en.explain: Footnote 40 to ¶4.9.17 states that in determining whether a business relationship presents a high ML/TF risk, an MSO should take into account all risk factors — including those in ¶4.9.5 — relevant to the relationship, not any single factor such as PEP status, transaction size or jurisdiction alone.

tc.q: 就第4.9.17段而言，在斷定某業務關係是否構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險時，金錢服務經營者須顧及什麼？
options: 與該業務關係相關的所有風險因素，包括第4.9.5段所載者
只限該客戶的政治人物身分，而不顧第4.9.5段所載的其他風險因素
只限交易金額，按第5章的交易監察規則評估
只限該客戶居住的司法管轄區，屬第4.9.5(c)段的國家風險因素
tc.explain: 第4.9.17段註腳40訂明，在斷定某業務關係是否構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險時，該經營者應顧及與該業務關係相關的所有風險因素，包括第4.9.5段所載者，而非僅其中單一因素（如政治人物身分、交易金額或司法管轄區）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.9.6(f)段

en.q: Which payment-related measure is listed among the possible enhanced due diligence measures?
options: Requiring first payment through an account in customer's name at a bank with similar CDD standards
Requiring payments to be made in cash at the counter, regardless of the transaction's risk rating
Requiring the customer to prepay a security deposit equal to the value of the intended transaction
Requiring payments to be split into amounts below the $8,000 CDD threshold to avoid extra scrutiny
en.explain: ¶4.9.6(f) lists among the possible EDD measures requiring the first payment to be carried out through an account in the customer's name with a bank subject to similar CDD standards. Splitting payments below $8,000 is not an EDD measure at all — ¶4.9.5(b)(ii) lists it as a higher-risk red flag (structuring to avoid a CDD threshold), the opposite of a mitigating measure.

tc.q: 下列哪一項與付款有關的措施列於可行的加強盡職審查措施之中？
options: 要求首筆付款透過客戶名義在受類似盡職審查標準規限銀行帳戶進行
要求所有付款一律在櫃檯以現金作出，不論該筆交易的風險評級高低
要求該客戶預先繳付相等於擬進行交易金額的保證金
要求將付款拆細至低於8,000元的盡職審查門檻，以規避審查
tc.explain: 第4.9.6(f)段在可行的加強盡職審查措施中，列出要求首筆付款透過以該客戶名義在受類似客戶盡職審查標準規限的銀行開立的帳戶進行。將付款拆細至8,000元以下並非加強盡職審查措施——第4.9.5(b)(ii)段反將此列為較高風險的警號（即以拆細交易規避盡職審查門檻），與緩解措施恰恰相反。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.12.1段

en.q: Who is a pre-existing customer for the purposes of ¶4.12 of the Guideline?
options: A customer whose relationship was established before the AMLO commenced on 1 April 2012
A customer whose relationship has lasted more than five years, matching the CDD record-keeping period
A customer onboarded before the MSO obtained its money service operator licence
A customer who has been dormant for more than twelve months without reactivation
en.explain: ¶4.12.1 defines pre-existing customers as those with whom the business relationship was established before the AMLO came into effect on 1 April 2012, and requires the MSO to perform CDD in respect of them when any of four listed circumstances arises. Five years is instead the minimum CDD record-keeping period under Chapter 8; licensing date and dormancy are not the statutory test.

tc.q: 就本指引第4.12段而言，何謂「先前客戶」？
options: 在《打擊洗錢條例》於2012年4月1日生效前已建立業務關係的客戶
業務關係已維持超過五年，與客戶盡職審查紀錄的最低備存年期相同
在該經營者取得金錢服務經營者牌照之前已開立帳戶的客戶
已停用超過十二個月而一直未有重新啟用的客戶
tc.explain: 第4.12.1段將先前客戶界定為在《打擊洗錢條例》於2012年4月1日生效前已與其建立業務關係的客戶；並規定該經營者在出現所列四種情況之一時，須就該等客戶進行客戶盡職審查。五年是第8章所訂的最低備存紀錄年期，並非「先前客戶」的法定測試；取得牌照的日期及停用狀況亦非有關測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.12.1段

en.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the four circumstances triggering CDD on a pre-existing customer?
options: The customer has not transacted with the MSO for twelve consecutive months
A transaction takes place that is unusual or suspicious by virtue of its amount or nature
A material change occurs in the way in which the customer's account is operated
The MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of information previously obtained to identify or verify the customer
en.explain: ¶4.12.1 lists four triggers: an unusual or suspicious transaction, or one inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, the customer's business or risk profile, or its knowledge of the source of funds; a material change in the way the account is operated; suspicion that the customer or the account is involved in ML/TF; and doubt about the veracity or adequacy of information previously obtained. Mere inactivity is not itself a trigger, though ¶4.12.2 treats re-activation of a dormant account as one.

tc.q: 下列何者並非就先前客戶觸發客戶盡職審查的四種情況之一？
options: 該客戶連續十二個月沒有與該經營者進行交易
發生一宗按其款額或性質屬不尋常或可疑的交易
該客戶帳戶的運作方式出現重大變動
該經營者對此前為識別或核實該客戶身分而取得的任何資料的真確性或充分性存疑
tc.explain: 第4.12.1段列出四項觸發情況：交易屬不尋常或可疑，或與該經營者對該客戶、其業務或風險狀況的了解，或對其資金來源的了解不一致；該客戶帳戶的運作方式出現重大變動；該經營者懷疑該客戶或其帳戶涉及洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集；以及對此前所取得資料的真確性或充分性存疑。單純不活躍本身並非觸發情況，但第4.12.2段將重新啟用停用帳戶視為觸發事件之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.12.1(a)段

en.q: Under ¶4.12.1(a), against what may a transaction by a pre-existing customer be measured to see whether CDD is triggered?
options: The MSO's knowledge of the customer, their business/risk profile, or funds source
The average transaction size across the MSO's entire customer base over the past year
The statutory occasional-transaction thresholds of $8,000 and $120,000 applied uniformly
The customer's credit rating issued by a recognized credit reference agency in Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶4.12.1(a) triggers CDD where a transaction is, by virtue of its amount or nature, unusual or suspicious, or is inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, the customer's business or risk profile, or of the source of the customer's funds — not against a portfolio average, the statutory CDD thresholds, or a credit rating, none of which ¶4.12.1(a) mentions.

tc.q: 根據第4.12.1(a)段，先前客戶的交易須與什麼比對，以判斷是否觸發客戶盡職審查？
options: 該經營者對客戶、其業務或風險狀況的了解，或其資金來源了解
該經營者整體客戶群於過去一整年內的平均單宗交易金額
法定的8,000元及120,000元單一宗交易門檻劃一適用
該客戶於香港認可的信貸資料機構所持有的信貸評級
tc.explain: 第4.12.1(a)段訂明，如發生的交易按其款額或性質屬不尋常或可疑；或與該經營者對該客戶或該客戶的業務或風險狀況的了解，或與其對該客戶資金來源的了解並不一致，即觸發客戶盡職審查——並非與客戶群平均交易額、法定盡職審查門檻或信貸評級比對，第4.12.1(a)段並無提及這些。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.12.2段

en.q: Which examples of trigger events does ¶4.12.2 give, and what does it add?
options: Re-activating a dormant account or a change in beneficial ownership/control, plus other MSO triggers
Re-activation of a dormant account only — the Guideline treats this as its exhaustive, complete list
A change in the customer's correspondence address only, with no other trigger events ever considered
Any transaction above the $8,000 occasional-transaction threshold only, with no others considered
en.explain: ¶4.12.2 states that trigger events may include the re-activation of a dormant account or a change in the beneficial ownership or control of the account, but that the MSO will need to consider other trigger events specific to their own customers and business — the examples are illustrative, not exhaustive, and are not limited to an address change or the $8,000 threshold.

tc.q: 第4.12.2段舉出哪些觸發事件的例子，並補充了什麼？
options: 重新啟用停用帳戶，或帳戶實益擁有權或控制權變動，及經營者特有其他觸發事件
僅重新啟用停用帳戶一項；本指引將此列為窮盡而不可再作擴展的觸發事件清單
僅客戶通訊地址出現變更一項，從不考慮任何其他類型的觸發事件
僅涉及超過8,000元單一宗交易門檻的交易一項，不考慮任何其他事件
tc.explain: 第4.12.2段訂明觸發事件可包括重新啟用停用帳戶，或該帳戶的實益擁有權或控制權出現變動；但該經營者須考慮其本身客戶及業務所特有的其他觸發事件——該等例子屬示例而非詳盡清單，並不限於通訊地址變更或8,000元門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.12.3段

en.q: Do the ongoing monitoring requirements under section 5 of Schedule 2 apply to pre-existing customers?
options: Yes — ¶4.12.3 expressly states that they also apply to pre-existing customers
No — ongoing monitoring applies only to relationships established on or after 1 April 2012
Only where the pre-existing customer is assessed as high risk
Only once a ¶4.12.1 trigger event has occurred
en.explain: ¶4.12.3 states that an MSO should note that the requirements for ongoing monitoring under section 5 of Schedule 2 also apply to pre-existing customers, cross-referring to Chapter 5. The ¶4.12.1 triggers govern when full CDD must be performed; they do not switch ongoing monitoring on or off.

tc.q: 附表2第5條的持續監察規定是否適用於先前客戶？
options: 適用——第4.12.3段明文訂明該等規定同樣適用於先前客戶
不適用——持續監察只適用於2012年4月1日或之後建立的業務關係
只在該先前客戶被評為高風險時適用
只在出現第4.12.1段的觸發事件後方適用
tc.explain: 第4.12.3段訂明該經營者應注意，附表2第5條的持續監察規定同樣適用於先前客戶，並參照第5章。第4.12.1段的觸發情況只規範何時須進行全面客戶盡職審查，並不影響持續監察的適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.13.1段

en.q: Which requirements in ¶4.13.1 must an MSO be unable to comply with before the prohibition on establishing a relationship bites?
options: The CDD requirements in Chapter 4, the ongoing due diligence requirements in Chapter 5, or both
The CDD requirements in Chapter 4 only, without regard to Chapter 5's ongoing due diligence duties
The record-keeping requirements in Chapter 8 only, not the CDD or ongoing due diligence chapters
The staff training and screening requirements in Chapter 9 only, not Chapters 4 or 5
en.explain: ¶4.13.1 applies where the MSO is unable to comply with the relevant CDD requirements set out in Chapter 4 and the ongoing due diligence requirements set out in Chapter 5 — a failure of either (or both) engages the paragraph, so a lapse at the ongoing-monitoring stage alone is enough to trigger it, not only a lapse at onboarding.

tc.q: 在禁止建立業務關係的規定生效前，金錢服務經營者須是無法遵從第4.13.1段所指的哪些規定？
options: 第4章所載的客戶盡職審查規定、第5章所載的持續盡職審查規定，或兩者兼備
只限第4章所載的客戶盡職審查規定，不涉及第5章的持續盡職審查責任
只限第8章所載的備存紀錄規定，不涉及客戶盡職審查或持續盡職審查章節
只限第9章所載的員工培訓及篩選規定，不涉及第4章或第5章
tc.explain: 第4.13.1段適用於該經營者無法遵從第4章所載相關客戶盡職審查規定，及第5章所載持續盡職審查規定的情況——只要其中一項（或兩者）失效即觸發本段，故僅在持續監察階段（而非只在開立客戶階段）出現的失誤，同樣足以觸發本段。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.13.1段

en.q: Where an MSO cannot satisfactorily complete CDD on an existing customer, how quickly should the business relationship be terminated?
options: As soon as reasonably practicable, where applicable
Within 3 business days, matching the wire-transfer information deadline
Within 5 years, matching the CDD record-keeping retention period
Only after the CCE has given prior written approval to the termination
en.explain: ¶4.13.1 provides that where the MSO is unable to comply with the relevant CDD and ongoing due diligence requirements it must not establish a business relationship or carry out any occasional transaction, or must terminate the relationship as soon as reasonably practicable where applicable. Three business days is instead the ¶10.12 deadline for supplying missing wire-transfer originator information; five years is the Chapter 8 record-keeping period; the CCE plays no approval role here.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者未能就現有客戶圓滿完成客戶盡職審查，應多快終止該業務關係？
options: 在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止（如適用）
須於3個營業日內終止，與電傳轉帳資料的補交期限相同
須於5年內終止，與客戶盡職審查紀錄的備存年期相同
須待海關關長事先給予書面批准後方可終止
tc.explain: 第4.13.1段訂明如該經營者無法遵從相關客戶盡職審查及持續盡職審查規定，則不得與該客戶建立業務關係或進行任何單一宗交易；或（如適用）須在合理切實可行範圍內盡快終止業務關係。3個營業日是第10.12段補交發起人資料的期限；5年是第8章的備存紀錄年期；海關關長在此並無批核角色。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.13.1段

en.q: Does terminating a relationship for failed CDD automatically require an STR?
options: No, an STR follows from relevant knowledge or suspicion, not termination alone
Yes — every termination for failed CDD automatically requires an STR to be filed
No — once the relationship has been terminated, a suspicion formed before it need not be reported
Yes — but only where the customer formally disputes the termination decision
en.explain: ¶4.13.1 couples the prohibition and termination duty with 'where there is relevant knowledge or suspicion, should make an STR to the JFIU'. The reporting duty turns on knowledge or suspicion, not on the fact of termination — though the circumstances that defeated CDD will often themselves give rise to suspicion, termination by itself is neither necessary nor sufficient for an STR.

tc.q: 因客戶盡職審查未能完成而終止業務關係，是否自動須作出可疑交易報告？
options: 否——只在有相關知悉或懷疑時方須作出報告；終止本身並非判斷準則
是——每宗因客戶盡職審查失敗而終止的個案均自動須提交可疑交易報告
不需要——業務關係一經終止，終止前形成的懷疑便無須再作報告
是——但只限該客戶正式就終止決定提出書面爭議的情況
tc.explain: 第4.13.1段將禁止及終止的責任與「如有相關知悉或懷疑，則應向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告」一併訂明。報告責任取決於知悉或懷疑，而非取決於是否終止關係——惟導致客戶盡職審查無法完成的情況本身往往亦足以構成懷疑；終止本身既非必要，亦非充分的觸發條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5、10.6、10.9及11.3段

en.q: A customer sends the equivalent of HK$9,000 in United States dollars through an MSO, whether by wire transfer or other remittance. Does the $8,000 threshold apply?
options: Yes — the threshold is $8,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency
No — the thresholds apply only to transfers and remittances denominated in Hong Kong dollars
No — foreign currency transfers are governed by the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold instead
Yes — but only if the customer chooses to settle the transfer in Hong Kong dollars
en.explain: ¶10.5, ¶10.6 and ¶10.9 (wire transfers) and ¶11.3 (other remittances) each express the threshold as an amount equal to or above $8,000 'or an equivalent amount in any other currency'. The currency in which a transfer or remittance is denominated therefore does not affect whether the information, verification or recording requirements apply, whichever route the customer uses.

tc.q: 某客戶透過金錢服務經營者匯出相當於港幣9,000元的美元款項，不論以電傳轉帳或其他匯款方式進行。8,000元的門檻是否適用？
options: 適用——門檻為8,000元或任何其他貨幣的等值款額
不適用——該等門檻只適用於以港元計值的電傳轉帳及匯款
不適用——外幣轉帳改為受120,000元的單一宗交易門檻規限
適用——但只限該客戶選擇以港元結算該筆轉帳的情況
tc.explain: 第10.5、10.6及10.9段（電傳轉帳）與第11.3段（其他匯款）均將門檻表述為相等於或高於8,000元「或任何其他貨幣的等值款額」。因此，不論客戶採用何種途徑，轉帳或匯款以何種貨幣計值，並不影響資料、核實身分或備存紀錄等規定是否適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段註腳49

en.q: What is a numbered account, as described in the Guideline?
options: An account where the MSO knows the customer's name but later replaces it with a number or code
An account for which the MSO has never obtained or recorded any customer name at all
An account identified only by the customer's identity document number, with no name recorded
An account held jointly by several customers, none of whom is individually named in it
en.explain: Footnote 49 to ¶4.14.1 explains that in respect of a numbered account, the name of the customer and/or the beneficial owner is known to the MSO but is substituted by an account number or code name in subsequent documentation. An account with no name ever obtained or recorded would instead be the anonymous account that ¶4.14.1 prohibits outright.

tc.q: 按本指引所述，何謂「編號帳戶」？
options: 經營者知悉客戶姓名後文件以號碼或代號取代的帳戶
該經營者從未取得或記錄任何客戶姓名的帳戶
僅以身分證明文件號碼識別、從未記錄姓名的帳戶
由多名客戶聯名持有、當中無人被個別具名的帳戶
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段註腳49解釋，就編號帳戶而言，該經營者知悉客戶（及／或實益擁有人）的姓名，但在其後的文件中以帳戶號碼或代號取代該姓名。從未取得或記錄姓名的帳戶，則屬第4.14.1段明文禁止的匿名帳戶，而非編號帳戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段

en.q: What standard of CDD and control applies to a confidential numbered account?
options: Exactly the same CDD and control measures as any other business relationship
A reduced set of measures reflecting the account's confidentiality, decided case-by-case
Enhanced measures in every case, regardless of the account's assessed risk
No measures at all, since the account holder is identified only by a code
en.explain: ¶4.14.1 states that confidential numbered accounts should not function as anonymous accounts; rather they should be subject to exactly the same CDD and control measures as all other business relationships. Confidentiality affects how the customer is referred to in documentation, not whether the measures are reduced, automatically enhanced, or dispensed with.

tc.q: 保密編號帳戶適用何種客戶盡職審查及管控標準？
options: 與任何其他業務關係完全相同的客戶盡職審查及管控措施
因應帳戶的保密性而酌情採用較寬鬆的措施
不論該帳戶的評估風險如何，一律採用加強措施
完全無須採取任何措施，因帳戶持有人僅以代號識別
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段訂明保密編號帳戶不應以匿名帳戶的方式運作，而應受與所有其他業務關係完全相同的客戶盡職審查及管控措施規限。保密性只影響文件中如何稱呼該客戶，並不會使措施變得寬鬆、自動加強或完全豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段

en.q: To how many staff must the identity of a numbered account holder be known?
options: A sufficient number of staff for effective CDD and ongoing monitoring
Exactly one designated staff member, to preserve the account's confidentiality
Every front-line staff member of the MSO, regardless of role or seniority
The compliance officer alone, to the exclusion of all other staff
en.explain: ¶4.14.1 states that while a numbered account can offer additional confidentiality, the customer's identity must be verified by the MSO and known to a sufficient number of staff to facilitate effective CDD and ongoing monitoring — not a single gatekeeper, the entire front line, or the compliance officer alone.

tc.q: 編號帳戶持有人的身分須為多少員工所知悉？
options: 足夠員工，以便有效盡職審查及持續監察
只限一名指定員工，以維持該帳戶的保密性
該經營者的每一名前線員工，不論職級高低
只限合規主任一人，不包括其他所有員工
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段訂明，雖然編號帳戶可為客戶提供額外保密性，但該經營者必須核實該客戶的身分，且該身分須為足夠數目的員工所知悉，以便有效進行客戶盡職審查及持續監察——並非只限一名把關人員、全體前線員工，或合規主任一人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段註腳50

en.q: Whose name must appear on a wire transfer or remittance made from a numbered account?
options: The real name of the account holder
The account number or code name used for the account
The name of the MSO carrying out the transfer
No name is required for numbered accounts
en.explain: Footnote 50 to ¶4.14.1 gives as an example of the same control measures that wire transfers, and remittance service, from numbered accounts must reflect the real name of the account holder. The code name may be used in the MSO's internal documentation but not in the payment message.

tc.q: 從編號帳戶作出的電傳轉帳或匯款，須顯示何人的姓名？
options: 該帳戶持有人的真實姓名
該帳戶所用的帳戶號碼或代號
進行該轉帳的金錢服務經營者的名稱
編號帳戶無須顯示任何姓名
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段註腳50以此為相同管控措施的例子：從編號帳戶作出的電傳轉帳及匯款服務，必須反映該帳戶持有人的真實姓名。代號可用於該經營者的內部文件，但不得用於付款訊息。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.14.1段

en.q: To whom must a customer's CDD record be available, whether or not the relationship involves a numbered account?
options: The CCE, competent authorities, the CO, auditors, and other staff with due authority
The JFIU, the HKMA, and the customer's relationship manager only
The CO and external auditors only, to the exclusion of the CCE and other competent authorities
Any staff member who requests access, without regard to their role or authority level
en.explain: ¶4.14.1 states that in all cases, whether the relationship involves numbered accounts or not, the customer's CDD record must be available to the CCE, other competent authorities, the CO, auditors, and other staff with appropriate authority. The JFIU and HKMA are real AML bodies but are not named here, and a relationship manager has no special access right; nor is the list limited to just the CO and auditors, or opened to any requesting staff member.

tc.q: 不論業務關係是否涉及編號帳戶，客戶的盡職審查紀錄須可供何人查閱？
options: 海關關長、主管當局、合規主任、審計師及有權限員工
聯合財富情報組、香港金融管理局，以及該客戶的客戶經理
只限合規主任及審計師，不包括海關關長及其他主管當局
任何提出查閱要求的員工，不論其職級或權限
tc.explain: 第4.14.1段訂明在所有情況下，不論業務關係是否涉及編號帳戶，客戶的盡職審查紀錄均須可供海關關長、其他主管當局、合規主任、審計師，以及具備適當權限的其他員工查閱。聯合財富情報組及香港金融管理局均為真實的打擊洗錢機構，但並非本段所列者；客戶經理亦無特別查閱權；名單亦未局限於合規主任及審計師，或開放予任何提出要求的員工。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.1段

en.q: To whom should EDD be applied where the FATF calls for it in respect of a jurisdiction?
options: Natural and legal persons, including FIs, from that jurisdiction — proportionate to the risks
Only individual customers from that jurisdiction who are also assessed as politically exposed persons
Only financial institutions from that jurisdiction that are not subject to similar CDD standards
Only business relationships established after the FATF's call for action, not existing ones
en.explain: ¶4.15.1 states that an MSO should apply EDD measures, proportionate to the risks, to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons — including FIs — from jurisdictions for which this is called for by the FATF, in accordance with the guidance in ¶4.9. The scope is not limited to PEP individuals, non-compliant FIs, or relationships formed only after the FATF's call.

tc.q: 如財務行動特別組織就某司法管轄區呼籲採取加強盡職審查，該措施應適用於何人？
options: 與來自該司法管轄區的自然人及法人（包括金融機構），並與風險相稱
只限來自該司法管轄區、同時被評為政治人物的個人客戶
只限來自該司法管轄區、未受類似客戶盡職審查標準規限的金融機構
只限財務行動特別組織發出呼籲後才建立的業務關係，不包括現有關係
tc.explain: 第4.15.1段訂明該經營者應按照第4.9段所提供的指引，就與來自財務行動特別組織呼籲採取此等措施的司法管轄區的自然人及法人（包括金融機構）的業務關係及交易，採取與風險相稱的加強盡職審查措施。範圍並不限於政治人物個人客戶、不合規的金融機構，或僅在呼籲發出後才建立的業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.2段

en.q: By what means, and in what two forms, may the CCE act where mandatory EDD or countermeasures are called for?
options: Via written notice, imposing Schedule 2 s.15 obligation or requiring specific countermeasures
Through an oral direction to licensees, or a press release naming the affected jurisdiction
Through an amendment to Schedule 2 itself, or a new condition attached to the MSO's licence
Through a court order obtained by the CCE, or a formal direction issued to the JFIU
en.explain: ¶4.15.2 provides that where mandatory EDD or countermeasures are called for by the FATF, or in other circumstances independent of any FATF call but also considered higher risk, the CCE may, through a notice in writing, (a) impose a general obligation on MSOs to comply with section 15 of Schedule 2, or (b) require MSOs to undertake specific countermeasures described in the notice. Oral directions, press releases, licence conditions, court orders and JFIU directions are not the mechanism ¶4.15.2 describes.

tc.q: 在須採取強制性加強盡職審查或反制措施的情況下，海關關長可透過甚麼方式、以哪兩種形式行事？
options: 以書面通知施加附表2第15條一般責任，或要求採取特定反制措施
透過向持牌人發出口頭指示，或發出點名有關司法管轄區的新聞稿
透過修訂附表2本身，或於該經營者的牌照附加新條件
透過海關關長取得的法院命令，或向聯合財富情報組發出的正式指示
tc.explain: 第4.15.2段訂明，如財務行動特別組織呼籲採取強制性加強盡職審查或反制措施，或在獨立於任何該等呼籲但同樣被視為較高風險的其他情況下，海關關長可透過書面通知：(a)向金錢服務經營者施加遵從附表2第15條規定的一般責任；或(b)要求金錢服務經營者採取該通知所述的特定反制措施。口頭指示、新聞稿、牌照條件、法院命令及聯合財富情報組指示均非第4.15.2段所指的方式。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.2段

en.q: How is the severity of measures imposed by the CCE under ¶4.15.2 calibrated?
options: They are proportionate to the nature of the risks and/or deficiencies
They are set at the maximum allowed under Schedule 2 in every case
They are fixed directly by the FATF rather than decided by the CCE
They are set only by agreement between the CCE and the affected MSOs
en.explain: ¶4.15.2 states that the type of measures in paragraphs (a) and (b) would be proportionate to the nature of the risks and/or deficiencies identified — the same proportionality principle that governs the EDD required under ¶4.15.1. The CCE, not the FATF, decides the measures, and no agreement with the MSO is required.

tc.q: 海關關長根據第4.15.2段施加的措施，其嚴格程度如何釐定？
options: 與已識別的風險及／或缺失的性質相稱
在任何情況下均按附表2容許的最高程度施加
直接由財務行動特別組織釐定，而非由海關關長決定
只按海關關長與受影響經營者之間的協議釐定
tc.explain: 第4.15.2段訂明(a)及(b)兩款所指措施的類型，會與已識別的風險及／或缺失的性質相稱——這與第4.15.1段所訂加強盡職審查的相稱原則一致。有關措施由海關關長而非財務行動特別組織決定，亦無須經與該經營者協議。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.15.2段註腳51

en.q: In respect of which jurisdictions may the FATF recommend the application of countermeasures?
options: Jurisdictions with serious deficiencies applying the FATF Recommendations and inadequate progress
Any jurisdiction that has simply not yet become a member of the FATF itself, regardless of its controls
Any jurisdiction that has not yet published its own FATF mutual evaluation report at all
Jurisdictions whose local currency is not freely convertible into US or Hong Kong dollars
en.explain: Footnote 51 to ¶4.15.2 states that for jurisdictions with serious deficiencies in applying the FATF Recommendations, and where inadequate progress has been made to improve their positions, the FATF may recommend the application of countermeasures. FATF membership, publication of a mutual evaluation report, and currency convertibility are not themselves the test.

tc.q: 財務行動特別組織可就哪類司法管轄區建議實施反制措施？
options: 在實施財務行動特別組織建議方面存在嚴重缺失，且改善進展不足的司法管轄區
本身尚未成為財務行動特別組織成員的任何司法管轄區
尚未公布本身相互評估報告的任何司法管轄區
貨幣未能自由兌換為美元的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第4.15.2段註腳51訂明，就在實施財務行動特別組織建議方面存在嚴重缺失、且在改善其狀況方面進展不足的司法管轄區，該組織可建議實施反制措施。是否為該組織成員、有否公布相互評估報告，或貨幣可否自由兌換，均非本身的判斷標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.1段

en.q: How does the AMLO define an equivalent jurisdiction?
options: A FATF member, not Hong Kong; or one imposing Schedule-2-like requirements
Any jurisdiction that is a member of the FATF, including Hong Kong itself
Any jurisdiction with which Hong Kong has a legal assistance agreement
Any jurisdiction so designated by the FATF in its published member list
en.explain: ¶4.16.1 states that equivalent jurisdiction is defined in the AMLO as (a) a jurisdiction that is a member of the FATF, other than Hong Kong; or (b) a jurisdiction that imposes requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2. The express carve-out of Hong Kong matters because the concept describes jurisdictions other than the home one; mutual legal assistance and a FATF membership list are not the statutory test.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》如何界定「同等司法管轄區」？
options: 財務行動特別組織成員，非香港；或施加附表2類似規定者
任何屬財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區，包括香港本身在內
任何與香港訂有相互法律協助安排的司法管轄區
任何獲財務行動特別組織在其成員名單中如此列明的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第4.16.1段訂明《打擊洗錢條例》將對等司法管轄區界定為：(a)屬財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區（香港除外）；或(b)施加與附表2所施加者類似規定的司法管轄區。明文剔除香港有其意義，因該概念是用以描述本地以外的司法管轄區；相互法律協助安排及該組織的成員名單均非法定測試。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.2段

en.q: Who evaluates whether a non-FATF-member jurisdiction applies requirements similar to Schedule 2?
options: The MSO itself, which must evaluate this and document its assessment
The CCE alone, which publishes a definitive list of equivalent jurisdictions
The FATF itself, through its own published mutual evaluation reports
The Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, on the MSO's behalf
en.explain: ¶4.16.2 states that an MSO may therefore be required to evaluate and determine for itself which jurisdictions other than FATF members apply requirements similar to those imposed under Schedule 2 for jurisdictional equivalence purposes, and that the MSO should document its assessment. Neither the CCE, the FATF, nor the FSTB performs this evaluation on the MSO's behalf.

tc.q: 由何人評估非財務行動特別組織成員的司法管轄區是否施加與附表2類似的規定？
options: 該經營者本身；其可能須自行評估及斷定，並將評估記錄
只限海關關長，並由其公布對等司法管轄區的權威名單
只限財務行動特別組織本身，透過其自行公布的相互評估報告
只限財經事務及庫務局，代該經營者作出評估
tc.explain: 第4.16.2段訂明就司法管轄區同等性而言，該經營者可能須自行評估及斷定財務行動特別組織成員以外的哪些司法管轄區施加與附表2所施加者類似的規定；該經營者並應將其評估記錄在案。海關關長、該組織及財經事務及庫務局均不會代該經營者作出此項評估。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.2段

en.q: Which of the following is among the factors an MSO may consider in assessing jurisdictional equivalence?
options: FATF-style regional body membership and their recent mutual evaluation reports
Whether the jurisdiction has a double taxation agreement in force with Hong Kong
The overall size and turnover of the jurisdiction's banking sector, published annually
Whether the jurisdiction's official language is used in the MSO's own documentation
en.explain: ¶4.16.2 lists the factors as: membership of FATF-style regional bodies and their recent mutual evaluation reports; whether the FATF identifies the jurisdiction as having strategic ML/TF deficiencies and its recent progress; any CCE advisory circular on poor AML/CFT controls; and other AML/CFT publications by specialised bodies. A double taxation agreement, banking-sector size, and shared language are not among them.

tc.q: 下列何者屬金錢服務經營者在評估司法管轄區同等性時可考慮的因素？
options: 財務行動特別組織式區域組織成員，及近期相互評估報告
該司法管轄區是否與香港訂有現行的避免雙重課稅協定
該司法管轄區銀行業的整體規模及交易額，每年更新公布一次
該司法管轄區的官方語言是否用於該經營者本身的文件
tc.explain: 第4.16.2段列出的因素為：該司法管轄區是否財務行動特別組織式區域組織的成員，以及該等組織近期公布的相互評估報告；該司法管轄區有否被財務行動特別組織識別為缺乏執行打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集策略，以及近期改善打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的進度；海關關長不時發出的忠告通函；以及專門機構發表的其他打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集刊物。避免雙重課稅協定、銀行業規模及語言均不在此列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第4.16.3段

en.q: Why, and how often, should an MSO review its jurisdictional equivalence assessment?
options: Because AML/CFT regimes change over time — regularly and/or upon trigger events
Because the FATF requires a fixed five-yearly review cycle for all jurisdictions, with a report filed
Because the CCE requires a review before every licence renewal, and every three years
Because a review is required only when a customer formally complains in writing
en.explain: ¶4.16.3 states that as the AML/CFT regime of a jurisdiction will change over time, an MSO should review the jurisdictional equivalence assessment on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events. There is no fixed five-year FATF cycle, no CCE pre-renewal requirement, and no customer-complaint trigger in the source.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者為何、以及應多久檢視其司法管轄區同等性評估？
options: 因打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度隨時間變須定期或遇觸發事件檢視
因為財務行動特別組織規定所有司法管轄區均須每五年檢視一次並交報告
因為海關關長規定須於每次續牌申請前及每三年檢視一次
只在客戶以書面正式作出投訴時，方須進行檢視
tc.explain: 第4.16.3段訂明由於司法管轄區的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度會隨時間改變，該經營者應定期及／或在出現觸發事件時檢視其司法管轄區同等性評估。來源並無訂明財務行動特別組織的五年檢視周期、海關關長的續牌前檢視規定，或客戶投訴觸發機制。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.1(a)段

en.q: What does the ongoing CDD limb of continuous monitoring require?
options: Reviewing the customer's CDD documents, data and information from time to time, to keep them up-to-date and relevant
Conducting appropriate scrutiny of transactions for consistency with the MSO's knowledge of the customer's business and risk profile
Subjecting the customer to a minimum of an annual review, with re-verification of identity documents at each review
Reviewing the customer's CDD records only upon reactivation of a dormant relationship, per the MSO's own policies
en.explain: ¶5.1(a) defines ongoing CDD as reviewing from time to time the documents, data and information relating to the customer obtained for the purpose of complying with Part 2 of Schedule 2, to ensure they remain up-to-date and relevant. Scrutinising transactions for consistency with the MSO's knowledge of the customer is transaction monitoring under ¶5.1(b)(i), not ongoing CDD. The annual-review minimum for high-risk customers comes from ¶5.3, and footnote 52 says re-verification of identity is not required merely because a review is due; the dormant-customer rule is footnote 53 to ¶5.2 — none of these is the definition of ongoing CDD itself.

tc.q: 持續監察中的「持續客戶盡職審查」一環要求什麼？
options: 不時檢視客戶的盡職審查文件、數據及資料，以確保其為最新及相關
適當審查交易，以確保與該經營者對客戶業務及風險狀況的了解一致
對客戶進行最少每年一次的檢視，並於每次檢視時重新核實身分證明文件
僅在停用客戶的關係重新啟用時，才根據政策檢視其盡職審查紀錄
tc.explain: 第5.1(a)段將持續客戶盡職審查界定為：不時檢視為遵從附表2第2部規定而就客戶取得的文件、數據及資料，以確保該等為最新及相關。審查交易是否與經營者對客戶的了解一致，屬第5.1(b)(i)段所指的交易監察，並非持續客戶盡職審查；最少每年檢視一次的規定見於第5.3段，註腳52則說明檢視到期並不等於需重新核實身分；停用客戶的規則則見於第5.2段註腳53，三者皆非持續客戶盡職審查本身的定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.1(b)(ii)段

en.q: Which two elements must both be present before a transaction falls within ¶5.1(b)(ii), and what must the MSO then do?
options: The transaction is complex, unusually large or of an unusual pattern, with no apparent economic or lawful purpose; the MSO must examine the background and record findings in writing
The transaction is inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, the customer's business, risk profile and source of funds; the MSO must conduct appropriate scrutiny of the transaction
The customer's documents, data and information are out of date and no longer relevant; the MSO must review them under Part 2 of Schedule 2
The transaction is equal to or above $120,000 and the customer is resident outside Hong Kong; the MSO must immediately file an STR without further enquiry
en.explain: ¶5.1(b)(ii) requires both limbs — (A) complex, unusually large in amount or of an unusual pattern, and (B) no apparent economic or lawful purpose — before the MSO must examine the background and purposes and set out its findings in writing. Scrutiny for consistency with known customer information is the separate (b)(i) limb; out-of-date records trigger (a) ongoing CDD, not (b)(ii); and $120,000 is the occasional-transaction CDD threshold, not a trigger for immediate STR filing without enquiry.

tc.q: 交易須同時具備哪兩項要素方屬第5.1(b)(ii)段所指者？該經營者其後須怎樣做？
options: 該交易複雜、款額異常龐大或模式不尋常，且無明顯經濟或合法目的；該經營者須審查背景，並以書面記錄
該交易與該經營者對客戶、其業務、風險狀況及資金來源的了解不一致；該經營者其後須對該交易進行適當審查
客戶的文件、數據及資料已過時且不再相關；該經營者須根據附表2第2部檢視該等資料
該交易款額等於或超過120,000元，且客戶在香港以外居住；該經營者須立即提交可疑交易報告而無須進一步查詢
tc.explain: 第5.1(b)(ii)段規定需同時符合兩項要素：(A)屬複雜、款額異常龐大或模式不尋常；及(B)並無明顯的經濟或合法目的，該經營者方需審查背景及目的，並以書面列明審查結果。與已知客戶資料一致性的審查屬另一項(b)(i)款；資料過時則觸發(a)持續客戶盡職審查，而非(b)(ii)；120,000元則是非經常交易的客戶盡職審查門檻，並非無須查詢即提交可疑交易報告的觸發點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.2段

en.q: On what two matters does ¶5.2 say clear policies and procedures should especially be developed?
options: The frequency of periodic review, and what constitutes a trigger event
The identity of the reviewing officer, and the retention period for review records
The format of the review report, and its distribution list
The threshold for escalation, and the penalty for non-compliance
en.explain: ¶5.2 states that to ensure documents, data and information obtained are up-to-date and relevant, an MSO should undertake reviews of existing CDD records of customers on a regular basis and/or upon trigger events, and that clear policies and procedures should be developed, especially on the frequency of periodic review or what constitutes a trigger event.

tc.q: 第5.2段指出應特別就哪兩方面制訂清晰的政策及程序？
options: 定期檢視的頻次，以及何謂觸發事件
負責檢視的人員身分，以及檢視紀錄的保存期限
檢視報告的格式，以及其傳閱名單
呈報的門檻，以及不合規的罰則
tc.explain: 第5.2段訂明為確保就客戶取得的文件、數據及資料為最新及相關，該經營者應定期及／或在出現觸發事件時檢視現有客戶盡職審查紀錄；並應制訂清晰的政策及程序，尤其是就定期檢視的頻次或何謂觸發事件而言。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.2段註腳52

en.q: Does keeping CDD information up-to-date require an MSO to re-verify identities it has already verified?
options: No — only if doubts arise over the veracity or adequacy of previously obtained identification information
Yes — because ¶5.2 requires regular reviews of existing CDD records and reviews upon trigger events, which the MSO must itself define in policy
Yes — but re-verification is required only for customers presenting high ML/TF risk, in line with the annual review cycle
No — under no circumstances, even where the customer's risk profile has changed, may an MSO re-verify an identity it has already verified
en.explain: Footnote 52 to ¶5.2 states that keeping CDD information up-to-date and relevant does not mean an MSO must re-verify identities that have been verified, unless doubts arise as to the veracity or adequacy of the information previously obtained. ¶5.2 itself does require regular reviews of existing CDD records and reviews upon trigger events, and ¶5.3 does require a minimum annual review for high-risk customers — but neither of those real requirements amounts to mandatory re-verification of identity, and footnote 52's exception for doubted information means re-verification is never wholly prohibited either.

tc.q: 保持客戶盡職審查資料為最新，是否要求金錢服務經營者重新核實已核實的身分？
options: 否——除非對先前取得的識別及核實資料的真確性或充分性產生疑問
是——因第5.2段規定須定期檢視盡職審查紀錄，並在觸發事件發生時進行檢視
是——但僅限於高風險客戶，並需配合每年檢視重新核實
否——即使客戶的風險狀況已轉變，在任何情況下均不得重新核實已核實的身分
tc.explain: 第5.2段註腳52訂明，保持客戶盡職審查資料為最新及相關，並不表示該經營者須重新核實已核實的身分；除非對此前為識別及核實客戶身分而取得的資料的真確性或充分性產生疑問。第5.2段本身確實要求定期檢視現有紀錄及在觸發事件時檢視，第5.3段亦確實要求高風險客戶最少每年檢視一次，但上述真實規定均不等於必須重新核實身分；註腳52對可疑資料的例外亦說明並非在任何情況下均一律禁止重新核實。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.2段註腳53

en.q: How should an MSO treat the CDD records of a dormant customer?
options: No regular review is required, but a review should occur on reactivation; the MSO should define 'dormant customer' in policy
The records must be reviewed at least annually, the same minimum frequency ¶5.3 sets for customers presenting high ML/TF risk
The records need not be reviewed even upon reactivation, unless doubts arise as to the veracity of the information previously obtained
The customer must be reported to the JFIU as dormant, in the same way suspicious transactions are reported under ¶5.12
en.explain: Footnote 53 to ¶5.2 states that while regular review of a dormant customer's CDD records is not necessary, an MSO should conduct a review upon reactivation of the relationship, and should define clearly what constitutes a dormant customer in its policies and procedures. The annual-review minimum in ¶5.3 applies to high-ML/TF-risk customers generally, not specifically to dormant ones; footnote 52's 'unless doubts arise' language concerns re-verifying identity, not the separate duty to review upon reactivation; and ¶5.12's JFIU reporting duty is triggered by suspicion, not by dormancy.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應如何處理停用客戶的盡職審查紀錄？
options: 無須定期檢視，但應在重新啟用該關係時進行檢視；該經營者應在政策中界定何謂停用客戶
須最少每年檢視一次，與第5.3段就構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險客戶所訂的最低頻次相同
即使重新啟用該關係亦無須檢視，除非對先前取得資料的真確性產生疑問
須向聯合財富情報組報告該客戶已停用，方式與第5.12段呈報可疑交易相同
tc.explain: 第5.2段註腳53訂明，雖無須定期檢視停用客戶的現有客戶盡職審查紀錄，但該經營者應在該關係重新啟用時進行檢視，並應在政策及程序中清楚界定何謂停用客戶。第5.3段的最少每年檢視規定適用於高風險客戶一般，並非特定適用於停用客戶；註腳52「除非產生疑問」的例外指的是重新核實身分，與重新啟用時的檢視責任有別；第5.12段向聯合財富情報組報告的責任則由懷疑而非停用本身觸發。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.3段

en.q: What is the minimum review frequency for customers presenting high ML/TF risks?
options: A minimum of an annual review, or more frequent reviews if deemed necessary by the MSO
A review upon reactivation of the relationship only, with no fixed periodic minimum
A minimum of a review every six months, the frequency ¶5.9 sets for monitoring
A minimum of a review every two years, unless the customer is a non-Hong Kong PEP
en.explain: ¶5.3 states that all customers that present high ML/TF risks should be subject to a minimum of an annual review, or more frequent reviews if deemed necessary by the MSO, to ensure the CDD information retained remains up-to-date and relevant. Review only upon reactivation is footnote 53's rule for dormant customers, not high-risk ones; ¶5.9 does call for enhanced transaction monitoring where ML/TF risk is high, but it does not set a six-monthly review figure; and no provision carves out a two-year cycle for non-PEP customers.

tc.q: 就構成高洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶，檢視的最低頻次為何？
options: 最少每年檢視一次；如該經營者認為有需要，則須更頻密檢視
只需在關係重新啟用時檢視，並無固定的定期最低頻次
最少每六個月檢視一次，與高風險的加強交易監察頻次相符
最少每兩年檢視一次，除非客戶屬非香港政治人物
tc.explain: 第5.3段訂明所有構成高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的客戶，應最少每年接受檢視一次；如該經營者認為有需要，則須更頻密檢視。僅於重新啟用時檢視是第5.2段註腳53就停用客戶所訂的規則，非高風險客戶適用；第5.9段確實要求對高風險進行加強交易監察，但並未訂明每六個月的檢視頻次；亦無任何條文對非政治人物客戶設有兩年一次的例外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.4段

en.q: Which factor is NOT among those to which the design and degree of automation of transaction monitoring systems should have regard?
options: The number of years the MSO has held its licence
The size and complexity of the MSO's business
The ML/TF risks arising from the MSO's business
The nature of the products and services provided, including the means of delivery or communication
en.explain: ¶5.4 lists the factors as the size and complexity of the business; the ML/TF risks arising from the business; the nature of its systems and controls; the monitoring procedures that already exist to satisfy other business needs; and the nature of the products and services provided, which includes the means of delivery or communication. The length of time the licence has been held is not among them.

tc.q: 下列何者並非設計交易監察系統及其自動化程度時須顧及的因素？
options: 該經營者持牌年期的長短
該經營者業務的規模及複雜程度
該經營者業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險
所提供產品及服務的性質（包括交付或通訊方式）
tc.explain: 第5.4段列出的因素為：其業務的規模及複雜程度；其業務所產生的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險；其系統及管控的性質；為滿足其他業務需要而已存在的監察程序；以及所提供產品及服務的性質（包括交付或通訊方式）。持牌年期並不在其列。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.5段

en.q: What must an MSO's transaction monitoring systems provide to the staff tasked with monitoring and investigation?
options: Timely and sufficient information to identify, analyse and effectively monitor customers' transactions
Automated system-generated conclusions on whether an STR should be filed with the JFIU, without staff review
Direct read access to the JFIU's suspicious transaction reporting portal for all frontline staff
A monthly summary confined to transactions at or above the $8,000 wire transfer CDD threshold
en.explain: ¶5.5 states that an MSO should ensure its transaction monitoring systems and processes can provide all relevant staff tasked with monitoring and investigation with timely and sufficient information required to identify, analyse and effectively monitor customers' transactions. The decision whether to file an STR remains the MSO's own judgement, not an automated system output; the JFIU is the body that receives STRs, not a portal staff read directly; and $8,000 is the wire-transfer CDD threshold from a different part of the Guideline, not a fixed reporting cut-off under ¶5.5.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的交易監察系統須向負責監察及調查的員工提供什麼？
options: 識別、分析及有效監察客戶交易所需的及時而充分的資料
由系統自動產生結論，判斷是否須提交可疑交易報告，毋須員工審閱
讓所有前線員工直接讀取聯合財富情報組的可疑交易報告系統
只涵蓋達到電傳轉帳8,000元盡職審查門檻的交易的每月摘要
tc.explain: 第5.5段訂明該經營者應確保其交易監察系統及程序，能向所有負責監察及調查的相關員工，提供識別、分析及有效監察客戶交易所需的及時而充分的資料。是否提交可疑交易報告仍屬該經營者自身的判斷，並非系統自動產生的結論；聯合財富情報組是接收可疑交易報告的機構，而非員工可直接讀取的舉報系統；8,000元則是本指引另一部分的電傳轉帳客戶盡職審查門檻，並非第5.5段所指的固定申報界線。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.6段

en.q: Which approach to ongoing monitoring does ¶5.6 say an MSO should preferably adopt?
options: A relationship-based approach, holistically covering a customer's multiple and related accounts, rather than transaction-by-transaction
A transaction-by-transaction approach, assessing each one separately rather than monitoring multiple accounts within or across lines of business
An account-by-account approach that does not aggregate a customer's multiple accounts within the same line of business
A branch-by-branch approach, confined to monitoring activity within each line of business rather than across lines of business
en.explain: ¶5.6 states that transaction monitoring systems and processes should support the ongoing monitoring of a business relationship in a holistic approach, covering a customer's multiple accounts within or across lines of business and related customers' accounts — meaning the MSO should preferably adopt a relationship-based approach rather than a transaction-by-transaction basis. ¶5.6 expressly rejects the transaction-by-transaction approach; the account-by-account and branch-by-branch framings are narrower variants of that same rejected, non-holistic approach.

tc.q: 第5.6段指出金錢服務經營者宜採用哪種持續監察方式？
options: 以關係為本而非逐宗交易的方式，涵蓋客戶多個帳戶及相關帳戶的整體監察
逐宗交易的方式，個別評估每宗交易，而不監察客戶在同一或跨業務線的多個帳戶
逐個帳戶的方式，不匯總客戶在同一業務線內的多個帳戶
逐條業務線的方式，監察只限於個別業務線內，而不跨業務線進行
tc.explain: 第5.6段訂明交易監察系統及程序應以整體方式支援業務關係的持續監察，涵蓋客戶在同一或跨業務線的多個帳戶，以及相關客戶的帳戶，即該經營者宜採用以關係為本而非逐宗交易的方式。第5.6段明確否定逐宗交易的方式；逐個帳戶及逐條業務線的說法同屬該非整體方式的較狹窄變體。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.7段

en.q: Which transaction characteristic does ¶5.7 illustrate with the example of structuring a single transaction into a number of cash deposits?
options: The nature of a series of transactions
The nature and type of transactions
The counterparties of transactions
The geographical origin or destination of a payment or receipt
en.explain: ¶5.7 lists the transaction characteristics to be taken into account when setting parameters and thresholds: the nature and type of transactions (e.g. abnormal size or frequency); the nature of a series of transactions (e.g. structuring a single transaction into a number of cash deposits); the counterparties of transactions; the geographical origin/destination of a payment or receipt; and the customer's normal account activity or turnover.

tc.q: 第5.7段以「將單一宗交易拆分為多筆現金存款」為例，說明哪一項交易特徵？
options: 一連串交易的性質
交易的性質及類型
交易的對手方
付款或收款的地域來源或目的地
tc.explain: 第5.7段列出設定參數及門檻時須顧及的交易特徵：交易的性質及類型（例如款額或頻次異常）；一連串交易的性質（例如將單一宗交易拆分為多筆現金存款）；交易的對手方；付款或收款的地域來源／目的地；以及該客戶的正常帳戶活動或營業額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.8段

en.q: What does ¶5.8 require of the parameters and thresholds adopted in a transaction monitoring system?
options: Properly documented and independently validated so they suit the MSO's own operations and context
Set once by the system vendor at installation and left unchanged, since only vendor staff are qualified to validate them
Documented internally but kept confidential from the MSO's own auditors, to protect customer information
Identical to those used by other MSOs of similar size and business lines, to ensure consistency across the industry
en.explain: ¶5.8 requires an MSO to regularly review the adequacy and effectiveness of its transaction monitoring systems and processes, including parameters and thresholds adopted, and that those parameters and thresholds be properly documented and independently validated to ensure they are appropriate to its own operations and context. ¶5.14 requires findings to be available to the CCE, other competent authorities and auditors, not withheld from them; nothing in ¶5.8 lets a vendor set-and-forget the parameters or requires uniformity across MSOs.

tc.q: 第5.8段就交易監察系統所採用的參數及門檻有何要求？
options: 應妥為記錄並經獨立驗證，以確保切合該經營者本身的營運及情況
由系統供應商在安裝時設定，其後不作更改，因只有供應商職員具驗證資格
在內部記錄但對本身審計師保密，以保障客戶資料
須與規模及業務線相若的其他金錢服務經營者所用者完全相同，以確保業界一致
tc.explain: 第5.8段規定該經營者須定期檢視其交易監察系統及程序（包括所採用的參數及門檻）的充分性及有效性，該等參數及門檻應妥為記錄並經獨立驗證，以確保切合其本身的營運及情況。第5.14段規定有關結果須可供關長、其他主管當局及審計師查閱，而非對其保密；第5.8段亦無容許供應商一次設定後不作檢視，或要求各金錢服務經營者劃一標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.9段

en.q: How should the extent of transaction monitoring vary under the risk-based approach?
options: Commensurate with the customer's ML/TF risk profile: enhanced if high risk, reduced if low risk
Identical for all customers regardless of risk, since ¶5.6 requires a consistent relationship-based approach across the board
Based solely on the customer's transaction volume, unrelated to the customer's risk profile
Enhanced for every customer without exception, since footnote 54 requires enhanced monitoring for all non-Hong Kong customers
en.explain: ¶5.9 requires transaction monitoring to follow the RBA: the extent of monitoring should be commensurate with the customer's ML/TF risk profile, enhanced where risk is high and reduced in low-risk situations. ¶5.6's relationship-based approach concerns how accounts are grouped for monitoring, not whether risk-based intensity applies; and footnote 54 gives only two narrow examples of high-risk situations — a non-Hong Kong PEP, or a relationship high-risk under Schedule 2 section 15 — not all non-Hong Kong customers.

tc.q: 按風險為本方式，交易監察的程度應如何變化？
options: 應與客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險狀況相稱：風險高則加強，風險低則可減省
對所有客戶劃一適用，不論風險狀況，因為第5.6段要求全面採用一致的以關係為本方式
僅取決於客戶的交易量，與客戶的風險狀況無關
對每名客戶一律加強，不設例外，因為註腳54規定須對所有非香港客戶進行加強監察
tc.explain: 第5.9段規定交易監察須按風險為本方式進行：監察的程度應與客戶的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險狀況相稱，風險高則加強，風險低則可減省。第5.6段的以關係為本方式，處理的是帳戶應如何歸併監察，並非是否適用風險為本的力度；註腳54僅舉出兩個狹窄的高風險情況例子——非香港政治人物，或按附表2第15條屬高風險的業務關係——並非所有非香港客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.9段註腳54

en.q: Which examples of high ML/TF risk situations requiring enhanced transaction monitoring does footnote 54 give?
options: A customer or beneficial owner who is a non-Hong Kong PEP; or a business relationship high-risk under Schedule 2, section 15
Any customer who transacts in cash above $8,000; and any customer using a numbered or anonymous account for a wire transfer
Any customer resident outside Hong Kong; and any corporate customer incorporated under the Companies Ordinance
Any customer whose annual review under ¶5.3 falls due; and any customer who has changed a registered address
en.explain: Footnote 54 to ¶5.9 gives as examples of high ML/TF risk situations requiring enhanced transaction monitoring: a customer or a beneficial owner of a customer being a non-Hong Kong PEP; and a business relationship presenting a high risk of ML/TF under section 15 of Schedule 2. $8,000 is the wire-transfer CDD threshold from a different part of the Guideline, not one of footnote 54's examples; mere non-residence, incorporation status, an annual review falling due, and an address change are not themselves the examples footnote 54 gives.

tc.q: 註腳54就須加強交易監察的高風險情況舉出哪些例子？
options: 客戶或其實益擁有人屬非香港政治人物；或按附表2第15條屬高風險的業務關係
以現金交易超過8,000元的客戶；及使用編號或匿名帳戶作電傳轉帳的客戶
在香港以外居住的任何客戶；以及根據《公司條例》註冊成立的任何法人客戶
根據第5.3段須進行週年檢視的任何客戶；以及已更改註冊地址的任何客戶
tc.explain: 第5.9段註腳54就須加強交易監察的高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險情況舉例：(a)客戶或客戶的實益擁有人屬非香港政治人物；及(b)按附表2第15條屬構成高洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險的業務關係。8,000元是本指引另一部分的電傳轉帳客戶盡職審查門檻，並非註腳54所舉的例子；單純非香港居住、註冊地位、週年檢視到期或更改地址，均非註腳54所舉的例子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.10段

en.q: What appropriate steps does ¶5.10 suggest to identify whether there are grounds for suspicion?
options: Examining the background and purpose of transactions, or seeking more CDD information from the customer
Filing an STR with the JFIU immediately in every case, without making any further enquiry first
Freezing the customer's funds immediately and unilaterally, pending the outcome of a full investigation into the matter
Referring the matter directly to the MSO's external auditor for a formal written opinion
en.explain: ¶5.10 states that an MSO should take appropriate steps — for example examining the background and purposes of the transactions, or making appropriate enquiries to or obtaining additional CDD information from a customer — to identify if there are any grounds for suspicion. Filing an STR outright, freezing funds unilaterally, and handing the matter to an external auditor are not the fact-finding steps ¶5.10 describes.

tc.q: 第5.10段建議採取哪些適當步驟以識別是否有懷疑的理由？
options: 審查交易的背景及目的，或向客戶查詢／取得額外的盡職審查資料
在任何情況下均立即向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，而不先作進一步查詢
在完整調查的結果出爐之前，立即單方面凍結該客戶的所有資金
將事宜直接轉介該經營者的外聘審計師，要求提供正式書面意見
tc.explain: 第5.10段訂明，如客戶的交易與該經營者對該客戶、其業務、風險狀況或資金來源的了解並不一致，或該經營者識別出符合第5.10(b)款兩項要素的交易，該經營者應採取適當步驟（例如審查交易的背景及目的；向客戶作出適當查詢或取得額外的客戶盡職審查資料），以識別是否有任何懷疑的理由。逕行提交報告、單方面凍結資金，或轉介外聘審計師，均非第5.10段所述的查證步驟。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.11段

en.q: Where an MSO obtains a satisfactory explanation of a transaction and concludes there are no grounds for suspicion, what should it still consider?
options: Updating the customer risk profile based on any relevant information obtained
Filing a precautionary STR with the JFIU in any event, even though no suspicion was found
Reducing the customer's transaction limits as a precaution going forward
Reporting the enquiry and its outcome to the CCE as a matter of routine
en.explain: ¶5.11 states that where an MSO conducts enquiries and obtains what it considers to be a satisfactory explanation of the transaction or activity, it may conclude that there are no grounds for suspicion and take no further action; but that even if no suspicion is identified, the MSO should consider updating the customer risk profile based on any relevant information obtained — not file a precautionary STR, tighten limits, or route the matter to the CCE as routine.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者就某交易取得圓滿解釋並認定並無懷疑理由，仍應考慮甚麼？
options: 按所取得的任何相關資料更新該客戶的風險狀況
即使並無發現懷疑，仍提交預防性的可疑交易報告
作為預防措施，調低該客戶日後的交易限額
將該次查詢及其結果，按慣常程序向關長報告
tc.explain: 第5.11段訂明，如該經營者作出查詢後取得其認為圓滿的交易或活動解釋，可認定並無懷疑的理由，因而無須採取進一步行動；但即使並未識別出懷疑，該經營者仍應考慮按所取得的任何相關資料更新該客戶的風險狀況——並非無論如何提交預防性報告、調低限額，或按慣常程序知會關長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.12段

en.q: What follows where an MSO cannot obtain a satisfactory explanation of a transaction or activity?
options: It may conclude there are grounds for suspicion, and an STR should go to the JFIU
It must terminate the business relationship immediately, without any report
It should defer any decision or action until the next scheduled periodic review
It should refer the matter to the CCE for a formal determination before acting
en.explain: ¶5.12 states that where the MSO cannot obtain a satisfactory explanation of the transaction or activity, it may conclude that there are grounds for suspicion, and that in any event where there is any suspicion identified during transaction monitoring, an STR should be made to the JFIU. Terminating without reporting, deferring to the next review, and routing the decision through the CCE are not what ¶5.12 requires.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者未能就某交易或活動取得圓滿解釋，會有甚麼結果？
options: 可認定有懷疑的理由，並應向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告
須立即終止該業務關係，而完全毋須作出任何報告
應將任何決定或行動，一律押後至下一次的定期檢視
應在採取任何行動之前，將整件事宜轉介予關長作出正式裁定
tc.explain: 第5.12段訂明，如該經營者未能就該交易或活動取得圓滿解釋，可認定有懷疑的理由；且在交易監察過程中一旦識別出任何懷疑，均應向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告。終止關係而不作報告、押後至下次檢視，或先轉介關長裁定，均非第5.12段的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.13段

en.q: What should an MSO do if it reasonably believes that performing the CDD process will tip off the customer?
options: It may stop the process, but should document the basis and file an STR to the JFIU
It must complete the CDD process in full regardless of any tipping-off risk
It should complete the process as normal but withhold the STR from the JFIU
It should first ask the customer for consent before continuing any further
en.explain: ¶5.13 states that an MSO should be aware that making enquiries to customers, when conducted properly and in good faith, will not constitute tipping off; however, if the MSO reasonably believes that performing the CDD process will tip off the customer, it may stop pursuing the process, and should document the basis for its assessment and file an STR to the JFIU. Completing CDD regardless, completing it while withholding the STR, and seeking the customer's consent first each defeat the point of the tipping-off safeguard.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者合理地相信進行客戶盡職審查程序會向客戶通風報信，應怎樣做？
options: 可停止該程序，但應記錄評估基礎，並向聯合財富情報組作出可疑交易報告
不論通風報信的風險有多高，該經營者仍須完成整個客戶盡職審查程序
應如常完成該程序，但同時向聯合財富情報組隱瞞可疑交易報告
應先徵詢客戶本人同意，方可繼續採取任何進一步行動
tc.explain: 第5.13段訂明該經營者應知悉，如以恰當方式並真誠地向客戶作出查詢，並不構成通風報信；但如該經營者合理地相信進行客戶盡職審查程序會向該客戶通風報信，則可停止進行該程序；該經營者應將其評估的基礎記錄在案，並向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。無論如何完成程序、完成後隱瞞報告，或先徵求客戶同意，均會令通風報信的防範措施失去意義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.14段

en.q: What must be documented in writing and made available to the CCE, other competent authorities and auditors under ¶5.14?
options: The findings and outcomes of the ¶5.10 steps, and the rationale of the decision reached
Only the STRs that were eventually filed with the JFIU, and nothing else
Only the transactions that happened to exceed the monitoring system's set numeric thresholds
Only the identity of the staff member who carried out the review
en.explain: ¶5.14 states that the findings and outcomes of the steps taken by the MSO in ¶5.10, as well as the rationale of any decision made after taking these steps, should be properly documented in writing and be available to the CCE, other competent authorities and auditors. This covers decisions not to report as much as decisions to report — not just the filed STRs, the threshold-triggering transactions, or the reviewer's identity.

tc.q: 根據第5.14段，甚麼須以書面妥為記錄，並可供關長、其他主管當局及審計師查閱？
options: 第5.10段所述步驟的結果及成效，以及所作決定的理據
只限最終有向聯合財富情報組提交的報告本身，其他一概不需
只限監察系統中恰好超出所訂數值門檻的個別交易紀錄
只限負責進行該次檢視的個別員工身分
tc.explain: 第5.14段訂明該經營者採取第5.10段所述步驟的結果及成效，以及在採取該等步驟後所作任何決定的理據，均應以書面妥為記錄，並可供關長、其他主管當局及審計師查閱。此既涵蓋作出報告的決定，亦涵蓋不作報告的決定——並非僅限已提交的報告、觸及門檻的交易，或檢視員工的身分。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: What is the essential difference in focus between money laundering and terrorist financing?
options: ML's focus is on the source of the property — criminal proceeds; TF's focus is on the destination or use of property, which may be legitimate in origin
TF is only made out where a terrorist act has actually been carried out using the property; ML merely requires the property to be suspected of criminal origin
ML concerns wire transfers of an amount equal to or above $8,000; TF concerns remittance transactions below that same threshold amount
ML depends on the Court of First Instance making an order that specifies the property; TF depends on a notice being published in the Gazette by the Chief Executive
en.explain: ¶6.1 states that different from ML — the focus of which is on the handling of criminal proceeds, i.e. the source of property is what matters — the focus of TF is on the destination or use of property, which may have derived from legitimate sources. TF liability does not depend on a terrorist act actually occurring (¶6.5(e)); the $8,000 threshold and the Gazette/Court of First Instance mechanisms in ¶6.4 and ¶6.7 are unrelated to this definitional distinction.

tc.q: 洗錢與恐怖分子資金籌集在焦點上的根本分別為何？
options: 洗錢的焦點在於財產的來源——即處理犯罪得益；恐怖分子資金籌集的焦點在於財產的去向或用途，而該等財產的來源可能屬合法
恐怖分子資金籌集只在恐怖活動已利用該財產實際發生後方告成立；洗錢則只須該財產涉嫌屬過去發生的犯罪得益
洗錢涉及匯款機構處理款額相等於或高於8,000元的電傳轉帳；恐怖分子資金籌集則涉及低於該門檻的匯款交易
洗錢須視乎原訟法庭有否應行政長官的申請而作出指明該財產的命令；恐怖分子資金籌集則須視乎行政長官有否已在憲報刊登相關公告
tc.explain: 第6.1段訂明，與洗錢不同——洗錢的焦點在於處理犯罪得益（即財產的來源至為關鍵）——恐怖分子資金籌集的焦點在於財產的去向或用途，而該等財產可能源自合法來源。恐怖分子資金籌集的罪責並不取決於恐怖活動是否實際發生（見第6.5(e)段）；第6.4及6.7段所述的8,000元門檻及憲報／原訟法庭機制，均與此定義上的分別無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: What does terrorist financing generally refer to, as described in ¶6.1?
options: Carrying out transactions involving property owned by terrorists or terrorist organisations, or that has been, or is intended to be, used to assist the commission of terrorist acts
Carrying out transactions with any person or entity designated by a Committee of the United Nations Security Council, regardless of any connection between the property involved and a terrorist act
Carrying out a wire transfer of an amount equal to or above $8,000 where the accompanying originator information turns out to be inaccurate or incomplete
Carrying out cash transactions above the $120,000 statutory threshold that ordinarily triggers customer due diligence for an occasional transaction
en.explain: ¶6.1 states that TF generally refers to the carrying out of transactions involving property owned by terrorists or terrorist organisations, or that has been, or is intended to be, used to assist the commission of terrorist acts. Designation by a UNSC Committee (¶6.4), the requirement that accompanying originator information be accurate for transfers of $8,000 or above (¶10.8), and the $120,000 CDD threshold for occasional transactions are separate concepts, not the definition of TF.

tc.q: 按第6.1段所述，恐怖分子資金籌集一般指甚麼？
options: 進行涉及恐怖分子或恐怖組織擁有，或已被或擬被用以協助進行恐怖活動的財產的交易
與經安理會轄下委員會指定的任何人士或實體進行交易，而不論該財產與恐怖活動有否關連
進行款額相等於或高於8,000元、而所附匯款人資料並不準確的電傳轉帳
進行超過120,000元法定門檻（觸發非經常交易的客戶盡職審查）的現金交易
tc.explain: 第6.1段訂明恐怖分子資金籌集一般指進行涉及恐怖分子或恐怖組織所擁有的財產，或已被用於或擬被用於協助進行恐怖活動的財產的交易。安理會轄下委員會的指定（第6.4段）、電傳轉帳8,000元或以上須具備準確匯款人資料的規定（第10.8段），以及非經常交易120,000元的客戶盡職審查門檻，均屬另外的概念，並非恐怖分子資金籌集的定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: What does UNSCR 1373 (2001) call on member states to do?
options: To act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts
To publish the names of individuals and organisations connected with Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban
To adopt a country-specific approach against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Iran
To prevent the travel of persons for the purpose of committing terrorist acts or undergoing terrorist training
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that UNSCR 1373 (2001) calls on all member states to act to prevent and suppress the financing of terrorist acts. Publishing the Al-Qa'ida/ISIL/Taliban-linked names is a separate mechanism under other UNSCRs described in the same paragraph; the DPRK/Iran country-specific approach comes from UNSCR 1718 (2006) and 2231 (2015) (¶6.9); and preventing travel for terrorist purposes or training is implemented via UNSCR 2178 (2014) (¶6.3) — none of these is what UNSCR 1373 calls on member states to do.

tc.q: 聯合國安全理事會第1373(2001)號決議呼籲成員國作甚麼？
options: 採取行動，防止及制止為恐怖活動籌集資金
公布與蓋達組織、伊斯蘭國及塔利班有關連的個人及組織名稱
對朝鮮民主主義人民共和國及伊朗伊斯蘭共和國採取國家層面的應對措施
防止某人為進行恐怖活動或接受恐怖訓練的目的而在國與國之間旅行
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明安理會通過的第1373(2001)號決議，呼籲所有成員國採取行動，防止及制止為恐怖活動籌集資金。公布蓋達組織／伊斯蘭國／塔利班相關名單，是同段所述、依據其他決議的另一機制；針對朝鮮及伊朗的國家層面措施源自第1718(2006)及2231(2015)號決議（第6.9段）；防止為恐怖活動或訓練而旅行則源自第2178(2014)號決議（第6.3段）——均非第1373號決議呼籲成員國作出的事項。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: In relation to which groups has the UN published names of individuals and organisations under UNSCR 1267 (1999) and its successors?
options: Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban
The Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Iran
Organised crime syndicates operating across Asia
Entities involved in the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that the UN has published the names of individuals and organisations in relation to involvement with Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban under relevant UNSCRs, giving UNSCR 1267 (1999), 1988 (2011), 1989 (2011), 2253 (2015), 2368 (2017) and their successor resolutions as examples. DPRK and Iran are dealt with under the separate PF resolutions in ¶6.9.

tc.q: 聯合國根據第1267(1999)號決議及其後續決議，就哪些組織公布個人及組織名單？
options: 「基地」組織、伊斯蘭國（達伊沙）及塔利班
朝鮮民主主義人民共和國及伊朗
在亞洲各地活動的有組織罪犯集團
涉及擴散大規模毀滅武器的實體
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明聯合國已根據有關決議（例如第1267(1999)、1988(2011)、1989(2011)、2253(2015)、2368(2017)號決議及其後續決議），公布涉及「基地」組織、伊斯蘭國（達伊沙）及塔利班的個人及組織名單。朝鮮及伊朗則由第6.9段所述另一套擴散資金籌集決議處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.2段

en.q: What two obligations are all UN member states required to discharge in respect of persons named in the UN terrorist lists?
options: To freeze any funds, other financial assets or economic resources of the named person, and to report suspected name matches to the relevant authorities
To publish the person's name and identifying particulars in the Gazette, and to apply to the Court of First Instance for an order specifying that person
To grant a licence permitting frozen terrorist property to be unfrozen, and to authorise reasonable living or legal expenses to be paid to a designated party
To adopt a global approach to countering proliferation financing under UNSCR 1540 (2004), and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK
en.explain: ¶6.2 states that all UN member states are required to freeze any funds, other financial assets or economic resources of any person named in the lists, and to report any suspected name matches to the relevant authorities. Publishing a Gazette notice and applying to the Court of First Instance are powers of Hong Kong's Chief Executive, not obligations of UN member states generally (¶6.4); licensing exceptions to unfreeze property is the Secretary for Security's power (¶6.6); and the global/country-specific approach is the UNSC's separate proliferation financing framework (¶6.9).

tc.q: 就聯合國恐怖分子名單所列人士，所有聯合國成員國須履行哪兩項責任？
options: 凍結名單所列任何人的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源；並向有關當局報告任何懷疑的姓名配對
在憲報公布該人的姓名及其他足以識別身分的資料；並向原訟法庭申請作出指明該人的命令
批予特許將已凍結的恐怖分子財產解凍；並批准支付合理的生活開支或法律開支予該指定方
在全球層面採用第1540(2004)號決議的方針；在國家層面採用針對朝鮮的第1718(2006)號決議
tc.explain: 第6.2段訂明所有聯合國成員國均須凍結名單所列任何人的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，並須向有關當局報告任何懷疑的姓名配對。在憲報公布及向原訟法庭申請命令，是香港行政長官（而非聯合國成員國一般）根據第6.4段的權力；批予特許解凍財產是保安局局長根據第6.6段的權力；全球／國家層面的方針則是安理會遏止擴散資金籌集的另一套框架（第6.9段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.3段

en.q: Which UNSCR decisions does the UNATMO implement, in addition to certain terrorism-related multilateral conventions and FATF Recommendations?
options: A decision under UNSCR 1373 (2001) on preventing terrorist acts, and a decision under UNSCR 2178 (2014) on preventing travel for terrorist acts or training
Decisions under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against the Islamic Republic of Iran and their successor resolutions
