A decision under UNSCR 1267 (1999) and its successor resolutions, concerning individuals and organisations linked to Al-Qa'ida, ISIL (Da'esh) and the Taliban
A decision under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and its successor resolutions on the global non-proliferation of weapons of mass destruction
en.explain: ¶6.3 states the UNATMO implements a decision under UNSCR 1373 (2001) on measures to prevent terrorist acts and a decision under UNSCR 2178 (2014) on preventing travel for terrorist acts or training, plus certain multilateral conventions and FATF Recommendations. UNSCR 1718 and 2231 are the country-specific proliferation financing resolutions implemented through UNSO regulations (¶6.9); UNSCR 1267 concerns the published sanctions lists (¶6.2); and UNSCR 1540 is the global proliferation financing resolution (¶6.9) — none is implemented by the UNATMO.

tc.q: 除若干與恐怖主義有關的多邊公約及財務行動特別組織建議外，《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》還實施哪些安理會決議的決定？
options: 第1373(2001)號決議中有關防止恐怖活動的決定，以及第2178(2014)號決議中有關防止為恐怖活動或訓練而旅行的決定
針對朝鮮民主主義人民共和國的第1718(2006)號決議，以及針對伊朗伊斯蘭共和國的第2231(2015)號決議及其後續各項決議
第1267(1999)號決議及其後續決議，內容關於與蓋達組織、伊斯蘭國（達伊沙）及塔利班有關連的個人及組織名單
有關大規模毀滅武器全球層面防擴散措施的第1540(2004)號決議及其後續決議
tc.explain: 第6.3段訂明《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》實施第1373(2001)號決議中有關防止恐怖活動措施的決定，以及第2178(2014)號決議中有關防止為恐怖活動或訓練而旅行的決定，並實施若干多邊公約及財務行動特別組織建議。第1718及2231號決議是透過《聯合國制裁條例》規例實施的國家層面擴散資金籌集措施（第6.9段）；第1267號決議關乎已公布的制裁名單（第6.2段）；第1540號決議是全球層面的擴散資金籌集措施（第6.9段）——均非由《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.4段

en.q: Under sections 4 and 5 of the UNATMO, by what two routes may a person or property be specified as a terrorist, terrorist associate or terrorist property?
options: By the Chief Executive publishing a Gazette notice after a UNSC Committee designation; or by applying to the Court of First Instance for an order, which is also gazetted
By the Secretary for Security issuing a freezing notice under section 6; or by the Chief Executive granting a licence exception to the freezing prohibitions under that section
By the United Nations Security Council alone, taking automatic effect throughout Hong Kong without any Gazette notice or Court of First Instance order
By the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau issuing a public notice; or by the Court of First Instance making a confiscation order over the property
en.explain: ¶6.4 states that where a person or property is designated by a UNSC Committee, the Chief Executive may publish a notice in the Gazette under section 4; alternatively, under section 5 the Chief Executive may apply to the Court of First Instance for an order, which if made is also published in the Gazette. The Secretary for Security's freezing and licensing powers (¶6.5(a), ¶6.6), automatic UNSC effect, and the CEDB's role in the separate UNSO sanctions regime (¶6.7-6.8) are not the section 4/5 designation routes.

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第4及5條，可透過哪兩個途徑將某人或財產指明為恐怖分子、恐怖分子聯繫者或恐怖分子財產？
options: 由行政長官在安理會轄下委員會作出指定後於憲報刊登公告；或向原訟法庭申請命令並刊登於憲報
由保安局局長根據第6條發出財產凍結通知；或由行政長官根據同一條文批出豁免有關凍結禁令的特許
僅由聯合國安全理事會作出決定，在香港全境自動生效，無須刊登憲報公告或法庭命令
由商務及經濟發展局發出公告；或由原訟法庭就該財產作出充公令，兩者均屬可行途徑
tc.explain: 第6.4段訂明，如某人或財產獲安理會轄下委員會指定，行政長官可根據第4條在憲報刊登公告；或行政長官可根據第5條向原訟法庭申請命令，如命令作出亦會在憲報刊登。保安局局長的凍結及特許權力（第6.5(a)及6.6段）、安理會決定的自動生效，以及商務及經濟發展局在另一套《聯合國制裁條例》制度下的角色（第6.7至6.8段），均非第4及5條所訂的指定途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.4段註腳56

en.q: How does section 2 of the UNATMO define terrorist property?
options: The property of a terrorist or terrorist associate, or other property intended or used to finance or assist terrorist acts
Property that is designated under the UNSO regulations as belonging to a person or entity named by the UN Security Council or its Committees
Property that has been frozen by the Secretary for Security pending the outcome of an application made to the Court of First Instance
Property connected with proliferation financing that a person believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, may be linked to such financing
en.explain: Footnote 56 states that terrorist property means the property of a terrorist or terrorist associate, or any other property intended to be used or used to finance or assist the commission of terrorist acts. UNSO-designated property (¶6.7) belongs to the separate sanctions regime; property frozen by the Secretary for Security (¶6.5(a)) describes the freezing process, not the statutory definition; and property connected to proliferation financing is addressed by section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O (¶6.10), a different offence.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第2條如何界定「恐怖分子財產」？
options: 恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產，或擬用於或曾用於資助或協助恐怖活動的其他財產
根據《聯合國制裁條例》相關規例被指定屬安理會或其轄下委員會指認人士或實體所有的財產
在行政長官向原訟法庭提出申請、等候法庭頒下命令期間，已由保安局局長凍結的財產
任何人有合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散資金籌集有關連的財產，不論該人是否已作出申報
tc.explain: 第6.4段註腳56訂明，恐怖分子財產指恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產，或擬用於或曾用於資助或協助進行恐怖活動的任何其他財產。根據《聯合國制裁條例》被指定的財產（第6.7段）屬另一套制裁制度；由保安局局長凍結的財產（第6.5(a)段）描述的是凍結程序而非法定定義；與擴散資金籌集有關連的財產則由《大規模毀滅武器(提供服務的管制)條例》第4條規管（第6.10段），屬另一項罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(a)段

en.q: What power does section 6 of the UNATMO confer, and on whom?
options: It empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze any property that is suspected of being terrorist property
It empowers the Chief Executive to apply to the Court of First Instance for an order specifying a person or property as a terrorist or associate
It empowers the Commissioner of Customs and Excise to take disciplinary action against an MSO for breaching a specified provision of the AMLO
It empowers the Court of First Instance to make a confiscation order over any property derived from an indictable offence
en.explain: ¶6.5(a) states that section 6 of the UNATMO empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property. The Chief Executive's power to apply to the Court of First Instance is conferred by section 5 (¶6.4); the CCE's disciplinary power over specified provisions arises under a different part of the AMLO framework; and no confiscation-order power is conferred by section 6.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條授予何人甚麼權力？
options: 授權保安局局長凍結任何懷疑屬恐怖分子財產的財產
授權行政長官向原訟法庭申請命令，將某人或財產指明為恐怖分子
授權關長向違反指明的條文的金錢服務經營者採取紀律處分
授權原訟法庭就源自任何可公訴罪行的財產作出充公令
tc.explain: 第6.5(a)段訂明《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑屬恐怖分子財產的財產。行政長官向原訟法庭申請命令的權力源自第5條（第6.4段）；關長就違反指明的條文採取紀律處分的權力屬《打擊洗錢條例》架構的另一部分；第6條並無授予任何充公令的權力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(b)及(c)段

en.q: What do sections 7 and 8 of the UNATMO respectively prohibit?
options: Section 7 prohibits providing or collecting property for use to commit terrorist acts; section 8 prohibits making available, collecting or soliciting property or financial or related services for terrorists and terrorist associates

Section 7 prohibits dealing with property while knowing or being reckless as to whether it is specified terrorist property; section 8 prohibits financing the travel of a person between states for a terrorist purpose, even if no terrorist act occurs

Section 7 prohibits tipping off a customer that a suspicious transaction report concerning them has been made; section 8 empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze property suspected of being terrorist property
Section 7 empowers the Chief Executive to publish terrorist designations in the Gazette; section 8 empowers the Chief Executive to apply to the Court of First Instance for a specifying order
en.explain: ¶6.5(b)-(c) state that section 7 prohibits the provision or collection of property for use to commit terrorist acts, and section 8 prohibits making available, collecting or soliciting property or financial or related services for terrorists and terrorist associates. Dealing with specified terrorist property and financing terrorist travel are offences under sections 8A and 11L (¶6.5(d)-(e)); tipping off is a UNATMO offence under section 12(5) (¶7.6), not section 7; freezing is a section 6 power (¶6.5(a)); and Gazette designation and Court of First Instance applications are section 4 and 5 powers (¶6.4).

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第7及8條分別禁止甚麼？
options: 第7條禁止提供或收集財產以用作進行恐怖活動；第8條禁止任何人為恐怖分子及恐怖分子聯繫者提供、收集或募集財產或金融（或有關）服務
第7條禁止在知悉或罔顧財產是否屬指明恐怖分子財產的情況下處理該財產；第8條禁止資助某人在國與國之間旅行以達致恐怖目的，即使無恐怖活動發生
第7條禁止向客戶通風報信，透露與其有關的可疑交易報告已經作出；第8條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑屬恐怖分子財產的財產
第7條授權行政長官在憲報刊登有關恐怖分子的指定公告；第8條授權行政長官向原訟法庭申請作出指明命令
tc.explain: 第6.5(b)及(c)段訂明，第7條禁止提供或收集財產以用作進行恐怖活動；第8條禁止任何人為恐怖分子及恐怖分子聯繫者提供、收集或募集財產或金融（或有關）服務。處理指明恐怖分子財產及資助恐怖分子旅行分別是第8A及11L條的罪行（第6.5(d)及(e)段）；通風報信是《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(5)條下的罪行（第7.6段），並非第7條；凍結是第6條的權力（第6.5(a)段）；憲報指定及向原訟法庭申請則是第4及5條的權力（第6.4段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(d)段

en.q: What mental element does section 8A of the UNATMO require in relation to dealing with property?
options: Knowing, or being reckless as to whether, the property is specified terrorist property or the property of a specified terrorist or associate
Knowing that the property is, or believing on reasonable grounds that it may be, connected with proliferation financing under the WMD(CPS)O
Intending, or knowing, that the property is being provided or collected to finance a person's travel for a terrorist purpose
Having reasonable grounds to suspect that the property represents the proceeds of an indictable offence, whether or not a report was made
en.explain: ¶6.5(d) states that section 8A prohibits dealing with property while knowing that, or being reckless as to whether, it is specified terrorist property or property of a specified terrorist or terrorist associate — recklessness suffices. The 'believes or suspects on reasonable grounds' standard belongs to section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O for proliferation financing (¶6.10); the intention/knowledge standard for financing travel belongs to section 11L (¶6.5(e)); and a generic 'reasonable grounds to suspect' proceeds standard is not the section 8A test.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第8A條就處理財產要求何種犯罪心態？
options: 知悉，或罔顧該財產是否屬指明恐怖分子財產或指明恐怖分子或聯繫者的財產
知悉該財產，或有合理理由相信該財產可能與《大規模毀滅武器條例》下的擴散資金籌集有關連
意圖或知悉財產正被提供或收集，以資助某人為恐怖目的而在國與國之間旅行
有合理理由懷疑該財產屬可公訴罪行的得益，不論有否已向聯合財富情報組作出報告
tc.explain: 第6.5(d)段訂明第8A條禁止在知悉或罔顧某財產是否屬指明恐怖分子財產或指明恐怖分子或恐怖分子聯繫者的財產的情況下處理該財產——罔顧已足以構成。「有合理理由相信或懷疑」的標準屬《大規模毀滅武器(提供服務的管制)條例》第4條就擴散資金籌集而設（第6.10段）；意圖或知悉資助旅行的標準屬第11L條（第6.5(e)段）；一般「有合理理由懷疑」得益的標準並非第8A條的標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(e)段

en.q: Does an offence under section 11L of the UNATMO require a terrorist act actually to occur?
options: No — the prohibition on financing terrorist travel or training applies even if no terrorist act actually occurs
Yes — but only where the Chief Executive has published a Gazette notice specifying the person as a terrorist
Yes — but only where the property has already been frozen by the Secretary for Security under section 6
No — but the prohibition applies only to travel that both begins and ends within Hong Kong
en.explain: ¶6.5(e) states that section 11L prohibits providing or collecting property to finance the travel of a person between states, or related training, for a terrorist purpose, even if no terrorist act actually occurs (or results from the training). No prior Gazette designation (¶6.4) or freezing order (¶6.5(a)) is a precondition, and the travel concerned is between states, not travel confined within Hong Kong.

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第11L條下的罪行，是否須有恐怖活動實際發生？
options: 否——即使並無恐怖活動實際發生，禁止資助恐怖分子旅行或訓練的規定仍然適用
是——但僅限於行政長官已先在憲報刊登公告，將該人指明為恐怖分子的情況
是——但僅限於該財產已由保安局局長根據第6條發出命令凍結的情況
否——但該項禁止只適用於旅程的起點及終點均在香港境內的情況
tc.explain: 第6.5(e)段訂明第11L條禁止提供或收集財產，以資助某人在國與國之間的旅行或有關訓練，藉以達致恐怖目的，即使並無恐怖活動實際發生（或因該訓練而發生）。事先在憲報作出指定（第6.4段）或根據第6條發出凍結令（第6.5(a)段），均非先決條件；而所涉旅行是國與國之間的旅行，並非局限於香港境內的旅程。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段

en.q: Who may licence exceptions to the UNATMO prohibitions, and to whom should an MSO write for such a licence?
options: The Secretary for Security, and the MSO should write to the Security Bureau
The Chief Executive, and the MSO should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The CCE, and the MSO should write to the Customs and Excise Department
The Court of First Instance, and the MSO should apply by summons
en.explain: ¶6.6 states that the S for S can licence exceptions to the prohibitions to enable frozen property to be unfrozen and to allow payments to be made to or for the benefit of a designated party under the UNATMO — for example reasonable living or legal expenses and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance — and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Security Bureau. Contrast ¶6.8, where UNSO licences come from the Chief Executive via the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.

tc.q: 何人可就《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》的禁制發出豁免許可？金錢服務經營者應向何處申請？
options: 保安局局長；該經營者應致函保安局
行政長官；該經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局
海關關長；該經營者應致函香港海關
原訟法庭；該經營者應以傳票方式申請
tc.explain: 第6.6段訂明保安局局長可就有關禁制發出許可，以容許解除凍結財產，並容許向指定人士或為其利益作出付款（例如合理生活或法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項）；擬申請該等許可的金錢服務經營者應致函保安局。此與第6.8段有別——《聯合國制裁條例》下的許可由行政長官批出，並須致函商務及經濟發展局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段

en.q: What does the UNSO empower the Chief Executive to do, and how are designated persons specified?
options: To make regulations implementing UNSC sanctions, including targeted financial sanctions; designated persons and entities are specified by notice in the Gazette or on the CEDB website
To freeze property directly without making any regulations under the UNSO; designated persons and entities are in each case notified individually by the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
To prosecute a person for breaching a specified provision of the AMLO; designated persons and entities are identified by the Secretary for Security
To grant exemptions from the requirements of Schedule 2 to the AMLO; designated persons and entities are identified by the Commissioner of Customs and Excise
en.explain: ¶6.7 states that the UNSO empowers the Chief Executive to make regulations to implement UNSC sanctions, including targeted financial sanctions, and that designated persons and entities are specified by notice in the Gazette or on the CEDB website. There is no direct freezing power without regulations, the JFIU plays no role in identifying sanctions designees, prosecuting AMLO breaches is a different function, and neither the Secretary for Security nor the CCE performs the identification.

tc.q: 《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官作甚麼？指定人士如何被指明？
options: 訂立規例以實施安理會的制裁，包括定向金融制裁；指定人士及實體以憲報公告或商經局網站公告指明
無須根據《聯合國制裁條例》訂立任何規例即直接凍結財產；指定人士及實體則由聯合財富情報組個別通知
檢控違反《打擊洗錢條例》指明的條文的人；指定人士及實體則由保安局局長負責識別
批出《打擊洗錢條例》附表2規定的豁免；指定人士及實體則由關長負責識別
tc.explain: 第6.7段訂明《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官訂立規例，以實施安理會決定的制裁，包括定向金融制裁；指定人士及實體以在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的公告指明。並無無須訂立規例的直接凍結權力；聯合財富情報組在識別受制裁指定人士方面並無角色；檢控違反《打擊洗錢條例》屬另一職能；保安局局長及關長均非負責識別的人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段註腳57

en.q: What do targeted financial sanctions comprise?
options: Both asset freezing and prohibitions on making funds available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities
Asset freezing only, without any prohibition on indirectly making funds available for a designated person's benefit
Trade embargoes and export controls imposed under the UNSO regulations made specifically against the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and Iran
Travel bans and diplomatic measures adopted by the United Nations Security Council under Chapter VII of the UN Charter
en.explain: Footnote 57 states that targeted financial sanctions comprise both asset freezing and prohibitions on making funds or other assets available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities — the two limbs in ¶6.7(a)-(b). Asset freezing alone omits the second limb; trade embargoes/export controls and travel bans/diplomatic measures are not what this Guideline describes as targeted financial sanctions, though DPRK/Iran-specific and Chapter VII measures are addressed separately at ¶6.9.

tc.q: 定向金融制裁包括甚麼？
options: 資產凍結，以及防止直接或間接為指定人士及實體的利益提供資金的禁制，兩者兼備
僅資產凍結，並無禁止直接或間接為指定人士的利益提供資金的規定
根據專門針對朝鮮民主主義人民共和國及伊朗訂立的相關規例實施的貿易禁運及出口管制
聯合國安全理事會根據《聯合國憲章》第七章通過決議所採取的旅遊禁令及外交措施
tc.explain: 註腳57訂明定向金融制裁兼指資產凍結，以及防止直接或間接為指定人士及實體的利益提供資金或其他資產的禁制——即第6.7(a)及(b)款所載的兩部分。僅資產凍結遺漏了第二部分；貿易禁運／出口管制及旅遊禁令／外交措施並非本指引所述的定向金融制裁，儘管針對朝鮮／伊朗及《聯合國憲章》第七章的措施另見第6.9段。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(a)段

en.q: Beyond designated persons and entities themselves, to whom is it an offence to make funds available under the applicable UNSO regulations?
options: Persons or entities acting on behalf of, or at the direction of, designated persons or entities, or owned or controlled by them; and entities owned by those persons
Any counterparty to a transaction with a designated person, provided that the transaction had already taken place before the person's name was first published in the Gazette
Any person who is merely resident in the same jurisdiction as a designated person, regardless of whether any relationship with that person exists
Only the immediate family members of a designated person, as determined from time to time by the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
en.explain: ¶6.7(a) makes it an offence to make funds available to designated persons or entities; persons or entities acting on their behalf or at their direction, or owned or controlled by them; or entities owned by the aforementioned. Pre-designation counterparties, mere co-residents, and JFIU-determined family members are not among the categories the regulation extends to.

tc.q: 除指定人士及實體本身外，根據適用的《聯合國制裁條例》規例，向何人提供資金亦屬罪行？
options: 代指定人士或實體行事或按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的人士或實體；以及由該等人士或實體擁有的實體
只要有關交易是在指定人士的姓名於憲報或商經局網站刊登之前已經進行，曾與該人進行交易的任何對手方均屬之
僅與指定人士居於同一司法管轄區的任何人，不論兩者之間有否任何實質的個人或商業關係存在
僅由聯合財富情報組不時認定的指定人士直系家庭成員，不論彼此有否任何實際的關連或往來
tc.explain: 第6.7(a)段訂明，向指定人士或實體；代其行事或按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的人士或實體；以及由上述人士或實體擁有的實體，提供資金即屬犯罪。指定前的交易對手方、僅屬同一司法管轄區居民，以及由聯合財富情報組認定的家庭成員，均不在該規例延伸涵蓋的類別之內。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7(b)段

en.q: What second limb of prohibition does ¶6.7(b) create?
options: Dealing, directly or indirectly, with funds or other financial assets or economic resources belonging to, or owned or controlled by, such persons or entities
Providing any service where a person believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that the service may be connected with proliferation financing
Advertising or marketing financial services in a jurisdiction that is the subject of a sanctions regime imposed by another jurisdiction's authorities
Employing, directly or indirectly, any person who is a terrorist associate as defined under section 2 of the UNATMO
en.explain: ¶6.7(b) prohibits dealing, directly or indirectly, with funds or other financial assets or economic resources belonging to, or owned or controlled by, the persons or entities in ¶6.7(a). The 'believes or suspects on reasonable grounds' service prohibition belongs to section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O (¶6.10); unilateral foreign sanctions are addressed at ¶6.11 without creating an HK-law offence; and employing a terrorist associate is not itself the prohibited conduct under ¶6.7(b) — dealing with property is.

tc.q: 第6.7(b)段訂立哪一項禁制？
options: 直接或間接處理屬於該等人士或實體所有，或由其擁有或控制的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源
任何人有合理理由相信或懷疑某項服務可能與擴散資金籌集有關連，而仍然提供該項服務
在其他司法管轄區主管當局實施單方面制裁制度所針對的司法管轄區宣傳或推廣金融服務
直接或間接僱用任何根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第2條界定為恐怖分子聯繫者的人士
tc.explain: 第6.7(b)段禁止直接或間接處理屬於第6.7(a)款所述人士或實體所有，或由其擁有或控制的任何資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源。「有合理理由相信或懷疑」的服務禁制屬《大規模毀滅武器(提供服務的管制)條例》第4條（第6.10段）；其他司法管轄區的單方面制裁見第6.11段，並不構成香港法例下的罪行；僱用恐怖分子聯繫者本身並非第6.7(b)款所禁止的行為——處理財產才是。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.8段

en.q: To which body should an MSO write when seeking a licence under the relevant UNSO regulation?
options: The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Security Bureau
The Financial Services and Treasury Bureau
The Customs and Excise Department
en.explain: ¶6.8 states that the Chief Executive may grant a licence for making available funds or dealing with funds belonging to certain persons or entities under specified circumstances in accordance with the provisions of the relevant regulation made under the UNSO, and that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者擬申請有關《聯合國制裁條例》規例下的許可，應致函哪個機構？
options: 商務及經濟發展局
保安局
財經事務及庫務局
香港海關
tc.explain: 第6.8段訂明行政長官可按《聯合國制裁條例》下有關規例的條文，在指明情況下就向若干人士或實體提供資金，或處理屬於該等人士或實體所有或由其擁有或控制的資金，批出許可；擬申請該等許可的金錢服務經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: What is the UNSC's two-tiered approach to combating proliferation financing?
options: A global approach under UNSCR 1540, and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 against Iran
A global approach under UNSCR 1373, and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1267 against Al-Qa'ida, ISIL and the Taliban
A Security Bureau licensing approach under the UNATMO, and a separate Commerce and Economic Development Bureau licensing approach under the UNSO
A voluntary tier applying to FATF member states, and a mandatory tier applying only to UNSC member states
en.explain: ¶6.9 states that to combat PF the UNSC adopts a two-tiered approach through Chapter VII resolutions binding all UN member states: a global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and successors, and a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran. UNSCR 1373 and 1267 belong to the separate terrorism-financing designation regime described at ¶6.2, not PF. The Security Bureau and CEDB licensing powers at ¶6.6/¶6.8 are a different mechanism (licensing exceptions), not the two-tiered approach itself, and both tiers bind all UN member states, not only FATF or UNSC members.

tc.q: 聯合國安全理事會打擊擴散資金籌集的雙層方針為何？
options: 第1540號決議所訂的全球性方針；以及針對朝鮮的第1718號決議及針對伊朗的第2231號決議所訂的針對特定國家方針
第1373號決議所訂的全球性方針；以及針對基地組織、伊黎伊斯蘭國（達伊沙）及塔利班組織的第1267號決議所訂的針對特定國家方針
根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》由保安局發牌的方針；以及根據《聯合國制裁條例》由商務及經濟發展局另行發牌的方針
對財務行動特別組織的成員國屬自願性質的一層；以及只對聯合國安全理事會的成員國屬強制性質的一層
tc.explain: 第6.9段訂明，為打擊擴散資金籌集，聯合國安全理事會透過根據《聯合國憲章》第七章作出、對全體聯合國成員國具約束力的決議，採取雙層方針：全球性方針及針對特定國家方針。第1373號及第1267號決議屬第6.2段所述另一套恐怖分子資金籌集指定機制，並非擴散資金籌集機制。第6.6／6.8段的保安局及商經局發牌權力屬另一機制（許可豁除），並非雙層方針本身；兩層方針均對全體聯合國成員國具約束力，並非只對財務行動特別組織或安理會成員具約束力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段

en.q: What alone can make lawful conduct that would otherwise be an offence under the applicable UNSO regulations?
options: The authority of a licence granted by the Chief Executive
The written consent of the designated person concerned
A determination by the CCE that the risk is low
Prior notification to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
en.explain: ¶6.7 provides that, except under the authority of a licence granted by the Chief Executive, it is an offence to make available funds or other financial assets or economic resources to or for the benefit of designated persons and entities, or to deal with funds belonging to or controlled by them. ¶6.8 adds that an MSO seeking such a licence should write to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau.

tc.q: 單憑甚麼可令原本違反適用《聯合國制裁條例》規例的行為變為合法？
options: 行政長官批出的許可的授權
有關指定人士的書面同意
海關關長裁定風險屬低
事先通知商務及經濟發展局
tc.explain: 第6.7段訂明，除非獲行政長官批出的許可授權，否則向指定人士及實體或為其利益提供資金、其他金融資產或經濟資源，或處理屬於其所有或由其控制的資金，即屬犯罪。第6.8段補充，擬申請該等許可的金錢服務經營者應致函商務及經濟發展局。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.10段

en.q: What test does section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O apply to the provision of services?
options: It prohibits providing services where the person believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, a PF connection
It prohibits providing any services to a person or entity resident or incorporated in the DPRK or Iran
It prohibits providing services without first obtaining a licence granted by the Chief Executive
It prohibits providing services only where the person actually knows, rather than merely suspects, of a PF connection
en.explain: ¶6.10 states that section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O prohibits a person from providing any services where he believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that those services may be connected to PF. The threshold is reasonable belief or suspicion. Residency of the counterparty in the DPRK or Iran is not the statutory test; a Chief Executive licence is a separate power under ¶6.8 for a different ordinance; and the threshold is not confined to actual knowledge.

tc.q: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條就提供服務採用何種準則？
options: 在有合理理由相信或懷疑服務與擴散資金籌集有關連時，禁止提供該服務
禁止向任何在朝鮮或伊朗居住、註冊或成立業務的人士或實體提供任何服務
禁止在未事先取得行政長官根據該條例發出的許可下提供任何服務
只在明知（而非僅屬合理理由相信或懷疑）服務與擴散資金籌集有關連時，方予禁止
tc.explain: 第6.10段訂明《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條禁止任何人在有合理理由相信或懷疑所提供的服務可能與擴散資金籌集有關連的情況下提供該等服務，準則為合理理由相信或懷疑。對手方是否居於朝鮮或伊朗並非法定準則；行政長官發牌屬第6.8段所述、適用於另一條例的獨立權力；而準則亦不限於實際知悉。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第5.4段

en.q: What standing duty does section 19(3) of Schedule 2 impose on an MSO in relation to transaction monitoring?
options: To establish and maintain adequate systems and processes to monitor transactions
To manually review every transaction before execution, regardless of size or complexity
To engage an external service provider to perform all transaction monitoring
To report every transaction of $8,000 or more to the CCE within the same month
en.explain: ¶5.4, citing section 19(3) of Schedule 2, states that an MSO should establish and maintain adequate systems and processes to monitor transactions, with design and sophistication developed having regard to five listed factors. It is not a manual pre-execution review of every transaction, not mandatory outsourcing to an external provider, and not a fixed monthly $8,000 reporting duty to the CCE (which conflates the Chapter 10 wire-transfer threshold with a reporting timetable that ¶5.4 does not impose).

tc.q: 就交易監察，附表2第19(3)條對金錢服務經營者施加甚麼持續責任？
options: 建立及維持足夠的系統及程序以監察交易
不論規模或複雜程度，在每宗交易執行前以人手覆核
委聘外聘服務供應商執行所有交易監察工作
須於同月內向關長報告每宗8,000元或以上的交易
tc.explain: 第5.4段引述附表2第19(3)條，訂明該經營者應建立及維持足夠的系統及程序以監察交易，其設計及精密程度須顧及其後所列的五項因素而發展。這並非在每宗交易執行前以人手覆核，也不是必須外判予外聘服務供應商，更非固定每月向關長報告8,000元或以上交易的責任（第5.4段並無此規定，8,000元門檻屬第10章電傳轉帳的另一事宜）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.11段

en.q: What is the position on unilateral sanctions imposed by authorities in other jurisdictions?
options: MSOs owe no Hong Kong-law duty to follow them, though internationally active MSOs must track their scope
They have the same binding legal force in Hong Kong as sanctions implemented through UNSCR-based legislation
Applying them would itself amount to a breach of Hong Kong law, so an MSO must always disregard them entirely
They bind an MSO only where that MSO maintains a registered branch or subsidiary office overseas
en.explain: ¶6.11 states that MSOs do not normally have any Hong Kong-law obligation to have regard to unilateral sanctions imposed by other jurisdictions, but an MSO operating internationally needs to be aware of their scope and focus and should consider implications and take appropriate measures. This differs from UNSCR-based sanctions implemented through Hong Kong legislation, which do bind MSOs; unilateral sanctions are not automatically unlawful to follow, nor do they apply only where there is an overseas branch.

tc.q: 就其他司法管轄區的當局所施加的單方面制裁，立場為何？
options: 金錢服務經營者按香港法律通常無須理會，但須知悉其範圍
在香港具有與透過聯合國決議實施的法例完全相同的法律約束力
採用該等制裁本身即屬違反香港法律，故經營者必須一律不予理會
只在該經營者設有已註冊的海外分行或附屬公司時，方具法律約束力
tc.explain: 第6.11段訂明，金錢服務經營者按香港法律通常並無責任顧及其他司法管轄區當局所施加的單方面制裁，但在國際間營運的經營者須知悉有關制裁制度的範圍及重點，並應考慮其影響及採取適當措施。這有別於透過香港法例實施、對經營者具約束力的聯合國決議制裁；單方面制裁並非因採用即屬違法而須一律不理，也不是只在該經營者設有海外分支機構時方具約束力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.12段

en.q: What does ¶6.12 require of an MSO in relation to the TF, financial sanctions and PF regimes?
options: Effective policies, procedures and controls, plus staff guidance and training
A written legal opinion obtained from external counsel covering each individual sanctions regime
An annual external audit report on its sanctions controls, submitted in writing to the CCE
Notification in writing to the CCE within 3 business days of every screening alert that is raised
en.explain: ¶6.12 states that an MSO should establish and maintain effective policies, procedures and controls to ensure compliance with TF, financial sanctions and PF regulations and legislation, with obligations well understood and adequate guidance and training provided to staff. It does not require a purchased external legal opinion, a mandatory annual external audit, or CCE notification within 3 business days — that time limit applies under ¶10.12 to providing complete originator information on request, not to screening alerts.

tc.q: 就恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集制度，第6.12段對金錢服務經營者有何要求？
options: 建立有效政策、程序及管控，向員工提供指引培訓
須就每套制裁制度分別取得外聘律師的書面法律意見
須每年就其制裁管控安排進行外部審計並呈交關長
須在提出每宗篩查警示後的3個營業日內以書面通知關長
tc.explain: 第6.12段訂明該經營者應建立及維持有效的政策、程序及管控，以確保遵從有關恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集的相關規例及法例，並向員工提供充分的指引及培訓。並非須取得外聘法律意見，也非強制性年度外部審計，更非固定3個營業日通知關長的責任——該3個營業日時限見於第10.12段就提供完整匯款人資料的規定，並非篩查警示。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.13段

en.q: What database should an MSO maintain, and what alternative is permitted?
options: A database of terrorist and designated-party names consolidating known lists, or a third-party provider's database
A database recording its own customers' transaction histories only, with absolutely no alternative permitted
A database maintained jointly with other MSOs through the CCE, or alternatively a manual paper file
A database supplied and updated directly by the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau, with no alternative permitted
en.explain: ¶6.13 states that an MSO should maintain a database of names and particulars of terrorists and designated parties consolidating known lists; alternatively it may subscribe to a third-party provider's database and take appropriate measures such as periodic sample testing to ensure completeness and accuracy. It is not a customers-only transaction database, not a joint database run through the CCE or a paper file, and not one supplied by the CEDB, whose role under ¶6.15 is publishing lists, not supplying the database.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者應維持甚麼資料庫？獲准採用甚麼替代方式？
options: 綜合已知悉名單的恐怖分子及指定人士資料庫；或第三方供應商的資料庫
只備存本身客戶的交易紀錄資料庫，完全不容許任何替代方式
與其他金錢服務經營者透過關長聯合維持的資料庫；或改以人手紙本檔案代替
由商務及經濟發展局直接提供並持續更新的資料庫，完全不容許任何替代方式
tc.explain: 第6.13段訂明該經營者應維持一個綜合已知悉名單的恐怖分子及指定人士姓名及詳情資料庫；或可訂用第三方服務供應商所維持的該等資料庫，並採取適當措施（例如定期抽樣測試）以確保完整及準確。並非只備存本身客戶交易紀錄的資料庫，也不是透過關長與其他經營者聯合維持的資料庫或人手紙本檔案，更不是由商務及經濟發展局提供——該局根據第6.15段的角色是刊登名單，並非提供資料庫。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.14段

en.q: What is the legal significance of inclusion of a country, individual, entity or activity in a UNSCR or sanctions list, even where that list has not been implemented through Hong Kong legislation?
options: Grounds for knowledge or suspicion under ML, TF and PF laws, triggering statutory reporting duties
It has no legal significance whatsoever in Hong Kong until the list is implemented through local legislation
It automatically renders void every transaction connected in any way with that country, individual or entity
It obliges the MSO to terminate the customer relationship immediately, without any further inquiry at all
en.explain: ¶6.14 states that whether or not a UNSCR or sanctions list has been implemented through Hong Kong legislation, inclusion of a country, individual, entity or activity in it may constitute grounds for knowledge or suspicion for the purposes of relevant ML, TF and PF laws, thereby triggering statutory (including reporting) obligations and offence provisions. It is not legally inert until local implementation, does not automatically void transactions, and does not itself require immediate termination of the relationship.

tc.q: 即使某份聯合國決議或制裁名單尚未透過香港法例實施，將某國家、個人、實體或活動列入其中可能有何法律意義？
options: 可構成洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集法律下知悉或懷疑的理由
在該名單透過香港本地法例正式生效實施之前，於香港完全並無任何法律意義
自動令與該國家、個人或實體有任何關連的交易一律歸於無效
令該經營者有責任在毋須任何進一步查詢下立即終止該客戶關係
tc.explain: 第6.14段訂明，不論有關聯合國決議或制裁名單有否透過香港法例實施，將某國家、個人、實體或活動列入其中，就有關洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的法律而言，均可構成知悉或懷疑的理由，從而觸發法定（包括報告）責任及罪行條文。並非在本地實施前並無法律意義，也不會自動令交易無效，更不會單憑此點即須立即終止業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.14段

en.q: How quickly must UNSCR and sanctions list entries be added to an MSO's database?
options: As soon as practicable after UNSC promulgation, regardless of Hong Kong implementation
Only once the relevant sanctions have themselves been implemented through Hong Kong legislation
Only at the MSO's next scheduled quarterly database update cycle, not immediately upon promulgation
Within 30 business days of the CCE formally drawing the update to the MSO's attention
en.explain: ¶6.14 states that the CCE draws updates to MSOs from time to time, and that MSOs should ensure entries are added to the database as soon as practicable after UNSC promulgation, regardless of whether the sanctions have been implemented by Hong Kong legislation. Addition is not conditional on local implementation, not limited to a quarterly cycle, and not governed by a fixed 30-business-day clock.

tc.q: 聯合國決議及制裁名單的項目須多快加入金錢服務經營者的資料庫？
options: 須在安理會公布後，在切實可行範圍內盡快加入，不論香港法例有否實施
須待有關制裁本身已透過香港法例實施後方可加入
只須於下次定期季度資料庫更新時加入，毋須於公布時加入
須在關長提請該經營者注意後30個營業日內加入
tc.explain: 第6.14段訂明關長會不時將名單更新提請經營者注意，而經營者應確保在安理會公布後，在切實可行範圍內盡快將有關項目加入資料庫，不論有關制裁有否已透過香港法例實施。加入並非須待本地實施後方可進行，也不限於季度周期，更非設有固定30個營業日時限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.15段

en.q: Which two categories of list must an MSO include in its database under ¶6.15?
options: Gazette or Commerce and Economic Development Bureau website lists, and lists the CCE draws to MSOs' attention
Lists published by the FATF, and the lists of licence exceptions granted by the Security Bureau
Lists maintained by a third-party database provider under ¶6.13, and the MSO's own internally compiled watchlist
Lists published by the JFIU in its quarterly report, and lists posted on the UNSC's own website
en.explain: ¶6.15 states that an MSO should include in its database the lists published in the Gazette or on the CEDB's website, and the lists that the CCE draws to MSOs' attention from time to time. The FATF and Security Bureau do not publish these two categories; the ¶6.13 third-party database is a substitute for the MSO's own consolidated database, not one of these two categories; and neither the JFIU nor the UNSC's own website is the source ¶6.15 identifies.

tc.q: 根據第6.15段，金錢服務經營者須在其資料庫中納入哪兩類名單？
options: 憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的名單；以及關長提請經營者注意的名單
財務行動特別組織公布的名單；以及保安局根據第6.6段批出許可豁免的名單
第6.13段所指第三方資料庫供應商維持的名單；以及經營者本身內部編製的監察名單
聯合財富情報組在其季度報告公布的名單；以及張貼於聯合國安理會網站的名單
tc.explain: 第6.15段訂明該經營者應在其資料庫中納入：(a)在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的名單；及(b)關長不時提請經營者注意的名單。財務行動特別組織及保安局並非刊登此兩類名單的機構；第6.13段的第三方資料庫是經營者本身綜合資料庫的替代方式，並非此兩類名單之一；聯合財富情報組及聯合國安理會網站亦非第6.15段所指的來源。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.15段

en.q: What two further requirements apply to the sanctions database itself?
options: Timely update whenever there are changes, and easy access for relevant staff
Daily backup of all records, with a copy stored outside Hong Kong at all times
End-to-end encryption, with access restricted solely to the compliance officer
Independent annual audit, with the results certified in writing by the CCE
en.explain: ¶6.15 states that the database should also be subject to timely update whenever there are changes, and should be made easily accessible by relevant staff. A database that is current but not usable by front-line staff does not serve the screening purpose in ¶6.16. Daily offshore backup, compliance-officer-only encryption, and a CCE-certified annual audit are not requirements this paragraph imposes.

tc.q: 就制裁資料庫本身，另有哪兩項要求？
options: 每當有變動時須適時更新；並須讓相關員工易於查閱
須每日備份所有紀錄，並須將副本一直存放於香港以外
須端對端加密，並只限合規主任方可查閱
須每年獨立審計，並由關長以書面核證結果
tc.explain: 第6.15段訂明該資料庫每當有變動時亦須適時更新，並須讓相關員工易於查閱。資料庫縱使是最新的，若前線員工無法使用，亦不能達到第6.16段的篩查目的。每日備份至香港以外、只限合規主任查閱的加密安排，以及由關長每年核證的審計，均非本段所要求。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16段

en.q: Which three elements must an MSO's screening mechanism include?
options: Screening at relationship establishment, on new/updated designations, and all parties to cross-border transfers
Screening only at onboarding; screening against updated designations once a year; and screening only domestic wire transfers
Screening customers only at onboarding, then re-screening annually thereafter; no screening for wire transfers
Screening only high-risk customers at onboarding and before each transaction; no database update required
en.explain: ¶6.16 requires an effective screening mechanism covering: screening customers and beneficial owners against the current database at relationship establishment; screening against all new or updated designations as soon as practicable; and screening all relevant parties in a cross-border wire transfer, including remittance, before executing the transfer. It is not an onboarding-only or annual-only cycle, is not customers-only, does not exempt wire transfers, and is not confined to high-risk customers.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者的篩查機制須包括哪三項元素？
options: 建立業務關係時；盡快就新增或更新的指定；以及跨境電傳轉帳前就所有相關方篩查
只在開立客戶時篩查一次；其後每年就更新的指定篩查一次；以及只篩查本地電傳轉帳
只在開立客戶時篩查客戶，其後每年重新篩查一次；電傳轉帳則無須進行任何篩查
只在開立時及每宗交易前篩查高風險客戶；資料庫則無須作任何更新
tc.explain: 第6.16段規定須實施有效的篩查機制，包括：(a)在建立業務關係時，就客戶及其實益擁有人與現行資料庫作篩查；(b)在切實可行範圍內盡快就資料庫所有新增或更新的指定作篩查；及(c)在執行跨境電傳轉帳（包括匯款交易）前，就所有相關方作篩查。並非只在開立時或只每年篩查一次，也不是只篩查客戶，並不豁免電傳轉帳，更不限於高風險客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第11.6段

en.q: Before a $20,000 remittance an MSO records the originator's name and identification document number, the currency and amount, the date and time of the instruction, and the recipient's name, address and method of delivery. Which required particular is missing?
options: The originator's address
The originator's occupation
The recipient's identification document number
The purpose of the remittance
en.explain: ¶11.6 requires five particulars: the originator's name; the originator's identification document number and, if it is a travel document, its place of issue; the originator's address; the currency and amount involved; and the date and time of receipt of the instruction, the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery. The originator's address is the one omitted here.

tc.q: 在一宗20,000元的匯款前，某金錢服務經營者記錄了匯款人的姓名及身分證明文件號碼、貨幣及款額、收到指示的日期及時間，以及收款人的姓名、地址及交付方式。欠缺了哪一項規定須記錄的詳情？
options: 匯款人的地址
匯款人的職業
收款人的身分證明文件號碼
該筆匯款的用途
tc.explain: 第11.6段規定五項詳情：匯款人的姓名；匯款人的身分證明文件號碼（如該文件是旅行證件，則另需其簽發地點）；匯款人的地址；所涉貨幣及款額；以及收到指示的日期及時間、收款人的姓名及地址，以及交付方式。此處遺漏的正是匯款人的地址。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.17段

en.q: To whom, beyond customers and beneficial owners, should the ¶6.16(a) and (b) screening requirements extend?
options: Connected parties and persons purporting to act for a customer, on a risk basis
All counterparties to every transaction the customer undertakes, without any risk-based limitation
Only the directors of a corporate customer, whose identity is verified using a document-based approach
Every employee of a corporate customer, regardless of their seniority or role
en.explain: ¶6.17 states that the screening requirements set out in ¶6.16(a) and (b) should extend to connected parties as defined in ¶4.3.19 (directors, partners, trustees, or senior management, depending on the customer type) and to persons purporting to act on behalf of a customer, using a risk-based approach. It is not every counterparty to every transaction, not directors alone verified on a document-based approach (¶4.3.19 also covers partners, trustees and senior management), and not every employee regardless of role.

tc.q: 除客戶及實益擁有人外，第6.16(a)及(b)款的篩查規定應延伸至何人？
options: 有關連人士及聲稱代客戶行事的人，按風險為本方式
該客戶進行的每宗交易的所有對手方，不設風險為本的限制
只限法人客戶的董事，並須以文件為本的方式核實其身分
法人客戶的每一名僱員，不論其職級或職務為何
tc.explain: 第6.17段訂明第6.16(a)及(b)款所載的篩查規定，應按風險為本方式延伸至第4.3.19段所界定的有關連人士（視乎客戶類別，包括董事、合夥人、受託人或高級管理人員）及聲稱代客戶行事的人。並非該客戶每宗交易的所有對手方，也不是只限董事並以文件為本方式核實（第4.3.19段亦涵蓋合夥人、受託人及高級管理人員），更不是不論職級的每一名僱員。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.18段

en.q: What should an MSO do when possible name matches are identified during screening?
options: Enhanced checks for genuine hits; report suspicions to the JFIU; and document the results
Treat every possible match as a confirmed hit, freeze the customer's funds and close the account immediately
Ask the customer to confirm whether they are the listed person, and rely on that answer without further checks
Refer the match to the CCE for a binding determination and suspend the relationship until it is given
en.explain: ¶6.18 states that when possible name matches are identified during screening, an MSO should conduct enhanced checks to determine whether the possible matches are genuine hits; in case of any suspicion of TF, PF or sanctions violations it should report to the JFIU; and it should document the enhanced checking results together with all screening records. It should not treat every match as confirmed, rely solely on the customer's own denial, or refer the matter to the CCE for determination.

tc.q: 在篩查過程中識別出可能的姓名配對時，金錢服務經營者應怎樣做？
options: 加強查核以確定是否真正命中；如有懷疑向聯合財富情報組報告並記錄結果
將每宗可能配對均視為已確認命中，並立即凍結該客戶的資金及關閉有關帳戶
要求客戶確認其是否名單所列人士，並只憑其答覆定案而不作進一步查核
將該配對轉介關長作出具約束力的裁定，並在裁定前暫停該業務關係
tc.explain: 第6.18段訂明在篩查過程中識別出可能的姓名配對時，該經營者應進行加強查核以斷定是否真正命中；如懷疑涉及恐怖分子資金籌集、擴散資金籌集或違反制裁，須向聯合財富情報組報告；並須將加強查核結果連同所有篩查紀錄記錄在案。並非將每宗配對均視為已確認命中，也不是只憑客戶本身的否認定案，更不是轉交關長裁定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.19段

en.q: May an MSO rely on its overseas office to maintain the sanctions database or undertake screening?
options: Yes, but ultimate responsibility for ensuring compliance remains with the MSO itself
No — the database and the screening process must both be performed within Hong Kong itself
Yes, and doing so transfers the compliance responsibility to that overseas office
Only after obtaining the CCE's prior written approval for the overseas arrangement
en.explain: ¶6.19 states that an MSO may rely on its overseas office to maintain the database or undertake the screening process, but the ultimate responsibility for ensuring compliance with the relevant TF, financial sanctions and PF regulations and legislation remains with the MSO. Reliance is permitted (it need not be performed in Hong Kong), does not transfer responsibility, and does not require the CCE's prior written approval.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者可否倚賴其海外辦事處維持制裁資料庫或進行篩查？
options: 可以，但確保遵從的最終責任仍由經營者承擔
不可——資料庫及篩查程序均須在香港境內進行
可以，且此舉會將合規責任轉移至該海外辦事處
須先就有關海外安排取得關長的書面批准
tc.explain: 第6.19段訂明該經營者可倚賴其海外辦事處維持資料庫或進行篩查程序，但確保遵從有關恐怖分子資金籌集、金融制裁及擴散資金籌集的相關規例及法例的最終責任，仍由該經營者承擔。倚賴海外辦事處是獲准的（毋須在香港境內進行），並不會轉移責任，亦毋須先取得關長的書面批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.13段

en.q: What two capabilities does ¶6.13 identify as particularly vital for an MSO?
options: Identifying terrorist suspects and designated parties, and detecting prohibited transactions
Freezing suspect property directly, and prosecuting offenders through the courts
Granting licence exceptions, and issuing formal waivers to designated parties
Publishing new designations in the Gazette, and updating the register the CCE maintains for MSOs
en.explain: ¶6.13 states that it is particularly vital that an MSO should be able to identify terrorist suspects and possible designated parties, and detect prohibited transactions — and it is to this end that the database requirement exists. Freezing property and prosecution are law-enforcement functions; granting licence exceptions or waivers is a Security Bureau/Chief Executive function under ¶6.6/6.8; and publishing designations is a government function, not an MSO capability.

tc.q: 第6.13段指出金錢服務經營者具備哪兩項能力至為關鍵？
options: 識別恐怖分子嫌疑人及指定人士，以及偵測受禁交易
直接凍結嫌疑財產，以及透過法院檢控犯罪者
批出豁免許可，以及向指定人士發出正式寬免
在憲報刊登新指定，以及更新關長為經營者備存的登記冊
tc.explain: 第6.13段訂明該經營者必須能夠識別恐怖分子嫌疑人及可能的指定人士，並偵測受禁交易——資料庫的規定正是為此而設。凍結財產及檢控屬執法機構職能；批出豁免許可或寬免屬第6.6/6.8段所述保安局／行政長官的職能；而公布指定屬政府職能，並非經營者的能力。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16段

en.q: At what point must the parties to a cross-border wire transfer be screened?
options: Before executing the transfer
Immediately after executing the transfer
Within one business day of the transfer
At the next periodic review of the customer
en.explain: ¶6.16(c) requires an MSO to screen all relevant parties in a cross-border / cross-boundary wire transfer, including a remittance transaction, against the current database before executing the transfer — screening after execution would not prevent the prohibited transaction.

tc.q: 跨境電傳轉帳的各方須在何時接受篩查？
options: 在執行該轉帳前
在執行該轉帳後隨即進行
在該轉帳後一個營業日內
在下次定期檢視該客戶時
tc.explain: 第6.16(c)款規定該經營者須在執行轉帳前，就跨境／跨界電傳轉帳（包括匯款交易）的所有相關方與現行資料庫作篩查——執行後才篩查並不能阻止受禁交易發生。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.16段

en.q: What is the stated purpose of the screening mechanism required by ¶6.16?
options: To avoid a relationship with, or services to, suspects and parties on sanctions lists
To satisfy the customer due diligence requirements imposed by section 2 of Schedule 2 to the AMLO
To assess and assign the customer's ML/TF risk rating under Chapter 2's risk-based approach
To satisfy the record-keeping requirements for wire transfers under Chapter 8 and section 20 of Schedule 2
en.explain: ¶6.16 introduces the screening mechanism as being to avoid establishing a business relationship with, or providing any financial services to, any terrorist suspects and possible sanctioned parties included in UNSCRs and sanctions lists. It is not to satisfy the Schedule 2 CDD requirements of Chapter 4, not to assess an ML/TF risk rating under Chapter 2's risk-based approach, and not to satisfy the Chapter 8 record-keeping requirements.

tc.q: 第6.16段所規定篩查機制的明訂目的為何？
options: 避免與制裁名單所列的嫌疑人及受制裁人士建立關係或向其提供服務
符合《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2條所施加的客戶盡職審查規定
按第2章的風險為本方式評估並釐定客戶的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評級
符合第8章及附表2第20條就電傳轉帳訂明的備存紀錄規定
tc.explain: 第6.16段訂明篩查機制旨在避免與聯合國決議及制裁名單所列的任何恐怖分子嫌疑人及可能受制裁人士建立業務關係，或向其提供任何金融服務。並非符合第4章附表2的客戶盡職審查規定，也不是按第2章風險為本方式評估洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評級，更不是符合第8章的備存紀錄規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.6段與第6.8段的比較

en.q: Which examples does the Guideline give of payments the Secretary for Security may licence under the UNATMO?
options: Reasonable living or legal expenses, and Employment Ordinance payments
Payments of dividends and interest declared to the company's shareholders
Payments made for charitable donations and religious or community purposes
Payments of outstanding taxes and government licensing or registration fees
en.explain: ¶6.6 states that the S for S can licence exceptions to the UNATMO prohibitions, giving as examples reasonable living or legal expenses and payments liable to be made under the Employment Ordinance. The Guideline does not cite dividend or interest payments, charitable or religious payments, or tax and government fee payments as examples.

tc.q: 本指引就保安局局長根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》可許可的付款，舉出哪些例子？
options: 合理生活／法律開支及《僱傭條例》下的付款
向該公司的股東宣派及派付的股息及利息款項
為慈善捐款及宗教或社區用途而作出的各項付款
繳付未清繳的稅款及政府牌照或註冊費用的款項
tc.explain: 第6.6段訂明保安局局長可就有關禁制發出許可，並以合理生活／法律開支，以及根據《僱傭條例》須支付的款項為例。本指引並未以股息利息付款、慈善或宗教用途付款，或稅款及政府費用付款為例。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: Under which part of the UN Charter are the resolutions imposing mandatory PF obligations on member states made?
options: Chapter VII
Chapter VI
Chapter V
Chapter IX
en.explain: ¶6.9 states that to combat PF the UNSC adopts a two-tiered approach through resolutions made under Chapter VII of the UN Charter, imposing mandatory obligations on UN member states — not Chapter VI, Chapter VIII, or Chapter IX, which are other chapters of the same Charter.

tc.q: 對成員國施加強制性擴散資金籌集責任的決議，是根據《聯合國憲章》哪一章作出？
options: 第七章
第六章
第八章
第九章
tc.explain: 第6.9段訂明為打擊擴散資金籌集，聯合國安全理事會透過根據《聯合國憲章》第七章作出、對聯合國成員國施加強制責任的決議，採取雙層方針——並非同一憲章下的第六章、第八章或第九章。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.18段

en.q: In what form must records of screening and enhanced checking be kept?
options: They should be documented, or recorded electronically
They must be kept in hard copy only
They must be kept on the third party's system
No records are required once a match is cleared
en.explain: ¶6.18 states that records of enhanced checking results, together with all screening records, should be documented, or recorded electronically. The obligation covers all screening records, not merely those that produced a genuine hit.

tc.q: 篩查及加強查核的紀錄須以何種形式保存？
options: 應以書面或電子方式記錄
只可以印本形式保存
須存放於第三方供應商的系統
一旦排除配對即無須保存紀錄
tc.explain: 第6.18段訂明加強查核結果的紀錄連同所有篩查紀錄，均應以書面或電子方式記錄。該項責任涵蓋所有篩查紀錄，而不限於產生真正命中的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.1段

en.q: How is a wire transfer defined for the purposes of section 12 of Schedule 2?
options: An electronic transaction for an originator, making money available at a beneficiary institution
Any transfer of money between two authorized institutions located in different jurisdictions, by any means
Any single electronic payment of an amount equal to or above $8,000 made through an ATM
Any transfer of money carried out otherwise than by cash, cheque or a bank draft instrument
en.explain: ¶10.1 defines a wire transfer as a transaction carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator by electronic means with a view to making an amount of money available to that person or another person at a beneficiary institution, whether or not intermediary institutions participate. It is not simply any interbank transfer across jurisdictions, is not defined by the $8,000 threshold (that triggers information requirements under ¶10.5, not the definition), and is not any non-cash transfer generally.

tc.q: 就附表2第12條而言，「電傳轉帳」如何界定？
options: 以電子方式為匯款人進行、使款項於收款機構可予取用的交易
在位於不同司法管轄區的兩家認可機構之間、以任何方式進行的款項轉移
透過自動櫃員機進行的單一相等於或高於8,000元的電子付款
以現金、支票或銀行匯票以外方式進行的款項轉移
tc.explain: 第10.1段界定電傳轉帳為：由某機構（匯款機構）代匯款人以電子方式進行的交易，目的是使某筆款項可由該人或另一人在某機構（收款機構）取得，不論有否中介機構參與。並非泛指跨司法管轄區的機構間轉帳，也非以8,000元為定義門檻（該門檻觸發的是第10.5段的資料規定，並非定義本身），更非泛指現金、支票或匯票以外的轉帳。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.1段註腳67

en.q: What example does the Guideline give of a wire transfer in which the beneficiary institution is the ordering institution?
options: A wire transfer conducted between branches of the same MSO
A wire transfer between an MSO and its correspondent bank
A wire transfer between two customers of the same MSO
A wire transfer returned to the originator on rejection
en.explain: Footnote 67 to ¶10.1 gives, as an example of a wire transfer where the beneficiary institution may be the ordering institution itself, a wire transfer conducted between branches of the same MSO.

tc.q: 本指引就收款機構同時是匯款機構的電傳轉帳，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 在同一金錢服務經營者的分行之間進行的電傳轉帳
金錢服務經營者與其代理銀行之間的電傳轉帳
同一金錢服務經營者的兩名客戶之間的電傳轉帳
被拒後退回匯款人的電傳轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.1段註腳67就收款機構可以是匯款機構本身的電傳轉帳舉例：在同一金錢服務經營者的分行之間進行的電傳轉帳。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.2段

en.q: What is the position where an MSO is itself the originator or the recipient of a wire transfer?
options: It is not an ordering, intermediary or beneficiary institution, so section 12 does not apply
It must still comply with all Chapter 10 requirements as though it were itself the ordering institution
It need only comply with the general record-keeping requirements set out in Chapter 8
It must first obtain the CCE's written approval before carrying out that transfer
en.explain: ¶10.2 states that where an MSO is the originator or recipient of a wire transfer, it is not acting as an ordering institution, an intermediary institution or a beneficiary institution, and thus is not required to comply with the requirements under section 12 of Schedule 2 or Chapter 10 in respect of that transaction. It does not still have to comply as though it were the ordering institution, is not limited merely to Chapter 8 record-keeping, and does not need the CCE's prior approval.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者本身是電傳轉帳的匯款人或收款人，情況如何？
options: 並非匯款、中介或收款機構，故附表2第12條不適用
仍須猶如其本身是匯款機構一樣，遵從第10章的所有規定
只須遵從第8章所訂明的一般備存紀錄規定即可
須先取得關長的書面批准，方可進行該宗轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.2段訂明，如該經營者是電傳轉帳的匯款人或收款人，即並非以匯款機構、中介機構或收款機構的身分行事，故就該宗交易無須遵從附表2第12條或第10章的規定。並非仍須猶如匯款機構般遵從第10章規定，也不是只須遵從第8章的備存紀錄規定，更毋須先取得關長批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.3段

en.q: Do the wire transfer requirements apply to transfers using a cover payment mechanism, such as MT202COV payments?
options: Yes — section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10 both apply to cover payment transfers too
No — cover payments are excluded because they are transfers between institutions only
Only where the underlying transfer equals or exceeds $120,000 in value
Only where at least one intermediary institution is involved in the chain
en.explain: ¶10.3 states that the requirements set out in section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10 are also applicable to wire transfers using a cover payment mechanism, giving MT202COV payments as the example. They are not excluded as inter-institution transfers, are not conditional on a $120,000 threshold (that is the separate general occasional-transaction/cash threshold used elsewhere in the Guideline, not the Chapter 10 figure), and do not depend on an intermediary institution being involved.

tc.q: 電傳轉帳的規定是否適用於使用補足付款機制（例如MT202COV付款）的轉帳？
options: 適用——附表2第12條及第10章同樣適用於補足付款轉帳
不適用——補足付款純屬機構之間的轉帳而獲豁除
只在相關轉帳的款額相等於或超過120,000元時適用
只在轉帳鏈中涉及最少一間中介機構時適用
tc.explain: 第10.3段訂明附表2第12條及第10章所載的規定，同樣適用於使用補足付款機制（例如MT202COV付款）的電傳轉帳。並非因屬機構間轉帳而獲豁除，也非以120,000元為適用門檻（該款額是本指引其他地方所用的一般非經常交易／現金門檻，並非第10章的款額），更不取決於是否涉及中介機構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.3段註腳68

en.q: Which two publications does the Guideline direct MSOs to on cover payment messages?
options: The Basel Committee's May 2009 paper on cover payment messages, and the HKMA's February 2010 guidance paper
The FATF Recommendations, and the advisory circulars issued by the CCE from time to time
The relevant UNSCRs promulgated by the UNSC, and the lists published by the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The WMD(CPS)O and the UNATMO, and their respective subsidiary regulations
en.explain: Footnote 68 to ¶10.3 states that reference should be made to the paper on due diligence and transparency regarding cover payment messages published by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision in May 2009, and the guidance paper on cover payment messages issued by the HKMA in February 2010. It does not direct MSOs to the FATF Recommendations or CCE circulars, to UNSC resolutions or CEDB lists, or to the sanctions ordinances themselves, none of which this footnote cites.

tc.q: 本指引就補足付款訊息指引金錢服務經營者參考哪兩份刊物？
options: 巴塞爾銀行監管委員會2009年5月的補足付款訊息文件，以及金融管理局2010年2月的指導文件
財務行動特別組織的建議，以及關長不時發出的通函
聯合國安理會公布的相關決議，以及商務及經濟發展局刊登的名單
《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，以及兩者的附屬規例
tc.explain: 第10.3段註腳68訂明應參考巴塞爾銀行監管委員會於2009年5月發表有關補足付款訊息的盡職審查及透明度文件，以及金融管理局於2010年2月發出的指導文件。該註腳並無指引經營者參考財務行動特別組織的建議或關長通函、聯合國安理會決議或商務及經濟發展局的名單，或兩套制裁條例本身。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.4(a)及(b)段

en.q: On what condition are wire transfers between an MSO and an FI, or between an MSO and a foreign institution, excluded from section 12 of Schedule 2?
options: If each of them acts on its own behalf
If the transfer is below $8,000
If the transfer is a domestic wire transfer
If both are supervised by the same regulator
en.explain: ¶10.4(a) and (b) exclude from section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10 a wire transfer between an MSO and an FI as defined in the AMLO, and a wire transfer between an MSO and a foreign institution, in each case if each of them acts on its own behalf. Where either acts for a customer, the exclusion does not apply.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者與金融機構之間，或與外地機構之間的電傳轉帳，在甚麼條件下獲豁除於附表2第12條之外？
options: 各方均為其本身行事
該轉帳低於8,000元
該轉帳屬本地電傳轉帳
雙方由同一監管機構監管
tc.explain: 第10.4(a)及(b)款將以下電傳轉帳豁除於附表2第12條及第10章之外：金錢服務經營者與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構之間的電傳轉帳，以及金錢服務經營者與外地機構之間的電傳轉帳——兩者均須各方為其本身行事。如任何一方是代客戶行事，則該豁除並不適用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.4段註腳69

en.q: How is a foreign institution defined for the purposes of section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10?
options: An institution outside Hong Kong carrying on a business similar to an FI under the AMLO
Any institution incorporated or registered outside Hong Kong, whatever business it carries on
Any institution licensed by a financial regulator in an equivalent overseas jurisdiction
Any institution that is a member of a banking group headquartered outside Hong Kong
en.explain: Footnote 69 to ¶10.4 states that for the purpose of section 12 of Schedule 2 and Chapter 10, 'foreign institution' means an institution that is located in a place outside Hong Kong and that carries on a business similar to that carried on by an FI as defined in the AMLO. Mere overseas incorporation, overseas licensing, or overseas group membership alone are not the statutory test — the business-similarity requirement is.

tc.q: 就附表2第12條及第10章而言，「外地機構」如何界定？
options: 位於香港以外、經營與《打擊洗錢條例》金融機構類似業務者
任何在香港以外地方註冊成立或登記的機構，不論其經營何種業務
任何獲同等海外司法管轄區的金融監管機構發牌的機構
任何屬總部設於香港以外地方的銀行集團成員的機構
tc.explain: 第10.4段註腳69訂明就附表2第12條及第10章而言，「外地機構」指位於香港以外地方，並經營與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構所經營者類似業務的機構。單純在海外註冊、獲海外發牌，或屬海外銀行集團成員，均非法定準則——業務類似的規定方是。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.4(c)段

en.q: Which three conditions must all be met for a card-related transaction to fall outside the wire transfer requirements?
options: A card transaction; no person-to-person transfer; and the card number is in the accompanying message
The card was issued in Hong Kong; the transaction is below $8,000; and the cardholder is also the originator
The card is a credit card only; the merchant is located in Hong Kong; and payment is in Hong Kong dollars
The card is used at an ATM; the transaction is a cash withdrawal; and the account is held with the MSO itself
en.explain: ¶10.4(c) excludes a wire transfer only where all three conditions are met: it arises from a transaction carried out using a credit, debit or prepaid card (such as an ATM withdrawal, a cash advance, or a purchase); the card is not used as a payment system to effect a person-to-person transfer; and the card number or equivalent unique identifier is included in the accompanying message or payment form. Where the card was issued, the transaction value, and the merchant's location are not among the three conditions.

tc.q: 與卡有關的交易須同時符合哪三項條件，方可豁除於電傳轉帳規定之外？
options: 卡交易；該卡並非用作人對人轉帳；以及卡號載於伴隨訊息內
該卡在香港發出；交易金額低於8,000元；以及持卡人同時是匯款人
該卡僅限信用卡；商戶位於香港；以及以港元付款
該卡於自動櫃員機使用；交易屬提取現金；以及帳戶在該經營者處開立
tc.explain: 第10.4(c)款訂明僅在同時符合以下三項條件時，方獲豁除：源自使用信用卡、扣賬卡或預付卡進行的交易（例如自動櫃員機提款、現金透支或購物）；該卡並非用作人對人轉帳的付款系統；以及卡號或等同識別編號已載於伴隨的訊息或付款表格內。發卡地點、交易金額及商戶所在地均非該三項條件之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5段

en.q: Which piece of originator information is required for a wire transfer of $8,000 or above but NOT for one below that amount?
options: The originator's address, customer ID or ID-document number, or date and place of birth
The originator's name, exactly as recorded when the account relationship was first established
The number of the originator's account with the ordering institution, or a unique reference number it assigns
The recipient's name, exactly as recorded in the beneficiary institution's account records
en.explain: ¶10.5 requires five items for a transfer of $8,000 or above: name, account/reference number, address/customer ID/ID document number or (for an individual) date and place of birth, recipient's name, and recipient's account/reference number. ¶10.6 requires only four for transfers below $8,000, omitting the address/ID/date-of-birth item. The name, account/reference number, and recipient's name items remain required at both tiers under ¶10.5 and ¶10.6 alike, so they are not items required only at $8,000 or above.

tc.q: 哪一項匯款人資料是8,000元或以上的電傳轉帳所需，但低於該款額的電傳轉帳則不需？
options: 匯款人的地址、客戶識別編號或身分證明文件號碼，或出生日期地點
匯款人的姓名，須與建立帳戶關係時所記錄者完全相符
匯款人在匯款機構開立的帳戶號碼，或由匯款機構編配的獨有參考編號
收款人的姓名，須與收款機構帳戶紀錄所載者完全相符
tc.explain: 第10.5段就8,000元或以上的電傳轉帳規定五項資料：姓名、帳戶／參考編號、地址／客戶識別編號／身分證明文件號碼或（如屬個人）出生日期及地點、收款人姓名，以及收款人帳戶／參考編號。第10.6段就低於8,000元的轉帳只規定四項，豁除地址／識別編號／出生日期一項。姓名、帳戶／參考編號及收款人姓名三項在第10.5及10.6段所訂兩個款額層級均須提供，故並非只在8,000元或以上方須提供的項目。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5(b)段

en.q: What must accompany a wire transfer where the originator has no account with the ordering institution?
options: A unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution
The originator's identity card number in place of an account number
The account number of the ordering institution itself
Nothing — the account number field may be left blank
en.explain: ¶10.5(b) requires the number of the originator's account maintained with the ordering institution and from which the money for the wire transfer is paid or, in the absence of such an account, a unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution. ¶10.7 adds that the number should permit traceability of the wire transfer.

tc.q: 如匯款人在匯款機構並無帳戶，電傳轉帳須附有甚麼？
options: 由匯款機構編配的獨有參考編號
以匯款人的身分證號碼代替帳戶號碼
匯款機構本身的帳戶號碼
無須任何資料——帳戶號碼一欄可留空
tc.explain: 第10.5(b)款規定須附有匯款人在匯款機構開立、並從中支付該電傳轉帳款項的帳戶的號碼；如並無該等帳戶，則須附有由匯款機構編配的獨有參考編號。第10.7段補充該編號應能追查該宗電傳轉帳。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.7段

en.q: What must the unique reference number assigned by an ordering or beneficiary institution permit?
options: Traceability of the wire transfer
Identification of the currency of the transfer
Calculation of the fee charged
Reconciliation of the institution's daily settlement
en.explain: ¶10.7 states that the unique reference number assigned by the ordering institution or beneficiary institution referred to in ¶10.5 and ¶10.6 should permit traceability of the wire transfer — which is the purpose the number serves in place of an account number.

tc.q: 由匯款機構或收款機構編配的獨有參考編號須能達到甚麼？
options: 追查該宗電傳轉帳
識別該轉帳的貨幣
計算所收取的費用
核對該機構的每日結算
tc.explain: 第10.7段訂明第10.5及10.6段所指由匯款機構或收款機構編配的獨有參考編號，應能追查該宗電傳轉帳——這正是該編號在沒有帳戶號碼時所發揮的作用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.5段註腳70

en.q: What must a customer identification number refer to, if it is used in place of the originator's address?
options: An originating-institution record with the address, ID number, or date and place of birth
A record held by the beneficiary institution containing the recipient's full contact details
The customer's bank statement or account records for the preceding twelve months
A record held centrally by the CCE for all registered money service operators
en.explain: Footnote 70 to ¶10.5 states that the customer identification number uniquely identifies the originator to the originating institution and is different from the unique transaction reference number in ¶10.7, and that it must refer to a record held by the originating institution containing at least one of: the customer address, the identification document number, or the date and place of birth. It is not a beneficiary-institution record, not a twelve-month statement, and not a record held centrally by the CCE.

tc.q: 如以客戶識別編號代替匯款人的地址，該編號須指向甚麼？
options: 匯款機構載有地址、文件號碼或出生日期地點的紀錄
由收款機構持有並載有該收款人完整聯絡詳情的紀錄
該客戶在過去十二個月內的銀行結單或帳戶紀錄
由關長就所有已登記的金錢服務經營者中央持有的紀錄
tc.explain: 第10.5段註腳70訂明客戶識別編號指可令匯款機構獨有地識別該匯款人的編號，並有別於第10.7段所指的獨有交易參考編號；該編號必須指向匯款機構所持有的紀錄，而該紀錄至少須載有以下其中一項：客戶地址、身分證明文件號碼，或出生日期及地點。並非收款機構所持有的紀錄，也不是十二個月結單，更不是由關長中央持有的紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.8段

en.q: What additional quality requirement applies to originator information accompanying a wire transfer of $8,000 or above?
options: The ordering institution must ensure required originator information is accurate
The information must additionally be certified in writing by the originator personally
The information must be officially translated into English before transmission
The information must be independently verified against a government database
en.explain: ¶10.8 states that for a wire transfer of an amount equal to or above $8,000, an ordering institution must ensure that the required originator information accompanying the wire transfer is accurate. It does not additionally require the originator's own written certification, official English translation, or independent verification against a government database.

tc.q: 就8,000元或以上的電傳轉帳，伴隨的匯款人資料另有何素質要求？
options: 匯款機構須確保所需的匯款人資料屬準確
該等資料另須由匯款人親自以書面核證
該等資料須於傳送前正式翻譯為英文
該等資料須獨立地與政府資料庫核對
tc.explain: 第10.8段訂明就款額相等於或高於8,000元的電傳轉帳，匯款機構須確保伴隨該電傳轉帳的所需匯款人資料屬準確。並非另須由匯款人親自書面核證，也不是須正式翻譯為英文，更不是須與政府資料庫獨立核對。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.9段

en.q: Must an ordering institution verify the originator's identity for an occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or above?
options: Yes — for such a transfer the ordering institution must verify the originator's identity
No — for an occasional wire transfer, identity verification only ever applies to standing business relationships
Only where the $8,000 occasional transfer is to a recipient who is not physically present
Only where the occasional wire transfer of $8,000 or above is also cross-border or cross-boundary
en.explain: ¶10.9 states that for an occasional wire transfer involving an amount equal to or above $8,000, an ordering institution must verify the identity of the originator. The duty is triggered by the $8,000 threshold itself, not confined to standing business relationships, not conditional on the recipient's physical absence, and not conditional on the transfer being cross-border.

tc.q: 就8,000元或以上的非經常電傳轉帳，匯款機構是否須核實匯款人的身分？
options: 須要——就該等轉帳，匯款機構須核實匯款人的身分
不須要——就非經常電傳轉帳，核實身分的規定只適用於持續業務關係
只在該8,000元的非經常轉帳的收款人並非親身在場時方須
只在該8,000元或以上的非經常電傳轉帳同時屬跨境或跨界時方須
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明就涉及款額相等於或高於8,000元的非經常電傳轉帳，匯款機構須核實匯款人的身分。有關責任由8,000元的門檻本身觸發，並非只適用於持續業務關係，也非以收款人不在場為條件，更非以轉帳屬跨境為條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.9段

en.q: In which two situations must an ordering institution verify the originator's identity even for an occasional wire transfer below $8,000?
options: Where several apparently linked transactions total $8,000 or more, or ML/TF is suspected
Where several apparently linked transactions total $120,000 or more, or where the transfer is cross-border
Where the originator holds no account with the ordering institution, or where the recipient is overseas
Where the transfer is denominated in a foreign currency, or where the originator pays in cash
en.explain: ¶10.9 states that for an occasional wire transfer below $8,000, the ordering institution is in general not required to verify the originator's identity, except when several transactions are carried out which appear to the ordering institution to be linked and are equal to or above $8,000, or when there is a suspicion of ML/TF. The linked-transaction threshold is $8,000, not $120,000; and the exception does not turn on the transfer being cross-border, on there being no account, on the recipient being overseas, on a foreign currency, or on payment in cash.

tc.q: 即使非經常電傳轉帳低於8,000元，匯款機構在哪兩種情況下仍須核實匯款人身分？
options: 多宗有關連交易合計達8,000元或以上；或懷疑洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集
多宗表面上有關連的交易合計達120,000元或以上；或該轉帳屬跨境轉帳
該匯款人在匯款機構並無開立帳戶；或該收款人身處香港以外地方
該宗轉帳以港元以外的貨幣計值；或該匯款人以現金支付
tc.explain: 第10.9段訂明就低於8,000元的非經常電傳轉帳，匯款機構一般無須核實匯款人的身分，但如進行多宗在匯款機構看來屬有關連且合計相等於或高於8,000元的交易，或有洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑，則屬例外。關連交易的門檻是8,000元，並非120,000元；例外情況亦不取決於轉帳是否跨境、有否帳戶、收款人是否在海外、是否以外幣計值或是否以現金支付。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.10段

en.q: What may an ordering institution include in the individual wire transfers within a batch file to recipients outside Hong Kong, and what must the batch file itself contain?
options: Only the originator's account/reference number per transfer; the batch file must hold full traceable originator and recipient information
Only the originator's account number, exactly as permitted for a purely domestic wire transfer, with no separate batch file requirement at all
The complete originator information in every individual transfer, so no batch file traceability requirement applies
Nothing at all in the individual transfer, provided complete information is supplied within 3 business days of any request
en.explain: ¶10.10 states that an ordering institution may bundle wire transfers into a batch file for recipients outside Hong Kong, and may include only the originator's account number or a unique reference number in each individual transfer, but the batch file itself should contain required and accurate originator information and required recipient information that is fully traceable within the recipient country. This is distinct from the domestic-transfer rule in ¶10.11 (no batch-file content requirement) and the 3-business-day disclosure rule in ¶10.12 (which applies to domestic transfers lacking complete information, not to batch files).

tc.q: 就傳送至香港以外收款人的批次檔案，匯款機構可在個別電傳轉帳中只載列甚麼？該批次檔案本身須載有甚麼？
options: 個別電傳轉帳可只載列匯款人的帳戶號碼或參考編號；批次檔案本身須載有完整而準確、在收款國家可追查的匯款人及收款人資料
可只載列匯款人的帳戶號碼，猶如純粹本地電傳轉帳一樣，完全無須另設批次檔案規定
每宗個別電傳轉帳均須載列完整的匯款人資料，故批次檔案毋須符合可追查規定
個別電傳轉帳無須載列任何資料，只要在任何要求提出後3個營業日內提供完整資料
tc.explain: 第10.10段訂明匯款機構可將電傳轉帳合併為批次檔案，傳送予身處香港以外的收款人，並可在個別電傳轉帳中只載列匯款人的帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號，但該批次檔案本身應載有所需而準確的匯款人資料及所需的收款人資料，並須在收款國家可完全追查。這有別於第10.11段的本地轉帳規定（並無批次檔案內容規定）及第10.12段的3個營業日披露規定（適用於欠缺完整資料的本地轉帳，並非批次檔案）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.11段註腳71

en.q: How is a domestic wire transfer defined?
options: The ordering, beneficiary and intermediary institutions involved are all Hong Kong-located FIs under the AMLO
A wire transfer between an MSO and an FI as defined in the AMLO, where each institution acts on its own behalf
A wire transfer between an MSO and a foreign institution located outside Hong Kong, where each acts on its own behalf
A wire transfer where the originator and recipient, rather than their institutions, are both Hong Kong residents
en.explain: Footnote 71 to ¶10.11 defines a domestic wire transfer as one where the ordering institution, the beneficiary institution and any intermediary institution(s) involved are all FIs as defined in the AMLO located in Hong Kong. The second and third options describe the separate ¶10.4(a) and (b) exclusions that take a transfer out of Chapter 10 altogether, not the domestic-transfer definition; the fourth wrongly tests the residency of the customers rather than the location of their institutions.

tc.q: 「本地電傳轉帳」如何界定？
options: 匯款機構、收款機構及任何中介機構，均為位於香港、《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構
金錢服務經營者與《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構之間，且各自代表本身行事的電傳轉帳
金錢服務經營者與位於香港以外地方的外地機構之間，且各自代表本身行事的電傳轉帳
轉帳所涉的匯款人及收款人（而非其所屬機構）均為香港居民的電傳轉帳
tc.explain: 第10.11段註腳71界定本地電傳轉帳，指匯款機構、收款機構，以及任何有參與的中介機構，均為位於香港、《打擊洗錢條例》所界定金融機構的電傳轉帳。第二及第三個選項所述的分別是第10.4(a)及(b)款另行訂明、令第10章完全不適用的豁除情況，並非本地轉帳的定義；第四個選項則錯誤地以客戶的居民身分、而非其所屬機構的所在地作為判斷標準。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.11段

en.q: What concession applies to an ordering institution in respect of a domestic wire transfer?
options: It may include only the account number, or a unique reference number, instead of full originator information
It may omit the originator's information entirely, provided the beneficiary institution consents in writing
It need not include any recipient information, even though full originator information is still required
It need not verify the originator's identity for any domestic wire transfer, no matter the amount
en.explain: ¶10.11 states that for a domestic wire transfer an ordering institution may choose not to include the complete required originator information but only the originator's account number or, absent an account, a unique reference number that permits traceability. There is no beneficiary-consent route to omit originator information altogether; recipient information is always required by ¶10.5/10.6, not the information this concession touches; and the separate identity-verification duty in ¶10.9 still turns on the $8,000 threshold, unaffected by this concession.

tc.q: 就本地電傳轉帳，匯款機構獲甚麼寬免？
options: 可只加入帳戶號碼或獨有參考編號，以代替完整匯款人資料
可完全不加入任何匯款人資料，但須事先取得收款機構書面同意方可
無須加入任何收款人姓名或帳戶資料，即使仍須加入完整匯款人資料
不論轉帳款額多少，本地電傳轉帳均一律無須核實匯款人的身分
tc.explain: 第10.11段訂明就本地電傳轉帳，匯款機構可選擇不載列完整的所需匯款人資料，而只載列帳戶號碼，或（如無帳戶）能追查該轉帳的獨有參考編號。並無規定容許經收款機構書面同意而完全不載列匯款人資料；收款人資料按第10.5／10.6段一律須載列，並非本項寬免所涉及的資料；而第10.9段就核實身分的獨立規定仍按8,000元門檻適用，不受本項寬免影響。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.12段

en.q: Within what period must an ordering institution that used the ¶10.11 concession supply complete originator information on request, and to whom?
options: Within 3 business days after the request, to the receiving institution or the CCE
Within 7 business days after the request, to the beneficiary institution only
Within 30 calendar days after the request, to the CCE only
Immediately upon request, but only if the request comes from a law enforcement agency
en.explain: ¶10.12 requires an ordering institution that relied on the ¶10.11 concession to provide complete originator information within 3 business days after receiving a request from the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction, or from the CCE — not 7 or 30 days, and not confined to the beneficiary institution or the CCE alone. Immediate provision on request is reserved for law enforcement agencies under the same paragraph, not for an institution/CCE request.

tc.q: 採用第10.11段寬免的匯款機構，須在多久內、應何人要求提供完整的匯款人資料？
options: 在接獲要求後3個營業日內，應接收機構或海關關長要求提供
在接獲要求後7個營業日內，只應收款機構的要求提供有關資料
在接獲要求後30個曆日內，只應海關關長的要求提供有關資料
須即時提供有關資料，但只限要求來自執法機構的情況下才適用
tc.explain: 第10.12段規定，匯款機構如採用第10.11段的寬免，須應接收其轉帳指示的機構或海關關長的要求，在收到要求後3個營業日內（而非7日或30日）提供完整的匯款人資料，並非只限收款機構或只限海關關長提出要求。至於須即時提供，則只適用於同段所指執法機構提出要求的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.12段

en.q: How quickly must such originator information be made available to law enforcement agencies?
options: Immediately upon request
Within 3 business days, as for other requests
Within 7 days of a written request
Only upon production of a court order
en.explain: ¶10.12 states that in addition to the 3-business-day period applying to a request from the institution receiving the transfer instruction or the CCE, such information should be made available to law enforcement agencies immediately upon request.

tc.q: 該等匯款人資料須多快提供予執法機關？
options: 應要求即時提供
一如其他要求，於3個營業日內提供
於書面要求後7日內提供
須出示法院命令方須提供
tc.explain: 第10.12段訂明，除適用於接收轉帳指示的機構或海關關長的3個營業日期限外，該等資料應應執法機關的要求即時提供。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.13(a)段

en.q: What example does the Guideline give of reasonable measures an ordering institution should take to identify outgoing transfers lacking required information?
options: Regular review or testing by the internal control or audit function to assess system capabilities
Post-event monitoring of completed transfers, the example given for beneficiary institutions
Measures consistent with straight-through processing, the standard set for intermediary institutions
Having risk-based policies and procedures for handling deficient transfers, a separate requirement in the same paragraph
en.explain: ¶10.13(a) gives regular review or testing by the internal control or audit function, to assess system capabilities, as the example for identifying deficient outgoing transfers. Post-event monitoring is instead the example ¶10.19(a) gives for beneficiary institutions, and straight-through-processing-consistent measures are what ¶10.16(a) requires of intermediary institutions; having risk-based policies is the separate limb at ¶10.13(b), not the identification example.

tc.q: 本指引就匯款機構識別欠缺所需資料的匯出轉帳，舉出哪一項合理措施的例子？
options: 由內部監控或審計職能定期檢視或測試，以評估系統能力
對已完成的轉帳進行事後監察，即收款機構所適用的例子
採取與直通式處理相符的措施，即中介機構所適用的標準
設有風險為本政策及程序以處理資料不足的轉帳，屬同段另一款的規定
tc.explain: 第10.13(a)款舉出的例子為：由內部監控或審計職能定期檢視或測試，以評估系統能力。事後監察是第10.19(a)款就收款機構所舉的例子；與直通式處理相符的措施則是第10.16(a)款對中介機構的規定；設有風險為本政策及程序是同段第10.13(b)款的另一項獨立規定，並非識別措施的例子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.13(b)段

en.q: Besides risk-based policies for handling deficient wire transfers, what further step does ¶10.13(b) require of an ordering institution?
options: Timely rectifying any control deficiencies identified
Reporting each deficient wire transfer to the JFIU within 3 business days
Notifying the CCE of each control deficiency within 7 days of discovery
Suspending the affected payment channel until a full system audit is completed
en.explain: ¶10.13(b) requires an ordering institution to have risk-based policies for handling wire transfers lacking required information, and to timely rectify any control deficiencies identified — it imposes no JFIU reporting duty, no fixed CCE notification deadline, and no automatic channel suspension pending audit.

tc.q: 除就資料不足的電傳轉帳訂立風險為本政策外，第10.13(b)款還要求匯款機構作甚麼？
options: 須適時糾正所識別的任何管控缺失，並防止再次發生
須在3個營業日內向聯合財富情報組報告每宗資料不足的轉帳
須在發現後7日內將每項管控缺失正式通知海關關長
須暫停受影響的付款渠道，直至完成全面的系統審計
tc.explain: 第10.13(b)款規定匯款機構須適時糾正所識別的任何管控缺失，並無規定須向聯合財富情報組報告、須在指定日數內通知海關關長，或須暫停付款渠道待審計完成。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.14段

en.q: What is the core duty of an intermediary institution under section 12(8) of Schedule 2?
options: To keep all originator and recipient information with the transfer and pass it to the next institution in the chain
To verify the identity of the originator before passing on the transfer, as an ordering institution must
To keep a record for five years, but only when technical limitations prevent information remaining attached
To obtain missing originator or recipient information from the institution that gave it the transfer instruction
en.explain: ¶10.14 requires an intermediary institution to ensure that all originator and recipient information accompanying the wire transfer is retained with it and transmitted to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction. Verifying the originator's identity is an ordering institution's duty under ¶10.9; the five-year record duty applies only in the technical-limitation situation covered by ¶10.15; and obtaining missing information from the instructing institution is the separate duty at ¶10.17, not the general ¶10.14 duty.

tc.q: 根據附表2第12(8)條，中介機構的核心責任為何？
options: 確保匯款人及收款人資料隨轉帳保留，並傳送予下一接收機構
在轉遞該轉帳前核實匯款人的身分，此為匯款機構的責任
僅在技術限制令資料無法隨轉帳保留時，將資料保存五年
向發出轉帳指示予它的機構，取得欠缺的匯款人或收款人資料
tc.explain: 第10.14段規定中介機構須確保伴隨電傳轉帳的所有匯款人及收款人資料，均隨該轉帳保留，並傳送予接收其轉帳指示的機構。核實匯款人身分是第10.9段匯款機構的責任；五年紀錄的規定只適用於第10.15段所述的技術限制情況；而向發出轉帳指示的機構取得欠缺資料，則是第10.17段的另一項獨立責任，並非第10.14段的一般責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.15段

en.q: What must an intermediary institution do where technical limitations prevent the required information accompanying a cross-border wire transfer from remaining with a related domestic wire transfer?
options: Keep a five-year record of all information received from the ordering or another intermediary institution
Reject the transfer outright and return the funds to the ordering institution the same day
Report the technical limitation to the CCE in writing within 3 business days of discovery
Convert the domestic wire transfer's classification into a cross-border wire transfer for record-keeping instead
en.explain: ¶10.15 requires the intermediary institution to keep a record, for at least five years, of all the information received from the ordering institution or another intermediary institution — it does not have to reject the transfer, and there is no duty to report the limitation to the CCE within 3 business days (that figure belongs to the unrelated ¶10.12 concession) or to convert the transfer's classification.

tc.q: 如技術限制令伴隨跨境電傳轉帳的所需資料無法隨相關的本地電傳轉帳保留，中介機構須怎樣做？
options: 須將從匯款機構或另一中介機構收到的資料存檔，最少五年
須直接拒絕該轉帳，並於當日將全部款項退回匯款機構
須在發現後3個營業日內以書面向海關關長報告該技術限制
為方便追查，須將該本地電傳轉帳重新分類為跨境電傳轉帳處理
tc.explain: 第10.15段規定中介機構須就從匯款機構或另一中介機構所收到的所有資料，保存紀錄最少五年；並無須拒絕該轉帳，亦無須在3個營業日內向海關關長報告該技術限制（3個營業日的期限屬另一項不相關的第10.12段寬免），也無須將轉帳的分類轉換。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.16(a)段

en.q: With what must an intermediary institution's measures for identifying deficient incoming cross-border transfers be consistent?
options: Straight-through processing
Post-event monitoring
Manual review of every transfer
The beneficiary institution's own procedures
en.explain: ¶10.16(a) requires an intermediary institution to take reasonable measures, which are consistent with straight-through processing, to identify cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required recipient information. By contrast ¶10.19(a) gives post-event monitoring as the example for a beneficiary institution.

tc.q: 中介機構識別資料不足的匯入跨境轉帳所採取的措施，須與甚麼一致？
options: 直通式處理
事後監察
對每宗轉帳作人手審核
收款機構本身的程序
tc.explain: 第10.16(a)款規定中介機構須採取與直通式處理一致的合理措施，以識別欠缺所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料的跨境電傳轉帳。相對而言，第10.19(a)款就收款機構所舉的例子則是事後監察。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.16(b)段

en.q: What two matters must an intermediary institution's risk-based policies and procedures determine?
options: When to execute, reject or suspend a deficient wire transfer, and the appropriate follow-up action
Whether the transfer is cross-border, and whether straight-through-processing-consistent measures were used
Whether to notify the originator and the recipient that the transfer has been delayed
Whether to restrict the relationship with that institution, and whether the missing information can be obtained
en.explain: ¶10.16(b) requires policies and procedures for determining when to execute, reject, or suspend a wire transfer lacking required originator or recipient information, and the appropriate follow-up action. Identifying cross-border transfers using straight-through-processing-consistent measures is instead ¶10.16(a)'s subject; notifying the customers is not mentioned; and restricting the relationship versus obtaining missing information describes the separate ¶10.17 follow-up duty, not the ¶10.16(b) policy content.

tc.q: 中介機構的風險為本政策及程序須就哪兩方面作出決定？
options: 何時執行、拒絕或暫停資料不足的電傳轉帳，以及適當的跟進行動
該宗轉帳是否屬於跨境轉帳，以及是否已採用與直通式處理相符的措施
是否須主動通知匯款人及收款人該宗轉帳已被延遲處理及原因
是否須限制或終止與該機構的關係，以及能否取得欠缺的資料
tc.explain: 第10.16(b)款規定須訂有政策及程序，以決定何時執行、拒絕或暫停欠缺所需匯款人或收款人資料的電傳轉帳，以及適當的跟進行動。以與直通式處理相符的措施識別跨境轉帳，是第10.16(a)款的內容；通知客戶並無提及；而限制關係或取得欠缺資料，則屬第10.17段另一項跟進責任，並非第10.16(b)款政策的內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第10.17段
