Safeguard all evidence; alert the JFIU by phone; freeze the customer's account; exit the business relationship
Screen new staff files; audit the branch accounts; file the inspection records; examine the AML/CFT Systems
en.explain: ¶7.11: the JFIU's “SAFE” approach comprises (a) Screening the account for suspicious indicators, (b) Asking the customer appropriate questions, (c) Finding out the customer's records, and (d) Evaluating all the above information — it is not a checklist for stopping/arresting, evidence-freezing, or staff/branch auditing.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組推廣以「SAFE」方法處理可能的可疑交易。四個步驟指甚麼？
options: 篩查戶口識別可疑指標；問客戶恰當問題；翻查客戶紀錄；評估以上資料
立即停止交易；拘捕任何嫌疑人；向警方提交報告；上報高級管理層
保存所有相關證據；致電通知聯合財富情報組；凍結客戶帳戶；終止業務關係
篩查新職員檔案；審計分行帳目；存檔巡查紀錄；檢查打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集系統
tc.explain: 第7.11段：聯合財富情報組推廣的「SAFE」方法包括：(a)篩查戶口識別可疑交易指標；(b)向客戶作出恰當提問；(c)翻查客戶的已知紀錄；及(d)根據以上資料作出評估——並非停止交易／拘捕、保存證據，或職員／分行審計的清單。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.13段

en.q: Which statement about internal suspicious transaction reporting lines is CORRECT?
options: Staff reports must never be filtered out by a supervisor with no responsibility for the ML reporting or compliance function
A branch manager may screen out reports they consider unfounded, provided the MLRO is informed of the decision within a reasonable time
Internal reports should pass through the branch manager, the compliance officer and the MLRO in turn, for quality control at each level
Staff should report suspicious transactions directly to the JFIU, with the MLRO informed only afterwards
en.explain: ¶7.13: under no circumstances should reports raised by staff be filtered out by supervisors or managers with no responsibility for the ML reporting/compliance function; reporting lines should be as short as possible. There is no exception for a manager who later informs the MLRO, no required three-tier review, and staff report to the MLRO, not directly to the JFIU.

tc.q: 關於內部可疑交易報告途徑，下列哪項正確？
options: 職員提出的報告，絕不可被無洗錢報告或合規職能的主管過濾篩走
分行經理可篩走其認為無根據的報告，惟須在合理時間內知會洗錢報告主任有關決定
內部報告須依次經分行經理、合規主任及洗錢報告主任三層審核，以進行質素管控
職員應將可疑交易直接向聯合財富情報組報告，並僅於事後知會洗錢報告主任
tc.explain: 第7.13段：在任何情況下，職員提出的報告均不得被並無洗錢報告／合規職能的主管或經理過濾篩走；報告途徑應盡量簡短。並無例外容許經理事後才知會洗錢報告主任，亦無規定須經三層審核；職員應向洗錢報告主任報告，而非直接向聯合財富情報組報告。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.14; s.25A(4) DTROP & OSCO, s.12(4) UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.14段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(4)條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(4)條

en.q: A front-line staff member reports a suspicion to the MLRO in accordance with the MSO's internal procedures. What is the staff member's remaining statutory reporting obligation?
options: None — once reported to the MLRO under the MSO's established procedures, the obligation is fully satisfied
The staff member must still personally file an STR with the JFIU before the MLRO completes any assessment
The staff member must formally remind the MLRO of the obligation not to tip off the customer
The staff member must obtain the customer's consent before the MLRO discloses the matter to the JFIU
en.explain: ¶7.14: once a staff member has reported the suspicion to the MLRO in accordance with the MSO's established policies and procedures, the staff member's statutory obligation has been fully satisfied. It is then for the MLRO to evaluate and decide whether to disclose to the JFIU (¶7.19), not the reporting staff member.

tc.q: 一名前線職員已按金錢服務經營者的內部程序向洗錢報告主任報告懷疑。該職員還有甚麼法定報告責任？
options: 沒有——按經營者既定程序向洗錢報告主任報告後，該項法定責任已完全履行
職員仍須在洗錢報告主任評估前，親自向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
職員須正式提醒洗錢報告主任不可作出通風報信
職員須在洗錢報告主任向聯合財富情報組披露事件前，取得客戶的書面同意
tc.explain: 第7.14段：職員按金錢服務經營者就作出報告而設的政策及程序，向洗錢報告主任報告懷疑後，其法定責任已獲完全履行。其後由洗錢報告主任評估並決定是否向聯合財富情報組披露（第7.19段），而非由報告的職員負責。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.20段

en.q: After reviewing an internal report and all available information, the MLRO concludes in good faith that there is no suspicion and decides not to file an STR. Which statement is CORRECT?
options: Criminal liability for failing to report is unlikely, but the MLRO must keep proper records of deliberations and actions
The MLRO is automatically criminally liable if the funds later prove to be criminal proceeds, regardless of good faith
The MLRO must file an STR for every internal report received, even where no suspicion is identified
The internal report may be discarded once the MLRO decides not to report, since only STRs actually filed need to be retained
en.explain: ¶7.20: provided the MLRO acts in good faith after considering all available information, criminal liability for failing to report is unlikely, but it is vital to keep proper records of the deliberations and actions taken to demonstrate reasonable conduct. ¶7.29 in fact requires a record of ALL internal reports, not just those resulting in an STR.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任覆核內部報告及一切可得資料後，真誠地認為並無懷疑，決定不向聯合財富情報組提交報告。下列哪項正確？
options: 未有報告不大可能構成刑事責任，但洗錢報告主任必須妥善備存其考量及所採取行動的紀錄
不論是否真誠行事，若資金其後證實屬犯罪得益，洗錢報告主任即自動負上刑責
即使並無識別到任何懷疑，洗錢報告主任仍須就每份內部報告向聯合財富情報組提交報告
洗錢報告主任決定不作報告後可銷毀該內部報告，因為備存紀錄的責任只適用於已提交的可疑交易報告
tc.explain: 第7.20段：只要洗錢報告主任在考慮一切可得資料後真誠地決定不提交報告，未有報告不大可能引致刑事責任，惟必須妥善備存考量及行動紀錄，以證明行事合理。事實上第7.29段要求備存所有內部報告的紀錄，並不僅限於其後有提交可疑交易報告的個案。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.21段

en.q: A customer under apparent law-enforcement investigation suddenly instructs the MSO to move all funds and close the account. How should urgent reporting be handled?
options: Indicate the urgency in the STR, and in exceptional cases consider notifying the JFIU by phone first
Wait and raise the matter in the JFIU's next quarterly report and feedback cycle instead
Complete the customer's instruction first, then file the STR within 30 days as for routine reports
Only report if the amount involved exceeds the $120,000 threshold that applies to occasional transactions generally
en.explain: ¶7.21: where urgent reporting is required (e.g. instructions to move funds, close the account, or make cash available, particularly where the account is part of an ongoing law-enforcement investigation), the MSO should indicate this in the STR and, in exceptional circumstances, consider an initial notification to the JFIU by telephone. There is no fixed reporting deadline and no monetary threshold for the reporting obligation itself (footnote 60).

tc.q: 一名顯然正受執法機構調查的客戶突然指示金錢服務經營者調走全部資金並結束帳戶。應如何處理緊急報告？
options: 在報告中表明情況緊急；如情況特殊，考慮先以電話通知聯合財富情報組
毋須即時處理，只須留待聯合財富情報組下一次季度報告的反饋週期一併提出
先完成客戶指示，再按一般報告方式於30日內提交可疑交易報告
只有金額超過一般非經常交易適用的120,000元門檻才須報告
tc.explain: 第7.21段：如須緊急報告（例如客戶指示調動資金、結束帳戶或提取現金，尤其帳戶涉及執法機構的調查），金錢服務經營者應在報告中表明；如情況特殊，應考慮先以電話向聯合財富情報組作初步通知。報告責任本身並無固定時限，亦不設款額門檻（註腳60）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶7.25; s.25A(2) DTROP & OSCO, s.12(2) UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.25段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(2)條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(2)條

en.q: Filing an STR provides an MSO with a statutory defence to ML/TF offences in respect of the disclosed acts, provided that:
options: Before the acts with the JFIU's consent; or after them, on the MSO's initiative as soon as reasonable
The report is filed within one year of the transaction, regardless of when the disclosed acts occurred
The customer must give written consent to the report before the MLRO files it with the JFIU
The transaction giving rise to the report falls below the $120,000 CDD threshold for occasional transactions
en.explain: ¶7.25: the statutory defence applies where (a) the report is made before the disclosed acts and the acts are undertaken with the JFIU's consent; or (b) the report is made after the acts, on the MSO's own initiative and as soon as it is reasonable. There is no one-year filing deadline, no customer-consent requirement, and no minimum-transaction-size exclusion — note the defence does not remove the legal, reputational or regulatory risks of continuing the account (¶7.26).

tc.q: 提交可疑交易報告可為金錢服務經營者就報告所披露的作為提供洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集罪行的法定免責辯護，條件是：
options: 作為前作出並經聯合財富情報組同意；或作為後由經營者主動盡快作出
不論所披露的作為何時發生，報告一律須於相關交易完成後一年內提交
客戶須在洗錢報告主任向聯合財富情報組提交報告之前，以書面表示同意
引致該報告的交易須低於120,000元的非經常交易客戶盡職審查門檻
tc.explain: 第7.25段：法定免責辯護的條件為：(a)報告在作出所披露作為之前作出，且該作為（交易）獲聯合財富情報組同意；或(b)報告在作為之後作出，由金錢服務經營者主動並在合理範圍內盡快作出。並無一年提交時限，亦無須客戶同意，更無最低交易金額的豁免——留意免責辯護不能消除繼續運作帳戶的法律、聲譽或監管風險（第7.26段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.26至7.27段

en.q: The JFIU gives “consent” in response to an MSO's pre-transaction STR. How should the MSO treat this consent?
options: Not a “clean bill of health” — the MSO must still review the relationship and apply risk-mitigating measures
As confirmation that the account poses no risk, based on the JFIU's quarterly report and feedback to MSOs generally
As permission to stop all ongoing monitoring of the customer for the remainder of the business relationship
As a guarantee that the CCE will take no future regulatory or supervisory action regarding the account
en.explain: ¶7.26: a consent response should not be construed as a clean bill of health for the continued operation of the account. ¶7.27: the MSO should conduct an appropriate review of the relationship upon filing an STR, irrespective of JFIU feedback, and apply appropriate risk-mitigating measures — continuing the relationship without further consideration is not acceptable, and issues should be escalated to senior management if necessary.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組就金錢服務經營者交易前提交的報告給予「同意」。經營者應如何看待這項同意？
options: 不應視為「安全證明」——經營者仍須檢視業務關係並採取減低風險措施
視為帳戶並無風險的確認，僅屬聯合財富情報組季度報告反饋的一部分內容
視為可在該業務關係餘下的整段期間停止對客戶的一切持續監察
視為關長保證日後不會就該帳戶採取任何監管或視察行動
tc.explain: 第7.26段：聯合財富情報組的「同意」回覆不應被解讀為帳戶可繼續運作的「安全證明」。第7.27段：提交報告後，不論聯合財富情報組其後有何回饋，經營者均應適當檢視有關業務關係並採取適當的減低風險措施——不加考慮便繼續維持關係並不可接受，有需要時應上報高級管理層。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.28段

en.q: An MSO has already filed an STR about a customer. The same customer later conducts further suspicious transactions. What should happen?
options: The further transactions must still be reported to the MLRO, who should make further reports to the JFIU if appropriate
Nothing further is required — the original STR is treated as covering that customer permanently, however different the new activity
The MSO should report only if the new transactions differ in nature or pattern from the earlier suspicion reported
The MSO should close the account at once and need not report anything further to the MLRO or JFIU
en.explain: ¶7.28: reporting one suspicion does not remove the need to report further suspicious transactions or events for the same customer — whether of the same or a different nature. They must continue to be reported to the MLRO, with further STRs to the JFIU as appropriate.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者已就某客戶提交可疑交易報告。該客戶其後再進行可疑交易。應如何處理？
options: 其後的可疑交易仍須向洗錢報告主任報告，並在適當時再向聯合財富情報組提交報告
毋須再作任何處理——不論其後活動性質如何不同，原有報告已永久涵蓋該客戶
只有新交易的性質或模式與先前的懷疑不同時，經營者才須作出報告
經營者應立即結束該帳戶，並毋須再向洗錢報告主任或聯合財富情報組作任何報告
tc.explain: 第7.28段：就某宗交易或事件報告懷疑後，並不免除就同一客戶的其後可疑交易或事件作出報告的需要——不論性質與先前相同與否，均須繼續向洗錢報告主任報告，並在適當時再向聯合財富情報組提交報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.29至7.30段

en.q: What records must an MSO maintain in relation to suspicious transaction reporting?
options: Records of all internal reports to the MLRO and all STRs to the JFIU, each with date, handler and paper location
Only records of the STRs that resulted in a criminal prosecution being brought by law enforcement agencies
No records at all should be kept, since retaining STR records would itself amount to tipping off the customer
Only a running annual count of the total number of STRs filed with the JFIU, without further detail
en.explain: ¶7.29–7.30: the MSO must maintain a record of all internal reports to the MLRO (date, handling staff, assessment results, whether an STR resulted, location of papers) and a record of all STRs to the JFIU (date, maker, location of papers). The two registers may be combined if appropriate.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須就可疑交易報告備存哪些紀錄？
options: 向洗錢報告主任作出的內部報告及向聯合財富情報組提交的報告均須有紀錄，並附日期及位置
只須備存最終導致執法機構提出正式刑事檢控程序的可疑交易報告紀錄，其餘一概毋須備存
完全毋須備存任何紀錄，因為備存可疑交易報告的相關紀錄本身已構成通風報信罪行
每個曆年只須備存向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的總數字，毋須備存其他詳情
tc.explain: 第7.29至7.30段：金錢服務經營者必須備存所有向洗錢報告主任作出的內部報告紀錄（日期、其後處理的職員、評估結果、有否向聯合財富情報組提交報告、相關文件位置），以及所有向聯合財富情報組提交的報告紀錄（日期、提交人、文件位置）。兩份紀錄冊可在適當情況下合併。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.3; s.20, Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20條

en.q: Which of the following should be included in an MSO's records under the record-keeping requirements?
options: Customer and beneficial owner identity documents; CDD and monitoring records; account records and correspondence
Only the customer's name and telephone number — no other CDD documentation needs to be kept on file, regardless of risk
Only records of transactions that individually meet or exceed the $120,000 occasional-transaction threshold
Only the records of customers who have actually been the subject of an STR made to the JFIU
en.explain: ¶8.3: records should include (a) identity documents/data for the customer, beneficial owner, beneficiary, PPTAs and connected parties; (b) documents obtained through CDD and ongoing monitoring including SDD and EDD; (c) purpose-and-intended-nature documents; (d) account records and material business correspondence; and (e) results of any analysis undertaken (e.g. on complex or unusually large transactions).

tc.q: 根據備存紀錄規定，下列哪項應包括在金錢服務經營者的紀錄內？
options: 客戶及實益擁有人的身分文件；客戶盡職審查所得紀錄；以及帳戶紀錄及業務通訊
只須備存客戶的姓名及電話號碼——完全毋須備存任何其他客戶盡職審查文件記錄，不論風險
只須備存個別已達到120,000元非經常交易門檻的交易紀錄及單據
只須備存曾實際成為向聯合財富情報組提交報告對象的客戶的相關紀錄
tc.explain: 第8.3段：紀錄應包括(a)識別及核實客戶、實益擁有人、受益人、看似代表客戶行事的人及有關連者身分的文件正本或副本及數據紀錄；(b)在客戶盡職審查及持續監察程序（包括簡化及更嚴格的盡職審查）期間取得的其他文件及紀錄；(c)業務關係目的及擬具性質的文件；(d)帳戶紀錄及重要業務通訊；及(e)所作任何分析的結果（例如就複雜或異常龐大交易的查究）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.4, ¶8.6; s.20(2)-(3A), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.4及8.6段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(2)至(3A)條

en.q: For how long must CDD documents and transaction records be kept?
options: Throughout the relationship and at least 5 years after it ends, or 5 years after an occasional or completed transaction
1 year after the business relationship ends — the same shorter period that applies only to the STR register kept separately
10 years from the date the account was first opened, regardless of when the relationship later ends
Only until the customer requests deletion of their personal data, as an overriding right under the AMLO
en.explain: ¶8.4: CDD documents and records must be kept throughout the relationship and for at least five years after it ends; for occasional transactions at or above the CDD thresholds, at least five years after the transaction date. ¶8.6: transaction records are kept at least five years after completion, regardless of whether the relationship ends. There is no 1-year or 10-year rule, and no customer-deletion right overrides these periods.

tc.q: 盡職審查文件及交易紀錄須保存多久？
options: 業務關係持續期間及結束後最少5年；非經常或已完成交易則在交易後最少5年
業務關係結束後僅1年而已——與可疑交易報告紀錄冊本身較短的法定保存期相同
由客戶首次開戶當日起計10年，不論業務關係其後何時結束
只須保存至客戶根據打擊洗錢條例行使刪除其個人資料的權利為止
tc.explain: 第8.4段：客戶盡職審查文件及紀錄須在業務關係持續期間保存，並在業務關係結束後保存最少5年；達到客戶盡職審查門檻的非經常交易，紀錄須在交易日期後保存最少5年。第8.6段：交易紀錄須在交易完成後保存最少5年，不論業務關係是否在期間內結束。並無1年或10年的規定，客戶亦不能要求刪除以縮短此等保存期。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶8.8; s.20(4), Sch. 2, AMLO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.8段；《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20(4)條

en.q: When may an MSO be required to keep records for LONGER than the standard five-year period?
options: When the CCE gives written notice requiring longer retention of specified records, e.g. because of an ongoing investigation
Whenever the customer is a politically exposed person — such customers' records must always be retained on file for 20 full years
Never — under the AMLO, five years is treated as an absolute statutory maximum in every case
Whenever a single transaction exceeds $1 million, which automatically triggers extended record retention
en.explain: ¶8.8: the CCE may, by written notice, require an MSO to keep records relating to a specified transaction or customer for a period longer than the standard retention periods, where the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other investigation or other purposes specified in the notice. There is no automatic PEP or transaction-size trigger, and five years is not an absolute ceiling.

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下，金錢服務經營者可被要求將紀錄保存超過標準的5年期？
options: 關長可以書面通知要求延長保存指明交易或客戶的紀錄，例如與調查有關
凡客戶屬政治人物，該等客戶的紀錄無論如何均一律須保存長達20年之久
絕無此情況——打擊洗錢條例訂明5年是任何情況下的法定絕對上限
凡單一交易超過100萬元，即自動觸發延長保存紀錄的規定
tc.explain: 第8.8段：如紀錄與關長正在進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或涉及通知內指明的其他目的，關長可以書面通知要求金錢服務經營者將指明交易或客戶的紀錄保存較長的指明期間。並無自動因政治人物身分或交易金額而觸發的延長規定，5年亦非絕對上限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.2及9.7段

en.q: Which statement about AML/CFT staff training is CORRECT?
options: New staff attend initial training as soon as possible after hiring, plus regular refresher training and 3-year record retention
Training is required only for the Compliance Officer and MLRO, since front-line staff carry no personal reporting obligations
One training session delivered at hiring is sufficient to cover a staff member's entire career at the MSO
Training records may be discarded as soon as a staff member passes the MSO's internal knowledge test
en.explain: ¶9.2: new staff require initial training as soon as possible after hiring, plus regular refresher training; scope and frequency should be tailored to the MSO's risks and each staff member's job function — front-line staff in particular need training on recognising suspicious transactions. ¶9.7: records of who was trained, when, and the type of training must be maintained for a minimum of 3 years.

tc.q: 關於打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集職員培訓，下列哪項正確？
options: 新職員獲聘後應盡快接受初步培訓，並定期舉辦複修培訓；紀錄須保存最少3年
只有合規主任及洗錢報告主任需要接受培訓，因為前線職員並無任何報告職責
職員入職時接受一次培訓，已足夠應付其整個職業生涯的需要
職員一旦通過經營者的內部測試，其培訓紀錄即可立即銷毀
tc.explain: 第9.2段：新職員獲聘用或委任後應盡快接受初步培訓，另應定期舉辦複修培訓；培訓的範圍及頻密程度應按經營者面對的特定風險及職員的職能而定——前線職員尤其需要接受識別可疑交易的培訓。第9.7段：須備存誰人受訓、受訓時間及培訓類別的紀錄，最少保存3年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第3.11至3.12段

en.q: How does the independent audit function help an MSO demonstrate and monitor its AML/CFT compliance?
options: It regularly reviews the AML/CFT Systems — risk assessment, STR systems, compliance and staff awareness
It develops and continuously reviews the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, and communicates key compliance issues to senior management
It acts as the central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions to the JFIU and law enforcement agencies
It exercises the board and senior management's overall oversight and understanding of the MSO's ML/TF risks
en.explain: ¶3.11–3.12: the independent audit function, with a direct line to senior management and sufficient expertise and resources, regularly reviews the AML/CFT Systems: adequacy of the systems, risk assessment framework and RBA application; effectiveness of STR systems; effectiveness of the compliance function; and staff AML/CFT awareness. Developing the Systems is the Compliance Officer's function (¶3.9); acting as the central reference point for reporting is the MLRO's function (¶3.10); overall risk oversight sits with senior management (¶3.6) — none of these is the audit function's own role.

tc.q: 獨立審核職能如何協助金錢服務經營者證明及監察其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集合規情況？
options: 定期覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度：風險評估、報告可疑交易、合規及職員意識
制訂並持續覆核經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，並與高級管理層溝通主要合規問題
作為向聯合財富情報組及執法機關報告可疑交易的中央參照點及主要聯絡點
行使董事會及高級管理層對經營者洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的整體監督、了解及管理
tc.explain: 第3.11至3.12段：獨立審核職能應能與高級管理層直接溝通，並具備充足專門知識及資源，定期覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度：制度、風險評估框架及風險為本方法的應用是否合適；報告可疑交易制度是否有效；合規職能是否有效；以及職員的意識水平。制訂制度屬合規主任的職能（第3.9段）；作為報告的中央聯絡點屬洗錢報告主任的職能（第3.10段）；整體風險監督屬高級管理層（第3.6段）——均非審核職能本身的角色。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: Under which statutory provisions does the obligation to file a suspicious transaction report arise?
options: Sections 25A(1) of the DTROP and the OSCO, and section 12(1) of the UNATMO
Section 5 of Schedule 2 to the AMLO alone, which deals with customer due diligence measures rather than reporting
Section 25A of the AMLO, since the AMLO governs all of an MSO's record-keeping and reporting duties
Section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O, which addresses proliferation-financing sanctions rather than STR obligations
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that it is a statutory obligation under sections 25A(1) of the DTROP and the OSCO, as well as section 12(1) of the UNATMO, that a person who knows or suspects that property falls within the specified descriptions shall as soon as it is reasonable for them to do so file an STR with the JFIU. The AMLO governs CDD and record-keeping, not the STR obligation itself, and the WMD(CPS)O is a separate sanctions regime.

tc.q: 提交可疑交易報告的責任源自哪些法定條文？
options: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條，以及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條
僅《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5條的規定，該條處理的是客戶盡職審查的相關措施，而非提交報告的法定責任
僅《打擊洗錢條例》第25A條的規定，因該條例規管的是經營者的所有備存紀錄及報告整體責任範圍
《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條的規定，處理的是擴散資金籌集的制裁措施，而非報告責任
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明，根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條，以及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條，任何人如知悉或懷疑任何財產屬指明的描述，均有法定責任在合理範圍內盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。《打擊洗錢條例》規管的是客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄，而非報告責任本身；《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》則屬另一套制裁制度。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: Which three descriptions of property, in relation to drug trafficking or an indictable offence, trigger the reporting obligation?
options: Represents a person's proceeds of; was used in connection with; or is intended for use in such conduct
Property that is held in cash; held overseas; or held in a numbered or anonymous account for privacy
Property that has already been frozen by court order; formally confiscated; or judicially forfeited
Property exceeding $8,000 for wire transfers, $120,000 for other transactions, or a higher threshold set by the CCE
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that the obligation arises where a person knows or suspects that any property (a) in whole or in part directly or indirectly represents any person's proceeds of, (b) was used in connection with, or (c) is intended to be used in connection with drug trafficking or an indictable offence; or that any property is terrorist property. Footnote 60 confirms the obligation applies irrespective of amount, so the CDD dollar thresholds are not a trigger for this obligation.

tc.q: 就販毒或可公訴罪行而言，哪三種財產描述會觸發報告責任？
options: 直接或間接代表任何人從該等行為所得的得益；曾用於或擬用於與該等行為有關連的用途
純粹以現金方式持有；存放於海外；或以編號或匿名帳戶持有以保密的財產
已被法院正式頒令凍結；已遭正式充公；或已被司法機構沒收的財產
電傳轉帳超過8,000元、其他交易超過120,000元，或關長訂定的較高門檻的財產
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明，如任何人知悉或懷疑任何財產：(a)全部或部分直接或間接代表任何人從販毒或可公訴罪行所得的得益；(b)曾用於與該等行為有關連的用途；或(c)擬用於與該等行為有關連的用途；或知悉或懷疑任何財產屬恐怖分子財產，即產生該項責任。註腳60確認該責任不論款額多少均適用，故客戶盡職審查的款額門檻並非觸發此責任的條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: What must accompany an STR made to the JFIU?
options: Any matter on which the knowledge or suspicion is based
A written legal opinion from external counsel confirming the suspicion
The customer's own written explanation of the transaction in question
A copy of the customer's identification document, and nothing else
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that the STR should be made together with any matter on which the knowledge or suspicion is based. The underlying material is part of the report itself — the Guideline does not require a legal opinion, a customer explanation, or identification documents alone.

tc.q: 向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告須附有甚麼？
options: 構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的任何事宜
由外聘律師出具、確認該懷疑成立的書面法律意見
客戶就引致該報告的相關交易作出的書面解釋
僅客戶的身分證明文件副本一份，別無其他
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明可疑交易報告應連同構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的任何事宜一併作出。有關基礎資料本身即屬報告的一部分——本指引並無要求附上法律意見、客戶解釋，或僅附身分證明文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.1段

en.q: What is the maximum penalty for failure to report knowledge or suspicion under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO?
options: Imprisonment for three months and a fine of $50,000
Imprisonment for two years and a fine of $200,000
Imprisonment for seven years and a $5,000,000 fine
A fine of $1,000,000 only
en.explain: ¶7.1 states that under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO, failure to report knowledge or suspicion carries a maximum penalty of imprisonment for three months and a fine of $50,000.

tc.q: 根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，未有報告知悉或懷疑的最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁三個月及罰款50,000元
監禁兩年及罰款200,000元
監禁七年及罰款500萬元
tc.explain: 第7.1段訂明根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》，未有報告知悉或懷疑的最高刑罰為監禁三個月及罰款50,000元。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.2段

en.q: What three things is knowledge likely to include, generally speaking?
options: Actual knowledge; circumstances indicating facts to a reasonable person; or circumstances prompting inquiry
Actual knowledge only, since the Guideline treats the knowledge test as a subjective, personal one
Documentary proof of the underlying offence; corroborating witness evidence; and a formal confession
Actual knowledge; unverified hearsay passed on by a third party; and unsubstantiated market rumour
en.explain: ¶7.2 states that generally speaking knowledge is likely to include actual knowledge; knowledge of circumstances which would indicate facts to a reasonable person; and knowledge of circumstances which would put a reasonable person on inquiry. The second and third limbs are objective tests — ¶7.3 separately describes suspicion, not knowledge, as more subjective.

tc.q: 一般而言，「知悉」相當可能包括哪三方面？
options: 實際知悉；會向合理的人顯示事實的情況；或令合理的人作出查究的情況
僅實際知悉，因為本指引將整個知悉的準則視為純屬主觀、個人的判斷
相關罪行的文件證據；具佐證力的證人證供；以及正式認罪
實際知悉；經第三者轉述、未經證實的傳聞；以及未經證實的市場傳言
tc.explain: 第7.2段訂明一般而言，知悉相當可能包括：實際知悉；知悉會向一個合理的人顯示某些事實的情況；以及知悉會令一個合理的人作出查究的情況。後兩項屬客觀準則——第7.3段形容的「較為主觀」是指懷疑，並非知悉。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.3段

en.q: How does the Guideline characterise suspicion as compared with knowledge?
options: Suspicion is more subjective — personal, and falling short of proof based on firm evidence
Suspicion requires a higher standard of certainty than knowledge before an MSO may act on it
Suspicion must always be supported by documentary proof before an internal report can be made
Suspicion and knowledge are treated as legally identical concepts throughout this Guideline
en.explain: ¶7.3: suspicion is more subjective — it is personal and falls short of proof based on firm evidence. Where a transaction is inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, or is unusual, the MSO should take appropriate steps to further examine it and identify if there is any suspicion (see ¶5.10–5.14).

tc.q: 本指引如何形容「懷疑」與「知悉」的分別？
options: 懷疑較為主觀——屬個人判斷，未及以確鑿證據為據的證明
懷疑須具備比知悉更高程度的肯定性，經營者方可據以行事
懷疑必須有充分的文件證據支持，方可作出內部報告
本指引自始至終將懷疑與知悉視為法律上完全相同的概念
tc.explain: 第7.3段：懷疑較為主觀；懷疑屬個人的判斷，其程度未及以確鑿證據為據的證明。如客戶的某宗或一連串交易與該經營者對該客戶的了解並不一致，或屬不尋常，該經營者應採取適當步驟進一步審查該等交易，並識別是否有任何懷疑（見第5.10至5.14段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.3段

en.q: Under ¶7.3, what should an MSO do when a customer's transaction is inconsistent with its knowledge of the customer, or is unusual?
options: Take appropriate steps to further examine the transaction and identify any suspicion
Automatically file an STR with the JFIU at once, without any further internal examination
Terminate the business relationship immediately and record the reason in the CDD file
Defer any inquiry until the customer's next scheduled periodic review takes place
en.explain: ¶7.3: when a transaction or series of transactions is inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer, or is unusual, the MSO should take appropriate steps to further examine the transactions and identify if there is any suspicion — before deciding whether an STR is warranted; there is no rule requiring immediate reporting, termination, or deferral to a periodic review.

tc.q: 根據第7.3段，如客戶的交易與金錢服務經營者對該客戶的了解不一致，或屬不尋常，該經營者應如何處理？
options: 採取適當步驟進一步審查有關交易，並識別是否存在任何懷疑
無須再作內部審查，應立即直接向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
立即終止該業務關係，並在客戶盡職審查檔案中記錄原因
延後處理，留待該客戶下次定期覆核時才作跟進
tc.explain: 第7.3段：如客戶的某宗或一連串交易與經營者對該客戶的了解不一致，或屬不尋常，經營者應採取適當步驟進一步審查該等交易，並識別是否有任何懷疑——然後才決定是否須提交可疑交易報告；並無規定須立即報告、終止關係，或延至定期覆核才處理。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.4段

en.q: Must a person know the nature of the underlying criminal activity before knowledge or suspicion arises?
options: No — one need not know the nature of the crime, or that the funds arose from it; the same applies to TF
Yes — the specific predicate offence that generated the funds must first be positively identified and proven
Yes — at least the general legal category of the offence involved must first be clearly identified
No — but the exact amount of the criminal proceeds involved must first be firmly established and verified
en.explain: ¶7.4: for a person to have knowledge or suspicion, they do not need to know the nature of the criminal activity underlying the ML, or that the funds themselves definitely arose from the criminal offence; the same principle applies to TF. Neither the predicate offence, its category, nor the exact amount need be established.

tc.q: 在產生知悉或懷疑之前，是否必須知悉相關犯罪活動的性質？
options: 否——無須知悉犯罪性質或資金來源；同一原則適用於恐怖分子資金籌集
是——必須先正面識別出產生該等資金的具體前置罪行是甚麼，並加以證明
是——最少須先清楚識別出所涉罪行所屬的一般法律類別為何，方符合規定
否——但須先確切核實並清楚證明所涉犯罪得益的準確金額為何，缺一不可
tc.explain: 第7.4段：就某人具有知悉或懷疑而言，該人無須知悉洗錢背後犯罪活動的性質，亦無須確知該等資金必然源自該項罪行；同一原則亦適用於恐怖分子資金籌集。既毋須確定前置罪行，也毋須確定罪行類別或準確金額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5(a)段

en.q: Must an STR be filed where no transaction has been conducted by or through the MSO?
options: Yes — an STR should be filed once knowledge or suspicion forms, even with no transaction
No — an actually completed transaction is always a precondition before any reporting obligation can arise
No — an internal record is sufficient where no transaction occurred, without any STR to the JFIU
Yes — but only where the customer already has an existing, ongoing business relationship with the MSO
en.explain: ¶7.5(a): once knowledge or suspicion has been formed, an MSO should file an STR even where no transaction has been conducted by or through it. Footnote 60 adds that the obligation applies whether or not a transaction was actually conducted, and also covers attempted transactions — there is no completed-transaction precondition and no existing-relationship requirement.

tc.q: 如並無任何交易經該金錢服務經營者或透過其進行，是否仍須提交可疑交易報告？
options: 須要——一旦形成知悉或懷疑，即使並無任何交易發生，仍須提交報告
無須——已實際完成的交易永遠是任何報告責任產生的先決條件
無須——如並無交易發生，只需內部紀錄即可，毋須向聯合財富情報組提交報告
須要——但只限該客戶與該經營者之間已有現存的持續業務關係
tc.explain: 第7.5(a)款訂明一旦形成知悉或懷疑，即使並無任何交易經該經營者或透過其進行，該經營者仍應提交可疑交易報告。註腳60補充該項責任不論交易是否實際進行均適用，並涵蓋未遂的交易——並無已完成交易的先決條件，亦無須現存業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5(b)段

en.q: By when must an STR be made once knowledge or suspicion has been formed?
options: As soon as reasonably practical after the suspicion was first identified
Within 24 hours of the transaction that gave rise to the suspicion being completed
Within 7 days of the end of the calendar month in which the suspicion first arose
Before the next periodic review of the customer's business relationship takes place
en.explain: ¶7.5(b) states that the STR must be made as soon as reasonably practical after the suspicion was first identified — the same timing standard as the statutory 'as soon as it is reasonable for him to do so' in ¶7.1. There is no fixed 24-hour, 7-day, or periodic-review deadline.

tc.q: 一旦形成知悉或懷疑，可疑交易報告須在何時作出？
options: 在首次識別出該項懷疑後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快作出
須在引致該懷疑的交易實際完成後的24小時內作出
須在該懷疑產生的當個曆月月底後的7個工作日內作出
可押後至該客戶下一次定期覆核業務關係時才作出
tc.explain: 第7.5(b)款訂明可疑交易報告須在首次識別出該項懷疑後，在合理切實可行範圍內盡快作出——與第7.1段法定的「在合理範圍內盡快」時限標準一致。並無固定的24小時、7日或待定期覆核的時限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5段註腳60

en.q: Does the reporting obligation extend to attempted transactions?
options: Yes — the obligation applies whether or not a transaction was conducted, and covers attempts
No — an executed, fully completed transaction must occur before the reporting obligation can arise
Yes — but only where the customer voluntarily abandoned the attempted transaction part-way through
No — attempted transactions need only be recorded internally, and never reported to the JFIU
en.explain: Footnote 60 to ¶7.5 states that the reporting provisions establish a reporting obligation whenever a suspicion arises, without reference to transactions per se, and that the obligation to report applies whether or not a transaction was actually conducted and also covers attempted transactions — regardless of whether the customer abandoned the attempt.

tc.q: 報告責任是否延伸至未遂的交易？
options: 是——不論交易是否實際進行，報告責任均適用並涵蓋未遂交易
否——須有已執行並完全完成的交易，該項責任方會產生
是——但只限該客戶在交易進行途中自願放棄的企圖
否——未遂的交易只須作內部紀錄，永不須向聯合財富情報組報告
tc.explain: 第7.5段註腳60訂明有關報告條文在懷疑產生時即確立報告責任，而不以交易本身為依歸；因此，不論交易是否實際進行，報告責任均適用，並涵蓋未遂的交易——不論客戶是否自願放棄該項企圖。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5段註腳60

en.q: Is the reporting obligation subject to any monetary threshold?
options: No — the obligation applies irrespective of the amount involved, because it covers 'any property'
Yes — the $8,000 threshold for wire and virtual asset transfers applies to reporting too
Yes — the $120,000 threshold for other occasional transactions applies to reporting too
Yes — a threshold set by the CCE from time to time applies to the reporting obligation
en.explain: Footnote 60 states that the reporting obligations require a person to report suspicions of ML/TF irrespective of the amount involved, that the obligations under section 25A(1) DTROP and OSCO and section 12(1) UNATMO apply to 'any property', and that these provisions establish a reporting obligation whenever a suspicion arises, without reference to transactions per se. The CDD dollar thresholds are a separate concept and do not limit the reporting obligation.

tc.q: 報告責任是否設有款額門檻？
options: 並無——不論所涉款額多少，任何人均須報告，因有關條文適用於「任何財產」
有——電傳轉帳及虛擬資產轉帳的8,000元門檻同樣適用於報告責任
有——其他非經常交易的120,000元門檻同樣適用於報告責任
有——關長不時訂定的門檻同樣適用於報告責任
tc.explain: 註腳60訂明不論所涉款額多少，報告責任均要求任何人報告洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的懷疑；《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A(1)條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12(1)條的責任適用於「任何財產」；該等條文在懷疑產生時即確立報告責任，而不以交易本身為依歸。客戶盡職審查的款額門檻屬另一概念，並不限制報告責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.5段註腳60

en.q: How is property defined for the purposes of the reporting obligation?
options: By reference to section 3 of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance, Cap. 1
By reference to the definition of 'property' set out in Schedule 1 to the AMLO, not Cap. 1
As money and negotiable instruments only, excluding all other forms of movable or immovable asset
As any asset held on account with a bank or other institution authorized under the Banking Ordinance
en.explain: Footnote 60 states that property includes both movable and immovable property within the meaning of section 3 of the Interpretation and General Clauses Ordinance, Cap. 1, and that as defined there property includes money, goods, choses in action and land, and related interests arising out of or incident to that property — not a separate AMLO schedule, and not limited to money, instruments, or bank-held assets.

tc.q: 就報告責任而言，「財產」如何界定？
options: 參照《釋義及通則條例》（第1章）第3條的定義
參照《打擊洗錢條例》附表1（而非第1章）所載的「財產」定義
僅指金錢及可流轉票據，不包括其他一切動產或不動產
指在根據《銀行業條例》獲認可的銀行或其他機構持有的任何資產
tc.explain: 註腳60訂明財產包括《釋義及通則條例》（第1章）第3條所指的動產及不動產；按該條的定義，財產包括金錢、貨品、據法權產及土地，以及因該等財產而產生或附帶的相關權益——並非參照《打擊洗錢條例》的附表，亦不限於金錢、票據或銀行持有的資產。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.6段

en.q: Does the tipping off offence apply where a suspicion has been raised internally but not yet reported to the JFIU?
options: Yes — it covers a suspicion raised internally but not yet reported to the JFIU
No — the tipping-off offence arises only once an STR has actually been filed with the JFIU
No — internal reports made before any STR is filed are entirely outside the tipping-off provision
Yes — but only once the internal report has actually reached and been reviewed by the MLRO
en.explain: ¶7.6: it is an offence (tipping off) to reveal to any person any information which might prejudice an investigation; if a customer is told that a report has been made, this would prejudice the investigation and an offence would be committed. The tipping-off provision includes circumstances where a suspicion has been raised internally within an MSO, but has not yet been reported to the JFIU — there is no requirement that an STR first be filed, or that the MLRO have already reviewed the report.

tc.q: 如懷疑已在內部提出但尚未向聯合財富情報組報告，通風報信罪行是否適用？
options: 適用——涵蓋懷疑已在內部提出但尚未向聯合財富情報組報告
不適用——通風報信罪行只在可疑交易報告已實際提交後方會產生
不適用——提交報告前作出的內部報告完全不受通風報信條文涵蓋
適用——但只限該內部報告已實際送達並經洗錢報告主任覆閱的情況
tc.explain: 第7.6段訂明向任何人透露可能損害調查的任何資料即屬犯罪（「通風報信」）；如告知客戶已作出報告，即會損害該調查並構成罪行。通風報信的條文涵蓋懷疑已在該經營者內部提出但尚未向聯合財富情報組報告的情況——並無須先提交可疑交易報告，亦無須洗錢報告主任已覆閱該報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.7段

en.q: Which three elements should an MSO's AML/CFT Systems include in relation to suspicious transaction reporting?
options: Appointment of an MLRO; policies on internal reporting, JFIU reporting and tipping-off prevention; and proper records of reports
Appointment of a compliance officer; an annual external audit reviewed by the CCE; and a whistle-blowing hotline for customers
A transaction monitoring system under Chapter 5; a sanctions screening database; and a staff AML/CFT training programme under Chapter 9
A reporting register maintained by the branch; a designated legal adviser; and an escalation committee chaired by the CCE
en.explain: ¶7.7: the AML/CFT Systems for suspicious transaction reporting should include (a) appointment of an MLRO, (b) clear policies and procedures over internal reporting, JFIU reporting, post-reporting risk mitigation and tipping-off prevention, and (c) proper records of internal reports and STRs — not an external audit and hotline, a Chapter 5 monitoring system and Chapter 9 training programme (real but different requirements), or a branch register and CCE-chaired committee.

tc.q: 就可疑交易報告，金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢系統應包括哪三項元素？
options: 委任洗錢報告主任；就內部及對外報告、防止通風報訊訂立清晰政策；以及妥為保存紀錄
委任該經營者的合規主任；由關長審閱的年度外部審計；以及供客戶使用的舉報熱線
交易監察系統；制裁篩查資料庫；以及第9章的員工打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓內容
由該經營者分行維持的報告登記冊；指定的法律顧問；以及由關長主持的呈報委員會
tc.explain: 第7.7段：可疑交易報告的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集系統應包括：(a)委任洗錢報告主任；(b)就內部報告、向聯合財富情報組報告、報告後風險緩減及防止通風報訊訂立清晰政策及程序；及(c)妥為保存內部報告及可疑交易報告的紀錄——並非外部審計及熱線、第5章監察系統與第9章培訓計劃（真實但屬不同規定），或分行登記冊及由關長主持的委員會。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.8段

en.q: How should the type and extent of the measures checking an MSO's reporting systems be determined?
options: Appropriate to the risk of ML/TF and to the nature and size of the MSO's business
Identical for all MSOs, as a single fixed checklist prescribed by the CCE for the whole industry
Determined by the MLRO alone, without regard to the size or complexity of the MSO's business
Set at the maximum practicable level in every case, regardless of the MSO's risk profile
en.explain: ¶7.8: the type and extent of measures checking an MSO's reporting systems should be appropriate having regard to the risk of ML/TF as well as the nature and size of its business — not a single CCE-fixed checklist, an MLRO's sole decision, or a uniform maximum in every case.

tc.q: 查核金錢服務經營者報告系統的措施，其類型及程度應如何釐定？
options: 須顧及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，以及業務的性質及規模而屬適當
對所有經營者劃一，即由關長為全行業訂立單一固定的查核清單
只由洗錢報告主任一人決定，不考慮該經營者業務的規模或複雜程度
在任何情況下均須設於切實可行的最高水平，不論該經營者本身的風險狀況
tc.explain: 第7.8段：查核經營者報告系統的措施，其類型及程度須顧及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，以及其業務的性質及規模而屬適當——並非由關長訂立劃一清單、僅由洗錢報告主任一人決定，或不論風險狀況一律設於最高水平。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.9段

en.q: What two roles does the MLRO fulfil under ¶7.9?
options: A central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions, and the main JFIU contact
The Compliance Officer, and the CCE's designated liaison officer responsible for the MSO sector
The senior management representative responsible for risk appetite, and the data protection officer
The training officer responsible for AML/CFT courses under Chapter 9, and the customer complaints officer
en.explain: ¶7.9: an MSO should appoint an MLRO as a central reference point for reporting suspicious transactions and also as the main point of contact with the JFIU and law enforcement agencies — the Guideline does not describe the MLRO as a compliance officer paired with a CCE liaison role, a risk-appetite representative paired with a data protection officer, or a training officer paired with a complaints officer.

tc.q: 根據第7.9段，洗錢報告主任擔當哪兩個角色？
options: 匯報可疑交易的中央參照點，以及與聯合財富情報組及執法機關的主要聯絡點
該經營者的合規主任，以及關長為金錢服務業指定的聯絡主任
負責釐定該經營者風險胃納的高級管理層代表，以及其資料保障主任
負責第9章打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓課程的培訓主任，以及客戶投訴主任
tc.explain: 第7.9段：經營者應委任洗錢報告主任，作為匯報可疑交易的中央參照點，以及與聯合財富情報組及執法機關的主要聯絡點——本指引並無將洗錢報告主任描述為合規主任兼關長聯絡主任、風險胃納代表兼資料保障主任，或培訓主任兼投訴主任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.9段

en.q: Which of the following is among the MLRO's principal functions?
options: Provision of guidance to reporting staff on how to avoid tipping off
Approval of all new customer relationships before the account is opened
Conduct of the MSO's annual independent AML/CFT audit required under other guidance
Setting the MSO's internal transaction limits for individual customers
en.explain: ¶7.9(c): the MLRO's principal functions include providing guidance on how to avoid tipping off (alongside reviewing internal disclosures and maintaining related records) — approving new relationships, conducting the independent audit, and setting transaction limits are not among the functions ¶7.9 lists for the MLRO.

tc.q: 下列何者屬洗錢報告主任的主要職能之一？
options: 向作出報告的員工提供如何避免通風報訊的清晰及具體指引
在開立戶口前，須先行批准所有新客戶關係的申請
按其他指引進行經營者的年度獨立打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集審計
為每名個別客戶，訂定並定期更新該經營者的內部交易限額
tc.explain: 第7.9(c)段：洗錢報告主任的主要職能包括就如何避免通風報訊提供指引（連同檢視內部披露及保存相關紀錄）——批准新客戶關係、進行獨立審計及訂定交易限額，均非第7.9段所列該主任的職能。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10段

en.q: What should the guidance an MSO provides to staff and agents on recognising ML/TF/PF take into account?
options: The transactions and customer instructions staff typically meet, the product or service type, and delivery means
The staff member's job function, responsibilities and experience, per the MSO's training policy under Chapter 9
The MSO's overall profitability targets and revenue growth plans set for the current financial year by senior management
The CCE's published inspection schedule and its industry-wide enforcement priorities for the year
en.explain: ¶7.10: guidance to staff and agents on recognising ML/TF/PF should take into account the nature of the transactions and customer instructions staff are likely to encounter, the type of product or service, and the means of delivery — job function and experience are factors for the scope and frequency of training under ¶9.2, a related but different requirement, while profitability targets and the CCE's inspection schedule play no role.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者向員工及代理人提供有關識別洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集的指引，應顧及甚麼？
options: 員工相當可能遇到的交易及指示的性質、產品類型及交付方式
員工的職能、職責及經驗，按第9章所訂的培訓政策而定
由高級管理層為本財政年度訂立的整體盈利目標及收入增長計劃
關長公布的巡查時間表及本年度的全行業執法優先事項
tc.explain: 第7.10段：向員工及代理人提供有關識別洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集的指引，應顧及員工相當可能遇到的交易及客戶指示的性質、產品或服務的類型，以及交付方式——職能及經驗屬第9.2段培訓範疇及頻密程度的考慮因素，是相關但不同的規定；盈利目標及關長的巡查時間表則毫不相干。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(iv)段

en.q: How does the Guideline describe 'structuring' or 'smurfing'?
options: Many lower value transactions conducted when one, or a few, large transactions could be used
Unnecessary routing of funds through various financial institutions or persons
Funds received from a person in a foreign jurisdiction remitted to the sender's own account in another jurisdiction
Exchanging an unusually large amount of small-denominated notes for higher-denomination notes in a different currency
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(iv) lists as a red flag indicator of transactions which do not make economic sense: 'structuring' or 'smurfing', that is many lower value transactions conducted when one, or a few, large transactions could be used. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10 red flags: unnecessary routing through institutions (a)(vi), the 'U-turn' variant where funds return to the sender's own account (a)(v), and exchanging small notes for larger ones in a different currency (b)(iii).

tc.q: 本指引如何形容「拆分交易」或「螞蟻搬家」？
options: 在本可使用一宗或少數幾宗大額交易的情況下，卻進行大量較低價值的交易
在無需要的情況下，通過不同金融機構或人士進行資金調度往來
從外地司法管轄區某人匯入的款項，最終轉匯至匯款人在另一司法管轄區的帳戶
將數量異常龐大的小額鈔票，兌換成另一種貨幣的較大面額鈔票
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(iv)段列出「在經濟上不合理的交易」的預警指標之一：「拆分交易」或「螞蟻搬家」，即在本可使用一宗或少數幾宗大額交易的情況下，卻進行大量較低價值的交易。其餘三項分別是第7.10段所列的其他預警指標：在無需要下經不同金融機構或人士進行資金調度往來（(a)(vi)）、「掉頭式」交易中款項匯回匯款人自己帳戶的情況（(a)(v)），以及將小額鈔票兌換成另一貨幣較大面額鈔票（(b)(iii)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(ii)段

en.q: Which mismatch is given as an example of a transaction incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer?
options: A mismatch between the economic activity, origin or person and the remittances
A transaction that cannot be reconciled with the customer's usual pattern of activity
Funds routed through various financial institutions or persons without any apparent need
Multiple senders transferring funds into a single individual's account
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(ii) lists transactions which are incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer or with the purpose of the relevant business transaction — for example, a mismatch between the economic activity, place of origin, or person and the remittances received. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(a) red flags: transactions inconsistent with the customer's usual activity (i), unnecessary routing through institutions (vi), and concentration of payments into a single account (viii).

tc.q: 哪一項不匹配的情況，被舉為與該經營者對客戶的了解及經驗不相容的交易例子？
options: 經濟活動、來源地或人物，與所收取匯款之間的不匹配
該項交易不符合客戶一直以來的慣常活動模式
通過不同金融機構或人士，進行不必要的資金調度往來活動
多名匯款人轉帳至某一人的帳戶，形成集中支付
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(ii)段列出與該經營者對有關客戶的了解及經驗，或與該項業務交易目的不相容的交易；並以經濟活動、來源地或人物與所收取匯款之間的不匹配為例。其餘三項分別是第7.10(a)段所列的其他預警指標：交易不符合客戶的慣常活動（(i)）、經不同金融機構或人士進行不必要的資金調度往來（(vi)），以及多名匯款人轉帳至某一人的帳戶形成集中支付（(viii)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(iii)段

en.q: Which red flag describes executing frequent or several transactions each of which is below CDD thresholds?
options: Concealing or disguising significant transactions to avoid disclosure for record purposes
Many lower value transactions conducted when one, or a few, large ones could be used
Multiple senders transferring funds into a single individual's account
Unnecessary routing of funds through various financial institutions or persons
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(iii) lists as a red flag conduct that conceals or disguises significant transactions to avoid disclosure for record purposes, by executing frequent or several transactions such that each transaction by itself is below CDD thresholds. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(a) red flags: structuring/smurfing (iv), concentration of payments (viii), and unnecessary routing through institutions (vi).

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標描述進行頻密或多宗交易，而每宗均低於客戶盡職審查門檻？
options: 隱瞞或掩飾重大交易，以規避備存紀錄的披露
在可用一宗或少數大額交易時，卻分成多宗較低價值交易
多名匯款人轉帳至某一人的帳戶，形成集中支付
通過不同金融機構或人士，進行不必要的資金調度往來
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(iii)段列出的預警指標為：藉進行頻密或多宗交易，使每宗交易本身均低於客戶盡職審查門檻，從而隱瞞或掩飾重大交易，以規避備存紀錄的披露。其餘三項分別是第7.10(a)段所列的其他預警指標：拆分交易或螞蟻搬家（(iv)）、付款集中支付（(viii)），以及不必要的資金調度往來（(vi)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(vii)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns a substantial increase in a customer's transaction activity?
options: Substantial increases in transaction number, frequency or amount without apparent cause
A transaction that cannot be reconciled with the customer's usual pattern of activity
A lack of apparent relationship between the person sending and the person receiving funds
Numerous transactions each below the CDD threshold whose cumulative total is substantial
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(vii) lists substantial increase(s) in the number of transactions, frequency or amounts by a customer without apparent cause — especially if remittances are made to a destination or person not normally associated with the customer. The distractors are other, distinct red flags: transactions inconsistent with the customer's usual activity (a)(i), lack of relationship between originator and recipient (a)(ix), and numerous sub-threshold transactions with a substantial cumulative total (b)(iv).

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及客戶交易活動大幅增加？
options: 客戶的交易數量、頻密程度或款額大幅上升而無明顯原因
交易的模式不符合客戶一貫的活動與往來背景
款項的匯款人與收款人之間沒有明顯的關係存在
多宗交易每宗均低於客戶盡職審查門檻，但累積總額仍然龐大
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(vii)段列出客戶的交易數量／頻密程度／交易款額大幅上升而沒有明顯原因，尤其是向通常與客戶沒有關連的目的地／人士匯款。其餘三項分別是其他不同的預警指標：交易不符合客戶的慣常活動（(a)(i)）、匯款人與收款人沒有明顯關係（(a)(ix)），以及多宗交易各低於客戶盡職審查門檻但累積總額龐大（(b)(iv)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(viii)段

en.q: What does the red flag 'concentration of payments' describe?
options: Multiple senders transferring funds to a single individual's account
Funds from a person in a foreign jurisdiction remitted to another person in the same jurisdiction
Unnecessary routing of funds through various financial institutions or persons
Customers together and simultaneously using separate branches to conduct large cash transactions
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(viii) lists as a red flag concentration of payments where multiple senders transfer funds to a single individual's account. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10 red flags: the 'U-turn' pattern of funds remitted to another person in the same foreign jurisdiction (a)(v), unnecessary routing through institutions (a)(vi), and customers simultaneously using separate branches for large cash transactions (b)(v).

tc.q: 「付款集中」這項預警指標描述甚麼？
options: 多名寄款人將資金轉入單一個人的帳戶
外地某人匯入的款項，轉匯予同一司法管轄區的另一人
通過不同金融機構或人士，進行不必要的資金調度往來
多名客戶一起在同一時間使用不同的分行處理大額現金交易
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(viii)段列出的預警指標為付款集中，即多名寄款人將資金轉入單一個人的帳戶。其餘三項分別是第7.10段所列的其他預警指標：「掉頭式」交易中匯往同一外地司法管轄區另一人的情況（(a)(v)）、經不同金融機構或人士進行不必要的資金調度往來（(a)(vi)），以及多名客戶同時使用不同分行處理大額現金交易（(b)(v)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(a)(ix)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns the relationship between the parties and the destination of a personal remittance?
options: A lack of apparent relationship between originator and recipient, or a personal remittance to a jurisdiction with no apparent family or business link to the customer
The 'U-turn' pattern — funds received from a person in a foreign jurisdiction remitted to another person or company in the same jurisdiction
A substantial increase in the number, frequency or amount of a customer's transactions without apparent cause, especially to an unrelated destination or person
A transaction incompatible with the MSO's knowledge and experience of the customer, for example a mismatch between economic activity, origin or person and the remittance received
en.explain: ¶7.10(a)(ix) lists a lack of apparent relationship between the originator and the recipient of funds, and/or personal remittances sent to jurisdictions that have no apparent family or business link to the customer, and/or the customer having no relation to the jurisdiction where he or she sends or receives the money and being unable sufficiently to explain why. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(a) red flags: the 'U-turn' pattern (v), a substantial unexplained increase in activity (vii), and the mismatch example under (ii).

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及各方之間的關係及個人匯款的目的地？
options: 款項的匯款人與收款人沒有明顯關係，及／或向與客戶沒有明顯家族或業務連繫的司法管轄區進行個人匯款
「掉頭式」交易，即從外地司法管轄區的某人匯入款項後，再轉帳回同一司法管轄區的另一人或公司
客戶的交易數量／頻密程度／交易款額大幅上升而沒有明顯原因，尤其是向通常與客戶沒有關連的目的地／人士匯款
交易不符合經營者對客戶的認知和經驗，例如接收的匯款與相關的經濟活動、來源地或人士不相稱
tc.explain: 第7.10(a)(ix)段列出匯款人與收款人之間欠缺明顯關係；及／或個人匯款匯往與該客戶並無明顯親屬或業務聯繫的司法管轄區；及／或該客戶與其收發款項的司法管轄區並無關係，且未能充分解釋原因。其餘三項分別是第7.10(a)段所列的其他預警指標：「掉頭式」交易（(v)）、並無原因的交易大幅增加（(vii)），以及(ii)所舉的不匹配例子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)(iii)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed among cash intensive transactions with abnormal patterns?
options: Exchanging an unusually large amount of small notes for higher-denomination notes in a different currency
Funds routed through a series of financial institutions or intermediaries without any apparent commercial need
A commodity shipped to or from a jurisdiction that is designated as higher risk for ML, TF or PF activities
Customer transactions that involve the use of counterfeit banknotes or forged payment instruments
en.explain: ¶7.10(b)(iii) lists among cash intensive transactions with abnormal patterns the exchanging of an unusually large amount of small-denominated notes for those of higher denomination in a different currency. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(b) red flags: frequent large cash transactions unjustified by the customer's business (i), large remittances to unrelated parties (ii), and transactions involving counterfeit notes (vi).

tc.q: 下列何者被列為「模式異常的現金密集交易」的預警指標？
options: 將異常大量的小額鈔票，兌換成另一貨幣的較大額鈔票
資金經多間金融機構或多名人士轉輸，而並無任何明顯需要
將商品付運至被界定為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集高風險的司法管轄區
客戶的交易涉及偽鈔或偽造的付款工具
tc.explain: 第7.10(b)(iii)段在「模式異常的現金密集交易」中列出：將異常大量的小額鈔票兌換成另一貨幣的較大額鈔票。其餘三項分別是第7.10(b)段所列的其他預警指標：無法解釋的頻繁大額現金交易（(i)）、匯予無關連人士或公司的大額或頻繁匯款（(ii)），以及涉及偽鈔或偽造工具的交易（(vi)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)(iv)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as a cash-related red flag concerning transaction volume over time?
options: Numerous transactions by a customer, each below the CDD threshold, whose cumulative total is substantial
Frequent transactions of large cash amounts not justified by the customer's business or background
Customers together and simultaneously using separate branches to conduct large cash transactions
Payments not clearly identifiable as genuine, involving higher-risk jurisdictions
en.explain: ¶7.10(b)(iv) lists numerous transactions by a customer, especially over a short period of time, where the amount of each transaction is below the CDD threshold or not substantial but the cumulative total is substantial or exceeds the threshold. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(b) red flags: frequent large cash transactions unjustified by the customer's business (i), customers simultaneously using separate branches (v), and unidentifiable regular payments to/from higher-risk jurisdictions (vii).

tc.q: 下列何者被列為與交易量隨時間變化有關的現金相關預警指標？
options: 客戶進行多宗交易，每宗均低於客戶盡職審查門檻，但總額龐大
從客戶業務活動或背景看來，無法解釋的頻繁大額現金交易
多名客戶一起在同一時間使用不同的分行處理大額現金交易
無法識別為真正交易的大額付款，涉及較高風險的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第7.10(b)(iv)段列出客戶進行多宗交易（尤其在短時間內），而每宗交易的金額低於客戶盡職審查門檻或並不龐大，但累計總額龐大或超出該門檻。其餘三項分別是第7.10(b)段所列的其他預警指標：無法解釋的頻繁大額現金交易（(i)）、多名客戶同時使用不同分行處理大額交易（(v)），以及款項匯出或匯入較高風險司法管轄區的定期大額付款（(vii)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(b)(v)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns customers and the MSO's branch network?
options: Customers who together, and simultaneously, use separate branches to conduct large cash transactions
Frequent transactions of large cash amounts not justified by the customer's business activity or background
Large or frequent remittances mostly to persons or companies unrelated to the customer's business
Large and regular payments that cannot be clearly identified as genuine, from or to higher-risk jurisdictions
en.explain: ¶7.10(b)(v) lists as a cash-related red flag customers who together, and simultaneously, use separate branches to conduct large cash transactions. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(b) red flags: frequent large cash transactions unjustified by the customer's business (i), large remittances to unrelated parties (ii), and unidentifiable regular payments to/from higher-risk jurisdictions (vii).

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及客戶與該經營者的分行網絡？
options: 多名客戶一同並同時使用不同分行進行大額（現金）交易
從客戶業務活動或背景看來，無法解釋的頻繁大額現金交易
客戶進行大額或頻繁匯款，多匯予與業務無關連的人士或公司
無法識別為真正交易的定期大額付款，涉及較高風險的司法管轄區
tc.explain: 第7.10(b)(v)段列出的現金相關預警指標為：多名客戶一同並同時使用不同分行進行大額（現金）交易。其餘三項分別是第7.10(b)段所列的其他預警指標：無法解釋的頻繁大額現金交易（(i)）、匯予無關連人士或公司的大額或頻繁匯款（(ii)），以及涉及較高風險司法管轄區、無法識別為真正交易的定期大額付款（(vii)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)段註腳62

en.q: What examples does the Guideline give of commodity types designated as higher risk for ML/TF/PF activities?
options: High-value, low-volume goods such as consumer electronics, and dual-use goods with high turnover and valuation difficulties
Commodities shipped to or from a country or jurisdiction designated as higher risk for money laundering or terrorist financing activities
A shipment size that appears inconsistent with the scale of the exporter's or importer's regular business activities
Commodities transhipped through one or more countries or jurisdictions for no apparent economic reason
en.explain: Footnote 62 to ¶7.10(c)(ii) gives as examples of higher-risk commodity types high-value, low-volume goods such as consumer electronics, and dual-use goods which have high turnover rates and present valuation difficulties. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(c) trade-based red flags: shipment to/from a higher-risk jurisdiction (i), a shipment size inconsistent with the business's scale (v), and transhipment through countries for no economic reason (x).

tc.q: 本指引就被列為洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集／擴散資金籌集較高風險的商品類型，舉出哪些例子？
options: 價值高、體積小的產品（例如消費電子），以及轉讓速度快、難以估值的兩用物品
商品被付運往返一個被指認為洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集「較高風險」的國家或司法管轄區
裝運或商品的大小，看似與出口商或進口商的常規業務活動規模不相稱
商品經一個或多個國家或司法管轄區轉運，而沒有明顯的經濟原因
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(ii)段註腳62就較高風險商品類型舉例：價值高、體積小的產品（例如消費電子），以及轉讓速度快、難以估值的兩用物品。其餘三項分別是第7.10(c)段所列的其他貿易相關預警指標：付運往返較高風險司法管轄區（(i)）、裝運規模與業務不相稱（(v)），以及經多國轉運而無明顯經濟原因（(x)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)(iii)及(iv)段

en.q: Which two discrepancies are listed as trade-based red flags?
options: Discrepancies between the commodity description on shipping documents and the goods shipped; and between invoiced value and fair market value
A shipment size inconsistent with the exporter's or importer's regular business scale; and a payment method inconsistent with the transaction's risk characteristics
Receipt of cash from a third party with no apparent connection to the transaction; and commodities shipped to a higher-risk jurisdiction
The commodity type itself designated as higher risk; and commodities transhipped through countries for no apparent economic reason
en.explain: ¶7.10(c)(iii) lists significant discrepancies between the description of the commodity on the bill of lading or invoice and the actual commodity shipped, and ¶7.10(c)(iv) lists significant discrepancies between the invoiced value and the commodity's fair market value. The distractors pair up other, distinct ¶7.10(c) trade-based red flags: shipment size/payment method inconsistency (v)+(vi), third-party cash receipt/higher-risk shipment (vii)+(i), and commodity type risk/transhipment (ii)+(x).

tc.q: 哪兩項差異被列為與貿易有關的預警指標？
options: 提單或發票上的商品說明與實際付運商品有差異；發票商品價值與市場價值亦有差異
裝運或商品的大小與出口商的業務規模不相稱；支付方法與交易的風險特徵不相稱
交易涉及向沒有明顯聯繫的第三方收取現金；商品付運往返一個較高風險的司法管轄區
付運的商品類別被指認為較高風險；商品經一個或多個國家轉運而沒有明顯經濟原因
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(iii)段列出提單或發票上的商品說明與實際付運商品之間出現重大差異，第7.10(c)(iv)段則列出發票商品價值與其公平市值之間出現重大差異。其餘三項分別配對了第7.10(c)段所列的其他不同貿易相關預警指標：裝運規模與付款方法不相稱（(v)+(vi)）、向無關連第三方收取現金與付運至較高風險司法管轄區（(vii)+(i)），以及商品類別風險與轉運（(ii)+(x)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)(vi)段註腳63

en.q: What example is given of a method of payment inconsistent with the risk characteristics of a trade transaction?
options: An advance payment for a shipment from a new supplier in a high-risk jurisdiction
The use of repeatedly amended or frequently extended letters of credit
A shipment size inconsistent with the scale of the exporter's or importer's regular business
Receipt of cash from a third party entity with no apparent connection to the transaction
en.explain: Footnote 63 to ¶7.10(c)(vi) gives as an example of a method of payment appearing inconsistent with the risk characteristics of the transaction the use of an advance payment for a shipment from a new supplier in a high-risk jurisdiction. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(c) trade-based red flags: repeatedly amended letters of credit (viii), an inconsistent shipment size (v), and third-party cash receipt (vii).

tc.q: 就付款方式與貿易交易風險特徵不相符，舉出甚麼例子？
options: 對來自高風險司法管轄區的新供應商付運預先付款
交易涉及使用一再修改或頻繁延期的信用證
裝運規模與出口商或進口商的常規業務活動規模不相稱
從與交易本身沒有明顯聯繫的第三方收取現金
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(vi)段註腳63就付款方式與該交易的風險特徵看似不相符舉例：就來自高風險司法管轄區的新供應商的付運採用預先付款。其餘三項分別是第7.10(c)段所列的其他不同貿易相關預警指標：一再修改或頻繁延期的信用證（(viii)）、裝運規模不相稱（(v)），以及向無關連第三方收取現金（(vii)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(c)(viii)及(ix)段

en.q: Which two trade-transaction red flags concern the documentation and corporate structure, rather than the goods, the route or the payment?
options: The use of repeatedly amended or frequently extended letters of credit; and the use of front or shell companies
A shipment size inconsistent with the exporter's business scale; and a payment method inconsistent with the transaction's risk characteristics
Commodities shipped to a higher-risk jurisdiction; and a commodity type itself designated as higher risk
Receipt of cash from an unconnected third party; and transhipment through countries for no apparent economic reason
en.explain: ¶7.10(c)(viii) lists transactions involving the use of repeatedly amended or frequently extended letters of credit, and ¶7.10(c)(ix) lists transactions involving the use of front (or shell) companies. The distractors pair up other, distinct ¶7.10(c) red flags: shipment size/payment method (v)+(vi), higher-risk jurisdiction/commodity type (i)+(ii), and third-party cash/transhipment (vii)+(x).

tc.q: 哪兩項貿易交易的預警訊號涉及單據及公司架構，而非貨品、路線或付款方式？
options: 使用一再修改或頻繁延期的信用證；以及使用門面（或空殼）公司
裝運規模與出口商業務不相稱；以及支付方法與交易風險特徵不相稱
商品付運往返較高風險司法管轄區；以及商品類別本身被指認為較高風險
從無明顯聯繫的第三方收取現金；以及商品經多國轉運而無明顯經濟原因
tc.explain: 第7.10(c)(viii)段列出交易涉及使用一再修改或頻繁延期的信用證；第7.10(c)(ix)段則列出交易涉及使用門面（或空殼）公司。其餘三項分別配對了第7.10(c)段所列的其他不同預警指標：裝運規模與付款方法（(v)+(vi)）、較高風險司法管轄區與商品類別（(i)+(ii)），以及第三方現金與轉運（(vii)+(x)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(d)(iv)段

en.q: Which charitable red flag is listed under other types of transactions?
options: A donation to a charity in a conflict zone or a jurisdiction with terrorist activity
Any donation made by wire transfer that reaches the $8,000 occasional transaction CDD threshold
A donation accompanied by false information given during the MSO's identification process
Account activity or transaction volume that is not commensurate with the customer's known personal profile
en.explain: ¶7.10(d)(iv) lists as a red flag a donation to a charity or non-profit organisation (NPO) located in a conflict zone or a jurisdiction reported to have terrorist activities or terrorist groups. The distractors mix a real but different figure (the $8,000 CDD threshold that applies specifically to occasional wire transfers, ¶4.2.1(b)(ii)) with two other, distinct ¶7.10(d) red flags: false information during identification (v) and account activity inconsistent with the known customer profile (i).

tc.q: 在「其他類型交易」中，列出哪一項與慈善有關的預警指標？
options: 向位於衝突地區或恐怖活動司法管轄區的慈善機構捐款
任何達到8,000元非經常交易客戶盡職審查門檻的電傳轉帳捐款
在該經營者的身分識別過程中提供虛假資料所伴隨的捐款
帳戶活動或交易量與客戶已知的個人狀況不相稱的捐款
tc.explain: 第7.10(d)(iv)段列出的預警指標為：向位於衝突地區或據報有恐怖活動／恐怖組織的司法管轄區的慈善機構或非牟利組織捐款。其餘三項混合了一個真實但不同的數字（適用於電傳轉帳非經常交易的8,000元客戶盡職審查門檻，見第4.2.1(b)(ii)段）與第7.10(d)段所列的另外兩項不同預警指標：識別過程中的虛假資料（(v)）及帳戶活動與已知客戶狀況不相稱（(i)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(d)(v)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns the identification process itself?
options: False information given during the identification process, or third parties used to conceal the sender or recipient of funds
The customer's address or authorised signatories change frequently and repeatedly
Transactions with jurisdictions or entities reported to be associated with terrorist activities or designated terrorists
Account activity or transaction volume that is not commensurate with the customer's known profile, such as age, occupation or income
en.explain: ¶7.10(d)(v) lists false information during the identification process, or the use of third parties to transfer funds aimed at concealing the sender and/or receiver of moneys. The distractors are other, distinct ¶7.10(d) red flags: frequent changes to address or authorised signatories (iii), transactions linked to terrorist activities or designated terrorists (ii), and account activity inconsistent with the known profile (i).

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及身分識別過程本身？
options: 在身分識別過程中提供虛假資料，或利用第三方轉移資金隱瞞收發款人
客戶的地址或獲授權簽署人的資料頻密地反覆更改
交易涉及的司法管轄區或實體，據稱與恐怖活動或已被指認的恐怖分子有關
帳戶活動或交易量，與已知的客戶狀況（例如年齡或職業）不相稱
tc.explain: 第7.10(d)(v)段列出在身分識別過程中提供虛假資料，或利用第三方轉移資金以隱瞞款項的寄款人及／或收款人。其餘三項分別是第7.10(d)段所列的其他不同預警指標：頻繁改變地址或授權簽署人（(iii)）、涉及恐怖活動或已被指認恐怖分子的司法管轄區或實體（(ii)），以及帳戶活動與已知客戶狀況不相稱（(i)）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(d)(vi)段

en.q: What does the Guideline note about the size of amounts in payments to or from tax havens or high-risk crime jurisdictions?
options: Amounts transacted are not necessarily to be large
Only amounts exceeding $120,000 are relevant
Only amounts over the CDD threshold are relevant
The size of the amount is the sole determinant
en.explain: ¶7.10(d)(vi) lists customers who send or receive regular payments from jurisdictions regarded as tax havens or likely to be exposed to serious crimes or high risk business such as drug trafficking, TF, smuggling, gambling or adult entertainments, and expressly adds that amounts transacted are not necessarily to be large.

tc.q: 就與避稅天堂或高風險罪案司法管轄區之間的付款，本指引就款額大小有何說明？
options: 交易款額不一定龐大
只有超過120,000元的款額方屬相關
只有超過客戶盡職審查門檻的款額方屬相關
款額大小是唯一的判斷準則
tc.explain: 第7.10(d)(vi)段列出客戶向被視為「避稅天堂」，或相當可能涉及嚴重罪行或高風險行業（例如販毒、恐怖分子資金籌集、走私、賭博或成人娛樂）的司法管轄區寄出或收取（經常性）付款；並明文補充交易款額不一定龐大。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(e)(iii)段

en.q: What is meant by an identification that 'evolves', as listed among red flags concerning agents or counterparts?
options: Some identification details change while others stay the same, across many transactions by one customer
The identity document is renewed on expiry and re-verified through the MSO's routine CDD process
The customer changes their legal name by deed poll and promptly updates their CDD records
The customer's photograph on file is updated periodically as part of ongoing monitoring
en.explain: ¶7.10(e)(iii): a large volume of transactions for the same customer with an identification that 'evolves' — where some parts of the identification change while other parts remain the same — is a red flag concerning agents or counterparts. Routine document renewal, a genuine deed-poll name change, or periodic photo updates are normal CDD housekeeping, not the indicator described.

tc.q: 在有關代理人或對手方的預警指標中，所謂身分識別資料「逐步變化」是指甚麼？
options: 部分身分識別資料有所改變，而其他部分則維持不變，貫穿同一客戶的大量交易
身分證明文件在屆滿後獲續期，並按該經營者的常規盡職審查程序重新核實
客戶其後以正式契據更改法定姓名，並主動即時更新其盡職審查紀錄
客戶存檔的相片按該經營者的持續監察安排而定期更新一次
tc.explain: 第7.10(e)(iii)段：就同一客戶的大量交易中，身分識別資料「逐步變化」——即部分內容有所改變，而其他部分維持不變——屬有關代理人或對手方的預警指標。常規文件續期、真實的契據改名，或定期更新照片，均屬正常的盡職審查工作，並非該指標所指的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(e)(iv)段

en.q: Which red flag concerns a customer's use of multiple agent locations?
options: The same customer sending funds on the same day to several agent locations, for the same or different recipients
An agent location handling an unusually high volume of large transactions compared with other agents in the same area
An agent or counterpart's reluctance to provide customers' identification information to the MSO
A customer using the agent location nearest to their home or workplace for every transaction
en.explain: ¶7.10(e)(iv): the transmission of funds by the same customer on the same day to several agent or counterpart locations, to purportedly the same or different recipients, is the listed red flag — a single agent's disproportionate transaction volume (¶7.10(e)(ii)) and an agent's reluctance to provide ID information (¶7.10(e)(i)) are different listed indicators, and using one's nearest branch is unremarkable.

tc.q: 哪一項預警指標涉及客戶使用多個代理點？
options: 同一客戶在同一日向多個代理點發出匯款，交予相同或不同的收款人
某代理點處理的大額交易量，較同區其他代理人或對手方地點明顯為高
代理人或對手方不願向該經營者提供客戶的身分識別資料
客戶每次交易均使用最接近其住所或工作地點的代理點
tc.explain: 第7.10(e)(iv)段：同一客戶在同一日向該經營者的多個代理人或對手方地點發出匯款，聲稱交予相同或不同的收款人，屬所列的預警指標——單一代理點交易量偏高（第7.10(e)(ii)段）及代理人不願提供身分資料（第7.10(e)(i)段）屬另外所列的指標，而使用最近分店則屬平常。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10(f)段

en.q: Which of the following is listed as a customer behaviour red flag?
options: The customer shows no interest in comparing MSOs' costs or exchange rates
The customer asks detailed, informed questions about the exchange rate before agreeing to transact
The customer requests a written receipt once the transaction is completed
The customer arrives at the MSO's premises shortly before the daily closing time
en.explain: ¶7.10(f)(iii): a customer showing no interest in comparing the costs or exchange rates offered by MSOs is a listed customer-behaviour red flag — asking informed rate questions, requesting a receipt, or arriving before closing are ordinary customer conduct, not listed indicators.

tc.q: 下列何者列為客戶行為方面的預警指標？
options: 客戶對比較各經營者的費用或匯率毫無興趣
客戶在同意交易前，就匯率提出詳細而熟悉市場的查詢
客戶在交易完成後，要求提供書面收據
客戶在每日的關門時間前不久到達該經營者的處所
tc.explain: 第7.10(f)(iii)段：客戶對比較各經營者所提供的費用及／或匯率毫無興趣，屬所列的客戶行為預警指標——熟悉市場地查詢匯率、要求收據，或在關門前到達，均屬平常的客戶行為，並非所列指標。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10段

en.q: What should the detection of a relevant red flag prompt an MSO to do?
options: Prompt further enquiries into the source of funds and additional CDD documentation
File an STR with the JFIU immediately, without the MLRO first evaluating the indicator
Terminate the business relationship immediately, before any further enquiry is made
Record the indicator on file and take no further action at all unless a second, separate indicator later appears
en.explain: ¶7.10 (closing paragraph): the detection of any relevant red flag should prompt further investigation and be a catalyst towards at least initial enquiries about the source of funds and additional CDD documentary support — it does not require an immediate STR bypassing MLRO evaluation, immediate termination, or inaction pending a second indicator.

tc.q: 偵測到相關預警指標時，金錢服務經營者應怎樣做？
options: 促使進一步查究資金來源，並索取額外的客戶盡職審查佐證文件
在洗錢報告主任評估該指標前，立即向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
在作出任何進一步查究之前，立即終止該業務關係
將該指標存檔記錄，除非其後出現另一項獨立指標，否則完全不採取任何行動
tc.explain: 第7.10段（結尾部分）：偵測到任何相關預警指標，應促使進一步調查，並成為契機，最少就資金來源作初步查詢及索取額外的客戶盡職審查佐證文件——並非毋須洗錢報告主任評估即時提交可疑交易報告、立即終止關係，或在無第二項指標前不採取行動。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.10段註腳61

en.q: According to footnote 61, where else might an MSO look for further red flag indicators beyond the Guideline's own list?
options: Guidance issued from time to time by the FATF, inter-governmental bodies, governments and authorities
The JFIU's quarterly report, which footnote 61 names as the sole approved external source for red flag indicators
The CCE's own disciplinary decisions issued against other licensed MSOs from time to time
The Basel Committee's published guidance on correspondent banking and cover payments
en.explain: Footnote 61 to ¶7.10 states that for more red flag indicators, reference can be made to relevant guidance issued by the FATF, inter-governmental organisations, governments and authorities from time to time (including FATF and APG typology materials) — it does not point to the JFIU's quarterly report as a sole source, to CCE disciplinary decisions, or to Basel Committee guidance.

tc.q: 根據註腳61，除本指引所列清單外，金錢服務經營者還可從何處參考更多預警指標？
options: 財務行動特別組織、政府間組織、各國政府及當局不時發出的相關指引
聯合財富情報組的季度報告——註腳61指明是唯一獲准的外部資料來源
關長不時對其他持牌金錢服務經營者作出的紀律處分決定
巴塞爾委員會就代理銀行業務及補足付款發出的指引
tc.explain: 第7.10段註腳61訂明，如需更多預警指標，可參考財務行動特別組織、政府間組織、各國政府及當局不時發出的相關指引（包括財務行動特別組織及亞太反洗錢組織的類型報告）——並非指明聯合財富情報組季度報告為唯一來源、關長的紀律處分決定，或巴塞爾委員會的指引。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.11段

en.q: In the JFIU's SAFE approach, what does the third step, 'F', require?
options: Finding out the customer's records
Filing a report with the JFIU
Freezing the funds pending review
Forwarding the matter to senior management
en.explain: ¶7.11 states that an MSO may adopt, where applicable, the SAFE approach promoted by the JFIU, which includes screening the account for suspicious indicators; asking the customer appropriate questions; finding out the customer's records; and evaluating all the above information.

tc.q: 在聯合財富情報組的「SAFE」方針中，第三步「F」要求甚麼？
options: 查閱該客戶的紀錄
向聯合財富情報組提交報告
在檢視期間凍結有關資金
將事宜轉呈高級管理層
tc.explain: 第7.11段訂明該經營者可在適用情況下採用聯合財富情報組推廣的「SAFE」方針，包括：就可疑指標篩查帳戶；向客戶提出適當問題；查閱該客戶的紀錄；以及評估上述所有資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.12段

en.q: What two matters must an MSO's clear policies and procedures on internal reporting ensure?
options: Staff know the MLRO's identity and reporting procedure, and reports reach the MLRO without undue delay
All staff are trained annually on AML/CFT, and all internal reports are made in writing and dated
All reports are first approved by a supervisor, and all reports are filed with the JFIU within 24 hours
All staff sign a confidentiality undertaking when joining the MSO, and all internal reports are anonymised before reaching the MLRO
en.explain: ¶7.12: clear policies and procedures should ensure that (a) all staff are made aware of the MLRO's identity and the procedure for making an internal report, and (b) all internal reports reach the MLRO without undue delay — not annual training and written reports, supervisor approval and a 24-hour JFIU filing deadline, or confidentiality undertakings and anonymised reports.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者就內部報告的清晰政策及程序，須確保哪兩方面？
options: 員工知悉洗錢報告主任的身分及報告程序，且報告毫不無理延誤地送達該主任
所有員工每年接受打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓，且所有內部報告均須以書面作出並註明日期
所有報告須先經主管批准，且所有報告須於24小時內向聯合財富情報組提交
所有員工於入職時簽署保密承諾，且所有內部報告在送達洗錢報告主任前須經匿名處理
tc.explain: 第7.12段：清晰的政策及程序應確保：(a)所有員工均知悉洗錢報告主任的身分，以及作出內部報告的程序；及(b)所有內部報告均毫不無理延誤地送達該主任——並非每年培訓及書面報告、主管批准及24小時內提交，或入職保密承諾及匿名報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.13段

en.q: May a supervisor or manager filter out a report raised by staff before it reaches the MLRO?
options: No — never, where that supervisor or manager has no responsibility for the ML reporting or compliance function
Yes, provided the supervisor documents their reasons for filtering out the report in writing and keeps a copy on file
Yes, where the supervisor genuinely considers the underlying suspicion to be unfounded
Yes, where the transaction that gave rise to the report is below the CDD threshold
en.explain: ¶7.13: under no circumstances should reports raised by staff be filtered out by supervisors or managers who have no responsibility for the ML reporting/compliance function — there is no exception for documenting reasons, for a supervisor's own view that the suspicion is unfounded, or for a sub-threshold transaction.

tc.q: 主管或經理可否在員工提出的報告送達洗錢報告主任前將其篩走？
options: 不可——如該主管或經理並不負責洗錢報告或合規職能
可以——只要該主管以書面記錄篩走報告的理由並存檔備查
可以——如該主管真心相信相關懷疑並無任何根據
可以——如引致該報告的交易低於客戶盡職審查門檻
tc.explain: 第7.13段：在任何情況下，均不得由並不負責洗錢報告／合規職能的主管或經理將職員提出的報告篩走——並無例外容許記錄理由、主管本身認為懷疑無根據，或交易低於門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.13段

en.q: Why should internal reporting lines be as short as possible?
options: Because the legal obligation is to report as soon as reasonable — short lines ensure speed, confidentiality and MLRO access
Because shorter reporting lines reduce the MSO's administrative and staffing costs each year
Because the CCE prescribes a maximum number of reviewers permitted in any MSO's internal reporting chain as a condition of its licence
Because staff generally prefer to deal directly with senior management rather than a supervisor
en.explain: ¶7.13: the legal obligation is to report as soon as it is reasonable to do so, so reporting lines should be as short as possible with the minimum number of people between the staff with the suspicion and the MLRO, ensuring speed, confidentiality and accessibility — not to cut costs, meet a CCE-prescribed reviewer cap, or match staff preference.

tc.q: 內部報告的層級為何應盡可能簡短？
options: 因為法律責任是盡快報告，簡短層級可確保迅速、保密及易於接觸該主任
因為較短的報告層級，每年均有助大幅降低該經營者的行政及人手成本開支
因為關長規定，任何經營者的內部報告鏈中審核人數設有上限
因為員工一般傾向直接與高級管理層接觸，而非透過主管
tc.explain: 第7.13段：法律責任是在合理範圍內盡快報告，故報告層級應盡可能簡短，令產生懷疑的員工與洗錢報告主任之間的人數減至最少，以確保迅速、保密及易於接觸——並非為節省成本、符合關長訂立的審核人數上限，或遷就員工的個人偏好。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.14段

en.q: When is a staff member's own statutory reporting obligation fully satisfied?
options: Once the staff member reports the suspicion to the MLRO, following the MSO's established policies and procedures
Only once the MLRO has actually filed an STR with the JFIU on the strength of that internal report
Only once the JFIU has formally acknowledged receipt of the STR that the MLRO subsequently files
Only once the customer's account has been formally reviewed and any restriction placed on its operation has been lifted
en.explain: ¶7.14: once a staff member has reported suspicion to the MLRO in accordance with the MSO's established policies and procedures, the staff member's statutory obligation is fully satisfied — the staff member need not wait for the MLRO to file an STR, for JFIU acknowledgement, or for any account review.

tc.q: 員工本身的法定報告責任在何時方屬完全履行？
options: 員工按該經營者訂立的政策及程序，向洗錢報告主任報告有關懷疑之時
須待洗錢報告主任根據該內部報告，實際向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告後
須待聯合財富情報組正式確認收到該主任其後提交的可疑交易報告後
須待該客戶的帳戶已正式覆核，且對其運作的任何限制已正式解除後
tc.explain: 第7.14段：員工一旦按該經營者訂立的政策及程序，向洗錢報告主任報告有關懷疑，該員工的法定責任即已完全履行——毋須待該主任提交可疑交易報告、聯合財富情報組確認收悉，或帳戶經正式覆核，方告履行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.15段

en.q: What should an internal report contain?
options: Sufficient details of the customer concerned and the information giving rise to the suspicion
The reporting staff member's own assessment of whether an STR should be filed with the JFIU
A complete copy of every document held on the customer's file since the account was opened
The customer's own explanation of the transaction, obtained by staff from the customer before the internal report is made
en.explain: ¶7.15: the internal report should include sufficient details of the customer concerned and the information giving rise to the suspicion. Assessing whether to file an STR is the MLRO's function (¶7.9, ¶7.17), not part of the report's content, and the report need not include a full customer file or a pre-obtained customer explanation — indeed seeking one risks tipping off.

tc.q: 內部報告應載有甚麼？
options: 有關客戶的充分詳情，以及引致該項懷疑的資料
作出報告的員工本身對應否向聯合財富情報組提交報告的評估
自開戶以來，該客戶檔案內每一份文件的完整副本
員工在作出內部報告前，先向客戶取得的該客戶對該宗交易的解釋
tc.explain: 第7.15段：內部報告應載有有關客戶的充分詳情，以及引致該項懷疑的資料。評估應否提交可疑交易報告屬洗錢報告主任的職能（第7.9及7.17段），並非報告內容的一部分；報告亦毋須包含完整客戶檔案或事先取得的客戶解釋——向客戶查問更有通風報訊之虞。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.16段

en.q: What two things should the MLRO do upon receiving an internal report?
options: Acknowledge receipt of the report, and remind the reporting staff of the tipping-off obligation
Acknowledge receipt, and inform the reporting staff of the outcome of the JFIU's eventual assessment
Notify the customer that a report has been made, and place the account under suspension
Notify the MSO's senior management of the report, and refer the matter to the external auditors
en.explain: ¶7.16: the MLRO should acknowledge receipt of an internal report and provide a reminder of the tipping-off obligation to the reporting staff — not report back the JFIU's eventual assessment (which would itself risk tipping off), notify the customer and suspend the account, or route the matter to senior management and external auditors.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任在收到內部報告時應作哪兩件事？
options: 確認收到該報告，並向作出報告的員工提醒有關通風報訊的責任
確認收到報告，並向作出報告的員工告知其後評估的最終結果
立即通知該客戶已作出報告，並將其帳戶暫停運作
將該報告通知該經營者的高級管理層，並將事宜轉介予外部審計師
tc.explain: 第7.16段：洗錢報告主任應在收到內部報告時確認收到，並向作出報告的員工提醒有關通風報訊的責任——並非回報聯合財富情報組其後的評估結果（此舉本身已有通風報訊之虞）、通知客戶並暫停帳戶，或轉交高級管理層及外部審計師。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.17段

en.q: What must the MLRO consider when evaluating an internal report?
options: All relevant information, including CDD and monitoring information on the entities the report concerns
Only the information contained within the internal report itself, without seeking further CDD or monitoring information
Only the specific transaction that triggered the internal report, examined entirely in isolation
Only information that the reporting staff member is personally able to verify as accurate
en.explain: ¶7.17: when evaluating an internal report, the MLRO must take reasonable steps to consider all relevant information, including CDD and ongoing monitoring information available within or to the MSO concerning the entities to which the report relates — the evaluation is not confined to the report itself, to the triggering transaction alone, or to information the reporting staff member could personally verify.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任在評估內部報告時，須考慮甚麼？
options: 所有相關資料，包括有關所涉實體的客戶盡職審查及持續監察資料
只限該內部報告本身所載的資料，並不再尋求任何盡職審查或監察資料
只限觸發該內部報告的該宗交易，並將其完全獨立地審視
只限作出報告的員工本人能夠核實準確無誤的資料
tc.explain: 第7.17段：洗錢報告主任在評估內部報告時，須採取合理步驟考慮所有相關資料，包括該經營者內部或可取得的、有關該報告所涉實體的客戶盡職審查及持續監察資料——評估範圍並不局限於該報告本身、觸發報告的單一交易，或作出報告的員工本人能核實的資料。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.17(a)段

en.q: Which approach should the MLRO preferably adopt when reviewing transaction patterns and volumes through connected accounts?
options: A relationship-based approach, rather than a transaction-by-transaction basis
A transaction-by-transaction basis, assessing each individual payment strictly on its own
An account-by-account basis, without any aggregation across connected accounts
A branch-by-branch basis, comparing volumes handled at each physical location
en.explain: ¶7.17(a): the MLRO's evaluation may include reviewing transaction patterns and volumes through connected accounts, preferably adopting a relationship-based approach rather than a transaction-by-transaction basis — the same preference as for transaction monitoring systems under ¶5.6 — not a strict transaction-by-transaction, account-by-account, or branch-by-branch method.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任在檢視相連帳戶的交易模式及交易量時，宜採用哪種方式？
options: 以關係為本的方式，而非按逐宗交易的方式
按逐宗交易的方式，將每筆款項嚴格個別評估
按逐個帳戶的方式，不對相連帳戶作任何匯總
按逐間分行的方式，比較各實體處所所處理的交易量
