tc.explain: 第7.17(a)款：洗錢報告主任的評估可包括檢視經相連帳戶進行的交易模式及交易量，並宜採用以關係為本的方式，而非按逐宗交易的方式——與第5.6段就交易監察系統所表達的取向一致——而非嚴格逐宗交易、逐個帳戶不作匯總，或逐間分行比較的方式。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.17(b)段

en.q: Which historical matters should the MLRO refer to when evaluating an internal report?
options: Previous instruction patterns, the length of the relationship, and CDD/monitoring information and documentation
The customer's personal credit history and loan repayment record, as compiled by banks and credit reference agencies
The MSO's own previous STRs concerning entirely different, unrelated customers
The customer's transaction dealings with other, unrelated money service operators
en.explain: ¶7.17(b): the MLRO's evaluation may include making reference to any previous patterns of instructions, the length of the business relationship, and CDD and ongoing monitoring information and documentation — not external credit history, the MSO's unrelated past STRs, or the customer's dealings with other operators.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任在評估內部報告時，應參考哪些過往事項？
options: 過往指示模式、業務關係的長短，以及盡職審查及監察資料
由銀行及信貸資料機構彙編的該客戶個人信貸紀錄及還款紀錄
該經營者過往就完全無關的其他客戶提交的可疑交易報告
該客戶與其他不相關的金錢服務經營者之間的交易往來
tc.explain: 第7.17(b)款：洗錢報告主任的評估可包括參考過往任何指示模式、業務關係的長短，以及客戶盡職審查及持續監察的資料及文件——並非外部信貸紀錄、該經營者與該客戶無關的過往報告，或該客戶與其他經營者的往來。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.18段

en.q: What competing considerations must an MSO weigh when deciding how far to search for information on connected accounts or relationships?
options: The statutory requirement to make a timely STR against any delay caused by searching for more information
The cost of conducting the search against its likely benefit to the MSO's bottom line
The customer's right to privacy against the MSO's own commercial interests in retaining them
The MLRO's existing workload against the overall volume of internal reports received across the whole MSO that month
en.explain: ¶7.18: the need to search for information concerning connected accounts or relationships should strike an appropriate balance between the statutory requirement to make a timely STR to the JFIU and any delays that searching for more information might cause — not a cost-benefit, privacy-versus-commercial-interest, or workload-versus-volume balance.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者在決定應搜尋相連帳戶或關係的資料至何種程度時，須權衡哪些相互競爭的考慮因素？
options: 適時提交可疑交易報告的法定規定，與搜尋更多資料可能造成的延誤
進行該項搜尋的成本，與其為該經營者帶來的實際整體效益
客戶本身的私隱權利，與該經營者本身的整體商業利益
洗錢報告主任本身現有的工作量，與該月整個經營者收到的內部報告總量
tc.explain: 第7.18段：搜尋有關相連帳戶或關係的資料的需要，應在適時向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告的法定規定，與搜尋更多相關資料可能引致的延誤之間，取得適當平衡——並非成本效益、私隱與商業利益，或工作量與報告數量之間的平衡。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.18段

en.q: What must be documented in relation to the MLRO's evaluation of an internal report?
options: The review process and any conclusions drawn
Only the decision whether or not to file an STR
Only the identity of the staff who conducted the review
Only those reviews that resulted in an STR being filed
en.explain: ¶7.18 states that the review process should be documented, together with any conclusions drawn. ¶7.21 reinforces the point in relation to a decision not to file, where records of the deliberations and actions taken are vital to demonstrate that the MLRO acted reasonably.

tc.q: 就洗錢報告主任對內部報告的評估，須記錄甚麼？
options: 檢視過程及所得的任何結論
只需是否提交可疑交易報告的決定
只需進行該項檢視的員工的身分
只需最終導致提交報告的檢視
tc.explain: 第7.18段訂明檢視過程應連同所得的任何結論一併記錄在案。第7.21段就決定不作報告的情況進一步強調此點：保存商議及所採取行動的紀錄，對證明該主任行事合理至為重要。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.19段

en.q: When may an STR be made in relation to the timing of the underlying transaction?
options: Before the transaction occurs, whether or not it proceeds, or after it is completed
Only before the transaction occurs, and only once it is confirmed that the transaction will proceed
Only after the JFIU has issued a written request asking the MSO to file a report on the matter
Only after the transaction has been declined and the customer's account has since been closed
en.explain: Paragraph 7.19 states that dependent on when knowledge or suspicion arises, an STR may be made either before a suspicious transaction or activity occurs (whether the intended transaction ultimately takes place or not), or after it has been completed. The rule does not require confirmation that the transaction will proceed, does not require a prior JFIU request, and is not limited to declined transactions.

tc.q: 就相關交易的時序而言，可疑交易報告可在何時作出？
options: 可在交易發生前作出（不論該交易最終有否進行），或在完成後作出
只可在交易發生前，並須待確認該交易的而且確會進行後方可作出
只可在聯合財富情報組就有關事宜發出書面要求該經營者提交報告後方可作出
只可在該交易已被拒絕，且客戶帳戶其後已被關閉的情況下作出
tc.explain: 第7.19段訂明，視乎知悉或懷疑產生的時間，可疑交易報告可在可疑交易或活動發生前作出（不論該擬進行的交易最終有否進行），或在其完成後作出；規定並不要求先確認交易會進行、並非須待聯合財富情報組發出書面要求，也不限於交易已被拒絕的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.19段

en.q: What should an MSO that controls both the ordering and the beneficiary sides of a suspicious wire transfer do?
options: File an STR in each affected jurisdiction, and share the details with the Financial Intelligence Unit
File an STR in Hong Kong only, treating it as the MSO's sole home jurisdiction of licence
File an STR only in the jurisdiction of the beneficiary institution, never the ordering side
Give the JFIU an initial telephone notification only, and treat that call as fully satisfying the STR obligation
en.explain: Paragraph 7.19 states that in the case of an MSO that controls both the ordering and the beneficiary sides of a wire transfer, the MSO should also file an STR in any jurisdiction affected by the suspicious wire transfer, and make relevant transaction information available to the Financial Intelligence Unit -- not Hong Kong alone, not the beneficiary side alone. An initial telephone notification is what paragraph 7.21 reserves for exceptional urgent cases, and does not substitute for the STR itself.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者同時控制可疑電傳轉帳的匯款方及收款方，應怎樣做？
options: 在受該電傳轉帳影響的每個司法管轄區提交報告，並向財富情報機構提供交易資料
只在香港——即該經營者的發牌所在司法管轄區——提交可疑交易報告
只在收款機構所在的司法管轄區提交報告，匯款方所在的司法管轄區則無須提交
只以電話向聯合財富情報組作初步通知，並視之為已完全履行提交可疑交易報告的責任
tc.explain: 第7.19段訂明，如某金錢服務經營者同時控制電傳轉帳的匯款方及收款方，該經營者亦應在受該可疑電傳轉帳影響的每個司法管轄區提交可疑交易報告，並向財富情報機構提供相關交易資料——並非只限香港，也並非只限收款方所在司法管轄區。第7.21段所述的初步電話通知只保留予情況特殊的緊急報告，並不能取代書面可疑交易報告本身。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.20段

en.q: What is the position on criminal liability where an MLRO decides in good faith not to file an STR?
options: Unlikely, provided the MLRO acted in good faith and found no suspicion after considering all available information
Automatic liability applies, matching the 3-month imprisonment and fine paragraph 7.1 fixes for non-reporting
Liability depends solely on whether the customer is later convicted of the underlying offence
The MLRO must first obtain the CCE's written confirmation before deciding not to report
en.explain: Paragraph 7.20 states that providing an MLRO acts in good faith in deciding not to file an STR, it is unlikely that there will be any criminal liability for failing to report if the MLRO concludes there is no suspicion after taking into account all available information. The paragraph 7.1 penalty attaches to an actual failure to report a genuine suspicion, not to a good-faith conclusion that no suspicion exists; liability does not turn on the customer's later conviction, and no CCE confirmation is required.

tc.q: 如洗錢報告主任真誠地決定不提交可疑交易報告，刑事責任的情況如何？
options: 只要該主任真誠行事，並在考慮所有可得資料後認為並無懷疑，相當可能不會負上刑事責任
一律自動負上刑事責任，因第7.1段就未有舉報訂明監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
責任純粹取決於該客戶其後有否因相關罪行被定罪，而非取決於該主任的真誠判斷
該主任決定不作報告前，須先取得關長就個案發出的書面確認，否則該決定無效
tc.explain: 第7.20段訂明，只要洗錢報告主任真誠地作出不提交可疑交易報告的決定，且在考慮所有可得資料後認為並無懷疑，則相當可能不會因未有報告而負上刑事責任。第7.1段所訂的刑罰適用於未有就真實懷疑作出舉報的情況，並非適用於真誠地認為並無懷疑的個案；責任並不取決於客戶其後有否被定罪，亦無須關長的書面確認。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.20段

en.q: Why is it vital for the MLRO to keep proper records of deliberations and actions taken?
options: To demonstrate that he has acted in a reasonable manner
To satisfy the record-keeping requirement in section 13 of Schedule 2
To provide evidence for the customer if the account is later closed
To support an application to the JFIU for consent
en.explain: ¶7.20 states that it is vital for the MLRO to keep proper records of the deliberations and actions taken to demonstrate that he has acted in a reasonable manner — the evidential basis on which the good-faith position in the same paragraph rests.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任為何必須妥為保存商議及所採取行動的紀錄？
options: 以證明其行事合理
以符合附表2第13條的備存紀錄規定
以便在帳戶其後被關閉時為該客戶提供證據
以支持向聯合財富情報組申請同意
tc.explain: 第7.20段訂明洗錢報告主任必須妥為保存商議及所採取行動的紀錄，以證明其行事合理——這正是同段所述真誠行事立場的證據基礎。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.21段

en.q: Which circumstances does the Guideline give as examples of when urgent reporting is required?
options: Where the customer instructs the MSO to move funds, close the account, or ready cash for collection
Where a transaction exceeds $120,000, the CDD threshold for non-wire-transfer transactions
Where the customer's transaction volume increases sharply without any apparent cause
Where the customer is identified as a non-Hong Kong politically exposed person
en.explain: Paragraph 7.21 gives urgent-reporting examples as where a customer has instructed the MSO to move funds or other property, close the account, make cash available for collection, or carry out significant changes to the relationship. $120,000 is the paragraph 8.4 CDD/record-keeping threshold, not an urgent-reporting trigger; a sharp rise in transaction volume is a paragraph 7.10 red-flag indicator of suspicion, not itself an urgent-reporting example; and PEP status is a risk factor addressed elsewhere in the Guideline, not listed in paragraph 7.21.

tc.q: 本指引就何時需要緊急報告，舉出哪些情況為例？
options: 客戶指示該經營者轉移資金或其他財產、關閉帳戶，或備妥現金以供提取
交易金額超過120,000元，即非電傳轉帳類交易的盡職審查門檻
客戶的交易量在沒有明顯原因的情況下大幅上升，且未能合理解釋
該客戶被識辨為非香港的政治人物，屬於較高風險客戶類別
tc.explain: 第7.21段舉出的緊急報告例子，包括客戶指示該經營者轉移資金或其他財產、關閉帳戶、備妥現金以供提取，或對業務關係作出重大改動。120,000元是第8.4段客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄的門檻，並非緊急報告的觸發情況；交易量大幅上升是第7.10段所列的可疑交易指標，並非第7.21段所舉的緊急報告例子；政治人物身分則屬本指引其他章節處理的風險因素，並非第7.21段所列的情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.21段

en.q: What should be considered where exceptional circumstances exist in relation to an urgent report?
options: An initial notification by telephone to the JFIU
Delivery of the report to the JFIU by hand
Notification of the CCE in the first instance
Suspension of the customer's account pending a written report
en.explain: ¶7.21 states that where exceptional circumstances exist in relation to an urgent reporting, an initial notification by telephone to the JFIU should be considered — in addition to indicating the urgency in the STR itself.

tc.q: 如緊急報告涉及特殊情況，應考慮甚麼？
options: 先以電話向聯合財富情報組作初步通知
將報告親自遞交聯合財富情報組
先行通知海關關長
在書面報告提交前暫停該客戶的帳戶
tc.explain: 第7.21段訂明如緊急報告涉及特殊情況，應考慮先以電話向聯合財富情報組作初步通知——此外仍須在可疑交易報告本身註明其緊急性。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.22段

en.q: What is an MSO recommended to indicate in its initial STR to the JFIU?
options: Any intention to terminate the business relationship
The date on which the account will next be reviewed
The identity of the staff member who raised the internal report
The amount of any fees earned from the customer
en.explain: ¶7.22 states that an MSO is recommended to indicate any intention to terminate a business relationship in its initial STR to the JFIU.

tc.q: 本指引建議金錢服務經營者在其初次向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告中註明甚麼？
options: 終止該業務關係的任何意向
該帳戶下次檢視的日期
提出內部報告的員工身分
從該客戶所賺取的費用金額
tc.explain: 第7.22段訂明建議該經營者在其初次向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告中，註明終止業務關係的任何意向。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.23段註腳65

en.q: What does the JFIU's quarterly report consist of, and how may an MSO obtain access?
options: STR analysis and matters of interest and feedback, in a secure area of the JFIU's website
Statistics on prosecutions and a list of designated persons, published in the Gazette
A summary of court decisions and sanctions updates, circulated internally by the CCE each quarter
FATF typologies and enforcement news, compiled by the CCE and sent to MSOs by post
en.explain: Footnote 65 to paragraph 7.23 states that the quarterly report consists of two parts -- analysis of STRs, and matters of interest and feedback -- and is available at a secure area of the JFIU's website, for which MSOs can apply for a login name and password. It is not Gazette-published prosecution statistics, not a CCE circular of court decisions, and not FATF material posted to MSOs.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組的季度報告包含甚麼？金錢服務經營者可如何取得？
options: 可疑交易報告分析及關注事項與回饋，載於聯合財富情報組網站保安區，可登入查閱
檢控統計數字及被指定人士的名單，按月於憲報刊登，供公眾查閱
法院判決摘要及制裁名單更新，由關長按季傳閱予各金錢服務經營者
財務行動特別組織發出的類型分析及執法消息，由關長彙編後按月以郵遞方式寄予經營者
tc.explain: 第7.23段註腳65訂明該季度報告分為兩部分——可疑交易報告分析，以及值得關注的事項及回饋——載於聯合財富情報組網站的保安區，金錢服務經營者可申請登入名稱及密碼查閱；並非於憲報刊登的檢控統計數字，也不是由關長傳閱的法院判決摘要，更不是以郵遞方式寄發的財務行動特別組織類型分析。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.23段

en.q: Whose feedback and guidance should an MSO take into account to ensure STRs are of high quality?
options: The JFIU, in its quarterly report, and the CCE from time to time
The Financial Action Task Force and the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering
The MSO's own external auditors and its appointed legal advisers
The MSO's correspondent banks and the intermediary that referred the customer
en.explain: Paragraph 7.23 states that an MSO should ensure STRs filed to the JFIU are of high quality, taking into account feedback and guidance provided by the JFIU in its quarterly report and the CCE from time to time -- not the FATF or the APG (international standard-setting bodies not named in this paragraph), not the MSO's own auditors or legal advisers, and not its correspondent banks or referring intermediaries.

tc.q: 為確保可疑交易報告質素良好，金錢服務經營者應顧及何人的回饋及指引？
options: 聯合財富情報組於其季度報告，以及關長不時提供者
財務行動特別組織及亞太反洗錢組織所提供者
該經營者的外聘核數師及委聘的法律顧問所提供者
該經營者的代理銀行，以及轉介該客戶的中介人所提供者
tc.explain: 第7.23段訂明該經營者應顧及聯合財富情報組於其季度報告，以及關長不時提供的回饋及指引，以確保提交的可疑交易報告質素良好——並非財務行動特別組織或亞太反洗錢組織（國際訂標準機構，本段並無提及）、並非該經營者的外聘核數師或法律顧問，也並非其代理銀行或轉介客戶的中介人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.24段

en.q: When will the JFIU usually give consent for an MSO to operate the account after an STR?
options: Where there is no need for imminent action, such as a restraint order on the account
In every case automatically, regardless of whether a restraint order is expected
Only after the criminal investigation and related court proceedings have concluded
Only where the MSO first obtains the CCE's written consent to operate the account
en.explain: Paragraph 7.24 states that if there is no need for imminent action, e.g. the issue of a restraint order on an account, consent will usually be given for the MSO to operate the account; otherwise the MSO should take appropriate action and seek legal advice. Consent is not automatic in every case, does not wait for the investigation or court proceedings to conclude, and it is the JFIU -- not the CCE -- that gives consent under this paragraph.

tc.q: 在提交可疑交易報告後，聯合財富情報組通常在甚麼情況下同意該經營者操作有關帳戶？
options: 在無需即時採取行動（例如就該帳戶發出限制令）的情況下
不論是否預期會就帳戶發出限制令，所有情況下均會同意
須待相關的刑事調查及任何法庭程序完全完結後
須待該經營者先取得關長就該帳戶運作發出的書面同意
tc.explain: 第7.24段訂明，如無需即時採取行動（例如就帳戶發出限制令），聯合財富情報組通常會同意該經營者操作有關帳戶；否則該經營者應採取適當行動並在有需要時尋求法律意見。同意並非在所有情況下自動作出，亦毋須待刑事調查或法庭程序完結；給予同意的是聯合財富情報組，並非關長，故亦無須先取得關長的書面同意。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.25段

en.q: On what conditions does filing an STR provide a statutory defence to the offence of ML/TF in respect of the acts disclosed?
options: Made before the acts with the JFIU's consent, or after them, on the MSO's own initiative and promptly
Made at any time before the MSO is formally charged with the ML/TF offence in question
Made within 30 days of the transaction taking place, regardless of consent
Made, and the matter is later featured in the JFIU's quarterly report to raise AML/CFT awareness sector-wide
en.explain: Paragraph 7.25 states that filing an STR provides a statutory defence provided (a) the report is made before the MSO undertakes the disclosed acts and they are undertaken with the JFIU's consent, or (b) the report is made after the acts, on the MSO's own initiative and as soon as reasonable. The defence does not turn on whether the MSO has yet been charged, there is no 30-day deadline in paragraph 7.25, and mention in the footnote-65 quarterly report (a separate feedback mechanism) is not one of the two conditions.

tc.q: 就報告所披露的作為，提交可疑交易報告在甚麼條件下可提供洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集罪行的法定免責辯護？
options: 在作出所披露作為之前，經聯合財富情報組同意提交；或在作為之後，由該經營者主動盡快提交
只要在該經營者被正式落案控告該洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集罪行之前的任何時間提交即可
須於相關交易發生後30日內向聯合財富情報組提交報告，不論有否取得同意
提交報告，且其後於聯合財富情報組的季度報告中被引用，以提高打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的意識
tc.explain: 第7.25段訂明，提交可疑交易報告可提供法定免責辯護，惟須符合：(a)報告在該經營者作出所披露作為之前提交，且該等作為經聯合財富情報組同意而作出；或(b)報告在該經營者作出該等作為之後，由該經營者主動並在合理範圍內盡快提交。免責辯護並非取決於該經營者有否已被落案控告，第7.25段亦無訂明30日的時限；而註腳65所述的季度報告是另一項回饋機制，並非該兩項條件之一。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.26段

en.q: What does the statutory defence in paragraph 7.25 NOT do?
options: It does not remove the legal, reputational or regulatory risk of keeping the account open
It does not extend to a report made before the disclosed transaction, only after
It does not continue to apply once the JFIU has given its consent to operate the account
It does not extend to terrorist financing offences, only to money laundering
en.explain: Paragraph 7.26 states that the statutory defence in paragraph 7.25 does not absolve an MSO from the legal, reputational or regulatory risks associated with the account's continued operation. Paragraph 7.25 makes the defence available to reports made either before or after the disclosed acts, so it is not limited to reports made after (it also covers pre-transaction reports made with consent); it does not lapse once consent is given; and it covers both ML and TF offences, not ML alone.

tc.q: 第7.25段所述的法定免責辯護不能達到甚麼效果？
options: 不能免除因繼續操作該帳戶而生的法律、聲譽或監管風險
不適用於在所披露交易發生前作出的報告，只適用於其後作出的報告
一旦聯合財富情報組同意該經營者操作該帳戶，即不再適用
不適用於恐怖分子資金籌集罪行，只適用於洗錢罪行
tc.explain: 第7.26段訂明第7.25段所述的法定免責辯護，並不能免除該經營者因繼續操作該帳戶而承受的法律、聲譽或監管風險。第7.25段的免責辯護適用於在所披露作為之前或之後提交的報告，故並非只限其後作出的報告（交易前經同意提交的報告同樣受保障）；亦不會在聯合財富情報組同意後即告失效；並同時涵蓋洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集罪行，並非只限洗錢罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.26段

en.q: How should a 'consent' response from the JFIU to a pre-transaction report be understood?
options: Not as a clean bill of health for the account, or as proof it poses no risk to the MSO
As confirmation that the account carries no ML/TF risk and needs no further ongoing monitoring
As removing the need for any further review of the business relationship
As an obligation on the MSO to keep operating the business relationship
en.explain: Paragraph 7.26 states that an MSO should be aware that a 'consent' response from the JFIU to a pre-transaction report should not be construed as a 'clean bill of health' for the continued operation of the account or an indication that the account does not pose a risk to the MSO. It does not confirm the account is risk-free, does not remove the need for further review (paragraph 7.27 requires one regardless of JFIU feedback), and creates no obligation to keep the relationship open.

tc.q: 聯合財富情報組就交易前報告作出的「同意」回應，應如何理解？
options: 不應視為帳戶的「無風險證明」，也不代表帳戶對經營者無風險
視為確認該帳戶並無洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，無須再作監察
視為已完全免除對該業務關係作進一步覆核的需要
視為該經營者從此有責任繼續維持該業務關係不變
tc.explain: 第7.26段訂明該經營者應知悉，聯合財富情報組就交易前報告作出的「同意」回應，不應理解為繼續操作該帳戶的「無風險證明」，亦不表示該帳戶對該經營者不構成風險。「同意」並不確認該帳戶並無風險，也不能免除進一步覆核的需要（第7.27段要求不論該組其後有否提供回饋均須覆核），更不會令該經營者有責任繼續維持該業務關係。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.27段

en.q: What review should an MSO conduct upon filing an STR, and does it depend on the JFIU's response?
options: A review of the relationship with risk-mitigating measures, regardless of any later JFIU feedback
A review only if and precisely when the JFIU withholds its consent to operate the account in question
A review only at the MSO's next scheduled periodic review date, never sooner than that
No review is required at all once the STR has already been filed with the JFIU
en.explain: Paragraph 7.27 states that an MSO should conduct an appropriate review of a business relationship upon the filing of an STR, irrespective of any subsequent feedback provided by the JFIU, and apply appropriate risk-mitigating measures. The review is not conditional on the JFIU withholding consent, is not deferred to the next scheduled periodic date, and filing the STR does not end the MSO's own review obligation.

tc.q: 提交可疑交易報告後，金錢服務經營者應進行甚麼檢視？該檢視是否取決於聯合財富情報組的回應？
options: 對業務關係進行適當覆核，並採取風險緩減措施，不論該組其後有否提供回饋
只在聯合財富情報組不同意該經營者操作該帳戶的情況下，方須進行覆核
只須待該經營者下次的定期覆核日期屆滿時方進行覆核，之前無須進行
一旦已向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，即無須再進行任何覆核
tc.explain: 第7.27段訂明該經營者應在提交可疑交易報告後，對業務關係進行適當覆核，不論聯合財富情報組其後有否提供任何回饋，並採取適當的風險緩減措施。覆核並非只在該組不同意操作帳戶時方須進行，也不應押後至下次定期覆核日期，提交報告後該經營者本身的覆核責任亦不會就此終止。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.27段

en.q: What practice does paragraph 7.27 expressly state is not acceptable?
options: Filing a report but continuing the relationship without considering risk or controls
Terminating the business relationship immediately the moment an STR has been filed
Escalating the matter promptly to the MSO's senior management for a decision on handling it
Filing a further STR about the same customer's later transactions, once they occur
en.explain: Paragraph 7.27 states that filing a report with the JFIU and continuing to operate the relationship without any further consideration of the risks and the imposition of appropriate controls to mitigate the risks identified is not acceptable. Immediate termination, escalation to senior management, and filing further STRs are not what the paragraph flags as unacceptable -- the unacceptable practice is inaction on risk after filing.

tc.q: 第7.27段明文指出哪一種做法並不可接受？
options: 提交報告後仍繼續經營該關係，卻不考慮風險或管控
在提交可疑交易報告的同時，立即終止該項業務關係
將事宜呈報該經營者的高級管理層，以決定如何處理
就同一客戶其後發生的交易，提交進一步的可疑交易報告
tc.explain: 第7.27段訂明，向聯合財富情報組提交報告後繼續經營該業務關係，卻不再進一步考慮風險，亦不施加適當管控以減低所識別的風險，此做法並不可接受。立即終止業務關係、呈報高級管理層，以及就同一客戶提交進一步報告，均非第7.27段指明的不可接受做法——不可接受的是提交報告後對風險不作為。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.27段

en.q: On what basis should senior management determine how to handle a relationship escalated to it after an STR?
options: In line with the MSO's business objectives and its risk-mitigation capacity
Solely on how profitable the business relationship has been to date
Solely on whether or not the JFIU has already granted consent to operate the account
Solely on how long the business relationship has already been running
en.explain: Paragraph 7.27 states that if necessary the issue should be escalated to the MSO's senior management to determine how to handle the relationship, in line with the MSO's business objectives and its capacity to mitigate the identified risks. The decision does not turn solely on past profitability, on the JFIU's consent decision, or on how long the relationship has lasted.

tc.q: 就提交可疑交易報告後呈報上來的業務關係，高級管理層應按甚麼基礎決定如何處理？
options: 按該經營者的業務目標，以及其減低所識別風險的能力
純粹按該業務關係至今為止的盈利能力而定
純粹按聯合財富情報組有否同意該經營者操作該帳戶而定
純粹按該業務關係已維持的年期長短而定
tc.explain: 第7.27段訂明如有需要，應將事宜呈報該經營者的高級管理層，按該經營者的業務目標及其減低所識別風險的能力，決定如何處理有關業務關係。有關決定並非純粹按該關係至今的盈利能力、聯合財富情報組的同意決定，或該關係已維持的年期而定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.28段

en.q: Does reporting a suspicion about one transaction remove the need to report further suspicions about the same customer?
options: No, further suspicious transactions of any nature must still reach the MLRO
Yes, a single STR filed for a customer satisfies the reporting obligation going forward
Yes, unless the further suspicious transactions are of a different nature
No, but further reports skip the MLRO entirely and go straight to the JFIU
en.explain: Paragraph 7.28 states that an MSO should be aware that reporting a suspicion in respect of a transaction or event does not remove the need to report further suspicious transactions or events in respect of the same customer; further suspicious transactions or events, whether of the same nature or different, must continue to be reported to the MLRO, who should make further reports to the JFIU if appropriate. A single STR does not discharge future obligations, the 'different nature' qualifier creates no exception, and reports still go through the MLRO, not directly to the JFIU.

tc.q: 就某宗交易報告懷疑後，是否已無須就同一客戶的進一步懷疑作出報告？
options: 否——不論性質相同或不同，進一步的可疑交易仍須向洗錢報告主任報告
是——就某客戶提交一份可疑交易報告，已足以履行日後的舉報責任
是——但僅限於進一步的可疑交易屬不同性質的情況
否——但進一步的報告一律須繞過洗錢報告主任，直接交予聯合財富情報組
tc.explain: 第7.28段訂明該經營者應知悉，就某交易或事件報告懷疑，並不免除就同一客戶報告進一步可疑交易或事件的需要；不論性質相同或不同，均須繼續向洗錢報告主任報告，該主任並應在適當時向聯合財富情報組作進一步報告。提交一份可疑交易報告並不能免除日後的舉報責任，「性質不同」亦不構成例外，報告仍須經洗錢報告主任處理，而非直接交予該組。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.29段

en.q: What should the record of ML/TF reports made to the MLRO include?
options: The date, who handled it, the assessment results, whether it led to an STR, and how to find the papers
Only the internal reports that actually and eventually resulted in a formal STR filed with the JFIU
Only the date of the report and the full name of the staff member who first made it
Only the customer's full name, account number, and declared nationality on file
en.explain: Paragraph 7.29 states that an MSO must establish and maintain a record of all ML/TF reports made to the MLRO, including the date the report was made, the staff members subsequently handling it, the results of the assessment, whether the internal report resulted in an STR, and information to allow the relevant papers to be located. It is not limited to reports that resulted in an STR, is not limited to the date and reporter's name, and does not turn on the customer's name, account number or nationality.

tc.q: 向洗錢報告主任作出的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集報告紀錄應載有甚麼？
options: 日期、處理人員、評估結果、有否致使提交報告，以及文件所在
只需備存最終導致須提交可疑交易報告的相關內部報告及紀錄
只需備存報告日期，以及作出該報告的職員姓名及職級
只需備存該客戶的姓名、帳戶號碼、國籍及聯絡電話
tc.explain: 第7.29段訂明該經營者須就所有向洗錢報告主任作出的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集報告，建立及維持紀錄，內容包括作出報告的日期、其後處理的人員、評估結果、該內部報告有否導致提交可疑交易報告，以及可據以找出相關文件的資料。紀錄並非只限最終導致提交可疑交易報告的個案，亦不只限日期及職員姓名，更與客戶的姓名、帳戶號碼或國籍無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.30段

en.q: What should the register of STRs made to the JFIU include, and may it be combined with the internal report register?
options: Its date, who made it, and how to find the papers; combinable with the internal register
The date and the customer's name only; the two registers must always be kept separate
The full text of every STR ever filed; the two registers must always be kept fully separate
Only the JFIU's reference number for each STR; the two registers must always be combined
en.explain: Paragraph 7.30 states that an MSO must establish and maintain a record of all STRs made to the JFIU, including the date of the STR, the person who made it, and information to allow the relevant papers to be located; this register may be combined with the register of internal reports if considered appropriate. It is not limited to date and customer name, does not require the full text of each STR, and combining the registers is optional, not compulsory either way.

tc.q: 向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告登記冊應載有甚麼？可否與內部報告登記冊合併？
options: 提交日期、提交人，以及文件所在資料；可與內部登記冊合併
只需日期及客戶姓名；兩份登記冊須一律分開保存，不得合併
每份可疑交易報告的全文；兩份登記冊須一律分開保存
只需每份報告的聯合財富情報組檔案編號；兩份登記冊須一律合併
tc.explain: 第7.30段訂明該經營者須就所有向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告，建立及維持紀錄，內容包括提交日期、提交報告的人，以及可據以找出相關文件的資料；如認為適當，該登記冊可與內部報告登記冊合併。紀錄並非只限日期及客戶姓名，亦無須備存每份報告的全文，而合併與否屬可選擇的做法，並非強制分開或強制合併。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.31段

en.q: Which court documents may an MSO be served with by law enforcement agencies?
options: Search warrants, production orders, restraint orders or confiscation orders
Injunctions and winding-up petitions filed by the company's creditors
Summonses and witness subpoenas issued by the Magistrates' Courts
Licence suspension notices issued by the CCE under the Licensing Guide
en.explain: Paragraph 7.31 states that an MSO may be served with various court documents from law enforcement agencies, e.g. search warrants, production orders, restraint orders or confiscation orders, pursuant to relevant legislation in Hong Kong. Injunctions and winding-up petitions are civil remedies sought by creditors, summonses and subpoenas belong to a separate court process, and CCE licence suspension notices are a disciplinary tool under the Licensing Guide -- none of these are the paragraph 7.31 examples.

tc.q: 執法機關可向金錢服務經營者送達哪些法庭文件？
options: 搜查令、交出物料令、限制令或充公令
由債權人向法院申請的禁制令及公司清盤呈請
由裁判法院發出的傳票及證人傳票
關長根據發牌指引發出的暫時吊銷牌照通知
tc.explain: 第7.31段訂明該經營者可能會依據香港的相關法例，獲執法機構送達各類法庭文件，例如搜查令、交出物料令、限制令或充公令。禁制令及公司清盤呈請是債權人尋求的民事濟助，傳票及證人傳票屬另一套法庭程序，而關長根據發牌指引發出的暫時吊銷牌照通知則是一項紀律工具——三者均非第7.31段所舉的例子。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.31段

en.q: What should an MSO's policies and procedures for handling court documents include?
options: Accurate information, sufficient resources, and a staff contact for law enforcement
Referral of every court document received to external legal counsel before any response is given
Notification of the customer concerned before the MSO responds to the document
Notification of the CCE before the MSO responds to any court document received
en.explain: Paragraph 7.31 states that an MSO should establish clear policies and procedures to handle court documents in an effective and timely manner, including provision of accurate information, allocation of sufficient resources, and appointing a staff member as the main point of contact with law enforcement agencies. It does not require referring every document to external counsel, notifying the customer, or notifying the CCE before responding.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者處理法庭文件的政策及程序應包括甚麼？
options: 提供準確資料、足夠資源，並委派專人作為執法機構聯絡點
在作出任何回應之前，一律將每份法庭文件轉交外聘法律顧問處理
在該經營者就該法庭文件作出回應前，須先行通知有關客戶
在該經營者回應任何已接獲的法庭文件前，先行通知關長
tc.explain: 第7.31段訂明該經營者應建立清晰的政策及程序，以有效及適時的方式處理法庭文件，包括提供準確資料、調配足夠資源，以及委派一名員工作為與執法機構的主要聯絡點。有關規定並不要求將每份文件轉交外聘法律顧問、在回應前通知有關客戶，或在回應前通知關長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.32段

en.q: How must an MSO respond to a search warrant or production order, and what should it do if it cannot meet the timeframe?
options: Provide all information in scope on time; if unable, contact the officer-in-charge
Respond only to what it considers relevant, and apply to the court for an extension of time
Respond within 30 days in every case, and notify the CCE of any delay in doing so
Obtain legal advice before responding, and inform the customer that the request was received
en.explain: Paragraph 7.32 states that an MSO must respond to any search warrant and production order within the required time limit by providing all the information or material that fall within the scope of the court document, and that where it encounters difficulty in complying with the timeframes it should at the earliest opportunity contact the officer-in-charge of the investigation for further guidance. The response is not limited to what the MSO itself considers relevant, there is no fixed 30-day rule, and there is no requirement to notify the customer of the request.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須如何回應搜查令或交出物料令？如未能符合時限應怎樣做？
options: 須按時限提供文件範圍內的資料；如未能符合應盡早聯絡調查主管
只須就其認為相關的部分回應；並向法院申請延長回應時限
不論任何情況，均須於30日內盡快回應；並將任何延誤情況通知關長
須先取得法律意見方可回應；並須告知該客戶已接獲該要求
tc.explain: 第7.32段訂明該經營者須在規定的時限內，就任何搜查令及交出物料令，提供屬該法庭文件範圍內的所有資料或物料；如遇上遵守時限方面的困難，應盡早聯絡負責該調查的主管人員以取得進一步指引。回應範圍並非只限該經營者自行認為相關的部分，第7.32段亦無訂明劃一的30日時限，也沒有須將該要求告知客戶的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.33段

en.q: What does a restraint order do, and what must an MSO ensure?
options: Bars dealing with the funds or property pending the outcome; the MSO must be able to withhold it
Permanently confiscates the property in question; the MSO must transfer it to the court registry at once
Closes the customer's account immediately; the MSO must return any balance to the customer
Requires reporting of all future transactions; the MSO must notify the JFIU every month
en.explain: Paragraph 7.33 states that during a law-enforcement investigation an MSO may be served with a restraint order, which prohibits dealing with particular funds or property pending the outcome of an investigation, and that the MSO must ensure it is able to withhold the relevant property that is the subject of the order. A restraint order does not permanently confiscate property (that is a confiscation order under paragraph 7.34), does not require closing the account, and creates no monthly JFIU reporting obligation.

tc.q: 限制令有何作用？金錢服務經營者須確保甚麼？
options: 禁止處理某些資金或財產直至調查有結果；該經營者須能扣起該財產
永久充公該有關財產；該經營者須立即將其轉交法院登記處
須立即關閉該客戶的帳戶；該經營者須將結餘退回該客戶
須申報日後發生的所有交易；該經營者須每月主動通知聯合財富情報組
tc.explain: 第7.33段訂明在執法調查期間，該經營者可能獲送達限制令，禁止在調查有結果前處理某些資金或財產；該經營者須確保其能扣起該命令所針對的有關財產。限制令並非永久充公財產（永久充公屬第7.34段所述的充公令）、並不要求關閉該帳戶，也不會產生每月向聯合財富情報組報告的責任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.33段

en.q: Does a restraint order necessarily apply to all funds or property in a business relationship?
options: No -- the order may not cover every asset; the MSO must assess what remains usable under Hong Kong law
Yes -- the whole business relationship is automatically frozen the instant the order is served on the MSO
Yes -- unless the customer successfully applies to the court to have the restraint order varied or lifted entirely
No -- the MSO alone decides, without regard to the order's actual terms, which funds to restrain
en.explain: Paragraph 7.33 states that it should be noted that the restraint order may not apply to all funds or property involved within a particular business relationship, and that the MSO should consider what, if any, funds or property may be utilised subject to the law of Hong Kong. The relationship is not automatically frozen in full, the qualifier is not conditional on a successful court application, and the MSO's assessment is made with regard to the order and Hong Kong law, not at its own unconstrained discretion.

tc.q: 限制令是否必然適用於某業務關係中的所有資金或財產？
options: 否——命令未必涵蓋每項資金或財產；須按香港法律評估可動用部分
是——該命令一經送達該經營者，其整段業務關係即會自動被全面凍結
是——除非該客戶成功向法院申請將該限制令全部更改或撤銷
否——該經營者可不理會命令的實際條款，自行決定限制哪些資金
tc.explain: 第7.33段訂明，應注意該限制令未必適用於某特定業務關係中涉及的所有資金或財產，該經營者應考慮在符合香港法律的前提下，哪些（如有）資金或財產仍可動用。業務關係並非會自動被全面凍結，有關考慮亦非取決於該客戶成功向法院申請，而該經營者的評估須按命令及香港法律進行，並非全憑其自身不受限制的判斷。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.34段

en.q: When may an MSO be served with a confiscation order, and what may a court order in respect of terrorist property?
options: On conviction, where the MSO holds funds deemed the crime benefit; a court may also forfeit terrorist property
Before charges are laid, where the MSO merely suspects the funds are criminal proceeds; a court may order a permanent freeze
Upon the filing of an STR with the JFIU; a court may order the customer's account permanently closed
On the CCE's direction to the MSO; a court may order the funds paid into the general revenue of Hong Kong
en.explain: Paragraph 7.34 states that upon the conviction of a defendant a court may order the confiscation of his criminal proceeds, and an MSO may be served with a confiscation order where it holds funds or other property belonging to that defendant that are deemed by the court to represent his benefit from the crime; a court may also order the forfeiture of property where satisfied that it is terrorist property. Confiscation follows conviction, not mere pre-charge suspicion; it is a court order, not a consequence of filing an STR; and it is the court, not the CCE, that directs it.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者可在何時獲送達充公令？法院就恐怖分子財產可作出甚麼命令？
options: 定罪後，如經營者持有經裁定屬犯罪得益的資金；法院可沒收恐怖分子財產
在落案控告前，只要該經營者懷疑該等資金屬犯罪得益；法院可命令永久凍結
在向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告後；法院可命令永久關閉該客戶帳戶
按關長對該經營者的指示；法院可命令將該等款項撥入香港政府一般收入
tc.explain: 第7.34段訂明被告一經定罪，法院可命令充公其犯罪得益；如該經營者持有屬該被告所有、並經法院裁定代表其犯罪得益的資金或其他財產，可能會獲送達充公令；法院亦可在信納某財產屬恐怖分子財產時，命令沒收該財產。充公須在定罪之後，並非單憑落案控告前的懷疑；充公令屬法院命令，並非提交可疑交易報告的後果；作出命令的是法院，並非關長。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.35段

en.q: What should an MSO do when served with a court document or a crime-related intelligence request relating to a particular customer?
options: Timely assess risks, and whether the customer or relationship needs review for suspicion
Terminate the business relationship with the customer immediately, without inquiry
File an STR automatically, without carrying out any further risk assessment
Wait for the law-enforcement investigation's outcome before taking any step at all
en.explain: Paragraph 7.35 states that when an MSO is served with a court document or crime-related intelligence requests from a law enforcement agency in relation to a particular customer or business relationship, the MSO should timely assess the risks involved and the need to conduct an appropriate review on the customer or the business relationship to determine whether there is any suspicion. It does not call for immediate termination, an automatic STR without assessment, or waiting for the investigation's outcome before acting.

tc.q: 如金錢服務經營者就某特定客戶獲送達法庭文件或與罪案有關的情報要求，應怎樣做？
options: 適時評估風險，客戶或業務關係應否覆核以辨懷疑
毋須進一步查詢，立即終止與該客戶的業務關係
毋須再作任何風險評估，自動提交可疑交易報告
須待執法調查有結果後，方可採取任何步驟
tc.explain: 第7.35段訂明，如該經營者就特定客戶或業務關係獲送達法庭文件，或收到執法機構與罪案有關的情報要求，該經營者應適時評估所涉風險，以及是否需要對該客戶或業務關係進行適當覆核，以斷定是否有任何懷疑。第7.35段並無要求立即終止業務關係、毋須評估即自動提交可疑交易報告，或須待調查有結果後方可採取行動。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.35段

en.q: What should an MSO bear in mind about the customer to whom a court document relates?
options: That the customer can be a victim of crime
That the customer is presumed to be under investigation as a suspect
That the customer must be reported to the JFIU
That the customer's relationship must be closed
en.explain: ¶7.35 states that the MSO should also be aware that the customer to whom the court document relates can be a victim of crime — so service of a court document is a trigger for assessment and review, not an automatic finding of suspicion against the customer.

tc.q: 就法庭文件所涉的客戶，金錢服務經營者應注意甚麼？
options: 該客戶可能是罪行的受害人
應推定該客戶正以嫌疑人身分接受調查
須將該客戶向聯合財富情報組報告
須結束與該客戶的業務關係
tc.explain: 第7.35段訂明該經營者亦應知悉，法庭文件所涉的客戶可能是罪行的受害人——故獲送達法庭文件只是評估及檢視的觸發點，並不等同自動認定對該客戶存有懷疑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第7.19段

en.q: What must accompany the MLRO's disclosure to the JFIU?
options: The information on which the knowledge or suspicion is based
The MSO's full internal risk assessment report for the customer concerned
The customer's written consent to the disclosure being made
A certified copy of the internal report register for the past year
en.explain: Paragraph 7.19 states that if after completing the review of the internal report an MLRO decides there are grounds for knowledge or suspicion, he should disclose the information to the JFIU as soon as it is reasonable to do so after his evaluation is complete, together with the information on which that knowledge or suspicion is based. Nothing in paragraph 7.19 requires a separate risk assessment report, the customer's consent (which would itself be tipping off under paragraph 7.6), or the internal report register.

tc.q: 洗錢報告主任向聯合財富情報組作出的披露，須附有甚麼？
options: 構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的資料
該經營者就有關客戶的完整內部風險評估報告
該客戶對作出該項披露的書面同意
過去一年內部報告登記冊的核證副本
tc.explain: 第7.19段訂明，如洗錢報告主任在完成檢視內部報告後認為有知悉或懷疑的理由，應在其評估完成後在合理範圍內盡快向聯合財富情報組披露該等資料，連同構成該項知悉或懷疑的基礎的資料。第7.19段並無規定須附上另一份風險評估報告、客戶的同意（這本身根據第7.6段即構成通風報訊），或內部報告登記冊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.1段

en.q: How does the Guideline describe the role of record-keeping for investigating authorities?
options: Part of the audit trail, helping profile a suspect and trace criminal or terrorist property
Primarily a means of resolving disputes between the MSO and its customers
Chiefly there to support the MSO's own accounting and tax obligations
Required only for customers in respect of whom an STR has already been filed in the last 5 years
en.explain: Paragraph 8.1 states that record-keeping is an essential part of the audit trail for the detection, investigation and confiscation of criminal or terrorist property or funds, and that it helps investigating authorities establish a financial profile of a suspect and trace the property or funds. It is not primarily a dispute-resolution tool, not chiefly for the MSO's own accounting and tax purposes, and it is required for all customers, not only those for whom an STR has been filed.

tc.q: 本指引如何形容備存紀錄對調查當局的作用？
options: 審計線索一環，助查疑犯狀況及追犯罪或恐怖分子財產
主要用作解決該經營者與客戶之間的爭議
主要為支援該經營者本身的會計及稅務責任
只在已就有關客戶於5年內提交可疑交易報告時方須備存
tc.explain: 第8.1段訂明備存紀錄是偵測、調查及充公犯罪或恐怖分子財產或資金的審計線索的重要一環，有助調查當局為疑犯建立財務狀況，並追查有關財產或資金。備存紀錄並非主要用作解決爭議的工具，亦非主要為支援該經營者本身的會計及稅務目的，且適用於所有客戶，並非只限已就其提交可疑交易報告的客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.1段

en.q: What two further purposes does record-keeping serve under ¶8.1?
options: Helping the Court examine past transactions for proceeds of crime or terrorism, and letting the MSO demonstrate AMLO and Guideline compliance
Supporting the MSO's internal marketing analysis of customer spending patterns, and satisfying its shareholder reporting requirements at each AGM
Enabling the JFIU to give formal consent to operate an account, and enabling the customer to verify their own past transactions
Supporting the MSO's insurance claims process, and strengthening its position in annual audit fee negotiations
en.explain: ¶8.1: record-keeping assists the Court to examine all relevant past transactions to assess whether property or funds are the proceeds of or relate to criminal or terrorist offences, and enables an MSO to demonstrate compliance with the AMLO, the Guideline and other CCE guidance — it does not serve marketing analysis and shareholder reporting, JFIU consent and customer verification, or insurance claims and audit-fee negotiations.

tc.q: 根據第8.1段，備存紀錄另有哪兩項作用？
options: 協助法院審視過往交易以評估是否犯罪得益，並使該經營者能證明其遵從相關法例
支援該經營者對客戶消費模式的內部市場分析，並在各股東周年大會上滿足股東的匯報要求
使聯合財富情報組能正式同意運作某帳戶，並使客戶能核對其本身的過往交易
支援該經營者的保險索償程序，並鞏固其在年度審計費用議價中的地位
tc.explain: 第8.1段：備存紀錄協助法院審視所有相關的過往交易，以評估有關財產或資金是否犯罪或恐怖分子罪行的得益或與之有關，並使該經營者能證明其遵從《打擊洗錢條例》、本指引及關長的其他指引——並非用於市場分析及股東匯報、聯合財富情報組同意及客戶核對交易，或保險索償及審計費用議價。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.2段

en.q: To what should the records an MSO maintains be appropriate?
options: Appropriate to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses
The volume of STRs that the MSO has filed with the JFIU over the preceding twelve months
The number of branches and agent locations the MSO currently operates across Hong Kong
The record-keeping requirements set by its correspondent banks and overseas settlement partners
en.explain: ¶8.2: an MSO should maintain CDD information, transaction records and other records that are necessary and sufficient to meet statutory and regulatory requirements, appropriate to the nature, size and complexity of its businesses — not calibrated to its recent STR volume, its branch count, or requirements set by correspondent banks.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者所保存的紀錄應與甚麼相稱？
options: 其業務的性質、規模及複雜程度，以符合法定及監管規定
該經營者在過去十二個月內向聯合財富情報組提交的可疑交易報告數量
該經營者目前在香港各區合共經營的分行及代理點總數目
其代理銀行及海外結算夥伴各自訂立的一切備存紀錄規定
tc.explain: 第8.2段：經營者應保存所需及充分的客戶盡職審查資料、交易紀錄及其他紀錄，以符合法定及監管規定，並與其業務的性質、規模及複雜程度相稱——並非按近期可疑交易報告數量、分行數目，或代理銀行所訂規定而定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.2段

en.q: Which three matters must an MSO ensure under ¶8.2?
options: A clear and complete audit trail; swift record access for the CCE and auditors; and demonstrable compliance with the Guideline
That records are stored at an offsite facility; that they are fully encrypted; and that they are destroyed automatically after five years
That records are kept in English only; that they are certified by a notary; and that they are independently audited every year
That records are shared with correspondent banks; that they are fully indexed; and that they are reconciled every month
en.explain: ¶8.2 requires an MSO to ensure (a) a clear and complete audit trail for funds moving through it, (b) swift availability of CDD information and transaction records to the CCE, other authorities and auditors, and (c) demonstrable compliance with the Guideline and other CCE guidelines — not offsite storage and automatic five-year destruction, English-only notarised annual audits, or correspondent-bank sharing and monthly reconciliation.

tc.q: 根據第8.2段，金錢服務經營者須確保哪三方面？
options: 審計線索清晰完整；關長及審計師能迅速取得紀錄；以及證明遵從本指引
紀錄須存放於獲批准的異地設施；須經全面加密處理；以及五年後須自動銷毀
紀錄只須以英文備存；須經公證人認證；以及每年獨立審計
紀錄須與代理銀行共享；須完整編制索引；以及每月核對
tc.explain: 第8.2段規定經營者須確保：(a)審計線索清晰完整；(b)關長、其他當局及審計師能迅速取得客戶盡職審查資料及交易紀錄；及(c)能證明遵從本指引及關長發出的其他指引——並非異地存放及五年後自動銷毀、只用英文並經公證人認證的年度審計，或與代理銀行共享及每月核對。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(a)段

en.q: Whose identification documents and data must an MSO keep under ¶8.3(a)?
options: The customer and, where applicable, the beneficial owner, beneficiary, and others connected to or acting for the customer
The customer only, since ¶8.3(a) does not extend the record-keeping duty to any other connected party
The customer and the beneficial owner only, since beneficiaries and persons acting on the customer's behalf fall outside ¶8.3(a)
The customer and any person who happens to attend the MSO's premises at the time of the transaction
en.explain: ¶8.3(a): an MSO should keep identification documents, data and information obtained in identifying and, where applicable, verifying the customer and/or beneficial owner and/or beneficiary and/or persons purporting to act on the customer's behalf and/or other connected parties — the duty is not limited to the customer alone, to the customer and beneficial owner alone, or to any bystander on the premises.

tc.q: 根據第8.3(a)款，金錢服務經營者須保存何人的身分證明文件及數據？
options: 客戶，以及（如適用）其實益擁有人、受益人，以及有關連或代其行事的其他人
只限客戶，因為第8.3(a)款並無將備存紀錄的責任延伸至任何其他有關連者
只限客戶及實益擁有人，因為受益人及代客戶行事的人不屬第8.3(a)款範圍
客戶，以及在交易發生時碰巧到訪該經營者處所的任何人
tc.explain: 第8.3(a)款：經營者須備存在識別及（如適用）核實客戶及／或客戶的實益擁有人及／或受益人及／或聲稱代客戶行事的人及／或與客戶有關連的其他各方時所取得的身分文件、數據及資料——有關責任並不僅限於客戶本人、客戶及實益擁有人，或碰巧在場的任何人。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(b)段

en.q: Which other documents and records must be kept under ¶8.3(b)?
options: Other documents and records obtained throughout the CDD and ongoing monitoring process, including SDD and EDD
Only documents obtained at the very outset, when the business relationship was first established
Only documents relating to enhanced due diligence measures applied to the MSO's high-risk customers
Only documents relating to transactions that exceed the applicable CDD threshold amount
en.explain: ¶8.3(b): an MSO must keep other documents and records obtained throughout the CDD and ongoing monitoring process, including SDD and EDD — not only documents from account opening, only EDD material for high-risk customers, or only records tied to above-threshold transactions.

tc.q: 根據第8.3(b)款，須保存哪些其他文件及紀錄？
options: 在整個客戶盡職審查及持續監察過程中取得的其他文件及紀錄，包括簡化及加強盡職審查
只限在業務關係剛建立、辦理開戶及首次核實身分手續當時所取得的相關文件
只限與適用於高風險客戶的加強盡職審查措施有關的文件，不包括簡化盡職審查的文件
只限與金額超過適用客戶盡職審查門檻的個別交易直接有關的文件及單據紀錄
tc.explain: 第8.3(b)款：經營者須保存在整個客戶盡職審查及持續監察過程中取得的其他文件及紀錄，包括簡化盡職審查及加強盡職審查——並非只限開戶時的文件、只限適用於高風險客戶的加強盡職審查文件，或只限與超過門檻交易有關的文件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(d)段

en.q: What business correspondence must, at a minimum, be kept?
options: Correspondence material to CDD measures or account changes
The original documents used to verify the customer's and beneficial owner's identity
The results of analysing transactions with no apparent economic or lawful purpose
Every single email or phone note exchanged with the customer, however trivial
en.explain: ¶8.3(d) requires business correspondence with the customer and any beneficial owner that is, at a minimum, material to CDD measures or significant changes to the operation of the account. Identity documents belong to ¶8.3(a) and analysis results to ¶8.3(e), and footnote 66 confirms an MSO need not keep every item of correspondence.

tc.q: 最低限度須保存哪些業務往來通訊？
options: 對客戶盡職審查措施或帳戶變動屬重要的業務通訊
為核實客戶及實益擁有人身分而取得的文件正本
對並無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易所作分析的結果
與客戶往來的每一封電郵或電話紀錄，不論如何瑣碎
tc.explain: 第8.3(d)款規定須保存與客戶及任何實益擁有人的業務通訊，最低限度須包括對客戶盡職審查措施或帳戶運作重大變動而言屬重要者。身分文件屬第8.3(a)款範圍，分析結果屬第8.3(e)款範圍，而註腳66確認並不要求保存每一項通訊。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3段註腳66

en.q: Is an MSO expected to keep every item of correspondence with a customer?
options: No — only sufficient correspondence to show AMLO compliance is required
Yes — every communication must be retained for at least five years, with no exceptions
Yes — but only correspondence relating to virtual asset transfers above $8,000
No — correspondence need not be kept unless the CCE requests it by written notice
en.explain: Footnote 66 to ¶8.3(d) states that an MSO need not keep each and every correspondence, such as a series of emails; sufficient correspondence to demonstrate compliance with the AMLO is enough. The five-year period in ¶8.4 and the $8,000 threshold apply to record retention generally, not as a trigger for keeping 'every' communication, and ¶8.8 concerns the CCE extending retention, not waiving it.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者是否須保存與客戶往來的每一項通訊？
options: 否——只須保存足以證明遵從《打擊洗錢條例》的通訊
是——每項通訊均須保留最少五年，不得有任何例外
是——但只限涉及超過8,000元的虛擬資產轉移的通訊
否——除非海關關長以書面通知索取，否則毋須保存通訊
tc.explain: 第8.3(d)款註腳66訂明並不要求該經營者保存每一項通訊（例如與客戶往來的一連串電郵），只須保存足以證明遵從《打擊洗錢條例》的通訊。第8.4段的五年期限及8,000元門檻適用於一般紀錄保存，並非用作「每項」通訊的保存觸發點；第8.8段則涉及海關關長延長保存期，而非豁免保存。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.3(e)段

en.q: What example does ¶8.3(e) give of 'the results of any analysis undertaken'?
options: Inquiries into the purpose of a complex or unusually large transaction
The MSO's periodic institutional risk assessment of its customer base
The results of the MSO's independent audit of its AML/CFT systems
Correspondence material to CDD measures or significant changes to account operation
en.explain: ¶8.3(e) gives the example of inquiries to establish the background and purpose of transactions that are complex, unusually large, or of unusual pattern, with no apparent economic or lawful purpose. Risk assessments, systems audits and business correspondence are all real MSO obligations but fall under different provisions, not ¶8.3(e).

tc.q: 第8.3(e)款就「所進行任何分析的結果」舉出甚麼例子？
options: 為何複雜或款額異常龐大的交易並無明顯經濟目的的查詢
該經營者就其客戶基礎的定期機構風險評估
該經營者對其打擊洗錢系統的獨立審計結果
對客戶盡職審查措施或帳戶運作重大變動屬重要的業務通訊
tc.explain: 第8.3(e)款舉例指出，須就屬複雜、款額異常龐大或模式不尋常且並無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易，保存為確立其背景及目的而作的查詢的結果。風險評估、系統審計及業務通訊均為該經營者的真實責任，惟屬其他條文範圍，並非第8.3(e)款所指。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.4段

en.q: Which occasional transaction thresholds trigger the ¶8.4 five-year retention duty?
options: $8,000 for wire/virtual asset transfers; $120,000 for other transaction types
$120,000 for wire/virtual asset transfers; $8,000 for other transaction types
$8,000 for every type of occasional transaction, with no higher threshold at all
$120,000 for every type of occasional transaction, with no lower threshold at all
en.explain: ¶8.4 sets the CDD threshold for occasional transactions at $8,000 for wire transfers and virtual asset transfers involving virtual assets, and $120,000 for other types of transactions — the two figures are not interchangeable and there is no single uniform threshold.

tc.q: 哪些單一宗交易門檻會觸發第8.4段的五年保存責任？
options: 電傳轉帳及虛擬資產轉移為8,000元，其他為120,000元
電傳轉帳及虛擬資產轉移改為120,000元，其他則為8,000元
所有類型的非經常交易一律為8,000元，並無較高門檻
所有類型的非經常交易一律為120,000元，並無較低門檻
tc.explain: 第8.4段訂明非經常交易的客戶盡職審查門檻為：電傳轉帳及涉及虛擬資產的虛擬資產轉移為8,000元，其他類型交易為120,000元；兩個數額不可互換，亦無劃一的單一門檻。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.4段

en.q: For how long must the ¶8.3 documents be kept in the case of a business relationship?
options: Throughout the relationship and for at least five years after it ends
For five years from the date each individual document was first obtained
For five years starting from the date the business relationship began
Only until the next periodic review of the customer's risk profile is completed
en.explain: ¶8.4 requires ¶8.3 documents to be kept throughout the business relationship and for at least five years after it ends — the clock runs from the end of the relationship, not from when each document was obtained, when the relationship began, or the next periodic review.

tc.q: 就業務關係而言，第8.3段所述文件須保存多久？
options: 在該業務關係持續期間，並在其終止後最少五年
自該經營者首次取得每份文件之日起計五年
自該業務關係開始之日（而非終止之日）起計五年
只須保存至下次完成該客戶風險狀況的定期覆核為止
tc.explain: 第8.4段規定第8.3段所述文件須在業務關係持續期間保存，並在其終止後保存最少五年——保存期是自業務關係終止之日起計，而非自取得文件之日、業務關係開始之日或下次定期覆核起計。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.5段

en.q: To what standard must transaction records be kept under ¶8.5?
options: Sufficient to reconstruct individual transactions as evidence for prosecution
Sufficient to allow the customer to reconcile and dispute entries in their own account
Sufficient to satisfy the MSO's external auditors during the annual statutory audit
Sufficient to support the preparation of the MSO's internal management accounts
en.explain: ¶8.5 requires transaction records sufficient to permit reconstruction of individual transactions so as to provide, if necessary, evidence for prosecution of criminal activity — not merely to satisfy customers, auditors, or internal management reporting.

tc.q: 根據第8.5段，交易紀錄須達到何種標準？
options: 足以重組個別交易，以便為檢控罪行提供證據
足以讓客戶核對其本身帳戶，並就分錄提出爭議
足以在法定年度審計中令外聘審計師滿意
足以支援編製該經營者的內部管理帳目
tc.explain: 第8.5段規定交易紀錄須足以重組個別交易，以便在有需要時就刑事罪行的檢控提供證據——而非僅為讓客戶核對帳戶、令審計師滿意或支援內部管理帳目。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.6段

en.q: For how long must transaction records be kept, and does the end of the business relationship shorten that period?
options: Five years after the transaction, whether or not the relationship ends first
At least five years after the relationship ends, whenever that occurs
At least three years after the completion of the transaction, no matter what
Until the CCE issues written confirmation that the records may be destroyed
en.explain: ¶8.6 requires transaction records to be kept for at least five years after completion of the transaction, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period — the clock is tied to the transaction, not to the separate end-of-relationship trigger in ¶8.4, is not shortened to three years, and does not depend on CCE confirmation.

tc.q: 交易紀錄須保存多久？業務關係終止會否縮短該期限？
options: 交易完成後最少五年，不論業務關係是否先行終止
業務關係終止後最少五年，不論何時終止
交易完成後最少三年，不論任何情況
直至海關關長發出書面確認，方可銷毀該等紀錄
tc.explain: 第8.6段規定交易紀錄須在交易完成後保存最少五年，不論業務關係是否在該期間終止——保存期以交易為準，並非如第8.4段般以業務關係終止為觸發點，亦不會縮短至三年，或取決於海關關長的確認。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.7段

en.q: In what form may records be retained under section 21 of Schedule 2?
options: A document: original or a microfilm/computer copy. Data: microfilm or computer database
Only the original hard copy is acceptable; microfilm and computer copies are not permitted
Only electronic form is acceptable; original paper documents may not be retained at all
Only a form that has received the CCE's prior written approval under a licence condition
en.explain: ¶8.7 provides two routes: if the record is a document, the original may be kept, or a copy may be kept on microfilm or in a computer database; if the record is data or information, it must be kept on microfilm or in a computer database. There is no rule limiting retention to hard copy only, electronic form only, or CCE pre-approval.

tc.q: 根據附表2第21條，紀錄可以何種形式保存？
options: 文件正本或縮微膠卷／電腦複本均可；數據也須如此保存
只可保存文件正本，不可以縮微膠卷或電腦複本方式保存
只可以電子形式保存，不可保留任何正本文件
只可以事先獲海關關長書面批准的牌照條件形式保存
tc.explain: 第8.7段訂明兩種方式：如紀錄屬文件，可保存正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存副本；如紀錄屬數據或資料，則須以縮微膠卷或電腦資料庫保存。並無規定僅限保存正本、僅限電子形式，或須經海關關長事先批准。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.8段

en.q: On what grounds may the CCE require records to be kept for longer than five years, and in what form must the requirement be made?
options: Relevant to a CCE investigation or another stated purpose; only by written notice
Where the customer is a politically exposed person; given orally during an inspection
Where the MSO has filed a suspicious transaction report; published in the Gazette
Where the records relate to a cross-border transaction; imposed as a licence condition
en.explain: ¶8.8 lets the CCE require longer retention, by notice in writing only, where the records are relevant to an ongoing criminal or other CCE investigation, or any other purpose specified in that notice. Being a PEP, having filed an STR, or a cross-border transaction are not the stated grounds, and the requirement is never made orally, by Gazette notice, or as a licence condition.

tc.q: 海關關長可基於甚麼理由要求保存紀錄超過五年？該要求須以何種形式作出？
options: 與海關關長的調查或指明目的有關；只可書面通知作出
如客戶是政治人物；於巡查期間以口頭方式作出
如該經營者已提交可疑交易報告；以憲報刊登方式作出
如該等紀錄與跨境交易有關；以牌照條件方式施加
tc.explain: 第8.8段容許海關關長只以書面通知方式，要求延長保存期，理由為有關紀錄與海關關長正進行的刑事或其他調查有關，或與該通知所指明的其他目的有關。客戶是政治人物、該經營者已提交可疑交易報告，或涉及跨境交易，均非訂明理由；而有關要求亦絕不會以口頭、憲報刊登或牌照條件方式作出。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.9段

en.q: Does the location where CDD and transaction records are held affect the MSO's obligations?
options: No — an MSO must still comply with all Hong Kong requirements regardless of location
Yes — records held overseas are instead governed by the law of the place where held
Yes — records held by an overseas group company are exempt from Hong Kong's requirements
Yes — records held in electronic form are subject to lighter record-keeping requirements
en.explain: ¶8.9 states that irrespective of where CDD and transaction records are held, an MSO must comply with all legal and regulatory requirements in Hong Kong, especially Part 3 of Schedule 2 — there is no exception for overseas storage, group companies, or electronic records.

tc.q: 客戶盡職審查及交易紀錄的存放地點，會否影響該經營者的責任？
options: 不會——不論存放於何處，仍須遵從香港所有規定
會——存放於海外的紀錄改為受存放地當地法律規管
會——由海外集團公司保存的紀錄可獲豁免香港的規定
會——以電子形式存放的紀錄受較寬鬆的規定規管
tc.explain: 第8.9段訂明不論客戶盡職審查及交易紀錄存放於何處，該經營者均須遵從香港所有法律及監管規定，尤其是附表2第3部——並無就海外存放、集團公司或電子紀錄設有例外。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.10段

en.q: Where identification and verification documents are held by an intermediary relied on for CDD, who remains responsible for record-keeping compliance?
options: The MSO remains responsible for compliance with all record-keeping requirements
The intermediary alone, once it has given the MSO written confirmation of compliance
The MSO and the intermediary share responsibility for compliance equally
Neither party, until the CCE formally requests the records in writing
en.explain: ¶8.10 states that where an intermediary holds identification and verification documents, the MSO relying on that intermediary for CDD remains responsible for compliance with all record-keeping requirements — responsibility is not transferred by the intermediary's confirmation, shared equally, or suspended until the CCE asks.

tc.q: 如身分識別及核實文件由該經營者所倚賴進行客戶盡職審查的中介人保存，何人仍須就備存紀錄的合規承擔責任？
options: 該金錢服務經營者仍須就遵從所有備存紀錄規定承擔責任
只限該中介人，一旦其已向該經營者作出正式書面合規確認
該經營者與該中介人平均分擔合規責任
雙方均無責任，直至海關關長以書面正式索取該等紀錄
tc.explain: 第8.10段訂明如中介人持有身分識別及核實文件，倚賴該中介人進行客戶盡職審查的經營者仍須就遵從所有備存紀錄規定承擔責任——責任並不會因中介人的確認而轉移、由雙方平均分擔，或在海關關長索取前處於暫停狀態。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.10段

en.q: What must an MSO ensure about an intermediary's record-keeping systems and responsiveness?
options: Systems meeting AMLO/Guideline requirements, and prompt records once practicable
That the intermediary keeps records for at least three years after each transaction
That the intermediary stores all records physically within Hong Kong only
That the intermediary provides records within three business days, without exception
en.explain: ¶8.10 requires the MSO to ensure the intermediary has systems to comply with all record-keeping requirements under the AMLO and the Guideline (¶8.3 to ¶8.9), and provides documents as soon as reasonably practicable after the MSO's request — there is no fixed three-year period, Hong Kong-only storage rule, or three-business-day deadline in the text.

tc.q: 就中介人的備存紀錄系統及回應速度，金錢服務經營者須確保甚麼？
options: 中介人設有系統符合所有備存紀錄規定，並盡快提供紀錄
中介人須就每宗交易保存紀錄最少三年
中介人須只在香港境內以實體方式存放所有紀錄
中介人須一律於3個營業日內提供紀錄，一概不得有任何例外
tc.explain: 第8.10段規定該經營者須確保中介人設有系統，以遵從《打擊洗錢條例》及本指引下所有備存紀錄規定（第8.3至8.9段），並在收到該經營者要求後在合理切實可行範圍內盡快提供文件及紀錄——文本並無訂明固定三年期、只限香港存放，或3個營業日的期限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.12段

en.q: What must an MSO ensure happens to documents and records upon termination of an intermediary's services?
options: That the intermediary will pass the documents and records to the MSO
That the intermediary will destroy the documents and records
That the intermediary will transfer them to the successor
That the intermediary will lodge them with the CCE
en.explain: ¶8.12 states that an MSO should ensure that an intermediary will pass the documents and records to the MSO upon termination of the services provided by the intermediary. This complements the ¶4.11.5 undertaking to supply copies where the intermediary is about to cease trading.

tc.q: 中介人所提供服務終止時，金錢服務經營者須確保文件及紀錄如何處理？
options: 該中介人會將文件及紀錄交予該經營者
該中介人會銷毀該等文件及紀錄
該中介人會將其轉交繼任的中介人
該中介人會將其送交海關關長存檔
tc.explain: 第8.12段訂明該經營者應確保在中介人所提供的服務終止時，該中介人會將文件及紀錄交予該經營者。此與第4.11.5段就中介人即將停業時提供副本的承諾互相補足。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.11段

en.q: What must an MSO relying on an intermediary for a CDD measure obtain immediately?
options: Data or information the intermediary obtained during that measure
Certified copies of every underlying document the intermediary relied upon
A written report summarising the CDD measures the intermediary performed
A copy of the intermediary's own internal AML/CFT policies and procedures
en.explain: ¶8.11 requires an MSO relying on an intermediary for a CDD measure to immediately obtain the data or information the intermediary obtained while carrying out that measure — not certified copies of documents, a summary report, or the intermediary's internal policies, none of which the paragraph mentions.

tc.q: 倚賴中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施的金錢服務經營者，須即時取得甚麼？
options: 該中介人在進行該措施過程中所取得的數據或資料
該中介人所倚賴的每份相關文件的經核證副本
概述中介人所進行整套客戶盡職審查措施的書面報告
該中介人本身內部打擊洗錢政策及程序的副本
tc.explain: 第8.11段規定倚賴中介人進行客戶盡職審查措施的經營者，須即時取得該中介人在進行該措施過程中所取得的數據或資料——並非經核證文件副本、書面報告或中介人的內部政策，該等內容並未見於本段。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.1段

en.q: Why does the Guideline treat ongoing staff training as important?
options: A well-designed control system can fail if the staff using it are not trained
Because training is a licensing condition imposed by the CCE on every MSO
Because it forms part of the audit trail for investigating criminal property
Because the FATF sets a minimum number of annual training hours for MSO staff
en.explain: ¶9.1 states that ongoing staff training matters because the effective implementation of even a well-designed internal control system can be compromised if staff using it are not adequately trained. The audit-trail rationale belongs to ¶8.1 (record-keeping), not training, and neither a CCE licensing condition nor an FATF hours minimum appears in the Guideline.

tc.q: 本指引為何視持續員工培訓為重要？
options: 設計完善的監控制度，使用者未受訓仍可能失效
因培訓是海關關長對所有經營者施加的牌照條件
因這是調查罪犯財產所需審計線索的一部分
因財務行動特別組織訂明最低年度培訓時數
tc.explain: 第9.1段訂明持續員工培訓的重要之處，在於即使設計完善的內部監控制度，若使用該制度的員工未獲充分培訓，其有效實施仍可能受損。審計線索的理據屬第8.1段（備存紀錄）範圍，並非培訓；本指引亦未訂明海關關長的牌照條件或財務行動特別組織的最低培訓時數。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.2段

en.q: How should the scope and frequency of training be determined?
options: Tailored to the MSO's risks and pitched to staff duties and experience
Set uniformly for all staff at a fixed number of hours per year, regardless of role
Left entirely to the external training provider engaged by the MSO to decide
Set by the CCE in a schedule applicable to each class of licensee
en.explain: ¶9.2 states that the scope and frequency of training should be tailored to the specific risks faced by the MSO and pitched according to the job functions, responsibilities and experience of the staff — it is not a uniform fixed-hours rule, left to an external provider, or set by the CCE.

tc.q: 培訓的範圍及頻次應如何釐定？
options: 按該經營者的風險而定，並按員工職責及經驗調整
對所有員工一律劃一訂定固定的每年培訓時數，不論職級
完全交由該經營者聘用的外部培訓機構決定
由海關關長按每類持牌人訂定的時間表規定
tc.explain: 第9.2段訂明培訓的範圍及頻次應按該經營者面對的特定風險量身設計，並按員工的工作職能、職責及經驗調整深淺——並非劃一的固定時數規則、交由外部機構決定，或由海關關長訂定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.2段

en.q: When should new staff attend initial training, and what should follow?
options: As soon as possible after hire; then regular refresher training on ML/TF
Within the first year of employment; no refresher training is required after that
Before the end of the probationary period; with further training only upon promotion
Only once assigned to a customer-facing role; followed by annual testing instead
en.explain: ¶9.2 requires new staff to attend initial training as soon as possible after being hired or appointed, followed by regular refresher training so staff remain aware of their responsibilities and informed of ML/TF developments — not training tied to the first year, probation, promotion, or a customer-facing role, and not replaced by annual testing.

tc.q: 新入職員工應在何時接受初次培訓？其後應有甚麼安排？
options: 受僱後盡快接受；其後定期提供複修培訓以掌握最新發展
於受僱首年內接受；其後無須再接受複修培訓
於試用期結束前接受；其後只在獲晉升時才再培訓
只在獲派前線職位後才接受初訓；其後改以每年測驗代替培訓
tc.explain: 第9.2段規定新員工須在受僱或獲委任後盡快接受初次培訓，其後定期提供複修培訓，以確保員工獲提醒職責並掌握洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的最新發展——並非繫於首年、試用期、晉升或前線職位，亦不會以每年測驗取代複修培訓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.4(a)及(b)段

en.q: Whose obligations must staff be made aware of in relation to CDD, record-keeping and reporting?
options: Both the MSO's and their own personal obligations, and the consequences of failure
The MSO's obligations only, because individual staff carry no personal statutory liability
Their own personal obligations only, not those of the MSO as a whole
The MLRO's obligations only, since other staff need not know their own duties
en.explain: ¶9.4(a) and (b) require staff to be made aware of both their MSO's and their own personal statutory obligations, and the possible consequences of failure to comply — staff are not exempt from personal liability, the MSO's own obligations are not excluded, and awareness is not confined to the MLRO.

tc.q: 就客戶盡職審查、備存紀錄及報告，員工須獲知悉何人的責任？
options: 該經營者及員工本身的責任，以及未有遵從的後果
只需該經營者的責任，因個別員工並無個人法定責任
只需員工本身的個人責任，不包括該經營者整體的責任
只需洗錢報告主任的責任，因其他員工無須知悉本身職責
tc.explain: 第9.4(a)及(b)款規定員工須獲知悉該經營者及員工本身的法定責任，以及未有遵從的可能後果——員工並非豁免個人責任，亦不排除該經營者本身的責任，知悉範圍亦不僅限於洗錢報告主任。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.4(c)段

en.q: Which ordinances are named in ¶9.4(c) as the source of other statutory and regulatory obligations staff must be aware of?
options: The DTROP, the OSCO, the UNATMO, the UNSO, the WMD(CPS)O and the AMLO
The AMLO, the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance and the Companies Ordinance
The Banking Ordinance, the Securities and Futures Ordinance and the Insurance Ordinance
The Companies Ordinance, the Trustee Ordinance and the Money Lenders Ordinance
en.explain: ¶9.4(c) names the DTROP, the OSCO, the UNATMO, the UNSO, the WMD(CPS)O and the AMLO as the source of other statutory and regulatory obligations staff must know. The AMLO also appears in ¶9.4(a), but the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance, the Banking Ordinance, the Securities and Futures Ordinance, the Insurance Ordinance, the Companies Ordinance, the Trustee Ordinance and the Money Lenders Ordinance are all real Hong Kong ordinances that ¶9.4(c) does not name.

tc.q: 第9.4(c)款列明員工須知悉的其他法定及監管責任，源自哪些條例？
options: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《聯合國制裁條例》、《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》及《打擊洗錢條例》
《打擊洗錢條例》、《個人資料（私隱）條例》、《公司條例》、《受託人條例》、《放債人條例》及《釋義及通則條例》
《銀行業條例》、《證券及期貨條例》、《保險業條例》、《放債人條例》、《公司條例》及《受託人條例》
《公司條例》、《受託人條例》、《放債人條例》、《釋義及通則條例》、《銀行業條例》及《保險業條例》
tc.explain: 第9.4(c)款列明的條例為《販毒（追討得益）條例》、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》、《聯合國制裁條例》、《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》及《打擊洗錢條例》。《打擊洗錢條例》同時見於第9.4(a)款，但《個人資料（私隱）條例》、《銀行業條例》、《證券及期貨條例》、《保險業條例》、《公司條例》、《受託人條例》、《放債人條例》及《釋義及通則條例》均為香港真實條例，第9.4(c)款並無列明。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.4(e)段

en.q: To what extent must staff be made aware of new and emerging ML/TF techniques, methods and trends?
options: To the extent needed for staff to carry out their particular AML/CFT role
To the fullest extent possible, applied equally to every member of staff regardless of role
Only where the staff member holds the position of MLRO within the MSO
Only in years where the MSO has filed at least one suspicious transaction report
en.explain: ¶9.4(e) limits awareness of new and emerging ML/TF techniques, methods and trends to the extent needed by staff to carry out their particular role in the MSO with respect to AML/CFT — it is not a uniform full-extent rule, confined to the MLRO, or conditional on having filed an STR.

tc.q: 員工須在何種程度上知悉新興的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集技巧、方法及趨勢？
options: 以員工履行其打擊洗錢方面特定崗位所需的程度為限
須盡可能全面知悉，不論資歷高低或職級一律相同看待
只限該員工在該經營者內出任洗錢報告主任一職
只限該經營者於該年度曾提交最少一份可疑交易報告
tc.explain: 第9.4(e)款規定員工須知悉洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集新興技巧、方法及趨勢的程度，以其履行在該經營者內打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集方面特定崗位所需者為限——並非劃一的全面知悉規則、僅限洗錢報告主任，或取決於曾否提交可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(a)段

en.q: Which training is appropriate for all new staff, irrespective of seniority?
options: ML/TF background and its importance; reporting duty to the MLRO; the tipping-off offence
Training on customer verification and how to recognise abnormal settlements or payments
Specific training on assessing internal reports and reporting suspicious transactions to the JFIU
Higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime
en.explain: ¶9.5(a) sets out what is appropriate for all new staff irrespective of seniority: an introduction to ML/TF and its importance to the MSO, the need to report suspicious transactions to the MLRO, and the tipping-off offence. Customer-verification training belongs to back-office staff under ¶9.5(c), JFIU-reporting training to MLROs under ¶9.5(e), and higher-level regime training to managerial staff under ¶9.5(d) — each real, but for a different group.

tc.q: 就所有新入職員工（不論職級），哪些培訓屬適當？
options: 洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集背景及其重要性；向洗錢報告主任舉報的需要；通風報信的罪行
有關客戶身分核實，以及如何辨識異常交收或付款的培訓
有關評估內部報告內容，以及向聯合財富情報組舉報可疑交易的專門培訓
涵蓋該經營者打擊洗錢制度各方面的較高層次培訓
tc.explain: 第9.5(a)款訂明適用於所有新員工（不論職級）的培訓，包括：洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的背景及該經營者對此的重視、向洗錢報告主任舉報可疑交易的需要，以及通風報信的罪行。客戶身分核實培訓屬第9.5(c)款後勤員工的範圍，向聯合財富情報組舉報的專門培訓屬第9.5(e)款洗錢報告主任的範圍，較高層次的制度培訓則屬第9.5(d)款管理層員工的範圍——三者均屬實情，惟針對不同員工組別。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(b)(i)段

en.q: How does the Guideline describe the role of front-line personnel in an MSO's ML/TF strategy?
options: As the first point of contact with potential money launderers
As the last line of defence after transaction monitoring
As the persons responsible for filing STRs with the JFIU
As the persons responsible for approving high risk accounts
en.explain: ¶9.5(b)(i) states that members of staff dealing directly with the public — for example front-line personnel — should be trained on the importance of their roles in the MSO's ML/TF strategy, as the first point of contact with potential money launderers.

tc.q: 本指引如何形容前線員工在該經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集策略中的角色？
options: 作為與潛在洗錢者接觸的第一個接觸點
作為交易監察之後的最後防線
作為負責提交可疑交易報告的人
作為負責批准高風險業務關係的人
tc.explain: 第9.5(b)(i)款訂明直接與公眾接觸的員工（例如前線人員）應獲培訓，了解其在該經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集策略中角色的重要性，因其為與潛在洗錢者接觸的第一個接觸點。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(b)(iii)段

en.q: Which two matters, besides circumstances that may give rise to suspicion, should front-line staff training cover?
options: Lines of reporting, and when extra vigilance may be needed in dealing with customers
The MSO's pricing policy, and its customer complaint-handling procedures
The JFIU's consent regime, and the statutory defence
The CCE's inspection powers, and the appeal process against licence decisions
en.explain: ¶9.5(b)(iii) states that front-line staff training should cover circumstances that may give rise to suspicion and relevant policies and procedures, including for example lines of reporting and when extra vigilance might be required — not pricing or complaints policy, the JFIU consent regime, or the CCE's inspection and appeal process, none of which ¶9.5(b) mentions.

tc.q: 除可能引致懷疑的情況外，前線員工培訓還應涵蓋哪兩方面？
options: 報告層級，以及在與客戶接觸時何時需要格外警覺
該經營者的定價政策，以及其客戶投訴處理程序
聯合財富情報組的同意制度，以及法定免責辯護
海關關長的巡查權力，以及牌照決定的上訴程序
tc.explain: 第9.5(b)(iii)款訂明前線員工培訓應涵蓋可能引致懷疑的情況，以及相關政策及程序，例如報告層級，以及何時可能需要格外警覺——並非定價或投訴政策、聯合財富情報組的同意制度，或海關關長的巡查及上訴程序，第9.5(b)款並無提及這些內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(c)段

en.q: What should back-office staff be trained to recognise, depending on their roles?
options: Unusual activities such as abnormal settlements or payments, and verification steps
The importance of their role as the first point of contact with potential money launderers
The background of ML/TF and the need to report suspicious transactions to the MLRO
Higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime and system audits
en.explain: ¶9.5(c) requires back-office staff to receive appropriate training on customer verification and relevant processing procedures, and on how to recognise unusual activities including abnormal settlements, payments or delivery instructions. Being the first point of contact is front-line training under ¶9.5(b), the ML/TF background introduction is new-staff training under ¶9.5(a), and higher-level regime training belongs to managerial staff under ¶9.5(d) — each real, but for a different group.

tc.q: 後勤員工按其崗位應獲培訓辨識甚麼？
options: 不尋常活動，例如異常的交收或付款，以及核實步驟
作為與潛在洗錢人接觸的第一點的重要性
洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集背景及其重要性，以及向洗錢報告主任舉報可疑交易的需要
涵蓋制度各方面及系統審計職責的較高層次培訓
tc.explain: 第9.5(c)款規定後勤員工應接受客戶身分核實及相關處理程序的適當培訓，並學習如何辨識不尋常活動，包括異常的交收、付款或交付指示。作為第一接觸點的重要性屬第9.5(b)款前線員工培訓，洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集背景簡介屬第9.5(a)款新員工培訓，較高層次的制度培訓則屬第9.5(d)款管理層培訓——三者均屬實情，惟針對不同員工組別。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(d)段

en.q: Which staff should receive higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime?
options: Managerial staff, including internal audit officers and compliance officers
Front-line personnel only, since they are the first point of contact with customers
All new staff, irrespective of seniority, as part of their initial induction
Back-office staff only, given their role in processing transactions
en.explain: ¶9.5(d) states that managerial staff, including internal audit officers and COs, should receive higher level training covering all aspects of the MSO's AML/CFT regime. Front-line personnel, all new staff, and back-office staff are real groups under ¶9.5(a)-(c), but each receives different, more targeted training, not this higher-level regime training.

tc.q: 哪些員工應接受涵蓋該經營者打擊洗錢制度各方面的較高層次培訓？
options: 管理層員工，包括內部審計人員及合規主任
只限前線人員，因其為與客戶接觸的第一點
所有新入職員工，不論職級，作為入職培訓的一部分
只限後勤員工，因其在處理交易方面的角色
tc.explain: 第9.5(d)款訂明管理層員工（包括內部審計人員及合規主任）應接受涵蓋該經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度各方面的較高層次培訓。前線人員、所有新員工及後勤員工均為第9.5(a)至(c)款下的真實組別，惟各自接受的是不同且更具針對性的培訓，並非此較高層次的制度培訓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.5(e)段

en.q: Which two kinds of training are identified as appropriate for MLROs?
options: Assessing STRs and reporting to the JFIU; and keeping abreast of AML/CFT developments
Training on customer service standards; and training on day-to-day foreign exchange operations
Training on drafting the MSO's business plan; and training on statutory financial reporting
Training on branch network management; and training on staff recruitment and selection
en.explain: ¶9.5(e) identifies two areas appropriate for MLROs: specific training on assessing suspicious transaction reports submitted to them and reporting to the JFIU, and training to keep abreast of AML/CFT requirements and developments generally — not customer service, business-plan drafting, financial reporting, branch management, or recruitment training, none of which ¶9.5(e) mentions.

tc.q: 本指引指出洗錢報告主任適合接受哪兩類培訓？
options: 評估可疑交易報告並舉報聯合財富情報組；及掌握最新規定
客戶服務標準培訓；以及日常外匯業務操作培訓
編製該經營者業務計劃及預算的培訓；以及法定財務報告編製培訓
分行網絡管理培訓；以及員工招聘甄選及入職培訓
tc.explain: 第9.5(e)款訂明洗錢報告主任適合接受兩類培訓：就評估提交予其的可疑交易報告及向聯合財富情報組報告的職責的專門培訓，以及使其掌握打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集規定及發展的培訓——並非客戶服務、業務計劃編製、財務報告、分行管理或招聘培訓，第9.5(e)款並無提及這些內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.6段

en.q: Which training techniques and tools does the Guideline suggest an MSO may use?
options: On-line learning, classroom training, videos, and paper- or intranet-based manuals
Mandatory external audits only, conducted annually by an independent accounting firm
External seminars only, delivered exclusively by CCE-accredited training providers
One-to-one coaching from the MLRO only, with no classroom or online sessions permitted
en.explain: ¶9.6 lists on-line learning systems, focused classroom training, relevant videos, and paper- or intranet-based procedures manuals as techniques an MSO may mix and match. Mandatory external audits, CCE-accredited seminars, and MLRO one-to-one coaching are not among the techniques and tools ¶9.6 identifies.

tc.q: 本指引建議金錢服務經營者可採用哪些培訓方式及工具？
options: 網上學習、課堂培訓、影片，以及紙本或內聯網程序手冊
只限強制性外部審計，每年由獨立會計師事務所進行
只限外部研討會，並須全部由海關關長認可的機構提供
只限由洗錢報告主任進行一對一指導，不設課堂或網上課程
tc.explain: 第9.6段列明網上學習系統、專題課堂培訓、相關影片，以及紙本或內聯網的程序手冊，作為該經營者可混合採用的培訓方式及工具。強制性外部審計、海關關長認可的研討會，以及洗錢報告主任一對一指導，均非第9.6段所列的培訓方式及工具。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.6段

en.q: What must an MSO be able to demonstrate to the CCE about its training materials?
options: That all materials are up-to-date and meet current requirements and standards
That all materials were prepared exclusively by an external compliance consultant
That all materials are available in both English and Chinese versions
That all materials have received the CCE's prior written approval
en.explain: ¶9.6 requires the MSO to be able to demonstrate to the CCE that all training materials are up-to-date and in line with current requirements and standards — not that they were prepared by an external consultant, exist in both languages, or were pre-approved by the CCE, none of which ¶9.6 requires.

tc.q: 就其培訓教材，金錢服務經營者須能向海關關長證明甚麼？
options: 所有教材均為最新，並符合現行規定及標準
所有教材均只由外聘合規顧問編製，經關長核實
所有教材均備有中英文版本
所有教材均須事先取得海關關長的正式書面批准
tc.explain: 第9.6段規定該經營者須能向海關關長證明所有教材均為最新，並符合現行規定及標準——並非規定教材須由外聘顧問編製、備有中英文版本，或事先取得海關關長批准，第9.6段並無此等規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.7段

en.q: What training records must an MSO maintain, and for how long?
options: Who, when and what type of training was given, kept for a minimum of 3 years
Attendance records only, without the type of training given; kept for 5 years
Test results only, without who attended; kept for a minimum of 3 years
The trainer's professional qualifications only; kept for a minimum of 7 years
en.explain: ¶9.7 requires an MSO to monitor and maintain records of who has been trained, when staff received training, and the type of training provided, kept for a minimum of 3 years — not attendance alone kept for 5 years, test results alone, or trainer qualifications kept for 7 years.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者須保存哪些培訓紀錄？須保存多久？
options: 受訓者、受訓時間及類型的紀錄，保存最少3年
只限出席紀錄，不包括培訓類型；須保存最少5年
只限測驗成績，不包括出席者身分；須保存最少3年
只限培訓導師的專業資歷；須保存最少7年
tc.explain: 第9.7段規定該經營者須監察並保存曾接受培訓者、員工接受培訓的時間，以及所提供培訓類型的紀錄，最少保存3年——並非只保存出席紀錄並保存5年、只保存測驗成績，或只保存培訓導師資歷並保存7年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.8(a)段

en.q: Which three things may be tested to monitor the effectiveness of training?
options: Understanding of AML/CFT policy and obligations, and spotting suspicious transactions
Staff's product knowledge, sales performance, and customer satisfaction scores
Staff's attendance record, punctuality, and overall length of service
Staff's language proficiency, computer literacy, and numeracy skills
en.explain: ¶9.8(a) lists testing staff's understanding of the MSO's policies and procedures to combat ML/TF, their understanding of statutory and regulatory obligations, and their ability to recognise suspicious transactions — not product knowledge and sales metrics, attendance and tenure, or language and numeracy skills, none of which ¶9.8(a) mentions.

tc.q: 可測試哪三方面以監察培訓成效？
options: 對打擊洗錢政策及法定責任的理解，以及識別可疑交易能力
員工的產品知識水平、銷售表現，以及客戶滿意度的評分
員工的出席紀錄、準時程度，以及整體服務年資長短
員工的語文能力、電腦知識，以及基本計算能力水平
tc.explain: 第9.8(a)款列明測試員工對該經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集政策及程序的理解、對其法定及監管責任的理解，以及其識別可疑交易的能力——並非產品知識及銷售指標、出席及年資，或語文及計算能力，第9.8(a)款並無提及這些內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.8(b)段

en.q: What does monitoring the quality and quantity of internal reports help an MSO to do?
options: Identify further training needs so that action can be taken
Calculate the MLRO's expected workload for annual staffing decisions
Benchmark its reporting volumes against other MSOs in the sector
Demonstrate to the JFIU that it is filing reports frequently enough
en.explain: ¶9.8(b) states that monitoring staff compliance with the MSO's AML/CFT Systems, and the quality and quantity of internal reports, helps identify further training needs so appropriate action can be taken — not to calculate MLRO staffing, benchmark against other MSOs, or demonstrate adequate reporting frequency to the JFIU.

tc.q: 監察內部報告的質與量有助金錢服務經營者做甚麼？
options: 識別進一步的培訓需要，以便採取適當行動
計算洗錢報告主任的預計工作量，以作人手安排
與業內其他金錢服務經營者比較其報告數量
向聯合財富情報組證明其報告頻密程度足夠
tc.explain: 第9.8(b)款訂明監察員工遵從該經營者打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集系統的情況，以及內部報告的質與量，有助識別進一步的培訓需要，以便採取適當行動——並非用以計算洗錢報告主任的人手安排、與其他經營者比較，或向聯合財富情報組證明報告頻密程度足夠。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.8(c)段

en.q: What third method of monitoring training effectiveness does ¶9.8 identify?
options: Monitoring attendance and following up with staff who miss training without cause
Requiring every staff member to sign an annual declaration of competence, sent to the CCE
Sending staff to sit external professional certification examinations
Rotating staff periodically between front-line and back-office roles
en.explain: ¶9.8(c) identifies monitoring attendance and following up with staff who miss training without reasonable cause as the third way to monitor training effectiveness — not a signed annual declaration, external certification exams, or role rotation, none of which ¶9.8(c) mentions.

tc.q: 第9.8段指出監察培訓成效的第三種方法為何？
options: 監察出席，跟進無故缺席培訓的員工
要求每名員工每年簽署一份書面能力聲明
安排員工參加外部專業資格認證考試
定期安排員工在前線與後勤崗位之間輪替
tc.explain: 第9.8(c)款訂明監察出席情況，並跟進無合理原因缺席該等培訓的員工，為監察培訓成效的第三種方法——並非簽署年度能力聲明、外部專業認證考試，或崗位輪替，第9.8(c)款並無提及這些內容。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第9.3段

en.q: What does ¶9.3 require an MSO to implement in relation to training?
options: A clear, well-articulated policy for adequate staff AML/CFT training
A minimum annual training budget set as a fixed percentage of turnover
A contractual training commitment written into every employment contract
A dedicated training committee chaired by a main board director
en.explain: ¶9.3 requires an MSO to implement a clear and well-articulated policy for ensuring that relevant staff receive adequate AML/CFT training; the content of that training is then set out in ¶9.4 and ¶9.5. A turnover-linked budget, a contractual clause, or a director-chaired committee are not what ¶9.3 requires.

tc.q: 第9.3段規定金錢服務經營者就培訓須實施甚麼？
options: 清晰明確的政策，確保員工接受充分的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓
以該經營者上一年度營業額的固定百分比訂定最低年度培訓預算
在每名新聘及在職員工的書面僱傭合約中均訂明具法律約束力的培訓承諾
由董事局其中一名執行董事出任主席的常設專責培訓委員會
tc.explain: 第9.3段規定該經營者須實施清晰而表述明確的政策，以確保相關員工接受充分的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集培訓；該等培訓的內容則載於第9.4及9.5段。以營業額計算的預算、合約條款，或由董事出任主席的委員會，均非第9.3段所規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第8.5段與第8.6段的比較

en.q: An MSO completes a transaction for a customer in year 1 and the business relationship ends in year 2. Until when must the transaction records be kept?
options: At least five years after the transaction, regardless of when the relationship ends
At least five years after the end of the business relationship, because that is later
Only until the end of the business relationship in year 2, with nothing more required
Five years after the transaction or the end of the relationship, whichever is earlier
en.explain: ¶8.6 requires transaction records to be kept for at least five years after completion of the transaction, regardless of whether the business relationship ends during that period — here, at least five years from year 1, unaffected by the year-2 end of the relationship. The separate ¶8.4 rule (five years after the end of the relationship) applies only to the CDD records in ¶8.3, not to transaction records, and there is no 'whichever is earlier' rule anywhere in the Guideline.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者於第一年為客戶完成一宗交易，該業務關係於第二年終止。交易紀錄須保存至何時？
options: 交易完成後最少五年，不論該業務關係何時終止
業務關係終止後最少五年，因該日期在任何情況下均較遲
只須保存至第二年業務關係終止時，其後無須再保存
交易後五年或業務關係終止兩者中，以較早者為準
tc.explain: 第8.6段規定交易紀錄須在交易完成後保存最少五年，不論業務關係是否在該期間內終止——本例即自第一年起計最少五年，不受第二年業務關係終止影響。第8.4段（業務關係終止後五年）的另一規則只適用於第8.3段的客戶盡職審查紀錄，並不適用於交易紀錄；本指引亦無「以較早者為準」的規則。
